265		WorktreeObservation TopologyObservation
266		RuntimeObservation  TopologyObservation
267	}
268	
269	// TaskOnly reports whether the row exists solely to retain an unbound task.
270	func (r RepoContextRow) TaskOnly() bool { return r.Kind == RepoContextRowTask }
271	
272	// RepoContext is the complete operational context for one discovered repo.
273	type RepoContext struct {
274		Repo repo.Repo
275		// RepositoryID is the canonical Git common directory and is stable across
276		// aliases and every linked checkout on this host.
277		RepositoryID string
278		IdentityErr  error
279		// Checkouts contains every authoritative gitx.Worktrees record in Git order.
280		// It remains the compatibility projection used by current CLI/TUI callers.
281		Checkouts []RepoCheckout
282		// Rows is the authoritative exact-once checkout plus task-only projection.
283		Rows []RepoContextRow
284		// OtherTasks are tracked tasks which were not bound to a checkout. It remains
285		// the compatibility projection of OtherTaskBindings.
286		OtherTasks        []*task.Task
287		OtherTaskBindings []TaskBinding
288		Runtime           string
289		// WorktreeCount remains the linked-worktree count expected by existing
290		// callers. On query failure it falls back to the administrative directory
291		// count so the error can explain a previously displayed count.
292		WorktreeCount       int
293		WorktreeErr         error
294		WorktreeObservation TopologyObservation
295		RuntimeObservation  TopologyObservation
296		LastActivity        time.Time
297	}
298	
299	// Main returns Git's actual primary record. The first-row fallback preserves
300	// compatibility with manually constructed contexts which predate Worktree.Main.
301	func (c RepoContext) Main() (RepoCheckout, bool) {
302		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
303			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
304				return checkout, true
305			}
306		}
307		if len(c.Checkouts) == 0 {
308			return RepoCheckout{}, false
309		}
310		return c.Checkouts[0], true
311	}
312	
313	// Linked returns every Git-registered non-main worktree.
314	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
315		hasMarkedMain := false
316		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
317			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
318				hasMarkedMain = true
319				break
320			}
321		}
322		if !hasMarkedMain {
323			if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
324				return nil
325			}
326			return c.Checkouts[1:]
327		}
328		out := make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(c.Checkouts)-1)
329		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
330			if !checkout.Worktree.Main {
331				out = append(out, checkout)
332			}
333		}
334		return out
335	}
336	
337	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
338	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
339	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
340		seen := map[string]bool{}
341		var out []runtime.Session
342		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
343			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
344				key := session.Handle
345				if key == "" {
346					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
347				}
348				if seen[key] {
349					continue
350				}
351				seen[key] = true
352				out = append(out, session)
353			}
354		}
355		return out
356	}
357	
358	// RepoContextOptions extends repository collection without changing the
359	// original CollectRepoContext API used by CLI and dashboard callers.
360	type RepoContextOptions struct {
361		Runtime         string
362		Sessions        []runtime.Session
363		RuntimeObserved bool
364		RuntimeErr      error
365		// Limiter shares one process-heavy enrichment bound across collectors.
366		Limiter *Limiter
367	}
368	
369	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository. The
370	// legacy entry point can prove observation only when sessions are present;
371	// callers that need a proven empty observation or typed failure use
372	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions.
373	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
374		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
375		return CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, r, tasks, RepoContextOptions{
376			Runtime: runtimeName, Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: len(sessions) > 0,
377		})
378	}
379	
380	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions builds repository topology from Git's complete
381	// registered worktree list. It never synthesizes a main checkout after a Git
382	// query failure.
383	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
384		opts RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
385		if ctx == nil {
386			ctx = context.Background()
387		}
388		out := RepoContext{
389			Repo: r, Runtime: opts.Runtime,
390			WorktreeObservation: TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved},
391			RuntimeObservation:  runtimeObservation(opts),
392		}
393		queryPath := repoQueryPath(r)
394		out.RepositoryID, out.IdentityErr = canonicalRepositoryID(ctx, r, queryPath)
395		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
396	
397		var (
398			worktrees []gitx.Worktree
399			err       error
400		)
401		if queryPath == "" {
402			err = fmt.Errorf("repository has no Git query path")
403		} else {
404			worktrees, err = gitx.Worktrees(ctx, queryPath)
405		}
406		if err != nil {
407			listErr := &WorktreeListError{Path: queryPath, Err: err}
408			out.WorktreeErr = listErr
409			out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: listErr}
410			assignTasksWithoutTopology(&out, tasks)
411			finishRepoContext(&out)
412			return out
413		}
414		out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
415		out.WorktreeCount = 0
416		out.Checkouts = make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(worktrees))
417		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
418			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
419			if canonicalPath == "" {
420				canonicalPath = filepath.Clean(worktree.Path)
421			}
422			checkout := RepoCheckout{
423				ID: canonicalPath, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
424				IdentityErr: canonicalErr,
425				Worktree:    worktree, Exists: pathIsDir(worktree.Path),
426				RuntimeObservation: out.RuntimeObservation,
427				Ownership:          CheckoutExternal,
428			}
429			if canonicalErr != nil {
430				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
431					Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: canonicalErr.Error(),
432				})
433			}
434			if worktree.Main {
435				checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
436					Kind: OwnershipEvidenceGitMain, Path: canonicalPath,
437				})
438			} else {
439				out.WorktreeCount++
440			}
441			out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
442		}
443	
444		enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx, out.Checkouts, opts.Limiter)
445		assignHarnessEvidence(&out)
446		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
447		if out.RuntimeObservation.Available() {
448			assignSessions(&out, opts.Sessions)
449		}
450		finishRepoContext(&out)
451		return out
452	}
453	
454	func runtimeObservation(opts RepoContextOptions) TopologyObservation {
455		if opts.RuntimeErr != nil {
456			err := &RuntimeListError{Runtime: opts.Runtime, Err: opts.RuntimeErr}
457			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: err}
458		}
459		if opts.RuntimeObserved {
460			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
461		}
462		return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved}
463	}
464	
465	func repoQueryPath(r repo.Repo) string {
466		for _, candidate := range []string{r.Path, r.RealPath, r.MainRoot, r.CommonDir} {
467			if candidate != "" {
468				return candidate
469			}
470		}
471		return ""
472	}
473	
474	func canonicalRepositoryID(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, queryPath string) (string, error) {
475		commonDir := r.CommonDir
476		if commonDir == "" && r.Bare {
477			commonDir = queryPath
478		}
479		if commonDir == "" && queryPath != "" {
480			if discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, queryPath); err == nil {
481				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
482			}
483		}
484		if commonDir == "" {
485			err := fmt.Errorf("Git common directory is empty")
486			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
487		}
488		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
489		if err != nil {
490			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
491		}
492		return canonical, nil
493	}
494	
495	func enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx context.Context, checkouts []RepoCheckout, limiter *Limiter) {
496		if limiter == nil {
497			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
498		}
499		var wg sync.WaitGroup
500		for i := range checkouts {
501			if checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare || checkouts[i].Worktree.Prunable || !checkouts[i].Exists {
502				continue
503			}
504			wg.Add(1)
505			go func(index int) {
506				defer wg.Done()
507				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
508				if !ok {
509					checkouts[index].StatusErr = ctx.Err()
510					return
511				}
512				defer release()
513				checkout := &checkouts[index]
514				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
515				checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(
516					ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status,
517				)
518			}(i)
519		}
520		wg.Wait()
521	}
522	
523	func assignHarnessEvidence(out *RepoContext) {
524		mainRoot := ""
525		for i := range out.Checkouts {
526			if out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Main && !out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare {
527				mainRoot = out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path
528				break
529			}
530		}
531		if mainRoot == "" {
532			return
533		}
534		for i := range out.Checkouts {
535			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
536			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
537				continue
538			}
539			evidence, ok := DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(mainRoot, checkout.Worktree.Path)
540			if !ok {
541				continue
542			}
543			checkout.HarnessEvidence = &evidence
544			checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
545				Kind: OwnershipEvidenceClaudeHarness, Path: evidence.Root,
546			})
547		}
548	}
549	
550	// IsEphemeralWorktree is the legacy broad display heuristic. Its branch-prefix
551	// compatibility is retained for existing adopters, but authoritative topology
552	// uses DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree: a worktree-* branch alone is not ownership
553	// evidence.
554	func IsEphemeralWorktree(path, branch string) bool {
555		slashPath := filepath.ToSlash(path)
556		return strings.Contains(slashPath, "/.claude/worktrees/") ||
557			strings.HasPrefix(branch, "worktree-")
558	}
559	
560	func linkedAdminCount(commonDir string) int {
561		if commonDir == "" {
562			return 0
563		}
564		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(commonDir, "worktrees"))
565		if err != nil {
566			return 0
567		}
568		n := 0
569		for _, entry := range entries {
570			if entry.IsDir() {
571				n++
572			}
573		}
574		return n
575	}
576	
577	func pathIsDir(path string) bool {
578		info, err := os.Stat(path)
579		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
580	}
581	
582	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
583		latest := status.LatestChange
584		var commit time.Time
585		var subject string
586		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
587			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
588			if commit.After(latest) {
589				latest = commit
590			}
591			subject = lastSubject
592		}
593		return latest, commit, subject
594	}
595	
596	func assignTasksWithoutTopology(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
597		for _, tracked := range sortedUniqueTasks(tasks) {
598			binding := TaskBinding{
599				Task: tracked, Kind: TaskBindingUnbound,
600				ConflictReasons: []TopologyReason{{
601					Code:   ReasonWorktreeInventoryUnavailable,
602					Detail: "registered worktrees could not be observed",
603				}},
604			}
605			out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, tracked)
606			out.OtherTaskBindings = append(out.OtherTaskBindings, binding)
607		}
608	}
609	
610	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
611		paths := map[string][]int{}
612		branches := map[string][]int{}
613		mainIndex := -1
614		for i := range out.Checkouts {
615			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
616			if checkout.ID != "" {
617				paths[checkout.ID] = append(paths[checkout.ID], i)
618			}
619			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" && !checkout.Worktree.Bare {
620				branches[branch] = append(branches[branch], i)
621			}
622			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
623				mainIndex = i
624			}
625		}
626	
627		for _, tracked := range sortedUniqueTasks(tasks) {
628			binding := TaskBinding{Task: tracked, Kind: TaskBindingUnbound}
629			mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
630			var recordedPathIssue *TopologyReason
631			if tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
632				canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(tracked.WorktreePath)
633				if err != nil {
634					reason := TopologyReason{Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: err.Error()}
635					recordedPathIssue = &reason
636				} else if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
637					if matches := paths[canonical]; len(matches) > 0 {
638						if len(matches) == 1 {
639							binding.Kind = TaskBindingExactPath
640							bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
641							continue
642						}
643						reason := TopologyReason{
644							Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
645							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s path matches %d registered checkout records", tracked.ID, len(matches)),
646						}
647						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
648						for _, index := range matches {
649							out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
650						}
651						appendOtherTask(out, binding)
652						continue
653					}
654				}
655				if mode != task.ModeWorktree {
656					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
657						Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
658						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
659							mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
660					})
661				}
662			}
663	
664			if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
665				matches := branches[tracked.Branch]
666				switch len(matches) {
667				case 1:
668					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMovedPath
669					binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, movedPathReason(tracked, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
670					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
671						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
672					}
673					bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
674					continue
675				case 0:
676					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
677						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
678					}
679					if tracked.WorktreePath != "" || taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
680						binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
681							Code:   ReasonWorktreePathMissing,
682							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no registered checkout for branch %s", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch),
683						})
684					}
685				default:
686					reason := TopologyReason{
687						Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
688						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s branch %s matches %d registered checkouts", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, len(matches)),
689					}
690					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
691					for _, index := range matches {
692						out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
693					}
694				}
695				appendOtherTask(out, binding)
696				continue
697			}
698	
699			if mainIndex >= 0 {
700				main := out.Checkouts[mainIndex]
701				if checkoutActionable(main) && main.Branch() == tracked.Branch {
702					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMainBranch
703					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
704						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
705					}
706					bindTask(out, mainIndex, annotateBoundTask(binding, main))
707					continue
708				}
709			}
710	
711			if recordedPathIssue != nil {
712				binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
713			}
714			for _, index := range branches[tracked.Branch] {
715				if index == mainIndex {
716					continue
717				}
718				reason := TopologyReason{
719					Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
720					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s branch is checked out outside Git main at %s",
721						mode, tracked.ID, out.Checkouts[index].Worktree.Path),
722				}
723				binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
724				out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
725			}
726			if taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
727				detail := fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s in Git main", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch)
728				switch {
729				case mainIndex < 0:
730					detail += ", but no Git main record exists"
731				case !checkoutActionable(out.Checkouts[mainIndex]):
732					detail += ", but Git main is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable"
733				default:
734					detail += fmt.Sprintf(", which is on %s", displayBranch(out.Checkouts[mainIndex]))
735				}
736				binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
737					Code: ReasonMainBranchMismatch, Detail: detail,
738				})
739			}
740			appendOtherTask(out, binding)
741		}
742	
743		finalizeCheckoutClaims(out)
744	}
745	
746	func sortedUniqueTasks(tasks []*task.Task) []*task.Task {
747		ordered := append([]*task.Task(nil), tasks...)
748		sort.SliceStable(ordered, func(i, j int) bool {
749			if ordered[i] == nil {
750				return false
751			}
752			if ordered[j] == nil {
753				return true
754			}
755			return ordered[i].ID < ordered[j].ID
756		})
757		seen := map[string]bool{}
758		out := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(ordered))
759		for _, tracked := range ordered {
760			if tracked == nil {
761				continue
762			}
763			if tracked.ID != "" && seen[tracked.ID] {
764				continue
765			}
766			if tracked.ID != "" {
767				seen[tracked.ID] = true
768			}
769			out = append(out, tracked)
770		}
771		return out
772	}
773	
774	func movedPathReason(tracked *task.Task, checkout RepoCheckout) TopologyReason {
775		if tracked.WorktreePath == "" {
776			return TopologyReason{
777				Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
778				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no recorded worktree path; branch %s is registered at %s",
779					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
780			}
781		}
782		return TopologyReason{
783			Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
784			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s records %s; branch %s is registered at %s",
785				tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
786		}
787	}
788	
789	func annotateBoundTask(binding TaskBinding, checkout RepoCheckout) TaskBinding {
790		tracked := binding.Task
791		if tracked == nil {
792			return binding
793		}
794		if !checkoutActionable(checkout) {
795			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
796				Code: ReasonCheckoutUnavailable,
797				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout %s is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable",
798					checkout.Worktree.Path),
799			})
800		}
801		if checkout.Branch() != tracked.Branch {
802			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
803				Code: ReasonBranchMismatch,
804				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s; registered checkout is on %s",
805					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, displayBranch(checkout)),
806			})
807		}
808		mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
809		switch {
810		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && checkout.Worktree.Main:
811			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
812				Code:   ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
813				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("worktree task %s resolved to Git main", tracked.ID),
814			})
815		case mode != task.ModeWorktree && !checkout.Worktree.Main:
816			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
817				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
818				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s resolved to linked worktree %s",
819					mode, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
820			})
821		}
822		if mode != task.ModeWorktree && tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
823			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
824				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
825				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
826					mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
827			})
828		}
829		if !taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
830			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
831				Code: ReasonUnexpectedCheckout,
832				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s still has registered checkout %s",
833					tracked.State, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
834			})
835		}
836		return binding
837	}
838	
839	func taskExpectsCheckout(tracked *task.Task) bool {
840		if tracked == nil || tracked.State == task.Cold {
841			return false
842		}
843		if tracked.State == task.Done && tracked.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
844			return tracked.WorktreePath != ""
845		}
846		return true
847	}
848	
849	func checkoutActionable(checkout RepoCheckout) bool {
850		return !checkout.Worktree.Bare && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable && checkout.Exists && checkout.StatusErr == nil
851	}
852	
853	func bindTask(out *RepoContext, index int, binding TaskBinding) {
854		checkout := &out.Checkouts[index]
855		binding.CheckoutID = checkout.ID
856		checkout.TaskBindings = append(checkout.TaskBindings, binding)
857		checkout.Tasks = append(checkout.Tasks, binding.Task)
858		if binding.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
859			checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
860				Kind: OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask, Path: checkout.ID,
861				TaskID: binding.Task.ID, Owner: binding.Task.Owner,
862			})
863		}
864	}
865	
866	func appendOtherTask(out *RepoContext, binding TaskBinding) {
867		out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, binding.Task)
868		out.OtherTaskBindings = append(out.OtherTaskBindings, binding)
869	}
870	
871	func finalizeCheckoutClaims(out *RepoContext) {
872		for i := range out.Checkouts {
873			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
874			sort.SliceStable(checkout.TaskBindings, func(a, b int) bool {
875				return checkout.TaskBindings[a].Task.ID < checkout.TaskBindings[b].Task.ID
876			})
877			sort.SliceStable(checkout.Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
878				return checkout.Tasks[a].ID < checkout.Tasks[b].ID
879			})
880			if len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 1 {
881				ids := make([]string, len(checkout.TaskBindings))
882				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
883					ids[j] = checkout.TaskBindings[j].Task.ID
884				}
885				reason := TopologyReason{
886					Code:   ReasonMultipleTaskClaims,
887					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout is claimed by tasks %s", strings.Join(ids, ", ")),
888				}
889				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
890				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
891					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
892						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
893					)
894				}
895			}
896			if checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil && len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 0 {
897				reason := TopologyReason{
898					Code: ReasonHarnessTaskConflict,
899					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("checkout has Claude harness evidence and %d managed task claim(s)",
900						len(checkout.TaskBindings)),
901				}
902				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
903				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
904					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
905						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
906					)
907				}
908			}
909			for _, binding := range checkout.TaskBindings {
910				for _, reason := range binding.DriftReasons {
911					checkout.DriftReasons = appendReason(checkout.DriftReasons, reason)
912				}
913				for _, reason := range binding.ConflictReasons {
914					checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
915				}
916			}
917			checkout.Ownership = displayOwnership(*checkout)
918		}
919	}

921	func displayOwnership(checkout RepoCheckout) CheckoutOwnership {

936	func appendReason(reasons []TopologyReason, candidate TopologyReason) []TopologyReason {

945	func finishRepoContext(out *RepoContext) {

977				Kind: RepoContextRowTask, CheckoutIndex: -1,

987	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
988	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
989	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
990	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
991		for _, session := range sessions {
992			assigned := map[int]bool{}
993			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
994				best, bestLen := -1, -1
995				for i := range out.Checkouts {
996					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Checkouts[i]) {
997						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(normalizePath(root)) > bestLen {
998							best, bestLen = i, len(normalizePath(root))
999						}
1000					}
1001				}
1002				if best >= 0 {
1003					assigned[best] = true
1004				}
1005			}
1006			for i := range assigned {
1007				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
1008			}
1009		}
1010	}
1011	
1012	func checkoutRoots(checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
1013		return []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
1014	}
1015	
1016	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
1017		if root == "" || path == "" {
1018			return false
1019		}
1020		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
1021		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
1022			return false
1023		}
1024		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
1025	}
1026	
1027	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
1028	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
1029	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
1030	// is not sufficient.
1031	func normalizePath(path string) string {
1032		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
1033			return canonical
1034		}
1035		return filepath.Clean(path)
1036	}

1038	// FormatRepoContext renders the deterministic Markdown used by both the CLI
1039	// and the TUI's yy binding. checkoutIndex < 0 means the whole repository.
1040	func FormatRepoContext(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
1041		var b strings.Builder
1042		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
1043			checkout := c.Checkouts[checkoutIndex]
1044			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev worktree context: %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout))
1045			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, false)
1046			return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
1047		}
1048	
1049		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev repo context: %s\n\n", c.Repo.Display())
1050		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Repository: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Display())
1051		mainPath := c.Repo.Path
1052		if main, ok := c.Main(); ok {
1053			mainPath = main.Worktree.Path
1054		}
1055		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Main path: `%s`\n", mainPath)
1056		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Linked worktrees: %d\n", c.WorktreeCount)
1057		if c.Runtime != "" && c.Runtime != "none" {
1058			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime: `%s`\n", c.Runtime)
1059		}
1060		if c.WorktreeErr != nil {
1061			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Worktree inventory error: %s\n", c.WorktreeErr)
1062		}
1063		b.WriteString("\n## Checkouts\n")
1064		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
1065			b.WriteString("\n")
1066			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, checkout.Worktree.Main)
1067		}
1068		if len(c.OtherTasks) > 0 {
1069			b.WriteString("\n## Other tracked tasks\n\n")
1070			if len(c.OtherTaskBindings) > 0 {
1071				for _, binding := range c.OtherTaskBindings {
1072					writeTaskMarkdown(&b, binding.Task)
1073					writeTopologyReasons(&b, binding.DriftReasons, binding.ConflictReasons)
1074				}
1075			} else {
1076				for _, tracked := range c.OtherTasks {
1077					writeTaskMarkdown(&b, tracked)
1078				}
1079			}
1080		}
1081		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
1082	}
1083	
1084	func writeCheckoutMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, c RepoContext, checkout RepoCheckout, canonical bool) {
1085		label := string(checkout.Ownership)
1086		if canonical {
1087			label = "canonical"
1088		}
1089		fmt.Fprintf(b, "### %s — %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout), label)
1090		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Path: `%s`\n", checkout.Worktree.Path)
1091		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Branch: `%s`\n", displayBranch(checkout))
1092		if checkout.Worktree.Bare {
1093			b.WriteString("- Git: bare repository\n")
1094		} else if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
1095			b.WriteString("- Git: unavailable (checkout path is missing)\n")
1096		} else if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
1097			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.StatusErr)
1098		} else {
1099			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: %s", checkout.Status.Summary())
1100			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
1101				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", checkout.Status.Breakdown())
1102			}
1103			b.WriteString("\n")
1104			if checkout.Status.Upstream != "" {
1105				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Upstream: `%s`\n", checkout.Status.Upstream)
1106			} else {
1107				b.WriteString("- Upstream: not published\n")
1108			}
1109		}
1110		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
1111			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)
1112			if reason == "" {
1113				reason = "no reason recorded"
1114			}
1115			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: locked — %s\n", reason)
1116		}
1117		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
1118			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)
1119			if reason == "" {
1120				reason = "checkout path is missing"
1121			}
1122			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: prunable — %s\n", reason)
1123		}
1124		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
1125			b.WriteString("- Runtime: closed\n")
1126		} else {
1127			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
1128				status := session.AgentStatus
1129				if status == "" {
1130					status = "unknown"
1131				}
1132				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: `%s %s` (%s)\n", c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
1133				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
1134					fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Agent sessions: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
1135				}
1136			}
1137		}
1138		if len(checkout.Tasks) == 0 {
1139			b.WriteString("- Task: untracked\n")
1140		} else {
1141			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
1142				writeTaskMarkdown(b, tracked)
1143			}
1144		}
1145		writeTopologyReasons(b, checkout.DriftReasons, checkout.ConflictReasons)
1146	}
1147	
1148	func writeTopologyReasons(b *strings.Builder, drift, conflicts []TopologyReason) {
1149		for _, reason := range drift {
1150			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Drift: `%s` — %s\n", reason.Code, reason.Detail)
1151		}
1152		for _, reason := range conflicts {
1153			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Conflict: `%s` — %s\n", reason.Code, reason.Detail)
1154		}
1155	}
1156	
1157	func writeTaskMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, tracked *task.Task) {
1158		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: `%s` — %s", tracked.ID, tracked.State)
1159		if tracked.Next != "" {
1160			fmt.Fprintf(b, "; next: %s", tracked.Next)
1161		}
1162		b.WriteString("\n")
1163		if tracked.AgentSession != "" {
1164			fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Recorded agent: `%s`\n", tracked.AgentSession)
1165		}
1166	}
1167	
1168	func displayBranch(checkout RepoCheckout) string {
1169		if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
1170			return branch
1171		}
1172		if checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached {
1173			return "(detached HEAD)"
1174		}
1175		return "(unknown branch)"
1176	}
1177	
1178	func markdownCodes(values []string) string {
1179		quoted := make([]string, 0, len(values))
1180		for _, value := range values {
1181			quoted = append(quoted, "`"+value+"`")
1182		}
1183		return strings.Join(quoted, ", ")
1184	}
1185	
1186	// FormatSessions renders the ys payload. checkoutIndex < 0 selects the whole
1187	// repository; otherwise it selects one checkout.
1188	func FormatSessions(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
1189		indices := make([]int, 0, len(c.Checkouts))
1190		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
1191			indices = append(indices, checkoutIndex)
1192		} else {
1193			for i := range c.Checkouts {
1194				indices = append(indices, i)
1195			}
1196		}
1197		var b strings.Builder
1198		for _, i := range indices {
1199			checkout := c.Checkouts[i]
1200			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
1201				status := session.AgentStatus
1202				if status == "" {
1203					status = "unknown"
1204				}
1205				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s %s` (%s)\n",
1206					checkout.Worktree.Path, c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
1207				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
1208					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - agents: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
1209				}
1210			}
1211		}
1212		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
1213	}
1214	
1215	// LinkedWorktreePaths returns the yw payload: absolute linked-worktree paths,
1216	// one per line. The canonical checkout is intentionally excluded because WT
1217	// counts linked worktrees only.
1218	func LinkedWorktreePaths(c RepoContext) string {
1219		paths := make([]string, 0, len(c.Linked()))
1220		for _, checkout := range c.Linked() {
1221			paths = append(paths, checkout.Worktree.Path)
1222		}
1223		return strings.Join(paths, "\n")
1224	}

244	func normalizeRequest(request Request) (Request, error) {
245		if !request.Action.Valid() {
246			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown action %q", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action)
247		}
248		options, err := cloneActionOptions(request.Options, request.Action)
249		if err != nil {
250			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
251		}
252		if options.Action() != request.Action {
253			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action %s cannot use %s options", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, options.Action())
254		}
255		if err := validateActionOptions(options); err != nil {
256			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, err)
257		}
258		request.Options = options
259		if isTransitionAction(request.Action) {
260			if _, err := RequireTransition(request.Locator.Mode, request.Locator.State, request.Action); err != nil {
261				return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
262			}
263		}
264		return request, nil
265	}

427	func (s *lifecycleService) handler(action Action) Handler {
428		return Handler{
429			Plan: func(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
430				return s.planSpec(ctx, request)
431			},
432			Apply: func(ctx context.Context, plan Plan) (Result, error) {
433				return s.applyGuarded(ctx, action, plan)
434			},
435		}
436	}
437	
438	func (s *lifecycleService) now() time.Time { return s.clock().UTC() }
439	
440	func (s *lifecycleService) runtimeFor(candidate task.Task) (runtime.Runtime, error) {
441		var rt runtime.Runtime
442		if candidate.RuntimeHandle != "" && candidate.RuntimeName != "" {
443			rt = s.namedRuntime(candidate.RuntimeName)
444			if rt == nil {
445				return nil, fmt.Errorf("recorded runtime backend %q is unavailable", candidate.RuntimeName)
446			}
447			if rt.Name() != candidate.RuntimeName {
448				return nil, fmt.Errorf("recorded runtime backend %q resolved to %q", candidate.RuntimeName, rt.Name())
449			}
450		} else {
451			rt = s.defaultRuntime()
452		}
453		if rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "" {
454			return nil, errors.New("taskflow runtime resolver returned no backend")
455		}
456		return rt, nil
457	}
458	
459	func openRuntimeSurface(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, path, label string) (runtime.OpenResult, error) {
460		if rt == nil {
461			return runtime.OpenResult{}, errors.New("open runtime: no backend")
462		}
463		if worktreeRuntime, ok := rt.(runtime.WorktreeOpener); ok {
464			return worktreeRuntime.OpenWorktree(ctx, path, label)
465		}
466		return rt.Open(ctx, path, label)
467	}
468	
469	type lifecycleLogWriter struct{ logf LogFunc }
470	
471	func (w lifecycleLogWriter) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
472		for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(string(data), "\n"), "\n") {
473			if line != "" {
474				w.logf("%s", line)
475			}
476		}
477		return len(data), nil
478	}

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}
48	
49	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAndSpecify(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (PlanSpec, lifecycleObservation, error) {
50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:
64			spec = s.resumeSpec(request, observed)
65		case CompleteDirect:
66			spec = s.completeDirectSpec(request, observed)
67		case CompleteFF:
68			spec = s.completeFFSpec(request, observed)
69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}
76		return spec, observed, nil
77	}
78	
79	func (s *lifecycleService) freshPlan(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (Plan, lifecycleObservation, error) {
80		spec, observed, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, record)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Plan{}, observed, err
83		}
84		plan, err := BuildPlan(request, spec)
85		return plan, observed, err
86	}
87	
88	func validateLifecycleLocator(locator Locator) error {
89		switch {
90		case locator.TaskID == "":
91			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact TaskID is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
92		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
93			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
94		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
95			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
96		case locator.RepoPath == "":
97			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
98		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
99			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
100		case locator.Branch == "":
101			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
102		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
103			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
104		case !validState(locator.State):
105			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
106		}
107		return nil
108	}
109	
110	func validateRecordIdentity(locator Locator, record task.Record) error {
111		candidate := record.Task
112		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
113		if record.Revision != locator.TaskRevision {
114			return staleTaskRevision(locator.TaskRevision, record.Revision, "task revision no longer matches the selected row")
115		}
116		checks := []struct {
117			name     string
118			expected string
119			actual   string
120		}{
121			{"TaskID", locator.TaskID, candidate.ID},
122			{"mode", string(locator.Mode), string(mode)},
123			{"state", string(locator.State), string(candidate.State)},
124			{"branch", locator.Branch, candidate.Branch},
125			{"base", locator.Base, candidate.Base},
126		}
127		for _, check := range checks {
128			if check.expected != check.actual {
129				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
130			}
131		}
132	
133		selectedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(locator.RepoPath)
134		if err != nil {
135			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.RepoPath, err)}
136		}
137		recordedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate.RepoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.RepoPath, err)}
140		}
141		if selectedRepo != recordedRepo {
142			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task repository path changed from %q to %q", selectedRepo, recordedRepo)}
143		}
144	
145		expectedCheckout := recordedRepo
146		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
147			expectedCheckout = ""
148			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
149				expectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(candidate.WorktreePath)
150				if err != nil {
151					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.WorktreePath, err)}
152				}
153			}
154		}
155		selectedCheckout := ""
156		if locator.CheckoutPath != "" {
157			selectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(locator.CheckoutPath)
158			if err != nil {
159				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.CheckoutPath, err)}
160			}
161		}
162		if selectedCheckout != expectedCheckout {
163			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task checkout path changed from %q to %q", selectedCheckout, expectedCheckout)}
164		}
165		return nil
166	}
167	
168	func staleTaskRevision(expected, actual, reason string) error {
169		return &StalePlanError{
170			ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: expected,
171			ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   actual,
172			Reason:                       reason,
173		}
174	}
175	
176	func (s *lifecycleService) observeLifecycle(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (lifecycleObservation, error) {
177		observed := lifecycleObservation{record: record, task: record.Task, mode: record.Task.EffectiveMode()}
178		observed.setCaller(s.host, s.cwd, s.callerWorkspace, s.callerPane)
179	
180		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
181		if err != nil {
182			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, record.Task.ID, err)
183		}
184		observed.repo = repository
185		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
186		if err != nil {
187			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
188		}
189		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
190		if err != nil {
191			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
192		}
193		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(record.Task.RepoPath)
194		if err != nil {
195			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
196		}
197		if recordedRepo != observed.repoPath {
198			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q", record.Task.RepoPath, recordedRepo, observed.repoPath)}
199		}
200		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
201		if err != nil {
202			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
203		}
204		if requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
205			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("Git common directory changed from %q to %q", requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir)}
206		}
207		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
208			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
209			if keyErr != nil {
210				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
211			}
212			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
213				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository key changed from %q to %q", requestedKey, observed.gitCommonDir)}
214			}
215		}
216	
217		s.observeCheckout(ctx, request, &observed)
218		if observed.hasCheckout() {
219			observed.status, observed.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
220			if observed.statusErr == nil {
221				observed.head, observed.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
222				observed.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.head)
223				observed.baseOID, observed.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
224				observed.upstreamOID, observed.upstreamOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.status.Upstream)
225				observed.operation, observed.inProgress, observed.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
226			}
227		}
228		s.observeActionRefs(ctx, request, &observed)
229		if err := validateLiveLocator(request.Locator, observed); err != nil {
230			return observed, err
231		}
232	
233		if isCompletionAction(request.Action) {
234			s.observeCompletionFacts(ctx, request, &observed)
235		}
236		observed.runtime, observed.runtimeErr = s.runtimeFor(observed.task)
237		if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
238			observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
239			s.observeActionRuntime(ctx, request, &observed)
240		}
241		return observed, nil
242	}
243	
244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
248			observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
249			if err == nil {
250				observed.worktreeFound = true
251				observed.checkout = registered.Path
252			}
253		case task.ModeWorktree:
254			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
255				registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.WorktreePath)
256				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
257				if err == nil {
258					observed.worktreeFound = true
259					observed.checkout = registered.Path
260				}
261			}
262			if observed.worktreeFound || request.Action != Resume ||
263				(observed.task.State != task.Warm && observed.task.State != task.Cold) {
264				return
265			}
266			worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
267			if err != nil {
268				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("list worktrees for parked-task resume: %w", err)
269				return
270			}
271			var candidate string
272			for _, worktree := range worktrees {
273				if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
274					observed.branchMatches++
275					candidate = worktree.Path
276				}
277			}
278			switch observed.branchMatches {
279			case 0:
280				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
281					observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has no checkout", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, observed.task.Branch)
282				}
283			case 1:
284				registered, resolveErr := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, candidate)
285				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, resolveErr
286				if resolveErr == nil {
287					observed.worktreeFound = true
288					observed.checkout = registered.Path
289				}
290			default:
291				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has %d registered checkouts", gitx.ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, observed.task.Branch, observed.branchMatches)
292			}
293		}
294	}
295	
296	func validateLiveLocator(locator Locator, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
297		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.hasCheckout() {
298			checks := []struct {
299				name     string
300				expected string
301				actual   string
302				required bool
303			}{
304				{"upstream", locator.Upstream, observed.status.Upstream, true},
305				{"HEAD", locator.HeadOID, observed.head, locator.HeadOID != ""},
306				{"base OID", locator.BaseOID, observed.baseOID, locator.BaseOID != ""},
307				{"upstream OID", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.upstreamOID, locator.UpstreamOID != ""},
308			}
309			for _, check := range checks {
310				if check.required && check.expected != check.actual {
311					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
312				}
313			}
314			return nil
315		}
316		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.HeadOID != "" {
317			if observed.localBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.HeadOID != observed.localBranchOID {
318				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected local branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.HeadOID, observed.localBranchOID)}
319			}
320		}
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.UpstreamOID != "" && locator.Upstream == observed.remoteBranch {
322			if observed.remoteBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.UpstreamOID != observed.remoteBranchOID {
323				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected remote branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.remoteBranchOID)}
324			}
325		}
326		return nil
327	}
328	
329	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRuntime(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
330		switch options := request.Options.(type) {
331		case ParkWarmOptions:
332			if options.KeepSession || !observed.hasCheckout() {
333				return
334			}
335			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
336			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
337		case ParkColdOptions:
338			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
339				return
340			}
341			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
342			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
343			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
344				observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
345			}
346		case ResumeOptions:
347			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
348				return
349			}
350			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
351				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
352				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
353				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
354			})
355			if s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) == nil {
356				observed.savedRuntimeLive = savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
357			}
358		case CompleteDirectOptions, CompleteFFOptions, ReviewHandoffOptions, VerifyMergedOptions:
359			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
360				return
361			}
362			occupancyOptions := runtime.OccupancyOptions{
363				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
364				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
365				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
366			}
367			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, occupancyOptions)
368			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
369				observed.integration.occupancy = observed.occupancy
370				observed.integration.occupancyErr = observed.occupancyErr
371			}
372			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.integration.worktreeFound {
373				observed.integration.occupancy, observed.integration.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(
374					ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, occupancyOptions,
375				)
376			}
377		}
378	}
379	
380	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRefs(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
381		observed.localBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
382		if observed.localBranchExists {
383			observed.localBranchOID, observed.localBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
384		}
385		observed.remoteBranch = "origin/" + observed.task.Branch
386		observed.remoteBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
387		if observed.remoteBranchExists {
388			observed.remoteBranchOID, observed.remoteBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
389		}
390	
391		switch request.Action {
392		case ParkCold:
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
394				observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
395				if observed.baseRef == "" {
396					observed.baseRef = s.gitDefaultBranch(ctx, observed.repoPath)
397				}
398				observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
399			}
400		case Resume:
401			observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
402			if observed.remoteBranchExists {
403				observed.baseRef = observed.remoteBranch
404			}
405			observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
406			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !observed.hasCheckout() &&
407				(observed.task.State == task.Warm || observed.task.State == task.Cold) {
408				if observed.task.State == task.Warm && observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
409					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.canonicalPath(observed.task.WorktreePath)
410				} else {
411					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.renderWorktreePath(observed.task)
412				}
413				if observed.desiredWorktreeErr == nil {
414					observed.desiredWorktreeErr = wt.ValidateTarget(observed.desiredWorktree, observed.repoPath)
415				}
416			}
417		case CompleteDirect:
418			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Branch
419		case CompleteFF, ReviewHandoff:
420			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
421		case VerifyMerged:
422			options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
423			observed.completionBaseRef = options.BaseRef
424			if observed.completionBaseRef == "" {
425				observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
426			}
427		}
428	}
429	
430	func (s *lifecycleService) renderWorktreePath(candidate task.Task) (string, error) {
431		values := config.Vars{
432			"worktree_root": config.Expand(s.cfg.Paths.WorktreeRoot),
433			"repo":          candidate.Repo,
434			"repo_path":     candidate.RepoPath,
435			"branch":        candidate.Branch,
436			"category":      "",
437			"host":          s.host,
438			"date":          s.now().Format("2006-01-02"),
439		}
440		rendered, err := config.Render(s.cfg.Paths.WorktreePath, values)
441		if err != nil {
442			return "", err
443		}
444		return s.canonicalPath(config.Expand(rendered))
445	}

496			"git.remote-branch":             observed.remoteBranch,
497			"git.remote-branch-exists":      boolString(observed.remoteBranchExists),
498			"git.remote-branch-oid":         observed.remoteBranchOID,
499			"git.remote-branch-oid-error":   errorString(observed.remoteBranchOIDErr),

506			"runtime.cleanup-blockers":      strings.Join(observed.cleanup.Blockers, "\x00"),
507			"runtime.cleanup-caller":        boolString(observed.cleanup.CallerContained),

518			"artifact.error":                errorString(observed.artifactErr),
519			"finish.fingerprint":            observed.finish.Fingerprint,
520			"finish.authority":              finishAuthority(observed.finish, observed.finishErr),
521			"finish.error":                  errorString(observed.finishErr),
522			"finish.base-only":              strconv.Itoa(observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly),
523			"finish.branch-only":            strconv.Itoa(observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly),
524			"finish.status-changed":         strconv.Itoa(observed.finish.Status.Changed),
525			"finish.status-staged":          strconv.Itoa(observed.finish.Status.Staged),

568	func appendOptionAuthority(authority map[string]string, options ActionOptions) {
569		switch value := options.(type) {
570		case ParkWarmOptions:
571			authority["option.next"] = value.Next
572			authority["option.note"] = value.Note
573			authority["option.commit-wip"] = boolString(value.CommitWIP)
574			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
575			authority["option.keep-session"] = boolString(value.KeepSession)
576			authority["option.close-unknown"] = boolString(value.CloseUnknown)
577			authority["option.assume-no-runtime"] = boolString(value.AssumeNoRuntime)
578			authority["option.timeout"] = value.Timeout.String()
579		case ParkColdOptions:
580			authority["option.next"] = value.Next
581			authority["option.note"] = value.Note
582			authority["option.commit-wip"] = boolString(value.CommitWIP)
583			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
584			authority["option.close-unknown"] = boolString(value.CloseUnknown)
585			authority["option.assume-no-runtime"] = boolString(value.AssumeNoRuntime)
586			authority["option.timeout"] = value.Timeout.String()
587		case ResumeOptions:
588			authority["option.fetch-refs"] = boolString(value.FetchRefs)
589			authority["option.no-provision"] = boolString(value.NoProvision)
590			authority["option.take-ownership"] = boolString(value.TakeOwnership)
591		case CompleteDirectOptions:
592			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
593			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
594		case CompleteFFOptions:
595			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
596			authority["option.push-base"] = boolString(value.PushBase)
597		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
598			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
599			authority["option.draft"] = boolString(value.Draft)
600			authority["option.title"] = value.Title
601			authority["option.body"] = value.Body
602		case VerifyMergedOptions:
603			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
604			authority["option.base-ref"] = value.BaseRef
605			authority["option.squash-commit"] = value.SquashCommit
606			authority["option.push-base"] = boolString(value.PushBase)
607		}
608	}
609	
610	func appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority map[string]string, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) {
611		authority["option.dirty"] = string(dirty)
612		authority["option.commit-message"] = message
613	}

615	func runtimeName(rt runtime.Runtime) string {
616		if rt == nil {
617			return ""
618		}
619		return rt.Name()
620	}

622	func (s *lifecycleService) resolveRefOID(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) (string, error) {
623		if ref == "" {
624			return "", nil
625		}
626		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", ref+"^{commit}")
627		return strings.TrimSpace(value), err
628	}

15	func (s *lifecycleService) applyGuarded(ctx context.Context, action Action, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
16		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
17			return Result{}, err
18		}
19		if approved.Action != action {
20			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("handler %s received %s", action, approved.Action)}
21		}
22		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
23			return Result{}, err
24		}
25		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
28		}
29	
30		var result Result
31		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
32			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
33				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
34				if loadErr != nil {
35					return &StalePlanError{
36						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID,
37						Reason:         "task record disappeared before apply",
38					}
39				}
40				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
41					return identityErr
42				}
43				fresh, observed, planErr := s.freshPlan(ctx, approved.Request, *record)
44				if planErr != nil {
45					return planErr
46				}
47				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
48				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
49					actual := ""
50					if current != nil {
51						actual = current.Revision
52					}
53					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked plan rebuild")
54				}
55				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
56					return &StalePlanError{
57						ExpectedPlanID:               approved.PlanID,
58						ActualPlanID:                 fresh.PlanID,
59						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
60						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
61						Reason:                       "fresh task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or option authority differs",
62					}
63				}
64				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
65					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
66					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
67				}
68	
69				execution := &executionState{
70					service: s, plan: fresh, observed: observed, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision,
71				}
72				var applyErr error
73				switch action {
74				case ParkWarm:
75					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkWarm(ctx)
76				case ParkCold:
77					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkCold(ctx)
78				case Resume:
79					result, applyErr = execution.applyResume(ctx)
80				case CompleteDirect:
81					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteDirect(ctx)
82				case CompleteFF:
83					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteFF(ctx)
84				case ReviewHandoff:
85					result, applyErr = execution.applyReviewHandoff(ctx)
86				case VerifyMerged:
87					result, applyErr = execution.applyVerifyMerged(ctx)
88				default:
89					applyErr = &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: action, Stage: "apply"}
90				}
91				return applyErr
92			})
93		})
94		return result, err
95	}

97	func (e *executionState) applyParkWarm(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
98		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ParkWarmOptions)
99		observed := &e.observed
100		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() && !options.CommitWIP {
101			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, observed.checkout+" has uncommitted changes; bytes remain in place")
102		}
103		if observed.desiredNext(options) == "" {
104			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "no next action is recorded")
105		}
106		if !options.KeepSession && observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
107			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "runtime remains active because the caller is contained; exit normally and reconcile later")
108		}
109	
110		closedRuntime := false
111		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
112			switch effect.Code {
113			case EffectCommitWIP:
114				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
115					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task and retry warm parking")
116				}
117				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
118					made, commitErr := e.service.wipCommit(ctx, observed.checkout, effect.Details.Map()["message"])
119					if commitErr != nil {
120						return "", fmt.Errorf("checkpoint WIP: %w", commitErr)
121					}
122					if !made {
123						return "no product changes required a checkpoint", nil
124					}
125					return "created WIP checkpoint", nil
126				})
127				if err != nil {
128					return e.fail(err, "preserve the checkout and retry after fixing the checkpoint failure")
129				}
130				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
131					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after WIP checkpoint: %w", err), "inspect the committed checkpoint before retrying")
132				}
133			case EffectPushBranch:
134				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
135					return e.fail(err, "inspect the checkout and retry the push")
136				}
137				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
138					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
139					if pushErr != nil {
140						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
141					}
142					return "pushed origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
143				})
144				if err != nil {
145					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains present; resolve the push and retry warm parking")
146				}
147				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
148					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after push: %w", err), "inspect the published branch before retrying")
149				}
150			case EffectCloseRuntime:
151				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
152					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task and retry runtime closure")
153				}
154				if err := e.service.revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx, *observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
155					return e.fail(err, "inspect runtime occupancy from outside the checkout")
156				}
157				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
158					closed, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
159						observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout))
160					if closeErr != nil {
161						return "", closeErr
162					}
163					observed.cleanup = closed
164					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", closed.ClosedSessions, observed.runtime.Name()), nil
165				})
166				if err != nil {
167					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and task record remain; inspect runtime occupancy and retry")
168				}
169				if err := e.service.ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx, observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
170					return e.fail(err, "a runtime reclaimed the checkout; close it from outside and retry")
171				}
172				closedRuntime = true
173			case EffectUpdateTask:
174				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
175					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task before recording WARM")
176				}
177				if !options.KeepSession {
178					var runtimeErr error
179					if closedRuntime {
180						runtimeErr = e.service.ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx, observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
181					} else {
182						runtimeErr = e.service.revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx, *observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
183					}
184					if runtimeErr != nil {
185						return e.fail(runtimeErr, "runtime occupancy changed; refresh and retry warm parking")
186					}
187				}
188				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
189					candidate := observed.task
190					candidate.State = task.Warm
191					candidate.Owner = e.service.host
192					if options.Next != "" {
193						candidate.Next = options.Next
194					}
195					if options.Note != "" {
196						candidate.Note = options.Note
197					}
198					if !options.KeepSession && !observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
199						candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
200						candidate.RuntimeName = ""
201					}
202					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
203					if updateErr != nil {
204						return "", fmt.Errorf("write WARM task state: %w", updateErr)
205					}
206					if updated == nil {
207						return "", errors.New("write WARM task state returned no revision")
208					}
209					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
210					observed.task = updated.Task
211					return "recorded WARM at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
212				})
213				if err != nil {
214					return e.fail(err, "Git/runtime effects may already be complete; reload the task and reconcile its state")
215				}
216			default:
217				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ParkWarm effect " + string(effect.Code)})
218			}
219		}
220		return e.result(), nil
221	}

262				}

264					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)

272				}
273				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {

275				}
276			case EffectCloseRuntime:
277				if err := e.service.ensureColdGitReady(ctx, observed); err != nil {

284					return e.fail(err, "runtime occupancy changed; refresh cold parking")

288						observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout))
289					if closeErr != nil {
290						return "", closeErr
291					}
292					observed.cleanup = closed
293					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", closed.ClosedSessions, observed.runtime.Name()), nil
294				})
295				if err != nil {

326				}
327				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
328					_, switchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "switch", base)
329					if switchErr != nil {

331					}
332					return "switched canonical checkout to " + base, nil

335					return e.fail(err, "the task branch remains retained; inspect the canonical checkout and retry")
336				}

338					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify canonical base switch: %w", err), "inspect the canonical checkout before reconciling task state")
339				}
340				if !e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch) {

350				}
351				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {

353					candidate.State = task.Cold
354					candidate.Owner = e.service.host
355					candidate.WorktreePath = ""
356					candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
357					candidate.RuntimeName = ""

359						candidate.Next = options.Next
360					}
361					if options.Note != "" {
362						candidate.Note = options.Note
363					}

367					}

372					observed.task = updated.Task

375				if err != nil {
376					return e.fail(err, "checkout cleanup succeeded but task persistence failed; reload and reconcile the task path/runtime/state")
377				}
378			default:
379				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ParkCold effect " + string(effect.Code)})
380			}
381		}
382		return e.result(), nil
383	}

385	func (e *executionState) applyResume(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {

553					if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {

560							return "", errors.New("HOT task requires the validated or newly opened runtime handle")
561						}
562					}
563					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)

565						return "", fmt.Errorf("write HOT task state: %w", updateErr)
566					}
567					if updated == nil {
568						return "", errors.New("write HOT task state returned no revision")
569					}
570					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
571					observed.task = updated.Task
572					if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {

574					} else {

584				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected Resume effect " + string(effect.Code)})

586		}
587		return e.result(), nil

590	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRepository(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
591		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
592		if err != nil {
593			return staleBoundary("canonical repository is no longer discoverable: " + err.Error())
594		}
595		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
596		if err != nil {
597			return staleBoundary("canonical repository path is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
598		}
599		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
600		if err != nil {
601			return staleBoundary("Git common directory is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
602		}
603		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
604			return staleBoundary("canonical repository or Git common directory changed")
605		}
606		return nil
607	}
608	
609	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateGitBaseline(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
610		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
611		if err != nil {
612			return staleBoundary("exact worktree registration changed: " + err.Error())
613		}
614		if registered != observed.worktree {
615			return staleBoundary("exact worktree path, branch, HEAD, Main, locked, or prunable flags changed")
616		}
617		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
618		if err != nil {
619			return staleBoundary("Git status observation changed: " + err.Error())
620		}
621		if !sameStatus(status, observed.status) {
622			return staleBoundary("Git status, branch, upstream, ahead, behind, dirty, or conflict evidence changed")
623		}
624		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
625		if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(head) != observed.head {
626			return staleBoundary("checkout HEAD changed")
627		}
628		baseOID, baseErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
629		upstreamOID, upstreamErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
630		if errorString(baseErr) != errorString(observed.baseOIDErr) || baseOID != observed.baseOID ||
631			errorString(upstreamErr) != errorString(observed.upstreamOIDErr) || upstreamOID != observed.upstreamOID {
632			return staleBoundary("base or upstream ref OID changed")
633		}
634		operation, active, err := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
635		if err != nil || operation != observed.operation || active != observed.inProgress {
636			return staleBoundary("Git operation evidence changed")
637		}
638		return nil
639	}
640	
641	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, expectedBranch string) error {
642		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
643		if err != nil {
644			return err
645		}
646		if registered.Path != observed.checkout || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
647			return errors.New("checkout path or Git common directory changed")
648		}
649		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !registered.IsLinkedWorktree() {
650			return errors.New("worktree task no longer resolves to a linked checkout")
651		}
652		if observed.mode != task.ModeWorktree && (!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare) {
653			return errors.New("canonical task no longer resolves to the main checkout")
654		}
655		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
656		if err != nil {
657			return err
658		}
659		if status.Detached || expectedBranch != "" && status.Branch != expectedBranch || registered.Worktree.Branch != status.Branch {
660			return fmt.Errorf("checkout branch changed: registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", registered.Worktree.Branch, status.Branch, expectedBranch)
661		}
662		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
663		if err != nil {
664			return err
665		}
666		head = strings.TrimSpace(head)
667		if registered.Worktree.Head != head {
668			return fmt.Errorf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", registered.Worktree.Head, head)
669		}
670		baseOID, baseOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
671		upstreamOID, upstreamOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
672		operation, active, operationErr := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
673		if operationErr != nil {
674			return operationErr
675		}
676		observed.worktree = registered
677		observed.status = status
678		observed.statusErr = nil
679		observed.head = head
680		observed.headErr = nil
681		observed.baseOID = baseOID
682		observed.baseOIDErr = baseOIDErr
683		observed.upstreamOID = upstreamOID
684		observed.upstreamOIDErr = upstreamOIDErr
685		observed.operation = operation
686		observed.inProgress = active
687		observed.operationErr = nil
688		return nil
689	}

691	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureParkBranchIdentity(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
692		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
693			return err
694		}
695		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch || observed.inProgress || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
696			return staleBoundary("task branch, conflict, or Git operation evidence changed before push")
697		}
698		return nil
699	}
