701	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureColdGitReady(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
702		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
703			return err
704		}
705		if observed.status.Dirty() {
706			return fmt.Errorf("cold parking requires a clean checkout: %s", observed.status.Breakdown())
707		}
708		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
709			return errors.New("cold parking checkout is no longer on the task branch")
710		}
711		if observed.inProgress || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
712			return errors.New("cold parking refuses an active Git operation or unresolved conflict")
713		}
714		if !observed.status.Published() || observed.status.Ahead != 0 {
715			return fmt.Errorf("cold parking requires a published ahead=0 branch; status is %s", observed.status.Summary())
716		}
717		return nil
718	}
719	
720	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateColdArtifact(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
721		if observed.mode != task.ModeWorktree {
722			return nil
723		}
724		fresh, err := s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
725		if err != nil {
726			return err
727		}
728		if !fresh.Ready() {
729			return errors.New("artifact readiness changed to blocked")
730		}
731		if artifactAuthority(fresh, nil) != artifactAuthority(observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr) {
732			return staleBoundary("artifact intent or receipt authority changed")
733		}
734		return nil
735	}
736	
737	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool, timeout time.Duration) error {
738		options := observed.cleanupOptions(closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, timeout)
739		fresh, err := s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, options)
740		if err != nil {
741			return err
742		}
743		if cleanupAuthority(fresh, nil) != cleanupAuthority(observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr) {
744			return staleBoundary("runtime occupancy, caller, agent, or session evidence changed")
745		}
746		return nil
747	}
748	
749	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool, timeout time.Duration) error {
750		fresh, err := s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
751			observed.cleanupOptions(closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, timeout))
752		if err != nil {
753			return err
754		}
755		if !fresh.Ready() || fresh.CallerContained || len(fresh.Sessions) > 0 {
756			return errors.New("runtime coverage reappeared after closure")
757		}
758		observed.cleanup = fresh
759		observed.cleanupErr = nil
760		return nil
761	}
762	
763	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureColdRemovalBoundary(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, options ParkColdOptions, runtimeWasClosed bool) error {
764		if err := s.ensureColdGitReady(ctx, observed); err != nil {
765			return err
766		}
767		if err := s.revalidateColdArtifact(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
768			return err
769		}
770		fresh, err := s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
771			observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout))
772		if err != nil {
773			return err
774		}
775		if !fresh.Ready() || fresh.CallerContained || len(fresh.Sessions) > 0 {
776			return errors.New("cleanup occupancy is no longer empty and safe")
777		}
778		if !runtimeWasClosed && cleanupAuthority(fresh, nil) != cleanupAuthority(observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr) {
779			return staleBoundary("runtime occupancy changed before cleanup")
780		}
781		observed.cleanup = fresh
782		observed.cleanupErr = nil
783		return nil
784	}

786	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateResumeCheckout(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
787		expected := observed.task.Branch
788		if err := s.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, expected); err != nil {
789			return staleBoundary("resume checkout identity changed: " + err.Error())
790		}
791		return nil
792	}

794	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateResumeOccupancy(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, compareAuthority bool) error {
795		fresh, err := s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
796			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
797			CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
798			CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
799		})
800		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh, err); occupancyErr != nil {
801			return occupancyErr
802		}
803		if compareAuthority && occupancyAuthority(fresh, nil) != occupancyAuthority(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) {
804			return staleBoundary("runtime session, caller, or recognized-agent occupancy changed")
805		}
806		observed.occupancy = fresh
807		observed.occupancyErr = nil
808		observed.savedRuntimeLive = savedHandleLive(fresh, observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
809		return nil
810	}

812	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureBranchSwitchBoundary(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
813		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
814			return err
815		}
816		if observed.status.Dirty() || observed.status.Detached || observed.inProgress || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
817			return errors.New("canonical checkout is no longer clean and switchable")
818		}
819		if !s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch) {
820			return staleBoundary("local task branch disappeared before switch")
821		}
822		return nil
823	}

825	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateResumeBranchRefs(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, allowRemoteChange bool) error {
826		localExists := s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
827		localOID, localErr := "", error(nil)
828		if localExists {
829			localOID, localErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
830		}
831		if localExists != observed.localBranchExists || localOID != observed.localBranchOID ||
832			errorString(localErr) != errorString(observed.localBranchOIDErr) {
833			return staleBoundary("local task branch OID changed before worktree reconstruction")
834		}
835		if allowRemoteChange {
836			return nil
837		}
838		remoteExists := s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
839		remoteOID, remoteErr := "", error(nil)
840		if remoteExists {
841			remoteOID, remoteErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
842		}
843		if remoteExists != observed.remoteBranchExists || remoteOID != observed.remoteBranchOID ||
844			errorString(remoteErr) != errorString(observed.remoteBranchOIDErr) {
845			return staleBoundary("remote task branch OID changed before worktree reconstruction")
846		}
847		return nil
848	}

850	func (s *lifecycleService) branchCheckoutCount(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) (int, error) {
851		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
852		if err != nil {
853			return 0, err
854		}
855		count := 0
856		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
857			if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
858				count++
859			}
860		}
861		return count, nil
862	}

864	func resumeExpectedBranchBeforeSwitch(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
865		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && observed.statusErr == nil {
866			return observed.status.Branch
867		}
868		return observed.task.Branch
869	}

+
+// RegisteredWorktree is an identity snapshot from Git's worktree registry.
+// Worktree preserves the complete parsed Git record; the other fields are canonical
+// filesystem identities suitable for exact comparison across symlink and macOS
+// path aliases. A snapshot proves registration, not permission to remove it.
+type RegisteredWorktree struct {
+	Worktree       Worktree
+	RepositoryPath string
+	GitCommonDir   string
+	Path           string
+}
+
+// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether the record is a linked checkout rather than
+// Git's main checkout or a bare repository. It is classification, not a removal
+// safety decision.
+func (w RegisteredWorktree) IsLinkedWorktree() bool {
+	return !w.Worktree.Main && !w.Worktree.Bare
+}
+
+// ResolveRegisteredWorktree resolves exactPath against a fresh authoritative
+// `git worktree list --porcelain` query for the repository containing repoPath.
+// Matching is exclusively by canonical filesystem identity, never by branch.
+// It performs no prune, removal, or other mutation.
+func ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx context.Context, repoPath, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
+	worktrees, err := Worktrees(ctx, repoPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("query registered worktrees: %w", err)
+	}
+	commonDir, err := run(ctx, repoPath, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir")
+	if err != nil {
+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve Git common directory: %w", err)
+	}
+	return resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees, commonDir, exactPath)
+}
+
+func resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees []Worktree, commonDir, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
+	path, err := pathx.Canonical(exactPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize requested worktree %q: %w", exactPath, err)
+	}
+	canonicalCommonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
+	if err != nil {
+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory %q: %w", commonDir, err)
+	}
+
+	type match struct {
+		worktree Worktree
+		path     string
+	}
+	var (
+		repositoryPath string
+		matches        []match
+	)
+	for _, worktree := range worktrees {
+		canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
+		if canonicalErr != nil {
+			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize registered worktree %q: %w", worktree.Path, canonicalErr)
+		}
+		if worktree.Main {
+			repositoryPath = canonicalPath
+		}
+		if sameCanonicalPath(path, canonicalPath) {
+			matches = append(matches, match{worktree: worktree, path: canonicalPath})
+		}
+	}
+
+	switch len(matches) {
+	case 0:
+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrWorktreeNotFound, path)
+	case 1:
+		if repositoryPath == "" {
+			return RegisteredWorktree{}, errors.New("registered worktree query has no main repository record")
+		}
+		return RegisteredWorktree{
+			Worktree:       matches[0].worktree,
+			RepositoryPath: repositoryPath,
+			GitCommonDir:   canonicalCommonDir,
+			Path:           matches[0].path,
+		}, nil
+	default:
+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s resolves to %d records", ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, path, len(matches))
+	}
+}
+
+func sameCanonicalPath(left, right string) bool {
+	if left == right {
+		return true
+	}
+	leftInfo, leftErr := os.Stat(left)
+	rightInfo, rightErr := os.Stat(right)
+	return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && os.SameFile(leftInfo, rightInfo)
+}

277			message.repoKey != m.loadRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.repository.RepoKey {
278			return m, nil
279		}
280		if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
281			m.loadRequest.cancel()
282		}
283		m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
284		m.loadRequest.loading = false
285	
286		if message.err == nil && message.snapshot.Repository.RepoKey != message.repoKey {
287			message.err = fmt.Errorf(
288				"loaded snapshot repository key %q does not match requested key %q",
289				message.snapshot.Repository.RepoKey, message.repoKey,
290			)
291		}
292		if message.err != nil {
293			m.loadRequest.err = message.err
294			m.loadRequest.stale = m.hasSnapshot
295			if m.hasSnapshot {
296				m.snapshot.Freshness = FreshnessStale
297			}
298			m.status = ""
299			return m, nil
300		}
301	
302		oldRow, hadOldRow := m.currentSurface()
303		oldIndex := m.rowCursor
304		oldActionID := ""
305		if choice, ok := m.currentAction(); ok {
306			oldActionID = choice.ID
307		}
308	
309		accepted := message.snapshot.Clone()
310		if accepted.Freshness == "" {
311			accepted.Freshness = FreshnessFresh
312		}
313		m.snapshot = accepted
314		m.hasSnapshot = true
315		m.loadRequest.err = nil
316		m.loadRequest.stale = accepted.Freshness != FreshnessFresh || accepted.Error != ""
317		m.repository = accepted.Repository
318		if remote, ok := accepted.Remote.RemoteObservation(); ok {
319			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
320		}
321	
322		rows := accepted.Surfaces.Values()
323		m.rowCursor = retainedSurfaceIndex(rows, oldRow, hadOldRow, oldIndex, m.desiredFocus)
324		m.desiredFocus = ""
325		m.actionCursor = retainedActionIndex(rows, m.rowCursor, oldActionID)
326		m.clampActionCursor()
327		m.status = ""
328		return m, nil
329	}
330	
331	func retainedSurfaceIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, previous SurfaceRow, hadPrevious bool, oldIndex int, focus string) int {
332		if len(rows) == 0 {
333			return 0
334		}
335		if hadPrevious {
336			for index, row := range rows {
337				if row.RowKey == previous.RowKey {
338					return index
339				}
340			}
341			if previous.Locator.TaskID != "" {
342				for index, row := range rows {
343					if row.Locator.TaskID == previous.Locator.TaskID {
344						return index
345					}
346				}
347			}
348			for index, row := range rows {
349				if locatorsReferToSameSurface(previous.Locator, row.Locator) {
350					return index
351				}
352			}
353		}
354		if focus != "" {
355			for index, row := range rows {
356				if row.RowKey == focus || row.Locator.RowKey == focus {
357					return index
358				}
359			}
360			for index, row := range rows {
361				if row.Locator.TaskID == focus {
362					return index
363				}
364			}
365			for index, row := range rows {
366				if row.Locator.CheckoutPath == focus {
367					return index
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		if oldIndex < 0 {
372			return 0
373		}
374		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
375			return len(rows) - 1
376		}
377		return oldIndex
378	}
379	
380	func retainedActionIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, rowIndex int, actionID string) int {
381		if actionID == "" || rowIndex < 0 || rowIndex >= len(rows) {
382			return 0
383		}
384		for index, action := range rows[rowIndex].Actions.Values() {
385			if action.ID == actionID {
386				return index
387			}
388		}
389		return 0
390	}
391	
392	func locatorsReferToSameSurface(left, right taskflow.Locator) bool {
393		if left.RepositoryID != "" && right.RepositoryID != "" && left.RepositoryID != right.RepositoryID {
394			return false
395		}
396		if left.CheckoutPath != "" && right.CheckoutPath != "" {
397			return left.CheckoutPath == right.CheckoutPath
398		}
399		if left.TaskID != "" && right.TaskID != "" {
400			return left.TaskID == right.TaskID
401		}
402		return left.RepoKey != "" && left.RepoKey == right.RepoKey &&
403			left.Branch != "" && left.Branch == right.Branch && left.Base == right.Base
404	}
405	
406	func (m Model) acceptPlan(message planMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
407		if message.generation != m.planRequest.generation ||
408			message.repoKey != m.planRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey ||
409			message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey || message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
410			return m, nil
411		}
412		if m.planRequest.cancel != nil {
413			m.planRequest.cancel()
414		}
415		m.planRequest.cancel = nil
416		m.planRequest.loading = false
417		m.planRequest.err = message.err
418		m.overlay = overlayPlan
419		m.status = ""
420	
421		if message.plan.PlanID != "" {
422			m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
423			m.hasPlan = true
424		}
425		if message.err != nil {
426			m.planErr = message.err
427			return m, nil
428		}
429		if err := message.plan.Validate(); err != nil {
430			m.planErr = combineError("invalid plan returned by callback", err)
431			return m, nil
432		}
433		if message.plan.Locator != m.planTarget.locator {
434			m.planErr = errors.New("plan locator does not match the exact selected surface")
435			return m, nil
436		}
437		if message.plan.Action != m.planTarget.choice.Action() {
438			m.planErr = errors.New("plan action does not match the exact selected action options")
439			return m, nil
440		}
441		expected, err := taskflow.NewRequest(m.planTarget.locator, m.planTarget.choice.Options())
442		if err != nil {
443			m.planErr = combineError("selected action options are invalid", err)
444			return m, nil
445		}
446		if !reflect.DeepEqual(message.plan.Request.Options, expected.Options) {
447			m.planErr = errors.New("plan was built with different concrete action options than the selected choice")
448			return m, nil
449		}
450		m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
451		m.hasPlan = true
452		m.planErr = nil
453		if m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady && m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
454			m.confirm.SetValue("")
455			m.confirm.CursorEnd()
456			return m, m.confirm.Focus()
457		}
458		return m, nil
459	}
460	
461	func (m Model) acceptApply(message applyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
462		if !m.applyRunning || message.generation != m.applyGeneration ||
463			message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey || message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey ||
464			message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
465			return m, nil
466		}
467		m.applyRunning = false
468		m.overlay = overlayResult
469		m.lastResult = message.result.Clone()
470		m.hasLastResult = true
471		m.lastResultErr = message.err
472		m.status = ""
473		if remote, ok := message.result.RemoteObservation(); ok {
474			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
475		}
476		if message.err == nil {
477			if handoff, ok := message.result.Handoff(); ok {
478				m.finalHandoff = handoff
479				m.hasHandoff = true
480			}
481		}
482	
483		queuedQuit := m.queuedQuit
484		m.queuedQuit, m.queuedRefresh = false, false
485		updated, command := m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
486		m = updated.(Model)
487		if queuedQuit {
488			// The fresh generation is established before honoring the queued quit. It
489			// cannot authorize anything and the mutation ledger remains in final Model.
490			if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
491				m.loadRequest.cancel()
492				m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
493			}
494			m.quitting = true
495			return m, tea.Quit
496		}
497		return m, command
498	}

135	// New constructs either an asynchronous repository picker (preselected=nil) or
136	// an asynchronous preselected-repository view. No callback runs until Init's
137	// command is executed, so View can return the initial frame immediately.
138	func New(actions Actions, preselected *RepositoryRow) Model {
139		filter := textinput.New()
140		filter.CharLimit = 240
141		filter.Placeholder = "repository filter"
142		confirm := textinput.New()
143		confirm.CharLimit = 300
144		confirm.Placeholder = "exact confirmation token"
145	
146		model := Model{
147			actions:        actions,
148			firstViewReady: make(chan struct{}),
149			firstViewOnce:  &sync.Once{},
150			width:          120, height: 34,
151			filter: filter, confirm: confirm,
152			focus: FocusSurfaces,
153		}
154		if preselected == nil {
155			model.screen = screenPicker
156			model.listRequest = requestState{generation: 1, repoKey: pickerRequestKey, loading: true}
157			return model
158		}
159		model.screen = screenRepository
160		model.repository = *preselected
161		model.desiredFocus = preselected.FocusTarget
162		model.loadRequest = requestState{generation: 1, repoKey: preselected.RepoKey, loading: true}
163		return model

189	// Init implements tea.Model without doing synchronous repository work.
190	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
191		var commands []tea.Cmd
192		switch m.screen {
193		case screenRepository:
194			if m.loadRequest.loading {
195				commands = append(commands, m.loadRepositoryCmd(m.loadRequest.generation, m.loadRequest.repoKey, m.baseContext()))
196			}
197		case screenPicker:
198			if m.listRequest.loading {
199				commands = append(commands, m.listRepositoriesCmd(m.listRequest.generation, m.baseContext()))
200			}
201		}
202		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
203			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
204		}
205		switch len(commands) {
206		case 0:
207			return nil
208		case 1:
209			return commands[0]
210		default:
211			return tea.Batch(commands...)
212		}
213	}

276	func (m Model) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
277		switch message := message.(type) {
278		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
279			m.width, m.height = message.Width, message.Height
280			return m, nil
281		case repositoryListMsg:
282			return m.acceptRepositoryList(message)
283		case repositoryLoadMsg:
284			return m.acceptRepositoryLoad(message)
285		case planMsg:
286			return m.acceptPlan(message)
287		case applyMsg:
288			return m.acceptApply(message)
289		case tea.KeyMsg:
290			if m.applyRunning {
291				return m.updateApplying(message)
292			}
293			if m.filterActive {
294				return m.updateFilter(message)
295			}
296			if m.overlay != overlayNone {
297				return m.updateOverlay(message)
298			}
299			if m.screen == screenPicker {
300				return m.updatePicker(message)
301			}
302			return m.updateRepository(message)
303		}
304		return m, nil
305	}

430	func (m Model) filteredRepositories() []RepositoryRow {
431		query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m.filter.Value()))
432		terms := strings.Fields(query)
433		out := make([]RepositoryRow, 0, len(m.repositories))
434		for _, row := range m.repositories {
435			haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{row.RepoKey, row.Name, row.Path, row.Error}, " "))
436			matched := true
437			for _, term := range terms {
438				if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
439					matched = false
440					break
441				}
442			}
443			if matched {
444				out = append(out, row)
445			}
446		}
447		return out
448	}

486		}
487		actions := row.Actions.Values()
488		if m.actionCursor < 0 || m.actionCursor >= len(actions) {
489			return ActionChoice{}, false
490		}
491		if !actions[m.actionCursor].Valid() {
492			return ActionChoice{}, false
493		}
494		return actions[m.actionCursor], true
495	}
496	
497	func (m *Model) setRowCursor(index int) {
498		count := 0
499		if m.hasSnapshot {
500			count = m.snapshot.Surfaces.Len()
501		}
502		switch {
503		case count == 0:
504			index = 0
505		case index < 0:
506			index = 0
507		case index >= count:
508			index = count - 1
509		}
510		if index != m.rowCursor {
511			m.rowCursor = index
512			m.actionCursor = 0
513		} else {
514			m.rowCursor = index
515		}
516		m.clampActionCursor()
517	}
518	
519	func (m *Model) clampActionCursor() {
520		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
521		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
522			m.actionCursor = 0
523			return
524		}
525		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
526			m.actionCursor = 0
527		}
528		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
529			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
530		}
531	}
532	
533	func (m *Model) moveAction(delta int) {
534		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
535		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
536			m.actionCursor = 0
537			return
538		}
539		m.actionCursor += delta
540		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
541			m.actionCursor = 0
542		}
543		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
544			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
545		}
546		m.focus = FocusActions
547	}
548	
549	func (m Model) selectRepository(row RepositoryRow) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
550		m.cancelRepositoryListRead()
551		m.screen = screenRepository
552		m.repository = row
553		m.desiredFocus = row.FocusTarget
554		m.hasSnapshot = false
555		m.snapshot = Snapshot{}
556		m.remote = OptionalRemoteObservation{}
557		m.rowCursor, m.actionCursor = 0, 0
558		m.overlay = overlayNone
559		m.hasPlan, m.planErr = false, nil
560		m.hasLastResult, m.lastResultErr = false, nil
561		m.hasHandoff = false
562		return m.beginRepositoryLoad(true)
563	}

566		if err == nil {
567			return nil
568		}
569		if label == "" {
570			return err
571		}
572		return errors.New(label + ": " + err.Error())
573	}

143	func runFlow(app *App, launch flowLaunch, runProgram flowProgramRunner) error {
144		if runProgram == nil {
145			return errors.New("flow program runner is unavailable")
146		}
147		flowtui.SetColorEnabled(app.outStyle().enabled)
148		app.traceTUI = true
149		runCtx, cancelRun := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
150		finishSetup := app.trace.Start(perftrace.TUISetup, perftrace.Fields{})
151		runtimeResolver := newTUIRuntimeResolver(app)
152		loader := newFlowLoader(app, runtimeResolver, launch.cwd)
153		if launch.repository != nil {
154			loader.registerRepository(*launch.repository, true)
155		}
156		actions := loader.actions()
157		if app.deferredReleaseRefresh {
158			actions.AfterFirstView = func(context.Context) { app.refreshReleaseDetached() }
159		}
160		model := flowtui.New(actions, launch.preselected).WithContext(runCtx)
161		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
162		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
163		final, err := runProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen())
164		cancelRun()
165		app.finishTrace()
166		if err != nil {
167			return err
168		}
169		withHandoff, ok := final.(interface {
170			Handoff() (taskflow.Handoff, bool)
171		})
172		if !ok {
173			return nil
174		}
175		handoff, ok := withHandoff.Handoff()
176		if !ok {
177			return nil
178		}
179		return honorFlowHandoff(app, runtimeResolver, handoff)
180	}
181	
182	func honorFlowHandoff(app *App, resolver flowRuntimeResolver, handoff taskflow.Handoff) error {
183		switch handoff.Kind {
184		case taskflow.HandoffDirectory:
185			if handoff.Path == "" {
186				return errors.New("flow returned an empty directory handoff")
187			}
188			return app.cdDirective(handoff.Path)
189		case taskflow.HandoffRuntime:
190			if handoff.Runtime == "" || handoff.RuntimeHandle == "" {
191				return errors.New("flow returned an incomplete runtime handoff")
192			}
193			var rt runtime.Runtime
194			if resolver != nil {
195				resolved, err := resolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
196				if err != nil {
197					return err
198				}
199				if resolved != nil && resolved.Name() == handoff.Runtime {
200					rt = resolved
201				}
202			}
203			if rt == nil {
204				rt = app.runtimeNamed(handoff.Runtime)
205			}
206			if rt == nil || rt.Name() != handoff.Runtime {
207				return fmt.Errorf("flow handoff backend %q is unavailable", handoff.Runtime)
208			}
209			return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
210		case taskflow.HandoffURL:
211			if handoff.URL == "" {
212				return errors.New("flow returned an empty URL handoff")
213			}
214			_, err := fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, handoff.URL)
215			return err
216		default:
217			return fmt.Errorf("flow returned unsupported handoff kind %q", handoff.Kind)
218		}
219	}

232	func availableFlowRepository(discovered gitx.Repo, preferred *repo.Repo, focus string) (flowRepository, error) {
233		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(discovered.GitCommonDir)
234		if err != nil {
235			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository identity: %w", err)
236		}
237		mainRoot := discovered.MainRoot
238		if mainRoot == "" && discovered.Bare {
239			mainRoot = discovered.GitCommonDir
240		}
241		mainRoot, err = pathx.Canonical(mainRoot)
242		if err != nil {
243			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository root: %w", err)
244		}
245		focusTarget := ""
246		if focus != "" {
247			focusTarget, err = pathx.Canonical(focus)
248			if err != nil {
249				return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow focus: %w", err)
250			}
251		}
252	
253		r := repo.Repo{
254			Name: discovered.Name, Path: mainRoot, RealPath: mainRoot,
255			CommonDir: commonDir, MainRoot: mainRoot, Bare: discovered.Bare, HasGit: true,
256		}
257		name := discovered.Name
258		if preferred != nil {
259			if preferred.Name != "" {
260				r.Name = preferred.Name
261			}
262			r.Root = preferred.Root
263			r.Category = preferred.Category
264			name = preferred.Display()
265			if name == "" {
266				name = r.Name
267			}
268		}
269		return flowRepository{
270			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
271				RepoKey: commonDir, Name: name, Path: mainRoot, Available: true,
272				FocusTarget: focusTarget,
273			},
274			repository: r,
275			available:  true,
276		}, nil
277	}

279	func unavailableFlowRepository(record task.Record, cause error) flowRepository {
280		path := record.Task.RepoPath

282			path = canonical
283		} else if absolute, absErr := filepath.Abs(path); absErr == nil {
284			path = filepath.Clean(absolute)

286		name := record.Task.Repo

288			name = filepath.Base(path)

292			message += ": " + cause.Error()
293		}
294		return flowRepository{

297				Available: false, Error: message,

299			available:        false,

301		}
302	}

402	func (l *flowLoader) ListRepositories(ctx context.Context) ([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, error) {
403		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
404			return nil, err
405		}
406		records, _, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
407		if taskErr != nil {
408			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list task-referenced repositories: %w", taskErr)
409		}
410		discovered, err := l.listRepo(ctx, l.app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
411		if err != nil {
412			return nil, err
413		}
414	
415		fresh := make(map[string]flowRepository)
416		l.mu.Lock()
417		for key := range l.pinned {
418			if existing, ok := l.repositories[key]; ok {
419				fresh[key] = existing
420			}
421		}
422		l.mu.Unlock()
423	
424		for index := range discovered {
425			candidate := discovered[index]
426			gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, candidate.Path)
427			if discoverErr != nil {
428				continue
429			}
430			entry, convertErr := availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, &candidate, "")
431			if convertErr != nil {
432				continue
433			}
434			if _, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
435				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
436			}
437		}
438	
439		pathResults := make(map[string]struct {
440			repository flowRepository
441			err        error
442		})
443		for _, record := range records {
444			path := record.Task.RepoPath
445			resolved, seen := pathResults[path]
446			if !seen {
447				gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, path)
448				if discoverErr == nil {
449					resolved.repository, discoverErr = availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, nil, "")
450				}
451				resolved.err = discoverErr
452				pathResults[path] = resolved
453			}
454			if resolved.err == nil {
455				if _, exists := fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
456					fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey] = resolved.repository
457				}
458				continue
459			}
460			entry := unavailableFlowRepository(record, resolved.err)
461			if existing, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; exists {
462				existing.unavailableTasks = appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(existing.unavailableTasks, record)
463				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = existing
464			} else {
465				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
466			}
467		}
468	
469		rows := make([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, 0, len(fresh))
470		for _, entry := range fresh {
471			rows = append(rows, entry.row)
472		}
473		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
474			left, right := strings.ToLower(rows[i].Name), strings.ToLower(rows[j].Name)
475			if left != right {
476				return left < right
477			}
478			if rows[i].Path != rows[j].Path {
479				return rows[i].Path < rows[j].Path
480			}
481			return rows[i].RepoKey < rows[j].RepoKey
482		})
483		l.mu.Lock()
484		l.repositories = fresh
485		l.mu.Unlock()
486		return rows, nil
487	}

498	func (l *flowLoader) LoadRepository(ctx context.Context, repoKey string) (flowtui.Snapshot, error) {

554		issues := make([]string, 0, 8)
555		if taskErr != nil {
556			issues = append(issues, "task inventory: "+taskErr.Error())
557		}
558		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
559			issues = append(issues, "task diagnostic: "+diagnostic.Error())
560		}
561		if contextSnapshot.IdentityErr != nil {
562			issues = append(issues, "repository identity: "+contextSnapshot.IdentityErr.Error())
563		}
564		if contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr != nil {
565			issues = append(issues, "worktree inventory: "+contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr.Error())
566		}
567		if rt.Name() != "none" && runtimeErr != nil {
568			issues = append(issues, "runtime observation: "+runtimeErr.Error())
569		}
570		for _, checkout := range contextSnapshot.Checkouts {
571			if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
572				issues = append(issues, "Git status "+checkout.Worktree.Path+": "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
573			}
574		}
575		issues = append(issues, projectionIssues...)
576		issues = uniqueStrings(issues)
577	
578		freshness := flowtui.FreshnessFresh
579		if len(issues) > 0 {
580			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
581		}
582		repositoryRow := selected.row
583		repositoryRow.Available = contextSnapshot.RepositoryID == repoKey && contextSnapshot.IdentityErr == nil
584		if contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != "" && contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != repoKey {
585			issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("repository identity changed from %s to %s", repoKey, contextSnapshot.RepositoryID))
586			repositoryRow.Available = false
587			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
588		}
589		snapshot := flowtui.Snapshot{
590			Repository: repositoryRow,
591			Surfaces:   flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
592			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(),
593			Freshness:  freshness,
594			Error:      strings.Join(uniqueStrings(issues), "; "),
595		}
596		l.mu.Lock()
597		l.targets[repoKey] = targets
598		if remote, exists := l.remote[repoKey]; exists {
599			snapshot.Remote = flowtui.SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
600		}
601		l.mu.Unlock()
602		return snapshot, nil
603	}
604	
605	func (l *flowLoader) unavailableSnapshot(selected flowRepository) flowtui.Snapshot {
606		rows := make([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, 0, len(selected.unavailableTasks))
607		for _, record := range selected.unavailableTasks {
608			tracked := record.Task
609			rows = append(rows, flowtui.SurfaceRow{
610				RowKey: tracked.ID, Kind: flowtui.SurfaceTaskOnly,
611				Label: tracked.Title(), Branch: tracked.Branch, Base: tracked.Base,
612				Mode: tracked.EffectiveMode(), State: tracked.State,
613				Drift: flowtui.NewLines("repository-unavailable: " + selected.row.Error),
614				Evidence: flowtui.NewLines(
615					"recorded repository path: "+tracked.RepoPath,
616					fmt.Sprintf("task: %s mode=%s state=%s", tracked.ID, tracked.EffectiveMode(), tracked.State),
617				),
618			})
619		}
620		l.mu.Lock()
621		l.targets[selected.row.RepoKey] = map[string]flowTarget{}
622		l.mu.Unlock()
623		return flowtui.Snapshot{
624			Repository: selected.row, Surfaces: flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
625			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(), Freshness: flowtui.FreshnessStale,
626			Error: selected.row.Error,
627		}
628	}
629	
630	func flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext) string {
631		if main, ok := contextSnapshot.Main(); ok && main.Worktree.Path != "" {
632			return main.Worktree.Path
633		}
634		for _, candidate := range []string{
635			contextSnapshot.Repo.MainRoot,
636			contextSnapshot.Repo.Path,
637			contextSnapshot.Repo.RealPath,
638			contextSnapshot.Repo.CommonDir,
639		} {
640			if candidate != "" {
641				return candidate
642			}
643		}
644		return ""
645	}
646	
647	func (l *flowLoader) projectRows(
648		ctx context.Context,
649		contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext,
650		service *taskflow.Service,
651		serviceErr error,
652		taskInventoryComplete bool,
653		defaultBase string,
654	) ([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, map[string]flowTarget, []string) {
655		rows := make([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, 0, len(contextSnapshot.Rows))
656		targets := make(map[string]flowTarget)
657		var issues []string
658		for _, contextRow := range contextSnapshot.Rows {
659			projected, rowIssues := l.projectRow(ctx, contextSnapshot, contextRow, service, serviceErr, taskInventoryComplete, defaultBase)
660			issues = append(issues, rowIssues...)
661	
662			validChoices := make([]flowtui.ActionChoice, 0, projected.Actions.Len())
663			for _, choice := range projected.Actions.Values() {
664				request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(projected.Locator, choice.Options())
665				if err != nil {
666					issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("row %s action %s: %v", projected.RowKey, choice.ID, err))
667					continue
668				}
669				target := flowTarget{
670					repoKey: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID, rowKey: projected.RowKey,
671					actionID: choice.ID, request: request,
672				}
673				targets[flowTargetKey(target.repoKey, target.rowKey, target.actionID)] = target
674				validChoices = append(validChoices, choice)
675			}
676			projected.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(validChoices...)
677			rows = append(rows, projected)
678		}
679		return rows, targets, issues
680	}
681	
682	func (l *flowLoader) projectRow(
683		ctx context.Context,
684		contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext,
685		contextRow inventory.RepoContextRow,
686		service *taskflow.Service,
687		serviceErr error,
688		taskInventoryComplete bool,
689		defaultBase string,
690	) (flowtui.SurfaceRow, []string) {
691		drift := topologyReasonLines(contextRow.DriftReasons)
692		conflicts := topologyReasonLines(contextRow.ConflictReasons)
693		var issues []string
694		var tracked *task.Task
695		if contextRow.TaskOnly() {
696			tracked = contextRow.Task
697		} else if contextRow.Checkout != nil && len(contextRow.Checkout.TaskBindings) == 1 {
698			tracked = contextRow.Checkout.TaskBindings[0].Task
699		}
700	
701		var managedLocator taskflow.Locator
702		managedExact := false
703		if tracked != nil {
704			if serviceErr != nil {
705				conflicts = append(conflicts, "locator-error: "+serviceErr.Error())
706				issues = append(issues, "managed locator "+tracked.ID+": "+serviceErr.Error())
707			} else if service != nil {
708				locator, err := service.LocateTask(ctx, tracked.ID)
709				if err != nil {
710					conflicts = append(conflicts, "locator-error: "+err.Error())
711					issues = append(issues, "managed locator "+tracked.ID+": "+err.Error())
712				} else if err := validateProjectedManagedLocator(contextSnapshot, contextRow, tracked, locator); err != nil {
713					conflicts = append(conflicts, "locator-mismatch: "+err.Error())
714					issues = append(issues, "managed locator "+tracked.ID+": "+err.Error())
715				} else {
716					managedLocator, managedExact = locator, true
717				}
718			}
719		}
720	
721		row := flowtui.SurfaceRow{
722			RowKey: contextRow.ID,
723			Kind:   flowtui.SurfaceTaskOnly,
724			Drift:  flowtui.NewLines(uniqueStrings(drift)...),
725			Base:   defaultBase,
726		}
727		if tracked != nil {
728			row.Label = tracked.Title()
729			row.Branch = tracked.Branch
730			row.Base = tracked.Base
731			row.Mode = tracked.EffectiveMode()
732			row.State = tracked.State
733			row.Locator = managedLocator
734		}
735	
736		if contextRow.Checkout != nil {
737			checkout := contextRow.Checkout
738			row.Path = checkout.ID
739			row.Branch = checkout.Branch()
740			row.Kind = classifyFlowCheckout(*checkout, tracked, managedExact, conflicts)
741			row.Label = flowCheckoutLabel(*checkout, tracked, row.Kind)
742			exactGitLocator := flowGitLocator(contextSnapshot, *checkout, defaultBase)
743			if !managedExact {
744				row.Locator = exactGitLocator
745			}
746			row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(flowCheckoutEvidence(contextSnapshot, *checkout)...)
747			if checkout.Exists && !checkout.Worktree.Bare && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
748				inspection, err := l.inspect(ctx, artifactStore(l.app), checkout.Worktree.Path)
749				row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(append(row.Evidence.Values(), artifactSummary(inspection, err))...)
750				if err != nil {
751					issues = append(issues, "artifact observation "+checkout.Worktree.Path+": "+err.Error())
752				}
753			}
754		} else if tracked != nil {
755			evidence := append([]string{
756				"repository path: " + tracked.RepoPath,
757				"checkout: no registered checkout is bound to this task",
758			}, flowTaskEvidence(tracked)...)
759			evidence = append(evidence, flowTaskOnlyRuntimeEvidence(contextSnapshot)...)
760			if tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
761				evidence = append(evidence, "recorded checkout: "+tracked.WorktreePath)
762			}
763			row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(evidence...)
764		}
765		if tracked != nil && contextRow.Checkout != nil {
766			row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(append(row.Evidence.Values(), flowTaskEvidence(tracked)...)...)
767		}
768	
769		conflicts = uniqueStrings(conflicts)
770		row.Conflicts = flowtui.NewLines(conflicts...)
771		if managedExact && len(conflicts) == 0 {
772			row.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(managedFlowChoices(*tracked)...)
773		} else if row.Kind == flowtui.SurfaceUnmanaged && taskInventoryComplete && exactFlowLocator(row.Locator) {
774			row.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(unmanagedFlowChoices(defaultBase)...)
775		}
776		if exactFlowRemoteLocator(row.Locator) {
777			choices := append(row.Actions.Values(), remoteFlowChoices()...)
778			row.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(choices...)
779		}
780		return row, issues
781	}
782	
783	func validateProjectedManagedLocator(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, row inventory.RepoContextRow, tracked *task.Task, locator taskflow.Locator) error {
784		if locator.RepoKey != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID || locator.RepositoryID != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID ||
785			locator.GitCommonDir != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID {
786			return errors.New("locator repository identity differs from inventory")
787		}
788		if locator.TaskID != tracked.ID || locator.Mode != tracked.EffectiveMode() || locator.State != tracked.State {
789			return errors.New("locator task identity, mode, or state differs from inventory")
790		}
791		if row.Checkout != nil && locator.CheckoutPath != row.Checkout.ID {
792			return fmt.Errorf("locator checkout %q differs from row %q", locator.CheckoutPath, row.Checkout.ID)
793		}
794		return nil
795	}
796	
797	func classifyFlowCheckout(checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, tracked *task.Task, managedExact bool, conflicts []string) flowtui.SurfaceKind {
798		switch {
799		case checkout.Worktree.Main:
800			return flowtui.SurfaceCanonical
801		case len(conflicts) > 0:
802			return flowtui.SurfaceConflict
803		case checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil:
804			return flowtui.SurfaceHarness
805		case tracked != nil && managedExact:
806			return flowtui.SurfaceManaged
807		default:
808			return flowtui.SurfaceUnmanaged
809		}
810	}
811	
812	func flowCheckoutLabel(checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, tracked *task.Task, kind flowtui.SurfaceKind) string {
813		branch := checkout.Branch()
814		if branch == "" {
815			branch = "detached HEAD"
816		}
817		if tracked != nil {
818			return tracked.Title() + " · " + branch
819		}
820		switch kind {
821		case flowtui.SurfaceCanonical:
822			return "Main · " + branch
823		case flowtui.SurfaceHarness:
824			return "Harness · " + branch
825		case flowtui.SurfaceConflict:
826			return "Conflict · " + branch
827		default:
828			return branch
829		}
830	}
831	
832	func flowGitLocator(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, base string) taskflow.Locator {
833		return taskflow.Locator{
834			RepoKey: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID, RowKey: checkout.ID, RowKind: "checkout",
835			RepositoryID: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID, GitCommonDir: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID,
836			RepoPath: flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot), CheckoutPath: checkout.ID,
837			Branch: checkout.Branch(), Base: base, Upstream: checkout.Status.Upstream, Remote: "origin",
838			HeadOID: checkout.Worktree.Head,
839		}
840	}
841	
842	func exactFlowLocator(locator taskflow.Locator) bool {
843		return locator.RepoKey != "" && locator.RepositoryID != "" && locator.GitCommonDir != "" &&
844			locator.RepoPath != "" && locator.CheckoutPath != "" && locator.Branch != "" && locator.HeadOID != ""
845	}
846	
847	func exactFlowRemoteLocator(locator taskflow.Locator) bool {
848		return locator.RepoKey != "" && locator.GitCommonDir != "" && locator.RepoPath != "" &&
849			locator.Branch != "" && locator.HeadOID != ""
850	}
851	
852	func flowCheckoutEvidence(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) []string {
853		branch := checkout.Branch()
854		if branch == "" {
855			branch = "(detached)"
856		}
857		lines := []string{
858			"path: " + checkout.Worktree.Path,
859			"branch: " + branch,
860			fmt.Sprintf("registered: Main=%t locked=%t prunable=%t bare=%t detached=%t HEAD=%s",
861				checkout.Worktree.Main, checkout.Worktree.Locked, checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
862				checkout.Worktree.Bare, checkout.Worktree.Detached, emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.Head)),
863		}
864		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
865			lines = append(lines, "registered lock reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason))
866		}
867		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
868			lines = append(lines, "registered prunable reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason))
869		}
870		switch {
871		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
872			lines = append(lines, "git: ERROR "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
873		case checkout.Worktree.Bare:
874			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (bare repository)")
875		case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
876			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (checkout unavailable)")
877		default:
878			cleanliness := "clean"
879			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
880				cleanliness = "dirty — " + checkout.Status.Breakdown()
881			}
882			lines = append(lines,
883				"git: "+cleanliness,
884				"upstream: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Status.Upstream),
885				fmt.Sprintf("ahead=%d behind=%d conflicted=%d", checkout.Status.Ahead, checkout.Status.Behind, checkout.Status.Conflicted),
886			)
887		}
888	
889		observation := checkout.RuntimeObservation
890		if observation.State == "" {
891			observation = contextSnapshot.RuntimeObservation
892		}
893		switch observation.State {
894		case inventory.ObservationAvailable:
895			if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
896				lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": observed; no covering sessions")
897			} else {
898				lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": observed")
899				for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
900					status := session.AgentStatus
901					if status == "" {
902						status = "unknown"
903					}
904					line := fmt.Sprintf("runtime session: %s:%s agent-state=%s", contextSnapshot.Runtime, emptyEvidence(session.Handle), status)
905					if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
906						line += " agents=" + strings.Join(session.AgentSessions, ",")
907					}
908					lines = append(lines, line)
909					for _, pane := range session.Panes {
910						if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" && pane.AgentStatus == "" {
911							continue
912						}
913						paneStatus := pane.AgentStatus
914						if paneStatus == "" {
915							paneStatus = "unknown"
916						}
917						lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("runtime agent pane: %s agent=%s state=%s session=%s",
918							emptyEvidence(pane.ID), emptyEvidence(pane.Agent), paneStatus, emptyEvidence(pane.AgentSession)))
919					}
920				}
921			}
922		case inventory.ObservationFailed:
923			message := "runtime observation failed"
924			if observation.Err != nil {
925				message += ": " + observation.Err.Error()
926			}
927			lines = append(lines, message)
928		default:
929			lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": unobserved; state is not known closed")
930		}
931		return lines
932	}
933	
934	func flowTaskOnlyRuntimeEvidence(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext) []string {
935		observation := contextSnapshot.RuntimeObservation
936		switch observation.State {
937		case inventory.ObservationAvailable:
938			return []string{"runtime " + emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime) + ": observed; task has no checkout whose coverage can be established"}
939		case inventory.ObservationFailed:
940			message := "runtime observation failed"
941			if observation.Err != nil {
942				message += ": " + observation.Err.Error()
943			}
944			return []string{message}
945		default:
946			return []string{"runtime " + emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime) + ": unobserved; state is not known closed"}
947		}
948	}
949	
950	func flowTaskEvidence(tracked *task.Task) []string {
951		if tracked == nil {
952			return nil
953		}
954		lines := []string{
955			fmt.Sprintf("task: %s mode=%s state=%s", tracked.ID, tracked.EffectiveMode(), tracked.State),
956			"task owner: " + emptyEvidence(tracked.Owner),
957			"task next: " + emptyEvidence(tracked.Next),
958			"base: " + emptyEvidence(tracked.Base),
959		}
960		if tracked.RuntimeName != "" || tracked.RuntimeHandle != "" {
961			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("task runtime hint: %s:%s", emptyEvidence(tracked.RuntimeName), emptyEvidence(tracked.RuntimeHandle)))
962		}
963		return lines
964	}
965	
966	func topologyReasonLines(reasons []inventory.TopologyReason) []string {
967		lines := make([]string, 0, len(reasons))
968		for _, reason := range reasons {
969			lines = append(lines, string(reason.Code)+": "+reason.Detail)
970		}
971		return uniqueStrings(lines)
972	}
973	
974	func artifactSummary(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection, err error) string {
975		if err != nil {
976			return "artifact: ERROR " + err.Error()
977		}
978		if inspection.KnownEmpty && len(inspection.Intents) == 0 {
979			return "artifact: ready; no intents"
980		}
981		counts := make(map[artifact.ReadinessState]int)
982		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
983			counts[intent.State]++
984		}
985		states := make([]string, 0, len(counts))
986		for state, count := range counts {
987			states = append(states, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%d", state, count))
988		}
989		sort.Strings(states)
990		readiness := "blocked or unknown"
991		if inspection.Ready() {
992			readiness = "ready"
993		}
994		if len(states) == 0 {
995			states = append(states, "no classified intents")
996		}
997		return "artifact: " + readiness + "; " + strings.Join(states, ", ")
998	}
999	
1000	func managedFlowChoices(tracked task.Task) []flowtui.ActionChoice {
1001		choice := func(id, label, description string, options taskflow.ActionOptions) flowtui.ActionChoice {
1002			return flowtui.NewActionChoice(id, label, description, options)
1003		}
1004		candidates := []flowtui.ActionChoice{
1005			choice("park-warm", "Park Warm", "Retain the checkout and branch while recording WARM intent.", taskflow.ParkWarmOptions{}),
1006			choice("park-cold", "Park Cold", "Require committed, pushed, reconstructible work before checkout cleanup.", taskflow.ParkColdOptions{}),
1007			choice("park-cold-push", "Park Cold + Push", "Push the branch, then park COLD only when every guard is ready.", taskflow.ParkColdOptions{Push: true}),
1008			choice("resume", "Resume", "Fetch refs and rebuild or reopen the exact task checkout.", taskflow.ResumeOptions{FetchRefs: true}),
1009			choice("complete-direct", "Complete Direct", "Record direct work DONE without changing dirty content.", taskflow.CompleteDirectOptions{Dirty: taskflow.DirtyFail}),
1010			choice("complete-ff", "Complete FF", "Fast-forward the explicit base only when dirty content needs no mutation.", taskflow.CompleteFFOptions{Dirty: taskflow.DirtyFail}),
1011			choice("review-handoff", "Review Handoff", "Push and create a review while preserving the current lifecycle state.", taskflow.ReviewHandoffOptions{Dirty: taskflow.DirtyFail}),
1012			choice("verify-merged", "Verify Merged", "Prove external integration before recording DONE.", taskflow.VerifyMergedOptions{Dirty: taskflow.DirtyFail}),
1013			choice("retire-keep-branch", "Retire (Keep Branch)", "Remove local task resources while retaining the branch.", taskflow.RetireOptions{}),
1014		}
1015		if tracked.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeDirect && tracked.Branch != tracked.Base {
1016			candidates = append(candidates,
1017				choice("retire-delete-branch", "Retire + Delete Contained Branch", "Delete the branch only when fresh containment evidence proves it safe.", taskflow.RetireOptions{DeleteBranch: true}),
1018			)
1019		}
1020	
1021		mode, state := tracked.EffectiveMode(), tracked.State
1022		choices := make([]flowtui.ActionChoice, 0, len(candidates))
1023		for _, candidate := range candidates {
1024			rule, found := taskflow.LookupTransition(mode, state, candidate.Action())
1025			if found && rule.Allowed {
1026				choices = append(choices, candidate)
1027			}
1028		}
1029		return choices
1030	}
1031	
1032	func unmanagedFlowChoices(base string) []flowtui.ActionChoice {
1033		choices := make([]flowtui.ActionChoice, 0, 2)
1034		if base != "" {
1035			choices = append(choices, flowtui.NewActionChoice(
1036				"adopt", "Adopt", "Create metadata for this exact linked checkout without changing Git content.",
1037				taskflow.AdoptOptions{Mode: task.ModeWorktree, Base: base},
1038			))
1039		}
1040		return append(choices, flowtui.NewActionChoice(
1041			"remove-checkout", "Remove Checkout", "Remove only a clean exact linked checkout and always preserve its branch.",
1042			taskflow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{},
1043		))
1044	}
1045	
1046	func remoteFlowChoices() []flowtui.ActionChoice {
1047		return []flowtui.ActionChoice{
1048			flowtui.NewActionChoice("remote-fetch", "Remote: Fetch Refs", "Fetch and prune the exact configured remote.", taskflow.RefreshRemoteOptions{FetchRefs: true}),
1049			flowtui.NewActionChoice("remote-review", "Remote: Query Review", "Query the exact head/base review relationship without fetching.", taskflow.RefreshRemoteOptions{QueryReview: true}),
1050			flowtui.NewActionChoice("remote-both", "Remote: Fetch + Review", "Fetch refs, then query the exact review relationship.", taskflow.RefreshRemoteOptions{FetchRefs: true, QueryReview: true}),
1051		}
1052	}
1053	
1054	func (l *flowLoader) Plan(
1055		ctx context.Context,
1056		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1057		locator taskflow.Locator,
1058		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1059	) (taskflow.Plan, error) {
1060		expected, request, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1061		if err != nil {
1062			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1063		}
1064		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1065		if err != nil {
1066			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1067		}
1068		service, err := l.service(rt)
1069		if err != nil {
1070			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1071		}
1072		plan, err := service.Plan(ctx, request)
1073		if err != nil {
1074			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1075		}
1076		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1077			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1078		}
1079		l.mu.Lock()
1080		l.approved[plan.PlanID] = flowApprovedPlan{target: expected, plan: plan.Clone()}
1081		l.mu.Unlock()
1082		return plan, nil
1083	}
1084	
1085	func (l *flowLoader) Apply(
1086		ctx context.Context,
1087		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1088		locator taskflow.Locator,
1089		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1090		plan taskflow.Plan,
1091		approval taskflow.Approval,
1092	) (taskflow.Result, error) {
1093		expected, _, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1094		if err != nil {
1095			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1096		}
1097		l.mu.Lock()
1098		approved, ok := l.approved[plan.PlanID]
1099		l.mu.Unlock()
1100		if !ok {
1101			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply rejected a plan not produced by this run")
1102		}
1103		if !sameFlowTarget(approved.target, expected) {
1104			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply target differs from the approved repository, row, action, locator, or options")
1105		}
1106		if !reflect.DeepEqual(approved.plan.Clone(), plan.Clone()) {
1107			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply plan differs from the exact approved plan")
1108		}
1109		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1110			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1111		}
1112		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1113		if err != nil {
1114			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1115		}
1116		service, err := l.service(rt)
1117		if err != nil {
1118			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1119		}
1120		result, applyErr := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
1121		l.mu.Lock()
1122		delete(l.approved, plan.PlanID)
1123		if remote, exists := result.RemoteObservation(); exists {
1124			l.remote[repoKey] = remote.Clone()
1125		}
1126		l.mu.Unlock()
1127		return result, applyErr
1128	}
1129	
1130	func (l *flowLoader) validateTarget(
1131		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1132		locator taskflow.Locator,
1133		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1134	) (flowTarget, taskflow.Request, error) {
1135		request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(locator, options)
1136		if err != nil {
1137			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, err
1138		}
1139		key := flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID)
1140		l.mu.Lock()
1141		expected, ok := l.targets[repoKey][key]
1142		l.mu.Unlock()
1143		if !ok {
1144			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action no longer matches the current repository snapshot")
1145		}
1146		actual := flowTarget{repoKey: repoKey, rowKey: rowKey, actionID: actionID, request: request}
1147		if !sameFlowTarget(expected, actual) {
1148			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action locator or options differ from the current exact row choice")
1149		}
1150		return expected, request, nil
1151	}
1152	
1153	func validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan taskflow.Plan, expected flowTarget) error {
1154		if err := plan.Validate(); err != nil {
1155			return err
1156		}
1157		if plan.Locator != expected.request.Locator || plan.Request.Locator != expected.request.Locator ||
1158			plan.Action != expected.request.Action || plan.Request.Action != expected.request.Action ||
1159			!reflect.DeepEqual(plan.Request.Options, expected.request.Options) {
1160			return errors.New("taskflow plan does not match the exact flow request identity")
1161		}
1162		return nil
1163	}
1164	
1165	func sameFlowTarget(left, right flowTarget) bool {
1166		return left.repoKey == right.repoKey && left.rowKey == right.rowKey && left.actionID == right.actionID &&
1167			left.request.Locator == right.request.Locator && left.request.Action == right.request.Action &&
1168			reflect.DeepEqual(left.request.Options, right.request.Options)
1169	}
1170	
1171	func flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID string) string {
1172		return repoKey + "\x00" + rowKey + "\x00" + actionID
1173	}
1174	
1175	func contextError(ctx context.Context) error {
1176		if ctx == nil {
1177			return errors.New("flow operation needs a context")
1178		}
1179		return ctx.Err()
1180	}
1181	
1182	func emptyEvidence(value string) string {
1183		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
1184			return "(none)"
1185		}
1186		return value
1187	}
1188	
1189	func uniqueStrings(values []string) []string {
1190		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(values))
1191		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
1192		for _, value := range values {
1193			if value == "" || seen[value] {
1194				continue
1195			}
1196			seen[value] = true
1197			out = append(out, value)
1198		}
1199		return out
1200	}
1201

122	// exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator converts a branch-selected checkout into the

125	func exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx context.Context, repoPath, checkoutPath string) (flow.Locator, error) {

135			GitCommonDir: registered.GitCommonDir,

141	}

203	func renderLifecycleResult(app *App, plan flow.Plan, result flow.Result) {
204		style := app.outStyle()
205		for _, step := range result.AttemptedSteps() {
206			if step.Status == flow.StepFailed {
207				label := step.Effect.Description
208				if label == "" {
209					label = string(step.Effect.Code)
210				}
211				failure := step.Failure
212				if failure == "" {
213					failure = "operation failed"
214				}
215				app.warnf("%s failed: %s", label, failure)
216				continue
217			}
218			if step.Status != flow.StepCompleted {
219				continue
220			}
221	
222			details := step.Effect.Details.Map()
223			switch step.Effect.Code {
224			case flow.EffectCommitWIP, flow.EffectCommitAll:
225				message := details["message"]
226				if message == "" {
227					message = step.Detail
228				}
229				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("committed"), message)
230			case flow.EffectDiscardAll:
231				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  checkout changes\n", style.label("discarded"))
232			case flow.EffectPushBranch, flow.EffectPushBase:
233				pushed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "pushed ")
234				pushed = strings.TrimPrefix(pushed, "published ")
235				if pushed == step.Detail || pushed == "" {
236					pushed = "origin/" + step.Effect.Target
237				}
238				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("pushed"), pushed)
239			case flow.EffectCloseRuntime:
240				closed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "closed ")
241				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("closed"), closed)
242			case flow.EffectRemoveWorktree:
243				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s removed: %s\n", style.label("worktree"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
244			case flow.EffectDeleteBranch:
245				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s deleted\n", style.label("branch"), step.Effect.Target)
246			case flow.EffectDeleteTask:
247				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s reaped\n", style.label("task"), step.Effect.Target)
248			case flow.EffectRebaseBranch:
249				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebased"), strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "rebased "))
250			case flow.EffectSwitchBase, flow.EffectSwitchBranch:
251				switched := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "switched ")
252				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("switched"), switched)
253			case flow.EffectMergeFF:
254				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("integrated"), step.Detail)
255			case flow.EffectCreateReview:
256				if handoff, ok := result.Handoff(); ok && handoff.Kind == flow.HandoffURL && handoff.URL != "" {
257					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("opened"), handoff.URL)
258				}
259			case flow.EffectVerifyAncestry:
260				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("verified"), step.Detail)
261			case flow.EffectUpdateTask:
262				if isCompletionAction(plan.Action) {
263					state := details["state"]
264					if state == "" {
265						state = "lifecycle state"
266					}
267					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("recorded"), strings.ToUpper(state))
268				}
269			case flow.EffectCreateWorktree:
270				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebuilt"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
271			}
272		}
273		for _, warning := range result.Warnings() {
274			switch warning {
275			case "no next action is recorded":
276				app.warnf("no next action recorded — `dev park --next \"...\"` is what makes resuming cheap")
277			default:
278				app.warnf("%s", warning)
279			}
280		}
281		for _, recovery := range result.Recovery() {
282			app.warnf("recovery: %s", recovery)
283		}
284	}
285	
286	func isCompletionAction(action flow.Action) bool {
287		switch action {
288		case flow.CompleteDirect, flow.CompleteFF, flow.ReviewHandoff, flow.VerifyMerged:
289			return true
290		default:
291			return false
292		}
293	}
294	
295	func presentLifecycleRequestError(selected task.Task, action flow.Action, err error) error {
296		var transition *flow.InvalidTransitionError
297		if !errors.As(err, &transition) {
298			return err
299		}
300		if action == flow.ParkCold && selected.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
301			return fmt.Errorf("direct task %s uses the canonical checkout on %s, so it cannot go cold; park it warm or finish it: %w",
302				selected.Title(), selected.Branch, err)
303		}
304		if action == flow.Retire {
305			return fmt.Errorf("task %s is %s, not merged; run dev done first: %w", selected.ID, selected.State, err)
306		}
307		return err
308	}
309	
310	func presentLifecycleApplyError(plan flow.Plan, err error) error {
311		if !errors.Is(err, flow.ErrPlanNotReady) {
312			return err
313		}
314		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
315		for _, condition := range blocking {
316			switch condition.Code {
317			case flow.ConditionCheckoutClean:
318				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
319					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes (%s).\nCommit them, or re-run with --force to discard them: %w",
320						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
321				}
322				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
323					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes; going cold removes the worktree.\nCommit them, or re-run with --wip to checkpoint automatically: %w",
324						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), err)
325				}
326			case flow.ConditionBranchPublished, flow.ConditionBranchPushed:
327				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
328					return fmt.Errorf("%s is not fully pushed (%s); a cold task must be reconstructible from the remote.\nRun `dev park --cold --push`: %w",
329						plan.Locator.Branch, condition.Evidence, err)
330				}
331			case flow.ConditionTaskClaims:
332				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
333					return fmt.Errorf("%s is claimed by task metadata (%s).\nUse managed dev park/dev retire, or reconcile the task claim before removing this checkout: %w",
334						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
335				}
336			case flow.ConditionTaskInventory:
337				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
338					return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove %s is unmanaged because task inventory is incomplete (%s).\nRepair or reconcile task metadata before using dev park/dev retire or removing this checkout: %w",
339						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
340				}
341			case flow.ConditionOwner:
342				if plan.Action == flow.Resume {
343					owner := plan.AuthorityFields()["task.owner"]
344					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is owned by %s.\nMake sure that machine has pushed its work, then re-run with --force to take ownership: %w",
345						plan.Locator.TaskID, owner, err)
346				}
347			case flow.ConditionAgentOccupancy:
348				if plan.Action == flow.Resume && strings.HasPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ") {
349					occupant := strings.TrimPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ")
350					return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership: %w",
351						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), occupant, err)
352				}
353			}
354		}
355	
356		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
357		for _, condition := range blocking {
358			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
359			if condition.Remediation != "" {
360				message += " (" + condition.Remediation + ")"
361			}
362			parts = append(parts, message)
363		}
364		if len(parts) == 0 {
365			return err
366		}
367		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability, strings.Join(parts, "; "), err)
368	}

181	func (o lifecycleObservation) hasCheckout() bool {
182		return o.worktreeFound && o.checkout != ""
183	}

186		return o.worktreeFound && o.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree()
187	}

189	func (o lifecycleObservation) desiredNext(options ActionOptions) string {
190		next := o.task.Next
191		switch value := options.(type) {
192		case ParkWarmOptions:
193			if value.Next != "" {
194				next = value.Next
195			}
196		case ParkColdOptions:
197			if value.Next != "" {
198				next = value.Next
199			}
200		}
201		return next
202	}

205		return retire.Options{
206			CWD:               o.taskflowCWD,
207			CallerWorkspaceID: o.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
208			CallerPaneID:      o.taskflowCallerPane,
209			CloseUnknown:      closeUnknown,
210			AssumeNoRuntime:   assumeNoRuntime,
211			Timeout:           timeout,
212		}

232	// executionState accumulates one final-status entry per declared effect.
233	type executionState struct {
234		service  *lifecycleService
235		plan     Plan
236		observed lifecycleObservation
237		tx       *task.Tx
238		revision string
239	
240		steps     []StepResult
241		warnings  []string
242		recovery  []string
243		snapshot  string
244		handoff   *Handoff
245		remote    *RemoteObservation
246		milestone Milestone
247		partial   bool
248	
249		resumePath          string
250		resumeRuntimeName   string
251		resumeRuntimeHandle string
252	}
253	
254	func (e *executionState) run(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error)) error {
255		step := StepResult{Effect: effect.Clone(), Status: StepAttempted, StartedAt: e.service.now()}
256		detail, err := operation()
257		step.FinishedAt = e.service.now()
258		step.Detail = detail
259		if err != nil {
260			step.Status = StepFailed
261			step.Failure = err.Error()
262			e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
263			return err
264		}
265		step.Status = StepCompleted
266		e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
267		return nil
268	}
269	
270	func (e *executionState) runWarning(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error), warningPrefix string) {
271		err := e.run(effect, operation)
272		if err != nil {
273			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, warningPrefix+": "+err.Error())
274		}
275	}
276	
277	func (e *executionState) result() Result {
278		spec := ResultSpec{
279			Steps: e.steps, Warnings: e.warnings, Recovery: e.recovery,
280			PartialSuccess: e.partial,
281			Milestone:      e.milestone, Handoff: e.handoff, Remote: e.remote, FreshSnapshotRef: e.snapshot,
282		}
283		for _, step := range e.steps {
284			if step.Status == StepCompleted {
285				spec.PartialSuccess = true
286				break
287			}
288		}
289		if len(e.steps) > 0 && e.steps[len(e.steps)-1].Status == StepCompleted &&
290			(e.snapshot != "" || e.remote != nil) && len(e.recovery) == 0 {
291			// Successful completion is not partial merely because it had effects.
292			// Remote refresh is intentionally run-local and therefore completes with
293			// structured data rather than a persisted snapshot reference.
294			spec.PartialSuccess = false
295		}
296		return NewResult(spec)
297	}
298	
299	func (e *executionState) fail(err error, recovery ...string) (Result, error) {
300		e.recovery = append(e.recovery, recovery...)
301		return e.result(), err
302	}
303	
304	func boolString(value bool) string { return strconv.FormatBool(value) }
305	
306	func errorString(err error) string {
307		if err == nil {
308			return ""
309		}
310		return err.Error()
311	}

313	func condition(code ConditionCode, verdict Verdict, requirement Requirement, evidence, remediation string) Condition {
314		return Condition{Code: code, Verdict: verdict, Requirement: requirement, Evidence: evidence, Remediation: remediation}
315	}

317	func stringifyStatus(status gitx.Status) string {
318		return strings.Join([]string{
319			status.Branch,

336	func authorityHash(domain string, values ...string) string {
337		writer := newIdentityWriter(domain)
338		for index, value := range values {
339			writer.addString(strconv.Itoa(index), value)
340		}
341		return "sha256:" + writer.sumHex()
342	}

423		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {

425			for _, pane := range session.Panes {
426				values = append(values, pane.ID, pane.CWD, pane.ShellCWD, pane.Agent, pane.AgentStatus, pane.AgentSession)
427			}

436				agent.Activity.Name, agent.Status, agent.Activity.CWD,

476	func occupancyObservationError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
477		if err != nil {
478			return err
479		}
480		if occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
481			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current %s runtime pane: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.CurrentPane.Err)
482		}
483		if occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
484			return fmt.Errorf("classify %s checkout coverage: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.SessionCoverageErr)
485		}
486		if occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil {
487			return fmt.Errorf("list %s runtime sessions: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.SessionList.Err)
488		}
489		if occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
490			return fmt.Errorf("list %s recognized agents: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err)
491		}
492		return nil
493	}
494	
495	func strictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
496		if observationErr := occupancyObservationError(occupancy, err); observationErr != nil {
497			return observationErr
498		}
499		var blockers []string
500		for _, agent := range occupancy.Agents {
501			if !agent.Blocking {
502				continue
503			}
504			label := agent.Activity.Name
505			if label == "" {
506				label = agent.Activity.Agent
507			}
508			if label == "" {
509				label = "agent"
510			}
511			blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, agent.Activity.PaneID))
512		}
513		if len(blockers) > 0 {
514			return fmt.Errorf("checkout is occupied by %s", strings.Join(blockers, ", "))
515		}
516		return nil
517	}
518	
519	func (s *lifecycleService) writerOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
520		if s.allowSharedCheckout {
521			return occupancyObservationError(occupancy, err)
522		}
523		return strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err)
524	}
525	
526	func savedHandleLive(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, handle string) bool {
527		if handle == "" {
528			return false
529		}
530		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
531			if session.Runtime.Handle == handle {
532				return true
533			}
534		}
535		return false
536	}
537	
538	func staleBoundary(reason string) error {
539		return &StalePlanError{Reason: reason}
540	}

542	func isWorktreeNotFound(err error) bool { return errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) }

544	func contextError(ctx context.Context) error {
545		if ctx == nil {
546			return errors.New("taskflow context is nil")
547		}
548		return ctx.Err()
549	}

174	// NewLifecycleService installs the concrete guarded parking, resume, and
175	// completion handlers. Actions without complete policy implementations remain
176	// unavailable rather than falling back to an unsafe generic executor.
177	func NewLifecycleService(input LifecycleConfig) (*Service, error) {
178		implementation, err := newLifecycleImplementation(input)
179		if err != nil {
180			return nil, err
181		}
182		service := NewService(Handlers{
183			ParkWarm:       implementation.handler(ParkWarm),
184			ParkCold:       implementation.handler(ParkCold),
185			Resume:         implementation.handler(Resume),
186			CompleteDirect: implementation.handler(CompleteDirect),
187			CompleteFF:     implementation.handler(CompleteFF),
188			ReviewHandoff:  implementation.handler(ReviewHandoff),
189			VerifyMerged:   implementation.handler(VerifyMerged),
190			Retire:         implementation.retireHandler(),
191			Adopt:          implementation.adoptHandler(),
192			RemoveCheckout: implementation.removeCheckoutHandler(),
193			RefreshRemote:  implementation.refreshRemoteHandler(),
194		})
195		service.locateTask = implementation.locateExactTask
196		return service, nil
197	}

199	func newLifecycleImplementation(input LifecycleConfig) (*lifecycleService, error) {
200		if input.Tasks == nil {

202		}
203		if input.Artifacts == nil {
204			return nil, errors.New("taskflow lifecycle service requires an artifact store")
205		}

207			return nil, fmt.Errorf("taskflow lifecycle config: %w", err)
208		}

212			host = config.Hostname()
213		}
214		if host == "" || host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
215			return nil, errors.New("taskflow lifecycle host must be normalized")
216		}
217		cwd := input.CWD

220			cwd, err = os.Getwd()

222				return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve taskflow caller directory: %w", err)
223			}

225		callerWorkspace := input.CallerWorkspaceID

227			callerWorkspace = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
228		}
229		callerPane := input.CallerPaneID
230		if callerPane == "" {
231			callerPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
232			if callerPane == "" {
233				callerPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
234			}
235		}
236		clock := input.Clock
237		if clock == nil {
238			clock = time.Now
239		}
240		logf := input.Logf
241		if logf == nil {
242			logf = func(string, ...any) {}
243		}
244	
245		defaultRuntime := input.DefaultRuntime
246		if defaultRuntime == nil {
247			defaultRuntime = func() runtime.Runtime {
248				return configuredRuntime(input.Config, input.Config.Runtime.Backend)
249			}
250		}
251		namedRuntime := input.NamedRuntime
252		if namedRuntime == nil {
253			namedRuntime = func(name string) runtime.Runtime {
254				return configuredRuntime(input.Config, name)
255			}
256		}
257	
258		s := &lifecycleService{
259			cfg: input.Config, tasks: input.Tasks, artifacts: input.Artifacts,
260			defaultRuntime: defaultRuntime, namedRuntime: namedRuntime,
261			host: host, cwd: cwd,
262			callerWorkspace: callerWorkspace, callerPane: callerPane,
263			allowSharedCheckout: input.AllowSharedCheckout,
264			clock:               clock, logf: logf,
265			repoLock: func(ctx context.Context, commonDir string, operation func() error) error {
266				return lockx.WithDir(ctx, filepath.Join(commonDir, "dev-taskflow"), "taskflow repository", operation)
267			},
268			gitDiscover: gitx.Discover,
269			gitStatus:   gitx.StatusOf,
270			gitInProgress: func(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, bool, error) {
271				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
272					return "", false, err
273				}
274				return gitx.InProgress(dir)
275			},
276			gitRun:           gitx.Run,
277			gitRemote:        gitx.Remote,
278			gitRefExists:     gitx.RefExists,
279			gitDefaultBranch: gitx.DefaultBranch,
280			gitWorktrees:     gitx.Worktrees,
281			resolveWorktree:  gitx.ResolveRegisteredWorktree,
282			wipCommit:        gitx.WipCommit,
283			analyzeFinish:    gitx.AnalyzeFinish,
284			commitAll:        gitx.CommitAllChanges,
285			discardAll:       gitx.DiscardAllChanges,
286			isAncestor:       gitIsAncestor,
287			removeWorktree:   gitx.RemoveWorktree,
288			inspectArtifacts: artifact.InspectReadiness,
289			inspectOccupancy: runtime.InspectOccupancy,
290			inspectCleanup:   retire.Inspect,
291			closeAndWait:     retire.CloseAndWait,
292			openRuntime:      openRuntimeSurface,
293			detectForge:      forge.Detect,
294			resolveForge:     forge.For,
295			createPR: func(ctx context.Context, provider forge.Forge, dir string, request forge.PRRequest) (string, error) {
296				if provider == nil {
297					return "", errors.New("create review: no forge provider")
298				}
299				return provider.CreatePR(ctx, dir, request)
300			},
301			queryReview: func(ctx context.Context, provider forge.Forge, dir string, query forge.ReviewQuery) (*forge.Review, error) {
302				if provider == nil {
303					return nil, errors.New("query review: no forge provider")
304				}
305				return forge.QueryReview(ctx, provider, dir, query)
306			},
307			taskCreate: func(tx *task.Tx, candidate *task.Task) (*task.Record, error) {
308				return tx.Create(candidate)

311				return tx.Update(candidate, revision)

326	func configuredRuntime(cfg config.Config, name string) runtime.Runtime {
327		rt := runtime.Select(name)
328		if herdr, ok := rt.(*runtime.Herdr); ok {
329			return herdr.WithMetadataSource(cfg.Runtime.MetadataSource)
330		}
331		return rt
332	}

334	func applyLifecycleHooks(s *lifecycleService, hooks LifecycleHooks) {
335		if hooks.RepoLock != nil {
336			s.repoLock = hooks.RepoLock
337		}
338		if hooks.GitDiscover != nil {
339			s.gitDiscover = hooks.GitDiscover
340		}
341		if hooks.GitStatus != nil {
342			s.gitStatus = hooks.GitStatus
343		}
344		if hooks.GitInProgress != nil {
