440	func (s *lifecycleService) runtimeFor(candidate task.Task) (runtime.Runtime, error) {
441		var rt runtime.Runtime
442		if candidate.RuntimeHandle != "" && candidate.RuntimeName != "" {
443			rt = s.namedRuntime(candidate.RuntimeName)
444			if rt == nil {
445				return nil, fmt.Errorf("recorded runtime backend %q is unavailable", candidate.RuntimeName)
446			}
447			if rt.Name() != candidate.RuntimeName {
448				return nil, fmt.Errorf("recorded runtime backend %q resolved to %q", candidate.RuntimeName, rt.Name())
449			}
450		} else {
451			rt = s.defaultRuntime()
452		}
453		if rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "" {
454			return nil, errors.New("taskflow runtime resolver returned no backend")
455		}
456		return rt, nil
457	}
458	
459	func openRuntimeSurface(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, path, label string) (runtime.OpenResult, error) {
460		if rt == nil {
461			return runtime.OpenResult{}, errors.New("open runtime: no backend")
462		}
463		if worktreeRuntime, ok := rt.(runtime.WorktreeOpener); ok {
464			return worktreeRuntime.OpenWorktree(ctx, path, label)
465		}
466		return rt.Open(ctx, path, label)
467	}

473			if line != "" {

475			}

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}

50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:

65		case CompleteDirect:

67		case CompleteFF:

69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}

88	func validateLifecycleLocator(locator Locator) error {
89		switch {
90		case locator.TaskID == "":
91			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact TaskID is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
92		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
93			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
94		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
95			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
96		case locator.RepoPath == "":
97			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
98		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
99			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
100		case locator.Branch == "":
101			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
102		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
103			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
104		case !validState(locator.State):
105			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
106		}
107		return nil
108	}
109	
110	func validateRecordIdentity(locator Locator, record task.Record) error {
111		candidate := record.Task
112		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
113		if record.Revision != locator.TaskRevision {
114			return staleTaskRevision(locator.TaskRevision, record.Revision, "task revision no longer matches the selected row")
115		}
116		checks := []struct {
117			name     string
118			expected string
119			actual   string
120		}{
121			{"TaskID", locator.TaskID, candidate.ID},
122			{"mode", string(locator.Mode), string(mode)},
123			{"state", string(locator.State), string(candidate.State)},
124			{"branch", locator.Branch, candidate.Branch},
125			{"base", locator.Base, candidate.Base},
126		}
127		for _, check := range checks {
128			if check.expected != check.actual {
129				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
130			}
131		}
132	
133		selectedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(locator.RepoPath)
134		if err != nil {
135			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.RepoPath, err)}
136		}
137		recordedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate.RepoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.RepoPath, err)}
140		}
141		if selectedRepo != recordedRepo {
142			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task repository path changed from %q to %q", selectedRepo, recordedRepo)}
143		}
144	
145		expectedCheckout := recordedRepo
146		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
147			expectedCheckout = ""
148			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
149				expectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(candidate.WorktreePath)
150				if err != nil {
151					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.WorktreePath, err)}
152				}
153			}
154		}
155		selectedCheckout := ""
156		if locator.CheckoutPath != "" {
157			selectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(locator.CheckoutPath)
158			if err != nil {
159				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.CheckoutPath, err)}
160			}
161		}
162		if selectedCheckout != expectedCheckout {
163			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task checkout path changed from %q to %q", selectedCheckout, expectedCheckout)}
164		}
165		return nil
166	}

170			ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: expected,
171			ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   actual,
172			Reason:                       reason,
173		}
174	}

176	func (s *lifecycleService) observeLifecycle(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (lifecycleObservation, error) {
177		observed := lifecycleObservation{record: record, task: record.Task, mode: record.Task.EffectiveMode()}
178		observed.setCaller(s.host, s.cwd, s.callerWorkspace, s.callerPane)
179	
180		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
181		if err != nil {
182			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, record.Task.ID, err)
183		}
184		observed.repo = repository
185		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
186		if err != nil {
187			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
188		}
189		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
190		if err != nil {
191			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
192		}
193		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(record.Task.RepoPath)
194		if err != nil {
195			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
196		}
197		if recordedRepo != observed.repoPath {
198			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q", record.Task.RepoPath, recordedRepo, observed.repoPath)}
199		}
200		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
201		if err != nil {
202			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
203		}
204		if requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
205			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("Git common directory changed from %q to %q", requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir)}
206		}
207		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
208			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
209			if keyErr != nil {
210				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
211			}
212			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
213				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository key changed from %q to %q", requestedKey, observed.gitCommonDir)}
214			}
215		}
216	
217		s.observeCheckout(ctx, request, &observed)
218		if observed.hasCheckout() {
219			observed.status, observed.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
220			if observed.statusErr == nil {
221				observed.head, observed.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
222				observed.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.head)
223				observed.baseOID, observed.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
224				observed.upstreamOID, observed.upstreamOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.status.Upstream)
225				observed.operation, observed.inProgress, observed.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
226			}
227		}
228		s.observeActionRefs(ctx, request, &observed)
229		if err := validateLiveLocator(request.Locator, observed); err != nil {
230			return observed, err
231		}
232	
233		if isCompletionAction(request.Action) {
234			s.observeCompletionFacts(ctx, request, &observed)
235		}
236		observed.runtime, observed.runtimeErr = s.runtimeFor(observed.task)
237		if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
238			observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
239			s.observeActionRuntime(ctx, request, &observed)
240		}
241		return observed, nil
242	}
243	
244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
248			observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
249			if err == nil {
250				observed.worktreeFound = true
251				observed.checkout = registered.Path
252			}
253		case task.ModeWorktree:
254			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
255				registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.WorktreePath)
256				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
257				if err == nil {
258					observed.worktreeFound = true
259					observed.checkout = registered.Path
260				}
261			}
262			if observed.worktreeFound || request.Action != Resume ||
263				(observed.task.State != task.Warm && observed.task.State != task.Cold) {
264				return
265			}
266			worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
267			if err != nil {
268				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("list worktrees for parked-task resume: %w", err)
269				return
270			}
271			var candidate string
272			for _, worktree := range worktrees {
273				if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
274					observed.branchMatches++
275					candidate = worktree.Path
276				}
277			}
278			switch observed.branchMatches {
279			case 0:
280				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
281					observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has no checkout", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, observed.task.Branch)
282				}
283			case 1:
284				registered, resolveErr := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, candidate)
285				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, resolveErr
286				if resolveErr == nil {
287					observed.worktreeFound = true
288					observed.checkout = registered.Path
289				}
290			default:
291				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has %d registered checkouts", gitx.ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, observed.task.Branch, observed.branchMatches)
292			}
293		}
294	}
295	
296	func validateLiveLocator(locator Locator, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
297		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.hasCheckout() {
298			checks := []struct {
299				name     string
300				expected string
301				actual   string
302				required bool
303			}{
304				{"upstream", locator.Upstream, observed.status.Upstream, true},
305				{"HEAD", locator.HeadOID, observed.head, locator.HeadOID != ""},
306				{"base OID", locator.BaseOID, observed.baseOID, locator.BaseOID != ""},
307				{"upstream OID", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.upstreamOID, locator.UpstreamOID != ""},
308			}
309			for _, check := range checks {
310				if check.required && check.expected != check.actual {
311					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
312				}
313			}
314			return nil
315		}
316		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.HeadOID != "" {
317			if observed.localBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.HeadOID != observed.localBranchOID {
318				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected local branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.HeadOID, observed.localBranchOID)}
319			}
320		}
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.UpstreamOID != "" && locator.Upstream == observed.remoteBranch {
322			if observed.remoteBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.UpstreamOID != observed.remoteBranchOID {
323				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected remote branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.remoteBranchOID)}
324			}
325		}
326		return nil
327	}

329	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRuntime(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
330		switch options := request.Options.(type) {
331		case ParkWarmOptions:
332			if options.KeepSession || !observed.hasCheckout() {
333				return
334			}
335			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
336			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
337		case ParkColdOptions:
338			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
339				return
340			}
341			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
342			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
343			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
344				observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
345			}
346		case ResumeOptions:
347			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
348				return
349			}
350			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
351				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
352				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
353				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
354			})
355			if s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) == nil {
356				observed.savedRuntimeLive = savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
357			}
358		case CompleteDirectOptions, CompleteFFOptions, ReviewHandoffOptions, VerifyMergedOptions:
359			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
360				return
361			}
362			occupancyOptions := runtime.OccupancyOptions{
363				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
364				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
365				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
366			}
367			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, occupancyOptions)
368			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
369				observed.integration.occupancy = observed.occupancy
370				observed.integration.occupancyErr = observed.occupancyErr
371			}
372			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.integration.worktreeFound {
373				observed.integration.occupancy, observed.integration.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(
374					ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, occupancyOptions,
375				)
376			}
377		}
378	}

380	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRefs(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
381		observed.localBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
382		if observed.localBranchExists {
383			observed.localBranchOID, observed.localBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
384		}
385		observed.remoteBranch = "origin/" + observed.task.Branch
386		observed.remoteBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
387		if observed.remoteBranchExists {
388			observed.remoteBranchOID, observed.remoteBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
389		}
390	
391		switch request.Action {
392		case ParkCold:
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
394				observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
395				if observed.baseRef == "" {
396					observed.baseRef = s.gitDefaultBranch(ctx, observed.repoPath)
397				}
398				observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
399			}
400		case Resume:
401			observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
402			if observed.remoteBranchExists {
403				observed.baseRef = observed.remoteBranch
404			}
405			observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
406			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !observed.hasCheckout() &&
407				(observed.task.State == task.Warm || observed.task.State == task.Cold) {
408				if observed.task.State == task.Warm && observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
409					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.canonicalPath(observed.task.WorktreePath)
410				} else {
411					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.renderWorktreePath(observed.task)
412				}
413				if observed.desiredWorktreeErr == nil {
414					observed.desiredWorktreeErr = wt.ValidateTarget(observed.desiredWorktree, observed.repoPath)
415				}
416			}
417		case CompleteDirect:
418			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Branch
419		case CompleteFF, ReviewHandoff:
420			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
421		case VerifyMerged:
422			options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
423			observed.completionBaseRef = options.BaseRef
424			if observed.completionBaseRef == "" {
425				observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
426			}
427		}
428	}

431		values := config.Vars{
432			"worktree_root": config.Expand(s.cfg.Paths.WorktreeRoot),
433			"repo":          candidate.Repo,
434			"repo_path":     candidate.RepoPath,
435			"branch":        candidate.Branch,
436			"category":      "",
437			"host":          s.host,

439		}
440		rendered, err := config.Render(s.cfg.Paths.WorktreePath, values)
441		if err != nil {

443		}
444		return s.canonicalPath(config.Expand(rendered))

568	func appendOptionAuthority(authority map[string]string, options ActionOptions) {
569		switch value := options.(type) {
570		case ParkWarmOptions:
571			authority["option.next"] = value.Next
572			authority["option.note"] = value.Note
573			authority["option.commit-wip"] = boolString(value.CommitWIP)
574			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
575			authority["option.keep-session"] = boolString(value.KeepSession)
576			authority["option.close-unknown"] = boolString(value.CloseUnknown)
577			authority["option.assume-no-runtime"] = boolString(value.AssumeNoRuntime)
578			authority["option.timeout"] = value.Timeout.String()
579		case ParkColdOptions:
580			authority["option.next"] = value.Next
581			authority["option.note"] = value.Note
582			authority["option.commit-wip"] = boolString(value.CommitWIP)
583			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
584			authority["option.close-unknown"] = boolString(value.CloseUnknown)
585			authority["option.assume-no-runtime"] = boolString(value.AssumeNoRuntime)
586			authority["option.timeout"] = value.Timeout.String()
587		case ResumeOptions:
588			authority["option.fetch-refs"] = boolString(value.FetchRefs)
589			authority["option.no-provision"] = boolString(value.NoProvision)
590			authority["option.take-ownership"] = boolString(value.TakeOwnership)
591		case CompleteDirectOptions:
592			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
593			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
594		case CompleteFFOptions:
595			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
596			authority["option.push-base"] = boolString(value.PushBase)
597		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
598			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
599			authority["option.draft"] = boolString(value.Draft)
600			authority["option.title"] = value.Title
601			authority["option.body"] = value.Body
602		case VerifyMergedOptions:
603			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
604			authority["option.base-ref"] = value.BaseRef
605			authority["option.squash-commit"] = value.SquashCommit
606			authority["option.push-base"] = boolString(value.PushBase)
607		}
608	}

610	func appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority map[string]string, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) {
611		authority["option.dirty"] = string(dirty)
612		authority["option.commit-message"] = message
613	}

622	func (s *lifecycleService) resolveRefOID(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) (string, error) {
623		if ref == "" {
624			return "", nil
625		}
626		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", ref+"^{commit}")
627		return strings.TrimSpace(value), err

15	func (s *lifecycleService) applyGuarded(ctx context.Context, action Action, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
16		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
17			return Result{}, err
18		}
19		if approved.Action != action {
20			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("handler %s received %s", action, approved.Action)}
21		}
22		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
23			return Result{}, err
24		}
25		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
28		}
29	
30		var result Result
31		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
32			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
33				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
34				if loadErr != nil {
35					return &StalePlanError{
36						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID,
37						Reason:         "task record disappeared before apply",
38					}
39				}
40				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
41					return identityErr
42				}
43				fresh, observed, planErr := s.freshPlan(ctx, approved.Request, *record)
44				if planErr != nil {
45					return planErr
46				}
47				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
48				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
49					actual := ""
50					if current != nil {
51						actual = current.Revision
52					}
53					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked plan rebuild")
54				}
55				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
56					return &StalePlanError{
57						ExpectedPlanID:               approved.PlanID,
58						ActualPlanID:                 fresh.PlanID,
59						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
60						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
61						Reason:                       "fresh task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or option authority differs",
62					}
63				}
64				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
65					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
66					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
67				}
68	
69				execution := &executionState{
70					service: s, plan: fresh, observed: observed, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision,
71				}
72				var applyErr error
73				switch action {
74				case ParkWarm:
75					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkWarm(ctx)
76				case ParkCold:
77					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkCold(ctx)
78				case Resume:
79					result, applyErr = execution.applyResume(ctx)
80				case CompleteDirect:
81					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteDirect(ctx)
82				case CompleteFF:
83					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteFF(ctx)
84				case ReviewHandoff:
85					result, applyErr = execution.applyReviewHandoff(ctx)
86				case VerifyMerged:
87					result, applyErr = execution.applyVerifyMerged(ctx)
88				default:
89					applyErr = &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: action, Stage: "apply"}
90				}
91				return applyErr
92			})
93		})
94		return result, err
95	}

97	func (e *executionState) applyParkWarm(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
98		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ParkWarmOptions)
99		observed := &e.observed
100		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() && !options.CommitWIP {
101			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, observed.checkout+" has uncommitted changes; bytes remain in place")
102		}
103		if observed.desiredNext(options) == "" {
104			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "no next action is recorded")
105		}
106		if !options.KeepSession && observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
107			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "runtime remains active because the caller is contained; exit normally and reconcile later")
108		}
109	
110		closedRuntime := false
111		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
112			switch effect.Code {
113			case EffectCommitWIP:
114				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
115					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task and retry warm parking")
116				}
117				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
118					made, commitErr := e.service.wipCommit(ctx, observed.checkout, effect.Details.Map()["message"])
119					if commitErr != nil {
120						return "", fmt.Errorf("checkpoint WIP: %w", commitErr)
121					}
122					if !made {
123						return "no product changes required a checkpoint", nil
124					}
125					return "created WIP checkpoint", nil
126				})
127				if err != nil {
128					return e.fail(err, "preserve the checkout and retry after fixing the checkpoint failure")
129				}
130				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
131					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after WIP checkpoint: %w", err), "inspect the committed checkpoint before retrying")
132				}
133			case EffectPushBranch:
134				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
135					return e.fail(err, "inspect the checkout and retry the push")
136				}
137				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
138					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
139					if pushErr != nil {
140						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
141					}
142					return "pushed origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
143				})
144				if err != nil {
145					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains present; resolve the push and retry warm parking")
146				}
147				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
148					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after push: %w", err), "inspect the published branch before retrying")
149				}
150			case EffectCloseRuntime:
151				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
152					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task and retry runtime closure")
153				}
154				if err := e.service.revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx, *observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
155					return e.fail(err, "inspect runtime occupancy from outside the checkout")
156				}
157				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
158					closed, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
159						observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout))
160					if closeErr != nil {
161						return "", closeErr
162					}
163					observed.cleanup = closed
164					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", closed.ClosedSessions, observed.runtime.Name()), nil
165				})
166				if err != nil {
167					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and task record remain; inspect runtime occupancy and retry")
168				}
169				if err := e.service.ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx, observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
170					return e.fail(err, "a runtime reclaimed the checkout; close it from outside and retry")
171				}
172				closedRuntime = true
173			case EffectUpdateTask:
174				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
175					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task before recording WARM")
176				}
177				if !options.KeepSession {
178					var runtimeErr error
179					if closedRuntime {
180						runtimeErr = e.service.ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx, observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
181					} else {
182						runtimeErr = e.service.revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx, *observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
183					}
184					if runtimeErr != nil {
185						return e.fail(runtimeErr, "runtime occupancy changed; refresh and retry warm parking")
186					}
187				}
188				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
189					candidate := observed.task
190					candidate.State = task.Warm
191					candidate.Owner = e.service.host
192					if options.Next != "" {
193						candidate.Next = options.Next
194					}
195					if options.Note != "" {
196						candidate.Note = options.Note
197					}
198					if !options.KeepSession && !observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
199						candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
200						candidate.RuntimeName = ""
201					}
202					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
203					if updateErr != nil {
204						return "", fmt.Errorf("write WARM task state: %w", updateErr)
205					}
206					if updated == nil {
207						return "", errors.New("write WARM task state returned no revision")
208					}
209					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
210					observed.task = updated.Task
211					return "recorded WARM at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
212				})
213				if err != nil {
214					return e.fail(err, "Git/runtime effects may already be complete; reload the task and reconcile its state")
215				}
216			default:
217				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ParkWarm effect " + string(effect.Code)})
218			}
219		}
220		return e.result(), nil
221	}

253					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after WIP checkpoint: %w", err), "inspect the checkpoint before retrying")
254				}
255				if observed.status.Dirty() {
256					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("checkout remains dirty after WIP checkpoint: %s", observed.status.Breakdown()),
257						"commit or finalize the remaining bytes before cold parking")
258				}
259			case EffectPushBranch:
260				if err := e.service.ensureParkBranchIdentity(ctx, observed); err != nil {
261					return e.fail(err, "inspect the checkout before retrying the push")
262				}
263				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
264					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
265					if pushErr != nil {
266						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
267					}
268					return "pushed origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
269				})
270				if err != nil {
271					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains present; resolve the push before retrying cold parking")
272				}
273				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
274					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after push: %w", err), "inspect the published branch before retrying")
275				}
276			case EffectCloseRuntime:
277				if err := e.service.ensureColdGitReady(ctx, observed); err != nil {
278					return e.fail(err, "restore a clean, fully pushed branch before runtime cleanup")
279				}
280				if err := e.service.revalidateColdArtifact(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
281					return e.fail(err, "finalize or restore artifact receipts before runtime cleanup")
282				}
283				if err := e.service.revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx, *observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
284					return e.fail(err, "runtime occupancy changed; refresh cold parking")
285				}
286				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
287					closed, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
288						observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout))
289					if closeErr != nil {
290						return "", closeErr
291					}
292					observed.cleanup = closed
293					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", closed.ClosedSessions, observed.runtime.Name()), nil
294				})
295				if err != nil {
296					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains present; inspect runtime occupancy and retry")
297				}
298				if err := e.service.ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx, observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
299					return e.fail(err, "a runtime reclaimed the checkout; close it from outside before retrying")
300				}
301				closedRuntime = true
302			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
303				if err := e.service.ensureColdRemovalBoundary(ctx, observed, options, closedRuntime); err != nil {
304					return e.fail(err, "the worktree was preserved; refresh every safety condition before retrying")
305				}
306				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
307					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
308						return "", fmt.Errorf("remove exact worktree %s: %w", observed.checkout, removeErr)
309					}
310					return "removed exact linked worktree; branch retained", nil
311				})
312				if err != nil {
313					return e.fail(err, "inspect the still-registered worktree; never force removal without preserving bytes")
314				}
315				checkoutRemoved = true
316				if !e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch) {
317					return e.fail(errors.New("task branch disappeared after worktree removal"), "restore the retained task branch before updating task state")
318				}
319			case EffectSwitchBase:
320				if err := e.service.ensureColdRemovalBoundary(ctx, observed, options, closedRuntime); err != nil {
321					return e.fail(err, "canonical checkout was not switched; refresh cold parking")
322				}
323				base := effect.Details.Map()["base"]
324				if base == "" || !e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, base) {
325					return e.fail(staleBoundary("explicit base ref changed before canonical checkout switch"), "restore the recorded base and retry")
326				}
327				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
328					_, switchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "switch", base)
329					if switchErr != nil {
330						return "", fmt.Errorf("switch canonical checkout to %s: %w", base, switchErr)
331					}
332					return "switched canonical checkout to " + base, nil
333				})
334				if err != nil {
335					return e.fail(err, "the task branch remains retained; inspect the canonical checkout and retry")
336				}
337				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, base); err != nil {
338					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify canonical base switch: %w", err), "inspect the canonical checkout before reconciling task state")
339				}
340				if !e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch) {
341					return e.fail(errors.New("task branch disappeared during canonical checkout switch"), "restore the task branch before updating task state")
342				}
343				baseSwitched = true
344			case EffectUpdateTask:
345				if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !checkoutRemoved {
346					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "task update reached before worktree removal"})
347				}
348				if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && !baseSwitched {
349					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "task update reached before canonical base switch"})
350				}
351				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
352					candidate := observed.task
353					candidate.State = task.Cold
354					candidate.Owner = e.service.host
355					candidate.WorktreePath = ""
356					candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
357					candidate.RuntimeName = ""
358					if options.Next != "" {
359						candidate.Next = options.Next
360					}
361					if options.Note != "" {
362						candidate.Note = options.Note
363					}
364					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
365					if updateErr != nil {
366						return "", fmt.Errorf("write COLD task state: %w", updateErr)
367					}
368					if updated == nil {
369						return "", errors.New("write COLD task state returned no revision")
370					}
371					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
372					observed.task = updated.Task
373					return "recorded COLD at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
374				})
375				if err != nil {
376					return e.fail(err, "checkout cleanup succeeded but task persistence failed; reload and reconcile the task path/runtime/state")
377				}
378			default:
379				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ParkCold effect " + string(effect.Code)})
380			}
381		}
382		return e.result(), nil
383	}
384	
385	func (e *executionState) applyResume(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
386		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ResumeOptions)
387		observed := &e.observed
388		e.resumePath = observed.checkout
389		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && observed.savedRuntimeLive {
390			e.resumeRuntimeName = observed.runtime.Name()
391			e.resumeRuntimeHandle = observed.task.RuntimeHandle
392		}
393		runtimeMutated := false
394		checkoutMutated := false
395	
396		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
397			switch effect.Code {
398			case EffectFetchRefs:
399				if err := e.service.revalidateRepository(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
400					return e.fail(err, "refresh the canonical repository before fetching")
401				}
402				if observed.hasCheckout() {
403					if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
404						return e.fail(err, "refresh checkout authority before fetching")
405					}
406				} else if matches, err := e.service.branchCheckoutCount(ctx, *observed); err != nil || matches != observed.branchMatches {
407					if err != nil {
408						return e.fail(err, "refresh worktree topology before fetching")
409					}
410					return e.fail(staleBoundary("task branch checkout topology changed before fetch"), "refresh resume")
411				}
412				e.runWarning(effect, func() (string, error) {
413					_, fetchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "origin")
414					if fetchErr != nil {
415						return "", fetchErr
416					}
417					return "fetched origin", nil
418				}, "fetch failed")
419				if observed.hasCheckout() {
420					if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, resumeExpectedBranchBeforeSwitch(*observed)); err != nil {
421						return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh checkout after fetch: %w", err), "inspect fetched refs and retry resume")
422					}
423				}
424			case EffectCreateWorktree:
425				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeBranchRefs(ctx, observed, options.FetchRefs); err != nil {
426					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task branch before rebuilding its checkout")
427				}
428				base := observed.task.Base
429				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch) {
430					base = observed.remoteBranch
431				}
432				if base == "" || !e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, base) {
433					return e.fail(staleBoundary("explicit worktree reconstruction base is unavailable after fetch"), "restore origin/"+observed.task.Branch+" or the recorded base")
434				}
435				if matches, err := e.service.branchCheckoutCount(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
436					return e.fail(err, "refresh repository topology before rebuilding")
437				} else if matches != 0 {
438					return e.fail(staleBoundary("the task branch acquired a checkout before reconstruction"), "refresh and reuse the newly registered exact checkout")
439				}
440				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
441					created, createErr := e.service.createWorktree(ctx, wt.CreateRequest{
442						RepoPath: observed.repoPath, RepoName: observed.task.Repo,
443						Branch: observed.task.Branch, Base: base,
444						Path: effect.Target, Label: resumeRuntimeLabel(observed.task),
445						NoProvision: options.NoProvision, NoRuntime: true,
446					})
447					if createErr != nil {
448						var exists *wt.ErrExists
449						if errors.As(createErr, &exists) {
450							return "", staleBoundary("the task branch became checked out at " + exists.Path)
451						}
452						return "", createErr
453					}
454					if created == nil || created.Path == "" {
455						return "", errors.New("worktree manager returned no checkout path")
456					}
457					path, canonicalErr := e.service.canonicalPath(created.Path)
458					if canonicalErr != nil {
459						return "", canonicalErr
460					}
461					target, targetErr := e.service.canonicalPath(effect.Target)
462					if targetErr != nil || path != target {
463						return "", fmt.Errorf("worktree manager created %q, approved target is %q", path, target)
464					}
465					e.resumePath = path
466					return "rebuilt linked worktree from " + base, nil
467				})
468				if err != nil {
469					return e.fail(err, "inspect any partially created checkout, then refresh resume before retrying")
470				}
471				registered, resolveErr := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, e.resumePath)
472				if resolveErr != nil {
473					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("resolve rebuilt exact worktree: %w", resolveErr), "preserve the rebuilt checkout and reconcile its registration")
474				}
475				observed.worktree = registered
476				observed.worktreeFound = true
477				observed.worktreeErr = nil
478				observed.checkout = registered.Path
479				if !registered.IsLinkedWorktree() || registered.Worktree.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
480					return e.fail(errors.New("rebuilt checkout is not the exact linked task branch"), "preserve and reconcile the rebuilt checkout")
481				}
482				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
483					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify rebuilt worktree: %w", err), "preserve and inspect the rebuilt checkout")
484				}
485				checkoutMutated = true
486			case EffectSwitchBranch:
487				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeOccupancy(ctx, observed, !runtimeMutated && !checkoutMutated); err != nil {
488					return e.fail(err, "another agent or runtime changed occupancy; refresh resume")
489				}
490				if err := e.service.ensureBranchSwitchBoundary(ctx, observed); err != nil {
491					return e.fail(err, "preserve canonical checkout changes and retry resume")
492				}
493				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
494					_, switchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "switch", observed.task.Branch)
495					if switchErr != nil {
496						return "", switchErr
497					}
498					return "switched canonical checkout to " + observed.task.Branch, nil
499				})
500				if err != nil {
501					return e.fail(err, "inspect the canonical checkout and retry resume")
502				}
503				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
504					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify task branch switch: %w", err), "inspect the canonical checkout before retrying")
505				}
506				checkoutMutated = true
507			case EffectOpenRuntime:
508				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeCheckout(ctx, observed); err != nil {
509					return e.fail(err, "refresh the exact checkout before opening a runtime")
510				}
511				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeOccupancy(ctx, observed, !runtimeMutated && !checkoutMutated); err != nil {
512					return e.fail(err, "another agent or runtime changed occupancy; refresh resume")
513				}
514				if savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle) {
515					return e.fail(staleBoundary("saved runtime handle became live before the declared open"), "refresh and reuse the saved runtime")
516				}
517				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
518					opened, openErr := e.service.openRuntime(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, resumeRuntimeLabel(observed.task))
519					if openErr != nil {
520						return "", openErr
521					}
522					if opened.Handle == "" {
523						return "", errors.New("runtime opened without a handle")
524					}
525					e.resumeRuntimeName = observed.runtime.Name()
526					e.resumeRuntimeHandle = opened.Handle
527					return "opened " + observed.runtime.Name() + " runtime " + opened.Handle, nil
528				})
529				if err != nil {
530					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains available; open a runtime manually or retry resume")
531				}
532				runtimeMutated = true
533			case EffectUpdateTask:
534				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeCheckout(ctx, observed); err != nil {
535					return e.fail(err, "refresh the exact checkout before recording HOT")
536				}
537				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeOccupancy(ctx, observed, !runtimeMutated && !checkoutMutated); err != nil {
538					return e.fail(err, "another recognized agent appeared; close the new surface or refresh resume")
539				}
540				if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !runtimeMutated && observed.task.RuntimeHandle != "" &&
541					!savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle) {
542					return e.fail(staleBoundary("saved runtime handle disappeared before HOT task write"), "refresh resume and open a new runtime")
543				}
544				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
545					candidate := observed.task
546					candidate.State = task.Hot
547					candidate.Owner = e.service.host
548					if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
549						candidate.WorktreePath = observed.checkout
550					} else {
551						candidate.WorktreePath = ""
552					}
553					if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
554						candidate.RuntimeName = ""
555						candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
556					} else {
557						candidate.RuntimeName = e.resumeRuntimeName
558						candidate.RuntimeHandle = e.resumeRuntimeHandle
559						if candidate.RuntimeName == "" || candidate.RuntimeHandle == "" {
560							return "", errors.New("HOT task requires the validated or newly opened runtime handle")
561						}
562					}
563					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
564					if updateErr != nil {
565						return "", fmt.Errorf("write HOT task state: %w", updateErr)
566					}
567					if updated == nil {
568						return "", errors.New("write HOT task state returned no revision")
569					}
570					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
571					observed.task = updated.Task
572					if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
573						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffDirectory, Path: observed.checkout, Label: candidate.Title()}
574					} else {
575						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffRuntime, Path: observed.checkout,
576							Runtime: candidate.RuntimeName, RuntimeHandle: candidate.RuntimeHandle, Label: candidate.Title()}
577					}
578					return "recorded HOT at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
579				})
580				if err != nil {
581					return e.fail(err, "checkout/runtime preparation may be complete; reload and reconcile task ownership, path, and runtime")
582				}
583			default:
584				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected Resume effect " + string(effect.Code)})
585			}
586		}
587		return e.result(), nil
588	}
589	
590	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRepository(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
591		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
592		if err != nil {
593			return staleBoundary("canonical repository is no longer discoverable: " + err.Error())
594		}
595		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
596		if err != nil {
597			return staleBoundary("canonical repository path is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
598		}
599		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
600		if err != nil {
601			return staleBoundary("Git common directory is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
602		}
603		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
604			return staleBoundary("canonical repository or Git common directory changed")
605		}
606		return nil
607	}
608	
609	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateGitBaseline(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
610		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
611		if err != nil {
612			return staleBoundary("exact worktree registration changed: " + err.Error())
613		}
614		if registered != observed.worktree {
615			return staleBoundary("exact worktree path, branch, HEAD, Main, locked, or prunable flags changed")
616		}
617		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
618		if err != nil {
619			return staleBoundary("Git status observation changed: " + err.Error())
620		}
621		if !sameStatus(status, observed.status) {
622			return staleBoundary("Git status, branch, upstream, ahead, behind, dirty, or conflict evidence changed")
623		}
624		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
625		if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(head) != observed.head {
626			return staleBoundary("checkout HEAD changed")
627		}
628		baseOID, baseErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
629		upstreamOID, upstreamErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
630		if errorString(baseErr) != errorString(observed.baseOIDErr) || baseOID != observed.baseOID ||
631			errorString(upstreamErr) != errorString(observed.upstreamOIDErr) || upstreamOID != observed.upstreamOID {
632			return staleBoundary("base or upstream ref OID changed")
633		}
634		operation, active, err := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
635		if err != nil || operation != observed.operation || active != observed.inProgress {
636			return staleBoundary("Git operation evidence changed")
637		}
638		return nil
639	}
640	
641	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, expectedBranch string) error {
642		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
643		if err != nil {
644			return err
645		}
646		if registered.Path != observed.checkout || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
647			return errors.New("checkout path or Git common directory changed")
648		}
649		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !registered.IsLinkedWorktree() {
650			return errors.New("worktree task no longer resolves to a linked checkout")
651		}
652		if observed.mode != task.ModeWorktree && (!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare) {
653			return errors.New("canonical task no longer resolves to the main checkout")
654		}
655		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
656		if err != nil {
657			return err
658		}
659		if status.Detached || expectedBranch != "" && status.Branch != expectedBranch || registered.Worktree.Branch != status.Branch {
660			return fmt.Errorf("checkout branch changed: registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", registered.Worktree.Branch, status.Branch, expectedBranch)
661		}
662		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
663		if err != nil {
664			return err
665		}
666		head = strings.TrimSpace(head)
667		if registered.Worktree.Head != head {
668			return fmt.Errorf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", registered.Worktree.Head, head)
669		}
670		baseOID, baseOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
671		upstreamOID, upstreamOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
672		operation, active, operationErr := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
673		if operationErr != nil {
674			return operationErr
675		}
676		observed.worktree = registered
677		observed.status = status
678		observed.statusErr = nil
679		observed.head = head
680		observed.headErr = nil
681		observed.baseOID = baseOID
682		observed.baseOIDErr = baseOIDErr
683		observed.upstreamOID = upstreamOID
684		observed.upstreamOIDErr = upstreamOIDErr
685		observed.operation = operation
686		observed.inProgress = active
687		observed.operationErr = nil
688		return nil
689	}
690	
691	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureParkBranchIdentity(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
692		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
693			return err
694		}
695		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch || observed.inProgress || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
696			return staleBoundary("task branch, conflict, or Git operation evidence changed before push")
697		}
698		return nil
699	}
700	
701	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureColdGitReady(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
702		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
703			return err
704		}
705		if observed.status.Dirty() {
706			return fmt.Errorf("cold parking requires a clean checkout: %s", observed.status.Breakdown())
707		}
708		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
709			return errors.New("cold parking checkout is no longer on the task branch")
710		}
711		if observed.inProgress || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
712			return errors.New("cold parking refuses an active Git operation or unresolved conflict")
713		}
714		if !observed.status.Published() || observed.status.Ahead != 0 {
715			return fmt.Errorf("cold parking requires a published ahead=0 branch; status is %s", observed.status.Summary())
716		}
717		return nil
718	}
719	
720	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateColdArtifact(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
721		if observed.mode != task.ModeWorktree {
722			return nil
723		}
724		fresh, err := s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
725		if err != nil {
726			return err
727		}
728		if !fresh.Ready() {
729			return errors.New("artifact readiness changed to blocked")
730		}
731		if artifactAuthority(fresh, nil) != artifactAuthority(observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr) {
732			return staleBoundary("artifact intent or receipt authority changed")
733		}
734		return nil
735	}
736	
737	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool, timeout time.Duration) error {
738		options := observed.cleanupOptions(closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, timeout)
739		fresh, err := s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, options)
740		if err != nil {
741			return err
742		}
743		if cleanupAuthority(fresh, nil) != cleanupAuthority(observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr) {
744			return staleBoundary("runtime occupancy, caller, agent, or session evidence changed")
745		}
746		return nil
747	}
748	
749	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool, timeout time.Duration) error {
750		fresh, err := s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
751			observed.cleanupOptions(closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, timeout))
752		if err != nil {
753			return err
754		}
755		if !fresh.Ready() || fresh.CallerContained || len(fresh.Sessions) > 0 {
756			return errors.New("runtime coverage reappeared after closure")
757		}
758		observed.cleanup = fresh
759		observed.cleanupErr = nil
760		return nil
761	}
762	
763	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureColdRemovalBoundary(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, options ParkColdOptions, runtimeWasClosed bool) error {
764		if err := s.ensureColdGitReady(ctx, observed); err != nil {
765			return err
766		}
767		if err := s.revalidateColdArtifact(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
768			return err
769		}
770		fresh, err := s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
771			observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout))
772		if err != nil {
773			return err
774		}
775		if !fresh.Ready() || fresh.CallerContained || len(fresh.Sessions) > 0 {
776			return errors.New("cleanup occupancy is no longer empty and safe")
777		}
778		if !runtimeWasClosed && cleanupAuthority(fresh, nil) != cleanupAuthority(observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr) {
779			return staleBoundary("runtime occupancy changed before cleanup")
780		}
781		observed.cleanup = fresh
782		observed.cleanupErr = nil
783		return nil
784	}
785	
786	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateResumeCheckout(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
787		expected := observed.task.Branch
788		if err := s.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, expected); err != nil {
789			return staleBoundary("resume checkout identity changed: " + err.Error())
790		}
791		return nil
792	}
793	
794	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateResumeOccupancy(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, compareAuthority bool) error {
795		fresh, err := s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
796			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
797			CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
798			CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
799		})
800		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh, err); occupancyErr != nil {
801			return occupancyErr
802		}
803		if compareAuthority && occupancyAuthority(fresh, nil) != occupancyAuthority(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) {
804			return staleBoundary("runtime session, caller, or recognized-agent occupancy changed")
805		}
806		observed.occupancy = fresh
807		observed.occupancyErr = nil
808		observed.savedRuntimeLive = savedHandleLive(fresh, observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
809		return nil
810	}
811	
812	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureBranchSwitchBoundary(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
813		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
814			return err
815		}
816		if observed.status.Dirty() || observed.status.Detached || observed.inProgress || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
817			return errors.New("canonical checkout is no longer clean and switchable")
818		}
819		if !s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch) {
820			return staleBoundary("local task branch disappeared before switch")
821		}
822		return nil
823	}
824	
825	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateResumeBranchRefs(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, allowRemoteChange bool) error {
826		localExists := s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
827		localOID, localErr := "", error(nil)
828		if localExists {
829			localOID, localErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
830		}
831		if localExists != observed.localBranchExists || localOID != observed.localBranchOID ||
832			errorString(localErr) != errorString(observed.localBranchOIDErr) {
833			return staleBoundary("local task branch OID changed before worktree reconstruction")
834		}
835		if allowRemoteChange {
836			return nil
837		}
838		remoteExists := s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
839		remoteOID, remoteErr := "", error(nil)
840		if remoteExists {
841			remoteOID, remoteErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
842		}
843		if remoteExists != observed.remoteBranchExists || remoteOID != observed.remoteBranchOID ||
844			errorString(remoteErr) != errorString(observed.remoteBranchOIDErr) {
845			return staleBoundary("remote task branch OID changed before worktree reconstruction")
846		}
847		return nil
848	}
849	
850	func (s *lifecycleService) branchCheckoutCount(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) (int, error) {
851		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
852		if err != nil {
853			return 0, err
854		}
855		count := 0
856		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
857			if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
858				count++
859			}
860		}
861		return count, nil
862	}
863	
864	func resumeExpectedBranchBeforeSwitch(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
865		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && observed.statusErr == nil {
866			return observed.status.Branch
867		}
868		return observed.task.Branch
869	}

85	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
86		clean := func(s string) string {
87			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
88			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
89				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
90			}

98			b = "branch"
99		}
100		return r + "__" + b
101	}

179	// transaction-scoped inventory. Callers using it for mutation authority must
180	// hold the store lock through the guarded operation.
181	func (s *Store) listRecordsUnlocked() ([]Record, []Diagnostic, error) {
182		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
183		if err != nil {
184			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
185				return nil, nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
186			}
187			return nil, nil, err
188		}
189		var records []Record
190		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
191		for _, entry := range entries {
192			name := entry.Name()
193			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
194				continue
195			}
196			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")

198			if err != nil {
199				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
200					ID: id, Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err,
201				})
202				continue
203			}
204			records = append(records, *record)
205		}
206		sortRecords(records)
207		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
208		return records, diagnostics, nil
209	}

288			return nil, errors.New("update nil task")
289		}
290		candidate := cloneTask(*t)
291		if candidate.ID == "" {
292			candidate.ID = MakeID(candidate.Repo, candidate.Branch)
293		}
294		current, err := tx.store.getRecordUnlocked(candidate.ID)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		if current.Revision != expectedRevision {
299			return nil, &StaleRevisionError{
300				ID: candidate.ID, Expected: expectedRevision, Actual: current.Revision,
301			}
302		}
303		record, err := tx.store.saveUnlocked(&candidate)
304		if err != nil {
305			return nil, err
306		}
307		*t = cloneTask(candidate)
308		return record, nil
309	}
310	
311	// Delete removes a task unconditionally inside a compatibility transaction.
312	func (tx *Tx) Delete(id string) error {
313		return tx.store.deleteUnlocked(id)
314	}
315	
316	// DeleteIfRevision removes a task only while its revision remains current.
317	func (tx *Tx) DeleteIfRevision(id, expectedRevision string) error {
318		current, err := tx.store.getRecordUnlocked(id)
319		if err != nil {
320			return err
321		}
322		if current.Revision != expectedRevision {
323			return &StaleRevisionError{ID: id, Expected: expectedRevision, Actual: current.Revision}
324		}
325		return tx.store.deleteUnlocked(id)
326	}
327	
328	// saveUnlocked atomically persists t. The caller must hold the store lock.
329	func (s *Store) saveUnlocked(t *Task) (*Record, error) {
330		if t.ID == "" {
331			t.ID = MakeID(t.Repo, t.Branch)
332		}
333		if err := t.Validate(); err != nil {
334			return nil, err
335		}
336		now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
337		if t.Created.IsZero() {
338			t.Created = now
339		}
340		t.Updated = now
341	
342		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
343			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create state dir: %w", err)
344		}
345		var encoded bytes.Buffer
346		if err := toml.NewEncoder(&encoded).Encode(t); err != nil {
347			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
348		}
349		data := encoded.Bytes()
350	
351		// Write to a temp file and rename, so an interrupted write can never leave
352		// a half-parsed task behind.
353		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+t.ID+".*.tmp")
354		if err != nil {
355			return nil, err
356		}
357		defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
358		if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
359			_ = tmp.Close()
360			return nil, fmt.Errorf("write task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
361		}
362		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
363			return nil, err
364		}
365		if err := os.Chmod(tmp.Name(), 0o644); err != nil {
366			return nil, err
367		}
368		if err := os.Rename(tmp.Name(), s.path(t.ID)); err != nil {
369			return nil, err
370		}
371		return &Record{Task: cloneTask(*t), Revision: revisionFor(t.ID, data)}, nil
372	}
373	
374	// getRecordUnlocked reads a complete record without taking the mutation lock.
375	// Atomic rename makes concurrent reads see either the previous or next bytes.
376	func (s *Store) getRecordUnlocked(id string) (*Record, error) {
377		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
378		if err != nil {
379			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
380				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
381			}
382			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
383		}
384		var t Task
385		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &t); err != nil {
386			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
387		}
388		t.ID = id
389		return &Record{Task: t, Revision: revisionFor(id, data)}, nil
390	}
391	
392	// deleteUnlocked removes one record. The caller must hold the store lock.
393	func (s *Store) deleteUnlocked(id string) error {
394		err := os.Remove(s.path(id))
395		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
396			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
397		}
398		return err
399	}
400	
401	// revisionFor hashes the task ID, a NUL domain separator, and the exact bytes
402	// persisted in the task file. A byte-for-byte rewrite keeps the revision;
403	// any byte or filename-ID change produces a different optimistic token.
404	func revisionFor(id string, data []byte) string {
405		payload := make([]byte, 0, len(id)+1+len(data))
406		payload = append(payload, id...)
407		payload = append(payload, 0)
408		payload = append(payload, data...)
409		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(payload))
410	}
411	
412	func cloneTask(t Task) Task {
413		t.Tags = append([]string(nil), t.Tags...)
414		return t
415	}
416	
417	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
418	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
419	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather
420	// than a silent pick.
421	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
422		if ref == "" {
423			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty task reference: %w", ErrNotFound)
424		}
425		all, err := s.List()
426		if err != nil {
427			return nil, err
428		}
429		for _, t := range all {
430			if t.ID == ref || t.Branch == ref {
431				return t, nil
432			}
433		}
434		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
435		var hits []*Task
436		for _, t := range all {
437			hay := strings.ToLower(t.ID + " " + t.Name + " " + t.Branch + " " + t.Repo)
438			if strings.Contains(hay, needle) {
439				hits = append(hits, t)
440			}
441		}
442		switch len(hits) {
443		case 1:
444			return hits[0], nil
445		case 0:
446			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", ref, ErrNotFound)
447		default:
448			names := make([]string, len(hits))
449			for i, t := range hits {
450				names[i] = t.ID
451			}
452			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))
453		}
454	}
455	
456	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
457	//
458	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
459	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
460	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
461	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
462	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
463	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
464		all, err := s.List()
465		if err != nil {
466			return nil, err
467		}
468		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
469			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
470		}
471		var best *Task
472		var bestLen int
473		for _, t := range all {
474			root := t.WorktreePath
475			if root == "" {
476				root = t.RepoPath
477			}
478			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
479				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
480			}
481		}
482		if best == nil {
483			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
484		}
485		return best, nil
486	}
487	
488	// stateRank orders states so the inventory reads as an attention queue.
489	func stateRank(s State) int {
490		switch s {
491		case Hot:
492			return 0
493		case Warm:
494			return 1
495		case Cold:
496			return 2
497		case Done:
498			return 3
499		}
500		return 4
501	}
502	
503	// Sort orders tasks hot-first, then by most recently updated.
504	func Sort(ts []*Task) {
505		sort.SliceStable(ts, func(i, j int) bool {
506			return taskLess(*ts[i], *ts[j])
507		})
508	}
509	
510	func sortRecords(records []Record) {
511		sort.SliceStable(records, func(i, j int) bool {
512			return taskLess(records[i].Task, records[j].Task)
513		})
514	}
515	
516	func taskLess(left, right Task) bool {
517		rl, rr := stateRank(left.State), stateRank(right.State)
518		if rl != rr {
519			return rl < rr
520		}
521		if !left.Updated.Equal(right.Updated) {
522			return left.Updated.After(right.Updated)
523		}
524		return left.ID < right.ID
525	}
526

78				var observeErr error

139	func appendAdoptIDClaim(observed *destructiveObservation, taskID string) {
140		if observed == nil || taskID == "" {
141			return
142		}
143		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
144			if record.Task.ID != taskID {
145				continue
146			}
147			for index := range observed.taskClaims {
148				if observed.taskClaims[index].ID == taskID {
149					if !strings.Contains(observed.taskClaims[index].Reason, "derived task ID") {
150						observed.taskClaims[index].Reason += " and derived task ID"
151					}
152					sortAdoptClaims(observed.taskClaims)
153					return
154				}
155			}
156			observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
157				ID: taskID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "derived task ID",
158			})
159			sortAdoptClaims(observed.taskClaims)
160			return
161		}
162	}

164	func sortAdoptClaims(claims []destructiveTaskClaim) {
165		sort.Slice(claims, func(i, j int) bool {
166			if claims[i].ID != claims[j].ID {
167				return claims[i].ID < claims[j].ID
168			}
169			return claims[i].Reason < claims[j].Reason
170		})
171	}

173	func deriveAdoptState(observed adoptObservation) (task.State, string, string, string) {
174		rt := observed.runtime
175		switch {
176		case observed.runtimeErr != nil:
177			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend resolution failed; adoption remains WARM"
178		case rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "":
179			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
180		case rt.Name() == "none":
181			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime none leaves session and recognized-agent evidence unobserved; adoption remains WARM"
182		case !observed.runtimeAvailable:
183			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
184		case !observed.worktreeFound:
185			return task.Warm, "", "", "exact checkout is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
186		case adoptStrictOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) != nil:
187			return task.Warm, "", "", "strict runtime occupancy is not ready; adoption remains WARM"
188		case !observed.occupancy.SessionList.Observed():
189			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime sessions were not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
190		case !observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed():
191			return task.Warm, "", "", "recognized-agent activity was not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
192		case len(observed.occupancy.Sessions) != 1:
193			return task.Warm, "", "", fmt.Sprintf("fresh runtime coverage contains %d sessions, not exactly one; adoption remains WARM", len(observed.occupancy.Sessions))
194		case len(observed.occupancy.Agents) != 0:
195			return task.Warm, "", "", "a recognized agent occupies the checkout; adoption remains WARM"
196		}
197	
198		session := observed.occupancy.Sessions[0]
199		handle := session.Runtime.Handle
200		if strings.TrimSpace(handle) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(handle) != handle || strings.ContainsRune(handle, '\x00') {
201			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session has no stable nonempty handle; adoption remains WARM"
202		}
203		if !adoptSessionShellOnly(session) {
204			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session is not shell-only; adoption remains WARM"
205		}
206		return task.Hot, rt.Name(), handle, "exactly one freshly observed shell-only runtime session covers the checkout with stable handle " + handle
207	}

209	func adoptStrictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
210		if occupancyErr := strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err); occupancyErr != nil {
211			return occupancyErr
212		}
213		var blockers []string
214		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
215			// OccupancySession.Panes contains only panes whose live cwd covers the
216			// checkout. A mixed session may also host an unrelated agent elsewhere;
217			// that agent is not a writer claim on this checkout.
218			for _, pane := range session.Panes {
219				if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) == "" && strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) == "" {
220					continue
221				}
222				if occupancy.CallerPaneID != "" && pane.ID == occupancy.CallerPaneID {
223					continue
224				}
225				status := strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus)
226				if status == "" {
227					status = "unknown"
228				}
229				blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent pane %s (%s)", pane.ID, status))
230			}
231		}
232		if len(blockers) > 0 {
233			return fmt.Errorf("checkout is occupied by %s", strings.Join(blockers, ", "))
234		}
235		return nil
236	}
237	
238	func adoptSessionShellOnly(session runtime.OccupancySession) bool {
239		if strings.TrimSpace(session.Runtime.AgentStatus) != "" || len(session.Runtime.AgentSessions) != 0 {
240			return false
241		}
242		panes := session.Runtime.Panes
243		if len(panes) == 0 {
244			panes = session.Panes
245		}
246		for _, pane := range panes {
247			if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) != "" {
248				return false
249			}
250		}
251		return true
252	}
