553	func (s *lifecycleService) applyAdopt(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
554		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
555			return Result{}, err
556		}
557		if approved.Action != Adopt {
558			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "adopt handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
559		}
560		if err := validateAdoptLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
561			return Result{}, err
562		}
563		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
564		if err != nil {
565			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
566		}
567	
568		var result Result
569		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
570			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
571				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeAdopt(ctx, approved.Request, tx.ListRecords)
572				if observeErr != nil {
573					return observeErr
574				}
575				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
576				if buildErr != nil {
577					return buildErr
578				}
579				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
580					return &StalePlanError{
581						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
582						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
583						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
584						Reason:                       "fresh unmanaged Git, worktree, task, base, runtime, agent, or harness authority differs",
585					}
586				}
587				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
588					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
589					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh adoption conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
590				}
591				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx}
592				result, observeErr = execution.executeAdopt(observed)
593				return observeErr
594			})
595		})
596		return result, err
597	}
598	
599	func (e *executionState) executeAdopt(observed adoptObservation) (Result, error) {
600		effects := e.plan.Effects()
601		if len(effects) != 1 || effects[0].Code != EffectCreateTask {
602			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "Adopt must contain exactly one create-task effect"})
603		}
604		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
605			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "runtime none left occupancy unobserved; the adopted task is WARM")
606		}
607	
608		effect := effects[0]
609		expected := observed.candidate
610		expected.Tags = append([]string(nil), observed.candidate.Tags...)
611		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
612			candidate := expected
613			candidate.Tags = append([]string(nil), expected.Tags...)
614			created, createErr := e.service.taskCreate(e.tx, &candidate)
615			if createErr != nil {
616				return "task create made no authorized non-task change", fmt.Errorf("create adopted task %s: %w", expected.ID, createErr)
617			}
618			if created == nil || created.Revision == "" {
619				return "task create returned no revision", errors.New("create adopted task returned no revision")
620			}
621			if adoptTaskAuthority(created.Task) != adoptTaskAuthority(expected) {
622				return "task create returned different metadata", errors.New("created task does not match the approved adoption metadata")
623			}
624			persisted, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(expected.ID)
625			if verifyErr != nil {
626				return "task create was not verified", fmt.Errorf("verify created adopted task %s: %w", expected.ID, verifyErr)
627			}
628			if persisted.Revision != created.Revision || adoptTaskAuthority(persisted.Task) != adoptTaskAuthority(expected) {
629				return "task create revision or metadata was not verified", errors.New("persisted adopted task differs from the task create result")
630			}
631			e.snapshot = "task:" + persisted.Revision
632			e.milestone = MilestoneAdopted
633			return "created task " + persisted.Task.ID + " at revision " + persisted.Revision, nil
634		})
635		if err != nil {
636			return e.fail(err, "the checkout, branch, runtime, and Git bytes were not changed; repair the task-store failure and refresh adoption")
637		}
638		if e.milestone != MilestoneAdopted || e.snapshot == "" {
639			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "adoption ended without a created task revision"})
640		}
641		return e.result(), nil
642	}

160				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unavailable", "select a registered linked checkout"),
161				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree flags are unavailable", "refresh exact worktree topology"),
162				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "branch identity is unavailable", "select a named non-detached checkout"),
163				condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "local branch ref is unavailable", "restore the exact local branch"),
164				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git status is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
165				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git operation state is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
166				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout cleanliness is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
167				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "harness ownership is unavailable", "refresh the exact checkout path"),
168			}
169		}
170	
171		exactVerdict := VerdictMet
172		exactEvidence := "selected path, repository, Git common directory, and HEAD are exact"
173		switch {
174		case observed.worktree.Path != observed.checkout:
175			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered path differs from selected checkout"
176		case observed.worktree.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir:
177			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered repository identity differs from selected repository"
178		case observed.headErr != nil:
179			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
180		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head:
181			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
182		case observed.locator.HeadOID != observed.head:
183			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("selected HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
184		}
185	
186		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
187		kindEvidence := "registered non-main, non-bare linked worktree"
188		if !observed.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree() {
189			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
190			kindEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("main=%t bare=%t; canonical and bare records are never removable", observed.worktree.Worktree.Main, observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare)
191		}
192	
193		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
194		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and non-prunable"
195		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked || observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable {
196			flagVerdict = VerdictBlocked
197			flagEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("locked=%t prunable=%t", observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked, observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable)
198		}
199	
200		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
201		branchEvidence := "registry and status identify named branch " + observed.locator.Branch
202		switch {
203		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch == "":
204			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered worktree is detached or unnamed"
205		case observed.statusErr != nil:
206			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
207		case observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.locator.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.locator.Branch:
208			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q selected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.locator.Branch)
209		}
210	
211		branchRefVerdict := VerdictMet
212		branchRefEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("local %s remains at selected HEAD %s", observed.branchRef, observed.locator.HeadOID)
213		switch {
214		case !observed.branchExists:
215			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "exact local branch ref does not exist"
216		case observed.branchOIDErr != nil:
217			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictError, observed.branchOIDErr.Error()
218		case observed.branchOID != observed.locator.HeadOID || observed.branchOID != observed.head:
219			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("branch OID=%q selected HEAD=%q live HEAD=%q", observed.branchOID, observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
220		}
221	
222		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
223		statusEvidence := observed.status.Summary()
224		if observed.statusErr != nil {
225			statusVerdict, statusEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
226		}
227		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
228		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
229		if observed.operationErr != nil {
230			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictError, observed.operationErr.Error()
231		} else if observed.inProgress {
232			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "Git operation "+observed.operation+" is in progress"
233		}
234		cleanVerdict := VerdictMet
235		cleanEvidence := "checkout is clean"
236		if observed.statusErr != nil {
237			cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
238		} else if observed.status.Dirty() {
239			cleanEvidence = observed.status.Breakdown()
240			switch {
241			case !options.DiscardDirty:
242				cleanVerdict = VerdictBlocked
243				cleanEvidence += "; default removal preserves all dirty bytes"
244			case observed.contentErr != nil:
245				cleanVerdict = VerdictError
246				cleanEvidence = "dirty content fingerprint failed: " + observed.contentErr.Error()
247			case observed.contentFingerprint == "":
248				cleanVerdict = VerdictError
249				cleanEvidence = "dirty content fingerprint is unavailable"
250			default:
251				cleanEvidence += "; exact-plan content fingerprint " + observed.contentFingerprint + " will be rechecked before discard"
252			}
253		}
254	
255		harnessVerdict := VerdictMet
256		harnessEvidence := "no strict harness path evidence"
257		if observed.isHarness {
258			harnessVerdict = VerdictBlocked
259			harnessEvidence = "checkout is strictly under harness root " + observed.harness.Root
260		}
261		return []Condition{
262			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
263			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "refresh the exact checkout locator"),
264			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "select a non-main linked checkout"),
265			condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, flagVerdict, RequirementRequired, flagEvidence, "unlock or repair the registration; pruning is never implicit"),
266			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named non-detached checkout"),
267			condition(ConditionBranchRef, branchRefVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchRefEvidence, "restore the exact local branch ref at selected HEAD"),
268			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
269			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
270			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementRequired, cleanEvidence, "commit changes or use the explicit CLI-compatible discard option"),
271			condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, harnessVerdict, RequirementRequired, harnessEvidence, "let the harness retire its own checkout"),
272		}
273	}
274	
275	func removeTaskInventoryConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
276		inventoryCondition := condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
277			"task inventory is complete, including a successful empty inventory", "")
278		switch {
279		case observed.taskInventoryErr != nil:
280			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
281				observed.taskInventoryErr.Error(), "repair task-store inventory before proving unmanaged ownership")
282		case len(observed.taskIncomplete) > 0:
283			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
284				strings.Join(observed.taskIncomplete, "; "), "repair every corrupt or unresolvable task record")
285		}
286		claimsCondition := condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
287			"no task claims the exact checkout path or branch in this repository", "")
288		if len(observed.taskClaims) > 0 {
289			claims := make([]string, len(observed.taskClaims))
290			for index, claim := range observed.taskClaims {
291				claims[index] = claim.ID + " (" + claim.Reason + ")"
292			}
293			claimsCondition = condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
294				"claimed by "+strings.Join(claims, ", "), "use managed lifecycle or reconcile the task claim")
295		}
296		return []Condition{inventoryCondition, claimsCondition}
297	}
298	
299	func removeContainmentConditions(observed destructiveObservation, options RemoveCheckoutOptions) []Condition {
300		if !options.RequireContained {
301			return []Condition{
302				condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
303					"unmanaged checkout removal does not require branch integration", ""),
304				condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
305					"branch is preserved regardless of containment", ""),
306				condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
307					"local branch will be retained", ""),
308			}
309		}
310		baseCondition := condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
311			fmt.Sprintf("local base %s is %s", observed.baseRef, observed.baseOID), "")
312		switch {
313		case !observed.baseExists:
314			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
315				"containment base "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "restore the exact local base")
316		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
317			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
318				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair containment-base observation")
319		case observed.baseOID == "":
320			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
321				"containment base resolved without an OID", "repair containment-base observation")
322		}
323		relationCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
324			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is contained in %s (%s)", observed.locator.Branch, observed.branchOID,
325				options.ContainmentBase, observed.baseOID), "")
326		switch {
327		case observed.containedErr != nil:
328			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
329				observed.containedErr.Error(), "repair local ancestry observation")
330		case !observed.branchExists || observed.branchOID == "" || !observed.baseExists || observed.baseOID == "":
331			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
332				"exact branch/base containment cannot be proved", "restore both exact local refs")
333		case !observed.contained:
334			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
335				"branch is not contained in "+options.ContainmentBase, "integrate it before contained retirement")
336		}
337		deletionCondition := condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
338			"local branch will be retained after contained checkout removal", "")
339		if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
340			deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
341				"ordinary git branch -d will run under the same repository/task lock", "")
342			if observed.locator.Branch == options.ContainmentBase {
343				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
344					"selected branch is the containment base", "retain the base branch")
345			} else if paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(true); err != nil {
346				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
347					err.Error(), "refresh worktree topology")
348			} else if len(paths) > 0 {
349				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
350					"branch is also checked out at "+strings.Join(paths, ", "), "remove or switch those checkouts first")
351			}
352		}
353		return []Condition{baseCondition, relationCondition, deletionCondition}
354	}
355	
356	func removeArtifactCondition(observed destructiveObservation) Condition {
357		switch {
358		case !observed.worktreeFound:
359			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
360				"artifact readiness requires the exact checkout", "restore the exact checkout")
361		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
362			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
363				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
364		case !observed.artifact.Ready():
365			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
366				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
367		default:
368			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
369				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "")
370		}
371	}
372	
373	func removeCheckoutFallback(observed destructiveObservation, options RemoveCheckoutOptions) string {
374		parts := []string{"dev", "wt", "rm", shellQuote(observed.locator.Branch)}
375		if options.RequireContained {
376			parts = []string{"dev", "retire", shellQuote(observed.checkout)}
377			if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
378				parts = append(parts, "--delete-branch")
379			}
380		} else if options.DiscardDirty {
381			parts = append(parts, "--force")
382		}
383		if options.CloseUnknown {
384			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
385		}
386		if options.AssumeNoRuntime {
387			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
388		}
389		if options.Timeout > 0 {
390			parts = append(parts, "--timeout", options.Timeout.String())
391		}
392		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
393	}

395	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
396		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
397			return Result{}, err
398		}
399		if approved.Action != RemoveCheckout {
400			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "remove-checkout handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
401		}
402		if err := validateRemoveCheckoutLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
403			return Result{}, err
404		}
405		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
406		if err != nil {
407			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
408		}
409	
410		var result Result
411		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
412			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
413				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, approved.Request, tx.ListRecords)
414				if observeErr != nil {
415					return observeErr
416				}
417				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
418				if buildErr != nil {
419					return buildErr
420				}
421				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
422					return &StalePlanError{
423						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
424						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
425						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
426						Reason:                       "fresh unmanaged Git, worktree, task, artifact, runtime, or harness authority differs",
427					}
428				}
429				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
430					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
431					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh unmanaged removal conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
432				}
433				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx}
434				result, observeErr = execution.executeRemoveCheckout(ctx, observed)
435				return observeErr
436			})
437		})
438		return result, err
439	}
440	
441	func (e *executionState) executeRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
442		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RemoveCheckoutOptions)
443		closedRuntime := false
444	
445		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
446			switch effect.Code {
447			case EffectDiscardAll:
448				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, false)
449				if err != nil {
450					return e.fail(err, "refresh unmanaged removal before discarding bytes")
451				}
452				baseline = fresh
453				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
454					if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, baseline.checkout); discardErr != nil {
455						return "dirty discard may be partial", fmt.Errorf("discard exact checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
456					}
457					return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
458				})
459				if err != nil {
460					e.partial = true
461					return e.fail(err, "inspect every checkout byte before retrying removal")
462				}
463				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, true, false)
464				if err != nil {
465					return e.fail(err, "discard completed but a safety source changed; preserve the checkout and refresh")
466				}
467				baseline = fresh
468	
469			case EffectCloseRuntime:
470				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, false)
471				if err != nil {
472					return e.fail(err, "refresh unmanaged removal before closing any runtime")
473				}
474				baseline = fresh
475				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
476					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
477						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
478						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
479					})
480					if closeErr != nil {
481						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
482					}
483					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil
484				})
485				if err != nil {
486					e.partial = true
487					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and branch remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
488				}
489				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, true)
490				if err != nil {
491					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh removal")
492				}
493				baseline = fresh
494				closedRuntime = true
495	
496			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
497				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, closedRuntime)
498				if err != nil {
499					return e.fail(err, "the checkout was preserved; refresh every safety source")
500				}
501				baseline = fresh
502				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
503					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
504						return "checkout removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact unmanaged checkout %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
505					}
506					return "removed exact clean linked checkout without force; branch preserved", nil
507				})
508				if err != nil {
509					e.partial = true
510					return e.fail(err, "inspect the exact worktree registration and preserved branch before retrying")
511				}
512				if err := e.verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
513					return e.fail(err, "checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact preserved local branch")
514				}
515				e.snapshot = "checkout:removed:" + baseline.checkout + ":" + baseline.branchOID
516	
517			case EffectDeleteBranch:
518				if e.snapshot == "" {
519					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before verified checkout removal"})
520				}
521				if err := e.revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
522					return e.fail(err, "the checkout was removed but the branch and task inventory changed; keep the branch and refresh")
523				}
524				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
525					if _, deleteErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, baseline.repoPath, "branch", "-d", "--", baseline.locator.Branch); deleteErr != nil {
526						return "contained branch deletion failed", deleteErr
527					}
528					return "deleted contained local branch " + baseline.locator.Branch, nil
529				})
530				if err != nil {
531					e.partial = true
532					return e.fail(err, "checkout removal remains complete; inspect the retained branch and retry")
533				}
534				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
535					return e.fail(errors.New("local branch still exists after successful deletion"), "inspect the branch before retrying")
536				}
537				e.snapshot += ":branch-deleted"
538	
539			default:
540				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RemoveCheckout effect " + string(effect.Code)})
541			}
542		}
543		if e.snapshot == "" {
544			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unmanaged removal ended without verified checkout removal"})
545		}
546		return e.result(), nil
547	}
548	
549	func (e *executionState) reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation, allowDiscard, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
550		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, e.plan.Request, e.tx.ListRecords)
551		if err != nil {
552			return fresh, err
553		}
554		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
555			return fresh, err
556		}
557		for _, check := range []struct {
558			name          string
559			before, after string
560		}{
561			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
562			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
563			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
564			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
565			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
566			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
567			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
568		} {
569			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
570				return fresh, err
571			}
572		}
573		if allowDiscard {
574			if err := comparePostDiscardGit(baseline, fresh); err != nil {
575				return fresh, err
576			}
577		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()); err != nil {
578			return fresh, err
579		}
580		if allowRuntimeChange {
581			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
582				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
583			}
584		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
585			return fresh, err
586		}
587		return fresh, nil
588	}
589	
590	func comparePostDiscardGit(before, after destructiveObservation) error {
591		if after.statusErr != nil || after.status.Dirty() {
592			return staleBoundary("checkout is not clean after explicit discard")
593		}
594		beforeStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
595			before.status.Branch, boolString(before.status.Detached), before.status.Upstream,
596			fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Behind),
597			before.head, errorString(before.headErr), before.operation, boolString(before.inProgress), errorString(before.operationErr),
598		)
599		afterStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
600			after.status.Branch, boolString(after.status.Detached), after.status.Upstream,
601			fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Behind),
602			after.head, errorString(after.headErr), after.operation, boolString(after.inProgress), errorString(after.operationErr),
603		)
604		return compareAuthorityCategory("post-discard Git identity", beforeStable, afterStable)
605	}
606	
607	func (e *executionState) revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
608		records, diagnostics, err := e.tx.ListRecords()
609		if err != nil {
610			return err
611		}
612		claims := baseline
613		claims.taskRecords = records
614		claims.taskDiagnostics = diagnostics
615		claims.taskClaims = nil
616		claims.taskIncomplete = nil
617		e.service.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &claims)
618		if len(claims.taskIncomplete) > 0 {
619			return staleBoundary("task inventory became incomplete before branch deletion")
620		}
621		if len(claims.taskClaims) > 0 {
622			return staleBoundary("a task claimed the checkout path or branch before branch deletion")
623		}
624		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
625		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
626		if fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID || fresh.baseOID != baseline.baseOID ||
627			fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.baseOIDErr != nil || fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
628			return staleBoundary("branch or containment-base authority changed before branch deletion")
629		}
630		worktrees, err := e.service.gitWorktrees(ctx, baseline.repoPath)
631		if err != nil {
632			return err
633		}
634		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
635			if worktree.Branch == baseline.locator.Branch {
636				return staleBoundary("branch acquired another checkout before deletion")
637			}
638		}
639		return nil
640	}

642	func (e *executionState) verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
643		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
644		if err == nil {
645			return staleBoundary("exact unmanaged checkout remains registered after removal")
646		}
647		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
648			return fmt.Errorf("verify exact unmanaged checkout removal: %w", err)
649		}
650		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
651		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, "")
652		if !fresh.branchExists || fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID {
653			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("preserved local branch changed from %s to %s", baseline.branchOID, fresh.branchOID))
654		}
655		return nil
656	}

226	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx context.Context, observed *destructiveObservation) {
227		for _, diagnostic := range observed.taskDiagnostics {
228			observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete, diagnostic.Error())
229		}
230		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
231			candidate := record.Task
232			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
233				observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
234					fmt.Sprintf("task %s is invalid: %v", candidate.ID, err))
235				continue
236			}
237	
238			pathClaim := false
239			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
240				path, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
241				if err != nil {
242					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
243						fmt.Sprintf("task %s checkout identity is unavailable: %v", candidate.ID, err))
244				} else {
245					pathClaim = path == observed.checkout
246				}
247			}
248	
249			branchClaim := false
250			if candidate.Branch == observed.locator.Branch {
251				repoMatches, complete, detail := s.taskRepositoryMatches(ctx, candidate, *observed)
252				if !complete {
253					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
254						fmt.Sprintf("task %s repository identity is unavailable: %s", candidate.ID, detail))
255				} else {
256					branchClaim = repoMatches
257				}
258			}
259	
260			if pathClaim {
261				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
262					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "exact checkout path",
263				})
264			}
265			if branchClaim {
266				reason := "exact branch in selected repository"
267				if pathClaim {
268					reason = "exact checkout path and branch in selected repository"
269					observed.taskClaims[len(observed.taskClaims)-1].Reason = reason
270					continue
271				}
272				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
273					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: reason,
274				})
275			}
276		}
277		sort.Slice(observed.taskClaims, func(i, j int) bool {
278			if observed.taskClaims[i].ID != observed.taskClaims[j].ID {
279				return observed.taskClaims[i].ID < observed.taskClaims[j].ID
280			}
281			return observed.taskClaims[i].Reason < observed.taskClaims[j].Reason
282		})
283		sort.Strings(observed.taskIncomplete)

408	func artifactEvidenceFromInspection(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection) string {
409		if inspection.KnownEmpty {
410			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
411		}
412		states := make([]string, 0, len(inspection.Intents))
413		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
414			states = append(states, intent.Intent.ID+"="+string(intent.State))
415		}
416		if len(states) == 0 {
417			return "artifact readiness is incomplete"
418		}
419		return strings.Join(states, ", ")
420	}

426		}

429		}

534	func parkFallback(id string, cold bool, options interface{}) string {
535		parts := []string{"dev", "park", shellQuote(id)}
536		if cold {
537			parts = append(parts, "--cold")
538		}
539		switch value := options.(type) {
540		case ParkWarmOptions:
541			parts = appendParkFlags(parts, value.Next, value.Note, value.CommitWIP, value.Push,
542				value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime)
543			if value.Timeout > 0 {
544				parts = append(parts, "--timeout", value.Timeout.String())
545			}
546			if value.KeepSession {
547				parts = append(parts, "--keep-session")
548			}
549		case ParkColdOptions:
550			parts = appendParkFlags(parts, value.Next, value.Note, value.CommitWIP, value.Push,
551				value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime)
552			if value.Timeout > 0 {
553				parts = append(parts, "--timeout", value.Timeout.String())
554			}
555		}
556		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
557	}

559	func appendParkFlags(parts []string, next, note string, wip, push, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool) []string {
560		if next != "" {
561			parts = append(parts, "--next", shellQuote(next))
562		}
563		if note != "" {
564			parts = append(parts, "--note", shellQuote(note))
565		}
566		if wip {
567			parts = append(parts, "--wip")

569		if push {
570			parts = append(parts, "--push")
571		}
572		if closeUnknown {
573			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
574		}
575		if assumeNoRuntime {
576			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")

581	func shellQuote(value string) string {

584		}
585		return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\\''") + "'"

196	// shellQuote makes a path safe to paste into a POSIX shell command.
197	func shellQuote(s string) string {
198		if s == "" {
199			return "''"
200		}
201		safe := true
202		for _, r := range s {
203			if !(r == '/' || r == '.' || r == '-' || r == '_' || r == '~' ||
204				(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9')) {
205				safe = false
206				break
207			}
208		}
209		if safe && utf8.ValidString(s) {
210			return s
211		}
212		return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", `'\''`) + "'"
213	}

3	import "context"
4	
5	// PlanHook performs action-specific observation and returns only construction
6	// input. BuildPlan remains the single graph, availability, and identity
7	// authority.
8	type PlanHook func(context.Context, Request) (PlanSpec, error)
9	
10	// ApplyHook executes one already validated plan and may return a partial Result
11	// together with an error.
12	type ApplyHook func(context.Context, Plan) (Result, error)
13	
14	// Handler contains the narrow hooks for one exact action. Either hook may be
15	// omitted; no production or unsafe fallback is installed.
16	type Handler struct {
17		Plan  PlanHook
18		Apply ApplyHook
19	}
20	
21	// Handlers maps stable action codes to injected behavior.
22	type Handlers map[Action]Handler
23	
24	// LocateTaskHook builds one exact managed-task locator from fresh durable and
25	// Git evidence. It is intentionally not accepted by NewService: only the
26	// guarded lifecycle constructor may install it.
27	type LocateTaskHook func(context.Context, string) (Locator, error)
28	
29	// Service is the UI-agnostic locate/plan/apply dispatcher.
30	type Service struct {
31		handlers   map[Action]Handler
32		locateTask LocateTaskHook
33	}
34	
35	// NewService copies handlers so later mutation of the caller's map cannot
36	// redirect a planned action.
37	func NewService(handlers Handlers) *Service {
38		copied := make(map[Action]Handler, len(handlers))
39		for action, handler := range handlers {
40			copied[action] = handler
41		}
42		return &Service{handlers: copied}
43	}
44	
45	// LocateTask returns an exact locator only when this service came from
46	// NewLifecycleService. Generic dispatch services deliberately have no fallback
47	// locator because guessing task, repository, or checkout identity is unsafe.
48	func (s *Service) LocateTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
49		if s == nil || s.locateTask == nil {
50			return Locator{}, ErrLocatorUnavailable
51		}
52		return s.locateTask(ctx, taskID)
53	}
54	
55	// Plan validates and freezes a request, delegates action-specific observations,
56	// then centrally builds the immutable plan.
57	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, err
61		}
62		handler, ok := s.handlers[normalized.Action]
63		if !ok || handler.Plan == nil {
64			return Plan{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: normalized.Action, Stage: "plan"}
65		}
66		spec, err := handler.Plan(ctx, normalized.Clone())
67		if err != nil {
68			return Plan{}, err
69		}
70		return BuildPlan(normalized, spec)
71	}
72	
73	// Apply validates identity and approval, rejects every status except READY, and
74	// delegates only to the handler registered for the plan's exact action. A
75	// handler's partial Result is returned unchanged in meaning alongside errors.
76	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, plan Plan, approval Approval) (Result, error) {
77		frozen := plan.Clone()
78		if err := frozen.Validate(); err != nil {
79			return Result{}, err
80		}
81		if err := frozen.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
82			return Result{}, err
83		}
84		if frozen.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
85			notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{
86				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Availability: frozen.Availability,
87				conditions: frozen.Conditions(),
88			}
89			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{
90				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Reason: "required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady,
91			}
92		}
93		handler, ok := s.handlers[frozen.Action]
94		if !ok || handler.Apply == nil {
95			return Result{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: frozen.Action, Stage: "apply"}
96		}
97		result, err := handler.Apply(ctx, frozen.Clone())
98		result = result.Clone()
99		if err != nil && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 {
100			result.PartialSuccess = true
101		}
102		return result, err
103	}

27	// NewFields copies values into a deterministic immutable representation.
28	func NewFields(values map[string]string) Fields {
29		entries := make([]Field, 0, len(values))
30		for key, value := range values {
31			entries = append(entries, Field{Key: key, Value: value})
32		}
33		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Key < entries[j].Key })
34		return Fields{entries: entries}
35	}

192	// Clone returns an independent observation value.
193	func (o Observation) Clone() Observation {
194		o.attributes = o.attributes.clone()
195		return o
196	}
197	
198	// ConditionCode is a stable machine-readable safety or readiness check.
199	type ConditionCode string
200	
201	// Verdict is the result of evaluating one condition.
202	type Verdict string
203	
204	const (
205		VerdictMet         Verdict = "met"
206		VerdictNeedsInput  Verdict = "needs-input"
207		VerdictBlocked     Verdict = "blocked"
208		VerdictUnknown     Verdict = "unknown"
209		VerdictError       Verdict = "error"
210		VerdictUnsupported Verdict = "unsupported"
211		VerdictCurrent     Verdict = "current"
212	)
213	
214	// Requirement determines whether a condition can prevent Apply.
215	type Requirement string
216	
217	const (
218		RequirementRequired Requirement = "required"
219		RequirementAdvisory Requirement = "advisory"
220	)
221	
222	// Condition carries a stable decision plus operator-facing evidence and the
223	// narrow remediation for an unmet result.
224	type Condition struct {
225		Code        ConditionCode
226		Verdict     Verdict
227		Requirement Requirement
228		Evidence    string
229		Remediation string
230	}
231	
232	var stableCode = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
233	
234	// Validate rejects conditions that cannot be fingerprinted or aggregated with
235	// defined semantics.
236	func (c Condition) Validate() error {
237		if !stableCode.MatchString(string(c.Code)) {
238			return fmt.Errorf("condition code %q is not a stable lowercase code", c.Code)
239		}
240		switch c.Verdict {
241		case VerdictMet, VerdictNeedsInput, VerdictBlocked, VerdictUnknown, VerdictError, VerdictUnsupported, VerdictCurrent:
242		default:
243			return fmt.Errorf("condition %s has unknown verdict %q", c.Code, c.Verdict)
244		}
245		switch c.Requirement {
246		case RequirementRequired, RequirementAdvisory:
247		default:
248			return fmt.Errorf("condition %s has unknown requirement %q", c.Code, c.Requirement)
249		}
250		return nil
251	}
252	
253	// ConditionFromObservation maps observation completeness to a fail-closed
254	// verdict. Capability policy such as unsupported remains an explicit condition
255	// decision rather than an inferred observation result.
256	func ConditionFromObservation(code ConditionCode, requirement Requirement, observation Observation, remediation string) Condition {
257		verdict := VerdictUnknown
258		switch observation.State {
259		case ObservationKnown:
260			verdict = VerdictMet
261		case ObservationError:
262			verdict = VerdictError
263		case ObservationUnknown, ObservationSkipped, ObservationLoading:
264			verdict = VerdictUnknown
265		default:
266			verdict = VerdictError
267		}
268		evidence := observation.Evidence
269		if evidence == "" {
270			switch {
271			case observation.Failure != "":
272				evidence = observation.Failure
273			case observation.Value != "":
274				evidence = observation.Value
275			default:
276				evidence = string(observation.State)
277			}
278		}
279		return Condition{
280			Code: code, Verdict: verdict, Requirement: requirement,
281			Evidence: evidence, Remediation: remediation,
282		}
283	}
284	
285	// Availability is the aggregate action status shown by any caller.
286	type Availability string
287	
288	const (
289		AvailabilityReady       Availability = "ready"
290		AvailabilityNeedsInput  Availability = "needs-input"
291		AvailabilityBlocked     Availability = "blocked"
292		AvailabilityUnknown     Availability = "unknown"
293		AvailabilityError       Availability = "error"
294		AvailabilityUnsupported Availability = "unsupported"
295		AvailabilityCurrent     Availability = "current"
296	)
297	
298	// AvailabilityFor derives action readiness from required conditions only. The
299	// order is fail-closed and deterministic when more than one required condition
300	// is unmet; advisory evidence never changes the result.
301	func AvailabilityFor(conditions []Condition) Availability {
302		availability := AvailabilityReady
303		priority := func(value Availability) int {
304			switch value {
305			case AvailabilityError:
306				return 6
307			case AvailabilityBlocked:
308				return 5
309			case AvailabilityNeedsInput:
310				return 4
311			case AvailabilityUnknown:
312				return 3
313			case AvailabilityUnsupported:
314				return 2
315			case AvailabilityCurrent:
316				return 1
317			default:
318				return 0
319			}
320		}
321		for _, condition := range conditions {
322			if condition.Requirement == RequirementAdvisory {
323				continue
324			}
325			candidate := AvailabilityReady
326			if condition.Requirement != RequirementRequired {
327				candidate = AvailabilityError
328			} else {
329				switch condition.Verdict {
330				case VerdictMet:
331					continue
332				case VerdictNeedsInput:
333					candidate = AvailabilityNeedsInput
334				case VerdictBlocked:
335					candidate = AvailabilityBlocked
336				case VerdictUnknown:
337					candidate = AvailabilityUnknown
338				case VerdictError:
339					candidate = AvailabilityError
340				case VerdictUnsupported:
341					candidate = AvailabilityUnsupported
342				case VerdictCurrent:
343					candidate = AvailabilityCurrent
344				default:
345					candidate = AvailabilityError
346				}
347			}
348			if priority(candidate) > priority(availability) {
349				availability = candidate
350			}
351		}
352		return availability
353	}
354	
355	// EffectCode is a stable machine-readable mutation or external operation.
356	type EffectCode string
357	
358	// Effect is one ordered operation proposed by a plan. Details are immutable by
359	// interface and may carry exact refs, handles, or paths needed by an executor.
360	type Effect struct {
361		Code        EffectCode
362		Description string
363		Target      string
364		Destructive bool
365		Network     bool
366		Details     Fields
367	}
368	
369	// NewEffect copies details into deterministic storage.
370	func NewEffect(code EffectCode, description, target string, destructive, network bool, details map[string]string) Effect {
371		return Effect{
372			Code: code, Description: description, Target: target,
373			Destructive: destructive, Network: network, Details: NewFields(details),
374		}
375	}
376	
377	// Clone returns an independent effect value.
378	func (e Effect) Clone() Effect {
379		e.Details = e.Details.clone()
380		return e
381	}
382	
383	// Validate rejects effects without a stable code.
384	func (e Effect) Validate() error {
385		if !stableCode.MatchString(string(e.Code)) {
386			return fmt.Errorf("effect code %q is not a stable lowercase code", e.Code)
387		}
388		for _, field := range e.Details.entries {
389			if strings.TrimSpace(field.Key) == "" {
390				return fmt.Errorf("effect %s has an empty detail key", e.Code)
391			}
392		}
393		return nil
394	}

55	// BuildPlan validates graph legality, derives availability, and seals a plan's
56	// deterministic authority fingerprint and PlanID.
57	func BuildPlan(request Request, spec PlanSpec) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid request", Cause: err}
61		}
62		if err := spec.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
63			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
64		}
65		conditions := append([]Condition(nil), spec.Conditions...)
66		if err := validateConditions(conditions); err != nil {
67			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
68		}
69		effects := cloneEffects(spec.Effects)
70		if err := validateEffects(effects); err != nil {
71			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
72		}
73		authority := NewFields(spec.Authority)
74		if err := validateAuthority(authority); err != nil {
75			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
76		}
77	
78		plan := Plan{
79			Request: normalized.Clone(), Locator: normalized.Locator, Action: normalized.Action,
80			Source:       normalized.Locator.State,
81			Availability: AvailabilityFor(conditions), Confirmation: spec.Confirmation,
82			FallbackCommand: spec.FallbackCommand, Summary: spec.Summary, DisplayedAt: spec.DisplayedAt,
83			authority: authority, conditions: conditions, effects: effects,
84			retained: NewStringList(spec.RetainedResources...),
85		}
86		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
87			rule, transitionErr := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
88			if transitionErr != nil {
89				return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid transition", Cause: transitionErr}
90			}
91			plan.HasPersistedTransition = true
92			plan.Target = rule.Target
93			plan.StatePreserving = rule.StatePreserving
94			plan.RemovesTask = rule.RemovesTask
95			plan.ExpectedMilestone = rule.Milestone
96		} else {
97			switch plan.Action {
98			case Adopt:
99				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
100			case Reconcile:
101				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
102			}
103		}
104		plan.AuthorityFingerprint, plan.PlanID = computePlanIdentity(plan)
105		return plan.Clone(), nil
106	}

154	// Validate proves that a plan is structurally consistent and still carries its
155	// original deterministic identity. It performs no live observations.
156	func (p Plan) Validate() error {
157		if p.PlanID == "" || p.AuthorityFingerprint == "" {
158			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan identity is missing"}
159		}
160		if !p.Action.Valid() {
161			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown action %q", p.Action)}
162		}
163		if p.Request.Action != p.Action {
164			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request action and plan action differ"}
165		}
166		if p.Request.Locator != p.Locator {
167			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request locator and plan locator differ"}
168		}
169		if p.Request.Options == nil {
170			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "normalized request options are missing"}
171		}
172		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(p.Request)
173		if err != nil {
174			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request is no longer valid", Cause: err}
175		}
176		if requestIdentity(normalized) != requestIdentity(p.Request) {
177			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request options are not normalized"}
178		}
179		if err := p.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
180			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
181		}
182		if err := validateConditions(p.conditions); err != nil {
183			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
184		}
185		if err := validateEffects(p.effects); err != nil {
186			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
187		}
188		if err := validateAuthority(p.authority); err != nil {
189			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
190		}
191		if err := validatePlanTransition(p); err != nil {
192			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "transition metadata is inconsistent", Cause: err}
193		}
194	
195		authorityFingerprint, planID := computePlanIdentity(p)
196		if authorityFingerprint != p.AuthorityFingerprint {
197			return &StalePlanError{
198				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
199				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
200				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
201				Reason:                       "authority fields, effects, or conditions changed",
202			}
203		}
204		if planID != p.PlanID {
205			return &StalePlanError{
206				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
207				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
208				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
209				Reason:                       "PlanID does not match its authority fingerprint",
210			}
211		}
212		if availability := AvailabilityFor(p.conditions); availability != p.Availability {
213			return &InvalidPlanError{
214				PlanID: p.PlanID,
215				Reason: fmt.Sprintf("availability is %s, want derived %s", p.Availability, availability),
216			}
217		}
218		return nil
219	}

221	// ValidateApproval binds affirmative approval and any typed token to this exact
222	// plan. It never changes plan readiness or condition verdicts.
223	func (p Plan) ValidateApproval(approval Approval) error {
224		if err := p.Validate(); err != nil {
225			return err
226		}
227		if !approval.Granted {
228			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "affirmative approval was not granted", Cause: ErrApprovalRequired}
229		}
230		if approval.PlanID != p.PlanID {
231			return &StalePlanError{
232				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: approval.PlanID,
233				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
234				Reason:                       "approval names a different plan",
235			}
236		}
237		if p.Confirmation.Kind == ConfirmationTyped {
238			if approval.Token != p.Confirmation.Token {
239				return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "typed confirmation token does not match", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
240			}
241		} else if approval.Token != "" {
242			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan does not accept a typed confirmation token", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
243		}
244		return nil
245	}

247	func validatePlanTransition(plan Plan) error {
248		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
249			rule, err := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
250			if err != nil {
251				return err
252			}
253			if !plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Source != rule.Source || plan.Target != rule.Target ||
254				plan.StatePreserving != rule.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask != rule.RemovesTask ||
255				plan.ExpectedMilestone != rule.Milestone {
256				return fmt.Errorf("plan does not match the transition table")
257			}
258			return nil
259		}
260		expectedMilestone := MilestoneNone
261		switch plan.Action {
262		case Adopt:
263			expectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
264		case Reconcile:
265			expectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
266		}
267		if plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Target != "" || plan.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask ||
268			plan.Source != plan.Locator.State || plan.ExpectedMilestone != expectedMilestone {
269			return fmt.Errorf("domain action is represented as a persisted-state edge")
270		}
271		return nil
272	}

274	func validateConditions(conditions []Condition) error {
275		seen := make(map[ConditionCode]bool, len(conditions))
276		for index, condition := range conditions {
277			if err := condition.Validate(); err != nil {
278				return fmt.Errorf("condition %d: %w", index, err)
279			}
280			if seen[condition.Code] {
281				return fmt.Errorf("condition code %q is duplicated", condition.Code)
282			}
283			seen[condition.Code] = true
284		}
285		return nil
286	}

330	func computePlanIdentity(plan Plan) (string, string) {
331		writer := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-authority-v1")
332		appendRequestIdentity(writer, plan.Request)
333		writer.addString("plan.action", string(plan.Action))
334		writer.addString("plan.source", string(plan.Source))
335		writer.addString("plan.target", string(plan.Target))
336		writer.addBool("plan.has-persisted-transition", plan.HasPersistedTransition)
337		writer.addBool("plan.state-preserving", plan.StatePreserving)
338		writer.addBool("plan.removes-task", plan.RemovesTask)
339		writer.addString("plan.expected-milestone", string(plan.ExpectedMilestone))
340		writer.addFields("plan.authority", plan.authority)
341		writer.addInt64("plan.condition-count", int64(len(plan.conditions)))
342		for index, condition := range plan.conditions {
343			prefix := "plan.condition." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
344			writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(condition.Code))
345			writer.addString(prefix+"verdict", string(condition.Verdict))
346			writer.addString(prefix+"requirement", string(condition.Requirement))
347			writer.addString(prefix+"evidence", condition.Evidence)
348			writer.addString(prefix+"remediation", condition.Remediation)
349		}
350		writer.addInt64("plan.effect-count", int64(len(plan.effects)))
351		for index, effect := range plan.effects {
352			prefix := "plan.effect." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
353			writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(effect.Code))
354			writer.addString(prefix+"description", effect.Description)
355			writer.addString(prefix+"target", effect.Target)
356			writer.addBool(prefix+"destructive", effect.Destructive)
357			writer.addBool(prefix+"network", effect.Network)
358			writer.addFields(prefix+"details", effect.Details)
359		}
360		writer.addStrings("plan.retained", plan.retained.values)
361		writer.addString("plan.confirmation-kind", string(plan.Confirmation.Kind))
362		writer.addString("plan.confirmation-token", plan.Confirmation.Token)
363		authorityFingerprint := "sha256:" + writer.sumHex()
364	
365		planWriter := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-plan-v1")
366		planWriter.addString("authority-fingerprint", authorityFingerprint)
367		return authorityFingerprint, "plan:" + planWriter.sumHex()
368	}

411	}

413	func (w *identityWriter) addInt64(label string, value int64) {
414		w.addString(label, strconv.FormatInt(value, 10))
415	}
416	
417	func (w *identityWriter) addStrings(label string, values []string) {
418		w.addInt64(label+".count", int64(len(values)))
419		for index, value := range values {
420			w.addString(label+"."+strconv.Itoa(index), value)
421		}
422	}
423	
424	func (w *identityWriter) addFields(label string, fields Fields) {
425		w.addInt64(label+".count", int64(len(fields.entries)))
426		for index, field := range fields.entries {
427			prefix := label + "." + strconv.Itoa(index)
428			w.addString(prefix+".key", field.Key)
429			w.addString(prefix+".value", field.Value)
430		}
431	}
432	
433	func (w *identityWriter) addBytes(value []byte) {
434		var length [8]byte
435		binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(value)))
436		_, _ = w.buffer.Write(length[:])
437		_, _ = w.buffer.Write(value)
438	}
439	
440	func (w *identityWriter) sumHex() string {
441		sum := sha256.Sum256(w.buffer.Bytes())
442		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
443	}
444

29	// Validate checks that typed confirmation has an exact non-empty token and
30	// other classes cannot accidentally retain one.

32		switch c.Kind {

35				return fmt.Errorf("confirmation %q cannot carry a typed token", c.Kind)
36			}

196	// ResultSpec is mutable construction input. NewResult copies every collection
197	// and optional value before returning a Result.
198	type ResultSpec struct {
199		Steps            []StepResult
200		Warnings         []string
201		Recovery         []string
202		PartialSuccess   bool
203		Milestone        Milestone
204		Handoff          *Handoff

207	}
208	
209	// Result is a value-safe execution ledger. It deliberately has no rollback
210	// field: completed effects remain completed and recovery describes the next
211	// safe action instead of claiming reversal.
212	type Result struct {
213		PartialSuccess bool
214		Milestone      Milestone
215	
216		steps            []StepResult
217		warnings         []string
218		recovery         []string
219		handoff          Handoff
220		hasHandoff       bool
221		remote           RemoteObservation
222		hasRemote        bool
223		freshSnapshotRef string
224	}
225	
226	// NewResult defensively copies a result specification.
227	func NewResult(spec ResultSpec) Result {
228		result := Result{
229			PartialSuccess:   spec.PartialSuccess,
230			Milestone:        spec.Milestone,
231			warnings:         append([]string(nil), spec.Warnings...),
232			recovery:         append([]string(nil), spec.Recovery...),
233			freshSnapshotRef: spec.FreshSnapshotRef,
234		}
235		result.steps = cloneSteps(spec.Steps)
236		if spec.Handoff != nil {
237			result.handoff = *spec.Handoff
238			result.hasHandoff = true
239		}
240		if spec.Remote != nil {
241			result.remote = spec.Remote.Clone()
242			result.hasRemote = true
243		}
244		if !result.PartialSuccess && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 && len(result.FailedSteps()) > 0 {
245			result.PartialSuccess = true
246		}
247		return result
248	}
249	
250	// Clone returns a result with independent ledger and message slices.
251	func (r Result) Clone() Result {
252		r.steps = cloneSteps(r.steps)
253		r.warnings = append([]string(nil), r.warnings...)
254		r.recovery = append([]string(nil), r.recovery...)
255		return r
256	}
257	
258	// AttemptedSteps returns every effect entered by the executor, in order.
259	func (r Result) AttemptedSteps() []StepResult { return cloneSteps(r.steps) }
260	
261	// CompletedSteps returns completed effects in ledger order.
262	func (r Result) CompletedSteps() []StepResult { return stepsWithStatus(r.steps, StepCompleted) }
263	
264	// FailedSteps returns failed effects in ledger order.
265	func (r Result) FailedSteps() []StepResult { return stepsWithStatus(r.steps, StepFailed) }
266	
267	// Warnings returns non-fatal diagnostics in emission order.
268	func (r Result) Warnings() []string { return append([]string(nil), r.warnings...) }
269	
270	// Recovery returns ordered, safe follow-up instructions after partial work.
271	func (r Result) Recovery() []string { return append([]string(nil), r.recovery...) }
272	
273	// Handoff returns the optional post-UI navigation or activation target.
274	func (r Result) Handoff() (Handoff, bool) { return r.handoff, r.hasHandoff }
275	
276	// RemoteObservation returns the optional run-local remote/ref/review evidence.
277	// The returned value shares no mutable backing storage with Result.
278	func (r Result) RemoteObservation() (RemoteObservation, bool) {
279		return r.remote.Clone(), r.hasRemote
280	}
281	
282	// FreshSnapshotRef returns the optional freshly loaded after-snapshot reference.
283	func (r Result) FreshSnapshotRef() (string, bool) {
284		return r.freshSnapshotRef, r.freshSnapshotRef != ""
285	}
286	
287	func cloneSteps(steps []StepResult) []StepResult {
288		out := make([]StepResult, len(steps))
289		for index, step := range steps {
290			out[index] = step.Clone()
291		}
292		return out
293	}
294	
295	func stepsWithStatus(steps []StepResult, status StepStatus) []StepResult {
296		out := make([]StepResult, 0, len(steps))
297		for _, step := range steps {
298			if step.Status == status {
299				out = append(out, step.Clone())
300			}
301		}
302		return out
303	}

174	// NewLifecycleService installs the concrete guarded parking, resume, and
175	// completion handlers. Actions without complete policy implementations remain
176	// unavailable rather than falling back to an unsafe generic executor.
177	func NewLifecycleService(input LifecycleConfig) (*Service, error) {
178		implementation, err := newLifecycleImplementation(input)
179		if err != nil {
180			return nil, err
181		}
182		service := NewService(Handlers{
183			ParkWarm:       implementation.handler(ParkWarm),
184			ParkCold:       implementation.handler(ParkCold),
185			Resume:         implementation.handler(Resume),
186			CompleteDirect: implementation.handler(CompleteDirect),
187			CompleteFF:     implementation.handler(CompleteFF),
188			ReviewHandoff:  implementation.handler(ReviewHandoff),
189			VerifyMerged:   implementation.handler(VerifyMerged),
190			Retire:         implementation.retireHandler(),
191			Adopt:          implementation.adoptHandler(),
192			RemoveCheckout: implementation.removeCheckoutHandler(),
193			RefreshRemote:  implementation.refreshRemoteHandler(),
194		})
195		service.locateTask = implementation.locateExactTask
196		return service, nil
197	}
198	
199	func newLifecycleImplementation(input LifecycleConfig) (*lifecycleService, error) {
200		if input.Tasks == nil {
201			return nil, errors.New("taskflow lifecycle service requires a task store")
202		}
203		if input.Artifacts == nil {
204			return nil, errors.New("taskflow lifecycle service requires an artifact store")
205		}
206		if err := input.Config.Validate(); err != nil {
207			return nil, fmt.Errorf("taskflow lifecycle config: %w", err)
208		}
209	
210		host := strings.TrimSpace(input.Host)
211		if host == "" {
212			host = config.Hostname()
213		}
214		if host == "" || host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
215			return nil, errors.New("taskflow lifecycle host must be normalized")
216		}
217		cwd := input.CWD
218		if cwd == "" {
219			var err error
220			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
221			if err != nil {
222				return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve taskflow caller directory: %w", err)
223			}
224		}
225		callerWorkspace := input.CallerWorkspaceID
226		if callerWorkspace == "" {
227			callerWorkspace = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
228		}
229		callerPane := input.CallerPaneID
230		if callerPane == "" {
231			callerPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
232			if callerPane == "" {
233				callerPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
234			}
235		}
236		clock := input.Clock
237		if clock == nil {
238			clock = time.Now
239		}
240		logf := input.Logf
241		if logf == nil {
242			logf = func(string, ...any) {}
243		}
244	
245		defaultRuntime := input.DefaultRuntime
246		if defaultRuntime == nil {
247			defaultRuntime = func() runtime.Runtime {
248				return configuredRuntime(input.Config, input.Config.Runtime.Backend)
249			}
250		}
251		namedRuntime := input.NamedRuntime
252		if namedRuntime == nil {
253			namedRuntime = func(name string) runtime.Runtime {
254				return configuredRuntime(input.Config, name)
255			}
256		}
257	
258		s := &lifecycleService{
259			cfg: input.Config, tasks: input.Tasks, artifacts: input.Artifacts,
260			defaultRuntime: defaultRuntime, namedRuntime: namedRuntime,
261			host: host, cwd: cwd,
262			callerWorkspace: callerWorkspace, callerPane: callerPane,
263			allowSharedCheckout: input.AllowSharedCheckout,
264			clock:               clock, logf: logf,
265			repoLock: func(ctx context.Context, commonDir string, operation func() error) error {
266				return lockx.WithDir(ctx, filepath.Join(commonDir, "dev-taskflow"), "taskflow repository", operation)
267			},
268			gitDiscover: gitx.Discover,
269			gitStatus:   gitx.StatusOf,
270			gitInProgress: func(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, bool, error) {
271				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
272					return "", false, err
273				}
274				return gitx.InProgress(dir)
275			},
276			gitRun:           gitx.Run,
277			gitRemote:        gitx.Remote,
278			gitRefExists:     gitx.RefExists,
279			gitDefaultBranch: gitx.DefaultBranch,

440	func (s *lifecycleService) runtimeFor(candidate task.Task) (runtime.Runtime, error) {
441		var rt runtime.Runtime
442		if candidate.RuntimeHandle != "" && candidate.RuntimeName != "" {
443			rt = s.namedRuntime(candidate.RuntimeName)
444			if rt == nil {
445				return nil, fmt.Errorf("recorded runtime backend %q is unavailable", candidate.RuntimeName)
446			}
447			if rt.Name() != candidate.RuntimeName {
448				return nil, fmt.Errorf("recorded runtime backend %q resolved to %q", candidate.RuntimeName, rt.Name())
449			}
450		} else {
451			rt = s.defaultRuntime()
452		}
453		if rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "" {
454			return nil, errors.New("taskflow runtime resolver returned no backend")
455		}
456		return rt, nil
457	}
458	
459	func openRuntimeSurface(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, path, label string) (runtime.OpenResult, error) {
460		if rt == nil {
461			return runtime.OpenResult{}, errors.New("open runtime: no backend")
462		}
463		if worktreeRuntime, ok := rt.(runtime.WorktreeOpener); ok {
464			return worktreeRuntime.OpenWorktree(ctx, path, label)
465		}
466		return rt.Open(ctx, path, label)
467	}

471	func (w lifecycleLogWriter) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
472		for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(string(data), "\n"), "\n") {
473			if line != "" {
474				w.logf("%s", line)
475			}
476		}
477		return len(data), nil
478	}

254	func (e *executionState) run(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error)) error {
255		step := StepResult{Effect: effect.Clone(), Status: StepAttempted, StartedAt: e.service.now()}
256		detail, err := operation()
257		step.FinishedAt = e.service.now()
258		step.Detail = detail
259		if err != nil {
260			step.Status = StepFailed
261			step.Failure = err.Error()
262			e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
263			return err
264		}
265		step.Status = StepCompleted
266		e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
267		return nil
268	}
269	
270	func (e *executionState) runWarning(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error), warningPrefix string) {
271		err := e.run(effect, operation)
272		if err != nil {
273			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, warningPrefix+": "+err.Error())
274		}
275	}
276	
277	func (e *executionState) result() Result {
278		spec := ResultSpec{
279			Steps: e.steps, Warnings: e.warnings, Recovery: e.recovery,
280			PartialSuccess: e.partial,
281			Milestone:      e.milestone, Handoff: e.handoff, Remote: e.remote, FreshSnapshotRef: e.snapshot,
282		}
283		for _, step := range e.steps {
284			if step.Status == StepCompleted {
285				spec.PartialSuccess = true
286				break
287			}
288		}
289		if len(e.steps) > 0 && e.steps[len(e.steps)-1].Status == StepCompleted &&
290			(e.snapshot != "" || e.remote != nil) && len(e.recovery) == 0 {
291			// Successful completion is not partial merely because it had effects.
292			// Remote refresh is intentionally run-local and therefore completes with
293			// structured data rather than a persisted snapshot reference.
294			spec.PartialSuccess = false
295		}
296		return NewResult(spec)
297	}
298	
299	func (e *executionState) fail(err error, recovery ...string) (Result, error) {
300		e.recovery = append(e.recovery, recovery...)
301		return e.result(), err
302	}

336	func authorityHash(domain string, values ...string) string {
337		writer := newIdentityWriter(domain)
338		for index, value := range values {

340		}

428			values = append(values, "mixed")
429			for _, pane := range session.Mixed {
430				values = append(values, pane.ID, pane.CWD, pane.ShellCWD, pane.Agent, pane.AgentStatus, pane.AgentSession)
431			}
432		}
433		for _, agent := range occupancy.Agents {
434			values = append(values,
435				agent.Activity.PaneID, agent.Activity.WorkspaceID, agent.Activity.Agent,
436				agent.Activity.Name, agent.Status, agent.Activity.CWD,
437				agent.SessionHandle, boolString(agent.IsCaller), boolString(agent.Blocking),
438			)
439		}
440		return authorityHash("taskflow-occupancy-v1", values...)
441	}

469			stringifyStatus(observed.status), errorString(observed.statusErr),
470			observed.head, errorString(observed.headErr),

476	func occupancyObservationError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
477		if err != nil {
478			return err
479		}
480		if occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
481			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current %s runtime pane: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.CurrentPane.Err)
482		}
483		if occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
484			return fmt.Errorf("classify %s checkout coverage: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.SessionCoverageErr)
485		}
486		if occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil {
487			return fmt.Errorf("list %s runtime sessions: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.SessionList.Err)
488		}
489		if occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
490			return fmt.Errorf("list %s recognized agents: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err)
491		}
492		return nil
493	}
494	
495	func strictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
496		if observationErr := occupancyObservationError(occupancy, err); observationErr != nil {
497			return observationErr
498		}
499		var blockers []string
500		for _, agent := range occupancy.Agents {
501			if !agent.Blocking {
502				continue
503			}
504			label := agent.Activity.Name
505			if label == "" {
506				label = agent.Activity.Agent
507			}
508			if label == "" {
509				label = "agent"
510			}
511			blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, agent.Activity.PaneID))
512		}
513		if len(blockers) > 0 {
514			return fmt.Errorf("checkout is occupied by %s", strings.Join(blockers, ", "))
515		}
516		return nil
517	}
518	
519	func (s *lifecycleService) writerOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
520		if s.allowSharedCheckout {
521			return occupancyObservationError(occupancy, err)
522		}
523		return strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err)
524	}
525	
526	func savedHandleLive(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, handle string) bool {
527		if handle == "" {
528			return false
529		}
530		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
531			if session.Runtime.Handle == handle {
532				return true
533			}
534		}
535		return false
536	}
537	
538	func staleBoundary(reason string) error {
539		return &StalePlanError{Reason: reason}
540	}

545		if ctx == nil {
546			return errors.New("taskflow context is nil")
547		}
548		return ctx.Err()
549	}

143	func runFlow(app *App, launch flowLaunch, runProgram flowProgramRunner) error {
144		if runProgram == nil {
145			return errors.New("flow program runner is unavailable")
146		}
147		flowtui.SetColorEnabled(app.outStyle().enabled)
148		app.traceTUI = true
149		runCtx, cancelRun := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
150		finishSetup := app.trace.Start(perftrace.TUISetup, perftrace.Fields{})
151		runtimeResolver := newTUIRuntimeResolver(app)
152		loader := newFlowLoader(app, runtimeResolver, launch.cwd)
153		if launch.repository != nil {
154			loader.registerRepository(*launch.repository, true)
155		}
156		actions := loader.actions()
157		if app.deferredReleaseRefresh {
158			actions.AfterFirstView = func(context.Context) { app.refreshReleaseDetached() }
159		}
160		model := flowtui.New(actions, launch.preselected).WithContext(runCtx)
161		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
162		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
163		final, err := runProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen())
164		cancelRun()
165		app.finishTrace()
166		if err != nil {
167			return err
168		}
169		withHandoff, ok := final.(interface {
170			Handoff() (taskflow.Handoff, bool)
171		})
172		if !ok {
173			return nil
174		}
175		handoff, ok := withHandoff.Handoff()
176		if !ok {
177			return nil
178		}
179		return honorFlowHandoff(app, runtimeResolver, handoff)
180	}

182	func honorFlowHandoff(app *App, resolver flowRuntimeResolver, handoff taskflow.Handoff) error {
183		switch handoff.Kind {
184		case taskflow.HandoffDirectory:
185			if handoff.Path == "" {
186				return errors.New("flow returned an empty directory handoff")
187			}
188			return app.cdDirective(handoff.Path)
189		case taskflow.HandoffRuntime:
190			if handoff.Runtime == "" || handoff.RuntimeHandle == "" {
191				return errors.New("flow returned an incomplete runtime handoff")
192			}
193			var rt runtime.Runtime
194			if resolver != nil {
195				resolved, err := resolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
196				if err != nil {
197					return err
198				}
199				if resolved != nil && resolved.Name() == handoff.Runtime {
200					rt = resolved
201				}
202			}
203			if rt == nil {
204				rt = app.runtimeNamed(handoff.Runtime)
205			}
206			if rt == nil || rt.Name() != handoff.Runtime {
207				return fmt.Errorf("flow handoff backend %q is unavailable", handoff.Runtime)
208			}
209			return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
210		case taskflow.HandoffURL:
211			if handoff.URL == "" {
212				return errors.New("flow returned an empty URL handoff")
213			}
214			_, err := fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, handoff.URL)
215			return err
216		default:
217			return fmt.Errorf("flow returned unsupported handoff kind %q", handoff.Kind)
218		}
219	}

232	func availableFlowRepository(discovered gitx.Repo, preferred *repo.Repo, focus string) (flowRepository, error) {
233		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(discovered.GitCommonDir)
234		if err != nil {
235			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository identity: %w", err)
236		}
237		mainRoot := discovered.MainRoot
238		if mainRoot == "" && discovered.Bare {
239			mainRoot = discovered.GitCommonDir
240		}
241		mainRoot, err = pathx.Canonical(mainRoot)
242		if err != nil {
243			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository root: %w", err)
244		}
245		focusTarget := ""
246		if focus != "" {
247			focusTarget, err = pathx.Canonical(focus)
248			if err != nil {
249				return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow focus: %w", err)
250			}
251		}
252	
253		r := repo.Repo{
254			Name: discovered.Name, Path: mainRoot, RealPath: mainRoot,
255			CommonDir: commonDir, MainRoot: mainRoot, Bare: discovered.Bare, HasGit: true,
256		}
257		name := discovered.Name
258		if preferred != nil {
259			if preferred.Name != "" {
260				r.Name = preferred.Name
261			}
262			r.Root = preferred.Root
263			r.Category = preferred.Category
264			name = preferred.Display()
265			if name == "" {
266				name = r.Name
267			}
268		}
269		return flowRepository{
270			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
271				RepoKey: commonDir, Name: name, Path: mainRoot, Available: true,
272				FocusTarget: focusTarget,
273			},
274			repository: r,
275			available:  true,
276		}, nil
277	}

279	func unavailableFlowRepository(record task.Record, cause error) flowRepository {

430			entry, convertErr := availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, &candidate, "")
431			if convertErr != nil {

433			}
434			if _, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
435				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry

439		pathResults := make(map[string]struct {

442		})

463				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = existing
464			} else {
465				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
466			}
467		}
468	
469		rows := make([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, 0, len(fresh))
470		for _, entry := range fresh {
471			rows = append(rows, entry.row)
472		}
473		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
474			left, right := strings.ToLower(rows[i].Name), strings.ToLower(rows[j].Name)
475			if left != right {
476				return left < right
477			}
478			if rows[i].Path != rows[j].Path {

480			}
481			return rows[i].RepoKey < rows[j].RepoKey
482		})
483		l.mu.Lock()
484		l.repositories = fresh
485		l.mu.Unlock()
486		return rows, nil
487	}
