36	func newLifecycleSession(ctx context.Context, app *App, resolve lifecycleTaskResolver) (lifecycleSession, error) {
37		var session lifecycleSession
38		selected, err := resolve()
39		if err != nil {
40			return session, err
41		}
42		if selected == nil {
43			return session, errors.New("task resolver returned no task")
44		}
45		session.Selected = *selected
46	
47		service, err := newCLILifecycleService(app)
48		if err != nil {
49			return session, err
50		}
51		session.service = service
52		session.Locator, err = service.LocateTask(ctx, selected.ID)
53		if err != nil {
54			return session, err
55		}
56		return session, nil
57	}

59	func (s lifecycleSession) plan(ctx context.Context, options flow.ActionOptions) (flow.Plan, error) {
60		request, err := flow.NewRequest(s.Locator, options)
61		if err != nil {
62			return flow.Plan{}, presentLifecycleRequestError(s.Selected, options.Action(), err)
63		}
64		return s.service.Plan(ctx, request)
65	}
66	
67	func (s lifecycleSession) apply(ctx context.Context, plan flow.Plan, approval flow.Approval) (flow.Result, error) {
68		return s.service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
69	}

71	func (s lifecycleSession) finalTask(app *App) (task.Task, error) {
72		final, err := app.Tasks.GetRecord(s.Locator.TaskID)
73		if err != nil {
74			return task.Task{}, fmt.Errorf("load final exact task %s: %w", s.Locator.TaskID, err)
75		}
76		return final.Task, nil
77	}

79	func (s lifecycleSession) requireRetired(app *App, result flow.Result) error {
80		if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneRetired {
81			return fmt.Errorf("task %s retirement returned milestone %s, want %s",
82				s.Locator.TaskID, result.Milestone, flow.MilestoneRetired)
83		}
84		if _, err := app.Tasks.GetRecord(s.Locator.TaskID); !errors.Is(err, task.ErrNotFound) {
85			if err == nil {
86				return fmt.Errorf("task %s retirement completed but the task record still exists", s.Locator.TaskID)
87			}
88			return fmt.Errorf("verify retired task %s is absent: %w", s.Locator.TaskID, err)
89		}
90		return nil
91	}

93	func executeTaskLifecycle(
94		ctx context.Context,
95		app *App,
96		resolve lifecycleTaskResolver,
97		options flow.ActionOptions,
98	) (lifecycleExecution, error) {
99		var execution lifecycleExecution
100		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, resolve)
101		if err != nil {
102			return execution, err
103		}
104		execution.Selected = session.Selected
105		execution.Plan, err = session.plan(ctx, options)
106		if err != nil {
107			return execution, err
108		}
109		execution.Result, err = session.apply(ctx, execution.Plan, flow.Approve(execution.Plan.PlanID))
110		renderLifecycleResult(app, execution.Plan, execution.Result)
111		if err != nil {
112			return execution, presentLifecycleApplyError(execution.Plan, err)
113		}
114	
115		execution.Task, err = session.finalTask(app)
116		if err != nil {
117			return execution, err
118		}
119		return execution, nil
120	}

122	// exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator converts a branch-selected checkout into the
123	// canonical identity taskflow requires. Branch lookup is only selection; fresh
124	// Git registry evidence supplies every authority field used by the plan.
125	func exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx context.Context, repoPath, checkoutPath string) (flow.Locator, error) {
126		registered, err := gitx.ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx, repoPath, checkoutPath)
127		if err != nil {
128			return flow.Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve exact registered worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(checkoutPath), err)
129		}
130		return flow.Locator{
131			RepoKey:      registered.GitCommonDir,
132			RowKey:       registered.Path,
133			RowKind:      "unmanaged",
134			RepositoryID: registered.GitCommonDir,
135			GitCommonDir: registered.GitCommonDir,
136			RepoPath:     registered.RepositoryPath,
137			CheckoutPath: registered.Path,
138			Branch:       registered.Worktree.Branch,
139			HeadOID:      registered.Worktree.Head,
140		}, nil
141	}
142	
143	// executeNonTaskLifecycle applies an exact non-task plan as an explicitly
144	// invoked CLI action. Destructive compatibility flags authorize only the typed
145	// token sealed into that same plan; they do not change readiness or blockers.
146	func executeNonTaskLifecycle(
147		ctx context.Context,
148		app *App,
149		locator flow.Locator,
150		options flow.ActionOptions,
151		authorizeTyped bool,
152	) (nonTaskLifecycleExecution, error) {
153		var execution nonTaskLifecycleExecution
154		service, err := newCLILifecycleService(app)
155		if err != nil {
156			return execution, err
157		}
158		request, err := flow.NewRequest(locator, options)
159		if err != nil {
160			return execution, err
161		}
162		execution.Plan, err = service.Plan(ctx, request)
163		if err != nil {
164			return execution, err
165		}
166		approval := flow.Approve(execution.Plan.PlanID)
167		if execution.Plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
168			if !authorizeTyped {
169				return execution, fmt.Errorf("%s requires its exact typed confirmation", execution.Plan.Summary)
170			}
171			approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(execution.Plan.PlanID, execution.Plan.Confirmation.Token)
172		}
173		execution.Result, err = service.Apply(ctx, execution.Plan, approval)
174		renderLifecycleResult(app, execution.Plan, execution.Result)
175		if err != nil {
176			return execution, presentLifecycleApplyError(execution.Plan, err)
177		}
178		return execution, nil
179	}

181	func newCLILifecycleService(app *App) (*flow.Service, error) {
182		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
183		if err != nil {
184			return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve lifecycle caller directory: %w", err)
185		}
186		return flow.NewLifecycleService(flow.LifecycleConfig{
187			Config:              app.Cfg,
188			Tasks:               app.Tasks,
189			Artifacts:           artifactStore(app),
190			DefaultRuntime:      app.Runtime,
191			NamedRuntime:        app.runtimeNamed,
192			Host:                config.Hostname(),
193			CWD:                 cwd,
194			AllowSharedCheckout: app.allowSharedCheckout,
195			Logf: func(format string, args ...any) {
196				if app.Err != nil {
197					fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, format+"\n", args...)
198				}
199			},
200		})
201	}
202	
203	func renderLifecycleResult(app *App, plan flow.Plan, result flow.Result) {
204		style := app.outStyle()
205		for _, step := range result.AttemptedSteps() {
206			if step.Status == flow.StepFailed {
207				label := step.Effect.Description
208				if label == "" {
209					label = string(step.Effect.Code)
210				}
211				failure := step.Failure
212				if failure == "" {
213					failure = "operation failed"
214				}
215				app.warnf("%s failed: %s", label, failure)
216				continue
217			}
218			if step.Status != flow.StepCompleted {
219				continue
220			}
221	
222			details := step.Effect.Details.Map()
223			switch step.Effect.Code {
224			case flow.EffectCommitWIP, flow.EffectCommitAll:
225				message := details["message"]
226				if message == "" {
227					message = step.Detail
228				}
229				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("committed"), message)
230			case flow.EffectDiscardAll:
231				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  checkout changes\n", style.label("discarded"))
232			case flow.EffectPushBranch, flow.EffectPushBase:
233				pushed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "pushed ")
234				pushed = strings.TrimPrefix(pushed, "published ")
235				if pushed == step.Detail || pushed == "" {
236					pushed = "origin/" + step.Effect.Target
237				}
238				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("pushed"), pushed)
239			case flow.EffectCloseRuntime:
240				closed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "closed ")
241				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("closed"), closed)
242			case flow.EffectRemoveWorktree:
243				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s removed: %s\n", style.label("worktree"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
244			case flow.EffectDeleteBranch:
245				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s deleted\n", style.label("branch"), step.Effect.Target)
246			case flow.EffectDeleteTask:
247				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s reaped\n", style.label("task"), step.Effect.Target)
248			case flow.EffectRebaseBranch:
249				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebased"), strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "rebased "))
250			case flow.EffectSwitchBase, flow.EffectSwitchBranch:
251				switched := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "switched ")
252				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("switched"), switched)
253			case flow.EffectMergeFF:
254				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("integrated"), step.Detail)
255			case flow.EffectCreateReview:
256				if handoff, ok := result.Handoff(); ok && handoff.Kind == flow.HandoffURL && handoff.URL != "" {
257					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("opened"), handoff.URL)
258				}
259			case flow.EffectVerifyAncestry:
260				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("verified"), step.Detail)
261			case flow.EffectUpdateTask:
262				if isCompletionAction(plan.Action) {
263					state := details["state"]
264					if state == "" {
265						state = "lifecycle state"
266					}
267					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("recorded"), strings.ToUpper(state))
268				}
269			case flow.EffectCreateWorktree:
270				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebuilt"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
271			}
272		}
273		for _, warning := range result.Warnings() {
274			switch warning {
275			case "no next action is recorded":
276				app.warnf("no next action recorded — `dev park --next \"...\"` is what makes resuming cheap")
277			default:
278				app.warnf("%s", warning)
279			}
280		}
281		for _, recovery := range result.Recovery() {
282			app.warnf("recovery: %s", recovery)
283		}
284	}
285	
286	func isCompletionAction(action flow.Action) bool {
287		switch action {
288		case flow.CompleteDirect, flow.CompleteFF, flow.ReviewHandoff, flow.VerifyMerged:
289			return true
290		default:
291			return false
292		}
293	}
294	
295	func presentLifecycleRequestError(selected task.Task, action flow.Action, err error) error {
296		var transition *flow.InvalidTransitionError
297		if !errors.As(err, &transition) {
298			return err
299		}
300		if action == flow.ParkCold && selected.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
301			return fmt.Errorf("direct task %s uses the canonical checkout on %s, so it cannot go cold; park it warm or finish it: %w",
302				selected.Title(), selected.Branch, err)
303		}
304		if action == flow.Retire {
305			return fmt.Errorf("task %s is %s, not merged; run dev done first: %w", selected.ID, selected.State, err)
306		}
307		return err
308	}
309	
310	func presentLifecycleApplyError(plan flow.Plan, err error) error {
311		if !errors.Is(err, flow.ErrPlanNotReady) {
312			return err
313		}
314		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
315		for _, condition := range blocking {
316			switch condition.Code {
317			case flow.ConditionCheckoutClean:
318				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
319					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes (%s).\nCommit them, or re-run with --force to discard them: %w",
320						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
321				}
322				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
323					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes; going cold removes the worktree.\nCommit them, or re-run with --wip to checkpoint automatically: %w",
324						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), err)
325				}
326			case flow.ConditionBranchPublished, flow.ConditionBranchPushed:
327				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
328					return fmt.Errorf("%s is not fully pushed (%s); a cold task must be reconstructible from the remote.\nRun `dev park --cold --push`: %w",
329						plan.Locator.Branch, condition.Evidence, err)
330				}
331			case flow.ConditionTaskClaims:
332				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
333					return fmt.Errorf("%s is claimed by task metadata (%s).\nUse managed dev park/dev retire, or reconcile the task claim before removing this checkout: %w",
334						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
335				}
336			case flow.ConditionTaskInventory:
337				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
338					return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove %s is unmanaged because task inventory is incomplete (%s).\nRepair or reconcile task metadata before using dev park/dev retire or removing this checkout: %w",
339						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
340				}
341			case flow.ConditionOwner:
342				if plan.Action == flow.Resume {
343					owner := plan.AuthorityFields()["task.owner"]
344					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is owned by %s.\nMake sure that machine has pushed its work, then re-run with --force to take ownership: %w",
345						plan.Locator.TaskID, owner, err)
346				}
347			case flow.ConditionAgentOccupancy:
348				if plan.Action == flow.Resume && strings.HasPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ") {
349					occupant := strings.TrimPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ")
350					return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership: %w",
351						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), occupant, err)
352				}
353			}
354		}
355	
356		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
357		for _, condition := range blocking {
358			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
359			if condition.Remediation != "" {
360				message += " (" + condition.Remediation + ")"
361			}
362			parts = append(parts, message)
363		}
364		if len(parts) == 0 {
365			return err
366		}
367		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability, strings.Join(parts, "; "), err)
368	}

227			message.repoKey != pickerRequestKey || m.listRequest.repoKey != pickerRequestKey {
228			return m, nil
229		}
230		if m.listRequest.cancel != nil {
231			m.listRequest.cancel()
232		}
233		m.listRequest.cancel = nil
234		m.listRequest.loading = false
235		m.listRequest.err = message.err
236	
237		selectedKey := ""
238		if selected, ok := m.currentRepository(); ok {
239			selectedKey = selected.RepoKey
240		}
241		oldIndex := m.repoCursor
242		if message.err != nil {
243			m.listRequest.stale = len(m.repositories) > 0
244			m.status = ""
245			return m, nil
246		}
247	
248		m.repositories = append([]RepositoryRow(nil), message.rows...)
249		m.listRequest.stale = false
250		m.status = ""
251		m.repoCursor = nearestRepositoryIndex(m.filteredRepositories(), selectedKey, oldIndex)
252		return m, nil
253	}
254	
255	func nearestRepositoryIndex(rows []RepositoryRow, repoKey string, oldIndex int) int {
256		if repoKey != "" {
257			for index, row := range rows {
258				if row.RepoKey == repoKey {
259					return index
260				}
261			}
262		}
263		if len(rows) == 0 {
264			return 0
265		}
266		if oldIndex < 0 {
267			return 0
268		}
269		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
270			return len(rows) - 1
271		}
272		return oldIndex
273	}

276		if message.generation != m.loadRequest.generation ||

278			return m, nil
279		}
280		if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
281			m.loadRequest.cancel()

283		m.loadRequest.cancel = nil

289				message.snapshot.Repository.RepoKey, message.repoKey,
290			)
291		}
292		if message.err != nil {
293			m.loadRequest.err = message.err
294			m.loadRequest.stale = m.hasSnapshot
295			if m.hasSnapshot {
296				m.snapshot.Freshness = FreshnessStale
297			}
298			m.status = ""
299			return m, nil
300		}
301	
302		oldRow, hadOldRow := m.currentSurface()
303		oldIndex := m.rowCursor
304		oldActionID := ""

322		rows := accepted.Surfaces.Values()
323		m.rowCursor = retainedSurfaceIndex(rows, oldRow, hadOldRow, oldIndex, m.desiredFocus)
324		m.desiredFocus = ""
325		m.actionCursor = retainedActionIndex(rows, m.rowCursor, oldActionID)
326		m.clampActionCursor()
327		m.status = ""
328		return m, nil
329	}

331	func retainedSurfaceIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, previous SurfaceRow, hadPrevious bool, oldIndex int, focus string) int {
332		if len(rows) == 0 {
333			return 0
334		}
335		if hadPrevious {
336			for index, row := range rows {
337				if row.RowKey == previous.RowKey {
338					return index
339				}
340			}
341			if previous.Locator.TaskID != "" {
342				for index, row := range rows {
343					if row.Locator.TaskID == previous.Locator.TaskID {
344						return index
345					}
346				}
347			}
348			for index, row := range rows {
349				if locatorsReferToSameSurface(previous.Locator, row.Locator) {
350					return index
351				}
352			}
353		}
354		if focus != "" {
355			for index, row := range rows {
356				if row.RowKey == focus || row.Locator.RowKey == focus {
357					return index
358				}
359			}
360			for index, row := range rows {
361				if row.Locator.TaskID == focus {
362					return index
363				}
364			}
365			for index, row := range rows {
366				if row.Locator.CheckoutPath == focus {
367					return index
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		if oldIndex < 0 {
372			return 0
373		}
374		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
375			return len(rows) - 1
376		}
377		return oldIndex
378	}
379	
380	func retainedActionIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, rowIndex int, actionID string) int {
381		if actionID == "" || rowIndex < 0 || rowIndex >= len(rows) {
382			return 0
383		}
384		for index, action := range rows[rowIndex].Actions.Values() {
385			if action.ID == actionID {
386				return index
387			}
388		}
389		return 0
390	}

392	func locatorsReferToSameSurface(left, right taskflow.Locator) bool {
393		if left.RepositoryID != "" && right.RepositoryID != "" && left.RepositoryID != right.RepositoryID {
394			return false
395		}
396		if left.CheckoutPath != "" && right.CheckoutPath != "" {
397			return left.CheckoutPath == right.CheckoutPath
398		}
399		if left.TaskID != "" && right.TaskID != "" {
400			return left.TaskID == right.TaskID
401		}
402		return left.RepoKey != "" && left.RepoKey == right.RepoKey &&
403			left.Branch != "" && left.Branch == right.Branch && left.Base == right.Base
404	}

407		if message.generation != m.planRequest.generation ||
408			message.repoKey != m.planRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey ||
409			message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey || message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
410			return m, nil
411		}
412		if m.planRequest.cancel != nil {
413			m.planRequest.cancel()
414		}
415		m.planRequest.cancel = nil
416		m.planRequest.loading = false
417		m.planRequest.err = message.err
418		m.overlay = overlayPlan
419		m.status = ""
420	
421		if message.plan.PlanID != "" {
422			m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
423			m.hasPlan = true
424		}
425		if message.err != nil {
426			m.planErr = message.err
427			return m, nil
428		}
429		if err := message.plan.Validate(); err != nil {
430			m.planErr = combineError("invalid plan returned by callback", err)
431			return m, nil
432		}
433		if message.plan.Locator != m.planTarget.locator {
434			m.planErr = errors.New("plan locator does not match the exact selected surface")
435			return m, nil
436		}
437		if message.plan.Action != m.planTarget.choice.Action() {
438			m.planErr = errors.New("plan action does not match the exact selected action options")
439			return m, nil
440		}
441		expected, err := taskflow.NewRequest(m.planTarget.locator, m.planTarget.choice.Options())
442		if err != nil {
443			m.planErr = combineError("selected action options are invalid", err)
444			return m, nil
445		}
446		if !reflect.DeepEqual(message.plan.Request.Options, expected.Options) {
447			m.planErr = errors.New("plan was built with different concrete action options than the selected choice")
448			return m, nil
449		}
450		m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
451		m.hasPlan = true
452		m.planErr = nil
453		if m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady && m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
454			m.confirm.SetValue("")
455			m.confirm.CursorEnd()
456			return m, m.confirm.Focus()
457		}
458		return m, nil
459	}

461	func (m Model) acceptApply(message applyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
462		if !m.applyRunning || message.generation != m.applyGeneration ||
463			message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey || message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey ||
464			message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
465			return m, nil
466		}
467		m.applyRunning = false
468		m.overlay = overlayResult
469		m.lastResult = message.result.Clone()
470		m.hasLastResult = true
471		m.lastResultErr = message.err
472		m.status = ""
473		if remote, ok := message.result.RemoteObservation(); ok {
474			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
475		}
476		if message.err == nil {
477			if handoff, ok := message.result.Handoff(); ok {
478				m.finalHandoff = handoff
479				m.hasHandoff = true
480			}
481		}
482	
483		queuedQuit := m.queuedQuit
484		m.queuedQuit, m.queuedRefresh = false, false
485		updated, command := m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
486		m = updated.(Model)
487		if queuedQuit {
488			// The fresh generation is established before honoring the queued quit. It
489			// cannot authorize anything and the mutation ledger remains in final Model.
490			if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
491				m.loadRequest.cancel()
492				m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
493			}
494			m.quitting = true
495			return m, tea.Quit
496		}
497		return m, command
498	}

5	// PlanHook performs action-specific observation and returns only construction

8	type PlanHook func(context.Context, Request) (PlanSpec, error)
9	
10	// ApplyHook executes one already validated plan and may return a partial Result
11	// together with an error.
12	type ApplyHook func(context.Context, Plan) (Result, error)
13	
14	// Handler contains the narrow hooks for one exact action. Either hook may be
15	// omitted; no production or unsafe fallback is installed.
16	type Handler struct {
17		Plan  PlanHook
18		Apply ApplyHook
19	}
20	
21	// Handlers maps stable action codes to injected behavior.
22	type Handlers map[Action]Handler
23	
24	// LocateTaskHook builds one exact managed-task locator from fresh durable and
25	// Git evidence. It is intentionally not accepted by NewService: only the
26	// guarded lifecycle constructor may install it.
27	type LocateTaskHook func(context.Context, string) (Locator, error)
28	
29	// Service is the UI-agnostic locate/plan/apply dispatcher.
30	type Service struct {
31		handlers   map[Action]Handler
32		locateTask LocateTaskHook
33	}
34	
35	// NewService copies handlers so later mutation of the caller's map cannot
36	// redirect a planned action.
37	func NewService(handlers Handlers) *Service {
38		copied := make(map[Action]Handler, len(handlers))
39		for action, handler := range handlers {
40			copied[action] = handler
41		}
42		return &Service{handlers: copied}
43	}
44	
45	// LocateTask returns an exact locator only when this service came from
46	// NewLifecycleService. Generic dispatch services deliberately have no fallback
47	// locator because guessing task, repository, or checkout identity is unsafe.
48	func (s *Service) LocateTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
49		if s == nil || s.locateTask == nil {
50			return Locator{}, ErrLocatorUnavailable
51		}
52		return s.locateTask(ctx, taskID)
53	}
54	
55	// Plan validates and freezes a request, delegates action-specific observations,
56	// then centrally builds the immutable plan.
57	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, err
61		}
62		handler, ok := s.handlers[normalized.Action]
63		if !ok || handler.Plan == nil {
64			return Plan{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: normalized.Action, Stage: "plan"}
65		}
66		spec, err := handler.Plan(ctx, normalized.Clone())
67		if err != nil {
68			return Plan{}, err
69		}
70		return BuildPlan(normalized, spec)
71	}
72	
73	// Apply validates identity and approval, rejects every status except READY, and
74	// delegates only to the handler registered for the plan's exact action. A
75	// handler's partial Result is returned unchanged in meaning alongside errors.
76	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, plan Plan, approval Approval) (Result, error) {
77		frozen := plan.Clone()
78		if err := frozen.Validate(); err != nil {
79			return Result{}, err
80		}
81		if err := frozen.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
82			return Result{}, err
83		}
84		if frozen.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
85			notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{
86				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Availability: frozen.Availability,
87				conditions: frozen.Conditions(),
88			}
89			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{
90				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Reason: "required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady,
91			}
92		}
93		handler, ok := s.handlers[frozen.Action]
94		if !ok || handler.Apply == nil {
95			return Result{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: frozen.Action, Stage: "apply"}
96		}
97		result, err := handler.Apply(ctx, frozen.Clone())
98		result = result.Clone()
99		if err != nil && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 {
100			result.PartialSuccess = true
101		}
102		return result, err
103	}

22	func normalizeDirty(policy DirtyPolicy) DirtyPolicy {

29	func validateDirty(policy DirtyPolicy, message string) error {

35		}
36		if message != "" && policy != DirtyAuto && policy != DirtyCommit {
37			return fmt.Errorf("commit message requires dirty policy auto or commit")
38		}
39		return nil
40	}

206	// Request binds one action and its typed options to an exact selected locator.
207	// DisplayedAt may be used by a caller but does not contribute to plan identity.
208	type Request struct {
209		Locator     Locator
210		Action      Action
211		Options     ActionOptions
212		DisplayedAt time.Time
213	}
214	
215	// NewRequest infers the action from options and returns a normalized value.
216	func NewRequest(locator Locator, options ActionOptions) (Request, error) {
217		if options == nil {
218			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action options are required", ErrInvalidRequest)
219		}
220		normalized, err := cloneActionOptions(options, "")
221		if err != nil {
222			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
223		}
224		request := Request{Locator: locator, Action: normalized.Action(), Options: normalized}
225		return normalizeRequest(request)
226	}
227	
228	// Clone returns a request whose option-owned collection values are independent.
229	func (r Request) Clone() Request {
230		options, err := cloneActionOptions(r.Options, r.Action)
231		if err == nil {
232			r.Options = options
233		}
234		return r
235	}
236	
237	// Validate checks option/action agreement and graph legality without performing
238	// observations or side effects.
239	func (r Request) Validate() error {
240		_, err := normalizeRequest(r)
241		return err
242	}
243	
244	func normalizeRequest(request Request) (Request, error) {
245		if !request.Action.Valid() {
246			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown action %q", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action)
247		}
248		options, err := cloneActionOptions(request.Options, request.Action)
249		if err != nil {
250			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
251		}
252		if options.Action() != request.Action {
253			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action %s cannot use %s options", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, options.Action())
254		}
255		if err := validateActionOptions(options); err != nil {
256			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, err)
257		}
258		request.Options = options
259		if isTransitionAction(request.Action) {
260			if _, err := RequireTransition(request.Locator.Mode, request.Locator.State, request.Action); err != nil {
261				return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
262			}
263		}
264		return request, nil
265	}

410	func validateActionOptions(options ActionOptions) error {
411		switch value := options.(type) {
412		case ParkWarmOptions:
413			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
414		case ParkColdOptions:
415			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
416		case ResumeOptions:
417			return nil
418		case CompleteDirectOptions:
419			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
420		case CompleteFFOptions:
421			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
422		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
423			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
424		case VerifyMergedOptions:
425			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
426		case RetireOptions:
427			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
428		case AdoptOptions:
429			if value.Mode != "" && value.Mode != task.ModeWorktree {
430				return fmt.Errorf("adopted checkout mode must be empty or %q, got %q", task.ModeWorktree, value.Mode)
431			}
432			if value.State != "" && !validState(value.State) {
433				return fmt.Errorf("unknown adopted task state %q", value.State)
434			}
435			if value.Base != strings.TrimSpace(value.Base) || strings.ContainsRune(value.Base, '\x00') {
436				return fmt.Errorf("adopted base must be normalized")
437			}
438			return nil
439		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
440			if err := validateTimeout(value.Timeout); err != nil {
441				return err
442			}
443			if value.DeleteContainedBranch && !value.RequireContained {
444				return fmt.Errorf("contained branch deletion requires containment proof")
445			}
446			if value.RequireContained {
447				if value.ContainmentBase == "" || value.ContainmentBase != strings.TrimSpace(value.ContainmentBase) ||
448					strings.ContainsRune(value.ContainmentBase, '\x00') {
449					return fmt.Errorf("containment base must be a normalized nonempty branch")
450				}
451			} else if value.ContainmentBase != "" {
452				return fmt.Errorf("containment base requires containment proof")
453			}
454			return nil
455		case RefreshRemoteOptions:
456			if !value.FetchRefs && !value.QueryReview {
457				return fmt.Errorf("select fetch refs, query review, or both")
458			}
459			return nil
460		case ReconcileOptions:
461			if strings.TrimSpace(value.Name) == "" {
462				return fmt.Errorf("a named reconciliation is required")
463			}
464			if value.Name != strings.TrimSpace(value.Name) {
465				return fmt.Errorf("reconciliation name must be normalized")
466			}
467			return nil
468		default:
469			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported options type %T", options)
470		}
471	}
472	
473	func validateTimeout(timeout time.Duration) error {
474		if timeout < 0 {
475			return fmt.Errorf("timeout cannot be negative")
476		}
477		return nil
478	}

482		switch value := options.(type) {

485			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
486			writer.addBool("commit-wip", value.CommitWIP)
487			writer.addBool("push", value.Push)
488			writer.addBool("keep-session", value.KeepSession)
489			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
490		case ParkColdOptions:
491			writer.addString("next", value.Next)
492			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
493			writer.addBool("commit-wip", value.CommitWIP)
494			writer.addBool("push", value.Push)
495			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
496		case ResumeOptions:
497			writer.addBool("fetch-refs", value.FetchRefs)
498			writer.addBool("no-provision", value.NoProvision)
499			writer.addBool("take-ownership", value.TakeOwnership)

502		case CompleteFFOptions:

504		case ReviewHandoffOptions:

506			writer.addString("commit-message", value.CommitMessage)
507			writer.addBool("draft", value.Draft)
508			writer.addString("title", value.Title)
509			writer.addString("body", value.Body)
510		case VerifyMergedOptions:
511			writer.addString("dirty", string(value.Dirty))
512			writer.addString("commit-message", value.CommitMessage)
513			writer.addString("base-ref", value.BaseRef)

531			writer.addString("containment-base", value.ContainmentBase)

534		case RefreshRemoteOptions:

5	// TransitionRule is one cell in the exhaustive persisted lifecycle table. An
6	// empty Target on an allowed rule means the task record is removed rather than
7	// assigned another persisted state.
8	type TransitionRule struct {
9		Mode            task.CheckoutMode
10		Source          task.State
11		Action          Action
12		Target          task.State
13		Allowed         bool
14		StatePreserving bool
15		RemovesTask     bool
16		Milestone       Milestone
17		Reason          string
18	}
19	
20	// HasTarget reports whether an allowed edge writes a persisted target state.
21	func (r TransitionRule) HasTarget() bool { return r.Allowed && r.Target != "" }
22	
23	type transitionKey struct {
24		mode   task.CheckoutMode
25		state  task.State
26		action Action
27	}
28	
29	var (
30		modeOrder = []task.CheckoutMode{
31			task.ModeWorktree,
32			task.ModeBranch,
33			task.ModeDirect,
34		}
35		stateOrder = []task.State{
36			task.Hot,
37			task.Warm,
38			task.Cold,
39			task.Done,
40		}
41		transitionActionOrder = []Action{
42			ParkWarm,
43			ParkCold,
44			Resume,
45			CompleteDirect,
46			CompleteFF,
47			ReviewHandoff,
48			VerifyMerged,
49			Retire,
50		}
51		transitionTable = buildTransitionTable()
52	)
53	
54	// TransitionActions returns the actions represented in every mode/state row.
55	// Adopt, RemoveCheckout, RefreshRemote, and Reconcile are deliberately absent
56	// because they operate on row ownership, repository context, or drift rather
57	// than persisted-state edges.
58	func TransitionActions() []Action {
59		return append([]Action(nil), transitionActionOrder...)
60	}
61	
62	// PersistedLifecycleActions is the stable action dimension of the lifecycle
63	// table, including state-preserving review handoff but excluding repository
64	// context actions such as remote refresh.
65	func PersistedLifecycleActions() []Action { return TransitionActions() }
66	
67	// Transitions returns all table cells in mode, state, and action order. Denied
68	// cells are retained so additions cannot silently fall through a switch.
69	func Transitions() []TransitionRule {
70		out := make([]TransitionRule, 0, len(modeOrder)*len(stateOrder)*len(transitionActionOrder))
71		for _, mode := range modeOrder {
72			for _, state := range stateOrder {
73				for _, action := range transitionActionOrder {
74					out = append(out, transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: state, action: action}])
75				}
76			}
77		}
78		return out
79	}

81	// LookupTransition returns the exhaustive table cell for known dimensions.
82	func LookupTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, bool) {
83		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(source) || !isTransitionAction(action) {
84			return TransitionRule{Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action}, false
85		}
86		rule, ok := transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}]
87		return rule, ok
88	}
89	
90	// RequireTransition returns the allowed table cell or a typed graph error.
91	func RequireTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, error) {
92		rule, found := LookupTransition(mode, source, action)
93		if !found {
94			rule.Reason = "unknown mode, state, or non-transition action"
95			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
96		}
97		if !rule.Allowed {
98			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
99		}
100		return rule, nil
101	}

103	func isTransitionAction(action Action) bool {
104		for _, candidate := range transitionActionOrder {
105			if action == candidate {
106				return true
107			}
108		}
109		return false
110	}

117		}

130	func buildTransitionTable() map[transitionKey]TransitionRule {
131		table := make(map[transitionKey]TransitionRule, len(modeOrder)*len(stateOrder)*len(transitionActionOrder))
132		for _, mode := range modeOrder {
133			for _, source := range stateOrder {
134				for _, action := range transitionActionOrder {
135					rule := TransitionRule{
136						Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action,
137						Reason: deniedTransitionReason(mode, source, action),
138					}
139					table[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}] = rule
140				}
141			}
142		}
143	
144		allow := func(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action, target task.State, preserving, removes bool, milestone Milestone) {
145			key := transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}
146			table[key] = TransitionRule{
147				Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action, Target: target,
148				Allowed: true, StatePreserving: preserving, RemovesTask: removes,
149				Milestone: milestone,
150			}
151		}
152	
153		for _, mode := range []task.CheckoutMode{task.ModeWorktree, task.ModeBranch} {
154			allow(mode, task.Hot, ParkWarm, task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
155			// Existing park accepts WARM tasks so it can update parking metadata and
156			// close a residual runtime without manufacturing a backward transition.
157			allow(mode, task.Warm, ParkWarm, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
158			allow(mode, task.Hot, ParkCold, task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
159			allow(mode, task.Warm, ParkCold, task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
160			allow(mode, task.Warm, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
161			allow(mode, task.Cold, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
162			allow(mode, task.Hot, CompleteFF, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
163			allow(mode, task.Warm, CompleteFF, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
164			allow(mode, task.Hot, VerifyMerged, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
165			allow(mode, task.Warm, VerifyMerged, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
166			allow(mode, task.Hot, ReviewHandoff, task.Hot, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
167			allow(mode, task.Warm, ReviewHandoff, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
168			allow(mode, task.Done, Retire, "", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
169		}
170	
171		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, ParkWarm, task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
172		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, ParkWarm, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
173		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
174		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, CompleteDirect, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
175		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, CompleteDirect, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
176		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Done, Retire, "", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
177	
178		return table
179	}
180	
181	func deniedTransitionReason(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) string {
182		if mode == task.ModeDirect && source == task.Cold {
183			return "direct tasks cannot be COLD"
184		}
185		if action == ParkCold && mode == task.ModeDirect {
186			return "direct tasks use the canonical checkout and cannot be parked COLD"
187		}
188		if source == task.Done {
189			return "DONE tasks can only be retired through the persisted lifecycle graph"
190		}
191		if source == task.Cold {
192			return "COLD tasks must resume before any completion or review action"
193		}
194		if action == CompleteDirect && mode != task.ModeDirect {
195			return "direct completion is only valid for direct tasks"
196		}
197		if (action == CompleteFF || action == ReviewHandoff || action == VerifyMerged) && mode == task.ModeDirect {
198			return "direct tasks have no separate branch to integrate or hand off"
199		}
200		return "the edge is not in the approved lifecycle graph"
201	}
202

13	// locateExactTask builds a managed locator from one exact task record and a
14	// fresh view of its repository. Missing checkout evidence is retained as an
15	// expected path (or an intentionally empty COLD path) so Plan can explain the
16	// drift instead of losing the task before transition validation.
17	func (s *lifecycleService) locateExactTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
18		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
19			return Locator{}, err
20		}
21		if !exactTaskID.MatchString(taskID) || filepath.Base(taskID) != taskID || taskID == "." || taskID == ".." {
22			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID)
23		}
24	
25		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
28		}
29		candidate := record.Task
30		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
31			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q is invalid: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
32		}
33		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
34		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(candidate.State) {
35			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q has invalid mode or state", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID)
36		}
37	
38		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
41		}
42		repoPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
43		if err != nil {
44			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
45		}
46		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
49		}
50		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
51		if err != nil {
52			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
53		}
54		if recordedRepo != repoPath {
55			return Locator{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
56				"recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q",
57				candidate.RepoPath, recordedRepo, repoPath,
58			)}
59		}
60	
61		expectedCheckout := repoPath
62		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
63			expectedCheckout = ""
64			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
65				expectedCheckout, err = s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
66				if err != nil {
67					return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize expected checkout for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
68				}
69			}
70		}
71	
72		locator := Locator{
73			RepoKey:      commonDir,
74			RowKey:       taskID,
75			RowKind:      "task",
76			RepositoryID: commonDir,
77			GitCommonDir: commonDir,
78			TaskID:       taskID,
79			TaskRevision: record.Revision,
80			RepoPath:     repoPath,
81			CheckoutPath: expectedCheckout,
82			Branch:       candidate.Branch,
83			Base:         candidate.Base,
84			Remote:       "origin",
85			Mode:         mode,
86			State:        candidate.State,
87		}
88	
89		registered, found := s.locateRegisteredCheckout(ctx, candidate, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
90		if found {
91			locator.RowKey = registered.Path
92			locator.RowKind = "checkout"
93			locator.HeadOID = strings.TrimSpace(registered.Worktree.Head)
94			if status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, registered.Path); statusErr == nil {
95				locator.Upstream = status.Upstream
96				if head, headErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, registered.Path, "HEAD"); headErr == nil {
97					locator.HeadOID = head
98				}
99			}
100		}
101		if locator.HeadOID == "" {
102			locator.HeadOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, localBranchRef(candidate.Branch))
103		}
104		if locator.Upstream == "" && (!found || mode == task.ModeWorktree) {
105			locator.Upstream = s.branchUpstream(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Branch)
106		}
107		locator.BaseOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Base)
108		locator.UpstreamOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, locator.Upstream)
109	
110		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)
111		if err != nil {
112			return Locator{}, &StalePlanError{
113				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
114				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while locating",
115			}
116		}
117		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
118			return Locator{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while locating")
119		}
120		return locator, nil
121	}
122	
123	func (s *lifecycleService) locateRegisteredCheckout(
124		ctx context.Context,
125		candidate task.Task,
126		repoPath string,
127		expectedCheckout string,
128	) (gitx.RegisteredWorktree, bool) {
129		if expectedCheckout != "" {
130			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
131			return registered, err == nil
132		}
133		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree || candidate.State != task.Cold {
134			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
135		}
136	
137		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, repoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
140		}
141		match := ""
142		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
143			if worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch {
144				continue
145			}
146			if match != "" {
147				return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
148			}
149			match = worktree.Path
150		}
151		if match == "" {
152			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
153		}
154		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, match)
155		return registered, err == nil
156	}
157	
158	func (s *lifecycleService) branchUpstream(ctx context.Context, repoPath, branch string) string {
159		if branch == "" {
160			return ""
161		}
162		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath,
163			"for-each-ref", "--format=%(upstream:short)", localBranchRef(branch),
164		)
165		if err != nil {
166			return ""
167		}
168		return strings.TrimSpace(value)
169	}

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}

26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {

45		}

50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}

54		if err != nil {

73		default:

104		case !validState(locator.State):

176	func (s *lifecycleService) observeLifecycle(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (lifecycleObservation, error) {

178		observed.setCaller(s.host, s.cwd, s.callerWorkspace, s.callerPane)

180		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
181		if err != nil {
182			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, record.Task.ID, err)
183		}
184		observed.repo = repository
185		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
186		if err != nil {
187			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
188		}
189		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
190		if err != nil {
191			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
192		}
193		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(record.Task.RepoPath)
194		if err != nil {
195			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
196		}
197		if recordedRepo != observed.repoPath {
198			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q", record.Task.RepoPath, recordedRepo, observed.repoPath)}
199		}
200		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
201		if err != nil {
202			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
203		}
204		if requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
205			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("Git common directory changed from %q to %q", requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir)}
206		}
207		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
208			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
209			if keyErr != nil {
210				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
211			}
212			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
213				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository key changed from %q to %q", requestedKey, observed.gitCommonDir)}
214			}
215		}
216	
217		s.observeCheckout(ctx, request, &observed)
218		if observed.hasCheckout() {
219			observed.status, observed.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
220			if observed.statusErr == nil {
221				observed.head, observed.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
222				observed.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.head)
223				observed.baseOID, observed.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
224				observed.upstreamOID, observed.upstreamOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.status.Upstream)
225				observed.operation, observed.inProgress, observed.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
226			}

228		s.observeActionRefs(ctx, request, &observed)
229		if err := validateLiveLocator(request.Locator, observed); err != nil {
230			return observed, err
231		}

234			s.observeCompletionFacts(ctx, request, &observed)
235		}
236		observed.runtime, observed.runtimeErr = s.runtimeFor(observed.task)
237		if observed.runtimeErr == nil {

244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
248			observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
249			if err == nil {
250				observed.worktreeFound = true
251				observed.checkout = registered.Path
252			}
253		case task.ModeWorktree:
254			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
255				registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.WorktreePath)
256				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
257				if err == nil {
258					observed.worktreeFound = true
259					observed.checkout = registered.Path
260				}
261			}
262			if observed.worktreeFound || request.Action != Resume ||
263				(observed.task.State != task.Warm && observed.task.State != task.Cold) {
264				return
265			}
266			worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
267			if err != nil {
268				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("list worktrees for parked-task resume: %w", err)
269				return
270			}
271			var candidate string
272			for _, worktree := range worktrees {
273				if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
274					observed.branchMatches++
275					candidate = worktree.Path
276				}
277			}
278			switch observed.branchMatches {
279			case 0:
280				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
281					observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has no checkout", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, observed.task.Branch)
282				}
283			case 1:
284				registered, resolveErr := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, candidate)
285				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, resolveErr
286				if resolveErr == nil {
287					observed.worktreeFound = true
288					observed.checkout = registered.Path
289				}
290			default:
291				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has %d registered checkouts", gitx.ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, observed.task.Branch, observed.branchMatches)
292			}
293		}
294	}
295	
296	func validateLiveLocator(locator Locator, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
297		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.hasCheckout() {
298			checks := []struct {
299				name     string
300				expected string
301				actual   string
302				required bool
303			}{
304				{"upstream", locator.Upstream, observed.status.Upstream, true},
305				{"HEAD", locator.HeadOID, observed.head, locator.HeadOID != ""},
306				{"base OID", locator.BaseOID, observed.baseOID, locator.BaseOID != ""},
307				{"upstream OID", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.upstreamOID, locator.UpstreamOID != ""},
308			}
309			for _, check := range checks {
310				if check.required && check.expected != check.actual {
311					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
312				}
313			}
314			return nil
315		}
316		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.HeadOID != "" {
317			if observed.localBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.HeadOID != observed.localBranchOID {
318				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected local branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.HeadOID, observed.localBranchOID)}
319			}
320		}
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.UpstreamOID != "" && locator.Upstream == observed.remoteBranch {
322			if observed.remoteBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.UpstreamOID != observed.remoteBranchOID {
323				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected remote branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.remoteBranchOID)}
324			}
325		}
326		return nil
327	}

329	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRuntime(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
330		switch options := request.Options.(type) {
331		case ParkWarmOptions:
332			if options.KeepSession || !observed.hasCheckout() {
333				return
334			}
335			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
336			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
337		case ParkColdOptions:
338			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
339				return
340			}
341			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
342			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
343			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
344				observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
345			}
346		case ResumeOptions:
347			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
348				return
349			}
350			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
351				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
352				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
353				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
354			})
355			if s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) == nil {
356				observed.savedRuntimeLive = savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
357			}
358		case CompleteDirectOptions, CompleteFFOptions, ReviewHandoffOptions, VerifyMergedOptions:
359			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
360				return
361			}
362			occupancyOptions := runtime.OccupancyOptions{
363				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
364				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
365				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
366			}
367			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, occupancyOptions)
368			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
369				observed.integration.occupancy = observed.occupancy
370				observed.integration.occupancyErr = observed.occupancyErr
371			}
372			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.integration.worktreeFound {
373				observed.integration.occupancy, observed.integration.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(
374					ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, occupancyOptions,
375				)
376			}
377		}
378	}

380	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRefs(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
381		observed.localBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
382		if observed.localBranchExists {
383			observed.localBranchOID, observed.localBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
384		}
385		observed.remoteBranch = "origin/" + observed.task.Branch
386		observed.remoteBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
387		if observed.remoteBranchExists {
388			observed.remoteBranchOID, observed.remoteBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
389		}
390	
391		switch request.Action {
392		case ParkCold:
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
394				observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
395				if observed.baseRef == "" {
396					observed.baseRef = s.gitDefaultBranch(ctx, observed.repoPath)
397				}
398				observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
399			}
400		case Resume:
401			observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
402			if observed.remoteBranchExists {
403				observed.baseRef = observed.remoteBranch
404			}
405			observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
406			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !observed.hasCheckout() &&
407				(observed.task.State == task.Warm || observed.task.State == task.Cold) {
408				if observed.task.State == task.Warm && observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
409					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.canonicalPath(observed.task.WorktreePath)
410				} else {
411					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.renderWorktreePath(observed.task)
412				}
413				if observed.desiredWorktreeErr == nil {
414					observed.desiredWorktreeErr = wt.ValidateTarget(observed.desiredWorktree, observed.repoPath)
415				}
416			}
417		case CompleteDirect:
418			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Branch
419		case CompleteFF, ReviewHandoff:
420			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
421		case VerifyMerged:
422			options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
423			observed.completionBaseRef = options.BaseRef
424			if observed.completionBaseRef == "" {
425				observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
426			}
427		}
428	}

431		values := config.Vars{

433			"repo":          candidate.Repo,
434			"repo_path":     candidate.RepoPath,
435			"branch":        candidate.Branch,
436			"category":      "",
437			"host":          s.host,
438			"date":          s.now().Format("2006-01-02"),
439		}
440		rendered, err := config.Render(s.cfg.Paths.WorktreePath, values)
441		if err != nil {

443		}
444		return s.canonicalPath(config.Expand(rendered))

568	func appendOptionAuthority(authority map[string]string, options ActionOptions) {
569		switch value := options.(type) {
570		case ParkWarmOptions:
571			authority["option.next"] = value.Next
572			authority["option.note"] = value.Note
573			authority["option.commit-wip"] = boolString(value.CommitWIP)
574			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
575			authority["option.keep-session"] = boolString(value.KeepSession)
576			authority["option.close-unknown"] = boolString(value.CloseUnknown)
577			authority["option.assume-no-runtime"] = boolString(value.AssumeNoRuntime)
578			authority["option.timeout"] = value.Timeout.String()
579		case ParkColdOptions:
580			authority["option.next"] = value.Next
581			authority["option.note"] = value.Note
582			authority["option.commit-wip"] = boolString(value.CommitWIP)
583			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
584			authority["option.close-unknown"] = boolString(value.CloseUnknown)
585			authority["option.assume-no-runtime"] = boolString(value.AssumeNoRuntime)
586			authority["option.timeout"] = value.Timeout.String()
587		case ResumeOptions:
588			authority["option.fetch-refs"] = boolString(value.FetchRefs)
589			authority["option.no-provision"] = boolString(value.NoProvision)
590			authority["option.take-ownership"] = boolString(value.TakeOwnership)
591		case CompleteDirectOptions:
592			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
593			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
594		case CompleteFFOptions:
595			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
596			authority["option.push-base"] = boolString(value.PushBase)
597		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
598			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
599			authority["option.draft"] = boolString(value.Draft)
600			authority["option.title"] = value.Title
601			authority["option.body"] = value.Body
602		case VerifyMergedOptions:
603			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
604			authority["option.base-ref"] = value.BaseRef
605			authority["option.squash-commit"] = value.SquashCommit
606			authority["option.push-base"] = boolString(value.PushBase)
607		}
608	}

610	func appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority map[string]string, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) {
611		authority["option.dirty"] = string(dirty)
612		authority["option.commit-message"] = message

622	func (s *lifecycleService) resolveRefOID(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) (string, error) {
623		if ref == "" {
624			return "", nil
625		}
626		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", ref+"^{commit}")
627		return strings.TrimSpace(value), err
628	}

15	func (s *lifecycleService) applyGuarded(ctx context.Context, action Action, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
16		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
17			return Result{}, err
18		}
19		if approved.Action != action {
20			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("handler %s received %s", action, approved.Action)}
21		}
22		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
23			return Result{}, err
24		}
25		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
28		}
29	
30		var result Result
31		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
32			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
33				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
34				if loadErr != nil {
35					return &StalePlanError{
36						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID,
37						Reason:         "task record disappeared before apply",
38					}
39				}
40				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
41					return identityErr
42				}
43				fresh, observed, planErr := s.freshPlan(ctx, approved.Request, *record)
44				if planErr != nil {
45					return planErr
46				}
47				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
48				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
49					actual := ""
50					if current != nil {
51						actual = current.Revision
52					}
53					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked plan rebuild")
54				}
55				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
56					return &StalePlanError{
57						ExpectedPlanID:               approved.PlanID,
58						ActualPlanID:                 fresh.PlanID,
59						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
60						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
61						Reason:                       "fresh task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or option authority differs",
62					}
63				}
64				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
65					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
66					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
67				}
68	
69				execution := &executionState{
70					service: s, plan: fresh, observed: observed, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision,
71				}
72				var applyErr error
73				switch action {
74				case ParkWarm:
75					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkWarm(ctx)
76				case ParkCold:
77					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkCold(ctx)
78				case Resume:
79					result, applyErr = execution.applyResume(ctx)
80				case CompleteDirect:
81					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteDirect(ctx)
82				case CompleteFF:
83					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteFF(ctx)
84				case ReviewHandoff:
85					result, applyErr = execution.applyReviewHandoff(ctx)
86				case VerifyMerged:
87					result, applyErr = execution.applyVerifyMerged(ctx)
88				default:
89					applyErr = &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: action, Stage: "apply"}
90				}
91				return applyErr
92			})
93		})
94		return result, err
95	}
