246				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout branch is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
247				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout status is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
248				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "Git operation state is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
249				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout cleanliness is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
250				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout ownership is unavailable", "refresh repository topology"),
251			}
252		}
253	
254		exactVerdict := VerdictMet
255		exactEvidence := "registered path, repository, Git common directory, and live HEAD are exact"
256		switch {
257		case observed.worktree.Path != observed.checkout:
258			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered path differs from the exact selected checkout"
259		case observed.worktree.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir:
260			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered repository identity differs from the selected repository"
261		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.headErr != nil:
262			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
263		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head:
264			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry HEAD %s differs from live HEAD %s", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
265		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.locator.HeadOID != "" && observed.locator.HeadOID != observed.head:
266			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("selected HEAD %s differs from live HEAD %s", observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
267		}
268	
269		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
270		kindEvidence := "Git main checkout retained"
271		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
272			kindEvidence = "registered non-main linked worktree"
273			if !observed.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree() {
274				kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
275				kindEvidence = "worktree task does not resolve to a non-main linked worktree"
276			}
277		} else if !observed.worktree.Worktree.Main || observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare || observed.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath {
278			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
279			kindEvidence = "branch/direct task does not resolve to the exact non-bare Git main checkout"
280		}
281	
282		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
283		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and non-prunable"
284		flagRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
285		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
286			flagRequirement = RequirementRequired
287			if observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked || observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable {
288				flagVerdict = VerdictBlocked
289				flagEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("locked=%t prunable=%t", observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked, observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable)
290			}
291		}
292	
293		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
294		branchEvidence := "canonical checkout branch is irrelevant because it is retained"
295		branchRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
296		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
297			branchRequirement = RequirementRequired
298			branchEvidence = "registry, status, branch ref, and live HEAD identify " + candidate.Branch
299			switch {
300			case observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch == "":
301				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered linked worktree is detached or unnamed"
302			case observed.statusErr != nil:
303				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
304			case observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != candidate.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch:
305				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, candidate.Branch)
306			case !observed.branchExists || observed.branchOID != observed.head:
307				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("branch exists=%t branch OID=%q live HEAD=%q", observed.branchExists, observed.branchOID, observed.head)
308			}
309		}
310	
311		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
312		statusEvidence := "canonical checkout content is retained"
313		statusRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
314		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
315		operationEvidence := "canonical checkout Git operation is retained"
316		operationRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
317		cleanVerdict := VerdictMet
318		cleanEvidence := "canonical checkout bytes are retained"
319		cleanRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
320		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
321			statusRequirement, operationRequirement, cleanRequirement = RequirementRequired, RequirementRequired, RequirementRequired
322			if observed.statusErr != nil {
323				statusVerdict, statusEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
324				cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
325			} else {
326				statusEvidence = observed.status.Summary()
327				if observed.status.Dirty() {
328					cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictBlocked, observed.status.Breakdown()
329				} else {
330					cleanEvidence = "checkout is clean"
331				}
332			}
333			if observed.operationErr != nil {
334				operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictError, observed.operationErr.Error()
335			} else if observed.inProgress {
336				operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "Git operation "+observed.operation+" is in progress"
337			} else {
338				operationEvidence = "no Git operation is in progress"
339			}
340		}
341	
342		harnessVerdict := VerdictMet
343		harnessEvidence := "checkout has no strict Claude harness ownership evidence"
344		harnessRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
345		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
346			harnessRequirement = RequirementRequired
347			if observed.isHarness {
348				harnessVerdict = VerdictBlocked
349				harnessEvidence = "checkout is strictly under harness root " + observed.harness.Root
350			}
351		}
352		return []Condition{
353			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
354			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "refresh the exact checkout identity"),
355			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "reconcile the task checkout mode"),
356			condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, flagVerdict, flagRequirement, flagEvidence, "unlock or repair the worktree registration"),
357			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, branchRequirement, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named branch and HEAD"),
358			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, statusRequirement, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
359			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, operationRequirement, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
360			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, cleanRequirement, cleanEvidence, "commit or preserve every changed byte"),
361			condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, harnessVerdict, harnessRequirement, harnessEvidence, "let the harness retire its own checkout"),
362		}
363	}
364	
365	func retireRefConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
366		baseCondition := condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
367			fmt.Sprintf("local base %s at %s", candidate.Base, observed.baseOID), "")
368		switch {
369		case candidate.Base == "":
370			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
371				"DONE retirement requires the task's explicit local base", "record the exact local base branch")
372		case !observed.baseExists:
373			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
374				"local base ref "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "restore the named local base branch")
375		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
376			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
377				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair local base observation")
378		case observed.baseOID == "":
379			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
380				"local base resolved to no commit", "restore the named local base branch")
381		}
382	
383		branchCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
384			fmt.Sprintf("local branch %s at %s", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID), "")
385		if !observed.branchExists {
386			if noCheckout {
387				branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
388					"local task branch is already absent for a persisted DONE task with no checkout", "")
389			} else {
390				branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
391					"local task branch "+observed.branchRef+" is missing", "restore the task branch before retiring its checkout")
392			}
393		} else if observed.branchOIDErr != nil {
394			branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
395				observed.branchOIDErr.Error(), "repair local task branch observation")
396		} else if observed.branchOID == "" {
397			branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
398				"local task branch resolved to no commit", "restore the local task branch")
399		}
400	
401		relationCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
402			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID), "")
403		switch {
404		case !observed.branchExists && noCheckout:
405			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
406				"missing branch is accepted only because persisted DONE records no checkout", "")
407		case observed.containedErr != nil:
408			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
409				observed.containedErr.Error(), "repair local containment observation")
410		case observed.branchExists && observed.baseExists && observed.branchOIDErr == nil && observed.baseOIDErr == nil && !observed.contained:
411			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
412				fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is not contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID),
413				"integrate the task branch into the named local base first")
414		case !observed.branchExists || !observed.baseExists || observed.branchOID == "" || observed.baseOID == "":
415			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
416				"containment cannot be proved from exact local branch and base OIDs", "restore both local refs")
417		}
418		return []Condition{baseCondition, branchCondition, relationCondition}
419	}
420	
421	func retireArtifactCondition(observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) Condition {
422		if noCheckout {
423			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
424				"no checkout is recorded for artifact inspection", "")
425		}
426		switch {
427		case !observed.worktreeFound:
428			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
429				"artifact readiness requires the exact linked checkout", "restore the checkout")
430		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
431			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
432				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
433		case !observed.artifact.Ready():
434			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
435				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
436		default:
437			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
438				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "")
439		}
440	}
441	
442	func retireRuntimeConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
443		if noCheckout {
444			if candidate.RuntimeName != "" || candidate.RuntimeHandle != "" {
445				return []Condition{
446					condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
447						"task has a runtime hint but no exact checkout", "reconcile or clear the runtime hint outside retirement"),
448					condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
449						"runtime coverage cannot be tied to an exact checkout", "reconcile the missing checkout"),
450					condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
451						"caller containment cannot be inspected without a checkout", "reconcile the missing checkout"),
452				}
453			}
454			return []Condition{
455				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "no runtime hint is recorded", ""),
456				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "no checkout or runtime hint requires cleanup", ""),
457				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "no checkout can contain the caller", ""),
458			}
459		}
460		return destructiveRuntimeConditions(observed)
461	}
462	
463	func destructiveRuntimeConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
464		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
465			return []Condition{
466				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
467				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime observation"),
468				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime was not inspected", "run cleanup from outside the checkout"),
469			}
470		}
471		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + runtimeName(observed.runtime) + " is available"
472		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
473			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " reports unavailable; cleanup evidence still controls"
474		}
475		if observed.cleanupErr != nil {
476			return []Condition{
477				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, "select an available backend or use the explicit external acknowledgement"),
478				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.cleanupErr.Error(), "repair runtime enumeration or use the explicit external acknowledgement"),
479				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime occupancy failed", "run cleanup from outside the checkout"),
480			}
481		}
482		occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
483		occupancyEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%d eligible runtime session(s)", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions))
484		if observed.cleanup.RuntimeUnknown {
485			occupancyEvidence = "runtime enumeration failed and the external assume-no-runtime acknowledgement is recorded"
486		}
487		if len(observed.cleanup.Blockers) > 0 {
488			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
489			occupancyEvidence = strings.Join(observed.cleanup.Blockers, "; ")
490		}
491		callerVerdict := VerdictMet
492		callerEvidence := "caller is outside the target checkout and covering runtimes"
493		if observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
494			callerVerdict = VerdictBlocked
495			callerEvidence = "caller is inside the target checkout or a covering runtime"
496		}
497		return []Condition{
498			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, ""),
499			condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop active agents and leave mixed/caller runtimes intact"),
500			condition(ConditionCallerContainment, callerVerdict, RequirementRequired, callerEvidence, "run cleanup from outside the target checkout and runtime"),
501		}
502	}
503	
504	func retireBranchDeletionCondition(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool, options RetireOptions) Condition {
505		if !options.DeleteBranch {
506			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
507				"local task branch will be retained", "")
508		}
509		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
510			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
511				"direct tasks never delete their branch", "retire without branch deletion")
512		}
513		if candidate.Branch == candidate.Base {
514			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
515				"task branch is the explicit base branch", "retire without deleting the base")
516		}
517		if !observed.branchExists && noCheckout {
518			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
519				"local task branch is already absent", "")
520		}
521		paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout)
522		if err != nil {
523			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
524				err.Error(), "refresh registered worktrees before branch deletion")
525		}
526		if len(paths) > 0 {
527			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
528				"branch is checked out at "+strings.Join(paths, ", "), "switch or remove those exact checkouts first")
529		}
530		return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
531			"ordinary git branch -d will delete only the freshly contained local branch", "")
532	}
533	
534	func retireRetainedResources(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool, options RetireOptions) []string {
535		var retained []string
536		if observed.branchExists && (!options.DeleteBranch || candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect) {
537			retained = append(retained, "branch:"+candidate.Branch)
538		}
539		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && observed.checkout != "" {
540			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+observed.checkout)
541		}
542		return retained
543	}
544	
545	func retireFallback(id string, options RetireOptions) string {
546		parts := []string{"dev", "retire", shellQuote(id)}
547		if options.DeleteBranch {
548			parts = append(parts, "--delete-branch")
549		}
550		if options.CloseUnknown {
551			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
552		}
553		if options.AssumeNoRuntime {
554			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
555		}
556		if options.Timeout > 0 {
557			parts = append(parts, "--timeout", options.Timeout.String())
558		}
559		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
560	}
561	
562	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRetire(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
563		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
564			return Result{}, err
565		}
566		if approved.Action != Retire {
567			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "retire handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
568		}
569		if err := validateRetireLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
570			return Result{}, err
571		}
572		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
573		if err != nil {
574			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
575		}
576	
577		var result Result
578		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
579			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
580				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
581				if loadErr != nil {
582					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before retirement apply"}
583				}
584				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
585					return identityErr
586				}
587				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRetire(ctx, approved.Request, *record, tx.ListRecords)
588				if observeErr != nil {
589					return observeErr
590				}
591				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
592				if buildErr != nil {
593					return buildErr
594				}
595				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
596				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
597					actual := ""
598					if current != nil {
599						actual = current.Revision
600					}
601					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked retirement replan")
602				}
603				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
604					return &StalePlanError{
605						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
606						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
607						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
608						Reason:                       "fresh retirement task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or ref authority differs",
609					}
610				}
611				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
612					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
613					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh retirement conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
614				}
615	
616				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision}
617				result, observeErr = execution.executeRetire(ctx, *record, observed)
618				return observeErr
619			})
620		})
621		return result, err
622	}
623	
624	func (e *executionState) executeRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
625		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RetireOptions)
626		candidate := record.Task
627		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
628		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == ""
629		closedRuntime := false
630		removedWorktree := false
631		deletedBranch := false
632	
633		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
634			switch effect.Code {
635			case EffectCloseRuntime:
636				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, false)
637				if err != nil {
638					return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before closing any runtime")
639				}
640				baseline = fresh
641				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
642					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
643						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
644						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
645					})
646					if closeErr != nil {
647						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
648					}
649					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil
650				})
651				if err != nil {
652					e.partial = true
653					return e.fail(err, "the task and checkout remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
654				}
655				fresh, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, true)
656				if err != nil {
657					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh retirement")
658				}
659				baseline = fresh
660				closedRuntime = true
661	
662			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
663				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
664				if err != nil {
665					return e.fail(err, "the worktree was preserved; refresh every retirement safety source")
666				}
667				baseline = fresh
668				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
669					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
670						return "worktree removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact worktree %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
671					}
672					return "removed exact linked worktree without force; branch retained", nil
673				})
674				if err != nil {
675					e.partial = true
676					return e.fail(err, "inspect Git worktree registration and retained branch before retrying")
677				}
678				removedWorktree = true
679				if err := e.verifyRemovedCheckout(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
680					return e.fail(err, "the checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact retained branch before reaping the task")
681				}
682	
683			case EffectDeleteBranch:
684				if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && !removedWorktree {
685					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before linked worktree removal"})
686				}
687				if mode != task.ModeWorktree || noCheckout {
688					fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
689					if err != nil {
690						return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before deleting the contained branch")
691					}
692					baseline = fresh
693				}
694				if err := e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, false); err != nil {
695					return e.fail(err, "branch or base authority changed; refresh retirement")
696				}
697				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
698					_, deleteErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, baseline.repoPath, "branch", "-d", "--", candidate.Branch)
699					if deleteErr != nil {
700						return "ordinary contained-branch deletion failed", fmt.Errorf("delete contained branch %s: %w", candidate.Branch, deleteErr)
701					}
702					return "deleted contained local branch " + candidate.Branch, nil
703				})
704				if err != nil {
705					e.partial = true
706					return e.fail(err, "the task record remains DONE; inspect the local branch and retry")
707				}
708				deletedBranch = true
709				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
710					return e.fail(errors.New("local branch still exists after successful branch deletion"), "the task remains DONE; inspect Git refs before retrying")
711				}
712				if err := e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
713					return e.fail(err, "the branch deletion completed; restore or inspect the explicit base before task reaping")
714				}
715	
716			case EffectDeleteTask:
717				if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && !removedWorktree {
718					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "task deletion reached before linked worktree removal"})
719				}
720				if err := e.revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch); err != nil {
721					return e.fail(err, "the task remains DONE; refresh retirement from current Git/runtime state")
722				}
723				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
724					if deleteErr := e.service.taskDelete(e.tx, candidate.ID, record.Revision); deleteErr != nil {
725						return "DONE task reap failed", fmt.Errorf("delete retired task %s: %w", candidate.ID, deleteErr)
726					}
727					if _, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(candidate.ID); !errors.Is(verifyErr, task.ErrNotFound) {
728						if verifyErr == nil {
729							verifyErr = errors.New("task record still exists")
730						}
731						return "DONE task reap was not verified", fmt.Errorf("verify retired task %s deletion: %w", candidate.ID, verifyErr)
732					}
733					return "reaped DONE task at revision " + record.Revision, nil
734				})
735				if err != nil {
736					if _, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(candidate.ID); errors.Is(verifyErr, task.ErrNotFound) {
737						e.partial = true
738					}
739					return e.fail(err, "local cleanup may already be complete; reload and retry the CAS task reap")
740				}
741				e.snapshot = "task:deleted:" + candidate.ID + ":" + record.Revision
742				e.milestone = MilestoneRetired
743	
744			default:
745				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected Retire effect " + string(effect.Code)})
746			}
747		}
748		if e.milestone != MilestoneRetired {
749			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "retirement ended without CAS task deletion"})
750		}
751		return e.result(), nil
752	}
753	
754	func (e *executionState) reinspectRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
755		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
756		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
757			actual := ""
758			if current != nil {
759				actual = current.Revision
760			}
761			return destructiveObservation{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed at a retirement boundary")
762		}
763		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRetire(ctx, e.plan.Request, *current, e.tx.ListRecords)
764		if err != nil {
765			return fresh, err
766		}
767		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
768			return fresh, err
769		}
770		for _, check := range []struct {
771			name          string
772			before, after string
773		}{
774			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
775			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
776			{"Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()},
777			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
778			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
779			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
780			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
781			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
782		} {
783			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
784				return fresh, err
785			}
786		}
787		if allowRuntimeChange {
788			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
789				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
790			}
791		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
792			return fresh, err
793		}
794		return fresh, nil
795	}
796	
797	func (e *executionState) verifyRemovedCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
798		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
799		if err == nil {
800			return staleBoundary("exact worktree remains registered after removal")
801		}
802		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
803			return fmt.Errorf("verify exact worktree removal: %w", err)
804		}
805		if err := e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, false); err != nil {
806			return err
807		}
808		return nil
809	}
810	
811	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireRefs(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation, allowMissingBranch bool) error {
812		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
813		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
814		if err := compareAuthorityCategory("explicit base ref", authorityHash("base", baseline.baseRef, boolString(baseline.baseExists), baseline.baseOID, errorString(baseline.baseOIDErr)),
815			authorityHash("base", fresh.baseRef, boolString(fresh.baseExists), fresh.baseOID, errorString(fresh.baseOIDErr))); err != nil {
816			return err
817		}
818		if allowMissingBranch && !fresh.branchExists {
819			return nil
820		}
821		if err := compareAuthorityCategory("task branch ref", authorityHash("branch", baseline.branchRef, boolString(baseline.branchExists), baseline.branchOID, errorString(baseline.branchOIDErr)),
822			authorityHash("branch", fresh.branchRef, boolString(fresh.branchExists), fresh.branchOID, errorString(fresh.branchOIDErr))); err != nil {
823			return err
824		}
825		if fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
826			return staleBoundary("fresh branch containment proof failed")
827		}
828		return nil
829	}
830	
831	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireBase(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
832		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
833		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, "", strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
834		return compareAuthorityCategory("explicit base ref",
835			authorityHash("base", baseline.baseRef, boolString(baseline.baseExists), baseline.baseOID, errorString(baseline.baseOIDErr)),
836			authorityHash("base", fresh.baseRef, boolString(fresh.baseExists), fresh.baseOID, errorString(fresh.baseOIDErr)),
837		)
838	}
839	
840	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch bool) error {
841		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
842		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
843			actual := ""
844			if current != nil {
845				actual = current.Revision
846			}
847			return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed before terminal retirement reap")
848		}
849		mode := record.Task.EffectiveMode()
850		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && record.Task.WorktreePath == ""
851		if removedWorktree {
852			if _, resolveErr := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout); resolveErr == nil {
853				return staleBoundary("removed linked checkout became registered again")
854			} else if !errors.Is(resolveErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
855				return resolveErr
856			}
857			if deletedBranch {
858				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
859					return staleBoundary("deleted task branch reappeared")
860				}
861				return e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline)
862			}
863			return e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, noCheckout && !baseline.branchExists)
864		}
865		if deletedBranch {
866			return e.revalidateRetireAfterBranchDelete(ctx, record, baseline)
867		}
868		_, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
869		return err
870	}
871	
872	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireAfterBranchDelete(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
873		if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
874			return staleBoundary("deleted task branch reappeared")
875		}
876		if err := e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
877			return err
878		}
879		_, fresh, err := e.service.observeRetire(ctx, e.plan.Request, record, e.tx.ListRecords)
880		if err != nil {
881			return err
882		}
883		for _, check := range []struct {
884			name          string
885			before, after string
886		}{
887			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
888			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
889			{"Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()},
890			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
891			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
892			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
893			{"runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)},
894		} {
895			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
896				return err
897			}
898		}
899		return nil
900	}

307				cleanVerdict = VerdictBlocked
308			default:
309				cleanEvidence += "; bytes remain in place"
310			}
311		}
312		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, cleanRequirement,
313			cleanEvidence, "commit changes or request an explicit WIP checkpoint"))
314		return conditions
315	}

317	func checkoutExactVerdict(observed lifecycleObservation) (Verdict, string) {
318		if observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
319			return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("worktree common directory %q differs from %q", observed.worktree.GitCommonDir, observed.gitCommonDir)
320		}
321		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
322			if observed.task.WorktreePath == "" {
323				if observed.task.State != task.Cold || observed.branchMatches != 1 {
324					return VerdictBlocked, "the task has no exact persisted checkout identity"
325				}
326			} else {
327				// ResolveRegisteredWorktree matched the recorded hint by canonical path;
328				// subsequent operations use only the returned registered identity.
329				if observed.worktree.Path == "" {
330					return VerdictBlocked, "the exact registered worktree path is empty"
331				}
332			}
333		} else {
334			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
335				return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("%s task unexpectedly retains worktree path %q", observed.mode, observed.task.WorktreePath)
336			}
337			if observed.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath {
338				return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registered main path %q differs from %q", observed.worktree.Path, observed.repoPath)
339			}
340		}
341		if observed.headErr != nil {
342			return VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
343		}
344		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head {
345			return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
346		}
347		return VerdictMet, "exact path, Git common directory, and HEAD match"
348	}

350	func requirementFor(required bool) Requirement {
351		if required {
352			return RequirementRequired
353		}
354		return RequirementAdvisory
355	}

357	func (s *lifecycleService) warmRuntimeConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, options ParkWarmOptions) []Condition {
358		if options.KeepSession {
359			return []Condition{
360				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "runtime is intentionally retained", ""),
361				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "--keep-session requests no runtime closure", ""),
362				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "caller containment is irrelevant while retaining the runtime", ""),
363			}
364		}
365		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
366			return []Condition{
367				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
368				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
369				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory, "runtime was not inspected", "inspect runtime occupancy"),
370			}
371		}
372		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
373		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is available"
374		if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
375			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
376			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
377		}
378		if observed.cleanupErr != nil {
379			return []Condition{
380				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
381				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.cleanupErr.Error(), "repair runtime occupancy observation"),
382				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory, "runtime occupancy failed", "inspect from outside the checkout"),
383			}
384		}
385		if observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
386			return []Condition{
387				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
388				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
389					"caller is contained; warm parking will not close any runtime", "exit the runtime and let a later sweep close it"),
390				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
391					"caller remains inside the checkout or its runtime", "runtime will be retained"),
392			}
393		}
394		if len(observed.cleanup.Blockers) > 0 {
395			return []Condition{
396				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
397				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
398					strings.Join(observed.cleanup.Blockers, "; "), "stop active agents or use only the explicit unknown-runtime acknowledgement"),
399				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "caller is outside the target runtime", ""),
400			}
401		}
402		return []Condition{
403			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
404			condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
405				fmt.Sprintf("%d closeable %s session(s)", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions), observed.runtime.Name()), ""),
406			condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "caller is outside the target runtime", ""),
407		}
408	}

415				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime was not inspected", "run cold parking from outside the checkout"),
416			}
417		}
418		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
419		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is available"
420		if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
421			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
422			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
423		}
424		if observed.cleanupErr != nil {
425			return []Condition{
426				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
427				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.cleanupErr.Error(), "repair runtime occupancy observation"),
428				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime occupancy failed", "run cold parking from outside the checkout"),
429			}
430		}
431		occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
432		occupancyEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%d closeable %s session(s)", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions), observed.runtime.Name())
433		if len(observed.cleanup.Blockers) > 0 {
434			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked

436		}
437		callerVerdict := VerdictMet
438		callerEvidence := "caller is outside the checkout and runtime"

442		}

445			condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop active agents and close mixed runtime panes"),
446			condition(ConditionCallerContainment, callerVerdict, RequirementRequired, callerEvidence, "run cold parking from outside the target checkout"),
447		}

450	func coldPublicationConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, options ParkColdOptions) []Condition {
451		if observed.statusErr != nil {
452			return []Condition{
453				condition(ConditionBranchPublished, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
454				condition(ConditionBranchPushed, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
455			}
456		}
457		publishedVerdict := VerdictMet
458		publishedEvidence := "upstream " + observed.status.Upstream
459		if !observed.status.Published() {
460			if options.Push {
461				publishedEvidence = "declared push will set origin/" + observed.task.Branch + " as upstream"
462			} else {
463				publishedVerdict = VerdictBlocked
464				publishedEvidence = "branch has no upstream"
465			}
466		}
467		pushedVerdict := VerdictMet
468		pushedEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("ahead=%d", observed.status.Ahead)
469		willCreateCommit := options.CommitWIP && observed.status.Dirty()
470		if observed.status.Ahead > 0 || willCreateCommit {
471			if options.Push {
472				pushedEvidence = "declared push will be followed by an ahead=0 check"
473			} else {
474				pushedVerdict = VerdictBlocked
475				pushedEvidence = "committed or checkpointed work would remain ahead of upstream"
476			}
477		}
478		return []Condition{
479			condition(ConditionBranchPublished, publishedVerdict, RequirementRequired, publishedEvidence, "request --push or publish the branch first"),
480			condition(ConditionBranchPushed, pushedVerdict, RequirementRequired, pushedEvidence, "request --push and resolve any rejected push"),
481		}
482	}

520	func artifactEvidence(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
521		if observed.artifact.KnownEmpty {
522			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
523		}
524		var states []string
525		for _, intent := range observed.artifact.Intents {
526			states = append(states, intent.Intent.ID+"="+string(intent.State))
527		}
528		if len(states) == 0 {
529			return "artifact readiness is incomplete"
530		}
531		return strings.Join(states, ", ")
532	}

534	func parkFallback(id string, cold bool, options interface{}) string {
535		parts := []string{"dev", "park", shellQuote(id)}
536		if cold {
537			parts = append(parts, "--cold")
538		}
539		switch value := options.(type) {
540		case ParkWarmOptions:
541			parts = appendParkFlags(parts, value.Next, value.Note, value.CommitWIP, value.Push,
542				value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime)
543			if value.Timeout > 0 {
544				parts = append(parts, "--timeout", value.Timeout.String())
545			}
546			if value.KeepSession {
547				parts = append(parts, "--keep-session")
548			}
549		case ParkColdOptions:
550			parts = appendParkFlags(parts, value.Next, value.Note, value.CommitWIP, value.Push,
551				value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime)
552			if value.Timeout > 0 {
553				parts = append(parts, "--timeout", value.Timeout.String())
554			}
555		}
556		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
557	}
558	
559	func appendParkFlags(parts []string, next, note string, wip, push, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool) []string {
560		if next != "" {
561			parts = append(parts, "--next", shellQuote(next))
562		}
563		if note != "" {
564			parts = append(parts, "--note", shellQuote(note))
565		}
566		if wip {
567			parts = append(parts, "--wip")
568		}
569		if push {
570			parts = append(parts, "--push")
571		}
572		if closeUnknown {
573			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
574		}
575		if assumeNoRuntime {
576			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
577		}
578		return parts
579	}
580	
581	func shellQuote(value string) string {
582		if value != "" && !strings.ContainsAny(value, " \t\n'\"`\\$;&|()<>*") {
583			return value
584		}
585		return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\\''") + "'"
586	}

28				map[string]string{"remote": "origin", "warning-on-failure": "true"}))
29		}

45		}
46		if shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed) {
47			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectOpenRuntime,
48				"open a runtime surface for the checkout", resumeEffectCheckout(observed), false, false,
49				map[string]string{"backend": runtimeName(observed.runtime), "label": resumeRuntimeLabel(observed.task)}))
50		}
51		runtimeDisposition := "clear"
52		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" {

55			} else {

59		path := observed.task.WorktreePath
60		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {

62				path = observed.checkout
63			} else {

65			}

75		}
76		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" {
77			retained = append(retained, "runtime:"+observed.runtime.Name())
78		}
79		return PlanSpec{

81			Conditions:        conditions,
82			Effects:           effects,

84			Confirmation:      Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Resume this task and claim its checkout?"},
85			FallbackCommand:   resumeFallback(observed.task.ID, options),

91	func resumeOwnerCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, options ResumeOptions) Condition {
92		if observed.task.OwnedBy(observed.taskflowHost) {

267			conflictEvidence, "resolve conflicts before switching branches"))

269		switchVerdict := VerdictMet
270		switchEvidence := "no branch switch is needed"
271		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {

273			if observed.status.Dirty() {

286		}
287		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionTargetBranch, targetVerdict, RequirementRequired,
288			targetEvidence, "restore the local task branch"))
289		return conditions

292	func (s *lifecycleService) resumeRuntimeConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
293		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
294			return []Condition{
295				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
296				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
297				condition(ConditionSavedRuntime, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory, "saved runtime was not validated", "refresh runtime state"),
298			}
299		}
300		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
301		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is available"
302		if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
303			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
304			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
305		}
306		if !observed.hasCheckout() {
307			return []Condition{
308				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
309				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
310					"missing checkout cannot be occupied; strict occupancy will be checked after reconstruction", ""),
311				condition(ConditionSavedRuntime, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
312					"saved runtime hint will be revalidated after reconstruction", ""),
313			}
314		}
315		occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr)
316		occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
317		occupancyEvidence := "no other recognized agent occupies the checkout"
318		if s.allowSharedCheckout && occupancyErr == nil {
319			occupancyEvidence = "shared-checkout override accepts the freshly observed agent occupancy"
320		}
321		if occupancyErr != nil {
322			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
323			occupancyEvidence = occupancyErr.Error()
324			if observed.occupancyErr != nil || observed.occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil ||
325				observed.occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil || observed.occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil ||
326				observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
327				occupancyVerdict = VerdictError
328			}
329		}
330		savedEvidence := "no saved runtime handle"
331		if observed.task.RuntimeHandle != "" {
332			if observed.savedRuntimeLive {
333				savedEvidence = "saved " + observed.runtime.Name() + " handle " + observed.task.RuntimeHandle + " covers the exact checkout"
334			} else {
335				savedEvidence = "saved runtime handle is stale and will be replaced or cleared"
336			}
337		}
338		return []Condition{
339			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
340			condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop the other recognized agent or use another checkout"),
341			condition(ConditionSavedRuntime, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, savedEvidence, ""),
342		}
343	}
344	
345	func resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
346		return observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && observed.hasCheckout() && observed.statusErr == nil &&
347			!observed.status.Detached && observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch
348	}
349	
350	func shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
351		return observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.savedRuntimeLive
352	}
353	
354	func resumeEffectCheckout(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
355		if observed.hasCheckout() {
356			return observed.checkout
357		}
358		return observed.desiredWorktree
359	}
360	
361	func resumeRuntimeLabel(candidate task.Task) string {
362		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
363			return candidate.Repo + "/" + candidate.Branch
364		}
365		return candidate.Title()
366	}
367	
368	func resumeFallback(id string, options ResumeOptions) string {
369		parts := []string{"dev", "resume", shellQuote(id)}
370		if !options.FetchRefs {
371			parts = append(parts, "--fetch=false")
372		}
373		if options.NoProvision {
374			parts = append(parts, "--no-provision")
375		}
376		if options.TakeOwnership {
377			parts = append(parts, "--force")
378		}
379		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
380	}

1	// Package repo discovers the repositories a user actually owns by walking the
2	// configured scan roots. It answers "what projects do I have?", which is a
3	// different question from "what am I working on?" — that one belongs to
4	// package task.
5	package repo
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"io/fs"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16	)
17	
18	// Repo is one discovered repository.
19	type Repo struct {
20		// Name is the directory basename, which is how users refer to it.
21		Name string
22		// Path is the absolute path reached through the scan root. It may be a
23		// symlink from a bootstrap index; commands intentionally keep that human
24		// navigation path rather than replacing it with the physical one.
25		Path string
26		// RealPath is the physical checkout path.
27		RealPath string
28		// Symlink reports that Path is an alias to RealPath.
29		Symlink bool
30		// Root is the scan root it was found under.
31		Root string
32		// Category is the path between the scan root and the repo ("Quant",
33		// "Web/Frontend"), empty for a repo sitting directly in the root. It is
34		// human organisation metadata, preserved for `dev graduate` to place new
35		// projects consistently.
36		Category string
37		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory; CommonDir is shared
38		// by every linked worktree of the clone.
39		GitDir    string
40		CommonDir string
41		MainRoot  string
42		// Bare reports a bare repository (a worktree hub).
43		Bare bool
44		// HasGit distinguishes a real repo from a plain directory that was found
45		// in a scan root; non-repos are reported so `dev repo list` can offer to
46		// initialise them.
47		HasGit bool
48	}
49	
50	// Display renders "Category/Name" or just "Name".
51	func (r Repo) Display() string {
52		if r.Category == "" {
53			return r.Name
54		}
55		return r.Category + "/" + r.Name
56	}
57	
58	// Options tunes discovery.
59	type Options struct {
60		// MaxDepth limits how deep below a scan root a repo may be found. The
61		// default layout is <root>/<Category>/<Repo>, so 2 suffices; 3 leaves room
62		// for a nested grouping without walking an entire home directory.
63		MaxDepth int
64		// IncludeNonRepos reports plain directories alongside repositories.
65		IncludeNonRepos bool
66		// Fast avoids per-repository git subprocesses. It is intended for shell
67		// completion: direct .git-file checkouts are skipped as linked worktrees and
68		// symlink aliases are deduplicated by their physical path.
69		Fast bool
70	}
71	
72	// DefaultOptions is the discovery configuration used by dev's commands.
73	func DefaultOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3} }
74	
75	// CompletionOptions trades full Git metadata for interactive latency.
76	func CompletionOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3, Fast: true} }
77	
78	// skipDirs are never descended into. These are large, never contain a project
79	// the user organises by hand, and walking them dominates scan time.
80	var skipDirs = map[string]bool{
81		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "target": true,
82		"vendor": true, "__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "dist": true,
83		"build": true, ".next": true, ".cache": true, ".terraform": true,
84		"Library": true, ".Trash": true,
85	}
86	
87	// Discover walks every root and returns the repositories found, sorted by
88	// display name. Unreadable directories are skipped rather than fatal — a scan
89	// root that has been unmounted must not break `dev ls`.
90	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
91		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
92			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
93		}
94		seen := map[string]bool{}
95		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
96		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
97		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
98		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
99		identities := map[string]bool{}
100		var out []Repo
101	
102		for _, root := range roots {
103			info, err := os.Stat(root)
104			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
105				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
106			}
107			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
108	
109			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
110				if err != nil {
111					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
112				}
113				if ctx.Err() != nil {
114					return ctx.Err()
115				}
116				isRoot := path == rootClean
117				name := d.Name()
118				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
119				isDir := d.IsDir()
120				if isLink {
121					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
122					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
123					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
124					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
125						isDir = info.IsDir()
126					}
127				}
128				if !isDir {
129					return nil
130				}
131				if !isRoot && (skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare")) {
132					return filepath.SkipDir
133				}
134	
135				rel := "."
136				depth := 0
137				if !isRoot {
138					rel, _ = filepath.Rel(rootClean, path)
139					depth = len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
140				}
141	
142				if isRepoDir(path) {
143					real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
144					if real == "" {
145						real = path
146					}
147					bare := isBareDir(path)
148					identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot := real, real, real, real
149					if !bare && opts.Fast && gitEntryIsFile(path) {
150						// A direct .git file at a discovered root is a linked
151						// worktree. Submodules are already hidden below their parent
152						// repository because discovery never descends into one.
153						return filepath.SkipDir
154					}
155					if !bare && !opts.Fast {
156						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path); err == nil {
157							// A linked worktree is execution state, not another
158							// project in the repo inventory.
159							if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
160								return filepath.SkipDir
161							}
162							identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot = g.GitCommonDir, g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir, g.MainRoot
163							real = g.MainRoot
164						}
165					}
166					if !seen[path] && !identities[identity] {
167						seen[path], identities[identity] = true, true
168						out = append(out, Repo{
169							Name:      name,
170							Path:      path,
171							RealPath:  real,
172							Symlink:   isLink,
173							Root:      rootClean,
174							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
175							GitDir:    gitDir,
176							CommonDir: commonDir,
177							MainRoot:  mainRoot,
178							Bare:      bare,
179							HasGit:    true,
180						})

1	package gitx

3	import (
4		"context"
5		"os"
6		"path/filepath"
7		"strings"
8	)
9	
10	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
11	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
12	type Repo struct {
13		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
14		Root string
15		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory. A linked worktree has
16		// its own entry below the shared common directory.
17		GitDir string
18		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
19		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
20		GitCommonDir string
21		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
22		Name string
23		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
24		// the main checkout.
25		IsLinkedWorktree bool
26		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
27		MainRoot string
28		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
29		Bare bool
30	}
31	
32	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
33	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
34	
35	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
36	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
37		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
38		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
39		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
40			"rev-parse",
41			"--path-format=absolute",
42			"--show-toplevel",
43			"--git-dir",
44			"--git-common-dir",
45			"--is-bare-repository",
46		)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Repo{}, err
49		}
50		f := lines(out)
51		r := Repo{}
52		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
53		switch len(f) {
54		case 4:
55			r.Root = f[0]
56			r.GitDir = f[1]
57			r.GitCommonDir = f[2]
58			r.Bare = f[3] == "true"
59		case 3:
60			r.GitDir = f[0]
61			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
62			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
63		default:
64			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
65		}
66	
67		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
68		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
69		if r.Bare {
70			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
71		} else if r.GitDir == r.GitCommonDir {
72			// A normal checkout may use --separate-git-dir, so the common directory's
73			// parent is not necessarily the working-tree root.
74			r.MainRoot = r.Root
75		} else {
76			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
77		}
78		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.GitDir != r.GitCommonDir
79		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
80		if r.Bare {
81			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
82			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
83			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
84				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
85			}
86		}
87		return r, nil
88	}
89	
90	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
91	// a full Discover.
92	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
93		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
94		return err == nil
95	}
96	
97	// DefaultBranch resolves the repository's default branch — origin/HEAD when the
98	// remote advertises it, else the first of main/master that exists locally.
99	// Returns "" when nothing can be determined, which callers must treat as
100	// "ask the user" rather than guessing.
101	func DefaultBranch(ctx context.Context, dir string) string {
102		if out, err := run(ctx, dir, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"); err == nil {
103			if _, b, ok := strings.Cut(out, "/"); ok {
104				return b
105			}
106		}
107		for _, cand := range []string{"main", "master", "trunk", "develop"} {
108			if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+cand); err == nil {
109				return cand
110			}
111		}
112		return ""
113	}
114	
115	// Remote returns the push URL of the named remote ("origin" when empty).
116	func Remote(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) string {
117		if name == "" {
118			name = "origin"
119		}
120		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "remote", "get-url", name)
121		if err != nil {
122			return ""
123		}
124		return out
125	}
126	
127	// RemoteFromConfig reads one remote URL directly from a Git common directory.
128	// It is the zero-process path used by whole-machine inventory, where spawning
129	// `git remote get-url` once per repo dominated startup. Includes and URL
130	// rewriting are deliberately not evaluated; callers that need Git's complete
131	// semantics should use Remote instead.
132	func RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, name string) string {
133		if commonDir == "" {
134			return ""
135		}
136		if name == "" {
137			name = "origin"
138		}
139		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(commonDir, "config"))
140		if err != nil {
141			return ""
142		}
143		want := `remote "` + name + `"`
144		section := ""
145		for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
146			line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
147			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || strings.HasPrefix(line, ";") {
148				continue
149			}
150			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.HasSuffix(line, "]") {
151				section = strings.TrimSpace(line[1 : len(line)-1])
152				continue
153			}
154			if section != want {
155				continue
156			}
157			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
158			if ok && strings.TrimSpace(key) == "url" {
159				return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), `"`)
160			}
161		}
162		return ""
163	}

1	package inventory
2	
3	import "context"
4	
5	// Limiter bounds expensive local enrichment across collectors that would
6	// otherwise each create their own worker pool.
7	type Limiter struct {
8		permits chan struct{}
9	}
10	
11	// NewLimiter returns a context-aware concurrency bound.
12	func NewLimiter(limit int) *Limiter {
13		if limit <= 0 {
14			limit = 8
15		}
16		return &Limiter{permits: make(chan struct{}, limit)}
17	}
18	
19	// Acquire waits for one permit and returns a matching release function.
20	func (l *Limiter) Acquire(ctx context.Context) (func(), bool) {
21		if l == nil {
22			return func() {}, true
23		}
24		if ctx == nil {
25			ctx = context.Background()
26		}
27		select {
28		case l.permits <- struct{}{}:
29			return func() { <-l.permits }, true
30		case <-ctx.Done():
31			return nil, false
32		}
33	}
34

1066			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1067		}
1068		service, err := l.service(rt)
1069		if err != nil {
1070			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1071		}
1072		plan, err := service.Plan(ctx, request)
1073		if err != nil {
1074			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1075		}
1076		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1077			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1078		}
1079		l.mu.Lock()
1080		l.approved[plan.PlanID] = flowApprovedPlan{target: expected, plan: plan.Clone()}
1081		l.mu.Unlock()
1082		return plan, nil
1083	}
1084	
1085	func (l *flowLoader) Apply(
1086		ctx context.Context,
1087		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1088		locator taskflow.Locator,
1089		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1090		plan taskflow.Plan,
1091		approval taskflow.Approval,
1092	) (taskflow.Result, error) {
1093		expected, _, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1094		if err != nil {
1095			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1096		}
1097		l.mu.Lock()
1098		approved, ok := l.approved[plan.PlanID]
1099		l.mu.Unlock()
1100		if !ok {
1101			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply rejected a plan not produced by this run")
1102		}
1103		if !sameFlowTarget(approved.target, expected) {
1104			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply target differs from the approved repository, row, action, locator, or options")
1105		}
1106		if !reflect.DeepEqual(approved.plan.Clone(), plan.Clone()) {
1107			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply plan differs from the exact approved plan")
1108		}
1109		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1110			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1111		}
1112		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1113		if err != nil {
1114			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1115		}
1116		service, err := l.service(rt)
1117		if err != nil {
1118			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1119		}
1120		result, applyErr := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
1121		l.mu.Lock()
1122		delete(l.approved, plan.PlanID)
1123		if remote, exists := result.RemoteObservation(); exists {
1124			l.remote[repoKey] = remote.Clone()
1125		}
1126		l.mu.Unlock()
1127		return result, applyErr
1128	}
1129	
1130	func (l *flowLoader) validateTarget(
1131		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1132		locator taskflow.Locator,
1133		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1134	) (flowTarget, taskflow.Request, error) {
1135		request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(locator, options)
1136		if err != nil {
1137			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, err
1138		}
1139		key := flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID)
1140		l.mu.Lock()
1141		expected, ok := l.targets[repoKey][key]
1142		l.mu.Unlock()
1143		if !ok {
1144			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action no longer matches the current repository snapshot")
1145		}
1146		actual := flowTarget{repoKey: repoKey, rowKey: rowKey, actionID: actionID, request: request}
1147		if !sameFlowTarget(expected, actual) {
1148			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action locator or options differ from the current exact row choice")
1149		}
1150		return expected, request, nil
1151	}
1152	
1153	func validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan taskflow.Plan, expected flowTarget) error {
1154		if err := plan.Validate(); err != nil {
1155			return err
1156		}
1157		if plan.Locator != expected.request.Locator || plan.Request.Locator != expected.request.Locator ||
1158			plan.Action != expected.request.Action || plan.Request.Action != expected.request.Action ||
1159			!reflect.DeepEqual(plan.Request.Options, expected.request.Options) {
1160			return errors.New("taskflow plan does not match the exact flow request identity")
1161		}
1162		return nil
1163	}
1164	
1165	func sameFlowTarget(left, right flowTarget) bool {
1166		return left.repoKey == right.repoKey && left.rowKey == right.rowKey && left.actionID == right.actionID &&
1167			left.request.Locator == right.request.Locator && left.request.Action == right.request.Action &&
1168			reflect.DeepEqual(left.request.Options, right.request.Options)
1169	}
1170	
1171	func flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID string) string {
1172		return repoKey + "\x00" + rowKey + "\x00" + actionID
1173	}
1174	
1175	func contextError(ctx context.Context) error {
1176		if ctx == nil {
1177			return errors.New("flow operation needs a context")
1178		}
1179		return ctx.Err()
1180	}
1181	
1182	func emptyEvidence(value string) string {
1183		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
1184			return "(none)"
1185		}
1186		return value
1187	}
1188	
1189	func uniqueStrings(values []string) []string {
1190		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(values))
1191		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
1192		for _, value := range values {
1193			if value == "" || seen[value] {
1194				continue
1195			}
1196			seen[value] = true
1197			out = append(out, value)
1198		}
1199		return out
1200	}

13	// locateExactTask builds a managed locator from one exact task record and a
14	// fresh view of its repository. Missing checkout evidence is retained as an
15	// expected path (or an intentionally empty COLD path) so Plan can explain the
16	// drift instead of losing the task before transition validation.
17	func (s *lifecycleService) locateExactTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
18		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
19			return Locator{}, err
20		}
21		if !exactTaskID.MatchString(taskID) || filepath.Base(taskID) != taskID || taskID == "." || taskID == ".." {
22			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID)
23		}
24	
25		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
28		}
29		candidate := record.Task
30		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
31			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q is invalid: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
32		}
33		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
34		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(candidate.State) {
35			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q has invalid mode or state", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID)
36		}
37	
38		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
41		}
42		repoPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
43		if err != nil {
44			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
45		}
46		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
49		}
50		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
51		if err != nil {
52			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
53		}
54		if recordedRepo != repoPath {
55			return Locator{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
56				"recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q",
57				candidate.RepoPath, recordedRepo, repoPath,
58			)}
59		}
60	
61		expectedCheckout := repoPath
62		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
63			expectedCheckout = ""
64			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
65				expectedCheckout, err = s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
66				if err != nil {
67					return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize expected checkout for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
68				}
69			}
70		}
71	
72		locator := Locator{
73			RepoKey:      commonDir,
74			RowKey:       taskID,
75			RowKind:      "task",
76			RepositoryID: commonDir,
77			GitCommonDir: commonDir,
78			TaskID:       taskID,
79			TaskRevision: record.Revision,
80			RepoPath:     repoPath,
81			CheckoutPath: expectedCheckout,
82			Branch:       candidate.Branch,
83			Base:         candidate.Base,
84			Remote:       "origin",
85			Mode:         mode,
86			State:        candidate.State,
87		}
88	
89		registered, found := s.locateRegisteredCheckout(ctx, candidate, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
90		if found {
91			locator.RowKey = registered.Path
92			locator.RowKind = "checkout"
93			locator.HeadOID = strings.TrimSpace(registered.Worktree.Head)
94			if status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, registered.Path); statusErr == nil {
95				locator.Upstream = status.Upstream
96				if head, headErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, registered.Path, "HEAD"); headErr == nil {
97					locator.HeadOID = head
98				}
99			}
100		}
101		if locator.HeadOID == "" {
102			locator.HeadOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, localBranchRef(candidate.Branch))
103		}
104		if locator.Upstream == "" && (!found || mode == task.ModeWorktree) {
105			locator.Upstream = s.branchUpstream(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Branch)
106		}
107		locator.BaseOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Base)
108		locator.UpstreamOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, locator.Upstream)
109	
110		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)
111		if err != nil {
112			return Locator{}, &StalePlanError{
113				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
114				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while locating",
115			}
116		}
117		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
118			return Locator{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while locating")
119		}
120		return locator, nil
121	}
122	
123	func (s *lifecycleService) locateRegisteredCheckout(
124		ctx context.Context,
125		candidate task.Task,
126		repoPath string,
127		expectedCheckout string,
128	) (gitx.RegisteredWorktree, bool) {
129		if expectedCheckout != "" {
130			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
131			return registered, err == nil
132		}
133		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree || candidate.State != task.Cold {
134			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
135		}
136	
137		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, repoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
140		}
141		match := ""
142		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
143			if worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch {
144				continue
145			}
146			if match != "" {
147				return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
148			}
149			match = worktree.Path
150		}
151		if match == "" {
152			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
153		}
154		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, match)
155		return registered, err == nil
156	}
157	
158	func (s *lifecycleService) branchUpstream(ctx context.Context, repoPath, branch string) string {
159		if branch == "" {
160			return ""
161		}
162		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath,
163			"for-each-ref", "--format=%(upstream:short)", localBranchRef(branch),
164		)
165		if err != nil {
166			return ""
167		}
168		return strings.TrimSpace(value)
169	}
