1	package taskflow
2	
3	import "context"
4	
5	// PlanHook performs action-specific observation and returns only construction
6	// input. BuildPlan remains the single graph, availability, and identity
7	// authority.
8	type PlanHook func(context.Context, Request) (PlanSpec, error)
9	
10	// ApplyHook executes one already validated plan and may return a partial Result
11	// together with an error.
12	type ApplyHook func(context.Context, Plan) (Result, error)
13	
14	// Handler contains the narrow hooks for one exact action. Either hook may be
15	// omitted; no production or unsafe fallback is installed.
16	type Handler struct {
17		Plan  PlanHook
18		Apply ApplyHook
19	}
20	
21	// Handlers maps stable action codes to injected behavior.
22	type Handlers map[Action]Handler
23	
24	// LocateTaskHook builds one exact managed-task locator from fresh durable and
25	// Git evidence. It is intentionally not accepted by NewService: only the
26	// guarded lifecycle constructor may install it.
27	type LocateTaskHook func(context.Context, string) (Locator, error)
28	
29	// Service is the UI-agnostic locate/plan/apply dispatcher.
30	type Service struct {
31		handlers   map[Action]Handler
32		locateTask LocateTaskHook
33	}
34	
35	// NewService copies handlers so later mutation of the caller's map cannot
36	// redirect a planned action.
37	func NewService(handlers Handlers) *Service {
38		copied := make(map[Action]Handler, len(handlers))
39		for action, handler := range handlers {
40			copied[action] = handler
41		}
42		return &Service{handlers: copied}
43	}
44	
45	// LocateTask returns an exact locator only when this service came from
46	// NewLifecycleService. Generic dispatch services deliberately have no fallback
47	// locator because guessing task, repository, or checkout identity is unsafe.
48	func (s *Service) LocateTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
49		if s == nil || s.locateTask == nil {
50			return Locator{}, ErrLocatorUnavailable
51		}
52		return s.locateTask(ctx, taskID)
53	}
54	
55	// Plan validates and freezes a request, delegates action-specific observations,
56	// then centrally builds the immutable plan.
57	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, err
61		}
62		handler, ok := s.handlers[normalized.Action]
63		if !ok || handler.Plan == nil {
64			return Plan{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: normalized.Action, Stage: "plan"}
65		}
66		spec, err := handler.Plan(ctx, normalized.Clone())
67		if err != nil {
68			return Plan{}, err
69		}
70		return BuildPlan(normalized, spec)
71	}
72	
73	// Apply validates identity and approval, rejects every status except READY, and
74	// delegates only to the handler registered for the plan's exact action. A
75	// handler's partial Result is returned unchanged in meaning alongside errors.
76	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, plan Plan, approval Approval) (Result, error) {
77		frozen := plan.Clone()
78		if err := frozen.Validate(); err != nil {
79			return Result{}, err
80		}
81		if err := frozen.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
82			return Result{}, err
83		}
84		if frozen.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
85			notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{
86				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Availability: frozen.Availability,
87				conditions: frozen.Conditions(),
88			}
89			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{
90				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Reason: "required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady,
91			}
92		}
93		handler, ok := s.handlers[frozen.Action]
94		if !ok || handler.Apply == nil {
95			return Result{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: frozen.Action, Stage: "apply"}
96		}
97		result, err := handler.Apply(ctx, frozen.Clone())
98		result = result.Clone()
99		if err != nil && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 {
100			result.PartialSuccess = true
101		}
102		return result, err
103	}

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}
48	
49	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAndSpecify(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (PlanSpec, lifecycleObservation, error) {
50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:
64			spec = s.resumeSpec(request, observed)
65		case CompleteDirect:
66			spec = s.completeDirectSpec(request, observed)
67		case CompleteFF:
68			spec = s.completeFFSpec(request, observed)
69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}
76		return spec, observed, nil
77	}

79	func (s *lifecycleService) freshPlan(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (Plan, lifecycleObservation, error) {
80		spec, observed, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, record)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Plan{}, observed, err
83		}
84		plan, err := BuildPlan(request, spec)
85		return plan, observed, err

88	func validateLifecycleLocator(locator Locator) error {

104		case !validState(locator.State):

156		if locator.CheckoutPath != "" {
157			selectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(locator.CheckoutPath)
158			if err != nil {
159				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.CheckoutPath, err)}
160			}
161		}
162		if selectedCheckout != expectedCheckout {
163			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task checkout path changed from %q to %q", selectedCheckout, expectedCheckout)}
164		}
165		return nil
166	}
167	
168	func staleTaskRevision(expected, actual, reason string) error {
169		return &StalePlanError{
170			ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: expected,
171			ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   actual,
172			Reason:                       reason,
173		}
174	}
175	
176	func (s *lifecycleService) observeLifecycle(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (lifecycleObservation, error) {
177		observed := lifecycleObservation{record: record, task: record.Task, mode: record.Task.EffectiveMode()}
178		observed.setCaller(s.host, s.cwd, s.callerWorkspace, s.callerPane)
179	
180		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
181		if err != nil {
182			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, record.Task.ID, err)
183		}
184		observed.repo = repository
185		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
186		if err != nil {
187			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
188		}
189		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
190		if err != nil {
191			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
192		}
193		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(record.Task.RepoPath)
194		if err != nil {
195			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
196		}
197		if recordedRepo != observed.repoPath {
198			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q", record.Task.RepoPath, recordedRepo, observed.repoPath)}
199		}
200		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
201		if err != nil {
202			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
203		}
204		if requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
205			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("Git common directory changed from %q to %q", requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir)}
206		}
207		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
208			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
209			if keyErr != nil {
210				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
211			}
212			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
213				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository key changed from %q to %q", requestedKey, observed.gitCommonDir)}
214			}
215		}
216	
217		s.observeCheckout(ctx, request, &observed)
218		if observed.hasCheckout() {
219			observed.status, observed.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
220			if observed.statusErr == nil {
221				observed.head, observed.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
222				observed.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.head)
223				observed.baseOID, observed.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
224				observed.upstreamOID, observed.upstreamOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.status.Upstream)
225				observed.operation, observed.inProgress, observed.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
226			}
227		}
228		s.observeActionRefs(ctx, request, &observed)
229		if err := validateLiveLocator(request.Locator, observed); err != nil {
230			return observed, err
231		}
232	
233		if isCompletionAction(request.Action) {
234			s.observeCompletionFacts(ctx, request, &observed)
235		}
236		observed.runtime, observed.runtimeErr = s.runtimeFor(observed.task)
237		if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
238			observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
239			s.observeActionRuntime(ctx, request, &observed)
240		}
241		return observed, nil
242	}
243	
244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
248			observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
249			if err == nil {
250				observed.worktreeFound = true
251				observed.checkout = registered.Path
252			}
253		case task.ModeWorktree:
254			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
255				registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.WorktreePath)
256				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
257				if err == nil {
258					observed.worktreeFound = true
259					observed.checkout = registered.Path
260				}
261			}
262			if observed.worktreeFound || request.Action != Resume ||
263				(observed.task.State != task.Warm && observed.task.State != task.Cold) {
264				return
265			}
266			worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
267			if err != nil {
268				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("list worktrees for parked-task resume: %w", err)
269				return
270			}
271			var candidate string
272			for _, worktree := range worktrees {
273				if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
274					observed.branchMatches++
275					candidate = worktree.Path
276				}
277			}
278			switch observed.branchMatches {
279			case 0:
280				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
281					observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has no checkout", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, observed.task.Branch)
282				}
283			case 1:
284				registered, resolveErr := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, candidate)
285				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, resolveErr
286				if resolveErr == nil {
287					observed.worktreeFound = true
288					observed.checkout = registered.Path
289				}
290			default:
291				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has %d registered checkouts", gitx.ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, observed.task.Branch, observed.branchMatches)
292			}
293		}
294	}
295	
296	func validateLiveLocator(locator Locator, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
297		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.hasCheckout() {
298			checks := []struct {
299				name     string
300				expected string
301				actual   string
302				required bool
303			}{
304				{"upstream", locator.Upstream, observed.status.Upstream, true},
305				{"HEAD", locator.HeadOID, observed.head, locator.HeadOID != ""},
306				{"base OID", locator.BaseOID, observed.baseOID, locator.BaseOID != ""},
307				{"upstream OID", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.upstreamOID, locator.UpstreamOID != ""},
308			}
309			for _, check := range checks {
310				if check.required && check.expected != check.actual {
311					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
312				}
313			}
314			return nil
315		}
316		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.HeadOID != "" {
317			if observed.localBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.HeadOID != observed.localBranchOID {
318				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected local branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.HeadOID, observed.localBranchOID)}
319			}
320		}
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.UpstreamOID != "" && locator.Upstream == observed.remoteBranch {
322			if observed.remoteBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.UpstreamOID != observed.remoteBranchOID {
323				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected remote branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.remoteBranchOID)}
324			}
325		}
326		return nil
327	}
328	
329	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRuntime(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
330		switch options := request.Options.(type) {
331		case ParkWarmOptions:
332			if options.KeepSession || !observed.hasCheckout() {
333				return
334			}
335			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
336			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
337		case ParkColdOptions:
338			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
339				return
340			}
341			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
342			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
343			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
344				observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
345			}
346		case ResumeOptions:
347			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
348				return
349			}
350			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
351				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
352				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
353				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
354			})
355			if s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) == nil {
356				observed.savedRuntimeLive = savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
357			}
358		case CompleteDirectOptions, CompleteFFOptions, ReviewHandoffOptions, VerifyMergedOptions:
359			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
360				return
361			}
362			occupancyOptions := runtime.OccupancyOptions{
363				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
364				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
365				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
366			}
367			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, occupancyOptions)
368			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
369				observed.integration.occupancy = observed.occupancy
370				observed.integration.occupancyErr = observed.occupancyErr
371			}
372			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.integration.worktreeFound {
373				observed.integration.occupancy, observed.integration.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(
374					ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, occupancyOptions,
375				)
376			}
377		}
378	}
379	
380	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRefs(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
381		observed.localBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
382		if observed.localBranchExists {
383			observed.localBranchOID, observed.localBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
384		}
385		observed.remoteBranch = "origin/" + observed.task.Branch
386		observed.remoteBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
387		if observed.remoteBranchExists {
388			observed.remoteBranchOID, observed.remoteBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
389		}
390	
391		switch request.Action {
392		case ParkCold:
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
394				observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
395				if observed.baseRef == "" {
396					observed.baseRef = s.gitDefaultBranch(ctx, observed.repoPath)
397				}
398				observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
399			}
400		case Resume:
401			observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
402			if observed.remoteBranchExists {
403				observed.baseRef = observed.remoteBranch
404			}
405			observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
406			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !observed.hasCheckout() &&
407				(observed.task.State == task.Warm || observed.task.State == task.Cold) {
408				if observed.task.State == task.Warm && observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
409					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.canonicalPath(observed.task.WorktreePath)
410				} else {
411					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.renderWorktreePath(observed.task)
412				}
413				if observed.desiredWorktreeErr == nil {
414					observed.desiredWorktreeErr = wt.ValidateTarget(observed.desiredWorktree, observed.repoPath)
415				}
416			}
417		case CompleteDirect:
418			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Branch
419		case CompleteFF, ReviewHandoff:
420			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
421		case VerifyMerged:
422			options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
423			observed.completionBaseRef = options.BaseRef
424			if observed.completionBaseRef == "" {
425				observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
426			}
427		}
428	}
429	
430	func (s *lifecycleService) renderWorktreePath(candidate task.Task) (string, error) {
431		values := config.Vars{
432			"worktree_root": config.Expand(s.cfg.Paths.WorktreeRoot),
433			"repo":          candidate.Repo,
434			"repo_path":     candidate.RepoPath,
435			"branch":        candidate.Branch,
436			"category":      "",
437			"host":          s.host,
438			"date":          s.now().Format("2006-01-02"),
439		}
440		rendered, err := config.Render(s.cfg.Paths.WorktreePath, values)
441		if err != nil {
442			return "", err
443		}
444		return s.canonicalPath(config.Expand(rendered))
445	}

530			"finish.equivalent-dirty":       strconv.Itoa(observed.finish.EquivalentDirty()),

540			"completion.proof-error":        errorString(observed.proofErr),
541			"completion.integration":        integrationAuthority(observed.integration),

543			"review.remote-url":             observed.reviewRemoteURL,
544			"review.repository":             observed.reviewRepository,

554			"caller.cwd":                    s.cwd,
555			"caller.workspace":              s.callerWorkspace,
556			"caller.pane":                   s.callerPane,
557		}
558		authority["finish.change-count"] = strconv.Itoa(len(observed.finish.Changes))
559		for index, change := range observed.finish.Changes {
560			prefix := fmt.Sprintf("finish.change.%d.", index)
561			authority[prefix+"path"] = change.DisplayPath()
562			authority[prefix+"base-equivalent"] = boolString(change.BaseEquivalent)
563		}
564		appendOptionAuthority(authority, request.Options)
565		return authority

568	func appendOptionAuthority(authority map[string]string, options ActionOptions) {
569		switch value := options.(type) {
570		case ParkWarmOptions:
571			authority["option.next"] = value.Next
572			authority["option.note"] = value.Note
573			authority["option.commit-wip"] = boolString(value.CommitWIP)
574			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
575			authority["option.keep-session"] = boolString(value.KeepSession)
576			authority["option.close-unknown"] = boolString(value.CloseUnknown)
577			authority["option.assume-no-runtime"] = boolString(value.AssumeNoRuntime)
578			authority["option.timeout"] = value.Timeout.String()
579		case ParkColdOptions:
580			authority["option.next"] = value.Next
581			authority["option.note"] = value.Note
582			authority["option.commit-wip"] = boolString(value.CommitWIP)
583			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
584			authority["option.close-unknown"] = boolString(value.CloseUnknown)
585			authority["option.assume-no-runtime"] = boolString(value.AssumeNoRuntime)
586			authority["option.timeout"] = value.Timeout.String()
587		case ResumeOptions:
588			authority["option.fetch-refs"] = boolString(value.FetchRefs)
589			authority["option.no-provision"] = boolString(value.NoProvision)
590			authority["option.take-ownership"] = boolString(value.TakeOwnership)
591		case CompleteDirectOptions:
592			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
593			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
594		case CompleteFFOptions:
595			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
596			authority["option.push-base"] = boolString(value.PushBase)
597		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
598			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
599			authority["option.draft"] = boolString(value.Draft)
600			authority["option.title"] = value.Title
601			authority["option.body"] = value.Body
602		case VerifyMergedOptions:
603			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
604			authority["option.base-ref"] = value.BaseRef
605			authority["option.squash-commit"] = value.SquashCommit
606			authority["option.push-base"] = boolString(value.PushBase)
607		}
608	}
609	
610	func appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority map[string]string, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) {
611		authority["option.dirty"] = string(dirty)
612		authority["option.commit-message"] = message
613	}
614	
615	func runtimeName(rt runtime.Runtime) string {
616		if rt == nil {
617			return ""
618		}
619		return rt.Name()
620	}
621	
622	func (s *lifecycleService) resolveRefOID(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) (string, error) {
623		if ref == "" {
624			return "", nil
625		}
626		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", ref+"^{commit}")
627		return strings.TrimSpace(value), err
628	}

427	func (s *lifecycleService) handler(action Action) Handler {
428		return Handler{
429			Plan: func(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
430				return s.planSpec(ctx, request)
431			},
432			Apply: func(ctx context.Context, plan Plan) (Result, error) {
433				return s.applyGuarded(ctx, action, plan)
434			},
435		}
436	}

439	
440	func (s *lifecycleService) runtimeFor(candidate task.Task) (runtime.Runtime, error) {
441		var rt runtime.Runtime
442		if candidate.RuntimeHandle != "" && candidate.RuntimeName != "" {
443			rt = s.namedRuntime(candidate.RuntimeName)
444			if rt == nil {
445				return nil, fmt.Errorf("recorded runtime backend %q is unavailable", candidate.RuntimeName)
446			}
447			if rt.Name() != candidate.RuntimeName {
448				return nil, fmt.Errorf("recorded runtime backend %q resolved to %q", candidate.RuntimeName, rt.Name())
449			}
450		} else {
451			rt = s.defaultRuntime()
452		}
453		if rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "" {
454			return nil, errors.New("taskflow runtime resolver returned no backend")
455		}
456		return rt, nil
457	}
458	
459	func openRuntimeSurface(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, path, label string) (runtime.OpenResult, error) {
460		if rt == nil {
461			return runtime.OpenResult{}, errors.New("open runtime: no backend")
462		}
463		if worktreeRuntime, ok := rt.(runtime.WorktreeOpener); ok {
464			return worktreeRuntime.OpenWorktree(ctx, path, label)
465		}
466		return rt.Open(ctx, path, label)
467	}
468	
469	type lifecycleLogWriter struct{ logf LogFunc }
470	
471	func (w lifecycleLogWriter) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
472		for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(string(data), "\n"), "\n") {
473			if line != "" {
474				w.logf("%s", line)
475			}
476		}
477		return len(data), nil
478	}

26	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCompletionFacts(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
27		observed.completionBranch = observed.task.Branch
28		if observed.hasCheckout() && observed.headErr == nil {
29			observed.completionBranchOID = observed.head
30		}
31		if observed.completionBaseRef != "" {
32			observed.completionBaseOID, observed.completionBaseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(
33				ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef,
34			)
35		}
36		if observed.hasCheckout() {
37			observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
38			if observed.completionBaseRef != "" {
39				observed.finish, observed.finishErr = s.analyzeFinish(
40					ctx, observed.checkout, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.task.Branch,
41				)
42			}
43		}
44	
45		switch request.Action {
46		case CompleteFF:
47			s.observeIntegrationFacts(ctx, observed)
48		case ReviewHandoff:
49			observed.reviewRemoteURL = strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, "origin"))
50			identityKind, identity := forge.IdentityFromURL(observed.reviewRemoteURL)
51			observed.reviewKind = s.detectForge(ctx, observed.repoPath)
52			if identityKind != forge.Unknown {
53				if observed.reviewKind != forge.Unknown && observed.reviewKind != identityKind {
54					observed.reviewResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("detected forge %s differs from origin identity %s", observed.reviewKind, identityKind)
55				}
56				observed.reviewKind = identityKind
57				observed.reviewRepository = identity
58			}
59			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil {
60				observed.reviewProvider, observed.reviewResolveErr = s.resolveForge(observed.reviewKind)
61			}
62			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil {
63				switch {
64				case observed.reviewProvider == nil:
65					observed.reviewResolveErr = errors.New("forge resolver returned no provider")
66				case observed.reviewProvider.Kind() != observed.reviewKind:
67					observed.reviewResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("forge resolver returned %s for detected %s remote",
68						observed.reviewProvider.Kind(), observed.reviewKind)
69				default:
70					observed.reviewAvailable = observed.reviewProvider.Available()
71				}
72			}
73		case VerifyMerged:
74			options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
75			observed.proofRef = options.SquashCommit
76			if observed.proofRef == "" {
77				observed.proofRef = observed.task.Branch
78			}
79			if observed.proofRef != "" {
80				observed.proofOID, observed.proofOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofRef)
81			}
82			if observed.completionBaseOIDErr == nil && observed.completionBaseOID != "" &&
83				observed.proofOIDErr == nil && observed.proofOID != "" {
84				observed.proofContained, observed.proofErr = s.isAncestor(
85					ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseOID,
86				)
87			}
88		}
89	}
90	
91	func (s *lifecycleService) observeIntegrationFacts(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
92		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
93			observed.integration = completionIntegrationObservation{
94				worktree: observed.worktree, worktreeFound: observed.worktreeFound, worktreeErr: observed.worktreeErr,
95				status: observed.status, statusErr: observed.statusErr,
96				head: observed.head, headErr: observed.headErr,
97				operation: observed.operation, inProgress: observed.inProgress, operationErr: observed.operationErr,
98			}
99			return
100		}
101	
102		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
103		observed.integration.worktree, observed.integration.worktreeErr = registered, err
104		if err != nil {
105			return
106		}
107		observed.integration.worktreeFound = true
108		observed.integration.status, observed.integration.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
109		if observed.integration.statusErr != nil {
110			return
111		}
112		observed.integration.head, observed.integration.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
113		observed.integration.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.integration.head)
114		observed.integration.operation, observed.integration.inProgress, observed.integration.operationErr =
115			s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
116	}

118	func (s *lifecycleService) completeDirectSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
119		options := request.Options.(CompleteDirectOptions)
120		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
121		conditions = append(conditions, condition(
122			ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
123			"direct mode records completion on "+observed.task.Branch+" without integrating another branch", "",
124		))
125	
126		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
127		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
128			if options.Push {
129				effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
130					EffectPushBranch, "push the directly completed branch", observed.task.Branch, false, true,
131					map[string]string{"remote": "origin", "checkout": observed.checkout},
132				))
133			}
134			effects = append(effects, completionTaskUpdateEffect(observed))
135		}
136		return s.completionPlanSpec(
137			request, observed, conditions, effects,
138			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Complete this direct task?"),
139			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage, options.Push, "", ""),
140			"Complete "+observed.task.Title()+" directly on "+observed.task.Branch,
141		)
142	}
143	
144	func (s *lifecycleService) completeFFSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
145		options := request.Options.(CompleteFFOptions)
146		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
147		relation := effectiveCompletionRelation(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
148		if !relation.Contained() {
149			conditions = append(conditions, completionIntegrationCondition(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage))
150			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
151				conditions = append(conditions, s.completionIntegrationOccupancyCondition(observed))
152			}
153		}
154	
155		relationEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%s is behind %d and ahead %d relative to %s",
156			observed.task.Branch, relation.BaseOnly, relation.BranchOnly, observed.completionBaseRef)
157		if relation.Contained() {
158			relationEvidence = observed.task.Branch + " is already contained in " + observed.completionBaseRef
159		}
160		conditions = append(conditions, condition(
161			ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, relationEvidence, "",
162		))
163	
164		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
165		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
166			if !relation.Contained() {
167				if relation.BaseOnly > 0 {
168					effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
169						EffectRebaseBranch, "rebase the task branch onto the explicit base", observed.checkout, false, false,
170						map[string]string{"branch": observed.task.Branch, "base": observed.completionBaseRef},
171					))
172				}
173				effects = append(effects,
174					NewEffect(
175						EffectSwitchBase, "switch the canonical main checkout to the explicit base", observed.repoPath, false, false,
176						map[string]string{"base": observed.completionBaseRef, "task-branch": observed.task.Branch},
177					),
178					NewEffect(
179						EffectMergeFF, "fast-forward the explicit base to the task branch", observed.repoPath, false, false,
180						map[string]string{"base": observed.completionBaseRef, "branch": observed.task.Branch, "strategy": "ff-only"},
181					),
182				)
183			}
184			if options.PushBase {
185				effects = append(effects, completionPushBaseEffect(observed))
186			}
187			effects = append(effects, completionTaskUpdateEffect(observed))
188		}
189		return s.completionPlanSpec(
190			request, observed, conditions, effects,
191			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Integrate this task with fast-forward only?"),
192			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--ff", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage, options.PushBase, "", ""),
193			"Fast-forward "+observed.task.Title()+" into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
194		)
195	}
196	
197	func (s *lifecycleService) reviewHandoffSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
198		options := request.Options.(ReviewHandoffOptions)
199		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
200		relation := effectiveCompletionRelation(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
201		relationVerdict := VerdictMet
202		relationEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d commit(s) not in %s", observed.task.Branch, relation.BranchOnly, observed.completionBaseRef)
203		if relation.Contained() {
204			if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() &&
205				(options.Dirty == DirtyAuto || options.Dirty == DirtyCommit && strings.TrimSpace(options.CommitMessage) == "") {
206				relationEvidence = "reviewability will be recomputed after an explicit dirty policy is selected"
207			} else {
208				relationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
209				relationEvidence = observed.task.Branch + " is already contained in " + observed.completionBaseRef
210			}
211		}
212		conditions = append(conditions,
213			condition(ConditionBranchRelation, relationVerdict, RequirementRequired, relationEvidence,
214				"use fast-forward completion or add reviewable task-branch commits"),
215			completionReviewProviderCondition(observed),
216		)
217	
218		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
219		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
220			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
221				EffectPushBranch, "publish the task branch for review", observed.task.Branch, false, true,
222				map[string]string{
223					"remote": "origin", "remote-url": observed.reviewRemoteURL,
224					"repository": observed.reviewRepository, "checkout": observed.checkout,
225				},
226			))
227			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil && observed.reviewProvider != nil && observed.reviewAvailable {
228				effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
229					EffectCreateReview, "create a provider pull or merge request", observed.checkout, false, true,
230					map[string]string{
231						"provider": string(observed.reviewKind), "repository": observed.reviewRepository,
232						"remote-url": observed.reviewRemoteURL, "base": observed.completionBaseRef,
233						"head": observed.task.Branch, "draft": boolString(options.Draft),
234						"title": options.Title, "body": options.Body,
235					},
236				))
237			}
238		}
239		return s.completionPlanSpec(
240			request, observed, conditions, effects,
241			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Publish this task for review?"),
242			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--pr", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage, false, "", ""),
243			"Publish "+observed.task.Title()+" for review into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
244		)
245	}
246	
247	func (s *lifecycleService) verifyMergedSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
248		options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
249		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
250		conditions = append(conditions,
251			condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
252				fmt.Sprintf("local relation to %s is behind %d and ahead %d",
253					observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly, observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly), ""),
254			completionProofCondition(observed),
255		)
256	
257		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
258		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
259			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
260				EffectVerifyAncestry, "prove exact merge ancestry", observed.completionBaseRef, false, false,
261				map[string]string{
262					"proof-ref": observed.proofRef, "proof-oid": observed.proofOID,
263					"base-ref": observed.completionBaseRef, "base-oid": observed.completionBaseOID,
264				},
265			))
266			if options.PushBase {
267				effects = append(effects, completionPushBaseEffect(observed))
268			}
269			effects = append(effects, completionTaskUpdateEffect(observed))
270		}
271		return s.completionPlanSpec(
272			request, observed, conditions, effects,
273			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Verify this merge and record DONE?"),
274			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--merged", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage,
275				options.PushBase, options.BaseRef, options.SquashCommit),
276			"Verify "+observed.task.Title()+" merged into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
277		)
278	}

280	func (s *lifecycleService) completionPlanSpec(
281		request Request,
282		observed lifecycleObservation,
283		conditions []Condition,
284		effects []Effect,
285		confirmation Confirmation,
286		fallback string,
287		summary string,
288	) PlanSpec {
289		return PlanSpec{
290			Authority:         s.baseAuthority(request, observed),
291			Conditions:        conditions,
292			Effects:           effects,
293			RetainedResources: completionRetainedResources(observed),
294			Confirmation:      confirmation,
295			FallbackCommand:   fallback,
296			Summary:           summary,
297			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
298		}

301	func (s *lifecycleService) completionConditions(
302		observed lifecycleObservation,
303		dirty DirtyPolicy,
304		message string,
305	) []Condition {
306		conditions := []Condition{
307			condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
308				"task "+observed.task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision, ""),
309			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
310				"Git common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
311		}
312		conditions = append(conditions, completionCheckoutConditions(observed)...)
313		conditions = append(conditions, completionGitConditions(observed, dirty, message)...)
314		conditions = append(conditions, completionArtifactCondition(observed))
315		conditions = append(conditions, s.completionRuntimeConditions(observed)...)
316		conditions = append(conditions, completionBaseCondition(observed))
317		return conditions
318	}
319	
320	func completionCheckoutConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() {
322			verdict := VerdictBlocked
323			evidence := "the exact task checkout is not registered"
324			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !isWorktreeNotFound(observed.worktreeErr) {
325				verdict = VerdictError
326				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
327			}
328			return []Condition{
329				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "resume or reconcile the exact checkout"),
330				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout identity is unavailable", "refresh worktree topology"),
331				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unavailable", "refresh worktree topology"),
332				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout branch is unavailable", "restore the named task branch"),
333			}
334		}
335	
336		exactVerdict, exactEvidence := checkoutExactVerdict(observed)
337		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
338		kindEvidence := "canonical main checkout"
339		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
340			kindEvidence = "exact linked worktree"
341			if !observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
342				kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
343				kindEvidence = "worktree task does not resolve to a linked checkout"
344			}
345		} else if !observed.worktree.Worktree.Main || observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare {
346			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
347			kindEvidence = "branch or direct task does not resolve to Git's canonical main checkout"
348		}
349	
350		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
351		branchEvidence := "checkout and registry name task branch " + observed.task.Branch
352		if observed.task.Branch == "" || observed.statusErr != nil || observed.status.Detached ||
353			observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached ||
354			observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
355			branchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
356			branchEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q expected=%q detached=%t",
357				observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.task.Branch,
358				observed.status.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached)
359			if observed.statusErr != nil {
360				branchVerdict = VerdictError
361				branchEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
362			}
363		}
364		return []Condition{
365			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
366			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "reconcile task and worktree identity"),
367			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "reconcile the task checkout mode"),
368			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named task branch"),
369		}
370	}
371	
372	func completionGitConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) []Condition {
373		status := observed.status
374		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
375		statusEvidence := status.Summary()
376		if observed.statusErr != nil {
377			statusVerdict = VerdictError
378			statusEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
379		}
380	
381		finishVerdict := VerdictMet
382		finishEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("fingerprint %s; base-only=%d branch-only=%d",
383			observed.finish.Fingerprint, observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly, observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly)
384		switch {
385		case !observed.hasCheckout():
386			finishVerdict = VerdictUnknown
387			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires the exact checkout"
388		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
389			finishVerdict = VerdictBlocked
390			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires an explicit base ref"
391		case observed.finishErr != nil:
392			finishVerdict = VerdictError
393			finishEvidence = observed.finishErr.Error()
394		case observed.finish.Fingerprint == "":
395			finishVerdict = VerdictError
396			finishEvidence = "finish analysis returned no content fingerprint"
397		}
398	
399		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
400		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
401		if observed.operationErr != nil {
402			operationVerdict = VerdictError
403			operationEvidence = observed.operationErr.Error()
404		} else if observed.inProgress {
405			operationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
406			operationEvidence = "Git operation " + observed.operation + " is in progress"
407		}
408	
409		conflictVerdict := VerdictMet
410		conflictEvidence := "no unmerged paths"
411		if observed.statusErr != nil {
412			conflictVerdict = VerdictError
413			conflictEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
414		} else if observed.status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
415			conflictVerdict = VerdictBlocked
416			conflictEvidence = strconv.Itoa(max(observed.status.Conflicted, observed.finish.Status.Conflicted)) + " conflicted path(s)"
417		}
418	
419		cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence := completionDirtyCondition(observed, dirty, message)
420		return []Condition{
421			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
422			condition(ConditionFinishAnalysis, finishVerdict, RequirementRequired, finishEvidence, "refresh the exact finish analysis"),
423			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
424			condition(ConditionGitConflict, conflictVerdict, RequirementRequired, conflictEvidence, "resolve or abort conflicts before completion"),
425			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementRequired, cleanEvidence, "select fail, commit with a message, or discard"),
426		}
427	}
428	
429	func completionDirtyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) (Verdict, string) {
430		if observed.statusErr != nil {
431			return VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
432		}
433		if !observed.status.Dirty() {
434			return VerdictMet, "checkout is clean; dirty policy " + string(dirty) + " causes no content mutation"
435		}
436		evidence := observed.status.Breakdown()
437		if observed.finishErr == nil {
438			evidence += fmt.Sprintf("; %d path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
439				observed.finish.EquivalentDirty(), observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.UniqueDirty())
440		}
441		switch dirty {
442		case DirtyAuto:
443			return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; choose an explicit dirty policy"
444		case DirtyFail:
445			return VerdictBlocked, evidence + "; fail policy refuses dirty completion"
446		case DirtyCommit:
447			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
448				return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; commit-all requires a nonempty message"
449			}
450			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; commit-all was explicitly selected"
451		case DirtyDiscard:
452			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
453				return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires DROP"
454			}
455			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires approval"
456		default:
457			return VerdictError, "unknown dirty policy " + string(dirty)
458		}
459	}
460	
461	func completionArtifactCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
462		switch {
463		case !observed.hasCheckout():
464			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
465				"artifact readiness requires the exact checkout", "restore the checkout")
466		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
467			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
468				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
469		case observed.artifact.Ready():
470			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, artifactEvidence(observed), "")
471		default:
472			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
473				artifactEvidence(observed), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
474		}
475	}
476	
477	func (s *lifecycleService) completionRuntimeConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
478		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
479			return []Condition{
480				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
481					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
482				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
483					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair recognized-agent observation"),
484			}
485		}
486		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
487		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + runtimeName(observed.runtime) + " was available for strict inspection"
488		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
489			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
490			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
491		}
492		occupancyVerdict, occupancyEvidence := s.completionOccupancyVerdict(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr)
493		return []Condition{
494			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired,
495				availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
496			condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired,
497				occupancyEvidence, "stop every other recognized agent or use another checkout"),
498		}
499	}
500	
501	func (s *lifecycleService) completionOccupancyVerdict(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) (Verdict, string) {
502		occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(occupancy, err)
503		if occupancyErr == nil {
504			if s.allowSharedCheckout {
505				return VerdictMet, "shared-checkout override accepts the freshly observed agent occupancy"
506			}
507			return VerdictMet, "no other recognized agent occupies the checkout; only the exact caller pane is excluded"
508		}
509		verdict := VerdictBlocked
510		if err != nil || occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil || occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil ||
511			occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil || occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
512			verdict = VerdictError
513		}
514		return verdict, occupancyErr.Error()
515	}
516	
517	func completionBaseCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
518		requirement := RequirementRequired
519		if observed.mode == task.ModeDirect {
520			requirement = RequirementAdvisory
521		}
522		switch {
523		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
524			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, requirement,
525				"completion has no explicit base ref", "record or select an explicit base ref")
526		case observed.completionBaseOIDErr != nil:
527			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, requirement,
528				observed.completionBaseOIDErr.Error(), "restore the exact base ref")
529		case observed.completionBaseOID == "":
530			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, requirement,
531				"base ref "+observed.completionBaseRef+" resolved to no commit", "restore the exact base ref")
532		default:
533			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, requirement,
534				fmt.Sprintf("base %s at %s", observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID), "")
535		}
536	}
537	
538	func completionIntegrationCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) Condition {
539		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
540			verdict, _ := completionDirtyCondition(observed, dirty, message)
541			if verdict == VerdictMet {
542				return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
543					"the exact canonical task checkout will be clean before switching to "+observed.completionBaseRef, "")
544			}
545			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, verdict, RequirementRequired,
546				"the canonical task checkout is not yet switchable", "finalize its dirty policy")
547		}
548		integration := observed.integration
549		switch {
550		case integration.worktreeErr != nil:
551			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
552				integration.worktreeErr.Error(), "repair canonical main worktree identity")
553		case !integration.worktreeFound:
554			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
555				"canonical main checkout is not registered", "restore the canonical main checkout")
556		case integration.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath || integration.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
557			!integration.worktree.Worktree.Main || integration.worktree.Worktree.Bare:
558			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
559				"integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout", "repair worktree topology")
560		case integration.statusErr != nil:
561			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
562				integration.statusErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout status observation")
563		case integration.headErr != nil:
564			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
565				integration.headErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout HEAD observation")
566		case integration.operationErr != nil:
567			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
568				integration.operationErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout Git-operation observation")
569		case integration.inProgress:
570			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
571				"canonical checkout has Git operation "+integration.operation+" in progress", "finish or abort it")
572		case integration.status.Conflicted > 0:
573			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
574				fmt.Sprintf("canonical checkout has %d conflicted path(s)", integration.status.Conflicted), "resolve or abort conflicts")
575		case integration.status.Dirty():
576			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
577				"canonical checkout is dirty: "+integration.status.Breakdown(), "preserve its unrelated bytes before integration")
578		case integration.worktree.Worktree.Head != integration.head:
579			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
580				"canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD", "refresh worktree topology")
581		default:
582			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,

650	func (s *lifecycleService) completionDirtyEffects(
651		observed lifecycleObservation,
652		dirty DirtyPolicy,
653		message string,
654	) []Effect {
655		if observed.statusErr != nil || !observed.status.Dirty() {
656			return nil
657		}
658		switch dirty {
659		case DirtyCommit:
660			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
661				return nil
662			}
663			return []Effect{NewEffect(
664				EffectCommitAll, "commit every staged, unstaged, and untracked change", observed.checkout, false, false,
665				map[string]string{"message": strings.TrimSpace(message), "scope": "all"},
666			)}
667		case DirtyDiscard:
668			details := map[string]string{"scope": "all", "finish-fingerprint": observed.finish.Fingerprint}
669			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
670				details["token"] = "DROP"
671			}
672			return []Effect{NewEffect(
673				EffectDiscardAll, "discard every staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked change", observed.checkout, true, false,
674				details,
675			)}
676		default:
677			return nil
678		}
679	}

743	func completionFallback(id, mode string, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string, push bool, baseRef, squash string) string {
744		parts := []string{"dev", "done", shellQuote(id)}
745		if mode != "" {
746			parts = append(parts, mode)
747		}
748		if dirty != DirtyAuto {
749			parts = append(parts, "--dirty="+string(dirty))
750		}
751		if dirty == DirtyCommit && strings.TrimSpace(message) != "" {
752			parts = append(parts, "--message", shellQuote(strings.TrimSpace(message)))
753		}
754		if baseRef != "" {
755			parts = append(parts, "--base-ref", shellQuote(baseRef))
756		}
757		if squash != "" {
758			parts = append(parts, "--confirm-squash", shellQuote(squash))
759		}
760		if push {
761			parts = append(parts, "--push")
762		}
763		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
764	}

766	func gitIsAncestor(ctx context.Context, dir, ancestor, descendant string) (bool, error) {
767		_, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", ancestor, descendant)
768		if err == nil {
769			return true, nil
770		}
771		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
772		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 {
773			return false, nil
774		}
775		return false, err
776	}

15	func (e *executionState) applyCompleteDirect(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
16		observed := &e.observed
17		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
18			switch effect.Code {
19			case EffectCommitAll, EffectDiscardAll:
20				if err := e.applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx, effect); err != nil {
21					return e.fail(err, "the task checkout and lifecycle state were retained; inspect the content finalization before retrying")
22				}
23			case EffectPushBranch:
24				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
25					return e.fail(err, "refresh direct completion before pushing")
26				}
27				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
28					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
29					if pushErr != nil {
30						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
31					}
32					return "pushed origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
33				})
34				if err != nil {
35					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and task remain active; resolve the push and retry")
36				}
37				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, false); err != nil {
38					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after direct push: %w", err), "inspect the pushed branch before retrying")
39				}
40			case EffectUpdateTask:
41				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
42					return e.fail(err, "refresh direct completion before recording DONE")
43				}
44				if err := e.writeCompletionDone(effect); err != nil {
45					return e.fail(err, "Git effects may already be complete; reload the task and retry the idempotent DONE write")
46				}
47			default:
48				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected CompleteDirect effect " + string(effect.Code)})
49			}
50		}
51		return e.result(), nil
52	}

205	func (e *executionState) applyReviewHandoff(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {

233				}

244				}

279		if !created {
280			if warning := reviewProviderWarning(*observed); warning != "" {
281				e.warnings = append(e.warnings, warning)
282			}
283		}
284		e.milestone = MilestoneReviewReady
285		e.snapshot = "task:" + e.revision
286		return e.result(), nil
287	}
288	
289	func (e *executionState) applyVerifyMerged(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
290		observed := &e.observed
291		verified := false
292		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
293			switch effect.Code {
294			case EffectCommitAll, EffectDiscardAll:
295				if err := e.applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx, effect); err != nil {
296					return e.fail(err, "the task remains active; inspect content finalization and refresh merge verification")
297				}
298				if observed.proofRef == observed.task.Branch {
299					observed.proofOID = observed.completionBranchOID
300				}
301			case EffectVerifyAncestry:
302				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
303					return e.fail(err, "refresh checkout authority before verifying merge ancestry")
304				}
305				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
306					contained, proofErr := e.service.revalidateMergeProof(ctx, observed)
307					if proofErr != nil {
308						return "", proofErr
309					}
310					if !contained {
311						return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot verify %s (%s) is an ancestor of %s (%s)",
312							observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID)
313					}
314					return fmt.Sprintf("verified %s (%s) is an ancestor of %s (%s)",
315						observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID), nil
316				})
317				if err != nil {
318					return e.fail(err, "no remote freshness was assumed; refresh or select the exact ref and retry while the task remains active")
319				}
320				verified = true
321			case EffectPushBase:
322				if !verified {
323					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "base push reached before merge proof"})
324				}
325				if err := e.service.revalidateVerifiedCompletion(ctx, observed); err != nil {
326					return e.fail(err, "refresh exact merge proof before the optional base push")
327				}
328				e.runWarning(effect, func() (string, error) {
329					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "push", "origin", observed.completionBaseRef)
330					if pushErr != nil {
331						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.completionBaseRef, pushErr)
332					}
333					return "pushed origin/" + observed.completionBaseRef, nil
334				}, "optional base push failed")
335			case EffectUpdateTask:
336				if !verified {
337					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "DONE update reached before merge proof"})
338				}
339				if err := e.service.revalidateVerifiedCompletion(ctx, observed); err != nil {
340					return e.fail(err, "merge proof changed before recording DONE")
341				}
342				if err := e.writeCompletionDone(effect); err != nil {
343					return e.fail(err, "the verified refs and resources remain; reload the task and retry the DONE write")
344				}
345			default:
346				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected VerifyMerged effect " + string(effect.Code)})
347			}
348		}
349		return e.result(), nil
350	}
351	
352	func (e *executionState) applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx context.Context, effect Effect) error {
353		observed := &e.observed
354		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
355			return err
356		}
357		before := observed.finish
358		beforeBranchOID := observed.completionBranchOID
359		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
360			switch effect.Code {
361			case EffectCommitAll:
362				message := effect.Details.Map()["message"]
363				if commitErr := e.service.commitAll(ctx, observed.checkout, message); commitErr != nil {
364					return "commit-all may have changed the index", fmt.Errorf("commit all checkout changes: %w", commitErr)
365				}
366				return "committed all checkout changes", nil
367			case EffectDiscardAll:
368				if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, observed.checkout); discardErr != nil {
369					return "discard-all may have partially reset checkout content", fmt.Errorf("discard all checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
370				}
371				return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
372			default:
373				return "", &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected dirty effect " + string(effect.Code)}
374			}
375		})
376		if err != nil {
377			e.partial = true
378			return err
379		}
380		allowBaseMove := observed.mode == task.ModeDirect && effect.Code == EffectCommitAll
381		if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, allowBaseMove); err != nil {
382			return fmt.Errorf("refresh after %s: %w", effect.Code, err)
383		}
384		if observed.finish.Status.Dirty() || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.inProgress {
385			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again after %s: %s", effect.Code, observed.finish.Status.Breakdown())
386		}
387		switch effect.Code {
388		case EffectCommitAll:
389			parent, parentErr := e.service.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBranchOID+"^")
390			if parentErr != nil || parent != beforeBranchOID {
391				return staleBoundary("commit-all did not create exactly one normal commit from the approved branch OID")
392			}
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeDirect {
394				if observed.finish.Relation != (gitx.BranchRelation{}) {
395					return staleBoundary("direct commit changed the self-relation unexpectedly")
396				}
397			} else if observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly != before.Relation.BaseOnly ||
398				observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly != before.Relation.BranchOnly+1 {
399				return staleBoundary("commit-all changed branch relation by more than the declared single commit")
400			}
401		case EffectDiscardAll:
402			if observed.completionBranchOID != beforeBranchOID || observed.finish.Relation != before.Relation {
403				return staleBoundary("discard-all unexpectedly changed committed branch identity or relation")
404			}
405		}
406		if observed.proofRef == observed.task.Branch {
407			observed.proofOID = observed.completionBranchOID
408		}
409		return nil
410	}
411	
412	func (e *executionState) writeCompletionDone(effect Effect) error {
413		return e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
414			candidate := e.observed.task
415			candidate.State = task.Done
416			updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
417			if updateErr != nil {
418				return "", fmt.Errorf("write DONE task state: %w", updateErr)
419			}
420			if updated == nil {
421				return "", errors.New("write DONE task state returned no revision")
422			}
423			e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
424			e.observed.task = updated.Task
425			e.milestone = MilestoneMerged
426			return "recorded DONE at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
427		})
428	}

430	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateReviewRemote(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
431		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, "origin"))
432		identityKind, repository := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
433		kind := s.detectForge(ctx, observed.repoPath)
434		if identityKind != forge.Unknown {
435			if kind != forge.Unknown && kind != identityKind {
436				return staleBoundary("detected forge no longer matches origin repository identity")
437			}
438			kind = identityKind
439		}
440		if remoteURL != observed.reviewRemoteURL || kind != observed.reviewKind || repository != observed.reviewRepository {
441			return staleBoundary("origin URL or forge repository identity changed after planning")
442		}
443		return nil
444	}

446	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
447		if err := s.revalidateRepository(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
448			return err
449		}
450		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
451			return err
452		}
453		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.completionBranch ||
454			observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.completionBranch {
455			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("completion checkout branch changed: registry=%q status=%q expected=%q",
456				observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.completionBranch))
457		}
458		if observed.inProgress || observed.operationErr != nil || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
459			return errors.New("completion checkout acquired a Git operation or conflict")
460		}
461		freshFinish, err := s.analyzeFinish(ctx, observed.checkout, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.task.Branch)
462		if err != nil {
463			return staleBoundary("finish analysis failed during revalidation: " + err.Error())
464		}
465		if finishAuthority(freshFinish, nil) != finishAuthority(observed.finish, observed.finishErr) {
466			return staleBoundary("finish content fingerprint or branch relation changed")
467		}
468		baseOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef)
469		if err != nil || baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {
470			return staleBoundary("completion base ref or OID changed")
471		}
472		if err := s.revalidateCompletionArtifacts(ctx, observed); err != nil {
473			return err
474		}
475		if err := s.revalidateCompletionOccupancy(ctx, observed); err != nil {
476			return err
477		}
478		return nil
479	}

506		}

541		if observed.runtime == nil {

636		ctx context.Context,
637		observed *lifecycleObservation,
638		compareAuthority bool,
639		expectedBranch string,
640	) error {
641		fresh, err := s.inspectIntegrationTarget(ctx, observed)
642		if err != nil {
643			return err
644		}
645		if compareAuthority && integrationAuthority(fresh) != integrationAuthority(observed.integration) {
646			return staleBoundary("canonical integration checkout or occupancy changed")
647		}
648		if expectedBranch != "" && (fresh.status.Detached || fresh.status.Branch != expectedBranch ||
649			fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch != expectedBranch) {
650			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("canonical integration checkout is on %q/%q, expected %q",
651				fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch, fresh.status.Branch, expectedBranch))
652		}
653		observed.integration = fresh

657	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectIntegrationTarget(
658		ctx context.Context,
659		observed *lifecycleObservation,
660	) (completionIntegrationObservation, error) {
661		var fresh completionIntegrationObservation
662		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
663		fresh.worktree, fresh.worktreeErr = registered, err
664		if err != nil {
665			return fresh, err
666		}
667		fresh.worktreeFound = true
668		if registered.Path != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
669			!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare {
670			return fresh, errors.New("integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout")
671		}
672		fresh.status, fresh.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
673		if fresh.statusErr != nil {
674			return fresh, fresh.statusErr
675		}
676		if fresh.status.Dirty() || fresh.status.Conflicted > 0 {
677			return fresh, fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout is not clean: %s", fresh.status.Breakdown())
678		}
679		fresh.head, fresh.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
680		if fresh.headErr != nil {
681			return fresh, fresh.headErr
682		}
683		fresh.head = strings.TrimSpace(fresh.head)
684		if registered.Worktree.Head != fresh.head {
685			return fresh, errors.New("canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD")
686		}
687		fresh.operation, fresh.inProgress, fresh.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
688		if fresh.operationErr != nil {
689			return fresh, fresh.operationErr
690		}
691		if fresh.inProgress {
692			return fresh, errors.New("canonical integration checkout has Git operation " + fresh.operation + " in progress")
693		}
694		fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
695			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
696			CallerWorkspaceID: observed.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
697			CallerPaneID:      observed.taskflowCallerPane,
698		})
699		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr); occupancyErr != nil {
700			return fresh, occupancyErr
701		}
702		return fresh, nil
703	}

715			return fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout branch is registry=%q status=%q expected=%q",
716				fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch, fresh.status.Branch, expectedBranch)
717		}

719		return nil

751	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateMergeProof(
752		ctx context.Context,
753		observed *lifecycleObservation,
754	) (bool, error) {
755		baseOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef)
756		if err != nil {
757			return false, err
758		}
759		if baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {
760			return false, staleBoundary("verification base ref moved from its approved OID")
761		}
762		proofOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofRef)
763		if err != nil {
764			return false, err
765		}
766		if proofOID != observed.proofOID {
767			return false, staleBoundary("verification proof ref moved from its expected OID")
768		}
769		contained, err := s.isAncestor(ctx, observed.repoPath, proofOID, baseOID)
770		if err != nil {
771			return false, err
772		}
773		observed.proofContained = contained
774		observed.proofErr = nil
775		return contained, nil
776	}

778	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateVerifiedCompletion(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
779		if err := s.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
780			return err
781		}
782		contained, err := s.revalidateMergeProof(ctx, observed)
783		if err != nil {
784			return err
785		}
786		if !contained {
787			return errors.New("exact merge proof is no longer contained in the selected base")
788		}
789		return nil
790	}

14		conditions := []Condition{
15			condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
16				"task "+observed.task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision, ""),
17			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
18				"Git common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
19		}
20		conditions = append(conditions, resumeOwnerCondition(observed, options))
21		conditions = append(conditions, s.resumeCheckoutConditions(observed, options)...)
22		conditions = append(conditions, s.resumeRuntimeConditions(observed)...)
23	
24		var effects []Effect

26			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectFetchRefs,
27				"fetch and prune origin before resuming", observed.repoPath, false, true,
28				map[string]string{"remote": "origin", "warning-on-failure": "true"}))
29		}
30		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !observed.hasCheckout() &&

33				"rebuild the missing linked worktree", observed.desiredWorktree, false, false,
34				map[string]string{
35					"repo": observed.repoPath, "branch": observed.task.Branch,
36					"preferred-base": observed.remoteBranch, "fallback-base": observed.task.Base,
37					"selected-base": observed.baseRef,
38					"provision":     boolString(!options.NoProvision), "runtime": "false",
39				}))
40		}
41		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
42			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectSwitchBranch,
43				"switch the clean canonical checkout to the task branch", observed.repoPath, false, false,
44				map[string]string{"from": observed.status.Branch, "to": observed.task.Branch}))
45		}
46		if shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed) {
47			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectOpenRuntime,
48				"open a runtime surface for the checkout", resumeEffectCheckout(observed), false, false,
49				map[string]string{"backend": runtimeName(observed.runtime), "label": resumeRuntimeLabel(observed.task)}))
50		}
51		runtimeDisposition := "clear"
52		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" {
53			if observed.savedRuntimeLive {
54				runtimeDisposition = "reuse:" + observed.runtime.Name() + ":" + observed.task.RuntimeHandle
55			} else {
56				runtimeDisposition = "open:" + observed.runtime.Name()
57			}
58		}
59		path := observed.task.WorktreePath
60		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
61			if observed.hasCheckout() {
62				path = observed.checkout
63			} else {
64				path = observed.desiredWorktree
65			}
66		} else {
67			path = ""
68		}
69		effects = append(effects, taskUpdateEffect(observed, task.Hot, path, runtimeDisposition,
70			observed.task.Next, observed.task.Note))
71	
72		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.task.Branch}
73		if checkout := resumeEffectCheckout(observed); checkout != "" {
74			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+checkout)
75		}
76		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" {
77			retained = append(retained, "runtime:"+observed.runtime.Name())
78		}
79		return PlanSpec{
80			Authority:         s.baseAuthority(request, observed),
81			Conditions:        conditions,
82			Effects:           effects,
83			RetainedResources: retained,
84			Confirmation:      Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Resume this task and claim its checkout?"},
85			FallbackCommand:   resumeFallback(observed.task.ID, options),
86			Summary:           "Resume " + observed.task.Title() + " HOT",
87			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
88		}
89	}

91	func resumeOwnerCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, options ResumeOptions) Condition {
92		if observed.task.OwnedBy(observed.taskflowHost) {
93			owner := observed.task.Owner
94			if owner == "" {
95				owner = "unclaimed"
96			}
97			return condition(ConditionOwner, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "task owner is "+owner, "")
98		}
99		if options.TakeOwnership {
100			return condition(ConditionOwner, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
101				"ownership transfer from "+observed.task.Owner+" was explicitly requested", "")
102		}
103		return condition(ConditionOwner, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
104			"task is owned by "+observed.task.Owner, "confirm the other machine pushed its work, then take ownership explicitly")
105	}
