39	func validateAdoptLocator(locator Locator) error {
40		switch {
41		case locator.TaskID != "":
42			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged adoption must not carry a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
43		case locator.TaskRevision != "":
44			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged adoption must not carry a task revision", ErrInvalidRequest)
45		case locator.RepoPath == "":
46			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
47		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
48			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
49		case locator.CheckoutPath == "":
50			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
51		case locator.Branch == "":
52			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact named branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
53		case locator.HeadOID == "":
54			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout HEAD is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
55		case strings.TrimSpace(locator.Branch) != locator.Branch || strings.ContainsRune(locator.Branch, '\x00'):
56			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact branch is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest)
57		case locator.Mode != "" && locator.Mode != task.ModeWorktree:
58			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged linked-checkout mode must be empty or %q", ErrInvalidRequest, task.ModeWorktree)
59		}
60		return nil
61	}
62	
63	func (s *lifecycleService) planAdopt(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
64		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
65			return PlanSpec{}, err
66		}
67		if err := validateAdoptLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
68			return PlanSpec{}, err
69		}
70		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
71		if err != nil {
72			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
73		}
74	
75		var spec PlanSpec
76		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
77			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
78				var observeErr error
79				spec, _, observeErr = s.observeAdopt(ctx, request, tx.ListRecords)
80				return observeErr
81			})
82		})
83		return spec, err
84	}
85	
86	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAdopt(ctx context.Context, request Request, loader taskInventoryLoader) (PlanSpec, adoptObservation, error) {
87		options := request.Options.(AdoptOptions)
88		base := options.Base
89		if base == "" {
90			base = s.gitDefaultBranch(ctx, request.Locator.RepoPath)
91		}
92	
93		rt, rtErr := s.runtimeForUnmanaged()
94		destructive, err := s.inspectDestructive(ctx, destructiveInspectInput{
95			locator: request.Locator,
96			runtime: rt,
97			rtErr:   rtErr,
98	
99			skipCleanup:  true,
100			inspectTasks: true,
101			loadTasks:    loader,
102		})
103		if rtErr == nil && rt != nil {
104			destructive.runtimeAvailable = rt.Available()
105		}
106		observed := adoptObservation{destructiveObservation: destructive, base: base}
107		if err != nil {
108			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
109		}
110		if destructive.repoPath != "" && base != "" {
111			observed.baseExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, destructive.repoPath, base)
112			if observed.baseExists {
113				observed.baseOID, observed.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, destructive.repoPath, base)
114			}
115		}
116	
117		observed.taskID = task.MakeID(destructive.repo.Name, request.Locator.Branch)
118		appendAdoptIDClaim(&observed.destructiveObservation, observed.taskID)
119		if destructive.worktreeFound && rtErr == nil {
120			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, destructive.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
121				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
122				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
123				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
124			})
125		}
126		observed.derivedState, observed.runtimeName, observed.runtimeHandle, observed.stateEvidence = deriveAdoptState(observed)
127		observed.candidate = task.Task{
128			ID: observed.taskID, Name: options.Name,
129			Repo: destructive.repo.Name, RepoPath: destructive.repoPath,
130			Branch: request.Locator.Branch, Base: base,
131			WorktreePath: destructive.checkout, Mode: task.ModeWorktree,
132			State: observed.derivedState, Owner: s.host,
133			Next: options.Next, Note: options.Note, Tags: options.Tags.Values(),
134			RuntimeName: observed.runtimeName, RuntimeHandle: observed.runtimeHandle,
135		}
136		return s.adoptSpec(request, observed), observed, nil
137	}
138	
139	func appendAdoptIDClaim(observed *destructiveObservation, taskID string) {
140		if observed == nil || taskID == "" {
141			return
142		}
143		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
144			if record.Task.ID != taskID {
145				continue
146			}
147			for index := range observed.taskClaims {
148				if observed.taskClaims[index].ID == taskID {
149					if !strings.Contains(observed.taskClaims[index].Reason, "derived task ID") {
150						observed.taskClaims[index].Reason += " and derived task ID"
151					}
152					sortAdoptClaims(observed.taskClaims)
153					return
154				}
155			}
156			observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
157				ID: taskID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "derived task ID",
158			})
159			sortAdoptClaims(observed.taskClaims)
160			return
161		}
162	}
163	
164	func sortAdoptClaims(claims []destructiveTaskClaim) {
165		sort.Slice(claims, func(i, j int) bool {
166			if claims[i].ID != claims[j].ID {
167				return claims[i].ID < claims[j].ID
168			}
169			return claims[i].Reason < claims[j].Reason
170		})
171	}
172	
173	func deriveAdoptState(observed adoptObservation) (task.State, string, string, string) {
174		rt := observed.runtime
175		switch {
176		case observed.runtimeErr != nil:
177			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend resolution failed; adoption remains WARM"
178		case rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "":
179			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
180		case rt.Name() == "none":
181			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime none leaves session and recognized-agent evidence unobserved; adoption remains WARM"
182		case !observed.runtimeAvailable:
183			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
184		case !observed.worktreeFound:
185			return task.Warm, "", "", "exact checkout is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
186		case adoptStrictOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) != nil:
187			return task.Warm, "", "", "strict runtime occupancy is not ready; adoption remains WARM"
188		case !observed.occupancy.SessionList.Observed():
189			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime sessions were not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
190		case !observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed():
191			return task.Warm, "", "", "recognized-agent activity was not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
192		case len(observed.occupancy.Sessions) != 1:
193			return task.Warm, "", "", fmt.Sprintf("fresh runtime coverage contains %d sessions, not exactly one; adoption remains WARM", len(observed.occupancy.Sessions))
194		case len(observed.occupancy.Agents) != 0:
195			return task.Warm, "", "", "a recognized agent occupies the checkout; adoption remains WARM"
196		}
197	
198		session := observed.occupancy.Sessions[0]
199		handle := session.Runtime.Handle
200		if strings.TrimSpace(handle) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(handle) != handle || strings.ContainsRune(handle, '\x00') {
201			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session has no stable nonempty handle; adoption remains WARM"
202		}
203		if !adoptSessionShellOnly(session) {
204			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session is not shell-only; adoption remains WARM"
205		}
206		return task.Hot, rt.Name(), handle, "exactly one freshly observed shell-only runtime session covers the checkout with stable handle " + handle
207	}
208	
209	func adoptStrictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
210		if occupancyErr := strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err); occupancyErr != nil {
211			return occupancyErr
212		}
213		var blockers []string
214		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
215			// OccupancySession.Panes contains only panes whose live cwd covers the
216			// checkout. A mixed session may also host an unrelated agent elsewhere;
217			// that agent is not a writer claim on this checkout.
218			for _, pane := range session.Panes {
219				if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) == "" && strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) == "" {
220					continue
221				}
222				if occupancy.CallerPaneID != "" && pane.ID == occupancy.CallerPaneID {
223					continue
224				}
225				status := strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus)
226				if status == "" {
227					status = "unknown"
228				}
229				blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent pane %s (%s)", pane.ID, status))
230			}
231		}
232		if len(blockers) > 0 {
233			return fmt.Errorf("checkout is occupied by %s", strings.Join(blockers, ", "))
234		}
235		return nil
236	}
237	
238	func adoptSessionShellOnly(session runtime.OccupancySession) bool {
239		if strings.TrimSpace(session.Runtime.AgentStatus) != "" || len(session.Runtime.AgentSessions) != 0 {
240			return false
241		}
242		panes := session.Runtime.Panes
243		if len(panes) == 0 {
244			panes = session.Panes
245		}
246		for _, pane := range panes {
247			if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) != "" {
248				return false
249			}
250		}
251		return true
252	}
253	
254	func (s *lifecycleService) adoptSpec(request Request, observed adoptObservation) PlanSpec {
255		conditions := []Condition{retireRepositoryCondition(observed.destructiveObservation)}
256		conditions = append(conditions, adoptIdentityConditions(observed.destructiveObservation)...)
257		conditions = append(conditions, adoptBaseCondition(observed))
258		conditions = append(conditions, adoptTaskInventoryConditions(observed.destructiveObservation)...)
259		conditions = append(conditions, adoptRuntimeConditions(observed)...)
260		conditions = append(conditions, adoptStateCondition(request.Options.(AdoptOptions), observed))
261		conditions = append(conditions, condition(
262			ConditionOwner, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
263			"adoption assigns checkout ownership to host "+s.host, "",
264		))
265	
266		details := map[string]string{
267			"id": observed.taskID, "repo": observed.candidate.Repo,
268			"repo-path": observed.candidate.RepoPath, "checkout": observed.candidate.WorktreePath,
269			"branch": observed.candidate.Branch, "head": observed.locator.HeadOID,
270			"base": observed.candidate.Base, "base-oid": observed.baseOID,
271			"mode": string(observed.candidate.Mode), "state": string(observed.candidate.State),
272			"owner": observed.candidate.Owner, "runtime": observed.candidate.RuntimeName,
273			"runtime-handle": observed.candidate.RuntimeHandle,
274		}
275		effect := NewEffect(
276			EffectCreateTask, "create one task record for the exact unmanaged linked checkout",
277			observed.taskID, false, false, details,
278		)
279		retained := []string{
280			"checkout:" + observed.checkout,
281			"branch:" + observed.locator.Branch + "@" + observed.branchOID,
282		}
283		if observed.derivedState == task.Hot {
284			retained = append(retained, "runtime:"+observed.runtimeName+":"+observed.runtimeHandle)
285		}
286		return PlanSpec{
287			Authority:         adoptAuthority(observed),
288			Conditions:        conditions,
289			Effects:           []Effect{effect},
290			RetainedResources: retained,
291			Confirmation: Confirmation{
292				Kind:   ConfirmationApproval,
293				Prompt: "Adopt this exact unmanaged checkout as a " + strings.ToUpper(string(observed.derivedState)) + " worktree task?",
294			},
295			FallbackCommand: "dev adopt --apply --state " + shellQuote(string(observed.derivedState)),
296			Summary:         "Adopt unmanaged checkout " + observed.checkout,
297			DisplayedAt:     s.now(),
298		}
299	}
300	
301	func adoptAuthority(observed adoptObservation) map[string]string {
302		authority := observed.destructiveObservation.authority()
303		authority["adopt.base"] = observed.base
304		authority["adopt.base-exists"] = boolString(observed.baseExists)
305		authority["adopt.base-oid"] = observed.baseOID
306		authority["adopt.base-error"] = errorString(observed.baseOIDErr)
307		authority["adopt.task-id"] = observed.taskID
308		authority["adopt.task"] = adoptTaskAuthority(observed.candidate)
309		authority["adopt.occupancy"] = occupancyAuthority(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr)
310		authority["adopt.derived-state"] = string(observed.derivedState)
311		authority["adopt.runtime-name"] = observed.runtimeName
312		authority["adopt.runtime-handle"] = observed.runtimeHandle
313		authority["adopt.state-evidence"] = observed.stateEvidence
314		return authority
315	}
316	
317	func adoptTaskAuthority(candidate task.Task) string {
318		values := []string{
319			candidate.ID, candidate.Name, candidate.Repo, candidate.RepoPath,
320			candidate.Branch, candidate.Base, candidate.WorktreePath,
321			string(candidate.Mode), string(candidate.State), candidate.Owner,
322			candidate.Next, candidate.Note, candidate.AgentSession,
323			candidate.RuntimeName, candidate.RuntimeHandle,
324		}
325		values = append(values, candidate.Tags...)
326		return authorityHash("taskflow-adopt-task-v1", values...)
327	}
328	
329	func adoptIdentityConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
330		if !observed.worktreeFound {
331			verdict := VerdictBlocked
332			evidence := "the exact checkout is not registered"
333			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !errors.Is(observed.worktreeErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
334				verdict = VerdictError
335				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
336			}
337			return []Condition{
338				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "refresh exact worktree topology"),
339				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout identity is unavailable", "refresh exact worktree topology"),
340				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unavailable", "select a registered linked checkout"),
341				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree flags are unavailable", "refresh exact worktree topology"),
342				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "branch identity is unavailable", "select a named non-detached checkout"),
343				condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "local branch ref is unavailable", "restore the exact local branch"),
344				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git status is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
345				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git operation state is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
346				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory, "checkout bytes were not inspected", "refresh the exact checkout"),
347				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "harness ownership is unavailable", "refresh the exact checkout path"),
348			}
349		}
350	
351		exactVerdict := VerdictMet
352		exactEvidence := "selected path, repository, Git common directory, registry HEAD, and live HEAD are exact"
353		switch {
354		case observed.worktreesErr != nil:
355			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.worktreesErr.Error()
356		case observed.worktree.Path != observed.checkout:
357			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered path differs from selected checkout"
358		case observed.worktree.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir:
359			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered repository identity differs from selected repository"
360		case observed.headErr != nil:
361			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
362		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head:
363			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
364		case observed.locator.HeadOID != observed.head:
365			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("selected HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
366		}
367	
368		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
369		kindEvidence := "registered non-main, non-bare linked worktree"
370		if !observed.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree() {
371			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
372			kindEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("main=%t bare=%t; canonical and bare records are never adoptable", observed.worktree.Worktree.Main, observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare)
373		}
374	
375		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
376		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and non-prunable"
377		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked || observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable {
378			flagVerdict = VerdictBlocked
379			flagEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("locked=%t prunable=%t", observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked, observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable)
380		}
381	
382		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
383		branchEvidence := "registry and status identify named branch " + observed.locator.Branch
384		switch {
385		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch == "":
386			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered worktree is detached or unnamed"
387		case observed.statusErr != nil:
388			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
389		case observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.locator.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.locator.Branch:
390			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q selected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.locator.Branch)
391		}
392	
393		branchRefVerdict := VerdictMet
394		branchRefEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("local %s is exactly selected HEAD %s", observed.branchRef, observed.locator.HeadOID)
395		switch {
396		case !observed.branchExists:
397			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "exact local branch ref does not exist"
398		case observed.branchOIDErr != nil:
399			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictError, observed.branchOIDErr.Error()
400		case observed.branchOID != observed.locator.HeadOID || observed.branchOID != observed.head:
401			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("branch OID=%q selected HEAD=%q live HEAD=%q", observed.branchOID, observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
402		}
403	
404		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
405		statusEvidence := observed.status.Summary()
406		if observed.statusErr != nil {
407			statusVerdict, statusEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
408		}
409		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
410		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
411		if observed.operationErr != nil {
412			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictError, observed.operationErr.Error()
413		} else if observed.inProgress {
414			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "Git operation "+observed.operation+" is in progress"
415		}
416		cleanVerdict := VerdictMet
417		cleanEvidence := "checkout is clean; adoption writes metadata only"
418		if observed.statusErr != nil {
419			cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictUnknown, "checkout cleanliness is unavailable; required Git status already blocks adoption"
420		} else if observed.status.Dirty() {
421			cleanEvidence = observed.status.Breakdown() + "; dirty bytes are allowed and remain untouched"
422		}
423	
424		harnessVerdict := VerdictMet
425		harnessEvidence := "no strict harness path evidence"
426		if observed.isHarness {
427			harnessVerdict = VerdictBlocked
428			harnessEvidence = "checkout is strictly under harness root " + observed.harness.Root
429		}
430		return []Condition{
431			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
432			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "refresh the exact checkout locator"),
433			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "select a non-main linked checkout"),
434			condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, flagVerdict, RequirementRequired, flagEvidence, "unlock or repair the registration; pruning is never implicit"),
435			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named non-detached checkout"),
436			condition(ConditionBranchRef, branchRefVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchRefEvidence, "restore the exact local branch ref at selected HEAD"),
437			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
438			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
439			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementAdvisory, cleanEvidence, "commit later if desired; adoption never changes checkout bytes"),
440			condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, harnessVerdict, RequirementRequired, harnessEvidence, "let the harness own its checkout"),
441		}
442	}
443	
444	func adoptBaseCondition(observed adoptObservation) Condition {
445		switch {
446		case observed.base == "":
447			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
448				"no explicit base was supplied and the repository default is unavailable", "supply an existing base ref")
449		case !observed.baseExists:
450			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
451				"base ref "+observed.base+" does not exist", "restore or select an existing base ref")
452		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
453			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
454				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair exact base-ref observation")
455		case observed.baseOID == "":
456			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
457				"base resolved to no commit", "restore the named base ref")
458		default:
459			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
460				fmt.Sprintf("base %s is exactly %s", observed.base, observed.baseOID), "")
461		}
462	}
463	
464	func adoptTaskInventoryConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
465		inventoryCondition := condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
466			"task inventory is complete, including a successful empty inventory", "")
467		switch {
468		case observed.taskInventoryErr != nil:
469			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
470				observed.taskInventoryErr.Error(), "repair task-store inventory before proving unmanaged ownership")
471		case len(observed.taskIncomplete) > 0:
472			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
473				strings.Join(observed.taskIncomplete, "; "), "repair every corrupt or unresolvable task record")
474		}
475		claimsCondition := condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
476			"no task claims the exact checkout path, repository branch, or derived task ID", "")
477		if len(observed.taskClaims) > 0 {
478			claims := make([]string, len(observed.taskClaims))
479			for index, claim := range observed.taskClaims {
480				claims[index] = claim.ID + " (" + claim.Reason + ")"
481			}
482			claimsCondition = condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
483				"claimed by "+strings.Join(claims, ", "), "use managed lifecycle or resolve every task claim")
484		}
485		return []Condition{inventoryCondition, claimsCondition}
486	}
487	
488	func adoptRuntimeConditions(observed adoptObservation) []Condition {
489		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
490			return []Condition{
491				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
492					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
493				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
494					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime session and recognized-agent observation"),
495			}
496		}
497		if observed.runtime == nil || observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
498			return []Condition{
499				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
500					"runtime none performs no session operation", ""),
501				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory,
502					"runtime none leaves session and recognized-agent occupancy unobserved; metadata-only adoption is retained as WARM", "inspect occupancy with a capable runtime if HOT metadata is required"),
503			}
504		}
505	
506		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
507		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is available for fresh strict inspection"
508		if !observed.runtimeAvailable {
509			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
510			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
511		}
512		occupancyVerdict := VerdictUnknown
513		occupancyEvidence := "exact checkout was unavailable for strict occupancy inspection"
514		if observed.worktreeFound {
515			occupancyErr := adoptStrictOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr)
516			if occupancyErr == nil {
517				occupancyVerdict = VerdictMet
518				occupancyEvidence = "no recognized agent other than the exact caller occupies the checkout"
519				if !observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed() {
520					occupancyEvidence += "; recognized-agent absence was not strong enough to derive HOT"
521				}
522			} else {
523				occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
524				occupancyEvidence = occupancyErr.Error()
525				if observed.occupancyErr != nil || observed.occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil ||
526					observed.occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil || observed.occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil ||
527					observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
528					occupancyVerdict = VerdictError
529				}
530			}
531		}
532		return []Condition{
533			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired,
534				availableEvidence, "select or restore an available runtime backend"),
535			condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired,
536				occupancyEvidence, "stop every other recognized agent or use another checkout"),
537		}
538	}
539	
540	func adoptStateCondition(options AdoptOptions, observed adoptObservation) Condition {
541		evidence := fmt.Sprintf("derived %s: %s", strings.ToUpper(string(observed.derivedState)), observed.stateEvidence)
542		if options.State != "" && options.State != observed.derivedState {
543			return condition(ConditionAdoptState, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
544				fmt.Sprintf("requested compatibility state %s does not equal %s", options.State, evidence),
545				"omit the requested state or pass the freshly derived state")
546		}
547		if options.State != "" {
548			evidence = fmt.Sprintf("requested compatibility state %s equals %s", options.State, evidence)
549		}
550		return condition(ConditionAdoptState, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, evidence, "")
551	}
552	
553	func (s *lifecycleService) applyAdopt(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
554		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
555			return Result{}, err
556		}
557		if approved.Action != Adopt {
558			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "adopt handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
559		}
560		if err := validateAdoptLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
561			return Result{}, err
562		}
563		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
564		if err != nil {
565			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
566		}
567	
568		var result Result
569		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
570			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
571				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeAdopt(ctx, approved.Request, tx.ListRecords)
572				if observeErr != nil {
573					return observeErr
574				}
575				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
576				if buildErr != nil {
577					return buildErr
578				}
579				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
580					return &StalePlanError{
581						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
582						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
583						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
584						Reason:                       "fresh unmanaged Git, worktree, task, base, runtime, agent, or harness authority differs",
585					}
586				}
587				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
588					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
589					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh adoption conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
590				}
591				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx}
592				result, observeErr = execution.executeAdopt(observed)
593				return observeErr
594			})
595		})
596		return result, err
597	}
598	
599	func (e *executionState) executeAdopt(observed adoptObservation) (Result, error) {
600		effects := e.plan.Effects()
601		if len(effects) != 1 || effects[0].Code != EffectCreateTask {
602			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "Adopt must contain exactly one create-task effect"})
603		}
604		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
605			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "runtime none left occupancy unobserved; the adopted task is WARM")
606		}
607	
608		effect := effects[0]
609		expected := observed.candidate
610		expected.Tags = append([]string(nil), observed.candidate.Tags...)
611		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
612			candidate := expected
613			candidate.Tags = append([]string(nil), expected.Tags...)
614			created, createErr := e.service.taskCreate(e.tx, &candidate)
615			if createErr != nil {
616				return "task create made no authorized non-task change", fmt.Errorf("create adopted task %s: %w", expected.ID, createErr)
617			}
618			if created == nil || created.Revision == "" {
619				return "task create returned no revision", errors.New("create adopted task returned no revision")
620			}
621			if adoptTaskAuthority(created.Task) != adoptTaskAuthority(expected) {
622				return "task create returned different metadata", errors.New("created task does not match the approved adoption metadata")
623			}
624			persisted, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(expected.ID)
625			if verifyErr != nil {
626				return "task create was not verified", fmt.Errorf("verify created adopted task %s: %w", expected.ID, verifyErr)
627			}
628			if persisted.Revision != created.Revision || adoptTaskAuthority(persisted.Task) != adoptTaskAuthority(expected) {
629				return "task create revision or metadata was not verified", errors.New("persisted adopted task differs from the task create result")
630			}
631			e.snapshot = "task:" + persisted.Revision
632			e.milestone = MilestoneAdopted
633			return "created task " + persisted.Task.ID + " at revision " + persisted.Revision, nil
634		})
635		if err != nil {
636			return e.fail(err, "the checkout, branch, runtime, and Git bytes were not changed; repair the task-store failure and refresh adoption")
637		}
638		if e.milestone != MilestoneAdopted || e.snapshot == "" {
639			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "adoption ended without a created task revision"})
640		}
641		return e.result(), nil
642	}
643

36	func newLifecycleSession(ctx context.Context, app *App, resolve lifecycleTaskResolver) (lifecycleSession, error) {
37		var session lifecycleSession
38		selected, err := resolve()
39		if err != nil {
40			return session, err
41		}
42		if selected == nil {
43			return session, errors.New("task resolver returned no task")

49			return session, err
50		}
51		session.service = service
52		session.Locator, err = service.LocateTask(ctx, selected.ID)
53		if err != nil {
54			return session, err
55		}
56		return session, nil
57	}

59	func (s lifecycleSession) plan(ctx context.Context, options flow.ActionOptions) (flow.Plan, error) {
60		request, err := flow.NewRequest(s.Locator, options)
61		if err != nil {
62			return flow.Plan{}, presentLifecycleRequestError(s.Selected, options.Action(), err)
63		}
64		return s.service.Plan(ctx, request)
65	}

68		return s.service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
69	}

71	func (s lifecycleSession) finalTask(app *App) (task.Task, error) {
72		final, err := app.Tasks.GetRecord(s.Locator.TaskID)
73		if err != nil {
74			return task.Task{}, fmt.Errorf("load final exact task %s: %w", s.Locator.TaskID, err)
75		}
76		return final.Task, nil
77	}

79	func (s lifecycleSession) requireRetired(app *App, result flow.Result) error {
80		if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneRetired {
81			return fmt.Errorf("task %s retirement returned milestone %s, want %s",
82				s.Locator.TaskID, result.Milestone, flow.MilestoneRetired)
83		}
84		if _, err := app.Tasks.GetRecord(s.Locator.TaskID); !errors.Is(err, task.ErrNotFound) {
85			if err == nil {
86				return fmt.Errorf("task %s retirement completed but the task record still exists", s.Locator.TaskID)
87			}
88			return fmt.Errorf("verify retired task %s is absent: %w", s.Locator.TaskID, err)
89		}
90		return nil

93	func executeTaskLifecycle(
94		ctx context.Context,
95		app *App,
96		resolve lifecycleTaskResolver,
97		options flow.ActionOptions,

118		}

122	// exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator converts a branch-selected checkout into the

125	func exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx context.Context, repoPath, checkoutPath string) (flow.Locator, error) {
126		registered, err := gitx.ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx, repoPath, checkoutPath)
127		if err != nil {
128			return flow.Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve exact registered worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(checkoutPath), err)
129		}
130		return flow.Locator{
131			RepoKey:      registered.GitCommonDir,
132			RowKey:       registered.Path,
133			RowKind:      "unmanaged",
134			RepositoryID: registered.GitCommonDir,
135			GitCommonDir: registered.GitCommonDir,
136			RepoPath:     registered.RepositoryPath,
137			CheckoutPath: registered.Path,
138			Branch:       registered.Worktree.Branch,
139			HeadOID:      registered.Worktree.Head,
140		}, nil
141	}

14	func newParkCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
15		var (
16			next            string
17			note            string
18			wip             bool
19			push            bool
20			cold            bool
21			keepRT          bool
22			closeUnknown    bool
23			assumeNoRuntime bool
24			timeout         time.Duration
25		)
26		cmd := &cobra.Command{
27			Use:   "park [task]",
28			Short: "Stop working on a task without losing the thread",
29			Long: `Park the current task (or the one named) so its runtime session can close.
30	
31	Parking is the missing move that makes a crowded sidebar shrink. It records
32	what to do next, optionally checkpoints uncommitted work, and closes the
33	runtime session — while leaving the branch and the worktree exactly where they
34	are. Closing a session is not abandoning a task.
35	
36	  warm (default)  worktree and branch stay; session closes. Back within days.
37	  cold (--cold)   work is committed and pushed, session closed, worktree
38	                  removed. Reconstruct it anywhere later with dev resume.
39	
40	--cold and --keep-session are incompatible: a runtime cannot stay pointed at a
41	checkout that cold parking removes.
42	
43	A checkpoint commit is preferred over git stash: a stash is invisible in the
44	log, easy to forget, and cannot be pushed — so it can never reach another
45	machine, which is exactly what parking needs to support.`,
46			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
47			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
48				ctx := ctxOf()
49				if cold && keepRT {
50					return fmt.Errorf("--cold and --keep-session cannot be combined: a session must not remain pointed at a removed checkout")
51				}
52	
53				var options taskflow.ActionOptions
54				if cold {
55					options = taskflow.ParkColdOptions{
56						Next: next, Note: note, CommitWIP: wip, Push: push,
57						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
58					}
59				} else {
60					options = taskflow.ParkWarmOptions{
61						Next: next, Note: note, CommitWIP: wip, Push: push, KeepSession: keepRT,
62						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
63					}
64				}
65				execution, err := executeTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
66					return resolveTask(app, args)
67				}, options)
68				if err != nil {
69					return err
70				}
71	
72				parked := &execution.Task
73				style := app.outStyle()
74				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s is %s", parked.State.Icon(), parked.Title(),
75					style.taskStateFor(string(parked.State), parked.State.Label()))
76				if parked.Next != "" {
77					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, " — %s %s", style.label("next:"), parked.Next)
78				}
79				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out)
80				return nil
81			},
82		}
83		f := cmd.Flags()
84		f.StringVarP(&next, "next", "n", "", "what to do when you come back")
85		f.StringVar(&note, "note", "", "free-form note")
86		f.BoolVar(&wip, "wip", false, "checkpoint uncommitted work as a wip: commit")
87		f.BoolVar(&push, "push", false, "push the branch so another machine can pick it up")
88		f.BoolVar(&cold, "cold", false, "go cold: remove the worktree after confirming everything is pushed")
89		f.BoolVar(&keepRT, "keep-session", false, "leave the runtime session open")
90		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow external closure of unknown runtime status")
91		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails")
92		f.DurationVar(&timeout, "timeout", 5*time.Second, "maximum time to wait for runtime closure")
93		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Hot, task.Warm)
94		return cmd
95	}
96	
97	// resolveTask picks the task an argument names, or infers it from the current
98	// directory when no argument is given.
99	func resolveTask(app *App, args []string) (*task.Task, error) {
100		if len(args) == 1 {
101			return app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
102		}
103		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, err
106		}
107		t, err := app.Tasks.FindByWorktree(cwd)
108		if err != nil {

13	func newResumeCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
14		var (
15			noProvision bool
16			fetch       bool
17			force       bool
18		)
19		cmd := &cobra.Command{
20			Use:   "resume <task>",
21			Short: "Pick a task back up, rebuilding whatever is missing",
22			Long: `Make a parked task hot again.
23	
24	Warm tasks still have their worktree, so this just reopens a runtime session.
25	Cold tasks do not: the worktree is rebuilt from the branch, which is why going
26	cold is safe in the first place — the branch, not the directory, is the task's
27	identity.
28	
29	If the task is owned by another machine, resuming here takes ownership. Two
30	machines writing the same branch is the one way to make this workflow produce
31	a conflict, so dev asks before doing it.`,
32			Args: cobra.ExactArgs(1),
33			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
34				ctx := ctxOf()
35				execution, err := executeTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
36					return app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
37				}, taskflow.ResumeOptions{
38					FetchRefs: fetch, NoProvision: noProvision, TakeOwnership: force,
39				})
40				if err != nil {
41					return err
42				}
43	
44				resumed := &execution.Task
45				handoff, ok := execution.Result.Handoff()
46				if !ok || handoff.Path == "" {
47					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is HOT, but resume returned no activation handoff", resumed.ID)
48				}
49				checkout := handoff.Path
50				var activationRuntime runtime.Runtime
51				switch handoff.Kind {
52				case taskflow.HandoffDirectory:
53					if resumed.RuntimeName != "" || resumed.RuntimeHandle != "" {
54						return fmt.Errorf("task %s returned a directory handoff with persisted runtime %s/%s",
55							resumed.ID, resumed.RuntimeName, resumed.RuntimeHandle)
56					}
57				case taskflow.HandoffRuntime:
58					activationRuntime = app.runtimeNamed(handoff.Runtime)
59					if activationRuntime == nil || activationRuntime.Name() != handoff.Runtime {
60						return fmt.Errorf("resume handoff backend %q is unavailable", handoff.Runtime)
61					}
62					if resumed.RuntimeName != handoff.Runtime || resumed.RuntimeHandle != handoff.RuntimeHandle {
63						return fmt.Errorf("task %s persisted runtime %s/%s, but resume handed off %s/%s",
64							resumed.ID, resumed.RuntimeName, resumed.RuntimeHandle, handoff.Runtime, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
65					}
66					annotate(app, activationRuntime, resumed)
67				default:
68					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is HOT, but resume returned unsupported %s handoff", resumed.ID, handoff.Kind)
69				}
70	
71				mode := resumed.EffectiveMode()
72				style := app.outStyle()
73				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s  %s on %s (%s)\n",
74					task.Hot.Icon(), resumed.Title(), resumed.Repo, resumed.Branch, style.dim(string(mode)))
75				if resumed.Next != "" {
76					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s      %s\n", style.label("next"), resumed.Next)
77				}
78				if resumed.AgentSession != "" {
79					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s (resumable)\n", style.label("agent"), resumed.AgentSession)
80				}
81				if st, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout); statusErr == nil {
82					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s       %s\n", style.label("git"), style.git(st.Summary()))
83					if st.Behind > 0 {
84						app.warnf("branch is %d behind upstream — `git pull --ff-only` before you start", st.Behind)
85					}
86				}
87				if handoff.Kind == taskflow.HandoffDirectory {
88					return app.cdDirective(checkout)
89				}
90				return activateRuntime(ctx, activationRuntime, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
91			},
92		}
93		f := cmd.Flags()
94		f.BoolVar(&noProvision, "no-provision", false, "skip dependency install when rebuilding a worktree")
95		f.BoolVar(&fetch, "fetch", true, "fetch from origin first")
96		f.BoolVar(&force, "force", false, "take ownership of a task owned by another machine")
97		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Warm, task.Cold)
98		return cmd
99	}

17	type retireCommandTarget struct {
18		Task *task.Task
19		Path string
20	}
21	
22	func newRetireCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
23		var (
24			closeUnknown    bool
25			assumeNoRuntime bool
26			deleteBranch    bool
27			timeout         time.Duration
28		)
29		cmd := &cobra.Command{
30			Use:   "retire [task-or-worktree]",
31			Short: "Close runtime state and safely remove an integrated worktree",
32			Long: `Retire local execution state after a change has been integrated.
33	
34	Run this from outside the target worktree and runtime. dev re-resolves every
35	covering session, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, waits for
36	runtime closure, revalidates Git state, and only then removes a linked worktree
37	without force. A task is deleted only after every requested cleanup step works.
38	
39	Unknown runtime status fails closed. An external coordinator may acknowledge it
40	with --close-unknown; working, blocked and waiting agents are never overridden.`,
41			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
42			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
43				ctx := ctxOf()
44				target, err := resolveRetireCommandTarget(ctx, app, args)
45				if err != nil {
46					return err
47				}
48				if target.Task != nil {
49					return retireTaskWithTaskflow(ctx, app, target.Task, flow.RetireOptions{
50						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime,
51						DeleteBranch: deleteBranch, Timeout: timeout,
52					}, cmd.Flags().Changed("delete-branch") && deleteBranch)
53				}
54				return retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility(ctx, app, target.Path, closeUnknown,
55					assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranch, timeout)
56			},
57		}
58		f := cmd.Flags()
59		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow an external caller to close unknown/empty runtime status")
60		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails (external callers only)")
61		f.BoolVar(&deleteBranch, "delete-branch", false, "delete the contained local branch after worktree removal")
62		f.DurationVar(&timeout, "timeout", 5*time.Second, "maximum time to wait for runtime sessions to close")
63		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Done)
64		return cmd
65	}
66	
67	func resolveRetireCommandTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (retireCommandTarget, error) {
68		if len(args) == 1 {
69			expanded := config.Expand(args[0])
70			if info, statErr := os.Stat(expanded); statErr == nil && info.IsDir() {
71				return retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx, app, expanded)
72			}
73			candidate, err := app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
74			if err != nil {
75				return retireCommandTarget{}, err
76			}
77			return retireCommandTarget{Task: candidate}, nil
78		}
79	
80		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
81		if err != nil {
82			return retireCommandTarget{}, err
83		}
84		return retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx, app, cwd)
85	}
86	
87	func retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx context.Context, app *App, path string) (retireCommandTarget, error) {
88		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
89		if err != nil {
90			return retireCommandTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
91		}
92		candidate, err := exactTaskForRetirementCheckout(app, repository.Root)
93		if err != nil {
94			return retireCommandTarget{}, err
95		}
96		if candidate != nil {
97			return retireCommandTarget{Task: candidate}, nil
98		}
99		return retireCommandTarget{Path: repository.Root}, nil
100	}
101	
102	func exactTaskForRetirementCheckout(app *App, checkout string) (*task.Task, error) {
103		canonicalCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize retirement checkout %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
106		}
107		records, _, err := app.Tasks.ListRecords()
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111		var matched *task.Task
112		for _, record := range records {
113			candidate := record.Task
114			if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == "" {
115				// A COLD/DONE worktree task with no checkout does not claim the
116				// canonical repository merely because checkoutOf falls back there.
117				continue
118			}
119			candidateCheckout, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(checkoutOf(&candidate))
120			if canonicalErr != nil || candidateCheckout != canonicalCheckout {
121				continue
122			}
123			if matched != nil {
124				return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkout %s is claimed by multiple tasks (%s, %s); name one explicitly or reconcile task metadata",
125					config.Contract(canonicalCheckout), matched.ID, candidate.ID)
126			}
127			matched = &candidate
128		}
129		return matched, nil
130	}
131	
132	func retireTaskWithTaskflow(
133		ctx context.Context,
134		app *App,
135		selected *task.Task,
136		options flow.RetireOptions,
137		authorizeBranchDeletion bool,
138	) error {
139		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) { return selected, nil })
140		if err != nil {
141			return err
142		}
143		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
144		if err != nil {
145			return err
146		}
147		approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
148		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
149			if !authorizeBranchDeletion {
150				return fmt.Errorf("%s requires its exact typed confirmation", plan.Summary)
151			}
152			approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
153		}
154		result, applyErr := session.apply(ctx, plan, approval)
155		if applyErr != nil {
156			renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
157			return presentLifecycleApplyError(plan, applyErr)
158		}
159		if err := session.requireRetired(app, result); err != nil {
160			return err
161		}
162	
163		style := app.outStyle()
164		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", style.success("RETIRED"), config.Contract(checkoutOf(selected)))
165		renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
166		return nil
167	}
168	
169	// retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility preserves the contained-only path contract
170	// while routing every mutation through taskflow's exact unmanaged transaction.
171	func retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility(
172		ctx context.Context,
173		app *App,
174		path string,
175		closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranch bool,
176		timeout time.Duration,
177	) error {
178		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
179		if err != nil {
180			return fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
181		}
182		if !repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
183			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a linked worktree; retire explicit paths only from their linked checkout", config.Contract(path))
184		}
185		locator, err := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, repository.Root)
186		if err != nil {
187			return err
188		}
189		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.MainRoot)
190		if base == "" {
191			return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove unmanaged retirement without an explicit repository default branch")
192		}
193		execution, err := executeNonTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
194			RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base, DeleteContainedBranch: deleteBranch,
195			CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
196		}, deleteBranch)
197		if err != nil {
198			return err
199		}
200		if execution.Result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneNone {
201			return fmt.Errorf("unmanaged retirement returned unexpected milestone %s", execution.Result.Milestone)
202		}
203		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", app.outStyle().success("RETIRED"), config.Contract(locator.CheckoutPath))
204		return nil
205	}

207			} else {
208				relationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
209				relationEvidence = observed.task.Branch + " is already contained in " + observed.completionBaseRef
210			}
211		}
212		conditions = append(conditions,
213			condition(ConditionBranchRelation, relationVerdict, RequirementRequired, relationEvidence,
214				"use fast-forward completion or add reviewable task-branch commits"),
215			completionReviewProviderCondition(observed),
216		)
217	
218		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
219		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
220			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
221				EffectPushBranch, "publish the task branch for review", observed.task.Branch, false, true,
222				map[string]string{
223					"remote": "origin", "remote-url": observed.reviewRemoteURL,
224					"repository": observed.reviewRepository, "checkout": observed.checkout,
225				},
226			))
227			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil && observed.reviewProvider != nil && observed.reviewAvailable {
228				effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
229					EffectCreateReview, "create a provider pull or merge request", observed.checkout, false, true,
230					map[string]string{
231						"provider": string(observed.reviewKind), "repository": observed.reviewRepository,
232						"remote-url": observed.reviewRemoteURL, "base": observed.completionBaseRef,
233						"head": observed.task.Branch, "draft": boolString(options.Draft),
234						"title": options.Title, "body": options.Body,
235					},
236				))
237			}
238		}
239		return s.completionPlanSpec(
240			request, observed, conditions, effects,
241			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Publish this task for review?"),
242			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--pr", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage, false, "", ""),
243			"Publish "+observed.task.Title()+" for review into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
244		)
245	}
246	
247	func (s *lifecycleService) verifyMergedSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
248		options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
249		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
250		conditions = append(conditions,
251			condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
252				fmt.Sprintf("local relation to %s is behind %d and ahead %d",
253					observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly, observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly), ""),
254			completionProofCondition(observed),
255		)
256	
257		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
258		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
259			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
260				EffectVerifyAncestry, "prove exact merge ancestry", observed.completionBaseRef, false, false,
261				map[string]string{
262					"proof-ref": observed.proofRef, "proof-oid": observed.proofOID,
263					"base-ref": observed.completionBaseRef, "base-oid": observed.completionBaseOID,
264				},
265			))
266			if options.PushBase {
267				effects = append(effects, completionPushBaseEffect(observed))
268			}
269			effects = append(effects, completionTaskUpdateEffect(observed))
270		}
271		return s.completionPlanSpec(
272			request, observed, conditions, effects,
273			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Verify this merge and record DONE?"),
274			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--merged", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage,
275				options.PushBase, options.BaseRef, options.SquashCommit),
276			"Verify "+observed.task.Title()+" merged into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
277		)
278	}
279	
280	func (s *lifecycleService) completionPlanSpec(
281		request Request,
282		observed lifecycleObservation,
283		conditions []Condition,
284		effects []Effect,
285		confirmation Confirmation,
286		fallback string,
287		summary string,
288	) PlanSpec {
289		return PlanSpec{
290			Authority:         s.baseAuthority(request, observed),
291			Conditions:        conditions,
292			Effects:           effects,
293			RetainedResources: completionRetainedResources(observed),
294			Confirmation:      confirmation,
295			FallbackCommand:   fallback,
296			Summary:           summary,
297			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
298		}
299	}
300	
301	func (s *lifecycleService) completionConditions(
302		observed lifecycleObservation,
303		dirty DirtyPolicy,
304		message string,
305	) []Condition {
306		conditions := []Condition{
307			condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
308				"task "+observed.task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision, ""),
309			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
310				"Git common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
311		}
312		conditions = append(conditions, completionCheckoutConditions(observed)...)
313		conditions = append(conditions, completionGitConditions(observed, dirty, message)...)
314		conditions = append(conditions, completionArtifactCondition(observed))
315		conditions = append(conditions, s.completionRuntimeConditions(observed)...)
316		conditions = append(conditions, completionBaseCondition(observed))
317		return conditions
318	}
319	
320	func completionCheckoutConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() {
322			verdict := VerdictBlocked
323			evidence := "the exact task checkout is not registered"
324			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !isWorktreeNotFound(observed.worktreeErr) {
325				verdict = VerdictError
326				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
327			}
328			return []Condition{
329				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "resume or reconcile the exact checkout"),
330				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout identity is unavailable", "refresh worktree topology"),
331				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unavailable", "refresh worktree topology"),
332				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout branch is unavailable", "restore the named task branch"),
333			}
334		}
335	
336		exactVerdict, exactEvidence := checkoutExactVerdict(observed)
337		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
338		kindEvidence := "canonical main checkout"
339		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
340			kindEvidence = "exact linked worktree"
341			if !observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
342				kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
343				kindEvidence = "worktree task does not resolve to a linked checkout"
344			}
345		} else if !observed.worktree.Worktree.Main || observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare {
346			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
347			kindEvidence = "branch or direct task does not resolve to Git's canonical main checkout"
348		}
349	
350		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
351		branchEvidence := "checkout and registry name task branch " + observed.task.Branch
352		if observed.task.Branch == "" || observed.statusErr != nil || observed.status.Detached ||
353			observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached ||
354			observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
355			branchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
356			branchEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q expected=%q detached=%t",
357				observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.task.Branch,
358				observed.status.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached)
359			if observed.statusErr != nil {
360				branchVerdict = VerdictError
361				branchEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
362			}
363		}
364		return []Condition{
365			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
366			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "reconcile task and worktree identity"),
367			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "reconcile the task checkout mode"),
368			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named task branch"),
369		}
370	}
371	
372	func completionGitConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) []Condition {
373		status := observed.status
374		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
375		statusEvidence := status.Summary()
376		if observed.statusErr != nil {
377			statusVerdict = VerdictError
378			statusEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
379		}
380	
381		finishVerdict := VerdictMet
382		finishEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("fingerprint %s; base-only=%d branch-only=%d",
383			observed.finish.Fingerprint, observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly, observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly)
384		switch {
385		case !observed.hasCheckout():
386			finishVerdict = VerdictUnknown
387			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires the exact checkout"
388		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
389			finishVerdict = VerdictBlocked
390			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires an explicit base ref"
391		case observed.finishErr != nil:
392			finishVerdict = VerdictError
393			finishEvidence = observed.finishErr.Error()
394		case observed.finish.Fingerprint == "":
395			finishVerdict = VerdictError
396			finishEvidence = "finish analysis returned no content fingerprint"
397		}
398	
399		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
400		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
401		if observed.operationErr != nil {
402			operationVerdict = VerdictError
403			operationEvidence = observed.operationErr.Error()
404		} else if observed.inProgress {
405			operationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
406			operationEvidence = "Git operation " + observed.operation + " is in progress"
407		}
408	
409		conflictVerdict := VerdictMet
410		conflictEvidence := "no unmerged paths"
411		if observed.statusErr != nil {
412			conflictVerdict = VerdictError
413			conflictEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
414		} else if observed.status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
415			conflictVerdict = VerdictBlocked
416			conflictEvidence = strconv.Itoa(max(observed.status.Conflicted, observed.finish.Status.Conflicted)) + " conflicted path(s)"
417		}
418	
419		cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence := completionDirtyCondition(observed, dirty, message)
420		return []Condition{
421			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
422			condition(ConditionFinishAnalysis, finishVerdict, RequirementRequired, finishEvidence, "refresh the exact finish analysis"),
423			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
424			condition(ConditionGitConflict, conflictVerdict, RequirementRequired, conflictEvidence, "resolve or abort conflicts before completion"),
425			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementRequired, cleanEvidence, "select fail, commit with a message, or discard"),
426		}
427	}
428	
429	func completionDirtyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) (Verdict, string) {
430		if observed.statusErr != nil {
431			return VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
432		}
433		if !observed.status.Dirty() {
434			return VerdictMet, "checkout is clean; dirty policy " + string(dirty) + " causes no content mutation"
435		}
436		evidence := observed.status.Breakdown()
437		if observed.finishErr == nil {
438			evidence += fmt.Sprintf("; %d path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
439				observed.finish.EquivalentDirty(), observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.UniqueDirty())
440		}
441		switch dirty {
442		case DirtyAuto:
443			return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; choose an explicit dirty policy"
444		case DirtyFail:
445			return VerdictBlocked, evidence + "; fail policy refuses dirty completion"
446		case DirtyCommit:
447			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
448				return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; commit-all requires a nonempty message"
449			}
450			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; commit-all was explicitly selected"
451		case DirtyDiscard:
452			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
453				return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires DROP"
454			}
455			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires approval"
456		default:
457			return VerdictError, "unknown dirty policy " + string(dirty)
458		}
459	}
460	
461	func completionArtifactCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
462		switch {
463		case !observed.hasCheckout():
464			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
465				"artifact readiness requires the exact checkout", "restore the checkout")
466		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
467			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
468				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
469		case observed.artifact.Ready():
470			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, artifactEvidence(observed), "")
471		default:
472			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
473				artifactEvidence(observed), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
474		}
475	}
476	
477	func (s *lifecycleService) completionRuntimeConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
478		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
479			return []Condition{
480				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
481					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
482				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
483					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair recognized-agent observation"),
484			}
485		}
486		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
487		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + runtimeName(observed.runtime) + " was available for strict inspection"
488		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
489			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
490			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
491		}
492		occupancyVerdict, occupancyEvidence := s.completionOccupancyVerdict(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr)
493		return []Condition{
494			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired,
495				availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
496			condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired,
497				occupancyEvidence, "stop every other recognized agent or use another checkout"),
498		}
499	}
500	
501	func (s *lifecycleService) completionOccupancyVerdict(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) (Verdict, string) {
502		occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(occupancy, err)
503		if occupancyErr == nil {
504			if s.allowSharedCheckout {
505				return VerdictMet, "shared-checkout override accepts the freshly observed agent occupancy"
506			}
507			return VerdictMet, "no other recognized agent occupies the checkout; only the exact caller pane is excluded"
508		}
509		verdict := VerdictBlocked
510		if err != nil || occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil || occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil ||
511			occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil || occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
512			verdict = VerdictError
513		}
514		return verdict, occupancyErr.Error()
515	}
516	
517	func completionBaseCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
518		requirement := RequirementRequired
519		if observed.mode == task.ModeDirect {
520			requirement = RequirementAdvisory
521		}
522		switch {
523		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
524			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, requirement,
525				"completion has no explicit base ref", "record or select an explicit base ref")
526		case observed.completionBaseOIDErr != nil:
527			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, requirement,
528				observed.completionBaseOIDErr.Error(), "restore the exact base ref")
529		case observed.completionBaseOID == "":
530			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, requirement,
531				"base ref "+observed.completionBaseRef+" resolved to no commit", "restore the exact base ref")
532		default:
533			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, requirement,
534				fmt.Sprintf("base %s at %s", observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID), "")
535		}
536	}
537	
538	func completionIntegrationCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) Condition {
539		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
540			verdict, _ := completionDirtyCondition(observed, dirty, message)
541			if verdict == VerdictMet {
542				return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
543					"the exact canonical task checkout will be clean before switching to "+observed.completionBaseRef, "")
544			}
545			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, verdict, RequirementRequired,
546				"the canonical task checkout is not yet switchable", "finalize its dirty policy")
547		}
548		integration := observed.integration
549		switch {
550		case integration.worktreeErr != nil:
551			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
552				integration.worktreeErr.Error(), "repair canonical main worktree identity")
553		case !integration.worktreeFound:
554			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
555				"canonical main checkout is not registered", "restore the canonical main checkout")
556		case integration.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath || integration.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
557			!integration.worktree.Worktree.Main || integration.worktree.Worktree.Bare:
558			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
559				"integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout", "repair worktree topology")
560		case integration.statusErr != nil:
561			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
562				integration.statusErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout status observation")
563		case integration.headErr != nil:
564			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
565				integration.headErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout HEAD observation")
566		case integration.operationErr != nil:
567			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
568				integration.operationErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout Git-operation observation")
569		case integration.inProgress:
570			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
571				"canonical checkout has Git operation "+integration.operation+" in progress", "finish or abort it")
572		case integration.status.Conflicted > 0:
573			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
574				fmt.Sprintf("canonical checkout has %d conflicted path(s)", integration.status.Conflicted), "resolve or abort conflicts")
575		case integration.status.Dirty():
576			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
577				"canonical checkout is dirty: "+integration.status.Breakdown(), "preserve its unrelated bytes before integration")
578		case integration.worktree.Worktree.Head != integration.head:
579			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
580				"canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD", "refresh worktree topology")
581		default:
582			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
583				"canonical main checkout is exact, clean, conflict-free, and switchable", "")
584		}
585	}
586	
587	func (s *lifecycleService) completionIntegrationOccupancyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
588		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
589			return condition(ConditionIntegrationOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
590				observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution")
591		}
592		verdict, evidence := s.completionOccupancyVerdict(observed.integration.occupancy, observed.integration.occupancyErr)
593		return condition(ConditionIntegrationOccupancy, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence,
594			"stop every other recognized agent in the canonical integration checkout")
595	}
596	
597	func completionReviewProviderCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
598		switch {
599		case observed.reviewResolveErr != nil:
600			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementAdvisory,
601				observed.reviewResolveErr.Error()+"; a successful branch push remains a valid publication", "open the review manually")
602		case observed.reviewProvider == nil:
603			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementAdvisory,
604				"no forge provider was resolved; a successful branch push remains a valid publication", "open the review manually")
605		case !observed.reviewAvailable:
606			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementAdvisory,
607				fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is unavailable; a successful branch push remains a valid publication",
608					observed.reviewKind, observed.reviewProvider.Bin()), "install or authenticate the provider CLI, or open the review manually")
609		default:
610			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
611				fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s will create the review", observed.reviewKind, observed.reviewProvider.Bin()), "")
612		}
613	}
614	
615	func completionProofCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
616		switch {
617		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
618			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
619				"merge proof requires an exact base ref", "select a local or explicit remote-tracking base ref")
620		case observed.completionBaseOIDErr != nil:
621			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
622				observed.completionBaseOIDErr.Error(), "restore the selected base ref")
623		case observed.completionBaseOID == "":
624			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
625				"merge proof requires an exact base OID", "restore the selected base ref")
626		case observed.proofRef == "":
627			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
628				"merge proof ref is empty", "restore the task branch or name an exact squash commit")
629		case observed.proofOIDErr != nil:
630			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
631				observed.proofOIDErr.Error(), "restore the exact proof ref")
632		case observed.proofOID == "":
633			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
634				"proof ref "+observed.proofRef+" resolved to no commit", "restore the exact proof commit")
635		case observed.proofErr != nil:
636			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
637				observed.proofErr.Error(), "repair local ancestry observation")
638		case !observed.proofContained:
639			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
640				fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is not an ancestor of %s (%s)",
641					observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID),
642				"fetch explicitly if desired, then select the freshly observed ref; no fetch is assumed")
643		default:
644			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
645				fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is an ancestor of %s (%s)",
646					observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID), "")
647		}
648	}
649	
650	func (s *lifecycleService) completionDirtyEffects(
651		observed lifecycleObservation,
652		dirty DirtyPolicy,
653		message string,
654	) []Effect {
655		if observed.statusErr != nil || !observed.status.Dirty() {
656			return nil
657		}
658		switch dirty {
659		case DirtyCommit:
660			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
661				return nil
662			}
663			return []Effect{NewEffect(
664				EffectCommitAll, "commit every staged, unstaged, and untracked change", observed.checkout, false, false,
665				map[string]string{"message": strings.TrimSpace(message), "scope": "all"},
666			)}
667		case DirtyDiscard:
668			details := map[string]string{"scope": "all", "finish-fingerprint": observed.finish.Fingerprint}
669			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
670				details["token"] = "DROP"
671			}
672			return []Effect{NewEffect(
673				EffectDiscardAll, "discard every staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked change", observed.checkout, true, false,
674				details,
675			)}
676		default:
677			return nil
678		}
679	}
680	
681	func completionDirtyExecutable(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) bool {
682		if observed.statusErr != nil || !observed.status.Dirty() {
683			return true
684		}
685		switch dirty {
686		case DirtyCommit:
687			return strings.TrimSpace(message) != ""
688		case DirtyDiscard:
689			return true
690		default:
691			return false
692		}
693	}
694	
695	func effectiveCompletionRelation(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) gitx.BranchRelation {
696		relation := observed.finish.Relation
697		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() && dirty == DirtyCommit && strings.TrimSpace(message) != "" {
698			relation.BranchOnly++
699		}
700		return relation
701	}
702	
703	func completionConfirmation(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, prompt string) Confirmation {
704		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() && dirty == DirtyDiscard && observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
705			return Confirmation{
706				Kind:   ConfirmationTyped,
707				Prompt: fmt.Sprintf("Type DROP to discard %d unique path(s) under this exact plan", observed.finish.UniqueDirty()),
708				Token:  "DROP",
709			}
710		}
711		return Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: prompt}
712	}
713	
714	func completionPushBaseEffect(observed lifecycleObservation) Effect {
715		return NewEffect(
716			EffectPushBase, "optionally push the selected base", observed.completionBaseRef, false, true,
717			map[string]string{"remote": "origin", "base": observed.completionBaseRef, "warning-on-failure": "true"},
718		)
719	}
720	
721	func completionTaskUpdateEffect(observed lifecycleObservation) Effect {
722		return NewEffect(
723			EffectUpdateTask, "write DONE lifecycle state last", observed.task.ID, false, false,
724			map[string]string{
725				"expected-revision": observed.record.Revision, "state": string(task.Done),
726				"owner": "retain", "worktree-path": observed.task.WorktreePath,
727				"runtime-name": observed.task.RuntimeName, "runtime-handle": observed.task.RuntimeHandle,
728			},
729		)

732	func completionRetainedResources(observed lifecycleObservation) []string {
733		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.task.Branch}
734		if observed.checkout != "" {
735			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+observed.checkout)
736		}
737		if observed.task.RuntimeName != "" || observed.task.RuntimeHandle != "" {
738			retained = append(retained, "runtime:"+observed.task.RuntimeName+":"+observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
739		}

743	func completionFallback(id, mode string, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string, push bool, baseRef, squash string) string {
744		parts := []string{"dev", "done", shellQuote(id)}
745		if mode != "" {
746			parts = append(parts, mode)
747		}
748		if dirty != DirtyAuto {
749			parts = append(parts, "--dirty="+string(dirty))
750		}
751		if dirty == DirtyCommit && strings.TrimSpace(message) != "" {
752			parts = append(parts, "--message", shellQuote(strings.TrimSpace(message)))
753		}
754		if baseRef != "" {
755			parts = append(parts, "--base-ref", shellQuote(baseRef))
756		}
757		if squash != "" {
758			parts = append(parts, "--confirm-squash", shellQuote(squash))
759		}
760		if push {
761			parts = append(parts, "--push")
762		}
763		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
764	}
765	
766	func gitIsAncestor(ctx context.Context, dir, ancestor, descendant string) (bool, error) {
767		_, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", ancestor, descendant)
768		if err == nil {
769			return true, nil
770		}
771		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
772		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 {
773			return false, nil
774		}
775		return false, err
776	}
777	
778	func reviewProviderBin(provider forge.Forge) string {
779		if provider == nil {
780			return ""
781		}
782		return provider.Bin()
783	}
784	
785	func reviewProviderWarning(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
786		switch {
787		case observed.reviewResolveErr != nil:
788			return observed.reviewResolveErr.Error() + "; branch was pushed, but no review URL was observed"
789		case observed.reviewProvider == nil:
790			return "no forge provider was resolved; branch was pushed, but no review URL was observed"
791		case !observed.reviewAvailable:
792			return fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is unavailable; branch was pushed, but no review URL was observed",
793				observed.reviewKind, observed.reviewProvider.Bin())
794		default:
795			return ""
796		}
797	}

800		return forge.PRRequest{

802			Title: options.Title, Body: options.Body, Draft: options.Draft,
803			Fill: options.Title == "", Web: false,
804		}

205	func (e *executionState) applyReviewHandoff(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
206		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ReviewHandoffOptions)
