210	
211		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {

216				}

226					if pushErr != nil {
227						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s for review: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
228					}
229					return "published origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
230				})
231				if err != nil {
232					return e.fail(err, "the task state and resources remain unchanged; resolve the push and retry")
233				}
234				pushed = true
235				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, false); err != nil {
236					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after review push: %w", err), "inspect the published branch before retrying")
237				}
238			case EffectCreateReview:
239				if !pushed {
240					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "review creation reached before branch publication"})
241				}
242				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
243					return e.fail(err, "refresh checkout authority after the successful push before creating review")
244				}
245				if err := e.service.revalidateReviewRemote(ctx, observed); err != nil {
246					return e.fail(err, "origin changed after publication; do not create review against a different repository")
247				}
248				if observed.reviewProvider == nil || !observed.reviewAvailable || !observed.reviewProvider.Available() {
249					err := errors.New("approved forge provider became unavailable after branch publication")
250					stepErr := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) { return "", err })
251					return e.fail(stepErr, "the branch is published and task state is unchanged; open the review manually or retry provider creation")
252				}
253				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
254					url, createErr := e.service.createPR(ctx, observed.reviewProvider, observed.checkout,
255						completionReviewRequest(*observed, options))

257						return "", fmt.Errorf("create %s review: %w", observed.reviewKind, createErr)
258					}
259					created = true
260					if strings.TrimSpace(url) != "" {
261						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffURL, URL: strings.TrimSpace(url), Label: observed.task.Title()}
262						return "created review at " + strings.TrimSpace(url), nil
263					}
264					return "provider reported successful review creation without a URL", nil
265				})
266				if err != nil {
267					return e.fail(err, "the branch is published and task state is unchanged; retry review creation or open it manually")
268				}
269			default:
270				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ReviewHandoff effect " + string(effect.Code)})
271			}
272		}
273		if !pushed {
274			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "review handoff completed without publishing the branch"})
275		}
276		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
277			return e.fail(err, "the branch is published; refresh local safety evidence before reporting review readiness")
278		}
279		if !created {
280			if warning := reviewProviderWarning(*observed); warning != "" {

352	func (e *executionState) applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx context.Context, effect Effect) error {
353		observed := &e.observed
354		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
355			return err
356		}
357		before := observed.finish
358		beforeBranchOID := observed.completionBranchOID
359		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
360			switch effect.Code {
361			case EffectCommitAll:
362				message := effect.Details.Map()["message"]
363				if commitErr := e.service.commitAll(ctx, observed.checkout, message); commitErr != nil {
364					return "commit-all may have changed the index", fmt.Errorf("commit all checkout changes: %w", commitErr)
365				}
366				return "committed all checkout changes", nil
367			case EffectDiscardAll:
368				if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, observed.checkout); discardErr != nil {
369					return "discard-all may have partially reset checkout content", fmt.Errorf("discard all checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
370				}
371				return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
372			default:
373				return "", &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected dirty effect " + string(effect.Code)}
374			}
375		})
376		if err != nil {
377			e.partial = true
378			return err
379		}
380		allowBaseMove := observed.mode == task.ModeDirect && effect.Code == EffectCommitAll
381		if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, allowBaseMove); err != nil {
382			return fmt.Errorf("refresh after %s: %w", effect.Code, err)
383		}
384		if observed.finish.Status.Dirty() || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.inProgress {
385			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again after %s: %s", effect.Code, observed.finish.Status.Breakdown())
386		}
387		switch effect.Code {
388		case EffectCommitAll:
389			parent, parentErr := e.service.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBranchOID+"^")
390			if parentErr != nil || parent != beforeBranchOID {
391				return staleBoundary("commit-all did not create exactly one normal commit from the approved branch OID")
392			}
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeDirect {
394				if observed.finish.Relation != (gitx.BranchRelation{}) {
395					return staleBoundary("direct commit changed the self-relation unexpectedly")
396				}
397			} else if observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly != before.Relation.BaseOnly ||
398				observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly != before.Relation.BranchOnly+1 {
399				return staleBoundary("commit-all changed branch relation by more than the declared single commit")
400			}
401		case EffectDiscardAll:
402			if observed.completionBranchOID != beforeBranchOID || observed.finish.Relation != before.Relation {
403				return staleBoundary("discard-all unexpectedly changed committed branch identity or relation")
404			}
405		}
406		if observed.proofRef == observed.task.Branch {
407			observed.proofOID = observed.completionBranchOID
408		}
409		return nil
410	}
411	
412	func (e *executionState) writeCompletionDone(effect Effect) error {
413		return e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
414			candidate := e.observed.task
415			candidate.State = task.Done
416			updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
417			if updateErr != nil {
418				return "", fmt.Errorf("write DONE task state: %w", updateErr)
419			}
420			if updated == nil {
421				return "", errors.New("write DONE task state returned no revision")
422			}
423			e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
424			e.observed.task = updated.Task
425			e.milestone = MilestoneMerged
426			return "recorded DONE at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
427		})
428	}

657	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectIntegrationTarget(
658		ctx context.Context,
659		observed *lifecycleObservation,
660	) (completionIntegrationObservation, error) {
661		var fresh completionIntegrationObservation
662		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
663		fresh.worktree, fresh.worktreeErr = registered, err
664		if err != nil {
665			return fresh, err
666		}
667		fresh.worktreeFound = true
668		if registered.Path != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
669			!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare {
670			return fresh, errors.New("integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout")
671		}
672		fresh.status, fresh.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
673		if fresh.statusErr != nil {
674			return fresh, fresh.statusErr
675		}
676		if fresh.status.Dirty() || fresh.status.Conflicted > 0 {
677			return fresh, fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout is not clean: %s", fresh.status.Breakdown())
678		}
679		fresh.head, fresh.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
680		if fresh.headErr != nil {
681			return fresh, fresh.headErr
682		}
683		fresh.head = strings.TrimSpace(fresh.head)
684		if registered.Worktree.Head != fresh.head {
685			return fresh, errors.New("canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD")
686		}
687		fresh.operation, fresh.inProgress, fresh.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
688		if fresh.operationErr != nil {
689			return fresh, fresh.operationErr
690		}
691		if fresh.inProgress {
692			return fresh, errors.New("canonical integration checkout has Git operation " + fresh.operation + " in progress")
693		}
694		fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
695			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
696			CallerWorkspaceID: observed.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
697			CallerPaneID:      observed.taskflowCallerPane,
698		})
699		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr); occupancyErr != nil {
700			return fresh, occupancyErr
701		}
702		return fresh, nil
703	}

48	func validateRefreshRemoteLocator(locator Locator) error {
49		switch {
50		case locator.RepoPath == "":
51			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
52		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
53			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
54		case !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Branch):
55			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact head branch %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Branch)
56		case locator.Base != "" && !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Base):
57			return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Base)
58		case locator.HeadOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.HeadOID):
59			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact HEAD OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.HeadOID)
60		case locator.BaseOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.BaseOID):
61			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact base OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.BaseOID)
62		}
63	
64		if locator.TaskID == "" {
65			switch {
66			case locator.TaskRevision != "":
67				return fmt.Errorf("%w: task revision requires a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
68			case locator.HeadOID == "":
69				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged remote refresh requires an exact HEAD OID", ErrInvalidRequest)
70			case locator.Mode != "" && !validMode(locator.Mode):
71				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown checkout mode %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Mode)
72			case locator.State != "" && !validState(locator.State):
73				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown task state %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.State)
74			}
75			return nil
76		}
77	
78		switch {
79		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
80			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
81		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
82			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
83		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
84			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
85		case !validState(locator.State):
86			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
87		}
88		return nil
89	}

91	func normalizedRemoteBranch(branch string) bool {
92		return branch != "" && branch == strings.TrimSpace(branch) &&
93			!strings.ContainsRune(branch, '\x00') &&
94			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/heads/") &&
95			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/remotes/")
96	}

98	func normalizeRemoteName(name string) (string, error) {
99		if name == "" {
100			return "origin", nil
101		}
102		if name != strings.TrimSpace(name) || strings.ContainsRune(name, '\x00') || strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") {
103			return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: remote name %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, name)
104		}
105		return name, nil
106	}

108	func (s *lifecycleService) planRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
109		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
110			return PlanSpec{}, err
111		}
112		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
113			return PlanSpec{}, err
114		}
115	
116		if request.Locator.TaskID == "" {
117			spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, nil)
118			return spec, err
119		}
120	
121		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
122		if err != nil {
123			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
124		}
125		spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, record)
126		if err != nil {
127			return PlanSpec{}, err
128		}
129		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning remote refresh"}
132		}
133		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
134			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning remote refresh")
135		}
136		return spec, nil
137	}

191		}
192	
193		if err := s.validateRemoteRefNames(ctx, observed.repoPath, remoteName, observed.head, observed.base); err != nil {
194			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
195		}
196		if record == nil {
197			if err := s.validateRefreshCheckout(ctx, request.Locator, &observed); err != nil {
198				return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
199			}
200		}
201	
202		observed.remoteURL = strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
203		observed.providerKind, observed.providerRepository = forge.IdentityFromURL(observed.remoteURL)
204		options := request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions)
205		if options.QueryReview && observed.remoteURL != "" && observed.providerKind != forge.Unknown && observed.providerRepository != "" {
206			observed.provider, observed.providerResolveErr = s.resolveForge(observed.providerKind)
207			if observed.providerResolveErr == nil {
208				switch {
209				case observed.provider == nil:
210					observed.providerResolveErr = errors.New("forge resolver returned no provider")
211				case observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind:
212					observed.providerResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("forge resolver returned %s for %s remote", observed.provider.Kind(), observed.providerKind)
213				default:
214					_, observed.providerCapable = observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier)
215					observed.providerAvailable = observed.provider.Available()
216				}
217			}
218		}
219	
220		observed.refs = s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
221		if request.Locator.HeadOID != "" {
222			if observed.refs.LocalHead.Failure != "" || !observed.refs.LocalHead.Exists || observed.refs.LocalHead.OID != request.Locator.HeadOID {
223				return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
224					"selected head changed from %q to %q", request.Locator.HeadOID, observed.refs.LocalHead.OID,
225				)}
226			}
227		}
228		if request.Locator.BaseOID != "" {
229			if observed.refs.LocalBase.Failure != "" || !observed.refs.LocalBase.Exists || observed.refs.LocalBase.OID != request.Locator.BaseOID {
230				return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
231					"selected base changed from %q to %q", request.Locator.BaseOID, observed.refs.LocalBase.OID,
232				)}
233			}
234		}
235		return s.refreshRemoteSpec(request, observed), observed, nil
236	}
237	
238	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRemoteRefNames(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) error {
239		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
240			"head":        "refs/heads/" + head,
241			"remote name": "refs/remotes/" + remote + "/__dev_refresh_probe__",
242		} {
243			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", ref); err != nil {
244				return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not a valid normalized Git name: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, label, err)
245			}
246		}
247		if base != "" {
248			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", "refs/heads/"+base); err != nil {
249				return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base is not a valid normalized Git branch: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
250			}
251		}
252		return nil
253	}
254	
255	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRefreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, locator Locator, observed *remoteRefreshObservation) error {
256		checkout := locator.CheckoutPath
257		if checkout == "" {
258			checkout = locator.RepoPath
259		}
260		canonical, err := s.canonicalPath(checkout)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize selected checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
263		}
264		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, canonical)
265		if err != nil {
266			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout registration changed: " + err.Error()}
267		}
268		if registered.Path != canonical || registered.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
269			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout no longer belongs to the exact repository identity"}
270		}
271		if registered.Worktree.Detached || registered.Worktree.Branch != locator.Branch {
272			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
273				"selected checkout branch changed from %q to %q", locator.Branch, registered.Worktree.Branch,
274			)}
275		}
276		liveHead, err := s.gitRun(ctx, canonical, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
277		if err != nil {
278			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout HEAD is no longer observable: " + err.Error()}
279		}
280		liveHead = strings.TrimSpace(liveHead)
281		if registered.Worktree.Head != liveHead || locator.HeadOID != liveHead {
282			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
283				"selected checkout HEAD changed from %q to registry=%q live=%q", locator.HeadOID, registered.Worktree.Head, liveHead,
284			)}
285		}
286		observed.checkout = canonical
287		observed.worktree = registered
288		return nil
289	}
290	
291	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRemoteRefs(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) RemoteRefsObservation {
292		result := RemoteRefsObservation{ObservedAt: s.now()}
293		result.LocalHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+head)
294		result.RemoteHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+head)
295		if base != "" {
296			result.LocalBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+base)
297			result.RemoteBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
298		}
299		return result
300	}
301	
302	func (s *lifecycleService) observeNamedRef(ctx context.Context, repoPath, ref string) NamedRefObservation {
303		observed := NamedRefObservation{Ref: ref}
304		if !s.gitRefExists(ctx, repoPath, ref) {
305			return observed
306		}
307		observed.Exists = true
308		oid, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, ref)
309		if err != nil {
310			observed.Failure = err.Error()
311			return observed
312		}
313		observed.OID = oid
314		return observed
315	}
316	
317	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshRemoteSpec(request Request, observed remoteRefreshObservation) PlanSpec {
318		options := request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions)
319		conditions := []Condition{
320			refreshTaskCondition(observed),
321			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
322				"Git main "+observed.repoPath+" with common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
323			refreshHeadCondition(observed),
324			refreshRemoteURLCondition(observed),
325			refreshRefsCondition(observed),
326			refreshReviewBaseCondition(observed, options),
327			refreshReviewProviderCondition(observed, options),
328			refreshReviewCapabilityCondition(observed, options),
329			refreshReviewCLICondition(observed, options),
330		}
331	
332		var effects []Effect
333		if options.FetchRefs {
334			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
335				EffectFetchRefs, "fetch and prune the exact configured remote", observed.repoPath, false, true,
336				map[string]string{
337					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
338					"pre-refs": remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs),
339				},
340			))
341		}
342		if options.QueryReview {
343			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
344				EffectQueryReview, "query the exact provider repository and head/base relationship", observed.providerRepository, false, true,
345				map[string]string{
346					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
347					"provider": string(observed.providerKind), "repository": observed.providerRepository,
348					"head": observed.head, "base": observed.base,
349				},
350			))
351		}
352	
353		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.head + "@" + observed.refs.LocalHead.OID}
354		if observed.checkout != "" {
355			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+observed.checkout)
356		}
357		return PlanSpec{
358			Authority:         refreshRemoteAuthority(observed),
359			Conditions:        conditions,
360			Effects:           effects,
361			RetainedResources: retained,
362			Confirmation: Confirmation{
363				Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Run the selected explicit remote network operations?",
364			},
365			Summary:     refreshRemoteSummary(observed, options),
366			DisplayedAt: s.now(),
367		}
368	}
369	
370	func refreshTaskCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
371		if observed.record == nil {
372			return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
373				"repository/checkout context has no persisted task record", "")
374		}
375		return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
376			"task "+observed.record.Task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision+" is validated without a state write", "")
377	}
378	
379	func refreshHeadCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
380		ref := observed.refs.LocalHead
381		switch {
382		case ref.Failure != "":
383			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, ref.Failure, "repair local head-ref observation")
384		case !ref.Exists:
385			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
386				"local head ref "+ref.Ref+" does not exist", "restore the exact named local branch")
387		case ref.OID == "":
388			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
389				"local head ref resolved without an OID", "repair local head-ref observation")
390		default:
391			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
392				ref.Ref+" is exactly "+ref.OID, "")
393		}
394	}
395	
396	func refreshRemoteURLCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
397		if observed.remoteURL == "" {
398			return condition(ConditionRemoteURL, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
399				"remote "+observed.remoteName+" has no configured URL", "configure the exact remote before network refresh")
400		}
401		return condition(ConditionRemoteURL, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
402			"remote "+observed.remoteName+" is configured as "+observed.remoteURL, "")
403	}
404	
405	func refreshRefsCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
406		verdict := VerdictMet
407		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{
408			observed.refs.LocalHead, observed.refs.LocalBase, observed.refs.RemoteHead, observed.refs.RemoteBase,
409		} {
410			if ref.Failure != "" {
411				verdict = VerdictError
412				break
413			}
414		}
415		return condition(ConditionRemoteRefs, verdict, RequirementAdvisory,
416			remoteRefsEvidence(observed.refs), "repair local Git ref observation before relying on freshness")
417	}
418	
419	func refreshReviewBaseCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
420		if !options.QueryReview {
421			return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
422				"review query is not selected; an explicit base is not required", "")
423		}
424		if observed.base == "" {
425			return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictNeedsInput, RequirementRequired,
426				"review query requires an exact base branch", "select the base from the current repository context")
427		}
428		return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
429			"review base is "+observed.base, "")
430	}
431	
432	func refreshReviewProviderCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
433		requirement := RequirementAdvisory
434		if options.QueryReview {
435			requirement = RequirementRequired
436		}
437		if observed.providerKind == forge.Unknown || observed.providerRepository == "" {
438			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, requirement,
439				"remote URL does not identify a supported GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps repository", "select fetch-only or configure a supported provider remote")
440		}
441		return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictMet, requirement,
442			fmt.Sprintf("%s repository identity %s", observed.providerKind, observed.providerRepository), "")
443	}
444	
445	func refreshReviewCapabilityCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
446		if !options.QueryReview {
447			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
448				"review query is not selected; forge capability is not required", "")
449		}
450		if observed.providerResolveErr != nil {
451			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
452				observed.providerResolveErr.Error(), "use fetch-only or install support for this provider")
453		}
454		if observed.provider == nil || !observed.providerCapable {
455			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
456				fmt.Sprintf("%s adapter does not implement review queries", observed.providerKind), "use fetch-only or a review-capable provider")
457		}
458		return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
459			fmt.Sprintf("%s adapter implements review queries", observed.providerKind), "")
460	}
461	
462	func refreshReviewCLICondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
463		if !options.QueryReview {
464			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
465				"review query is not selected; no provider CLI is required", "")
466		}
467		if observed.provider == nil || observed.providerResolveErr != nil || !observed.providerCapable {
468			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
469				"review-capable provider CLI could not be selected", "resolve provider capability first")
470		}
471		if !observed.providerAvailable {
472			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
473				fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is not installed", observed.providerKind, observed.provider.Bin()), "install the provider CLI and retry")
474		}
475		return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
476			fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is locally available", observed.providerKind, observed.provider.Bin()), "")
477	}
478	
479	func refreshRemoteAuthority(observed remoteRefreshObservation) map[string]string {
480		authority := map[string]string{
481			"remote.repo-main":          observed.repoPath,
482			"remote.git-common-dir":     observed.gitCommonDir,
483			"remote.checkout":           observed.checkout,
484			"remote.worktree":           worktreeAuthority(observed.worktree, observed.checkout != "", nil, 0),
485			"remote.name":               observed.remoteName,
486			"remote.url":                observed.remoteURL,
487			"remote.head":               observed.head,
488			"remote.base":               observed.base,
489			"remote.provider":           string(observed.providerKind),
490			"remote.repository":         observed.providerRepository,
491			"remote.provider-bin":       reviewProviderBin(observed.provider),
492			"remote.provider-error":     errorString(observed.providerResolveErr),
493			"remote.provider-capable":   boolString(observed.providerCapable),
494			"remote.provider-available": boolString(observed.providerAvailable),
495			"remote.refs":               remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs),
496		}
497		if observed.record != nil {
498			authority["remote.task-id"] = observed.record.Task.ID
499			authority["remote.task-revision"] = observed.record.Revision
500			authority["remote.task-mode"] = string(observed.record.Task.EffectiveMode())
501			authority["remote.task-state"] = string(observed.record.Task.State)
502		} else {
503			authority["remote.task-id"] = ""
504			authority["remote.task-revision"] = ""
505			authority["remote.task-mode"] = ""
506			authority["remote.task-state"] = ""
507		}
508		return authority
509	}
510	
511	func remoteRefsAuthority(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
512		values := make([]string, 0, 16)
513		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
514			values = append(values, ref.Ref, boolString(ref.Exists), ref.OID, ref.Failure)
515		}
516		return authorityHash("taskflow-remote-refs-v1", values...)
517	}
518	
519	func remoteRefsEvidence(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
520		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
521		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
522			if ref.Ref == "" {
523				continue
524			}
525			switch {
526			case ref.Failure != "":
527				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" error: "+ref.Failure)
528			case ref.Exists:
529				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"="+ref.OID)
530			default:
531				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" is absent")
532			}
533		}
534		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
535	}
536	
537	func refreshRemoteSummary(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) string {
538		operation := "fetch refs and query review"
539		switch {
540		case options.FetchRefs && !options.QueryReview:
541			operation = "fetch refs"
542		case !options.FetchRefs && options.QueryReview:
543			operation = "query review"
544		}
545		return operation + " for " + observed.head + " via " + observed.remoteName
546	}
547	
548	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
549		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
550			return Result{}, err
551		}
552		if approved.Action != RefreshRemote {
553			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "refresh-remote handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
554		}
555		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
556			return Result{}, err
557		}
558		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
559		if err != nil {
560			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
561		}
562	
563		var result Result
564		applyLocked := func(tx *task.Tx) error {
565			var record *task.Record
566			if approved.Locator.TaskID != "" {
567				if tx == nil {
568					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "managed remote refresh has no task transaction"}
569				}
570				current, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
571				if loadErr != nil {
572					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before remote refresh"}
573				}
574				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *current); identityErr != nil {
575					return identityErr
576				}
577				record = current
578			}
579	
580			spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, approved.Request, record)
581			if observeErr != nil {
582				return observeErr
583			}
584			fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
585			if buildErr != nil {
586				return buildErr
587			}
588			if record != nil {
589				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
590				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
591					actual := ""
592					if current != nil {
593						actual = current.Revision
594					}
595					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked remote refresh replan")
596				}
597			}
598			if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
599				return &StalePlanError{
600					ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
601					ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
602					ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
603					Reason:                       "fresh task, repository, remote URL, provider, or ref authority differs",
604				}
605			}
606			if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
607				notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
608				return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh remote refresh conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
609			}
610	
611			execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh}
612			result, observeErr = execution.executeRefreshRemote(ctx, observed)
613			return observeErr
614		}
615	
616		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
617			if approved.Locator.TaskID == "" {
618				return applyLocked(nil)
619			}
620			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, applyLocked)
621		})
622		return result, err
623	}
624	
625	func (e *executionState) executeRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation) (Result, error) {
626		data := RemoteObservation{
627			RemoteName: observed.remoteName, RemoteURL: observed.remoteURL,
628			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
629			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, BeforeRefs: observed.refs,
630		}
631		e.remote = &data
632		fetched := false
633	
634		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
635			switch effect.Code {
636			case EffectFetchRefs:
637				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
638					_, fetchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "--", observed.remoteName)
639					if fetchErr != nil {
640						return "", fmt.Errorf("fetch --prune %s: %w", observed.remoteName, fetchErr)
641					}
642					return "fetched and pruned " + observed.remoteName, nil
643				})
644				if err != nil {
645					recovery := []string{"remote refs were not proven refreshed; repair the exact remote fetch and create a fresh plan"}
646					if e.plan.Request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions).QueryReview {
647						recovery = append(recovery, "review query was not attempted after the failed fetch")
648					}
649					return e.fail(err, recovery...)
650				}
651				fetched = true
652				data.AfterRefs = e.service.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
653				data.HasAfterRefs = true
654	
655			case EffectQueryReview:
656				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
657					if err := e.service.revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx, observed, fetched); err != nil {
658						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
659						return "", err
660					}
661					query := forge.ReviewQuery{Repository: observed.providerRepository, Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base}
662					review, queryErr := e.service.queryReview(ctx, observed.provider, observed.repoPath, query)
663					if queryErr != nil {
664						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, queryErr)
665						return "", queryErr
666					}
667					if review == nil {
668						data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
669							State: ObservationKnown, Exists: false,
670							Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
671							Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
672						}
673						data.HasReview = true
674						return "provider reports no exact review", nil
675					}
676					if err := validateRemoteReview(observed, *review); err != nil {
677						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
678						return "", err
679					}
680					observedAt := review.ObservedAt.UTC()
681					if review.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
682						observedAt = e.service.now()
683					}
684					data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
685						State: ObservationKnown, Exists: true,
686						Provider: review.Provider, Repository: review.Repository,
687						ID: review.ID, Number: review.Number, ReviewState: review.State,
688						Draft: review.Draft, URL: review.URL, Head: review.Head, Base: review.Base,
689						ObservedAt: observedAt,
690					}
691					data.HasReview = true
692					return fmt.Sprintf("observed %s review #%d (%s)", review.Provider, review.Number, review.State), nil
693				})
694				if err != nil {
695					if fetched {
696						return e.fail(err, "fetch completed; review evidence remains an explicit error and may be retried from a fresh query-only plan")
697					}
698					return e.fail(err, "local refs and task state were unchanged; repair provider access or response handling and retry")
699				}
700	
701			default:
702				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RefreshRemote effect " + string(effect.Code)})
703			}
704		}
705		return e.result(), nil
706	}
707	
708	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation, allowFetchedRefs bool) error {
709		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
710		if err != nil {
711			return staleBoundary("repository became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
712		}
713		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
714		if err != nil {
715			return staleBoundary("repository main path became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
716		}
717		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
718		if err != nil {
719			return staleBoundary("Git common directory became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
720		}
721		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
722			return staleBoundary("repository identity changed before review query")
723		}
724		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
725		kind, repositoryIdentity := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
726		if remoteURL != observed.remoteURL || kind != observed.providerKind || repositoryIdentity != observed.providerRepository {
727			return staleBoundary("remote URL or provider repository identity changed before review query")
728		}
729		if observed.provider == nil || observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind {
730			return staleBoundary("review provider identity changed before query")
731		}
732		if _, ok := observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier); !ok {
733			return staleBoundary("review provider capability changed before query")
734		}
735		if !observed.provider.Available() {
736			return staleBoundary("review provider CLI became unavailable before query")
737		}
738		if !allowFetchedRefs {
739			freshRefs := s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
740			if remoteRefsAuthority(freshRefs) != remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs) {
741				return staleBoundary("local or remote-tracking ref authority changed before query")
742			}
743		}
744		return nil
745	}
746	
747	func (e *executionState) setRemoteReviewFailure(data *RemoteObservation, observed remoteRefreshObservation, err error) {
748		data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
749			State: ObservationError, Exists: false,
750			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
751			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
752			FailureKind: classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err), Failure: err.Error(),
753		}
754		data.HasReview = true
755	}
756	
757	func classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err error) RemoteReviewFailureKind {
758		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrAmbiguousReview) {
759			return RemoteReviewFailureAmbiguous
760		}
761		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrMalformedReviewResponse) {
762			return RemoteReviewFailureMalformed
763		}
764		var unsupported *forge.ErrUnsupported
765		if errors.As(err, &unsupported) {
766			return RemoteReviewFailureUnsupported
767		}
768		var missingCLI *forge.ErrNoCLI
769		if errors.As(err, &missingCLI) {
770			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingCLI
771		}
772		var missingExtension *forge.ErrNoExtension
773		if errors.As(err, &missingExtension) {
774			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingExtension
775		}
776		return RemoteReviewFailureProvider
777	}
778	
779	func validateRemoteReview(observed remoteRefreshObservation, review forge.Review) error {
780		switch {
781		case review.Provider != observed.providerKind:
782			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "provider")
783		case review.Repository != observed.providerRepository:
784			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "repository identity")
785		case review.Head != observed.head:
786			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "head branch")
787		case review.Base != observed.base:
788			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "base branch")
789		case strings.TrimSpace(review.ID) == "" || review.ID != strings.TrimSpace(review.ID):
790			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "identifier")
791		case review.Number <= 0:
792			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "number")
793		case !review.State.Valid():
794			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "state")
795		case review.State == forge.ReviewDraft && !review.Draft:
796			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft flag")
797		case review.State == forge.ReviewOpen && review.Draft:
798			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft state")
799		case !validRemoteReviewURL(review.URL):
800			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "URL")
801		}
802		return nil
803	}
804	
805	func malformedRemoteReview(provider forge.Kind, field string) error {
806		return &forge.MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: 0, Field: field}
807	}
808	
809	func validRemoteReviewURL(raw string) bool {
810		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
811		return err == nil && parsed.Host != "" && (parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http")
812	}
813	
814	func remoteRefCount(refs RemoteRefsObservation) int {
815		count := 0
816		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
817			if ref.Exists && ref.Failure == "" && ref.OID != "" {
818				count++
819			}
820		}
821		return count
822	}
823	
824	func remoteRefSummary(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
825		return strconv.Itoa(remoteRefCount(refs)) + " named ref OID(s) observed"
826	}

13	// locateExactTask builds a managed locator from one exact task record and a

15	// expected path (or an intentionally empty COLD path) so Plan can explain the
16	// drift instead of losing the task before transition validation.
17	func (s *lifecycleService) locateExactTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
18		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
19			return Locator{}, err
20		}
21		if !exactTaskID.MatchString(taskID) || filepath.Base(taskID) != taskID || taskID == "." || taskID == ".." {

23		}
24	
25		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)

28		}
29		candidate := record.Task
30		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
31			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q is invalid: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
32		}
33		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
34		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(candidate.State) {
35			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q has invalid mode or state", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID)
36		}
37	
38		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
41		}
42		repoPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
43		if err != nil {
44			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
45		}
46		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
49		}
50		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
51		if err != nil {
52			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
53		}
54		if recordedRepo != repoPath {
55			return Locator{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
56				"recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q",
57				candidate.RepoPath, recordedRepo, repoPath,
58			)}
59		}
60	
61		expectedCheckout := repoPath
62		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
63			expectedCheckout = ""
64			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {

87		}

97					locator.HeadOID = head
98				}

100		}

103		}

105			locator.Upstream = s.branchUpstream(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Branch)
106		}
107		locator.BaseOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Base)
108		locator.UpstreamOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, locator.Upstream)

123	func (s *lifecycleService) locateRegisteredCheckout(
124		ctx context.Context,
125		candidate task.Task,
126		repoPath string,
127		expectedCheckout string,
128	) (gitx.RegisteredWorktree, bool) {
129		if expectedCheckout != "" {
130			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
131			return registered, err == nil
132		}
133		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree || candidate.State != task.Cold {
134			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
135		}
136	
137		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, repoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
140		}
141		match := ""
142		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
143			if worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch {
144				continue
145			}
146			if match != "" {
147				return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
148			}
149			match = worktree.Path
150		}
151		if match == "" {
152			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
153		}
154		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, match)
155		return registered, err == nil
156	}
157	
158	func (s *lifecycleService) branchUpstream(ctx context.Context, repoPath, branch string) string {
159		if branch == "" {
160			return ""
161		}
162		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath,
163			"for-each-ref", "--format=%(upstream:short)", localBranchRef(branch),
164		)
165		if err != nil {
166			return ""
167		}
168		return strings.TrimSpace(value)
169	}

76	// those steps.
77	type Tx struct{ store *Store }
78	
79	// NewStore returns a store rooted at dir.
80	func NewStore(dir string) *Store { return &Store{Dir: dir} }
81	
82	var idUnsafe = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+`)
83	
84	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
85	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
86		clean := func(s string) string {
87			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
88			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
89				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
90			}
91			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
92		}
93		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
94		if r == "" {
95			r = "repo"
96		}
97		if b == "" {
98			b = "branch"
99		}
100		return r + "__" + b
101	}
102	
103	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }
104	
105	// Save writes a task, stamping Updated (and Created on first write). Save is a
106	// compatibility upsert; callers that need collision or lost-update protection
107	// should use Create or Update.
108	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {
109		return s.WithLock(context.Background(), func(tx *Tx) error {
110			_, err := tx.Save(t)
111			return err
112		})
113	}
114	
115	// Create atomically writes t only when its derived ID is unused. The caller's
116	// task receives its ID and timestamps only after the write succeeds.
117	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, t *Task) (*Record, error) {
118		var created *Record
119		err := s.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *Tx) error {
120			var err error
121			created, err = tx.Create(t)
122			return err
123		})
124		return created, err
125	}
126	
127	// Update atomically replaces t only when expectedRevision still describes the
128	// exact persisted bytes for its ID. On success t receives the store-owned
129	// Updated timestamp and the returned record carries the new revision.
130	func (s *Store) Update(ctx context.Context, t *Task, expectedRevision string) (*Record, error) {
131		var updated *Record
132		err := s.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *Tx) error {
133			var err error
134			updated, err = tx.Update(t, expectedRevision)
135			return err
136		})
137		return updated, err
138	}
139	
140	// Get loads one task by its exact id.
141	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Task, error) {
142		record, err := s.GetRecord(id)
143		if err != nil {
144			return nil, err
145		}
146		return &record.Task, nil
147	}
148	
149	// GetRecord loads one task and fingerprints its exact persisted bytes plus ID.
150	func (s *Store) GetRecord(id string) (*Record, error) {
151		return s.getRecordUnlocked(id)
152	}
153	
154	// List loads every task, sorted by state (hot first) then most recent. Corrupt
155	// records retain the historical warning behavior; ListRecords exposes them as
156	// typed diagnostics to callers that need to aggregate or retain the failures.
157	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Task, error) {
158		records, diagnostics, err := s.ListRecords()
159		if err != nil {
160			return nil, err
161		}
162		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
163			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: %v\n", diagnostic)
164		}
165		var out []*Task
166		for i := range records {
167			out = append(out, &records[i].Task)
168		}
169		return out, nil
170	}
171	
172	// ListRecords returns every valid task and a typed diagnostic for each task
173	// file that could not be read or decoded. Directory-level failures are fatal.
174	func (s *Store) ListRecords() ([]Record, []Diagnostic, error) {
175		return s.listRecordsUnlocked()
176	}
177	
178	// listRecordsUnlocked implements both the public read-only inventory and the
179	// transaction-scoped inventory. Callers using it for mutation authority must
180	// hold the store lock through the guarded operation.
181	func (s *Store) listRecordsUnlocked() ([]Record, []Diagnostic, error) {
182		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
183		if err != nil {
184			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
185				return nil, nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
186			}
187			return nil, nil, err
188		}
189		var records []Record
190		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
191		for _, entry := range entries {
192			name := entry.Name()
193			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
194				continue
195			}
196			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
197			record, err := s.getRecordUnlocked(id)
198			if err != nil {
199				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
200					ID: id, Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err,
201				})
202				continue
203			}
204			records = append(records, *record)
205		}
206		sortRecords(records)
207		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
208		return records, diagnostics, nil
209	}

211	// Delete removes a task entry. It never touches git state. Delete is the
212	// compatibility unconditional form; use DeleteIfRevision to protect a planned
213	// mutation from concurrent changes.

215		return s.WithLock(context.Background(), func(tx *Tx) error {

224			return tx.DeleteIfRevision(id, expectedRevision)
225		})
226	}

228	// WithLock runs operation while holding the task store's cross-process lock.
229	// Callers must use the supplied Tx inside the callback; calling Store mutation
230	// methods from it would try to acquire the same lock again.
231	func (s *Store) WithLock(ctx context.Context, operation func(*Tx) error) error {
232		if operation == nil {
233			return errors.New("task store transaction callback is nil")
234		}
235		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "task store", func() error {
236			return operation(&Tx{store: s})
237		})
238	}
239	
240	// GetRecord returns one record while the transaction lock is held.

242		return tx.store.getRecordUnlocked(id)
243	}
244	
245	// ListRecords returns the complete diagnostic-preserving task inventory while
246	// the transaction lock is held. It is intended for claim checks that must stay
247	// stable through a subsequent guarded mutation.
248	func (tx *Tx) ListRecords() ([]Record, []Diagnostic, error) {
249		return tx.store.listRecordsUnlocked()
250	}
251	
252	// Save performs the compatibility unconditional write inside a transaction.
253	func (tx *Tx) Save(t *Task) (*Record, error) {
254		if t == nil {
255			return nil, errors.New("save nil task")
256		}
257		return tx.store.saveUnlocked(t)
258	}
259	
260	// Create writes a task only when its derived ID is not already present.
261	func (tx *Tx) Create(t *Task) (*Record, error) {
262		if t == nil {
263			return nil, errors.New("create nil task")
264		}
265		candidate := cloneTask(*t)
266		if candidate.ID == "" {
267			candidate.ID = MakeID(candidate.Repo, candidate.Branch)
268		}
269		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
270			return nil, err
271		}
272		if _, err := os.Lstat(tx.store.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
273			return nil, fmt.Errorf("task %q: %w", candidate.ID, ErrAlreadyExists)
274		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
275			return nil, fmt.Errorf("check task %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
276		}
277		record, err := tx.store.saveUnlocked(&candidate)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, err
280		}
281		*t = cloneTask(candidate)
282		return record, nil
283	}
284	
285	// Update replaces a task only when the expected revision is still current.
286	func (tx *Tx) Update(t *Task, expectedRevision string) (*Record, error) {
287		if t == nil {
288			return nil, errors.New("update nil task")
289		}
290		candidate := cloneTask(*t)
291		if candidate.ID == "" {
292			candidate.ID = MakeID(candidate.Repo, candidate.Branch)
293		}
294		current, err := tx.store.getRecordUnlocked(candidate.ID)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		if current.Revision != expectedRevision {
299			return nil, &StaleRevisionError{
300				ID: candidate.ID, Expected: expectedRevision, Actual: current.Revision,
301			}
302		}
303		record, err := tx.store.saveUnlocked(&candidate)
304		if err != nil {
305			return nil, err
306		}
307		*t = cloneTask(candidate)
308		return record, nil
309	}
310	
311	// Delete removes a task unconditionally inside a compatibility transaction.
312	func (tx *Tx) Delete(id string) error {
313		return tx.store.deleteUnlocked(id)
314	}
315	
316	// DeleteIfRevision removes a task only while its revision remains current.
317	func (tx *Tx) DeleteIfRevision(id, expectedRevision string) error {
318		current, err := tx.store.getRecordUnlocked(id)
319		if err != nil {
320			return err
321		}
322		if current.Revision != expectedRevision {
323			return &StaleRevisionError{ID: id, Expected: expectedRevision, Actual: current.Revision}
324		}
325		return tx.store.deleteUnlocked(id)
326	}
327	
328	// saveUnlocked atomically persists t. The caller must hold the store lock.
329	func (s *Store) saveUnlocked(t *Task) (*Record, error) {
330		if t.ID == "" {
331			t.ID = MakeID(t.Repo, t.Branch)
332		}
333		if err := t.Validate(); err != nil {
334			return nil, err
335		}
336		now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
337		if t.Created.IsZero() {
338			t.Created = now
339		}
340		t.Updated = now
341	
342		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
343			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create state dir: %w", err)
344		}
345		var encoded bytes.Buffer
346		if err := toml.NewEncoder(&encoded).Encode(t); err != nil {
347			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
348		}
349		data := encoded.Bytes()
350	
351		// Write to a temp file and rename, so an interrupted write can never leave
352		// a half-parsed task behind.
353		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+t.ID+".*.tmp")
354		if err != nil {
355			return nil, err
356		}
357		defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
358		if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
359			_ = tmp.Close()
360			return nil, fmt.Errorf("write task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
361		}
362		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
363			return nil, err
364		}
365		if err := os.Chmod(tmp.Name(), 0o644); err != nil {
366			return nil, err
367		}
368		if err := os.Rename(tmp.Name(), s.path(t.ID)); err != nil {
369			return nil, err
370		}
371		return &Record{Task: cloneTask(*t), Revision: revisionFor(t.ID, data)}, nil
372	}
373	
374	// getRecordUnlocked reads a complete record without taking the mutation lock.
375	// Atomic rename makes concurrent reads see either the previous or next bytes.
376	func (s *Store) getRecordUnlocked(id string) (*Record, error) {
377		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
378		if err != nil {
379			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
380				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
381			}
382			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
383		}
384		var t Task
385		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &t); err != nil {
386			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
387		}
388		t.ID = id
389		return &Record{Task: t, Revision: revisionFor(id, data)}, nil
390	}
391	
392	// deleteUnlocked removes one record. The caller must hold the store lock.
393	func (s *Store) deleteUnlocked(id string) error {
394		err := os.Remove(s.path(id))
395		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
396			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
397		}
398		return err
399	}
400	
401	// revisionFor hashes the task ID, a NUL domain separator, and the exact bytes
402	// persisted in the task file. A byte-for-byte rewrite keeps the revision;
403	// any byte or filename-ID change produces a different optimistic token.
404	func revisionFor(id string, data []byte) string {
405		payload := make([]byte, 0, len(id)+1+len(data))
406		payload = append(payload, id...)
407		payload = append(payload, 0)
408		payload = append(payload, data...)
409		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(payload))
410	}
411	
412	func cloneTask(t Task) Task {
413		t.Tags = append([]string(nil), t.Tags...)
414		return t
415	}

48	// ReadinessState classifies one intent without changing its durable record.
49	type ReadinessState string
50	
51	const (
52		ReadinessPending              ReadinessState = "pending"
53		ReadinessFailed               ReadinessState = "failed"
54		ReadinessDiscarded            ReadinessState = "discarded"
55		ReadinessFinalizedReachable   ReadinessState = "finalized-reachable"
56		ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable ReadinessState = "finalized-unreachable"
57		ReadinessObservationError     ReadinessState = "observation-error"
58	)

60	// IntentReadiness is the read-only finalization evidence for one intent whose
61	// recorded worktree is the exact checkout being inspected.
62	type IntentReadiness struct {
63		Intent           Intent
64		State            ReadinessState
65		Finalized        bool
66		ReceiptReachable bool
67		ObservationError error
68	}
69	
70	// ReadinessInspection is a complete read-only observation for one exact
71	// checkout. KnownEmpty is true only when the store was read successfully and no
72	// intent matched the checkout; it distinguishes absence from failed observation.
73	type ReadinessInspection struct {
74		Checkout         string
75		KnownEmpty       bool
76		Intents          []IntentReadiness
77		ObservationError error
78	}
79	
80	// Ready applies only the existing artifact finalization contract: an exact
81	// checkout is ready when it has no intents, or every intent was explicitly
82	// discarded or has a finalized receipt that is still reachable. Missing or
83	// incomplete evidence fails closed.
84	func (i ReadinessInspection) Ready() bool {
85		if i.ObservationError != nil {
86			return false
87		}
88		if len(i.Intents) == 0 {
89			return i.KnownEmpty
90		}
91		if i.KnownEmpty {
92			return false
93		}
94		for _, intent := range i.Intents {
95			if intent.ObservationError != nil {
96				return false
97			}
98			switch intent.State {
99			case ReadinessDiscarded:
100				// Discard is the existing explicit operator escape hatch.
101			case ReadinessFinalizedReachable:
102				if !intent.Finalized || !intent.ReceiptReachable {
103					return false
104				}
105			default:
106				return false
107			}
108		}
109		return true
110	}
111	
112	// InspectReadiness gathers artifact finalization evidence for one exact
113	// checkout. It never reconciles receipts, finalizes intents, or writes either
114	// source files or intent records. The returned inspection retains partial
115	// evidence and the same wrapped error returned separately to ordinary callers.
116	func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
117		inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
118		if ctx == nil {
119			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")
120			inspection.ObservationError = err
121			return inspection, err
122		}
123		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
124			inspection.ObservationError = err
125			return inspection, err
126		}
127		if store == nil {
128			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a store")
129			inspection.ObservationError = err
130			return inspection, err
131		}
132	
133		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
134		if err != nil {
135			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
136			inspection.ObservationError = err
137			return inspection, err
138		}
139		inspection.Checkout = canonical
140	
141		intents, err := store.List()
142		if err != nil {
143			err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
144			inspection.ObservationError = err
145			return inspection, err
146		}
147		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
148			inspection.ObservationError = err
149			return inspection, err
150		}
151	
152		for _, intent := range intents {
153			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
154				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
155				break
156			}
157			intentCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
158			if err != nil {
159				err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, err)
160				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
161				continue
162			}
163			if intentCheckout != canonical {
164				continue
165			}
166	
167			evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
168			switch intent.Status {
169			case Armed, Finalizing:
170				evidence.State = ReadinessPending
171			case Failed:
172				evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
173			case Discarded:
174				evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
175			case Finalized:
176				evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, canonical, intent)
177				switch {
178				case err != nil:
179					err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
180					evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
181					evidence.ObservationError = err
182					inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
183				case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
184					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
185				default:
186					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
187				}
188			default:
189				// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
190				// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
191				err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
192				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
193				evidence.ObservationError = err
194				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
195			}
196			inspection.Intents = append(inspection.Intents, evidence)
197		}
198	
199		inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
200		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
201	}

203	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
204		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
205			return false, nil
206		}
207		candidates := []struct {
208			dir string
209			ref string
210		}{
211			{checkout, "HEAD"},
212			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
213			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
214		}
215		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
216		var observationErr error
217		for _, candidate := range candidates {
218			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
219				continue
220			}
221			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
222			if seen[key] {
223				continue
224			}
225			seen[key] = true
226			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
227				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
228			}
229			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
230				return true, nil
231			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
232				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
233					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
234			}
235		}
236		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
237			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
238		}
239		return false, observationErr
240	}
241	
242	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
243		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
244		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
245	}
246	
247	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
248		if current == nil {
249			return next
250		}
251		if next == nil {
252			return current
253		}
254		return errors.Join(current, next)
255	}

257	func (s *Service) Prepare(ctx context.Context, request PrepareRequest) (*Intent, error) {
258		if s.Store == nil {
259			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
260		}
261		provider, sessionID, err := ParseSession(request.Session)
262		if err != nil {
263			return nil, err
264		}
265		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, request.Worktree)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, err
268		}
269		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
270		if err != nil {
271			return nil, err
272		}
273		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
274			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires a named branch")
275		}
276		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
277			return nil, err
278		} else if active {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation refuses Git operation %s in progress", operation)
280		}
281		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
282		if err != nil {
283			return nil, err
284		}
285		changes, err := statusPaths(ctx, repository.Root)
286		if err != nil {
287			return nil, err
288		}
289		var unrelated []string
290		for _, change := range changes {
291			if change.Staged {
292				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires an empty index; staged path: %s", change.Path)
293			}
294			if !isRecognizedArtifact(change.Path) {
295				return nil, fmt.Errorf("commit product changes before prepare; dirty path: %s", change.Path)
296			}
297			unrelated = append(unrelated, change.Path)
298		}
299		transcript, err := FindTranscript(repository.Root, provider, sessionID)
300		if err != nil {
301			return nil, err
302		}
303		tracked, err := gitTracked(ctx, repository.Root, transcript.Path)
304		if err != nil {
305			return nil, err
306		}
307		info, err := os.Stat(transcript.Path)
308		if err != nil {
309			return nil, err
310		}
311		limit := s.LargeLimit
312		if limit <= 0 {
313			limit = DefaultLargeLimit
314		}
315		if !tracked && info.Size() > limit && !request.AllowLarge {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("untracked transcript is %d bytes; re-run with --allow-large after reviewing repository growth", info.Size())
317		}
318		plans, err := normalizePlans(repository.Root, request.Plans)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		runID := request.RunID
323		if runID == "" {
324			runID = os.Getenv("DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID")
325		}
326		if runID == "" {
327			runID = fmt.Sprintf("run-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
328		}
329		selected := make(map[string]bool, len(plans)+1)
330		relTranscript, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, transcript.Path)
331		selected[filepath.ToSlash(relTranscript)] = true
332		for _, plan := range plans {
333			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, plan)
334			selected[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
335		}
336		filtered := unrelated[:0]
337		for _, path := range unrelated {
338			if !selected[path] {
339				filtered = append(filtered, path)
340			}
341		}
342		intent := &Intent{
343			RunID: runID, Provider: provider, SessionID: sessionID, TaskID: request.TaskID,
344			RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, GitCommonDir: repository.GitCommonDir,
345			WorktreePath: repository.Root, Branch: status.Branch, Base: request.Base,
346			Head: head, PlanPaths: plans, UnrelatedArtifacts: filtered, AllowLarge: request.AllowLarge,
347		}
348		if err := s.Store.Create(ctx, intent); err != nil {
349			return nil, err
350		}
351		return intent, nil
352	}

354	func (s *Service) ObserveSessionEnd(ctx context.Context, runID string, when time.Time) error {
355		intent, err := s.Store.FindByRunID(runID)
356		if err != nil {
357			return nil // SessionEnd without an armed intent is deliberately a no-op.
358		}
359		if when.IsZero() {
360			when = time.Now()
361		}
362		return s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
363			candidate.SessionEndedAt = when.UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
364			return nil
365		})
366	}

368	func (s *Service) Finalize(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
369		if s.Store == nil {
370			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
371		}
372		intent, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
373		if err != nil {
374			return nil, err
375		}
376		lockDir := filepath.Join(intent.GitCommonDir, "dev-artifact-finalize")
377		var finalized *Intent
378		err = catalog.NewStore(lockDir).WithLock(ctx, func() error {
379			current, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
380			if err != nil {
381				return err
382			}
383			finalized, err = s.finalizeLocked(ctx, request, current)
384			return err
385		})
386		return finalized, err
387	}
388	
389	func (s *Service) finalizeLocked(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest, intent *Intent) (*Intent, error) {
390		if intent.Status == Finalized {
391			if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok && commit != intent.ArtifactCommit {
392				if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
393					return nil, err
394				}
395				return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
396			}
397			return intent, nil
398		}
399		if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok {
400			if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
401				return nil, err
402			}
403			return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
404		}
405		if s.ScanStaged == nil {
406			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scanner-missing", fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization requires a staged secret scanner"))
407		}
408		if err := s.revalidate(ctx, intent); err != nil {
409			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "git-drift", err)
410		}
411		if intent.SessionEndedAt.IsZero() && !request.WriterStopped {
412			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-unproven",
413				fmt.Errorf("finalization requires SessionEnd observation or explicit post-writer proof"))
414		}
415		transcript, err := FindTranscript(intent.WorktreePath, intent.Provider, intent.SessionID)
416		if err != nil {
417			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "transcript-missing", err)
418		}
419		if err := s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
420			candidate.Status = Finalizing
421			candidate.TranscriptPath = transcript.Path
422			candidate.FailureCode = ""
423			return nil
424		}); err != nil {
425			return nil, err
426		}
427		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
428			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
429		}
430		paths := append([]string{transcript.Path}, intent.PlanPaths...)
431		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, nil); err != nil {
432			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-not-empty", err)
433		}
434		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"add", "--"}, paths...)...); err != nil {
435			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "stage-failed", err)
436		}
437		cleanup := func() {
438			_, _ = gitx.Run(context.Background(), intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"reset", "--"}, paths...)...)
439		}
440		if err := s.ScanStaged(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
441			cleanup()
442			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scan-failed", err)
443		}
444		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
445			cleanup()
446			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
447		}
448		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
449			cleanup()
450			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
451		}
452		if err := stagedFilesMatch(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
453			cleanup()
454			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
455		}
456		message := fmt.Sprintf("chore: finalize %s agent session", intent.Provider)
457		trailers := fmt.Sprintf("Agent-Artifact-Session: %s:%s\nDev-Artifact-Intent: %s", intent.Provider, intent.SessionID, intent.ID)
458		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "commit", "-m", message, "-m", trailers); err != nil {
459			cleanup()
460			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "commit-failed", err)
461		}
462		commit, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
463		if err != nil {
464			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "receipt-failed", err)
465		}
466		if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, transcript.Path, commit); err != nil {
467			return nil, err
468		}
469		return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
470	}
