472	func (s *Service) resolveIntent(request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
473		if request.IntentID != "" {
474			return s.Store.Get(request.IntentID)
475		}
476		if request.RunID != "" {
477			return s.Store.FindByRunID(request.RunID)
478		}
479		return nil, fmt.Errorf("finalize requires an intent or run id")
480	}
481	
482	func (s *Service) revalidate(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
483		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
484		if err != nil {
485			return err
486		}
487		if repository.GitCommonDir != intent.GitCommonDir {
488			return fmt.Errorf("Git common-dir changed")
489		}
490		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
491		if err != nil {
492			return err
493		}
494		if status.Branch != intent.Branch || status.Detached {
495			return fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
496		}
497		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(intent.WorktreePath); err != nil {
498			return err
499		} else if active {
500			return fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
501		}
502		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
503		if err != nil {
504			return err
505		}
506		if head != intent.Head {
507			return fmt.Errorf("HEAD changed from %s to %s", intent.Head, head)
508		}
509		return nil
510	}
511	
512	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, id, code string, cause error) error {
513		_ = s.Store.Update(ctx, id, func(intent *Intent) error {
514			intent.Status = Failed
515			intent.FailureCode = code
516			return nil
517		})
518		return fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization %s: %w", code, cause)
519	}
520	
521	func (s *Service) markFinalized(ctx context.Context, id, transcript, commit string) error {
522		return s.Store.Update(ctx, id, func(intent *Intent) error {
523			intent.Status = Finalized
524			intent.TranscriptPath = transcript
525			intent.ArtifactCommit = commit
526			intent.FailureCode = ""
527			return nil
528		})
529	}
530	
531	type statusPath struct {
532		Path   string
533		Staged bool
534	}
535	
536	func statusPaths(ctx context.Context, repo string) ([]statusPath, error) {
537		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
538		if err != nil {
539			return nil, err
540		}
541		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
542		var paths []statusPath
543		for i := 0; i < len(fields); i++ {
544			entry := fields[i]
545			if len(entry) < 4 {
546				continue
547			}
548			code, path := entry[:2], filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:])
549			paths = append(paths, statusPath{Path: path, Staged: code[0] != ' ' && code[0] != '?'})
550			if code[0] == 'R' || code[0] == 'C' {
551				i++ // porcelain -z emits the source path as the next field.
552			}
553		}
554		return paths, nil
555	}
556	
557	func isRecognizedArtifact(path string) bool {
558		path = filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(path, "./"))
559		for _, prefix := range []string{
560			".specstory/history/", ".claude/plans/", ".cursor/plans/", ".cursor/rules/",
561			".opencode/plans/", ".specify/", ".codex/",
562		} {
563			if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
564				return true
565			}
566		}
567		return path == ".specstory/statistics.json"
568	}
569	
570	func normalizePlans(root string, paths []string) ([]string, error) {
571		var out []string
572		for _, path := range paths {
573			if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
574				path = filepath.Join(root, path)
575			}
576			inside, err := pathx.Contains(filepath.Join(root, ".claude", "plans"), path)
577			if err != nil || !inside {
578				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is outside .claude/plans", path)
579			}
580			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
581			if err != nil {
582				return nil, err
583			}
584			info, err := os.Stat(canonical)
585			if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
586				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is not a regular file", path)
587			}
588			out = append(out, canonical)
589		}
590		sort.Strings(out)
591		return out, nil
592	}
593	
594	func gitTracked(ctx context.Context, repo, path string) (bool, error) {
595		rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
596		if err != nil {
597			return false, err
598		}
599		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", "--", rel)
600		if err == nil {
601			return true, nil
602		}
603		var gitErr *gitx.Error
604		if errors.As(err, &gitErr) {
605			return false, nil
606		}
607		return false, err
608	}
609	
610	func ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx context.Context, repo string, allowed []string) error {
611		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z")
612		if err != nil {
613			return err
614		}
615		allow := make(map[string]bool, len(allowed))
616		for _, path := range allowed {
617			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
618			allow[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
619		}
620		for _, path := range strings.Split(out, "\x00") {
621			if path != "" && !allow[filepath.ToSlash(path)] {
622				return fmt.Errorf("index contains unrelated path %s", path)
623			}
624		}
625		return nil
626	}
627	
628	func stagedFilesMatch(ctx context.Context, repo string, paths []string) error {
629		for _, path := range paths {
630			rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
631			if err != nil {
632				return err
633			}
634			workingBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "hash-object", "--", rel)
635			if err != nil {
636				return err
637			}
638			stagedBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "rev-parse", ":"+filepath.ToSlash(rel))
639			if err != nil {
640				return err
641			}
642			if workingBlob != stagedBlob {
643				return fmt.Errorf("staged artifact %s no longer matches scanned working bytes", filepath.ToSlash(rel))
644			}
645		}
646		return nil
647	}
648	
649	func findReceipt(ctx context.Context, repo, intentID string) (string, bool) {
650		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "log", "-n", "100", "--format=%H%x00%B%x00")
651		if err != nil {
652			return "", false
653		}
654		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
655		for i := 0; i+1 < len(fields); i += 2 {
656			if strings.Contains(fields[i+1], "Dev-Artifact-Intent: "+intentID) {
657				return fields[i], true
658			}
659		}
660		return "", false
661	}
662

135	// New constructs either an asynchronous repository picker (preselected=nil) or
136	// an asynchronous preselected-repository view. No callback runs until Init's
137	// command is executed, so View can return the initial frame immediately.
138	func New(actions Actions, preselected *RepositoryRow) Model {
139		filter := textinput.New()
140		filter.CharLimit = 240
141		filter.Placeholder = "repository filter"
142		confirm := textinput.New()
143		confirm.CharLimit = 300
144		confirm.Placeholder = "exact confirmation token"
145	
146		model := Model{
147			actions:        actions,
148			firstViewReady: make(chan struct{}),
149			firstViewOnce:  &sync.Once{},
150			width:          120, height: 34,
151			filter: filter, confirm: confirm,
152			focus: FocusSurfaces,
153		}
154		if preselected == nil {
155			model.screen = screenPicker
156			model.listRequest = requestState{generation: 1, repoKey: pickerRequestKey, loading: true}
157			return model
158		}
159		model.screen = screenRepository
160		model.repository = *preselected
161		model.desiredFocus = preselected.FocusTarget
162		model.loadRequest = requestState{generation: 1, repoKey: preselected.RepoKey, loading: true}
163		return model
164	}
165	
166	// NewPicker constructs a model which discovers repositories asynchronously.
167	func NewPicker(actions Actions) Model { return New(actions, nil) }
168	
169	// NewRepository constructs a model focused on one exact repository key.
170	func NewRepository(actions Actions, repository RepositoryRow) Model {
171		return New(actions, &repository)
172	}
173	
174	// WithContext bounds cancelable list/load/plan callbacks to one TUI run. Apply
175	// deliberately uses a cancellation-detached child so queued quit cannot abort a
176	// mutation whose result ledger must be retained.
177	func (m Model) WithContext(ctx context.Context) Model {
178		m.runContext = ctx
179		return m
180	}
181	
182	func (m Model) baseContext() context.Context {
183		if m.runContext != nil {
184			return m.runContext
185		}
186		return context.Background()
187	}
188	
189	// Init implements tea.Model without doing synchronous repository work.
190	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
191		var commands []tea.Cmd
192		switch m.screen {
193		case screenRepository:
194			if m.loadRequest.loading {
195				commands = append(commands, m.loadRepositoryCmd(m.loadRequest.generation, m.loadRequest.repoKey, m.baseContext()))
196			}
197		case screenPicker:
198			if m.listRequest.loading {
199				commands = append(commands, m.listRepositoriesCmd(m.listRequest.generation, m.baseContext()))
200			}
201		}
202		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
203			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
204		}
205		switch len(commands) {
206		case 0:
207			return nil
208		case 1:
209			return commands[0]
210		default:
211			return tea.Batch(commands...)
212		}
213	}
214	
215	func (m Model) signalFirstView() {
216		if m.firstViewOnce != nil && m.firstViewReady != nil {
217			m.firstViewOnce.Do(func() { close(m.firstViewReady) })
218		}
219	}
220	
221	func (m Model) runAfterFirstView() tea.Cmd {
222		return func() tea.Msg {
223			select {
224			case <-m.baseContext().Done():
225				return nil
226			case <-m.firstViewReady:
227				m.actions.AfterFirstView(m.baseContext())
228				return nil
229			}
230		}
231	}

234	// plans, and exit status alone can never populate it.

236

240	}

246	// reloads for the current repository.

275	// Update implements tea.Model.
276	func (m Model) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
277		switch message := message.(type) {
278		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
279			m.width, m.height = message.Width, message.Height
280			return m, nil
281		case repositoryListMsg:
282			return m.acceptRepositoryList(message)
283		case repositoryLoadMsg:
284			return m.acceptRepositoryLoad(message)
285		case planMsg:
286			return m.acceptPlan(message)
287		case applyMsg:
288			return m.acceptApply(message)
289		case tea.KeyMsg:
290			if m.applyRunning {
291				return m.updateApplying(message)
292			}
293			if m.filterActive {
294				return m.updateFilter(message)
295			}
296			if m.overlay != overlayNone {
297				return m.updateOverlay(message)
298			}
299			if m.screen == screenPicker {
300				return m.updatePicker(message)
301			}
302			return m.updateRepository(message)
303		}
304		return m, nil
305	}
306	
307	func (m Model) updatePicker(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
308		switch message.String() {
309		case "q", "ctrl+c":
310			return m.quit()
311		case "esc":
312			if m.filter.Value() != "" {
313				m.filter.SetValue("")
314				m.repoCursor = 0
315				return m, nil
316			}
317			return m.quit()
318		case "j", "down":
319			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor + 1)
320		case "k", "up":
321			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor - 1)
322		case "/":
323			m.filterActive = true
324			m.filter.CursorEnd()
325			return m, m.filter.Focus()
326		case "?":
327			m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
328			m.overlay = overlayHelp
329			return m, nil
330		case "r":
331			return m.beginRepositoryList()
332		case "enter":
333			row, ok := m.currentRepository()
334			if !ok {
335				return m, nil
336			}
337			return m.selectRepository(row)
338		}
339		return m, nil
340	}
341	
342	func (m Model) updateFilter(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
343		switch message.String() {
344		case "ctrl+c":
345			return m.quit()
346		case "esc":
347			m.filterActive = false
348			m.filter.Blur()
349			m.filter.SetValue("")
350			m.repoCursor = 0
351			return m, nil
352		case "enter":
353			m.filterActive = false
354			m.filter.Blur()
355			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor)
356			return m, nil
357		}
358		var command tea.Cmd
359		m.filter, command = m.filter.Update(message)
360		m.repoCursor = 0
361		return m, command
362	}
363	
364	func (m Model) updateRepository(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
365		switch message.String() {
366		case "q", "ctrl+c":
367			return m.quit()
368		case "esc":
369			m.cancelRepositoryRead()
370			m.screen = screenPicker
371			m.overlay = overlayNone
372			return m.beginRepositoryList()
373		case "j", "down":
374			m.setRowCursor(m.rowCursor + 1)
375		case "k", "up":
376			m.setRowCursor(m.rowCursor - 1)
377		case "l", "right":
378			m.moveAction(1)
379		case "h", "left":
380			m.moveAction(-1)
381		case "tab":
382			m.focus = FocusPane((int(m.focus) + 1) % 3)
383		case "shift+tab":
384			m.focus = FocusPane((int(m.focus) + 2) % 3)
385		case "?":
386			m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
387			m.overlay = overlayHelp
388		case "r":
389			return m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
390		case "R":
391			return m.openRemoteMenu()
392		case "enter":
393			choice, ok := m.currentAction()
394			if !ok {
395				return m, nil
396			}
397			return m.beginPlan(choice)
398		}
399		return m, nil
400	}
401	
402	func (m Model) updateApplying(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
403		switch message.String() {
404		case "q", "ctrl+c":
405			m.queuedQuit = true
406			m.status = "quit queued; waiting for Apply to finish"
407		case "r", "R":
408			m.queuedRefresh = true
409			m.status = "refresh queued; waiting for Apply to finish"
410		default:
411			m.status = "Apply is running; navigation is disabled"
412		}
413		return m, nil
414	}
415	
416	func (m Model) quit() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
417		m.quitting = true
418		if m.listRequest.cancel != nil {
419			m.listRequest.cancel()
420		}
421		if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
422			m.loadRequest.cancel()
423		}
424		if m.planRequest.cancel != nil {
425			m.planRequest.cancel()
426		}
427		return m, tea.Quit
428	}
429	
430	func (m Model) filteredRepositories() []RepositoryRow {
431		query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m.filter.Value()))
432		terms := strings.Fields(query)
433		out := make([]RepositoryRow, 0, len(m.repositories))
434		for _, row := range m.repositories {
435			haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{row.RepoKey, row.Name, row.Path, row.Error}, " "))
436			matched := true
437			for _, term := range terms {
438				if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
439					matched = false
440					break
441				}
442			}
443			if matched {
444				out = append(out, row)
445			}
446		}
447		return out
448	}
449	
450	func (m Model) currentRepository() (RepositoryRow, bool) {
451		rows := m.filteredRepositories()
452		if m.repoCursor < 0 || m.repoCursor >= len(rows) {
453			return RepositoryRow{}, false
454		}
455		return rows[m.repoCursor], true
456	}
457	
458	func (m *Model) setRepoCursor(index int) {
459		count := len(m.filteredRepositories())
460		switch {
461		case count == 0:
462			index = 0
463		case index < 0:
464			index = 0
465		case index >= count:
466			index = count - 1
467		}
468		m.repoCursor = index
469	}
470	
471	func (m Model) currentSurface() (SurfaceRow, bool) {
472		if !m.hasSnapshot {
473			return SurfaceRow{}, false
474		}
475		rows := m.snapshot.Surfaces.Values()
476		if m.rowCursor < 0 || m.rowCursor >= len(rows) {
477			return SurfaceRow{}, false
478		}
479		return rows[m.rowCursor], true
480	}
481	
482	func (m Model) currentAction() (ActionChoice, bool) {
483		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
484		if !ok {
485			return ActionChoice{}, false
486		}
487		actions := row.Actions.Values()
488		if m.actionCursor < 0 || m.actionCursor >= len(actions) {
489			return ActionChoice{}, false
490		}
491		if !actions[m.actionCursor].Valid() {
492			return ActionChoice{}, false
493		}
494		return actions[m.actionCursor], true
495	}
496	
497	func (m *Model) setRowCursor(index int) {
498		count := 0
499		if m.hasSnapshot {
500			count = m.snapshot.Surfaces.Len()
501		}
502		switch {
503		case count == 0:
504			index = 0
505		case index < 0:
506			index = 0
507		case index >= count:
508			index = count - 1
509		}
510		if index != m.rowCursor {
511			m.rowCursor = index
512			m.actionCursor = 0
513		} else {
514			m.rowCursor = index
515		}
516		m.clampActionCursor()
517	}
518	
519	func (m *Model) clampActionCursor() {
520		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
521		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
522			m.actionCursor = 0
523			return
524		}
525		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
526			m.actionCursor = 0
527		}
528		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
529			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
530		}
531	}
532	
533	func (m *Model) moveAction(delta int) {
534		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
535		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
536			m.actionCursor = 0
537			return
538		}
539		m.actionCursor += delta
540		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
541			m.actionCursor = 0
542		}
543		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
544			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
545		}
546		m.focus = FocusActions
547	}
548	
549	func (m Model) selectRepository(row RepositoryRow) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
550		m.cancelRepositoryListRead()
551		m.screen = screenRepository
552		m.repository = row
553		m.desiredFocus = row.FocusTarget
554		m.hasSnapshot = false
555		m.snapshot = Snapshot{}
556		m.remote = OptionalRemoteObservation{}
557		m.rowCursor, m.actionCursor = 0, 0
558		m.overlay = overlayNone
559		m.hasPlan, m.planErr = false, nil
560		m.hasLastResult, m.lastResultErr = false, nil
561		m.hasHandoff = false
562		return m.beginRepositoryLoad(true)
563	}
564	
565	func combineError(label string, err error) error {
566		if err == nil {
567			return nil
568		}
569		if label == "" {
570			return err
571		}
572		return errors.New(label + ": " + err.Error())
573	}

181		m.plan, m.hasPlan, m.planErr = taskflow.Plan{}, false, nil
182		m.confirm.SetValue("")
183		m.confirm.Blur()
184		m.overlay = overlayPlanLoading
185		m.status = "planning " + choice.Label
186		return m, m.planCmd(m.planRequest.generation, m.planTarget, ctx)
187	}

189	func (m *Model) cancelRepositoryRead() {
190		if !m.loadRequest.loading {
191			return
192		}

194			m.loadRequest.cancel()
195		}
196		m.loadRequest.generation++
197		m.loadRequest.loading = false
198		m.loadRequest.cancel = nil

212		m.listRequest.err = nil

225	func (m Model) acceptRepositoryList(message repositoryListMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
226		if message.generation != m.listRequest.generation ||
227			message.repoKey != pickerRequestKey || m.listRequest.repoKey != pickerRequestKey {
228			return m, nil
229		}
230		if m.listRequest.cancel != nil {
231			m.listRequest.cancel()
232		}
233		m.listRequest.cancel = nil
234		m.listRequest.loading = false
235		m.listRequest.err = message.err
236	
237		selectedKey := ""
238		if selected, ok := m.currentRepository(); ok {
239			selectedKey = selected.RepoKey
240		}
241		oldIndex := m.repoCursor
242		if message.err != nil {
243			m.listRequest.stale = len(m.repositories) > 0
244			m.status = ""
245			return m, nil
246		}
247	
248		m.repositories = append([]RepositoryRow(nil), message.rows...)
249		m.listRequest.stale = false
250		m.status = ""
251		m.repoCursor = nearestRepositoryIndex(m.filteredRepositories(), selectedKey, oldIndex)
252		return m, nil
253	}
254	
255	func nearestRepositoryIndex(rows []RepositoryRow, repoKey string, oldIndex int) int {
256		if repoKey != "" {
257			for index, row := range rows {
258				if row.RepoKey == repoKey {
259					return index
260				}
261			}
262		}
263		if len(rows) == 0 {
264			return 0
265		}
266		if oldIndex < 0 {
267			return 0
268		}
269		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
270			return len(rows) - 1
271		}
272		return oldIndex
273	}
274	
275	func (m Model) acceptRepositoryLoad(message repositoryLoadMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
276		if message.generation != m.loadRequest.generation ||
277			message.repoKey != m.loadRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.repository.RepoKey {
278			return m, nil
279		}
280		if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
281			m.loadRequest.cancel()
282		}
283		m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
284		m.loadRequest.loading = false
285	
286		if message.err == nil && message.snapshot.Repository.RepoKey != message.repoKey {
287			message.err = fmt.Errorf(
288				"loaded snapshot repository key %q does not match requested key %q",
289				message.snapshot.Repository.RepoKey, message.repoKey,
290			)
291		}
292		if message.err != nil {
293			m.loadRequest.err = message.err
294			m.loadRequest.stale = m.hasSnapshot
295			if m.hasSnapshot {
296				m.snapshot.Freshness = FreshnessStale
297			}
298			m.status = ""
299			return m, nil
300		}
301	
302		oldRow, hadOldRow := m.currentSurface()
303		oldIndex := m.rowCursor
304		oldActionID := ""
305		if choice, ok := m.currentAction(); ok {
306			oldActionID = choice.ID
307		}
308	
309		accepted := message.snapshot.Clone()
310		if accepted.Freshness == "" {
311			accepted.Freshness = FreshnessFresh
312		}
313		m.snapshot = accepted
314		m.hasSnapshot = true
315		m.loadRequest.err = nil
316		m.loadRequest.stale = accepted.Freshness != FreshnessFresh || accepted.Error != ""
317		m.repository = accepted.Repository
318		if remote, ok := accepted.Remote.RemoteObservation(); ok {
319			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
320		}
321	
322		rows := accepted.Surfaces.Values()
323		m.rowCursor = retainedSurfaceIndex(rows, oldRow, hadOldRow, oldIndex, m.desiredFocus)
324		m.desiredFocus = ""
325		m.actionCursor = retainedActionIndex(rows, m.rowCursor, oldActionID)
326		m.clampActionCursor()
327		m.status = ""
328		return m, nil
329	}
330	
331	func retainedSurfaceIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, previous SurfaceRow, hadPrevious bool, oldIndex int, focus string) int {
332		if len(rows) == 0 {
333			return 0
334		}
335		if hadPrevious {
336			for index, row := range rows {
337				if row.RowKey == previous.RowKey {
338					return index
339				}
340			}
341			if previous.Locator.TaskID != "" {
342				for index, row := range rows {
343					if row.Locator.TaskID == previous.Locator.TaskID {
344						return index
345					}
346				}
347			}
348			for index, row := range rows {
349				if locatorsReferToSameSurface(previous.Locator, row.Locator) {
350					return index
351				}
352			}
353		}
354		if focus != "" {
355			for index, row := range rows {
356				if row.RowKey == focus || row.Locator.RowKey == focus {
357					return index
358				}
359			}
360			for index, row := range rows {
361				if row.Locator.TaskID == focus {
362					return index
363				}
364			}
365			for index, row := range rows {
366				if row.Locator.CheckoutPath == focus {
367					return index
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		if oldIndex < 0 {
372			return 0
373		}
374		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
375			return len(rows) - 1
376		}
377		return oldIndex
378	}
379	
380	func retainedActionIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, rowIndex int, actionID string) int {
381		if actionID == "" || rowIndex < 0 || rowIndex >= len(rows) {
382			return 0
383		}
384		for index, action := range rows[rowIndex].Actions.Values() {
385			if action.ID == actionID {
386				return index
387			}
388		}
389		return 0
390	}
391	
392	func locatorsReferToSameSurface(left, right taskflow.Locator) bool {
393		if left.RepositoryID != "" && right.RepositoryID != "" && left.RepositoryID != right.RepositoryID {
394			return false
395		}
396		if left.CheckoutPath != "" && right.CheckoutPath != "" {
397			return left.CheckoutPath == right.CheckoutPath
398		}
399		if left.TaskID != "" && right.TaskID != "" {
400			return left.TaskID == right.TaskID
401		}
402		return left.RepoKey != "" && left.RepoKey == right.RepoKey &&
403			left.Branch != "" && left.Branch == right.Branch && left.Base == right.Base
404	}
405	
406	func (m Model) acceptPlan(message planMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
407		if message.generation != m.planRequest.generation ||
408			message.repoKey != m.planRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey ||
409			message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey || message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
410			return m, nil
411		}
412		if m.planRequest.cancel != nil {
413			m.planRequest.cancel()
414		}
415		m.planRequest.cancel = nil
416		m.planRequest.loading = false
417		m.planRequest.err = message.err
418		m.overlay = overlayPlan
419		m.status = ""
420	
421		if message.plan.PlanID != "" {
422			m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
423			m.hasPlan = true
424		}
425		if message.err != nil {
426			m.planErr = message.err
427			return m, nil
428		}
429		if err := message.plan.Validate(); err != nil {
430			m.planErr = combineError("invalid plan returned by callback", err)
431			return m, nil
432		}
433		if message.plan.Locator != m.planTarget.locator {
434			m.planErr = errors.New("plan locator does not match the exact selected surface")
435			return m, nil
436		}
437		if message.plan.Action != m.planTarget.choice.Action() {
438			m.planErr = errors.New("plan action does not match the exact selected action options")
439			return m, nil
440		}
441		expected, err := taskflow.NewRequest(m.planTarget.locator, m.planTarget.choice.Options())
442		if err != nil {
443			m.planErr = combineError("selected action options are invalid", err)
444			return m, nil
445		}
446		if !reflect.DeepEqual(message.plan.Request.Options, expected.Options) {
447			m.planErr = errors.New("plan was built with different concrete action options than the selected choice")
448			return m, nil
449		}
450		m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
451		m.hasPlan = true
452		m.planErr = nil
453		if m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady && m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
454			m.confirm.SetValue("")
455			m.confirm.CursorEnd()
456			return m, m.confirm.Focus()
457		}
458		return m, nil
459	}
460	
461	func (m Model) acceptApply(message applyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
462		if !m.applyRunning || message.generation != m.applyGeneration ||
463			message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey || message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey ||
464			message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
465			return m, nil
466		}
467		m.applyRunning = false
468		m.overlay = overlayResult
469		m.lastResult = message.result.Clone()
470		m.hasLastResult = true
471		m.lastResultErr = message.err
472		m.status = ""
473		if remote, ok := message.result.RemoteObservation(); ok {
474			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
475		}
476		if message.err == nil {
477			if handoff, ok := message.result.Handoff(); ok {
478				m.finalHandoff = handoff
479				m.hasHandoff = true
480			}
481		}
482	
483		queuedQuit := m.queuedQuit
484		m.queuedQuit, m.queuedRefresh = false, false
485		updated, command := m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
486		m = updated.(Model)
487		if queuedQuit {
488			// The fresh generation is established before honoring the queued quit. It
489			// cannot authorize anything and the mutation ledger remains in final Model.
490			if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
491				m.loadRequest.cancel()
492				m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
493			}
494			m.quitting = true
495			return m, tea.Quit
496		}
497		return m, command
498	}

10	func (m Model) openRemoteMenu() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
11		if m.loadRequest.loading {
12			m.status = "wait for the current local reload before planning remote work"
13			return m, nil
14		}
15		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
16		if !ok {
17			return m, nil
18		}
19		choices := make([]ActionChoice, 0, row.Actions.Len())
20		for _, choice := range row.Actions.Values() {
21			if choice.Valid() && choice.Action() == taskflow.RefreshRemote {
22				choices = append(choices, choice)
23			}
24		}
25		if len(choices) == 0 {
26			m.status = "no remote action choices are available for this surface"
27			return m, nil
28		}
29		m.remoteChoices = NewActionList(choices...)
30		m.remoteCursor = 0
31		m.overlay = overlayRemoteMenu
32		m.status = ""
33		return m, nil
34	}
35	
36	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
37		switch m.overlay {
38		case overlayHelp:
39			switch message.String() {
40			case "esc", "?":
41				m.overlay = m.overlayReturn
42				m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
43				return m, nil
44			case "q", "ctrl+c":
45				return m.quit()
46			}
47			return m, nil
48	
49		case overlayRemoteMenu:
50			switch message.String() {
51			case "q", "ctrl+c":
52				return m.quit()
53			case "esc", "R":
54				m.overlay = overlayNone
55				return m, nil
56			case "j", "down":
57				if m.remoteCursor+1 < m.remoteChoices.Len() {
58					m.remoteCursor++
59				}
60			case "k", "up":
61				if m.remoteCursor > 0 {
62					m.remoteCursor--
63				}
64			case "enter":
65				choices := m.remoteChoices.Values()
66				if m.remoteCursor >= 0 && m.remoteCursor < len(choices) {
67					return m.beginPlan(choices[m.remoteCursor])
68				}
69			}
70			return m, nil
71	
72		case overlayPlanLoading:
73			switch message.String() {
74			case "q", "ctrl+c":
75				m.cancelPlanRead()
76				return m.quit()
77			case "esc":
78				m.cancelPlanRead()
79				m.overlay = overlayNone
80				m.status = ""
81			}
82			return m, nil
83	
84		case overlayPlan:
85			if message.String() == "ctrl+c" {
86				return m.quit()
87			}
88			if message.String() == "esc" {
89				m.confirm.Blur()
90				m.overlay = overlayNone
91				m.status = ""
92				return m, nil
93			}
94			if !m.planCanApply() {
95				if message.String() == "q" {
96					return m.quit()
97				}
98				return m, nil
99			}
100			if m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
101				if message.String() == "enter" {
102					token := m.confirm.Value()
103					if token != m.plan.Confirmation.Token {
104						m.status = "confirmation token does not match exactly"
105						return m, nil
106					}
107					return m.startApply(taskflow.ApproveWithToken(m.plan.PlanID, token))
108				}
109				var command tea.Cmd
110				m.confirm, command = m.confirm.Update(message)
111				return m, command
112			}
113			switch message.String() {
114			case "q":
115				return m.quit()
116			case "y", "Y":
117				return m.startApply(taskflow.Approve(m.plan.PlanID))
118			}
119			return m, nil
120	
121		case overlayResult:
122			switch message.String() {
123			case "q", "ctrl+c":
124				return m.quit()
125			case "esc":
126				m.overlay = overlayNone
127				m.status = ""
128				return m, nil
129			case "r":
130				return m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
131			case "?":
132				m.overlayReturn = overlayResult
133				m.overlay = overlayHelp
134				return m, nil
135			}
136			return m, nil
137		}
138		return m, nil
139	}
140	
141	func (m Model) planCanApply() bool {
142		return m.hasPlan && m.planErr == nil && m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady
143	}
144	
145	func (m Model) startApply(approval taskflow.Approval) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
146		if !m.planCanApply() {
147			return m, nil
148		}
149		if err := m.plan.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
150			m.status = fmt.Sprintf("approval rejected: %v", err)
151			return m, nil
152		}
153		m.applyGeneration++
154		m.applyRunning = true
155		m.overlay = overlayApplying
156		m.status = "Apply in progress; quit and refresh will be queued"
157		m.hasHandoff = false
158		m.finalHandoff = taskflow.Handoff{}
159		m.hasLastResult = false
160		m.lastResult = taskflow.Result{}
161		m.lastResultErr = nil
162		return m, m.applyCmd(m.applyGeneration, m.planTarget, m.plan, approval)
163	}

167			builder.WriteString(renderNarrowPanel(panelTitle("SURFACES", m.focus == FocusSurfaces), left))
168			builder.WriteString("\n")
169			builder.WriteString(renderNarrowPanel(panelTitle("LIFECYCLE / EVIDENCE", m.focus == FocusLifecycle), middle))
170			builder.WriteString("\n")
171			builder.WriteString(renderNarrowPanel(panelTitle("ACTIONS / CONDITION", m.focus == FocusActions), right))
172		}
173		builder.WriteString("\n\n" + m.renderRepositoryFooter())
174		return builder.String()
175	}

177	func (m Model) localStatusLine() string {
178		label := "UNKNOWN"
179		if m.hasSnapshot {
180			label = strings.ToUpper(string(m.snapshot.Freshness))
181		}
182		if m.loadRequest.loading {
183			label = "REFRESHING"
184		}
185		authoritative := m.hasSnapshot && m.snapshot.Authoritative() && !m.loadRequest.loading
186		if !authoritative {
187			label += " | NON-AUTHORITATIVE"
188		}
189		if m.loadRequest.stale {
190			label += " | STALE"
191		}
192		if m.hasSnapshot && !m.snapshot.Repository.Available {
193			label += " | UNAVAILABLE"
194		}
195		return "LOCAL: " + label
196	}

199		if focused {
200			return title + " [FOCUS]"
201		}
202		return title
203	}

205	func (m Model) surfacePanelLines() []string {
206		rows := m.snapshot.Surfaces.Values()
207		if len(rows) == 0 {
208			return []string{"(valid empty snapshot)", "No checkout or task-only rows."}
209		}
210		lines := make([]string, 0, len(rows)*2)
211		for index, row := range rows {
212			marker := "  "
213			if index == m.rowCursor {
214				marker = "> "
215			}
216			badges := []string{"[" + strings.ToUpper(string(row.Kind)) + "]"}
217			if len(row.Drift.Values()) > 0 {
218				badges = append(badges, "[DRIFT]")
219			}
220			if len(row.Conflicts.Values()) > 0 || row.Kind == SurfaceConflict {
221				badges = append(badges, "[CONFLICT]")
222			}
223			label := row.Label
224			if label == "" {
225				label = row.Branch
226			}
227			if label == "" {
228				label = row.RowKey
229			}
230			line := marker + label + " " + strings.Join(badges, " ")
231			if index == m.rowCursor {
232				line = styleSelected.Render(line)
233			}
234			lines = append(lines, line)
235			if row.Path != "" {
236				lines = append(lines, "    "+row.Path)
237			} else if row.Locator.TaskID != "" {
238				lines = append(lines, "    task "+row.Locator.TaskID+" (no checkout)")
239			}
240		}
241		return lines
242	}
243	
244	func (m Model) lifecyclePanelLines() []string {
245		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
246		if !ok {
247			return []string{"No surface selected."}
248		}
249		lines := []string{"kind: " + strings.ToUpper(string(row.Kind))}
250		if row.Mode == "" || row.State == "" {
251			lines = append(lines, "recorded lifecycle: UNTRACKED")
252		} else {
253			lines = append(lines,
254				"mode: "+strings.ToUpper(string(row.Mode)),
255				"rail: "+lifecycleRail(row.Mode, row.State),
256				"current persisted state: "+strings.ToUpper(string(row.State)),
257			)
258		}
259		if row.Branch != "" {
260			lines = append(lines, "branch: "+row.Branch)
261		}
262		if row.Base != "" {
263			lines = append(lines, "base: "+row.Base)
264		}
265		for _, evidence := range row.Evidence.Values() {
266			lines = append(lines, "EVIDENCE: "+evidence)
267		}
268		for _, drift := range row.Drift.Values() {
269			lines = append(lines, "DRIFT: "+drift)
270		}
271		for _, conflict := range row.Conflicts.Values() {
272			lines = append(lines, "CONFLICT: "+conflict)
273		}
274		if remote, ok := m.remote.RemoteObservation(); ok {
275			lines = append(lines, remoteObservationLines(remote)...)
276		}
277		return lines
278	}
279	
280	func lifecycleRail(mode task.CheckoutMode, current task.State) string {
281		states := []task.State{task.Hot, task.Warm, task.Cold, task.Done}
282		if mode == task.ModeDirect {
283			states = []task.State{task.Hot, task.Warm, task.Done}
284		}
285		parts := make([]string, 0, len(states))
286		for _, state := range states {
287			label := strings.ToUpper(string(state))
288			if state == current {
289				label = "[" + label + " CURRENT]"
290			}
291			parts = append(parts, colourState(state, label))
292		}
293		return strings.Join(parts, " -> ")
294	}
295	
296	func colourState(state task.State, value string) string {
297		switch state {
298		case task.Hot:
299			return styleHot.Render(value)
300		case task.Warm:
301			return styleWarm.Render(value)
302		case task.Cold:
303			return styleCold.Render(value)
304		case task.Done:
305			return styleDone.Render(value)
306		default:
307			return value
308		}
309	}

311	func (m Model) actionPanelLines() []string {
312		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
313		if !ok {
314			return []string{"No surface selected."}
315		}
316		actions := row.Actions.Values()
317		if len(actions) == 0 {
318			return []string{"No guarded actions are available.", "This row is inspect-only."}
319		}
320		lines := make([]string, 0, len(actions)+4)
321		for index, choice := range actions {
322			marker := "  "
323			if index == m.actionCursor {
324				marker = "> "
325			}
326			label := choice.Label
327			if !choice.Valid() {
328				label += " [INVALID]"
329			}
330			line := marker + label
331			if index == m.actionCursor {
332				line = styleSelected.Render(line)
333			}
334			lines = append(lines, line)
335		}
336		if choice, ok := m.currentAction(); ok {
337			lines = append(lines, "", "selected: "+choice.Description)
338			lines = append(lines, "Enter: inspect a fresh plan; no immediate mutation.")
339			if choice.Action() == taskflow.RefreshRemote {
340				lines = append(lines, "network variant: "+remoteChoiceDescription(choice.Options()))
341			}
342		}
343		return lines
344	}
345	
346	func remoteChoiceDescription(options taskflow.ActionOptions) string {
347		remote, ok := options.(taskflow.RefreshRemoteOptions)
348		if !ok {
349			return "invalid remote options"
350		}
351		switch {
352		case remote.FetchRefs && remote.QueryReview:
353			return "FETCH REFS + QUERY REVIEW"
354		case remote.FetchRefs:
355			return "FETCH REFS"
356		case remote.QueryReview:
357			return "QUERY REVIEW"
358		default:
359			return "NO OPERATION SELECTED"
360		}
361	}

364		var lines []string
365		if m.status != "" {
366			lines = append(lines, "STATUS: "+m.status)
367		}
368		lines = append(lines,
369			"j/k or arrows row | h/l or arrows action | Tab focus | Enter plan",
370			"r local reload | R remote menu | Esc repositories | ? help | q quit",

374	
375	func renderWidePanels(leftTitle string, left []string, middleTitle string, middle []string, rightTitle string, right []string, width int) string {
376		gutter := " | "
377		usable := width - 2*lipgloss.Width(gutter)
378		if usable < 60 {
379			usable = 60
380		}
381		leftWidth := usable * 30 / 100
382		middleWidth := usable * 36 / 100
383		rightWidth := usable - leftWidth - middleWidth
384		left = append([]string{leftTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, leftWidth))}, left...)
385		middle = append([]string{middleTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, middleWidth))}, middle...)
386		right = append([]string{rightTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, rightWidth))}, right...)
387		count := max(len(left), len(middle), len(right))
388		var builder strings.Builder
389		for index := 0; index < count; index++ {
390			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(left, index), leftWidth))
391			builder.WriteString(gutter)
392			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(middle, index), middleWidth))
393			builder.WriteString(gutter)
394			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(right, index), rightWidth))
395			if index+1 < count {
396				builder.WriteByte('\n')
397			}
398		}
399		return builder.String()
400	}
401	
402	func renderNarrowPanel(title string, lines []string) string {
403		return title + "\n" + strings.Repeat("-", max(1, lipgloss.Width(title))) + "\n" + strings.Join(lines, "\n")
404	}
405	
406	func lineAt(lines []string, index int) string {
407		if index < 0 || index >= len(lines) {
408			return ""
409		}
410		return lines[index]
411	}
412	
413	func fitPanelLine(value string, width int) string {
414		value = truncateDisplay(value, width)
415		missing := width - lipgloss.Width(value)
416		if missing > 0 {
417			value += strings.Repeat(" ", missing)
418		}
419		return value
420	}
421	
422	func truncateDisplay(value string, width int) string {
423		if width <= 0 {
424			return ""
425		}
426		return ansi.Truncate(value, width, "…")
427	}

433			"MODEL",
434			"  HOT / WARM / COLD / DONE are the only persisted task states.",
435			"  READY is plan availability; REVIEW / MERGED / RETIRED are result milestones only.",

488	func (m Model) renderPlan(applying bool) string {
489		var builder strings.Builder
490		title := "dev flow  PLAN"
491		if applying {
492			title = "dev flow  APPLYING"
493		}
494		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render(title) + "\n\n")
495		builder.WriteString("repository: " + m.planTarget.repoKey + "\n")
496		builder.WriteString("row: " + m.planTarget.rowKey + "\n")
497		builder.WriteString("choice: " + m.planTarget.actionID + " — " + m.planTarget.choice.Label + "\n")
498		if m.planErr != nil {
499			builder.WriteString("\n" + styleBad.Render("PLAN ERROR: "+m.planErr.Error()) + "\n")
500		}
501		if !m.hasPlan {
502			builder.WriteString("\nNo valid plan is available. This error is inspectable and has no Apply path.\n")
503			builder.WriteString("\n" + styleMuted.Render("Esc back | q quit"))
504			return builder.String()
505		}
506	
507		builder.WriteString("plan ID: " + m.plan.PlanID + "\n")
508		builder.WriteString("availability: " + availabilityLabel(m.plan.Availability) + "\n")
509		if m.plan.Summary != "" {
510			builder.WriteString("summary: " + m.plan.Summary + "\n")
511		}
512		if m.plan.HasPersistedTransition {
513			target := strings.ToUpper(string(m.plan.Target))
514			if m.plan.RemovesTask {
515				target = "TASK REMOVED"
516			}
517			builder.WriteString("persisted transition: " + strings.ToUpper(string(m.plan.Source)) + " -> " + target)
518			if m.plan.StatePreserving {
519				builder.WriteString(" (state-preserving)")
520			}
521			builder.WriteString("\n")
522		}
523		if milestone := milestoneLabel(m.plan.ExpectedMilestone); milestone != "" {
524			builder.WriteString("expected result milestone: " + milestone + " (not a persisted state)\n")
525		}
526	
527		builder.WriteString("\nCONDITIONS (ordered)\n")
528		conditions := m.plan.Conditions()
529		if len(conditions) == 0 {
530			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
531		}
532		for index, condition := range conditions {
533			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. [%s] [%s] %s\n", index+1,
534				availabilityLabel(taskflow.Availability(condition.Verdict)), strings.ToUpper(string(condition.Requirement)), condition.Code))
535			evidence := condition.Evidence
536			if evidence == "" {
537				evidence = "(none recorded)"
538			}
539			builder.WriteString("     evidence: " + evidence + "\n")
540			remediation := condition.Remediation
541			if remediation == "" {
542				remediation = "(none required)"
543			}
544			builder.WriteString("     remediation: " + remediation + "\n")
545		}
546	
547		builder.WriteString("\nEFFECTS (execution order)\n")
548		effects := m.plan.Effects()
549		if len(effects) == 0 {
550			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
551		}
552		for index, effect := range effects {
553			markers := []string{}
554			if effect.Network {
555				markers = append(markers, "NETWORK")
556			}
557			if effect.Destructive {
558				markers = append(markers, "DESTRUCTIVE")
559			}
560			markerText := ""
561			if len(markers) > 0 {
562				markerText = " [" + strings.Join(markers, "] [") + "]"
563			}
564			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. %s%s — %s", index+1, effect.Code, markerText, effect.Description))
565			if effect.Target != "" {
566				builder.WriteString(" -> " + effect.Target)
567			}
568			builder.WriteString("\n")
569			for _, detail := range effect.Details.Entries() {
570				builder.WriteString("     " + detail.Key + ": " + detail.Value + "\n")
571			}
572		}
573	
574		builder.WriteString("\nRETAINED RESOURCES\n")
575		retained := m.plan.RetainedResources()
576		if len(retained) == 0 {
577			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
578		} else {
579			for _, resource := range retained {
580				builder.WriteString("  - " + resource + "\n")
581			}
582		}
583		builder.WriteString("fallback command: ")
584		if m.plan.FallbackCommand == "" {
585			builder.WriteString("(none supplied)\n")
586		} else {
587			builder.WriteString(m.plan.FallbackCommand + "\n")
588		}
589	
590		builder.WriteString("\n")
591		switch {
592		case applying:
593			builder.WriteString("APPLYING: conflicting navigation and refresh are disabled. q/r are queued.\n")
594		case !m.planCanApply():
595			builder.WriteString("NO APPLY PATH: only READY plans can be approved; this plan remains inspectable.\n")
596		case m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped:
597			prompt := m.plan.Confirmation.Prompt
598			if prompt == "" {
599				prompt = "Type the exact confirmation token"
600			}
601			builder.WriteString(prompt + "\n")
602			builder.WriteString("required exact token: " + m.plan.Confirmation.Token + "\n")
603			builder.WriteString("confirmation: " + m.confirm.View() + "\n")
604			builder.WriteString("Enter validates and applies; any mismatch remains non-mutating.\n")
605		default:
606			prompt := m.plan.Confirmation.Prompt
607			if prompt != "" {
608				builder.WriteString(prompt + "\n")
609			}
610			builder.WriteString("Press y to approve this exact PlanID. Enter never applies.\n")
611		}
612		if m.status != "" {
613			builder.WriteString("STATUS: " + m.status + "\n")
614		}
615		if !applying {
616			builder.WriteString(styleMuted.Render("Esc back | q quit"))
617		}
618		return builder.String()
619	}
620	
621	func availabilityLabel(value taskflow.Availability) string {
622		if value == "" {
623			return "UNKNOWN"
624		}
625		return strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(string(value), "-", " "))
626	}
627	
628	func milestoneLabel(value taskflow.Milestone) string {
629		switch value {
630		case taskflow.MilestoneReviewReady:
631			return "REVIEW"
632		case taskflow.MilestoneMerged:
633			return "MERGED"
634		case taskflow.MilestoneRetired:
635			return "RETIRED"
636		case taskflow.MilestoneAdopted:
637			return "ADOPTED"
638		case taskflow.MilestoneReconciled:
639			return "RECONCILED"
640		default:
641			return ""
642		}
643	}
644	
645	func (m Model) renderResult() string {
646		var builder strings.Builder
647		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev flow  RESULT") + "\n\n")
648		builder.WriteString("choice: " + m.planTarget.actionID + " — " + m.planTarget.choice.Label + "\n")
649		if m.lastResultErr != nil {
650			builder.WriteString(styleBad.Render("APPLY ERROR: "+m.lastResultErr.Error()) + "\n")
651		} else {
652			builder.WriteString(styleGood.Render("APPLY COMPLETED") + "\n")
653		}
654		if m.lastResult.PartialSuccess {
655			builder.WriteString("PARTIAL SUCCESS: completed effects remain completed; no rollback is implied.\n")
656		}
657		if milestone := milestoneLabel(m.lastResult.Milestone); milestone != "" {
658			builder.WriteString("result milestone: " + milestone + " (not a persisted state)\n")
659		}
660	
661		builder.WriteString("\nSTEP LEDGER\n")
662		steps := m.lastResult.AttemptedSteps()
663		if len(steps) == 0 {
664			builder.WriteString("  (no effect was attempted)\n")
665		}
666		for index, step := range steps {
667			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. [%s] %s — %s", index+1,
668				strings.ToUpper(string(step.Status)), step.Effect.Code, step.Effect.Description))
669			if step.Detail != "" {
670				builder.WriteString(" | " + step.Detail)
671			}
672			if step.Failure != "" {
673				builder.WriteString(" | FAILURE: " + step.Failure)
674			}
675			builder.WriteString("\n")
676		}
677		builder.WriteString("\nWARNINGS\n")
678		writeStringSection(&builder, m.lastResult.Warnings())
679		builder.WriteString("RECOVERY\n")
680		writeStringSection(&builder, m.lastResult.Recovery())
681		if remote, ok := m.lastResult.RemoteObservation(); ok {
682			builder.WriteString("REMOTE OBSERVATION (run-local)\n")
683			for _, line := range remoteObservationLines(remote) {
684				builder.WriteString("  " + line + "\n")
685			}
686		}
687		if handoff, ok := m.lastResult.Handoff(); ok {
688			builder.WriteString("HANDOFF (available after alternate-screen exit)\n")
689			builder.WriteString("  " + handoffDescription(handoff) + "\n")
690		}
691		if m.loadRequest.loading {
692			builder.WriteString("\nREFRESHING: a new local generation is loading; state was not changed optimistically.\n")
693		} else if m.loadRequest.err != nil {
694			builder.WriteString("\nSTALE: post-Apply local reload failed: " + m.loadRequest.err.Error() + "\n")
695		}
696		if m.status != "" {
697			builder.WriteString("STATUS: " + m.status + "\n")
698		}
699		builder.WriteString("\n" + styleMuted.Render("Esc return to repository | r reload again | ? help | q quit"))
700		return builder.String()
701	}
702	
703	func writeStringSection(builder *strings.Builder, values []string) {
704		if len(values) == 0 {
705			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
706			return
707		}
708		for _, value := range values {
709			builder.WriteString("  - " + value + "\n")
710		}
711	}
712	
713	func handoffDescription(handoff taskflow.Handoff) string {
714		parts := []string{strings.ToUpper(string(handoff.Kind))}
715		for _, value := range []string{handoff.Path, handoff.Runtime, handoff.RuntimeHandle, handoff.URL, handoff.Label} {
716			if value != "" {
717				parts = append(parts, value)
718			}
719		}
720		return strings.Join(parts, " | ")
721	}
722	
723	func remoteObservationLines(remote taskflow.RemoteObservation) []string {
724		lines := []string{"REMOTE: " + remote.RemoteName}
725		if remote.Provider != "" {
726			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE PROVIDER: "+strings.ToUpper(string(remote.Provider)))
727		}
728		if remote.Repository != "" {
729			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REPOSITORY: "+remote.Repository)
730		}
731		if remote.Head != "" || remote.Base != "" {
732			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BRANCHES: "+remote.Head+" -> "+remote.Base)
733		}
734		lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BEFORE REFS: "+refsSummary(remote.BeforeRefs))
735		if !remote.BeforeRefs.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
736			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BEFORE OBSERVED: "+formatTime(remote.BeforeRefs.ObservedAt))
737		}
738		if remote.HasAfterRefs {
739			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE AFTER REFS: "+refsSummary(remote.AfterRefs))
740			if !remote.AfterRefs.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
741				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE AFTER OBSERVED: "+formatTime(remote.AfterRefs.ObservedAt))
742			}
743		}
744		if remote.HasReview {
745			review := remote.Review
746			switch {
747			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationError:
748				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW ERROR: "+string(review.FailureKind)+" — "+review.Failure)
749			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationKnown && !review.Exists:
750				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW: NONE (known)")
751			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationKnown:
752				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("REMOTE REVIEW: #%d %s %s", review.Number, strings.ToUpper(string(review.ReviewState)), review.URL))
753			default:
754				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW: "+strings.ToUpper(string(review.State)))
755			}
756			if !review.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
757				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW OBSERVED: "+formatTime(review.ObservedAt))
758			}
759		}
760		return lines
761	}
762	
763	func refsSummary(refs taskflow.RemoteRefsObservation) string {
764		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
765		for _, ref := range []taskflow.NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
766			if ref.Ref == "" {
767				continue
768			}
769			switch {
770			case ref.Failure != "":
771				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"=ERROR("+ref.Failure+")")
772			case ref.Exists:
773				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"="+ref.OID)
774			default:
775				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"=ABSENT")
776			}
777		}
778		if len(parts) == 0 {
779			return "no named refs observed"
780		}
781		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
782	}
783	
784	func formatTime(value time.Time) string {
785		return value.Local().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05 MST")
786	}

98	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructive(ctx context.Context, input destructiveInspectInput) (destructiveObservation, error) {
99		observed := destructiveObservation{locator: input.locator, runtime: input.runtime, runtimeErr: input.rtErr}
100		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
101			return observed, err
102		}
103	
104		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, input.locator.RepoPath)
105		if err != nil {
106			observed.repoErr = err
107			return observed, nil
108		}
109		observed.repo = repository
110		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
111		if err != nil {
112			observed.repoErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git main checkout: %w", err)
113			return observed, nil
114		}
115		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
116		if err != nil {
117			observed.repoErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory: %w", err)
118			return observed, nil
119		}
120		requestedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.RepoPath)
121		if err != nil {
122			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
123		}
124		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.GitCommonDir)
125		if err != nil {
126			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
127		}
128		if requestedRepo != observed.repoPath || requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
129			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
130				"selected repository identity changed: main %q -> %q, common directory %q -> %q",
131				requestedRepo, observed.repoPath, requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir,
132			)}
133		}
134		if filepath.IsAbs(input.locator.RepoKey) {
135			key, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.RepoKey)
136			if keyErr != nil {
137				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
138			}
139			if key != observed.gitCommonDir {
140				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected repository key no longer names the Git common directory"}
141			}
142		}
143	
144		observed.worktrees, observed.worktreesErr = s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
145		if !input.noCheckout {
146			observed.checkout, err = s.canonicalPath(input.locator.CheckoutPath)
147			if err != nil {
148				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize selected checkout: %w", err)
149			} else {
150				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
151				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
152					observed.worktreeFound = true
153					observed.observeCheckoutFacts(ctx, s)
154					if input.inspectContent && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() {
155						analysis, contentErr := s.analyzeFinish(ctx, observed.checkout, input.locator.Branch, input.locator.Branch)
156						observed.contentFingerprint = analysis.Fingerprint
157						observed.contentErr = contentErr
158					}
159					observed.harness, observed.isHarness = inventory.DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
160				}
161			}
162		}
163	
164		observed.observeRefs(ctx, s, input.locator.Branch, input.base)
165		if input.inspectArtifacts && observed.worktreeFound {
166			observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
167		}
168		if !input.noCheckout && !input.skipCleanup {
169			if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
170				if observed.runtime == nil || strings.TrimSpace(observed.runtime.Name()) == "" {
171					observed.runtimeErr = errors.New("destructive inspection has no runtime backend")
172				} else {
173					observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
174					observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, input.cleanup)
175				}
176			}
177		}
178		if input.inspectTasks {
179			if input.loadTasks == nil {
180				observed.taskInventoryErr = errors.New("task inventory loader is unavailable")
181			} else {
182				observed.taskRecords, observed.taskDiagnostics, observed.taskInventoryErr = input.loadTasks()
183				if observed.taskInventoryErr == nil {
184					s.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &observed)
185				}
186			}
187		}
188		return observed, nil
189	}

191	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeCheckoutFacts(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService) {
192		o.status, o.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, o.checkout)
193		o.head, o.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, o.checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
194		o.head = strings.TrimSpace(o.head)
195		o.operation, o.inProgress, o.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, o.checkout)
196	}
197	
198	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeRefs(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService, branch, base string) {
199		o.branchRef = localBranchRef(branch)
200		if o.repoPath != "" && o.branchRef != "" {
201			o.branchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchRef)
202			if o.branchExists {
203				o.branchOID, o.branchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchRef)
204			}
205		}
206		o.baseRef = localBranchRef(base)
207		if o.repoPath != "" && o.baseRef != "" {
208			o.baseExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, o.repoPath, o.baseRef)
209			if o.baseExists {
210				o.baseOID, o.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, o.repoPath, o.baseRef)
211			}
212		}
213		if o.branchExists && o.branchOIDErr == nil && o.branchOID != "" &&
214			o.baseExists && o.baseOIDErr == nil && o.baseOID != "" {
215			o.contained, o.containedErr = s.isAncestor(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchOID, o.baseOID)
216		}
217	}
218	
219	func localBranchRef(branch string) string {
220		if branch == "" {
221			return ""
222		}
223		return "refs/heads/" + branch
224	}
225	
226	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx context.Context, observed *destructiveObservation) {
227		for _, diagnostic := range observed.taskDiagnostics {
228			observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete, diagnostic.Error())
229		}
230		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
231			candidate := record.Task
232			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
233				observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
234					fmt.Sprintf("task %s is invalid: %v", candidate.ID, err))
235				continue
236			}
237	
238			pathClaim := false
239			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
240				path, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
241				if err != nil {
242					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
243						fmt.Sprintf("task %s checkout identity is unavailable: %v", candidate.ID, err))
244				} else {
245					pathClaim = path == observed.checkout
246				}
247			}
248	
249			branchClaim := false
250			if candidate.Branch == observed.locator.Branch {
251				repoMatches, complete, detail := s.taskRepositoryMatches(ctx, candidate, *observed)
252				if !complete {
253					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
254						fmt.Sprintf("task %s repository identity is unavailable: %s", candidate.ID, detail))
255				} else {
256					branchClaim = repoMatches
257				}
258			}
259	
260			if pathClaim {
261				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
262					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "exact checkout path",
263				})
264			}
265			if branchClaim {
266				reason := "exact branch in selected repository"
267				if pathClaim {
268					reason = "exact checkout path and branch in selected repository"
269					observed.taskClaims[len(observed.taskClaims)-1].Reason = reason
270					continue
271				}
272				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
273					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: reason,
274				})
275			}
276		}
277		sort.Slice(observed.taskClaims, func(i, j int) bool {
278			if observed.taskClaims[i].ID != observed.taskClaims[j].ID {
279				return observed.taskClaims[i].ID < observed.taskClaims[j].ID
280			}
281			return observed.taskClaims[i].Reason < observed.taskClaims[j].Reason
282		})
283		sort.Strings(observed.taskIncomplete)
284	}

286	func (s *lifecycleService) taskRepositoryMatches(ctx context.Context, candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation) (bool, bool, string) {
287		candidatePath, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
288		if err != nil {
289			return false, false, err.Error()
290		}
291		if candidatePath == observed.repoPath {
292			return true, true, ""
293		}
294		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return false, false, err.Error()
297		}
298		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
299		if err != nil {
300			return false, false, err.Error()
301		}
302		return commonDir == observed.gitCommonDir, true, ""
303	}

305	func (o destructiveObservation) branchCheckoutPaths(excludeTarget bool) ([]string, error) {
306		if o.worktreesErr != nil {
307			return nil, o.worktreesErr
308		}
309		var paths []string
310		for _, worktree := range o.worktrees {
311			if worktree.Bare || worktree.Branch != o.locator.Branch {
312				continue
313			}
314			path := worktree.Path
315			if canonical, err := filepath.Abs(path); err == nil {
316				path = filepath.Clean(canonical)
317			}
318			if excludeTarget && o.checkout != "" {
319				candidate, err := filepath.Abs(o.checkout)
320				if err == nil && filepath.Clean(candidate) == path {
321					continue
322				}
323			}
324			paths = append(paths, path)
325		}
326		sort.Strings(paths)
327		return paths, nil
328	}

336			"destructive.repo":                    o.repositoryAuthority(),
337			"destructive.checkout":                o.checkoutAuthority(),
338			"destructive.git":                     o.gitAuthority(),
339			"destructive.refs":                    o.refsAuthority(),
340			"destructive.artifact":                artifactAuthority(o.artifact, o.artifactErr),

342			"destructive.runtime-backend":         runtimeName(o.runtime),
343			"destructive.runtime-error":           errorString(o.runtimeErr),
344			"destructive.runtime-available":       boolString(o.runtimeAvailable),

408	func artifactEvidenceFromInspection(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection) string {
409		if inspection.KnownEmpty {
410			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
411		}
412		states := make([]string, 0, len(inspection.Intents))
413		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
414			states = append(states, intent.Intent.ID+"="+string(intent.State))
415		}
416		if len(states) == 0 {
417			return "artifact readiness is incomplete"
418		}
419		return strings.Join(states, ", ")
420	}

422	func mergeAuthority(base, additional map[string]string) map[string]string {
423		out := make(map[string]string, len(base)+len(additional))
424		for key, value := range base {
425			out[key] = value
426		}
427		for key, value := range additional {
428			out[key] = value
429		}
430		return out
431	}

433	func destructiveConditionsReady(conditions []Condition) error {
434		if availability := AvailabilityFor(conditions); availability != AvailabilityReady {
435			var evidence []string
436			for _, current := range conditions {
437				if current.Requirement == RequirementRequired && current.Verdict != VerdictMet {
438					evidence = append(evidence, string(current.Code)+": "+current.Evidence)
439				}
440			}
441			return staleBoundary("destructive safety is no longer ready (" + strings.Join(evidence, "; ") + ")")
442		}
443		return nil
444	}

446	func compareAuthorityCategory(name, before, after string) error {
447		if before != after {
448			return staleBoundary(name + " authority changed")
449		}
450		return nil
451	}

48	func validateRefreshRemoteLocator(locator Locator) error {
49		switch {
50		case locator.RepoPath == "":
51			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
52		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
53			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
54		case !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Branch):
55			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact head branch %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Branch)
56		case locator.Base != "" && !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Base):
57			return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Base)
58		case locator.HeadOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.HeadOID):
59			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact HEAD OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.HeadOID)
60		case locator.BaseOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.BaseOID):
61			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact base OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.BaseOID)
62		}
63	
64		if locator.TaskID == "" {
65			switch {
66			case locator.TaskRevision != "":
67				return fmt.Errorf("%w: task revision requires a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
68			case locator.HeadOID == "":
69				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged remote refresh requires an exact HEAD OID", ErrInvalidRequest)
70			case locator.Mode != "" && !validMode(locator.Mode):
71				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown checkout mode %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Mode)
72			case locator.State != "" && !validState(locator.State):
73				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown task state %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.State)
74			}
75			return nil
76		}
77	
78		switch {
79		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
80			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
81		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
82			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
83		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
84			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
85		case !validState(locator.State):
86			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
87		}
88		return nil
89	}

91	func normalizedRemoteBranch(branch string) bool {
92		return branch != "" && branch == strings.TrimSpace(branch) &&
93			!strings.ContainsRune(branch, '\x00') &&
94			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/heads/") &&
95			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/remotes/")
96	}

98	func normalizeRemoteName(name string) (string, error) {
99		if name == "" {
100			return "origin", nil
101		}
102		if name != strings.TrimSpace(name) || strings.ContainsRune(name, '\x00') || strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") {
103			return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: remote name %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, name)
104		}
105		return name, nil
106	}

108	func (s *lifecycleService) planRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
109		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
110			return PlanSpec{}, err
111		}
112		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
113			return PlanSpec{}, err
114		}
115	
116		if request.Locator.TaskID == "" {
117			spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, nil)
118			return spec, err
119		}
120	
121		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
122		if err != nil {
123			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
124		}
125		spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, record)
126		if err != nil {
127			return PlanSpec{}, err
128		}
129		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning remote refresh"}
132		}
133		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
134			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning remote refresh")
135		}
136		return spec, nil
137	}

238	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRemoteRefNames(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) error {
239		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
240			"head":        "refs/heads/" + head,
241			"remote name": "refs/remotes/" + remote + "/__dev_refresh_probe__",
242		} {
243			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", ref); err != nil {
244				return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not a valid normalized Git name: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, label, err)
245			}
246		}
247		if base != "" {
248			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", "refs/heads/"+base); err != nil {
249				return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base is not a valid normalized Git branch: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
250			}
251		}
252		return nil
253	}

255	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRefreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, locator Locator, observed *remoteRefreshObservation) error {
256		checkout := locator.CheckoutPath
257		if checkout == "" {
258			checkout = locator.RepoPath
259		}
260		canonical, err := s.canonicalPath(checkout)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize selected checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
263		}
264		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, canonical)
265		if err != nil {
266			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout registration changed: " + err.Error()}
267		}
268		if registered.Path != canonical || registered.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
269			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout no longer belongs to the exact repository identity"}
270		}
271		if registered.Worktree.Detached || registered.Worktree.Branch != locator.Branch {
272			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
273				"selected checkout branch changed from %q to %q", locator.Branch, registered.Worktree.Branch,
274			)}
275		}
276		liveHead, err := s.gitRun(ctx, canonical, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
277		if err != nil {
278			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout HEAD is no longer observable: " + err.Error()}
279		}
280		liveHead = strings.TrimSpace(liveHead)
281		if registered.Worktree.Head != liveHead || locator.HeadOID != liveHead {
282			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
283				"selected checkout HEAD changed from %q to registry=%q live=%q", locator.HeadOID, registered.Worktree.Head, liveHead,
284			)}
285		}
286		observed.checkout = canonical
287		observed.worktree = registered
288		return nil
289	}

291	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRemoteRefs(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) RemoteRefsObservation {
292		result := RemoteRefsObservation{ObservedAt: s.now()}
293		result.LocalHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+head)
294		result.RemoteHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+head)
295		if base != "" {
296			result.LocalBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+base)
297			result.RemoteBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
298		}

302	func (s *lifecycleService) observeNamedRef(ctx context.Context, repoPath, ref string) NamedRefObservation {
303		observed := NamedRefObservation{Ref: ref}
304		if !s.gitRefExists(ctx, repoPath, ref) {

323			refreshHeadCondition(observed),
324			refreshRemoteURLCondition(observed),
325			refreshRefsCondition(observed),
326			refreshReviewBaseCondition(observed, options),
327			refreshReviewProviderCondition(observed, options),

329			refreshReviewCLICondition(observed, options),
330		}

332		var effects []Effect

334			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
335				EffectFetchRefs, "fetch and prune the exact configured remote", observed.repoPath, false, true,
336				map[string]string{
337					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
338					"pre-refs": remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs),
339				},
340			))
341		}
342		if options.QueryReview {
343			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
344				EffectQueryReview, "query the exact provider repository and head/base relationship", observed.providerRepository, false, true,
345				map[string]string{
346					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
347					"provider": string(observed.providerKind), "repository": observed.providerRepository,
348					"head": observed.head, "base": observed.base,
349				},
350			))
351		}
352	
353		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.head + "@" + observed.refs.LocalHead.OID}
354		if observed.checkout != "" {
355			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+observed.checkout)
356		}
357		return PlanSpec{
358			Authority:         refreshRemoteAuthority(observed),
359			Conditions:        conditions,
360			Effects:           effects,
361			RetainedResources: retained,
362			Confirmation: Confirmation{
363				Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Run the selected explicit remote network operations?",
364			},
365			Summary:     refreshRemoteSummary(observed, options),
366			DisplayedAt: s.now(),
367		}
368	}

511	func remoteRefsAuthority(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
512		values := make([]string, 0, 16)

519	func remoteRefsEvidence(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
520		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
521		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
522			if ref.Ref == "" {
523				continue
524			}
525			switch {
526			case ref.Failure != "":
527				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" error: "+ref.Failure)
528			case ref.Exists:
529				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"="+ref.OID)
530			default:
531				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" is absent")
532			}
533		}
534		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
535	}
