548	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
549		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
550			return Result{}, err
551		}
552		if approved.Action != RefreshRemote {
553			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "refresh-remote handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
554		}
555		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
556			return Result{}, err
557		}
558		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
559		if err != nil {
560			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
561		}
562	
563		var result Result
564		applyLocked := func(tx *task.Tx) error {
565			var record *task.Record
566			if approved.Locator.TaskID != "" {
567				if tx == nil {
568					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "managed remote refresh has no task transaction"}
569				}
570				current, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
571				if loadErr != nil {
572					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before remote refresh"}
573				}
574				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *current); identityErr != nil {
575					return identityErr
576				}
577				record = current
578			}
579	
580			spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, approved.Request, record)
581			if observeErr != nil {
582				return observeErr
583			}
584			fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
585			if buildErr != nil {
586				return buildErr
587			}
588			if record != nil {
589				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
590				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
591					actual := ""
592					if current != nil {
593						actual = current.Revision
594					}
595					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked remote refresh replan")
596				}
597			}
598			if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
599				return &StalePlanError{
600					ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
601					ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
602					ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
603					Reason:                       "fresh task, repository, remote URL, provider, or ref authority differs",
604				}
605			}
606			if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
607				notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
608				return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh remote refresh conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
609			}
610	
611			execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh}
612			result, observeErr = execution.executeRefreshRemote(ctx, observed)
613			return observeErr
614		}
615	
616		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
617			if approved.Locator.TaskID == "" {
618				return applyLocked(nil)
619			}
620			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, applyLocked)
621		})
622		return result, err
623	}
624	
625	func (e *executionState) executeRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation) (Result, error) {
626		data := RemoteObservation{
627			RemoteName: observed.remoteName, RemoteURL: observed.remoteURL,
628			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
629			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, BeforeRefs: observed.refs,
630		}
631		e.remote = &data
632		fetched := false
633	
634		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
635			switch effect.Code {
636			case EffectFetchRefs:
637				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
638					_, fetchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "--", observed.remoteName)
639					if fetchErr != nil {
640						return "", fmt.Errorf("fetch --prune %s: %w", observed.remoteName, fetchErr)
641					}
642					return "fetched and pruned " + observed.remoteName, nil
643				})
644				if err != nil {
645					recovery := []string{"remote refs were not proven refreshed; repair the exact remote fetch and create a fresh plan"}
646					if e.plan.Request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions).QueryReview {
647						recovery = append(recovery, "review query was not attempted after the failed fetch")
648					}
649					return e.fail(err, recovery...)
650				}
651				fetched = true
652				data.AfterRefs = e.service.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
653				data.HasAfterRefs = true
654	
655			case EffectQueryReview:
656				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
657					if err := e.service.revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx, observed, fetched); err != nil {
658						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
659						return "", err
660					}
661					query := forge.ReviewQuery{Repository: observed.providerRepository, Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base}
662					review, queryErr := e.service.queryReview(ctx, observed.provider, observed.repoPath, query)
663					if queryErr != nil {
664						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, queryErr)
665						return "", queryErr
666					}
667					if review == nil {
668						data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
669							State: ObservationKnown, Exists: false,
670							Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
671							Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
672						}
673						data.HasReview = true
674						return "provider reports no exact review", nil
675					}
676					if err := validateRemoteReview(observed, *review); err != nil {
677						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
678						return "", err
679					}
680					observedAt := review.ObservedAt.UTC()
681					if review.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
682						observedAt = e.service.now()
683					}
684					data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
685						State: ObservationKnown, Exists: true,
686						Provider: review.Provider, Repository: review.Repository,
687						ID: review.ID, Number: review.Number, ReviewState: review.State,
688						Draft: review.Draft, URL: review.URL, Head: review.Head, Base: review.Base,
689						ObservedAt: observedAt,
690					}
691					data.HasReview = true
692					return fmt.Sprintf("observed %s review #%d (%s)", review.Provider, review.Number, review.State), nil
693				})
694				if err != nil {
695					if fetched {
696						return e.fail(err, "fetch completed; review evidence remains an explicit error and may be retried from a fresh query-only plan")
697					}
698					return e.fail(err, "local refs and task state were unchanged; repair provider access or response handling and retry")
699				}
700	
701			default:
702				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RefreshRemote effect " + string(effect.Code)})
703			}
704		}
705		return e.result(), nil
706	}
707	
708	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation, allowFetchedRefs bool) error {
709		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
710		if err != nil {
711			return staleBoundary("repository became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
712		}
713		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
714		if err != nil {
715			return staleBoundary("repository main path became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
716		}
717		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
718		if err != nil {
719			return staleBoundary("Git common directory became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
720		}
721		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
722			return staleBoundary("repository identity changed before review query")
723		}
724		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
725		kind, repositoryIdentity := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
726		if remoteURL != observed.remoteURL || kind != observed.providerKind || repositoryIdentity != observed.providerRepository {
727			return staleBoundary("remote URL or provider repository identity changed before review query")
728		}
729		if observed.provider == nil || observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind {
730			return staleBoundary("review provider identity changed before query")
731		}
732		if _, ok := observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier); !ok {
733			return staleBoundary("review provider capability changed before query")
734		}
735		if !observed.provider.Available() {
736			return staleBoundary("review provider CLI became unavailable before query")
737		}
738		if !allowFetchedRefs {
739			freshRefs := s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
740			if remoteRefsAuthority(freshRefs) != remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs) {
741				return staleBoundary("local or remote-tracking ref authority changed before query")
742			}
743		}
744		return nil
745	}
746	
747	func (e *executionState) setRemoteReviewFailure(data *RemoteObservation, observed remoteRefreshObservation, err error) {
748		data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
749			State: ObservationError, Exists: false,
750			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
751			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
752			FailureKind: classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err), Failure: err.Error(),
753		}
754		data.HasReview = true
755	}
756	
757	func classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err error) RemoteReviewFailureKind {
758		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrAmbiguousReview) {
759			return RemoteReviewFailureAmbiguous
760		}
761		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrMalformedReviewResponse) {
762			return RemoteReviewFailureMalformed
763		}
764		var unsupported *forge.ErrUnsupported
765		if errors.As(err, &unsupported) {
766			return RemoteReviewFailureUnsupported
767		}
768		var missingCLI *forge.ErrNoCLI
769		if errors.As(err, &missingCLI) {
770			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingCLI
771		}
772		var missingExtension *forge.ErrNoExtension
773		if errors.As(err, &missingExtension) {
774			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingExtension
775		}
776		return RemoteReviewFailureProvider
777	}
778	
779	func validateRemoteReview(observed remoteRefreshObservation, review forge.Review) error {
780		switch {
781		case review.Provider != observed.providerKind:
782			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "provider")
783		case review.Repository != observed.providerRepository:
784			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "repository identity")
785		case review.Head != observed.head:
786			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "head branch")
787		case review.Base != observed.base:
788			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "base branch")
789		case strings.TrimSpace(review.ID) == "" || review.ID != strings.TrimSpace(review.ID):
790			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "identifier")
791		case review.Number <= 0:
792			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "number")
793		case !review.State.Valid():
794			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "state")
795		case review.State == forge.ReviewDraft && !review.Draft:
796			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft flag")
797		case review.State == forge.ReviewOpen && review.Draft:
798			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft state")
799		case !validRemoteReviewURL(review.URL):
800			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "URL")
801		}
802		return nil
803	}
804	
805	func malformedRemoteReview(provider forge.Kind, field string) error {
806		return &forge.MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: 0, Field: field}
807	}
808	
809	func validRemoteReviewURL(raw string) bool {
810		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
811		return err == nil && parsed.Host != "" && (parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http")
812	}
813	
814	func remoteRefCount(refs RemoteRefsObservation) int {
815		count := 0
816		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
817			if ref.Exists && ref.Failure == "" && ref.OID != "" {
818				count++
819			}
820		}
821		return count
822	}
823	
824	func remoteRefSummary(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
825		return strconv.Itoa(remoteRefCount(refs)) + " named ref OID(s) observed"
826	}

36	func newLifecycleSession(ctx context.Context, app *App, resolve lifecycleTaskResolver) (lifecycleSession, error) {

40			return session, err

94		ctx context.Context,
95		app *App,
96		resolve lifecycleTaskResolver,
97		options flow.ActionOptions,
98	) (lifecycleExecution, error) {
99		var execution lifecycleExecution
100		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, resolve)
101		if err != nil {
102			return execution, err
103		}
104		execution.Selected = session.Selected
105		execution.Plan, err = session.plan(ctx, options)
106		if err != nil {
107			return execution, err
108		}
109		execution.Result, err = session.apply(ctx, execution.Plan, flow.Approve(execution.Plan.PlanID))
110		renderLifecycleResult(app, execution.Plan, execution.Result)
111		if err != nil {
112			return execution, presentLifecycleApplyError(execution.Plan, err)
113		}
114	
115		execution.Task, err = session.finalTask(app)
116		if err != nil {
117			return execution, err
118		}
119		return execution, nil
120	}
121	
122	// exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator converts a branch-selected checkout into the
123	// canonical identity taskflow requires. Branch lookup is only selection; fresh
124	// Git registry evidence supplies every authority field used by the plan.
125	func exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx context.Context, repoPath, checkoutPath string) (flow.Locator, error) {
126		registered, err := gitx.ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx, repoPath, checkoutPath)
127		if err != nil {
128			return flow.Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve exact registered worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(checkoutPath), err)
129		}
130		return flow.Locator{
131			RepoKey:      registered.GitCommonDir,
132			RowKey:       registered.Path,
133			RowKind:      "unmanaged",
134			RepositoryID: registered.GitCommonDir,
135			GitCommonDir: registered.GitCommonDir,
136			RepoPath:     registered.RepositoryPath,
137			CheckoutPath: registered.Path,
138			Branch:       registered.Worktree.Branch,
139			HeadOID:      registered.Worktree.Head,
140		}, nil
141	}
142	
143	// executeNonTaskLifecycle applies an exact non-task plan as an explicitly
144	// invoked CLI action. Destructive compatibility flags authorize only the typed
145	// token sealed into that same plan; they do not change readiness or blockers.
146	func executeNonTaskLifecycle(
147		ctx context.Context,
148		app *App,
149		locator flow.Locator,
150		options flow.ActionOptions,
151		authorizeTyped bool,
152	) (nonTaskLifecycleExecution, error) {
153		var execution nonTaskLifecycleExecution
154		service, err := newCLILifecycleService(app)
155		if err != nil {
156			return execution, err
157		}
158		request, err := flow.NewRequest(locator, options)
159		if err != nil {
160			return execution, err
161		}
162		execution.Plan, err = service.Plan(ctx, request)
163		if err != nil {
164			return execution, err
165		}
166		approval := flow.Approve(execution.Plan.PlanID)
167		if execution.Plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
168			if !authorizeTyped {
169				return execution, fmt.Errorf("%s requires its exact typed confirmation", execution.Plan.Summary)
170			}
171			approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(execution.Plan.PlanID, execution.Plan.Confirmation.Token)
172		}
173		execution.Result, err = service.Apply(ctx, execution.Plan, approval)
174		renderLifecycleResult(app, execution.Plan, execution.Result)
175		if err != nil {
176			return execution, presentLifecycleApplyError(execution.Plan, err)
177		}
178		return execution, nil
179	}

181	func newCLILifecycleService(app *App) (*flow.Service, error) {
182		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
183		if err != nil {
184			return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve lifecycle caller directory: %w", err)
185		}
186		return flow.NewLifecycleService(flow.LifecycleConfig{
187			Config:              app.Cfg,
188			Tasks:               app.Tasks,
189			Artifacts:           artifactStore(app),
190			DefaultRuntime:      app.Runtime,
191			NamedRuntime:        app.runtimeNamed,
192			Host:                config.Hostname(),
193			CWD:                 cwd,
194			AllowSharedCheckout: app.allowSharedCheckout,
195			Logf: func(format string, args ...any) {
196				if app.Err != nil {
197					fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, format+"\n", args...)
198				}
199			},
200		})
201	}

203	func renderLifecycleResult(app *App, plan flow.Plan, result flow.Result) {
204		style := app.outStyle()
205		for _, step := range result.AttemptedSteps() {
206			if step.Status == flow.StepFailed {
207				label := step.Effect.Description
208				if label == "" {
209					label = string(step.Effect.Code)
210				}
211				failure := step.Failure
212				if failure == "" {
213					failure = "operation failed"
214				}
215				app.warnf("%s failed: %s", label, failure)
216				continue
217			}
218			if step.Status != flow.StepCompleted {
219				continue
220			}
221	
222			details := step.Effect.Details.Map()
223			switch step.Effect.Code {
224			case flow.EffectCommitWIP, flow.EffectCommitAll:
225				message := details["message"]
226				if message == "" {
227					message = step.Detail
228				}
229				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("committed"), message)
230			case flow.EffectDiscardAll:
231				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  checkout changes\n", style.label("discarded"))
232			case flow.EffectPushBranch, flow.EffectPushBase:
233				pushed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "pushed ")
234				pushed = strings.TrimPrefix(pushed, "published ")
235				if pushed == step.Detail || pushed == "" {
236					pushed = "origin/" + step.Effect.Target
237				}
238				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("pushed"), pushed)
239			case flow.EffectCloseRuntime:
240				closed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "closed ")
241				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("closed"), closed)
242			case flow.EffectRemoveWorktree:
243				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s removed: %s\n", style.label("worktree"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
244			case flow.EffectDeleteBranch:
245				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s deleted\n", style.label("branch"), step.Effect.Target)
246			case flow.EffectDeleteTask:
247				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s reaped\n", style.label("task"), step.Effect.Target)
248			case flow.EffectRebaseBranch:
249				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebased"), strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "rebased "))
250			case flow.EffectSwitchBase, flow.EffectSwitchBranch:
251				switched := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "switched ")
252				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("switched"), switched)
253			case flow.EffectMergeFF:
254				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("integrated"), step.Detail)
255			case flow.EffectCreateReview:
256				if handoff, ok := result.Handoff(); ok && handoff.Kind == flow.HandoffURL && handoff.URL != "" {
257					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("opened"), handoff.URL)
258				}
259			case flow.EffectVerifyAncestry:
260				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("verified"), step.Detail)
261			case flow.EffectUpdateTask:
262				if isCompletionAction(plan.Action) {
263					state := details["state"]
264					if state == "" {
265						state = "lifecycle state"
266					}
267					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("recorded"), strings.ToUpper(state))
268				}
269			case flow.EffectCreateWorktree:
270				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebuilt"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
271			}
272		}
273		for _, warning := range result.Warnings() {
274			switch warning {
275			case "no next action is recorded":
276				app.warnf("no next action recorded — `dev park --next \"...\"` is what makes resuming cheap")
277			default:
278				app.warnf("%s", warning)
279			}
280		}
281		for _, recovery := range result.Recovery() {
282			app.warnf("recovery: %s", recovery)
283		}
284	}
285	
286	func isCompletionAction(action flow.Action) bool {
287		switch action {
288		case flow.CompleteDirect, flow.CompleteFF, flow.ReviewHandoff, flow.VerifyMerged:
289			return true
290		default:
291			return false
292		}
293	}
294	
295	func presentLifecycleRequestError(selected task.Task, action flow.Action, err error) error {
296		var transition *flow.InvalidTransitionError
297		if !errors.As(err, &transition) {
298			return err
299		}
300		if action == flow.ParkCold && selected.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
301			return fmt.Errorf("direct task %s uses the canonical checkout on %s, so it cannot go cold; park it warm or finish it: %w",
302				selected.Title(), selected.Branch, err)
303		}
304		if action == flow.Retire {
305			return fmt.Errorf("task %s is %s, not merged; run dev done first: %w", selected.ID, selected.State, err)
306		}
307		return err
308	}
309	
310	func presentLifecycleApplyError(plan flow.Plan, err error) error {
311		if !errors.Is(err, flow.ErrPlanNotReady) {
312			return err
313		}
314		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
315		for _, condition := range blocking {
316			switch condition.Code {
317			case flow.ConditionCheckoutClean:
318				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
319					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes (%s).\nCommit them, or re-run with --force to discard them: %w",
320						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
321				}
322				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
323					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes; going cold removes the worktree.\nCommit them, or re-run with --wip to checkpoint automatically: %w",
324						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), err)
325				}
326			case flow.ConditionBranchPublished, flow.ConditionBranchPushed:
327				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
328					return fmt.Errorf("%s is not fully pushed (%s); a cold task must be reconstructible from the remote.\nRun `dev park --cold --push`: %w",
329						plan.Locator.Branch, condition.Evidence, err)
330				}
331			case flow.ConditionTaskClaims:
332				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
333					return fmt.Errorf("%s is claimed by task metadata (%s).\nUse managed dev park/dev retire, or reconcile the task claim before removing this checkout: %w",
334						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
335				}
336			case flow.ConditionTaskInventory:
337				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
338					return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove %s is unmanaged because task inventory is incomplete (%s).\nRepair or reconcile task metadata before using dev park/dev retire or removing this checkout: %w",
339						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
340				}
341			case flow.ConditionOwner:
342				if plan.Action == flow.Resume {
343					owner := plan.AuthorityFields()["task.owner"]
344					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is owned by %s.\nMake sure that machine has pushed its work, then re-run with --force to take ownership: %w",
345						plan.Locator.TaskID, owner, err)
346				}
347			case flow.ConditionAgentOccupancy:
348				if plan.Action == flow.Resume && strings.HasPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ") {
349					occupant := strings.TrimPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ")
350					return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership: %w",
351						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), occupant, err)
352				}
353			}
354		}
355	
356		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
357		for _, condition := range blocking {
358			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
359			if condition.Remediation != "" {
360				message += " (" + condition.Remediation + ")"
361			}
362			parts = append(parts, message)
363		}
364		if len(parts) == 0 {
365			return err
366		}
367		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability, strings.Join(parts, "; "), err)
368	}
369

68	Without an argument, a checkout opens its canonical repository and focuses the

92	func resolveFlowLaunch(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string, deps flowCommandDeps) (flowLaunch, error) {
93		var launch flowLaunch

95			return launch, errors.New("flow command dependencies are incomplete")
96		}

100		}

105			if err != nil {

107			}

109			if queryPath == "" {
110				queryPath = resolved.RealPath
111			}

115			}

143	func runFlow(app *App, launch flowLaunch, runProgram flowProgramRunner) error {
144		if runProgram == nil {
145			return errors.New("flow program runner is unavailable")
146		}
147		flowtui.SetColorEnabled(app.outStyle().enabled)
148		app.traceTUI = true
149		runCtx, cancelRun := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
150		finishSetup := app.trace.Start(perftrace.TUISetup, perftrace.Fields{})
151		runtimeResolver := newTUIRuntimeResolver(app)
152		loader := newFlowLoader(app, runtimeResolver, launch.cwd)
153		if launch.repository != nil {
154			loader.registerRepository(*launch.repository, true)
155		}
156		actions := loader.actions()
157		if app.deferredReleaseRefresh {
158			actions.AfterFirstView = func(context.Context) { app.refreshReleaseDetached() }
159		}
160		model := flowtui.New(actions, launch.preselected).WithContext(runCtx)
161		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
162		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
163		final, err := runProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen())
164		cancelRun()
165		app.finishTrace()
166		if err != nil {
167			return err
168		}
169		withHandoff, ok := final.(interface {
170			Handoff() (taskflow.Handoff, bool)
171		})
172		if !ok {
173			return nil
174		}
175		handoff, ok := withHandoff.Handoff()
176		if !ok {
177			return nil
178		}
179		return honorFlowHandoff(app, runtimeResolver, handoff)
180	}
181	
182	func honorFlowHandoff(app *App, resolver flowRuntimeResolver, handoff taskflow.Handoff) error {
183		switch handoff.Kind {
184		case taskflow.HandoffDirectory:
185			if handoff.Path == "" {
186				return errors.New("flow returned an empty directory handoff")
187			}
188			return app.cdDirective(handoff.Path)
189		case taskflow.HandoffRuntime:
190			if handoff.Runtime == "" || handoff.RuntimeHandle == "" {
191				return errors.New("flow returned an incomplete runtime handoff")
192			}
193			var rt runtime.Runtime
194			if resolver != nil {
195				resolved, err := resolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
196				if err != nil {
197					return err
198				}
199				if resolved != nil && resolved.Name() == handoff.Runtime {
200					rt = resolved
201				}
202			}
203			if rt == nil {
204				rt = app.runtimeNamed(handoff.Runtime)
205			}
206			if rt == nil || rt.Name() != handoff.Runtime {
207				return fmt.Errorf("flow handoff backend %q is unavailable", handoff.Runtime)
208			}
209			return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
210		case taskflow.HandoffURL:
211			if handoff.URL == "" {
212				return errors.New("flow returned an empty URL handoff")
213			}
214			_, err := fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, handoff.URL)
215			return err
216		default:
217			return fmt.Errorf("flow returned unsupported handoff kind %q", handoff.Kind)
218		}
219	}

232	func availableFlowRepository(discovered gitx.Repo, preferred *repo.Repo, focus string) (flowRepository, error) {
233		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(discovered.GitCommonDir)
234		if err != nil {
235			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository identity: %w", err)
236		}
237		mainRoot := discovered.MainRoot
238		if mainRoot == "" && discovered.Bare {
239			mainRoot = discovered.GitCommonDir
240		}
241		mainRoot, err = pathx.Canonical(mainRoot)
242		if err != nil {
243			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository root: %w", err)
244		}
245		focusTarget := ""
246		if focus != "" {
247			focusTarget, err = pathx.Canonical(focus)
248			if err != nil {
249				return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow focus: %w", err)
250			}
251		}
252	
253		r := repo.Repo{
254			Name: discovered.Name, Path: mainRoot, RealPath: mainRoot,
255			CommonDir: commonDir, MainRoot: mainRoot, Bare: discovered.Bare, HasGit: true,
256		}
257		name := discovered.Name
258		if preferred != nil {
259			if preferred.Name != "" {
260				r.Name = preferred.Name
261			}
262			r.Root = preferred.Root
263			r.Category = preferred.Category
264			name = preferred.Display()
265			if name == "" {
266				name = r.Name
267			}
268		}
269		return flowRepository{
270			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
271				RepoKey: commonDir, Name: name, Path: mainRoot, Available: true,
272				FocusTarget: focusTarget,
273			},
274			repository: r,
275			available:  true,
276		}, nil
277	}

279	func unavailableFlowRepository(record task.Record, cause error) flowRepository {
280		path := record.Task.RepoPath
281		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
282			path = canonical
283		} else if absolute, absErr := filepath.Abs(path); absErr == nil {
284			path = filepath.Clean(absolute)
285		}
286		name := record.Task.Repo
287		if name == "" {
288			name = filepath.Base(path)
289		}
290		message := "repository is unavailable"
291		if cause != nil {
292			message += ": " + cause.Error()
293		}
294		return flowRepository{
295			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
296				RepoKey: "unavailable:" + path, Name: name, Path: path,
297				Available: false, Error: message,
298			},
299			available:        false,
300			unavailableTasks: []task.Record{record},
301		}
302	}

311	type flowApprovedPlan struct {
312		target flowTarget
313		plan   taskflow.Plan
314	}
315	
316	type flowLoader struct {
317		app      *App
318		runtime  flowRuntimeResolver
319		limiter  *inventory.Limiter
320		cwd      string
321		now      func() time.Time
322		discover func(context.Context, string) (gitx.Repo, error)
323		listRepo func(context.Context, []string, repo.Options) ([]repo.Repo, error)
324		inspect  func(context.Context, *artifact.Store, string) (artifact.ReadinessInspection, error)
325		base     func(context.Context, string) string
326		service  func(runtime.Runtime) (*taskflow.Service, error)
327	
328		mu           sync.Mutex
329		repositories map[string]flowRepository
330		pinned       map[string]bool
331		targets      map[string]map[string]flowTarget
332		approved     map[string]flowApprovedPlan
333		remote       map[string]taskflow.RemoteObservation
334	}
335	
336	func newFlowLoader(app *App, resolver flowRuntimeResolver, cwd string) *flowLoader {
337		loader := &flowLoader{
338			app:          app,
339			runtime:      resolver,
340			limiter:      inventory.NewLimiter(8),
341			cwd:          cwd,
342			now:          time.Now,
343			discover:     gitx.Discover,
344			listRepo:     repo.Discover,
345			inspect:      artifact.InspectReadiness,
346			base:         gitx.DefaultBranch,
347			repositories: make(map[string]flowRepository),
348			pinned:       make(map[string]bool),
349			targets:      make(map[string]map[string]flowTarget),
350			approved:     make(map[string]flowApprovedPlan),
351			remote:       make(map[string]taskflow.RemoteObservation),
352		}
353		loader.service = func(rt runtime.Runtime) (*taskflow.Service, error) {
354			return newFlowLifecycleService(app, rt, cwd)
355		}
356		return loader
357	}
358	
359	func newFlowLifecycleService(app *App, resolved runtime.Runtime, cwd string) (*taskflow.Service, error) {
360		if resolved == nil {
361			return nil, errors.New("flow runtime resolver returned no backend")
362		}
363		return taskflow.NewLifecycleService(taskflow.LifecycleConfig{
364			Config: app.Cfg, Tasks: app.Tasks, Artifacts: artifactStore(app),
365			DefaultRuntime: func() runtime.Runtime { return resolved },
366			NamedRuntime: func(name string) runtime.Runtime {
367				if name == "" || name == resolved.Name() {
368					return resolved
369				}
370				return app.runtimeNamed(name)
371			},
372			Host: config.Hostname(), CWD: cwd,
373			// The flow preview deliberately never inherits the expert shared-writer
374			// override. Its normal choices must remain fail-closed.
375			AllowSharedCheckout: false,
376			Logf: func(format string, args ...any) {
377				if app.Err != nil {
378					fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, format+"\n", args...)
379				}
380			},
381		})
382	}
383	
384	func (l *flowLoader) registerRepository(repository flowRepository, pinned bool) {
385		l.mu.Lock()
386		defer l.mu.Unlock()
387		l.repositories[repository.row.RepoKey] = repository
388		if pinned {
389			l.pinned[repository.row.RepoKey] = true
390		}
391	}
392	
393	func (l *flowLoader) actions() flowtui.Actions {
394		return flowtui.Actions{
395			ListRepositories: l.ListRepositories,
396			LoadRepository:   l.LoadRepository,
397			Plan:             l.Plan,
398			Apply:            l.Apply,
399		}
400	}
401	
402	func (l *flowLoader) ListRepositories(ctx context.Context) ([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, error) {
403		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
404			return nil, err
405		}
406		records, _, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
407		if taskErr != nil {
408			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list task-referenced repositories: %w", taskErr)
409		}
410		discovered, err := l.listRepo(ctx, l.app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
411		if err != nil {
412			return nil, err
413		}
414	
415		fresh := make(map[string]flowRepository)
416		l.mu.Lock()
417		for key := range l.pinned {
418			if existing, ok := l.repositories[key]; ok {
419				fresh[key] = existing
420			}
421		}
422		l.mu.Unlock()
423	
424		for index := range discovered {
425			candidate := discovered[index]
426			gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, candidate.Path)
427			if discoverErr != nil {
428				continue
429			}
430			entry, convertErr := availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, &candidate, "")
431			if convertErr != nil {
432				continue
433			}
434			if _, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
435				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
436			}
437		}
438	
439		pathResults := make(map[string]struct {
440			repository flowRepository
441			err        error
442		})
443		for _, record := range records {
444			path := record.Task.RepoPath
445			resolved, seen := pathResults[path]
446			if !seen {
447				gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, path)
448				if discoverErr == nil {
449					resolved.repository, discoverErr = availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, nil, "")
450				}
451				resolved.err = discoverErr
452				pathResults[path] = resolved
453			}
454			if resolved.err == nil {
455				if _, exists := fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
456					fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey] = resolved.repository
457				}
458				continue
459			}
460			entry := unavailableFlowRepository(record, resolved.err)
461			if existing, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; exists {
462				existing.unavailableTasks = appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(existing.unavailableTasks, record)
463				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = existing
464			} else {
465				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
466			}
467		}
468	
469		rows := make([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, 0, len(fresh))
470		for _, entry := range fresh {
471			rows = append(rows, entry.row)
472		}
473		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
474			left, right := strings.ToLower(rows[i].Name), strings.ToLower(rows[j].Name)
475			if left != right {
476				return left < right
477			}
478			if rows[i].Path != rows[j].Path {
479				return rows[i].Path < rows[j].Path
480			}
481			return rows[i].RepoKey < rows[j].RepoKey
482		})
483		l.mu.Lock()
484		l.repositories = fresh
485		l.mu.Unlock()
486		return rows, nil
487	}
488	
489	func appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(records []task.Record, candidate task.Record) []task.Record {
490		for _, record := range records {
491			if record.Task.ID == candidate.Task.ID {
492				return records
493			}
494		}
495		return append(records, candidate)
496	}
497	
498	func (l *flowLoader) LoadRepository(ctx context.Context, repoKey string) (flowtui.Snapshot, error) {
499		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
500			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
501		}
502		l.mu.Lock()
503		selected, ok := l.repositories[repoKey]
504		l.mu.Unlock()
505		if !ok {
506			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is not in the current flow inventory", repoKey)
507		}
508		if !selected.available {
509			return l.unavailableSnapshot(selected), nil
510		}
511	
512		records, diagnostics, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
513		selectedTasks := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(records))
514		for index := range records {
515			record := records[index]
516			resolved, err := l.discover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
517			if err != nil {
518				continue
519			}
520			commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(resolved.GitCommonDir)
521			if err != nil || commonDir != repoKey {
522				continue
523			}
524			copy := record.Task
525			copy.Tags = append([]string(nil), record.Task.Tags...)
526			selectedTasks = append(selectedTasks, &copy)
527		}
528	
529		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
530		if err != nil {
531			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
532		}
533		if rt == nil {
534			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, errors.New("flow runtime resolver returned no backend")
535		}
536		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
537		runtimeObserved := runtimeErr == nil && rt.Name() != "none"
538		contextSnapshot := inventory.CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, selected.repository, selectedTasks, inventory.RepoContextOptions{
539			Runtime: rt.Name(), Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: runtimeObserved,
540			RuntimeErr: runtimeErr, Limiter: l.limiter,
541		})
542		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
543			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
544		}
545	
546		service, serviceErr := l.service(rt)
547		base := ""
548		if queryPath := flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot); queryPath != "" {
549			base = l.base(ctx, queryPath)
550		}
551		taskComplete := taskErr == nil && len(diagnostics) == 0
552		rows, targets, projectionIssues := l.projectRows(ctx, contextSnapshot, service, serviceErr, taskComplete, base)
553	
554		issues := make([]string, 0, 8)
555		if taskErr != nil {
556			issues = append(issues, "task inventory: "+taskErr.Error())
557		}
558		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
559			issues = append(issues, "task diagnostic: "+diagnostic.Error())
560		}
561		if contextSnapshot.IdentityErr != nil {
562			issues = append(issues, "repository identity: "+contextSnapshot.IdentityErr.Error())
563		}
564		if contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr != nil {
565			issues = append(issues, "worktree inventory: "+contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr.Error())
566		}
567		if rt.Name() != "none" && runtimeErr != nil {
568			issues = append(issues, "runtime observation: "+runtimeErr.Error())
569		}
570		for _, checkout := range contextSnapshot.Checkouts {
571			if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
572				issues = append(issues, "Git status "+checkout.Worktree.Path+": "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
573			}
574		}
575		issues = append(issues, projectionIssues...)
576		issues = uniqueStrings(issues)
577	
578		freshness := flowtui.FreshnessFresh
579		if len(issues) > 0 {
580			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
581		}
582		repositoryRow := selected.row
583		repositoryRow.Available = contextSnapshot.RepositoryID == repoKey && contextSnapshot.IdentityErr == nil
584		if contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != "" && contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != repoKey {
585			issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("repository identity changed from %s to %s", repoKey, contextSnapshot.RepositoryID))
586			repositoryRow.Available = false
587			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
588		}
589		snapshot := flowtui.Snapshot{
590			Repository: repositoryRow,
591			Surfaces:   flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
592			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(),
593			Freshness:  freshness,
594			Error:      strings.Join(uniqueStrings(issues), "; "),
595		}
596		l.mu.Lock()
597		l.targets[repoKey] = targets
598		if remote, exists := l.remote[repoKey]; exists {
599			snapshot.Remote = flowtui.SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
600		}
601		l.mu.Unlock()
602		return snapshot, nil
603	}
604	
605	func (l *flowLoader) unavailableSnapshot(selected flowRepository) flowtui.Snapshot {
606		rows := make([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, 0, len(selected.unavailableTasks))
607		for _, record := range selected.unavailableTasks {
608			tracked := record.Task
609			rows = append(rows, flowtui.SurfaceRow{
610				RowKey: tracked.ID, Kind: flowtui.SurfaceTaskOnly,
611				Label: tracked.Title(), Branch: tracked.Branch, Base: tracked.Base,
612				Mode: tracked.EffectiveMode(), State: tracked.State,
613				Drift: flowtui.NewLines("repository-unavailable: " + selected.row.Error),
614				Evidence: flowtui.NewLines(
615					"recorded repository path: "+tracked.RepoPath,
616					fmt.Sprintf("task: %s mode=%s state=%s", tracked.ID, tracked.EffectiveMode(), tracked.State),
617				),
618			})
619		}
620		l.mu.Lock()
621		l.targets[selected.row.RepoKey] = map[string]flowTarget{}
622		l.mu.Unlock()
623		return flowtui.Snapshot{
624			Repository: selected.row, Surfaces: flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
625			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(), Freshness: flowtui.FreshnessStale,
626			Error: selected.row.Error,
627		}
628	}
629	
630	func flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext) string {
631		if main, ok := contextSnapshot.Main(); ok && main.Worktree.Path != "" {
632			return main.Worktree.Path
633		}
634		for _, candidate := range []string{
635			contextSnapshot.Repo.MainRoot,
636			contextSnapshot.Repo.Path,
637			contextSnapshot.Repo.RealPath,
638			contextSnapshot.Repo.CommonDir,
639		} {
640			if candidate != "" {
641				return candidate
642			}
643		}
644		return ""
645	}
646	
647	func (l *flowLoader) projectRows(
648		ctx context.Context,
649		contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext,
650		service *taskflow.Service,
651		serviceErr error,
652		taskInventoryComplete bool,
653		defaultBase string,
654	) ([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, map[string]flowTarget, []string) {
655		rows := make([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, 0, len(contextSnapshot.Rows))
656		targets := make(map[string]flowTarget)
657		var issues []string
658		for _, contextRow := range contextSnapshot.Rows {
659			projected, rowIssues := l.projectRow(ctx, contextSnapshot, contextRow, service, serviceErr, taskInventoryComplete, defaultBase)
660			issues = append(issues, rowIssues...)
661	
662			validChoices := make([]flowtui.ActionChoice, 0, projected.Actions.Len())
663			for _, choice := range projected.Actions.Values() {
664				request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(projected.Locator, choice.Options())
665				if err != nil {
666					issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("row %s action %s: %v", projected.RowKey, choice.ID, err))
667					continue
668				}
669				target := flowTarget{
670					repoKey: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID, rowKey: projected.RowKey,
671					actionID: choice.ID, request: request,
672				}
673				targets[flowTargetKey(target.repoKey, target.rowKey, target.actionID)] = target
674				validChoices = append(validChoices, choice)
675			}
676			projected.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(validChoices...)
677			rows = append(rows, projected)
678		}
679		return rows, targets, issues
680	}
681	
682	func (l *flowLoader) projectRow(
683		ctx context.Context,
684		contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext,
685		contextRow inventory.RepoContextRow,
686		service *taskflow.Service,
687		serviceErr error,
688		taskInventoryComplete bool,
689		defaultBase string,
690	) (flowtui.SurfaceRow, []string) {
691		drift := topologyReasonLines(contextRow.DriftReasons)
692		conflicts := topologyReasonLines(contextRow.ConflictReasons)
693		var issues []string
694		var tracked *task.Task
695		if contextRow.TaskOnly() {
696			tracked = contextRow.Task
697		} else if contextRow.Checkout != nil && len(contextRow.Checkout.TaskBindings) == 1 {
698			tracked = contextRow.Checkout.TaskBindings[0].Task
699		}
700	
701		var managedLocator taskflow.Locator
702		managedExact := false
703		if tracked != nil {
704			if serviceErr != nil {
705				conflicts = append(conflicts, "locator-error: "+serviceErr.Error())
706				issues = append(issues, "managed locator "+tracked.ID+": "+serviceErr.Error())
707			} else if service != nil {
708				locator, err := service.LocateTask(ctx, tracked.ID)
709				if err != nil {
710					conflicts = append(conflicts, "locator-error: "+err.Error())
711					issues = append(issues, "managed locator "+tracked.ID+": "+err.Error())
712				} else if err := validateProjectedManagedLocator(contextSnapshot, contextRow, tracked, locator); err != nil {
713					conflicts = append(conflicts, "locator-mismatch: "+err.Error())
714					issues = append(issues, "managed locator "+tracked.ID+": "+err.Error())
715				} else {
716					managedLocator, managedExact = locator, true
717				}
718			}
719		}
720	
721		row := flowtui.SurfaceRow{
722			RowKey: contextRow.ID,
723			Kind:   flowtui.SurfaceTaskOnly,
724			Drift:  flowtui.NewLines(uniqueStrings(drift)...),
725			Base:   defaultBase,
726		}
727		if tracked != nil {
728			row.Label = tracked.Title()
729			row.Branch = tracked.Branch
730			row.Base = tracked.Base
731			row.Mode = tracked.EffectiveMode()
732			row.State = tracked.State
733			row.Locator = managedLocator
734		}
735	
736		if contextRow.Checkout != nil {
737			checkout := contextRow.Checkout
738			row.Path = checkout.ID
739			row.Branch = checkout.Branch()
740			row.Kind = classifyFlowCheckout(*checkout, tracked, managedExact, conflicts)
741			row.Label = flowCheckoutLabel(*checkout, tracked, row.Kind)
742			exactGitLocator := flowGitLocator(contextSnapshot, *checkout, defaultBase)
743			if !managedExact {
744				row.Locator = exactGitLocator
745			}
746			row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(flowCheckoutEvidence(contextSnapshot, *checkout)...)
747			if checkout.Exists && !checkout.Worktree.Bare && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
748				inspection, err := l.inspect(ctx, artifactStore(l.app), checkout.Worktree.Path)
749				row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(append(row.Evidence.Values(), artifactSummary(inspection, err))...)
750				if err != nil {
751					issues = append(issues, "artifact observation "+checkout.Worktree.Path+": "+err.Error())
752				}
753			}
754		} else if tracked != nil {
755			evidence := append([]string{
756				"repository path: " + tracked.RepoPath,
757				"checkout: no registered checkout is bound to this task",
758			}, flowTaskEvidence(tracked)...)
759			evidence = append(evidence, flowTaskOnlyRuntimeEvidence(contextSnapshot)...)
760			if tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
761				evidence = append(evidence, "recorded checkout: "+tracked.WorktreePath)
762			}
763			row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(evidence...)
764		}
765		if tracked != nil && contextRow.Checkout != nil {
766			row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(append(row.Evidence.Values(), flowTaskEvidence(tracked)...)...)
767		}
768	
769		conflicts = uniqueStrings(conflicts)
770		row.Conflicts = flowtui.NewLines(conflicts...)
771		if managedExact && len(conflicts) == 0 {
772			row.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(managedFlowChoices(*tracked)...)
773		} else if row.Kind == flowtui.SurfaceUnmanaged && taskInventoryComplete && exactFlowLocator(row.Locator) {
774			row.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(unmanagedFlowChoices(defaultBase)...)
775		}
776		if exactFlowRemoteLocator(row.Locator) {
777			choices := append(row.Actions.Values(), remoteFlowChoices()...)
778			row.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(choices...)
779		}
780		return row, issues
781	}
782	
783	func validateProjectedManagedLocator(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, row inventory.RepoContextRow, tracked *task.Task, locator taskflow.Locator) error {
784		if locator.RepoKey != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID || locator.RepositoryID != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID ||
785			locator.GitCommonDir != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID {
786			return errors.New("locator repository identity differs from inventory")
787		}
788		if locator.TaskID != tracked.ID || locator.Mode != tracked.EffectiveMode() || locator.State != tracked.State {
789			return errors.New("locator task identity, mode, or state differs from inventory")
790		}
791		if row.Checkout != nil && locator.CheckoutPath != row.Checkout.ID {
792			return fmt.Errorf("locator checkout %q differs from row %q", locator.CheckoutPath, row.Checkout.ID)
793		}
794		return nil
795	}
796	
797	func classifyFlowCheckout(checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, tracked *task.Task, managedExact bool, conflicts []string) flowtui.SurfaceKind {
798		switch {
799		case checkout.Worktree.Main:
800			return flowtui.SurfaceCanonical
801		case len(conflicts) > 0:
802			return flowtui.SurfaceConflict
803		case checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil:
804			return flowtui.SurfaceHarness
805		case tracked != nil && managedExact:
806			return flowtui.SurfaceManaged
807		default:
808			return flowtui.SurfaceUnmanaged
809		}
810	}
811	
812	func flowCheckoutLabel(checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, tracked *task.Task, kind flowtui.SurfaceKind) string {
813		branch := checkout.Branch()
814		if branch == "" {
815			branch = "detached HEAD"
816		}
817		if tracked != nil {
818			return tracked.Title() + " · " + branch
819		}
820		switch kind {
821		case flowtui.SurfaceCanonical:
822			return "Main · " + branch
823		case flowtui.SurfaceHarness:
824			return "Harness · " + branch
825		case flowtui.SurfaceConflict:
826			return "Conflict · " + branch
827		default:
828			return branch
829		}
830	}
831	
832	func flowGitLocator(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, base string) taskflow.Locator {
833		return taskflow.Locator{
834			RepoKey: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID, RowKey: checkout.ID, RowKind: "checkout",
835			RepositoryID: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID, GitCommonDir: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID,
836			RepoPath: flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot), CheckoutPath: checkout.ID,
837			Branch: checkout.Branch(), Base: base, Upstream: checkout.Status.Upstream, Remote: "origin",
838			HeadOID: checkout.Worktree.Head,
839		}
840	}
841	
842	func exactFlowLocator(locator taskflow.Locator) bool {
843		return locator.RepoKey != "" && locator.RepositoryID != "" && locator.GitCommonDir != "" &&
844			locator.RepoPath != "" && locator.CheckoutPath != "" && locator.Branch != "" && locator.HeadOID != ""
845	}
846	
847	func exactFlowRemoteLocator(locator taskflow.Locator) bool {
848		return locator.RepoKey != "" && locator.GitCommonDir != "" && locator.RepoPath != "" &&
849			locator.Branch != "" && locator.HeadOID != ""
850	}
851	
852	func flowCheckoutEvidence(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) []string {
853		branch := checkout.Branch()
854		if branch == "" {
855			branch = "(detached)"
856		}
857		lines := []string{
858			"path: " + checkout.Worktree.Path,
859			"branch: " + branch,
860			fmt.Sprintf("registered: Main=%t locked=%t prunable=%t bare=%t detached=%t HEAD=%s",
861				checkout.Worktree.Main, checkout.Worktree.Locked, checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
862				checkout.Worktree.Bare, checkout.Worktree.Detached, emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.Head)),
863		}
864		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
865			lines = append(lines, "registered lock reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason))
866		}
867		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
868			lines = append(lines, "registered prunable reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason))
869		}
870		switch {
871		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
872			lines = append(lines, "git: ERROR "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
873		case checkout.Worktree.Bare:
874			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (bare repository)")
875		case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
876			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (checkout unavailable)")
877		default:
878			cleanliness := "clean"
879			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
880				cleanliness = "dirty — " + checkout.Status.Breakdown()
881			}
882			lines = append(lines,
883				"git: "+cleanliness,
884				"upstream: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Status.Upstream),

988		}
989		sort.Strings(states)
990		readiness := "blocked or unknown"
991		if inspection.Ready() {
992			readiness = "ready"
993		}
994		if len(states) == 0 {
995			states = append(states, "no classified intents")

1054	func (l *flowLoader) Plan(
1055		ctx context.Context,
1056		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1057		locator taskflow.Locator,
1058		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1059	) (taskflow.Plan, error) {
1060		expected, request, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1061		if err != nil {
1062			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1063		}
1064		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1065		if err != nil {
1066			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1067		}
1068		service, err := l.service(rt)
1069		if err != nil {
1070			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1071		}
1072		plan, err := service.Plan(ctx, request)
1073		if err != nil {
1074			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1075		}
1076		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1077			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1078		}
1079		l.mu.Lock()
1080		l.approved[plan.PlanID] = flowApprovedPlan{target: expected, plan: plan.Clone()}
1081		l.mu.Unlock()
1082		return plan, nil
1083	}

1085	func (l *flowLoader) Apply(
1086		ctx context.Context,
1087		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1088		locator taskflow.Locator,
1089		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1090		plan taskflow.Plan,
1091		approval taskflow.Approval,
1092	) (taskflow.Result, error) {
1093		expected, _, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1094		if err != nil {
1095			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1096		}
1097		l.mu.Lock()
1098		approved, ok := l.approved[plan.PlanID]
1099		l.mu.Unlock()
1100		if !ok {
1101			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply rejected a plan not produced by this run")
1102		}
1103		if !sameFlowTarget(approved.target, expected) {
1104			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply target differs from the approved repository, row, action, locator, or options")
1105		}
1106		if !reflect.DeepEqual(approved.plan.Clone(), plan.Clone()) {
1107			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply plan differs from the exact approved plan")
1108		}
1109		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1110			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1111		}
1112		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1113		if err != nil {
1114			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1115		}
1116		service, err := l.service(rt)
1117		if err != nil {
1118			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1119		}
1120		result, applyErr := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
1121		l.mu.Lock()
1122		delete(l.approved, plan.PlanID)
1123		if remote, exists := result.RemoteObservation(); exists {
1124			l.remote[repoKey] = remote.Clone()
1125		}
1126		l.mu.Unlock()
1127		return result, applyErr
1128	}

1130	func (l *flowLoader) validateTarget(
1131		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1132		locator taskflow.Locator,
1133		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1134	) (flowTarget, taskflow.Request, error) {
1135		request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(locator, options)
1136		if err != nil {
1137			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, err
1138		}
1139		key := flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID)
1140		l.mu.Lock()
1141		expected, ok := l.targets[repoKey][key]
1142		l.mu.Unlock()
1143		if !ok {
1144			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action no longer matches the current repository snapshot")
1145		}
1146		actual := flowTarget{repoKey: repoKey, rowKey: rowKey, actionID: actionID, request: request}
1147		if !sameFlowTarget(expected, actual) {
1148			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action locator or options differ from the current exact row choice")
1149		}
1150		return expected, request, nil
1151	}
1152	
1153	func validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan taskflow.Plan, expected flowTarget) error {
1154		if err := plan.Validate(); err != nil {
1155			return err
1156		}
1157		if plan.Locator != expected.request.Locator || plan.Request.Locator != expected.request.Locator ||
1158			plan.Action != expected.request.Action || plan.Request.Action != expected.request.Action ||
1159			!reflect.DeepEqual(plan.Request.Options, expected.request.Options) {
1160			return errors.New("taskflow plan does not match the exact flow request identity")
1161		}
1162		return nil
1163	}
1164	
1165	func sameFlowTarget(left, right flowTarget) bool {
1166		return left.repoKey == right.repoKey && left.rowKey == right.rowKey && left.actionID == right.actionID &&
1167			left.request.Locator == right.request.Locator && left.request.Action == right.request.Action &&
1168			reflect.DeepEqual(left.request.Options, right.request.Options)
1169	}
1170	
1171	func flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID string) string {
1172		return repoKey + "\x00" + rowKey + "\x00" + actionID
1173	}

1182	func emptyEvidence(value string) string {
1183		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
1184			return "(none)"

1186		return value

1189	func uniqueStrings(values []string) []string {
1190		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(values))
1191		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
1192		for _, value := range values {
1193			if value == "" || seen[value] {
1194				continue
1195			}
1196			seen[value] = true
1197			out = append(out, value)
1198		}
1199		return out
1200	}

16	type OccupancyProfile uint8

18	const (

21		// It is the zero value so an omitted profile fails toward exclusive ownership.
22		OccupancyStrict OccupancyProfile = iota

89	// InspectOccupancy collects independent runtime, recognized-agent, and caller

91	// observation failures are retained in their corresponding fields so each

93	func InspectOccupancy(ctx context.Context, rt Runtime, target string, opts OccupancyOptions) (Occupancy, error) {
94		checkout, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, target)
95		if err != nil {
96			return Occupancy{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize occupancy target: %w", err)
97		}
98		result := Occupancy{
99			Target:               checkout.path,
100			Backend:              "none",
101			Profile:              opts.Profile,
102			CallerWorkspaceID:    opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
103			ReportedCallerPaneID: opts.CallerPaneID,
104			CallerPaneID:         opts.CallerPaneID,
105		}
106		if rt == nil {
107			return result, nil
108		}
109		result.Backend = rt.Name()
110		if result.Backend == "none" {
111			return result, nil
112		}
113	
114		result.SessionList.Supported = true
115		resolver, resolvesCurrentPane := rt.(CurrentPaneResolver)
116		result.CurrentPane.Supported = resolvesCurrentPane
117		if resolvesCurrentPane && opts.CallerPaneID != "" {
118			result.CurrentPane.Attempted = true
119			result.CallerPaneID = ""
120			paneID, resolveErr := resolver.CurrentPaneID(ctx)
121			if resolveErr != nil {
122				result.CurrentPane.Err = resolveErr
123			} else if paneID == "" {
124				result.CurrentPane.Err = fmt.Errorf("current pane resolver returned an empty pane id")
125			} else {
126				result.CallerPaneID = paneID
127			}
128		}
129	
130		result.SessionList.Attempted = true
131		sessions, listErr := rt.List(ctx)
132		if listErr != nil {
133			result.SessionList.Err = listErr
134		} else {
135			for _, observed := range sessions {
136				covering, mixed, classifyErr := classifyOccupancySession(ctx, checkout, observed)
137				if classifyErr != nil {
138					result.SessionCoverageErr = classifyErr
139					result.Sessions = nil
140					break
141				}
142				if len(covering) == 0 {
143					continue
144				}
145				result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, OccupancySession{
146					Runtime: observed,
147					Panes:   covering,
148					Mixed:   mixed,
149					IsCaller: observed.Handle == opts.CallerWorkspaceID ||
150						occupancyPanePresent(observed.Panes, result.CallerPaneID),
151				})
152			}
153		}
154	
155		lister, listsAgents := rt.(AgentActivityLister)
156		result.AgentActivityList.Supported = listsAgents
157		if !listsAgents {
158			// Some backends can identify an agent on a pane without providing the
159			// richer recognized-agent inventory. Preserve that live evidence as the
160			// strict-profile fallback rather than treating an unsupported lister as an
161			// observed empty list.
162			for _, session := range result.Sessions {
163				for _, pane := range session.Panes {
164					if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" {
165						continue
166					}
167					cwd := pane.CWD
168					if cwd == "" {
169						cwd = pane.ShellCWD
170					}
171					activity := AgentActivity{
172						PaneID: pane.ID, WorkspaceID: session.Runtime.Handle,
173						Agent: pane.Agent, Status: pane.AgentStatus, CWD: cwd,
174					}

176						result.SessionCoverageErr = coverageErr
177						result.Agents = nil
178						return result, nil

180				}

182			return result, nil
183		}
184		result.AgentActivityList.Attempted = true

186		if activityErr != nil {
187			result.AgentActivityList.Err = activityErr
188			return result, nil
189		}
190		for _, activity := range activities {
191			if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
192				result.AgentActivityList.Err = coverageErr
193				result.Agents = nil
194				return result, nil
195			}
196		}
197		return result, nil

226	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
227		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
228		if err != nil {
229			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
230		}
231		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
232		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
233			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
234			if canonicalErr != nil {
235				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
236			}
237			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true}, nil
238		}
239		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
240			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
241		}
242		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
243	}

245	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string) (bool, error) {
246		if cwd == "" {
247			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
248		}
249		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
250		if err != nil {
251			return false, err
252		}
253		if target.git && activity.git {
254			return target.path == activity.path, nil
255		}
256		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
257	}

260		panes := session.Panes
261		if len(panes) == 0 {
262			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
263				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
264			}
265		}
266		var covering, mixed []Pane
267		for _, pane := range panes {
268			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
269			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
270				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
271			}
272			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
273			for _, path := range paths {
274				if path == "" {
275					continue
276				}
277				observed = true
278				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path)
279				if err != nil {
280					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
281				}
282				if inside {
283					paneCovers = true
284				} else {
285					paneOutside = true
286				}
287			}
288			if paneCovers {
289				covering = append(covering, pane)
290			}
291			if paneOutside || !observed {
292				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
293			}
294		}
295		return covering, mixed, nil
296	}
297	
298	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
299		if id == "" {
300			return false
301		}
302		for _, pane := range panes {
303			if pane.ID == id {
304				return true
305			}
306		}
307		return false
308	}
309	
310	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
311		for _, session := range sessions {
312			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
313				return session.Runtime.Handle
314			}
315			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
316				return session.Runtime.Handle
317			}
318		}
319		return ""
320	}
321	
322	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
323		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
324		if status == "" {
325			return "unknown"
326		}
327		return status
328	}
329	
330	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
331		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
332			return !caller
333		}
334		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
335		// with a freshly listed covering session.
336		if caller || !correlated {
337			return true
338		}
339		switch status {
340		case "idle", "done":
341			return false
342		case "unknown":
343			return !opts.CloseUnknown
344		default:
345			return true
346		}
347	}

70	// ReadinessInspection is a complete read-only observation for one exact
71	// checkout. KnownEmpty is true only when the store was read successfully and no
72	// intent matched the checkout; it distinguishes absence from failed observation.
73	type ReadinessInspection struct {
74		Checkout         string
75		KnownEmpty       bool
76		Intents          []IntentReadiness
77		ObservationError error

80	// Ready applies only the existing artifact finalization contract: an exact
81	// checkout is ready when it has no intents, or every intent was explicitly
82	// discarded or has a finalized receipt that is still reachable. Missing or
83	// incomplete evidence fails closed.
84	func (i ReadinessInspection) Ready() bool {
85		if i.ObservationError != nil {
86			return false
87		}
88		if len(i.Intents) == 0 {
89			return i.KnownEmpty
90		}
91		if i.KnownEmpty {
92			return false
93		}
94		for _, intent := range i.Intents {
95			if intent.ObservationError != nil {
96				return false
97			}
98			switch intent.State {
99			case ReadinessDiscarded:
100				// Discard is the existing explicit operator escape hatch.
101			case ReadinessFinalizedReachable:
102				if !intent.Finalized || !intent.ReceiptReachable {
103					return false
104				}
105			default:
106				return false
107			}
108		}
109		return true
110	}

112	// InspectReadiness gathers artifact finalization evidence for one exact
113	// checkout. It never reconciles receipts, finalizes intents, or writes either
114	// source files or intent records. The returned inspection retains partial
115	// evidence and the same wrapped error returned separately to ordinary callers.
116	func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
117		inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
118		if ctx == nil {
119			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")
120			inspection.ObservationError = err
121			return inspection, err
122		}
123		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
124			inspection.ObservationError = err
125			return inspection, err
126		}
127		if store == nil {
128			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a store")
129			inspection.ObservationError = err
130			return inspection, err
131		}
132	
133		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
134		if err != nil {
135			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
136			inspection.ObservationError = err
137			return inspection, err
138		}
139		inspection.Checkout = canonical
140	
141		intents, err := store.List()
142		if err != nil {
143			err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
144			inspection.ObservationError = err
145			return inspection, err
146		}
147		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
148			inspection.ObservationError = err
149			return inspection, err
150		}
151	
152		for _, intent := range intents {
153			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
154				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
155				break
156			}
157			intentCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
158			if err != nil {
159				err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, err)
160				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
161				continue
162			}
163			if intentCheckout != canonical {
164				continue
165			}
166	
167			evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
168			switch intent.Status {
169			case Armed, Finalizing:
170				evidence.State = ReadinessPending
171			case Failed:
172				evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
173			case Discarded:
174				evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
175			case Finalized:
176				evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, canonical, intent)
177				switch {
178				case err != nil:
179					err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
180					evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
181					evidence.ObservationError = err
182					inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
183				case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
184					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
185				default:
186					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
187				}
188			default:
189				// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
190				// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
191				err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
192				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
193				evidence.ObservationError = err
194				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
195			}
196			inspection.Intents = append(inspection.Intents, evidence)
197		}
198	
199		inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
200		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
201	}

203	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
204		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
205			return false, nil
206		}
207		candidates := []struct {
208			dir string
209			ref string
210		}{
211			{checkout, "HEAD"},
212			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
213			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
214		}
215		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
216		var observationErr error
217		for _, candidate := range candidates {
218			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
219				continue
220			}
221			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
222			if seen[key] {
223				continue
224			}
225			seen[key] = true
226			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
227				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
228			}
229			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
230				return true, nil
231			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
232				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
233					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
234			}
235		}
236		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
237			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
238		}
239		return false, observationErr
240	}
241	
242	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
243		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
244		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
245	}
246	
247	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
248		if current == nil {
249			return next
250		}
251		if next == nil {
252			return current
253		}
254		return errors.Join(current, next)
255	}

368	func (s *Service) Finalize(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
369		if s.Store == nil {
370			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
371		}
372		intent, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
373		if err != nil {
374			return nil, err
375		}

379			current, err := s.resolveIntent(request)

401				return nil, err

433		}
434		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"add", "--"}, paths...)...); err != nil {
435			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "stage-failed", err)
436		}
437		cleanup := func() {
438			_, _ = gitx.Run(context.Background(), intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"reset", "--"}, paths...)...)
439		}

441			cleanup()
442			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scan-failed", err)
443		}
444		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
445			cleanup()

447		}
448		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
449			cleanup()
450			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
451		}
452		if err := stagedFilesMatch(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
453			cleanup()
454			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
455		}
456		message := fmt.Sprintf("chore: finalize %s agent session", intent.Provider)
457		trailers := fmt.Sprintf("Agent-Artifact-Session: %s:%s\nDev-Artifact-Intent: %s", intent.Provider, intent.SessionID, intent.ID)
458		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "commit", "-m", message, "-m", trailers); err != nil {
459			cleanup()

461		}
462		commit, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
463		if err != nil {

465		}

474			return s.Store.Get(request.IntentID)
475		}
476		if request.RunID != "" {

482	func (s *Service) revalidate(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
483		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
484		if err != nil {
485			return err
486		}
487		if repository.GitCommonDir != intent.GitCommonDir {
488			return fmt.Errorf("Git common-dir changed")
489		}
490		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
491		if err != nil {
492			return err
493		}
494		if status.Branch != intent.Branch || status.Detached {
495			return fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
496		}
497		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(intent.WorktreePath); err != nil {
498			return err
499		} else if active {
500			return fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
501		}
502		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
503		if err != nil {
504			return err
505		}
506		if head != intent.Head {
507			return fmt.Errorf("HEAD changed from %s to %s", intent.Head, head)
508		}
509		return nil
510	}

514			intent.Status = Failed
515			intent.FailureCode = code
516			return nil
517		})
518		return fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization %s: %w", code, cause)
519	}

533		Staged bool

536	func statusPaths(ctx context.Context, repo string) ([]statusPath, error) {
537		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
538		if err != nil {
539			return nil, err
540		}
541		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
542		var paths []statusPath
543		for i := 0; i < len(fields); i++ {
544			entry := fields[i]
545			if len(entry) < 4 {
546				continue
547			}
548			code, path := entry[:2], filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:])
549			paths = append(paths, statusPath{Path: path, Staged: code[0] != ' ' && code[0] != '?'})
550			if code[0] == 'R' || code[0] == 'C' {
551				i++ // porcelain -z emits the source path as the next field.
552			}
553		}
554		return paths, nil
555	}
556	
557	func isRecognizedArtifact(path string) bool {
558		path = filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(path, "./"))
559		for _, prefix := range []string{
560			".specstory/history/", ".claude/plans/", ".cursor/plans/", ".cursor/rules/",
561			".opencode/plans/", ".specify/", ".codex/",
562		} {
563			if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
564				return true
565			}
566		}
567		return path == ".specstory/statistics.json"
568	}
569	
570	func normalizePlans(root string, paths []string) ([]string, error) {
571		var out []string
572		for _, path := range paths {
573			if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
574				path = filepath.Join(root, path)
575			}
576			inside, err := pathx.Contains(filepath.Join(root, ".claude", "plans"), path)
577			if err != nil || !inside {
578				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is outside .claude/plans", path)
579			}
580			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
581			if err != nil {
582				return nil, err
583			}
584			info, err := os.Stat(canonical)
585			if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
586				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is not a regular file", path)
587			}
588			out = append(out, canonical)
589		}
590		sort.Strings(out)
591		return out, nil
592	}

594	func gitTracked(ctx context.Context, repo, path string) (bool, error) {
595		rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
596		if err != nil {
597			return false, err
598		}
599		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", "--", rel)
600		if err == nil {
601			return true, nil
602		}
603		var gitErr *gitx.Error
604		if errors.As(err, &gitErr) {
605			return false, nil
606		}
607		return false, err
608	}
609	
610	func ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx context.Context, repo string, allowed []string) error {
611		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z")
612		if err != nil {
613			return err
614		}
615		allow := make(map[string]bool, len(allowed))
616		for _, path := range allowed {
617			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
618			allow[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
619		}
620		for _, path := range strings.Split(out, "\x00") {
621			if path != "" && !allow[filepath.ToSlash(path)] {
622				return fmt.Errorf("index contains unrelated path %s", path)
623			}
624		}
625		return nil
626	}
627	
628	func stagedFilesMatch(ctx context.Context, repo string, paths []string) error {
629		for _, path := range paths {
630			rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
631			if err != nil {
632				return err
633			}
634			workingBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "hash-object", "--", rel)
635			if err != nil {
636				return err
637			}
638			stagedBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "rev-parse", ":"+filepath.ToSlash(rel))
639			if err != nil {
640				return err
641			}
642			if workingBlob != stagedBlob {
643				return fmt.Errorf("staged artifact %s no longer matches scanned working bytes", filepath.ToSlash(rel))
644			}
645		}
646		return nil
647	}
648	
649	func findReceipt(ctx context.Context, repo, intentID string) (string, bool) {
650		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "log", "-n", "100", "--format=%H%x00%B%x00")
651		if err != nil {
652			return "", false
653		}
654		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
655		for i := 0; i+1 < len(fields); i += 2 {
656			if strings.Contains(fields[i+1], "Dev-Artifact-Intent: "+intentID) {
657				return fields[i], true
658			}
659		}
660		return "", false
661	}

84	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
85	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
86		clean := func(s string) string {
87			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
88			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
89				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
90			}
91			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
92		}
93		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
94		if r == "" {

96		}
97		if b == "" {
98			b = "branch"
99		}
100		return r + "__" + b
101	}

178	// listRecordsUnlocked implements both the public read-only inventory and the

181	func (s *Store) listRecordsUnlocked() ([]Record, []Diagnostic, error) {
182		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)

184			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
185				return nil, nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
186			}

206		sortRecords(records)
207		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
