123	func (s *lifecycleService) locateRegisteredCheckout(
124		ctx context.Context,
125		candidate task.Task,
126		repoPath string,
127		expectedCheckout string,
128	) (gitx.RegisteredWorktree, bool) {
129		if expectedCheckout != "" {
130			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
131			return registered, err == nil
132		}
133		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree || candidate.State != task.Cold {
134			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
135		}
136	
137		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, repoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
140		}
141		match := ""
142		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
143			if worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch {
144				continue
145			}
146			if match != "" {
147				return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
148			}
149			match = worktree.Path
150		}
151		if match == "" {
152			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
153		}
154		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, match)
155		return registered, err == nil
156	}
157	
158	func (s *lifecycleService) branchUpstream(ctx context.Context, repoPath, branch string) string {
159		if branch == "" {
160			return ""
161		}
162		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath,
163			"for-each-ref", "--format=%(upstream:short)", localBranchRef(branch),
164		)
165		if err != nil {
166			return ""
167		}
168		return strings.TrimSpace(value)
169	}

func guardSharedCheckout(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout string) error {
	if app.allowSharedCheckout {
		return nil
	}
	excludePane, err := callerPaneID(ctx, rt)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
	}
	activities, err := checkoutAgentActivities(ctx, rt, checkout, excludePane)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
	}
	if len(activities) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	var occupied []string
	for _, activity := range activities {
		label := activity.Agent
		if activity.Name != "" {
			label = activity.Name
		}
		if label == "" {
			label = "agent"
		}
		state := activity.Status
		if state == "" {
			state = "unknown"
		}
		occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, state, activity.PaneID))
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
		config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
}

func callerPaneID(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime) (string, error) {
	inherited := os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
	if inherited == "" {
		return "", nil
	}
	if resolver, ok := rt.(runtime.CurrentPaneResolver); ok {
		return resolver.CurrentPaneID(ctx)
	}
	return inherited, nil
}

+// ReadinessState classifies one intent without changing its durable record.
+type ReadinessState string
+
+const (
+	ReadinessPending              ReadinessState = "pending"
+	ReadinessFailed               ReadinessState = "failed"
+	ReadinessDiscarded            ReadinessState = "discarded"
+	ReadinessFinalizedReachable   ReadinessState = "finalized-reachable"
+	ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable ReadinessState = "finalized-unreachable"
+	ReadinessObservationError     ReadinessState = "observation-error"
+)
+
+// IntentReadiness is the read-only finalization evidence for one intent whose
+// recorded worktree is the exact checkout being inspected.
+type IntentReadiness struct {
+	Intent           Intent
+	State            ReadinessState
+	Finalized        bool
+	ReceiptReachable bool
+	ObservationError error
+}
+
+// ReadinessInspection is a complete read-only observation for one exact
+// checkout. KnownEmpty is true only when the store was read successfully and no
+// intent matched the checkout; it distinguishes absence from failed observation.
+type ReadinessInspection struct {
+	Checkout         string
+	KnownEmpty       bool
+	Intents          []IntentReadiness
+	ObservationError error
+}
+

89	// InspectOccupancy collects independent runtime, recognized-agent, and caller
90	// evidence for target. Initial target canonicalization errors are returned;
91	// observation failures are retained in their corresponding fields so each
92	// action can apply its own fail-closed acknowledgement policy.
93	func InspectOccupancy(ctx context.Context, rt Runtime, target string, opts OccupancyOptions) (Occupancy, error) {
94		checkout, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, target)
95		if err != nil {
96			return Occupancy{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize occupancy target: %w", err)
97		}
98		result := Occupancy{
99			Target:               checkout.path,
100			Backend:              "none",
101			Profile:              opts.Profile,
102			CallerWorkspaceID:    opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
103			ReportedCallerPaneID: opts.CallerPaneID,
104			CallerPaneID:         opts.CallerPaneID,
105		}
106		if rt == nil {
107			return result, nil
108		}
109		result.Backend = rt.Name()
110		if result.Backend == "none" {
111			return result, nil
112		}
113	
114		result.SessionList.Supported = true
115		resolver, resolvesCurrentPane := rt.(CurrentPaneResolver)
116		result.CurrentPane.Supported = resolvesCurrentPane
117		if resolvesCurrentPane && opts.CallerPaneID != "" {
118			result.CurrentPane.Attempted = true
119			result.CallerPaneID = ""
120			paneID, resolveErr := resolver.CurrentPaneID(ctx)
121			if resolveErr != nil {
122				result.CurrentPane.Err = resolveErr
123			} else if paneID == "" {
124				result.CurrentPane.Err = fmt.Errorf("current pane resolver returned an empty pane id")
125			} else {
126				result.CallerPaneID = paneID
127			}
128		}
129	
130		result.SessionList.Attempted = true
131		sessions, listErr := rt.List(ctx)
132		if listErr != nil {
133			result.SessionList.Err = listErr
134		} else {
135			for _, observed := range sessions {
136				covering, mixed, classifyErr := classifyOccupancySession(ctx, checkout, observed)
137				if classifyErr != nil {
138					result.SessionCoverageErr = classifyErr
139					result.Sessions = nil
140					break
141				}
142				if len(covering) == 0 {
143					continue
144				}
145				result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, OccupancySession{
146					Runtime: observed,
147					Panes:   covering,
148					Mixed:   mixed,
149					IsCaller: observed.Handle == opts.CallerWorkspaceID ||
150						occupancyPanePresent(observed.Panes, result.CallerPaneID),
151				})
152			}
153		}
154	
155		lister, listsAgents := rt.(AgentActivityLister)
156		result.AgentActivityList.Supported = listsAgents
157		if !listsAgents {
158			// Some backends can identify an agent on a pane without providing the
159			// richer recognized-agent inventory. Preserve that live evidence as the
160			// strict-profile fallback rather than treating an unsupported lister as an
161			// observed empty list.
162			for _, session := range result.Sessions {
163				for _, pane := range session.Panes {
164					if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" {
165						continue
166					}
167					cwd := pane.CWD
168					if cwd == "" {
169						cwd = pane.ShellCWD
170					}
171					activity := AgentActivity{
172						PaneID: pane.ID, WorkspaceID: session.Runtime.Handle,
173						Agent: pane.Agent, Status: pane.AgentStatus, CWD: cwd,
174					}
175					if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
176						result.SessionCoverageErr = coverageErr
177						result.Agents = nil
178						return result, nil
179					}
180				}
181			}
182			return result, nil
183		}
184		result.AgentActivityList.Attempted = true
185		activities, activityErr := lister.AgentActivities(ctx)
186		if activityErr != nil {
187			result.AgentActivityList.Err = activityErr
188			return result, nil
189		}
190		for _, activity := range activities {
191			if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
192				result.AgentActivityList.Err = coverageErr
193				result.Agents = nil
194				return result, nil
195			}
196		}
197		return result, nil
198	}

200	func appendOccupancyAgent(ctx context.Context, result *Occupancy, checkout checkoutIdentity, opts OccupancyOptions, activity AgentActivity) error {
201		covered, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, checkout, activity.CWD)
202		if err != nil {
203			return fmt.Errorf("classify recognized agent pane %s: %w", activity.PaneID, err)
204		}
205		if !covered {
206			return nil
207		}
208		status := normalizeOccupancyStatus(activity.Status)
209		caller := result.CallerPaneID != "" && activity.PaneID == result.CallerPaneID
210		handle := correlatedSession(result.Sessions, activity)
211		result.Agents = append(result.Agents, OccupancyAgent{
212			Activity:      activity,
213			Status:        status,
214			SessionHandle: handle,
215			IsCaller:      caller,
216			Blocking:      occupancyAgentBlocks(opts, status, caller, handle != ""),
217		})
218		return nil
219	}

221	type checkoutIdentity struct {
222		path string
223		git  bool
224	}
225	
226	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
227		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
228		if err != nil {
229			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
230		}
231		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
232		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
233			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
234			if canonicalErr != nil {
235				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
236			}
237			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true}, nil
238		}
239		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
240			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
241		}
242		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string) (bool, error) {
246		if cwd == "" {
247			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
248		}
249		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
250		if err != nil {
251			return false, err
252		}
253		if target.git && activity.git {
254			return target.path == activity.path, nil
255		}
256		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
257	}
258	
259	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
260		panes := session.Panes
261		if len(panes) == 0 {
262			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
263				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
264			}
265		}
266		var covering, mixed []Pane
267		for _, pane := range panes {
268			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
269			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
270				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
271			}
272			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
273			for _, path := range paths {
274				if path == "" {
275					continue
276				}
277				observed = true
278				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path)
279				if err != nil {
280					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
281				}
282				if inside {
283					paneCovers = true
284				} else {
285					paneOutside = true
286				}
287			}
288			if paneCovers {
289				covering = append(covering, pane)
290			}
291			if paneOutside || !observed {
292				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
293			}
294		}
295		return covering, mixed, nil
296	}
297	
298	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
299		if id == "" {
300			return false
301		}
302		for _, pane := range panes {
303			if pane.ID == id {
304				return true
305			}
306		}
307		return false
308	}
309	
310	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
311		for _, session := range sessions {
312			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
313				return session.Runtime.Handle
314			}
315			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
316				return session.Runtime.Handle
317			}
318		}
319		return ""
320	}
321	
322	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
323		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
324		if status == "" {
325			return "unknown"
326		}
327		return status
328	}
329	
330	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
331		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
332			return !caller
333		}
334		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
335		// with a freshly listed covering session.
336		if caller || !correlated {
337			return true
338		}
339		switch status {
340		case "idle", "done":
341			return false
342		case "unknown":
343			return !opts.CloseUnknown
344		default:
345			return true
346		}
347	}

1	// Package retire coordinates destructive cleanup from outside the runtime and
2	// worktree being retired.
3	package retire
4	
5	import (
6		"context"
7		"fmt"
8		"os"
9		"sort"
10		"strings"
11		"time"
12	
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
15	)
16	
17	// Options controls only fail-closed observations. Caller protection and active
18	// agent states are never bypassable.
19	type Options struct {
20		CWD               string
21		CallerWorkspaceID string
22		CallerPaneID      string
23		CloseUnknown      bool
24		AssumeNoRuntime   bool
25		PollInterval      time.Duration
26		Timeout           time.Duration
27	}
28	
29	// Session is one runtime session that currently covers the target checkout.
30	type Session struct {
31		Runtime runtime.Session
32		Panes   []runtime.Pane
33		Mixed   []runtime.Pane
34	}
35	
36	// Inspection is a fresh view of every runtime surface covering a checkout.
37	type Inspection struct {
38		Target          string
39		Sessions        []Session
40		ClosedSessions  int
41		Blockers        []string
42		RuntimeUnknown  bool
43		CallerContained bool
44	}
45	
46	// Ready reports whether destructive cleanup may proceed.
47	func (i Inspection) Ready() bool { return len(i.Blockers) == 0 }
48	
49	// Inspect discovers covering sessions and applies caller, mixed-workspace, and
50	// agent-state safety policy.
51	func Inspect(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
52		runtimeName := ""
53		if rt != nil {
54			runtimeName = rt.Name()
55		}
56		if opts.CallerWorkspaceID == "" && runtimeName != "tmux" && runtimeName != "zellij" && runtimeName != "none" {
57			opts.CallerWorkspaceID = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
58		}
59		if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
60			switch runtimeName {
61			case "herdr":
62				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
63			case "tmux":
64				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
65			case "zellij", "none":
66			default:
67				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
68				if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
69					opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
70				}
71			}
72		}
73		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, target, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
74			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyCleanup,
75			CallerWorkspaceID: opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
76			CallerPaneID:      opts.CallerPaneID,
77			CloseUnknown:      opts.CloseUnknown,
78		})
79		if err != nil {
80			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect retirement occupancy: %w", err)
81		}
82		result := Inspection{Target: evidence.Target}
83		cwd := opts.CWD
84		if cwd == "" {
85			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
86			if err != nil {
87				return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve caller directory: %w", err)
88			}
89		}
90		if inside, compareErr := pathx.Contains(evidence.Target, cwd); compareErr != nil {
91			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("compare caller directory: %w", compareErr)
92		} else if inside {
93			result.CallerContained = true
94			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
95				fmt.Sprintf("caller is inside target checkout %s", evidence.Target))
96		}
97	
98		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
99			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve current %s runtime pane: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
100		}
101		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
102			return Inspection{}, evidence.SessionCoverageErr
103		}
104		if !evidence.SessionList.Supported {
105			return dedupe(result), nil
106		}
107		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
108			if !opts.AssumeNoRuntime {
109				return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("list %s runtime sessions: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.SessionList.Err)
110			}
111			result.RuntimeUnknown = true
112		}
113		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
114			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("list %s recognized agents: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
115		}
116		for _, observed := range evidence.Sessions {
117			result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, Session{
118				Runtime: observed.Runtime,
119				Panes:   observed.Panes,
120				Mixed:   observed.Mixed,
121			})
122			if observed.IsCaller {
123				result.CallerContained = true
124				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
125					fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", observed.Runtime.Handle))
126			}
127			if len(observed.Mixed) > 0 {
128				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
129					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s also contains %d pane(s) outside the target", observed.Runtime.Handle, len(observed.Mixed)))
130			}
131			for _, status := range coveringAgentStatuses(observed.Panes, observed.Runtime.AgentStatus) {
132				appendAgentStatusBlocker(&result, observed.Runtime.Handle, status, opts.CloseUnknown)
133			}
134		}
135		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
136			if !agent.Blocking {
137				continue
138			}
139			if agent.IsCaller {
140				result.CallerContained = true
141				if agent.SessionHandle != "" {
142					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
143						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", agent.SessionHandle))
144				} else {
145					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
146						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime pane %s contains the target checkout", agent.Activity.PaneID))
147				}
148				continue
149			}
150			if agent.SessionHandle == "" {
151				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
152					fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent in pane %s covers the target without a closeable runtime session", agent.Activity.PaneID))
153				continue
154			}
155			appendAgentStatusBlocker(&result, agent.SessionHandle, agent.Status, opts.CloseUnknown)
156		}
157		return dedupe(result), nil
158	}

160	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
161	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
162	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
163		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
164		if err != nil {
165			return inspection, err
166		}
167		if !inspection.Ready() {
168			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
169		}
170		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
171			return inspection, nil
172		}
173		interval := opts.PollInterval
174		if interval <= 0 {
175			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
176		}
177		timeout := opts.Timeout
178		if timeout <= 0 {
179			timeout = 5 * time.Second
180		}
181		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
182		closed := make(map[string]bool)
183		for {
184			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
185			if inspectErr != nil {
186				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
187			}
188			if !fresh.Ready() {
189				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
190			}
191			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
192				inspection.Sessions = nil
193				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
194				return inspection, nil
195			}
196			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
197				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
198					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
199			}
200			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
201				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
202				if closed[handle] {
203					continue
204				}
205				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
206					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
207				}
208				closed[handle] = true
209				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
210			}
211			select {
212			case <-ctx.Done():
213				return inspection, ctx.Err()
214			case <-time.After(interval):
215			}
216		}
217	}
218	
219	func coveringAgentStatuses(panes []runtime.Pane, fallback string) []string {
220		set := make(map[string]bool)
221		for _, pane := range panes {
222			if pane.Agent != "" || pane.AgentSession != "" || pane.AgentStatus != "" {
223				set[strings.ToLower(pane.AgentStatus)] = true
224			}
225		}
226		if len(set) == 0 {
227			set[strings.ToLower(fallback)] = true
228		}
229		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
230		for status := range set {
231			out = append(out, status)
232		}
233		sort.Strings(out)
234		return out
235	}
236	
237	func appendAgentStatusBlocker(result *Inspection, handle, rawStatus string, closeUnknown bool) {
238		status := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawStatus))
239		switch status {
240		case "idle", "done":
241			// Eligible after all structural checks pass.
242		case "working", "running", "busy", "blocked", "waiting":
243			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
244				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has agent status %s", handle, status))
245		case "", "unknown":
246			if !closeUnknown {
247				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
248					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unknown agent status; pass --close-unknown from outside it", handle))
249			}
250		default:
251			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
252				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unrecognized agent status %s", handle, status))
253		}
254	}
255	
256	func dedupe(inspection Inspection) Inspection {
257		seen := make(map[string]bool)
258		out := inspection.Blockers[:0]
259		for _, blocker := range inspection.Blockers {
260			if !seen[blocker] {
261				seen[blocker] = true
262				out = append(out, blocker)
263			}
264		}
265		inspection.Blockers = out
266		return inspection
267	}

1	package cli

3	import (
4		"context"

13	func guardSharedCheckout(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout string) error {
14		if app.allowSharedCheckout {
15			return nil
16		}
17		reportedPane := ""
18		if rt != nil {
19			switch rt.Name() {
20			case "herdr":
21				reportedPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
22			case "tmux":
23				reportedPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
24			}
25		}
26		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
27			Profile:      runtime.OccupancyStrict,
28			CallerPaneID: reportedPane,
29		})
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("check live occupancy before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
32		}
33		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
34			return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
35		}
36		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("classify live runtime coverage before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionCoverageErr)
38		}
39		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("list live runtime sessions before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionList.Err)
41		}
42		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
44		}
45	
46		var occupied []string
47		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
48			if !agent.Blocking {
49				continue
50			}
51			activity := agent.Activity
52			label := activity.Agent
53			if activity.Name != "" {
54				label = activity.Name
55			}
56			if label == "" {
57				label = "agent"
58			}
59			occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, activity.PaneID))
60		}
61		if len(occupied) == 0 {
62			return nil
63		}
64		return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
65			config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
66	}
67	
68	// checkoutAgentActivities returns recognized agents whose reported cwd resolves
69	// to the same canonical Git worktree root as checkout. A pane is excluded only
70	// when its exact ID matches excludePane; lifecycle state never makes it free.
71	func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {
72		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{Profile: runtime.OccupancyStrict})
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
77			return nil, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err
78		}
79		out := make([]runtime.AgentActivity, 0, len(evidence.Agents))
80		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
81			if excludePane == "" || agent.Activity.PaneID != excludePane {
82				out = append(out, agent.Activity)
83			}
84		}
85		return out, nil
86	}

1	// Package retire coordinates destructive cleanup from outside the runtime and
2	// worktree being retired.
3	package retire
4	
5	import (
6		"context"
7		"fmt"
8		"os"
9		"sort"
10		"strings"
11		"time"
12	
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
15	)
16	
17	// Options controls only fail-closed observations. Caller protection and active
18	// agent states are never bypassable.
19	type Options struct {
20		CWD               string
21		CallerWorkspaceID string
22		CallerPaneID      string
23		CloseUnknown      bool
24		AssumeNoRuntime   bool
25		PollInterval      time.Duration
26		Timeout           time.Duration
27	}
28	
29	// Session is one runtime session that currently covers the target checkout.
30	type Session struct {
31		Runtime runtime.Session
32		Panes   []runtime.Pane
33		Mixed   []runtime.Pane
34	}
35	
36	// Inspection is a fresh view of every runtime surface covering a checkout.
37	type Inspection struct {
38		Target          string
39		Sessions        []Session
40		ClosedSessions  int
41		Blockers        []string
42		RuntimeUnknown  bool
43		CallerContained bool
44	}
45	
46	// Ready reports whether destructive cleanup may proceed.
47	func (i Inspection) Ready() bool { return len(i.Blockers) == 0 }
48	
49	// Inspect discovers covering sessions and applies caller, mixed-workspace, and
50	// agent-state safety policy.
51	func Inspect(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
52		runtimeName := ""
53		if rt != nil {
54			runtimeName = rt.Name()
55		}
56		if opts.CallerWorkspaceID == "" && runtimeName != "tmux" && runtimeName != "zellij" && runtimeName != "none" {
57			opts.CallerWorkspaceID = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
58		}
59		if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
60			switch runtimeName {
61			case "herdr":
62				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
63			case "tmux":
64				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
65			case "zellij", "none":
66			default:
67				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
68				if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
69					opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
70				}
71			}
72		}
73		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, target, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
74			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyCleanup,
75			CallerWorkspaceID: opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
76			CallerPaneID:      opts.CallerPaneID,
77			CloseUnknown:      opts.CloseUnknown,
78		})
79		if err != nil {
80			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect retirement occupancy: %w", err)
81		}
82		result := Inspection{Target: evidence.Target}
83		cwd := opts.CWD
84		if cwd == "" {
85			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
86			if err != nil {
87				return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve caller directory: %w", err)
88			}
89		}
90		if inside, compareErr := pathx.Contains(evidence.Target, cwd); compareErr != nil {
91			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("compare caller directory: %w", compareErr)
92		} else if inside {
93			result.CallerContained = true
94			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
95				fmt.Sprintf("caller is inside target checkout %s", evidence.Target))
96		}
97	
98		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
99			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve current %s runtime pane: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
100		}
101		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
102			return Inspection{}, evidence.SessionCoverageErr
103		}
104		if !evidence.SessionList.Supported {
105			return dedupe(result), nil
106		}
107		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
108			if !opts.AssumeNoRuntime {
109				return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("list %s runtime sessions: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.SessionList.Err)
110			}
111			result.RuntimeUnknown = true
112		}
113		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
114			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("list %s recognized agents: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
115		}
116		for _, observed := range evidence.Sessions {
117			result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, Session{
118				Runtime: observed.Runtime,
119				Panes:   observed.Panes,
120				Mixed:   observed.Mixed,
121			})
122			if observed.IsCaller {
123				result.CallerContained = true
124				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
125					fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", observed.Runtime.Handle))
126			}
127			if len(observed.Mixed) > 0 {
128				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
129					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s also contains %d pane(s) outside the target", observed.Runtime.Handle, len(observed.Mixed)))
130			}
131			for _, status := range coveringAgentStatuses(observed.Panes, observed.Runtime.AgentStatus) {
132				appendAgentStatusBlocker(&result, observed.Runtime.Handle, status, opts.CloseUnknown)
133			}
134		}
135		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
136			if !agent.Blocking {
137				continue
138			}
139			if agent.IsCaller {
140				result.CallerContained = true
141				if agent.SessionHandle != "" {
142					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
143						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", agent.SessionHandle))
144				} else {
145					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
146						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime pane %s contains the target checkout", agent.Activity.PaneID))
147				}
148				continue
149			}
150			if agent.SessionHandle == "" {
151				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
152					fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent in pane %s covers the target without a closeable runtime session", agent.Activity.PaneID))
153				continue
154			}
155			appendAgentStatusBlocker(&result, agent.SessionHandle, agent.Status, opts.CloseUnknown)
156		}
157		return dedupe(result), nil
158	}

160	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
161	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
162	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
163		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
164		if err != nil {
165			return inspection, err
166		}
167		if !inspection.Ready() {
168			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
169		}
170		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
171			return inspection, nil
172		}
173		interval := opts.PollInterval
174		if interval <= 0 {
175			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
176		}
177		timeout := opts.Timeout
178		if timeout <= 0 {
179			timeout = 5 * time.Second
180		}
181		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
182		closed := make(map[string]bool)
183		for {
184			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
185			if inspectErr != nil {
186				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
187			}
188			if !fresh.Ready() {
189				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
190			}
191			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
192				inspection.Sessions = nil
193				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
194				return inspection, nil
195			}
196			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
197				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
198					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
199			}
200			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
201				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
202				if closed[handle] {
203					continue
204				}
205				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
206					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
207				}
208				closed[handle] = true
209				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
210			}
211			select {
212			case <-ctx.Done():
213				return inspection, ctx.Err()
214			case <-time.After(interval):
215			}
216		}
217	}
218

13	// Worktree is one entry of `git worktree list --porcelain`.
14	type Worktree struct {
15		Path string
16		// Head is the commit the worktree is checked out at.
17		Head string
18		// Branch is the short branch name, empty when detached.
19		Branch   string
20		Detached bool
21		Bare     bool
22		// Locked reports a `git worktree lock`; Prunable reports a checkout whose
23		// directory has gone missing. Both block a plain remove.
24		Locked         bool
25		LockedReason   string
26		Prunable       bool
27		PrunableReason string
28		// Main reports the primary (non-linked) checkout.
29		Main bool
30	}
31	
32	var (
33		// ErrWorktreeNotFound reports that Git's current registry has no worktree at
34		// the requested canonical path.
35		ErrWorktreeNotFound = errors.New("registered worktree not found")
36		// ErrWorktreeAmbiguous reports that multiple Git records resolve to the same
37		// canonical path. Callers must not choose one of the aliases implicitly.
38		ErrWorktreeAmbiguous = errors.New("registered worktree path is ambiguous")
39	)
40	
41	// RegisteredWorktree is an identity snapshot from Git's worktree registry.
42	// Worktree preserves the complete parsed Git record; the other fields are canonical
43	// filesystem identities suitable for exact comparison across symlink and macOS
44	// path aliases. A snapshot proves registration, not permission to remove it.
45	type RegisteredWorktree struct {
46		Worktree       Worktree
47		RepositoryPath string
48		GitCommonDir   string
49		Path           string
50	}
51	
52	// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether the record is a linked checkout rather than
53	// Git's main checkout or a bare repository. It is classification, not a removal
54	// safety decision.
55	func (w RegisteredWorktree) IsLinkedWorktree() bool {
56		return !w.Worktree.Main && !w.Worktree.Bare
57	}
58	
59	// ResolveRegisteredWorktree resolves exactPath against a fresh authoritative
60	// `git worktree list --porcelain` query for the repository containing repoPath.
61	// Matching is exclusively by canonical filesystem identity, never by branch.
62	// It performs no prune, removal, or other mutation.
63	func ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx context.Context, repoPath, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
64		worktrees, err := Worktrees(ctx, repoPath)
65		if err != nil {
66			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("query registered worktrees: %w", err)
67		}
68		commonDir, err := run(ctx, repoPath, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir")
69		if err != nil {
70			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve Git common directory: %w", err)
71		}
72		return resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees, commonDir, exactPath)
73	}
74	
75	func resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees []Worktree, commonDir, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
76		path, err := pathx.Canonical(exactPath)
77		if err != nil {
78			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize requested worktree %q: %w", exactPath, err)
79		}
80		canonicalCommonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
81		if err != nil {
82			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory %q: %w", commonDir, err)
83		}
84	
85		type match struct {
86			worktree Worktree
87			path     string
88		}
89		var (
90			repositoryPath string
91			matches        []match
92		)
93		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
94			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
95			if canonicalErr != nil {
96				return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize registered worktree %q: %w", worktree.Path, canonicalErr)
97			}
98			if worktree.Main {
99				repositoryPath = canonicalPath
100			}
101			if sameCanonicalPath(path, canonicalPath) {
102				matches = append(matches, match{worktree: worktree, path: canonicalPath})
103			}
104		}
105	
106		switch len(matches) {
107		case 0:
108			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrWorktreeNotFound, path)
109		case 1:
110			if repositoryPath == "" {
111				return RegisteredWorktree{}, errors.New("registered worktree query has no main repository record")
112			}
113			return RegisteredWorktree{
114				Worktree:       matches[0].worktree,
115				RepositoryPath: repositoryPath,
116				GitCommonDir:   canonicalCommonDir,
117				Path:           matches[0].path,
118			}, nil
119		default:
120			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s resolves to %d records", ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, path, len(matches))
121		}
122	}
123	
124	func sameCanonicalPath(left, right string) bool {
125		if left == right {
126			return true
127		}
128		leftInfo, leftErr := os.Stat(left)
129		rightInfo, rightErr := os.Stat(right)
130		return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && os.SameFile(leftInfo, rightInfo)
131	}

133	// Worktrees lists every worktree of the repository containing dir, in git's
134	// own order: the main checkout first, then linked worktrees.
135	func Worktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]Worktree, error) {
136		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		var (
141			list []Worktree
142			cur  *Worktree
143		)
144		flush := func() {
145			if cur != nil {
146				list = append(list, *cur)
147				cur = nil
148			}
149		}
150		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
151			if line == "" { // records are blank-line separated
152				flush()
153				continue
154			}
155			key, val, _ := strings.Cut(line, " ")
156			switch key {
157			case "worktree":
158				flush()
159				cur = &Worktree{Path: val, Main: len(list) == 0}
160			case "HEAD":
161				if cur != nil {
162					cur.Head = val
163				}
164			case "branch":
165				if cur != nil {
166					cur.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(val, "refs/heads/")
167				}
168			case "detached":
169				if cur != nil {
170					cur.Detached = true
171				}

211	// silently inherit feature/A's commits.

279		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}

89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104

115		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
116			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
117		default:
118			return canonicalCandidate, nil
119		}
120	}

122	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
123	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
124	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
125		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)

128		}

130			return false, nil
131		}
132		return false, err
133	}

206	// Request binds one action and its typed options to an exact selected locator.
207	// DisplayedAt may be used by a caller but does not contribute to plan identity.
208	type Request struct {
209		Locator     Locator
210		Action      Action
211		Options     ActionOptions
212		DisplayedAt time.Time
213	}
214	
215	// NewRequest infers the action from options and returns a normalized value.
216	func NewRequest(locator Locator, options ActionOptions) (Request, error) {
217		if options == nil {
218			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action options are required", ErrInvalidRequest)
219		}
220		normalized, err := cloneActionOptions(options, "")
221		if err != nil {
222			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
223		}
224		request := Request{Locator: locator, Action: normalized.Action(), Options: normalized}
225		return normalizeRequest(request)
226	}
227	
228	// Clone returns a request whose option-owned collection values are independent.
229	func (r Request) Clone() Request {
230		options, err := cloneActionOptions(r.Options, r.Action)
231		if err == nil {
232			r.Options = options
233		}
234		return r
235	}
236	
237	// Validate checks option/action agreement and graph legality without performing
238	// observations or side effects.
239	func (r Request) Validate() error {
240		_, err := normalizeRequest(r)
241		return err
242	}
243	
244	func normalizeRequest(request Request) (Request, error) {
245		if !request.Action.Valid() {
246			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown action %q", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action)
247		}
248		options, err := cloneActionOptions(request.Options, request.Action)
249		if err != nil {
250			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
251		}
252		if options.Action() != request.Action {
253			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action %s cannot use %s options", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, options.Action())
254		}
255		if err := validateActionOptions(options); err != nil {
256			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, err)
257		}
258		request.Options = options
259		if isTransitionAction(request.Action) {
260			if _, err := RequireTransition(request.Locator.Mode, request.Locator.State, request.Action); err != nil {
261				return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
262			}
263		}
264		return request, nil
265	}

380		switch action {

385		case Resume:

387		case CompleteDirect:

389		case CompleteFF:

391		case ReviewHandoff:

393		case VerifyMerged:

395		case Retire:
396			return RetireOptions{}, nil
397		case Adopt:

410	func validateActionOptions(options ActionOptions) error {
411		switch value := options.(type) {
412		case ParkWarmOptions:
413			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
414		case ParkColdOptions:
415			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
416		case ResumeOptions:
417			return nil
418		case CompleteDirectOptions:
419			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
420		case CompleteFFOptions:
421			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
422		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
423			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
424		case VerifyMergedOptions:
425			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
426		case RetireOptions:
427			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
428		case AdoptOptions:
429			if value.Mode != "" && value.Mode != task.ModeWorktree {
430				return fmt.Errorf("adopted checkout mode must be empty or %q, got %q", task.ModeWorktree, value.Mode)
431			}
432			if value.State != "" && !validState(value.State) {
433				return fmt.Errorf("unknown adopted task state %q", value.State)
434			}
435			if value.Base != strings.TrimSpace(value.Base) || strings.ContainsRune(value.Base, '\x00') {
436				return fmt.Errorf("adopted base must be normalized")
437			}
438			return nil
439		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
440			if err := validateTimeout(value.Timeout); err != nil {
441				return err
442			}
443			if value.DeleteContainedBranch && !value.RequireContained {
444				return fmt.Errorf("contained branch deletion requires containment proof")
445			}
446			if value.RequireContained {
447				if value.ContainmentBase == "" || value.ContainmentBase != strings.TrimSpace(value.ContainmentBase) ||
448					strings.ContainsRune(value.ContainmentBase, '\x00') {
449					return fmt.Errorf("containment base must be a normalized nonempty branch")
450				}
451			} else if value.ContainmentBase != "" {
452				return fmt.Errorf("containment base requires containment proof")
453			}
454			return nil
455		case RefreshRemoteOptions:
456			if !value.FetchRefs && !value.QueryReview {
457				return fmt.Errorf("select fetch refs, query review, or both")
458			}
459			return nil
460		case ReconcileOptions:
461			if strings.TrimSpace(value.Name) == "" {
462				return fmt.Errorf("a named reconciliation is required")
463			}
464			if value.Name != strings.TrimSpace(value.Name) {
465				return fmt.Errorf("reconciliation name must be normalized")
466			}
467			return nil
468		default:
469			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported options type %T", options)
470		}
471	}
472	
473	func validateTimeout(timeout time.Duration) error {
474		if timeout < 0 {
475			return fmt.Errorf("timeout cannot be negative")
476		}
477		return nil
478	}

482		switch value := options.(type) {
483		case ParkWarmOptions:
484			writer.addString("next", value.Next)
485			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
486			writer.addBool("commit-wip", value.CommitWIP)
487			writer.addBool("push", value.Push)
488			writer.addBool("keep-session", value.KeepSession)
489			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
490		case ParkColdOptions:
491			writer.addString("next", value.Next)
492			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
493			writer.addBool("commit-wip", value.CommitWIP)
494			writer.addBool("push", value.Push)
495			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
496		case ResumeOptions:
497			writer.addBool("fetch-refs", value.FetchRefs)
498			writer.addBool("no-provision", value.NoProvision)
499			writer.addBool("take-ownership", value.TakeOwnership)
500		case CompleteDirectOptions:
501			appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage, value.Push)
502		case CompleteFFOptions:
503			appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage, value.PushBase)
504		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
505			writer.addString("dirty", string(value.Dirty))
506			writer.addString("commit-message", value.CommitMessage)
507			writer.addBool("draft", value.Draft)
508			writer.addString("title", value.Title)
509			writer.addString("body", value.Body)
510		case VerifyMergedOptions:
511			writer.addString("dirty", string(value.Dirty))
512			writer.addString("commit-message", value.CommitMessage)
513			writer.addString("base-ref", value.BaseRef)
514			writer.addString("squash-commit", value.SquashCommit)
515			writer.addBool("push-base", value.PushBase)
516		case RetireOptions:
517			writer.addBool("delete-branch", value.DeleteBranch)
518			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
519		case AdoptOptions:
520			writer.addString("mode", string(value.Mode))
521			writer.addString("state", string(value.State))
522			writer.addString("name", value.Name)
523			writer.addString("base", value.Base)
524			writer.addString("owner", value.Owner)
525			writer.addString("next", value.Next)
526			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
527			writer.addStrings("tags", value.Tags.values)
528		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
529			writer.addBool("discard-dirty", value.DiscardDirty)
530			writer.addBool("require-contained", value.RequireContained)
531			writer.addString("containment-base", value.ContainmentBase)
532			writer.addBool("delete-contained-branch", value.DeleteContainedBranch)
533			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
534		case RefreshRemoteOptions:
535			writer.addBool("fetch-refs", value.FetchRefs)
536			writer.addBool("query-review", value.QueryReview)
537		case ReconcileOptions:
538			writer.addString("name", value.Name)
539			writer.addFields("parameters", value.Parameters)
540		}
541	}

13	func (s *lifecycleService) parkWarmSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
14		options := request.Options.(ParkWarmOptions)
15		conditions := s.parkCheckoutConditions(observed, false, options.CommitWIP)
16	
17		if observed.statusErr != nil {
18			conditions = append(conditions,
19				condition(ConditionBranchPublished, VerdictError, RequirementAdvisory, observed.statusErr.Error(), "refresh Git status"),
20				condition(ConditionBranchPushed, VerdictError, RequirementAdvisory, observed.statusErr.Error(), "refresh Git status"),
21			)
22		} else {
23			published := "branch has no upstream"
24			if observed.status.Published() {
25				published = "upstream " + observed.status.Upstream
26			}
27			conditions = append(conditions,
28				condition(ConditionBranchPublished, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, published, "use --push to publish the branch"),
29				condition(ConditionBranchPushed, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
30					fmt.Sprintf("ahead=%d behind=%d", observed.status.Ahead, observed.status.Behind),
31					"use --push to publish committed work"),
32			)
33		}
34	
35		conditions = append(conditions, s.warmRuntimeConditions(observed, options)...)
36		next := observed.desiredNext(options)
37		if next == "" {
38			conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionNextAction, VerdictNeedsInput, RequirementAdvisory,
39				"no next action is recorded", "set --next so resuming is cheap"))
40		} else {
41			conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionNextAction, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
42				"next: "+next, ""))
43		}
44	
45		var effects []Effect
46		if options.CommitWIP && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() {
47			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectCommitWIP,
48				"checkpoint uncommitted product work", observed.checkout, false, false,
49				map[string]string{"message": wipMessage(next)}))
50		}
51		if options.Push {
52			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectPushBranch,
53				"push the task branch", observed.task.Branch, false, true,
54				map[string]string{"remote": "origin", "checkout": observed.checkout}))
55		}
56		if shouldCloseWarmRuntime(observed, options) {
57			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectCloseRuntime,
58				"close runtime sessions covering the checkout", observed.checkout, false, false,
59				map[string]string{"backend": runtimeName(observed.runtime)}))
60		}
61		effects = append(effects, taskUpdateEffect(observed, task.Warm, observed.task.WorktreePath, runtimeDispositionWarm(observed, options), next, desiredNote(observed.task.Note, options.Note)))
62	
63		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.task.Branch}
64		if observed.checkout != "" {
65			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+observed.checkout)
66		}
67		if (options.KeepSession || observed.cleanup.CallerContained) && observed.task.RuntimeHandle != "" {
68			retained = append(retained, "runtime:"+observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
69		}
70		return PlanSpec{
71			Authority:         s.baseAuthority(request, observed),
72			Conditions:        conditions,
73			Effects:           effects,
74			RetainedResources: retained,
75			Confirmation:      Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Park this task WARM?"},
76			FallbackCommand:   parkFallback(observed.task.ID, false, options),
77			Summary:           "Park " + observed.task.Title() + " WARM",
78			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
79		}
80	}

82	func (s *lifecycleService) parkColdSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
83		options := request.Options.(ParkColdOptions)
84		conditions := s.parkCheckoutConditions(observed, true, options.CommitWIP)
85		conditions = append(conditions, coldPublicationConditions(observed, options)...)
86	
87		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
88			switch {
89			case !observed.hasCheckout() || !observed.isLinkedWorktree():
90				conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
91					"artifact readiness requires an exact linked checkout", "restore or reconcile the linked worktree"))
92			case observed.artifactErr != nil:
93				conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
94					observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact intent observation"))
95			case observed.artifact.Ready():
96				conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
97					artifactEvidence(observed), ""))
98			default:
99				conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
100					artifactEvidence(observed), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent"))
101			}
102		} else {
103			conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
104				"no linked worktree will be removed", ""))
105		}
106		conditions = append(conditions, s.coldRuntimeConditions(observed)...)

108		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {

113			case !observed.baseRefExists:

115					"base ref "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "restore or choose an existing base branch"))

118					"canonical checkout will return to "+observed.baseRef, ""))

123		}
124	
125		next := observed.desiredNext(options)
126		if next == "" {
127			conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionNextAction, VerdictNeedsInput, RequirementAdvisory,
128				"no next action is recorded", "set --next so resuming is cheap"))
129		} else {
130			conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionNextAction, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "next: "+next, ""))
131		}
132	
133		var effects []Effect
134		if options.CommitWIP && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() {
135			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectCommitWIP,
136				"checkpoint uncommitted product work", observed.checkout, false, false,
137				map[string]string{"message": wipMessage(next)}))
138		}
139		if options.Push {
140			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectPushBranch,
141				"push the task branch", observed.task.Branch, false, true,
142				map[string]string{"remote": "origin", "checkout": observed.checkout}))
143		}
144		if observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" {
145			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectCloseRuntime,
146				"close runtime sessions covering the checkout", observed.checkout, false, false,
147				map[string]string{"backend": observed.runtime.Name()}))
148		}
149		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
150			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectRemoveWorktree,
151				"remove the exact linked worktree without force", observed.checkout, true, false,
152				map[string]string{
153					"repo": observed.repoPath, "branch": observed.task.Branch,
154					"head": observed.head, "force": "false",
155				}))
156		} else {
157			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectSwitchBase,
158				"switch the canonical checkout back to the explicit base", observed.repoPath, false, false,
159				map[string]string{"base": observed.baseRef, "task-branch": observed.task.Branch}))
160		}
161		effects = append(effects, taskUpdateEffect(observed, task.Cold, "", "clear", next, desiredNote(observed.task.Note, options.Note)))
162	
163		return PlanSpec{
164			Authority:         s.baseAuthority(request, observed),
165			Conditions:        conditions,
166			Effects:           effects,
167			RetainedResources: []string{"branch:" + observed.task.Branch},
168			Confirmation:      Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Park this task COLD and remove its checkout?"},
169			FallbackCommand:   parkFallback(observed.task.ID, true, options),
170			Summary:           "Park " + observed.task.Title() + " COLD",
171			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
172		}
173	}

175	func (s *lifecycleService) parkCheckoutConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, cold, commitWIP bool) []Condition {
176		conditions := []Condition{
177			condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
178				"task "+observed.task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision, ""),
179			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
180				"Git common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
181		}
182	
183		if !observed.hasCheckout() {
184			verdict := VerdictBlocked
185			evidence := "the task checkout is not registered"
186			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !errors.Is(observed.worktreeErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
187				verdict = VerdictError
188				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
189			}
190			conditions = append(conditions,
191				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "restore or reconcile the exact checkout"),
192				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired, "no exact Git worktree identity", "refresh repository topology"),
193				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unknown", "refresh repository topology"),
194				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(cold), "worktree flags are unknown", "refresh repository topology"),
195				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout branch is unknown", "refresh Git status"),
196				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout is absent", "restore the checkout"),
197				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(cold || commitWIP), "checkout is absent", "restore the checkout"),
198				condition(ConditionGitConflict, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(cold || commitWIP), "checkout is absent", "restore the checkout"),
199				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(cold), "checkout is absent", "restore the checkout"),
200			)
201			return conditions
202		}
203	
204		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
205			"registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""))
206		exactVerdict, exactEvidence := checkoutExactVerdict(observed)
207		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired,
208			exactEvidence, "reconcile the task and Git worktree identities"))
209	
210		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
211		kindEvidence := "canonical main checkout"
212		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
213			kindEvidence = "linked worktree"
214			if !observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
215				kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
216				kindEvidence = "task checkout resolves to the main or bare worktree"
217			}
218		} else if !observed.worktree.Worktree.Main || observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare {
219			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
220			kindEvidence = "canonical task does not resolve to Git's main checkout"
221		}
222		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired,
223			kindEvidence, "reconcile the checkout mode"))
224	
225		flagRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
226		if cold && observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
227			flagRequirement = RequirementRequired
228		}
229		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
230		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and not prunable"
231		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked || observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable {
232			flagVerdict = VerdictBlocked
233			flagEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("locked=%t prunable=%t", observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked, observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable)
234		}
235		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, flagVerdict, flagRequirement,
236			flagEvidence, "unlock or repair the worktree registration"))
237	
238		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
239		branchEvidence := "checkout is on " + observed.task.Branch
240		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.task.Branch ||
241			observed.statusErr == nil && (observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch) {
242			branchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
243			branchEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.task.Branch)
244		}
245		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired,
246			branchEvidence, "switch or reconcile the exact task branch"))
247	
248		if observed.statusErr != nil {
249			conditions = append(conditions,
250				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
251				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictError, requirementFor(cold || commitWIP), observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
252				condition(ConditionGitConflict, VerdictError, requirementFor(cold || commitWIP), observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
253				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictError, requirementFor(cold), observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
254			)
255			return conditions
256		}
257		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
258			observed.status.Summary(), ""))
259	
260		operationRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
261		if cold || commitWIP {
262			operationRequirement = RequirementRequired
263		}
264		switch {
265		case observed.operationErr != nil:
266			conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictError, operationRequirement,
267				observed.operationErr.Error(), "repair Git operation observation"))
268		case observed.inProgress:
269			verdict := VerdictBlocked
270			if operationRequirement == RequirementAdvisory {
271				verdict = VerdictMet
272			}
273			conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionGitOperation, verdict, operationRequirement,
274				"Git operation "+observed.operation+" is in progress", "finish or abort the Git operation"))
275		default:
276			conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictMet, operationRequirement,
277				"no Git operation is in progress", ""))
278		}
279	
280		conflictRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
281		if cold || commitWIP {
282			conflictRequirement = RequirementRequired
283		}
284		conflictVerdict := VerdictMet
285		conflictEvidence := "no unmerged paths"
286		if observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
287			conflictEvidence = strconv.Itoa(observed.status.Conflicted) + " unmerged path(s)"
288			if conflictRequirement == RequirementRequired {
289				conflictVerdict = VerdictBlocked
290			}
291		}
292		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionGitConflict, conflictVerdict, conflictRequirement,
293			conflictEvidence, "resolve conflicts before checkpointing or cold parking"))
294	
295		cleanRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
296		if cold {
297			cleanRequirement = RequirementRequired
298		}
299		cleanVerdict := VerdictMet
300		cleanEvidence := "checkout is clean"
301		if observed.status.Dirty() {
302			cleanEvidence = observed.status.Breakdown()
303			switch {
304			case cold && commitWIP:
305				cleanEvidence += "; declared WIP commit will be followed by a fresh clean check"
306			case cold:
307				cleanVerdict = VerdictBlocked
308			default:
309				cleanEvidence += "; bytes remain in place"
310			}
311		}
312		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, cleanRequirement,
313			cleanEvidence, "commit changes or request an explicit WIP checkpoint"))
314		return conditions
315	}

317	func checkoutExactVerdict(observed lifecycleObservation) (Verdict, string) {
318		if observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
319			return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("worktree common directory %q differs from %q", observed.worktree.GitCommonDir, observed.gitCommonDir)
320		}
321		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
322			if observed.task.WorktreePath == "" {
323				if observed.task.State != task.Cold || observed.branchMatches != 1 {
324					return VerdictBlocked, "the task has no exact persisted checkout identity"
325				}
326			} else {
327				// ResolveRegisteredWorktree matched the recorded hint by canonical path;
328				// subsequent operations use only the returned registered identity.
329				if observed.worktree.Path == "" {
330					return VerdictBlocked, "the exact registered worktree path is empty"
331				}
332			}
333		} else {
334			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
335				return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("%s task unexpectedly retains worktree path %q", observed.mode, observed.task.WorktreePath)
336			}
337			if observed.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath {
338				return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registered main path %q differs from %q", observed.worktree.Path, observed.repoPath)
339			}
340		}
341		if observed.headErr != nil {
342			return VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
343		}
344		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head {
345			return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
346		}
347		return VerdictMet, "exact path, Git common directory, and HEAD match"
348	}

350	func requirementFor(required bool) Requirement {
351		if required {
352			return RequirementRequired
353		}
354		return RequirementAdvisory
355	}

357	func (s *lifecycleService) warmRuntimeConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, options ParkWarmOptions) []Condition {
358		if options.KeepSession {
359			return []Condition{
360				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "runtime is intentionally retained", ""),
361				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "--keep-session requests no runtime closure", ""),
362				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "caller containment is irrelevant while retaining the runtime", ""),
363			}
364		}
365		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
366			return []Condition{
367				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
368				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
369				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory, "runtime was not inspected", "inspect runtime occupancy"),
370			}
371		}
372		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
373		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is available"
374		if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
375			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
376			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
377		}
378		if observed.cleanupErr != nil {
379			return []Condition{
380				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
381				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.cleanupErr.Error(), "repair runtime occupancy observation"),
382				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory, "runtime occupancy failed", "inspect from outside the checkout"),
383			}
384		}
385		if observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
386			return []Condition{
387				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
388				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
389					"caller is contained; warm parking will not close any runtime", "exit the runtime and let a later sweep close it"),
390				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
391					"caller remains inside the checkout or its runtime", "runtime will be retained"),
392			}
393		}
394		if len(observed.cleanup.Blockers) > 0 {
395			return []Condition{
396				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
397				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
398					strings.Join(observed.cleanup.Blockers, "; "), "stop active agents or use only the explicit unknown-runtime acknowledgement"),
399				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "caller is outside the target runtime", ""),
400			}
401		}
402		return []Condition{
403			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
404			condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
405				fmt.Sprintf("%d closeable %s session(s)", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions), observed.runtime.Name()), ""),
406			condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "caller is outside the target runtime", ""),
407		}
408	}

410	func (s *lifecycleService) coldRuntimeConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
411		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
412			return []Condition{
413				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
414				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
415				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime was not inspected", "run cold parking from outside the checkout"),
416			}
417		}
418		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
419		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is available"
420		if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
421			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
422			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
423		}
424		if observed.cleanupErr != nil {
425			return []Condition{
426				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
427				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.cleanupErr.Error(), "repair runtime occupancy observation"),
428				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime occupancy failed", "run cold parking from outside the checkout"),
429			}
430		}
431		occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
432		occupancyEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%d closeable %s session(s)", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions), observed.runtime.Name())
433		if len(observed.cleanup.Blockers) > 0 {
434			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
435			occupancyEvidence = strings.Join(observed.cleanup.Blockers, "; ")
436		}
437		callerVerdict := VerdictMet
438		callerEvidence := "caller is outside the checkout and runtime"
439		if observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
440			callerVerdict = VerdictBlocked
441			callerEvidence = "caller is inside the checkout or a covering runtime"
442		}
443		return []Condition{
444			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
445			condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop active agents and close mixed runtime panes"),
446			condition(ConditionCallerContainment, callerVerdict, RequirementRequired, callerEvidence, "run cold parking from outside the target checkout"),
447		}
448	}

450	func coldPublicationConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, options ParkColdOptions) []Condition {
451		if observed.statusErr != nil {
452			return []Condition{
453				condition(ConditionBranchPublished, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
454				condition(ConditionBranchPushed, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
455			}
456		}
457		publishedVerdict := VerdictMet
458		publishedEvidence := "upstream " + observed.status.Upstream
459		if !observed.status.Published() {
460			if options.Push {
461				publishedEvidence = "declared push will set origin/" + observed.task.Branch + " as upstream"
462			} else {
463				publishedVerdict = VerdictBlocked
464				publishedEvidence = "branch has no upstream"
465			}
466		}
467		pushedVerdict := VerdictMet
468		pushedEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("ahead=%d", observed.status.Ahead)
469		willCreateCommit := options.CommitWIP && observed.status.Dirty()
470		if observed.status.Ahead > 0 || willCreateCommit {
471			if options.Push {
472				pushedEvidence = "declared push will be followed by an ahead=0 check"
473			} else {
474				pushedVerdict = VerdictBlocked
475				pushedEvidence = "committed or checkpointed work would remain ahead of upstream"
476			}
477		}
478		return []Condition{
479			condition(ConditionBranchPublished, publishedVerdict, RequirementRequired, publishedEvidence, "request --push or publish the branch first"),
480			condition(ConditionBranchPushed, pushedVerdict, RequirementRequired, pushedEvidence, "request --push and resolve any rejected push"),
481		}
482	}

484	func shouldCloseWarmRuntime(observed lifecycleObservation, options ParkWarmOptions) bool {
485		return !options.KeepSession && observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.runtime != nil &&
486			observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.cleanup.CallerContained
487	}

491			return "retain"
492		}
493		return "clear"

503	func taskUpdateEffect(observed lifecycleObservation, state task.State, path, runtimeDisposition, next, note string) Effect {
504		return NewEffect(EffectUpdateTask, "write lifecycle task state last", observed.task.ID, false, false,
505			map[string]string{

515			return "wip: checkpoint"

520	func artifactEvidence(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
521		if observed.artifact.KnownEmpty {
522			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
523		}
524		var states []string
525		for _, intent := range observed.artifact.Intents {
526			states = append(states, intent.Intent.ID+"="+string(intent.State))
527		}
528		if len(states) == 0 {
529			return "artifact readiness is incomplete"
530		}
531		return strings.Join(states, ", ")
532	}
533	
534	func parkFallback(id string, cold bool, options interface{}) string {
535		parts := []string{"dev", "park", shellQuote(id)}
536		if cold {
537			parts = append(parts, "--cold")
538		}
539		switch value := options.(type) {
540		case ParkWarmOptions:
541			parts = appendParkFlags(parts, value.Next, value.Note, value.CommitWIP, value.Push,
542				value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime)
543			if value.Timeout > 0 {
544				parts = append(parts, "--timeout", value.Timeout.String())
545			}
546			if value.KeepSession {
547				parts = append(parts, "--keep-session")
548			}
549		case ParkColdOptions:
550			parts = appendParkFlags(parts, value.Next, value.Note, value.CommitWIP, value.Push,
551				value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime)
552			if value.Timeout > 0 {
553				parts = append(parts, "--timeout", value.Timeout.String())
554			}
555		}
556		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
557	}
558	
559	func appendParkFlags(parts []string, next, note string, wip, push, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool) []string {
560		if next != "" {
561			parts = append(parts, "--next", shellQuote(next))
562		}
563		if note != "" {
564			parts = append(parts, "--note", shellQuote(note))
565		}
566		if wip {
567			parts = append(parts, "--wip")
568		}
569		if push {
570			parts = append(parts, "--push")
571		}
572		if closeUnknown {
573			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
574		}
575		if assumeNoRuntime {
576			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
577		}
578		return parts
579	}
580	
581	func shellQuote(value string) string {
582		if value != "" && !strings.ContainsAny(value, " \t\n'\"`\\$;&|()<>*") {
583			return value
584		}
585		return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\\''") + "'"
586	}
