16	// exact identities such as status, runtime, artifact, or remote fingerprints.
17	// BuildPlan copies every map and slice.

29	// Plan is an immutable-by-interface proposal bound to one request and one

31	type Plan struct {
32		PlanID                 string
33		AuthorityFingerprint   string

55	// BuildPlan validates graph legality, derives availability, and seals a plan's
56	// deterministic authority fingerprint and PlanID.
57	func BuildPlan(request Request, spec PlanSpec) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid request", Cause: err}
61		}
62		if err := spec.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
63			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
64		}
65		conditions := append([]Condition(nil), spec.Conditions...)
66		if err := validateConditions(conditions); err != nil {
67			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
68		}
69		effects := cloneEffects(spec.Effects)
70		if err := validateEffects(effects); err != nil {
71			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
72		}
73		authority := NewFields(spec.Authority)
74		if err := validateAuthority(authority); err != nil {
75			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
76		}
77	
78		plan := Plan{
79			Request: normalized.Clone(), Locator: normalized.Locator, Action: normalized.Action,
80			Source:       normalized.Locator.State,
81			Availability: AvailabilityFor(conditions), Confirmation: spec.Confirmation,
82			FallbackCommand: spec.FallbackCommand, Summary: spec.Summary, DisplayedAt: spec.DisplayedAt,
83			authority: authority, conditions: conditions, effects: effects,
84			retained: NewStringList(spec.RetainedResources...),
85		}
86		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
87			rule, transitionErr := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
88			if transitionErr != nil {
89				return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid transition", Cause: transitionErr}
90			}
91			plan.HasPersistedTransition = true
92			plan.Target = rule.Target
93			plan.StatePreserving = rule.StatePreserving
94			plan.RemovesTask = rule.RemovesTask
95			plan.ExpectedMilestone = rule.Milestone
96		} else {
97			switch plan.Action {
98			case Adopt:
99				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
100			case Reconcile:
101				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
102			}
103		}
104		plan.AuthorityFingerprint, plan.PlanID = computePlanIdentity(plan)
105		return plan.Clone(), nil
106	}
107	
108	// Clone returns a plan with independent request, map, and slice storage.
109	func (p Plan) Clone() Plan {
110		p.Request = p.Request.Clone()
111		p.authority = p.authority.clone()
112		p.conditions = append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...)
113		p.effects = cloneEffects(p.effects)
114		p.retained = p.retained.clone()
115		return p
116	}

122	func (p Plan) Conditions() []Condition { return append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...) }

134			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict == VerdictNeedsInput
135		})

142			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired &&
143				condition.Verdict != VerdictMet && condition.Verdict != VerdictNeedsInput

154	// Validate proves that a plan is structurally consistent and still carries its
155	// original deterministic identity. It performs no live observations.
156	func (p Plan) Validate() error {
157		if p.PlanID == "" || p.AuthorityFingerprint == "" {
158			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan identity is missing"}
159		}
160		if !p.Action.Valid() {
161			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown action %q", p.Action)}
162		}
163		if p.Request.Action != p.Action {
164			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request action and plan action differ"}
165		}
166		if p.Request.Locator != p.Locator {
167			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request locator and plan locator differ"}
168		}
169		if p.Request.Options == nil {
170			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "normalized request options are missing"}
171		}
172		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(p.Request)
173		if err != nil {
174			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request is no longer valid", Cause: err}
175		}
176		if requestIdentity(normalized) != requestIdentity(p.Request) {
177			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request options are not normalized"}
178		}
179		if err := p.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
180			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
181		}
182		if err := validateConditions(p.conditions); err != nil {
183			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
184		}
185		if err := validateEffects(p.effects); err != nil {
186			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
187		}
188		if err := validateAuthority(p.authority); err != nil {
189			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
190		}
191		if err := validatePlanTransition(p); err != nil {
192			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "transition metadata is inconsistent", Cause: err}
193		}
194	
195		authorityFingerprint, planID := computePlanIdentity(p)
196		if authorityFingerprint != p.AuthorityFingerprint {
197			return &StalePlanError{
198				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
199				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
200				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
201				Reason:                       "authority fields, effects, or conditions changed",
202			}
203		}
204		if planID != p.PlanID {
205			return &StalePlanError{
206				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
207				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
208				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
209				Reason:                       "PlanID does not match its authority fingerprint",
210			}
211		}
212		if availability := AvailabilityFor(p.conditions); availability != p.Availability {
213			return &InvalidPlanError{
214				PlanID: p.PlanID,
215				Reason: fmt.Sprintf("availability is %s, want derived %s", p.Availability, availability),
216			}
217		}
218		return nil
219	}
220	
221	// ValidateApproval binds affirmative approval and any typed token to this exact
222	// plan. It never changes plan readiness or condition verdicts.
223	func (p Plan) ValidateApproval(approval Approval) error {
224		if err := p.Validate(); err != nil {
225			return err
226		}
227		if !approval.Granted {
228			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "affirmative approval was not granted", Cause: ErrApprovalRequired}
229		}
230		if approval.PlanID != p.PlanID {
231			return &StalePlanError{
232				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: approval.PlanID,
233				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
234				Reason:                       "approval names a different plan",
235			}
236		}
237		if p.Confirmation.Kind == ConfirmationTyped {
238			if approval.Token != p.Confirmation.Token {
239				return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "typed confirmation token does not match", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
240			}
241		} else if approval.Token != "" {
242			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan does not accept a typed confirmation token", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
243		}
244		return nil
245	}

247	func validatePlanTransition(plan Plan) error {
248		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
249			rule, err := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
250			if err != nil {
251				return err
252			}
253			if !plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Source != rule.Source || plan.Target != rule.Target ||
254				plan.StatePreserving != rule.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask != rule.RemovesTask ||
255				plan.ExpectedMilestone != rule.Milestone {
256				return fmt.Errorf("plan does not match the transition table")
257			}
258			return nil
259		}
260		expectedMilestone := MilestoneNone
261		switch plan.Action {
262		case Adopt:
263			expectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
264		case Reconcile:
265			expectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
266		}
267		if plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Target != "" || plan.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask ||
268			plan.Source != plan.Locator.State || plan.ExpectedMilestone != expectedMilestone {
269			return fmt.Errorf("domain action is represented as a persisted-state edge")
270		}
271		return nil
272	}
273	
274	func validateConditions(conditions []Condition) error {
275		seen := make(map[ConditionCode]bool, len(conditions))
276		for index, condition := range conditions {
277			if err := condition.Validate(); err != nil {
278				return fmt.Errorf("condition %d: %w", index, err)
279			}
280			if seen[condition.Code] {
281				return fmt.Errorf("condition code %q is duplicated", condition.Code)
282			}
283			seen[condition.Code] = true
284		}
285		return nil
286	}
287	
288	func validateEffects(effects []Effect) error {
289		for index, effect := range effects {
290			if err := effect.Validate(); err != nil {
291				return fmt.Errorf("effect %d: %w", index, err)
292			}
293		}
294		return nil
295	}
296	
297	func validateAuthority(authority Fields) error {
298		for _, field := range authority.entries {
299			if field.Key == "" {
300				return fmt.Errorf("authority field key is empty")
301			}
302		}
303		return nil
304	}

306	func cloneEffects(effects []Effect) []Effect {
307		out := make([]Effect, len(effects))
308		for index, effect := range effects {
309			out[index] = effect.Clone()
310		}
311		return out
312	}

314	func filterConditions(conditions []Condition, keep func(Condition) bool) []Condition {
315		out := make([]Condition, 0, len(conditions))
316		for _, condition := range conditions {
317			if keep(condition) {
318				out = append(out, condition)
319			}
320		}
321		return out
322	}

324	func requestIdentity(request Request) string {
325		writer := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-request-v1")
326		appendRequestIdentity(writer, request)
327		return writer.sumHex()
328	}
329	
330	func computePlanIdentity(plan Plan) (string, string) {
331		writer := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-authority-v1")
332		appendRequestIdentity(writer, plan.Request)
333		writer.addString("plan.action", string(plan.Action))
334		writer.addString("plan.source", string(plan.Source))
335		writer.addString("plan.target", string(plan.Target))
336		writer.addBool("plan.has-persisted-transition", plan.HasPersistedTransition)
337		writer.addBool("plan.state-preserving", plan.StatePreserving)
338		writer.addBool("plan.removes-task", plan.RemovesTask)
339		writer.addString("plan.expected-milestone", string(plan.ExpectedMilestone))
340		writer.addFields("plan.authority", plan.authority)
341		writer.addInt64("plan.condition-count", int64(len(plan.conditions)))
342		for index, condition := range plan.conditions {
343			prefix := "plan.condition." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
344			writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(condition.Code))
345			writer.addString(prefix+"verdict", string(condition.Verdict))
346			writer.addString(prefix+"requirement", string(condition.Requirement))
347			writer.addString(prefix+"evidence", condition.Evidence)
348			writer.addString(prefix+"remediation", condition.Remediation)
349		}
350		writer.addInt64("plan.effect-count", int64(len(plan.effects)))
351		for index, effect := range plan.effects {
352			prefix := "plan.effect." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
353			writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(effect.Code))
354			writer.addString(prefix+"description", effect.Description)
355			writer.addString(prefix+"target", effect.Target)
356			writer.addBool(prefix+"destructive", effect.Destructive)
357			writer.addBool(prefix+"network", effect.Network)
358			writer.addFields(prefix+"details", effect.Details)
359		}
360		writer.addStrings("plan.retained", plan.retained.values)
361		writer.addString("plan.confirmation-kind", string(plan.Confirmation.Kind))
362		writer.addString("plan.confirmation-token", plan.Confirmation.Token)
363		authorityFingerprint := "sha256:" + writer.sumHex()
364	
365		planWriter := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-plan-v1")
366		planWriter.addString("authority-fingerprint", authorityFingerprint)
367		return authorityFingerprint, "plan:" + planWriter.sumHex()
368	}
369	
370	func appendRequestIdentity(writer *identityWriter, request Request) {
371		locator := request.Locator
372		writer.addString("request.action", string(request.Action))
373		writer.addString("locator.repo-key", locator.RepoKey)
374		writer.addString("locator.row-key", locator.RowKey)
375		writer.addString("locator.row-kind", locator.RowKind)
376		writer.addString("locator.repository-id", locator.RepositoryID)
377		writer.addString("locator.git-common-dir", locator.GitCommonDir)
378		writer.addString("locator.task-id", locator.TaskID)
379		writer.addString("locator.task-revision", locator.TaskRevision)
380		writer.addString("locator.repo-path", locator.RepoPath)
381		writer.addString("locator.checkout-path", locator.CheckoutPath)
382		writer.addString("locator.branch", locator.Branch)
383		writer.addString("locator.base", locator.Base)
384		writer.addString("locator.upstream", locator.Upstream)
385		writer.addString("locator.remote", locator.Remote)
386		writer.addString("locator.head-oid", locator.HeadOID)
387		writer.addString("locator.base-oid", locator.BaseOID)
388		writer.addString("locator.upstream-oid", locator.UpstreamOID)
389		writer.addString("locator.mode", string(locator.Mode))
390		writer.addString("locator.state", string(locator.State))
391		appendOptionsIdentity(writer, request.Options)
392	}
393	
394	type identityWriter struct {
395		buffer bytes.Buffer
396	}
397	
398	func newIdentityWriter(domain string) *identityWriter {
399		writer := &identityWriter{}
400		writer.addString("domain", domain)
401		return writer
402	}
403	
404	func (w *identityWriter) addString(label, value string) {
405		w.addBytes([]byte(label))
406		w.addBytes([]byte(value))
407	}
408	
409	func (w *identityWriter) addBool(label string, value bool) {
410		w.addString(label, strconv.FormatBool(value))
411	}
412	
413	func (w *identityWriter) addInt64(label string, value int64) {
414		w.addString(label, strconv.FormatInt(value, 10))
415	}
416	
417	func (w *identityWriter) addStrings(label string, values []string) {
418		w.addInt64(label+".count", int64(len(values)))
419		for index, value := range values {
420			w.addString(label+"."+strconv.Itoa(index), value)
421		}
422	}
423	
424	func (w *identityWriter) addFields(label string, fields Fields) {
425		w.addInt64(label+".count", int64(len(fields.entries)))
426		for index, field := range fields.entries {
427			prefix := label + "." + strconv.Itoa(index)
428			w.addString(prefix+".key", field.Key)
429			w.addString(prefix+".value", field.Value)
430		}
431	}
432	
433	func (w *identityWriter) addBytes(value []byte) {
434		var length [8]byte
435		binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(value)))
436		_, _ = w.buffer.Write(length[:])
437		_, _ = w.buffer.Write(value)
438	}
439	
440	func (w *identityWriter) sumHex() string {
441		sum := sha256.Sum256(w.buffer.Bytes())
442		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
443	}

48	func validateRefreshRemoteLocator(locator Locator) error {
49		switch {
50		case locator.RepoPath == "":
51			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
52		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
53			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
54		case !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Branch):
55			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact head branch %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Branch)
56		case locator.Base != "" && !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Base):
57			return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Base)
58		case locator.HeadOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.HeadOID):
59			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact HEAD OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.HeadOID)
60		case locator.BaseOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.BaseOID):
61			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact base OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.BaseOID)
62		}
63	
64		if locator.TaskID == "" {
65			switch {
66			case locator.TaskRevision != "":
67				return fmt.Errorf("%w: task revision requires a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
68			case locator.HeadOID == "":
69				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged remote refresh requires an exact HEAD OID", ErrInvalidRequest)
70			case locator.Mode != "" && !validMode(locator.Mode):
71				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown checkout mode %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Mode)
72			case locator.State != "" && !validState(locator.State):
73				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown task state %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.State)
74			}
75			return nil
76		}
77	
78		switch {
79		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
80			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
81		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
82			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
83		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
84			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
85		case !validState(locator.State):
86			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
87		}
88		return nil
89	}

91	func normalizedRemoteBranch(branch string) bool {
92		return branch != "" && branch == strings.TrimSpace(branch) &&
93			!strings.ContainsRune(branch, '\x00') &&
94			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/heads/") &&
95			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/remotes/")
96	}

98	func normalizeRemoteName(name string) (string, error) {
99		if name == "" {
100			return "origin", nil
101		}
102		if name != strings.TrimSpace(name) || strings.ContainsRune(name, '\x00') || strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") {
103			return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: remote name %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, name)
104		}
105		return name, nil
106	}

108	func (s *lifecycleService) planRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
109		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
110			return PlanSpec{}, err
111		}
112		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
113			return PlanSpec{}, err
114		}
115	
116		if request.Locator.TaskID == "" {
117			spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, nil)
118			return spec, err
119		}
120	
121		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
122		if err != nil {
123			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
124		}
125		spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, record)
126		if err != nil {
127			return PlanSpec{}, err
128		}
129		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning remote refresh"}
132		}
133		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
134			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning remote refresh")
135		}
136		return spec, nil
137	}

181			)}
182		}
183		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
184			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
185			if keyErr != nil {
186				return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
187			}
188			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
189				return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected repository key no longer names the Git common directory"}
190			}
191		}
192	
193		if err := s.validateRemoteRefNames(ctx, observed.repoPath, remoteName, observed.head, observed.base); err != nil {
194			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
195		}
196		if record == nil {
197			if err := s.validateRefreshCheckout(ctx, request.Locator, &observed); err != nil {
198				return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
199			}
200		}
201	
202		observed.remoteURL = strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
203		observed.providerKind, observed.providerRepository = forge.IdentityFromURL(observed.remoteURL)
204		options := request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions)
205		if options.QueryReview && observed.remoteURL != "" && observed.providerKind != forge.Unknown && observed.providerRepository != "" {
206			observed.provider, observed.providerResolveErr = s.resolveForge(observed.providerKind)
207			if observed.providerResolveErr == nil {
208				switch {
209				case observed.provider == nil:
210					observed.providerResolveErr = errors.New("forge resolver returned no provider")
211				case observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind:
212					observed.providerResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("forge resolver returned %s for %s remote", observed.provider.Kind(), observed.providerKind)
213				default:
214					_, observed.providerCapable = observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier)
215					observed.providerAvailable = observed.provider.Available()
216				}
217			}
218		}
219	
220		observed.refs = s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
221		if request.Locator.HeadOID != "" {
222			if observed.refs.LocalHead.Failure != "" || !observed.refs.LocalHead.Exists || observed.refs.LocalHead.OID != request.Locator.HeadOID {
223				return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
224					"selected head changed from %q to %q", request.Locator.HeadOID, observed.refs.LocalHead.OID,
225				)}
226			}
227		}
228		if request.Locator.BaseOID != "" {
229			if observed.refs.LocalBase.Failure != "" || !observed.refs.LocalBase.Exists || observed.refs.LocalBase.OID != request.Locator.BaseOID {
230				return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
231					"selected base changed from %q to %q", request.Locator.BaseOID, observed.refs.LocalBase.OID,
232				)}
233			}
234		}
235		return s.refreshRemoteSpec(request, observed), observed, nil
236	}
237	
238	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRemoteRefNames(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) error {
239		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
240			"head":        "refs/heads/" + head,
241			"remote name": "refs/remotes/" + remote + "/__dev_refresh_probe__",
242		} {
243			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", ref); err != nil {
244				return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not a valid normalized Git name: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, label, err)
245			}
246		}
247		if base != "" {
248			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", "refs/heads/"+base); err != nil {
249				return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base is not a valid normalized Git branch: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
250			}
251		}
252		return nil
253	}
254	
255	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRefreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, locator Locator, observed *remoteRefreshObservation) error {
256		checkout := locator.CheckoutPath
257		if checkout == "" {
258			checkout = locator.RepoPath
259		}
260		canonical, err := s.canonicalPath(checkout)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize selected checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
263		}
264		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, canonical)
265		if err != nil {
266			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout registration changed: " + err.Error()}
267		}
268		if registered.Path != canonical || registered.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
269			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout no longer belongs to the exact repository identity"}
270		}
271		if registered.Worktree.Detached || registered.Worktree.Branch != locator.Branch {
272			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
273				"selected checkout branch changed from %q to %q", locator.Branch, registered.Worktree.Branch,
274			)}
275		}
276		liveHead, err := s.gitRun(ctx, canonical, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
277		if err != nil {
278			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout HEAD is no longer observable: " + err.Error()}
279		}
280		liveHead = strings.TrimSpace(liveHead)
281		if registered.Worktree.Head != liveHead || locator.HeadOID != liveHead {
282			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
283				"selected checkout HEAD changed from %q to registry=%q live=%q", locator.HeadOID, registered.Worktree.Head, liveHead,
284			)}
285		}
286		observed.checkout = canonical
287		observed.worktree = registered
288		return nil
289	}
290	
291	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRemoteRefs(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) RemoteRefsObservation {
292		result := RemoteRefsObservation{ObservedAt: s.now()}
293		result.LocalHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+head)
294		result.RemoteHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+head)
295		if base != "" {
296			result.LocalBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+base)
297			result.RemoteBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
298		}
299		return result
300	}
301	
302	func (s *lifecycleService) observeNamedRef(ctx context.Context, repoPath, ref string) NamedRefObservation {
303		observed := NamedRefObservation{Ref: ref}
304		if !s.gitRefExists(ctx, repoPath, ref) {
305			return observed
306		}
307		observed.Exists = true
308		oid, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, ref)
309		if err != nil {
310			observed.Failure = err.Error()
311			return observed
312		}
313		observed.OID = oid
314		return observed
315	}
316	
317	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshRemoteSpec(request Request, observed remoteRefreshObservation) PlanSpec {
318		options := request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions)
319		conditions := []Condition{
320			refreshTaskCondition(observed),
321			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
322				"Git main "+observed.repoPath+" with common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
323			refreshHeadCondition(observed),
324			refreshRemoteURLCondition(observed),
325			refreshRefsCondition(observed),
326			refreshReviewBaseCondition(observed, options),
327			refreshReviewProviderCondition(observed, options),
328			refreshReviewCapabilityCondition(observed, options),
329			refreshReviewCLICondition(observed, options),
330		}
331	
332		var effects []Effect
333		if options.FetchRefs {
334			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
335				EffectFetchRefs, "fetch and prune the exact configured remote", observed.repoPath, false, true,
336				map[string]string{
337					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
338					"pre-refs": remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs),
339				},
340			))
341		}
342		if options.QueryReview {
343			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
344				EffectQueryReview, "query the exact provider repository and head/base relationship", observed.providerRepository, false, true,
345				map[string]string{
346					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
347					"provider": string(observed.providerKind), "repository": observed.providerRepository,
348					"head": observed.head, "base": observed.base,
349				},
350			))
351		}
352	
353		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.head + "@" + observed.refs.LocalHead.OID}
354		if observed.checkout != "" {
355			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+observed.checkout)
356		}
357		return PlanSpec{
358			Authority:         refreshRemoteAuthority(observed),
359			Conditions:        conditions,
360			Effects:           effects,
361			RetainedResources: retained,
362			Confirmation: Confirmation{
363				Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Run the selected explicit remote network operations?",
364			},
365			Summary:     refreshRemoteSummary(observed, options),
366			DisplayedAt: s.now(),
367		}
368	}
369	
370	func refreshTaskCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
371		if observed.record == nil {
372			return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
373				"repository/checkout context has no persisted task record", "")
374		}
375		return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
376			"task "+observed.record.Task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision+" is validated without a state write", "")
377	}
378	
379	func refreshHeadCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
380		ref := observed.refs.LocalHead
381		switch {
382		case ref.Failure != "":
383			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, ref.Failure, "repair local head-ref observation")
384		case !ref.Exists:
385			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
386				"local head ref "+ref.Ref+" does not exist", "restore the exact named local branch")
387		case ref.OID == "":
388			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
389				"local head ref resolved without an OID", "repair local head-ref observation")
390		default:
391			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
392				ref.Ref+" is exactly "+ref.OID, "")
393		}
394	}
395	
396	func refreshRemoteURLCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
397		if observed.remoteURL == "" {
398			return condition(ConditionRemoteURL, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
399				"remote "+observed.remoteName+" has no configured URL", "configure the exact remote before network refresh")
400		}
401		return condition(ConditionRemoteURL, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
402			"remote "+observed.remoteName+" is configured as "+observed.remoteURL, "")
403	}
404	
405	func refreshRefsCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
406		verdict := VerdictMet
407		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{
408			observed.refs.LocalHead, observed.refs.LocalBase, observed.refs.RemoteHead, observed.refs.RemoteBase,
409		} {
410			if ref.Failure != "" {
411				verdict = VerdictError
412				break
413			}
414		}
415		return condition(ConditionRemoteRefs, verdict, RequirementAdvisory,
416			remoteRefsEvidence(observed.refs), "repair local Git ref observation before relying on freshness")
417	}
418	
419	func refreshReviewBaseCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
420		if !options.QueryReview {
421			return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
422				"review query is not selected; an explicit base is not required", "")
423		}
424		if observed.base == "" {
425			return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictNeedsInput, RequirementRequired,
426				"review query requires an exact base branch", "select the base from the current repository context")
427		}
428		return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
429			"review base is "+observed.base, "")
430	}
431	
432	func refreshReviewProviderCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
433		requirement := RequirementAdvisory
434		if options.QueryReview {
435			requirement = RequirementRequired
436		}
437		if observed.providerKind == forge.Unknown || observed.providerRepository == "" {
438			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, requirement,
439				"remote URL does not identify a supported GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps repository", "select fetch-only or configure a supported provider remote")
440		}
441		return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictMet, requirement,
442			fmt.Sprintf("%s repository identity %s", observed.providerKind, observed.providerRepository), "")
443	}
444	
445	func refreshReviewCapabilityCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
446		if !options.QueryReview {
447			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
448				"review query is not selected; forge capability is not required", "")
449		}
450		if observed.providerResolveErr != nil {
451			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
452				observed.providerResolveErr.Error(), "use fetch-only or install support for this provider")
453		}
454		if observed.provider == nil || !observed.providerCapable {
455			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
456				fmt.Sprintf("%s adapter does not implement review queries", observed.providerKind), "use fetch-only or a review-capable provider")
457		}
458		return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
459			fmt.Sprintf("%s adapter implements review queries", observed.providerKind), "")
460	}
461	
462	func refreshReviewCLICondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
463		if !options.QueryReview {
464			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
465				"review query is not selected; no provider CLI is required", "")
466		}
467		if observed.provider == nil || observed.providerResolveErr != nil || !observed.providerCapable {
468			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
469				"review-capable provider CLI could not be selected", "resolve provider capability first")
470		}
471		if !observed.providerAvailable {
472			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
473				fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is not installed", observed.providerKind, observed.provider.Bin()), "install the provider CLI and retry")
474		}
475		return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
476			fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is locally available", observed.providerKind, observed.provider.Bin()), "")
477	}
478	
479	func refreshRemoteAuthority(observed remoteRefreshObservation) map[string]string {
480		authority := map[string]string{
481			"remote.repo-main":          observed.repoPath,
482			"remote.git-common-dir":     observed.gitCommonDir,
483			"remote.checkout":           observed.checkout,
484			"remote.worktree":           worktreeAuthority(observed.worktree, observed.checkout != "", nil, 0),
485			"remote.name":               observed.remoteName,
486			"remote.url":                observed.remoteURL,
487			"remote.head":               observed.head,
488			"remote.base":               observed.base,
489			"remote.provider":           string(observed.providerKind),
490			"remote.repository":         observed.providerRepository,
491			"remote.provider-bin":       reviewProviderBin(observed.provider),
492			"remote.provider-error":     errorString(observed.providerResolveErr),
493			"remote.provider-capable":   boolString(observed.providerCapable),
494			"remote.provider-available": boolString(observed.providerAvailable),
495			"remote.refs":               remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs),
496		}
497		if observed.record != nil {
498			authority["remote.task-id"] = observed.record.Task.ID
499			authority["remote.task-revision"] = observed.record.Revision
500			authority["remote.task-mode"] = string(observed.record.Task.EffectiveMode())
501			authority["remote.task-state"] = string(observed.record.Task.State)
502		} else {
503			authority["remote.task-id"] = ""
504			authority["remote.task-revision"] = ""
505			authority["remote.task-mode"] = ""
506			authority["remote.task-state"] = ""
507		}
508		return authority
509	}
510	
511	func remoteRefsAuthority(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
512		values := make([]string, 0, 16)
513		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
514			values = append(values, ref.Ref, boolString(ref.Exists), ref.OID, ref.Failure)
515		}
516		return authorityHash("taskflow-remote-refs-v1", values...)
517	}
518	
519	func remoteRefsEvidence(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
520		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
521		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
522			if ref.Ref == "" {
523				continue
524			}
525			switch {
526			case ref.Failure != "":
527				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" error: "+ref.Failure)
528			case ref.Exists:
529				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"="+ref.OID)
530			default:
531				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" is absent")
532			}
533		}
534		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
535	}
536	
537	func refreshRemoteSummary(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) string {
538		operation := "fetch refs and query review"
539		switch {
540		case options.FetchRefs && !options.QueryReview:
541			operation = "fetch refs"
542		case !options.FetchRefs && options.QueryReview:
543			operation = "query review"
544		}
545		return operation + " for " + observed.head + " via " + observed.remoteName
546	}
547	
548	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
549		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
550			return Result{}, err
551		}
552		if approved.Action != RefreshRemote {
553			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "refresh-remote handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
554		}
555		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
556			return Result{}, err
557		}
558		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
559		if err != nil {
560			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
561		}
562	
563		var result Result
564		applyLocked := func(tx *task.Tx) error {
565			var record *task.Record
566			if approved.Locator.TaskID != "" {
567				if tx == nil {
568					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "managed remote refresh has no task transaction"}
569				}
570				current, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
571				if loadErr != nil {
572					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before remote refresh"}
573				}
574				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *current); identityErr != nil {
575					return identityErr
576				}
577				record = current
578			}
579	
580			spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, approved.Request, record)
581			if observeErr != nil {
582				return observeErr
583			}
584			fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
585			if buildErr != nil {
586				return buildErr
587			}
588			if record != nil {
589				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
590				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
591					actual := ""
592					if current != nil {
593						actual = current.Revision
594					}
595					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked remote refresh replan")
596				}
597			}
598			if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
599				return &StalePlanError{
600					ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
601					ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
602					ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
603					Reason:                       "fresh task, repository, remote URL, provider, or ref authority differs",
604				}
605			}
606			if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
607				notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
608				return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh remote refresh conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
609			}
610	
611			execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh}
612			result, observeErr = execution.executeRefreshRemote(ctx, observed)
613			return observeErr
614		}
615	
616		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
617			if approved.Locator.TaskID == "" {
618				return applyLocked(nil)
619			}
620			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, applyLocked)
621		})
622		return result, err
623	}
624	
625	func (e *executionState) executeRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation) (Result, error) {
626		data := RemoteObservation{
627			RemoteName: observed.remoteName, RemoteURL: observed.remoteURL,
628			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
629			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, BeforeRefs: observed.refs,
630		}
631		e.remote = &data
632		fetched := false
633	
634		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
635			switch effect.Code {
636			case EffectFetchRefs:
637				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
638					_, fetchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "--", observed.remoteName)
639					if fetchErr != nil {
640						return "", fmt.Errorf("fetch --prune %s: %w", observed.remoteName, fetchErr)
641					}
642					return "fetched and pruned " + observed.remoteName, nil
643				})
644				if err != nil {
645					recovery := []string{"remote refs were not proven refreshed; repair the exact remote fetch and create a fresh plan"}
646					if e.plan.Request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions).QueryReview {
647						recovery = append(recovery, "review query was not attempted after the failed fetch")
648					}
649					return e.fail(err, recovery...)
650				}
651				fetched = true
652				data.AfterRefs = e.service.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
653				data.HasAfterRefs = true
654	
655			case EffectQueryReview:
656				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
657					if err := e.service.revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx, observed, fetched); err != nil {
658						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
659						return "", err
660					}
661					query := forge.ReviewQuery{Repository: observed.providerRepository, Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base}
662					review, queryErr := e.service.queryReview(ctx, observed.provider, observed.repoPath, query)
663					if queryErr != nil {
664						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, queryErr)
665						return "", queryErr
666					}
667					if review == nil {
668						data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
669							State: ObservationKnown, Exists: false,
670							Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
671							Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
672						}
673						data.HasReview = true
674						return "provider reports no exact review", nil
675					}
676					if err := validateRemoteReview(observed, *review); err != nil {
677						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
678						return "", err
679					}
680					observedAt := review.ObservedAt.UTC()
681					if review.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
682						observedAt = e.service.now()
683					}
684					data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
685						State: ObservationKnown, Exists: true,
686						Provider: review.Provider, Repository: review.Repository,
687						ID: review.ID, Number: review.Number, ReviewState: review.State,
688						Draft: review.Draft, URL: review.URL, Head: review.Head, Base: review.Base,
689						ObservedAt: observedAt,
690					}
691					data.HasReview = true
692					return fmt.Sprintf("observed %s review #%d (%s)", review.Provider, review.Number, review.State), nil
693				})
694				if err != nil {
695					if fetched {
696						return e.fail(err, "fetch completed; review evidence remains an explicit error and may be retried from a fresh query-only plan")
697					}
698					return e.fail(err, "local refs and task state were unchanged; repair provider access or response handling and retry")
699				}
700	
701			default:
702				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RefreshRemote effect " + string(effect.Code)})
703			}
704		}
705		return e.result(), nil
706	}
707	
708	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation, allowFetchedRefs bool) error {
709		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
710		if err != nil {
711			return staleBoundary("repository became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
712		}
713		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
714		if err != nil {
715			return staleBoundary("repository main path became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
716		}
717		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
718		if err != nil {
719			return staleBoundary("Git common directory became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
720		}
721		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
722			return staleBoundary("repository identity changed before review query")
723		}
724		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
725		kind, repositoryIdentity := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
726		if remoteURL != observed.remoteURL || kind != observed.providerKind || repositoryIdentity != observed.providerRepository {
727			return staleBoundary("remote URL or provider repository identity changed before review query")
728		}
729		if observed.provider == nil || observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind {
730			return staleBoundary("review provider identity changed before query")
731		}
732		if _, ok := observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier); !ok {
733			return staleBoundary("review provider capability changed before query")
734		}
735		if !observed.provider.Available() {
736			return staleBoundary("review provider CLI became unavailable before query")
737		}
738		if !allowFetchedRefs {
739			freshRefs := s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
740			if remoteRefsAuthority(freshRefs) != remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs) {
741				return staleBoundary("local or remote-tracking ref authority changed before query")
742			}
743		}
744		return nil
745	}
746	
747	func (e *executionState) setRemoteReviewFailure(data *RemoteObservation, observed remoteRefreshObservation, err error) {
748		data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
749			State: ObservationError, Exists: false,
750			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
751			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
752			FailureKind: classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err), Failure: err.Error(),
753		}
754		data.HasReview = true
755	}
756	
757	func classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err error) RemoteReviewFailureKind {
758		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrAmbiguousReview) {
759			return RemoteReviewFailureAmbiguous
760		}
761		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrMalformedReviewResponse) {
762			return RemoteReviewFailureMalformed
763		}
764		var unsupported *forge.ErrUnsupported
765		if errors.As(err, &unsupported) {
766			return RemoteReviewFailureUnsupported
767		}
768		var missingCLI *forge.ErrNoCLI
769		if errors.As(err, &missingCLI) {
770			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingCLI
771		}
772		var missingExtension *forge.ErrNoExtension
773		if errors.As(err, &missingExtension) {
774			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingExtension
775		}
776		return RemoteReviewFailureProvider
777	}
778	
779	func validateRemoteReview(observed remoteRefreshObservation, review forge.Review) error {
780		switch {
781		case review.Provider != observed.providerKind:
782			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "provider")
783		case review.Repository != observed.providerRepository:
784			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "repository identity")
785		case review.Head != observed.head:
786			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "head branch")
787		case review.Base != observed.base:
788			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "base branch")
789		case strings.TrimSpace(review.ID) == "" || review.ID != strings.TrimSpace(review.ID):
790			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "identifier")
791		case review.Number <= 0:
792			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "number")
793		case !review.State.Valid():
794			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "state")
795		case review.State == forge.ReviewDraft && !review.Draft:
796			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft flag")
797		case review.State == forge.ReviewOpen && review.Draft:
798			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft state")
799		case !validRemoteReviewURL(review.URL):
800			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "URL")
801		}
802		return nil
803	}
804	
805	func malformedRemoteReview(provider forge.Kind, field string) error {
806		return &forge.MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: 0, Field: field}
807	}
808	
809	func validRemoteReviewURL(raw string) bool {
810		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
811		return err == nil && parsed.Host != "" && (parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http")
812	}
813	
814	func remoteRefCount(refs RemoteRefsObservation) int {
815		count := 0
816		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
817			if ref.Exists && ref.Failure == "" && ref.OID != "" {
818				count++
819			}
820		}
821		return count
822	}
823	
824	func remoteRefSummary(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
825		return strconv.Itoa(remoteRefCount(refs)) + " named ref OID(s) observed"
826	}

299	func removeContainmentConditions(observed destructiveObservation, options RemoveCheckoutOptions) []Condition {

312		switch {

315				"containment base "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "restore the exact local base")
316		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:

321				"containment base resolved without an OID", "repair containment-base observation")
322		}

324			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is contained in %s (%s)", observed.locator.Branch, observed.branchOID,
325				options.ContainmentBase, observed.baseOID), "")
326		switch {
327		case observed.containedErr != nil:
328			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
329				observed.containedErr.Error(), "repair local ancestry observation")
330		case !observed.branchExists || observed.branchOID == "" || !observed.baseExists || observed.baseOID == "":
331			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
332				"exact branch/base containment cannot be proved", "restore both exact local refs")
333		case !observed.contained:

335				"branch is not contained in "+options.ContainmentBase, "integrate it before contained retirement")
336		}

338			"local branch will be retained after contained checkout removal", "")
339		if options.DeleteContainedBranch {

341				"ordinary git branch -d will run under the same repository/task lock", "")
342			if observed.locator.Branch == options.ContainmentBase {

363				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
364		case !observed.artifact.Ready():
365			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
366				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
367		default:
368			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
369				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "")
370		}
371	}

373	func removeCheckoutFallback(observed destructiveObservation, options RemoveCheckoutOptions) string {
374		parts := []string{"dev", "wt", "rm", shellQuote(observed.locator.Branch)}
375		if options.RequireContained {
376			parts = []string{"dev", "retire", shellQuote(observed.checkout)}
377			if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
378				parts = append(parts, "--delete-branch")
379			}
380		} else if options.DiscardDirty {
381			parts = append(parts, "--force")
382		}
383		if options.CloseUnknown {
384			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
385		}
386		if options.AssumeNoRuntime {
387			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
388		}
389		if options.Timeout > 0 {
390			parts = append(parts, "--timeout", options.Timeout.String())
391		}
392		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
393	}

395	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
396		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
397			return Result{}, err
398		}
399		if approved.Action != RemoveCheckout {
400			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "remove-checkout handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
401		}
402		if err := validateRemoveCheckoutLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
403			return Result{}, err
404		}
405		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
406		if err != nil {
407			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
408		}
409	
410		var result Result
411		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
412			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
413				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, approved.Request, tx.ListRecords)
414				if observeErr != nil {
415					return observeErr
416				}
417				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
418				if buildErr != nil {
419					return buildErr
420				}
421				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
422					return &StalePlanError{
423						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
424						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
425						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
426						Reason:                       "fresh unmanaged Git, worktree, task, artifact, runtime, or harness authority differs",
427					}
428				}
429				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
430					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
431					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh unmanaged removal conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
432				}
433				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx}
434				result, observeErr = execution.executeRemoveCheckout(ctx, observed)
435				return observeErr
436			})
437		})
438		return result, err
439	}
440	
441	func (e *executionState) executeRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
442		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RemoveCheckoutOptions)
443		closedRuntime := false
444	
445		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
446			switch effect.Code {
447			case EffectDiscardAll:
448				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, false)
449				if err != nil {
450					return e.fail(err, "refresh unmanaged removal before discarding bytes")
451				}
452				baseline = fresh
453				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
454					if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, baseline.checkout); discardErr != nil {
455						return "dirty discard may be partial", fmt.Errorf("discard exact checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
456					}
457					return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
458				})
459				if err != nil {
460					e.partial = true
461					return e.fail(err, "inspect every checkout byte before retrying removal")
462				}
463				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, true, false)
464				if err != nil {
465					return e.fail(err, "discard completed but a safety source changed; preserve the checkout and refresh")
466				}
467				baseline = fresh
468	
469			case EffectCloseRuntime:
470				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, false)
471				if err != nil {
472					return e.fail(err, "refresh unmanaged removal before closing any runtime")
473				}
474				baseline = fresh
475				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
476					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
477						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
478						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
479					})
480					if closeErr != nil {
481						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
482					}
483					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil
484				})
485				if err != nil {
486					e.partial = true
487					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and branch remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
488				}
489				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, true)
490				if err != nil {
491					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh removal")
492				}
493				baseline = fresh
494				closedRuntime = true
495	
496			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
497				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, closedRuntime)
498				if err != nil {
499					return e.fail(err, "the checkout was preserved; refresh every safety source")
500				}
501				baseline = fresh
502				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
503					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
504						return "checkout removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact unmanaged checkout %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
505					}
506					return "removed exact clean linked checkout without force; branch preserved", nil
507				})
508				if err != nil {
509					e.partial = true
510					return e.fail(err, "inspect the exact worktree registration and preserved branch before retrying")
511				}
512				if err := e.verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
513					return e.fail(err, "checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact preserved local branch")
514				}
515				e.snapshot = "checkout:removed:" + baseline.checkout + ":" + baseline.branchOID
516	
517			case EffectDeleteBranch:
518				if e.snapshot == "" {
519					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before verified checkout removal"})
520				}
521				if err := e.revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
522					return e.fail(err, "the checkout was removed but the branch and task inventory changed; keep the branch and refresh")
523				}
524				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
525					if _, deleteErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, baseline.repoPath, "branch", "-d", "--", baseline.locator.Branch); deleteErr != nil {
526						return "contained branch deletion failed", deleteErr
527					}
528					return "deleted contained local branch " + baseline.locator.Branch, nil
529				})
530				if err != nil {
531					e.partial = true
532					return e.fail(err, "checkout removal remains complete; inspect the retained branch and retry")
533				}
534				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
535					return e.fail(errors.New("local branch still exists after successful deletion"), "inspect the branch before retrying")
536				}
537				e.snapshot += ":branch-deleted"
538	
539			default:
540				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RemoveCheckout effect " + string(effect.Code)})
541			}
542		}
543		if e.snapshot == "" {
544			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unmanaged removal ended without verified checkout removal"})
545		}
546		return e.result(), nil
547	}

549	func (e *executionState) reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation, allowDiscard, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
550		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, e.plan.Request, e.tx.ListRecords)
551		if err != nil {
552			return fresh, err
553		}
554		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
555			return fresh, err
556		}
557		for _, check := range []struct {
558			name          string
559			before, after string
560		}{
561			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
562			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
563			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
564			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
565			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
566			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
567			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
568		} {
569			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
570				return fresh, err
571			}
572		}
573		if allowDiscard {
574			if err := comparePostDiscardGit(baseline, fresh); err != nil {
575				return fresh, err
576			}
577		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()); err != nil {
578			return fresh, err
579		}
580		if allowRuntimeChange {
581			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
582				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
583			}
584		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
585			return fresh, err
586		}
587		return fresh, nil
588	}
589	
590	func comparePostDiscardGit(before, after destructiveObservation) error {
591		if after.statusErr != nil || after.status.Dirty() {
592			return staleBoundary("checkout is not clean after explicit discard")
593		}
594		beforeStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
595			before.status.Branch, boolString(before.status.Detached), before.status.Upstream,
596			fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Behind),
597			before.head, errorString(before.headErr), before.operation, boolString(before.inProgress), errorString(before.operationErr),
598		)
599		afterStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
600			after.status.Branch, boolString(after.status.Detached), after.status.Upstream,
601			fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Behind),
602			after.head, errorString(after.headErr), after.operation, boolString(after.inProgress), errorString(after.operationErr),
603		)
604		return compareAuthorityCategory("post-discard Git identity", beforeStable, afterStable)
605	}
606	
607	func (e *executionState) revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
608		records, diagnostics, err := e.tx.ListRecords()
609		if err != nil {
610			return err
611		}
612		claims := baseline
613		claims.taskRecords = records
614		claims.taskDiagnostics = diagnostics
615		claims.taskClaims = nil
616		claims.taskIncomplete = nil
617		e.service.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &claims)
618		if len(claims.taskIncomplete) > 0 {
619			return staleBoundary("task inventory became incomplete before branch deletion")
620		}
621		if len(claims.taskClaims) > 0 {
622			return staleBoundary("a task claimed the checkout path or branch before branch deletion")
623		}
624		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
625		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
626		if fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID || fresh.baseOID != baseline.baseOID ||
627			fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.baseOIDErr != nil || fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
628			return staleBoundary("branch or containment-base authority changed before branch deletion")
629		}
630		worktrees, err := e.service.gitWorktrees(ctx, baseline.repoPath)
631		if err != nil {
632			return err
633		}
634		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
635			if worktree.Branch == baseline.locator.Branch {
636				return staleBoundary("branch acquired another checkout before deletion")
637			}
638		}
639		return nil
640	}
641	
642	func (e *executionState) verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
643		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
644		if err == nil {
645			return staleBoundary("exact unmanaged checkout remains registered after removal")
646		}
647		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
648			return fmt.Errorf("verify exact unmanaged checkout removal: %w", err)
649		}
650		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
651		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, "")
652		if !fresh.branchExists || fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID {
653			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("preserved local branch changed from %s to %s", baseline.branchOID, fresh.branchOID))
654		}
655		return nil
656	}

287	func cloneSteps(steps []StepResult) []StepResult {
288		out := make([]StepResult, len(steps))
289		for index, step := range steps {
290			out[index] = step.Clone()
291		}
292		return out
293	}
294	
295	func stepsWithStatus(steps []StepResult, status StepStatus) []StepResult {
296		out := make([]StepResult, 0, len(steps))
297		for _, step := range steps {
298			if step.Status == status {
299				out = append(out, step.Clone())
300			}
301		}
302		return out
303	}
304

345	func resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
346		return observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && observed.hasCheckout() && observed.statusErr == nil &&
347			!observed.status.Detached && observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch
348	}

350	func shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
351		return observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.savedRuntimeLive
352	}

354	func resumeEffectCheckout(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
355		if observed.hasCheckout() {
356			return observed.checkout
357		}
358		return observed.desiredWorktree
359	}

361	func resumeRuntimeLabel(candidate task.Task) string {
362		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
363			return candidate.Repo + "/" + candidate.Branch
364		}
365		return candidate.Title()
366	}

368	func resumeFallback(id string, options ResumeOptions) string {
369		parts := []string{"dev", "resume", shellQuote(id)}
370		if !options.FetchRefs {
371			parts = append(parts, "--fetch=false")
372		}
373		if options.NoProvision {
374			parts = append(parts, "--no-provision")
375		}
376		if options.TakeOwnership {
377			parts = append(parts, "--force")
378		}
379		return strings.Join(parts, " ")

15	func (s *lifecycleService) retireHandler() Handler {
16		return Handler{
17			Plan:  s.planRetire,
18			Apply: s.applyRetire,
19		}
20	}
21	
22	func validateRetireLocator(locator Locator) error {
23		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(locator); err != nil {
24			return err
25		}
26		if locator.Mode == task.ModeWorktree && locator.CheckoutPath != "" && locator.HeadOID == "" {
27			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact linked-checkout HEAD is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
28		}
29		return nil
30	}
31	
32	func (s *lifecycleService) planRetire(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
33		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		if err := validateRetireLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
37			return PlanSpec{}, err
38		}
39		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
40		if err != nil {
41			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
42		}
43		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, *record); err != nil {
44			return PlanSpec{}, err
45		}
46		spec, _, err := s.observeRetire(ctx, request, *record, s.tasks.ListRecords)
47		if err != nil {
48			return PlanSpec{}, err
49		}
50		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
51		if err != nil {
52			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning retirement"}
53		}
54		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
55			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning retirement")
56		}
57		return spec, nil
58	}
59	
60	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRetire(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record, loadTasks taskInventoryLoader) (PlanSpec, destructiveObservation, error) {
61		candidate := record.Task
62		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
63		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == ""
64		var (
65			rt    runtime.Runtime
66			rtErr error
67		)
68		if noCheckout && candidate.RuntimeName == "" && candidate.RuntimeHandle == "" {
69			rt = runtime.None{}
70		} else {
71			rt, rtErr = s.runtimeFor(candidate)
72		}
73		options := request.Options.(RetireOptions)
74		cleanup := retire.Options{
75			CWD: s.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: s.callerPane,
76			CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
77		}
78		observed, err := s.inspectDestructive(ctx, destructiveInspectInput{
79			locator: request.Locator, base: candidate.Base, runtime: rt, rtErr: rtErr, cleanup: cleanup,
80			noCheckout: noCheckout, inspectArtifacts: !noCheckout,
81			inspectTasks: true, loadTasks: loadTasks,
82		})
83		if err != nil {
84			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
85		}
86		return s.retireSpec(request, record, observed), observed, nil
