109				EffectCloseRuntime, "close eligible runtime sessions covering the checkout", observed.checkout, true, false,
110				map[string]string{"backend": runtimeName(observed.runtime), "sessions": fmt.Sprintf("%d", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions))},
111			))
112		}
113		if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout {
114			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
115				EffectRemoveWorktree, "remove the exact clean linked worktree without force", observed.checkout, true, false,
116				map[string]string{"repo": observed.repoPath, "branch": candidate.Branch, "head": observed.head, "force": "false"},
117			))
118		}
119		if options.DeleteBranch && mode != task.ModeDirect && candidate.Branch != candidate.Base && observed.branchExists {
120			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
121				EffectDeleteBranch, "delete the freshly contained local task branch", candidate.Branch, true, false,
122				map[string]string{"branch-ref": observed.branchRef, "branch-oid": observed.branchOID, "base-ref": observed.baseRef, "base-oid": observed.baseOID},
123			))
124		}
125		effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
126			EffectDeleteTask, "CAS-delete the DONE task record last", candidate.ID, true, false,
127			map[string]string{"expected-revision": record.Revision},
128		))
129	
130		confirmation := Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Retire this DONE task and its eligible local resources?"}
131		if options.DeleteBranch && mode != task.ModeDirect && candidate.Branch != candidate.Base && observed.branchExists {
132			confirmation = Confirmation{
133				Kind: ConfirmationTyped, Token: "DELETE " + candidate.Branch,
134				Prompt: "Type DELETE " + candidate.Branch + " to remove the contained local branch under this exact plan",
135			}
136		}
137		retained := retireRetainedResources(candidate, observed, noCheckout, options)
138		return PlanSpec{
139			Authority:         mergeAuthority(retireTaskAuthority(record), observed.authority()),
140			Conditions:        conditions,
141			Effects:           effects,
142			RetainedResources: retained,
143			Confirmation:      confirmation,
144			FallbackCommand:   retireFallback(candidate.ID, options),
145			Summary:           "Retire " + candidate.Title(),
146			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
147		}
148	}
149	
150	func retireTaskAuthority(record task.Record) map[string]string {
151		candidate := record.Task
152		return map[string]string{
153			"task.id": record.Task.ID, "task.revision": record.Revision,
154			"task.mode": string(candidate.EffectiveMode()), "task.state": string(candidate.State),
155			"task.repo": candidate.Repo, "task.repo-path": candidate.RepoPath,
156			"task.branch": candidate.Branch, "task.base": candidate.Base,
157			"task.worktree-path": candidate.WorktreePath,
158			"task.runtime-name":  candidate.RuntimeName, "task.runtime-handle": candidate.RuntimeHandle,
159		}
160	}
161	
162	func retireRepositoryCondition(observed destructiveObservation) Condition {
163		if observed.repoErr != nil {
164			return condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
165				observed.repoErr.Error(), "restore the exact repository before retirement")
166		}
167		return condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
168			"Git main "+observed.repoPath+" with common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, "")
169	}
170	
171	func retireTaskClaimConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
172		inventoryCondition := condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
173			"task inventory is complete for retirement claim checks", "")
174		switch {
175		case observed.taskInventoryErr != nil:
176			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
177				observed.taskInventoryErr.Error(), "repair task-store inventory before retirement")
178		case len(observed.taskIncomplete) > 0:
179			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
180				strings.Join(observed.taskIncomplete, "; "), "repair every corrupt or unresolvable task record")
181		}
182	
183		var conflicting []string
184		for _, claim := range observed.taskClaims {
185			if claim.ID != candidate.ID {
186				conflicting = append(conflicting, claim.ID+" ("+claim.Reason+")")
187			}
188		}
189		claimsCondition := condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
190			"only task "+candidate.ID+" claims the retirement branch/checkout", "")
191		if len(conflicting) > 0 {
192			claimsCondition = condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
193				"also claimed by "+strings.Join(conflicting, ", "),
194				"reconcile every conflicting task before removing shared resources")
195		}
196		return []Condition{inventoryCondition, claimsCondition}
197	}
198	
199	func retireCheckoutConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
200		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
201		if noCheckout {
202			paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(false)
203			exactVerdict := VerdictMet
204			exactEvidence := "persisted DONE task records no checkout and Git has no checkout for its branch"
205			if err != nil {
206				exactVerdict = VerdictError
207				exactEvidence = err.Error()
208			} else if len(paths) > 0 {
209				exactVerdict = VerdictBlocked
210				exactEvidence = "task branch is still checked out at " + strings.Join(paths, ", ")
211			}
212			return []Condition{
213				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
214					"no recorded checkout is the narrow persisted-DONE reap case", ""),
215				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence,
216					"reconcile the discovered checkout before retirement"),
217				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
218					"no worktree removal is requested", ""),
219				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
220					"no worktree registration will be removed", ""),
221				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
222					"branch identity is proved from the local ref", ""),
223				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
224					"no checkout status is required for record-only reaping", ""),
225				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
226					"no checkout Git operation can be removed", ""),
227				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
228					"no checkout bytes will be removed", ""),
229				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
230					"no checkout path is selected", ""),
231			}
232		}
233	
234		if !observed.worktreeFound {
235			verdict := VerdictBlocked
236			evidence := "the exact recorded checkout is not registered"
237			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !errors.Is(observed.worktreeErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
238				verdict = VerdictError
239				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
240			}
241			return []Condition{
242				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "restore or reconcile the exact checkout"),
243				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree identity is unavailable", "refresh Git topology"),
244				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree kind is unavailable", "refresh Git topology"),
245				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "worktree flags are unavailable", "refresh Git topology"),
246				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout branch is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
247				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout status is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
248				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "Git operation state is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
249				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout cleanliness is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
250				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout ownership is unavailable", "refresh repository topology"),
251			}
252		}
253	
254		exactVerdict := VerdictMet
255		exactEvidence := "registered path, repository, Git common directory, and live HEAD are exact"
256		switch {
257		case observed.worktree.Path != observed.checkout:
258			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered path differs from the exact selected checkout"
259		case observed.worktree.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir:
260			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered repository identity differs from the selected repository"
261		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.headErr != nil:
262			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
263		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head:
264			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry HEAD %s differs from live HEAD %s", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
265		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.locator.HeadOID != "" && observed.locator.HeadOID != observed.head:
266			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("selected HEAD %s differs from live HEAD %s", observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
267		}
268	
269		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
270		kindEvidence := "Git main checkout retained"
271		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
272			kindEvidence = "registered non-main linked worktree"
273			if !observed.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree() {
274				kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
275				kindEvidence = "worktree task does not resolve to a non-main linked worktree"
276			}
277		} else if !observed.worktree.Worktree.Main || observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare || observed.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath {
278			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
279			kindEvidence = "branch/direct task does not resolve to the exact non-bare Git main checkout"
280		}
281	
282		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
283		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and non-prunable"
284		flagRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
285		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
286			flagRequirement = RequirementRequired
287			if observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked || observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable {
288				flagVerdict = VerdictBlocked
289				flagEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("locked=%t prunable=%t", observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked, observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable)
290			}
291		}
292	
293		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
294		branchEvidence := "canonical checkout branch is irrelevant because it is retained"
295		branchRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
296		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
297			branchRequirement = RequirementRequired
298			branchEvidence = "registry, status, branch ref, and live HEAD identify " + candidate.Branch
299			switch {
300			case observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch == "":
301				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered linked worktree is detached or unnamed"
302			case observed.statusErr != nil:
303				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
304			case observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != candidate.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch:
305				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, candidate.Branch)
306			case !observed.branchExists || observed.branchOID != observed.head:
307				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("branch exists=%t branch OID=%q live HEAD=%q", observed.branchExists, observed.branchOID, observed.head)
308			}
309		}
310	
311		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
312		statusEvidence := "canonical checkout content is retained"
313		statusRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
314		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
315		operationEvidence := "canonical checkout Git operation is retained"
316		operationRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
317		cleanVerdict := VerdictMet
318		cleanEvidence := "canonical checkout bytes are retained"
319		cleanRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
320		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
321			statusRequirement, operationRequirement, cleanRequirement = RequirementRequired, RequirementRequired, RequirementRequired
322			if observed.statusErr != nil {
323				statusVerdict, statusEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
324				cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
325			} else {
326				statusEvidence = observed.status.Summary()
327				if observed.status.Dirty() {
328					cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictBlocked, observed.status.Breakdown()
329				} else {
330					cleanEvidence = "checkout is clean"
331				}
332			}
333			if observed.operationErr != nil {
334				operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictError, observed.operationErr.Error()
335			} else if observed.inProgress {
336				operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "Git operation "+observed.operation+" is in progress"
337			} else {
338				operationEvidence = "no Git operation is in progress"
339			}
340		}
341	
342		harnessVerdict := VerdictMet
343		harnessEvidence := "checkout has no strict Claude harness ownership evidence"
344		harnessRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
345		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
346			harnessRequirement = RequirementRequired
347			if observed.isHarness {
348				harnessVerdict = VerdictBlocked
349				harnessEvidence = "checkout is strictly under harness root " + observed.harness.Root
350			}
351		}
352		return []Condition{
353			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
354			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "refresh the exact checkout identity"),
355			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "reconcile the task checkout mode"),
356			condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, flagVerdict, flagRequirement, flagEvidence, "unlock or repair the worktree registration"),
357			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, branchRequirement, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named branch and HEAD"),
358			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, statusRequirement, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
359			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, operationRequirement, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
360			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, cleanRequirement, cleanEvidence, "commit or preserve every changed byte"),
361			condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, harnessVerdict, harnessRequirement, harnessEvidence, "let the harness retire its own checkout"),
362		}
363	}
364	
365	func retireRefConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
366		baseCondition := condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
367			fmt.Sprintf("local base %s at %s", candidate.Base, observed.baseOID), "")
368		switch {
369		case candidate.Base == "":
370			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
371				"DONE retirement requires the task's explicit local base", "record the exact local base branch")
372		case !observed.baseExists:
373			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
374				"local base ref "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "restore the named local base branch")
375		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
376			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
377				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair local base observation")
378		case observed.baseOID == "":
379			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
380				"local base resolved to no commit", "restore the named local base branch")
381		}
382	
383		branchCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
384			fmt.Sprintf("local branch %s at %s", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID), "")
385		if !observed.branchExists {
386			if noCheckout {
387				branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
388					"local task branch is already absent for a persisted DONE task with no checkout", "")
389			} else {
390				branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
391					"local task branch "+observed.branchRef+" is missing", "restore the task branch before retiring its checkout")
392			}
393		} else if observed.branchOIDErr != nil {
394			branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
395				observed.branchOIDErr.Error(), "repair local task branch observation")
396		} else if observed.branchOID == "" {
397			branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
398				"local task branch resolved to no commit", "restore the local task branch")
399		}
400	
401		relationCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
402			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID), "")
403		switch {
404		case !observed.branchExists && noCheckout:
405			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
406				"missing branch is accepted only because persisted DONE records no checkout", "")
407		case observed.containedErr != nil:
408			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
409				observed.containedErr.Error(), "repair local containment observation")
410		case observed.branchExists && observed.baseExists && observed.branchOIDErr == nil && observed.baseOIDErr == nil && !observed.contained:
411			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
412				fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is not contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID),
413				"integrate the task branch into the named local base first")
414		case !observed.branchExists || !observed.baseExists || observed.branchOID == "" || observed.baseOID == "":
415			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
416				"containment cannot be proved from exact local branch and base OIDs", "restore both local refs")
417		}
418		return []Condition{baseCondition, branchCondition, relationCondition}
419	}
420	
421	func retireArtifactCondition(observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) Condition {
422		if noCheckout {
423			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
424				"no checkout is recorded for artifact inspection", "")
425		}
426		switch {
427		case !observed.worktreeFound:
428			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
429				"artifact readiness requires the exact linked checkout", "restore the checkout")
430		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
431			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
432				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
433		case !observed.artifact.Ready():
434			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
435				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
436		default:
437			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
438				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "")
439		}
440	}
441	
442	func retireRuntimeConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
443		if noCheckout {
444			if candidate.RuntimeName != "" || candidate.RuntimeHandle != "" {
445				return []Condition{
446					condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
447						"task has a runtime hint but no exact checkout", "reconcile or clear the runtime hint outside retirement"),
448					condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
449						"runtime coverage cannot be tied to an exact checkout", "reconcile the missing checkout"),
450					condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
451						"caller containment cannot be inspected without a checkout", "reconcile the missing checkout"),
452				}
453			}
454			return []Condition{
455				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "no runtime hint is recorded", ""),
456				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "no checkout or runtime hint requires cleanup", ""),
457				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "no checkout can contain the caller", ""),
458			}
459		}
460		return destructiveRuntimeConditions(observed)
461	}
462	
463	func destructiveRuntimeConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
464		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
465			return []Condition{
466				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
467				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime observation"),
468				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime was not inspected", "run cleanup from outside the checkout"),
469			}
470		}
471		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + runtimeName(observed.runtime) + " is available"
472		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
473			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " reports unavailable; cleanup evidence still controls"
474		}
475		if observed.cleanupErr != nil {
476			return []Condition{
477				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, "select an available backend or use the explicit external acknowledgement"),
478				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.cleanupErr.Error(), "repair runtime enumeration or use the explicit external acknowledgement"),
479				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime occupancy failed", "run cleanup from outside the checkout"),
480			}
481		}
482		occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
483		occupancyEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%d eligible runtime session(s)", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions))
484		if observed.cleanup.RuntimeUnknown {
485			occupancyEvidence = "runtime enumeration failed and the external assume-no-runtime acknowledgement is recorded"
486		}
487		if len(observed.cleanup.Blockers) > 0 {
488			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
489			occupancyEvidence = strings.Join(observed.cleanup.Blockers, "; ")
490		}
491		callerVerdict := VerdictMet
492		callerEvidence := "caller is outside the target checkout and covering runtimes"
493		if observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
494			callerVerdict = VerdictBlocked
495			callerEvidence = "caller is inside the target checkout or a covering runtime"
496		}
497		return []Condition{
498			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, ""),
499			condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop active agents and leave mixed/caller runtimes intact"),
500			condition(ConditionCallerContainment, callerVerdict, RequirementRequired, callerEvidence, "run cleanup from outside the target checkout and runtime"),
501		}
502	}
503	
504	func retireBranchDeletionCondition(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool, options RetireOptions) Condition {
505		if !options.DeleteBranch {
506			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
507				"local task branch will be retained", "")
508		}
509		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
510			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
511				"direct tasks never delete their branch", "retire without branch deletion")
512		}
513		if candidate.Branch == candidate.Base {
514			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
515				"task branch is the explicit base branch", "retire without deleting the base")
516		}
517		if !observed.branchExists && noCheckout {
518			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
519				"local task branch is already absent", "")
520		}
521		paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout)
522		if err != nil {
523			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
524				err.Error(), "refresh registered worktrees before branch deletion")
525		}
526		if len(paths) > 0 {
527			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
528				"branch is checked out at "+strings.Join(paths, ", "), "switch or remove those exact checkouts first")
529		}
530		return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
531			"ordinary git branch -d will delete only the freshly contained local branch", "")
532	}
533	
534	func retireRetainedResources(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool, options RetireOptions) []string {
535		var retained []string
536		if observed.branchExists && (!options.DeleteBranch || candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect) {
537			retained = append(retained, "branch:"+candidate.Branch)
538		}
539		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && observed.checkout != "" {
540			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+observed.checkout)
541		}
542		return retained
543	}
544	
545	func retireFallback(id string, options RetireOptions) string {
546		parts := []string{"dev", "retire", shellQuote(id)}
547		if options.DeleteBranch {
548			parts = append(parts, "--delete-branch")
549		}
550		if options.CloseUnknown {
551			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
552		}
553		if options.AssumeNoRuntime {
554			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
555		}
556		if options.Timeout > 0 {
557			parts = append(parts, "--timeout", options.Timeout.String())
558		}
559		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
560	}
561	
562	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRetire(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
563		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
564			return Result{}, err
565		}
566		if approved.Action != Retire {
567			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "retire handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
568		}
569		if err := validateRetireLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
570			return Result{}, err
571		}
572		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
573		if err != nil {
574			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
575		}
576	
577		var result Result
578		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
579			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
580				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
581				if loadErr != nil {
582					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before retirement apply"}
583				}
584				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
585					return identityErr
586				}
587				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRetire(ctx, approved.Request, *record, tx.ListRecords)
588				if observeErr != nil {
589					return observeErr
590				}
591				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
592				if buildErr != nil {
593					return buildErr
594				}
595				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
596				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
597					actual := ""
598					if current != nil {
599						actual = current.Revision
600					}
601					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked retirement replan")
602				}
603				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
604					return &StalePlanError{
605						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
606						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
607						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
608						Reason:                       "fresh retirement task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or ref authority differs",
609					}
610				}
611				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
612					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
613					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh retirement conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
614				}
615	
616				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision}
617				result, observeErr = execution.executeRetire(ctx, *record, observed)
618				return observeErr
619			})
620		})
621		return result, err
622	}
623	
624	func (e *executionState) executeRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
625		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RetireOptions)
626		candidate := record.Task
627		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
628		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == ""
629		closedRuntime := false
630		removedWorktree := false
631		deletedBranch := false
632	
633		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
634			switch effect.Code {
635			case EffectCloseRuntime:
636				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, false)
637				if err != nil {
638					return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before closing any runtime")
639				}
640				baseline = fresh
641				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
642					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
643						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
644						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
645					})
646					if closeErr != nil {
647						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
648					}
649					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil
650				})
651				if err != nil {
652					e.partial = true
653					return e.fail(err, "the task and checkout remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
654				}
655				fresh, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, true)
656				if err != nil {
657					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh retirement")
658				}
659				baseline = fresh
660				closedRuntime = true
661	
662			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
663				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
664				if err != nil {
665					return e.fail(err, "the worktree was preserved; refresh every retirement safety source")
666				}
667				baseline = fresh
668				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
669					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
670						return "worktree removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact worktree %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
671					}
672					return "removed exact linked worktree without force; branch retained", nil
673				})
674				if err != nil {
675					e.partial = true
676					return e.fail(err, "inspect Git worktree registration and retained branch before retrying")
677				}
678				removedWorktree = true
679				if err := e.verifyRemovedCheckout(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
680					return e.fail(err, "the checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact retained branch before reaping the task")
681				}
682	
683			case EffectDeleteBranch:
684				if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && !removedWorktree {
685					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before linked worktree removal"})
686				}
687				if mode != task.ModeWorktree || noCheckout {
688					fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
689					if err != nil {
690						return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before deleting the contained branch")
691					}
692					baseline = fresh
693				}
694				if err := e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, false); err != nil {
695					return e.fail(err, "branch or base authority changed; refresh retirement")
696				}
697				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
698					_, deleteErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, baseline.repoPath, "branch", "-d", "--", candidate.Branch)
699					if deleteErr != nil {
700						return "ordinary contained-branch deletion failed", fmt.Errorf("delete contained branch %s: %w", candidate.Branch, deleteErr)
701					}
702					return "deleted contained local branch " + candidate.Branch, nil
703				})
704				if err != nil {
705					e.partial = true
706					return e.fail(err, "the task record remains DONE; inspect the local branch and retry")
707				}
708				deletedBranch = true
709				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
710					return e.fail(errors.New("local branch still exists after successful branch deletion"), "the task remains DONE; inspect Git refs before retrying")
711				}
712				if err := e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
713					return e.fail(err, "the branch deletion completed; restore or inspect the explicit base before task reaping")
714				}
715	
716			case EffectDeleteTask:
717				if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && !removedWorktree {
718					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "task deletion reached before linked worktree removal"})
719				}
720				if err := e.revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch); err != nil {
721					return e.fail(err, "the task remains DONE; refresh retirement from current Git/runtime state")
722				}
723				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
724					if deleteErr := e.service.taskDelete(e.tx, candidate.ID, record.Revision); deleteErr != nil {
725						return "DONE task reap failed", fmt.Errorf("delete retired task %s: %w", candidate.ID, deleteErr)
726					}
727					if _, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(candidate.ID); !errors.Is(verifyErr, task.ErrNotFound) {
728						if verifyErr == nil {
729							verifyErr = errors.New("task record still exists")
730						}
731						return "DONE task reap was not verified", fmt.Errorf("verify retired task %s deletion: %w", candidate.ID, verifyErr)
732					}
733					return "reaped DONE task at revision " + record.Revision, nil
734				})
735				if err != nil {
736					if _, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(candidate.ID); errors.Is(verifyErr, task.ErrNotFound) {
737						e.partial = true
738					}
739					return e.fail(err, "local cleanup may already be complete; reload and retry the CAS task reap")
740				}
741				e.snapshot = "task:deleted:" + candidate.ID + ":" + record.Revision
742				e.milestone = MilestoneRetired
743	
744			default:
745				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected Retire effect " + string(effect.Code)})
746			}
747		}
748		if e.milestone != MilestoneRetired {
749			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "retirement ended without CAS task deletion"})
750		}
751		return e.result(), nil
752	}
753	
754	func (e *executionState) reinspectRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
755		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
756		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
757			actual := ""
758			if current != nil {
759				actual = current.Revision
760			}
761			return destructiveObservation{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed at a retirement boundary")
762		}
763		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRetire(ctx, e.plan.Request, *current, e.tx.ListRecords)
764		if err != nil {
765			return fresh, err
766		}
767		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
768			return fresh, err
769		}
770		for _, check := range []struct {
771			name          string
772			before, after string
773		}{
774			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
775			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
776			{"Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()},
777			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
778			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
779			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
780			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
781			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
782		} {
783			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
784				return fresh, err
785			}
786		}
787		if allowRuntimeChange {
788			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
789				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
790			}
791		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
792			return fresh, err
793		}
794		return fresh, nil
795	}
796	
797	func (e *executionState) verifyRemovedCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
798		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
799		if err == nil {
800			return staleBoundary("exact worktree remains registered after removal")
801		}
802		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
803			return fmt.Errorf("verify exact worktree removal: %w", err)
804		}
805		if err := e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, false); err != nil {
806			return err
807		}
808		return nil
809	}
810	
811	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireRefs(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation, allowMissingBranch bool) error {
812		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
813		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
814		if err := compareAuthorityCategory("explicit base ref", authorityHash("base", baseline.baseRef, boolString(baseline.baseExists), baseline.baseOID, errorString(baseline.baseOIDErr)),
815			authorityHash("base", fresh.baseRef, boolString(fresh.baseExists), fresh.baseOID, errorString(fresh.baseOIDErr))); err != nil {
816			return err
817		}
818		if allowMissingBranch && !fresh.branchExists {
819			return nil
820		}
821		if err := compareAuthorityCategory("task branch ref", authorityHash("branch", baseline.branchRef, boolString(baseline.branchExists), baseline.branchOID, errorString(baseline.branchOIDErr)),
822			authorityHash("branch", fresh.branchRef, boolString(fresh.branchExists), fresh.branchOID, errorString(fresh.branchOIDErr))); err != nil {
823			return err
824		}
825		if fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
826			return staleBoundary("fresh branch containment proof failed")
827		}
828		return nil
829	}
830	
831	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireBase(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
832		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
833		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, "", strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
834		return compareAuthorityCategory("explicit base ref",
835			authorityHash("base", baseline.baseRef, boolString(baseline.baseExists), baseline.baseOID, errorString(baseline.baseOIDErr)),
836			authorityHash("base", fresh.baseRef, boolString(fresh.baseExists), fresh.baseOID, errorString(fresh.baseOIDErr)),
837		)
838	}
839	
840	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch bool) error {
841		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
842		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
843			actual := ""
844			if current != nil {
845				actual = current.Revision
846			}
847			return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed before terminal retirement reap")
848		}
849		mode := record.Task.EffectiveMode()
850		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && record.Task.WorktreePath == ""
851		if removedWorktree {
852			if _, resolveErr := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout); resolveErr == nil {
853				return staleBoundary("removed linked checkout became registered again")
854			} else if !errors.Is(resolveErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
855				return resolveErr
856			}
857			if deletedBranch {
858				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
859					return staleBoundary("deleted task branch reappeared")
860				}
861				return e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline)
862			}
863			return e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, noCheckout && !baseline.branchExists)
864		}
865		if deletedBranch {
866			return e.revalidateRetireAfterBranchDelete(ctx, record, baseline)
867		}
868		_, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
869		return err
870	}
871	
872	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireAfterBranchDelete(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
873		if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
874			return staleBoundary("deleted task branch reappeared")
875		}
876		if err := e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
877			return err
878		}
879		_, fresh, err := e.service.observeRetire(ctx, e.plan.Request, record, e.tx.ListRecords)
880		if err != nil {
881			return err
882		}
883		for _, check := range []struct {
884			name          string
885			before, after string
886		}{
887			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
888			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
889			{"Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()},
890			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
891			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
892			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
893			{"runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)},
894		} {
895			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
896				return err
897			}
898		}
899		return nil
900	}

1	package taskflow
2	
3	import "context"
4	
5	// PlanHook performs action-specific observation and returns only construction
6	// input. BuildPlan remains the single graph, availability, and identity
7	// authority.
8	type PlanHook func(context.Context, Request) (PlanSpec, error)
9	
10	// ApplyHook executes one already validated plan and may return a partial Result
11	// together with an error.
12	type ApplyHook func(context.Context, Plan) (Result, error)
13	
14	// Handler contains the narrow hooks for one exact action. Either hook may be
15	// omitted; no production or unsafe fallback is installed.
16	type Handler struct {
17		Plan  PlanHook
18		Apply ApplyHook
19	}
20	
21	// Handlers maps stable action codes to injected behavior.
22	type Handlers map[Action]Handler
23	
24	// LocateTaskHook builds one exact managed-task locator from fresh durable and
25	// Git evidence. It is intentionally not accepted by NewService: only the
26	// guarded lifecycle constructor may install it.
27	type LocateTaskHook func(context.Context, string) (Locator, error)
28	
29	// Service is the UI-agnostic locate/plan/apply dispatcher.
30	type Service struct {
31		handlers   map[Action]Handler
32		locateTask LocateTaskHook
33	}
34	
35	// NewService copies handlers so later mutation of the caller's map cannot
36	// redirect a planned action.
37	func NewService(handlers Handlers) *Service {
38		copied := make(map[Action]Handler, len(handlers))
39		for action, handler := range handlers {
40			copied[action] = handler
41		}
42		return &Service{handlers: copied}
43	}
44	
45	// LocateTask returns an exact locator only when this service came from
46	// NewLifecycleService. Generic dispatch services deliberately have no fallback
47	// locator because guessing task, repository, or checkout identity is unsafe.
48	func (s *Service) LocateTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
49		if s == nil || s.locateTask == nil {
50			return Locator{}, ErrLocatorUnavailable
51		}
52		return s.locateTask(ctx, taskID)
53	}
54	
55	// Plan validates and freezes a request, delegates action-specific observations,
56	// then centrally builds the immutable plan.
57	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, err
61		}
62		handler, ok := s.handlers[normalized.Action]
63		if !ok || handler.Plan == nil {
64			return Plan{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: normalized.Action, Stage: "plan"}
65		}
66		spec, err := handler.Plan(ctx, normalized.Clone())
67		if err != nil {
68			return Plan{}, err
69		}
70		return BuildPlan(normalized, spec)
71	}
72	
73	// Apply validates identity and approval, rejects every status except READY, and
74	// delegates only to the handler registered for the plan's exact action. A
75	// handler's partial Result is returned unchanged in meaning alongside errors.
76	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, plan Plan, approval Approval) (Result, error) {
77		frozen := plan.Clone()
78		if err := frozen.Validate(); err != nil {
79			return Result{}, err
80		}
81		if err := frozen.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
82			return Result{}, err
83		}
84		if frozen.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
85			notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{
86				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Availability: frozen.Availability,
87				conditions: frozen.Conditions(),
88			}
89			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{
90				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Reason: "required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady,
91			}
92		}
93		handler, ok := s.handlers[frozen.Action]
94		if !ok || handler.Apply == nil {
95			return Result{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: frozen.Action, Stage: "apply"}
96		}
97		result, err := handler.Apply(ctx, frozen.Clone())
98		result = result.Clone()
99		if err != nil && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 {
100			result.PartialSuccess = true
101		}
102		return result, err
103	}

1	package taskflow
2	
3	import "github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
4	
5	// TransitionRule is one cell in the exhaustive persisted lifecycle table. An
6	// empty Target on an allowed rule means the task record is removed rather than
7	// assigned another persisted state.
8	type TransitionRule struct {
9		Mode            task.CheckoutMode
10		Source          task.State
11		Action          Action
12		Target          task.State
13		Allowed         bool
14		StatePreserving bool
15		RemovesTask     bool
16		Milestone       Milestone
17		Reason          string
18	}
19	
20	// HasTarget reports whether an allowed edge writes a persisted target state.
21	func (r TransitionRule) HasTarget() bool { return r.Allowed && r.Target != "" }
22	
23	type transitionKey struct {
24		mode   task.CheckoutMode
25		state  task.State
26		action Action
27	}
28	
29	var (
30		modeOrder = []task.CheckoutMode{
31			task.ModeWorktree,
32			task.ModeBranch,
33			task.ModeDirect,
34		}
35		stateOrder = []task.State{
36			task.Hot,
37			task.Warm,
38			task.Cold,
39			task.Done,
40		}
41		transitionActionOrder = []Action{
42			ParkWarm,
43			ParkCold,
44			Resume,
45			CompleteDirect,
46			CompleteFF,
47			ReviewHandoff,
48			VerifyMerged,
49			Retire,
50		}
51		transitionTable = buildTransitionTable()
52	)
53	
54	// TransitionActions returns the actions represented in every mode/state row.
55	// Adopt, RemoveCheckout, RefreshRemote, and Reconcile are deliberately absent
56	// because they operate on row ownership, repository context, or drift rather
57	// than persisted-state edges.
58	func TransitionActions() []Action {
59		return append([]Action(nil), transitionActionOrder...)
60	}
61	
62	// PersistedLifecycleActions is the stable action dimension of the lifecycle
63	// table, including state-preserving review handoff but excluding repository
64	// context actions such as remote refresh.
65	func PersistedLifecycleActions() []Action { return TransitionActions() }
66	
67	// Transitions returns all table cells in mode, state, and action order. Denied
68	// cells are retained so additions cannot silently fall through a switch.
69	func Transitions() []TransitionRule {
70		out := make([]TransitionRule, 0, len(modeOrder)*len(stateOrder)*len(transitionActionOrder))
71		for _, mode := range modeOrder {
72			for _, state := range stateOrder {
73				for _, action := range transitionActionOrder {
74					out = append(out, transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: state, action: action}])
75				}
76			}
77		}
78		return out
79	}
80	
81	// LookupTransition returns the exhaustive table cell for known dimensions.
82	func LookupTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, bool) {
83		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(source) || !isTransitionAction(action) {
84			return TransitionRule{Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action}, false
85		}
86		rule, ok := transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}]
87		return rule, ok
88	}
89	
90	// RequireTransition returns the allowed table cell or a typed graph error.
91	func RequireTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, error) {
92		rule, found := LookupTransition(mode, source, action)
93		if !found {
94			rule.Reason = "unknown mode, state, or non-transition action"
95			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
96		}
97		if !rule.Allowed {
98			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
99		}
100		return rule, nil
101	}
102	
103	func isTransitionAction(action Action) bool {
104		for _, candidate := range transitionActionOrder {
105			if action == candidate {
106				return true
107			}
108		}
109		return false
110	}
111	
112	func validMode(mode task.CheckoutMode) bool {
113		for _, candidate := range modeOrder {
114			if mode == candidate {
115				return true
116			}
117		}
118		return false
119	}
120	
121	func validState(state task.State) bool {
122		for _, candidate := range stateOrder {
123			if state == candidate {
124				return true
125			}
126		}
127		return false
128	}
129	
130	func buildTransitionTable() map[transitionKey]TransitionRule {
131		table := make(map[transitionKey]TransitionRule, len(modeOrder)*len(stateOrder)*len(transitionActionOrder))
132		for _, mode := range modeOrder {
133			for _, source := range stateOrder {
134				for _, action := range transitionActionOrder {
135					rule := TransitionRule{
136						Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action,
137						Reason: deniedTransitionReason(mode, source, action),
138					}
139					table[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}] = rule
140				}
141			}
142		}
143	
144		allow := func(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action, target task.State, preserving, removes bool, milestone Milestone) {
145			key := transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}
146			table[key] = TransitionRule{
147				Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action, Target: target,
148				Allowed: true, StatePreserving: preserving, RemovesTask: removes,
149				Milestone: milestone,
150			}
151		}
152	
153		for _, mode := range []task.CheckoutMode{task.ModeWorktree, task.ModeBranch} {
154			allow(mode, task.Hot, ParkWarm, task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
155			// Existing park accepts WARM tasks so it can update parking metadata and
156			// close a residual runtime without manufacturing a backward transition.
157			allow(mode, task.Warm, ParkWarm, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
158			allow(mode, task.Hot, ParkCold, task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
159			allow(mode, task.Warm, ParkCold, task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
160			allow(mode, task.Warm, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
161			allow(mode, task.Cold, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
162			allow(mode, task.Hot, CompleteFF, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
163			allow(mode, task.Warm, CompleteFF, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
164			allow(mode, task.Hot, VerifyMerged, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
165			allow(mode, task.Warm, VerifyMerged, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
166			allow(mode, task.Hot, ReviewHandoff, task.Hot, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
167			allow(mode, task.Warm, ReviewHandoff, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
168			allow(mode, task.Done, Retire, "", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
169		}
170	
171		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, ParkWarm, task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
172		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, ParkWarm, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
173		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
174		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, CompleteDirect, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
175		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, CompleteDirect, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
176		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Done, Retire, "", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
177	
178		return table
179	}
180	
181	func deniedTransitionReason(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) string {
182		if mode == task.ModeDirect && source == task.Cold {
183			return "direct tasks cannot be COLD"
184		}
185		if action == ParkCold && mode == task.ModeDirect {
186			return "direct tasks use the canonical checkout and cannot be parked COLD"
187		}
188		if source == task.Done {
189			return "DONE tasks can only be retired through the persisted lifecycle graph"
190		}
191		if source == task.Cold {
192			return "COLD tasks must resume before any completion or review action"
193		}
194		if action == CompleteDirect && mode != task.ModeDirect {
195			return "direct completion is only valid for direct tasks"
196		}
197		if (action == CompleteFF || action == ReviewHandoff || action == VerifyMerged) && mode == task.ModeDirect {
198			return "direct tasks have no separate branch to integrate or hand off"
199		}
200		return "the edge is not in the approved lifecycle graph"
201	}
202

15	// Field is one stable key/value member of an immutable Fields value.

21	// Fields is a map-shaped value whose backing storage is not exposed. Entries
22	// are kept in key order so fingerprints do not depend on map iteration order.
23	type Fields struct {
24		entries []Field
25	}
26	
27	// NewFields copies values into a deterministic immutable representation.
28	func NewFields(values map[string]string) Fields {
29		entries := make([]Field, 0, len(values))
30		for key, value := range values {
31			entries = append(entries, Field{Key: key, Value: value})
32		}
33		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Key < entries[j].Key })
34		return Fields{entries: entries}
35	}
36	
37	// Entries returns a copy in stable key order.
38	func (f Fields) Entries() []Field {
39		return append([]Field(nil), f.entries...)
40	}

42	// Map returns a mutable copy of the fields.

44		out := make(map[string]string, len(f.entries))
45		for _, entry := range f.entries {
46			out[entry.Key] = entry.Value
47		}

49	}

222	// Condition carries a stable decision plus operator-facing evidence and the

232	var stableCode = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$`)

234	// Validate rejects conditions that cannot be fingerprinted or aggregated with
235	// defined semantics.
236	func (c Condition) Validate() error {
237		if !stableCode.MatchString(string(c.Code)) {
238			return fmt.Errorf("condition code %q is not a stable lowercase code", c.Code)
239		}
240		switch c.Verdict {
241		case VerdictMet, VerdictNeedsInput, VerdictBlocked, VerdictUnknown, VerdictError, VerdictUnsupported, VerdictCurrent:
242		default:
243			return fmt.Errorf("condition %s has unknown verdict %q", c.Code, c.Verdict)
244		}
245		switch c.Requirement {
246		case RequirementRequired, RequirementAdvisory:
247		default:
248			return fmt.Errorf("condition %s has unknown requirement %q", c.Code, c.Requirement)
249		}
250		return nil
251	}

253	// ConditionFromObservation maps observation completeness to a fail-closed
254	// verdict. Capability policy such as unsupported remains an explicit condition
255	// decision rather than an inferred observation result.
256	func ConditionFromObservation(code ConditionCode, requirement Requirement, observation Observation, remediation string) Condition {
257		verdict := VerdictUnknown
258		switch observation.State {
259		case ObservationKnown:
260			verdict = VerdictMet
261		case ObservationError:
262			verdict = VerdictError
263		case ObservationUnknown, ObservationSkipped, ObservationLoading:
264			verdict = VerdictUnknown
265		default:
266			verdict = VerdictError
267		}
268		evidence := observation.Evidence
269		if evidence == "" {
270			switch {
271			case observation.Failure != "":
272				evidence = observation.Failure
273			case observation.Value != "":
274				evidence = observation.Value
275			default:
276				evidence = string(observation.State)
277			}
278		}
279		return Condition{
280			Code: code, Verdict: verdict, Requirement: requirement,
281			Evidence: evidence, Remediation: remediation,
282		}
283	}

285	// Availability is the aggregate action status shown by any caller.
286	type Availability string
287	
288	const (
289		AvailabilityReady       Availability = "ready"
290		AvailabilityNeedsInput  Availability = "needs-input"
291		AvailabilityBlocked     Availability = "blocked"
292		AvailabilityUnknown     Availability = "unknown"
293		AvailabilityError       Availability = "error"
294		AvailabilityUnsupported Availability = "unsupported"
295		AvailabilityCurrent     Availability = "current"
296	)
297	
298	// AvailabilityFor derives action readiness from required conditions only. The
299	// order is fail-closed and deterministic when more than one required condition
300	// is unmet; advisory evidence never changes the result.
301	func AvailabilityFor(conditions []Condition) Availability {
302		availability := AvailabilityReady
303		priority := func(value Availability) int {
304			switch value {
305			case AvailabilityError:
306				return 6
307			case AvailabilityBlocked:
308				return 5
309			case AvailabilityNeedsInput:
310				return 4
311			case AvailabilityUnknown:
312				return 3
313			case AvailabilityUnsupported:
314				return 2
315			case AvailabilityCurrent:
316				return 1
317			default:
318				return 0
319			}
320		}
321		for _, condition := range conditions {
322			if condition.Requirement == RequirementAdvisory {
323				continue
324			}
325			candidate := AvailabilityReady
326			if condition.Requirement != RequirementRequired {
327				candidate = AvailabilityError
328			} else {
329				switch condition.Verdict {
330				case VerdictMet:
331					continue
332				case VerdictNeedsInput:
333					candidate = AvailabilityNeedsInput
334				case VerdictBlocked:
335					candidate = AvailabilityBlocked
336				case VerdictUnknown:
337					candidate = AvailabilityUnknown
338				case VerdictError:
339					candidate = AvailabilityError
340				case VerdictUnsupported:
341					candidate = AvailabilityUnsupported
342				case VerdictCurrent:
343					candidate = AvailabilityCurrent
344				default:
345					candidate = AvailabilityError
346				}
347			}
348			if priority(candidate) > priority(availability) {
349				availability = candidate
350			}
351		}
352		return availability
353	}

166	// DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree returns canonical path evidence only when the
167	// checkout is strictly below <repositoryRoot>/.claude/worktrees. A matching
168	// branch name or a lexical .claude segment elsewhere on disk is not evidence.
169	func DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(repositoryRoot, checkoutPath string) (ClaudeHarnessEvidence, bool) {
170		if repositoryRoot == "" || checkoutPath == "" {
171			return ClaudeHarnessEvidence{}, false
172		}
173		harnessPath := filepath.Join(repositoryRoot, ".claude", "worktrees")
174		canonicalCheckout, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(harnessPath, checkoutPath)
175		if err != nil {
176			return ClaudeHarnessEvidence{}, false
177		}
178		harnessRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(harnessPath)
179		if err != nil {
180			return ClaudeHarnessEvidence{}, false
181		}
182		return ClaudeHarnessEvidence{Root: harnessRoot, CheckoutPath: canonicalCheckout}, true
183	}

299	// Main returns Git's actual primary record. The first-row fallback preserves
300	// compatibility with manually constructed contexts which predate Worktree.Main.
301	func (c RepoContext) Main() (RepoCheckout, bool) {
302		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
303			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
304				return checkout, true
305			}
306		}
307		if len(c.Checkouts) == 0 {
308			return RepoCheckout{}, false
309		}
310		return c.Checkouts[0], true
311	}

313	// Linked returns every Git-registered non-main worktree.
314	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
315		hasMarkedMain := false
316		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
317			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
318				hasMarkedMain = true
319				break
320			}
321		}
322		if !hasMarkedMain {
323			if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
324				return nil
325			}
326			return c.Checkouts[1:]
327		}
328		out := make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(c.Checkouts)-1)
329		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
330			if !checkout.Worktree.Main {
331				out = append(out, checkout)
332			}
333		}
334		return out
335	}

337	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
338	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
339	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
340		seen := map[string]bool{}
341		var out []runtime.Session
342		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
343			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
344				key := session.Handle
345				if key == "" {
346					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
347				}
348				if seen[key] {
349					continue
350				}
351				seen[key] = true
352				out = append(out, session)
353			}
354		}
355		return out
356	}

369	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository. The
370	// legacy entry point can prove observation only when sessions are present;
371	// callers that need a proven empty observation or typed failure use
372	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions.
373	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
374		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
375		return CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, r, tasks, RepoContextOptions{
376			Runtime: runtimeName, Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: len(sessions) > 0,
377		})
378	}

380	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions builds repository topology from Git's complete
381	// registered worktree list. It never synthesizes a main checkout after a Git
382	// query failure.
383	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
384		opts RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
385		if ctx == nil {
386			ctx = context.Background()
387		}
388		out := RepoContext{
389			Repo: r, Runtime: opts.Runtime,
390			WorktreeObservation: TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved},
391			RuntimeObservation:  runtimeObservation(opts),
392		}
393		queryPath := repoQueryPath(r)
394		out.RepositoryID, out.IdentityErr = canonicalRepositoryID(ctx, r, queryPath)
395		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
396	
397		var (
398			worktrees []gitx.Worktree
399			err       error
400		)

495	func enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx context.Context, checkouts []RepoCheckout, limiter *Limiter) {
496		if limiter == nil {
497			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
498		}
499		var wg sync.WaitGroup
500		for i := range checkouts {
501			if checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare || checkouts[i].Worktree.Prunable || !checkouts[i].Exists {
502				continue
503			}
504			wg.Add(1)
505			go func(index int) {
506				defer wg.Done()
507				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
508				if !ok {
509					checkouts[index].StatusErr = ctx.Err()
510					return
511				}
512				defer release()
513				checkout := &checkouts[index]
514				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
515				checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(
516					ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status,
517				)
518			}(i)
519		}
520		wg.Wait()
521	}

582	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
583		latest := status.LatestChange
584		var commit time.Time
585		var subject string
586		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
587			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)

746	func sortedUniqueTasks(tasks []*task.Task) []*task.Task {
747		ordered := append([]*task.Task(nil), tasks...)
748		sort.SliceStable(ordered, func(i, j int) bool {
749			if ordered[i] == nil {
750				return false
751			}
752			if ordered[j] == nil {
753				return true
754			}
755			return ordered[i].ID < ordered[j].ID
756		})
757		seen := map[string]bool{}
758		out := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(ordered))
759		for _, tracked := range ordered {
760			if tracked == nil {
761				continue
762			}
763			if tracked.ID != "" && seen[tracked.ID] {
764				continue
765			}
766			if tracked.ID != "" {
767				seen[tracked.ID] = true
768			}
769			out = append(out, tracked)
770		}
771		return out
772	}

778				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no recorded worktree path; branch %s is registered at %s",
779					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
780			}
781		}
782		return TopologyReason{
783			Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
784			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s records %s; branch %s is registered at %s",
785				tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
786		}
787	}
788	
789	func annotateBoundTask(binding TaskBinding, checkout RepoCheckout) TaskBinding {
790		tracked := binding.Task
791		if tracked == nil {
792			return binding
793		}
794		if !checkoutActionable(checkout) {
795			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
796				Code: ReasonCheckoutUnavailable,
797				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout %s is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable",
798					checkout.Worktree.Path),
799			})
800		}
801		if checkout.Branch() != tracked.Branch {
802			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
803				Code: ReasonBranchMismatch,
804				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s; registered checkout is on %s",
805					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, displayBranch(checkout)),
806			})
807		}
808		mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
809		switch {
810		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && checkout.Worktree.Main:
811			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
812				Code:   ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
813				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("worktree task %s resolved to Git main", tracked.ID),
814			})
815		case mode != task.ModeWorktree && !checkout.Worktree.Main:
816			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
817				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
818				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s resolved to linked worktree %s",
819					mode, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
820			})
821		}
822		if mode != task.ModeWorktree && tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
823			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
824				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
825				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
826					mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
827			})
828		}
829		if !taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
830			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
831				Code: ReasonUnexpectedCheckout,
832				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s still has registered checkout %s",
833					tracked.State, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
834			})
835		}
836		return binding
837	}
838	
839	func taskExpectsCheckout(tracked *task.Task) bool {
840		if tracked == nil || tracked.State == task.Cold {
841			return false
842		}
843		if tracked.State == task.Done && tracked.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
844			return tracked.WorktreePath != ""
845		}
846		return true
847	}
848	
849	func checkoutActionable(checkout RepoCheckout) bool {
850		return !checkout.Worktree.Bare && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable && checkout.Exists && checkout.StatusErr == nil

1	package forge
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"encoding/json"
6		"errors"
7		"fmt"
8		"net/url"
9		"strings"
10		"time"
11	)
12	
13	// ReviewQuery identifies one exact head/base relationship in one repository.
14	// Repository is the forge's stable repository identity: owner/repository for
15	// GitHub, group/repository for GitLab, or organization/project/repository for
16	// Azure DevOps. Adapters must still verify the returned branches because CLI
17	// filters are not sufficient evidence on their own.
18	type ReviewQuery struct {
19		Repository string `json:"repository"`
20		Head       string `json:"head"`
21		Base       string `json:"base"`
22	}
23	
24	// ReviewState is the portable lifecycle state observed for a provider review.
25	type ReviewState string
26	
27	const (
28		ReviewOpen   ReviewState = "open"
29		ReviewDraft  ReviewState = "draft"
30		ReviewMerged ReviewState = "merged"
31		ReviewClosed ReviewState = "closed"
32	)
33	
34	// Valid reports whether s has defined portable review semantics.
35	func (s ReviewState) Valid() bool {
36		switch s {
37		case ReviewOpen, ReviewDraft, ReviewMerged, ReviewClosed:
38			return true
39		default:
40			return false
41		}
42	}
43	
44	// Review is the minimal provider evidence for an exact head/base relationship.
45	// ID is the provider-stable identity and Number is the repository-local human
46	// identifier. Head, Base, State and Draft are observations from the provider
47	// response rather than values copied from ReviewQuery.
48	type Review struct {
49		Provider   Kind        `json:"provider"`
50		Repository string      `json:"repository"`
51		ID         string      `json:"id"`
52		Number     int         `json:"number"`
53		State      ReviewState `json:"state"`
54		Draft      bool        `json:"draft"`
55		URL        string      `json:"url"`
56		Head       string      `json:"head"`
57		Base       string      `json:"base"`
58		ObservedAt time.Time   `json:"observed_at"`
59	}
60	
61	// ReviewQuerier is an optional forge capability. A nil Review and nil error is
62	// a successful observation that no exact review exists. One exact match returns
63	// provider evidence; multiple exact matches fail with AmbiguousReviewError.
64	type ReviewQuerier interface {
65		QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error)
66	}
67	
68	var (
69		// ErrAmbiguousReview identifies a query with multiple exact head/base
70		// matches. Callers must not select one by recency or provider ordering.
71		ErrAmbiguousReview = errors.New("multiple reviews match")
72		// ErrMalformedReviewResponse identifies provider JSON that cannot supply the
73		// critical portable fields without guessing.
74		ErrMalformedReviewResponse = errors.New("malformed review response")
75	)
76	
77	// AmbiguousReviewError carries every exact match while keeping Error text free
78	// of provider response values such as private URLs and branch names.
79	type AmbiguousReviewError struct {
80		Provider Kind
81		Query    ReviewQuery
82		Matches  []Review
83	}
84	
85	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Error() string {
86		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review query returned %d exact matches", e.Provider, len(e.Matches))
87	}
88	
89	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguousReview }
90	
91	// MalformedReviewResponseError identifies the unusable response field without
92	// embedding its value or the response body. Index is zero-based and is -1 when
93	// the whole JSON document is malformed. Err retains safe decoder diagnostics.
94	type MalformedReviewResponseError struct {
95		Provider Kind
96		Index    int
97		Field    string
98		Err      error
99	}
100	
101	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Error() string {
102		location := "response"
103		if e.Index >= 0 {
104			location = fmt.Sprintf("response item %d", e.Index+1)
105		}
106		detail := "missing or invalid " + e.Field
107		if e.Err != nil {
108			detail = e.Err.Error()
109		}
110		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review %s is malformed: %s", e.Provider, location, detail)
111	}
112	
113	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
114	
115	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Is(target error) bool {
116		return target == ErrMalformedReviewResponse
117	}
118	
119	// QueryReview invokes the optional capability without widening Forge. It never
120	// caches or initiates a query unless a caller explicitly calls this function.
121	func QueryReview(ctx context.Context, f Forge, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
122		querier, ok := f.(ReviewQuerier)
123		if !ok {
124			return nil, &ErrUnsupported{Kind: f.Kind(), Operation: "review queries"}
125		}
126		return querier.QueryReview(ctx, dir, query)
127	}
128	
129	type reviewCandidate struct {
130		ID     string
131		Number int
132		State  string
133		Draft  *bool
134		URL    string
135		Head   string
136		Base   string
137	}
138	
139	type reviewStateNormalizer func(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error)
140	
141	func validateReviewQuery(query ReviewQuery) error {
142		switch {
143		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Repository) == "":
144			return errors.New("review query repository is required")
145		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Head) == "":
146			return errors.New("review query head is required")
147		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Base) == "":
148			return errors.New("review query base is required")
149		default:
150			return nil
151		}
152	}
153	
154	func decodeReviewJSON(provider Kind, out string, target any) error {
155		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(out)
156		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
157			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON array", nil)
158		}
159		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), target); err != nil {
160			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON", err)
161		}
162		return nil
163	}
164	
165	func selectExactReview(provider Kind, query ReviewQuery, candidates []reviewCandidate, normalize reviewStateNormalizer) (*Review, error) {
166		matches := make([]Review, 0, 1)
167		observedAt := time.Now().UTC()
168		for index, candidate := range candidates {
169			if candidate.Head == "" {
170				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "head branch", nil)
171			}
172			if candidate.Base == "" {
173				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "base branch", nil)
174			}
175			if candidate.Head != query.Head || candidate.Base != query.Base {
176				continue
177			}
178			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate.ID) == "" {
179				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "identifier", nil)
180			}
181			if candidate.Number <= 0 {
182				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "number", nil)
183			}
184			if candidate.Draft == nil {
185				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "draft flag", nil)
186			}
187			if !validReviewURL(candidate.URL) {
188				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "URL", nil)
189			}
190			state, err := normalize(candidate.State, *candidate.Draft)
191			if err != nil {
192				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "state", err)
193			}
194			matches = append(matches, Review{
195				Provider: provider, Repository: query.Repository,
196				ID: candidate.ID, Number: candidate.Number,
197				State: state, Draft: *candidate.Draft, URL: candidate.URL,
198				Head: candidate.Head, Base: candidate.Base, ObservedAt: observedAt,
199			})
200		}
201	
202		switch len(matches) {
203		case 0:
204			return nil, nil
205		case 1:
206			return &matches[0], nil
207		default:
208			return nil, &AmbiguousReviewError{
209				Provider: provider, Query: query,
210				Matches: append([]Review(nil), matches...),
211			}
212		}
213	}
214	
215	func malformedReviewResponse(provider Kind, index int, field string, err error) error {
216		return &MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: index, Field: field, Err: err}
217	}
218	
219	func validReviewURL(raw string) bool {
220		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
221		if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" {
222			return false
223		}
224		return parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http"
225	}
226

48	func validateRefreshRemoteLocator(locator Locator) error {
49		switch {
50		case locator.RepoPath == "":
51			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
52		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
53			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
54		case !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Branch):
55			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact head branch %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Branch)
56		case locator.Base != "" && !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Base):
57			return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Base)
58		case locator.HeadOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.HeadOID):
59			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact HEAD OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.HeadOID)
60		case locator.BaseOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.BaseOID):
61			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact base OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.BaseOID)
62		}
63	
64		if locator.TaskID == "" {
65			switch {
66			case locator.TaskRevision != "":
67				return fmt.Errorf("%w: task revision requires a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
68			case locator.HeadOID == "":
69				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged remote refresh requires an exact HEAD OID", ErrInvalidRequest)
70			case locator.Mode != "" && !validMode(locator.Mode):
71				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown checkout mode %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Mode)
72			case locator.State != "" && !validState(locator.State):
73				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown task state %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.State)
74			}
75			return nil
76		}
77	
78		switch {
79		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
80			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
