238	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRemoteRefNames(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) error {
239		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
240			"head":        "refs/heads/" + head,
241			"remote name": "refs/remotes/" + remote + "/__dev_refresh_probe__",
242		} {
243			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", ref); err != nil {
244				return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not a valid normalized Git name: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, label, err)
245			}
246		}
247		if base != "" {
248			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", "refs/heads/"+base); err != nil {
249				return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base is not a valid normalized Git branch: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
250			}
251		}
252		return nil
253	}

255	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRefreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, locator Locator, observed *remoteRefreshObservation) error {
256		checkout := locator.CheckoutPath
257		if checkout == "" {
258			checkout = locator.RepoPath
259		}
260		canonical, err := s.canonicalPath(checkout)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize selected checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
263		}
264		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, canonical)
265		if err != nil {
266			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout registration changed: " + err.Error()}
267		}
268		if registered.Path != canonical || registered.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
269			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout no longer belongs to the exact repository identity"}
270		}
271		if registered.Worktree.Detached || registered.Worktree.Branch != locator.Branch {
272			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(

274			)}

276		liveHead, err := s.gitRun(ctx, canonical, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")

279		}
280		liveHead = strings.TrimSpace(liveHead)

282			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
283				"selected checkout HEAD changed from %q to registry=%q live=%q", locator.HeadOID, registered.Worktree.Head, liveHead,
284			)}
285		}
286		observed.checkout = canonical
287		observed.worktree = registered
288		return nil

871	func finalizeCheckoutClaims(out *RepoContext) {
872		for i := range out.Checkouts {
873			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
874			sort.SliceStable(checkout.TaskBindings, func(a, b int) bool {
875				return checkout.TaskBindings[a].Task.ID < checkout.TaskBindings[b].Task.ID
876			})
877			sort.SliceStable(checkout.Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
878				return checkout.Tasks[a].ID < checkout.Tasks[b].ID
879			})
880			if len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 1 {
881				ids := make([]string, len(checkout.TaskBindings))
882				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
883					ids[j] = checkout.TaskBindings[j].Task.ID
884				}
885				reason := TopologyReason{

887					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout is claimed by tasks %s", strings.Join(ids, ", ")),
888				}
889				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
890				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
891					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
892						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
893					)
894				}
895			}
896			if checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil && len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 0 {
897				reason := TopologyReason{
898					Code: ReasonHarnessTaskConflict,
899					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("checkout has Claude harness evidence and %d managed task claim(s)",
900						len(checkout.TaskBindings)),
901				}
902				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
903				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
904					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
905						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
906					)
907				}
908			}
909			for _, binding := range checkout.TaskBindings {
910				for _, reason := range binding.DriftReasons {
911					checkout.DriftReasons = appendReason(checkout.DriftReasons, reason)
912				}
913				for _, reason := range binding.ConflictReasons {

987	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
988	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
989	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
990	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
991		for _, session := range sessions {
992			assigned := map[int]bool{}
993			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
994				best, bestLen := -1, -1
995				for i := range out.Checkouts {
996					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Checkouts[i]) {
997						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(normalizePath(root)) > bestLen {
998							best, bestLen = i, len(normalizePath(root))
999						}
1000					}
1001				}
1002				if best >= 0 {
1003					assigned[best] = true
1004				}
1005			}
1006			for i := range assigned {
1007				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
1008			}
1009		}
1010	}
1011	
1012	func checkoutRoots(checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
1013		return []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
1014	}
1015	
1016	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
1017		if root == "" || path == "" {
1018			return false
1019		}
1020		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
1021		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
1022			return false
1023		}
1024		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
1025	}
1026	
1027	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
1028	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
1029	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
1030	// is not sufficient.
1031	func normalizePath(path string) string {
1032		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
1033			return canonical
1034		}
1035		return filepath.Clean(path)
1036	}

1215	// LinkedWorktreePaths returns the yw payload: absolute linked-worktree paths,
1216	// one per line. The canonical checkout is intentionally excluded because WT
1217	// counts linked worktrees only.
1218	func LinkedWorktreePaths(c RepoContext) string {
1219		paths := make([]string, 0, len(c.Linked()))
1220		for _, checkout := range c.Linked() {
1221			paths = append(paths, checkout.Worktree.Path)
1222		}
1223		return strings.Join(paths, "\n")
1224	}

200	func appendOccupancyAgent(ctx context.Context, result *Occupancy, checkout checkoutIdentity, opts OccupancyOptions, activity AgentActivity) error {
201		covered, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, checkout, activity.CWD)

213			Status:        status,
214			SessionHandle: handle,
215			IsCaller:      caller,
216			Blocking:      occupancyAgentBlocks(opts, status, caller, handle != ""),

226	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
227		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
228		if err != nil {
229			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
230		}
231		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
232		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
233			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
234			if canonicalErr != nil {
235				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
236			}
237			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true}, nil
238		}
239		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
240			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
241		}
242		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string) (bool, error) {
246		if cwd == "" {
247			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
248		}
249		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
250		if err != nil {
251			return false, err
252		}
253		if target.git && activity.git {
254			return target.path == activity.path, nil
255		}
256		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
257	}

259	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
260		panes := session.Panes
261		if len(panes) == 0 {
262			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
263				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
264			}
265		}
266		var covering, mixed []Pane
267		for _, pane := range panes {
268			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
269			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
270				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
271			}
272			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
273			for _, path := range paths {
274				if path == "" {
275					continue
276				}
277				observed = true
278				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path)
279				if err != nil {
280					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
281				}
282				if inside {
283					paneCovers = true
284				} else {
285					paneOutside = true
286				}
287			}
288			if paneCovers {
289				covering = append(covering, pane)
290			}
291			if paneOutside || !observed {
292				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
293			}
294		}
295		return covering, mixed, nil
296	}
297	
298	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
299		if id == "" {
300			return false
301		}
302		for _, pane := range panes {
303			if pane.ID == id {
304				return true
305			}
306		}
307		return false
308	}
309	
310	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
311		for _, session := range sessions {
312			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
313				return session.Runtime.Handle
314			}
315			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
316				return session.Runtime.Handle
317			}
318		}
319		return ""
320	}
321	
322	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
323		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
324		if status == "" {
325			return "unknown"
326		}
327		return status
328	}
329	
330	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
331		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
332			return !caller
333		}
334		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
335		// with a freshly listed covering session.
336		if caller || !correlated {
337			return true
338		}
339		switch status {
340		case "idle", "done":
341			return false
342		case "unknown":
343			return !opts.CloseUnknown
344		default:
345			return true
346		}
347	}

48	// ReadinessState classifies one intent without changing its durable record.

52		ReadinessPending              ReadinessState = "pending"
53		ReadinessFailed               ReadinessState = "failed"
54		ReadinessDiscarded            ReadinessState = "discarded"
55		ReadinessFinalizedReachable   ReadinessState = "finalized-reachable"
56		ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable ReadinessState = "finalized-unreachable"
57		ReadinessObservationError     ReadinessState = "observation-error"

60	// IntentReadiness is the read-only finalization evidence for one intent whose
61	// recorded worktree is the exact checkout being inspected.
62	type IntentReadiness struct {

64		State            ReadinessState
65		Finalized        bool
66		ReceiptReachable bool

68	}
69	
70	// ReadinessInspection is a complete read-only observation for one exact
71	// checkout. KnownEmpty is true only when the store was read successfully and no
72	// intent matched the checkout; it distinguishes absence from failed observation.
73	type ReadinessInspection struct {
74		Checkout         string
75		KnownEmpty       bool
76		Intents          []IntentReadiness
77		ObservationError error
78	}
79	
80	// Ready applies only the existing artifact finalization contract: an exact
81	// checkout is ready when it has no intents, or every intent was explicitly
82	// discarded or has a finalized receipt that is still reachable. Missing or
83	// incomplete evidence fails closed.
84	func (i ReadinessInspection) Ready() bool {
85		if i.ObservationError != nil {
86			return false
87		}
88		if len(i.Intents) == 0 {
89			return i.KnownEmpty
90		}
91		if i.KnownEmpty {
92			return false
93		}
94		for _, intent := range i.Intents {
95			if intent.ObservationError != nil {
96				return false
97			}
98			switch intent.State {
99			case ReadinessDiscarded:
100				// Discard is the existing explicit operator escape hatch.
101			case ReadinessFinalizedReachable:
102				if !intent.Finalized || !intent.ReceiptReachable {
103					return false
104				}
105			default:
106				return false
107			}
108		}
109		return true
110	}
111	
112	// InspectReadiness gathers artifact finalization evidence for one exact
113	// checkout. It never reconciles receipts, finalizes intents, or writes either
114	// source files or intent records. The returned inspection retains partial
115	// evidence and the same wrapped error returned separately to ordinary callers.
116	func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
117		inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
118		if ctx == nil {
119			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")
120			inspection.ObservationError = err
121			return inspection, err
122		}
123		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
124			inspection.ObservationError = err
125			return inspection, err
126		}
127		if store == nil {
128			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a store")
129			inspection.ObservationError = err
130			return inspection, err
131		}
132	
133		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
134		if err != nil {
135			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
136			inspection.ObservationError = err
137			return inspection, err
138		}
139		inspection.Checkout = canonical
140	
141		intents, err := store.List()
142		if err != nil {
143			err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
144			inspection.ObservationError = err
145			return inspection, err
146		}
147		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
148			inspection.ObservationError = err
149			return inspection, err
150		}
151	
152		for _, intent := range intents {
153			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
154				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
155				break
156			}
157			intentCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
158			if err != nil {
159				err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, err)
160				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
161				continue
162			}
163			if intentCheckout != canonical {
164				continue
165			}
166	
167			evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
168			switch intent.Status {
169			case Armed, Finalizing:
170				evidence.State = ReadinessPending
171			case Failed:
172				evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
173			case Discarded:
174				evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
175			case Finalized:
176				evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, canonical, intent)
177				switch {
178				case err != nil:
179					err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
180					evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
181					evidence.ObservationError = err
182					inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
183				case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
184					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
185				default:
186					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
187				}
188			default:
189				// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
190				// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
191				err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
192				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
193				evidence.ObservationError = err
194				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
195			}
196			inspection.Intents = append(inspection.Intents, evidence)
197		}
198	
199		inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
200		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
201	}

203	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
204		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
205			return false, nil
206		}
207		candidates := []struct {
208			dir string
209			ref string
210		}{
211			{checkout, "HEAD"},
212			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
213			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
214		}
215		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
216		var observationErr error
217		for _, candidate := range candidates {
218			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
219				continue
220			}
221			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
222			if seen[key] {
223				continue
224			}
225			seen[key] = true
226			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
227				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
228			}
229			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
230				return true, nil
231			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
232				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
233					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
234			}
235		}
236		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
237			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
238		}
239		return false, observationErr
240	}
241	
242	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
243		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
244		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
245	}
246	
247	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
248		if current == nil {
249			return next
250		}
251		if next == nil {
252			return current
253		}
254		return errors.Join(current, next)
255	}

257	func (s *Service) Prepare(ctx context.Context, request PrepareRequest) (*Intent, error) {
258		if s.Store == nil {

260		}

262		if err != nil {

309			return nil, err
310		}
311		limit := s.LargeLimit
312		if limit <= 0 {
313			limit = DefaultLargeLimit
314		}
315		if !tracked && info.Size() > limit && !request.AllowLarge {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("untracked transcript is %d bytes; re-run with --allow-large after reviewing repository growth", info.Size())
317		}
318		plans, err := normalizePlans(repository.Root, request.Plans)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		runID := request.RunID
323		if runID == "" {
324			runID = os.Getenv("DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID")
325		}
326		if runID == "" {
327			runID = fmt.Sprintf("run-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
328		}
329		selected := make(map[string]bool, len(plans)+1)
330		relTranscript, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, transcript.Path)
331		selected[filepath.ToSlash(relTranscript)] = true
332		for _, plan := range plans {
333			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, plan)
334			selected[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
335		}
336		filtered := unrelated[:0]
337		for _, path := range unrelated {
338			if !selected[path] {
339				filtered = append(filtered, path)
340			}
341		}
342		intent := &Intent{
343			RunID: runID, Provider: provider, SessionID: sessionID, TaskID: request.TaskID,
344			RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, GitCommonDir: repository.GitCommonDir,
345			WorktreePath: repository.Root, Branch: status.Branch, Base: request.Base,
346			Head: head, PlanPaths: plans, UnrelatedArtifacts: filtered, AllowLarge: request.AllowLarge,
347		}
348		if err := s.Store.Create(ctx, intent); err != nil {
349			return nil, err
350		}
351		return intent, nil
352	}

354	func (s *Service) ObserveSessionEnd(ctx context.Context, runID string, when time.Time) error {
355		intent, err := s.Store.FindByRunID(runID)
356		if err != nil {
357			return nil // SessionEnd without an armed intent is deliberately a no-op.
358		}
359		if when.IsZero() {
360			when = time.Now()
361		}
362		return s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
363			candidate.SessionEndedAt = when.UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
364			return nil
365		})
366	}

368	func (s *Service) Finalize(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
369		if s.Store == nil {
370			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
371		}
372		intent, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
373		if err != nil {
374			return nil, err
375		}
376		lockDir := filepath.Join(intent.GitCommonDir, "dev-artifact-finalize")
377		var finalized *Intent
378		err = catalog.NewStore(lockDir).WithLock(ctx, func() error {
379			current, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
380			if err != nil {
381				return err
382			}
383			finalized, err = s.finalizeLocked(ctx, request, current)
384			return err
385		})
386		return finalized, err
387	}
388	
389	func (s *Service) finalizeLocked(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest, intent *Intent) (*Intent, error) {
390		if intent.Status == Finalized {
391			if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok && commit != intent.ArtifactCommit {
392				if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
393					return nil, err
394				}
395				return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
396			}
397			return intent, nil
398		}
399		if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok {
400			if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
401				return nil, err
402			}
403			return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
404		}
405		if s.ScanStaged == nil {
406			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scanner-missing", fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization requires a staged secret scanner"))
407		}
408		if err := s.revalidate(ctx, intent); err != nil {
409			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "git-drift", err)
410		}
411		if intent.SessionEndedAt.IsZero() && !request.WriterStopped {
412			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-unproven",
413				fmt.Errorf("finalization requires SessionEnd observation or explicit post-writer proof"))
414		}
415		transcript, err := FindTranscript(intent.WorktreePath, intent.Provider, intent.SessionID)
416		if err != nil {
417			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "transcript-missing", err)
418		}
419		if err := s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
420			candidate.Status = Finalizing
421			candidate.TranscriptPath = transcript.Path
422			candidate.FailureCode = ""
423			return nil
424		}); err != nil {
425			return nil, err
426		}
427		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
428			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
429		}
430		paths := append([]string{transcript.Path}, intent.PlanPaths...)
431		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, nil); err != nil {
432			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-not-empty", err)
433		}
434		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"add", "--"}, paths...)...); err != nil {
435			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "stage-failed", err)
436		}
437		cleanup := func() {
438			_, _ = gitx.Run(context.Background(), intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"reset", "--"}, paths...)...)
439		}
440		if err := s.ScanStaged(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
441			cleanup()
442			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scan-failed", err)
443		}
444		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
445			cleanup()
446			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
447		}
448		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
449			cleanup()
450			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
451		}
452		if err := stagedFilesMatch(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
453			cleanup()
454			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
455		}
456		message := fmt.Sprintf("chore: finalize %s agent session", intent.Provider)
457		trailers := fmt.Sprintf("Agent-Artifact-Session: %s:%s\nDev-Artifact-Intent: %s", intent.Provider, intent.SessionID, intent.ID)
458		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "commit", "-m", message, "-m", trailers); err != nil {
459			cleanup()
460			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "commit-failed", err)
461		}
462		commit, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
463		if err != nil {
464			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "receipt-failed", err)
465		}
466		if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, transcript.Path, commit); err != nil {
467			return nil, err
468		}
469		return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
470	}

472	func (s *Service) resolveIntent(request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
473		if request.IntentID != "" {
474			return s.Store.Get(request.IntentID)
475		}
476		if request.RunID != "" {
477			return s.Store.FindByRunID(request.RunID)
478		}
479		return nil, fmt.Errorf("finalize requires an intent or run id")
480	}

482	func (s *Service) revalidate(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
483		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
484		if err != nil {
485			return err
486		}
487		if repository.GitCommonDir != intent.GitCommonDir {
488			return fmt.Errorf("Git common-dir changed")
489		}
490		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
491		if err != nil {
492			return err
493		}
494		if status.Branch != intent.Branch || status.Detached {
495			return fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
496		}
497		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(intent.WorktreePath); err != nil {
498			return err
499		} else if active {
500			return fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
501		}
502		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
503		if err != nil {
504			return err
505		}
506		if head != intent.Head {
507			return fmt.Errorf("HEAD changed from %s to %s", intent.Head, head)
508		}
509		return nil
510	}

512	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, id, code string, cause error) error {
513		_ = s.Store.Update(ctx, id, func(intent *Intent) error {
514			intent.Status = Failed
515			intent.FailureCode = code
516			return nil
517		})
518		return fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization %s: %w", code, cause)
519	}

522		return s.Store.Update(ctx, id, func(intent *Intent) error {
523			intent.Status = Finalized
524			intent.TranscriptPath = transcript
525			intent.ArtifactCommit = commit

527			return nil
528		})

531	type statusPath struct {
532		Path   string
533		Staged bool
534	}
535	
536	func statusPaths(ctx context.Context, repo string) ([]statusPath, error) {
537		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
538		if err != nil {
539			return nil, err
540		}
541		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
542		var paths []statusPath
543		for i := 0; i < len(fields); i++ {
544			entry := fields[i]
545			if len(entry) < 4 {
546				continue
547			}
548			code, path := entry[:2], filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:])
549			paths = append(paths, statusPath{Path: path, Staged: code[0] != ' ' && code[0] != '?'})
550			if code[0] == 'R' || code[0] == 'C' {
551				i++ // porcelain -z emits the source path as the next field.
552			}
553		}
554		return paths, nil
555	}
556	
557	func isRecognizedArtifact(path string) bool {
558		path = filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(path, "./"))
559		for _, prefix := range []string{
560			".specstory/history/", ".claude/plans/", ".cursor/plans/", ".cursor/rules/",
561			".opencode/plans/", ".specify/", ".codex/",
562		} {
563			if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
564				return true
565			}
566		}
567		return path == ".specstory/statistics.json"
568	}
569	
570	func normalizePlans(root string, paths []string) ([]string, error) {
571		var out []string
572		for _, path := range paths {
573			if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
574				path = filepath.Join(root, path)
575			}
576			inside, err := pathx.Contains(filepath.Join(root, ".claude", "plans"), path)
577			if err != nil || !inside {
578				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is outside .claude/plans", path)
579			}
580			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
581			if err != nil {
582				return nil, err
583			}
584			info, err := os.Stat(canonical)
585			if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
586				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is not a regular file", path)
587			}
588			out = append(out, canonical)
589		}
590		sort.Strings(out)
591		return out, nil
592	}
593	
594	func gitTracked(ctx context.Context, repo, path string) (bool, error) {
595		rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
596		if err != nil {
597			return false, err
598		}
599		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", "--", rel)
600		if err == nil {
601			return true, nil
602		}
603		var gitErr *gitx.Error
604		if errors.As(err, &gitErr) {
605			return false, nil
606		}
607		return false, err
608	}
609	
610	func ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx context.Context, repo string, allowed []string) error {
611		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z")
612		if err != nil {
613			return err
614		}
615		allow := make(map[string]bool, len(allowed))
616		for _, path := range allowed {
617			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
618			allow[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
619		}
620		for _, path := range strings.Split(out, "\x00") {
621			if path != "" && !allow[filepath.ToSlash(path)] {
622				return fmt.Errorf("index contains unrelated path %s", path)
623			}
624		}
625		return nil
626	}
627	
628	func stagedFilesMatch(ctx context.Context, repo string, paths []string) error {
629		for _, path := range paths {
630			rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
631			if err != nil {
632				return err
633			}
634			workingBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "hash-object", "--", rel)
635			if err != nil {
636				return err
637			}
638			stagedBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "rev-parse", ":"+filepath.ToSlash(rel))
639			if err != nil {
640				return err
641			}
642			if workingBlob != stagedBlob {
643				return fmt.Errorf("staged artifact %s no longer matches scanned working bytes", filepath.ToSlash(rel))
644			}
645		}
646		return nil
647	}
648	
649	func findReceipt(ctx context.Context, repo, intentID string) (string, bool) {
650		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "log", "-n", "100", "--format=%H%x00%B%x00")
651		if err != nil {
652			return "", false
653		}
654		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
655		for i := 0; i+1 < len(fields); i += 2 {
656			if strings.Contains(fields[i+1], "Dev-Artifact-Intent: "+intentID) {
657				return fields[i], true
658			}
659		}
660		return "", false
661	}

2	// exchanged between lifecycle planners, callers, and action executors.

15	// Field is one stable key/value member of an immutable Fields value.
16	type Field struct {
17		Key   string
18		Value string
19	}
20	
21	// Fields is a map-shaped value whose backing storage is not exposed. Entries
22	// are kept in key order so fingerprints do not depend on map iteration order.
23	type Fields struct {
24		entries []Field
25	}
26	
27	// NewFields copies values into a deterministic immutable representation.
28	func NewFields(values map[string]string) Fields {
29		entries := make([]Field, 0, len(values))
30		for key, value := range values {
31			entries = append(entries, Field{Key: key, Value: value})
32		}
33		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Key < entries[j].Key })
34		return Fields{entries: entries}
35	}
36	
37	// Entries returns a copy in stable key order.
38	func (f Fields) Entries() []Field {
39		return append([]Field(nil), f.entries...)
40	}
41	
42	// Map returns a mutable copy of the fields.
43	func (f Fields) Map() map[string]string {
44		out := make(map[string]string, len(f.entries))
45		for _, entry := range f.entries {
46			out[entry.Key] = entry.Value
47		}
48		return out
49	}
50	
51	func (f Fields) clone() Fields { return Fields{entries: f.Entries()} }
52

206		VerdictNeedsInput  Verdict = "needs-input"
207		VerdictBlocked     Verdict = "blocked"
208		VerdictUnknown     Verdict = "unknown"
209		VerdictError       Verdict = "error"
210		VerdictUnsupported Verdict = "unsupported"

218		RequirementRequired Requirement = "required"
219		RequirementAdvisory Requirement = "advisory"
220	)

222	// Condition carries a stable decision plus operator-facing evidence and the
223	// narrow remediation for an unmet result.
224	type Condition struct {
225		Code        ConditionCode
226		Verdict     Verdict
227		Requirement Requirement
228		Evidence    string
229		Remediation string

232	var stableCode = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
233	
234	// Validate rejects conditions that cannot be fingerprinted or aggregated with
235	// defined semantics.
236	func (c Condition) Validate() error {
237		if !stableCode.MatchString(string(c.Code)) {
238			return fmt.Errorf("condition code %q is not a stable lowercase code", c.Code)
239		}
240		switch c.Verdict {
241		case VerdictMet, VerdictNeedsInput, VerdictBlocked, VerdictUnknown, VerdictError, VerdictUnsupported, VerdictCurrent:
242		default:
243			return fmt.Errorf("condition %s has unknown verdict %q", c.Code, c.Verdict)
244		}
245		switch c.Requirement {
246		case RequirementRequired, RequirementAdvisory:
247		default:
248			return fmt.Errorf("condition %s has unknown requirement %q", c.Code, c.Requirement)
249		}
250		return nil
251	}

253	// ConditionFromObservation maps observation completeness to a fail-closed
254	// verdict. Capability policy such as unsupported remains an explicit condition
255	// decision rather than an inferred observation result.
256	func ConditionFromObservation(code ConditionCode, requirement Requirement, observation Observation, remediation string) Condition {
257		verdict := VerdictUnknown
258		switch observation.State {
259		case ObservationKnown:
260			verdict = VerdictMet
261		case ObservationError:
262			verdict = VerdictError
263		case ObservationUnknown, ObservationSkipped, ObservationLoading:
264			verdict = VerdictUnknown
265		default:
266			verdict = VerdictError
267		}
268		evidence := observation.Evidence
269		if evidence == "" {
270			switch {
271			case observation.Failure != "":
272				evidence = observation.Failure
273			case observation.Value != "":
274				evidence = observation.Value
275			default:
276				evidence = string(observation.State)
277			}
278		}
279		return Condition{
280			Code: code, Verdict: verdict, Requirement: requirement,
281			Evidence: evidence, Remediation: remediation,
282		}
283	}
284	
285	// Availability is the aggregate action status shown by any caller.
286	type Availability string
287	
288	const (
289		AvailabilityReady       Availability = "ready"
290		AvailabilityNeedsInput  Availability = "needs-input"
291		AvailabilityBlocked     Availability = "blocked"
292		AvailabilityUnknown     Availability = "unknown"
293		AvailabilityError       Availability = "error"
294		AvailabilityUnsupported Availability = "unsupported"
295		AvailabilityCurrent     Availability = "current"
296	)
297	
298	// AvailabilityFor derives action readiness from required conditions only. The
299	// order is fail-closed and deterministic when more than one required condition
300	// is unmet; advisory evidence never changes the result.
301	func AvailabilityFor(conditions []Condition) Availability {
302		availability := AvailabilityReady
303		priority := func(value Availability) int {
304			switch value {
305			case AvailabilityError:
306				return 6
307			case AvailabilityBlocked:
308				return 5
309			case AvailabilityNeedsInput:
310				return 4
311			case AvailabilityUnknown:
312				return 3
313			case AvailabilityUnsupported:
314				return 2
315			case AvailabilityCurrent:
316				return 1
317			default:
318				return 0
319			}
320		}
321		for _, condition := range conditions {
322			if condition.Requirement == RequirementAdvisory {
323				continue
324			}
325			candidate := AvailabilityReady
326			if condition.Requirement != RequirementRequired {
327				candidate = AvailabilityError
328			} else {
329				switch condition.Verdict {
330				case VerdictMet:
331					continue
332				case VerdictNeedsInput:
333					candidate = AvailabilityNeedsInput
334				case VerdictBlocked:
335					candidate = AvailabilityBlocked
336				case VerdictUnknown:
337					candidate = AvailabilityUnknown
338				case VerdictError:
339					candidate = AvailabilityError
340				case VerdictUnsupported:
341					candidate = AvailabilityUnsupported
342				case VerdictCurrent:
343					candidate = AvailabilityCurrent
344				default:
345					candidate = AvailabilityError
346				}
347			}
348			if priority(candidate) > priority(availability) {
349				availability = candidate
350			}
351		}
352		return availability
353	}
354	
355	// EffectCode is a stable machine-readable mutation or external operation.
356	type EffectCode string
357	
358	// Effect is one ordered operation proposed by a plan. Details are immutable by
359	// interface and may carry exact refs, handles, or paths needed by an executor.
360	type Effect struct {
361		Code        EffectCode
362		Description string
363		Target      string
364		Destructive bool
365		Network     bool
366		Details     Fields
367	}
368	
369	// NewEffect copies details into deterministic storage.
370	func NewEffect(code EffectCode, description, target string, destructive, network bool, details map[string]string) Effect {
371		return Effect{
372			Code: code, Description: description, Target: target,
373			Destructive: destructive, Network: network, Details: NewFields(details),
374		}
375	}
376	
377	// Clone returns an independent effect value.
378	func (e Effect) Clone() Effect {
379		e.Details = e.Details.clone()
380		return e
381	}
382	
383	// Validate rejects effects without a stable code.
384	func (e Effect) Validate() error {
385		if !stableCode.MatchString(string(e.Code)) {
386			return fmt.Errorf("effect code %q is not a stable lowercase code", e.Code)
387		}
388		for _, field := range e.Details.entries {
389			if strings.TrimSpace(field.Key) == "" {
390				return fmt.Errorf("effect %s has an empty detail key", e.Code)
391			}
392		}
393		return nil
394	}

13	func guardSharedCheckout(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout string) error {
14		if app.allowSharedCheckout {
15			return nil
16		}
17		reportedPane := ""
18		if rt != nil {
19			switch rt.Name() {
20			case "herdr":
21				reportedPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
22			case "tmux":
23				reportedPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
24			}
25		}
26		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
27			Profile:      runtime.OccupancyStrict,
28			CallerPaneID: reportedPane,
29		})
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("check live occupancy before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
32		}
33		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
34			return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
35		}
36		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("classify live runtime coverage before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionCoverageErr)
38		}
39		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("list live runtime sessions before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionList.Err)
41		}
42		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
44		}
45	
46		var occupied []string
47		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
48			if !agent.Blocking {
49				continue
50			}
51			activity := agent.Activity
52			label := activity.Agent
53			if activity.Name != "" {
54				label = activity.Name
55			}
56			if label == "" {
57				label = "agent"
58			}
59			occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, activity.PaneID))
60		}
61		if len(occupied) == 0 {
62			return nil
63		}
64		return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
65			config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
66	}
67	
68	// checkoutAgentActivities returns recognized agents whose reported cwd resolves
69	// to the same canonical Git worktree root as checkout. A pane is excluded only
70	// when its exact ID matches excludePane; lifecycle state never makes it free.
71	func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {
72		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{Profile: runtime.OccupancyStrict})
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
77			return nil, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err
78		}
79		out := make([]runtime.AgentActivity, 0, len(evidence.Agents))
80		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
81			if excludePane == "" || agent.Activity.PaneID != excludePane {
82				out = append(out, agent.Activity)
83			}
84		}
85		return out, nil
86	}

40	func newTUICmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
41		cmd := &cobra.Command{
42			Use:   "tui",
43			Short: "Interactive dashboard over the inventory",
44			Long: `Browse and act on your work in progress.
45	
46	Shows exactly what "dev ls" shows, from the same code path, plus the ability
47	to open, park and annotate a task without retyping its name.
48	
49	Six lists, switched with tab:
50	
51	  TASKS   change streams dev is tracking — what am I working on
52	  REPOS   durable repositories under the scan roots — what do I have here
53	  FLEET   repositories and active work across configured SSH machines
54	  TRY     scratch experiments and retained lifecycle history
55	  REMOTE  repositories visible through configured forge CLIs — what can I clone/open

148	func suggestFor(app *App, ctx context.Context, r inventory.Row, stale time.Duration, retireOptions sweepRetireOptions) []suggestion {
149		t := r.Task
150		var out []suggestion
151		current, currentErr := app.Tasks.GetRecord(t.ID)
152		if currentErr != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(current.Task, *t) {
153			detail := "task changed after the sweep inventory snapshot"
154			if currentErr != nil {
155				detail = "task could not be reloaded after the sweep inventory snapshot: " + currentErr.Error()
156			}
157			return []suggestion{{
158				row: r, reason: detail,
159				action: "rerun sweep to inspect the current task revision — not changed automatically",
160			}}
161		}
162		revision := current.Revision
163	
164		// A task whose repository is gone cannot be finished, resumed, parked or
165		// retired: every one of those resolves the repository first, and `dev done`
166		// refuses outright once the checkout is missing. Nothing else in this
167		// function reaches it either — the dead-branch rule below excludes direct
168		// mode, and the stale-worktree rule needs a recorded worktree path. Left
169		// alone, the record is unreachable by any command in the binary.
170		//
171		// Reaping removes dev's record of intent and nothing else; the branch, the
172		// commits and the remote are untouched. A live session proves the directory
173		// is there, so it is the one condition that rules this out.
174		if t.RepoPath != "" && !r.Live() && !dirExists(t.RepoPath) {
175			out = append(out, suggestion{
176				row:    r,
177				reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository %s no longer exists", config.Contract(t.RepoPath)),
178				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s (Git keeps any work; this drops only dev's record)", t.ID),
179				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
180			})
181			return out
182		}
183	
184		out = append(out, orphanSuggestions(app, r)...)
185	
186		switch {
187		// A hot task with no live session is the commonest drift: the session was
188		// closed (or the machine rebooted) without parking.
189		case t.State == task.Hot && r.StateDrift() == "no live session":
190			reason := fmt.Sprintf("hot but no live session, idle %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
191			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkWarmOptions{})
192			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
193				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded warm parking is blocked",
194					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})
195				break
196			}
197			out = append(out, suggestion{
198				row: r, reason: reason, action: fmt.Sprintf("mark %s warm", t.ID),
199				apply: func() error {
200					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
201					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
202					return err
203				},
204			})
205	
206		// A warm task nobody has touched in weeks is a candidate for cold: keeping
207		// the worktree costs disk and clutters every listing.
208		case t.State == task.Warm && r.Age() > stale:
209			reason := fmt.Sprintf("warm and untouched for %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
210			if t.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
211				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but direct tasks cannot go cold",
212					action: "keep it warm or finish it — not changed automatically"})
213				break
214			}
215			if r.Status.Dirty() {
216				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but has uncommitted work",
217					action: "commit or `dev park --wip` before going cold — not changed automatically"})
218				break
219			}
220			if !r.Status.Synced() {
221				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + fmt.Sprintf(", not pushed (%s)", r.Status.Summary()),
222					action: fmt.Sprintf("push %s so it can go cold: dev park %s --cold --push", t.Branch, t.ID)})
223				break
224			}
225			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkColdOptions{})
226			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
227				detail := sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)
228				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded cold parking is blocked",
229					action: detail + " — not changed automatically"})
230				break
231			}
232			out = append(out, suggestion{
233				row:    r,
234				reason: reason + ", clean and pushed",
235				action: fmt.Sprintf("go cold: remove %s (branch and remote keep the work)", config.Contract(r.Checkout)),
236				apply: func() error {
237					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
238					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
239					return err
240				},
241			})
242	
243		// DONE means integrated; runtime/worktree cleanup is a separate,
244		// externally coordinated retirement step.
245		case t.State == task.Done:
246			action := fmt.Sprintf("retire runtime/worktree for %s", t.ID)
247			if retireOptions.deleteBranches && t.Branch != "" && t.Branch != t.Base {
248				action += fmt.Sprintf(" and delete %s", t.Branch)
249			}
250			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.RetireOptions{
251				CloseUnknown: retireOptions.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: retireOptions.assumeNoRuntime,
252				DeleteBranch: retireOptions.deleteBranches,
253			})
254			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
255				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: "merged, but guarded retirement is blocked",
256					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})
257				break
258			}
259			out = append(out, suggestion{

268					return err
269				},
270			})
271		}
272	
273		// A branch-backed task whose branch git no longer has is dead: the branch
274		// was deleted after integration, so the record holds intent for work that
275		// no longer exists anywhere. It cannot be finished, resumed, or retired,
276		// because every one of those paths resolves the branch first.

279			t.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeDirect && !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, t.RepoPath, t.Branch) {
280			out = append(out, suggestion{
281				row:    r,
282				reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch %s no longer exists", t.Branch),
283				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s", t.ID),
284				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
285			})
286			return out
287		}
288	
289		// A cold task keeps no checkout by definition: that is what going cold
290		// means. One still on disk is drift inventory already reports and nothing
291		// could act on.
292		if t.State == task.Cold && t.WorktreePath != "" && r.CheckoutExists && !r.WorktreeMissing &&
293			!r.Live() && !r.Status.Dirty() && r.Status.Synced() {
294			out = append(out, suggestion{
295				row:    r,
296				reason: "cold, but its worktree is still on disk",
297				action: fmt.Sprintf("reconcile %s with an exact guarded plan — not changed automatically", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
298			})
299		}

306				reason: "records a worktree that git no longer knows about",
307				action: fmt.Sprintf("inspect repository-wide prune scope before clearing %s — not changed automatically", config.Contract(wtPath)),
308			})
309		}

313	func sweepTaskPlan(ctx context.Context, app *App, id string, options flow.ActionOptions) (lifecycleSession, flow.Plan, error) {
314		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
315			return app.Tasks.Get(id)
316		})
317		if err != nil {
318			return lifecycleSession{}, flow.Plan{}, err
319		}
320		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
321		return session, plan, err
322	}
323	
324	func sweepPlanBlocker(plan flow.Plan, err error) string {
325		if err != nil {
326			return err.Error()
327		}
328		var parts []string

15	// Field is one stable key/value member of an immutable Fields value.

19	}

21	// Fields is a map-shaped value whose backing storage is not exposed. Entries
22	// are kept in key order so fingerprints do not depend on map iteration order.
23	type Fields struct {
24		entries []Field
25	}
26	
27	// NewFields copies values into a deterministic immutable representation.
28	func NewFields(values map[string]string) Fields {
29		entries := make([]Field, 0, len(values))
30		for key, value := range values {
31			entries = append(entries, Field{Key: key, Value: value})
32		}
33		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Key < entries[j].Key })
34		return Fields{entries: entries}
35	}
36

39		return append([]Field(nil), f.entries...)
40	}

44		out := make(map[string]string, len(f.entries))

46			out[entry.Key] = entry.Value
47		}
48		return out
49	}

207		VerdictBlocked     Verdict = "blocked"
208		VerdictUnknown     Verdict = "unknown"
209		VerdictError       Verdict = "error"
210		VerdictUnsupported Verdict = "unsupported"
211		VerdictCurrent     Verdict = "current"

219		RequirementAdvisory Requirement = "advisory"
220	)

222	// Condition carries a stable decision plus operator-facing evidence and the
223	// narrow remediation for an unmet result.
224	type Condition struct {
225		Code        ConditionCode
226		Verdict     Verdict
227		Requirement Requirement
228		Evidence    string
229		Remediation string
230	}
231	
232	var stableCode = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
233	
234	// Validate rejects conditions that cannot be fingerprinted or aggregated with
235	// defined semantics.
236	func (c Condition) Validate() error {
237		if !stableCode.MatchString(string(c.Code)) {
238			return fmt.Errorf("condition code %q is not a stable lowercase code", c.Code)
239		}
240		switch c.Verdict {
241		case VerdictMet, VerdictNeedsInput, VerdictBlocked, VerdictUnknown, VerdictError, VerdictUnsupported, VerdictCurrent:
242		default:
243			return fmt.Errorf("condition %s has unknown verdict %q", c.Code, c.Verdict)
244		}
245		switch c.Requirement {
246		case RequirementRequired, RequirementAdvisory:
247		default:
248			return fmt.Errorf("condition %s has unknown requirement %q", c.Code, c.Requirement)
249		}
250		return nil
251	}
252	
253	// ConditionFromObservation maps observation completeness to a fail-closed
254	// verdict. Capability policy such as unsupported remains an explicit condition
255	// decision rather than an inferred observation result.
256	func ConditionFromObservation(code ConditionCode, requirement Requirement, observation Observation, remediation string) Condition {
257		verdict := VerdictUnknown
258		switch observation.State {
259		case ObservationKnown:
260			verdict = VerdictMet
261		case ObservationError:
262			verdict = VerdictError
263		case ObservationUnknown, ObservationSkipped, ObservationLoading:
264			verdict = VerdictUnknown
265		default:
266			verdict = VerdictError
267		}
268		evidence := observation.Evidence
269		if evidence == "" {
270			switch {
271			case observation.Failure != "":
272				evidence = observation.Failure
273			case observation.Value != "":
274				evidence = observation.Value
275			default:
276				evidence = string(observation.State)
277			}
278		}
279		return Condition{
280			Code: code, Verdict: verdict, Requirement: requirement,
281			Evidence: evidence, Remediation: remediation,
282		}
283	}
284	
285	// Availability is the aggregate action status shown by any caller.
286	type Availability string
287	
288	const (
289		AvailabilityReady       Availability = "ready"
290		AvailabilityNeedsInput  Availability = "needs-input"
291		AvailabilityBlocked     Availability = "blocked"
292		AvailabilityUnknown     Availability = "unknown"
293		AvailabilityError       Availability = "error"
294		AvailabilityUnsupported Availability = "unsupported"
295		AvailabilityCurrent     Availability = "current"
296	)
297	
298	// AvailabilityFor derives action readiness from required conditions only. The
299	// order is fail-closed and deterministic when more than one required condition
300	// is unmet; advisory evidence never changes the result.
301	func AvailabilityFor(conditions []Condition) Availability {
302		availability := AvailabilityReady
303		priority := func(value Availability) int {
304			switch value {
305			case AvailabilityError:
306				return 6
307			case AvailabilityBlocked:
308				return 5
309			case AvailabilityNeedsInput:
310				return 4
311			case AvailabilityUnknown:
312				return 3
313			case AvailabilityUnsupported:
314				return 2
315			case AvailabilityCurrent:
316				return 1
317			default:
318				return 0
319			}
320		}
321		for _, condition := range conditions {
322			if condition.Requirement == RequirementAdvisory {
323				continue
324			}
325			candidate := AvailabilityReady
326			if condition.Requirement != RequirementRequired {
327				candidate = AvailabilityError
328			} else {
329				switch condition.Verdict {
330				case VerdictMet:
331					continue
332				case VerdictNeedsInput:
333					candidate = AvailabilityNeedsInput
334				case VerdictBlocked:
335					candidate = AvailabilityBlocked
336				case VerdictUnknown:
337					candidate = AvailabilityUnknown
338				case VerdictError:
339					candidate = AvailabilityError
340				case VerdictUnsupported:
341					candidate = AvailabilityUnsupported
342				case VerdictCurrent:
343					candidate = AvailabilityCurrent
344				default:
345					candidate = AvailabilityError
346				}
347			}
348			if priority(candidate) > priority(availability) {
349				availability = candidate
350			}
351		}
352		return availability
353	}

371		return Effect{

373			Destructive: destructive, Network: network, Details: NewFields(details),
374		}
375	}

387		}

389			if strings.TrimSpace(field.Key) == "" {
390				return fmt.Errorf("effect %s has an empty detail key", e.Code)
391			}
392		}
393		return nil
394	}

1	package taskflow
2	
3	import "context"
4	
5	// PlanHook performs action-specific observation and returns only construction
6	// input. BuildPlan remains the single graph, availability, and identity
7	// authority.
8	type PlanHook func(context.Context, Request) (PlanSpec, error)
9	
10	// ApplyHook executes one already validated plan and may return a partial Result
11	// together with an error.
12	type ApplyHook func(context.Context, Plan) (Result, error)
13	
14	// Handler contains the narrow hooks for one exact action. Either hook may be
15	// omitted; no production or unsafe fallback is installed.
16	type Handler struct {
17		Plan  PlanHook
18		Apply ApplyHook
19	}
20	
21	// Handlers maps stable action codes to injected behavior.
22	type Handlers map[Action]Handler
23	
24	// LocateTaskHook builds one exact managed-task locator from fresh durable and
25	// Git evidence. It is intentionally not accepted by NewService: only the
26	// guarded lifecycle constructor may install it.
27	type LocateTaskHook func(context.Context, string) (Locator, error)
28	
29	// Service is the UI-agnostic locate/plan/apply dispatcher.
30	type Service struct {
31		handlers   map[Action]Handler
32		locateTask LocateTaskHook
33	}
34	
35	// NewService copies handlers so later mutation of the caller's map cannot
36	// redirect a planned action.
37	func NewService(handlers Handlers) *Service {
38		copied := make(map[Action]Handler, len(handlers))
39		for action, handler := range handlers {
40			copied[action] = handler
41		}
42		return &Service{handlers: copied}
43	}
44	
45	// LocateTask returns an exact locator only when this service came from
46	// NewLifecycleService. Generic dispatch services deliberately have no fallback
47	// locator because guessing task, repository, or checkout identity is unsafe.
48	func (s *Service) LocateTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
49		if s == nil || s.locateTask == nil {
50			return Locator{}, ErrLocatorUnavailable
51		}
52		return s.locateTask(ctx, taskID)
53	}
54	
55	// Plan validates and freezes a request, delegates action-specific observations,
56	// then centrally builds the immutable plan.
57	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, err
61		}
62		handler, ok := s.handlers[normalized.Action]
63		if !ok || handler.Plan == nil {
64			return Plan{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: normalized.Action, Stage: "plan"}
65		}
66		spec, err := handler.Plan(ctx, normalized.Clone())
67		if err != nil {
68			return Plan{}, err
69		}
70		return BuildPlan(normalized, spec)
71	}
72	
73	// Apply validates identity and approval, rejects every status except READY, and
74	// delegates only to the handler registered for the plan's exact action. A
75	// handler's partial Result is returned unchanged in meaning alongside errors.
76	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, plan Plan, approval Approval) (Result, error) {
77		frozen := plan.Clone()
78		if err := frozen.Validate(); err != nil {
79			return Result{}, err
80		}
81		if err := frozen.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
82			return Result{}, err
83		}
84		if frozen.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
85			notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{
86				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Availability: frozen.Availability,
87				conditions: frozen.Conditions(),
88			}
89			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{
90				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Reason: "required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady,
91			}
92		}
93		handler, ok := s.handlers[frozen.Action]
94		if !ok || handler.Apply == nil {
95			return Result{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: frozen.Action, Stage: "apply"}
96		}
97		result, err := handler.Apply(ctx, frozen.Clone())
98		result = result.Clone()
99		if err != nil && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 {
100			result.PartialSuccess = true
101		}
102		return result, err
103	}
104

14	
15	// PlanSpec is action-handler construction input. Authority holds additional
16	// exact identities such as status, runtime, artifact, or remote fingerprints.
17	// BuildPlan copies every map and slice.
18	type PlanSpec struct {
19		Authority         map[string]string
20		Conditions        []Condition
21		Effects           []Effect
22		RetainedResources []string
23		Confirmation      Confirmation
24		FallbackCommand   string
25		Summary           string
26		DisplayedAt       time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Plan is an immutable-by-interface proposal bound to one request and one
30	// authority fingerprint. Collection accessors always return copies.
31	type Plan struct {
32		PlanID                 string
33		AuthorityFingerprint   string
34		Request                Request
35		Locator                Locator
36		Action                 Action
37		Source                 task.State
38		Target                 task.State
39		HasPersistedTransition bool
40		StatePreserving        bool
41		RemovesTask            bool
42		Availability           Availability
43		Confirmation           Confirmation
44		ExpectedMilestone      Milestone
45		FallbackCommand        string
46		Summary                string
47		DisplayedAt            time.Time
48	
49		authority  Fields
50		conditions []Condition
51		effects    []Effect
52		retained   StringList
53	}
54	
55	// BuildPlan validates graph legality, derives availability, and seals a plan's
56	// deterministic authority fingerprint and PlanID.
57	func BuildPlan(request Request, spec PlanSpec) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid request", Cause: err}
61		}
62		if err := spec.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
63			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
64		}
65		conditions := append([]Condition(nil), spec.Conditions...)
66		if err := validateConditions(conditions); err != nil {
67			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
68		}
69		effects := cloneEffects(spec.Effects)
70		if err := validateEffects(effects); err != nil {
71			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
72		}
73		authority := NewFields(spec.Authority)
74		if err := validateAuthority(authority); err != nil {
75			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
76		}
77	
78		plan := Plan{
79			Request: normalized.Clone(), Locator: normalized.Locator, Action: normalized.Action,
80			Source:       normalized.Locator.State,
81			Availability: AvailabilityFor(conditions), Confirmation: spec.Confirmation,
82			FallbackCommand: spec.FallbackCommand, Summary: spec.Summary, DisplayedAt: spec.DisplayedAt,
83			authority: authority, conditions: conditions, effects: effects,
84			retained: NewStringList(spec.RetainedResources...),
85		}
86		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
87			rule, transitionErr := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
88			if transitionErr != nil {
89				return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid transition", Cause: transitionErr}
90			}
91			plan.HasPersistedTransition = true
92			plan.Target = rule.Target
93			plan.StatePreserving = rule.StatePreserving
94			plan.RemovesTask = rule.RemovesTask
95			plan.ExpectedMilestone = rule.Milestone
96		} else {
97			switch plan.Action {
98			case Adopt:
99				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
100			case Reconcile:
101				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
102			}
103		}
104		plan.AuthorityFingerprint, plan.PlanID = computePlanIdentity(plan)
105		return plan.Clone(), nil
106	}
107	
108	// Clone returns a plan with independent request, map, and slice storage.
109	func (p Plan) Clone() Plan {
110		p.Request = p.Request.Clone()
111		p.authority = p.authority.clone()
112		p.conditions = append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...)
113		p.effects = cloneEffects(p.effects)
114		p.retained = p.retained.clone()
115		return p
116	}

118	// AuthorityFields returns a mutable copy of the extra authority identities.

122	func (p Plan) Conditions() []Condition { return append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...) }

124	// Effects returns independent copies of the ordered effects.
125	func (p Plan) Effects() []Effect { return cloneEffects(p.effects) }

130	// InputConditions returns required operator input without conflating it with a
131	// safety override.
132	func (p Plan) InputConditions() []Condition {
133		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
134			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict == VerdictNeedsInput
135		})
136	}

138	// BlockingConditions returns every required, non-input condition that prevents
139	// READY. Advisory conditions are intentionally absent.
140	func (p Plan) BlockingConditions() []Condition {
141		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
142			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired &&
143				condition.Verdict != VerdictMet && condition.Verdict != VerdictNeedsInput
144		})
145	}

147	// AdvisoryConditions returns non-authorizing evidence for display.
148	func (p Plan) AdvisoryConditions() []Condition {
149		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
150			return condition.Requirement == RequirementAdvisory
151		})
152	}

154	// Validate proves that a plan is structurally consistent and still carries its
155	// original deterministic identity. It performs no live observations.
156	func (p Plan) Validate() error {
157		if p.PlanID == "" || p.AuthorityFingerprint == "" {
158			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan identity is missing"}
159		}
160		if !p.Action.Valid() {
161			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown action %q", p.Action)}
162		}
163		if p.Request.Action != p.Action {
164			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request action and plan action differ"}
165		}
166		if p.Request.Locator != p.Locator {
167			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request locator and plan locator differ"}
168		}
169		if p.Request.Options == nil {
170			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "normalized request options are missing"}
171		}
172		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(p.Request)
173		if err != nil {
174			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request is no longer valid", Cause: err}
175		}
176		if requestIdentity(normalized) != requestIdentity(p.Request) {
177			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request options are not normalized"}
178		}
179		if err := p.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
180			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
181		}
182		if err := validateConditions(p.conditions); err != nil {
183			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
184		}
185		if err := validateEffects(p.effects); err != nil {
186			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
187		}
188		if err := validateAuthority(p.authority); err != nil {
189			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
190		}
191		if err := validatePlanTransition(p); err != nil {
192			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "transition metadata is inconsistent", Cause: err}
193		}
194	
195		authorityFingerprint, planID := computePlanIdentity(p)
196		if authorityFingerprint != p.AuthorityFingerprint {
197			return &StalePlanError{
198				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
199				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
200				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
201				Reason:                       "authority fields, effects, or conditions changed",
202			}
203		}
204		if planID != p.PlanID {
205			return &StalePlanError{
206				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
207				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
208				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
209				Reason:                       "PlanID does not match its authority fingerprint",
210			}
211		}
212		if availability := AvailabilityFor(p.conditions); availability != p.Availability {
213			return &InvalidPlanError{
214				PlanID: p.PlanID,
215				Reason: fmt.Sprintf("availability is %s, want derived %s", p.Availability, availability),
216			}
217		}
218		return nil
219	}
220	
221	// ValidateApproval binds affirmative approval and any typed token to this exact
222	// plan. It never changes plan readiness or condition verdicts.
223	func (p Plan) ValidateApproval(approval Approval) error {
224		if err := p.Validate(); err != nil {
225			return err
226		}
227		if !approval.Granted {
228			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "affirmative approval was not granted", Cause: ErrApprovalRequired}
229		}
230		if approval.PlanID != p.PlanID {
231			return &StalePlanError{
232				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: approval.PlanID,
233				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
234				Reason:                       "approval names a different plan",
235			}
236		}
237		if p.Confirmation.Kind == ConfirmationTyped {
238			if approval.Token != p.Confirmation.Token {
239				return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "typed confirmation token does not match", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
240			}
241		} else if approval.Token != "" {
242			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan does not accept a typed confirmation token", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
243		}
244		return nil
245	}
246	
247	func validatePlanTransition(plan Plan) error {
248		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
249			rule, err := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
250			if err != nil {
251				return err
252			}
253			if !plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Source != rule.Source || plan.Target != rule.Target ||
254				plan.StatePreserving != rule.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask != rule.RemovesTask ||
255				plan.ExpectedMilestone != rule.Milestone {
256				return fmt.Errorf("plan does not match the transition table")
257			}
258			return nil
259		}
260		expectedMilestone := MilestoneNone
261		switch plan.Action {
262		case Adopt:
263			expectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
264		case Reconcile:
265			expectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
266		}
267		if plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Target != "" || plan.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask ||
268			plan.Source != plan.Locator.State || plan.ExpectedMilestone != expectedMilestone {
269			return fmt.Errorf("domain action is represented as a persisted-state edge")
270		}
271		return nil
272	}
273	
274	func validateConditions(conditions []Condition) error {
275		seen := make(map[ConditionCode]bool, len(conditions))
276		for index, condition := range conditions {
277			if err := condition.Validate(); err != nil {
278				return fmt.Errorf("condition %d: %w", index, err)
279			}
280			if seen[condition.Code] {
281				return fmt.Errorf("condition code %q is duplicated", condition.Code)
282			}
283			seen[condition.Code] = true
284		}
285		return nil
286	}
287	
288	func validateEffects(effects []Effect) error {
289		for index, effect := range effects {
290			if err := effect.Validate(); err != nil {
291				return fmt.Errorf("effect %d: %w", index, err)
292			}
293		}
294		return nil
295	}
296	
297	func validateAuthority(authority Fields) error {
298		for _, field := range authority.entries {
299			if field.Key == "" {
300				return fmt.Errorf("authority field key is empty")
301			}
302		}
303		return nil
304	}
305	
306	func cloneEffects(effects []Effect) []Effect {
307		out := make([]Effect, len(effects))
308		for index, effect := range effects {
309			out[index] = effect.Clone()
310		}
311		return out
312	}
313	
314	func filterConditions(conditions []Condition, keep func(Condition) bool) []Condition {
315		out := make([]Condition, 0, len(conditions))
316		for _, condition := range conditions {
317			if keep(condition) {
318				out = append(out, condition)
319			}
320		}
321		return out
322	}

324	func requestIdentity(request Request) string {
325		writer := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-request-v1")
326		appendRequestIdentity(writer, request)
327		return writer.sumHex()
328	}
329	
330	func computePlanIdentity(plan Plan) (string, string) {
331		writer := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-authority-v1")
332		appendRequestIdentity(writer, plan.Request)
333		writer.addString("plan.action", string(plan.Action))
334		writer.addString("plan.source", string(plan.Source))
335		writer.addString("plan.target", string(plan.Target))
336		writer.addBool("plan.has-persisted-transition", plan.HasPersistedTransition)
337		writer.addBool("plan.state-preserving", plan.StatePreserving)
338		writer.addBool("plan.removes-task", plan.RemovesTask)
339		writer.addString("plan.expected-milestone", string(plan.ExpectedMilestone))
340		writer.addFields("plan.authority", plan.authority)
341		writer.addInt64("plan.condition-count", int64(len(plan.conditions)))
342		for index, condition := range plan.conditions {
343			prefix := "plan.condition." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
344			writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(condition.Code))
345			writer.addString(prefix+"verdict", string(condition.Verdict))
346			writer.addString(prefix+"requirement", string(condition.Requirement))
347			writer.addString(prefix+"evidence", condition.Evidence)
348			writer.addString(prefix+"remediation", condition.Remediation)
349		}
350		writer.addInt64("plan.effect-count", int64(len(plan.effects)))
351		for index, effect := range plan.effects {
352			prefix := "plan.effect." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
353			writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(effect.Code))
354			writer.addString(prefix+"description", effect.Description)
355			writer.addString(prefix+"target", effect.Target)
356			writer.addBool(prefix+"destructive", effect.Destructive)
357			writer.addBool(prefix+"network", effect.Network)
358			writer.addFields(prefix+"details", effect.Details)
359		}
360		writer.addStrings("plan.retained", plan.retained.values)
361		writer.addString("plan.confirmation-kind", string(plan.Confirmation.Kind))
362		writer.addString("plan.confirmation-token", plan.Confirmation.Token)
363		authorityFingerprint := "sha256:" + writer.sumHex()
364	
365		planWriter := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-plan-v1")
366		planWriter.addString("authority-fingerprint", authorityFingerprint)
367		return authorityFingerprint, "plan:" + planWriter.sumHex()
368	}
369	
370	func appendRequestIdentity(writer *identityWriter, request Request) {
371		locator := request.Locator
372		writer.addString("request.action", string(request.Action))
373		writer.addString("locator.repo-key", locator.RepoKey)
374		writer.addString("locator.row-key", locator.RowKey)
375		writer.addString("locator.row-kind", locator.RowKind)
376		writer.addString("locator.repository-id", locator.RepositoryID)
377		writer.addString("locator.git-common-dir", locator.GitCommonDir)
378		writer.addString("locator.task-id", locator.TaskID)
379		writer.addString("locator.task-revision", locator.TaskRevision)
380		writer.addString("locator.repo-path", locator.RepoPath)
381		writer.addString("locator.checkout-path", locator.CheckoutPath)
382		writer.addString("locator.branch", locator.Branch)
383		writer.addString("locator.base", locator.Base)
384		writer.addString("locator.upstream", locator.Upstream)
385		writer.addString("locator.remote", locator.Remote)
386		writer.addString("locator.head-oid", locator.HeadOID)
387		writer.addString("locator.base-oid", locator.BaseOID)
388		writer.addString("locator.upstream-oid", locator.UpstreamOID)
389		writer.addString("locator.mode", string(locator.Mode))
390		writer.addString("locator.state", string(locator.State))
391		appendOptionsIdentity(writer, request.Options)
392	}
393	
394	type identityWriter struct {
395		buffer bytes.Buffer
396	}
397	
398	func newIdentityWriter(domain string) *identityWriter {
399		writer := &identityWriter{}
400		writer.addString("domain", domain)
401		return writer
402	}
403	
404	func (w *identityWriter) addString(label, value string) {
405		w.addBytes([]byte(label))
406		w.addBytes([]byte(value))
407	}
408	
409	func (w *identityWriter) addBool(label string, value bool) {
410		w.addString(label, strconv.FormatBool(value))
411	}
412	
413	func (w *identityWriter) addInt64(label string, value int64) {
414		w.addString(label, strconv.FormatInt(value, 10))
415	}
416	
417	func (w *identityWriter) addStrings(label string, values []string) {
418		w.addInt64(label+".count", int64(len(values)))
419		for index, value := range values {
420			w.addString(label+"."+strconv.Itoa(index), value)
421		}
422	}
423	
424	func (w *identityWriter) addFields(label string, fields Fields) {
425		w.addInt64(label+".count", int64(len(fields.entries)))
426		for index, field := range fields.entries {
427			prefix := label + "." + strconv.Itoa(index)
428			w.addString(prefix+".key", field.Key)
429			w.addString(prefix+".value", field.Value)
430		}
431	}
432	
433	func (w *identityWriter) addBytes(value []byte) {
434		var length [8]byte
435		binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(value)))
436		_, _ = w.buffer.Write(length[:])
437		_, _ = w.buffer.Write(value)
438	}
439	
440	func (w *identityWriter) sumHex() string {
441		sum := sha256.Sum256(w.buffer.Bytes())
442		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
443	}

254	func (e *executionState) run(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error)) error {
255		step := StepResult{Effect: effect.Clone(), Status: StepAttempted, StartedAt: e.service.now()}
256		detail, err := operation()
257		step.FinishedAt = e.service.now()
258		step.Detail = detail
259		if err != nil {
260			step.Status = StepFailed
261			step.Failure = err.Error()
262			e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
263			return err
264		}
265		step.Status = StepCompleted
266		e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
267		return nil
268	}
269	
270	func (e *executionState) runWarning(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error), warningPrefix string) {
271		err := e.run(effect, operation)
272		if err != nil {
273			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, warningPrefix+": "+err.Error())
274		}
275	}
276	
277	func (e *executionState) result() Result {
278		spec := ResultSpec{
279			Steps: e.steps, Warnings: e.warnings, Recovery: e.recovery,
280			PartialSuccess: e.partial,
281			Milestone:      e.milestone, Handoff: e.handoff, Remote: e.remote, FreshSnapshotRef: e.snapshot,
282		}
283		for _, step := range e.steps {
284			if step.Status == StepCompleted {
285				spec.PartialSuccess = true
286				break
287			}
288		}
289		if len(e.steps) > 0 && e.steps[len(e.steps)-1].Status == StepCompleted &&
290			(e.snapshot != "" || e.remote != nil) && len(e.recovery) == 0 {
291			// Successful completion is not partial merely because it had effects.
292			// Remote refresh is intentionally run-local and therefore completes with
293			// structured data rather than a persisted snapshot reference.
294			spec.PartialSuccess = false
295		}
296		return NewResult(spec)
297	}

299	func (e *executionState) fail(err error, recovery ...string) (Result, error) {
300		e.recovery = append(e.recovery, recovery...)
301		return e.result(), err
302	}
