13	func newResumeCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
14		var (
15			noProvision bool
16			fetch       bool
17			force       bool
18		)
19		cmd := &cobra.Command{
20			Use:   "resume <task>",
21			Short: "Pick a task back up, rebuilding whatever is missing",
22			Long: `Make a parked task hot again.
23	
24	Warm tasks still have their worktree, so this just reopens a runtime session.
25	Cold tasks do not: the worktree is rebuilt from the branch, which is why going
26	cold is safe in the first place — the branch, not the directory, is the task's
27	identity.
28	
29	If the task is owned by another machine, resuming here takes ownership. Two
30	machines writing the same branch is the one way to make this workflow produce
31	a conflict, so dev asks before doing it.`,
32			Args: cobra.ExactArgs(1),
33			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
34				ctx := ctxOf()
35				execution, err := executeTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
36					return app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
37				}, taskflow.ResumeOptions{
38					FetchRefs: fetch, NoProvision: noProvision, TakeOwnership: force,
39				})
40				if err != nil {
41					return err
42				}
43	
44				resumed := &execution.Task
45				handoff, ok := execution.Result.Handoff()
46				if !ok || handoff.Path == "" {
47					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is HOT, but resume returned no activation handoff", resumed.ID)
48				}
49				checkout := handoff.Path
50				var activationRuntime runtime.Runtime
51				switch handoff.Kind {
52				case taskflow.HandoffDirectory:
53					if resumed.RuntimeName != "" || resumed.RuntimeHandle != "" {
54						return fmt.Errorf("task %s returned a directory handoff with persisted runtime %s/%s",
55							resumed.ID, resumed.RuntimeName, resumed.RuntimeHandle)
56					}
57				case taskflow.HandoffRuntime:
58					activationRuntime = app.runtimeNamed(handoff.Runtime)
59					if activationRuntime == nil || activationRuntime.Name() != handoff.Runtime {
60						return fmt.Errorf("resume handoff backend %q is unavailable", handoff.Runtime)
61					}
62					if resumed.RuntimeName != handoff.Runtime || resumed.RuntimeHandle != handoff.RuntimeHandle {
63						return fmt.Errorf("task %s persisted runtime %s/%s, but resume handed off %s/%s",
64							resumed.ID, resumed.RuntimeName, resumed.RuntimeHandle, handoff.Runtime, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
65					}
66					annotate(app, activationRuntime, resumed)
67				default:
68					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is HOT, but resume returned unsupported %s handoff", resumed.ID, handoff.Kind)
69				}
70	
71				mode := resumed.EffectiveMode()
72				style := app.outStyle()
73				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s  %s on %s (%s)\n",
74					task.Hot.Icon(), resumed.Title(), resumed.Repo, resumed.Branch, style.dim(string(mode)))
75				if resumed.Next != "" {
76					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s      %s\n", style.label("next"), resumed.Next)
77				}
78				if resumed.AgentSession != "" {
79					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s (resumable)\n", style.label("agent"), resumed.AgentSession)
80				}
81				if st, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout); statusErr == nil {
82					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s       %s\n", style.label("git"), style.git(st.Summary()))
83					if st.Behind > 0 {
84						app.warnf("branch is %d behind upstream — `git pull --ff-only` before you start", st.Behind)
85					}
86				}
87				if handoff.Kind == taskflow.HandoffDirectory {
88					return app.cdDirective(checkout)
89				}
90				return activateRuntime(ctx, activationRuntime, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
91			},
92		}
93		f := cmd.Flags()
94		f.BoolVar(&noProvision, "no-provision", false, "skip dependency install when rebuilding a worktree")
95		f.BoolVar(&fetch, "fetch", true, "fetch from origin first")
96		f.BoolVar(&force, "force", false, "take ownership of a task owned by another machine")
97		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Warm, task.Cold)
98		return cmd
99	}

27	func newAdoptCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
28		var (
29			apply       bool
30			yes         bool
31			noWorktrees bool
32			noSessions  bool
33			noBranches  bool
34			state       string
35		)
36		cmd := &cobra.Command{
37			Use:   "adopt",
38			Short: "Import existing worktrees, sessions and branches as tasks",
39			Long: `Bring what is already on this machine under dev's inventory.
40	
41	There is nothing to migrate to start using dev — repositories are discovered
42	wherever your scan roots point, and no directory is moved or renamed. What is
43	worth importing is the work already in flight: linked worktrees created by
44	hand or by another tool, runtime sessions sitting in a repo, and local
45	branches that are ahead of their base.
46	
47	Reports by default. Nothing is created without --apply, and nothing on disk is
48	ever moved, renamed or deleted by this command.`,
49			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
50			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
51				ctx := ctxOf()
52	
53				target, err := task.ParseState(state)
54				if err != nil {
55					return err
56				}
57	
58				repos, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
59				if err != nil {
60					return err
61				}
62				existing, err := app.Tasks.List()
63				if err != nil {
64					return err
65				}
66				known := map[string]bool{}
67				for _, t := range existing {
68					known[t.ID] = true
69				}
70

74					sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)

81					}

162	
163	// scanRepo collects everything in one repository that looks like work in
164	// flight but is not yet recorded.
165	func scanRepo(ctx context.Context, app *App, r repo.Repo, sessions []runtime.Session,
166		known map[string]bool, target task.State, doWorktrees, doSessions, doBranches bool) []candidate {
167	
168		var out []candidate
169		seen := map[string]bool{}
170	
171		add := func(branch, worktree, reason string, state task.State) {
172			if branch == "" || seen[branch] {
173				return
174			}
175			id := task.MakeID(r.Name, branch)
176			if known[id] {
177				return
178			}
179			seen[branch] = true
180			mode := task.ModeBranch
181			if worktree != "" {
182				mode = task.ModeWorktree
183			}
184			out = append(out, candidate{
185				Reason: reason,
186				Task: &task.Task{
187					ID:           id,
188					Name:         branch,
189					Repo:         r.Name,
190					RepoPath:     r.Path,
191					Branch:       branch,
192					Base:         gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, r.Path),
193					WorktreePath: worktree,
194					Mode:         mode,
195					State:        state,
196					Owner:        config.Hostname(),
197				},
198			})
199		}
200	
201		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
202		if err != nil {
203			return nil
204		}
205	
206		if doWorktrees {
207			for _, w := range worktrees {
208				if w.Main || w.Branch == "" || w.Prunable {
209					continue
210				}
211				// A harness's turn-scoped worktree is not a change stream a human
212				// tracks; adopting those would fill the inventory with noise that
213				// the harness will delete on its own.
214				if inventory.IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
215					continue
216				}
217				state := target
218				reason := "existing worktree"
219				if sessionAt(sessions, w.Path) != nil {
220					state, reason = task.Hot, "worktree with a live session"
221				}
222				add(w.Branch, w.Path, reason, state)
223			}
224		}
225	
226		if doSessions {
227			for i := range sessions {
228				for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
229					if d != r.Path {
230						continue
231					}
232					st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
233					if err != nil || st.Branch == "" {
234						continue
235					}
236					add(st.Branch, "", "live session in the main checkout", task.Hot)
237				}
238			}
239		}
240	
241		if doBranches {
242			for _, branch := range unmergedBranches(ctx, r.Path) {
243				add(branch, worktreePathFor(worktrees, branch), "branch ahead of the base", target)
244			}
245		}
246		return out
247	}
248	
249	func sessionAt(sessions []runtime.Session, dir string) *runtime.Session {
250		for i := range sessions {
251			for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
252				if d == dir {
253					return &sessions[i]
254				}
255			}
256		}
257		return nil
258	}
259	
260	func worktreePathFor(worktrees []gitx.Worktree, branch string) string {
261		for _, w := range worktrees {
262			if w.Branch == branch && !w.Main {
263				return w.Path
264			}
265		}
266		return ""
267	}
268	
269	// unmergedBranches lists local branches carrying commits the default branch
270	// does not — unfinished work that would otherwise be invisible to dev.
271	func unmergedBranches(ctx context.Context, repoPath string) []string {
272		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repoPath)
273		if base == "" {
274			return nil
275		}
276		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname:short)", "refs/heads/")
277		if err != nil {
278			return nil
279		}
280		var branches []string
281		for _, b := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
282			b = strings.TrimSpace(b)
283			if b == "" || b == base || inventory.IsEphemeralWorktree("", b) {
284				continue
285			}
286			// Contained in the base means the work has already landed.
287			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", b, base); err == nil {
288				continue
289			}
290			branches = append(branches, b)
291		}
292		return branches
293	}

405			Use:   "plan",

407			Long: `Report the project types detected in this repository and exactly what
408	provisioning a new worktree would do — which gitignored files get copied,
409	which dependency directories are copied or shared, and which install commands
410	run.
411	
412	A worktree that comes up broken is the commonest reason people abandon
413	worktrees, and the config alone cannot answer "what will this actually do":
414	that depends on which lockfiles exist, which tools are installed here, and

435			},

444	// renderPlan prints a provisioning plan as a table plus its warnings.
445	func renderPlan(app *App, plan wt.Plan, repoPath string) {
446		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s\n\n", config.Contract(repoPath))
447	
448		if len(plan.Ecosystems) == 0 {
449			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No project type detected — only gitignored files will be carried over.")
450		} else {
451			t := app.newTable("PROJECT", "MANAGER", "FROM", "DEPENDENCIES", "TOOL")
452			style := app.outStyle()
453			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
454				deps := "—"
455				if len(e.DepDirs) > 0 {
456					deps = strings.Join(e.DepDirs, ", ")
457				} else {
458					deps = "global cache"
459				}
460				tool := "installed"
461				if !e.ToolInstalled() {
462					tool = style.danger("MISSING: " + e.Tool)
463				} else {
464					tool = style.success(tool)
465				}
466				t.Add(e.Name, e.Manager, e.Marker, deps, tool)
467			}
468			t.Render(app.Out)
469		}
470	
471		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out)
472		if len(plan.Steps) == 0 {
473			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Nothing to provision.")
474		} else {
475			st := app.newTable("", "ACTION", "WHAT", "WHY")
476			style := app.outStyle()
477			for _, s := range plan.Steps {
478				mark := "✓"
479				if s.Skipped {
480					mark = style.dim("·")
481				} else {
482					mark = style.success(mark)
483				}
484				st.Add(mark, string(s.Kind), truncate(s.What, 34), s.Why)
485			}
486			st.Render(app.Out)
487		}
488	
489		for _, w := range plan.Warnings {
490			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%s %s\n", app.errStyle().warning("warning:"), w)
491		}
492		if plan.Empty() {
493			fmt.Fprintln(app.Err, "\nNothing would run. If a new worktree comes up broken, add what it needs to "+
494				"worktree.post_create, or commit .dev-cli/config.toml with `dev wt plan --write`.")
495		}
496	}
497	
498	// writeRepoTemplate seeds .dev-cli/config.toml from the detected plan.
499	//
500	// Committing it is what makes a project's worktree setup reproducible: the
501	// next machine, and the next person, get the same one without having to
502	// rediscover it.
503	func writeRepoTemplate(app *App, repoPath string, plan wt.Plan, set wt.Settings) error {
504		path, err := projectconfig.ConfigPath(repoPath)
505		if err != nil {
506			return err
507		}
508		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
509			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists — edit it directly", config.Contract(path))
510		}
511		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
512			return err
513		}
514	
515		var b strings.Builder
516		b.WriteString("# dev project configuration (versioned with this repository).\n")
517		b.WriteString("version = 1\n\n")
518		b.WriteString("#\n")
519		b.WriteString("# Committed on purpose: a worktree is a clean checkout, so without this a\n")
520		b.WriteString("# new one comes up with no dependencies and none of the gitignored files the\n")
521		b.WriteString("# project needs. Seeded by `dev wt plan --write`; edit freely.\n\n")
522		b.WriteString("[worktree]\n")
523	
524		b.WriteString("# Gitignored files to carry into a new worktree. Only files that are BOTH\n")
525		b.WriteString("# listed here AND gitignored are copied — a tracked file is already in the\n")
526		b.WriteString("# checkout on the correct branch.\n")
527		b.WriteString("include = [")
528		for i, inc := range set.Include {
529			if i > 0 {
530				b.WriteString(", ")
531			}
532			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%q", inc)
533		}
534		b.WriteString("]\n\n")
535	
536		if len(plan.Ecosystems) > 0 {
537			b.WriteString("# Detected in this repository:\n")
538			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
539				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "#   %-8s %-8s (%s) → %s\n", e.Name, e.Manager, e.Marker, e.Install)
540			}
541			b.WriteString("#\n")
542			b.WriteString("# \"auto\" runs those install commands. Replace with an explicit list if this\n")
543			b.WriteString("# project needs something else:  post_create = [\"make bootstrap\"]\n")
544			b.WriteString("post_create = \"auto\"\n\n")
545	
546			b.WriteString("# How each project type gets its dependencies:\n")
547			b.WriteString("#   reinstall  run the install command (correct, the default)\n")
548			b.WriteString("#   copy       duplicate the directory from the source checkout (fast)\n")
549			b.WriteString("#   link       share one directory between checkouts (fastest, risky)\n")
550			b.WriteString("#   skip       leave the worktree without dependencies\n")
551			b.WriteString("[worktree.strategies]\n")
552			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
553				switch {
554				case len(e.DepDirs) == 0:
555					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# %-8s = \"reinstall\"  # %s uses a global cache; nothing to copy\n",
556						e.Name, e.Manager)
557				case e.CopySafe:
558					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%-10s = \"reinstall\"  # \"copy\" is sound here and much faster\n", e.Name)
559				default:
560					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%-10s = \"reinstall\"  # copy/link unsupported: %s\n", e.Name, e.Hazard)
561				}
562			}
563		} else {
564			b.WriteString("# No project type detected. Add the commands a fresh checkout needs:\n")
565			b.WriteString("# post_create = [\"make bootstrap\"]\n")
566			b.WriteString("post_create = \"auto\"\n")
567		}
568	
569		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(b.String()), 0o644); err != nil {
570			return err
571		}
572		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "wrote %s\n", config.Contract(path))
573		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Commit it so every machine provisions worktrees the same way.")
574		return nil
575	}

299	// Main returns Git's actual primary record. The first-row fallback preserves

304				return checkout, true

307		if len(c.Checkouts) == 0 {

313	// Linked returns every Git-registered non-main worktree.
314	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
315		hasMarkedMain := false
316		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
317			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
318				hasMarkedMain = true
319				break
320			}
321		}
322		if !hasMarkedMain {
323			if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
324				return nil

326			return c.Checkouts[1:]
327		}
328		out := make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(c.Checkouts)-1)
329		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
330			if !checkout.Worktree.Main {

337	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
338	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
339	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
340		seen := map[string]bool{}
341		var out []runtime.Session
342		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
343			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
344				key := session.Handle
345				if key == "" {
346					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
347				}
348				if seen[key] {
349					continue
350				}
351				seen[key] = true
352				out = append(out, session)
353			}
354		}
355		return out
356	}

373	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
374		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {

377		})

380	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions builds repository topology from Git's complete
381	// registered worktree list. It never synthesizes a main checkout after a Git
382	// query failure.
383	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
384		opts RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
385		if ctx == nil {
386			ctx = context.Background()
387		}
388		out := RepoContext{
389			Repo: r, Runtime: opts.Runtime,
390			WorktreeObservation: TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved},
391			RuntimeObservation:  runtimeObservation(opts),
392		}
393		queryPath := repoQueryPath(r)
394		out.RepositoryID, out.IdentityErr = canonicalRepositoryID(ctx, r, queryPath)
395		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
396	
397		var (
398			worktrees []gitx.Worktree
399			err       error
400		)
401		if queryPath == "" {
402			err = fmt.Errorf("repository has no Git query path")
403		} else {
404			worktrees, err = gitx.Worktrees(ctx, queryPath)
405		}
406		if err != nil {
407			listErr := &WorktreeListError{Path: queryPath, Err: err}
408			out.WorktreeErr = listErr
409			out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: listErr}
410			assignTasksWithoutTopology(&out, tasks)
411			finishRepoContext(&out)
412			return out
413		}
414		out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
415		out.WorktreeCount = 0
416		out.Checkouts = make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(worktrees))
417		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
418			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
419			if canonicalPath == "" {
420				canonicalPath = filepath.Clean(worktree.Path)
421			}
422			checkout := RepoCheckout{
423				ID: canonicalPath, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
424				IdentityErr: canonicalErr,
425				Worktree:    worktree, Exists: pathIsDir(worktree.Path),
426				RuntimeObservation: out.RuntimeObservation,
427				Ownership:          CheckoutExternal,
428			}
429			if canonicalErr != nil {
430				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
431					Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: canonicalErr.Error(),
432				})
433			}
434			if worktree.Main {
435				checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
436					Kind: OwnershipEvidenceGitMain, Path: canonicalPath,
437				})
438			} else {
439				out.WorktreeCount++
440			}
441			out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
442		}
443	
444		enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx, out.Checkouts, opts.Limiter)
445		assignHarnessEvidence(&out)
446		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
447		if out.RuntimeObservation.Available() {
448			assignSessions(&out, opts.Sessions)
449		}
450		finishRepoContext(&out)
451		return out
452	}

454	func runtimeObservation(opts RepoContextOptions) TopologyObservation {
455		if opts.RuntimeErr != nil {
456			err := &RuntimeListError{Runtime: opts.Runtime, Err: opts.RuntimeErr}
457			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: err}
458		}
459		if opts.RuntimeObserved {
460			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
461		}
462		return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved}
463	}

465	func repoQueryPath(r repo.Repo) string {
466		for _, candidate := range []string{r.Path, r.RealPath, r.MainRoot, r.CommonDir} {
467			if candidate != "" {
468				return candidate
469			}
470		}
471		return ""
472	}
473	
474	func canonicalRepositoryID(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, queryPath string) (string, error) {
475		commonDir := r.CommonDir
476		if commonDir == "" && r.Bare {
477			commonDir = queryPath
478		}
479		if commonDir == "" && queryPath != "" {
480			if discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, queryPath); err == nil {
481				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
482			}
483		}
484		if commonDir == "" {
485			err := fmt.Errorf("Git common directory is empty")
486			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
487		}
488		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
489		if err != nil {
490			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
491		}
492		return canonical, nil
493	}
494	
495	func enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx context.Context, checkouts []RepoCheckout, limiter *Limiter) {
496		if limiter == nil {
497			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
498		}
499		var wg sync.WaitGroup
500		for i := range checkouts {
501			if checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare || checkouts[i].Worktree.Prunable || !checkouts[i].Exists {
502				continue
503			}
504			wg.Add(1)
505			go func(index int) {
506				defer wg.Done()
507				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
508				if !ok {
509					checkouts[index].StatusErr = ctx.Err()
510					return
511				}
512				defer release()
513				checkout := &checkouts[index]
514				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
515				checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(
516					ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status,
517				)
518			}(i)
519		}
520		wg.Wait()
521	}
522	
523	func assignHarnessEvidence(out *RepoContext) {
524		mainRoot := ""
525		for i := range out.Checkouts {
526			if out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Main && !out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare {
527				mainRoot = out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path
528				break
529			}
530		}
531		if mainRoot == "" {
532			return
533		}
534		for i := range out.Checkouts {
535			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
536			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
537				continue
538			}
539			evidence, ok := DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(mainRoot, checkout.Worktree.Path)
540			if !ok {
541				continue
542			}
543			checkout.HarnessEvidence = &evidence
544			checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
545				Kind: OwnershipEvidenceClaudeHarness, Path: evidence.Root,
546			})
547		}
548	}
549	
550	// IsEphemeralWorktree is the legacy broad display heuristic. Its branch-prefix
551	// compatibility is retained for existing adopters, but authoritative topology
552	// uses DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree: a worktree-* branch alone is not ownership
553	// evidence.
554	func IsEphemeralWorktree(path, branch string) bool {
555		slashPath := filepath.ToSlash(path)
556		return strings.Contains(slashPath, "/.claude/worktrees/") ||
557			strings.HasPrefix(branch, "worktree-")
558	}

560	func linkedAdminCount(commonDir string) int {
561		if commonDir == "" {
562			return 0
563		}
564		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(commonDir, "worktrees"))
565		if err != nil {
566			return 0
567		}
568		n := 0
569		for _, entry := range entries {
570			if entry.IsDir() {
571				n++
572			}
573		}
574		return n
575	}
576	
577	func pathIsDir(path string) bool {
578		info, err := os.Stat(path)
579		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
580	}
581	
582	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
583		latest := status.LatestChange
584		var commit time.Time
585		var subject string
586		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
587			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
588			if commit.After(latest) {
589				latest = commit
590			}
591			subject = lastSubject
592		}
593		return latest, commit, subject
594	}
595	
596	func assignTasksWithoutTopology(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
597		for _, tracked := range sortedUniqueTasks(tasks) {
598			binding := TaskBinding{
599				Task: tracked, Kind: TaskBindingUnbound,
600				ConflictReasons: []TopologyReason{{
601					Code:   ReasonWorktreeInventoryUnavailable,
602					Detail: "registered worktrees could not be observed",
603				}},
604			}
605			out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, tracked)
606			out.OtherTaskBindings = append(out.OtherTaskBindings, binding)
607		}
608	}
609	
610	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
611		paths := map[string][]int{}
612		branches := map[string][]int{}
613		mainIndex := -1
614		for i := range out.Checkouts {
615			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
616			if checkout.ID != "" {
617				paths[checkout.ID] = append(paths[checkout.ID], i)
618			}
619			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" && !checkout.Worktree.Bare {
620				branches[branch] = append(branches[branch], i)
621			}
622			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
623				mainIndex = i
624			}
625		}
626	
627		for _, tracked := range sortedUniqueTasks(tasks) {
628			binding := TaskBinding{Task: tracked, Kind: TaskBindingUnbound}
629			mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
630			var recordedPathIssue *TopologyReason
631			if tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
632				canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(tracked.WorktreePath)
633				if err != nil {
634					reason := TopologyReason{Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: err.Error()}
635					recordedPathIssue = &reason
636				} else if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
637					if matches := paths[canonical]; len(matches) > 0 {
638						if len(matches) == 1 {
639							binding.Kind = TaskBindingExactPath
640							bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
641							continue
642						}
643						reason := TopologyReason{
644							Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
645							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s path matches %d registered checkout records", tracked.ID, len(matches)),
646						}
647						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
648						for _, index := range matches {
649							out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
650						}
651						appendOtherTask(out, binding)
652						continue
653					}
654				}
655				if mode != task.ModeWorktree {
656					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
657						Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
658						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
659							mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
660					})
661				}
662			}
663	
664			if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
665				matches := branches[tracked.Branch]
666				switch len(matches) {
667				case 1:
668					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMovedPath
669					binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, movedPathReason(tracked, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
670					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
671						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
672					}
673					bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
674					continue
675				case 0:
676					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
677						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
678					}
679					if tracked.WorktreePath != "" || taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
680						binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
681							Code:   ReasonWorktreePathMissing,
682							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no registered checkout for branch %s", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch),
683						})
684					}
685				default:
686					reason := TopologyReason{
687						Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
688						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s branch %s matches %d registered checkouts", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, len(matches)),
689					}
690					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
691					for _, index := range matches {
692						out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
693					}
694				}
695				appendOtherTask(out, binding)
696				continue
697			}
698	
699			if mainIndex >= 0 {
700				main := out.Checkouts[mainIndex]
701				if checkoutActionable(main) && main.Branch() == tracked.Branch {
702					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMainBranch
703					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
704						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
705					}
706					bindTask(out, mainIndex, annotateBoundTask(binding, main))
707					continue
708				}
709			}
710	
711			if recordedPathIssue != nil {
712				binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
713			}
714			for _, index := range branches[tracked.Branch] {
715				if index == mainIndex {
716					continue
717				}
718				reason := TopologyReason{
719					Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
720					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s branch is checked out outside Git main at %s",
721						mode, tracked.ID, out.Checkouts[index].Worktree.Path),
722				}
723				binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
724				out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
725			}
726			if taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
727				detail := fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s in Git main", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch)
728				switch {
729				case mainIndex < 0:
730					detail += ", but no Git main record exists"
731				case !checkoutActionable(out.Checkouts[mainIndex]):
732					detail += ", but Git main is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable"
733				default:
734					detail += fmt.Sprintf(", which is on %s", displayBranch(out.Checkouts[mainIndex]))
735				}
736				binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
737					Code: ReasonMainBranchMismatch, Detail: detail,
738				})
739			}
740			appendOtherTask(out, binding)
741		}
742	
743		finalizeCheckoutClaims(out)
744	}
745	
746	func sortedUniqueTasks(tasks []*task.Task) []*task.Task {
747		ordered := append([]*task.Task(nil), tasks...)
748		sort.SliceStable(ordered, func(i, j int) bool {
749			if ordered[i] == nil {
750				return false
751			}
752			if ordered[j] == nil {
753				return true
754			}
755			return ordered[i].ID < ordered[j].ID
756		})
757		seen := map[string]bool{}
758		out := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(ordered))
759		for _, tracked := range ordered {
760			if tracked == nil {
761				continue
762			}
763			if tracked.ID != "" && seen[tracked.ID] {
764				continue
765			}
766			if tracked.ID != "" {
767				seen[tracked.ID] = true
768			}
769			out = append(out, tracked)
770		}
771		return out
772	}
773	
774	func movedPathReason(tracked *task.Task, checkout RepoCheckout) TopologyReason {
775		if tracked.WorktreePath == "" {
776			return TopologyReason{
777				Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
778				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no recorded worktree path; branch %s is registered at %s",
779					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
780			}
781		}
782		return TopologyReason{
783			Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
784			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s records %s; branch %s is registered at %s",
785				tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
786		}
787	}
788	
789	func annotateBoundTask(binding TaskBinding, checkout RepoCheckout) TaskBinding {
790		tracked := binding.Task
791		if tracked == nil {
792			return binding
793		}
794		if !checkoutActionable(checkout) {
795			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
796				Code: ReasonCheckoutUnavailable,
797				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout %s is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable",
798					checkout.Worktree.Path),
799			})
800		}
801		if checkout.Branch() != tracked.Branch {
802			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
803				Code: ReasonBranchMismatch,
804				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s; registered checkout is on %s",
805					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, displayBranch(checkout)),
806			})
807		}
808		mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
809		switch {
810		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && checkout.Worktree.Main:
811			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
812				Code:   ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
813				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("worktree task %s resolved to Git main", tracked.ID),
814			})
815		case mode != task.ModeWorktree && !checkout.Worktree.Main:
816			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
817				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
818				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s resolved to linked worktree %s",
819					mode, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
820			})
821		}
822		if mode != task.ModeWorktree && tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
823			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
824				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
825				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
826					mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
827			})
828		}
829		if !taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
830			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
831				Code: ReasonUnexpectedCheckout,
832				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s still has registered checkout %s",
833					tracked.State, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
834			})
835		}
836		return binding
837	}
838	
839	func taskExpectsCheckout(tracked *task.Task) bool {
840		if tracked == nil || tracked.State == task.Cold {
841			return false
842		}
843		if tracked.State == task.Done && tracked.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
844			return tracked.WorktreePath != ""
845		}
846		return true
847	}
848	
849	func checkoutActionable(checkout RepoCheckout) bool {
850		return !checkout.Worktree.Bare && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable && checkout.Exists && checkout.StatusErr == nil
851	}
852	
853	func bindTask(out *RepoContext, index int, binding TaskBinding) {
854		checkout := &out.Checkouts[index]
855		binding.CheckoutID = checkout.ID
856		checkout.TaskBindings = append(checkout.TaskBindings, binding)
857		checkout.Tasks = append(checkout.Tasks, binding.Task)
858		if binding.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
859			checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
860				Kind: OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask, Path: checkout.ID,
861				TaskID: binding.Task.ID, Owner: binding.Task.Owner,
862			})
863		}
864	}
865	
866	func appendOtherTask(out *RepoContext, binding TaskBinding) {
867		out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, binding.Task)
868		out.OtherTaskBindings = append(out.OtherTaskBindings, binding)
869	}
870	
871	func finalizeCheckoutClaims(out *RepoContext) {
872		for i := range out.Checkouts {
873			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
874			sort.SliceStable(checkout.TaskBindings, func(a, b int) bool {
875				return checkout.TaskBindings[a].Task.ID < checkout.TaskBindings[b].Task.ID
876			})
877			sort.SliceStable(checkout.Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
878				return checkout.Tasks[a].ID < checkout.Tasks[b].ID
879			})
880			if len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 1 {
881				ids := make([]string, len(checkout.TaskBindings))
882				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
883					ids[j] = checkout.TaskBindings[j].Task.ID
884				}
885				reason := TopologyReason{
886					Code:   ReasonMultipleTaskClaims,
887					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout is claimed by tasks %s", strings.Join(ids, ", ")),
888				}
889				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
890				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
891					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
892						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
893					)
894				}
895			}
896			if checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil && len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 0 {
897				reason := TopologyReason{
898					Code: ReasonHarnessTaskConflict,
899					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("checkout has Claude harness evidence and %d managed task claim(s)",
900						len(checkout.TaskBindings)),
901				}
902				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
903				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
904					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
905						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
906					)
907				}
908			}
909			for _, binding := range checkout.TaskBindings {
910				for _, reason := range binding.DriftReasons {
911					checkout.DriftReasons = appendReason(checkout.DriftReasons, reason)
912				}
913				for _, reason := range binding.ConflictReasons {
914					checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
915				}
916			}
917			checkout.Ownership = displayOwnership(*checkout)
918		}
919	}
920	
921	func displayOwnership(checkout RepoCheckout) CheckoutOwnership {
922		if checkout.Worktree.Main {
923			return CheckoutCanonical
924		}
925		if checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil {
926			return CheckoutEphemeral
927		}
928		for _, evidence := range checkout.OwnershipEvidence {
929			if evidence.Kind == OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask {
930				return CheckoutDev
931			}
932		}
933		return CheckoutExternal
934	}
935	
936	func appendReason(reasons []TopologyReason, candidate TopologyReason) []TopologyReason {
937		for _, reason := range reasons {
938			if reason.Code == candidate.Code && reason.Detail == candidate.Detail {
939				return reasons
940			}
941		}
942		return append(reasons, candidate)
943	}
944	
945	func finishRepoContext(out *RepoContext) {
946		for _, checkout := range out.Checkouts {
947			if checkout.LastActivity.After(out.LastActivity) {
948				out.LastActivity = checkout.LastActivity
949			}
950			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
951				if tracked.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
952					out.LastActivity = tracked.Updated
953				}
954			}
955		}
956		for _, tracked := range out.OtherTasks {
957			if tracked.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
958				out.LastActivity = tracked.Updated
959			}
960		}
961	
962		out.Rows = make([]RepoContextRow, 0, len(out.Checkouts)+len(out.OtherTaskBindings))
963		for i := range out.Checkouts {
964			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
965			out.Rows = append(out.Rows, RepoContextRow{
966				ID: checkout.ID, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
967				Kind: RepoContextRowCheckout, CheckoutIndex: i, Checkout: checkout,
968				DriftReasons:        append([]TopologyReason(nil), checkout.DriftReasons...),
969				ConflictReasons:     append([]TopologyReason(nil), checkout.ConflictReasons...),
970				WorktreeObservation: out.WorktreeObservation,
971				RuntimeObservation:  out.RuntimeObservation,
972			})
973		}
974		for _, binding := range out.OtherTaskBindings {
975			out.Rows = append(out.Rows, RepoContextRow{
976				ID: binding.Task.ID, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
977				Kind: RepoContextRowTask, CheckoutIndex: -1,
978				Task: binding.Task, Binding: binding,
979				DriftReasons:        append([]TopologyReason(nil), binding.DriftReasons...),
980				ConflictReasons:     append([]TopologyReason(nil), binding.ConflictReasons...),
981				WorktreeObservation: out.WorktreeObservation,
982				RuntimeObservation:  out.RuntimeObservation,
983			})
984		}
985	}
986	
987	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
988	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
989	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
990	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
991		for _, session := range sessions {
992			assigned := map[int]bool{}
993			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
994				best, bestLen := -1, -1
995				for i := range out.Checkouts {
996					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Checkouts[i]) {
997						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(normalizePath(root)) > bestLen {
998							best, bestLen = i, len(normalizePath(root))
999						}
1000					}
1001				}
1002				if best >= 0 {
1003					assigned[best] = true
1004				}
1005			}
1006			for i := range assigned {
1007				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
1008			}
1009		}
1010	}
1011	
1012	func checkoutRoots(checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
1013		return []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
1014	}
1015	
1016	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
1017		if root == "" || path == "" {
1018			return false
1019		}
1020		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
1021		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
1022			return false
1023		}
1024		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
1025	}
1026	
1027	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
1028	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
1029	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
1030	// is not sufficient.
1031	func normalizePath(path string) string {
1032		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
1033			return canonical
1034		}
1035		return filepath.Clean(path)
1036	}
1037	
1038	// FormatRepoContext renders the deterministic Markdown used by both the CLI
1039	// and the TUI's yy binding. checkoutIndex < 0 means the whole repository.
1040	func FormatRepoContext(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
1041		var b strings.Builder
1042		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
1043			checkout := c.Checkouts[checkoutIndex]
1044			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev worktree context: %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout))
1045			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, false)
1046			return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
1047		}
1048	
1049		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev repo context: %s\n\n", c.Repo.Display())
1050		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Repository: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Display())
1051		mainPath := c.Repo.Path
1052		if main, ok := c.Main(); ok {
1053			mainPath = main.Worktree.Path
1054		}
1055		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Main path: `%s`\n", mainPath)
1056		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Linked worktrees: %d\n", c.WorktreeCount)
1057		if c.Runtime != "" && c.Runtime != "none" {
1058			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime: `%s`\n", c.Runtime)
1059		}
1060		if c.WorktreeErr != nil {
1061			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Worktree inventory error: %s\n", c.WorktreeErr)
1062		}
1063		b.WriteString("\n## Checkouts\n")
1064		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
1065			b.WriteString("\n")
1066			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, checkout.Worktree.Main)
1067		}
1068		if len(c.OtherTasks) > 0 {
1069			b.WriteString("\n## Other tracked tasks\n\n")
1070			if len(c.OtherTaskBindings) > 0 {
1071				for _, binding := range c.OtherTaskBindings {
1072					writeTaskMarkdown(&b, binding.Task)
1073					writeTopologyReasons(&b, binding.DriftReasons, binding.ConflictReasons)
1074				}
1075			} else {
1076				for _, tracked := range c.OtherTasks {
1077					writeTaskMarkdown(&b, tracked)
1078				}
1079			}
1080		}
1081		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
1082	}
1083	
1084	func writeCheckoutMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, c RepoContext, checkout RepoCheckout, canonical bool) {
1085		label := string(checkout.Ownership)
1086		if canonical {
1087			label = "canonical"
1088		}
1089		fmt.Fprintf(b, "### %s — %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout), label)
1090		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Path: `%s`\n", checkout.Worktree.Path)
1091		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Branch: `%s`\n", displayBranch(checkout))
1092		if checkout.Worktree.Bare {
1093			b.WriteString("- Git: bare repository\n")
1094		} else if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
1095			b.WriteString("- Git: unavailable (checkout path is missing)\n")
1096		} else if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
1097			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.StatusErr)
1098		} else {
1099			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: %s", checkout.Status.Summary())
1100			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
1101				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", checkout.Status.Breakdown())
1102			}
1103			b.WriteString("\n")
1104			if checkout.Status.Upstream != "" {
1105				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Upstream: `%s`\n", checkout.Status.Upstream)
1106			} else {
1107				b.WriteString("- Upstream: not published\n")
1108			}
1109		}
1110		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
1111			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)
1112			if reason == "" {
1113				reason = "no reason recorded"
1114			}
1115			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: locked — %s\n", reason)
1116		}
1117		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
1118			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)
1119			if reason == "" {
1120				reason = "checkout path is missing"
1121			}
1122			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: prunable — %s\n", reason)
1123		}
1124		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
1125			b.WriteString("- Runtime: closed\n")
1126		} else {
1127			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
1128				status := session.AgentStatus
1129				if status == "" {
1130					status = "unknown"
1131				}
1132				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: `%s %s` (%s)\n", c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
1133				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
1134					fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Agent sessions: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
1135				}
1136			}
1137		}
1138		if len(checkout.Tasks) == 0 {
1139			b.WriteString("- Task: untracked\n")
1140		} else {
1141			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
1142				writeTaskMarkdown(b, tracked)
1143			}
1144		}
1145		writeTopologyReasons(b, checkout.DriftReasons, checkout.ConflictReasons)
1146	}

1148	func writeTopologyReasons(b *strings.Builder, drift, conflicts []TopologyReason) {
1149		for _, reason := range drift {
1150			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Drift: `%s` — %s\n", reason.Code, reason.Detail)
1151		}
1152		for _, reason := range conflicts {
1153			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Conflict: `%s` — %s\n", reason.Code, reason.Detail)
1154		}
1155	}
1156	
1157	func writeTaskMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, tracked *task.Task) {
1158		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: `%s` — %s", tracked.ID, tracked.State)
1159		if tracked.Next != "" {
1160			fmt.Fprintf(b, "; next: %s", tracked.Next)
1161		}
1162		b.WriteString("\n")
1163		if tracked.AgentSession != "" {
1164			fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Recorded agent: `%s`\n", tracked.AgentSession)
1165		}
1166	}
1167	
1168	func displayBranch(checkout RepoCheckout) string {
1169		if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
1170			return branch
1171		}
1172		if checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached {
1173			return "(detached HEAD)"
1174		}
1175		return "(unknown branch)"
1176	}
1177	
1178	func markdownCodes(values []string) string {
1179		quoted := make([]string, 0, len(values))
1180		for _, value := range values {
1181			quoted = append(quoted, "`"+value+"`")
1182		}
1183		return strings.Join(quoted, ", ")
1184	}
1185	
1186	// FormatSessions renders the ys payload. checkoutIndex < 0 selects the whole
1187	// repository; otherwise it selects one checkout.
1188	func FormatSessions(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
1189		indices := make([]int, 0, len(c.Checkouts))
1190		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
1191			indices = append(indices, checkoutIndex)
1192		} else {
1193			for i := range c.Checkouts {
1194				indices = append(indices, i)
1195			}
1196		}
1197		var b strings.Builder
1198		for _, i := range indices {
1199			checkout := c.Checkouts[i]
1200			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
1201				status := session.AgentStatus
1202				if status == "" {
1203					status = "unknown"
1204				}
1205				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s %s` (%s)\n",
1206					checkout.Worktree.Path, c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
1207				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
1208					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - agents: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
1209				}
1210			}
1211		}
1212		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
1213	}
1214	
1215	// LinkedWorktreePaths returns the yw payload: absolute linked-worktree paths,
1216	// one per line. The canonical checkout is intentionally excluded because WT
1217	// counts linked worktrees only.
1218	func LinkedWorktreePaths(c RepoContext) string {
1219		paths := make([]string, 0, len(c.Linked()))
1220		for _, checkout := range c.Linked() {
1221			paths = append(paths, checkout.Worktree.Path)
1222		}
1223		return strings.Join(paths, "\n")
1224	}

317	func checkoutExactVerdict(observed lifecycleObservation) (Verdict, string) {
318		if observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
319			return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("worktree common directory %q differs from %q", observed.worktree.GitCommonDir, observed.gitCommonDir)
320		}
321		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
322			if observed.task.WorktreePath == "" {
323				if observed.task.State != task.Cold || observed.branchMatches != 1 {
324					return VerdictBlocked, "the task has no exact persisted checkout identity"
325				}
326			} else {
327				// ResolveRegisteredWorktree matched the recorded hint by canonical path;
328				// subsequent operations use only the returned registered identity.
329				if observed.worktree.Path == "" {
330					return VerdictBlocked, "the exact registered worktree path is empty"
331				}
332			}
333		} else {
334			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
335				return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("%s task unexpectedly retains worktree path %q", observed.mode, observed.task.WorktreePath)
336			}
337			if observed.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath {
338				return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registered main path %q differs from %q", observed.worktree.Path, observed.repoPath)
339			}
340		}
341		if observed.headErr != nil {
342			return VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
343		}
344		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head {
345			return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
346		}
347		return VerdictMet, "exact path, Git common directory, and HEAD match"
348	}

423		}
424		if observed.cleanupErr != nil {

427				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.cleanupErr.Error(), "repair runtime occupancy observation"),
428				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime occupancy failed", "run cold parking from outside the checkout"),
429			}
430		}

432		occupancyEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%d closeable %s session(s)", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions), observed.runtime.Name())

436		}
437		callerVerdict := VerdictMet
438		callerEvidence := "caller is outside the checkout and runtime"
439		if observed.cleanup.CallerContained {

441			callerEvidence = "caller is inside the checkout or a covering runtime"
442		}
443		return []Condition{
444			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
445			condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop active agents and close mixed runtime panes"),
446			condition(ConditionCallerContainment, callerVerdict, RequirementRequired, callerEvidence, "run cold parking from outside the target checkout"),
447		}

450	func coldPublicationConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, options ParkColdOptions) []Condition {
451		if observed.statusErr != nil {
452			return []Condition{
453				condition(ConditionBranchPublished, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
454				condition(ConditionBranchPushed, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
455			}

462			} else {

465			}
466		}

468		pushedEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("ahead=%d", observed.status.Ahead)
469		willCreateCommit := options.CommitWIP && observed.status.Dirty()

472				pushedEvidence = "declared push will be followed by an ahead=0 check"
473			} else {

475				pushedEvidence = "committed or checkpointed work would remain ahead of upstream"
476			}

479			condition(ConditionBranchPublished, publishedVerdict, RequirementRequired, publishedEvidence, "request --push or publish the branch first"),
480			condition(ConditionBranchPushed, pushedVerdict, RequirementRequired, pushedEvidence, "request --push and resolve any rejected push"),
481		}

503	func taskUpdateEffect(observed lifecycleObservation, state task.State, path, runtimeDisposition, next, note string) Effect {
504		return NewEffect(EffectUpdateTask, "write lifecycle task state last", observed.task.ID, false, false,
505			map[string]string{
506				"expected-revision": observed.record.Revision,
507				"state":             string(state), "owner": "current-host",
508				"worktree-path": path, "runtime": runtimeDisposition,

515			return "wip: checkpoint"

520	func artifactEvidence(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
521		if observed.artifact.KnownEmpty {
522			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
523		}
524		var states []string
525		for _, intent := range observed.artifact.Intents {
526			states = append(states, intent.Intent.ID+"="+string(intent.State))
527		}
528		if len(states) == 0 {
529			return "artifact readiness is incomplete"
530		}
531		return strings.Join(states, ", ")
532	}
533	
534	func parkFallback(id string, cold bool, options interface{}) string {
535		parts := []string{"dev", "park", shellQuote(id)}
536		if cold {
537			parts = append(parts, "--cold")
538		}
539		switch value := options.(type) {
540		case ParkWarmOptions:
541			parts = appendParkFlags(parts, value.Next, value.Note, value.CommitWIP, value.Push,
542				value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime)
543			if value.Timeout > 0 {
544				parts = append(parts, "--timeout", value.Timeout.String())
545			}
546			if value.KeepSession {
547				parts = append(parts, "--keep-session")
548			}
549		case ParkColdOptions:
550			parts = appendParkFlags(parts, value.Next, value.Note, value.CommitWIP, value.Push,
551				value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime)
552			if value.Timeout > 0 {
553				parts = append(parts, "--timeout", value.Timeout.String())
554			}
555		}
556		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
557	}
558	
559	func appendParkFlags(parts []string, next, note string, wip, push, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool) []string {
560		if next != "" {
561			parts = append(parts, "--next", shellQuote(next))
562		}
563		if note != "" {
564			parts = append(parts, "--note", shellQuote(note))
565		}
566		if wip {
567			parts = append(parts, "--wip")
568		}
569		if push {
570			parts = append(parts, "--push")
571		}
572		if closeUnknown {
573			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
574		}
575		if assumeNoRuntime {
576			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
577		}
578		return parts
579	}
580	
581	func shellQuote(value string) string {
582		if value != "" && !strings.ContainsAny(value, " \t\n'\"`\\$;&|()<>*") {
583			return value
584		}
585		return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\\''") + "'"
586	}

319			occupancyEvidence = "shared-checkout override accepts the freshly observed agent occupancy"
320		}
321		if occupancyErr != nil {
322			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
323			occupancyEvidence = occupancyErr.Error()
324			if observed.occupancyErr != nil || observed.occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil ||
325				observed.occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil || observed.occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil ||
326				observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
327				occupancyVerdict = VerdictError
328			}
329		}
330		savedEvidence := "no saved runtime handle"
331		if observed.task.RuntimeHandle != "" {
332			if observed.savedRuntimeLive {
333				savedEvidence = "saved " + observed.runtime.Name() + " handle " + observed.task.RuntimeHandle + " covers the exact checkout"
334			} else {
335				savedEvidence = "saved runtime handle is stale and will be replaced or cleared"
336			}
337		}
338		return []Condition{
339			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
340			condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop the other recognized agent or use another checkout"),
341			condition(ConditionSavedRuntime, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, savedEvidence, ""),
342		}
343	}
344	
345	func resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
346		return observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && observed.hasCheckout() && observed.statusErr == nil &&
347			!observed.status.Detached && observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch
348	}
349	
350	func shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
351		return observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.savedRuntimeLive
352	}
353	
354	func resumeEffectCheckout(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
355		if observed.hasCheckout() {
356			return observed.checkout
357		}
358		return observed.desiredWorktree
359	}
360	
361	func resumeRuntimeLabel(candidate task.Task) string {
362		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
363			return candidate.Repo + "/" + candidate.Branch
364		}
365		return candidate.Title()
366	}
367	
368	func resumeFallback(id string, options ResumeOptions) string {
369		parts := []string{"dev", "resume", shellQuote(id)}
370		if !options.FetchRefs {
371			parts = append(parts, "--fetch=false")
372		}
373		if options.NoProvision {
374			parts = append(parts, "--no-provision")
375		}
376		if options.TakeOwnership {
377			parts = append(parts, "--force")
378		}
379		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
380	}

428	
429	func completionDirtyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) (Verdict, string) {
430		if observed.statusErr != nil {
431			return VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
432		}
433		if !observed.status.Dirty() {
434			return VerdictMet, "checkout is clean; dirty policy " + string(dirty) + " causes no content mutation"
435		}
436		evidence := observed.status.Breakdown()
437		if observed.finishErr == nil {
438			evidence += fmt.Sprintf("; %d path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
439				observed.finish.EquivalentDirty(), observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.UniqueDirty())
440		}
441		switch dirty {
442		case DirtyAuto:
443			return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; choose an explicit dirty policy"
444		case DirtyFail:
445			return VerdictBlocked, evidence + "; fail policy refuses dirty completion"
446		case DirtyCommit:
447			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
448				return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; commit-all requires a nonempty message"
449			}
450			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; commit-all was explicitly selected"
451		case DirtyDiscard:
452			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
453				return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires DROP"
454			}
455			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires approval"
456		default:
457			return VerdictError, "unknown dirty policy " + string(dirty)
458		}

743	func completionFallback(id, mode string, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string, push bool, baseRef, squash string) string {
744		parts := []string{"dev", "done", shellQuote(id)}
745		if mode != "" {
746			parts = append(parts, mode)
747		}
748		if dirty != DirtyAuto {
749			parts = append(parts, "--dirty="+string(dirty))
750		}
751		if dirty == DirtyCommit && strings.TrimSpace(message) != "" {
752			parts = append(parts, "--message", shellQuote(strings.TrimSpace(message)))
753		}
754		if baseRef != "" {
755			parts = append(parts, "--base-ref", shellQuote(baseRef))
756		}
757		if squash != "" {
758			parts = append(parts, "--confirm-squash", shellQuote(squash))
759		}
760		if push {
761			parts = append(parts, "--push")
762		}
763		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
764	}

766	func gitIsAncestor(ctx context.Context, dir, ancestor, descendant string) (bool, error) {
767		_, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", ancestor, descendant)
768		if err == nil {
769			return true, nil
770		}
771		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
772		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 {
773			return false, nil
774		}
775		return false, err
776	}

151			verdict := VerdictBlocked
152			evidence := "the exact checkout is not registered"
153			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !errors.Is(observed.worktreeErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
154				verdict = VerdictError
155				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
156			}
157			return []Condition{
158				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "refresh exact worktree topology"),
159				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout identity is unavailable", "refresh exact worktree topology"),
160				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unavailable", "select a registered linked checkout"),
161				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree flags are unavailable", "refresh exact worktree topology"),
162				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "branch identity is unavailable", "select a named non-detached checkout"),
163				condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "local branch ref is unavailable", "restore the exact local branch"),
164				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git status is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
165				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git operation state is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
166				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout cleanliness is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
167				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "harness ownership is unavailable", "refresh the exact checkout path"),
168			}
169		}
170	
171		exactVerdict := VerdictMet
172		exactEvidence := "selected path, repository, Git common directory, and HEAD are exact"
173		switch {
174		case observed.worktree.Path != observed.checkout:
175			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered path differs from selected checkout"
176		case observed.worktree.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir:
177			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered repository identity differs from selected repository"
178		case observed.headErr != nil:
179			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
180		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head:
181			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
182		case observed.locator.HeadOID != observed.head:
183			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("selected HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
184		}
185	
186		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
187		kindEvidence := "registered non-main, non-bare linked worktree"
188		if !observed.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree() {
189			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
190			kindEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("main=%t bare=%t; canonical and bare records are never removable", observed.worktree.Worktree.Main, observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare)
191		}
192	
193		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
194		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and non-prunable"
195		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked || observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable {
196			flagVerdict = VerdictBlocked
197			flagEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("locked=%t prunable=%t", observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked, observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable)
198		}
199	
200		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
201		branchEvidence := "registry and status identify named branch " + observed.locator.Branch
202		switch {
203		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch == "":
204			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered worktree is detached or unnamed"
205		case observed.statusErr != nil:
206			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
207		case observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.locator.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.locator.Branch:
208			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q selected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.locator.Branch)
209		}
210	
211		branchRefVerdict := VerdictMet
212		branchRefEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("local %s remains at selected HEAD %s", observed.branchRef, observed.locator.HeadOID)
213		switch {
214		case !observed.branchExists:
215			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "exact local branch ref does not exist"
216		case observed.branchOIDErr != nil:
217			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictError, observed.branchOIDErr.Error()
218		case observed.branchOID != observed.locator.HeadOID || observed.branchOID != observed.head:
219			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("branch OID=%q selected HEAD=%q live HEAD=%q", observed.branchOID, observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
220		}
221	
222		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
223		statusEvidence := observed.status.Summary()
224		if observed.statusErr != nil {
225			statusVerdict, statusEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
226		}
227		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
228		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
229		if observed.operationErr != nil {
230			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictError, observed.operationErr.Error()
231		} else if observed.inProgress {
232			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "Git operation "+observed.operation+" is in progress"
233		}
234		cleanVerdict := VerdictMet
235		cleanEvidence := "checkout is clean"
236		if observed.statusErr != nil {
237			cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
238		} else if observed.status.Dirty() {
239			cleanEvidence = observed.status.Breakdown()
240			switch {
241			case !options.DiscardDirty:
242				cleanVerdict = VerdictBlocked
243				cleanEvidence += "; default removal preserves all dirty bytes"
244			case observed.contentErr != nil:
245				cleanVerdict = VerdictError
246				cleanEvidence = "dirty content fingerprint failed: " + observed.contentErr.Error()
247			case observed.contentFingerprint == "":
248				cleanVerdict = VerdictError
249				cleanEvidence = "dirty content fingerprint is unavailable"
250			default:
251				cleanEvidence += "; exact-plan content fingerprint " + observed.contentFingerprint + " will be rechecked before discard"
252			}
253		}
254	
255		harnessVerdict := VerdictMet
256		harnessEvidence := "no strict harness path evidence"
257		if observed.isHarness {
258			harnessVerdict = VerdictBlocked
259			harnessEvidence = "checkout is strictly under harness root " + observed.harness.Root
260		}
261		return []Condition{
262			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
263			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "refresh the exact checkout locator"),
264			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "select a non-main linked checkout"),
265			condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, flagVerdict, RequirementRequired, flagEvidence, "unlock or repair the registration; pruning is never implicit"),
266			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named non-detached checkout"),
267			condition(ConditionBranchRef, branchRefVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchRefEvidence, "restore the exact local branch ref at selected HEAD"),
268			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
269			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
270			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementRequired, cleanEvidence, "commit changes or use the explicit CLI-compatible discard option"),
271			condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, harnessVerdict, RequirementRequired, harnessEvidence, "let the harness retire its own checkout"),
272		}
273	}
274	
275	func removeTaskInventoryConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
276		inventoryCondition := condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
277			"task inventory is complete, including a successful empty inventory", "")
278		switch {
279		case observed.taskInventoryErr != nil:
280			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
281				observed.taskInventoryErr.Error(), "repair task-store inventory before proving unmanaged ownership")
282		case len(observed.taskIncomplete) > 0:
283			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
284				strings.Join(observed.taskIncomplete, "; "), "repair every corrupt or unresolvable task record")
285		}
286		claimsCondition := condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
287			"no task claims the exact checkout path or branch in this repository", "")
288		if len(observed.taskClaims) > 0 {
289			claims := make([]string, len(observed.taskClaims))
290			for index, claim := range observed.taskClaims {
291				claims[index] = claim.ID + " (" + claim.Reason + ")"
292			}
293			claimsCondition = condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
294				"claimed by "+strings.Join(claims, ", "), "use managed lifecycle or reconcile the task claim")
295		}
296		return []Condition{inventoryCondition, claimsCondition}
297	}
298	
299	func removeContainmentConditions(observed destructiveObservation, options RemoveCheckoutOptions) []Condition {
300		if !options.RequireContained {
301			return []Condition{
302				condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
303					"unmanaged checkout removal does not require branch integration", ""),
304				condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
305					"branch is preserved regardless of containment", ""),
306				condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
307					"local branch will be retained", ""),
308			}
309		}
310		baseCondition := condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
311			fmt.Sprintf("local base %s is %s", observed.baseRef, observed.baseOID), "")
312		switch {
313		case !observed.baseExists:
314			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
315				"containment base "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "restore the exact local base")
316		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
317			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
318				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair containment-base observation")
319		case observed.baseOID == "":
320			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
321				"containment base resolved without an OID", "repair containment-base observation")
322		}
323		relationCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
324			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is contained in %s (%s)", observed.locator.Branch, observed.branchOID,
325				options.ContainmentBase, observed.baseOID), "")
326		switch {
327		case observed.containedErr != nil:
328			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
329				observed.containedErr.Error(), "repair local ancestry observation")
330		case !observed.branchExists || observed.branchOID == "" || !observed.baseExists || observed.baseOID == "":
331			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
332				"exact branch/base containment cannot be proved", "restore both exact local refs")
333		case !observed.contained:
334			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
335				"branch is not contained in "+options.ContainmentBase, "integrate it before contained retirement")
336		}
337		deletionCondition := condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
338			"local branch will be retained after contained checkout removal", "")
339		if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
340			deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
341				"ordinary git branch -d will run under the same repository/task lock", "")
342			if observed.locator.Branch == options.ContainmentBase {
343				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
344					"selected branch is the containment base", "retain the base branch")
345			} else if paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(true); err != nil {
346				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
347					err.Error(), "refresh worktree topology")
348			} else if len(paths) > 0 {
349				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
350					"branch is also checked out at "+strings.Join(paths, ", "), "remove or switch those checkouts first")
351			}
352		}
353		return []Condition{baseCondition, relationCondition, deletionCondition}
354	}
355	
356	func removeArtifactCondition(observed destructiveObservation) Condition {
357		switch {
358		case !observed.worktreeFound:
359			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
360				"artifact readiness requires the exact checkout", "restore the exact checkout")
361		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
362			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
363				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
364		case !observed.artifact.Ready():
365			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
366				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
367		default:
368			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
369				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "")
370		}
371	}
372	
373	func removeCheckoutFallback(observed destructiveObservation, options RemoveCheckoutOptions) string {
374		parts := []string{"dev", "wt", "rm", shellQuote(observed.locator.Branch)}
375		if options.RequireContained {
376			parts = []string{"dev", "retire", shellQuote(observed.checkout)}
377			if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
378				parts = append(parts, "--delete-branch")
379			}
380		} else if options.DiscardDirty {
381			parts = append(parts, "--force")
382		}
383		if options.CloseUnknown {
384			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
385		}
386		if options.AssumeNoRuntime {
387			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
388		}
389		if options.Timeout > 0 {
390			parts = append(parts, "--timeout", options.Timeout.String())
391		}
392		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
393	}
