395	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
396		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
397			return Result{}, err
398		}
399		if approved.Action != RemoveCheckout {
400			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "remove-checkout handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
401		}
402		if err := validateRemoveCheckoutLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
403			return Result{}, err
404		}
405		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
406		if err != nil {
407			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
408		}
409	
410		var result Result
411		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
412			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
413				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, approved.Request, tx.ListRecords)
414				if observeErr != nil {
415					return observeErr
416				}
417				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
418				if buildErr != nil {
419					return buildErr
420				}
421				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
422					return &StalePlanError{
423						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
424						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
425						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
426						Reason:                       "fresh unmanaged Git, worktree, task, artifact, runtime, or harness authority differs",
427					}
428				}
429				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
430					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
431					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh unmanaged removal conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
432				}
433				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx}
434				result, observeErr = execution.executeRemoveCheckout(ctx, observed)
435				return observeErr
436			})
437		})
438		return result, err
439	}
440	
441	func (e *executionState) executeRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
442		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RemoveCheckoutOptions)
443		closedRuntime := false
444	
445		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
446			switch effect.Code {
447			case EffectDiscardAll:
448				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, false)
449				if err != nil {
450					return e.fail(err, "refresh unmanaged removal before discarding bytes")
451				}
452				baseline = fresh
453				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
454					if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, baseline.checkout); discardErr != nil {
455						return "dirty discard may be partial", fmt.Errorf("discard exact checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
456					}
457					return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
458				})
459				if err != nil {
460					e.partial = true
461					return e.fail(err, "inspect every checkout byte before retrying removal")
462				}
463				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, true, false)
464				if err != nil {
465					return e.fail(err, "discard completed but a safety source changed; preserve the checkout and refresh")
466				}
467				baseline = fresh
468	
469			case EffectCloseRuntime:
470				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, false)
471				if err != nil {
472					return e.fail(err, "refresh unmanaged removal before closing any runtime")
473				}
474				baseline = fresh
475				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
476					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
477						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
478						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
479					})
480					if closeErr != nil {
481						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
482					}
483					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil
484				})
485				if err != nil {
486					e.partial = true
487					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and branch remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
488				}
489				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, true)
490				if err != nil {
491					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh removal")
492				}
493				baseline = fresh
494				closedRuntime = true
495	
496			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
497				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, closedRuntime)
498				if err != nil {
499					return e.fail(err, "the checkout was preserved; refresh every safety source")
500				}
501				baseline = fresh
502				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
503					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
504						return "checkout removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact unmanaged checkout %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
505					}
506					return "removed exact clean linked checkout without force; branch preserved", nil
507				})
508				if err != nil {
509					e.partial = true
510					return e.fail(err, "inspect the exact worktree registration and preserved branch before retrying")
511				}
512				if err := e.verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
513					return e.fail(err, "checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact preserved local branch")
514				}
515				e.snapshot = "checkout:removed:" + baseline.checkout + ":" + baseline.branchOID
516	
517			case EffectDeleteBranch:
518				if e.snapshot == "" {
519					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before verified checkout removal"})
520				}
521				if err := e.revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
522					return e.fail(err, "the checkout was removed but the branch and task inventory changed; keep the branch and refresh")
523				}
524				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
525					if _, deleteErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, baseline.repoPath, "branch", "-d", "--", baseline.locator.Branch); deleteErr != nil {
526						return "contained branch deletion failed", deleteErr
527					}
528					return "deleted contained local branch " + baseline.locator.Branch, nil
529				})
530				if err != nil {
531					e.partial = true
532					return e.fail(err, "checkout removal remains complete; inspect the retained branch and retry")
533				}
534				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
535					return e.fail(errors.New("local branch still exists after successful deletion"), "inspect the branch before retrying")
536				}
537				e.snapshot += ":branch-deleted"
538	
539			default:
540				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RemoveCheckout effect " + string(effect.Code)})
541			}
542		}
543		if e.snapshot == "" {
544			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unmanaged removal ended without verified checkout removal"})
545		}
546		return e.result(), nil
547	}
548	
549	func (e *executionState) reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation, allowDiscard, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
550		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, e.plan.Request, e.tx.ListRecords)
551		if err != nil {
552			return fresh, err
553		}
554		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
555			return fresh, err
556		}
557		for _, check := range []struct {
558			name          string
559			before, after string
560		}{
561			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
562			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
563			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
564			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
565			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
566			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
567			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
568		} {
569			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
570				return fresh, err
571			}
572		}
573		if allowDiscard {
574			if err := comparePostDiscardGit(baseline, fresh); err != nil {
575				return fresh, err
576			}
577		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()); err != nil {
578			return fresh, err
579		}
580		if allowRuntimeChange {
581			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
582				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
583			}
584		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
585			return fresh, err
586		}
587		return fresh, nil
588	}
589	
590	func comparePostDiscardGit(before, after destructiveObservation) error {
591		if after.statusErr != nil || after.status.Dirty() {
592			return staleBoundary("checkout is not clean after explicit discard")
593		}
594		beforeStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
595			before.status.Branch, boolString(before.status.Detached), before.status.Upstream,
596			fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Behind),
597			before.head, errorString(before.headErr), before.operation, boolString(before.inProgress), errorString(before.operationErr),
598		)
599		afterStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
600			after.status.Branch, boolString(after.status.Detached), after.status.Upstream,
601			fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Behind),
602			after.head, errorString(after.headErr), after.operation, boolString(after.inProgress), errorString(after.operationErr),
603		)
604		return compareAuthorityCategory("post-discard Git identity", beforeStable, afterStable)
605	}
606	
607	func (e *executionState) revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
608		records, diagnostics, err := e.tx.ListRecords()
609		if err != nil {
610			return err
611		}
612		claims := baseline
613		claims.taskRecords = records
614		claims.taskDiagnostics = diagnostics
615		claims.taskClaims = nil
616		claims.taskIncomplete = nil
617		e.service.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &claims)
618		if len(claims.taskIncomplete) > 0 {
619			return staleBoundary("task inventory became incomplete before branch deletion")
620		}
621		if len(claims.taskClaims) > 0 {
622			return staleBoundary("a task claimed the checkout path or branch before branch deletion")
623		}
624		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}

+func sweepTaskPlan(ctx context.Context, app *App, id string, options flow.ActionOptions) (lifecycleSession, flow.Plan, error) {
+	session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
+		return app.Tasks.Get(id)
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		return lifecycleSession{}, flow.Plan{}, err
+	}
+	plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
+	return session, plan, err
+}
+
+func sweepPlanBlocker(plan flow.Plan, err error) string {
+	if err != nil {
+		return err.Error()
+	}
+	var parts []string
+	for _, condition := range append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...) {
+		parts = append(parts, string(condition.Code)+": "+condition.Evidence)
+	}
+	if len(parts) == 0 {
+		return "guarded plan is " + string(plan.Availability)
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
+}
+
+func sweepDeleteTask(ctx context.Context, store *task.Store, id, revision string) error {
+	if revision == "" {
+		return fmt.Errorf("task %s had no report-time revision; rerun sweep", id)
+	}
+	return store.DeleteIfRevision(ctx, id, revision)
+}
+

358	// RepoContextOptions extends repository collection without changing the
359	// original CollectRepoContext API used by CLI and dashboard callers.
360	type RepoContextOptions struct {
361		Runtime         string
362		Sessions        []runtime.Session
363		RuntimeObserved bool
364		RuntimeErr      error
365		// Limiter shares one process-heavy enrichment bound across collectors.
366		Limiter *Limiter
367	}
368	
369	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository. The
370	// legacy entry point can prove observation only when sessions are present;
371	// callers that need a proven empty observation or typed failure use
372	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions.
373	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
374		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
375		return CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, r, tasks, RepoContextOptions{
376			Runtime: runtimeName, Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: len(sessions) > 0,
377		})
378	}
379	
380	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions builds repository topology from Git's complete
381	// registered worktree list. It never synthesizes a main checkout after a Git
382	// query failure.
383	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
384		opts RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
385		if ctx == nil {
386			ctx = context.Background()
387		}
388		out := RepoContext{
389			Repo: r, Runtime: opts.Runtime,
390			WorktreeObservation: TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved},
391			RuntimeObservation:  runtimeObservation(opts),
392		}
393		queryPath := repoQueryPath(r)
394		out.RepositoryID, out.IdentityErr = canonicalRepositoryID(ctx, r, queryPath)
395		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
396	
397		var (
398			worktrees []gitx.Worktree
399			err       error
400		)
401		if queryPath == "" {
402			err = fmt.Errorf("repository has no Git query path")
403		} else {
404			worktrees, err = gitx.Worktrees(ctx, queryPath)
405		}
406		if err != nil {
407			listErr := &WorktreeListError{Path: queryPath, Err: err}
408			out.WorktreeErr = listErr
409			out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: listErr}
410			assignTasksWithoutTopology(&out, tasks)
411			finishRepoContext(&out)
412			return out
413		}
414		out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
415		out.WorktreeCount = 0
416		out.Checkouts = make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(worktrees))
417		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
418			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
419			if canonicalPath == "" {
420				canonicalPath = filepath.Clean(worktree.Path)
421			}
422			checkout := RepoCheckout{
423				ID: canonicalPath, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
424				IdentityErr: canonicalErr,
425				Worktree:    worktree, Exists: pathIsDir(worktree.Path),
426				RuntimeObservation: out.RuntimeObservation,
427				Ownership:          CheckoutExternal,
428			}
429			if canonicalErr != nil {
430				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
431					Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: canonicalErr.Error(),
432				})
433			}
434			if worktree.Main {
435				checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
436					Kind: OwnershipEvidenceGitMain, Path: canonicalPath,
437				})
438			} else {
439				out.WorktreeCount++
440			}
441			out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
442		}
443	
444		enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx, out.Checkouts, opts.Limiter)
445		assignHarnessEvidence(&out)
446		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
447		if out.RuntimeObservation.Available() {
448			assignSessions(&out, opts.Sessions)
449		}
450		finishRepoContext(&out)
451		return out
452	}
453	
454	func runtimeObservation(opts RepoContextOptions) TopologyObservation {
455		if opts.RuntimeErr != nil {
456			err := &RuntimeListError{Runtime: opts.Runtime, Err: opts.RuntimeErr}
457			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: err}
458		}
459		if opts.RuntimeObserved {
460			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
461		}
462		return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved}
463	}
464	
465	func repoQueryPath(r repo.Repo) string {
466		for _, candidate := range []string{r.Path, r.RealPath, r.MainRoot, r.CommonDir} {
467			if candidate != "" {
468				return candidate
469			}
470		}
471		return ""
472	}
473	
474	func canonicalRepositoryID(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, queryPath string) (string, error) {
475		commonDir := r.CommonDir
476		if commonDir == "" && r.Bare {
477			commonDir = queryPath
478		}
479		if commonDir == "" && queryPath != "" {
480			if discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, queryPath); err == nil {
481				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
482			}
483		}
484		if commonDir == "" {
485			err := fmt.Errorf("Git common directory is empty")
486			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
487		}
488		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
489		if err != nil {
490			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
491		}
492		return canonical, nil
493	}
494	
495	func enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx context.Context, checkouts []RepoCheckout, limiter *Limiter) {
496		if limiter == nil {
497			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
498		}
499		var wg sync.WaitGroup
500		for i := range checkouts {
501			if checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare || checkouts[i].Worktree.Prunable || !checkouts[i].Exists {
502				continue
503			}
504			wg.Add(1)
505			go func(index int) {
506				defer wg.Done()
507				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
508				if !ok {
509					checkouts[index].StatusErr = ctx.Err()
510					return
511				}
512				defer release()
513				checkout := &checkouts[index]
514				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
515				checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(
516					ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status,
517				)
518			}(i)
519		}
520		wg.Wait()
521	}
522	
523	func assignHarnessEvidence(out *RepoContext) {
524		mainRoot := ""
525		for i := range out.Checkouts {
526			if out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Main && !out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare {
527				mainRoot = out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path
528				break
529			}

642	+func sweepTaskPlan(ctx context.Context, app *App, id string, options flow.ActionOptions) (lifecycleSession, flow.Plan, error) {
643	+	session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
644	+		return app.Tasks.Get(id)
645	+	})
646	+	if err != nil {
647	+		return lifecycleSession{}, flow.Plan{}, err
648	+	}
649	+	plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
650	+	return session, plan, err
651	+}
652	+
653	+func sweepPlanBlocker(plan flow.Plan, err error) string {
654	+	if err != nil {
655	+		return err.Error()
656	+	}
657	+	var parts []string
658	+	for _, condition := range append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...) {
659	+		parts = append(parts, string(condition.Code)+": "+condition.Evidence)
660	+	}
661	+	if len(parts) == 0 {
662	+		return "guarded plan is " + string(plan.Availability)
663	+	}
664	+	return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
665	+}
666	+
667	+func sweepDeleteTask(ctx context.Context, store *task.Store, id, revision string) error {
668	+	if revision == "" {
669	+		return fmt.Errorf("task %s had no report-time revision; rerun sweep", id)
670	+	}
671	+	return store.DeleteIfRevision(ctx, id, revision)
672	+}

676	 	info, err := os.Stat(path)
677	 	return err == nil && info.IsDir()
678	 }

702	 			action: fmt.Sprintf("salvage %s first — not removed automatically", strings.Join(unsalvaged, ", ")),

855	 func confirm(app *App, in *bufio.Reader, action string) bool {
856	 	s := app.outStyle()
857	 	prompt := s.prompt(action + "?")
858	 	lower := strings.ToLower(action)
859	 	if strings.Contains(lower, "delete") || strings.Contains(lower, "remove") ||
860	 		strings.Contains(lower, "discard") || strings.Contains(lower, "drop") {
861	 		prompt = s.danger(action + "?")
862	 	}
863	 	fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s ", prompt, s.dim("[y/N]"))
864	 	line, err := in.ReadString('\n')
865	 	if err != nil {
866	 		return false
867	 	}
868	 	answer := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
869	 	return answer == "y" || answer == "yes"
870	 }

13	// ReviewQuery identifies one exact head/base relationship in one repository.
14	// Repository is the forge's stable repository identity: owner/repository for
15	// GitHub, group/repository for GitLab, or organization/project/repository for
16	// Azure DevOps. Adapters must still verify the returned branches because CLI
17	// filters are not sufficient evidence on their own.
18	type ReviewQuery struct {
19		Repository string `json:"repository"`
20		Head       string `json:"head"`
21		Base       string `json:"base"`
22	}
23	
24	// ReviewState is the portable lifecycle state observed for a provider review.
25	type ReviewState string
26	
27	const (
28		ReviewOpen   ReviewState = "open"
29		ReviewDraft  ReviewState = "draft"
30		ReviewMerged ReviewState = "merged"
31		ReviewClosed ReviewState = "closed"
32	)
33	
34	// Valid reports whether s has defined portable review semantics.
35	func (s ReviewState) Valid() bool {
36		switch s {
37		case ReviewOpen, ReviewDraft, ReviewMerged, ReviewClosed:
38			return true
39		default:
40			return false
41		}
42	}
43	
44	// Review is the minimal provider evidence for an exact head/base relationship.
45	// ID is the provider-stable identity and Number is the repository-local human
46	// identifier. Head, Base, State and Draft are observations from the provider
47	// response rather than values copied from ReviewQuery.
48	type Review struct {
49		Provider   Kind        `json:"provider"`
50		Repository string      `json:"repository"`
51		ID         string      `json:"id"`
52		Number     int         `json:"number"`
53		State      ReviewState `json:"state"`
54		Draft      bool        `json:"draft"`
55		URL        string      `json:"url"`
56		Head       string      `json:"head"`
57		Base       string      `json:"base"`
58		ObservedAt time.Time   `json:"observed_at"`
59	}
60	
61	// ReviewQuerier is an optional forge capability. A nil Review and nil error is
62	// a successful observation that no exact review exists. One exact match returns
63	// provider evidence; multiple exact matches fail with AmbiguousReviewError.
64	type ReviewQuerier interface {
65		QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error)
66	}
67	
68	var (
69		// ErrAmbiguousReview identifies a query with multiple exact head/base
70		// matches. Callers must not select one by recency or provider ordering.
71		ErrAmbiguousReview = errors.New("multiple reviews match")
72		// ErrMalformedReviewResponse identifies provider JSON that cannot supply the
73		// critical portable fields without guessing.
74		ErrMalformedReviewResponse = errors.New("malformed review response")
75	)
76	
77	// AmbiguousReviewError carries every exact match while keeping Error text free
78	// of provider response values such as private URLs and branch names.
79	type AmbiguousReviewError struct {
80		Provider Kind
81		Query    ReviewQuery
82		Matches  []Review
83	}
84	
85	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Error() string {
86		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review query returned %d exact matches", e.Provider, len(e.Matches))
87	}
88	
89	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguousReview }
90	
91	// MalformedReviewResponseError identifies the unusable response field without
92	// embedding its value or the response body. Index is zero-based and is -1 when
93	// the whole JSON document is malformed. Err retains safe decoder diagnostics.
94	type MalformedReviewResponseError struct {
95		Provider Kind
96		Index    int
97		Field    string
98		Err      error
99	}
100	
101	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Error() string {
102		location := "response"
103		if e.Index >= 0 {
104			location = fmt.Sprintf("response item %d", e.Index+1)
105		}
106		detail := "missing or invalid " + e.Field
107		if e.Err != nil {
108			detail = e.Err.Error()
109		}
110		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review %s is malformed: %s", e.Provider, location, detail)
111	}
112	
113	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
114	
115	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Is(target error) bool {
116		return target == ErrMalformedReviewResponse
117	}
118	
119	// QueryReview invokes the optional capability without widening Forge. It never
120	// caches or initiates a query unless a caller explicitly calls this function.
121	func QueryReview(ctx context.Context, f Forge, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
122		querier, ok := f.(ReviewQuerier)
123		if !ok {
124			return nil, &ErrUnsupported{Kind: f.Kind(), Operation: "review queries"}
125		}
126		return querier.QueryReview(ctx, dir, query)
127	}
128	
129	type reviewCandidate struct {
130		ID     string
131		Number int
132		State  string
133		Draft  *bool
134		URL    string
135		Head   string
136		Base   string
137	}
138	
139	type reviewStateNormalizer func(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error)
140	
141	func validateReviewQuery(query ReviewQuery) error {
142		switch {
143		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Repository) == "":
144			return errors.New("review query repository is required")
145		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Head) == "":
146			return errors.New("review query head is required")
147		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Base) == "":
148			return errors.New("review query base is required")
149		default:
150			return nil
151		}
152	}
153	
154	func decodeReviewJSON(provider Kind, out string, target any) error {
155		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(out)
156		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
157			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON array", nil)
158		}
159		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), target); err != nil {
160			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON", err)
161		}
162		return nil
163	}
164	
165	func selectExactReview(provider Kind, query ReviewQuery, candidates []reviewCandidate, normalize reviewStateNormalizer) (*Review, error) {
166		matches := make([]Review, 0, 1)
167		observedAt := time.Now().UTC()
168		for index, candidate := range candidates {
169			if candidate.Head == "" {
170				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "head branch", nil)
171			}
172			if candidate.Base == "" {
173				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "base branch", nil)
174			}
175			if candidate.Head != query.Head || candidate.Base != query.Base {
176				continue
177			}
178			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate.ID) == "" {
179				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "identifier", nil)
180			}
181			if candidate.Number <= 0 {
182				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "number", nil)
183			}
184			if candidate.Draft == nil {
185				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "draft flag", nil)
186			}
187			if !validReviewURL(candidate.URL) {
188				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "URL", nil)
189			}
190			state, err := normalize(candidate.State, *candidate.Draft)
191			if err != nil {
192				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "state", err)
193			}
194			matches = append(matches, Review{
195				Provider: provider, Repository: query.Repository,
196				ID: candidate.ID, Number: candidate.Number,
197				State: state, Draft: *candidate.Draft, URL: candidate.URL,
198				Head: candidate.Head, Base: candidate.Base, ObservedAt: observedAt,
199			})
200		}
201	
202		switch len(matches) {
203		case 0:
204			return nil, nil
205		case 1:
206			return &matches[0], nil
207		default:
208			return nil, &AmbiguousReviewError{
209				Provider: provider, Query: query,
210				Matches: append([]Review(nil), matches...),
211			}
212		}
213	}
214	
215	func malformedReviewResponse(provider Kind, index int, field string, err error) error {
216		return &MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: index, Field: field, Err: err}
217	}
218	
219	func validReviewURL(raw string) bool {
220		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
221		if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" {
222			return false
223		}
224		return parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http"
225	}

14	
15	func (g *gh) Kind() Kind      { return GitHub }
16	func (g *gh) Bin() string     { return "gh" }
17	func (g *gh) Available() bool { return have("gh") }
18	
19	// CreatePR opens a GitHub pull request.
20	func (g *gh) CreatePR(ctx context.Context, dir string, req PRRequest) (string, error) {
21		if !g.Available() {
22			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
23		}
24		args := []string{"pr", "create", "--base", req.Base, "--head", req.Head}
25		switch {
26		case req.Title != "":
27			args = append(args, "--title", req.Title, "--body", req.Body)
28		default:
29			// --fill derives title and body from the branch's commits, which is
30			// the right default for a solo workflow where the commits already say
31			// what happened.
32			args = append(args, "--fill")
33		}
34		if req.Draft {
35			args = append(args, "--draft")
36		}
37		if req.Web {
38			args = append(args, "--web")
39		}
40		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
41		return lastURL(out), err
42	}
43	
44	// QueryReview manually observes an exact GitHub pull request relationship.
45	func (g *gh) QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
46		if !g.Available() {
47			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
48		}
49		if err := validateReviewQuery(query); err != nil {
50			return nil, err
51		}
52		out, err := reviewRunner(ctx, "gh", dir,
53			"pr", "list", "--repo", query.Repository,
54			"--head", query.Head, "--base", query.Base, "--state", "all",
55			"--limit", "1000",
56			"--json", "id,number,state,isDraft,url,headRefName,baseRefName")
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, err

144				"--query", azureReviewJSONQuery, "--output", "json", "--only-show-errors")
145			out, err := reviewRunner(ctx, "az", dir, args...)
146			if err != nil {
147				return nil, err
148			}
149			pageCandidates, err := parseAzureReviewCandidates(out)
150			if err != nil {
151				return nil, err
152			}
153			candidates = append(candidates, pageCandidates...)
154			if len(pageCandidates) < pageSize {
155				break
156			}
157		}
158		return selectExactReview(AzureDevOps, effectiveQuery, candidates, normalizeAzureReviewState)
159	}

161	func (a *az) reviewQueryScope(query ReviewQuery) (ReviewQuery, []string) {
162		organization, project, repository, fullIdentity := splitAzureReviewIdentity(query.Repository)
163		if fullIdentity {
164			organizationURL := "https://dev.azure.com/" + url.PathEscape(organization)
165			for _, target := range a.targets {
166				if strings.EqualFold(target.Project, project) && strings.EqualFold(azureTargetOrganization(target.Organization), organization) {
167					organizationURL = target.Organization
168					break
169				}
170			}
171			query.Repository = strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repository}, "/")
172			query.Head = azureReviewBranch(query.Head)
173			query.Base = azureReviewBranch(query.Base)
174			return query, []string{
175				"--detect", "false", "--organization", organizationURL,
176				"--project", project, "--repository", repository,
177			}
178		}
179	
180		if len(a.targets) == 1 {
181			target := a.targets[0]
182			repository := strings.Trim(query.Repository, "/")
183			if organization := azureTargetOrganization(target.Organization); organization != "" {
184				query.Repository = strings.Join([]string{organization, target.Project, repository}, "/")
185			}
186			query.Head = azureReviewBranch(query.Head)
187			query.Base = azureReviewBranch(query.Base)
188			return query, []string{
189				"--detect", "false", "--organization", target.Organization,
190				"--project", target.Project, "--repository", repository,
191			}
192		}
193	
194		query.Head = azureReviewBranch(query.Head)
195		query.Base = azureReviewBranch(query.Base)
196		return query, []string{"--detect", "true", "--repository", query.Repository}
197	}

199	func splitAzureReviewIdentity(identity string) (organization, project, repository string, ok bool) {
200		parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(identity, "/"), "/")
201		if len(parts) != 3 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" || parts[2] == "" {
202			return "", "", "", false
203		}
204		return parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], true
205	}

207	func azureTargetOrganization(raw string) string {
208		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
209		parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed)
210		if err == nil && parsed.Hostname() != "" {
211			host := strings.ToLower(parsed.Hostname())
212			switch {
213			case host == "dev.azure.com":
214				segments := escapedSegments(parsed.EscapedPath())
215				if len(segments) == 1 {
216					return segments[0]
217				}
218			case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com"):
219				return strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")
220			}
221			return ""
222		}
223		if !strings.ContainsAny(trimmed, "/:") {
224			return trimmed
225		}
226		return ""
227	}

229	func parseAzureReviewCandidates(out string) ([]reviewCandidate, error) {
230		var raw []struct {
231			PullRequestID       *int   `json:"pullRequestId"`
232			Status              string `json:"status"`
233			IsDraft             *bool  `json:"isDraft"`
234			SourceRefName       string `json:"sourceRefName"`
235			TargetRefName       string `json:"targetRefName"`
236			RemoteURL           string `json:"remoteUrl"`
237			RepositoryRemoteURL string `json:"repositoryRemoteUrl"`
238		}
239		if err := decodeReviewJSON(AzureDevOps, out, &raw); err != nil {
240			return nil, err
241		}
242		candidates := make([]reviewCandidate, 0, len(raw))
243		for _, item := range raw {
244			id, number := "", 0
245			if item.PullRequestID != nil {
246				number = *item.PullRequestID
247				id = strconv.Itoa(number)
248			}
249			reviewURL := item.RemoteURL
250			if !validReviewURL(reviewURL) && item.RepositoryRemoteURL != "" && number > 0 {
251				if _, repositoryURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(item.RepositoryRemoteURL); ok {
252					reviewURL = strings.TrimRight(repositoryURL, "/") + "/pullrequest/" + strconv.Itoa(number)
253				}
254			}
255			candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
256				ID: id, Number: number, State: item.Status, Draft: item.IsDraft,
257				URL: reviewURL, Head: azureReviewBranch(item.SourceRefName), Base: azureReviewBranch(item.TargetRefName),
258			})
259		}
260		return candidates, nil
261	}

263	func azureReviewBranch(ref string) string {

267	func normalizeAzureReviewState(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error) {
268		switch strings.ToLower(state) {
269		case "active":
270			if draft {

272			}
273			return ReviewOpen, nil
274		case "completed":
275			return ReviewMerged, nil
276		case "abandoned":

278		default:
279			return "", errors.New("unrecognized Azure DevOps review state")

294	// ListRepos queries every configured organization/project concurrently. Azure
295	// CLI already returns every repository in the selected team project.
296	func (a *az) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
297		if len(a.targets) == 0 {
298			return nil, errors.New("Azure DevOps remote inventory needs at least one [[forge.azure_devops]] target")
299		}
300		if err := a.ensureExtension(ctx); err != nil {
301			return nil, err
302		}
303		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
304		defer cancel()
305	
306		type result struct {
307			repos []RemoteRepo
308			err   error
309		}
310		ch := make(chan result, len(a.targets))
311		var wg sync.WaitGroup
312		for _, target := range a.targets {
313			target := target
314			wg.Add(1)
315			go func() {
316				defer wg.Done()
317				out, err := run(ctx, "az", "", "repos", "list", "--detect", "false",
318					"--organization", target.Organization, "--project", target.Project,
319					"--output", "json", "--only-show-errors")
320				if err != nil {
321					ch <- result{err: fmt.Errorf("Azure DevOps %s / %s: %w", target.Organization, target.Project, err)}
322					return
323				}
324				repos, err := parseAzureDevOpsRepos(out)
325				if err != nil {
326					err = fmt.Errorf("Azure DevOps %s / %s: %w", target.Organization, target.Project, err)
327				}
328				ch <- result{repos: repos, err: err}
329			}()
330		}
331		wg.Wait()
332		close(ch)
333	
334		var repos []RemoteRepo
335		var errs []error
336		for item := range ch {
337			repos = append(repos, item.repos...)
338			if item.err != nil {
339				errs = append(errs, item.err)
340			}
341		}
342		sort.Slice(repos, func(i, j int) bool { return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label() })
343		unique := repos[:0]
344		seen := map[string]bool{}
345		for _, repo := range repos {
346			key := strings.ToLower(repo.Label())
347			if seen[key] {
348				continue
349			}
350			seen[key] = true
351			unique = append(unique, repo)
352		}
353		return unique, errors.Join(errs...)
354	}

356	func parseAzureDevOpsRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
357		var raw []struct {
358			Name          string `json:"name"`
359			DefaultBranch string `json:"defaultBranch"`
360			IsFork        bool   `json:"isFork"`
361			RemoteURL     string `json:"remoteUrl"`
362			SSHURL        string `json:"sshUrl"`
363			Project       struct {
364				Name       string `json:"name"`
365				Visibility string `json:"visibility"`
366			} `json:"project"`
367		}
368		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
369			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode az repos list: %w", err)
370		}
371		repos := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
372		for _, item := range raw {
373			identity, webURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(item.RemoteURL)
374			if !ok {
375				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode az repos list: unrecognized remoteUrl %q", item.RemoteURL)
376			}
377			repos = append(repos, RemoteRepo{
378				Forge: AzureDevOps, Name: item.Name, FullName: identity,
379				URL: webURL, CloneURL: webURL, SSHURL: item.SSHURL,
380				Visibility:    strings.ToLower(item.Project.Visibility),
381				DefaultBranch: strings.TrimPrefix(item.DefaultBranch, "refs/heads/"),
382				Fork:          item.IsFork,
383			})
384		}
385		return repos, nil
386	}

388	// parseAzureDevOpsRemote returns the provider identity and browser-safe HTTPS
389	// repository URL for supported Azure DevOps Services clone URL forms.
390	func parseAzureDevOpsRemote(raw string) (identity, webURL string, ok bool) {
391		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
392		if raw == "" {
393			return "", "", false
394		}
395		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
396			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
397			if err != nil || u.Fragment != "" || u.RawQuery != "" {
398				return "", "", false
399			}
400			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
401			case "https":
402				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
403					return "", "", false
404				}
405				return parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u)
406			case "ssh":
407				if u.User == nil || (u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22") {
408					return "", "", false
409				}
410				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
411					return "", "", false
412				}
413				return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(u.User.Username(), strings.ToLower(u.Hostname()), escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath()))
414			default:
415				return "", "", false
416			}
417		}
418		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
419		if at <= 0 {
420			return "", "", false
421		}
422		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
423		if colon < 0 {
424			return "", "", false
425		}
426		colon += at + 1
427		return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(raw[:at], strings.ToLower(raw[at+1:colon]), decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(raw[colon+1:], "/"), "/")))
428	}
429	
430	func parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u *url.URL) (string, string, bool) {
431		if u.User != nil {
432			if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
433				return "", "", false
434			}
435		}
436		host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
437		segments := escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath())
438		var organization, project, repo string
439		switch {
440		case host == "dev.azure.com":
441			if len(segments) != 4 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[2], "_git") {
442				return "", "", false
443			}
444			organization, project, repo = segments[0], segments[1], segments[3]
445			if u.User != nil && !strings.EqualFold(u.User.Username(), organization) {
446				return "", "", false
447			}
448		case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com") && host != "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com":
449			if len(segments) < 3 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[len(segments)-2], "_git") || u.User != nil {
450				return "", "", false
451			}
452			organization = strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")
453			project, repo = segments[len(segments)-3], segments[len(segments)-1]
454		default:
455			return "", "", false
456		}
457		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
458		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
459			return "", "", false
460		}
461		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
462		webURL := azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo)
463		return identity, webURL, true
464	}
465	
466	func parseAzureDevOpsSSH(user, host string, segments []string) (string, string, bool) {
467		var organization, project, repo string
468		switch {
469		case host == "ssh.dev.azure.com" && strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && len(segments) == 4 && strings.EqualFold(segments[0], "v3"):
470			organization, project, repo = segments[1], segments[2], segments[3]
471			host = "dev.azure.com"
472		case host == "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com" && len(segments) == 3 && strings.EqualFold(segments[1], "_ssh"):
473			organization, project, repo = user, segments[0], segments[2]
474			host = strings.ToLower(organization) + ".visualstudio.com"
475		default:
476			return "", "", false
477		}
478		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
479		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
480			return "", "", false
481		}
482		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
483		return identity, azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo), true
484	}
485	
486	func azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo string) string {
487		if host == "dev.azure.com" {
488			return "https://dev.azure.com/" + url.PathEscape(organization) + "/" + url.PathEscape(project) + "/_git/" + url.PathEscape(repo)
489		}
490		return "https://" + host + "/" + url.PathEscape(project) + "/_git/" + url.PathEscape(repo)
491	}
492	
493	func escapedSegments(path string) []string {
494		return decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(path, "/"), "/"))
495	}
496	
497	func decodeSegments(segments []string) []string {
498		if len(segments) == 1 && segments[0] == "" {
499			return nil
500		}
501		out := make([]string, 0, len(segments))
502		for _, segment := range segments {
503			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(segment)
504			if err != nil || decoded == "" || strings.Contains(decoded, "/") {
505				return nil
506			}
507			out = append(out, decoded)
508		}
509		return out
510	}

159		}
160		model := flowtui.New(actions, launch.preselected).WithContext(runCtx)
161		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
162		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
163		final, err := runProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen())
164		cancelRun()

178		}

182	func honorFlowHandoff(app *App, resolver flowRuntimeResolver, handoff taskflow.Handoff) error {

194			if resolver != nil {
195				resolved, err := resolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
196				if err != nil {

198				}
199				if resolved != nil && resolved.Name() == handoff.Runtime {
200					rt = resolved
201				}
202			}
203			if rt == nil {
204				rt = app.runtimeNamed(handoff.Runtime)
205			}
206			if rt == nil || rt.Name() != handoff.Runtime {
207				return fmt.Errorf("flow handoff backend %q is unavailable", handoff.Runtime)
208			}
209			return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
210		case taskflow.HandoffURL:
211			if handoff.URL == "" {
212				return errors.New("flow returned an empty URL handoff")
213			}
214			_, err := fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, handoff.URL)
215			return err
216		default:
217			return fmt.Errorf("flow returned unsupported handoff kind %q", handoff.Kind)
218		}
219	}
220	
221	type flowRuntimeResolver interface {
222		Resolve(context.Context) (runtime.Runtime, error)
223	}
224	
225	type flowRepository struct {
226		row              flowtui.RepositoryRow
227		repository       repo.Repo
228		available        bool
229		unavailableTasks []task.Record
230	}
231	
232	func availableFlowRepository(discovered gitx.Repo, preferred *repo.Repo, focus string) (flowRepository, error) {
233		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(discovered.GitCommonDir)
234		if err != nil {
235			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository identity: %w", err)
236		}
237		mainRoot := discovered.MainRoot
238		if mainRoot == "" && discovered.Bare {
239			mainRoot = discovered.GitCommonDir
240		}
241		mainRoot, err = pathx.Canonical(mainRoot)
242		if err != nil {
243			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository root: %w", err)
244		}
245		focusTarget := ""
246		if focus != "" {
247			focusTarget, err = pathx.Canonical(focus)
248			if err != nil {
249				return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow focus: %w", err)
250			}
251		}
252	
253		r := repo.Repo{
254			Name: discovered.Name, Path: mainRoot, RealPath: mainRoot,
255			CommonDir: commonDir, MainRoot: mainRoot, Bare: discovered.Bare, HasGit: true,
256		}
257		name := discovered.Name
258		if preferred != nil {
259			if preferred.Name != "" {
260				r.Name = preferred.Name
261			}
262			r.Root = preferred.Root
263			r.Category = preferred.Category
264			name = preferred.Display()
265			if name == "" {
266				name = r.Name
267			}
268		}
269		return flowRepository{
270			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
271				RepoKey: commonDir, Name: name, Path: mainRoot, Available: true,
272				FocusTarget: focusTarget,
273			},
274			repository: r,
275			available:  true,
276		}, nil
277	}
278	
279	func unavailableFlowRepository(record task.Record, cause error) flowRepository {
280		path := record.Task.RepoPath
281		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
282			path = canonical
283		} else if absolute, absErr := filepath.Abs(path); absErr == nil {
284			path = filepath.Clean(absolute)
285		}
286		name := record.Task.Repo
287		if name == "" {
288			name = filepath.Base(path)
289		}
290		message := "repository is unavailable"
291		if cause != nil {
292			message += ": " + cause.Error()
293		}
294		return flowRepository{
295			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
296				RepoKey: "unavailable:" + path, Name: name, Path: path,
297				Available: false, Error: message,
298			},
299			available:        false,
300			unavailableTasks: []task.Record{record},
301		}
302	}

304	type flowTarget struct {
305		repoKey  string
306		rowKey   string
307		actionID string
308		request  taskflow.Request
309	}

316	type flowLoader struct {
317		app      *App
318		runtime  flowRuntimeResolver
319		limiter  *inventory.Limiter
320		cwd      string
321		now      func() time.Time
322		discover func(context.Context, string) (gitx.Repo, error)
323		listRepo func(context.Context, []string, repo.Options) ([]repo.Repo, error)
324		inspect  func(context.Context, *artifact.Store, string) (artifact.ReadinessInspection, error)
325		base     func(context.Context, string) string
326		service  func(runtime.Runtime) (*taskflow.Service, error)
327	
328		mu           sync.Mutex
329		repositories map[string]flowRepository
330		pinned       map[string]bool
331		targets      map[string]map[string]flowTarget
332		approved     map[string]flowApprovedPlan
333		remote       map[string]taskflow.RemoteObservation
334	}
335	
336	func newFlowLoader(app *App, resolver flowRuntimeResolver, cwd string) *flowLoader {
337		loader := &flowLoader{
338			app:          app,
339			runtime:      resolver,
340			limiter:      inventory.NewLimiter(8),
341			cwd:          cwd,
342			now:          time.Now,
343			discover:     gitx.Discover,
344			listRepo:     repo.Discover,
345			inspect:      artifact.InspectReadiness,
346			base:         gitx.DefaultBranch,
347			repositories: make(map[string]flowRepository),
348			pinned:       make(map[string]bool),
349			targets:      make(map[string]map[string]flowTarget),
350			approved:     make(map[string]flowApprovedPlan),
351			remote:       make(map[string]taskflow.RemoteObservation),
352		}
353		loader.service = func(rt runtime.Runtime) (*taskflow.Service, error) {
354			return newFlowLifecycleService(app, rt, cwd)
355		}
356		return loader
357	}
358	
359	func newFlowLifecycleService(app *App, resolved runtime.Runtime, cwd string) (*taskflow.Service, error) {
360		if resolved == nil {
361			return nil, errors.New("flow runtime resolver returned no backend")
362		}
363		return taskflow.NewLifecycleService(taskflow.LifecycleConfig{
364			Config: app.Cfg, Tasks: app.Tasks, Artifacts: artifactStore(app),
365			DefaultRuntime: func() runtime.Runtime { return resolved },
366			NamedRuntime: func(name string) runtime.Runtime {
367				if name == "" || name == resolved.Name() {
368					return resolved
369				}
370				return app.runtimeNamed(name)
371			},
372			Host: config.Hostname(), CWD: cwd,
373			// The flow preview deliberately never inherits the expert shared-writer
374			// override. Its normal choices must remain fail-closed.
375			AllowSharedCheckout: false,
376			Logf: func(format string, args ...any) {
377				if app.Err != nil {
378					fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, format+"\n", args...)
379				}
380			},
381		})
382	}
383	
384	func (l *flowLoader) registerRepository(repository flowRepository, pinned bool) {
385		l.mu.Lock()
386		defer l.mu.Unlock()
387		l.repositories[repository.row.RepoKey] = repository
388		if pinned {
389			l.pinned[repository.row.RepoKey] = true
390		}
391	}
392	
393	func (l *flowLoader) actions() flowtui.Actions {
394		return flowtui.Actions{
395			ListRepositories: l.ListRepositories,
396			LoadRepository:   l.LoadRepository,
397			Plan:             l.Plan,
398			Apply:            l.Apply,
399		}
400	}
401	
402	func (l *flowLoader) ListRepositories(ctx context.Context) ([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, error) {
403		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
404			return nil, err
405		}
406		records, _, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
407		if taskErr != nil {
408			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list task-referenced repositories: %w", taskErr)
409		}
410		discovered, err := l.listRepo(ctx, l.app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
411		if err != nil {
412			return nil, err
413		}
414	
415		fresh := make(map[string]flowRepository)
416		l.mu.Lock()
417		for key := range l.pinned {
418			if existing, ok := l.repositories[key]; ok {
419				fresh[key] = existing
420			}
421		}
422		l.mu.Unlock()
423	
424		for index := range discovered {
425			candidate := discovered[index]
426			gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, candidate.Path)
427			if discoverErr != nil {
428				continue
429			}
430			entry, convertErr := availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, &candidate, "")
431			if convertErr != nil {
432				continue
433			}
434			if _, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
435				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
436			}
437		}
438	
439		pathResults := make(map[string]struct {
440			repository flowRepository
441			err        error
442		})
443		for _, record := range records {
444			path := record.Task.RepoPath
445			resolved, seen := pathResults[path]
446			if !seen {
447				gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, path)
448				if discoverErr == nil {
449					resolved.repository, discoverErr = availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, nil, "")
450				}
451				resolved.err = discoverErr
452				pathResults[path] = resolved
453			}
454			if resolved.err == nil {
455				if _, exists := fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
456					fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey] = resolved.repository
457				}
458				continue
459			}
460			entry := unavailableFlowRepository(record, resolved.err)
461			if existing, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; exists {
462				existing.unavailableTasks = appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(existing.unavailableTasks, record)
463				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = existing
464			} else {
465				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
466			}
467		}
468	
469		rows := make([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, 0, len(fresh))
470		for _, entry := range fresh {
471			rows = append(rows, entry.row)
472		}
473		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
474			left, right := strings.ToLower(rows[i].Name), strings.ToLower(rows[j].Name)
475			if left != right {
476				return left < right
477			}
478			if rows[i].Path != rows[j].Path {
479				return rows[i].Path < rows[j].Path
480			}
481			return rows[i].RepoKey < rows[j].RepoKey
482		})
483		l.mu.Lock()
484		l.repositories = fresh
485		l.mu.Unlock()
486		return rows, nil
487	}
488	
489	func appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(records []task.Record, candidate task.Record) []task.Record {
490		for _, record := range records {
491			if record.Task.ID == candidate.Task.ID {
492				return records
493			}
494		}
495		return append(records, candidate)
496	}
497	
498	func (l *flowLoader) LoadRepository(ctx context.Context, repoKey string) (flowtui.Snapshot, error) {
499		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
500			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
501		}
502		l.mu.Lock()
503		selected, ok := l.repositories[repoKey]
504		l.mu.Unlock()
505		if !ok {
506			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is not in the current flow inventory", repoKey)
507		}
508		if !selected.available {
509			return l.unavailableSnapshot(selected), nil
510		}
511	
512		records, diagnostics, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
513		selectedTasks := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(records))
514		for index := range records {
515			record := records[index]
516			resolved, err := l.discover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
517			if err != nil {
518				continue
519			}
520			commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(resolved.GitCommonDir)
521			if err != nil || commonDir != repoKey {
522				continue
523			}
524			copy := record.Task
525			copy.Tags = append([]string(nil), record.Task.Tags...)
526			selectedTasks = append(selectedTasks, &copy)
527		}
528	
529		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
530		if err != nil {
531			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
532		}
533		if rt == nil {
534			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, errors.New("flow runtime resolver returned no backend")
535		}
536		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
537		runtimeObserved := runtimeErr == nil && rt.Name() != "none"
538		contextSnapshot := inventory.CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, selected.repository, selectedTasks, inventory.RepoContextOptions{
539			Runtime: rt.Name(), Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: runtimeObserved,
540			RuntimeErr: runtimeErr, Limiter: l.limiter,
541		})
542		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
543			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
544		}
545	
546		service, serviceErr := l.service(rt)
547		base := ""
548		if queryPath := flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot); queryPath != "" {
549			base = l.base(ctx, queryPath)
550		}
551		taskComplete := taskErr == nil && len(diagnostics) == 0
552		rows, targets, projectionIssues := l.projectRows(ctx, contextSnapshot, service, serviceErr, taskComplete, base)
553	
554		issues := make([]string, 0, 8)
555		if taskErr != nil {
556			issues = append(issues, "task inventory: "+taskErr.Error())
557		}
558		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
559			issues = append(issues, "task diagnostic: "+diagnostic.Error())
560		}
561		if contextSnapshot.IdentityErr != nil {
562			issues = append(issues, "repository identity: "+contextSnapshot.IdentityErr.Error())
563		}
564		if contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr != nil {
565			issues = append(issues, "worktree inventory: "+contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr.Error())
566		}
567		if rt.Name() != "none" && runtimeErr != nil {
568			issues = append(issues, "runtime observation: "+runtimeErr.Error())
569		}
570		for _, checkout := range contextSnapshot.Checkouts {
571			if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
572				issues = append(issues, "Git status "+checkout.Worktree.Path+": "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
573			}
574		}
575		issues = append(issues, projectionIssues...)
576		issues = uniqueStrings(issues)
577	
578		freshness := flowtui.FreshnessFresh
579		if len(issues) > 0 {
580			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
581		}
582		repositoryRow := selected.row
583		repositoryRow.Available = contextSnapshot.RepositoryID == repoKey && contextSnapshot.IdentityErr == nil
584		if contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != "" && contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != repoKey {
585			issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("repository identity changed from %s to %s", repoKey, contextSnapshot.RepositoryID))
586			repositoryRow.Available = false
587			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
588		}
589		snapshot := flowtui.Snapshot{
590			Repository: repositoryRow,
591			Surfaces:   flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
592			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(),
593			Freshness:  freshness,
594			Error:      strings.Join(uniqueStrings(issues), "; "),
595		}
596		l.mu.Lock()
597		l.targets[repoKey] = targets
598		if remote, exists := l.remote[repoKey]; exists {
599			snapshot.Remote = flowtui.SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
600		}
601		l.mu.Unlock()
602		return snapshot, nil
603	}
604	
605	func (l *flowLoader) unavailableSnapshot(selected flowRepository) flowtui.Snapshot {
606		rows := make([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, 0, len(selected.unavailableTasks))
607		for _, record := range selected.unavailableTasks {
608			tracked := record.Task
609			rows = append(rows, flowtui.SurfaceRow{
610				RowKey: tracked.ID, Kind: flowtui.SurfaceTaskOnly,
611				Label: tracked.Title(), Branch: tracked.Branch, Base: tracked.Base,
612				Mode: tracked.EffectiveMode(), State: tracked.State,
613				Drift: flowtui.NewLines("repository-unavailable: " + selected.row.Error),
614				Evidence: flowtui.NewLines(
615					"recorded repository path: "+tracked.RepoPath,
616					fmt.Sprintf("task: %s mode=%s state=%s", tracked.ID, tracked.EffectiveMode(), tracked.State),
617				),
618			})
619		}
620		l.mu.Lock()
621		l.targets[selected.row.RepoKey] = map[string]flowTarget{}
622		l.mu.Unlock()
623		return flowtui.Snapshot{
624			Repository: selected.row, Surfaces: flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
625			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(), Freshness: flowtui.FreshnessStale,
626			Error: selected.row.Error,
627		}
628	}
629	
630	func flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext) string {
631		if main, ok := contextSnapshot.Main(); ok && main.Worktree.Path != "" {
632			return main.Worktree.Path
633		}
634		for _, candidate := range []string{
635			contextSnapshot.Repo.MainRoot,
636			contextSnapshot.Repo.Path,
637			contextSnapshot.Repo.RealPath,
638			contextSnapshot.Repo.CommonDir,
639		} {
640			if candidate != "" {
641				return candidate
642			}
643		}
644		return ""
645	}
646	
647	func (l *flowLoader) projectRows(
648		ctx context.Context,
649		contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext,
650		service *taskflow.Service,
651		serviceErr error,
652		taskInventoryComplete bool,
653		defaultBase string,
654	) ([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, map[string]flowTarget, []string) {
655		rows := make([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, 0, len(contextSnapshot.Rows))
656		targets := make(map[string]flowTarget)
657		var issues []string
658		for _, contextRow := range contextSnapshot.Rows {
659			projected, rowIssues := l.projectRow(ctx, contextSnapshot, contextRow, service, serviceErr, taskInventoryComplete, defaultBase)
660			issues = append(issues, rowIssues...)
661	
662			validChoices := make([]flowtui.ActionChoice, 0, projected.Actions.Len())
663			for _, choice := range projected.Actions.Values() {
664				request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(projected.Locator, choice.Options())
665				if err != nil {
666					issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("row %s action %s: %v", projected.RowKey, choice.ID, err))
667					continue
668				}
669				target := flowTarget{
670					repoKey: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID, rowKey: projected.RowKey,
671					actionID: choice.ID, request: request,
672				}
673				targets[flowTargetKey(target.repoKey, target.rowKey, target.actionID)] = target
674				validChoices = append(validChoices, choice)
675			}
676			projected.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(validChoices...)
677			rows = append(rows, projected)
678		}
679		return rows, targets, issues
680	}
681	
682	func (l *flowLoader) projectRow(
683		ctx context.Context,
684		contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext,
685		contextRow inventory.RepoContextRow,
686		service *taskflow.Service,
687		serviceErr error,
688		taskInventoryComplete bool,
689		defaultBase string,
690	) (flowtui.SurfaceRow, []string) {
691		drift := topologyReasonLines(contextRow.DriftReasons)
692		conflicts := topologyReasonLines(contextRow.ConflictReasons)
693		var issues []string
694		var tracked *task.Task
695		if contextRow.TaskOnly() {
696			tracked = contextRow.Task
697		} else if contextRow.Checkout != nil && len(contextRow.Checkout.TaskBindings) == 1 {
698			tracked = contextRow.Checkout.TaskBindings[0].Task
699		}
700	
701		var managedLocator taskflow.Locator
702		managedExact := false
703		if tracked != nil {
704			if serviceErr != nil {
705				conflicts = append(conflicts, "locator-error: "+serviceErr.Error())
706				issues = append(issues, "managed locator "+tracked.ID+": "+serviceErr.Error())
707			} else if service != nil {
708				locator, err := service.LocateTask(ctx, tracked.ID)
709				if err != nil {
710					conflicts = append(conflicts, "locator-error: "+err.Error())
711					issues = append(issues, "managed locator "+tracked.ID+": "+err.Error())
712				} else if err := validateProjectedManagedLocator(contextSnapshot, contextRow, tracked, locator); err != nil {
713					conflicts = append(conflicts, "locator-mismatch: "+err.Error())
714					issues = append(issues, "managed locator "+tracked.ID+": "+err.Error())
715				} else {
716					managedLocator, managedExact = locator, true
717				}
718			}
719		}
720	
721		row := flowtui.SurfaceRow{
722			RowKey: contextRow.ID,
723			Kind:   flowtui.SurfaceTaskOnly,
724			Drift:  flowtui.NewLines(uniqueStrings(drift)...),
725			Base:   defaultBase,
726		}
727		if tracked != nil {
728			row.Label = tracked.Title()
729			row.Branch = tracked.Branch
730			row.Base = tracked.Base
731			row.Mode = tracked.EffectiveMode()
732			row.State = tracked.State
733			row.Locator = managedLocator
734		}
735	
736		if contextRow.Checkout != nil {
737			checkout := contextRow.Checkout
738			row.Path = checkout.ID
739			row.Branch = checkout.Branch()
740			row.Kind = classifyFlowCheckout(*checkout, tracked, managedExact, conflicts)
741			row.Label = flowCheckoutLabel(*checkout, tracked, row.Kind)
742			exactGitLocator := flowGitLocator(contextSnapshot, *checkout, defaultBase)
743			if !managedExact {
744				row.Locator = exactGitLocator
745			}
746			row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(flowCheckoutEvidence(contextSnapshot, *checkout)...)
747			if checkout.Exists && !checkout.Worktree.Bare && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
748				inspection, err := l.inspect(ctx, artifactStore(l.app), checkout.Worktree.Path)
749				row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(append(row.Evidence.Values(), artifactSummary(inspection, err))...)
750				if err != nil {
751					issues = append(issues, "artifact observation "+checkout.Worktree.Path+": "+err.Error())
752				}
753			}
754		} else if tracked != nil {
755			evidence := append([]string{
756				"repository path: " + tracked.RepoPath,
757				"checkout: no registered checkout is bound to this task",
758			}, flowTaskEvidence(tracked)...)
759			evidence = append(evidence, flowTaskOnlyRuntimeEvidence(contextSnapshot)...)
760			if tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
761				evidence = append(evidence, "recorded checkout: "+tracked.WorktreePath)
762			}
763			row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(evidence...)
764		}
765		if tracked != nil && contextRow.Checkout != nil {
766			row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(append(row.Evidence.Values(), flowTaskEvidence(tracked)...)...)
767		}
768	
769		conflicts = uniqueStrings(conflicts)
770		row.Conflicts = flowtui.NewLines(conflicts...)
771		if managedExact && len(conflicts) == 0 {
772			row.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(managedFlowChoices(*tracked)...)
773		} else if row.Kind == flowtui.SurfaceUnmanaged && taskInventoryComplete && exactFlowLocator(row.Locator) {
774			row.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(unmanagedFlowChoices(defaultBase)...)
775		}
776		if exactFlowRemoteLocator(row.Locator) {
777			choices := append(row.Actions.Values(), remoteFlowChoices()...)
778			row.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(choices...)
779		}
780		return row, issues
781	}
782	
783	func validateProjectedManagedLocator(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, row inventory.RepoContextRow, tracked *task.Task, locator taskflow.Locator) error {
784		if locator.RepoKey != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID || locator.RepositoryID != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID ||
785			locator.GitCommonDir != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID {
786			return errors.New("locator repository identity differs from inventory")
787		}
788		if locator.TaskID != tracked.ID || locator.Mode != tracked.EffectiveMode() || locator.State != tracked.State {
789			return errors.New("locator task identity, mode, or state differs from inventory")
790		}
791		if row.Checkout != nil && locator.CheckoutPath != row.Checkout.ID {
792			return fmt.Errorf("locator checkout %q differs from row %q", locator.CheckoutPath, row.Checkout.ID)
793		}
794		return nil
795	}
796	
797	func classifyFlowCheckout(checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, tracked *task.Task, managedExact bool, conflicts []string) flowtui.SurfaceKind {

852	func flowCheckoutEvidence(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) []string {
853		branch := checkout.Branch()
854		if branch == "" {
855			branch = "(detached)"
856		}
857		lines := []string{
858			"path: " + checkout.Worktree.Path,
859			"branch: " + branch,
860			fmt.Sprintf("registered: Main=%t locked=%t prunable=%t bare=%t detached=%t HEAD=%s",
861				checkout.Worktree.Main, checkout.Worktree.Locked, checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
862				checkout.Worktree.Bare, checkout.Worktree.Detached, emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.Head)),
863		}
864		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
865			lines = append(lines, "registered lock reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason))
866		}
867		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
868			lines = append(lines, "registered prunable reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason))
869		}
870		switch {
871		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
872			lines = append(lines, "git: ERROR "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
873		case checkout.Worktree.Bare:
874			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (bare repository)")
875		case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
876			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (checkout unavailable)")
877		default:
878			cleanliness := "clean"
879			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
880				cleanliness = "dirty — " + checkout.Status.Breakdown()
881			}
882			lines = append(lines,
883				"git: "+cleanliness,
884				"upstream: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Status.Upstream),
885				fmt.Sprintf("ahead=%d behind=%d conflicted=%d", checkout.Status.Ahead, checkout.Status.Behind, checkout.Status.Conflicted),
886			)
887		}
888	
889		observation := checkout.RuntimeObservation
890		if observation.State == "" {
891			observation = contextSnapshot.RuntimeObservation
892		}
893		switch observation.State {
894		case inventory.ObservationAvailable:
895			if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
896				lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": observed; no covering sessions")
897			} else {
898				lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": observed")
899				for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
900					status := session.AgentStatus
901					if status == "" {
902						status = "unknown"
903					}
904					line := fmt.Sprintf("runtime session: %s:%s agent-state=%s", contextSnapshot.Runtime, emptyEvidence(session.Handle), status)
905					if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
906						line += " agents=" + strings.Join(session.AgentSessions, ",")
907					}
908					lines = append(lines, line)
909					for _, pane := range session.Panes {
910						if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" && pane.AgentStatus == "" {
911							continue
912						}
913						paneStatus := pane.AgentStatus
914						if paneStatus == "" {
915							paneStatus = "unknown"
916						}
917						lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("runtime agent pane: %s agent=%s state=%s session=%s",
918							emptyEvidence(pane.ID), emptyEvidence(pane.Agent), paneStatus, emptyEvidence(pane.AgentSession)))
919					}
920				}
921			}
922		case inventory.ObservationFailed:
923			message := "runtime observation failed"
924			if observation.Err != nil {
925				message += ": " + observation.Err.Error()
926			}
927			lines = append(lines, message)
928		default:
929			lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": unobserved; state is not known closed")
930		}
931		return lines
932	}

974	func artifactSummary(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection, err error) string {
975		if err != nil {
976			return "artifact: ERROR " + err.Error()
977		}
978		if inspection.KnownEmpty && len(inspection.Intents) == 0 {
979			return "artifact: ready; no intents"
980		}
981		counts := make(map[artifact.ReadinessState]int)
982		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
983			counts[intent.State]++
984		}
985		states := make([]string, 0, len(counts))
986		for state, count := range counts {
987			states = append(states, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%d", state, count))
988		}
989		sort.Strings(states)
990		readiness := "blocked or unknown"
991		if inspection.Ready() {
992			readiness = "ready"
993		}
994		if len(states) == 0 {
995			states = append(states, "no classified intents")
996		}
997		return "artifact: " + readiness + "; " + strings.Join(states, ", ")
998	}

1054	func (l *flowLoader) Plan(
1055		ctx context.Context,
1056		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1057		locator taskflow.Locator,
1058		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1059	) (taskflow.Plan, error) {
1060		expected, request, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1061		if err != nil {
1062			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1063		}
1064		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1065		if err != nil {
1066			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1067		}
1068		service, err := l.service(rt)
1069		if err != nil {
1070			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1071		}
1072		plan, err := service.Plan(ctx, request)
1073		if err != nil {
1074			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1075		}
1076		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1077			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1078		}
1079		l.mu.Lock()
1080		l.approved[plan.PlanID] = flowApprovedPlan{target: expected, plan: plan.Clone()}
1081		l.mu.Unlock()
1082		return plan, nil
1083	}
1084	
1085	func (l *flowLoader) Apply(
1086		ctx context.Context,
1087		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1088		locator taskflow.Locator,
1089		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1090		plan taskflow.Plan,
1091		approval taskflow.Approval,
1092	) (taskflow.Result, error) {
1093		expected, _, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1094		if err != nil {
1095			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1096		}
1097		l.mu.Lock()
1098		approved, ok := l.approved[plan.PlanID]
1099		l.mu.Unlock()
1100		if !ok {
1101			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply rejected a plan not produced by this run")
1102		}
1103		if !sameFlowTarget(approved.target, expected) {
1104			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply target differs from the approved repository, row, action, locator, or options")
1105		}
1106		if !reflect.DeepEqual(approved.plan.Clone(), plan.Clone()) {
1107			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply plan differs from the exact approved plan")
1108		}
1109		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1110			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1111		}
1112		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1113		if err != nil {
1114			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1115		}
1116		service, err := l.service(rt)
1117		if err != nil {
1118			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1119		}
1120		result, applyErr := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
1121		l.mu.Lock()
1122		delete(l.approved, plan.PlanID)
1123		if remote, exists := result.RemoteObservation(); exists {
1124			l.remote[repoKey] = remote.Clone()
1125		}
1126		l.mu.Unlock()
1127		return result, applyErr
1128	}
1129	
1130	func (l *flowLoader) validateTarget(
1131		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1132		locator taskflow.Locator,
1133		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1134	) (flowTarget, taskflow.Request, error) {
1135		request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(locator, options)
1136		if err != nil {
1137			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, err
1138		}
1139		key := flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID)
1140		l.mu.Lock()
1141		expected, ok := l.targets[repoKey][key]
1142		l.mu.Unlock()
1143		if !ok {
1144			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action no longer matches the current repository snapshot")
1145		}
1146		actual := flowTarget{repoKey: repoKey, rowKey: rowKey, actionID: actionID, request: request}
1147		if !sameFlowTarget(expected, actual) {
1148			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action locator or options differ from the current exact row choice")
1149		}
1150		return expected, request, nil
1151	}
1152	
1153	func validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan taskflow.Plan, expected flowTarget) error {
1154		if err := plan.Validate(); err != nil {
1155			return err
1156		}
1157		if plan.Locator != expected.request.Locator || plan.Request.Locator != expected.request.Locator ||
1158			plan.Action != expected.request.Action || plan.Request.Action != expected.request.Action ||
1159			!reflect.DeepEqual(plan.Request.Options, expected.request.Options) {
1160			return errors.New("taskflow plan does not match the exact flow request identity")
1161		}
1162		return nil
1163	}
1164	
1165	func sameFlowTarget(left, right flowTarget) bool {
1166		return left.repoKey == right.repoKey && left.rowKey == right.rowKey && left.actionID == right.actionID &&
1167			left.request.Locator == right.request.Locator && left.request.Action == right.request.Action &&
1168			reflect.DeepEqual(left.request.Options, right.request.Options)
1169	}
1170	
1171	func flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID string) string {
1172		return repoKey + "\x00" + rowKey + "\x00" + actionID
1173	}
1174	
1175	func contextError(ctx context.Context) error {
1176		if ctx == nil {
1177			return errors.New("flow operation needs a context")
1178		}
1179		return ctx.Err()
1180	}
1181	
1182	func emptyEvidence(value string) string {
1183		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
1184			return "(none)"
1185		}
1186		return value
1187	}
1188	
1189	func uniqueStrings(values []string) []string {
1190		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(values))
1191		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
1192		for _, value := range values {
1193			if value == "" || seen[value] {
1194				continue
1195			}
1196			seen[value] = true
1197			out = append(out, value)
1198		}
1199		return out
1200	}
