199	func runTUI(app *App) error {
200		app.traceTUI = true
201		runCtx, cancelRun := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
202		defer cancelRun()
203		finishSetup := app.trace.Start(perftrace.TUISetup, perftrace.Fields{})
204		// --color, NO_COLOR and TERM=dumb governed every other surface but stopped
205		// at the dashboard, which resolved its own palette independently.
206		tui.SetColorEnabled(app.outStyle().enabled)
207		appState := newTUIAppState(app)
208		runtimeResolver := newTUIRuntimeResolver(app)
209		projectRootResolver := newTUIProjectRootResolver(app.trace, runCtx)
210		localLoader := newTUILocalLoader(app, runtimeResolver)
211		localLoader.current = appState.Current
212	
213		reload := func(ctx context.Context) ([]inventory.Row, error) {
214			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
215			if err != nil {
216				return nil, err
217			}
218			tasks, err := appState.Current().Tasks.List()
219			if err != nil {
220				return nil, err
221			}
222			return inventory.Collect(ctx, tasks, rt, inventory.Options{}), nil
223		}
224		reloadRepos := func(ctx context.Context) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
225			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
226			if err != nil {
227				return nil, err
228			}
229			// Keep Try repositories in the model's local snapshot so cached REMOTE
230			// rows can be matched and cleared correctly. The REPOS view filters them.
231			return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, appState.Current(), rt, repoCollectOptions{IncludeTries: true})
232		}
233		reloadRemote := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
234			return collectRemotesForRows(ctx, appState.Current(), locals)
235		}
236		reloadFleet := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.FleetRow, error) {
237			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
238			if err != nil {
239				return nil, err
240			}
241			snapshot := fleetSnapshotFromRepoRows(locals, rt.Name())
242			results, _, err := collectFleet(ctx, appState.Current(), fleetCollectOptions{LocalSnapshot: &snapshot})
243			return fleetRows(results), err
244		}
245		reloadSkills := func(ctx context.Context) ([]agentskill.Skill, error) {
246			projectRoot, err := projectRootResolver.Resolve(ctx)
247			if err != nil {
248				return nil, err
249			}
250			return agentskill.List(ctx, projectRoot, agentskill.ListOptions{})
251		}
252		reloadTries := func(ctx context.Context, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
253			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
254			if err != nil {
255				return nil, err
256			}
257			return collectTries(ctx, appState.Current(), rt, includeAll)
258		}
259		openResolved := func(ctx context.Context, dir, label, statusLabel string) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
260			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
261			if err != nil {
262				return tui.OpenResult{}, err
263			}
264			handle, err := openCheckout(ctx, rt, dir, label)
265			if err != nil {
266				return tui.OpenResult{}, err
267			}
268			if rt.Name() == "none" {
269				return tui.OpenResult{Directory: dir}, nil
270			}
271			if statusLabel == "" {
272				statusLabel = label
273			}
274			return tui.OpenResult{
275				Status:        fmt.Sprintf("%s open in %s (%s)", statusLabel, rt.Name(), handle.Handle),
276				RuntimeHandle: handle.Handle,
277			}, nil
278		}
279	
280		actions := tui.Actions{
281			Reload:                reload,
282			ReloadRepos:           reloadRepos,
283			ReloadRemoteWithRepos: reloadRemote,
284			ReloadFleetWithRepos:  reloadFleet,
285			ReloadSkills:          reloadSkills,
286			LoadRemoteCache: func(context.Context) tui.RemoteCacheResult {
287				rows, found, stale := cachedRemoteRows(appState.Current())
288				return tui.RemoteCacheResult{Rows: rows, Found: found, Stale: stale}
289			},
290			LoadFleetCache: func(context.Context) tui.FleetCacheResult {
291				rows := cachedFleetRows(appState.Current())
292				return tui.FleetCacheResult{Rows: rows, Found: len(rows) > 0}
293			},
294			AfterFirstView: func(context.Context) {
295				if app.deferredReleaseRefresh {
296					app.refreshReleaseDetached()
297				}
298			},
299			CheckSkills: func(ctx context.Context, rows []agentskill.Skill) []agentskill.Skill {
300				return agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, rows)
301			},
302			AddSkill: func() (*exec.Cmd, error) {
303				projectRoot, ok := projectRootResolver.Current()
304				if !ok {
305					return nil, errors.New("project root is still loading")
306				}
307				return agentskill.AddCommand(context.Background(), projectRoot, agentskill.DefaultSource)
308			},
309			UpdateSkill: func(row agentskill.Skill) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
310				projectRoot, ok := projectRootResolver.Current()
311				if !ok {
312					return nil, errors.New("project root is still loading")
313				}
314				return agentskill.UpdateCommand(context.Background(), projectRoot, row.Name, row.Scope)
315			},
316			Repos: tui.RepoActions{
317				Patch: func(ctx context.Context, row tui.RepoRow, tags []string, note string) (string, error) {
318					active := appState.Current()
319					remove := []string(nil)
320					if row.Asset != nil {
321						remove = append(remove, row.Asset.Tags...)
322					}
323					marked, err := patchRepositoryCatalog(ctx, active, row.Repo, tags, remove, &note)
324					if err != nil {
325						return "", err
326					}
327					return "updated metadata for " + marked.Title(), nil
328				},
329			},
330			Tries: tui.TryActions{
331				Reload: reloadTries,
332				Apply: func(ctx context.Context, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
333					rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
334					if err != nil {
335						return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
336					}
337					return applyTryAction(ctx, appState.Current(), rt, request)
338				},
339			},
340			Notes: tui.NoteActions{
341				List: func(ctx context.Context, target tui.NoteTarget) ([]*note.Note, error) {
342					active := appState.Current()
343					entry, _, err := ensureNoteRepository(ctx, active, target)
344					if err != nil {
345						return nil, err
346					}
347					return active.Notes.List(entry.ID)
348				},
349				Search: func(ctx context.Context, target tui.NoteTarget, query string) ([]*note.Note, error) {
350					active := appState.Current()
351					entry, _, err := ensureNoteRepository(ctx, active, target)
352					if err != nil {
353						return nil, err
354					}
355					return active.Notes.Search(query, entry.ID, 100)
356				},
357				Add: func(ctx context.Context, target tui.NoteTarget, body string) (string, error) {
358					active := appState.Current()
359					entry, _, err := ensureNoteRepository(ctx, active, target)
360					if err != nil {
361						return "", err
362					}
363					n, err := active.Notes.Add(ctx, entry.ID, entry.Title(), body, nil)
364					if err != nil {
365						return "", err
366					}
367					return "added note " + n.ID[:8] + " to " + entry.Title(), nil
368				},
369				Delete: func(ctx context.Context, n *note.Note) (string, error) {
370					if err := appState.Current().Notes.Delete(ctx, n.ID); err != nil {
371						return "", err
372					}
373					return "deleted note " + n.ID[:8], nil
374				},
375				Edit: func(n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {
376					return prepareTUINoteEdit(appState.Current(), n)
377				},
378			},
379			Sizes: tui.SizeActions{
380				Start: func(ctx context.Context, targets []diskusage.Target, force bool) diskusage.Load {
381					return appState.Current().Sizes.Start(ctx, targets, force)
382				},
383				Cancel: func(loadID uint64) { appState.Current().Sizes.Cancel(loadID) },
384			},
385			Local:       tui.LocalActions{Start: localLoader.Start},
386			Tools:       externalTools(app),
387			RepoColumns: app.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
388			RepoSort:    app.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
389			RepoReverse: app.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
390			Copy:        clipboard.WriteAll,
391	
392			// Open is navigation-only. The model rejects missing/unregistered and
393			// cold worktree tasks before this callback so reconciliation and writer
394			// ownership remain explicit `dev sweep` / `dev resume` operations.
395			Open: func(ctx context.Context, t *task.Task) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
396				checkout := checkoutOf(t)
397				if _, err := os.Stat(checkout); err != nil {
398					return tui.OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout — run `dev resume %s`", t.Title(), t.ID)
399				}
400				// Enter is navigation only. Claiming a writer is an explicit
401				// `dev resume`/start action with collision checks.
402				return openResolved(ctx, checkout, t.Title(), "")
403			},
404	
405			OpenRepo: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
406				return openResolved(ctx, r.Repo.Path, r.Repo.Name, "")
407			},
408	
409			OpenCheckout: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
410				branch := checkout.Branch()
411				if branch == "" {
412					branch = filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
413				}
414				label := r.Repo.Name + "/" + branch
415				return openResolved(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, label, "")
416			},
417	
418			OpenRemote: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RemoteRow) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
419				if r.LocalPath == "" {
420					return tui.OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%s has no local checkout; press c to clone it", r.Repo.FullName)
421				}
422				return openResolved(ctx, r.LocalPath, r.Repo.Name, r.Repo.FullName)
423			},
424	
425			OpenFleet: func(ctx context.Context, row tui.FleetRow) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
426				active := appState.Current()
427				if row.Repository == nil {
428					return nil, fmt.Errorf("host %s has no repository selected", row.Host)
429				}
430				executable, err := os.Executable()
431				if err != nil {
432					return nil, err
433				}
434				args := []string{}
435				if active.configPath != "" {
436					args = append(args, "--config", active.configPath)
437				}
438				if active.remotesPath != "" {
439					args = append(args, "--remotes", active.remotesPath)
440				}
441				if row.Local {
442					args = append(args, "repo", "open", row.Repository.Path)
443				} else {
444					args = append(args, "fleet", "open", row.Host, row.Repository.Path)
445				}
446				return exec.CommandContext(ctx, executable, args...), nil
447			},
448	
449			CloneRemote: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RemoteRow) (tui.OpenResult, string, error) {
450				dest, err := tuiRemoteCloneDestination(appState.Current(), r.Repo.Name)
451				if err != nil {
452					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", err
453				}
454				if _, err := os.Stat(dest); err == nil {
455					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", fmt.Errorf("%s already exists; add it to scan_roots or clone somewhere explicit",
456						config.Contract(dest))
457				}
458				if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, filepath.Dir(dest), "clone", r.Repo.CloneURL, dest); err != nil {
459					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", err
460				}
461				opened, err := openResolved(ctx, dest, r.Repo.Name, r.Repo.FullName)
462				if err != nil {
463					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", fmt.Errorf("cloned to %s, but could not open it: %w", config.Contract(dest), err)
464				}
465				if opened.Directory != "" {
466					opened.Status = "cloned " + r.Repo.FullName + " to " + config.Contract(dest)
467				} else {
468					opened.Status = fmt.Sprintf("cloned %s to %s; %s", r.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(dest), opened.Status)
469				}
470				return opened, dest, nil
471			},
472	
473			Park: func(ctx context.Context, selected *task.Task, next string) (string, error) {
474				active := appState.Current()
475				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
476				if err != nil {
477					return "", err
478				}
479				actionApp := *active
480				actionApp.runtimeInstance = rt
481				execution, err := executeTaskLifecycle(ctx, &actionApp, func() (*task.Task, error) {
482					return actionApp.Tasks.Get(selected.ID)
483				}, flow.ParkWarmOptions{Next: next})
484				if err != nil {
485					return "", err
486				}
487				return execution.Task.Title() + " parked warm — worktree and branch kept", nil
488			},
489	
490			SetNext: func(ctx context.Context, selected *task.Task, next string) error {
491				active := appState.Current()
492				current, err := active.Tasks.GetRecord(selected.ID)
493				if err != nil {
494					return err
495				}
496				updated := current.Task
497				updated.Next = next
498				persisted, err := active.Tasks.Update(ctx, &updated, current.Revision)
499				if err != nil {
500					return err
501				}
502				annotate(active, runtimeForTask(active, &persisted.Task), &persisted.Task)
503				return nil
504			},
505	
506			// Start is the bridge from "here are my repositories" to "here is what
507			// I am working on" — the step that otherwise means dropping out of the
508			// dashboard to type a command.
509			Start: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
510				active := appState.Current()
511				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
512				if err != nil {
513					return "", err
514				}
515				actionApp := *active
516				actionApp.runtimeInstance = rt
517				spec, err := buildStartSpecForRepository(ctx, &actionApp, r.Repo, startRequest{
518					Name: name, Mode: task.ModeWorktree,
519				})
520				if err != nil {
521					return "", err
522				}
523				started, err := executeStartSpec(ctx, &actionApp, spec, nil)
524				if err != nil {
525					return "", err
526				}
527				return fmt.Sprintf("started %s on %s", name, started.Task.Branch), nil
528			},
529	
530			StartDirect: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
531				active := appState.Current()
532				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
533				if err != nil {
534					return "", err
535				}
536				if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, active, rt, r.Repo.Path); err != nil {
537					return "", err
538				}
539				st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Repo.Path)
540				if err != nil {
541					return "", err
542				}
543				if st.Detached || st.Branch == "" {
544					return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
545				}
546				id := task.MakeID(r.Repo.Name, st.Branch)
547				if existing, err := active.Tasks.Get(id); err == nil && existing.State != task.Done {
548					return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
549				}
550				handle, err := rt.Open(ctx, r.Repo.Path, r.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
551				if err != nil {
552					return "", err
553				}
554				t := &task.Task{
555					Name: name, Repo: r.Repo.Name, RepoPath: r.Repo.Path,
556					Branch: st.Branch, Base: st.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
557					State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),
558				}
559				setTaskRuntime(t, rt, handle)
560				if err := active.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
561					return "", err
562				}
563				annotate(active, rt, t)
564				return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, st.Branch), nil
565			},
566	
567			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
568				active := appState.Current()
569				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
570				if err != nil {
571					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
572				}
573				defer store.Close()
574				until := time.Now()
575				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
576				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
577					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
578				})
579				if err != nil {
580					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
581				}
582				seconds, days := 0, 0
583				for _, value := range totals {
584					seconds += value
585					if value > 0 {
586						days++
587					}
588				}
589				return tui.StatsPanel{
590					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
591					Since: since, Until: until,
592					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
593						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
594					}),
595				}, nil
596			},
597	
598			BackfillStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) error {
599				active := appState.Current()
600				r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, active.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repoName)
601				if err != nil {
602					return err
603				}
604				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
605				if err != nil {
606					return err
607				}
608				defer store.Close()
609				_, err = stats.BackfillGit(ctx, store, []repo.Repo{r}, time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), "")
610				return err
611			},
612	
613			EditConfig: func() (*exec.Cmd, error) {
614				proc, _, _, err := configEditorProcess(appState.Current(), "")
615				return proc, err
616			},
617	
618			EditFleetConfig: func() (*exec.Cmd, error) {
619				return fleetConfigEditorProcess(appState.Current(), "")
620			},
621	
622			// loadFleetConfig applies defaults and re-runs the private-mode check,
623			// so an edit that loosens remotes.toml's permissions while it holds a
624			// plaintext password is caught here rather than at the next fan-out.
625			ValidateFleetConfig: func() error {
626				_, err := loadFleetConfig(appState.Current())
627				return err
628			},
629	
630			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
631				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
632				if err != nil {
633					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
634				}
635				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
636				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
637				if err != nil {
638					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
639				}
640				status := "config + data reloaded"
641				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
642					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
643				}
644				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
645					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
646					Tools:       externalTools(next),
647					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
648					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
649					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
650				}, status, nil
651			},
652		}
653	
654		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
655		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
656		// while dozens of repos are probed.
657		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
658		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
659		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
660		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
661		cancelRun()
662		app.finishTrace()
663		if err != nil {
664			return err
665		}
666		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
667		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
668		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
669			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
670				return app.cdDirective(dir)
671			}
672			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
673				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
674				if resolveErr != nil {
675					return resolveErr
676				}
677				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
678			}
679		}
680		return nil
681	}

683	func collectTries(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
684		options := experiment.ListOptions{All: includeAll}
685		return collectTriesWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, options, nil, false)
686	}
687	
688	func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,
689		sessions []runtime.Session, sessionsSet bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
690		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
691		if err != nil {
692			return nil, err
693		}
694		items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
695		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
696		if !sessionsSet {
697			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
698		}
699		rows := make([]tui.TryRow, 0, len(items))
700		for _, item := range items {
701			row := tui.TryRow{Item: item}
702			if item.Entry != nil {
703				if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname()); ok {
704					copy := location
705					row.Location = &copy
706				}
707			}
708			sizeRepo := item.Live.Repo
709			if sizeRepo == nil && item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
710				if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); discoverErr == nil {
711					sizeRepo = &discovered
712				}
713			}
714			if sizeRepo != nil {
715				worktreeCount := 0
716				if worktrees, worktreeErr := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); worktreeErr == nil && len(worktrees) > 1 {
717					worktreeCount = len(worktrees) - 1
718				}
719				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(*sizeRepo, worktreeCount)
720			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
721				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(item.Live.CurrentPath)
722			}
723			if item.Live.Present && item.Live.Repo != nil {
724				row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
725			}
726			if item.Live.Present {
727				for _, session := range sessions {
728					if session.Covers(item.Live.CurrentPath) ||
729						(item.Live.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(item.Live.RealPath)) {
730						row.Live = true
731						row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
732						break
733					}
734				}
735			}
736			rows = append(rows, row)
737		}
738		return rows, listErr
739	}
740	
741	func applyTryAction(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
742		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
743		if err != nil {
744			return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
745		}
746		resolve := func() (experiment.Item, error) {
747			item, diagnostics, resolveErr := service.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.ID, experiment.ResolveOptions{
748				IncludeDeprecated: true, IncludeArchived: true,
749				IncludeEvicted: true, IncludeGraduated: true,
750			})
751			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
752			return item, resolveErr
753		}
754		open := func(item experiment.Item, status string) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
755			if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
756				return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("Try %s is not present on this host", item.DisplayName())
757			}
758			handle, openErr := openCheckout(ctx, rt, item.Live.CurrentPath, item.DisplayName())
759			if openErr != nil {
760				return tui.TryActionResult{}, openErr
761			}
762			result := tui.TryActionResult{Status: status, RefreshRepos: true}
763			if rt.Name() == "none" {
764				result.CD = item.Live.CurrentPath
765			} else {
766				result.Status += fmt.Sprintf(" in %s (%s)", rt.Name(), handle.Handle)
767				result.RuntimeHandle = handle.Handle
768			}
769			if _, touchErr := service.Touch(ctx, item.ID); touchErr != nil {
770				return result, fmt.Errorf("%s, but could not record activity: %w", status, touchErr)
771			}
772			return result, nil
773		}
774	
775		switch request.Action {
776		case tui.TryOpen:
777			item, resolveErr := resolve()
778			if resolveErr != nil {
779				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
780			}
781			return open(item, "opened "+item.DisplayName())
782	
783		case tui.TryCreate:
784			created, createErr := service.ResolveOrCreate(ctx, experiment.CreateRequest{
785				Name: request.Name, Clone: request.Clone, NoGit: request.NoGit,
786			})
787			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, created.Diagnostics)
788			if created.InitWarning != nil {
789				app.warnf("could not git init: %v", created.InitWarning)
790			}
791			if createErr != nil {
792				return tui.TryActionResult{}, createErr
793			}
794			status := "created " + created.Item.DisplayName()
795			if created.Existing {
796				status = "opened existing " + created.Item.DisplayName()
797			}
798			result, openErr := open(created.Item, status)
799			result.RefreshRepos = true
800			return result, openErr
801	
802		case tui.TryMark:
803			item, resolveErr := resolve()
804			if resolveErr != nil {
805				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
806			}
807			desired := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.Tags)
808			remove := append([]string(nil), item.Tags...)
809			note := request.Note
810			updated, diagnostics, patchErr := service.Patch(ctx, experiment.PatchRequest{
811				Ref: item.ID, AddTags: desired, RemoveTags: remove, Note: &note,
812			})
813			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
814			return tui.TryActionResult{
815				Status: "updated metadata for " + updated.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
816			}, patchErr
817	
818		case tui.TryDeprecate:
819			transition, transitionErr := service.Deprecate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
820			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
821			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "deprecated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
822	
823		case tui.TryReactivate:
824			transition, transitionErr := service.Reactivate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
825			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
826			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "reactivated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
827	
828		case tui.TryArchive:
829			transition, transitionErr := service.Archive(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
830			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
831			return tui.TryActionResult{
832				Status: "archived " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
833			}, transitionErr
834	
835		case tui.TryRestore:
836			transition, transitionErr := service.Restore(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID, To: request.To})
837			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
838			return tui.TryActionResult{
839				Status: "restored " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
840			}, transitionErr
841	
842		case tui.TryGraduate:
843			graduated, graduateErr := service.Graduate(ctx, experiment.GraduateRequest{
844				Ref: request.ID, Category: request.Category, Name: request.Name,
845			})
846			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, graduated.Diagnostics)
847			if graduateErr != nil {
848				return tui.TryActionResult{}, graduateErr
849			}
850			result, openErr := open(graduated.Item, "graduated "+graduated.Plan.Name)
851			result.RefreshRepos = true
852			return result, openErr
853		}
854		return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown Try action %q", request.Action)
855	}
856	
857	// repoCollectOptions leaves an opt-in path for the future TRY view while the
858	// ordinary repository inventory suppresses active and deprecated Tries.
859	type repoCollectOptions struct {
860		IncludeTries bool
861		Sessions     []runtime.Session
862		SessionsSet  bool
863		Tasks        []*task.Task
864		TasksSet     bool
865		Repos        []repo.Repo
866		ReposSet     bool
867		Limiter      *inventory.Limiter
868	}
869	
870	// collectRepos builds the default repository view: what exists, plus how much
871	// of it is in flight, excluding cataloged active/deprecated Tries.
872	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
873		return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
874	}
875	
876	func collectReposWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
877		repos := options.Repos
878		var err error
879		if !options.ReposSet {
880			repos, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
881			if err != nil {
882				return nil, err
883			}
884		}
885		assets, catalogComplete, err := joinRepoAssets(app, repos)
886		if err != nil {
887			return nil, err
888		}
889		if !options.IncludeTries {
890			visibleRepos := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(repos))
891			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
892			for index, repository := range repos {
893				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
894					continue
895				}
896				visibleRepos = append(visibleRepos, repository)
897				visibleAssets = append(visibleAssets, assets[index])
898			}
899			repos, assets = visibleRepos, visibleAssets
900		}
901		tasks := options.Tasks
902		if !options.TasksSet {
903			tasks, err = app.Tasks.List()
904			if err != nil {
905				return nil, err
906			}
907		}
908		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
909		for _, t := range tasks {
910			byRepo[t.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[t.RepoPath], t)
911		}
912		sessions := options.Sessions
913		if !options.SessionsSet {
914			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
915		}
916		notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
917		if app.Notes != nil {
918			allNotes, noteErr := app.Notes.List("")
919			if noteErr != nil {
920				return nil, noteErr
921			}
922			for _, n := range allNotes {
923				notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID] = append(notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID], n)
924			}
925		}
926	
927		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
928		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising
929		// ~3*56 git processes was the measured 4.2s startup bottleneck; eight
930		// workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once. TUI callers
931		// share the limiter with task enrichment.
932		limiter := options.Limiter
933		if limiter == nil {
934			limiter = inventory.NewLimiter(8)
935		}
936		var wg sync.WaitGroup
937		for i, r := range repos {
938			wg.Add(1)
939			go func(i int, r repo.Repo) {
940				defer wg.Done()
941				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
942				if !ok {
943					return
944				}
945				defer release()
946	
947				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: assets[i]}
948				if row.Asset != nil {
949					repoNotes := notesByRepo[row.Asset.ID]
950					row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
951					if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
952						row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
953					}
954				}
955				if r.HasGit {
956					row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, r.Path)
957				}
958				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
959				if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
960					row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
961				}
962				row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
963				row.LastActivity = row.Context.LastActivity
964				row.Worktrees = row.Context.WorktreeCount
965				if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
966					row.Status = main.Status
967				}
968				if !r.Bare {
969					row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
970				}
971				if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
972					row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
973					row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
974				}
975				if r.HasGit {
976					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(gitx.Repo{
977						Root: r.Path, GitDir: r.GitDir, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
978						MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
979					}, row.Worktrees)
980				} else {
981					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(r.Path)
982				}
983				out[i] = row
984			}(i, r)
985		}
986		wg.Wait()
987		return out, ctx.Err()
988	}
989	
990	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
991	//
992	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
993	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
994	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
995	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
996		var out []tui.Tool
997		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
998			run := t.Run
999			name := t.Name
1000			if name == "" {
1001				name = firstWord(run)
1002			}
1003			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
1004			if t.Interactive {
1005				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
1006				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
1007				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
1008				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
1009				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
1010			}
1011			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
1012				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
1013				Probe: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
1014			})
1015		}
1016		return out
1017	}
1018	
1019	// commandRunnable resolves the command's first word on PATH, expanding a
1020	// leading environment variable so "$EDITOR ." checks the editor itself. The
1021	// returned probe is run by a bounded Bubble Tea command, never by View.
1022	func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func(context.Context) bool {
1023		return func(ctx context.Context) bool { return checkCommandRunnable(ctx, run, interactive) }
1024	}
1025	
1026	func checkCommandRunnable(ctx context.Context, run string, interactive bool) bool {
1027		if ctx == nil {
1028			ctx = context.Background()
1029		}
1030		word := firstWord(run)
1031		if strings.HasPrefix(word, "$") {
1032			word = os.Getenv(strings.TrimPrefix(word, "$"))
1033			if word == "" {
1034				return false
1035			}
1036			word = firstWord(word)
1037		}
1038		if word == "" {
1039			return false
1040		}
1041		if interactive {
1042			// Ask the configured shell after it loads its rc files; LookPath
1043			// cannot see aliases or functions.
1044			probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
1045			defer cancel()
1046			probe := exec.CommandContext(probeCtx, shellPath(), "-lic",
1047				`command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1`, "dev-tool-probe", word)
1048			return probe.Run() == nil
1049		}
1050		if filepath.IsAbs(word) {
1051			_, err := os.Stat(word)
1052			return err == nil
1053		}
1054		_, err := exec.LookPath(word)
1055		return err == nil
1056	}
1057	
1058	func firstWord(s string) string {
1059		f := strings.Fields(s)
1060		if len(f) == 0 {
1061			return ""
1062		}
1063		return f[0]
1064	}
1065	
1066	func shellPath() string {
1067		if s := os.Getenv("SHELL"); s != "" {
1068			return s
1069		}
1070		return "/bin/sh"
1071	}
1072	
1073	// remoteCachePath is private because the inventory can contain names and URLs
1074	// of private repositories.
1075	func remoteCachePath() string {
1076		return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
1077	}
1078	
1079	func remoteCacheSourceID(app *App) string {
1080		parts := []string{
1081			"forge-source-v1",
1082			"GH_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GH_HOST"),
1083			"GITLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST"),
1084			"GLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GLAB_HOST"),
1085		}
1086		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1087			parts = append(parts, "azure="+target.Organization+"\x00"+target.Project)
1088		}
1089		sort.Strings(parts)
1090		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
1091		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:])
1092	}
1093	
1094	// cachedRemoteRows reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or
1095	// subprocess — so it is safe on the startup path. Local clone markers are
1096	// filled when the background local inventory arrives.
1097	func cachedRemoteRows(app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool, bool) {
1098		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1099		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1100		if !ok || cache.SourceID != sourceID {
1101			return nil, false, false
1102		}
1103		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
1104		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {
1105			out = append(out, tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr})
1106		}
1107		return out, true, !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID)
1108	}
1109	
1110	// cachedRemotesForRepoRows uses the local repo data the dashboard already
1111	// collected, avoiding another process-spawning scan on startup.
1112	func cachedRemotesForRepoRows(app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1113		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1114		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1115			return nil, false
1116		}
1117		return matchRemoteRepoRows(cache.Repos, locals), true
1118	}
1119	
1120	func matchRemoteRepoRows(remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo, locals []tui.RepoRow) []tui.RemoteRow {
1121		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
1122		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1123		for _, r := range locals {
1124			if r.RemoteForge == forge.Unknown || r.RemoteName == "" {
1125				continue
1126			}
1127			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1128			if ambiguous[key] {
1129				continue
1130			}
1131			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1132				delete(byRemote, key)
1133				ambiguous[key] = true
1134				continue
1135			}

1153	// cachedRemotes returns a fresh, already-local-matched cache for instant TUI
1154	// navigation. Local paths are recomputed rather than cached because clones can
1155	// move independently of the forge inventory.
1156	func cachedRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1157		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1158		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1159			return nil, false
1160		}
1161		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), true
1162	}
1163	
1164	func cachedRemotesAny(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, forge.Cache, bool) {
1165		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1166		if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1167			return nil, forge.Cache{}, false
1168		}
1169		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), cache, true

1172	// collectRemotes aggregates configured forge CLIs, caches the normalised response, then
1173	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
1174	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
1175	type remoteCollectOptions struct {
1176		Locals       []tui.RepoRow
1177		LocalsSet    bool
1178		Providers    []forge.Forge
1179		ProvidersSet bool
1180	}
1181	
1182	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1183		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{})
1184	}
1185	
1186	func collectRemotesForRows(ctx context.Context, app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1187		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{Locals: locals, LocalsSet: true})
1188	}

1190	func collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, options remoteCollectOptions) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1191		type result struct {
1192			kind  forge.Kind
1193			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1194			err   error
1195		}
1196		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1197		matchRows := func(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1198			if options.LocalsSet {
1199				return matchRemoteRepoRows(repos, options.Locals)
1200			}
1201			return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, repos)
1202		}
1203		providers := options.Providers
1204		if !options.ProvidersSet {
1205			providers = configuredForges(app)
1206		}
1207		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1208		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1209		available := 0
1210		var unavailable []error
1211		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1212		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1213		for _, f := range providers {
1214			if !f.Available() {
1215				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1216				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1217				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1218					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1219					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1220					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())
1221				}
1222				continue
1223			}
1224			expected[f.Kind()] = true
1225			available++
1226			wg.Add(1)
1227			go func(f forge.Forge) {
1228				defer wg.Done()
1229				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx)
1230				ch <- result{kind: f.Kind(), repos: r, err: err}
1231			}(f)
1232		}
1233		wg.Wait()
1234		close(ch)
1235		if available == 0 {
1236			if cached, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok && cached.SourceID == sourceID {
1237				rows := matchRows(cached.Repos)
1238				if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1239					return rows, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1240				}
1241				return rows, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1242			}
1243			if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1244				return nil, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1245			}
1246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1247		}
1248	
1249		old, _ := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1250		if old.SourceID != sourceID {
1251			old = forge.Cache{}
1252		}
1253		byProvider := map[forge.Kind][]forge.RemoteRepo{}
1254		statuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1255		for _, r := range old.Repos {
1256			byProvider[r.Forge] = append(byProvider[r.Forge], r)
1257		}
1258		for kind, status := range old.Providers {
1259			statuses[kind] = status
1260		}
1261		errs := append([]error(nil), unavailable...)
1262		successful := 0
1263		now := time.Now().UTC()
1264		for _, kind := range unavailableKinds {
1265			status := statuses[kind]
1266			status.Error = "provider CLI unavailable"
1267			statuses[kind] = status
1268		}
1269		for res := range ch {
1270			if res.err != nil {
1271				errs = append(errs, res.err)
1272				status := statuses[res.kind]
1273				status.Error = res.err.Error()
1274				if len(byProvider[res.kind]) == 0 && len(res.repos) > 0 {
1275					byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1276					status.FetchedAt = now
1277					status.Complete = false
1278				}
1279				statuses[res.kind] = status
1280				continue
1281			}
1282			successful++
1283			byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1284			statuses[res.kind] = forge.ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
1285		}
1286		var remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo
1287		complete := true
1288		providerStatuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1289		for kind := range expected {
1290			status, ok := statuses[kind]
1291			if !ok || !status.Complete {
1292				complete = false
1293			}
1294			if ok {
1295				providerStatuses[kind] = status
1296			}
1297			remoteRepos = append(remoteRepos, byProvider[kind]...)
1298		}
1299		sortRemoteRepos(remoteRepos)
1300		if successful > 0 {
1301			_ = forge.SaveCacheStateContext(ctx, remoteCachePath(), forge.Cache{
1302				Version: forge.CacheVersion, SourceID: sourceID, FetchedAt: now, Complete: complete,
1303				Providers: providerStatuses, Repos: remoteRepos,
1304			})
1305		}
1306		return matchRows(remoteRepos), errors.Join(errs...)
1307	}

1309	func sortRemoteRepos(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) {
1310		sort.SliceStable(repos, func(i, j int) bool {
1311			if !repos[i].UpdatedAt.Equal(repos[j].UpdatedAt) {
1312				return repos[i].UpdatedAt.After(repos[j].UpdatedAt)
1313			}
1314			return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label()
1315		})
1316	}
1317	
1318	func configuredForges(app *App) []forge.Forge {
1319		providers := forge.All()
1320		if app == nil || len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps) == 0 {
1321			return providers
1322		}
1323		targets := make([]forge.AzureDevOpsTarget, 0, len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps))
1324		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1325			targets = append(targets, forge.AzureDevOpsTarget{
1326				Organization: target.Organization,
1327				Project:      target.Project,
1328			})
1329		}
1330		return forge.All(forge.NewAzureDevOps(targets))
1331	}

1333	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1334		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
1335		assets, _, assetErr := joinRepoAssets(app, locals)
1336		if assetErr != nil {
1337			app.warnf("could not join catalog metadata to remote locals: %v", assetErr)
1338			assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(locals))
1339		}
1340		type localMatch struct {
1341			repository repo.Repo
1342			asset      *catalog.Entry
1343		}
1344		localByRemote := map[string]localMatch{}
1345		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1346		for index, r := range locals {
1347			if r.Bare {
1348				continue
1349			}
1350			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1351			if kind == forge.Unknown || name == "" {
1352				continue
1353			}
1354			key := string(kind) + "/" + strings.ToLower(name)
1355			if ambiguous[key] {
1356				continue
1357			}
1358			if _, exists := localByRemote[key]; exists {
1359				delete(localByRemote, key)
1360				ambiguous[key] = true
1361				continue
1362			}
1363			localByRemote[key] = localMatch{repository: r, asset: assets[index]}
1364		}
1365		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1366		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1367			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1368			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1369				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.repository.Path, local.repository.Display()
1370				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1371				if local.asset != nil {
1372					row.LocalKind = local.asset.Kind
1373				}
1374			}
1375			out = append(out, row)
1376		}
1377		// Linked-worktree Tries are intentionally absent from repo.Discover's project
1378		// inventory, so use their explicit catalog identity as a second safe source.
1379		applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app, out)
1380		return out
1381	}
1382	
1383	func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {
1384		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil || len(rows) == 0 {
1385			return
1386		}
1387		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
1388		if err != nil {
1389			app.warnf("could not read catalog for remote matching: %v", err)
1390			return
1391		}
1392		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1393			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
1394		}
1395		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
1396			return
1397		}
1398		host := config.Hostname()
1399		byIdentity := make(map[string][]*catalog.Entry)
1400		for _, entry := range entries {
1401			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
1402			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || entry.RemoteIdentity == "" ||
1403				liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {
1404				continue
1405			}
1406			byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity] = append(byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity], entry)
1407		}
1408		for index := range rows {
1409			identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(rows[index].Repo.CloneURL)
1410			matches := byIdentity[identity]
1411			if identity == "" || len(matches) != 1 {
1412				continue
1413			}
1414			location, _ := matches[0].LocationFor(host)
1415			rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
1416			rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
1417			rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind
1418		}
1419	}
1420	
1421	func liveCatalogLocationPath(location catalog.Location) string {
1422		for _, candidate := range []string{location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath} {
1423			if candidate == "" {
1424				continue
1425			}
1426			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
1427				return candidate
1428			}
1429		}
1430		return ""
1431	}

1433	func prepareTUINoteEdit(app *App, n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {
1434		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-note-*.md")
1435		if err != nil {
1436			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1437		}
1438		path := tmp.Name()
1439		if _, err := io.WriteString(tmp, n.Body); err != nil {
1440			_ = tmp.Close()
1441			_ = os.Remove(path)
1442			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1443		}
1444		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
1445			_ = os.Remove(path)
1446			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1447		}
1448		proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
1449		if err != nil {
1450			_ = os.Remove(path)
1451			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1452		}
1453		return tui.NoteEdit{
1454			Command: proc,
1455			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
1456				if runErr != nil {
1457					_ = os.Remove(path)
1458					return runErr
1459				}
1460				body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1461				if err != nil {
1462					return fmt.Errorf("read edited body (preserved at %s): %w", path, err)
1463				}
1464				if strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) == "" {
1465					_ = os.Remove(path)
1466					return fmt.Errorf("edited note body is empty; not saved")
1467				}
1468				_, err = app.Notes.Update(context.Background(), n.ID, n.Revision(), string(body), n.Tags)
1469				if err != nil {
1470					return fmt.Errorf("save edited note: %w; edited body preserved at %s", err, path)
1471				}
1472				_ = os.Remove(path)
1473				return nil
1474			},
1475		}, nil
1476	}

444	// renderPlan prints a provisioning plan as a table plus its warnings.
445	func renderPlan(app *App, plan wt.Plan, repoPath string) {
446		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s\n\n", config.Contract(repoPath))
447	
448		if len(plan.Ecosystems) == 0 {
449			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No project type detected — only gitignored files will be carried over.")
450		} else {
451			t := app.newTable("PROJECT", "MANAGER", "FROM", "DEPENDENCIES", "TOOL")
452			style := app.outStyle()
453			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
454				deps := "—"
455				if len(e.DepDirs) > 0 {
456					deps = strings.Join(e.DepDirs, ", ")
457				} else {
458					deps = "global cache"
459				}
460				tool := "installed"
461				if !e.ToolInstalled() {
462					tool = style.danger("MISSING: " + e.Tool)
463				} else {
464					tool = style.success(tool)
465				}
466				t.Add(e.Name, e.Manager, e.Marker, deps, tool)
467			}
468			t.Render(app.Out)
469		}
470	
471		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out)
472		if len(plan.Steps) == 0 {
473			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Nothing to provision.")
474		} else {
475			st := app.newTable("", "ACTION", "WHAT", "WHY")
476			style := app.outStyle()
477			for _, s := range plan.Steps {
478				mark := "✓"
479				if s.Skipped {
480					mark = style.dim("·")
481				} else {
482					mark = style.success(mark)
483				}
484				st.Add(mark, string(s.Kind), truncate(s.What, 34), s.Why)
485			}
486			st.Render(app.Out)
487		}
488	
489		for _, w := range plan.Warnings {
490			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%s %s\n", app.errStyle().warning("warning:"), w)
491		}
492		if plan.Empty() {
493			fmt.Fprintln(app.Err, "\nNothing would run. If a new worktree comes up broken, add what it needs to "+
494				"worktree.post_create, or commit .dev-cli/config.toml with `dev wt plan --write`.")
495		}
496	}
497	
498	// writeRepoTemplate seeds .dev-cli/config.toml from the detected plan.
499	//
500	// Committing it is what makes a project's worktree setup reproducible: the
501	// next machine, and the next person, get the same one without having to
502	// rediscover it.
503	func writeRepoTemplate(app *App, repoPath string, plan wt.Plan, set wt.Settings) error {
504		path, err := projectconfig.ConfigPath(repoPath)
505		if err != nil {
506			return err
507		}
508		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
509			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists — edit it directly", config.Contract(path))
510		}
511		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
512			return err
513		}
514	
515		var b strings.Builder
516		b.WriteString("# dev project configuration (versioned with this repository).\n")
517		b.WriteString("version = 1\n\n")
518		b.WriteString("#\n")
519		b.WriteString("# Committed on purpose: a worktree is a clean checkout, so without this a\n")
520		b.WriteString("# new one comes up with no dependencies and none of the gitignored files the\n")
521		b.WriteString("# project needs. Seeded by `dev wt plan --write`; edit freely.\n\n")
522		b.WriteString("[worktree]\n")
523	
524		b.WriteString("# Gitignored files to carry into a new worktree. Only files that are BOTH\n")
525		b.WriteString("# listed here AND gitignored are copied — a tracked file is already in the\n")
526		b.WriteString("# checkout on the correct branch.\n")
527		b.WriteString("include = [")
528		for i, inc := range set.Include {
529			if i > 0 {
530				b.WriteString(", ")
531			}
532			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%q", inc)
533		}
534		b.WriteString("]\n\n")
535	
536		if len(plan.Ecosystems) > 0 {
537			b.WriteString("# Detected in this repository:\n")
538			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
539				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "#   %-8s %-8s (%s) → %s\n", e.Name, e.Manager, e.Marker, e.Install)
540			}
541			b.WriteString("#\n")
542			b.WriteString("# \"auto\" runs those install commands. Replace with an explicit list if this\n")
543			b.WriteString("# project needs something else:  post_create = [\"make bootstrap\"]\n")
544			b.WriteString("post_create = \"auto\"\n\n")
545	
546			b.WriteString("# How each project type gets its dependencies:\n")
547			b.WriteString("#   reinstall  run the install command (correct, the default)\n")
548			b.WriteString("#   copy       duplicate the directory from the source checkout (fast)\n")
549			b.WriteString("#   link       share one directory between checkouts (fastest, risky)\n")
550			b.WriteString("#   skip       leave the worktree without dependencies\n")
551			b.WriteString("[worktree.strategies]\n")
552			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
553				switch {
554				case len(e.DepDirs) == 0:
555					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# %-8s = \"reinstall\"  # %s uses a global cache; nothing to copy\n",
556						e.Name, e.Manager)
557				case e.CopySafe:
558					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%-10s = \"reinstall\"  # \"copy\" is sound here and much faster\n", e.Name)
559				default:
560					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%-10s = \"reinstall\"  # copy/link unsupported: %s\n", e.Name, e.Hazard)
561				}
562			}
563		} else {
564			b.WriteString("# No project type detected. Add the commands a fresh checkout needs:\n")
565			b.WriteString("# post_create = [\"make bootstrap\"]\n")
566			b.WriteString("post_create = \"auto\"\n")
567		}
568	
569		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(b.String()), 0o644); err != nil {
570			return err
571		}
572		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "wrote %s\n", config.Contract(path))
573		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Commit it so every machine provisions worktrees the same way.")
574		return nil
575	}

220		root := newRootCommand(app)
221		finishRoot(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
222		cmd, err := root.ExecuteC()
223		if err == nil {
224			return 0
225		}
226		style := styleForWriter(os.Stderr, colorModeFromArgs(os.Args[1:]))
227		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, style.danger("dev:")+" "+err.Error())
228		if cmd != nil && wantsUsage(err) {
229			fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, renderCobraHelp(cmd.UsageString(), style))
230		}
231		return 1
232	}
233

1	package forge
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"encoding/json"
6		"errors"
7		"fmt"
8		"net/url"
9		"strings"
10		"time"
11	)
12	
13	// ReviewQuery identifies one exact head/base relationship in one repository.
14	// Repository is the forge's stable repository identity: owner/repository for
15	// GitHub, group/repository for GitLab, or organization/project/repository for
16	// Azure DevOps. Adapters must still verify the returned branches because CLI
17	// filters are not sufficient evidence on their own.
18	type ReviewQuery struct {
19		Repository string `json:"repository"`
20		Head       string `json:"head"`
21		Base       string `json:"base"`
22	}
23	
24	// ReviewState is the portable lifecycle state observed for a provider review.
25	type ReviewState string
26	
27	const (
28		ReviewOpen   ReviewState = "open"
29		ReviewDraft  ReviewState = "draft"
30		ReviewMerged ReviewState = "merged"
31		ReviewClosed ReviewState = "closed"
32	)
33	
34	// Valid reports whether s has defined portable review semantics.
35	func (s ReviewState) Valid() bool {
36		switch s {
37		case ReviewOpen, ReviewDraft, ReviewMerged, ReviewClosed:
38			return true
39		default:
40			return false
41		}
42	}
43	
44	// Review is the minimal provider evidence for an exact head/base relationship.
45	// ID is the provider-stable identity and Number is the repository-local human
46	// identifier. Head, Base, State and Draft are observations from the provider
47	// response rather than values copied from ReviewQuery.
48	type Review struct {
49		Provider   Kind        `json:"provider"`
50		Repository string      `json:"repository"`
51		ID         string      `json:"id"`
52		Number     int         `json:"number"`
53		State      ReviewState `json:"state"`
54		Draft      bool        `json:"draft"`
55		URL        string      `json:"url"`
56		Head       string      `json:"head"`
57		Base       string      `json:"base"`
58		ObservedAt time.Time   `json:"observed_at"`
59	}
60	
61	// ReviewQuerier is an optional forge capability. A nil Review and nil error is
62	// a successful observation that no exact review exists. One exact match returns
63	// provider evidence; multiple exact matches fail with AmbiguousReviewError.
64	type ReviewQuerier interface {
65		QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error)
66	}
67	
68	var (
69		// ErrAmbiguousReview identifies a query with multiple exact head/base
70		// matches. Callers must not select one by recency or provider ordering.
71		ErrAmbiguousReview = errors.New("multiple reviews match")
72		// ErrMalformedReviewResponse identifies provider JSON that cannot supply the
73		// critical portable fields without guessing.
74		ErrMalformedReviewResponse = errors.New("malformed review response")
75	)
76	
77	// AmbiguousReviewError carries every exact match while keeping Error text free
78	// of provider response values such as private URLs and branch names.
79	type AmbiguousReviewError struct {
80		Provider Kind
81		Query    ReviewQuery
82		Matches  []Review
83	}
84	
85	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Error() string {
86		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review query returned %d exact matches", e.Provider, len(e.Matches))
87	}
88	
89	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguousReview }
90	
91	// MalformedReviewResponseError identifies the unusable response field without
92	// embedding its value or the response body. Index is zero-based and is -1 when
93	// the whole JSON document is malformed. Err retains safe decoder diagnostics.
94	type MalformedReviewResponseError struct {
95		Provider Kind
96		Index    int
97		Field    string
98		Err      error
99	}
100	
101	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Error() string {
102		location := "response"
103		if e.Index >= 0 {
104			location = fmt.Sprintf("response item %d", e.Index+1)
105		}
106		detail := "missing or invalid " + e.Field
107		if e.Err != nil {
108			detail = e.Err.Error()
109		}
110		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review %s is malformed: %s", e.Provider, location, detail)
111	}
112	
113	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
114	
115	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Is(target error) bool {
116		return target == ErrMalformedReviewResponse
117	}
118	
119	// QueryReview invokes the optional capability without widening Forge. It never
120	// caches or initiates a query unless a caller explicitly calls this function.
121	func QueryReview(ctx context.Context, f Forge, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
122		querier, ok := f.(ReviewQuerier)
123		if !ok {
124			return nil, &ErrUnsupported{Kind: f.Kind(), Operation: "review queries"}
125		}
126		return querier.QueryReview(ctx, dir, query)
127	}
128	
129	type reviewCandidate struct {
130		ID     string
131		Number int
132		State  string
133		Draft  *bool
134		URL    string
135		Head   string
136		Base   string
137	}
138	
139	type reviewStateNormalizer func(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error)
140	
141	func validateReviewQuery(query ReviewQuery) error {
142		switch {
143		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Repository) == "":
144			return errors.New("review query repository is required")
145		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Head) == "":
146			return errors.New("review query head is required")
147		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Base) == "":
148			return errors.New("review query base is required")
149		default:
150			return nil
151		}
152	}
153	
154	func decodeReviewJSON(provider Kind, out string, target any) error {
155		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(out)
156		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
157			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON array", nil)
158		}
159		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), target); err != nil {
160			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON", err)
161		}
162		return nil
163	}
164	
165	func selectExactReview(provider Kind, query ReviewQuery, candidates []reviewCandidate, normalize reviewStateNormalizer) (*Review, error) {
166		matches := make([]Review, 0, 1)
167		observedAt := time.Now().UTC()
168		for index, candidate := range candidates {
169			if candidate.Head == "" {
170				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "head branch", nil)
171			}
172			if candidate.Base == "" {
173				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "base branch", nil)
174			}
175			if candidate.Head != query.Head || candidate.Base != query.Base {
176				continue
177			}
178			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate.ID) == "" {
179				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "identifier", nil)
180			}
181			if candidate.Number <= 0 {
182				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "number", nil)
183			}
184			if candidate.Draft == nil {
185				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "draft flag", nil)
186			}
187			if !validReviewURL(candidate.URL) {
188				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "URL", nil)
189			}
190			state, err := normalize(candidate.State, *candidate.Draft)
191			if err != nil {
192				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "state", err)
193			}
194			matches = append(matches, Review{
195				Provider: provider, Repository: query.Repository,
196				ID: candidate.ID, Number: candidate.Number,
197				State: state, Draft: *candidate.Draft, URL: candidate.URL,
198				Head: candidate.Head, Base: candidate.Base, ObservedAt: observedAt,
199			})
200		}
201	
202		switch len(matches) {
203		case 0:
204			return nil, nil
205		case 1:
206			return &matches[0], nil
207		default:
208			return nil, &AmbiguousReviewError{
209				Provider: provider, Query: query,
210				Matches: append([]Review(nil), matches...),
211			}
212		}
213	}
214	
215	func malformedReviewResponse(provider Kind, index int, field string, err error) error {
216		return &MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: index, Field: field, Err: err}
217	}
218	
219	func validReviewURL(raw string) bool {
220		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
221		if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" {
222			return false
223		}
224		return parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http"
225	}
226

1	package forge

3	import (

8		"strings"
9		"time"

12	// gh drives the GitHub CLI.
13	type gh struct{}
14	
15	func (g *gh) Kind() Kind      { return GitHub }
16	func (g *gh) Bin() string     { return "gh" }
17	func (g *gh) Available() bool { return have("gh") }
18	
19	// CreatePR opens a GitHub pull request.
20	func (g *gh) CreatePR(ctx context.Context, dir string, req PRRequest) (string, error) {
21		if !g.Available() {
22			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
23		}
24		args := []string{"pr", "create", "--base", req.Base, "--head", req.Head}
25		switch {
26		case req.Title != "":
27			args = append(args, "--title", req.Title, "--body", req.Body)
28		default:
29			// --fill derives title and body from the branch's commits, which is
30			// the right default for a solo workflow where the commits already say
31			// what happened.
32			args = append(args, "--fill")
33		}
34		if req.Draft {
35			args = append(args, "--draft")
36		}
37		if req.Web {
38			args = append(args, "--web")
39		}
40		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
41		return lastURL(out), err
42	}
43	
44	// QueryReview manually observes an exact GitHub pull request relationship.
45	func (g *gh) QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
46		if !g.Available() {
47			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
48		}
49		if err := validateReviewQuery(query); err != nil {
50			return nil, err
51		}
52		out, err := reviewRunner(ctx, "gh", dir,
53			"pr", "list", "--repo", query.Repository,
54			"--head", query.Head, "--base", query.Base, "--state", "all",
55			"--limit", "1000",
56			"--json", "id,number,state,isDraft,url,headRefName,baseRefName")
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, err
59		}
60		return parseGitHubReviews(out, query)
61	}
62	
63	func parseGitHubReviews(out string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
64		var raw []struct {
65			ID          string `json:"id"`
66			Number      *int   `json:"number"`
67			State       string `json:"state"`
68			IsDraft     *bool  `json:"isDraft"`
69			URL         string `json:"url"`
70			HeadRefName string `json:"headRefName"`
71			BaseRefName string `json:"baseRefName"`
72		}
73		if err := decodeReviewJSON(GitHub, out, &raw); err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		candidates := make([]reviewCandidate, 0, len(raw))
77		for _, item := range raw {
78			number := 0
79			if item.Number != nil {
80				number = *item.Number
81			}
82			candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
83				ID: item.ID, Number: number, State: item.State, Draft: item.IsDraft,
84				URL: item.URL, Head: item.HeadRefName, Base: item.BaseRefName,
85			})
86		}
87		return selectExactReview(GitHub, query, candidates, normalizeGitHubReviewState)
88	}
89	
90	func normalizeGitHubReviewState(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error) {
91		switch strings.ToUpper(state) {
92		case "OPEN":
93			if draft {
94				return ReviewDraft, nil
95			}
96			return ReviewOpen, nil
97		case "MERGED":
98			return ReviewMerged, nil
99		case "CLOSED":
100			return ReviewClosed, nil
101		default:
102			return "", errors.New("unrecognized GitHub review state")
103		}
104	}
105	
106	// CreateRepo creates a GitHub repository from the local checkout.
107	func (g *gh) CreateRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (string, error) {
108		if !g.Available() {
109			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
110		}
111		target, err := resolveRepoRequest(req)
112		if err != nil {
113			return "", err
114		}
115		args := []string{"repo", "create", target.fullName, "--source", ".", "--remote", target.remoteName,
116			visibilityFlag(target.visibility)}
117		if req.Description != "" {
118			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
119		}
120		if req.Push {
121			args = append(args, "--push")
122		}
123		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
124		return lastURL(out), err
125	}
126	
127	// PublishRepo creates an empty GitHub repository. Unlike CreateRepo it does
128	// not pass --source, --remote or --push, leaving all local Git mutations to the
129	// shared caller-side transaction.
130	func (g *gh) PublishRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (CreateRepoResult, error) {
131		if !g.Available() {
132			return CreateRepoResult{}, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
133		}
134		target, err := resolveRepoRequest(req)
135		if err != nil {
136			return CreateRepoResult{}, err
137		}
138		args := []string{"repo", "create", target.fullName, visibilityFlag(target.visibility)}
139		if req.Description != "" {
140			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
141		}
142		out, err := publishRunner(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
143		if err != nil {
144			return createRepoResult(GitHub, target, out, false), err
145		}
146		result := createRepoResult(GitHub, target, out, true)
147		if result.RemoteURL == "" {
148			return result, fmt.Errorf("gh created %q but did not report a repository URL", target.fullName)
149		}
150		return result, nil
151	}
152	
153	// CloneURL renders a clone target. gh accepts a bare owner/name, so a
154	// shorthand reference is passed through untouched.
155	func (g *gh) CloneURL(ref string) string {
156		if strings.Contains(ref, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "git@") {
157			return ref
158		}
159		return "https://github.com/" + strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git") + ".git"
160	}
161	
162	// lastURL picks the URL out of a CLI's chatter, which may print progress
163	// lines before the created resource's address.
164	func lastURL(out string) string {
165		found := lastHTTPURL(out)
166		if found == "" {
167			return strings.TrimSpace(out)
168		}
169		return found
170	}
171	
172	// ListRepos lists GitHub repositories visible to the authenticated user —
173	// owned, collaborated on, and organisation membership — most recently pushed
174	// first. gh api is intentionally used instead of a custom HTTP client:
175	// authentication and token refresh stay owned by the forge CLI.
176	func (g *gh) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
177		if !g.Available() {
178			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
179		}
180		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 60*time.Second)
181		defer cancel()
182		const pageSize = 100
183		var result []RemoteRepo
184		for page := 1; ; page++ {
185			out, err := run(ctx, "gh", "", "api", "user/repos", "--method", "GET",
186				"-f", "per_page=100", "-f", fmt.Sprintf("page=%d", page),
187				"-f", "sort=pushed", "-f", "direction=desc")
188			if err != nil {
189				return result, err
190			}
191			repos, err := parseGitHubRepos(out)
192			if err != nil {
193				return result, err
194			}
195			result = append(result, repos...)
196			if len(repos) < pageSize {
197				break
198			}
199		}
200		return result, nil
201	}
202	
203	func parseGitHubRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
204		var raw []struct {
205			Name          string `json:"name"`
206			FullName      string `json:"full_name"`
207			Description   string `json:"description"`
208			URL           string `json:"html_url"`
209			CloneURL      string `json:"clone_url"`
210			SSHURL        string `json:"ssh_url"`
211			Visibility    string `json:"visibility"`
212			Fork          bool   `json:"fork"`
213			Archived      bool   `json:"archived"`
214			PushedAt      string `json:"pushed_at"`
215			DefaultBranch string `json:"default_branch"`
216		}
217		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
218			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode gh api user/repos: %w", err)
219		}
220		result := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
221		for _, r := range raw {
222			updated, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.PushedAt)
223			result = append(result, RemoteRepo{
224				Forge: GitHub, Name: r.Name, FullName: r.FullName,
225				Description: r.Description, URL: r.URL,
226				CloneURL: r.CloneURL, SSHURL: r.SSHURL,
227				Visibility: r.Visibility, DefaultBranch: r.DefaultBranch,
228				Archived: r.Archived, Fork: r.Fork, UpdatedAt: updated,
229			})
230		}
231		return result, nil
232	}

14	// glab drives the GitLab CLI. GitLab calls the same concept a merge request,

25		if !g.Available() {
26			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitLab, Bin: "glab"}
27		}
28		args := []string{"mr", "create", "--target-branch", req.Base, "--source-branch", req.Head}
29		switch {
30		case req.Title != "":
31			args = append(args, "--title", req.Title, "--description", req.Body)
32		default:

34		}
35		if req.Draft {
36			args = append(args, "--draft")
37		}
38		if req.Web {
39			args = append(args, "--web")
40		}
41		// Without this glab prompts interactively even when everything is supplied.
42		args = append(args, "--yes")

44		return lastURL(out), err

56		const pageSize = 100

60				"mr", "list", "--repo", query.Repository,

62				"--all", "--output", "json", "--per-page", strconv.Itoa(pageSize),

141		}
142		args := []string{"repo", "create"}
143		if req.FullName == "" && req.Namespace == "" && !strings.Contains(req.Name, "/") {
144			// Preserve the original invocation for existing callers such as Try
145			// graduation; glab uses the current checkout and adds the requested
146			// remote as before.
147			args = append(args, target.name)
148		} else {
149			args = append(args, "--name", target.name)
150			if target.namespace != "" {
151				args = append(args, "--group", target.namespace)
152			}
153		}
154		args = append(args, "--remoteName", target.remoteName, visibilityFlag(target.visibility))
155		if req.Description != "" {
156			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
157		}
158		out, err := run(ctx, "glab", dir, args...)
159		return lastURL(out), err
160	}

162	// PublishRepo creates an empty GitLab project while --skipGitInit prevents
163	// glab from initializing, cloning or changing the local checkout.
164	func (g *glab) PublishRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (CreateRepoResult, error) {
165		if !g.Available() {
166			return CreateRepoResult{}, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitLab, Bin: "glab"}
167		}
168		target, err := resolveRepoRequest(req)
169		if err != nil {
170			return CreateRepoResult{}, err
171		}
172		args := []string{"repo", "create", "--name", target.name, "--skipGitInit",
173			visibilityFlag(target.visibility)}
174		if target.namespace != "" {
175			args = append(args, "--group", target.namespace)
176		}
177		if req.Description != "" {
178			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
179		}
180		out, err := publishRunner(ctx, "glab", dir, args...)
181		if err != nil {
182			return createRepoResult(GitLab, target, out, false), err
183		}
184		result := createRepoResult(GitLab, target, out, true)
185		if result.RemoteURL == "" {
186			return result, fmt.Errorf("glab created %q but did not report a repository URL", target.fullName)
187		}
188		return result, nil
189	}

201	func (g *glab) CloneURL(ref string) string {
202		if strings.Contains(ref, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "git@") {
203			return ref
204		}
205		return "https://" + gitLabHost() + "/" + strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git") + ".git"

208	// ListRepos lists every GitLab project of which the authenticated user is a
209	// member, most recently active first. glab owns authentication; dev passes an
210	// explicit GITLAB_HOST/GLAB_HOST (default gitlab.com) so inventory and cache
211	// identity never depend on the process's current Git repository.
212	func (g *glab) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
213		if !g.Available() {
214			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitLab, Bin: "glab"}
215		}
216		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 60*time.Second)
217		defer cancel()
218		const pageSize = 100
219		var result []RemoteRepo
220		for page := 1; ; page++ {
221			out, err := run(ctx, "glab", "", "api", "--hostname", gitLabHost(), "projects", "--method", "GET",
222				"-f", "membership=true", "-f", "simple=true", "-f", "per_page=100",
223				"-f", fmt.Sprintf("page=%d", page), "-f", "order_by=last_activity_at", "-f", "sort=desc")
224			if err != nil {
225				return result, err
226			}
227			repos, err := parseGitLabRepos(out)
228			if err != nil {
229				return result, err
230			}
231			result = append(result, repos...)
232			if len(repos) < pageSize {
233				break
234			}
235		}
236		return result, nil
237	}

239	func parseGitLabRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
240		var raw []struct {
241			Name              string `json:"name"`
242			PathWithNamespace string `json:"path_with_namespace"`
243			Description       string `json:"description"`
244			DefaultBranch     string `json:"default_branch"`
245			Visibility        string `json:"visibility"`
246			SSHURL            string `json:"ssh_url_to_repo"`
247			HTTPURL           string `json:"http_url_to_repo"`
248			WebURL            string `json:"web_url"`
249			Archived          bool   `json:"archived"`
250			ForkedFrom        any    `json:"forked_from_project"`
251			LastActivityAt    string `json:"last_activity_at"`
252		}
253		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
254			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode glab api projects: %w", err)
255		}
256		result := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
257		for _, r := range raw {
258			updated, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, r.LastActivityAt)
259			result = append(result, RemoteRepo{
260				Forge: GitLab, Name: r.Name, FullName: r.PathWithNamespace,
261				Description: r.Description, URL: r.WebURL,
262				CloneURL: r.HTTPURL, SSHURL: r.SSHURL,
263				Visibility: r.Visibility, DefaultBranch: r.DefaultBranch,
264				Archived: r.Archived, Fork: r.ForkedFrom != nil, UpdatedAt: updated,
265			})
266		}
267		return result, nil
268	}

294	// ListRepos queries every configured organization/project concurrently. Azure
295	// CLI already returns every repository in the selected team project.
296	func (a *az) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
297		if len(a.targets) == 0 {
298			return nil, errors.New("Azure DevOps remote inventory needs at least one [[forge.azure_devops]] target")
299		}
300		if err := a.ensureExtension(ctx); err != nil {
301			return nil, err
302		}
303		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
304		defer cancel()
305	
306		type result struct {
307			repos []RemoteRepo
308			err   error
309		}
310		ch := make(chan result, len(a.targets))
311		var wg sync.WaitGroup
312		for _, target := range a.targets {
313			target := target
314			wg.Add(1)
315			go func() {
316				defer wg.Done()
317				out, err := run(ctx, "az", "", "repos", "list", "--detect", "false",
318					"--organization", target.Organization, "--project", target.Project,
319					"--output", "json", "--only-show-errors")
320				if err != nil {
321					ch <- result{err: fmt.Errorf("Azure DevOps %s / %s: %w", target.Organization, target.Project, err)}
322					return
323				}
324				repos, err := parseAzureDevOpsRepos(out)
325				if err != nil {
326					err = fmt.Errorf("Azure DevOps %s / %s: %w", target.Organization, target.Project, err)
327				}
328				ch <- result{repos: repos, err: err}
329			}()
330		}
331		wg.Wait()
332		close(ch)
333	
334		var repos []RemoteRepo
335		var errs []error
336		for item := range ch {
337			repos = append(repos, item.repos...)
338			if item.err != nil {
339				errs = append(errs, item.err)
340			}
341		}
342		sort.Slice(repos, func(i, j int) bool { return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label() })
343		unique := repos[:0]
344		seen := map[string]bool{}
345		for _, repo := range repos {
346			key := strings.ToLower(repo.Label())
347			if seen[key] {
348				continue
349			}
350			seen[key] = true
351			unique = append(unique, repo)
352		}
353		return unique, errors.Join(errs...)
354	}
