388	// parseAzureDevOpsRemote returns the provider identity and browser-safe HTTPS
389	// repository URL for supported Azure DevOps Services clone URL forms.
390	func parseAzureDevOpsRemote(raw string) (identity, webURL string, ok bool) {
391		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
392		if raw == "" {
393			return "", "", false
394		}
395		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
396			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
397			if err != nil || u.Fragment != "" || u.RawQuery != "" {
398				return "", "", false
399			}
400			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
401			case "https":
402				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
403					return "", "", false
404				}
405				return parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u)
406			case "ssh":
407				if u.User == nil || (u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22") {
408					return "", "", false
409				}
410				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
411					return "", "", false
412				}
413				return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(u.User.Username(), strings.ToLower(u.Hostname()), escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath()))
414			default:
415				return "", "", false
416			}
417		}
418		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
419		if at <= 0 {
420			return "", "", false
421		}
422		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
423		if colon < 0 {
424			return "", "", false
425		}
426		colon += at + 1
427		return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(raw[:at], strings.ToLower(raw[at+1:colon]), decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(raw[colon+1:], "/"), "/")))
428	}
429	
430	func parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u *url.URL) (string, string, bool) {
431		if u.User != nil {
432			if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
433				return "", "", false
434			}
435		}
436		host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
437		segments := escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath())
438		var organization, project, repo string
439		switch {
440		case host == "dev.azure.com":
441			if len(segments) != 4 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[2], "_git") {
442				return "", "", false
443			}
444			organization, project, repo = segments[0], segments[1], segments[3]
445			if u.User != nil && !strings.EqualFold(u.User.Username(), organization) {
446				return "", "", false
447			}
448		case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com") && host != "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com":
449			if len(segments) < 3 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[len(segments)-2], "_git") || u.User != nil {
450				return "", "", false
451			}
452			organization = strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")
453			project, repo = segments[len(segments)-3], segments[len(segments)-1]
454		default:
455			return "", "", false
456		}
457		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
458		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
459			return "", "", false
460		}
461		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
462		webURL := azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo)
463		return identity, webURL, true
464	}
465	
466	func parseAzureDevOpsSSH(user, host string, segments []string) (string, string, bool) {
467		var organization, project, repo string
468		switch {
469		case host == "ssh.dev.azure.com" && strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && len(segments) == 4 && strings.EqualFold(segments[0], "v3"):
470			organization, project, repo = segments[1], segments[2], segments[3]
471			host = "dev.azure.com"
472		case host == "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com" && len(segments) == 3 && strings.EqualFold(segments[1], "_ssh"):
473			organization, project, repo = user, segments[0], segments[2]
474			host = strings.ToLower(organization) + ".visualstudio.com"
475		default:
476			return "", "", false
477		}
478		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
479		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
480			return "", "", false
481		}
482		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
483		return identity, azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo), true
484	}
485	
486	func azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo string) string {
487		if host == "dev.azure.com" {
488			return "https://dev.azure.com/" + url.PathEscape(organization) + "/" + url.PathEscape(project) + "/_git/" + url.PathEscape(repo)
489		}
490		return "https://" + host + "/" + url.PathEscape(project) + "/_git/" + url.PathEscape(repo)
491	}
492	
493	func escapedSegments(path string) []string {
494		return decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(path, "/"), "/"))
495	}
496	
497	func decodeSegments(segments []string) []string {
498		if len(segments) == 1 && segments[0] == "" {
499			return nil
500		}
501		out := make([]string, 0, len(segments))
502		for _, segment := range segments {
503			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(segment)
504			if err != nil || decoded == "" || strings.Contains(decoded, "/") {
505				return nil
506			}
507			out = append(out, decoded)
508		}
509		return out
510	}

3	import (
4		"context"

9	
10	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
11	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
12	type Repo struct {
13		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
14		Root string
15		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory. A linked worktree has
16		// its own entry below the shared common directory.
17		GitDir string
18		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
19		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
20		GitCommonDir string
21		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
22		Name string
23		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
24		// the main checkout.
25		IsLinkedWorktree bool
26		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
27		MainRoot string
28		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
29		Bare bool
30	}
31	
32	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
33	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
34	
35	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
36	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
37		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
38		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
39		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
40			"rev-parse",
41			"--path-format=absolute",
42			"--show-toplevel",
43			"--git-dir",
44			"--git-common-dir",
45			"--is-bare-repository",
46		)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Repo{}, err
49		}
50		f := lines(out)
51		r := Repo{}
52		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
53		switch len(f) {
54		case 4:
55			r.Root = f[0]
56			r.GitDir = f[1]
57			r.GitCommonDir = f[2]
58			r.Bare = f[3] == "true"
59		case 3:
60			r.GitDir = f[0]
61			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
62			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
63		default:
64			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
65		}
66	
67		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
68		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
69		if r.Bare {
70			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
71		} else if r.GitDir == r.GitCommonDir {
72			// A normal checkout may use --separate-git-dir, so the common directory's
73			// parent is not necessarily the working-tree root.
74			r.MainRoot = r.Root
75		} else {
76			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
77		}
78		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.GitDir != r.GitCommonDir
79		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
80		if r.Bare {
81			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
82			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
83			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
84				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
85			}
86		}
87		return r, nil
88	}
89	
90	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
91	// a full Discover.
92	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
93		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
94		return err == nil
95	}
96	
97	// DefaultBranch resolves the repository's default branch — origin/HEAD when the
98	// remote advertises it, else the first of main/master that exists locally.
99	// Returns "" when nothing can be determined, which callers must treat as
100	// "ask the user" rather than guessing.
101	func DefaultBranch(ctx context.Context, dir string) string {
102		if out, err := run(ctx, dir, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"); err == nil {
103			if _, b, ok := strings.Cut(out, "/"); ok {
104				return b
105			}
106		}
107		for _, cand := range []string{"main", "master", "trunk", "develop"} {
108			if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+cand); err == nil {
109				return cand
110			}
111		}
112		return ""
113	}
114	
115	// Remote returns the push URL of the named remote ("origin" when empty).
116	func Remote(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) string {
117		if name == "" {
118			name = "origin"
119		}
120		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "remote", "get-url", name)
121		if err != nil {
122			return ""
123		}
124		return out
125	}
126	
127	// RemoteFromConfig reads one remote URL directly from a Git common directory.
128	// It is the zero-process path used by whole-machine inventory, where spawning
129	// `git remote get-url` once per repo dominated startup. Includes and URL
130	// rewriting are deliberately not evaluated; callers that need Git's complete
131	// semantics should use Remote instead.
132	func RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, name string) string {
133		if commonDir == "" {
134			return ""
135		}
136		if name == "" {
137			name = "origin"
138		}
139		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(commonDir, "config"))
140		if err != nil {
141			return ""
142		}
143		want := `remote "` + name + `"`
144		section := ""
145		for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
146			line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
147			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || strings.HasPrefix(line, ";") {
148				continue
149			}
150			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.HasSuffix(line, "]") {
151				section = strings.TrimSpace(line[1 : len(line)-1])
152				continue
153			}
154			if section != want {
155				continue
156			}
157			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
158			if ok && strings.TrimSpace(key) == "url" {
159				return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), `"`)
160			}
161		}
162		return ""
163	}

281				e.warnings = append(e.warnings, warning)
282			}
283		}
284		e.milestone = MilestoneReviewReady
285		e.snapshot = "task:" + e.revision
286		return e.result(), nil
287	}
288	
289	func (e *executionState) applyVerifyMerged(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
290		observed := &e.observed
291		verified := false
292		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
293			switch effect.Code {
294			case EffectCommitAll, EffectDiscardAll:
295				if err := e.applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx, effect); err != nil {
296					return e.fail(err, "the task remains active; inspect content finalization and refresh merge verification")
297				}
298				if observed.proofRef == observed.task.Branch {
299					observed.proofOID = observed.completionBranchOID
300				}
301			case EffectVerifyAncestry:
302				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
303					return e.fail(err, "refresh checkout authority before verifying merge ancestry")
304				}
305				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
306					contained, proofErr := e.service.revalidateMergeProof(ctx, observed)
307					if proofErr != nil {
308						return "", proofErr
309					}
310					if !contained {
311						return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot verify %s (%s) is an ancestor of %s (%s)",
312							observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID)
313					}
314					return fmt.Sprintf("verified %s (%s) is an ancestor of %s (%s)",
315						observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID), nil
316				})
317				if err != nil {
318					return e.fail(err, "no remote freshness was assumed; refresh or select the exact ref and retry while the task remains active")
319				}
320				verified = true
321			case EffectPushBase:
322				if !verified {
323					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "base push reached before merge proof"})
324				}
325				if err := e.service.revalidateVerifiedCompletion(ctx, observed); err != nil {
326					return e.fail(err, "refresh exact merge proof before the optional base push")
327				}
328				e.runWarning(effect, func() (string, error) {
329					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "push", "origin", observed.completionBaseRef)
330					if pushErr != nil {
331						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.completionBaseRef, pushErr)
332					}
333					return "pushed origin/" + observed.completionBaseRef, nil
334				}, "optional base push failed")
335			case EffectUpdateTask:
336				if !verified {
337					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "DONE update reached before merge proof"})
338				}
339				if err := e.service.revalidateVerifiedCompletion(ctx, observed); err != nil {
340					return e.fail(err, "merge proof changed before recording DONE")
341				}
342				if err := e.writeCompletionDone(effect); err != nil {
343					return e.fail(err, "the verified refs and resources remain; reload the task and retry the DONE write")
344				}
345			default:
346				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected VerifyMerged effect " + string(effect.Code)})
347			}
348		}
349		return e.result(), nil
350	}
351	
352	func (e *executionState) applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx context.Context, effect Effect) error {
353		observed := &e.observed
354		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
355			return err
356		}
357		before := observed.finish
358		beforeBranchOID := observed.completionBranchOID
359		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
360			switch effect.Code {
361			case EffectCommitAll:
362				message := effect.Details.Map()["message"]
363				if commitErr := e.service.commitAll(ctx, observed.checkout, message); commitErr != nil {
364					return "commit-all may have changed the index", fmt.Errorf("commit all checkout changes: %w", commitErr)
365				}
366				return "committed all checkout changes", nil
367			case EffectDiscardAll:
368				if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, observed.checkout); discardErr != nil {
369					return "discard-all may have partially reset checkout content", fmt.Errorf("discard all checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
370				}
371				return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
372			default:
373				return "", &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected dirty effect " + string(effect.Code)}
374			}
375		})
376		if err != nil {
377			e.partial = true
378			return err
379		}
380		allowBaseMove := observed.mode == task.ModeDirect && effect.Code == EffectCommitAll
381		if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, allowBaseMove); err != nil {
382			return fmt.Errorf("refresh after %s: %w", effect.Code, err)
383		}
384		if observed.finish.Status.Dirty() || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.inProgress {
385			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again after %s: %s", effect.Code, observed.finish.Status.Breakdown())
386		}
387		switch effect.Code {
388		case EffectCommitAll:
389			parent, parentErr := e.service.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBranchOID+"^")
390			if parentErr != nil || parent != beforeBranchOID {
391				return staleBoundary("commit-all did not create exactly one normal commit from the approved branch OID")

395					return staleBoundary("direct commit changed the self-relation unexpectedly")

397			} else if observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly != before.Relation.BaseOnly ||

404			}
405		}
406		if observed.proofRef == observed.task.Branch {
407			observed.proofOID = observed.completionBranchOID
408		}
409		return nil
410	}

154		}
155	
156		left := m.surfacePanelLines()
157		middle := m.lifecyclePanelLines()
158		right := m.actionPanelLines()
159		if m.width >= wideLayoutWidth {
160			builder.WriteString(renderWidePanels(
161				panelTitle("SURFACES", m.focus == FocusSurfaces), left,
162				panelTitle("LIFECYCLE / EVIDENCE", m.focus == FocusLifecycle), middle,
163				panelTitle("ACTIONS / CONDITION", m.focus == FocusActions), right,
164				m.width,
165			))
166		} else {
167			builder.WriteString(renderNarrowPanel(panelTitle("SURFACES", m.focus == FocusSurfaces), left))
168			builder.WriteString("\n")
169			builder.WriteString(renderNarrowPanel(panelTitle("LIFECYCLE / EVIDENCE", m.focus == FocusLifecycle), middle))
170			builder.WriteString("\n")
171			builder.WriteString(renderNarrowPanel(panelTitle("ACTIONS / CONDITION", m.focus == FocusActions), right))
172		}
173		builder.WriteString("\n\n" + m.renderRepositoryFooter())
174		return builder.String()
175	}
176	
177	func (m Model) localStatusLine() string {
178		label := "UNKNOWN"
179		if m.hasSnapshot {
180			label = strings.ToUpper(string(m.snapshot.Freshness))
181		}
182		if m.loadRequest.loading {
183			label = "REFRESHING"
184		}
185		authoritative := m.hasSnapshot && m.snapshot.Authoritative() && !m.loadRequest.loading
186		if !authoritative {
187			label += " | NON-AUTHORITATIVE"
188		}
189		if m.loadRequest.stale {
190			label += " | STALE"
191		}
192		if m.hasSnapshot && !m.snapshot.Repository.Available {
193			label += " | UNAVAILABLE"
194		}
195		return "LOCAL: " + label
196	}

198	func panelTitle(title string, focused bool) string {
199		if focused {
200			return title + " [FOCUS]"
201		}
202		return title
203	}
204	
205	func (m Model) surfacePanelLines() []string {
206		rows := m.snapshot.Surfaces.Values()
207		if len(rows) == 0 {
208			return []string{"(valid empty snapshot)", "No checkout or task-only rows."}
209		}
210		lines := make([]string, 0, len(rows)*2)
211		for index, row := range rows {
212			marker := "  "
213			if index == m.rowCursor {
214				marker = "> "
215			}
216			badges := []string{"[" + strings.ToUpper(string(row.Kind)) + "]"}
217			if len(row.Drift.Values()) > 0 {
218				badges = append(badges, "[DRIFT]")
219			}
220			if len(row.Conflicts.Values()) > 0 || row.Kind == SurfaceConflict {
221				badges = append(badges, "[CONFLICT]")
222			}
223			label := row.Label
224			if label == "" {
225				label = row.Branch
226			}
227			if label == "" {
228				label = row.RowKey
229			}
230			line := marker + label + " " + strings.Join(badges, " ")
231			if index == m.rowCursor {
232				line = styleSelected.Render(line)
233			}
234			lines = append(lines, line)
235			if row.Path != "" {
236				lines = append(lines, "    "+row.Path)
237			} else if row.Locator.TaskID != "" {
238				lines = append(lines, "    task "+row.Locator.TaskID+" (no checkout)")
239			}
240		}
241		return lines
242	}
243	
244	func (m Model) lifecyclePanelLines() []string {
245		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
246		if !ok {
247			return []string{"No surface selected."}
248		}
249		lines := []string{"kind: " + strings.ToUpper(string(row.Kind))}
250		if row.Mode == "" || row.State == "" {
251			lines = append(lines, "recorded lifecycle: UNTRACKED")
252		} else {
253			lines = append(lines,
254				"mode: "+strings.ToUpper(string(row.Mode)),
255				"rail: "+lifecycleRail(row.Mode, row.State),
256				"current persisted state: "+strings.ToUpper(string(row.State)),
257			)
258		}
259		if row.Branch != "" {
260			lines = append(lines, "branch: "+row.Branch)
261		}
262		if row.Base != "" {
263			lines = append(lines, "base: "+row.Base)
264		}
265		for _, evidence := range row.Evidence.Values() {
266			lines = append(lines, "EVIDENCE: "+evidence)
267		}
268		for _, drift := range row.Drift.Values() {
269			lines = append(lines, "DRIFT: "+drift)
270		}
271		for _, conflict := range row.Conflicts.Values() {
272			lines = append(lines, "CONFLICT: "+conflict)
273		}
274		if remote, ok := m.remote.RemoteObservation(); ok {
275			lines = append(lines, remoteObservationLines(remote)...)
276		}
277		return lines
278	}
279	
280	func lifecycleRail(mode task.CheckoutMode, current task.State) string {
281		states := []task.State{task.Hot, task.Warm, task.Cold, task.Done}
282		if mode == task.ModeDirect {
283			states = []task.State{task.Hot, task.Warm, task.Done}
284		}
285		parts := make([]string, 0, len(states))
286		for _, state := range states {
287			label := strings.ToUpper(string(state))
288			if state == current {
289				label = "[" + label + " CURRENT]"
290			}
291			parts = append(parts, colourState(state, label))
292		}
293		return strings.Join(parts, " -> ")
294	}
295	
296	func colourState(state task.State, value string) string {
297		switch state {
298		case task.Hot:
299			return styleHot.Render(value)
300		case task.Warm:
301			return styleWarm.Render(value)
302		case task.Cold:
303			return styleCold.Render(value)
304		case task.Done:
305			return styleDone.Render(value)
306		default:
307			return value
308		}
309	}

311	func (m Model) actionPanelLines() []string {
312		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
313		if !ok {
314			return []string{"No surface selected."}
315		}
316		actions := row.Actions.Values()
317		if len(actions) == 0 {
318			return []string{"No guarded actions are available.", "This row is inspect-only."}
319		}
320		lines := make([]string, 0, len(actions)+4)
321		for index, choice := range actions {
322			marker := "  "
323			if index == m.actionCursor {
324				marker = "> "
325			}
326			label := choice.Label
327			if !choice.Valid() {
328				label += " [INVALID]"
329			}
330			line := marker + label
331			if index == m.actionCursor {
332				line = styleSelected.Render(line)
333			}
334			lines = append(lines, line)
335		}
336		if choice, ok := m.currentAction(); ok {
337			lines = append(lines, "", "selected: "+choice.Description)
338			lines = append(lines, "Enter: inspect a fresh plan; no immediate mutation.")
339			if choice.Action() == taskflow.RefreshRemote {
340				lines = append(lines, "network variant: "+remoteChoiceDescription(choice.Options()))
341			}
342		}
343		return lines
344	}
345	
346	func remoteChoiceDescription(options taskflow.ActionOptions) string {
347		remote, ok := options.(taskflow.RefreshRemoteOptions)
348		if !ok {
349			return "invalid remote options"
350		}
351		switch {
352		case remote.FetchRefs && remote.QueryReview:
353			return "FETCH REFS + QUERY REVIEW"
354		case remote.FetchRefs:
355			return "FETCH REFS"
356		case remote.QueryReview:
357			return "QUERY REVIEW"
358		default:
359			return "NO OPERATION SELECTED"
360		}
361	}

363	func (m Model) renderRepositoryFooter() string {
364		var lines []string
365		if m.status != "" {
366			lines = append(lines, "STATUS: "+m.status)
367		}
368		lines = append(lines,
369			"j/k or arrows row | h/l or arrows action | Tab focus | Enter plan",
370			"r local reload | R remote menu | Esc repositories | ? help | q quit",
371		)
372		return styleMuted.Render(strings.Join(lines, "\n"))
373	}
374	
375	func renderWidePanels(leftTitle string, left []string, middleTitle string, middle []string, rightTitle string, right []string, width int) string {
376		gutter := " | "
377		usable := width - 2*lipgloss.Width(gutter)
378		if usable < 60 {
379			usable = 60
380		}
381		leftWidth := usable * 30 / 100
382		middleWidth := usable * 36 / 100
383		rightWidth := usable - leftWidth - middleWidth
384		left = append([]string{leftTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, leftWidth))}, left...)
385		middle = append([]string{middleTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, middleWidth))}, middle...)
386		right = append([]string{rightTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, rightWidth))}, right...)
387		count := max(len(left), len(middle), len(right))
388		var builder strings.Builder
389		for index := 0; index < count; index++ {
390			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(left, index), leftWidth))
391			builder.WriteString(gutter)
392			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(middle, index), middleWidth))
393			builder.WriteString(gutter)
394			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(right, index), rightWidth))
395			if index+1 < count {
396				builder.WriteByte('\n')
397			}
398		}
399		return builder.String()
400	}
401	
402	func renderNarrowPanel(title string, lines []string) string {
403		return title + "\n" + strings.Repeat("-", max(1, lipgloss.Width(title))) + "\n" + strings.Join(lines, "\n")
404	}
405	
406	func lineAt(lines []string, index int) string {
407		if index < 0 || index >= len(lines) {
408			return ""
409		}
410		return lines[index]
411	}
412	
413	func fitPanelLine(value string, width int) string {
414		value = truncateDisplay(value, width)
415		missing := width - lipgloss.Width(value)
416		if missing > 0 {
417			value += strings.Repeat(" ", missing)
418		}
419		return value
420	}
421	
422	func truncateDisplay(value string, width int) string {
423		if width <= 0 {
424			return ""
425		}
426		return ansi.Truncate(value, width, "…")
427	}

430		return strings.Join([]string{
431			styleTitle.Render("dev flow  HELP"),
432			"",
433			"MODEL",
434			"  HOT / WARM / COLD / DONE are the only persisted task states.",
435			"  READY is plan availability; REVIEW / MERGED / RETIRED are result milestones only.",
436			"  DRIFT and CONFLICT are evidence labels, never mutation permission.",
437			"  STALE and ERROR observations are non-authoritative.",
438			"",
439			"KEYS",
440			"  j/k or up/down     select surface (or repository/menu row)",
441			"  h/l or left/right  select an already-concrete action variant",
442			"  Tab                move panel focus",
443			"  /                  filter the repository picker",
444			"  Enter              call Plan and inspect it; never mutate immediately",
445			"  y                  approve a READY non-typed plan",
446			"  r                  reload local facts only",
447			"  R                  choose provided fetch/query/both remote variants",
448			"  Esc                back out",
449			"  q                  quit (queued while Apply is running)",
450			"",
451			styleMuted.Render("? or Esc closes help | q quits"),
452		}, "\n")
453	}

474		return builder.String()

479			styleTitle.Render("dev flow  PLAN"),
480			"",
481			"Planning " + m.planTarget.choice.Label + " for exact row " + m.planTarget.rowKey + "...",
482			"No mutation has started.",
483			"",

487	
488	func (m Model) renderPlan(applying bool) string {
489		var builder strings.Builder
490		title := "dev flow  PLAN"
491		if applying {
492			title = "dev flow  APPLYING"
493		}
494		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render(title) + "\n\n")
495		builder.WriteString("repository: " + m.planTarget.repoKey + "\n")
496		builder.WriteString("row: " + m.planTarget.rowKey + "\n")
497		builder.WriteString("choice: " + m.planTarget.actionID + " — " + m.planTarget.choice.Label + "\n")
498		if m.planErr != nil {
499			builder.WriteString("\n" + styleBad.Render("PLAN ERROR: "+m.planErr.Error()) + "\n")
500		}
501		if !m.hasPlan {
502			builder.WriteString("\nNo valid plan is available. This error is inspectable and has no Apply path.\n")
503			builder.WriteString("\n" + styleMuted.Render("Esc back | q quit"))
504			return builder.String()
505		}
506	
507		builder.WriteString("plan ID: " + m.plan.PlanID + "\n")
508		builder.WriteString("availability: " + availabilityLabel(m.plan.Availability) + "\n")
509		if m.plan.Summary != "" {
510			builder.WriteString("summary: " + m.plan.Summary + "\n")
511		}
512		if m.plan.HasPersistedTransition {
513			target := strings.ToUpper(string(m.plan.Target))
514			if m.plan.RemovesTask {
515				target = "TASK REMOVED"
516			}
517			builder.WriteString("persisted transition: " + strings.ToUpper(string(m.plan.Source)) + " -> " + target)
518			if m.plan.StatePreserving {
519				builder.WriteString(" (state-preserving)")
520			}
521			builder.WriteString("\n")
522		}
523		if milestone := milestoneLabel(m.plan.ExpectedMilestone); milestone != "" {
524			builder.WriteString("expected result milestone: " + milestone + " (not a persisted state)\n")
525		}
526	
527		builder.WriteString("\nCONDITIONS (ordered)\n")
528		conditions := m.plan.Conditions()
529		if len(conditions) == 0 {
530			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
531		}
532		for index, condition := range conditions {
533			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. [%s] [%s] %s\n", index+1,
534				availabilityLabel(taskflow.Availability(condition.Verdict)), strings.ToUpper(string(condition.Requirement)), condition.Code))
535			evidence := condition.Evidence
536			if evidence == "" {
537				evidence = "(none recorded)"
538			}
539			builder.WriteString("     evidence: " + evidence + "\n")
540			remediation := condition.Remediation
541			if remediation == "" {
542				remediation = "(none required)"
543			}
544			builder.WriteString("     remediation: " + remediation + "\n")
545		}
546	
547		builder.WriteString("\nEFFECTS (execution order)\n")
548		effects := m.plan.Effects()
549		if len(effects) == 0 {
550			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
551		}
552		for index, effect := range effects {
553			markers := []string{}
554			if effect.Network {
555				markers = append(markers, "NETWORK")
556			}
557			if effect.Destructive {
558				markers = append(markers, "DESTRUCTIVE")
559			}
560			markerText := ""
561			if len(markers) > 0 {
562				markerText = " [" + strings.Join(markers, "] [") + "]"
563			}
564			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. %s%s — %s", index+1, effect.Code, markerText, effect.Description))
565			if effect.Target != "" {
566				builder.WriteString(" -> " + effect.Target)
567			}
568			builder.WriteString("\n")
569			for _, detail := range effect.Details.Entries() {
570				builder.WriteString("     " + detail.Key + ": " + detail.Value + "\n")
571			}
572		}
573	
574		builder.WriteString("\nRETAINED RESOURCES\n")
575		retained := m.plan.RetainedResources()
576		if len(retained) == 0 {
577			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
578		} else {
579			for _, resource := range retained {
580				builder.WriteString("  - " + resource + "\n")
581			}
582		}
583		builder.WriteString("fallback command: ")
584		if m.plan.FallbackCommand == "" {
585			builder.WriteString("(none supplied)\n")
586		} else {
587			builder.WriteString(m.plan.FallbackCommand + "\n")
588		}
589	
590		builder.WriteString("\n")
591		switch {
592		case applying:
593			builder.WriteString("APPLYING: conflicting navigation and refresh are disabled. q/r are queued.\n")
594		case !m.planCanApply():
595			builder.WriteString("NO APPLY PATH: only READY plans can be approved; this plan remains inspectable.\n")
596		case m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped:
597			prompt := m.plan.Confirmation.Prompt
598			if prompt == "" {
599				prompt = "Type the exact confirmation token"
600			}
601			builder.WriteString(prompt + "\n")
602			builder.WriteString("required exact token: " + m.plan.Confirmation.Token + "\n")
603			builder.WriteString("confirmation: " + m.confirm.View() + "\n")
604			builder.WriteString("Enter validates and applies; any mismatch remains non-mutating.\n")
605		default:
606			prompt := m.plan.Confirmation.Prompt
607			if prompt != "" {
608				builder.WriteString(prompt + "\n")
609			}
610			builder.WriteString("Press y to approve this exact PlanID. Enter never applies.\n")
611		}
612		if m.status != "" {
613			builder.WriteString("STATUS: " + m.status + "\n")
614		}
615		if !applying {
616			builder.WriteString(styleMuted.Render("Esc back | q quit"))
617		}
618		return builder.String()
619	}
620	
621	func availabilityLabel(value taskflow.Availability) string {
622		if value == "" {
623			return "UNKNOWN"
624		}
625		return strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(string(value), "-", " "))
626	}
627	
628	func milestoneLabel(value taskflow.Milestone) string {
629		switch value {
630		case taskflow.MilestoneReviewReady:
631			return "REVIEW"
632		case taskflow.MilestoneMerged:
633			return "MERGED"
634		case taskflow.MilestoneRetired:
635			return "RETIRED"
636		case taskflow.MilestoneAdopted:
637			return "ADOPTED"
638		case taskflow.MilestoneReconciled:
639			return "RECONCILED"
640		default:
641			return ""
642		}
643	}
644	
645	func (m Model) renderResult() string {
646		var builder strings.Builder
647		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev flow  RESULT") + "\n\n")
648		builder.WriteString("choice: " + m.planTarget.actionID + " — " + m.planTarget.choice.Label + "\n")
649		if m.lastResultErr != nil {
650			builder.WriteString(styleBad.Render("APPLY ERROR: "+m.lastResultErr.Error()) + "\n")
651		} else {
652			builder.WriteString(styleGood.Render("APPLY COMPLETED") + "\n")
653		}
654		if m.lastResult.PartialSuccess {
655			builder.WriteString("PARTIAL SUCCESS: completed effects remain completed; no rollback is implied.\n")
656		}
657		if milestone := milestoneLabel(m.lastResult.Milestone); milestone != "" {
658			builder.WriteString("result milestone: " + milestone + " (not a persisted state)\n")
659		}
660	
661		builder.WriteString("\nSTEP LEDGER\n")
662		steps := m.lastResult.AttemptedSteps()
663		if len(steps) == 0 {
664			builder.WriteString("  (no effect was attempted)\n")
665		}
666		for index, step := range steps {
667			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. [%s] %s — %s", index+1,
668				strings.ToUpper(string(step.Status)), step.Effect.Code, step.Effect.Description))
669			if step.Detail != "" {
670				builder.WriteString(" | " + step.Detail)
671			}
672			if step.Failure != "" {
673				builder.WriteString(" | FAILURE: " + step.Failure)
674			}
675			builder.WriteString("\n")
676		}
677		builder.WriteString("\nWARNINGS\n")
678		writeStringSection(&builder, m.lastResult.Warnings())
679		builder.WriteString("RECOVERY\n")
680		writeStringSection(&builder, m.lastResult.Recovery())
681		if remote, ok := m.lastResult.RemoteObservation(); ok {
682			builder.WriteString("REMOTE OBSERVATION (run-local)\n")
683			for _, line := range remoteObservationLines(remote) {
684				builder.WriteString("  " + line + "\n")
685			}
686		}
687		if handoff, ok := m.lastResult.Handoff(); ok {
688			builder.WriteString("HANDOFF (available after alternate-screen exit)\n")
689			builder.WriteString("  " + handoffDescription(handoff) + "\n")
690		}
691		if m.loadRequest.loading {
692			builder.WriteString("\nREFRESHING: a new local generation is loading; state was not changed optimistically.\n")
693		} else if m.loadRequest.err != nil {
694			builder.WriteString("\nSTALE: post-Apply local reload failed: " + m.loadRequest.err.Error() + "\n")
695		}
696		if m.status != "" {
697			builder.WriteString("STATUS: " + m.status + "\n")
698		}
699		builder.WriteString("\n" + styleMuted.Render("Esc return to repository | r reload again | ? help | q quit"))
700		return builder.String()
701	}
702	
703	func writeStringSection(builder *strings.Builder, values []string) {
704		if len(values) == 0 {
705			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
706			return
707		}
708		for _, value := range values {
709			builder.WriteString("  - " + value + "\n")
710		}
711	}
712	
713	func handoffDescription(handoff taskflow.Handoff) string {
714		parts := []string{strings.ToUpper(string(handoff.Kind))}
715		for _, value := range []string{handoff.Path, handoff.Runtime, handoff.RuntimeHandle, handoff.URL, handoff.Label} {
716			if value != "" {
717				parts = append(parts, value)
718			}
719		}
720		return strings.Join(parts, " | ")
721	}
722	
723	func remoteObservationLines(remote taskflow.RemoteObservation) []string {
724		lines := []string{"REMOTE: " + remote.RemoteName}
725		if remote.Provider != "" {
726			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE PROVIDER: "+strings.ToUpper(string(remote.Provider)))
727		}
728		if remote.Repository != "" {
729			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REPOSITORY: "+remote.Repository)
730		}
731		if remote.Head != "" || remote.Base != "" {
732			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BRANCHES: "+remote.Head+" -> "+remote.Base)
733		}
734		lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BEFORE REFS: "+refsSummary(remote.BeforeRefs))
735		if !remote.BeforeRefs.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
736			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BEFORE OBSERVED: "+formatTime(remote.BeforeRefs.ObservedAt))
737		}
738		if remote.HasAfterRefs {
739			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE AFTER REFS: "+refsSummary(remote.AfterRefs))
740			if !remote.AfterRefs.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
741				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE AFTER OBSERVED: "+formatTime(remote.AfterRefs.ObservedAt))
742			}
743		}
744		if remote.HasReview {
745			review := remote.Review
746			switch {
747			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationError:
748				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW ERROR: "+string(review.FailureKind)+" — "+review.Failure)
749			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationKnown && !review.Exists:
750				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW: NONE (known)")
751			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationKnown:
752				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("REMOTE REVIEW: #%d %s %s", review.Number, strings.ToUpper(string(review.ReviewState)), review.URL))
753			default:
754				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW: "+strings.ToUpper(string(review.State)))
755			}
756			if !review.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
757				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW OBSERVED: "+formatTime(review.ObservedAt))
758			}
759		}
760		return lines
761	}
762	
763	func refsSummary(refs taskflow.RemoteRefsObservation) string {
764		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
765		for _, ref := range []taskflow.NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
766			if ref.Ref == "" {
767				continue
768			}
769			switch {
770			case ref.Failure != "":
771				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"=ERROR("+ref.Failure+")")
772			case ref.Exists:
773				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"="+ref.OID)
774			default:
775				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"=ABSENT")
776			}
777		}
778		if len(parts) == 0 {
779			return "no named refs observed"
780		}
781		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
782	}
783	
784	func formatTime(value time.Time) string {
785		return value.Local().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05 MST")
786	}

27			return m, nil
28		}
29		m.remoteChoices = NewActionList(choices...)
30		m.remoteCursor = 0
31		m.overlay = overlayRemoteMenu
32		m.status = ""
33		return m, nil
34	}

36	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
37		switch m.overlay {
38		case overlayHelp:
39			switch message.String() {
40			case "esc", "?":
41				m.overlay = m.overlayReturn
42				m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
43				return m, nil
44			case "q", "ctrl+c":
45				return m.quit()
46			}
47			return m, nil
48	
49		case overlayRemoteMenu:
50			switch message.String() {
51			case "q", "ctrl+c":
52				return m.quit()
53			case "esc", "R":
54				m.overlay = overlayNone
55				return m, nil
56			case "j", "down":
57				if m.remoteCursor+1 < m.remoteChoices.Len() {
58					m.remoteCursor++
59				}
60			case "k", "up":
61				if m.remoteCursor > 0 {
62					m.remoteCursor--
63				}
64			case "enter":
65				choices := m.remoteChoices.Values()
66				if m.remoteCursor >= 0 && m.remoteCursor < len(choices) {
67					return m.beginPlan(choices[m.remoteCursor])
68				}
69			}
70			return m, nil
71	
72		case overlayPlanLoading:
73			switch message.String() {
74			case "q", "ctrl+c":
75				m.cancelPlanRead()
76				return m.quit()
77			case "esc":
78				m.cancelPlanRead()
79				m.overlay = overlayNone
80				m.status = ""
81			}
82			return m, nil
83	
84		case overlayPlan:
85			if message.String() == "ctrl+c" {
86				return m.quit()
87			}
88			if message.String() == "esc" {
89				m.confirm.Blur()
90				m.overlay = overlayNone
91				m.status = ""
92				return m, nil
93			}
94			if !m.planCanApply() {
95				if message.String() == "q" {
96					return m.quit()
97				}
98				return m, nil
99			}
100			if m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
101				if message.String() == "enter" {
102					token := m.confirm.Value()
103					if token != m.plan.Confirmation.Token {
104						m.status = "confirmation token does not match exactly"
105						return m, nil
106					}
107					return m.startApply(taskflow.ApproveWithToken(m.plan.PlanID, token))
108				}
109				var command tea.Cmd
110				m.confirm, command = m.confirm.Update(message)
111				return m, command
112			}
113			switch message.String() {
114			case "q":
115				return m.quit()
116			case "y", "Y":
117				return m.startApply(taskflow.Approve(m.plan.PlanID))
118			}
119			return m, nil
120	
121		case overlayResult:
122			switch message.String() {
123			case "q", "ctrl+c":
124				return m.quit()
125			case "esc":
126				m.overlay = overlayNone
127				m.status = ""
128				return m, nil
129			case "r":
130				return m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
131			case "?":
132				m.overlayReturn = overlayResult
133				m.overlay = overlayHelp
134				return m, nil
135			}
136			return m, nil
137		}
138		return m, nil
139	}

141	func (m Model) planCanApply() bool {
142		return m.hasPlan && m.planErr == nil && m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady
143	}

145	func (m Model) startApply(approval taskflow.Approval) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
146		if !m.planCanApply() {
147			return m, nil
148		}
149		if err := m.plan.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
150			m.status = fmt.Sprintf("approval rejected: %v", err)
151			return m, nil
152		}
153		m.applyGeneration++
154		m.applyRunning = true
155		m.overlay = overlayApplying
156		m.status = "Apply in progress; quit and refresh will be queued"
157		m.hasHandoff = false
158		m.finalHandoff = taskflow.Handoff{}
159		m.hasLastResult = false
160		m.lastResult = taskflow.Result{}
161		m.lastResultErr = nil
162		return m, m.applyCmd(m.applyGeneration, m.planTarget, m.plan, approval)
163	}

169	func DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(repositoryRoot, checkoutPath string) (ClaudeHarnessEvidence, bool) {

299	// Main returns Git's actual primary record. The first-row fallback preserves
300	// compatibility with manually constructed contexts which predate Worktree.Main.
301	func (c RepoContext) Main() (RepoCheckout, bool) {
302		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
303			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
304				return checkout, true
305			}
306		}
307		if len(c.Checkouts) == 0 {
308			return RepoCheckout{}, false
309		}
310		return c.Checkouts[0], true
311	}

313	// Linked returns every Git-registered non-main worktree.
314	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
315		hasMarkedMain := false
316		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
317			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
318				hasMarkedMain = true
319				break
320			}
321		}
322		if !hasMarkedMain {
323			if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
324				return nil
325			}
326			return c.Checkouts[1:]
327		}
328		out := make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(c.Checkouts)-1)
329		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
330			if !checkout.Worktree.Main {
331				out = append(out, checkout)
332			}
333		}
334		return out
335	}

337	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
338	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
339	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
340		seen := map[string]bool{}
341		var out []runtime.Session
342		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
343			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
344				key := session.Handle
345				if key == "" {
346					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
347				}
348				if seen[key] {
349					continue
350				}
351				seen[key] = true
352				out = append(out, session)
353			}
354		}
355		return out
356	}

371	// callers that need a proven empty observation or typed failure use

373	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
374		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
375		return CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, r, tasks, RepoContextOptions{
376			Runtime: runtimeName, Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: len(sessions) > 0,
377		})
378	}

380	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions builds repository topology from Git's complete
381	// registered worktree list. It never synthesizes a main checkout after a Git
382	// query failure.
383	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
384		opts RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
385		if ctx == nil {
386			ctx = context.Background()
387		}
388		out := RepoContext{
389			Repo: r, Runtime: opts.Runtime,
390			WorktreeObservation: TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved},
391			RuntimeObservation:  runtimeObservation(opts),
392		}
393		queryPath := repoQueryPath(r)
394		out.RepositoryID, out.IdentityErr = canonicalRepositoryID(ctx, r, queryPath)
395		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
396	
397		var (
398			worktrees []gitx.Worktree
399			err       error
400		)
401		if queryPath == "" {
402			err = fmt.Errorf("repository has no Git query path")
403		} else {
404			worktrees, err = gitx.Worktrees(ctx, queryPath)
405		}
406		if err != nil {
407			listErr := &WorktreeListError{Path: queryPath, Err: err}
408			out.WorktreeErr = listErr
409			out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: listErr}
410			assignTasksWithoutTopology(&out, tasks)
411			finishRepoContext(&out)
412			return out
413		}
414		out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
415		out.WorktreeCount = 0
416		out.Checkouts = make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(worktrees))
417		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
418			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
419			if canonicalPath == "" {
420				canonicalPath = filepath.Clean(worktree.Path)
421			}
422			checkout := RepoCheckout{
423				ID: canonicalPath, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
424				IdentityErr: canonicalErr,
425				Worktree:    worktree, Exists: pathIsDir(worktree.Path),
426				RuntimeObservation: out.RuntimeObservation,
427				Ownership:          CheckoutExternal,
428			}
429			if canonicalErr != nil {
430				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
431					Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: canonicalErr.Error(),
432				})
433			}
434			if worktree.Main {
435				checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
436					Kind: OwnershipEvidenceGitMain, Path: canonicalPath,
437				})
438			} else {
439				out.WorktreeCount++
440			}
441			out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
442		}
443	
444		enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx, out.Checkouts, opts.Limiter)
445		assignHarnessEvidence(&out)
446		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
447		if out.RuntimeObservation.Available() {
448			assignSessions(&out, opts.Sessions)
449		}
450		finishRepoContext(&out)
451		return out
452	}
453	
454	func runtimeObservation(opts RepoContextOptions) TopologyObservation {
455		if opts.RuntimeErr != nil {
456			err := &RuntimeListError{Runtime: opts.Runtime, Err: opts.RuntimeErr}
457			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: err}
458		}
459		if opts.RuntimeObserved {
460			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
461		}
462		return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved}
463	}
464	
465	func repoQueryPath(r repo.Repo) string {
466		for _, candidate := range []string{r.Path, r.RealPath, r.MainRoot, r.CommonDir} {
467			if candidate != "" {
468				return candidate
469			}
470		}
471		return ""
472	}
473	
474	func canonicalRepositoryID(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, queryPath string) (string, error) {
475		commonDir := r.CommonDir
476		if commonDir == "" && r.Bare {
477			commonDir = queryPath
478		}
479		if commonDir == "" && queryPath != "" {
480			if discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, queryPath); err == nil {
481				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
482			}
483		}
484		if commonDir == "" {
485			err := fmt.Errorf("Git common directory is empty")
486			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
487		}
488		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
489		if err != nil {
490			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
491		}
492		return canonical, nil
493	}
494	
495	func enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx context.Context, checkouts []RepoCheckout, limiter *Limiter) {
496		if limiter == nil {
497			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
498		}
499		var wg sync.WaitGroup
500		for i := range checkouts {
501			if checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare || checkouts[i].Worktree.Prunable || !checkouts[i].Exists {
502				continue
503			}
504			wg.Add(1)
505			go func(index int) {
506				defer wg.Done()
507				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
508				if !ok {
509					checkouts[index].StatusErr = ctx.Err()
510					return
511				}
512				defer release()
513				checkout := &checkouts[index]
514				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
515				checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(
516					ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status,
517				)
518			}(i)
519		}
520		wg.Wait()
521	}
522	
523	func assignHarnessEvidence(out *RepoContext) {
524		mainRoot := ""
525		for i := range out.Checkouts {
526			if out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Main && !out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare {
527				mainRoot = out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path
528				break
529			}
530		}
531		if mainRoot == "" {
532			return
533		}
534		for i := range out.Checkouts {
535			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
536			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
537				continue
538			}
539			evidence, ok := DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(mainRoot, checkout.Worktree.Path)
540			if !ok {
541				continue
542			}
543			checkout.HarnessEvidence = &evidence
544			checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
545				Kind: OwnershipEvidenceClaudeHarness, Path: evidence.Root,
546			})
547		}
548	}
549	
550	// IsEphemeralWorktree is the legacy broad display heuristic. Its branch-prefix
551	// compatibility is retained for existing adopters, but authoritative topology
552	// uses DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree: a worktree-* branch alone is not ownership
553	// evidence.
554	func IsEphemeralWorktree(path, branch string) bool {
555		slashPath := filepath.ToSlash(path)
556		return strings.Contains(slashPath, "/.claude/worktrees/") ||
557			strings.HasPrefix(branch, "worktree-")
558	}
559	
560	func linkedAdminCount(commonDir string) int {
561		if commonDir == "" {
562			return 0
563		}
564		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(commonDir, "worktrees"))
565		if err != nil {
566			return 0
567		}
568		n := 0
569		for _, entry := range entries {
570			if entry.IsDir() {
571				n++
572			}
573		}
574		return n
575	}
576	
577	func pathIsDir(path string) bool {
578		info, err := os.Stat(path)
579		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
580	}
581	
582	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
583		latest := status.LatestChange
584		var commit time.Time
585		var subject string
586		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
587			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
588			if commit.After(latest) {
589				latest = commit
590			}
591			subject = lastSubject
592		}
593		return latest, commit, subject
594	}
595	
596	func assignTasksWithoutTopology(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
597		for _, tracked := range sortedUniqueTasks(tasks) {
598			binding := TaskBinding{
599				Task: tracked, Kind: TaskBindingUnbound,
600				ConflictReasons: []TopologyReason{{
601					Code:   ReasonWorktreeInventoryUnavailable,
602					Detail: "registered worktrees could not be observed",
603				}},
604			}
605			out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, tracked)
606			out.OtherTaskBindings = append(out.OtherTaskBindings, binding)
607		}
608	}
609	
610	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
611		paths := map[string][]int{}
612		branches := map[string][]int{}
613		mainIndex := -1
614		for i := range out.Checkouts {
615			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
616			if checkout.ID != "" {
617				paths[checkout.ID] = append(paths[checkout.ID], i)
618			}
619			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" && !checkout.Worktree.Bare {
620				branches[branch] = append(branches[branch], i)
621			}
622			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
623				mainIndex = i
624			}
625		}
626	
627		for _, tracked := range sortedUniqueTasks(tasks) {
628			binding := TaskBinding{Task: tracked, Kind: TaskBindingUnbound}
629			mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
630			var recordedPathIssue *TopologyReason
631			if tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
632				canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(tracked.WorktreePath)
633				if err != nil {
634					reason := TopologyReason{Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: err.Error()}
635					recordedPathIssue = &reason
636				} else if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
637					if matches := paths[canonical]; len(matches) > 0 {
638						if len(matches) == 1 {
639							binding.Kind = TaskBindingExactPath
640							bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
641							continue
642						}
643						reason := TopologyReason{
644							Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
645							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s path matches %d registered checkout records", tracked.ID, len(matches)),
646						}
647						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
648						for _, index := range matches {
649							out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
650						}
651						appendOtherTask(out, binding)
652						continue
653					}
654				}
655				if mode != task.ModeWorktree {
656					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
657						Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
658						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
659							mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
660					})
661				}
662			}
663	
664			if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
665				matches := branches[tracked.Branch]
666				switch len(matches) {
667				case 1:
668					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMovedPath
669					binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, movedPathReason(tracked, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
670					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
671						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
672					}
673					bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
674					continue
675				case 0:
676					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
677						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
678					}
679					if tracked.WorktreePath != "" || taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
680						binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
681							Code:   ReasonWorktreePathMissing,
682							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no registered checkout for branch %s", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch),
683						})
684					}
685				default:
686					reason := TopologyReason{
687						Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
688						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s branch %s matches %d registered checkouts", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, len(matches)),
689					}
690					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
691					for _, index := range matches {
692						out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
693					}
694				}
695				appendOtherTask(out, binding)
696				continue
697			}
698	
699			if mainIndex >= 0 {
700				main := out.Checkouts[mainIndex]
701				if checkoutActionable(main) && main.Branch() == tracked.Branch {
702					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMainBranch
703					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
704						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
705					}
706					bindTask(out, mainIndex, annotateBoundTask(binding, main))
707					continue
708				}
709			}
710	
711			if recordedPathIssue != nil {
712				binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
713			}
714			for _, index := range branches[tracked.Branch] {
715				if index == mainIndex {
716					continue
717				}
718				reason := TopologyReason{
719					Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
720					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s branch is checked out outside Git main at %s",
721						mode, tracked.ID, out.Checkouts[index].Worktree.Path),
722				}
723				binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
724				out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
725			}
726			if taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
727				detail := fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s in Git main", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch)
728				switch {
729				case mainIndex < 0:
730					detail += ", but no Git main record exists"
731				case !checkoutActionable(out.Checkouts[mainIndex]):
732					detail += ", but Git main is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable"
733				default:
734					detail += fmt.Sprintf(", which is on %s", displayBranch(out.Checkouts[mainIndex]))
735				}
736				binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
737					Code: ReasonMainBranchMismatch, Detail: detail,
738				})
739			}
740			appendOtherTask(out, binding)
741		}
742	
743		finalizeCheckoutClaims(out)
744	}
745	
746	func sortedUniqueTasks(tasks []*task.Task) []*task.Task {
747		ordered := append([]*task.Task(nil), tasks...)
748		sort.SliceStable(ordered, func(i, j int) bool {
749			if ordered[i] == nil {
750				return false
751			}
752			if ordered[j] == nil {
753				return true
754			}
755			return ordered[i].ID < ordered[j].ID
756		})
757		seen := map[string]bool{}
758		out := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(ordered))
759		for _, tracked := range ordered {
760			if tracked == nil {
761				continue
762			}
763			if tracked.ID != "" && seen[tracked.ID] {
764				continue
765			}
766			if tracked.ID != "" {
767				seen[tracked.ID] = true
768			}
769			out = append(out, tracked)
770		}
771		return out
772	}
773	
774	func movedPathReason(tracked *task.Task, checkout RepoCheckout) TopologyReason {
775		if tracked.WorktreePath == "" {
776			return TopologyReason{
777				Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
778				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no recorded worktree path; branch %s is registered at %s",
779					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
780			}
781		}
782		return TopologyReason{
783			Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
784			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s records %s; branch %s is registered at %s",
785				tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
786		}
787	}
788	
789	func annotateBoundTask(binding TaskBinding, checkout RepoCheckout) TaskBinding {
790		tracked := binding.Task
791		if tracked == nil {
792			return binding
793		}
794		if !checkoutActionable(checkout) {
795			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
796				Code: ReasonCheckoutUnavailable,
797				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout %s is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable",
798					checkout.Worktree.Path),
799			})
800		}
801		if checkout.Branch() != tracked.Branch {
802			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
803				Code: ReasonBranchMismatch,
804				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s; registered checkout is on %s",
805					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, displayBranch(checkout)),
806			})
807		}
808		mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
809		switch {
810		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && checkout.Worktree.Main:
811			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
812				Code:   ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
813				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("worktree task %s resolved to Git main", tracked.ID),
814			})
815		case mode != task.ModeWorktree && !checkout.Worktree.Main:
816			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
817				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
818				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s resolved to linked worktree %s",
819					mode, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
820			})
821		}
822		if mode != task.ModeWorktree && tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
823			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
824				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
825				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
826					mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
827			})
828		}
829		if !taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
830			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
831				Code: ReasonUnexpectedCheckout,
832				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s still has registered checkout %s",
833					tracked.State, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
834			})
835		}
836		return binding
837	}
838	
839	func taskExpectsCheckout(tracked *task.Task) bool {
840		if tracked == nil || tracked.State == task.Cold {
841			return false
842		}
843		if tracked.State == task.Done && tracked.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
844			return tracked.WorktreePath != ""
845		}
846		return true
847	}
848	
849	func checkoutActionable(checkout RepoCheckout) bool {
850		return !checkout.Worktree.Bare && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable && checkout.Exists && checkout.StatusErr == nil
851	}
852	
853	func bindTask(out *RepoContext, index int, binding TaskBinding) {
854		checkout := &out.Checkouts[index]
855		binding.CheckoutID = checkout.ID
856		checkout.TaskBindings = append(checkout.TaskBindings, binding)
857		checkout.Tasks = append(checkout.Tasks, binding.Task)
858		if binding.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
859			checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
860				Kind: OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask, Path: checkout.ID,
861				TaskID: binding.Task.ID, Owner: binding.Task.Owner,
862			})
863		}
864	}
865	
866	func appendOtherTask(out *RepoContext, binding TaskBinding) {
867		out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, binding.Task)
868		out.OtherTaskBindings = append(out.OtherTaskBindings, binding)
869	}
870	
871	func finalizeCheckoutClaims(out *RepoContext) {
872		for i := range out.Checkouts {
873			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
874			sort.SliceStable(checkout.TaskBindings, func(a, b int) bool {
875				return checkout.TaskBindings[a].Task.ID < checkout.TaskBindings[b].Task.ID
876			})
877			sort.SliceStable(checkout.Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
878				return checkout.Tasks[a].ID < checkout.Tasks[b].ID
879			})
880			if len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 1 {
881				ids := make([]string, len(checkout.TaskBindings))
882				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
883					ids[j] = checkout.TaskBindings[j].Task.ID
884				}
885				reason := TopologyReason{
886					Code:   ReasonMultipleTaskClaims,
887					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout is claimed by tasks %s", strings.Join(ids, ", ")),
888				}
889				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
890				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
891					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
892						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
893					)
894				}
895			}
896			if checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil && len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 0 {
897				reason := TopologyReason{
898					Code: ReasonHarnessTaskConflict,
899					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("checkout has Claude harness evidence and %d managed task claim(s)",
900						len(checkout.TaskBindings)),
901				}
902				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
903				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
904					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
905						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
906					)
907				}
908			}
909			for _, binding := range checkout.TaskBindings {
910				for _, reason := range binding.DriftReasons {
911					checkout.DriftReasons = appendReason(checkout.DriftReasons, reason)
912				}
913				for _, reason := range binding.ConflictReasons {
914					checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
915				}
916			}
917			checkout.Ownership = displayOwnership(*checkout)
918		}
919	}
920	
921	func displayOwnership(checkout RepoCheckout) CheckoutOwnership {
922		if checkout.Worktree.Main {
923			return CheckoutCanonical
924		}
925		if checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil {
926			return CheckoutEphemeral
927		}
928		for _, evidence := range checkout.OwnershipEvidence {
929			if evidence.Kind == OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask {
930				return CheckoutDev
931			}
932		}
933		return CheckoutExternal
934	}
935	
936	func appendReason(reasons []TopologyReason, candidate TopologyReason) []TopologyReason {
937		for _, reason := range reasons {
938			if reason.Code == candidate.Code && reason.Detail == candidate.Detail {
939				return reasons
940			}
941		}
942		return append(reasons, candidate)
943	}
944	
945	func finishRepoContext(out *RepoContext) {
946		for _, checkout := range out.Checkouts {
947			if checkout.LastActivity.After(out.LastActivity) {
948				out.LastActivity = checkout.LastActivity
949			}
950			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
951				if tracked.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
952					out.LastActivity = tracked.Updated
953				}
954			}
955		}
956		for _, tracked := range out.OtherTasks {
957			if tracked.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
958				out.LastActivity = tracked.Updated
959			}
960		}
961	
962		out.Rows = make([]RepoContextRow, 0, len(out.Checkouts)+len(out.OtherTaskBindings))
963		for i := range out.Checkouts {
964			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
965			out.Rows = append(out.Rows, RepoContextRow{
966				ID: checkout.ID, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
967				Kind: RepoContextRowCheckout, CheckoutIndex: i, Checkout: checkout,
968				DriftReasons:        append([]TopologyReason(nil), checkout.DriftReasons...),
969				ConflictReasons:     append([]TopologyReason(nil), checkout.ConflictReasons...),
970				WorktreeObservation: out.WorktreeObservation,
971				RuntimeObservation:  out.RuntimeObservation,
972			})
973		}
974		for _, binding := range out.OtherTaskBindings {
975			out.Rows = append(out.Rows, RepoContextRow{
976				ID: binding.Task.ID, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
977				Kind: RepoContextRowTask, CheckoutIndex: -1,
978				Task: binding.Task, Binding: binding,
979				DriftReasons:        append([]TopologyReason(nil), binding.DriftReasons...),
980				ConflictReasons:     append([]TopologyReason(nil), binding.ConflictReasons...),
981				WorktreeObservation: out.WorktreeObservation,
982				RuntimeObservation:  out.RuntimeObservation,
983			})
984		}
985	}
986	
987	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
988	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
989	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
990	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
991		for _, session := range sessions {
992			assigned := map[int]bool{}
993			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
994				best, bestLen := -1, -1
995				for i := range out.Checkouts {
996					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Checkouts[i]) {
997						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(normalizePath(root)) > bestLen {
998							best, bestLen = i, len(normalizePath(root))
999						}
1000					}
1001				}

1016	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
1017		if root == "" || path == "" {
1018			return false
1019		}
1020		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
1021		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
1022			return false
1023		}
1024		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
1025	}
1026	
1027	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
1028	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
1029	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
1030	// is not sufficient.
1031	func normalizePath(path string) string {
1032		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
1033			return canonical
1034		}
1035		return filepath.Clean(path)
1036	}

1038	// FormatRepoContext renders the deterministic Markdown used by both the CLI
1039	// and the TUI's yy binding. checkoutIndex < 0 means the whole repository.
1040	func FormatRepoContext(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
1041		var b strings.Builder
1042		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
1043			checkout := c.Checkouts[checkoutIndex]
1044			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev worktree context: %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout))
1045			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, false)
1046			return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
1047		}
1048	
1049		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev repo context: %s\n\n", c.Repo.Display())
1050		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Repository: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Display())
1051		mainPath := c.Repo.Path
1052		if main, ok := c.Main(); ok {
1053			mainPath = main.Worktree.Path
1054		}
1055		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Main path: `%s`\n", mainPath)
1056		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Linked worktrees: %d\n", c.WorktreeCount)
1057		if c.Runtime != "" && c.Runtime != "none" {
1058			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime: `%s`\n", c.Runtime)
1059		}
1060		if c.WorktreeErr != nil {
1061			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Worktree inventory error: %s\n", c.WorktreeErr)
1062		}
1063		b.WriteString("\n## Checkouts\n")
1064		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
1065			b.WriteString("\n")
1066			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, checkout.Worktree.Main)
1067		}
1068		if len(c.OtherTasks) > 0 {
1069			b.WriteString("\n## Other tracked tasks\n\n")
1070			if len(c.OtherTaskBindings) > 0 {
1071				for _, binding := range c.OtherTaskBindings {
1072					writeTaskMarkdown(&b, binding.Task)
1073					writeTopologyReasons(&b, binding.DriftReasons, binding.ConflictReasons)
1074				}
1075			} else {
1076				for _, tracked := range c.OtherTasks {
1077					writeTaskMarkdown(&b, tracked)
1078				}
1079			}
1080		}
1081		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
1082	}

1084	func writeCheckoutMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, c RepoContext, checkout RepoCheckout, canonical bool) {
1085		label := string(checkout.Ownership)
1086		if canonical {
1087			label = "canonical"
1088		}
1089		fmt.Fprintf(b, "### %s — %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout), label)
1090		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Path: `%s`\n", checkout.Worktree.Path)
1091		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Branch: `%s`\n", displayBranch(checkout))
1092		if checkout.Worktree.Bare {
1093			b.WriteString("- Git: bare repository\n")
1094		} else if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
1095			b.WriteString("- Git: unavailable (checkout path is missing)\n")
1096		} else if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
1097			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.StatusErr)
1098		} else {
1099			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: %s", checkout.Status.Summary())
1100			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
1101				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", checkout.Status.Breakdown())
1102			}
1103			b.WriteString("\n")
1104			if checkout.Status.Upstream != "" {
1105				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Upstream: `%s`\n", checkout.Status.Upstream)
1106			} else {
1107				b.WriteString("- Upstream: not published\n")
1108			}
1109		}
1110		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
1111			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)
1112			if reason == "" {
1113				reason = "no reason recorded"
1114			}
1115			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: locked — %s\n", reason)
1116		}
1117		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
1118			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)
1119			if reason == "" {
1120				reason = "checkout path is missing"
1121			}
1122			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: prunable — %s\n", reason)
1123		}
1124		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
1125			b.WriteString("- Runtime: closed\n")
1126		} else {
1127			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
1128				status := session.AgentStatus
1129				if status == "" {
1130					status = "unknown"
1131				}
1132				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: `%s %s` (%s)\n", c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
1133				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
1134					fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Agent sessions: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
1135				}
1136			}
1137		}
1138		if len(checkout.Tasks) == 0 {
1139			b.WriteString("- Task: untracked\n")
1140		} else {
1141			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
1142				writeTaskMarkdown(b, tracked)
1143			}
1144		}
1145		writeTopologyReasons(b, checkout.DriftReasons, checkout.ConflictReasons)
1146	}
1147	
1148	func writeTopologyReasons(b *strings.Builder, drift, conflicts []TopologyReason) {
1149		for _, reason := range drift {
1150			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Drift: `%s` — %s\n", reason.Code, reason.Detail)
1151		}
1152		for _, reason := range conflicts {
1153			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Conflict: `%s` — %s\n", reason.Code, reason.Detail)
1154		}
1155	}

1157	func writeTaskMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, tracked *task.Task) {
1158		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: `%s` — %s", tracked.ID, tracked.State)
1159		if tracked.Next != "" {
1160			fmt.Fprintf(b, "; next: %s", tracked.Next)
1161		}
1162		b.WriteString("\n")
1163		if tracked.AgentSession != "" {
1164			fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Recorded agent: `%s`\n", tracked.AgentSession)
1165		}
1166	}

1168	func displayBranch(checkout RepoCheckout) string {
1169		if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
1170			return branch
1171		}
1172		if checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached {
1173			return "(detached HEAD)"
1174		}
1175		return "(unknown branch)"
1176	}

1178	func markdownCodes(values []string) string {

1181			quoted = append(quoted, "`"+value+"`")
1182		}
1183		return strings.Join(quoted, ", ")

657	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectIntegrationTarget(
658		ctx context.Context,
659		observed *lifecycleObservation,
660	) (completionIntegrationObservation, error) {
661		var fresh completionIntegrationObservation
662		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
663		fresh.worktree, fresh.worktreeErr = registered, err
664		if err != nil {
665			return fresh, err
666		}
667		fresh.worktreeFound = true
668		if registered.Path != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
669			!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare {
670			return fresh, errors.New("integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout")
671		}
672		fresh.status, fresh.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
673		if fresh.statusErr != nil {
674			return fresh, fresh.statusErr
675		}
676		if fresh.status.Dirty() || fresh.status.Conflicted > 0 {
677			return fresh, fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout is not clean: %s", fresh.status.Breakdown())
678		}
679		fresh.head, fresh.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
680		if fresh.headErr != nil {
681			return fresh, fresh.headErr
682		}
683		fresh.head = strings.TrimSpace(fresh.head)
684		if registered.Worktree.Head != fresh.head {
685			return fresh, errors.New("canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD")
686		}
687		fresh.operation, fresh.inProgress, fresh.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
688		if fresh.operationErr != nil {
689			return fresh, fresh.operationErr
690		}
691		if fresh.inProgress {
692			return fresh, errors.New("canonical integration checkout has Git operation " + fresh.operation + " in progress")
693		}
694		fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
695			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
696			CallerWorkspaceID: observed.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
697			CallerPaneID:      observed.taskflowCallerPane,
698		})
699		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr); occupancyErr != nil {
700			return fresh, occupancyErr
701		}
702		return fresh, nil
703	}

754	) (bool, error) {
755		baseOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef)
756		if err != nil {
757			return false, err
758		}
759		if baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {
760			return false, staleBoundary("verification base ref moved from its approved OID")
761		}
762		proofOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofRef)
763		if err != nil {
764			return false, err
765		}
766		if proofOID != observed.proofOID {
767			return false, staleBoundary("verification proof ref moved from its expected OID")
768		}
769		contained, err := s.isAncestor(ctx, observed.repoPath, proofOID, baseOID)
770		if err != nil {
771			return false, err
772		}
773		observed.proofContained = contained
774		observed.proofErr = nil
775		return contained, nil
776	}
777	
778	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateVerifiedCompletion(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
779		if err := s.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
780			return err
781		}
782		contained, err := s.revalidateMergeProof(ctx, observed)
783		if err != nil {
784			return err
785		}
786		if !contained {
787			return errors.New("exact merge proof is no longer contained in the selected base")
788		}
789		return nil
790	}
