133	// Worktrees lists every worktree of the repository containing dir, in git's
134	// own order: the main checkout first, then linked worktrees.
135	func Worktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]Worktree, error) {
136		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		var (
141			list []Worktree
142			cur  *Worktree
143		)
144		flush := func() {
145			if cur != nil {
146				list = append(list, *cur)
147				cur = nil
148			}
149		}
150		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
151			if line == "" { // records are blank-line separated
152				flush()
153				continue
154			}
155			key, val, _ := strings.Cut(line, " ")
156			switch key {
157			case "worktree":
158				flush()
159				cur = &Worktree{Path: val, Main: len(list) == 0}
160			case "HEAD":
161				if cur != nil {
162					cur.Head = val
163				}
164			case "branch":
165				if cur != nil {
166					cur.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(val, "refs/heads/")
167				}
168			case "detached":
169				if cur != nil {
170					cur.Detached = true
171				}
172			case "bare":
173				if cur != nil {
174					cur.Bare = true
175				}
176			case "locked":
177				if cur != nil {
178					cur.Locked, cur.LockedReason = true, val
179				}
180			case "prunable":
181				if cur != nil {
182					cur.Prunable, cur.PrunableReason = true, val
183				}
184			}
185		}
186		flush()
187		return list, nil
188	}
189	
190	// WorktreeFor finds the first worktree checked out on branch, if any. Git
191	// normally refuses duplicate branch checkouts, but --force can create them;
192	// identity-sensitive callers must use ResolveRegisteredWorktree instead.
193	func WorktreeFor(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) (Worktree, bool, error) {
194		list, err := Worktrees(ctx, dir)
195		if err != nil {
196			return Worktree{}, false, err
197		}
198		for _, w := range list {
199			if w.Branch == branch {
200				return w, true, nil
201			}
202		}
203		return Worktree{}, false, nil
204	}
205	
206	// AddWorktree creates a linked worktree at path.
207	//
208	// When branch already exists it is checked out; otherwise it is created from
209	// base. Passing an explicit base matters: without one git branches from the
210	// *current* HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on feature/A would
211	// silently inherit feature/A's commits.
212	func AddWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path, branch, base string) error {
213		exists := BranchExists(ctx, dir, branch)
214		args := []string{"worktree", "add"}
215		if exists {
216			args = append(args, path, branch)
217		} else {
218			args = append(args, "-b", branch, path)
219			if base != "" {
220				args = append(args, base)
221			}
222		}
223		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
224		return err
225	}
226	
227	// MoveWorktree relocates a linked worktree through Git so the shared
228	// administrative metadata keeps pointing at the checkout's new path. dir may
229	// be any checkout of the same repository.
230	func MoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, source, destination string) error {
231		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "move", source, destination)
232		return err
233	}
234	
235	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
236	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
237	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
238		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
239		if err != nil {
240			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current directory before removing worktree: %w", err)
241		}
242		inside, err := pathx.Contains(path, cwd)
243		if err != nil {
244			return fmt.Errorf("compare current directory with worktree %s: %w", path, err)
245		}
246		if inside {
247			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to remove worktree %s while the caller is inside it", path)
248		}
249		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
250		if force {
251			args = append(args, "--force")
252		}
253		args = append(args, path)
254		_, err = run(ctx, dir, args...)
255		return err
256	}
257	
258	// PruneWorktrees clears administrative entries for checkouts whose directories
259	// were deleted behind git's back.
260	func PruneWorktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {
261		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "prune")
262		return err
263	}
264	
265	// BranchExists reports whether a local branch of that name exists.
266	func BranchExists(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) bool {
267		if branch == "" {
268			return false
269		}
270		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+branch)
271		return err == nil
272	}
273	
274	// RefExists reports whether any ref or commit-ish resolves.
275	func RefExists(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) bool {
276		if ref == "" {
277			return false
278		}
279		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")
280		return err == nil
281	}

34	Run this from outside the target worktree and runtime. dev re-resolves every
35	covering session, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, waits for
36	runtime closure, revalidates Git state, and only then removes a linked worktree
37	without force. A task is deleted only after every requested cleanup step works.

67	func resolveRetireCommandTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (retireCommandTarget, error) {
68		if len(args) == 1 {
69			expanded := config.Expand(args[0])
70			if info, statErr := os.Stat(expanded); statErr == nil && info.IsDir() {
71				return retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx, app, expanded)
72			}
73			candidate, err := app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
74			if err != nil {
75				return retireCommandTarget{}, err
76			}
77			return retireCommandTarget{Task: candidate}, nil
78		}
79	
80		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
81		if err != nil {
82			return retireCommandTarget{}, err
83		}
84		return retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx, app, cwd)
85	}

87	func retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx context.Context, app *App, path string) (retireCommandTarget, error) {
88		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
89		if err != nil {
90			return retireCommandTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
91		}
92		candidate, err := exactTaskForRetirementCheckout(app, repository.Root)
93		if err != nil {
94			return retireCommandTarget{}, err
95		}
96		if candidate != nil {
97			return retireCommandTarget{Task: candidate}, nil
98		}
99		return retireCommandTarget{Path: repository.Root}, nil
100	}

102	func exactTaskForRetirementCheckout(app *App, checkout string) (*task.Task, error) {
103		canonicalCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize retirement checkout %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
106		}
107		records, _, err := app.Tasks.ListRecords()
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111		var matched *task.Task
112		for _, record := range records {
113			candidate := record.Task
114			if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == "" {
115				// A COLD/DONE worktree task with no checkout does not claim the
116				// canonical repository merely because checkoutOf falls back there.
117				continue
118			}
119			candidateCheckout, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(checkoutOf(&candidate))
120			if canonicalErr != nil || candidateCheckout != canonicalCheckout {
121				continue
122			}
123			if matched != nil {
124				return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkout %s is claimed by multiple tasks (%s, %s); name one explicitly or reconcile task metadata",
125					config.Contract(canonicalCheckout), matched.ID, candidate.ID)
126			}
127			matched = &candidate
128		}
129		return matched, nil
130	}
131	
132	func retireTaskWithTaskflow(
133		ctx context.Context,
134		app *App,
135		selected *task.Task,
136		options flow.RetireOptions,
137		authorizeBranchDeletion bool,
138	) error {
139		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) { return selected, nil })
140		if err != nil {
141			return err
142		}
143		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
144		if err != nil {
145			return err
146		}
147		approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
148		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
149			if !authorizeBranchDeletion {
150				return fmt.Errorf("%s requires its exact typed confirmation", plan.Summary)
151			}
152			approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
153		}
154		result, applyErr := session.apply(ctx, plan, approval)
155		if applyErr != nil {
156			renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
157			return presentLifecycleApplyError(plan, applyErr)
158		}
159		if err := session.requireRetired(app, result); err != nil {
160			return err
161		}
162	
163		style := app.outStyle()
164		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", style.success("RETIRED"), config.Contract(checkoutOf(selected)))
165		renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
166		return nil
167	}
168	
169	// retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility preserves the contained-only path contract
170	// while routing every mutation through taskflow's exact unmanaged transaction.
171	func retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility(
172		ctx context.Context,
173		app *App,
174		path string,
175		closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranch bool,
176		timeout time.Duration,
177	) error {
178		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
179		if err != nil {
180			return fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
181		}
182		if !repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
183			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a linked worktree; retire explicit paths only from their linked checkout", config.Contract(path))
184		}
185		locator, err := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, repository.Root)
186		if err != nil {
187			return err
188		}
189		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.MainRoot)
190		if base == "" {
191			return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove unmanaged retirement without an explicit repository default branch")
192		}
193		execution, err := executeNonTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
194			RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base, DeleteContainedBranch: deleteBranch,
195			CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
196		}, deleteBranch)
197		if err != nil {
198			return err
199		}
200		if execution.Result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneNone {
201			return fmt.Errorf("unmanaged retirement returned unexpected milestone %s", execution.Result.Milestone)
202		}
203		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", app.outStyle().success("RETIRED"), config.Contract(locator.CheckoutPath))
204		return nil
205	}

22	// suggestion is one proposed change, with the reason and the exact effect.
23	type suggestion struct {

25		action string
26		reason string
27		// apply performs the change. nil means "report only".
28		apply func() error
29	}

31	type sweepRetireOptions struct {

37	func newSweepCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
38		var (
39			apply           bool
40			staleDays       int
41			yes             bool
42			mergedWorktrees bool
43			baseRef         string
44			closeUnknown    bool
45			assumeNoRuntime bool
46			deleteBranches  bool
47		)
48		cmd := &cobra.Command{
49			Use:   "sweep",
50			Short: "Review stale tasks and drifted state, and act on them",
51			Long: `Show which tasks have gone stale or drifted, and what dev would do about it.
52	
53	Cleanup usually fails not because people are unwilling but because there is no
54	trustworthy way to be sure the work is recoverable. So sweep reports first and
55	only changes things with --apply, confirming each one unless you pass --yes.
56	Nothing here ever deletes uncommitted work.`,
57			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
58			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
59				ctx := ctxOf()
60				style := app.outStyle()
61				tasks, err := app.Tasks.List()
62				if err != nil {
63					return err
64				}
65				rt := app.Runtime()
66				rows := inventory.Collect(ctx, tasks, rt, inventory.Options{})
67				stale := time.Duration(staleDays) * 24 * time.Hour
68				retireOptions := sweepRetireOptions{
69					closeUnknown: closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranches: deleteBranches,
70				}
71	
72				var sugg []suggestion
73				if mergedWorktrees {
74					merged, err := suggestMergedWorktrees(app, ctx, rows, baseRef, retireOptions)
75					if err != nil {
76						return err
77					}
78					sugg = append(sugg, merged...)
79				} else {
80					for _, r := range rows {
81						sugg = append(sugg, suggestFor(app, ctx, r, stale, retireOptions)...)
82					}
83				}
84	
85				// Live sessions no task claims: the other half of a crowded sidebar.
86				if !mergedWorktrees {
87					if sessions, err := rt.List(ctx); err == nil {
88						if orphans := inventory.Orphans(sessions, rows); len(orphans) > 0 {
89							fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%d live session(s) with no task recorded:\n", len(orphans))
90							for _, s := range orphans {
91								dir := "—"
92								if len(s.Dirs) > 0 {
93									dir = config.Contract(s.Dirs[0])
94								}
95								fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %-24s %s\n", truncate(s.Label, 24), style.dim(dir))
96							}
97							fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("  → `dev start` in one of those directories to track it, or just close it."))
98						}
99					}
100				}
101	
102				if len(sugg) == 0 {
103					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.success("\nNothing to sweep")+" — no task drift or eligible merged worktree was found.")
104					return nil
105				}
106	
107				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%s\n\n", style.title(fmt.Sprintf("%d suggestion(s):", len(sugg))))
108				for _, s := range sugg {
109					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %-28s %s\n", s.row.Task.State.Icon(),
110						truncate(s.row.Task.Title(), 28), style.warning(s.reason))
111					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "     → %s\n", s.action)
112				}
113	
114				if !apply {
115					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nRe-run with --apply to act on these (each is confirmed individually)."))
116					return nil
117				}
118	
119				in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
120				for _, s := range sugg {
121					if s.apply == nil {
122						continue
123					}
124					if !yes && !confirm(app, in, s.action) {
125						continue
126					}
127					if err := s.apply(); err != nil {
128						app.warnf("%s: %v", s.row.Task.ID, err)
129						continue

131					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s\n", style.success("done:"), s.action)
132				}
133				return nil
134			},
135		}
136		f := cmd.Flags()
137		f.BoolVar(&apply, "apply", false, "act on the suggestions instead of only reporting")
138		f.IntVar(&staleDays, "stale-days", 14, "days without a commit before a task counts as stale")
139		f.BoolVar(&yes, "yes", false, "with --apply, do not confirm each change")
140		f.BoolVar(&mergedWorktrees, "merged-worktrees", false, "focus on linked worktrees whose branches are contained in the main branch")
141		f.StringVar(&baseRef, "base", "", "containment base for --merged-worktrees (default: the repository default branch)")
142		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow external closure of unknown runtime status during retirement")
143		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails during retirement")
144		f.BoolVar(&deleteBranches, "delete-branches", false, "also delete contained local branches after worktree retirement")
145		return cmd
146	}

148	func suggestFor(app *App, ctx context.Context, r inventory.Row, stale time.Duration, retireOptions sweepRetireOptions) []suggestion {
149		t := r.Task
150		var out []suggestion
151		current, currentErr := app.Tasks.GetRecord(t.ID)
152		if currentErr != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(current.Task, *t) {
153			detail := "task changed after the sweep inventory snapshot"
154			if currentErr != nil {
155				detail = "task could not be reloaded after the sweep inventory snapshot: " + currentErr.Error()
156			}
157			return []suggestion{{
158				row: r, reason: detail,
159				action: "rerun sweep to inspect the current task revision — not changed automatically",
160			}}
161		}
162		revision := current.Revision
163	
164		// A task whose repository is gone cannot be finished, resumed, parked or
165		// retired: every one of those resolves the repository first, and `dev done`
166		// refuses outright once the checkout is missing. Nothing else in this
167		// function reaches it either — the dead-branch rule below excludes direct
168		// mode, and the stale-worktree rule needs a recorded worktree path. Left
169		// alone, the record is unreachable by any command in the binary.
170		//
171		// Reaping removes dev's record of intent and nothing else; the branch, the
172		// commits and the remote are untouched. A live session proves the directory
173		// is there, so it is the one condition that rules this out.
174		if t.RepoPath != "" && !r.Live() && !dirExists(t.RepoPath) {
175			out = append(out, suggestion{
176				row:    r,
177				reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository %s no longer exists", config.Contract(t.RepoPath)),
178				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s (Git keeps any work; this drops only dev's record)", t.ID),
179				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
180			})
181			return out
182		}
183	
184		out = append(out, orphanSuggestions(app, r)...)
185	
186		switch {
187		// A hot task with no live session is the commonest drift: the session was
188		// closed (or the machine rebooted) without parking.
189		case t.State == task.Hot && r.StateDrift() == "no live session":
190			reason := fmt.Sprintf("hot but no live session, idle %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
191			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkWarmOptions{})
192			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
193				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded warm parking is blocked",
194					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})
195				break
196			}
197			out = append(out, suggestion{
198				row: r, reason: reason, action: fmt.Sprintf("mark %s warm", t.ID),
199				apply: func() error {
200					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
201					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
202					return err
203				},
204			})
205	
206		// A warm task nobody has touched in weeks is a candidate for cold: keeping
207		// the worktree costs disk and clutters every listing.
208		case t.State == task.Warm && r.Age() > stale:
209			reason := fmt.Sprintf("warm and untouched for %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
210			if t.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
211				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but direct tasks cannot go cold",
212					action: "keep it warm or finish it — not changed automatically"})
213				break
214			}
215			if r.Status.Dirty() {
216				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but has uncommitted work",
217					action: "commit or `dev park --wip` before going cold — not changed automatically"})
218				break
219			}
220			if !r.Status.Synced() {
221				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + fmt.Sprintf(", not pushed (%s)", r.Status.Summary()),
222					action: fmt.Sprintf("push %s so it can go cold: dev park %s --cold --push", t.Branch, t.ID)})
223				break
224			}
225			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkColdOptions{})
226			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
227				detail := sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)
228				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded cold parking is blocked",
229					action: detail + " — not changed automatically"})
230				break
231			}
232			out = append(out, suggestion{
233				row:    r,
234				reason: reason + ", clean and pushed",
235				action: fmt.Sprintf("go cold: remove %s (branch and remote keep the work)", config.Contract(r.Checkout)),
236				apply: func() error {
237					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
238					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
239					return err
240				},
241			})
242	
243		// DONE means integrated; runtime/worktree cleanup is a separate,
244		// externally coordinated retirement step.
245		case t.State == task.Done:
246			action := fmt.Sprintf("retire runtime/worktree for %s", t.ID)
247			if retireOptions.deleteBranches && t.Branch != "" && t.Branch != t.Base {
248				action += fmt.Sprintf(" and delete %s", t.Branch)
249			}
250			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.RetireOptions{
251				CloseUnknown: retireOptions.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: retireOptions.assumeNoRuntime,
252				DeleteBranch: retireOptions.deleteBranches,
253			})
254			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
255				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: "merged, but guarded retirement is blocked",
256					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})
257				break
258			}
259			out = append(out, suggestion{
260				row: r, reason: "merged, cleanup pending", action: action,
261				apply: func() error {
262					approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
263					if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
264						approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
265					}
266					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, approval)
267					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
268					return err
269				},
270			})
271		}
272	
273		// A branch-backed task whose branch git no longer has is dead: the branch
274		// was deleted after integration, so the record holds intent for work that
275		// no longer exists anywhere. It cannot be finished, resumed, or retired,
276		// because every one of those paths resolves the branch first.
277		noCheckout := t.WorktreePath == "" || r.WorktreeMissing
278		if noCheckout && t.Branch != "" && t.RepoPath != "" &&
279			t.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeDirect && !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, t.RepoPath, t.Branch) {
280			out = append(out, suggestion{
281				row:    r,
282				reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch %s no longer exists", t.Branch),
283				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s", t.ID),
284				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
285			})
286			return out
287		}
288	
289		// A cold task keeps no checkout by definition: that is what going cold
290		// means. One still on disk is drift inventory already reports and nothing
291		// could act on.
292		if t.State == task.Cold && t.WorktreePath != "" && r.CheckoutExists && !r.WorktreeMissing &&
293			!r.Live() && !r.Status.Dirty() && r.Status.Synced() {
294			out = append(out, suggestion{
295				row:    r,
296				reason: "cold, but its worktree is still on disk",
297				action: fmt.Sprintf("reconcile %s with an exact guarded plan — not changed automatically", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
298			})
299		}
300	
301		// Drift that is independent of the lifecycle stage.
302		if r.WorktreeMissing && t.WorktreePath != "" {
303			wtPath := t.WorktreePath
304			out = append(out, suggestion{
305				row:    r,
306				reason: "records a worktree that git no longer knows about",
307				action: fmt.Sprintf("inspect repository-wide prune scope before clearing %s — not changed automatically", config.Contract(wtPath)),
308			})
309		}
310		return out
311	}

313	func sweepTaskPlan(ctx context.Context, app *App, id string, options flow.ActionOptions) (lifecycleSession, flow.Plan, error) {
314		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
315			return app.Tasks.Get(id)
316		})
317		if err != nil {
318			return lifecycleSession{}, flow.Plan{}, err
319		}
320		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
321		return session, plan, err
322	}
323	
324	func sweepPlanBlocker(plan flow.Plan, err error) string {
325		if err != nil {
326			return err.Error()
327		}
328		var parts []string
329		for _, condition := range append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...) {
330			parts = append(parts, string(condition.Code)+": "+condition.Evidence)
331		}
332		if len(parts) == 0 {
333			return "guarded plan is " + string(plan.Availability)
334		}
335		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
336	}
337	
338	func sweepDeleteTask(ctx context.Context, store *task.Store, id, revision string) error {
339		if revision == "" {
340			return fmt.Errorf("task %s had no report-time revision; rerun sweep", id)
341		}
342		return store.DeleteIfRevision(ctx, id, revision)
343	}
344	
345	// dirExists reports whether path is a directory that can be read right now.
346	func dirExists(path string) bool {
347		info, err := os.Stat(path)
348		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
349	}
350	
351	// orphanSuggestions handles the residue of a worktree removed while its
352	// transcript writer was still running: the path exists, Git has no record of
353	// it, and it holds only agent artifacts. Removing it is offered only once every
354	// file in it is proven byte-identical to one the repository already has.
355	func orphanSuggestions(app *App, r inventory.Row) []suggestion {
356		t := r.Task
357		if t.WorktreePath == "" || !r.WorktreeMissing || !r.CheckoutExists {
358			return nil
359		}
360		orphan, ok, err := retirement.InspectOrphan(t.WorktreePath)
361		if err != nil || !ok {
362			return nil
363		}
364		unsalvaged, err := retirement.Unsalvaged(orphan, t.RepoPath)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil
367		}
368		if len(unsalvaged) > 0 {
369			return []suggestion{{
370				row: r,
371				reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace holding %d file(s) the repository does not have",
372					config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(unsalvaged)),
373				action: fmt.Sprintf("salvage %s first — not removed automatically", strings.Join(unsalvaged, ", ")),
374			}}
375		}
376		return []suggestion{{
377			row:    r,
378			reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace git does not know", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
379			action: fmt.Sprintf("remove the empty shell %s (its %d artifact file(s) are already in the repository)",
380				config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(orphan.Files)),
381			apply: func() error { return os.RemoveAll(t.WorktreePath) },
382		}}
383	}

385	func suggestMergedWorktrees(app *App, ctx context.Context, rows []inventory.Row, requestedBase string, options sweepRetireOptions) ([]suggestion, error) {
386		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, mustGetwd())
387		if err != nil {
388			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees requires a Git repository: %w", err)
389		}
390		if repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
391			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees must run from the canonical checkout, not linked worktree %s", config.Contract(repository.Root))
392		}
393		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, err
396		}
397		base := requestedBase
398		if base == "" {
399			base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.Root)
400			if status.Branch != base {
401				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees defaults to %s; switch the canonical checkout to it or pass --base explicitly", base)
402			}
403		}
404		if !gitx.RefExists(ctx, repository.Root, base) {
405			return nil, fmt.Errorf("merged-worktree base %s does not resolve to a commit", base)
406		}
407	
408		claimed := make(map[string]inventory.Row)
409		for _, row := range rows {
410			if row.Task == nil || row.Checkout == "" {
411				continue
412			}
413			canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(row.Checkout)
414			if canonicalErr == nil {
415				claimed[canonical] = row
416			}
417		}
418		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, repository.Root)
419		if err != nil {
420			return nil, err
421		}
422		var suggestions []suggestion
423		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
424			if worktree.Main || worktree.Bare || worktree.Detached || worktree.Branch == "" || worktree.Branch == base {
425				continue
426			}
427			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", worktree.Branch, base); err != nil {
428				continue
429			}
430			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
431			if err != nil {
432				continue
433			}
434			if row, ok := claimed[canonical]; ok {
435				if row.Task.State == task.Done {
436					suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestFor(app, ctx, row, 0, options)...)
437					continue
438				}
439				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
440					fmt.Sprintf("task is %s; verify integration with `dev done --merged` first", row.Task.State)))
441				continue
442			}
443	
444			displayTask := &task.Task{
445				ID: task.MakeID(repository.Name, worktree.Branch), Name: worktree.Branch,
446				Repo: repository.Name, RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, Branch: worktree.Branch,
447				Base: base, WorktreePath: canonical, Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done,
448			}
449			row := inventory.Row{Task: displayTask, Checkout: canonical, CheckoutExists: true}
450			if inventory.IsClaudeHarnessWorktree(repository.Root, canonical) {
451				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
452					"checkout is owned by the Claude harness"))
453				continue
454			}
455			locator, locateErr := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, canonical)
456			if locateErr != nil {
457				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, locateErr.Error()))
458				continue
459			}
460			service, serviceErr := newCLILifecycleService(app)
461			if serviceErr != nil {
462				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, serviceErr.Error()))
463				continue
464			}
465			request, requestErr := flow.NewRequest(locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
466				RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base,
467				DeleteContainedBranch: options.deleteBranches,
468				CloseUnknown:          options.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.assumeNoRuntime,
469			})
470			if requestErr != nil {
471				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, requestErr.Error()))
472				continue
473			}
474			plan, planErr := service.Plan(ctx, request)
475			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
476				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)))
477				continue
478			}
479			branch := worktree.Branch
480			action := fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s (branch %s kept)",
481				config.Contract(canonical), branch)
482			if options.deleteBranches {
483				action = fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s and delete contained branch %s",
484					config.Contract(canonical), branch)
485			}
486			suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestion{
487				row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("untracked worktree branch is contained in %s", base), action: action,
488				apply: func() error {
489					approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
490					if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
491						approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
492					}
493					result, err := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
494					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
495					return err
496				},
497			})
498		}
499		return suggestions, nil
500	}
501	
502	func mergedWorktreeBlocker(row inventory.Row, base, blocker string) suggestion {
503		return suggestion{
504			row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch is contained in %s, but retirement is blocked", base),
505			action: blocker + " — not changed automatically",
506		}
507	}
508	
509	func confirm(app *App, in *bufio.Reader, action string) bool {
510		s := app.outStyle()
511		prompt := s.prompt(action + "?")
512		lower := strings.ToLower(action)
513		if strings.Contains(lower, "delete") || strings.Contains(lower, "remove") ||
514			strings.Contains(lower, "discard") || strings.Contains(lower, "drop") {
515			prompt = s.danger(action + "?")
516		}
517		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s ", prompt, s.dim("[y/N]"))
518		line, err := in.ReadString('\n')
519		if err != nil {
520			return false
521		}
522		answer := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
523		return answer == "y" || answer == "yes"
524	}

218				}
219			}
220		}
221	
222		if err := donePlanReadinessError(selected, plan, selection); err != nil {
223			return err
224		}
225	
226		approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
227		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped && opts.Yes {
228			approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
229		}
230		if prompted && !opts.Yes {
231			confirmed, token, promptErr := confirmDonePlan(app, p, selected, plan)
232			if canceledDone(app, promptErr, !confirmed) {
233				return nil
234			}
235			if promptErr != nil {
236				return promptErr
237			}
238			if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
239				approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, token)
240			}
241		}
242		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped && approval.Token == "" {
243			return errors.New("destructive finish plan requires its typed confirmation")
244		}
245	
246		if opts.ConfirmSquash != "" {
247			app.warnf("accepting operator attestation that squash commit %s represents branch %s",
248				opts.ConfirmSquash, selected.Branch)
249		}
250		result, applyErr := session.apply(ctx, plan, approval)
251		renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
252		if applyErr != nil {
253			return presentDoneApplyError(result, applyErr)
254		}
255		final, err := session.finalTask(app)
256		if err != nil {
257			return err
258		}
259		return renderDoneSuccess(app, selected, final, plan, result, doneView(initial))
260	}

262	func doneActionOptions(selected task.Task, selection doneSelection, opts doneOptions) flow.ActionOptions {
263		if selected.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
264			return flow.CompleteDirectOptions{
265				Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message, Push: opts.Push,
266			}
267		}
268		switch selection.Integration {
269		case doneIntegrationPR:
270			return flow.ReviewHandoffOptions{Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message}
271		case doneIntegrationMerged:
272			return flow.VerifyMergedOptions{
273				Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message,
274				BaseRef: opts.BaseRef, SquashCommit: opts.ConfirmSquash, PushBase: opts.Push,
275			}
276		default:
277			return flow.CompleteFFOptions{
278				Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message, PushBase: opts.Push,
279			}
280		}
281	}

283	func replanDone(
284		ctx context.Context,
285		session lifecycleSession,
286		previous flow.Plan,
287		options flow.ActionOptions,
288	) (flow.Plan, error) {
289		fresh, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
290		if err != nil {
291			if errors.Is(err, flow.ErrStalePlan) {
292				return flow.Plan{}, presentDoneApplyError(flow.Result{}, err)
293			}
294			return flow.Plan{}, err
295		}
296		if changed := changedDoneAuthority(previous, fresh); changed != "" {
297			stale := &flow.StalePlanError{
298				ExpectedPlanID: previous.PlanID,
299				ActualPlanID:   fresh.PlanID,
300				Reason:         changed + " changed while the finish plan was open",
301			}
302			return flow.Plan{}, presentDoneApplyError(flow.Result{}, stale)
303		}
304		return fresh, nil
305	}
306	
307	func changedDoneAuthority(previous, fresh flow.Plan) string {
308		before := previous.AuthorityFields()
309		after := fresh.AuthorityFields()
310		for _, key := range []string{
311			"task.revision", "task.mode", "task.state", "task.repo-path", "task.branch", "task.base", "task.worktree-path",
312			"repo.git-common-dir", "worktree.fingerprint",
313			"git.status-error", "git.branch", "git.detached", "git.upstream", "git.ahead", "git.behind",
314			"git.changed", "git.staged", "git.unstaged", "git.untracked", "git.conflicted", "git.head",
315			"git.base-oid", "git.upstream-oid", "git.operation", "git.operation-active", "git.operation-error",
316			"artifact.fingerprint", "finish.authority", "completion.base-ref", "completion.base-oid",
317			"completion.expected-branch", "completion.branch-oid", "runtime.backend", "runtime.available",
318			"runtime.occupancy-fingerprint", "runtime.occupancy-error",
319		} {
320			if before[key] != after[key] {
321				return key
322			}
323		}
324		return ""
325	}

327	func canceledDone(app *App, err error, canceled bool) bool {
328		if errors.Is(err, errPromptCanceled) || canceled {
329			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Canceled; nothing was changed.")
330			return true
331		}

335	func doneFatalPreflightError(selected task.Task, plan flow.Plan) error {
336		view := doneView(plan)
337		if view.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
338			return fmt.Errorf("%s has %d conflicted path(s); resolve or abort the merge/rebase before finishing",
339				config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), view.Status.Conflicted)
340		}
341		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionCheckoutPresent); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
342			return fmt.Errorf("%s no longer exists — resume the task first", config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath))
343		}
344		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionExplicitBase); ok &&
345			condition.Requirement == flow.RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
346			return fmt.Errorf("cannot determine the base branch for %s — pass --base when starting a task", selected.Repo)
347		}
348		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionFinishAnalysis); ok && condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictError {
349			return errors.New(condition.Evidence)
350		}
351		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionArtifactReady); ok &&
352			(condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictBlocked || condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictError) {
353			return fmt.Errorf("artifact readiness for %s is blocked: %s; finalize or discard the intent before integration",
354				config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence)
355		}
356		return nil
357	}
358	
359	func donePlanReadinessError(selected task.Task, plan flow.Plan, selection doneSelection) error {
360		if plan.Availability == flow.AvailabilityReady {
361			return nil
362		}
363		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionCheckoutClean); ok &&
364			condition.Requirement == flow.RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
365			switch selection.Dirty {
366			case flow.DirtyAuto, flow.DirtyFail:
367				return dirtyFinishError(selected, plan)
368			case flow.DirtyCommit:
369				if strings.TrimSpace(selection.Message) == "" {
370					return errors.New("--message is required with --dirty=commit outside an interactive terminal")
371				}
372			}
373		}
374		if plan.Action == flow.ReviewHandoff {
375			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionBranchRelation); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
376				base := doneView(plan).Base
377				return fmt.Errorf("%s is already contained in %s; use --ff to finalize cleanup instead of opening a PR",
378					selected.Branch, base)
379			}
380		}
381		if plan.Action == flow.VerifyMerged {
382			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionMergeProof); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
383				fields := plan.AuthorityFields()
384				return fmt.Errorf("cannot verify %s is contained in %s", fields["completion.proof-ref"], fields["completion.base-ref"])
385			}
386		}
387		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
388		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
389		for _, condition := range blocking {
390			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
391			if condition.Remediation != "" {
392				message += " (" + condition.Remediation + ")"
393			}
394			parts = append(parts, message)
395		}
396		if len(parts) == 0 {
397			return fmt.Errorf("finish plan is %s: %w", plan.Availability, flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
398		}
399		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability,
400			strings.Join(parts, "; "), flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
401	}

403	func dirtyFinishError(t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) error {
404		view := doneView(plan)
405		return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes: %s; branch relation to %s is behind %d, ahead %d; "+
406			"%d dirty path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
407			config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), view.Status.Breakdown(), view.Base,
408			view.BaseOnly, view.BranchOnly, view.Equivalent, view.Base, view.Unique)
409	}

411	func renderDonePreflight(app *App, t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) {
412		view := doneView(plan)
413		s := app.outStyle()
414		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", s.title("Finish"), t.Title())
415		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s      %s\n", s.label("branch"), t.Branch)
416		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s        %s\n", s.label("base"), view.Base)
417		switch {
418		case view.BaseOnly == 0 && view.BranchOnly == 0:
419			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already equal to %s (behind 0, ahead 0)", view.Base)))
420		case view.contained():
421			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already contained in %s (behind %d, ahead 0)", view.Base, view.BaseOnly)))
422		default:
423			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("behind %d, ahead %d relative to %s",
424				view.BaseOnly, view.BranchOnly, view.Base)))
425		}
426		if !view.Status.Dirty() {
427			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.success("clean"))
428			return
429		}
430		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.warning(view.Status.Breakdown()))
431		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s, %s\n", s.label("contents"),
432			s.success(fmt.Sprintf("%d match %s", view.Equivalent, view.Base)),
433			s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("%d unique", view.Unique)))
434		for _, change := range view.Changes {
435			marker := s.warning("unique")
436			if change.BaseEquivalent {
437				marker = s.success("matches " + view.Base)
438			}
439			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s%s %s\n", marker,
440				strings.Repeat(" ", max(0, 12-width(marker))), change.Path)
441		}
442	}

444	func confirmDonePlan(app *App, p *prompter, t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) (bool, string, error) {
445		view := doneView(plan)
446		s := app.outStyle()
447		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\n"+s.title("Summary"))
448		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s        %s\n", s.label("task"), t.Title())
449		switch {
450		case donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectCommitAll):
451			message := doneEffectDetails(plan, flow.EffectCommitAll)["message"]
452			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("commit all as %q", message)))
453		case donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectDiscardAll):
454			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.danger("discard all staged, unstaged and untracked changes"))
455		default:
456			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.success("none"))
457		}
458		switch {
459		case plan.Action == flow.ReviewHandoff:
460			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.review("open a PR into "+view.Base))
461		case plan.Action == flow.VerifyMerged:
462			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("verify merge into "+view.Base))
463		case !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectMergeFF) && !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectRebaseBranch):
464			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("already contained in "+view.Base+"; cleanup only"))
465		default:
466			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("fast-forward into "+view.Base))
467		}
468		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
469			label := plan.Confirmation.Prompt
470			if view.Unique > 0 {
471				label = fmt.Sprintf("Type %s to discard %d unique path(s)", plan.Confirmation.Token, view.Unique)
472			}
473			value, err := p.dangerLine(label)
474			if err != nil {
475				return false, "", err
476			}
477			return value == plan.Confirmation.Token, value, nil
478		}
479		confirmed, err := p.confirm("Proceed with this finish plan?", false)
480		return confirmed, "", err
481	}

483	func presentDoneApplyError(result flow.Result, err error) error {
484		for _, step := range result.FailedSteps() {
485			switch step.Effect.Code {
486			case flow.EffectCommitAll:
487				return fmt.Errorf("commit dirty checkout: %w", err)
488			case flow.EffectDiscardAll:
489				return fmt.Errorf("discard dirty checkout: %w", err)
490			}
491		}
492		if errors.Is(err, flow.ErrStalePlan) {
493			for _, step := range result.CompletedSteps() {
494				if step.Effect.Code == flow.EffectCommitAll || step.Effect.Code == flow.EffectDiscardAll {
495					return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again during finalization; stop the active writer and rerun dev done: %w", err)
496				}
497			}
498			return fmt.Errorf("checkout or branch changed while the finish plan was open; review the new state and rerun dev done: %w", err)
499		}
500		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "changed again after") {
501			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again during finalization; stop the active writer and rerun dev done: %w", err)
502		}
503		return err
504	}
505	
506	func renderDoneSuccess(app *App, selected, final task.Task, plan flow.Plan, result flow.Result, initial donePlanView) error {
507		switch plan.Action {
508		case flow.ReviewHandoff:
509			if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneReviewReady {
510				return fmt.Errorf("review handoff completed without the review-ready milestone")
511			}
512			if final.State != selected.State {
513				return fmt.Errorf("review handoff changed task state from %s to %s", selected.State, final.State)
514			}
515			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nREADY FOR REVIEW · runtime and worktree kept")
516			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "After merge: dev done --merged --base-ref origin/"+doneView(plan).Base)
517			return nil
518		case flow.CompleteDirect, flow.CompleteFF, flow.VerifyMerged:
519			if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneMerged || final.State != task.Done {
520				return fmt.Errorf("completion returned milestone %s and task state %s; want merged and DONE",
521					result.Milestone, final.State)
522			}
523		default:
524			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported completion result action %s", plan.Action)
525		}
526	
527		if plan.Action == flow.CompleteDirect {
528			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s completed directly on %s\n", task.Done.Icon(), final.Title(), final.Branch)
529			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   no branch or worktree was created or removed")
530			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · cleanup pending: run dev retire from outside this runtime")
531			return nil
532		}
533		view := doneView(plan)
534		if plan.Action == flow.CompleteFF && initial.contained() &&
535			!donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectRebaseBranch) && !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectMergeFF) {
536			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   already merged  %s is contained in %s\n", final.Branch, view.Base)
537		}
538		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s merged into %s\n", task.Done.Icon(), final.Title(), view.Base)
539		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · runtime and worktree kept")
540		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   cleanup pending · run `dev retire %s` from outside its workspace\n", final.ID)
541		return nil
542	}
543	
544	func doneView(plan flow.Plan) donePlanView {
545		fields := plan.AuthorityFields()
546		view := donePlanView{
547			Base:       fields["completion.base-ref"],
548			BaseOnly:   authorityInt(fields, "finish.base-only"),
549			BranchOnly: authorityInt(fields, "finish.branch-only"),
550			Equivalent: authorityInt(fields, "finish.equivalent-dirty"),
551			Unique:     authorityInt(fields, "finish.unique-dirty"),
552			Status: gitx.Status{
553				Branch: fields["git.branch"], Upstream: fields["git.upstream"],
554				Ahead: authorityInt(fields, "git.ahead"), Behind: authorityInt(fields, "git.behind"),
555				Changed: authorityIntFirst(fields, "finish.status-changed", "git.changed"),
556				Staged:  authorityIntFirst(fields, "finish.status-staged", "git.staged"),
557				Unstaged: authorityIntFirst(fields,
558					"finish.status-unstaged", "git.unstaged"),
559				Untracked: authorityIntFirst(fields,
560					"finish.status-untracked", "git.untracked"),
561				Conflicted: authorityIntFirst(fields,
562					"finish.status-conflicted", "git.conflicted"),
563			},
564		}
565		for index := 0; index < authorityInt(fields, "finish.change-count"); index++ {
566			prefix := fmt.Sprintf("finish.change.%d.", index)
567			view.Changes = append(view.Changes, doneChangeView{
568				Path: fields[prefix+"path"], BaseEquivalent: fields[prefix+"base-equivalent"] == "true",
569			})
570		}
571		return view
572	}
573	
574	func authorityInt(fields map[string]string, key string) int {
575		value, _ := strconv.Atoi(fields[key])
576		return value
577	}
578	
579	func authorityIntFirst(fields map[string]string, keys ...string) int {
580		for _, key := range keys {
581			if _, ok := fields[key]; ok {
582				return authorityInt(fields, key)
583			}
584		}
585		return 0
586	}
587	
588	func doneCondition(plan flow.Plan, code flow.ConditionCode) (flow.Condition, bool) {
589		for _, condition := range plan.Conditions() {
590			if condition.Code == code {
591				return condition, true
592			}
593		}
594		return flow.Condition{}, false
595	}
596	
597	func donePlanHasEffect(plan flow.Plan, code flow.EffectCode) bool {
598		for _, effect := range plan.Effects() {
599			if effect.Code == code {
600				return true
601			}
602		}
603		return false
604	}
605	
606	func doneEffectDetails(plan flow.Plan, code flow.EffectCode) map[string]string {
607		for _, effect := range plan.Effects() {
608			if effect.Code == code {
609				return effect.Details.Map()
610			}
611		}
612		return nil
613	}

17	// Options controls only fail-closed observations. Caller protection and active

36	// Inspection is a fresh view of every runtime surface covering a checkout.

64				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
65			case "zellij", "none":
66			default:

126			}
127			if len(observed.Mixed) > 0 {
128				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
129					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s also contains %d pane(s) outside the target", observed.Runtime.Handle, len(observed.Mixed)))
130			}
131			for _, status := range coveringAgentStatuses(observed.Panes, observed.Runtime.AgentStatus) {
132				appendAgentStatusBlocker(&result, observed.Runtime.Handle, status, opts.CloseUnknown)
133			}
134		}
135		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
136			if !agent.Blocking {
137				continue
138			}
139			if agent.IsCaller {
140				result.CallerContained = true
141				if agent.SessionHandle != "" {
142					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
143						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", agent.SessionHandle))
144				} else {
145					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
146						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime pane %s contains the target checkout", agent.Activity.PaneID))
147				}
148				continue
149			}
150			if agent.SessionHandle == "" {
151				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
152					fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent in pane %s covers the target without a closeable runtime session", agent.Activity.PaneID))
153				continue
154			}
155			appendAgentStatusBlocker(&result, agent.SessionHandle, agent.Status, opts.CloseUnknown)
156		}
157		return dedupe(result), nil
158	}
159	
160	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
161	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
162	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
163		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
164		if err != nil {
165			return inspection, err
166		}
167		if !inspection.Ready() {
168			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
169		}
170		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
171			return inspection, nil
172		}
173		interval := opts.PollInterval
174		if interval <= 0 {
175			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
176		}
177		timeout := opts.Timeout
178		if timeout <= 0 {
179			timeout = 5 * time.Second
180		}
181		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
182		closed := make(map[string]bool)
183		for {
184			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
185			if inspectErr != nil {
186				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
187			}
188			if !fresh.Ready() {
189				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
190			}
191			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
192				inspection.Sessions = nil
193				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
194				return inspection, nil
195			}
196			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
197				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
198					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
199			}
200			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
201				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
202				if closed[handle] {
203					continue
204				}
205				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
206					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
207				}
208				closed[handle] = true
209				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
210			}
211			select {
212			case <-ctx.Done():
213				return inspection, ctx.Err()
214			case <-time.After(interval):
215			}
216		}
217	}
218	
219	func coveringAgentStatuses(panes []runtime.Pane, fallback string) []string {
220		set := make(map[string]bool)
221		for _, pane := range panes {
222			if pane.Agent != "" || pane.AgentSession != "" || pane.AgentStatus != "" {
223				set[strings.ToLower(pane.AgentStatus)] = true
224			}
225		}
226		if len(set) == 0 {
227			set[strings.ToLower(fallback)] = true
228		}
229		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
230		for status := range set {
231			out = append(out, status)
232		}
233		sort.Strings(out)
234		return out
235	}
236	
237	func appendAgentStatusBlocker(result *Inspection, handle, rawStatus string, closeUnknown bool) {
238		status := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawStatus))
239		switch status {
240		case "idle", "done":
241			// Eligible after all structural checks pass.
242		case "working", "running", "busy", "blocked", "waiting":
243			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
244				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has agent status %s", handle, status))
245		case "", "unknown":
246			if !closeUnknown {
247				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
248					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unknown agent status; pass --close-unknown from outside it", handle))
249			}
250		default:
251			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
252				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unrecognized agent status %s", handle, status))
253		}
254	}
255	
256	func dedupe(inspection Inspection) Inspection {
257		seen := make(map[string]bool)
258		out := inspection.Blockers[:0]
259		for _, blocker := range inspection.Blockers {
260			if !seen[blocker] {
261				seen[blocker] = true
262				out = append(out, blocker)
263			}
264		}
265		inspection.Blockers = out
266		return inspection
267	}
268

1	package gitx

3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"os"
8		"strings"
9	
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
11	)
12	
13	// Worktree is one entry of `git worktree list --porcelain`.
14	type Worktree struct {
15		Path string
16		// Head is the commit the worktree is checked out at.
17		Head string
18		// Branch is the short branch name, empty when detached.
19		Branch   string
20		Detached bool
21		Bare     bool
22		// Locked reports a `git worktree lock`; Prunable reports a checkout whose
23		// directory has gone missing. Both block a plain remove.
24		Locked         bool
25		LockedReason   string
26		Prunable       bool
27		PrunableReason string
28		// Main reports the primary (non-linked) checkout.
29		Main bool
30	}
31	
32	var (
33		// ErrWorktreeNotFound reports that Git's current registry has no worktree at
34		// the requested canonical path.
35		ErrWorktreeNotFound = errors.New("registered worktree not found")
36		// ErrWorktreeAmbiguous reports that multiple Git records resolve to the same
37		// canonical path. Callers must not choose one of the aliases implicitly.
38		ErrWorktreeAmbiguous = errors.New("registered worktree path is ambiguous")
39	)
40	
41	// RegisteredWorktree is an identity snapshot from Git's worktree registry.
42	// Worktree preserves the complete parsed Git record; the other fields are canonical
43	// filesystem identities suitable for exact comparison across symlink and macOS
44	// path aliases. A snapshot proves registration, not permission to remove it.
45	type RegisteredWorktree struct {
46		Worktree       Worktree
47		RepositoryPath string
48		GitCommonDir   string
49		Path           string
50	}
51	
52	// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether the record is a linked checkout rather than
53	// Git's main checkout or a bare repository. It is classification, not a removal
54	// safety decision.
55	func (w RegisteredWorktree) IsLinkedWorktree() bool {
56		return !w.Worktree.Main && !w.Worktree.Bare
57	}
58	
59	// ResolveRegisteredWorktree resolves exactPath against a fresh authoritative
60	// `git worktree list --porcelain` query for the repository containing repoPath.
61	// Matching is exclusively by canonical filesystem identity, never by branch.
62	// It performs no prune, removal, or other mutation.
63	func ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx context.Context, repoPath, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
64		worktrees, err := Worktrees(ctx, repoPath)
65		if err != nil {
66			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("query registered worktrees: %w", err)
67		}
68		commonDir, err := run(ctx, repoPath, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir")
69		if err != nil {
70			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve Git common directory: %w", err)
71		}
72		return resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees, commonDir, exactPath)
73	}
74	
75	func resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees []Worktree, commonDir, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
76		path, err := pathx.Canonical(exactPath)
77		if err != nil {
78			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize requested worktree %q: %w", exactPath, err)
79		}
80		canonicalCommonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
81		if err != nil {
82			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory %q: %w", commonDir, err)
83		}
84	
85		type match struct {
86			worktree Worktree
87			path     string
88		}
89		var (
90			repositoryPath string
91			matches        []match
92		)
93		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
94			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
95			if canonicalErr != nil {
96				return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize registered worktree %q: %w", worktree.Path, canonicalErr)
97			}
98			if worktree.Main {
99				repositoryPath = canonicalPath
100			}
101			if sameCanonicalPath(path, canonicalPath) {
102				matches = append(matches, match{worktree: worktree, path: canonicalPath})
103			}
104		}
105	
106		switch len(matches) {
107		case 0:
108			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrWorktreeNotFound, path)
109		case 1:
110			if repositoryPath == "" {
111				return RegisteredWorktree{}, errors.New("registered worktree query has no main repository record")
112			}
113			return RegisteredWorktree{
114				Worktree:       matches[0].worktree,
115				RepositoryPath: repositoryPath,
116				GitCommonDir:   canonicalCommonDir,
117				Path:           matches[0].path,
118			}, nil
119		default:
120			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s resolves to %d records", ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, path, len(matches))
121		}
122	}
123	
124	func sameCanonicalPath(left, right string) bool {
125		if left == right {
126			return true
127		}
128		leftInfo, leftErr := os.Stat(left)
129		rightInfo, rightErr := os.Stat(right)
130		return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && os.SameFile(leftInfo, rightInfo)
131	}
132	
133	// Worktrees lists every worktree of the repository containing dir, in git's
134	// own order: the main checkout first, then linked worktrees.
135	func Worktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]Worktree, error) {
136		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		var (
141			list []Worktree
142			cur  *Worktree
143		)
144		flush := func() {
145			if cur != nil {
146				list = append(list, *cur)
147				cur = nil
148			}
149		}
150		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
151			if line == "" { // records are blank-line separated
152				flush()
153				continue
154			}
155			key, val, _ := strings.Cut(line, " ")
156			switch key {
157			case "worktree":
158				flush()
159				cur = &Worktree{Path: val, Main: len(list) == 0}
160			case "HEAD":
161				if cur != nil {
162					cur.Head = val
163				}
164			case "branch":
165				if cur != nil {
166					cur.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(val, "refs/heads/")
167				}
168			case "detached":
169				if cur != nil {
170					cur.Detached = true
171				}
172			case "bare":
173				if cur != nil {
174					cur.Bare = true
175				}
176			case "locked":
177				if cur != nil {
178					cur.Locked, cur.LockedReason = true, val
179				}
180			case "prunable":
181				if cur != nil {
182					cur.Prunable, cur.PrunableReason = true, val
183				}
184			}
185		}
186		flush()
187		return list, nil
188	}
189	
190	// WorktreeFor finds the first worktree checked out on branch, if any. Git
191	// normally refuses duplicate branch checkouts, but --force can create them;
192	// identity-sensitive callers must use ResolveRegisteredWorktree instead.
193	func WorktreeFor(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) (Worktree, bool, error) {
194		list, err := Worktrees(ctx, dir)
195		if err != nil {
196			return Worktree{}, false, err
197		}
198		for _, w := range list {
199			if w.Branch == branch {
200				return w, true, nil
201			}
202		}
203		return Worktree{}, false, nil
204	}
205	
206	// AddWorktree creates a linked worktree at path.
207	//
208	// When branch already exists it is checked out; otherwise it is created from
209	// base. Passing an explicit base matters: without one git branches from the
210	// *current* HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on feature/A would
211	// silently inherit feature/A's commits.
212	func AddWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path, branch, base string) error {
213		exists := BranchExists(ctx, dir, branch)
214		args := []string{"worktree", "add"}
215		if exists {
216			args = append(args, path, branch)
217		} else {
218			args = append(args, "-b", branch, path)
219			if base != "" {
220				args = append(args, base)
221			}
222		}
223		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
224		return err
225	}
226	
227	// MoveWorktree relocates a linked worktree through Git so the shared
228	// administrative metadata keeps pointing at the checkout's new path. dir may
229	// be any checkout of the same repository.
230	func MoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, source, destination string) error {
231		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "move", source, destination)
232		return err
233	}
234	
235	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
236	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
237	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
238		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
239		if err != nil {
240			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current directory before removing worktree: %w", err)
241		}
242		inside, err := pathx.Contains(path, cwd)
243		if err != nil {
244			return fmt.Errorf("compare current directory with worktree %s: %w", path, err)
245		}
246		if inside {
247			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to remove worktree %s while the caller is inside it", path)
248		}
249		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
250		if force {
251			args = append(args, "--force")
252		}
253		args = append(args, path)
254		_, err = run(ctx, dir, args...)
255		return err
256	}
257	
258	// PruneWorktrees clears administrative entries for checkouts whose directories
259	// were deleted behind git's back.
260	func PruneWorktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {
261		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "prune")
262		return err
263	}
264	
265	// BranchExists reports whether a local branch of that name exists.
266	func BranchExists(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) bool {
267		if branch == "" {
268			return false
269		}
270		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+branch)
271		return err == nil
272	}
273	
274	// RefExists reports whether any ref or commit-ish resolves.
275	func RefExists(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) bool {
276		if ref == "" {
277			return false
278		}
279		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")
280		return err == nil
281	}

220		m.planRequest.loading = false
221		m.planRequest.cancel = nil
222		m.planRequest.err = nil
223	}
224	
225	func (m Model) acceptRepositoryList(message repositoryListMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
226		if message.generation != m.listRequest.generation ||
227			message.repoKey != pickerRequestKey || m.listRequest.repoKey != pickerRequestKey {
228			return m, nil
229		}
230		if m.listRequest.cancel != nil {
231			m.listRequest.cancel()
232		}
233		m.listRequest.cancel = nil
234		m.listRequest.loading = false
235		m.listRequest.err = message.err
236	
237		selectedKey := ""
238		if selected, ok := m.currentRepository(); ok {
239			selectedKey = selected.RepoKey
240		}
241		oldIndex := m.repoCursor
242		if message.err != nil {
243			m.listRequest.stale = len(m.repositories) > 0
244			m.status = ""
245			return m, nil
246		}
247	
248		m.repositories = append([]RepositoryRow(nil), message.rows...)
249		m.listRequest.stale = false
250		m.status = ""
251		m.repoCursor = nearestRepositoryIndex(m.filteredRepositories(), selectedKey, oldIndex)
252		return m, nil
253	}
254	
255	func nearestRepositoryIndex(rows []RepositoryRow, repoKey string, oldIndex int) int {
256		if repoKey != "" {
257			for index, row := range rows {
258				if row.RepoKey == repoKey {
259					return index
260				}
261			}
262		}
263		if len(rows) == 0 {
264			return 0
265		}
266		if oldIndex < 0 {
267			return 0
268		}
269		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
270			return len(rows) - 1
271		}
272		return oldIndex
273	}
274	
275	func (m Model) acceptRepositoryLoad(message repositoryLoadMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
276		if message.generation != m.loadRequest.generation ||
277			message.repoKey != m.loadRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.repository.RepoKey {
278			return m, nil
279		}
280		if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
281			m.loadRequest.cancel()
282		}
283		m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
284		m.loadRequest.loading = false
285	
286		if message.err == nil && message.snapshot.Repository.RepoKey != message.repoKey {
287			message.err = fmt.Errorf(
288				"loaded snapshot repository key %q does not match requested key %q",
289				message.snapshot.Repository.RepoKey, message.repoKey,
290			)
291		}
292		if message.err != nil {
293			m.loadRequest.err = message.err
294			m.loadRequest.stale = m.hasSnapshot
295			if m.hasSnapshot {
296				m.snapshot.Freshness = FreshnessStale
297			}
298			m.status = ""
299			return m, nil
300		}
301	
302		oldRow, hadOldRow := m.currentSurface()
303		oldIndex := m.rowCursor
304		oldActionID := ""
305		if choice, ok := m.currentAction(); ok {
306			oldActionID = choice.ID
307		}
308	
309		accepted := message.snapshot.Clone()
310		if accepted.Freshness == "" {
311			accepted.Freshness = FreshnessFresh
312		}
313		m.snapshot = accepted
314		m.hasSnapshot = true
315		m.loadRequest.err = nil
316		m.loadRequest.stale = accepted.Freshness != FreshnessFresh || accepted.Error != ""
317		m.repository = accepted.Repository
318		if remote, ok := accepted.Remote.RemoteObservation(); ok {
319			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
320		}
321	
322		rows := accepted.Surfaces.Values()
323		m.rowCursor = retainedSurfaceIndex(rows, oldRow, hadOldRow, oldIndex, m.desiredFocus)
324		m.desiredFocus = ""
325		m.actionCursor = retainedActionIndex(rows, m.rowCursor, oldActionID)
326		m.clampActionCursor()
327		m.status = ""
328		return m, nil
329	}
330	
331	func retainedSurfaceIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, previous SurfaceRow, hadPrevious bool, oldIndex int, focus string) int {
332		if len(rows) == 0 {
333			return 0
334		}
335		if hadPrevious {
336			for index, row := range rows {
337				if row.RowKey == previous.RowKey {
338					return index
339				}
340			}
341			if previous.Locator.TaskID != "" {
342				for index, row := range rows {
343					if row.Locator.TaskID == previous.Locator.TaskID {
344						return index
345					}
346				}
347			}
348			for index, row := range rows {
349				if locatorsReferToSameSurface(previous.Locator, row.Locator) {
350					return index
351				}
352			}
353		}
354		if focus != "" {
355			for index, row := range rows {
356				if row.RowKey == focus || row.Locator.RowKey == focus {
357					return index
358				}
359			}
360			for index, row := range rows {
361				if row.Locator.TaskID == focus {
362					return index
363				}
364			}
365			for index, row := range rows {
366				if row.Locator.CheckoutPath == focus {
367					return index
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		if oldIndex < 0 {
372			return 0
373		}
374		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
375			return len(rows) - 1
376		}
377		return oldIndex
378	}
379	
380	func retainedActionIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, rowIndex int, actionID string) int {
381		if actionID == "" || rowIndex < 0 || rowIndex >= len(rows) {
382			return 0
383		}
384		for index, action := range rows[rowIndex].Actions.Values() {
385			if action.ID == actionID {
386				return index
387			}
388		}
389		return 0
390	}
391	
392	func locatorsReferToSameSurface(left, right taskflow.Locator) bool {
393		if left.RepositoryID != "" && right.RepositoryID != "" && left.RepositoryID != right.RepositoryID {
394			return false
395		}
396		if left.CheckoutPath != "" && right.CheckoutPath != "" {
397			return left.CheckoutPath == right.CheckoutPath
398		}
399		if left.TaskID != "" && right.TaskID != "" {
400			return left.TaskID == right.TaskID
401		}
402		return left.RepoKey != "" && left.RepoKey == right.RepoKey &&
403			left.Branch != "" && left.Branch == right.Branch && left.Base == right.Base
404	}
405	
406	func (m Model) acceptPlan(message planMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
407		if message.generation != m.planRequest.generation ||
408			message.repoKey != m.planRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey ||
409			message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey || message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
410			return m, nil
411		}
412		if m.planRequest.cancel != nil {
413			m.planRequest.cancel()
414		}
415		m.planRequest.cancel = nil
416		m.planRequest.loading = false
417		m.planRequest.err = message.err
418		m.overlay = overlayPlan
419		m.status = ""
420	
421		if message.plan.PlanID != "" {
422			m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
423			m.hasPlan = true
424		}
425		if message.err != nil {
426			m.planErr = message.err
427			return m, nil
428		}
429		if err := message.plan.Validate(); err != nil {
430			m.planErr = combineError("invalid plan returned by callback", err)
431			return m, nil
432		}
433		if message.plan.Locator != m.planTarget.locator {
434			m.planErr = errors.New("plan locator does not match the exact selected surface")
435			return m, nil
436		}
437		if message.plan.Action != m.planTarget.choice.Action() {
438			m.planErr = errors.New("plan action does not match the exact selected action options")
439			return m, nil
440		}
441		expected, err := taskflow.NewRequest(m.planTarget.locator, m.planTarget.choice.Options())
442		if err != nil {
443			m.planErr = combineError("selected action options are invalid", err)
444			return m, nil
445		}
446		if !reflect.DeepEqual(message.plan.Request.Options, expected.Options) {
447			m.planErr = errors.New("plan was built with different concrete action options than the selected choice")
448			return m, nil
449		}
450		m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
451		m.hasPlan = true
452		m.planErr = nil
453		if m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady && m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
454			m.confirm.SetValue("")
455			m.confirm.CursorEnd()
456			return m, m.confirm.Focus()
457		}
458		return m, nil
459	}
460	
461	func (m Model) acceptApply(message applyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
462		if !m.applyRunning || message.generation != m.applyGeneration ||
463			message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey || message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey ||
464			message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
465			return m, nil
466		}
467		m.applyRunning = false
468		m.overlay = overlayResult
469		m.lastResult = message.result.Clone()
470		m.hasLastResult = true
471		m.lastResultErr = message.err
472		m.status = ""
473		if remote, ok := message.result.RemoteObservation(); ok {
474			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
475		}
476		if message.err == nil {
477			if handoff, ok := message.result.Handoff(); ok {
478				m.finalHandoff = handoff
479				m.hasHandoff = true
480			}
481		}
482	
483		queuedQuit := m.queuedQuit
484		m.queuedQuit, m.queuedRefresh = false, false
485		updated, command := m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
486		m = updated.(Model)
487		if queuedQuit {
488			// The fresh generation is established before honoring the queued quit. It
489			// cannot authorize anything and the mutation ledger remains in final Model.
490			if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
491				m.loadRequest.cancel()
492				m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
493			}
494			m.quitting = true
495			return m, tea.Quit
496		}
497		return m, command
498	}

135	// New constructs either an asynchronous repository picker (preselected=nil) or
136	// an asynchronous preselected-repository view. No callback runs until Init's
137	// command is executed, so View can return the initial frame immediately.
138	func New(actions Actions, preselected *RepositoryRow) Model {
139		filter := textinput.New()
140		filter.CharLimit = 240
141		filter.Placeholder = "repository filter"
142		confirm := textinput.New()
143		confirm.CharLimit = 300
144		confirm.Placeholder = "exact confirmation token"
145	
146		model := Model{
147			actions:        actions,
148			firstViewReady: make(chan struct{}),
149			firstViewOnce:  &sync.Once{},
150			width:          120, height: 34,
151			filter: filter, confirm: confirm,
152			focus: FocusSurfaces,
153		}
154		if preselected == nil {
155			model.screen = screenPicker
156			model.listRequest = requestState{generation: 1, repoKey: pickerRequestKey, loading: true}
157			return model
158		}
159		model.screen = screenRepository
160		model.repository = *preselected
161		model.desiredFocus = preselected.FocusTarget
162		model.loadRequest = requestState{generation: 1, repoKey: preselected.RepoKey, loading: true}
163		return model
164	}

174	// WithContext bounds cancelable list/load/plan callbacks to one TUI run. Apply
175	// deliberately uses a cancellation-detached child so queued quit cannot abort a

182	func (m Model) baseContext() context.Context {
183		if m.runContext != nil {
184			return m.runContext
185		}
186		return context.Background()
187	}

189	// Init implements tea.Model without doing synchronous repository work.
190	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
191		var commands []tea.Cmd
192		switch m.screen {
193		case screenRepository:
194			if m.loadRequest.loading {
195				commands = append(commands, m.loadRepositoryCmd(m.loadRequest.generation, m.loadRequest.repoKey, m.baseContext()))
196			}
197		case screenPicker:
198			if m.listRequest.loading {
199				commands = append(commands, m.listRepositoriesCmd(m.listRequest.generation, m.baseContext()))
200			}
201		}
202		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
203			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
204		}
205		switch len(commands) {
206		case 0:
207			return nil
208		case 1:
209			return commands[0]
210		default:
211			return tea.Batch(commands...)
212		}
213	}

215	func (m Model) signalFirstView() {
216		if m.firstViewOnce != nil && m.firstViewReady != nil {
217			m.firstViewOnce.Do(func() { close(m.firstViewReady) })
218		}

221	func (m Model) runAfterFirstView() tea.Cmd {
222		return func() tea.Msg {

228				return nil
229			}

275	// Update implements tea.Model.
276	func (m Model) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
277		switch message := message.(type) {
278		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
279			m.width, m.height = message.Width, message.Height
280			return m, nil
281		case repositoryListMsg:
282			return m.acceptRepositoryList(message)
283		case repositoryLoadMsg:
284			return m.acceptRepositoryLoad(message)
285		case planMsg:
286			return m.acceptPlan(message)
287		case applyMsg:
288			return m.acceptApply(message)
289		case tea.KeyMsg:
290			if m.applyRunning {
291				return m.updateApplying(message)
292			}
293			if m.filterActive {
294				return m.updateFilter(message)
295			}
296			if m.overlay != overlayNone {
297				return m.updateOverlay(message)
298			}
299			if m.screen == screenPicker {
300				return m.updatePicker(message)
301			}
302			return m.updateRepository(message)
303		}
304		return m, nil
305	}

307	func (m Model) updatePicker(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
308		switch message.String() {
309		case "q", "ctrl+c":
310			return m.quit()
311		case "esc":
312			if m.filter.Value() != "" {
313				m.filter.SetValue("")
314				m.repoCursor = 0
315				return m, nil
316			}
317			return m.quit()
318		case "j", "down":
319			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor + 1)
320		case "k", "up":
321			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor - 1)
322		case "/":
323			m.filterActive = true
324			m.filter.CursorEnd()
325			return m, m.filter.Focus()
326		case "?":
327			m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
328			m.overlay = overlayHelp
329			return m, nil
330		case "r":
331			return m.beginRepositoryList()
332		case "enter":
333			row, ok := m.currentRepository()
334			if !ok {
335				return m, nil
336			}
337			return m.selectRepository(row)
338		}
339		return m, nil
340	}
