430	func (m Model) filteredRepositories() []RepositoryRow {
431		query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m.filter.Value()))
432		terms := strings.Fields(query)
433		out := make([]RepositoryRow, 0, len(m.repositories))
434		for _, row := range m.repositories {
435			haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{row.RepoKey, row.Name, row.Path, row.Error}, " "))
436			matched := true
437			for _, term := range terms {
438				if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
439					matched = false
440					break
441				}
442			}
443			if matched {
444				out = append(out, row)
445			}
446		}
447		return out
448	}
449	
450	func (m Model) currentRepository() (RepositoryRow, bool) {
451		rows := m.filteredRepositories()
452		if m.repoCursor < 0 || m.repoCursor >= len(rows) {
453			return RepositoryRow{}, false
454		}
455		return rows[m.repoCursor], true
456	}
457	
458	func (m *Model) setRepoCursor(index int) {
459		count := len(m.filteredRepositories())
460		switch {
461		case count == 0:
462			index = 0
463		case index < 0:
464			index = 0
465		case index >= count:
466			index = count - 1
467		}
468		m.repoCursor = index
469	}
470	
471	func (m Model) currentSurface() (SurfaceRow, bool) {
472		if !m.hasSnapshot {
473			return SurfaceRow{}, false
474		}
475		rows := m.snapshot.Surfaces.Values()
476		if m.rowCursor < 0 || m.rowCursor >= len(rows) {
477			return SurfaceRow{}, false
478		}
479		return rows[m.rowCursor], true
480	}
481	
482	func (m Model) currentAction() (ActionChoice, bool) {
483		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
484		if !ok {
485			return ActionChoice{}, false
486		}
487		actions := row.Actions.Values()
488		if m.actionCursor < 0 || m.actionCursor >= len(actions) {
489			return ActionChoice{}, false
490		}
491		if !actions[m.actionCursor].Valid() {
492			return ActionChoice{}, false
493		}
494		return actions[m.actionCursor], true
495	}
496	
497	func (m *Model) setRowCursor(index int) {
498		count := 0
499		if m.hasSnapshot {
500			count = m.snapshot.Surfaces.Len()
501		}
502		switch {
503		case count == 0:
504			index = 0
505		case index < 0:
506			index = 0
507		case index >= count:
508			index = count - 1
509		}
510		if index != m.rowCursor {
511			m.rowCursor = index
512			m.actionCursor = 0
513		} else {
514			m.rowCursor = index
515		}
516		m.clampActionCursor()
517	}
518	
519	func (m *Model) clampActionCursor() {
520		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
521		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
522			m.actionCursor = 0
523			return
524		}
525		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
526			m.actionCursor = 0
527		}
528		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
529			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
530		}
531	}
532	
533	func (m *Model) moveAction(delta int) {
534		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
535		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
536			m.actionCursor = 0
537			return
538		}
539		m.actionCursor += delta
540		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
541			m.actionCursor = 0
542		}
543		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
544			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
545		}
546		m.focus = FocusActions
547	}
548	
549	func (m Model) selectRepository(row RepositoryRow) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
550		m.cancelRepositoryListRead()
551		m.screen = screenRepository
552		m.repository = row
553		m.desiredFocus = row.FocusTarget
554		m.hasSnapshot = false
555		m.snapshot = Snapshot{}
556		m.remote = OptionalRemoteObservation{}
557		m.rowCursor, m.actionCursor = 0, 0
558		m.overlay = overlayNone
559		m.hasPlan, m.planErr = false, nil
560		m.hasLastResult, m.lastResultErr = false, nil
561		m.hasHandoff = false
562		return m.beginRepositoryLoad(true)
563	}
564	
565	func combineError(label string, err error) error {
566		if err == nil {
567			return nil
568		}
569		if label == "" {
570			return err
571		}
572		return errors.New(label + ": " + err.Error())
573	}

10	func (m Model) openRemoteMenu() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
11		if m.loadRequest.loading {
12			m.status = "wait for the current local reload before planning remote work"
13			return m, nil
14		}
15		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
16		if !ok {
17			return m, nil
18		}
19		choices := make([]ActionChoice, 0, row.Actions.Len())
20		for _, choice := range row.Actions.Values() {
21			if choice.Valid() && choice.Action() == taskflow.RefreshRemote {
22				choices = append(choices, choice)
23			}
24		}
25		if len(choices) == 0 {
26			m.status = "no remote action choices are available for this surface"
27			return m, nil
28		}
29		m.remoteChoices = NewActionList(choices...)
30		m.remoteCursor = 0
31		m.overlay = overlayRemoteMenu
32		m.status = ""
33		return m, nil
34	}
35	
36	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
37		switch m.overlay {
38		case overlayHelp:
39			switch message.String() {
40			case "esc", "?":
41				m.overlay = m.overlayReturn
42				m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
43				return m, nil
44			case "q", "ctrl+c":
45				return m.quit()
46			}
47			return m, nil
48	
49		case overlayRemoteMenu:
50			switch message.String() {
51			case "q", "ctrl+c":
52				return m.quit()
53			case "esc", "R":
54				m.overlay = overlayNone
55				return m, nil
56			case "j", "down":
57				if m.remoteCursor+1 < m.remoteChoices.Len() {
58					m.remoteCursor++
59				}
60			case "k", "up":
61				if m.remoteCursor > 0 {
62					m.remoteCursor--
63				}
64			case "enter":
65				choices := m.remoteChoices.Values()
66				if m.remoteCursor >= 0 && m.remoteCursor < len(choices) {
67					return m.beginPlan(choices[m.remoteCursor])
68				}
69			}
70			return m, nil
71	
72		case overlayPlanLoading:
73			switch message.String() {
74			case "q", "ctrl+c":
75				m.cancelPlanRead()
76				return m.quit()
77			case "esc":
78				m.cancelPlanRead()
79				m.overlay = overlayNone
80				m.status = ""
81			}
82			return m, nil
83	
84		case overlayPlan:
85			if message.String() == "ctrl+c" {
86				return m.quit()
87			}
88			if message.String() == "esc" {
89				m.confirm.Blur()
90				m.overlay = overlayNone
91				m.status = ""
92				return m, nil
93			}
94			if !m.planCanApply() {
95				if message.String() == "q" {
96					return m.quit()
97				}
98				return m, nil
99			}
100			if m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
101				if message.String() == "enter" {
102					token := m.confirm.Value()
103					if token != m.plan.Confirmation.Token {
104						m.status = "confirmation token does not match exactly"
105						return m, nil
106					}
107					return m.startApply(taskflow.ApproveWithToken(m.plan.PlanID, token))
108				}
109				var command tea.Cmd
110				m.confirm, command = m.confirm.Update(message)
111				return m, command
112			}
113			switch message.String() {
114			case "q":
115				return m.quit()
116			case "y", "Y":
117				return m.startApply(taskflow.Approve(m.plan.PlanID))
118			}
119			return m, nil
120	
121		case overlayResult:
122			switch message.String() {
123			case "q", "ctrl+c":
124				return m.quit()
125			case "esc":
126				m.overlay = overlayNone
127				m.status = ""
128				return m, nil
129			case "r":
130				return m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
131			case "?":
132				m.overlayReturn = overlayResult
133				m.overlay = overlayHelp
134				return m, nil
135			}
136			return m, nil
137		}
138		return m, nil
139	}
140	
141	func (m Model) planCanApply() bool {
142		return m.hasPlan && m.planErr == nil && m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady
143	}
144	
145	func (m Model) startApply(approval taskflow.Approval) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
146		if !m.planCanApply() {
147			return m, nil
148		}
149		if err := m.plan.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
150			m.status = fmt.Sprintf("approval rejected: %v", err)
151			return m, nil
152		}
153		m.applyGeneration++
154		m.applyRunning = true
155		m.overlay = overlayApplying
156		m.status = "Apply in progress; quit and refresh will be queued"
157		m.hasHandoff = false
158		m.finalHandoff = taskflow.Handoff{}
159		m.hasLastResult = false
160		m.lastResult = taskflow.Result{}
161		m.lastResultErr = nil
162		return m, m.applyCmd(m.applyGeneration, m.planTarget, m.plan, approval)
163	}

1	// Package flowtui implements the independent, plan-first Bubble Tea interface
2	// for repository lifecycle flows. It owns presentation and interaction only;
3	// callers inject every repository read, plan, and mutation.
4	package flowtui
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"time"
9	
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
11		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/taskflow"
12	)
13	
14	// Freshness describes the local repository observation rendered by a Snapshot.
15	// Only FreshnessFresh with no snapshot error is authoritative display data.
16	type Freshness string
17	
18	const (
19		FreshnessUnknown Freshness = "unknown"
20		FreshnessFresh   Freshness = "fresh"
21		FreshnessStale   Freshness = "stale"
22	)
23	
24	// SurfaceKind is the caller-projected ownership/topology class of one row.
25	type SurfaceKind string
26	
27	const (
28		SurfaceCanonical SurfaceKind = "canonical"
29		SurfaceManaged   SurfaceKind = "managed"
30		SurfaceUnmanaged SurfaceKind = "unmanaged"
31		SurfaceHarness   SurfaceKind = "harness"
32		SurfaceTaskOnly  SurfaceKind = "task-only"
33		SurfaceConflict  SurfaceKind = "conflict"
34	)
35	
36	// RepositoryRow is one stable repository-picker entry. FocusTarget optionally
37	// names a RowKey, TaskID, or checkout path to select after the repository loads.
38	type RepositoryRow struct {
39		RepoKey     string
40		Name        string
41		Path        string
42		Available   bool
43		Error       string
44		FocusTarget string
45	}
46	
47	// Lines is an ordered, immutable-by-interface list of display evidence.
48	type Lines = taskflow.StringList
49	
50	// NewLines copies display lines without changing their order.
51	func NewLines(values ...string) Lines { return taskflow.NewStringList(values...) }
52	
53	// ActionChoice is one already-concrete operation variant supplied by the
54	// caller. The options value is normalized to an independent value at both the
55	// constructor and accessor boundaries.
56	type ActionChoice struct {
57		ID          string
58		Label       string
59		Description string
60	
61		options taskflow.ActionOptions
62	}
63	
64	// NewActionChoice copies the concrete action options. A nil/typed-nil option is
65	// retained as unavailable input and will never be sent to Plan.
66	func NewActionChoice(id, label, description string, options taskflow.ActionOptions) ActionChoice {
67		return ActionChoice{
68			ID: id, Label: label, Description: description,
69			options: cloneActionOptions(options),
70		}
71	}
72	
73	// Action returns the stable taskflow action represented by this choice.
74	func (c ActionChoice) Action() taskflow.Action {
75		options := cloneActionOptions(c.options)
76		if options == nil {
77			return ""
78		}
79		return options.Action()
80	}
81	
82	// Options returns a defensive copy of the concrete options value.
83	func (c ActionChoice) Options() taskflow.ActionOptions { return cloneActionOptions(c.options) }
84	
85	// Valid reports whether a choice carries stable UI identity and concrete
86	// taskflow options.
87	func (c ActionChoice) Valid() bool {
88		return c.ID != "" && c.Label != "" && c.Action().Valid() && c.Options() != nil
89	}
90	
91	func (c ActionChoice) clone() ActionChoice {
92		c.options = cloneActionOptions(c.options)
93		return c
94	}
95	
96	// ActionList is an ordered, immutable-by-interface collection of choices.
97	type ActionList struct {
98		values []ActionChoice
99	}
100	
101	// NewActionList defensively copies choices and their option values.
102	func NewActionList(values ...ActionChoice) ActionList {
103		out := ActionList{values: make([]ActionChoice, len(values))}
104		for index, value := range values {
105			out.values[index] = value.clone()
106		}
107		return out
108	}
109	
110	// Values returns independent choices in caller-supplied order.
111	func (l ActionList) Values() []ActionChoice {
112		out := make([]ActionChoice, len(l.values))
113		for index, value := range l.values {
114			out[index] = value.clone()
115		}
116		return out
117	}
118	
119	// Len returns the number of ordered choices.
120	func (l ActionList) Len() int { return len(l.values) }
121	
122	// SurfaceRow is one exact checkout or task-only row. Mode and State are empty
123	// for untracked rows. Drift, conflicts, evidence, and actions are ordered,
124	// immutable-by-interface values so copying a row cannot expose shared mutation.
125	type SurfaceRow struct {
126		RowKey string
127		Kind   SurfaceKind
128		Label  string
129		Path   string
130		Branch string
131		Base   string
132	
133		Mode  task.CheckoutMode
134		State task.State
135	
136		Drift     Lines
137		Conflicts Lines
138		Evidence  Lines
139		Locator   taskflow.Locator
140		Actions   ActionList
141	}
142	
143	func (r SurfaceRow) clone() SurfaceRow {
144		r.Drift = NewLines(r.Drift.Values()...)
145		r.Conflicts = NewLines(r.Conflicts.Values()...)
146		r.Evidence = NewLines(r.Evidence.Values()...)
147		r.Actions = NewActionList(r.Actions.Values()...)
148		return r
149	}
150	
151	// SurfaceList is an ordered, immutable-by-interface surface collection.
152	type SurfaceList struct {
153		values []SurfaceRow
154	}
155	
156	// NewSurfaceList copies rows and every collection they own.
157	func NewSurfaceList(values ...SurfaceRow) SurfaceList {
158		out := SurfaceList{values: make([]SurfaceRow, len(values))}
159		for index, value := range values {
160			out.values[index] = value.clone()
161		}
162		return out
163	}
164	
165	// Values returns independent rows in caller-supplied order.
166	func (l SurfaceList) Values() []SurfaceRow {
167		out := make([]SurfaceRow, len(l.values))
168		for index, value := range l.values {
169			out[index] = value.clone()
170		}
171		return out
172	}
173	
174	// Len returns the number of projected surfaces.
175	func (l SurfaceList) Len() int { return len(l.values) }
176	
177	// OptionalRemoteObservation is a value-safe optional run-local remote result.
178	type OptionalRemoteObservation struct {
179		value taskflow.RemoteObservation
180		set   bool
181	}
182	
183	// SomeRemoteObservation constructs a present optional observation.
184	func SomeRemoteObservation(value taskflow.RemoteObservation) OptionalRemoteObservation {
185		return OptionalRemoteObservation{value: value.Clone(), set: true}
186	}
187	
188	// RemoteObservation returns an independent value when present.
189	func (o OptionalRemoteObservation) RemoteObservation() (taskflow.RemoteObservation, bool) {
190		return o.value.Clone(), o.set
191	}
192	
193	// Snapshot is one repository-local observation. Error is part of a valid
194	// snapshot (for example incomplete enrichment); a callback error instead means
195	// the refresh failed and the previous snapshot must be retained.
196	type Snapshot struct {
197		Repository RepositoryRow
198		Surfaces   SurfaceList
199		ObservedAt time.Time
200		Freshness  Freshness
201		Error      string
202		Remote     OptionalRemoteObservation
203	}
204	
205	// Clone returns a snapshot with independent surface/action storage.
206	func (s Snapshot) Clone() Snapshot {
207		s.Surfaces = NewSurfaceList(s.Surfaces.Values()...)
208		if remote, ok := s.Remote.RemoteObservation(); ok {
209			s.Remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
210		}
211		return s
212	}
213	
214	// Authoritative reports whether the displayed local observation is fresh,
215	// complete, and associated with an available repository.
216	func (s Snapshot) Authoritative() bool {
217		return s.Freshness == FreshnessFresh && s.Error == "" && s.Repository.Available
218	}
219	
220	// Actions is the entire side-effect boundary. Every operation receives the
221	// exact stable keys selected by the model. Plan and Apply also receive an
222	// independent concrete options value; Apply additionally receives the exact
223	// locator and approved immutable plan.

227		AfterFirstView   func(context.Context)

231		Apply            func(context.Context, string, string, string, taskflow.Locator, taskflow.ActionOptions, taskflow.Plan, taskflow.Approval) (taskflow.Result, error)
232	}

16	// View implements tea.Model. It performs no callback or probe work.

20			return ""
21		}
22		switch m.overlay {
23		case overlayHelp:
24			return m.renderHelp()
25		case overlayRemoteMenu:
26			return m.renderRemoteMenu()
27		case overlayPlanLoading:
28			return m.renderPlanLoading()
29		case overlayPlan:
30			return m.renderPlan(false)
31		case overlayApplying:
32			return m.renderPlan(true)
33		case overlayResult:
34			return m.renderResult()
35		}
36		if m.screen == screenPicker {
37			return m.renderPicker()
38		}
39		return m.renderRepository()
40	}

42	func (m Model) renderPicker() string {
43		var builder strings.Builder
44		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev flow  REPOSITORIES"))
45		status := ""
46		switch {
47		case m.listRequest.loading:
48			status = "LOADING"
49		case m.listRequest.err != nil && m.listRequest.stale:
50			status = "STALE"
51		case m.listRequest.err != nil:
52			status = "ERROR"
53		}
54		if status != "" {
55			builder.WriteString("  [" + status + "]")
56		}
57		builder.WriteString("\n\n")
58		if m.filterActive {
59			builder.WriteString("filter: " + m.filter.View() + "\n\n")
60		} else if m.filter.Value() != "" {
61			builder.WriteString("filter: /" + m.filter.Value() + "\n\n")
62		}
63		if m.listRequest.err != nil {
64			builder.WriteString(styleBad.Render("ERROR: "+m.listRequest.err.Error()) + "\n")
65			if m.listRequest.stale {
66				builder.WriteString("STALE: retaining the prior repository list; it is non-authoritative.\n")
67			}
68		}
69		rows := m.filteredRepositories()
70		if len(rows) == 0 {
71			switch {
72			case m.listRequest.loading:
73				builder.WriteString("Loading local repositories asynchronously...\n")
74			case m.listRequest.err != nil:
75				builder.WriteString("No authoritative repository list is available.\n")
76			case m.filter.Value() != "":
77				builder.WriteString("No repository matches the current filter.\n")
78			default:
79				builder.WriteString("No repositories found.\n")
80			}
81		} else {
82			for index, row := range rows {
83				marker := "  "
84				if index == m.repoCursor {
85					marker = "> "
86				}
87				availability := "AVAILABLE"
88				if !row.Available {
89					availability = "UNAVAILABLE"
90				}
91				line := fmt.Sprintf("%s [%s] %s", marker, availability, repositoryLabel(row))
92				if index == m.repoCursor {
93					line = styleSelected.Render(line)
94				}
95				builder.WriteString(line + "\n")
96				if row.Path != "" {
97					builder.WriteString("    " + row.Path + "\n")
98				}
99				if row.Error != "" {
100					builder.WriteString("    ERROR: " + row.Error + "\n")
101				}
102			}
103		}
104		builder.WriteString("\n")
105		if m.status != "" {
106			builder.WriteString("STATUS: " + m.status + "\n")
107		}
108		builder.WriteString(styleMuted.Render("j/k or arrows move | / filter | Enter select | r reload | ? help | q quit"))
109		return builder.String()
110	}
111	
112	func repositoryLabel(row RepositoryRow) string {
113		if row.Name != "" {
114			return row.Name
115		}
116		if row.Path != "" {
117			return row.Path
118		}
119		return row.RepoKey
120	}

122	func (m Model) renderRepository() string {
123		var builder strings.Builder
124		name := repositoryLabel(m.repository)
125		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev flow  "+name) + "\n")
126		if m.repository.Path != "" {
127			builder.WriteString(m.repository.Path + "\n")
128		}
129		builder.WriteString(m.localStatusLine() + "\n")
130		if m.hasSnapshot && !m.snapshot.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
131			builder.WriteString("observed: " + formatTime(m.snapshot.ObservedAt) + "\n")
132		}
133		if m.repository.Error != "" {
134			builder.WriteString("REPOSITORY ERROR: " + m.repository.Error + "\n")
135		}
136		if m.hasSnapshot && m.snapshot.Error != "" {
137			builder.WriteString("SNAPSHOT ERROR: " + m.snapshot.Error + "\n")
138		}
139		if m.loadRequest.err != nil {
140			builder.WriteString(styleBad.Render("REFRESH ERROR: "+m.loadRequest.err.Error()) + "\n")
141		}
142		builder.WriteString("\n")
143	
144		if !m.hasSnapshot {
145			if m.loadRequest.loading {
146				builder.WriteString("Loading repository topology and local observations asynchronously...\n")
147			} else if m.loadRequest.err != nil {
148				builder.WriteString("No authoritative repository snapshot is available.\n")
149			} else {
150				builder.WriteString("No repository snapshot is available.\n")
151			}
152			builder.WriteString("\n" + m.renderRepositoryFooter())
153			return builder.String()
154		}
155	
156		left := m.surfacePanelLines()
157		middle := m.lifecyclePanelLines()
158		right := m.actionPanelLines()
159		if m.width >= wideLayoutWidth {
160			builder.WriteString(renderWidePanels(
161				panelTitle("SURFACES", m.focus == FocusSurfaces), left,
162				panelTitle("LIFECYCLE / EVIDENCE", m.focus == FocusLifecycle), middle,
163				panelTitle("ACTIONS / CONDITION", m.focus == FocusActions), right,
164				m.width,
165			))
166		} else {
167			builder.WriteString(renderNarrowPanel(panelTitle("SURFACES", m.focus == FocusSurfaces), left))
168			builder.WriteString("\n")
169			builder.WriteString(renderNarrowPanel(panelTitle("LIFECYCLE / EVIDENCE", m.focus == FocusLifecycle), middle))
170			builder.WriteString("\n")
171			builder.WriteString(renderNarrowPanel(panelTitle("ACTIONS / CONDITION", m.focus == FocusActions), right))
172		}
173		builder.WriteString("\n\n" + m.renderRepositoryFooter())
174		return builder.String()
175	}

177	func (m Model) localStatusLine() string {
178		label := "UNKNOWN"
179		if m.hasSnapshot {
180			label = strings.ToUpper(string(m.snapshot.Freshness))
181		}
182		if m.loadRequest.loading {
183			label = "REFRESHING"
184		}
185		authoritative := m.hasSnapshot && m.snapshot.Authoritative() && !m.loadRequest.loading
186		if !authoritative {
187			label += " | NON-AUTHORITATIVE"
188		}
189		if m.loadRequest.stale {
190			label += " | STALE"
191		}
192		if m.hasSnapshot && !m.snapshot.Repository.Available {
193			label += " | UNAVAILABLE"
194		}
195		return "LOCAL: " + label
196	}

198	func panelTitle(title string, focused bool) string {
199		if focused {
200			return title + " [FOCUS]"
201		}
202		return title
203	}

205	func (m Model) surfacePanelLines() []string {
206		rows := m.snapshot.Surfaces.Values()
207		if len(rows) == 0 {
208			return []string{"(valid empty snapshot)", "No checkout or task-only rows."}
209		}
210		lines := make([]string, 0, len(rows)*2)
211		for index, row := range rows {
212			marker := "  "
213			if index == m.rowCursor {
214				marker = "> "
215			}
216			badges := []string{"[" + strings.ToUpper(string(row.Kind)) + "]"}
217			if len(row.Drift.Values()) > 0 {
218				badges = append(badges, "[DRIFT]")
219			}
220			if len(row.Conflicts.Values()) > 0 || row.Kind == SurfaceConflict {
221				badges = append(badges, "[CONFLICT]")
222			}
223			label := row.Label
224			if label == "" {
225				label = row.Branch
226			}
227			if label == "" {
228				label = row.RowKey
229			}
230			line := marker + label + " " + strings.Join(badges, " ")
231			if index == m.rowCursor {
232				line = styleSelected.Render(line)
233			}
234			lines = append(lines, line)
235			if row.Path != "" {
236				lines = append(lines, "    "+row.Path)
237			} else if row.Locator.TaskID != "" {
238				lines = append(lines, "    task "+row.Locator.TaskID+" (no checkout)")
239			}
240		}
241		return lines
242	}
243	
244	func (m Model) lifecyclePanelLines() []string {
245		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
246		if !ok {
247			return []string{"No surface selected."}
248		}
249		lines := []string{"kind: " + strings.ToUpper(string(row.Kind))}
250		if row.Mode == "" || row.State == "" {
251			lines = append(lines, "recorded lifecycle: UNTRACKED")
252		} else {
253			lines = append(lines,
254				"mode: "+strings.ToUpper(string(row.Mode)),
255				"rail: "+lifecycleRail(row.Mode, row.State),
256				"current persisted state: "+strings.ToUpper(string(row.State)),
257			)
258		}
259		if row.Branch != "" {
260			lines = append(lines, "branch: "+row.Branch)
261		}
262		if row.Base != "" {
263			lines = append(lines, "base: "+row.Base)
264		}
265		for _, evidence := range row.Evidence.Values() {
266			lines = append(lines, "EVIDENCE: "+evidence)
267		}
268		for _, drift := range row.Drift.Values() {
269			lines = append(lines, "DRIFT: "+drift)
270		}
271		for _, conflict := range row.Conflicts.Values() {
272			lines = append(lines, "CONFLICT: "+conflict)
273		}
274		if remote, ok := m.remote.RemoteObservation(); ok {
275			lines = append(lines, remoteObservationLines(remote)...)
276		}
277		return lines
278	}
279	
280	func lifecycleRail(mode task.CheckoutMode, current task.State) string {
281		states := []task.State{task.Hot, task.Warm, task.Cold, task.Done}
282		if mode == task.ModeDirect {
283			states = []task.State{task.Hot, task.Warm, task.Done}
284		}
285		parts := make([]string, 0, len(states))
286		for _, state := range states {
287			label := strings.ToUpper(string(state))
288			if state == current {
289				label = "[" + label + " CURRENT]"
290			}
291			parts = append(parts, colourState(state, label))
292		}
293		return strings.Join(parts, " -> ")
294	}
295	
296	func colourState(state task.State, value string) string {
297		switch state {
298		case task.Hot:
299			return styleHot.Render(value)
300		case task.Warm:
301			return styleWarm.Render(value)
302		case task.Cold:
303			return styleCold.Render(value)
304		case task.Done:
305			return styleDone.Render(value)
306		default:
307			return value
308		}
309	}

311	func (m Model) actionPanelLines() []string {
312		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
313		if !ok {
314			return []string{"No surface selected."}
315		}
316		actions := row.Actions.Values()
317		if len(actions) == 0 {
318			return []string{"No guarded actions are available.", "This row is inspect-only."}
319		}
320		lines := make([]string, 0, len(actions)+4)
321		for index, choice := range actions {
322			marker := "  "
323			if index == m.actionCursor {
324				marker = "> "
325			}
326			label := choice.Label
327			if !choice.Valid() {
328				label += " [INVALID]"
329			}
330			line := marker + label
331			if index == m.actionCursor {
332				line = styleSelected.Render(line)
333			}
334			lines = append(lines, line)
335		}
336		if choice, ok := m.currentAction(); ok {
337			lines = append(lines, "", "selected: "+choice.Description)
338			lines = append(lines, "Enter: inspect a fresh plan; no immediate mutation.")
339			if choice.Action() == taskflow.RefreshRemote {
340				lines = append(lines, "network variant: "+remoteChoiceDescription(choice.Options()))
341			}
342		}
343		return lines
344	}
345	
346	func remoteChoiceDescription(options taskflow.ActionOptions) string {
347		remote, ok := options.(taskflow.RefreshRemoteOptions)
348		if !ok {
349			return "invalid remote options"
350		}
351		switch {
352		case remote.FetchRefs && remote.QueryReview:
353			return "FETCH REFS + QUERY REVIEW"
354		case remote.FetchRefs:
355			return "FETCH REFS"
356		case remote.QueryReview:
357			return "QUERY REVIEW"
358		default:
359			return "NO OPERATION SELECTED"
360		}
361	}

363	func (m Model) renderRepositoryFooter() string {
364		var lines []string
365		if m.status != "" {
366			lines = append(lines, "STATUS: "+m.status)
367		}
368		lines = append(lines,
369			"j/k or arrows row | h/l or arrows action | Tab focus | Enter plan",
370			"r local reload | R remote menu | Esc repositories | ? help | q quit",
371		)
372		return styleMuted.Render(strings.Join(lines, "\n"))
373	}
374	
375	func renderWidePanels(leftTitle string, left []string, middleTitle string, middle []string, rightTitle string, right []string, width int) string {
376		gutter := " | "
377		usable := width - 2*lipgloss.Width(gutter)
378		if usable < 60 {
379			usable = 60
380		}
381		leftWidth := usable * 30 / 100
382		middleWidth := usable * 36 / 100
383		rightWidth := usable - leftWidth - middleWidth
384		left = append([]string{leftTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, leftWidth))}, left...)
385		middle = append([]string{middleTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, middleWidth))}, middle...)
386		right = append([]string{rightTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, rightWidth))}, right...)
387		count := max(len(left), len(middle), len(right))
388		var builder strings.Builder
389		for index := 0; index < count; index++ {
390			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(left, index), leftWidth))
391			builder.WriteString(gutter)
392			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(middle, index), middleWidth))
393			builder.WriteString(gutter)
394			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(right, index), rightWidth))
395			if index+1 < count {
396				builder.WriteByte('\n')
397			}
398		}
399		return builder.String()
400	}
401	
402	func renderNarrowPanel(title string, lines []string) string {
403		return title + "\n" + strings.Repeat("-", max(1, lipgloss.Width(title))) + "\n" + strings.Join(lines, "\n")
404	}
405	
406	func lineAt(lines []string, index int) string {
407		if index < 0 || index >= len(lines) {
408			return ""
409		}
410		return lines[index]
411	}
412	
413	func fitPanelLine(value string, width int) string {
414		value = truncateDisplay(value, width)
415		missing := width - lipgloss.Width(value)
416		if missing > 0 {
417			value += strings.Repeat(" ", missing)
418		}
419		return value
420	}
421	
422	func truncateDisplay(value string, width int) string {
423		if width <= 0 {
424			return ""
425		}
426		return ansi.Truncate(value, width, "…")
427	}

431			styleTitle.Render("dev flow  HELP"),
432			"",
433			"MODEL",
434			"  HOT / WARM / COLD / DONE are the only persisted task states.",
435			"  READY is plan availability; REVIEW / MERGED / RETIRED are result milestones only.",
436			"  DRIFT and CONFLICT are evidence labels, never mutation permission.",
437			"  STALE and ERROR observations are non-authoritative.",
438			"",
439			"KEYS",
440			"  j/k or up/down     select surface (or repository/menu row)",
441			"  h/l or left/right  select an already-concrete action variant",
442			"  Tab                move panel focus",
443			"  /                  filter the repository picker",
444			"  Enter              call Plan and inspect it; never mutate immediately",
445			"  y                  approve a READY non-typed plan",
446			"  r                  reload local facts only",
447			"  R                  choose provided fetch/query/both remote variants",
448			"  Esc                back out",
449			"  q                  quit (queued while Apply is running)",
450			"",
451			styleMuted.Render("? or Esc closes help | q quits"),
452		}, "\n")
453	}

469			if choice.Description != "" {
470				builder.WriteString("    " + choice.Description + "\n")
471			}
472		}
473		builder.WriteString("\n" + styleMuted.Render("j/k choose | Enter plan | R or Esc back | q quit"))
474		return builder.String()

478		return strings.Join([]string{
479			styleTitle.Render("dev flow  PLAN"),
480			"",
481			"Planning " + m.planTarget.choice.Label + " for exact row " + m.planTarget.rowKey + "...",
482			"No mutation has started.",
483			"",
484			styleMuted.Render("Esc cancel planning | q quit"),
485		}, "\n")

487	
488	func (m Model) renderPlan(applying bool) string {
489		var builder strings.Builder
490		title := "dev flow  PLAN"
491		if applying {
492			title = "dev flow  APPLYING"
493		}
494		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render(title) + "\n\n")
495		builder.WriteString("repository: " + m.planTarget.repoKey + "\n")
496		builder.WriteString("row: " + m.planTarget.rowKey + "\n")
497		builder.WriteString("choice: " + m.planTarget.actionID + " — " + m.planTarget.choice.Label + "\n")
498		if m.planErr != nil {
499			builder.WriteString("\n" + styleBad.Render("PLAN ERROR: "+m.planErr.Error()) + "\n")
500		}
501		if !m.hasPlan {
502			builder.WriteString("\nNo valid plan is available. This error is inspectable and has no Apply path.\n")
503			builder.WriteString("\n" + styleMuted.Render("Esc back | q quit"))
504			return builder.String()
505		}
506	
507		builder.WriteString("plan ID: " + m.plan.PlanID + "\n")
508		builder.WriteString("availability: " + availabilityLabel(m.plan.Availability) + "\n")
509		if m.plan.Summary != "" {
510			builder.WriteString("summary: " + m.plan.Summary + "\n")
511		}
512		if m.plan.HasPersistedTransition {
513			target := strings.ToUpper(string(m.plan.Target))
514			if m.plan.RemovesTask {
515				target = "TASK REMOVED"
516			}
517			builder.WriteString("persisted transition: " + strings.ToUpper(string(m.plan.Source)) + " -> " + target)
518			if m.plan.StatePreserving {
519				builder.WriteString(" (state-preserving)")
520			}
521			builder.WriteString("\n")
522		}
523		if milestone := milestoneLabel(m.plan.ExpectedMilestone); milestone != "" {
524			builder.WriteString("expected result milestone: " + milestone + " (not a persisted state)\n")
525		}
526	
527		builder.WriteString("\nCONDITIONS (ordered)\n")
528		conditions := m.plan.Conditions()
529		if len(conditions) == 0 {
530			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
531		}
532		for index, condition := range conditions {
533			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. [%s] [%s] %s\n", index+1,
534				availabilityLabel(taskflow.Availability(condition.Verdict)), strings.ToUpper(string(condition.Requirement)), condition.Code))
535			evidence := condition.Evidence
536			if evidence == "" {
537				evidence = "(none recorded)"
538			}
539			builder.WriteString("     evidence: " + evidence + "\n")
540			remediation := condition.Remediation
541			if remediation == "" {
542				remediation = "(none required)"
543			}
544			builder.WriteString("     remediation: " + remediation + "\n")
545		}
546	
547		builder.WriteString("\nEFFECTS (execution order)\n")
548		effects := m.plan.Effects()
549		if len(effects) == 0 {
550			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
551		}
552		for index, effect := range effects {
553			markers := []string{}
554			if effect.Network {
555				markers = append(markers, "NETWORK")
556			}
557			if effect.Destructive {
558				markers = append(markers, "DESTRUCTIVE")
559			}
560			markerText := ""
561			if len(markers) > 0 {
562				markerText = " [" + strings.Join(markers, "] [") + "]"
563			}
564			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. %s%s — %s", index+1, effect.Code, markerText, effect.Description))
565			if effect.Target != "" {
566				builder.WriteString(" -> " + effect.Target)
567			}
568			builder.WriteString("\n")
569			for _, detail := range effect.Details.Entries() {
570				builder.WriteString("     " + detail.Key + ": " + detail.Value + "\n")
571			}
572		}
573	
574		builder.WriteString("\nRETAINED RESOURCES\n")
575		retained := m.plan.RetainedResources()
576		if len(retained) == 0 {
577			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
578		} else {
579			for _, resource := range retained {
580				builder.WriteString("  - " + resource + "\n")
581			}
582		}
583		builder.WriteString("fallback command: ")
584		if m.plan.FallbackCommand == "" {
585			builder.WriteString("(none supplied)\n")
586		} else {
587			builder.WriteString(m.plan.FallbackCommand + "\n")
588		}
589	
590		builder.WriteString("\n")
591		switch {
592		case applying:
593			builder.WriteString("APPLYING: conflicting navigation and refresh are disabled. q/r are queued.\n")
594		case !m.planCanApply():
595			builder.WriteString("NO APPLY PATH: only READY plans can be approved; this plan remains inspectable.\n")
596		case m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped:
597			prompt := m.plan.Confirmation.Prompt
598			if prompt == "" {
599				prompt = "Type the exact confirmation token"
600			}
601			builder.WriteString(prompt + "\n")
602			builder.WriteString("required exact token: " + m.plan.Confirmation.Token + "\n")
603			builder.WriteString("confirmation: " + m.confirm.View() + "\n")
604			builder.WriteString("Enter validates and applies; any mismatch remains non-mutating.\n")
605		default:
606			prompt := m.plan.Confirmation.Prompt
607			if prompt != "" {
608				builder.WriteString(prompt + "\n")
609			}
610			builder.WriteString("Press y to approve this exact PlanID. Enter never applies.\n")
611		}
612		if m.status != "" {
613			builder.WriteString("STATUS: " + m.status + "\n")
614		}
615		if !applying {
616			builder.WriteString(styleMuted.Render("Esc back | q quit"))
617		}
618		return builder.String()
619	}
620	
621	func availabilityLabel(value taskflow.Availability) string {
622		if value == "" {
623			return "UNKNOWN"
624		}
625		return strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(string(value), "-", " "))
626	}
627	
628	func milestoneLabel(value taskflow.Milestone) string {
629		switch value {
630		case taskflow.MilestoneReviewReady:
631			return "REVIEW"
632		case taskflow.MilestoneMerged:
633			return "MERGED"
634		case taskflow.MilestoneRetired:
635			return "RETIRED"
636		case taskflow.MilestoneAdopted:
637			return "ADOPTED"
638		case taskflow.MilestoneReconciled:
639			return "RECONCILED"
640		default:
641			return ""
642		}
643	}
644	
645	func (m Model) renderResult() string {
646		var builder strings.Builder
647		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev flow  RESULT") + "\n\n")
648		builder.WriteString("choice: " + m.planTarget.actionID + " — " + m.planTarget.choice.Label + "\n")
649		if m.lastResultErr != nil {
650			builder.WriteString(styleBad.Render("APPLY ERROR: "+m.lastResultErr.Error()) + "\n")
651		} else {
652			builder.WriteString(styleGood.Render("APPLY COMPLETED") + "\n")
653		}
654		if m.lastResult.PartialSuccess {
655			builder.WriteString("PARTIAL SUCCESS: completed effects remain completed; no rollback is implied.\n")
656		}
657		if milestone := milestoneLabel(m.lastResult.Milestone); milestone != "" {
658			builder.WriteString("result milestone: " + milestone + " (not a persisted state)\n")
659		}
660	
661		builder.WriteString("\nSTEP LEDGER\n")
662		steps := m.lastResult.AttemptedSteps()
663		if len(steps) == 0 {
664			builder.WriteString("  (no effect was attempted)\n")
665		}
666		for index, step := range steps {
667			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. [%s] %s — %s", index+1,
668				strings.ToUpper(string(step.Status)), step.Effect.Code, step.Effect.Description))
669			if step.Detail != "" {
670				builder.WriteString(" | " + step.Detail)
671			}
672			if step.Failure != "" {
673				builder.WriteString(" | FAILURE: " + step.Failure)
674			}
675			builder.WriteString("\n")
676		}
677		builder.WriteString("\nWARNINGS\n")
678		writeStringSection(&builder, m.lastResult.Warnings())
679		builder.WriteString("RECOVERY\n")
680		writeStringSection(&builder, m.lastResult.Recovery())
681		if remote, ok := m.lastResult.RemoteObservation(); ok {
682			builder.WriteString("REMOTE OBSERVATION (run-local)\n")
683			for _, line := range remoteObservationLines(remote) {
684				builder.WriteString("  " + line + "\n")
685			}
686		}
687		if handoff, ok := m.lastResult.Handoff(); ok {
688			builder.WriteString("HANDOFF (available after alternate-screen exit)\n")
689			builder.WriteString("  " + handoffDescription(handoff) + "\n")
690		}
691		if m.loadRequest.loading {
692			builder.WriteString("\nREFRESHING: a new local generation is loading; state was not changed optimistically.\n")
693		} else if m.loadRequest.err != nil {
694			builder.WriteString("\nSTALE: post-Apply local reload failed: " + m.loadRequest.err.Error() + "\n")
695		}
696		if m.status != "" {
697			builder.WriteString("STATUS: " + m.status + "\n")
698		}
699		builder.WriteString("\n" + styleMuted.Render("Esc return to repository | r reload again | ? help | q quit"))
700		return builder.String()
701	}
702	
703	func writeStringSection(builder *strings.Builder, values []string) {
704		if len(values) == 0 {
705			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
706			return
707		}
708		for _, value := range values {
709			builder.WriteString("  - " + value + "\n")
710		}
711	}
712	
713	func handoffDescription(handoff taskflow.Handoff) string {
714		parts := []string{strings.ToUpper(string(handoff.Kind))}
715		for _, value := range []string{handoff.Path, handoff.Runtime, handoff.RuntimeHandle, handoff.URL, handoff.Label} {
716			if value != "" {
717				parts = append(parts, value)
718			}
719		}
720		return strings.Join(parts, " | ")
721	}
722	
723	func remoteObservationLines(remote taskflow.RemoteObservation) []string {
724		lines := []string{"REMOTE: " + remote.RemoteName}
725		if remote.Provider != "" {
726			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE PROVIDER: "+strings.ToUpper(string(remote.Provider)))
727		}
728		if remote.Repository != "" {
729			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REPOSITORY: "+remote.Repository)
730		}
731		if remote.Head != "" || remote.Base != "" {
732			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BRANCHES: "+remote.Head+" -> "+remote.Base)
733		}
734		lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BEFORE REFS: "+refsSummary(remote.BeforeRefs))
735		if !remote.BeforeRefs.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
736			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BEFORE OBSERVED: "+formatTime(remote.BeforeRefs.ObservedAt))
737		}
738		if remote.HasAfterRefs {
739			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE AFTER REFS: "+refsSummary(remote.AfterRefs))
740			if !remote.AfterRefs.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
741				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE AFTER OBSERVED: "+formatTime(remote.AfterRefs.ObservedAt))
742			}
743		}
744		if remote.HasReview {
745			review := remote.Review
746			switch {
747			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationError:
748				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW ERROR: "+string(review.FailureKind)+" — "+review.Failure)
749			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationKnown && !review.Exists:
750				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW: NONE (known)")
751			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationKnown:
752				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("REMOTE REVIEW: #%d %s %s", review.Number, strings.ToUpper(string(review.ReviewState)), review.URL))
753			default:
754				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW: "+strings.ToUpper(string(review.State)))
755			}
756			if !review.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
757				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW OBSERVED: "+formatTime(review.ObservedAt))
758			}
759		}
760		return lines
761	}
762	
763	func refsSummary(refs taskflow.RemoteRefsObservation) string {
764		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
765		for _, ref := range []taskflow.NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
766			if ref.Ref == "" {
767				continue
768			}
769			switch {
770			case ref.Failure != "":
771				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"=ERROR("+ref.Failure+")")
772			case ref.Exists:
773				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"="+ref.OID)
774			default:
775				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"=ABSENT")
776			}
777		}
778		if len(parts) == 0 {
779			return "no named refs observed"
780		}
781		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
782	}
783	
784	func formatTime(value time.Time) string {
785		return value.Local().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05 MST")
786	}

229	func parseAzureReviewCandidates(out string) ([]reviewCandidate, error) {
230		var raw []struct {
231			PullRequestID       *int   `json:"pullRequestId"`
232			Status              string `json:"status"`
233			IsDraft             *bool  `json:"isDraft"`
234			SourceRefName       string `json:"sourceRefName"`
235			TargetRefName       string `json:"targetRefName"`
236			RemoteURL           string `json:"remoteUrl"`
237			RepositoryRemoteURL string `json:"repositoryRemoteUrl"`
238		}
239		if err := decodeReviewJSON(AzureDevOps, out, &raw); err != nil {
240			return nil, err
241		}
242		candidates := make([]reviewCandidate, 0, len(raw))
243		for _, item := range raw {
244			id, number := "", 0
245			if item.PullRequestID != nil {
246				number = *item.PullRequestID
247				id = strconv.Itoa(number)
248			}
249			reviewURL := item.RemoteURL
250			if !validReviewURL(reviewURL) && item.RepositoryRemoteURL != "" && number > 0 {
251				if _, repositoryURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(item.RepositoryRemoteURL); ok {
252					reviewURL = strings.TrimRight(repositoryURL, "/") + "/pullrequest/" + strconv.Itoa(number)
253				}
254			}
255			candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
256				ID: id, Number: number, State: item.Status, Draft: item.IsDraft,
257				URL: reviewURL, Head: azureReviewBranch(item.SourceRefName), Base: azureReviewBranch(item.TargetRefName),
258			})
259		}
260		return candidates, nil
261	}

268		switch strings.ToLower(state) {
269		case "active":
270			if draft {

272			}
273			return ReviewOpen, nil
274		case "completed":
275			return ReviewMerged, nil
276		case "abandoned":
277			return ReviewClosed, nil
278		default:
279			return "", errors.New("unrecognized Azure DevOps review state")
280		}

13	func guardSharedCheckout(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout string) error {
14		if app.allowSharedCheckout {
15			return nil
16		}
17		reportedPane := ""
18		if rt != nil {
19			switch rt.Name() {
20			case "herdr":
21				reportedPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
22			case "tmux":
23				reportedPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
24			}
25		}
26		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
27			Profile:      runtime.OccupancyStrict,
28			CallerPaneID: reportedPane,
29		})
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("check live occupancy before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
32		}
33		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
34			return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
35		}
36		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("classify live runtime coverage before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionCoverageErr)
38		}
39		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("list live runtime sessions before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionList.Err)
41		}
42		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
44		}
45	
46		var occupied []string
47		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
48			if !agent.Blocking {
49				continue
50			}
51			activity := agent.Activity
52			label := activity.Agent
53			if activity.Name != "" {
54				label = activity.Name
55			}
56			if label == "" {
57				label = "agent"
58			}
59			occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, activity.PaneID))
60		}
61		if len(occupied) == 0 {
62			return nil
63		}
64		return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
65			config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
66	}
67	
68	// checkoutAgentActivities returns recognized agents whose reported cwd resolves
69	// to the same canonical Git worktree root as checkout. A pane is excluded only
70	// when its exact ID matches excludePane; lifecycle state never makes it free.
71	func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {
72		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{Profile: runtime.OccupancyStrict})
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
77			return nil, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err
78		}
79		out := make([]runtime.AgentActivity, 0, len(evidence.Agents))
80		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
81			if excludePane == "" || agent.Activity.PaneID != excludePane {
82				out = append(out, agent.Activity)
83			}
84		}
85		return out, nil
86	}

187	func tuiRemoteCloneDestination(app *App, name string) (string, error) {
188		projectRoot := config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot)
189		if err := os.MkdirAll(projectRoot, 0o755); err != nil {
190			return "", err
191		}
192		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(projectRoot, name)
193		if err != nil {
194			return "", fmt.Errorf("remote repository name %q is not a safe clone destination: %w", name, err)
195		}
196		return destination, nil
197	}

392			// Open is navigation-only. The model rejects missing/unregistered and
393			// cold worktree tasks before this callback so reconciliation and writer
394			// ownership remain explicit `dev sweep` / `dev resume` operations.
395			Open: func(ctx context.Context, t *task.Task) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
396				checkout := checkoutOf(t)

398					return tui.OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout — run `dev resume %s`", t.Title(), t.ID)
399				}
400				// Enter is navigation only. Claiming a writer is an explicit
401				// `dev resume`/start action with collision checks.
402				return openResolved(ctx, checkout, t.Title(), "")
403			},

427				if row.Repository == nil {

429				}
430				executable, err := os.Executable()
431				if err != nil {
432					return nil, err

434				args := []string{}
435				if active.configPath != "" {
436					args = append(args, "--config", active.configPath)
437				}
438				if active.remotesPath != "" {
439					args = append(args, "--remotes", active.remotesPath)
440				}
441				if row.Local {
442					args = append(args, "repo", "open", row.Repository.Path)
443				} else {

449			CloneRemote: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RemoteRow) (tui.OpenResult, string, error) {
450				dest, err := tuiRemoteCloneDestination(appState.Current(), r.Repo.Name)
451				if err != nil {
452					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", err
453				}
454				if _, err := os.Stat(dest); err == nil {
455					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", fmt.Errorf("%s already exists; add it to scan_roots or clone somewhere explicit",
456						config.Contract(dest))
457				}
458				if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, filepath.Dir(dest), "clone", r.Repo.CloneURL, dest); err != nil {
459					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", err
460				}
461				opened, err := openResolved(ctx, dest, r.Repo.Name, r.Repo.FullName)
462				if err != nil {
463					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", fmt.Errorf("cloned to %s, but could not open it: %w", config.Contract(dest), err)
464				}
465				if opened.Directory != "" {
466					opened.Status = "cloned " + r.Repo.FullName + " to " + config.Contract(dest)
467				} else {
468					opened.Status = fmt.Sprintf("cloned %s to %s; %s", r.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(dest), opened.Status)
469				}
470				return opened, dest, nil
471			},

507			// I am working on" — the step that otherwise means dropping out of the

509			Start: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {

515				actionApp := *active
516				actionApp.runtimeInstance = rt
517				spec, err := buildStartSpecForRepository(ctx, &actionApp, r.Repo, startRequest{
518					Name: name, Mode: task.ModeWorktree,
519				})
520				if err != nil {
521					return "", err
522				}
523				started, err := executeStartSpec(ctx, &actionApp, spec, nil)

530			StartDirect: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
531				active := appState.Current()
532				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
533				if err != nil {
534					return "", err
535				}
536				if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, active, rt, r.Repo.Path); err != nil {
537					return "", err
538				}
539				st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Repo.Path)
540				if err != nil {
541					return "", err
542				}
543				if st.Detached || st.Branch == "" {
544					return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
545				}
546				id := task.MakeID(r.Repo.Name, st.Branch)
547				if existing, err := active.Tasks.Get(id); err == nil && existing.State != task.Done {
548					return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
549				}
550				handle, err := rt.Open(ctx, r.Repo.Path, r.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
551				if err != nil {
552					return "", err
553				}
554				t := &task.Task{
555					Name: name, Repo: r.Repo.Name, RepoPath: r.Repo.Path,
556					Branch: st.Branch, Base: st.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
557					State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),
558				}
559				setTaskRuntime(t, rt, handle)
560				if err := active.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
561					return "", err
562				}
563				annotate(active, rt, t)
564				return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, st.Branch), nil
565			},

567			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
568				active := appState.Current()
569				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
570				if err != nil {
571					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
572				}
573				defer store.Close()
574				until := time.Now()
575				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
576				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
577					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
578				})
579				if err != nil {
580					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
581				}
582				seconds, days := 0, 0
583				for _, value := range totals {
584					seconds += value
585					if value > 0 {
586						days++
587					}
588				}
589				return tui.StatsPanel{
590					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
591					Since: since, Until: until,
592					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
593						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
594					}),
595				}, nil
596			},
597

599				active := appState.Current()

604				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
605				if err != nil {
606					return err
607				}
608				defer store.Close()
609				_, err = stats.BackfillGit(ctx, store, []repo.Repo{r}, time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), "")
610				return err
611			},

630			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
631				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
632				if err != nil {
633					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
634				}
635				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
636				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
637				if err != nil {
638					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
639				}
640				status := "config + data reloaded"
641				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
642					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
643				}
644				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
645					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
646					Tools:       externalTools(next),
647					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
648					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
649					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
650				}, status, nil
651			},
652		}
653	
654		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
655		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
656		// while dozens of repos are probed.
657		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
658		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
659		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
660		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
661		cancelRun()
662		app.finishTrace()
663		if err != nil {
664			return err
665		}
666		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
667		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
668		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
669			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
670				return app.cdDirective(dir)
671			}
672			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
673				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
674				if resolveErr != nil {
675					return resolveErr
676				}
677				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
678			}
679		}
680		return nil
681	}

683	func collectTries(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
684		options := experiment.ListOptions{All: includeAll}
685		return collectTriesWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, options, nil, false)
686	}
687	
688	func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,
689		sessions []runtime.Session, sessionsSet bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
690		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
691		if err != nil {
692			return nil, err
693		}
694		items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
695		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
696		if !sessionsSet {
697			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
698		}
699		rows := make([]tui.TryRow, 0, len(items))
700		for _, item := range items {
701			row := tui.TryRow{Item: item}
702			if item.Entry != nil {
703				if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname()); ok {
704					copy := location
705					row.Location = &copy
706				}
707			}
708			sizeRepo := item.Live.Repo
709			if sizeRepo == nil && item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
710				if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); discoverErr == nil {
711					sizeRepo = &discovered
712				}
713			}
714			if sizeRepo != nil {
715				worktreeCount := 0
716				if worktrees, worktreeErr := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); worktreeErr == nil && len(worktrees) > 1 {
717					worktreeCount = len(worktrees) - 1
718				}
719				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(*sizeRepo, worktreeCount)
720			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
721				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(item.Live.CurrentPath)
722			}
723			if item.Live.Present && item.Live.Repo != nil {
724				row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
725			}
726			if item.Live.Present {
727				for _, session := range sessions {
728					if session.Covers(item.Live.CurrentPath) ||
729						(item.Live.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(item.Live.RealPath)) {
730						row.Live = true
731						row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
732						break
733					}
734				}
735			}
736			rows = append(rows, row)
737		}
738		return rows, listErr
739	}

741	func applyTryAction(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
742		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
743		if err != nil {
744			return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
745		}
746		resolve := func() (experiment.Item, error) {
747			item, diagnostics, resolveErr := service.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.ID, experiment.ResolveOptions{
748				IncludeDeprecated: true, IncludeArchived: true,
749				IncludeEvicted: true, IncludeGraduated: true,
750			})
751			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
752			return item, resolveErr
753		}
754		open := func(item experiment.Item, status string) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
755			if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
756				return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("Try %s is not present on this host", item.DisplayName())
757			}
758			handle, openErr := openCheckout(ctx, rt, item.Live.CurrentPath, item.DisplayName())
759			if openErr != nil {
760				return tui.TryActionResult{}, openErr
761			}
762			result := tui.TryActionResult{Status: status, RefreshRepos: true}
763			if rt.Name() == "none" {
764				result.CD = item.Live.CurrentPath
765			} else {
766				result.Status += fmt.Sprintf(" in %s (%s)", rt.Name(), handle.Handle)
767				result.RuntimeHandle = handle.Handle
768			}
769			if _, touchErr := service.Touch(ctx, item.ID); touchErr != nil {
770				return result, fmt.Errorf("%s, but could not record activity: %w", status, touchErr)
771			}
772			return result, nil
773		}
774	
775		switch request.Action {
776		case tui.TryOpen:
777			item, resolveErr := resolve()
778			if resolveErr != nil {
779				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
780			}
781			return open(item, "opened "+item.DisplayName())
782	
783		case tui.TryCreate:
784			created, createErr := service.ResolveOrCreate(ctx, experiment.CreateRequest{
785				Name: request.Name, Clone: request.Clone, NoGit: request.NoGit,
786			})
787			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, created.Diagnostics)
788			if created.InitWarning != nil {
789				app.warnf("could not git init: %v", created.InitWarning)
790			}
791			if createErr != nil {
792				return tui.TryActionResult{}, createErr
793			}
794			status := "created " + created.Item.DisplayName()
795			if created.Existing {
796				status = "opened existing " + created.Item.DisplayName()
797			}
798			result, openErr := open(created.Item, status)
799			result.RefreshRepos = true
800			return result, openErr
801	
802		case tui.TryMark:
803			item, resolveErr := resolve()
804			if resolveErr != nil {
805				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
806			}
807			desired := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.Tags)
808			remove := append([]string(nil), item.Tags...)
809			note := request.Note
810			updated, diagnostics, patchErr := service.Patch(ctx, experiment.PatchRequest{
811				Ref: item.ID, AddTags: desired, RemoveTags: remove, Note: &note,
812			})
813			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
814			return tui.TryActionResult{
815				Status: "updated metadata for " + updated.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
816			}, patchErr
817	
818		case tui.TryDeprecate:
819			transition, transitionErr := service.Deprecate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
820			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
821			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "deprecated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
822	
823		case tui.TryReactivate:
824			transition, transitionErr := service.Reactivate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
825			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
826			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "reactivated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
827	
828		case tui.TryArchive:
829			transition, transitionErr := service.Archive(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
830			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
831			return tui.TryActionResult{
832				Status: "archived " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
833			}, transitionErr
834	
835		case tui.TryRestore:
836			transition, transitionErr := service.Restore(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID, To: request.To})
837			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
838			return tui.TryActionResult{
839				Status: "restored " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
840			}, transitionErr
841	
842		case tui.TryGraduate:
843			graduated, graduateErr := service.Graduate(ctx, experiment.GraduateRequest{
844				Ref: request.ID, Category: request.Category, Name: request.Name,
845			})
846			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, graduated.Diagnostics)
847			if graduateErr != nil {
848				return tui.TryActionResult{}, graduateErr
849			}
850			result, openErr := open(graduated.Item, "graduated "+graduated.Plan.Name)
851			result.RefreshRepos = true
852			return result, openErr
853		}
854		return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown Try action %q", request.Action)
855	}
856	
857	// repoCollectOptions leaves an opt-in path for the future TRY view while the
858	// ordinary repository inventory suppresses active and deprecated Tries.
859	type repoCollectOptions struct {
860		IncludeTries bool
861		Sessions     []runtime.Session
862		SessionsSet  bool
863		Tasks        []*task.Task
864		TasksSet     bool
865		Repos        []repo.Repo
866		ReposSet     bool
867		Limiter      *inventory.Limiter
868	}
869	
870	// collectRepos builds the default repository view: what exists, plus how much
871	// of it is in flight, excluding cataloged active/deprecated Tries.
872	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
873		return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
874	}
875	
876	func collectReposWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
877		repos := options.Repos
878		var err error
879		if !options.ReposSet {
880			repos, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
881			if err != nil {
882				return nil, err
883			}
884		}
885		assets, catalogComplete, err := joinRepoAssets(app, repos)
886		if err != nil {
887			return nil, err
888		}
889		if !options.IncludeTries {
890			visibleRepos := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(repos))
891			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
892			for index, repository := range repos {
893				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
894					continue
895				}
896				visibleRepos = append(visibleRepos, repository)
897				visibleAssets = append(visibleAssets, assets[index])
898			}
899			repos, assets = visibleRepos, visibleAssets
900		}
901		tasks := options.Tasks
902		if !options.TasksSet {
903			tasks, err = app.Tasks.List()
904			if err != nil {
905				return nil, err
906			}
907		}
908		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
909		for _, t := range tasks {
910			byRepo[t.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[t.RepoPath], t)
911		}
912		sessions := options.Sessions
913		if !options.SessionsSet {
914			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
915		}
916		notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
917		if app.Notes != nil {
918			allNotes, noteErr := app.Notes.List("")
919			if noteErr != nil {
920				return nil, noteErr
921			}
922			for _, n := range allNotes {
923				notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID] = append(notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID], n)
924			}
925		}
926	
927		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
928		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising
929		// ~3*56 git processes was the measured 4.2s startup bottleneck; eight
930		// workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once. TUI callers
931		// share the limiter with task enrichment.
932		limiter := options.Limiter
933		if limiter == nil {
934			limiter = inventory.NewLimiter(8)
935		}
936		var wg sync.WaitGroup
937		for i, r := range repos {
938			wg.Add(1)
939			go func(i int, r repo.Repo) {
940				defer wg.Done()
941				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
942				if !ok {
943					return
944				}
945				defer release()
946	
947				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: assets[i]}
948				if row.Asset != nil {
949					repoNotes := notesByRepo[row.Asset.ID]
950					row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
951					if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
952						row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
953					}
954				}
955				if r.HasGit {
956					row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, r.Path)
957				}
958				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
959				if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
960					row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
961				}
962				row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
963				row.LastActivity = row.Context.LastActivity
964				row.Worktrees = row.Context.WorktreeCount
965				if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
966					row.Status = main.Status
967				}
968				if !r.Bare {
969					row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
970				}
971				if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
972					row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
973					row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
974				}
975				if r.HasGit {
976					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(gitx.Repo{
977						Root: r.Path, GitDir: r.GitDir, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
978						MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
979					}, row.Worktrees)
980				} else {
981					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(r.Path)
982				}
983				out[i] = row
984			}(i, r)
985		}
986		wg.Wait()
987		return out, ctx.Err()
988	}
989	
990	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
991	//
992	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
993	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
994	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
995	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
996		var out []tui.Tool
997		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
998			run := t.Run
999			name := t.Name
1000			if name == "" {
1001				name = firstWord(run)
1002			}
1003			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
1004			if t.Interactive {
1005				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
1006				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
1007				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
1008				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
1009				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
1010			}
1011			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
1012				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
1013				Probe: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
1014			})
1015		}
1016		return out
1017	}
1018	
1019	// commandRunnable resolves the command's first word on PATH, expanding a
1020	// leading environment variable so "$EDITOR ." checks the editor itself. The
1021	// returned probe is run by a bounded Bubble Tea command, never by View.
1022	func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func(context.Context) bool {
1023		return func(ctx context.Context) bool { return checkCommandRunnable(ctx, run, interactive) }
1024	}
1025	
1026	func checkCommandRunnable(ctx context.Context, run string, interactive bool) bool {
1027		if ctx == nil {
1028			ctx = context.Background()
1029		}
1030		word := firstWord(run)
1031		if strings.HasPrefix(word, "$") {
1032			word = os.Getenv(strings.TrimPrefix(word, "$"))
1033			if word == "" {
1034				return false
1035			}
1036			word = firstWord(word)
1037		}
1038		if word == "" {
1039			return false
1040		}
1041		if interactive {
1042			// Ask the configured shell after it loads its rc files; LookPath
1043			// cannot see aliases or functions.
1044			probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
1045			defer cancel()
1046			probe := exec.CommandContext(probeCtx, shellPath(), "-lic",
1047				`command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1`, "dev-tool-probe", word)
1048			return probe.Run() == nil
1049		}
1050		if filepath.IsAbs(word) {
1051			_, err := os.Stat(word)
1052			return err == nil
1053		}
1054		_, err := exec.LookPath(word)
1055		return err == nil
1056	}
1057	
1058	func firstWord(s string) string {
1059		f := strings.Fields(s)
1060		if len(f) == 0 {
1061			return ""
1062		}
1063		return f[0]
1064	}
1065	
1066	func shellPath() string {
1067		if s := os.Getenv("SHELL"); s != "" {
1068			return s
1069		}
1070		return "/bin/sh"
1071	}
1072	
1073	// remoteCachePath is private because the inventory can contain names and URLs
1074	// of private repositories.
1075	func remoteCachePath() string {
1076		return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
1077	}
1078	
1079	func remoteCacheSourceID(app *App) string {
1080		parts := []string{
1081			"forge-source-v1",
1082			"GH_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GH_HOST"),
1083			"GITLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST"),
1084			"GLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GLAB_HOST"),
1085		}
1086		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1087			parts = append(parts, "azure="+target.Organization+"\x00"+target.Project)
1088		}
1089		sort.Strings(parts)
1090		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
1091		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:])
1092	}
1093	
1094	// cachedRemoteRows reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or
1095	// subprocess — so it is safe on the startup path. Local clone markers are
1096	// filled when the background local inventory arrives.
1097	func cachedRemoteRows(app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool, bool) {
1098		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1099		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1100		if !ok || cache.SourceID != sourceID {
1101			return nil, false, false
1102		}
1103		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
1104		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {
1105			out = append(out, tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr})
1106		}
1107		return out, true, !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID)
1108	}
1109	
1110	// cachedRemotesForRepoRows uses the local repo data the dashboard already
1111	// collected, avoiding another process-spawning scan on startup.
1112	func cachedRemotesForRepoRows(app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1113		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1114		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1115			return nil, false
1116		}
1117		return matchRemoteRepoRows(cache.Repos, locals), true
1118	}
1119	
1120	func matchRemoteRepoRows(remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo, locals []tui.RepoRow) []tui.RemoteRow {
1121		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
1122		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1123		for _, r := range locals {
1124			if r.RemoteForge == forge.Unknown || r.RemoteName == "" {
1125				continue
1126			}
1127			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1128			if ambiguous[key] {
1129				continue
1130			}
1131			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1132				delete(byRemote, key)
1133				ambiguous[key] = true
1134				continue
1135			}
1136			byRemote[key] = r
1137		}
1138		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1139		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1140			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1141			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1142				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
1143				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1144				if local.Asset != nil {
1145					row.LocalKind = local.Asset.Kind
1146				}
1147			}
1148			out = append(out, row)
1149		}
1150		return out
1151	}
1152	
1153	// cachedRemotes returns a fresh, already-local-matched cache for instant TUI
1154	// navigation. Local paths are recomputed rather than cached because clones can
1155	// move independently of the forge inventory.
1156	func cachedRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1157		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1158		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1159			return nil, false
1160		}
1161		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), true
1162	}
1163	
1164	func cachedRemotesAny(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, forge.Cache, bool) {
1165		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1166		if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1167			return nil, forge.Cache{}, false
1168		}
1169		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), cache, true
1170	}
1171	
1172	// collectRemotes aggregates configured forge CLIs, caches the normalised response, then
1173	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
1174	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
1175	type remoteCollectOptions struct {
1176		Locals       []tui.RepoRow
1177		LocalsSet    bool
1178		Providers    []forge.Forge
1179		ProvidersSet bool
1180	}
1181	
1182	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1183		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{})
1184	}
1185	
1186	func collectRemotesForRows(ctx context.Context, app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1187		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{Locals: locals, LocalsSet: true})
1188	}
1189	
1190	func collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, options remoteCollectOptions) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1191		type result struct {
1192			kind  forge.Kind
1193			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1194			err   error
1195		}
1196		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1197		matchRows := func(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1198			if options.LocalsSet {
1199				return matchRemoteRepoRows(repos, options.Locals)
1200			}
1201			return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, repos)
1202		}
1203		providers := options.Providers
1204		if !options.ProvidersSet {
1205			providers = configuredForges(app)
1206		}
1207		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1208		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1209		available := 0
1210		var unavailable []error
1211		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1212		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1213		for _, f := range providers {
1214			if !f.Available() {
1215				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1216				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1217				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1218					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1219					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1220					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())
1221				}
1222				continue
1223			}
1224			expected[f.Kind()] = true
1225			available++
1226			wg.Add(1)
1227			go func(f forge.Forge) {
1228				defer wg.Done()
1229				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx)
1230				ch <- result{kind: f.Kind(), repos: r, err: err}
1231			}(f)
1232		}
1233		wg.Wait()
1234		close(ch)
1235		if available == 0 {
1236			if cached, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok && cached.SourceID == sourceID {
1237				rows := matchRows(cached.Repos)
1238				if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1239					return rows, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1240				}
1241				return rows, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1242			}
1243			if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1244				return nil, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1245			}
1246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1247		}
1248	
1249		old, _ := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1250		if old.SourceID != sourceID {
1251			old = forge.Cache{}
1252		}
1253		byProvider := map[forge.Kind][]forge.RemoteRepo{}
1254		statuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1255		for _, r := range old.Repos {
1256			byProvider[r.Forge] = append(byProvider[r.Forge], r)
1257		}
1258		for kind, status := range old.Providers {
1259			statuses[kind] = status
1260		}
1261		errs := append([]error(nil), unavailable...)
1262		successful := 0
1263		now := time.Now().UTC()
1264		for _, kind := range unavailableKinds {
1265			status := statuses[kind]
1266			status.Error = "provider CLI unavailable"
1267			statuses[kind] = status
1268		}
1269		for res := range ch {
1270			if res.err != nil {
1271				errs = append(errs, res.err)
1272				status := statuses[res.kind]
1273				status.Error = res.err.Error()
1274				if len(byProvider[res.kind]) == 0 && len(res.repos) > 0 {
1275					byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1276					status.FetchedAt = now
1277					status.Complete = false
1278				}
1279				statuses[res.kind] = status
1280				continue
1281			}
1282			successful++
1283			byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1284			statuses[res.kind] = forge.ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
1285		}
1286		var remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo
1287		complete := true
1288		providerStatuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1289		for kind := range expected {
1290			status, ok := statuses[kind]
1291			if !ok || !status.Complete {
1292				complete = false
1293			}
1294			if ok {
1295				providerStatuses[kind] = status
1296			}
1297			remoteRepos = append(remoteRepos, byProvider[kind]...)
1298		}
1299		sortRemoteRepos(remoteRepos)
1300		if successful > 0 {
1301			_ = forge.SaveCacheStateContext(ctx, remoteCachePath(), forge.Cache{
1302				Version: forge.CacheVersion, SourceID: sourceID, FetchedAt: now, Complete: complete,
1303				Providers: providerStatuses, Repos: remoteRepos,
1304			})
1305		}
1306		return matchRows(remoteRepos), errors.Join(errs...)
1307	}
