1309	func sortRemoteRepos(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) {
1310		sort.SliceStable(repos, func(i, j int) bool {
1311			if !repos[i].UpdatedAt.Equal(repos[j].UpdatedAt) {
1312				return repos[i].UpdatedAt.After(repos[j].UpdatedAt)
1313			}
1314			return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label()
1315		})
1316	}
1317	
1318	func configuredForges(app *App) []forge.Forge {
1319		providers := forge.All()
1320		if app == nil || len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps) == 0 {
1321			return providers
1322		}
1323		targets := make([]forge.AzureDevOpsTarget, 0, len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps))
1324		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1325			targets = append(targets, forge.AzureDevOpsTarget{
1326				Organization: target.Organization,
1327				Project:      target.Project,
1328			})
1329		}
1330		return forge.All(forge.NewAzureDevOps(targets))
1331	}
1332	
1333	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1334		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
1335		assets, _, assetErr := joinRepoAssets(app, locals)
1336		if assetErr != nil {
1337			app.warnf("could not join catalog metadata to remote locals: %v", assetErr)
1338			assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(locals))
1339		}
1340		type localMatch struct {
1341			repository repo.Repo
1342			asset      *catalog.Entry
1343		}
1344		localByRemote := map[string]localMatch{}
1345		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1346		for index, r := range locals {
1347			if r.Bare {
1348				continue
1349			}
1350			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1351			if kind == forge.Unknown || name == "" {
1352				continue
1353			}
1354			key := string(kind) + "/" + strings.ToLower(name)
1355			if ambiguous[key] {
1356				continue
1357			}
1358			if _, exists := localByRemote[key]; exists {
1359				delete(localByRemote, key)
1360				ambiguous[key] = true
1361				continue
1362			}
1363			localByRemote[key] = localMatch{repository: r, asset: assets[index]}
1364		}
1365		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1366		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1367			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1368			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1369				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.repository.Path, local.repository.Display()
1370				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1371				if local.asset != nil {
1372					row.LocalKind = local.asset.Kind
1373				}
1374			}
1375			out = append(out, row)
1376		}
1377		// Linked-worktree Tries are intentionally absent from repo.Discover's project
1378		// inventory, so use their explicit catalog identity as a second safe source.
1379		applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app, out)
1380		return out
1381	}
1382	
1383	func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {
1384		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil || len(rows) == 0 {
1385			return
1386		}
1387		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
1388		if err != nil {
1389			app.warnf("could not read catalog for remote matching: %v", err)
1390			return
1391		}
1392		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1393			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
1394		}
1395		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
1396			return
1397		}
1398		host := config.Hostname()
1399		byIdentity := make(map[string][]*catalog.Entry)
1400		for _, entry := range entries {
1401			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
1402			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || entry.RemoteIdentity == "" ||
1403				liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {
1404				continue
1405			}
1406			byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity] = append(byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity], entry)
1407		}
1408		for index := range rows {
1409			identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(rows[index].Repo.CloneURL)
1410			matches := byIdentity[identity]
1411			if identity == "" || len(matches) != 1 {
1412				continue
1413			}
1414			location, _ := matches[0].LocationFor(host)
1415			rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
1416			rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
1417			rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind
1418		}
1419	}
1420	
1421	func liveCatalogLocationPath(location catalog.Location) string {
1422		for _, candidate := range []string{location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath} {
1423			if candidate == "" {
1424				continue
1425			}
1426			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
1427				return candidate
1428			}
1429		}
1430		return ""
1431	}
1432	
1433	func prepareTUINoteEdit(app *App, n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {
1434		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-note-*.md")
1435		if err != nil {
1436			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1437		}
1438		path := tmp.Name()
1439		if _, err := io.WriteString(tmp, n.Body); err != nil {
1440			_ = tmp.Close()
1441			_ = os.Remove(path)
1442			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1443		}
1444		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
1445			_ = os.Remove(path)
1446			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1447		}
1448		proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
1449		if err != nil {
1450			_ = os.Remove(path)
1451			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1452		}
1453		return tui.NoteEdit{
1454			Command: proc,
1455			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
1456				if runErr != nil {
1457					_ = os.Remove(path)
1458					return runErr
1459				}
1460				body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1461				if err != nil {
1462					return fmt.Errorf("read edited body (preserved at %s): %w", path, err)
1463				}
1464				if strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) == "" {
1465					_ = os.Remove(path)
1466					return fmt.Errorf("edited note body is empty; not saved")
1467				}
1468				_, err = app.Notes.Update(context.Background(), n.ID, n.Revision(), string(body), n.Tags)
1469				if err != nil {
1470					return fmt.Errorf("save edited note: %w; edited body preserved at %s", err, path)
1471				}
1472				_ = os.Remove(path)
1473				return nil
1474			},
1475		}, nil
1476	}
1477

206	func Execute() int {
207		trace, tracePath, traceErr := traceFromEnvironment()
208		app := &App{
209			In: os.Stdin, Out: os.Stdout, Err: os.Stderr,
210			trace: trace, tracePath: tracePath, traceOnce: &sync.Once{},
211		}

216		defer app.finishTrace()

219		finishRoot := app.trace.Start(perftrace.CLIRootBuild, perftrace.Fields{})
220		root := newRootCommand(app)
221		finishRoot(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
222		cmd, err := root.ExecuteC()
223		if err == nil {
224			return 0
225		}
226		style := styleForWriter(os.Stderr, colorModeFromArgs(os.Args[1:]))
227		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, style.danger("dev:")+" "+err.Error())
228		if cmd != nil && wantsUsage(err) {
229			fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, renderCobraHelp(cmd.UsageString(), style))
230		}

232	}

174	// Ready reports whether the provider CLI is both installed and authenticated.
175	func (r Readiness) Ready() bool { return r.Installed && r.Authenticated }
176	
177	// Detect infers the forge for a checkout from its origin remote. A repo with
178	// no remote, or one on a self-hosted host neither CLI knows, resolves to
179	// Unknown — which callers must treat as "use plain git".
180	func Detect(ctx context.Context, dir string) Kind {
181		return FromURL(gitx.Remote(ctx, dir, "origin"))
182	}
183	
184	// FromURL classifies a remote URL.
185	func FromURL(url string) Kind {
186		if _, _, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(url); ok {
187			return AzureDevOps
188		}
189		u := strings.ToLower(url)
190		switch {
191		case u == "":
192			return Unknown
193		case strings.Contains(u, "github.com"), strings.Contains(u, "github."):
194			return GitHub
195		case strings.Contains(u, "gitlab.com"), strings.Contains(u, "gitlab."):
196			return GitLab
197		}
198		return Unknown
199	}
200	
201	// For returns the adapter for a kind.
202	func For(k Kind) (Forge, error) {
203		switch k {
204		case GitHub:
205			return &gh{}, nil
206		case GitLab:
207			return &glab{}, nil
208		case AzureDevOps:
209			return NewAzureDevOps(nil), nil
210		}
211		return nil, errors.New("no forge CLI for this remote; falling back to plain git")
212	}
213	
214	// Preferred returns the first available forge, for commands like `repo new`
215	// that have no existing remote to infer from.
216	func Preferred() (Forge, error) {
217		for _, f := range []Forge{&gh{}, &glab{}} {
218			if f.Available() {
219				return f, nil
220			}
221		}
222		return nil, errors.New("neither gh nor glab is installed")
223	}
224	
225	// PublishRepo creates an empty upstream through adapters that support the
226	// caller-managed remote/push flow. It never changes local Git configuration.
227	func PublishRepo(ctx context.Context, f Forge, dir string, req RepoRequest) (CreateRepoResult, error) {
228		publisher, ok := f.(RepoPublisher)
229		if !ok {
230			return CreateRepoResult{}, &ErrUnsupported{Kind: f.Kind(), Operation: "caller-managed repository publishing"}
231		}
232		return publisher.PublishRepo(ctx, dir, req)
233	}
234	
235	// Probe checks installation and authentication without turning an optional
236	// integration into a command failure. GitHub and GitLab are intentionally
237	// probed against the host their create commands will use in a repository-less
238	// working directory.
239	func Probe(ctx context.Context, kind Kind) Readiness {
240		f, err := For(kind)
241		if err != nil {
242			return Readiness{
243				Forge: kind, Status: ReadinessUnsupported,
244				Detail: err.Error(), Action: "use a supported forge or add the remote with git",
245			}
246		}
247		return ProbeForge(ctx, f)
248	}
249	
250	// ProbeForge is Probe for an already-selected adapter.
251	func ProbeForge(ctx context.Context, f Forge) Readiness {
252		result := Readiness{Forge: f.Kind(), Bin: f.Bin()}
253		if !f.Available() {
254			result.Status = ReadinessMissingCLI
255			result.Detail = fmt.Sprintf("%s is not installed", f.Bin())
256			result.Action = installAndLoginAction(f.Kind())
257			return result
258		}
259		result.Installed = true
260	
261		args, action, ok := authProbe(f.Kind())
262		if !ok {
263			result.Status = ReadinessUnsupported
264			result.Detail = fmt.Sprintf("%s authentication probing is not supported", f.Kind())
265			return result
266		}
267		probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
268		defer cancel()
269		if _, err := probeRunner(probeCtx, f.Bin(), "", args...); err != nil {
270			if probeCtx.Err() != nil {
271				result.Status = ReadinessProbeFailed
272				result.Detail = probeCtx.Err().Error()
273				result.Action = "run `" + f.Bin() + " auth status` to diagnose the provider CLI"
274				return result
275			}
276			result.Status = ReadinessUnauthenticated
277			result.Detail = err.Error()
278			result.Action = action
279			return result
280		}
281		result.Status = ReadinessReady
282		result.Authenticated = true
283		return result
284	}
285	
286	// ProbeAll returns readiness in stable wizard display order.
287	func ProbeAll(ctx context.Context) []Readiness {
288		kinds := []Kind{GitHub, GitLab}
289		results := make([]Readiness, len(kinds))
290		var wg sync.WaitGroup
291		for i, kind := range kinds {
292			wg.Add(1)
293			go func() {
294				defer wg.Done()
295				results[i] = Probe(ctx, kind)
296			}()
297		}
298		wg.Wait()
299		return results
300	}

302	func authProbe(kind Kind) (args []string, action string, ok bool) {

306			if host == "" {
307				host = "github.com"
308			}
309			return []string{"auth", "status", "--active", "--hostname", host},
310				"run `gh auth login --hostname " + host + "`", true
311		case GitLab:

315			}
316			return []string{"auth", "status", "--hostname", host},
317				"run `glab auth login --hostname " + host + "`", true
318		default:
319			return nil, "", false
320		}
321	}

326			return "install `gh`, then run `gh auth login`"

334	type repoTarget struct {
335		name       string
336		namespace  string
337		fullName   string
338		visibility Visibility
339		remoteName string
340	}
341	
342	func resolveRepoRequest(req RepoRequest) (repoTarget, error) {
343		fullName := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.FullName), "/")
344		name := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.Name), "/")
345		namespace := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.Namespace), "/")
346		if fullName == "" {
347			fullName = name
348			if namespace != "" && !strings.Contains(name, "/") {
349				fullName = namespace + "/" + name
350			}
351		}
352		if fullName == "" {
353			return repoTarget{}, errors.New("repository name is required")
354		}
355		if strings.Contains(fullName, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(fullName, "git@") {
356			return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("repository name %q must not be a URL", fullName)
357		}
358		parts := strings.Split(fullName, "/")
359		for _, part := range parts {
360			if part == "" || part == "." || part == ".." {
361				return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid repository name %q", fullName)
362			}
363		}
364		name = parts[len(parts)-1]
365		if len(parts) > 1 {
366			namespace = strings.Join(parts[:len(parts)-1], "/")
367		}
368	
369		visibility := req.Visibility
370		if visibility == "" {
371			if req.Private {
372				visibility = VisibilityPrivate
373			} else {
374				visibility = VisibilityPublic
375			}
376		}
377		switch visibility {
378		case VisibilityPublic, VisibilityPrivate, VisibilityInternal:
379		default:
380			return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported repository visibility %q", visibility)
381		}
382		remoteName := strings.TrimSpace(req.RemoteName)
383		if remoteName == "" {
384			remoteName = "origin"
385		}
386		return repoTarget{
387			name: name, namespace: namespace, fullName: fullName,
388			visibility: visibility, remoteName: remoteName,
389		}, nil
390	}
391	
392	func visibilityFlag(visibility Visibility) string { return "--" + string(visibility) }
393	
394	func createRepoResult(kind Kind, target repoTarget, out string, allowFallback bool) CreateRepoResult {
395		webURL := lastHTTPURL(out)
396		fullName := target.fullName
397		if parsed, err := url.Parse(webURL); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
398			if path := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/"); path != "" {
399				fullName = path
400			}
401		}
402		if webURL == "" && allowFallback && strings.Contains(fullName, "/") {
403			host := defaultForgeHost(kind)
404			if host != "" {
405				webURL = "https://" + host + "/" + fullName
406			}
407		}
408		webURL = strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimRight(webURL, "/"), ".git")
409		cloneURL := ""
410		sshURL := ""
411		if parsed, err := url.Parse(webURL); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
412			path := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/")
413			cloneURL = strings.TrimRight(webURL, "/") + ".git"
414			sshURL = "git@" + parsed.Host + ":" + path + ".git"
415		}
416		name := target.name
417		if slash := strings.LastIndex(fullName, "/"); slash >= 0 {
418			name = fullName[slash+1:]
419		}
420		return CreateRepoResult{
421			Forge: kind, Name: name, FullName: fullName, URL: webURL,
422			CloneURL: cloneURL, SSHURL: sshURL, RemoteURL: cloneURL,
423			RemoteName: target.remoteName,
424		}
425	}
426	
427	func defaultForgeHost(kind Kind) string {
428		switch kind {
429		case GitHub:
430			if host := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("GH_HOST")); host != "" {
431				return host
432			}
433			return "github.com"
434		case GitLab:
435			if host := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST")); host != "" {
436				return host
437			}
438			return "gitlab.com"
439		default:
440			return ""
441		}
442	}
443	
444	type cliRunner func(context.Context, string, string, ...string) (string, error)
445	
446	// Separate hooks keep readiness, publishing and review-query tests
447	// platform-independent; production uses the same subprocess runner as the
448	// legacy adapter methods.
449	var (
450		probeRunner   cliRunner = run
451		publishRunner cliRunner = runCombined
452		reviewRunner  cliRunner = run
453		lookupPath              = exec.LookPath
454	)
455	
456	// run executes a forge CLI, streaming stderr through so the user sees the
457	// CLI's own authentication prompts and error messages verbatim.
458	func run(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
459		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
460		cmd.Dir = dir
461		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
462		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
463		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
464		cmd.Stdin = os.Stdin
465		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
466			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
467			if detail != "" {
468				return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
469					bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
470			}
471			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
472		}
473		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
474	}
475	
476	// runCombined is used for non-interactive publishing because gh/glab versions
477	// differ on whether the created repository URL is written to stdout or stderr.
478	// Stdin is deliberately left closed so a supposedly complete publish request
479	// cannot unexpectedly drop into a second provider-owned wizard.
480	func runCombined(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
481		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
482		cmd.Dir = dir
483		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
484		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
485		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
486		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
487			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
488			if detail != "" {
489				return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
490					bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
491			}
492			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
493		}
494		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()) + "\n" + strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())), nil
495	}
496	
497	func have(bin string) bool {
498		_, err := lookupPath(bin)
499		return err == nil
500	}
501	
502	func lastHTTPURL(out string) string {
503		var found string
504		for _, field := range strings.Fields(out) {
505			candidate := strings.Trim(field, "<>()[]{}\"',;.")
506			if strings.HasPrefix(candidate, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(candidate, "https://") {
507				found = candidate
508			}
509		}
510		return found
511	}
512	
513	// IdentityFromURL returns a forge and owner/name identity for an HTTPS or SSH
514	// Git remote. It is used to match remote inventories to local clones without
515	// assuming the checkout directory has the same name.
516	func IdentityFromURL(raw string) (Kind, string) {
517		kind := FromURL(raw)
518		if kind == Unknown {
519			return Unknown, ""
520		}
521		if kind == AzureDevOps {
522			identity, _, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(raw)
523			if !ok {
524				return Unknown, ""
525			}
526			return kind, identity
527		}
528		s := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
529		if strings.Contains(s, "://") {
530			if parsed, err := url.Parse(s); err == nil {
531				s = strings.TrimPrefix(parsed.Path, "/")
532			}
533		} else if at := strings.IndexByte(s, '@'); at >= 0 {
534			// SCP-style SSH: git@github.com:owner/repo.git
535			s = s[at+1:]
536			if colon := strings.IndexByte(s, ':'); colon >= 0 {
537				s = s[colon+1:]
538			}
539		}
540		s = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(s, ".git"), "/")
541		return kind, s
542	}

+	ObservationAvailable  ObservationState = "available"
+	ObservationFailed     ObservationState = "failed"

+type TopologyObservation struct {

+

+// empty.
+func (o TopologyObservation) Available() bool { return o.State == ObservationAvailable }
+

+func (o TopologyObservation) Failed() bool { return o.State == ObservationFailed }

22	func validateRetireLocator(locator Locator) error {

24			return err
25		}
26		if locator.Mode == task.ModeWorktree && locator.CheckoutPath != "" && locator.HeadOID == "" {

29		return nil

32	func (s *lifecycleService) planRetire(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
33		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		if err := validateRetireLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
37			return PlanSpec{}, err
38		}
39		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
40		if err != nil {
41			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
42		}
43		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, *record); err != nil {
44			return PlanSpec{}, err
45		}
46		spec, _, err := s.observeRetire(ctx, request, *record, s.tasks.ListRecords)
47		if err != nil {
48			return PlanSpec{}, err
49		}
50		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
51		if err != nil {
52			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning retirement"}
53		}
54		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
55			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning retirement")
56		}
57		return spec, nil
58	}

61		candidate := record.Task
62		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
63		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == ""
64		var (

69			rt = runtime.None{}

81			inspectTasks: true, loadTasks: loadTasks,
82		})

84			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
85		}
86		return s.retireSpec(request, record, observed), observed, nil

562	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRetire(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
563		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
564			return Result{}, err
565		}
566		if approved.Action != Retire {
567			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "retire handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
568		}
569		if err := validateRetireLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
570			return Result{}, err
571		}
572		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
573		if err != nil {
574			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
575		}
576	
577		var result Result
578		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
579			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
580				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
581				if loadErr != nil {
582					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before retirement apply"}
583				}
584				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
585					return identityErr
586				}
587				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRetire(ctx, approved.Request, *record, tx.ListRecords)
588				if observeErr != nil {
589					return observeErr
590				}
591				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
592				if buildErr != nil {
593					return buildErr
594				}
595				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
596				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
597					actual := ""
598					if current != nil {
599						actual = current.Revision
600					}
601					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked retirement replan")
602				}
603				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
604					return &StalePlanError{
605						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
606						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
607						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
608						Reason:                       "fresh retirement task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or ref authority differs",
609					}
610				}
611				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
612					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
613					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh retirement conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
614				}
615	
616				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision}
617				result, observeErr = execution.executeRetire(ctx, *record, observed)
618				return observeErr
619			})
620		})
621		return result, err
622	}

624	func (e *executionState) executeRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
625		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RetireOptions)
626		candidate := record.Task
627		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
628		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == ""
629		closedRuntime := false
630		removedWorktree := false
631		deletedBranch := false
632	
633		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
634			switch effect.Code {
635			case EffectCloseRuntime:
636				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, false)
637				if err != nil {
638					return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before closing any runtime")
639				}
640				baseline = fresh
641				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
642					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
643						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
644						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
645					})
646					if closeErr != nil {
647						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
648					}
649					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil
650				})
651				if err != nil {
652					e.partial = true
653					return e.fail(err, "the task and checkout remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
654				}
655				fresh, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, true)
656				if err != nil {
657					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh retirement")
658				}
659				baseline = fresh
660				closedRuntime = true
661	
662			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
663				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
664				if err != nil {
665					return e.fail(err, "the worktree was preserved; refresh every retirement safety source")
666				}
667				baseline = fresh
668				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
669					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
670						return "worktree removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact worktree %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
671					}
672					return "removed exact linked worktree without force; branch retained", nil
673				})
674				if err != nil {
675					e.partial = true
676					return e.fail(err, "inspect Git worktree registration and retained branch before retrying")
677				}
678				removedWorktree = true
679				if err := e.verifyRemovedCheckout(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
680					return e.fail(err, "the checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact retained branch before reaping the task")
681				}
682	
683			case EffectDeleteBranch:
684				if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && !removedWorktree {
685					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before linked worktree removal"})
686				}
687				if mode != task.ModeWorktree || noCheckout {
688					fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
689					if err != nil {
690						return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before deleting the contained branch")
691					}
692					baseline = fresh
693				}
694				if err := e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, false); err != nil {
695					return e.fail(err, "branch or base authority changed; refresh retirement")
696				}
697				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
698					_, deleteErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, baseline.repoPath, "branch", "-d", "--", candidate.Branch)
699					if deleteErr != nil {
700						return "ordinary contained-branch deletion failed", fmt.Errorf("delete contained branch %s: %w", candidate.Branch, deleteErr)
701					}
702					return "deleted contained local branch " + candidate.Branch, nil
703				})
704				if err != nil {
705					e.partial = true
706					return e.fail(err, "the task record remains DONE; inspect the local branch and retry")
707				}
708				deletedBranch = true
709				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
710					return e.fail(errors.New("local branch still exists after successful branch deletion"), "the task remains DONE; inspect Git refs before retrying")
711				}
712				if err := e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
713					return e.fail(err, "the branch deletion completed; restore or inspect the explicit base before task reaping")
714				}
715	
716			case EffectDeleteTask:
717				if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && !removedWorktree {
718					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "task deletion reached before linked worktree removal"})
719				}
720				if err := e.revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch); err != nil {
721					return e.fail(err, "the task remains DONE; refresh retirement from current Git/runtime state")
722				}
723				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
724					if deleteErr := e.service.taskDelete(e.tx, candidate.ID, record.Revision); deleteErr != nil {
725						return "DONE task reap failed", fmt.Errorf("delete retired task %s: %w", candidate.ID, deleteErr)
726					}
727					if _, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(candidate.ID); !errors.Is(verifyErr, task.ErrNotFound) {
728						if verifyErr == nil {
729							verifyErr = errors.New("task record still exists")
730						}
731						return "DONE task reap was not verified", fmt.Errorf("verify retired task %s deletion: %w", candidate.ID, verifyErr)
732					}
733					return "reaped DONE task at revision " + record.Revision, nil
734				})
735				if err != nil {
736					if _, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(candidate.ID); errors.Is(verifyErr, task.ErrNotFound) {
737						e.partial = true
738					}
739					return e.fail(err, "local cleanup may already be complete; reload and retry the CAS task reap")
740				}
741				e.snapshot = "task:deleted:" + candidate.ID + ":" + record.Revision
742				e.milestone = MilestoneRetired
743	
744			default:
745				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected Retire effect " + string(effect.Code)})
746			}
747		}
748		if e.milestone != MilestoneRetired {
749			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "retirement ended without CAS task deletion"})
750		}
751		return e.result(), nil
752	}

754	func (e *executionState) reinspectRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
755		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
756		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
757			actual := ""
758			if current != nil {
759				actual = current.Revision
760			}
761			return destructiveObservation{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed at a retirement boundary")
762		}
763		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRetire(ctx, e.plan.Request, *current, e.tx.ListRecords)
764		if err != nil {
765			return fresh, err
766		}
767		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
768			return fresh, err
769		}
770		for _, check := range []struct {
771			name          string
772			before, after string
773		}{
774			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
775			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
776			{"Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()},
777			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
778			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
779			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
780			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
781			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
782		} {
783			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
784				return fresh, err
785			}
786		}
787		if allowRuntimeChange {
788			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
789				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
790			}
791		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
792			return fresh, err
793		}
794		return fresh, nil
795	}
796	
797	func (e *executionState) verifyRemovedCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
798		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
799		if err == nil {
800			return staleBoundary("exact worktree remains registered after removal")
801		}
802		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
803			return fmt.Errorf("verify exact worktree removal: %w", err)
804		}
805		if err := e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, false); err != nil {
806			return err
807		}
808		return nil
809	}
810	
811	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireRefs(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation, allowMissingBranch bool) error {
812		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
813		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
814		if err := compareAuthorityCategory("explicit base ref", authorityHash("base", baseline.baseRef, boolString(baseline.baseExists), baseline.baseOID, errorString(baseline.baseOIDErr)),
815			authorityHash("base", fresh.baseRef, boolString(fresh.baseExists), fresh.baseOID, errorString(fresh.baseOIDErr))); err != nil {
816			return err
817		}
818		if allowMissingBranch && !fresh.branchExists {
819			return nil
820		}
821		if err := compareAuthorityCategory("task branch ref", authorityHash("branch", baseline.branchRef, boolString(baseline.branchExists), baseline.branchOID, errorString(baseline.branchOIDErr)),
822			authorityHash("branch", fresh.branchRef, boolString(fresh.branchExists), fresh.branchOID, errorString(fresh.branchOIDErr))); err != nil {
823			return err
824		}
825		if fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
826			return staleBoundary("fresh branch containment proof failed")
827		}
828		return nil
829	}
830	
831	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireBase(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
832		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
833		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, "", strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
834		return compareAuthorityCategory("explicit base ref",
835			authorityHash("base", baseline.baseRef, boolString(baseline.baseExists), baseline.baseOID, errorString(baseline.baseOIDErr)),
836			authorityHash("base", fresh.baseRef, boolString(fresh.baseExists), fresh.baseOID, errorString(fresh.baseOIDErr)),
837		)
838	}
839	
840	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch bool) error {
841		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
842		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
843			actual := ""
844			if current != nil {
845				actual = current.Revision
846			}
847			return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed before terminal retirement reap")
848		}
849		mode := record.Task.EffectiveMode()
850		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && record.Task.WorktreePath == ""
851		if removedWorktree {
852			if _, resolveErr := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout); resolveErr == nil {
853				return staleBoundary("removed linked checkout became registered again")
854			} else if !errors.Is(resolveErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
855				return resolveErr
856			}
857			if deletedBranch {
858				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
859					return staleBoundary("deleted task branch reappeared")
860				}
861				return e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline)
862			}
863			return e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, noCheckout && !baseline.branchExists)
864		}
865		if deletedBranch {
866			return e.revalidateRetireAfterBranchDelete(ctx, record, baseline)
867		}
868		_, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
869		return err
870	}
871	
872	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireAfterBranchDelete(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
873		if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
874			return staleBoundary("deleted task branch reappeared")
875		}
876		if err := e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
877			return err
878		}
879		_, fresh, err := e.service.observeRetire(ctx, e.plan.Request, record, e.tx.ListRecords)
880		if err != nil {
881			return err
882		}
883		for _, check := range []struct {
884			name          string
885			before, after string
886		}{
887			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
888			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
889			{"Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()},
890			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
891			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
892			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
893			{"runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)},
894		} {
895			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
896				return err
897			}
898		}
899		return nil
900	}

395	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
396		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
397			return Result{}, err
398		}
399		if approved.Action != RemoveCheckout {
400			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "remove-checkout handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
401		}
402		if err := validateRemoveCheckoutLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
403			return Result{}, err
404		}
405		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
406		if err != nil {
407			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
408		}
409	
410		var result Result
411		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
412			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
413				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, approved.Request, tx.ListRecords)
414				if observeErr != nil {
415					return observeErr
416				}
417				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
418				if buildErr != nil {
419					return buildErr
420				}
421				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
422					return &StalePlanError{
423						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
424						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
425						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
426						Reason:                       "fresh unmanaged Git, worktree, task, artifact, runtime, or harness authority differs",
427					}
428				}
429				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
430					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
431					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh unmanaged removal conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
432				}
433				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx}
434				result, observeErr = execution.executeRemoveCheckout(ctx, observed)
435				return observeErr
436			})
437		})
438		return result, err
439	}

443		closedRuntime := false
444	
445		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {

447			case EffectDiscardAll:

449				if err != nil {

458				})
459				if err != nil {
460					e.partial = true
461					return e.fail(err, "inspect every checkout byte before retrying removal")
462				}
463				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, true, false)
464				if err != nil {
465					return e.fail(err, "discard completed but a safety source changed; preserve the checkout and refresh")
466				}
467				baseline = fresh
468	
469			case EffectCloseRuntime:
470				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, false)
471				if err != nil {

473				}
474				baseline = fresh
475				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
476					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
477						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
478						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
479					})

482					}

484				})
485				if err != nil {
486					e.partial = true
487					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and branch remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
488				}
489				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, true)
490				if err != nil {
491					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh removal")
492				}
493				baseline = fresh
494				closedRuntime = true
495	
496			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
497				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, closedRuntime)
498				if err != nil {
499					return e.fail(err, "the checkout was preserved; refresh every safety source")
500				}
501				baseline = fresh
502				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
503					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
504						return "checkout removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact unmanaged checkout %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
505					}
506					return "removed exact clean linked checkout without force; branch preserved", nil
507				})
508				if err != nil {
509					e.partial = true
510					return e.fail(err, "inspect the exact worktree registration and preserved branch before retrying")
511				}
512				if err := e.verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
513					return e.fail(err, "checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact preserved local branch")
514				}
515				e.snapshot = "checkout:removed:" + baseline.checkout + ":" + baseline.branchOID
516	
517			case EffectDeleteBranch:
518				if e.snapshot == "" {
519					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before verified checkout removal"})
520				}
521				if err := e.revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx, baseline); err != nil {

523				}

539			default:
540				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RemoveCheckout effect " + string(effect.Code)})

549	func (e *executionState) reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation, allowDiscard, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
550		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, e.plan.Request, e.tx.ListRecords)
551		if err != nil {
552			return fresh, err
553		}
554		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
555			return fresh, err
556		}
557		for _, check := range []struct {
558			name          string
559			before, after string
560		}{
561			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
562			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
563			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
564			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
565			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
566			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
567			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
568		} {
569			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
570				return fresh, err
571			}
572		}
573		if allowDiscard {
574			if err := comparePostDiscardGit(baseline, fresh); err != nil {
575				return fresh, err
576			}
577		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()); err != nil {
578			return fresh, err
579		}
580		if allowRuntimeChange {
581			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
582				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
583			}
584		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
585			return fresh, err
586		}
587		return fresh, nil
588	}

590	func comparePostDiscardGit(before, after destructiveObservation) error {
591		if after.statusErr != nil || after.status.Dirty() {
592			return staleBoundary("checkout is not clean after explicit discard")
593		}
594		beforeStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
595			before.status.Branch, boolString(before.status.Detached), before.status.Upstream,
596			fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Behind),
597			before.head, errorString(before.headErr), before.operation, boolString(before.inProgress), errorString(before.operationErr),
598		)
599		afterStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
600			after.status.Branch, boolString(after.status.Detached), after.status.Upstream,
601			fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Behind),
602			after.head, errorString(after.headErr), after.operation, boolString(after.inProgress), errorString(after.operationErr),
603		)
604		return compareAuthorityCategory("post-discard Git identity", beforeStable, afterStable)
605	}

607	func (e *executionState) revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
608		records, diagnostics, err := e.tx.ListRecords()
609		if err != nil {
610			return err
611		}
612		claims := baseline
613		claims.taskRecords = records
614		claims.taskDiagnostics = diagnostics
615		claims.taskClaims = nil
616		claims.taskIncomplete = nil
617		e.service.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &claims)
618		if len(claims.taskIncomplete) > 0 {
619			return staleBoundary("task inventory became incomplete before branch deletion")
620		}
621		if len(claims.taskClaims) > 0 {
622			return staleBoundary("a task claimed the checkout path or branch before branch deletion")
623		}
624		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
625		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
626		if fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID || fresh.baseOID != baseline.baseOID ||
627			fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.baseOIDErr != nil || fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
628			return staleBoundary("branch or containment-base authority changed before branch deletion")
629		}
630		worktrees, err := e.service.gitWorktrees(ctx, baseline.repoPath)
631		if err != nil {
632			return err
633		}
634		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
635			if worktree.Branch == baseline.locator.Branch {
636				return staleBoundary("branch acquired another checkout before deletion")
637			}
638		}
639		return nil
640	}

642	func (e *executionState) verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
643		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
644		if err == nil {
645			return staleBoundary("exact unmanaged checkout remains registered after removal")
646		}
647		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {

226	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx context.Context, observed *destructiveObservation) {
227		for _, diagnostic := range observed.taskDiagnostics {

238			pathClaim := false

244				} else {

262					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "exact checkout path",

277		sort.Slice(observed.taskClaims, func(i, j int) bool {

408	func artifactEvidenceFromInspection(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection) string {
409		if inspection.KnownEmpty {
410			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
411		}
412		states := make([]string, 0, len(inspection.Intents))
413		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {

415		}

418		}
419		return strings.Join(states, ", ")

+func sweepTaskPlan(ctx context.Context, app *App, id string, options flow.ActionOptions) (lifecycleSession, flow.Plan, error) {
+	session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
+		return app.Tasks.Get(id)
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		return lifecycleSession{}, flow.Plan{}, err
+	}
+	plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
+	return session, plan, err
+}
+
+func sweepPlanBlocker(plan flow.Plan, err error) string {
+	if err != nil {
+		return err.Error()
+	}
+	var parts []string
+	for _, condition := range append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...) {
+		parts = append(parts, string(condition.Code)+": "+condition.Evidence)
+	}
+	if len(parts) == 0 {
+		return "guarded plan is " + string(plan.Availability)
+	}
+	return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
+}
+
+func sweepDeleteTask(ctx context.Context, store *task.Store, id, revision string) error {
+	if revision == "" {
+		return fmt.Errorf("task %s had no report-time revision; rerun sweep", id)
+	}
+	return store.DeleteIfRevision(ctx, id, revision)
+}

191	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeCheckoutFacts(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService) {
192		o.status, o.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, o.checkout)
193		o.head, o.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, o.checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
194		o.head = strings.TrimSpace(o.head)
195		o.operation, o.inProgress, o.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, o.checkout)

215			o.contained, o.containedErr = s.isAncestor(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchOID, o.baseOID)
216		}
217	}

221			return ""
222		}

226	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx context.Context, observed *destructiveObservation) {
227		for _, diagnostic := range observed.taskDiagnostics {
228			observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete, diagnostic.Error())
229		}
230		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
231			candidate := record.Task
232			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
233				observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
234					fmt.Sprintf("task %s is invalid: %v", candidate.ID, err))
235				continue
236			}
237	
238			pathClaim := false
239			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
240				path, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
241				if err != nil {
242					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
243						fmt.Sprintf("task %s checkout identity is unavailable: %v", candidate.ID, err))
244				} else {
245					pathClaim = path == observed.checkout
246				}
247			}
248	
249			branchClaim := false
250			if candidate.Branch == observed.locator.Branch {
251				repoMatches, complete, detail := s.taskRepositoryMatches(ctx, candidate, *observed)
252				if !complete {
253					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
254						fmt.Sprintf("task %s repository identity is unavailable: %s", candidate.ID, detail))
255				} else {
256					branchClaim = repoMatches
257				}
258			}
259	
260			if pathClaim {
261				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
262					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "exact checkout path",
263				})
264			}
265			if branchClaim {
266				reason := "exact branch in selected repository"
267				if pathClaim {
268					reason = "exact checkout path and branch in selected repository"
269					observed.taskClaims[len(observed.taskClaims)-1].Reason = reason
270					continue
271				}
272				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
273					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: reason,
274				})
275			}
276		}
277		sort.Slice(observed.taskClaims, func(i, j int) bool {
278			if observed.taskClaims[i].ID != observed.taskClaims[j].ID {
279				return observed.taskClaims[i].ID < observed.taskClaims[j].ID
280			}
281			return observed.taskClaims[i].Reason < observed.taskClaims[j].Reason
282		})
283		sort.Strings(observed.taskIncomplete)
284	}

286	func (s *lifecycleService) taskRepositoryMatches(ctx context.Context, candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation) (bool, bool, string) {
287		candidatePath, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
288		if err != nil {
289			return false, false, err.Error()
290		}
291		if candidatePath == observed.repoPath {
292			return true, true, ""
293		}
294		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return false, false, err.Error()
297		}
298		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
299		if err != nil {
300			return false, false, err.Error()
301		}
302		return commonDir == observed.gitCommonDir, true, ""
303	}

305	func (o destructiveObservation) branchCheckoutPaths(excludeTarget bool) ([]string, error) {
306		if o.worktreesErr != nil {
307			return nil, o.worktreesErr
308		}
309		var paths []string
310		for _, worktree := range o.worktrees {
311			if worktree.Bare || worktree.Branch != o.locator.Branch {
312				continue
313			}
314			path := worktree.Path
315			if canonical, err := filepath.Abs(path); err == nil {
316				path = filepath.Clean(canonical)
317			}
318			if excludeTarget && o.checkout != "" {
319				candidate, err := filepath.Abs(o.checkout)
320				if err == nil && filepath.Clean(candidate) == path {
321					continue
322				}
323			}
324			paths = append(paths, path)
325		}
326		sort.Strings(paths)
327		return paths, nil
328	}

334		}
335		authority := map[string]string{
336			"destructive.repo":                    o.repositoryAuthority(),
337			"destructive.checkout":                o.checkoutAuthority(),
338			"destructive.git":                     o.gitAuthority(),
339			"destructive.refs":                    o.refsAuthority(),
340			"destructive.artifact":                artifactAuthority(o.artifact, o.artifactErr),
341			"destructive.runtime":                 cleanupAuthority(o.cleanup, o.cleanupErr),
342			"destructive.runtime-backend":         runtimeName(o.runtime),
343			"destructive.runtime-error":           errorString(o.runtimeErr),
344			"destructive.runtime-available":       boolString(o.runtimeAvailable),
345			"destructive.harness":                 boolString(o.isHarness),
346			"destructive.harness-root":            o.harness.Root,
347			"destructive.task-inventory":          o.taskInventoryAuthority(),
348			"destructive.task-inventory-error":    errorString(o.taskInventoryErr),
349			"destructive.task-claims":             strings.Join(claims, "\x01"),
350			"destructive.task-incomplete":         strings.Join(o.taskIncomplete, "\x01"),
351			"destructive.worktree-list-error":     errorString(o.worktreesErr),
352			"destructive.worktree-list-authority": o.worktreeListAuthority(),
353		}
354		return authority

401				boolString(worktree.Locked), worktree.LockedReason,

408	func artifactEvidenceFromInspection(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection) string {
409		if inspection.KnownEmpty {
410			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
411		}
412		states := make([]string, 0, len(inspection.Intents))
413		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
414			states = append(states, intent.Intent.ID+"="+string(intent.State))
415		}
416		if len(states) == 0 {
417			return "artifact readiness is incomplete"
418		}
419		return strings.Join(states, ", ")
420	}

422	func mergeAuthority(base, additional map[string]string) map[string]string {
423		out := make(map[string]string, len(base)+len(additional))
424		for key, value := range base {
425			out[key] = value
426		}
427		for key, value := range additional {
428			out[key] = value
429		}
430		return out
431	}

433	func destructiveConditionsReady(conditions []Condition) error {
434		if availability := AvailabilityFor(conditions); availability != AvailabilityReady {
435			var evidence []string
436			for _, current := range conditions {
437				if current.Requirement == RequirementRequired && current.Verdict != VerdictMet {
438					evidence = append(evidence, string(current.Code)+": "+current.Evidence)
439				}
440			}
441			return staleBoundary("destructive safety is no longer ready (" + strings.Join(evidence, "; ") + ")")
442		}
443		return nil
444	}

446	func compareAuthorityCategory(name, before, after string) error {
447		if before != after {
448			return staleBoundary(name + " authority changed")
449		}
450		return nil
451	}

48	func validateRefreshRemoteLocator(locator Locator) error {
49		switch {
50		case locator.RepoPath == "":
51			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
52		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
53			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
54		case !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Branch):
55			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact head branch %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Branch)
56		case locator.Base != "" && !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Base):
57			return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Base)
58		case locator.HeadOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.HeadOID):
59			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact HEAD OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.HeadOID)
60		case locator.BaseOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.BaseOID):
61			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact base OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.BaseOID)
62		}
63	
64		if locator.TaskID == "" {
65			switch {
66			case locator.TaskRevision != "":
67				return fmt.Errorf("%w: task revision requires a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
68			case locator.HeadOID == "":
69				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged remote refresh requires an exact HEAD OID", ErrInvalidRequest)
70			case locator.Mode != "" && !validMode(locator.Mode):
71				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown checkout mode %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Mode)
72			case locator.State != "" && !validState(locator.State):
73				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown task state %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.State)
74			}
75			return nil
76		}
77	
78		switch {
79		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
80			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
81		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
82			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
83		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
84			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
85		case !validState(locator.State):
86			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
87		}
88		return nil
89	}

91	func normalizedRemoteBranch(branch string) bool {
92		return branch != "" && branch == strings.TrimSpace(branch) &&
93			!strings.ContainsRune(branch, '\x00') &&
94			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/heads/") &&
95			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/remotes/")
96	}
97	
98	func normalizeRemoteName(name string) (string, error) {
99		if name == "" {
100			return "origin", nil
101		}
102		if name != strings.TrimSpace(name) || strings.ContainsRune(name, '\x00') || strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") {
103			return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: remote name %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, name)
104		}
105		return name, nil
106	}

108	func (s *lifecycleService) planRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
109		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
110			return PlanSpec{}, err
111		}
112		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
113			return PlanSpec{}, err
114		}
115	
116		if request.Locator.TaskID == "" {
117			spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, nil)
118			return spec, err
119		}
120	
121		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
122		if err != nil {
123			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
124		}
125		spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, record)
126		if err != nil {
127			return PlanSpec{}, err
128		}
129		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning remote refresh"}
132		}
133		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
134			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning remote refresh")
135		}
136		return spec, nil
137	}

139	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, request Request, record *task.Record) (PlanSpec, remoteRefreshObservation, error) {
140		observed := remoteRefreshObservation{record: record, head: request.Locator.Branch, base: request.Locator.Base}
141		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
142			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
143		}
144		if record != nil {
145			if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, *record); err != nil {
146				return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
147			}
148		}
149	
150		remoteName, err := normalizeRemoteName(request.Locator.Remote)
151		if err != nil {
152			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
153		}
154		observed.remoteName = remoteName

156		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, request.Locator.RepoPath)
157		if err != nil {
158			return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover selected repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
159		}
160		observed.repo = repository

163			return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
164		}
165		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
166		if err != nil {
167			return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
168		}
169		requestedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoPath)
170		if err != nil {
171			return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
172		}
173		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
174		if err != nil {
175			return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
176		}
177		if requestedRepo != observed.repoPath || requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
178			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
179				"selected repository identity changed: main %q -> %q, common directory %q -> %q",
180				requestedRepo, observed.repoPath, requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir,
181			)}
182		}
183		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
184			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
185			if keyErr != nil {
186				return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
187			}
188			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
189				return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected repository key no longer names the Git common directory"}
190			}
191		}

193		if err := s.validateRemoteRefNames(ctx, observed.repoPath, remoteName, observed.head, observed.base); err != nil {
194			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
195		}
196		if record == nil {
197			if err := s.validateRefreshCheckout(ctx, request.Locator, &observed); err != nil {
198				return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
199			}
200		}
201	
202		observed.remoteURL = strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
203		observed.providerKind, observed.providerRepository = forge.IdentityFromURL(observed.remoteURL)
204		options := request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions)
205		if options.QueryReview && observed.remoteURL != "" && observed.providerKind != forge.Unknown && observed.providerRepository != "" {
206			observed.provider, observed.providerResolveErr = s.resolveForge(observed.providerKind)
207			if observed.providerResolveErr == nil {
208				switch {
209				case observed.provider == nil:
210					observed.providerResolveErr = errors.New("forge resolver returned no provider")
211				case observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind:
212					observed.providerResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("forge resolver returned %s for %s remote", observed.provider.Kind(), observed.providerKind)
213				default:
214					_, observed.providerCapable = observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier)
215					observed.providerAvailable = observed.provider.Available()
216				}
217			}
218		}
219	
220		observed.refs = s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
221		if request.Locator.HeadOID != "" {
222			if observed.refs.LocalHead.Failure != "" || !observed.refs.LocalHead.Exists || observed.refs.LocalHead.OID != request.Locator.HeadOID {
223				return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
224					"selected head changed from %q to %q", request.Locator.HeadOID, observed.refs.LocalHead.OID,
225				)}
226			}
227		}
228		if request.Locator.BaseOID != "" {
229			if observed.refs.LocalBase.Failure != "" || !observed.refs.LocalBase.Exists || observed.refs.LocalBase.OID != request.Locator.BaseOID {
230				return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
231					"selected base changed from %q to %q", request.Locator.BaseOID, observed.refs.LocalBase.OID,
232				)}
233			}
234		}
235		return s.refreshRemoteSpec(request, observed), observed, nil
236	}

238	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRemoteRefNames(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) error {
239		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
240			"head":        "refs/heads/" + head,
241			"remote name": "refs/remotes/" + remote + "/__dev_refresh_probe__",
242		} {
243			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", ref); err != nil {
244				return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not a valid normalized Git name: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, label, err)
245			}
246		}
247		if base != "" {
248			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", "refs/heads/"+base); err != nil {
249				return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base is not a valid normalized Git branch: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
250			}
251		}
252		return nil
253	}

255	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRefreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, locator Locator, observed *remoteRefreshObservation) error {
256		checkout := locator.CheckoutPath
257		if checkout == "" {
258			checkout = locator.RepoPath
259		}
260		canonical, err := s.canonicalPath(checkout)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize selected checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
263		}
264		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, canonical)
265		if err != nil {
266			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout registration changed: " + err.Error()}
267		}
268		if registered.Path != canonical || registered.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
269			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout no longer belongs to the exact repository identity"}
270		}
271		if registered.Worktree.Detached || registered.Worktree.Branch != locator.Branch {
272			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
273				"selected checkout branch changed from %q to %q", locator.Branch, registered.Worktree.Branch,
274			)}
275		}
276		liveHead, err := s.gitRun(ctx, canonical, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
277		if err != nil {
278			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout HEAD is no longer observable: " + err.Error()}
279		}
280		liveHead = strings.TrimSpace(liveHead)
281		if registered.Worktree.Head != liveHead || locator.HeadOID != liveHead {
282			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
283				"selected checkout HEAD changed from %q to registry=%q live=%q", locator.HeadOID, registered.Worktree.Head, liveHead,
284			)}
285		}
286		observed.checkout = canonical
287		observed.worktree = registered
288		return nil
289	}

291	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRemoteRefs(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) RemoteRefsObservation {
292		result := RemoteRefsObservation{ObservedAt: s.now()}
293		result.LocalHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+head)
294		result.RemoteHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+head)
295		if base != "" {
296			result.LocalBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+base)
297			result.RemoteBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
298		}
299		return result
300	}

302	func (s *lifecycleService) observeNamedRef(ctx context.Context, repoPath, ref string) NamedRefObservation {
303		observed := NamedRefObservation{Ref: ref}
304		if !s.gitRefExists(ctx, repoPath, ref) {
305			return observed
306		}
307		observed.Exists = true
308		oid, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, ref)
309		if err != nil {
310			observed.Failure = err.Error()
311			return observed
312		}
313		observed.OID = oid
314		return observed
315	}

317	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshRemoteSpec(request Request, observed remoteRefreshObservation) PlanSpec {
318		options := request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions)
319		conditions := []Condition{
320			refreshTaskCondition(observed),
321			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
322				"Git main "+observed.repoPath+" with common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
323			refreshHeadCondition(observed),
324			refreshRemoteURLCondition(observed),
325			refreshRefsCondition(observed),
326			refreshReviewBaseCondition(observed, options),
327			refreshReviewProviderCondition(observed, options),
328			refreshReviewCapabilityCondition(observed, options),
329			refreshReviewCLICondition(observed, options),
330		}
331	
332		var effects []Effect
333		if options.FetchRefs {
334			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
335				EffectFetchRefs, "fetch and prune the exact configured remote", observed.repoPath, false, true,
336				map[string]string{
337					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
338					"pre-refs": remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs),
339				},
340			))
341		}
342		if options.QueryReview {
343			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
344				EffectQueryReview, "query the exact provider repository and head/base relationship", observed.providerRepository, false, true,
345				map[string]string{
346					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
347					"provider": string(observed.providerKind), "repository": observed.providerRepository,
348					"head": observed.head, "base": observed.base,
349				},
350			))
351		}
352	
353		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.head + "@" + observed.refs.LocalHead.OID}
354		if observed.checkout != "" {
355			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+observed.checkout)
356		}
357		return PlanSpec{
358			Authority:         refreshRemoteAuthority(observed),
359			Conditions:        conditions,
360			Effects:           effects,
361			RetainedResources: retained,
362			Confirmation: Confirmation{
363				Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Run the selected explicit remote network operations?",
364			},
365			Summary:     refreshRemoteSummary(observed, options),
366			DisplayedAt: s.now(),
367		}
368	}

370	func refreshTaskCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
371		if observed.record == nil {
372			return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
373				"repository/checkout context has no persisted task record", "")
374		}
375		return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
376			"task "+observed.record.Task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision+" is validated without a state write", "")
377	}
378	
379	func refreshHeadCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
380		ref := observed.refs.LocalHead
381		switch {
382		case ref.Failure != "":
383			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, ref.Failure, "repair local head-ref observation")
384		case !ref.Exists:
385			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
386				"local head ref "+ref.Ref+" does not exist", "restore the exact named local branch")
387		case ref.OID == "":
388			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
389				"local head ref resolved without an OID", "repair local head-ref observation")
390		default:
391			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
392				ref.Ref+" is exactly "+ref.OID, "")
393		}
394	}
395	
396	func refreshRemoteURLCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
397		if observed.remoteURL == "" {
398			return condition(ConditionRemoteURL, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
399				"remote "+observed.remoteName+" has no configured URL", "configure the exact remote before network refresh")
400		}
401		return condition(ConditionRemoteURL, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
402			"remote "+observed.remoteName+" is configured as "+observed.remoteURL, "")
403	}
404	
405	func refreshRefsCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
406		verdict := VerdictMet
407		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{
408			observed.refs.LocalHead, observed.refs.LocalBase, observed.refs.RemoteHead, observed.refs.RemoteBase,
409		} {
410			if ref.Failure != "" {
411				verdict = VerdictError
412				break
413			}
414		}
415		return condition(ConditionRemoteRefs, verdict, RequirementAdvisory,
416			remoteRefsEvidence(observed.refs), "repair local Git ref observation before relying on freshness")
417	}

419	func refreshReviewBaseCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
420		if !options.QueryReview {
421			return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
422				"review query is not selected; an explicit base is not required", "")
423		}
424		if observed.base == "" {
425			return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictNeedsInput, RequirementRequired,
426				"review query requires an exact base branch", "select the base from the current repository context")
427		}
428		return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
429			"review base is "+observed.base, "")
430	}
431	
432	func refreshReviewProviderCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
433		requirement := RequirementAdvisory
434		if options.QueryReview {
435			requirement = RequirementRequired
436		}
437		if observed.providerKind == forge.Unknown || observed.providerRepository == "" {
438			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, requirement,
439				"remote URL does not identify a supported GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps repository", "select fetch-only or configure a supported provider remote")
440		}
441		return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictMet, requirement,
442			fmt.Sprintf("%s repository identity %s", observed.providerKind, observed.providerRepository), "")
443	}
444	
445	func refreshReviewCapabilityCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
446		if !options.QueryReview {
447			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
448				"review query is not selected; forge capability is not required", "")
449		}
450		if observed.providerResolveErr != nil {
451			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
452				observed.providerResolveErr.Error(), "use fetch-only or install support for this provider")
453		}
454		if observed.provider == nil || !observed.providerCapable {
455			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
456				fmt.Sprintf("%s adapter does not implement review queries", observed.providerKind), "use fetch-only or a review-capable provider")
457		}
458		return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
459			fmt.Sprintf("%s adapter implements review queries", observed.providerKind), "")
460	}
461	
462	func refreshReviewCLICondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
463		if !options.QueryReview {
464			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
465				"review query is not selected; no provider CLI is required", "")
466		}
467		if observed.provider == nil || observed.providerResolveErr != nil || !observed.providerCapable {
468			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
469				"review-capable provider CLI could not be selected", "resolve provider capability first")
470		}
471		if !observed.providerAvailable {
472			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
473				fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is not installed", observed.providerKind, observed.provider.Bin()), "install the provider CLI and retry")
474		}
475		return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
476			fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is locally available", observed.providerKind, observed.provider.Bin()), "")
477	}

511	func remoteRefsAuthority(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
512		values := make([]string, 0, 16)
513		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
514			values = append(values, ref.Ref, boolString(ref.Exists), ref.OID, ref.Failure)
515		}
516		return authorityHash("taskflow-remote-refs-v1", values...)
517	}
518	
519	func remoteRefsEvidence(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
520		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
521		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
522			if ref.Ref == "" {
523				continue
524			}
525			switch {
526			case ref.Failure != "":
527				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" error: "+ref.Failure)
528			case ref.Exists:
529				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"="+ref.OID)
530			default:
531				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" is absent")
532			}
533		}
534		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
535	}

541			operation = "fetch refs"
542		case !options.FetchRefs && options.QueryReview:
543			operation = "query review"
544		}
545		return operation + " for " + observed.head + " via " + observed.remoteName
