548	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
549		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
550			return Result{}, err
551		}
552		if approved.Action != RefreshRemote {
553			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "refresh-remote handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
554		}
555		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
556			return Result{}, err
557		}
558		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
559		if err != nil {
560			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
561		}
562	
563		var result Result
564		applyLocked := func(tx *task.Tx) error {
565			var record *task.Record
566			if approved.Locator.TaskID != "" {
567				if tx == nil {
568					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "managed remote refresh has no task transaction"}
569				}
570				current, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
571				if loadErr != nil {
572					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before remote refresh"}
573				}
574				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *current); identityErr != nil {
575					return identityErr
576				}
577				record = current
578			}
579	
580			spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, approved.Request, record)
581			if observeErr != nil {
582				return observeErr
583			}
584			fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
585			if buildErr != nil {
586				return buildErr
587			}
588			if record != nil {
589				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
590				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
591					actual := ""
592					if current != nil {
593						actual = current.Revision
594					}
595					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked remote refresh replan")
596				}
597			}
598			if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
599				return &StalePlanError{
600					ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
601					ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
602					ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
603					Reason:                       "fresh task, repository, remote URL, provider, or ref authority differs",
604				}
605			}
606			if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
607				notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
608				return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh remote refresh conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
609			}
610	
611			execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh}
612			result, observeErr = execution.executeRefreshRemote(ctx, observed)
613			return observeErr
614		}
615	
616		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
617			if approved.Locator.TaskID == "" {
618				return applyLocked(nil)
619			}
620			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, applyLocked)
621		})
622		return result, err
623	}
624	
625	func (e *executionState) executeRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation) (Result, error) {
626		data := RemoteObservation{
627			RemoteName: observed.remoteName, RemoteURL: observed.remoteURL,
628			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
629			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, BeforeRefs: observed.refs,
630		}
631		e.remote = &data
632		fetched := false
633	
634		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
635			switch effect.Code {
636			case EffectFetchRefs:
637				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
638					_, fetchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "--", observed.remoteName)
639					if fetchErr != nil {
640						return "", fmt.Errorf("fetch --prune %s: %w", observed.remoteName, fetchErr)
641					}
642					return "fetched and pruned " + observed.remoteName, nil
643				})
644				if err != nil {
645					recovery := []string{"remote refs were not proven refreshed; repair the exact remote fetch and create a fresh plan"}
646					if e.plan.Request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions).QueryReview {
647						recovery = append(recovery, "review query was not attempted after the failed fetch")
648					}
649					return e.fail(err, recovery...)
650				}
651				fetched = true
652				data.AfterRefs = e.service.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
653				data.HasAfterRefs = true
654	
655			case EffectQueryReview:
656				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
657					if err := e.service.revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx, observed, fetched); err != nil {
658						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
659						return "", err
660					}
661					query := forge.ReviewQuery{Repository: observed.providerRepository, Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base}
662					review, queryErr := e.service.queryReview(ctx, observed.provider, observed.repoPath, query)
663					if queryErr != nil {
664						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, queryErr)
665						return "", queryErr
666					}
667					if review == nil {
668						data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
669							State: ObservationKnown, Exists: false,
670							Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
671							Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
672						}
673						data.HasReview = true
674						return "provider reports no exact review", nil
675					}
676					if err := validateRemoteReview(observed, *review); err != nil {
677						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
678						return "", err
679					}
680					observedAt := review.ObservedAt.UTC()
681					if review.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
682						observedAt = e.service.now()
683					}
684					data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
685						State: ObservationKnown, Exists: true,
686						Provider: review.Provider, Repository: review.Repository,
687						ID: review.ID, Number: review.Number, ReviewState: review.State,
688						Draft: review.Draft, URL: review.URL, Head: review.Head, Base: review.Base,
689						ObservedAt: observedAt,
690					}
691					data.HasReview = true
692					return fmt.Sprintf("observed %s review #%d (%s)", review.Provider, review.Number, review.State), nil
693				})
694				if err != nil {
695					if fetched {
696						return e.fail(err, "fetch completed; review evidence remains an explicit error and may be retried from a fresh query-only plan")
697					}
698					return e.fail(err, "local refs and task state were unchanged; repair provider access or response handling and retry")
699				}
700	
701			default:
702				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RefreshRemote effect " + string(effect.Code)})
703			}
704		}
705		return e.result(), nil
706	}
707	
708	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation, allowFetchedRefs bool) error {
709		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
710		if err != nil {
711			return staleBoundary("repository became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
712		}
713		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
714		if err != nil {
715			return staleBoundary("repository main path became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
716		}
717		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
718		if err != nil {
719			return staleBoundary("Git common directory became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
720		}
721		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
722			return staleBoundary("repository identity changed before review query")
723		}
724		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
725		kind, repositoryIdentity := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
726		if remoteURL != observed.remoteURL || kind != observed.providerKind || repositoryIdentity != observed.providerRepository {
727			return staleBoundary("remote URL or provider repository identity changed before review query")
728		}
729		if observed.provider == nil || observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind {
730			return staleBoundary("review provider identity changed before query")
731		}
732		if _, ok := observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier); !ok {
733			return staleBoundary("review provider capability changed before query")
734		}
735		if !observed.provider.Available() {
736			return staleBoundary("review provider CLI became unavailable before query")
737		}
738		if !allowFetchedRefs {
739			freshRefs := s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
740			if remoteRefsAuthority(freshRefs) != remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs) {
741				return staleBoundary("local or remote-tracking ref authority changed before query")
742			}
743		}
744		return nil
745	}
746	
747	func (e *executionState) setRemoteReviewFailure(data *RemoteObservation, observed remoteRefreshObservation, err error) {
748		data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
749			State: ObservationError, Exists: false,
750			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
751			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
752			FailureKind: classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err), Failure: err.Error(),
753		}
754		data.HasReview = true
755	}
756	
757	func classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err error) RemoteReviewFailureKind {
758		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrAmbiguousReview) {
759			return RemoteReviewFailureAmbiguous
760		}
761		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrMalformedReviewResponse) {
762			return RemoteReviewFailureMalformed
763		}
764		var unsupported *forge.ErrUnsupported
765		if errors.As(err, &unsupported) {
766			return RemoteReviewFailureUnsupported
767		}
768		var missingCLI *forge.ErrNoCLI
769		if errors.As(err, &missingCLI) {
770			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingCLI
771		}
772		var missingExtension *forge.ErrNoExtension
773		if errors.As(err, &missingExtension) {
774			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingExtension
775		}
776		return RemoteReviewFailureProvider
777	}
778	
779	func validateRemoteReview(observed remoteRefreshObservation, review forge.Review) error {
780		switch {
781		case review.Provider != observed.providerKind:
782			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "provider")
783		case review.Repository != observed.providerRepository:
784			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "repository identity")
785		case review.Head != observed.head:
786			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "head branch")
787		case review.Base != observed.base:
788			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "base branch")
789		case strings.TrimSpace(review.ID) == "" || review.ID != strings.TrimSpace(review.ID):
790			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "identifier")
791		case review.Number <= 0:
792			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "number")
793		case !review.State.Valid():
794			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "state")
795		case review.State == forge.ReviewDraft && !review.Draft:
796			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft flag")
797		case review.State == forge.ReviewOpen && review.Draft:
798			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft state")
799		case !validRemoteReviewURL(review.URL):
800			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "URL")
801		}
802		return nil
803	}
804	
805	func malformedRemoteReview(provider forge.Kind, field string) error {
806		return &forge.MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: 0, Field: field}
807	}
808	
809	func validRemoteReviewURL(raw string) bool {
810		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
811		return err == nil && parsed.Host != "" && (parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http")
812	}
813	
814	func remoteRefCount(refs RemoteRefsObservation) int {
815		count := 0
816		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
817			if ref.Exists && ref.Failure == "" && ref.OID != "" {
818				count++
819			}
820		}
821		return count
822	}
823	
824	func remoteRefSummary(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
825		return strconv.Itoa(remoteRefCount(refs)) + " named ref OID(s) observed"
826	}

15	func (s *lifecycleService) applyGuarded(ctx context.Context, action Action, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
16		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
17			return Result{}, err
18		}
19		if approved.Action != action {
20			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("handler %s received %s", action, approved.Action)}
21		}
22		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
23			return Result{}, err
24		}
25		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
28		}
29	
30		var result Result
31		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
32			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
33				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
34				if loadErr != nil {
35					return &StalePlanError{
36						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID,
37						Reason:         "task record disappeared before apply",
38					}
39				}
40				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
41					return identityErr
42				}
43				fresh, observed, planErr := s.freshPlan(ctx, approved.Request, *record)
44				if planErr != nil {
45					return planErr
46				}
47				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
48				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
49					actual := ""
50					if current != nil {
51						actual = current.Revision
52					}
53					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked plan rebuild")
54				}
55				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
56					return &StalePlanError{
57						ExpectedPlanID:               approved.PlanID,
58						ActualPlanID:                 fresh.PlanID,
59						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
60						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
61						Reason:                       "fresh task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or option authority differs",
62					}
63				}
64				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
65					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
66					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
67				}
68	
69				execution := &executionState{
70					service: s, plan: fresh, observed: observed, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision,
71				}
72				var applyErr error
73				switch action {
74				case ParkWarm:
75					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkWarm(ctx)
76				case ParkCold:
77					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkCold(ctx)
78				case Resume:
79					result, applyErr = execution.applyResume(ctx)
80				case CompleteDirect:
81					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteDirect(ctx)
82				case CompleteFF:
83					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteFF(ctx)
84				case ReviewHandoff:
85					result, applyErr = execution.applyReviewHandoff(ctx)
86				case VerifyMerged:
87					result, applyErr = execution.applyVerifyMerged(ctx)
88				default:
89					applyErr = &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: action, Stage: "apply"}
90				}
91				return applyErr
92			})
93		})
94		return result, err
95	}
96	
97	func (e *executionState) applyParkWarm(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
98		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ParkWarmOptions)
99		observed := &e.observed
100		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() && !options.CommitWIP {
101			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, observed.checkout+" has uncommitted changes; bytes remain in place")
102		}
103		if observed.desiredNext(options) == "" {
104			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "no next action is recorded")
105		}
106		if !options.KeepSession && observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
107			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "runtime remains active because the caller is contained; exit normally and reconcile later")
108		}
109	
110		closedRuntime := false
111		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
112			switch effect.Code {
113			case EffectCommitWIP:
114				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
115					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task and retry warm parking")
116				}
117				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
118					made, commitErr := e.service.wipCommit(ctx, observed.checkout, effect.Details.Map()["message"])
119					if commitErr != nil {
120						return "", fmt.Errorf("checkpoint WIP: %w", commitErr)
121					}
122					if !made {
123						return "no product changes required a checkpoint", nil
124					}
125					return "created WIP checkpoint", nil
126				})
127				if err != nil {
128					return e.fail(err, "preserve the checkout and retry after fixing the checkpoint failure")
129				}
130				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
131					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after WIP checkpoint: %w", err), "inspect the committed checkpoint before retrying")
132				}
133			case EffectPushBranch:
134				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
135					return e.fail(err, "inspect the checkout and retry the push")
136				}
137				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
138					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
139					if pushErr != nil {
140						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
141					}
142					return "pushed origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
143				})
144				if err != nil {
145					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains present; resolve the push and retry warm parking")
146				}
147				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
148					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after push: %w", err), "inspect the published branch before retrying")
149				}
150			case EffectCloseRuntime:
151				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
152					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task and retry runtime closure")
153				}
154				if err := e.service.revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx, *observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
155					return e.fail(err, "inspect runtime occupancy from outside the checkout")
156				}
157				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
158					closed, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
159						observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout))
160					if closeErr != nil {
161						return "", closeErr
162					}
163					observed.cleanup = closed
164					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", closed.ClosedSessions, observed.runtime.Name()), nil
165				})
166				if err != nil {
167					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and task record remain; inspect runtime occupancy and retry")
168				}
169				if err := e.service.ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx, observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
170					return e.fail(err, "a runtime reclaimed the checkout; close it from outside and retry")
171				}
172				closedRuntime = true
173			case EffectUpdateTask:
174				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
175					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task before recording WARM")
176				}
177				if !options.KeepSession {
178					var runtimeErr error
179					if closedRuntime {
180						runtimeErr = e.service.ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx, observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
181					} else {
182						runtimeErr = e.service.revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx, *observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
183					}
184					if runtimeErr != nil {
185						return e.fail(runtimeErr, "runtime occupancy changed; refresh and retry warm parking")
186					}
187				}
188				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
189					candidate := observed.task
190					candidate.State = task.Warm
191					candidate.Owner = e.service.host
192					if options.Next != "" {
193						candidate.Next = options.Next
194					}
195					if options.Note != "" {
196						candidate.Note = options.Note
197					}
198					if !options.KeepSession && !observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
199						candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
200						candidate.RuntimeName = ""
201					}
202					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
203					if updateErr != nil {
204						return "", fmt.Errorf("write WARM task state: %w", updateErr)
205					}
206					if updated == nil {
207						return "", errors.New("write WARM task state returned no revision")
208					}
209					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
210					observed.task = updated.Task
211					return "recorded WARM at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
212				})
213				if err != nil {
214					return e.fail(err, "Git/runtime effects may already be complete; reload the task and reconcile its state")
215				}
216			default:
217				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ParkWarm effect " + string(effect.Code)})
218			}
219		}
220		return e.result(), nil
221	}
222	
223	func (e *executionState) applyParkCold(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
224		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ParkColdOptions)
225		observed := &e.observed
226		if observed.desiredNext(options) == "" {
227			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "no next action is recorded")
228		}
229		closedRuntime := false
230		checkoutRemoved := false
231		baseSwitched := false
232	
233		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
234			switch effect.Code {
235			case EffectCommitWIP:
236				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
237					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task and retry cold parking")
238				}
239				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
240					made, commitErr := e.service.wipCommit(ctx, observed.checkout, effect.Details.Map()["message"])
241					if commitErr != nil {
242						return "", fmt.Errorf("checkpoint WIP: %w", commitErr)
243					}
244					if !made {
245						return "no product changes required a checkpoint", nil
246					}
247					return "created WIP checkpoint", nil
248				})
249				if err != nil {
250					return e.fail(err, "preserve the checkout and resolve the checkpoint failure")
251				}
252				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
253					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after WIP checkpoint: %w", err), "inspect the checkpoint before retrying")
254				}
255				if observed.status.Dirty() {
256					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("checkout remains dirty after WIP checkpoint: %s", observed.status.Breakdown()),
257						"commit or finalize the remaining bytes before cold parking")
258				}
259			case EffectPushBranch:
260				if err := e.service.ensureParkBranchIdentity(ctx, observed); err != nil {
261					return e.fail(err, "inspect the checkout before retrying the push")
262				}
263				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
264					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
265					if pushErr != nil {
266						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
267					}
268					return "pushed origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
269				})
270				if err != nil {
271					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains present; resolve the push before retrying cold parking")
272				}
273				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
274					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after push: %w", err), "inspect the published branch before retrying")
275				}
276			case EffectCloseRuntime:
277				if err := e.service.ensureColdGitReady(ctx, observed); err != nil {
278					return e.fail(err, "restore a clean, fully pushed branch before runtime cleanup")
279				}
280				if err := e.service.revalidateColdArtifact(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
281					return e.fail(err, "finalize or restore artifact receipts before runtime cleanup")
282				}
283				if err := e.service.revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx, *observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
284					return e.fail(err, "runtime occupancy changed; refresh cold parking")
285				}
286				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
287					closed, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
288						observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout))
289					if closeErr != nil {
290						return "", closeErr
291					}
292					observed.cleanup = closed
293					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", closed.ClosedSessions, observed.runtime.Name()), nil
294				})
295				if err != nil {
296					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains present; inspect runtime occupancy and retry")
297				}
298				if err := e.service.ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx, observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
299					return e.fail(err, "a runtime reclaimed the checkout; close it from outside before retrying")
300				}
301				closedRuntime = true
302			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
303				if err := e.service.ensureColdRemovalBoundary(ctx, observed, options, closedRuntime); err != nil {
304					return e.fail(err, "the worktree was preserved; refresh every safety condition before retrying")
305				}
306				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
307					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
308						return "", fmt.Errorf("remove exact worktree %s: %w", observed.checkout, removeErr)
309					}
310					return "removed exact linked worktree; branch retained", nil
311				})
312				if err != nil {
313					return e.fail(err, "inspect the still-registered worktree; never force removal without preserving bytes")
314				}
315				checkoutRemoved = true
316				if !e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch) {
317					return e.fail(errors.New("task branch disappeared after worktree removal"), "restore the retained task branch before updating task state")
318				}
319			case EffectSwitchBase:
320				if err := e.service.ensureColdRemovalBoundary(ctx, observed, options, closedRuntime); err != nil {
321					return e.fail(err, "canonical checkout was not switched; refresh cold parking")
322				}
323				base := effect.Details.Map()["base"]
324				if base == "" || !e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, base) {
325					return e.fail(staleBoundary("explicit base ref changed before canonical checkout switch"), "restore the recorded base and retry")
326				}
327				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
328					_, switchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "switch", base)
329					if switchErr != nil {
330						return "", fmt.Errorf("switch canonical checkout to %s: %w", base, switchErr)
331					}
332					return "switched canonical checkout to " + base, nil
333				})
334				if err != nil {
335					return e.fail(err, "the task branch remains retained; inspect the canonical checkout and retry")
336				}
337				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, base); err != nil {
338					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify canonical base switch: %w", err), "inspect the canonical checkout before reconciling task state")
339				}
340				if !e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch) {
341					return e.fail(errors.New("task branch disappeared during canonical checkout switch"), "restore the task branch before updating task state")
342				}
343				baseSwitched = true
344			case EffectUpdateTask:
345				if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !checkoutRemoved {
346					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "task update reached before worktree removal"})
347				}
348				if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && !baseSwitched {
349					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "task update reached before canonical base switch"})
350				}
351				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
352					candidate := observed.task
353					candidate.State = task.Cold
354					candidate.Owner = e.service.host
355					candidate.WorktreePath = ""
356					candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
357					candidate.RuntimeName = ""
358					if options.Next != "" {
359						candidate.Next = options.Next
360					}
361					if options.Note != "" {
362						candidate.Note = options.Note
363					}
364					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
365					if updateErr != nil {
366						return "", fmt.Errorf("write COLD task state: %w", updateErr)
367					}
368					if updated == nil {
369						return "", errors.New("write COLD task state returned no revision")
370					}
371					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
372					observed.task = updated.Task
373					return "recorded COLD at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
374				})
375				if err != nil {
376					return e.fail(err, "checkout cleanup succeeded but task persistence failed; reload and reconcile the task path/runtime/state")
377				}
378			default:
379				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ParkCold effect " + string(effect.Code)})
380			}
381		}
382		return e.result(), nil
383	}
384	
385	func (e *executionState) applyResume(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
386		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ResumeOptions)
387		observed := &e.observed
388		e.resumePath = observed.checkout
389		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && observed.savedRuntimeLive {
390			e.resumeRuntimeName = observed.runtime.Name()
391			e.resumeRuntimeHandle = observed.task.RuntimeHandle
392		}
393		runtimeMutated := false
394		checkoutMutated := false
395	
396		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
397			switch effect.Code {
398			case EffectFetchRefs:
399				if err := e.service.revalidateRepository(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
400					return e.fail(err, "refresh the canonical repository before fetching")
401				}
402				if observed.hasCheckout() {
403					if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
404						return e.fail(err, "refresh checkout authority before fetching")
405					}
406				} else if matches, err := e.service.branchCheckoutCount(ctx, *observed); err != nil || matches != observed.branchMatches {
407					if err != nil {
408						return e.fail(err, "refresh worktree topology before fetching")
409					}
410					return e.fail(staleBoundary("task branch checkout topology changed before fetch"), "refresh resume")
411				}
412				e.runWarning(effect, func() (string, error) {
413					_, fetchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "origin")
414					if fetchErr != nil {
415						return "", fetchErr
416					}
417					return "fetched origin", nil
418				}, "fetch failed")
419				if observed.hasCheckout() {
420					if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, resumeExpectedBranchBeforeSwitch(*observed)); err != nil {
421						return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh checkout after fetch: %w", err), "inspect fetched refs and retry resume")
422					}
423				}
424			case EffectCreateWorktree:
425				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeBranchRefs(ctx, observed, options.FetchRefs); err != nil {
426					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task branch before rebuilding its checkout")
427				}
428				base := observed.task.Base
429				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch) {
430					base = observed.remoteBranch
431				}
432				if base == "" || !e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, base) {
433					return e.fail(staleBoundary("explicit worktree reconstruction base is unavailable after fetch"), "restore origin/"+observed.task.Branch+" or the recorded base")
434				}
435				if matches, err := e.service.branchCheckoutCount(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
436					return e.fail(err, "refresh repository topology before rebuilding")
437				} else if matches != 0 {
438					return e.fail(staleBoundary("the task branch acquired a checkout before reconstruction"), "refresh and reuse the newly registered exact checkout")
439				}
440				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
441					created, createErr := e.service.createWorktree(ctx, wt.CreateRequest{
442						RepoPath: observed.repoPath, RepoName: observed.task.Repo,
443						Branch: observed.task.Branch, Base: base,
444						Path: effect.Target, Label: resumeRuntimeLabel(observed.task),
445						NoProvision: options.NoProvision, NoRuntime: true,
446					})
447					if createErr != nil {
448						var exists *wt.ErrExists
449						if errors.As(createErr, &exists) {
450							return "", staleBoundary("the task branch became checked out at " + exists.Path)
451						}
452						return "", createErr
453					}
454					if created == nil || created.Path == "" {
455						return "", errors.New("worktree manager returned no checkout path")
456					}
457					path, canonicalErr := e.service.canonicalPath(created.Path)
458					if canonicalErr != nil {
459						return "", canonicalErr
460					}
461					target, targetErr := e.service.canonicalPath(effect.Target)
462					if targetErr != nil || path != target {
463						return "", fmt.Errorf("worktree manager created %q, approved target is %q", path, target)
464					}
465					e.resumePath = path
466					return "rebuilt linked worktree from " + base, nil
467				})
468				if err != nil {
469					return e.fail(err, "inspect any partially created checkout, then refresh resume before retrying")
470				}
471				registered, resolveErr := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, e.resumePath)
472				if resolveErr != nil {
473					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("resolve rebuilt exact worktree: %w", resolveErr), "preserve the rebuilt checkout and reconcile its registration")
474				}
475				observed.worktree = registered
476				observed.worktreeFound = true
477				observed.worktreeErr = nil
478				observed.checkout = registered.Path
479				if !registered.IsLinkedWorktree() || registered.Worktree.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
480					return e.fail(errors.New("rebuilt checkout is not the exact linked task branch"), "preserve and reconcile the rebuilt checkout")
481				}
482				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
483					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify rebuilt worktree: %w", err), "preserve and inspect the rebuilt checkout")
484				}
485				checkoutMutated = true
486			case EffectSwitchBranch:
487				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeOccupancy(ctx, observed, !runtimeMutated && !checkoutMutated); err != nil {
488					return e.fail(err, "another agent or runtime changed occupancy; refresh resume")
489				}
490				if err := e.service.ensureBranchSwitchBoundary(ctx, observed); err != nil {
491					return e.fail(err, "preserve canonical checkout changes and retry resume")
492				}
493				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
494					_, switchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "switch", observed.task.Branch)
495					if switchErr != nil {
496						return "", switchErr
497					}
498					return "switched canonical checkout to " + observed.task.Branch, nil
499				})
500				if err != nil {
501					return e.fail(err, "inspect the canonical checkout and retry resume")
502				}
503				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
504					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify task branch switch: %w", err), "inspect the canonical checkout before retrying")
505				}
506				checkoutMutated = true
507			case EffectOpenRuntime:
508				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeCheckout(ctx, observed); err != nil {
509					return e.fail(err, "refresh the exact checkout before opening a runtime")
510				}
511				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeOccupancy(ctx, observed, !runtimeMutated && !checkoutMutated); err != nil {
512					return e.fail(err, "another agent or runtime changed occupancy; refresh resume")
513				}
514				if savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle) {
515					return e.fail(staleBoundary("saved runtime handle became live before the declared open"), "refresh and reuse the saved runtime")
516				}
517				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
518					opened, openErr := e.service.openRuntime(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, resumeRuntimeLabel(observed.task))
519					if openErr != nil {
520						return "", openErr
521					}
522					if opened.Handle == "" {
523						return "", errors.New("runtime opened without a handle")
524					}
525					e.resumeRuntimeName = observed.runtime.Name()
526					e.resumeRuntimeHandle = opened.Handle
527					return "opened " + observed.runtime.Name() + " runtime " + opened.Handle, nil
528				})
529				if err != nil {
530					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains available; open a runtime manually or retry resume")
531				}
532				runtimeMutated = true
533			case EffectUpdateTask:
534				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeCheckout(ctx, observed); err != nil {
535					return e.fail(err, "refresh the exact checkout before recording HOT")
536				}
537				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeOccupancy(ctx, observed, !runtimeMutated && !checkoutMutated); err != nil {
538					return e.fail(err, "another recognized agent appeared; close the new surface or refresh resume")
539				}
540				if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !runtimeMutated && observed.task.RuntimeHandle != "" &&
541					!savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle) {
542					return e.fail(staleBoundary("saved runtime handle disappeared before HOT task write"), "refresh resume and open a new runtime")
543				}
544				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
545					candidate := observed.task
546					candidate.State = task.Hot
547					candidate.Owner = e.service.host
548					if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
549						candidate.WorktreePath = observed.checkout
550					} else {
551						candidate.WorktreePath = ""
552					}
553					if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
554						candidate.RuntimeName = ""
555						candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
556					} else {
557						candidate.RuntimeName = e.resumeRuntimeName
558						candidate.RuntimeHandle = e.resumeRuntimeHandle
559						if candidate.RuntimeName == "" || candidate.RuntimeHandle == "" {
560							return "", errors.New("HOT task requires the validated or newly opened runtime handle")
561						}
562					}
563					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
564					if updateErr != nil {
565						return "", fmt.Errorf("write HOT task state: %w", updateErr)
566					}
567					if updated == nil {
568						return "", errors.New("write HOT task state returned no revision")
569					}
570					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
571					observed.task = updated.Task
572					if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
573						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffDirectory, Path: observed.checkout, Label: candidate.Title()}
574					} else {
575						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffRuntime, Path: observed.checkout,
576							Runtime: candidate.RuntimeName, RuntimeHandle: candidate.RuntimeHandle, Label: candidate.Title()}
577					}
578					return "recorded HOT at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
579				})
580				if err != nil {
581					return e.fail(err, "checkout/runtime preparation may be complete; reload and reconcile task ownership, path, and runtime")
582				}
583			default:
584				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected Resume effect " + string(effect.Code)})
585			}
586		}
587		return e.result(), nil
588	}

590	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRepository(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
591		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
592		if err != nil {
593			return staleBoundary("canonical repository is no longer discoverable: " + err.Error())
594		}
595		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
596		if err != nil {
597			return staleBoundary("canonical repository path is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
598		}
599		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
600		if err != nil {
601			return staleBoundary("Git common directory is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
602		}
603		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
604			return staleBoundary("canonical repository or Git common directory changed")
605		}
606		return nil
607	}

609	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateGitBaseline(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
610		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
611		if err != nil {
612			return staleBoundary("exact worktree registration changed: " + err.Error())
613		}
614		if registered != observed.worktree {
615			return staleBoundary("exact worktree path, branch, HEAD, Main, locked, or prunable flags changed")
616		}
617		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
618		if err != nil {
619			return staleBoundary("Git status observation changed: " + err.Error())
620		}
621		if !sameStatus(status, observed.status) {
622			return staleBoundary("Git status, branch, upstream, ahead, behind, dirty, or conflict evidence changed")
623		}
624		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
625		if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(head) != observed.head {
626			return staleBoundary("checkout HEAD changed")
627		}
628		baseOID, baseErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
629		upstreamOID, upstreamErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
630		if errorString(baseErr) != errorString(observed.baseOIDErr) || baseOID != observed.baseOID ||
631			errorString(upstreamErr) != errorString(observed.upstreamOIDErr) || upstreamOID != observed.upstreamOID {
632			return staleBoundary("base or upstream ref OID changed")
633		}
634		operation, active, err := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
635		if err != nil || operation != observed.operation || active != observed.inProgress {
636			return staleBoundary("Git operation evidence changed")
637		}
638		return nil
639	}

641	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, expectedBranch string) error {
642		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
643		if err != nil {
644			return err
645		}
646		if registered.Path != observed.checkout || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
647			return errors.New("checkout path or Git common directory changed")
648		}
649		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !registered.IsLinkedWorktree() {
650			return errors.New("worktree task no longer resolves to a linked checkout")
651		}
652		if observed.mode != task.ModeWorktree && (!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare) {
653			return errors.New("canonical task no longer resolves to the main checkout")
654		}
655		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
656		if err != nil {
657			return err
658		}
659		if status.Detached || expectedBranch != "" && status.Branch != expectedBranch || registered.Worktree.Branch != status.Branch {
660			return fmt.Errorf("checkout branch changed: registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", registered.Worktree.Branch, status.Branch, expectedBranch)
661		}
662		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
663		if err != nil {
664			return err
665		}
666		head = strings.TrimSpace(head)
667		if registered.Worktree.Head != head {
668			return fmt.Errorf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", registered.Worktree.Head, head)
669		}
670		baseOID, baseOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
671		upstreamOID, upstreamOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
672		operation, active, operationErr := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
673		if operationErr != nil {
674			return operationErr
675		}
676		observed.worktree = registered
677		observed.status = status
678		observed.statusErr = nil
679		observed.head = head
680		observed.headErr = nil
681		observed.baseOID = baseOID
682		observed.baseOIDErr = baseOIDErr
683		observed.upstreamOID = upstreamOID
684		observed.upstreamOIDErr = upstreamOIDErr
685		observed.operation = operation
686		observed.inProgress = active
687		observed.operationErr = nil
688		return nil
689	}

701	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureColdGitReady(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
702		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
703			return err
704		}
705		if observed.status.Dirty() {
706			return fmt.Errorf("cold parking requires a clean checkout: %s", observed.status.Breakdown())
707		}
708		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
709			return errors.New("cold parking checkout is no longer on the task branch")
710		}
711		if observed.inProgress || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
712			return errors.New("cold parking refuses an active Git operation or unresolved conflict")
713		}
714		if !observed.status.Published() || observed.status.Ahead != 0 {
715			return fmt.Errorf("cold parking requires a published ahead=0 branch; status is %s", observed.status.Summary())
716		}
717		return nil
718	}

763	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureColdRemovalBoundary(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, options ParkColdOptions, runtimeWasClosed bool) error {
764		if err := s.ensureColdGitReady(ctx, observed); err != nil {
765			return err
766		}

772		if err != nil {

775		if !fresh.Ready() || fresh.CallerContained || len(fresh.Sessions) > 0 {

851		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
852		if err != nil {
853			return 0, err
854		}
855		count := 0
856		for _, worktree := range worktrees {

103		conditions = append(conditions, retireRuntimeConditions(candidate, observed, noCheckout)...)
104		conditions = append(conditions, retireBranchDeletionCondition(candidate, observed, noCheckout, options))
105	
106		var effects []Effect
107		if !noCheckout && observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.cleanupErr == nil && len(observed.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
108			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
109				EffectCloseRuntime, "close eligible runtime sessions covering the checkout", observed.checkout, true, false,
110				map[string]string{"backend": runtimeName(observed.runtime), "sessions": fmt.Sprintf("%d", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions))},
111			))
112		}
113		if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout {
114			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
115				EffectRemoveWorktree, "remove the exact clean linked worktree without force", observed.checkout, true, false,
116				map[string]string{"repo": observed.repoPath, "branch": candidate.Branch, "head": observed.head, "force": "false"},
117			))
118		}
119		if options.DeleteBranch && mode != task.ModeDirect && candidate.Branch != candidate.Base && observed.branchExists {
120			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
121				EffectDeleteBranch, "delete the freshly contained local task branch", candidate.Branch, true, false,
122				map[string]string{"branch-ref": observed.branchRef, "branch-oid": observed.branchOID, "base-ref": observed.baseRef, "base-oid": observed.baseOID},
123			))
124		}
125		effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
126			EffectDeleteTask, "CAS-delete the DONE task record last", candidate.ID, true, false,
127			map[string]string{"expected-revision": record.Revision},
128		))
129	
130		confirmation := Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Retire this DONE task and its eligible local resources?"}
131		if options.DeleteBranch && mode != task.ModeDirect && candidate.Branch != candidate.Base && observed.branchExists {
132			confirmation = Confirmation{
133				Kind: ConfirmationTyped, Token: "DELETE " + candidate.Branch,
134				Prompt: "Type DELETE " + candidate.Branch + " to remove the contained local branch under this exact plan",
135			}

137		retained := retireRetainedResources(candidate, observed, noCheckout, options)
138		return PlanSpec{

140			Conditions:        conditions,
141			Effects:           effects,

145			Summary:           "Retire " + candidate.Title(),

174		switch {
175		case observed.taskInventoryErr != nil:
176			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
177				observed.taskInventoryErr.Error(), "repair task-store inventory before retirement")
178		case len(observed.taskIncomplete) > 0:
179			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
180				strings.Join(observed.taskIncomplete, "; "), "repair every corrupt or unresolvable task record")
181		}
182	
183		var conflicting []string
184		for _, claim := range observed.taskClaims {
185			if claim.ID != candidate.ID {
186				conflicting = append(conflicting, claim.ID+" ("+claim.Reason+")")
187			}
188		}
189		claimsCondition := condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
190			"only task "+candidate.ID+" claims the retirement branch/checkout", "")
191		if len(conflicting) > 0 {
192			claimsCondition = condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
193				"also claimed by "+strings.Join(conflicting, ", "),
194				"reconcile every conflicting task before removing shared resources")
195		}
196		return []Condition{inventoryCondition, claimsCondition}
197	}
198	
199	func retireCheckoutConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
200		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
201		if noCheckout {
202			paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(false)
203			exactVerdict := VerdictMet
204			exactEvidence := "persisted DONE task records no checkout and Git has no checkout for its branch"
205			if err != nil {
206				exactVerdict = VerdictError
207				exactEvidence = err.Error()
208			} else if len(paths) > 0 {
209				exactVerdict = VerdictBlocked
210				exactEvidence = "task branch is still checked out at " + strings.Join(paths, ", ")
211			}
212			return []Condition{
213				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
214					"no recorded checkout is the narrow persisted-DONE reap case", ""),
215				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence,
216					"reconcile the discovered checkout before retirement"),
217				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
218					"no worktree removal is requested", ""),
219				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
220					"no worktree registration will be removed", ""),
221				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
222					"branch identity is proved from the local ref", ""),
223				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
224					"no checkout status is required for record-only reaping", ""),
225				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
226					"no checkout Git operation can be removed", ""),
227				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
228					"no checkout bytes will be removed", ""),
229				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
230					"no checkout path is selected", ""),
231			}
232		}
233	
234		if !observed.worktreeFound {
235			verdict := VerdictBlocked
236			evidence := "the exact recorded checkout is not registered"
237			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !errors.Is(observed.worktreeErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
238				verdict = VerdictError
239				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
240			}
241			return []Condition{
242				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "restore or reconcile the exact checkout"),
243				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree identity is unavailable", "refresh Git topology"),
244				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree kind is unavailable", "refresh Git topology"),
245				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "worktree flags are unavailable", "refresh Git topology"),
246				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout branch is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
247				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout status is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
248				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "Git operation state is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
249				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout cleanliness is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
250				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout ownership is unavailable", "refresh repository topology"),
251			}
252		}
253	
254		exactVerdict := VerdictMet
255		exactEvidence := "registered path, repository, Git common directory, and live HEAD are exact"
256		switch {
257		case observed.worktree.Path != observed.checkout:
258			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered path differs from the exact selected checkout"
259		case observed.worktree.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir:
260			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered repository identity differs from the selected repository"
261		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.headErr != nil:
262			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
263		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head:
264			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry HEAD %s differs from live HEAD %s", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
265		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.locator.HeadOID != "" && observed.locator.HeadOID != observed.head:
266			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("selected HEAD %s differs from live HEAD %s", observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
267		}
268	
269		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
270		kindEvidence := "Git main checkout retained"
271		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
272			kindEvidence = "registered non-main linked worktree"
273			if !observed.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree() {
274				kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
275				kindEvidence = "worktree task does not resolve to a non-main linked worktree"
276			}
277		} else if !observed.worktree.Worktree.Main || observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare || observed.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath {
278			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
279			kindEvidence = "branch/direct task does not resolve to the exact non-bare Git main checkout"
280		}
281	
282		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
283		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and non-prunable"
284		flagRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
285		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
286			flagRequirement = RequirementRequired
287			if observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked || observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable {
288				flagVerdict = VerdictBlocked
289				flagEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("locked=%t prunable=%t", observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked, observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable)
290			}
291		}
292	
293		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
294		branchEvidence := "canonical checkout branch is irrelevant because it is retained"
295		branchRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
296		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
297			branchRequirement = RequirementRequired
298			branchEvidence = "registry, status, branch ref, and live HEAD identify " + candidate.Branch
299			switch {
300			case observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch == "":
301				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered linked worktree is detached or unnamed"
302			case observed.statusErr != nil:
303				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
304			case observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != candidate.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch:
305				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, candidate.Branch)
306			case !observed.branchExists || observed.branchOID != observed.head:
307				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("branch exists=%t branch OID=%q live HEAD=%q", observed.branchExists, observed.branchOID, observed.head)
308			}
309		}
310	
311		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
312		statusEvidence := "canonical checkout content is retained"
313		statusRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
314		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
315		operationEvidence := "canonical checkout Git operation is retained"
316		operationRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
317		cleanVerdict := VerdictMet
318		cleanEvidence := "canonical checkout bytes are retained"
319		cleanRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
320		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
321			statusRequirement, operationRequirement, cleanRequirement = RequirementRequired, RequirementRequired, RequirementRequired
322			if observed.statusErr != nil {
323				statusVerdict, statusEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
324				cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
325			} else {
326				statusEvidence = observed.status.Summary()
327				if observed.status.Dirty() {
328					cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictBlocked, observed.status.Breakdown()
329				} else {
330					cleanEvidence = "checkout is clean"
331				}
332			}
333			if observed.operationErr != nil {
334				operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictError, observed.operationErr.Error()
335			} else if observed.inProgress {
336				operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "Git operation "+observed.operation+" is in progress"
337			} else {
338				operationEvidence = "no Git operation is in progress"
339			}
340		}
341	
342		harnessVerdict := VerdictMet
343		harnessEvidence := "checkout has no strict Claude harness ownership evidence"
344		harnessRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
345		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
346			harnessRequirement = RequirementRequired
347			if observed.isHarness {
348				harnessVerdict = VerdictBlocked
349				harnessEvidence = "checkout is strictly under harness root " + observed.harness.Root
350			}
351		}
352		return []Condition{
353			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
354			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "refresh the exact checkout identity"),
355			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "reconcile the task checkout mode"),
356			condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, flagVerdict, flagRequirement, flagEvidence, "unlock or repair the worktree registration"),
357			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, branchRequirement, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named branch and HEAD"),
358			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, statusRequirement, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
359			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, operationRequirement, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
360			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, cleanRequirement, cleanEvidence, "commit or preserve every changed byte"),
361			condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, harnessVerdict, harnessRequirement, harnessEvidence, "let the harness retire its own checkout"),
362		}
363	}
364	
365	func retireRefConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
366		baseCondition := condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
367			fmt.Sprintf("local base %s at %s", candidate.Base, observed.baseOID), "")
368		switch {
369		case candidate.Base == "":
370			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
371				"DONE retirement requires the task's explicit local base", "record the exact local base branch")
372		case !observed.baseExists:
373			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
374				"local base ref "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "restore the named local base branch")
375		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
376			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
377				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair local base observation")
378		case observed.baseOID == "":
379			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
380				"local base resolved to no commit", "restore the named local base branch")
381		}
382	
383		branchCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
384			fmt.Sprintf("local branch %s at %s", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID), "")
385		if !observed.branchExists {
386			if noCheckout {
387				branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
388					"local task branch is already absent for a persisted DONE task with no checkout", "")
389			} else {
390				branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
391					"local task branch "+observed.branchRef+" is missing", "restore the task branch before retiring its checkout")
392			}
393		} else if observed.branchOIDErr != nil {
394			branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
395				observed.branchOIDErr.Error(), "repair local task branch observation")
396		} else if observed.branchOID == "" {
397			branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
398				"local task branch resolved to no commit", "restore the local task branch")
399		}
400	
401		relationCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
402			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID), "")
403		switch {
404		case !observed.branchExists && noCheckout:
405			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
406				"missing branch is accepted only because persisted DONE records no checkout", "")
407		case observed.containedErr != nil:
408			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
409				observed.containedErr.Error(), "repair local containment observation")
410		case observed.branchExists && observed.baseExists && observed.branchOIDErr == nil && observed.baseOIDErr == nil && !observed.contained:
411			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
412				fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is not contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID),
413				"integrate the task branch into the named local base first")
414		case !observed.branchExists || !observed.baseExists || observed.branchOID == "" || observed.baseOID == "":
415			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
416				"containment cannot be proved from exact local branch and base OIDs", "restore both local refs")
417		}
418		return []Condition{baseCondition, branchCondition, relationCondition}
419	}
420	
421	func retireArtifactCondition(observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) Condition {
422		if noCheckout {
423			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
424				"no checkout is recorded for artifact inspection", "")
425		}
426		switch {
427		case !observed.worktreeFound:
428			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
429				"artifact readiness requires the exact linked checkout", "restore the checkout")
430		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
431			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
432				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
433		case !observed.artifact.Ready():
434			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
435				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
436		default:
437			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
438				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "")
439		}
440	}
441	
442	func retireRuntimeConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
443		if noCheckout {
444			if candidate.RuntimeName != "" || candidate.RuntimeHandle != "" {
445				return []Condition{
446					condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
447						"task has a runtime hint but no exact checkout", "reconcile or clear the runtime hint outside retirement"),
448					condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
449						"runtime coverage cannot be tied to an exact checkout", "reconcile the missing checkout"),
450					condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
451						"caller containment cannot be inspected without a checkout", "reconcile the missing checkout"),
452				}
453			}
454			return []Condition{
455				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "no runtime hint is recorded", ""),
456				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "no checkout or runtime hint requires cleanup", ""),
457				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "no checkout can contain the caller", ""),
458			}
459		}
460		return destructiveRuntimeConditions(observed)
461	}
462	
463	func destructiveRuntimeConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
464		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
465			return []Condition{
466				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
467				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime observation"),
468				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime was not inspected", "run cleanup from outside the checkout"),
469			}
470		}
471		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + runtimeName(observed.runtime) + " is available"
472		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
473			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " reports unavailable; cleanup evidence still controls"
474		}
475		if observed.cleanupErr != nil {
476			return []Condition{
477				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, "select an available backend or use the explicit external acknowledgement"),
478				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.cleanupErr.Error(), "repair runtime enumeration or use the explicit external acknowledgement"),
479				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime occupancy failed", "run cleanup from outside the checkout"),
480			}
481		}
482		occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
483		occupancyEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%d eligible runtime session(s)", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions))
484		if observed.cleanup.RuntimeUnknown {
485			occupancyEvidence = "runtime enumeration failed and the external assume-no-runtime acknowledgement is recorded"
486		}
487		if len(observed.cleanup.Blockers) > 0 {
488			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
489			occupancyEvidence = strings.Join(observed.cleanup.Blockers, "; ")
490		}
491		callerVerdict := VerdictMet
492		callerEvidence := "caller is outside the target checkout and covering runtimes"
493		if observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
494			callerVerdict = VerdictBlocked
495			callerEvidence = "caller is inside the target checkout or a covering runtime"
496		}
497		return []Condition{
498			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, ""),
499			condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop active agents and leave mixed/caller runtimes intact"),
500			condition(ConditionCallerContainment, callerVerdict, RequirementRequired, callerEvidence, "run cleanup from outside the target checkout and runtime"),
501		}
502	}
503	
504	func retireBranchDeletionCondition(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool, options RetireOptions) Condition {
505		if !options.DeleteBranch {
506			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
507				"local task branch will be retained", "")
508		}
509		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
510			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
511				"direct tasks never delete their branch", "retire without branch deletion")
512		}
513		if candidate.Branch == candidate.Base {
514			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
515				"task branch is the explicit base branch", "retire without deleting the base")
516		}
517		if !observed.branchExists && noCheckout {
518			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
519				"local task branch is already absent", "")
520		}
521		paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout)
522		if err != nil {
523			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
524				err.Error(), "refresh registered worktrees before branch deletion")
525		}
526		if len(paths) > 0 {
527			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
528				"branch is checked out at "+strings.Join(paths, ", "), "switch or remove those exact checkouts first")
529		}
530		return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
531			"ordinary git branch -d will delete only the freshly contained local branch", "")
532	}
533	
534	func retireRetainedResources(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool, options RetireOptions) []string {
535		var retained []string
536		if observed.branchExists && (!options.DeleteBranch || candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect) {
537			retained = append(retained, "branch:"+candidate.Branch)
538		}
539		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && observed.checkout != "" {
540			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+observed.checkout)
541		}
542		return retained
543	}
544	
545	func retireFallback(id string, options RetireOptions) string {
546		parts := []string{"dev", "retire", shellQuote(id)}
547		if options.DeleteBranch {
548			parts = append(parts, "--delete-branch")
549		}
550		if options.CloseUnknown {
551			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
552		}
553		if options.AssumeNoRuntime {
554			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
555		}
556		if options.Timeout > 0 {
557			parts = append(parts, "--timeout", options.Timeout.String())
558		}
559		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
560	}
561	
562	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRetire(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
563		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
564			return Result{}, err
565		}
566		if approved.Action != Retire {
567			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "retire handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
568		}
569		if err := validateRetireLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
570			return Result{}, err
571		}
572		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
573		if err != nil {
574			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
575		}
576	
577		var result Result
578		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
579			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
580				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
581				if loadErr != nil {
582					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before retirement apply"}
583				}
584				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
585					return identityErr
586				}
587				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRetire(ctx, approved.Request, *record, tx.ListRecords)
588				if observeErr != nil {
589					return observeErr
590				}
591				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
592				if buildErr != nil {
593					return buildErr
594				}
595				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
596				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
597					actual := ""
598					if current != nil {
599						actual = current.Revision
600					}
601					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked retirement replan")
602				}
603				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
604					return &StalePlanError{
605						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
606						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
607						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
608						Reason:                       "fresh retirement task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or ref authority differs",
609					}
610				}
611				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
612					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
613					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh retirement conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
614				}
615	
616				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision}
617				result, observeErr = execution.executeRetire(ctx, *record, observed)
618				return observeErr
619			})
620		})
621		return result, err
622	}
623	
624	func (e *executionState) executeRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
625		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RetireOptions)
626		candidate := record.Task
627		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
628		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == ""
629		closedRuntime := false
630		removedWorktree := false
631		deletedBranch := false
632	
633		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
634			switch effect.Code {
635			case EffectCloseRuntime:
636				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, false)
637				if err != nil {
638					return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before closing any runtime")
639				}
640				baseline = fresh
641				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
642					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
643						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
644						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
645					})
646					if closeErr != nil {
647						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
648					}
649					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil

754	func (e *executionState) reinspectRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
755		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
756		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
757			actual := ""
758			if current != nil {
759				actual = current.Revision
760			}
761			return destructiveObservation{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed at a retirement boundary")
762		}
763		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRetire(ctx, e.plan.Request, *current, e.tx.ListRecords)
764		if err != nil {
765			return fresh, err
766		}
767		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
768			return fresh, err
769		}
770		for _, check := range []struct {
771			name          string
772			before, after string
773		}{
774			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
775			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
776			{"Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()},
777			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
778			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
779			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
780			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
781			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
782		} {
783			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
784				return fresh, err
785			}
786		}
787		if allowRuntimeChange {
788			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
789				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
790			}
791		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
792			return fresh, err
793		}
794		return fresh, nil
795	}

840	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch bool) error {
