```text
112	// InspectReadiness gathers artifact finalization evidence for one exact
113	// checkout. It never reconciles receipts, finalizes intents, or writes either
114	// source files or intent records. The returned inspection retains partial
115	// evidence and the same wrapped error returned separately to ordinary callers.
116	func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
117		inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
118		if ctx == nil {
119			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")
120			inspection.ObservationError = err
121			return inspection, err
122		}
123		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
124			inspection.ObservationError = err
125			return inspection, err
126		}
127		if store == nil {
128			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a store")
129			inspection.ObservationError = err
130			return inspection, err
131		}
132	
133		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
134		if err != nil {
135			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
136			inspection.ObservationError = err
137			return inspection, err
138		}
139		inspection.Checkout = canonical
140	
141		intents, err := store.List()
142		if err != nil {
143			err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
144			inspection.ObservationError = err
145			return inspection, err
146		}
147		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
148			inspection.ObservationError = err
149			return inspection, err
150		}
151	
152		for _, intent := range intents {
153			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
154				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
155				break
156			}
157			intentCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
158			if err != nil {
159				err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, err)
160				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
161				continue
162			}
163			if intentCheckout != canonical {
164				continue
165			}
166	
167			evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
168			switch intent.Status {
169			case Armed, Finalizing:
170				evidence.State = ReadinessPending
171			case Failed:
172				evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
173			case Discarded:
174				evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
175			case Finalized:
176				evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, canonical, intent)
177				switch {
178				case err != nil:
179					err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
180					evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
181					evidence.ObservationError = err
182					inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
183				case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
184					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
185				default:
186					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
187				}
188			default:
189				// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
190				// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
191				err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
192				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
193				evidence.ObservationError = err
194				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
195			}
196			inspection.Intents = append(inspection.Intents, evidence)
197		}
198	
199		inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
200		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
201	}
202	
203	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
204		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
205			return false, nil
206		}
207		candidates := []struct {
208			dir string
209			ref string
210		}{
211			{checkout, "HEAD"},
212			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
213			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
214		}
215		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
216		var observationErr error
217		for _, candidate := range candidates {
218			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
219				continue
220			}
221			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
222			if seen[key] {
223				continue
224			}
225			seen[key] = true
226			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
227				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
228			}
229			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
230				return true, nil
231			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
232				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
233					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
234			}
235		}
236		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
237			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
238		}
239		return false, observationErr
240	}
241	
242	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
243		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
244		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
245	}
246	
247	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
248		if current == nil {
249			return next
250		}
251		if next == nil {
252			return current
253		}
254		return errors.Join(current, next)
```

```text
+	KnownEmpty       bool
+	Intents          []IntentReadiness
+	ObservationError error
+}
+
+// Ready applies only the existing artifact finalization contract: an exact
+// checkout is ready when it has no intents, or every intent was explicitly
+// discarded or has a finalized receipt that is still reachable. Missing or
+// incomplete evidence fails closed.
+func (i ReadinessInspection) Ready() bool {
+	if i.ObservationError != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if len(i.Intents) == 0 {
+		return i.KnownEmpty
+	}
+	if i.KnownEmpty {
+		return false
+	}
+	for _, intent := range i.Intents {
+		if intent.ObservationError != nil {
+			return false
+		}
+		switch intent.State {
+		case ReadinessDiscarded:
+			// Discard is the existing explicit operator escape hatch.
+		case ReadinessFinalizedReachable:
+			if !intent.Finalized || !intent.ReceiptReachable {
+				return false
+			}
+		default:
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+// InspectReadiness gathers artifact finalization evidence for one exact
+// checkout. It never reconciles receipts, finalizes intents, or writes either
+// source files or intent records. The returned inspection retains partial
+// evidence and the same wrapped error returned separately to ordinary callers.
+func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
+	inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
+	if ctx == nil {
+		err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")
+		inspection.ObservationError = err
+		return inspection, err
+	}
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		inspection.ObservationError = err
+		return inspection, err
+	}
+	if store == nil {
+		err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a store")
+		inspection.ObservationError = err
+		return inspection, err
+	}
+
+	canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
+	if err != nil {
+		err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
+		inspection.ObservationError = err
+		return inspection, err
+	}
+	inspection.Checkout = canonical
+
+	intents, err := store.List()
+	if err != nil {
+		err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
+		inspection.ObservationError = err
+		return inspection, err
+	}
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		inspection.ObservationError = err
+		return inspection, err
+	}
+
+	for _, intent := range intents {
+		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+			inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
+			break
+		}
+		intentCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
+		if err != nil {
+			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, err)
+			inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
+			continue
+		}
+		if intentCheckout != canonical {
+			continue
+		}
+
+		evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
+		switch intent.Status {
+		case Armed, Finalizing:
+			evidence.State = ReadinessPending
+		case Failed:
+			evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
+		case Discarded:
+			evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
+		case Finalized:
+			evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, canonical, intent)
+			switch {
+			case err != nil:
+				err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
+				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
+				evidence.ObservationError = err
+				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
+			case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
+				evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
+			default:
+				evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
+			}
+		default:
+			// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
+			// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
+			err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
+			evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
+			evidence.ObservationError = err
+			inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
+		}
+		inspection.Intents = append(inspection.Intents, evidence)
+	}
+
+	inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
+	return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
+}
+
+func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
+	if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
+		return false, nil
+	}
+	candidates := []struct {
+		dir string
+		ref string
+	}{
+		{checkout, "HEAD"},
+		{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
+		{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
+	var observationErr error
+	for _, candidate := range candidates {
+		if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
+		if seen[key] {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[key] = true
+		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+			return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
+		}
+		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
+			return true, nil
+		} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
+			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
+				fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
+		}
+	}
+	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+		observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
+	}
+	return false, observationErr
+}
+
+func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
+	var exitErr *exec.ExitError
+	return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
+}
+
+func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
+	if current == nil {
+		return next
+	}
+	if next == nil {
+		return current
+	}
+	return errors.Join(current, next)
+}
+

 	if s.Store == nil {
 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
```

```text
56	
57	The context includes the canonical checkout, every linked worktree, Git state,
58	runtime and agent sessions, and tracked task state. With no repository argument,
59	the repository containing the current directory is used; standing in a linked
60	worktree still reports the whole repository.`,
61			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),

63				ctx := ctxOf()

67					if err != nil {
68						return err

70					r = resolved

82						CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,

100	func tasksForRepo(tasks []*task.Task, r repo.Repo) []*task.Task {

102		for _, t := range tasks {
103			if sameCleanPath(t.RepoPath, r.Path) || sameCleanPath(t.RepoPath, r.RealPath) {
104				out = append(out, t)
105			}
106		}
107		return out
108	}
109	
110	func sameCleanPath(a, b string) bool {
111		return a != "" && b != "" && filepath.Clean(a) == filepath.Clean(b)
112	}
```

```text
39	func validateAdoptLocator(locator Locator) error {

43		case locator.TaskRevision != "":
44			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged adoption must not carry a task revision", ErrInvalidRequest)
45		case locator.RepoPath == "":

47		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":

49		case locator.CheckoutPath == "":

51		case locator.Branch == "":
52			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact named branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
53		case locator.HeadOID == "":

55		case strings.TrimSpace(locator.Branch) != locator.Branch || strings.ContainsRune(locator.Branch, '\x00'):
56			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact branch is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest)
57		case locator.Mode != "" && locator.Mode != task.ModeWorktree:
58			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged linked-checkout mode must be empty or %q", ErrInvalidRequest, task.ModeWorktree)

63	func (s *lifecycleService) planAdopt(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
64		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
65			return PlanSpec{}, err
66		}
67		if err := validateAdoptLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
68			return PlanSpec{}, err
69		}
70		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
71		if err != nil {
72			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
73		}
74	
75		var spec PlanSpec
76		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
77			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
78				var observeErr error
79				spec, _, observeErr = s.observeAdopt(ctx, request, tx.ListRecords)
80				return observeErr
81			})
82		})
83		return spec, err
84	}

139	func appendAdoptIDClaim(observed *destructiveObservation, taskID string) {
140		if observed == nil || taskID == "" {
141			return
142		}
143		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
144			if record.Task.ID != taskID {
145				continue
146			}
147			for index := range observed.taskClaims {
148				if observed.taskClaims[index].ID == taskID {
149					if !strings.Contains(observed.taskClaims[index].Reason, "derived task ID") {
150						observed.taskClaims[index].Reason += " and derived task ID"
151					}
152					sortAdoptClaims(observed.taskClaims)
153					return
154				}
155			}
156			observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
157				ID: taskID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "derived task ID",
158			})
159			sortAdoptClaims(observed.taskClaims)
160			return
161		}
162	}
163	
164	func sortAdoptClaims(claims []destructiveTaskClaim) {
165		sort.Slice(claims, func(i, j int) bool {
166			if claims[i].ID != claims[j].ID {
167				return claims[i].ID < claims[j].ID
168			}
169			return claims[i].Reason < claims[j].Reason
170		})
171	}

173	func deriveAdoptState(observed adoptObservation) (task.State, string, string, string) {
174		rt := observed.runtime
175		switch {
176		case observed.runtimeErr != nil:
177			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend resolution failed; adoption remains WARM"
178		case rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "":
179			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
180		case rt.Name() == "none":
181			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime none leaves session and recognized-agent evidence unobserved; adoption remains WARM"
182		case !observed.runtimeAvailable:
183			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
184		case !observed.worktreeFound:
185			return task.Warm, "", "", "exact checkout is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
186		case adoptStrictOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) != nil:
187			return task.Warm, "", "", "strict runtime occupancy is not ready; adoption remains WARM"
188		case !observed.occupancy.SessionList.Observed():
189			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime sessions were not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
190		case !observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed():
191			return task.Warm, "", "", "recognized-agent activity was not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
192		case len(observed.occupancy.Sessions) != 1:
193			return task.Warm, "", "", fmt.Sprintf("fresh runtime coverage contains %d sessions, not exactly one; adoption remains WARM", len(observed.occupancy.Sessions))
194		case len(observed.occupancy.Agents) != 0:
195			return task.Warm, "", "", "a recognized agent occupies the checkout; adoption remains WARM"
196		}
197	
198		session := observed.occupancy.Sessions[0]
199		handle := session.Runtime.Handle
200		if strings.TrimSpace(handle) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(handle) != handle || strings.ContainsRune(handle, '\x00') {
201			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session has no stable nonempty handle; adoption remains WARM"
202		}
203		if !adoptSessionShellOnly(session) {
204			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session is not shell-only; adoption remains WARM"
205		}
206		return task.Hot, rt.Name(), handle, "exactly one freshly observed shell-only runtime session covers the checkout with stable handle " + handle
207	}
208	
209	func adoptStrictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
210		if occupancyErr := strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err); occupancyErr != nil {
211			return occupancyErr
212		}
213		var blockers []string
214		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
215			// OccupancySession.Panes contains only panes whose live cwd covers the
216			// checkout. A mixed session may also host an unrelated agent elsewhere;
217			// that agent is not a writer claim on this checkout.
218			for _, pane := range session.Panes {
219				if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) == "" && strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) == "" {
220					continue
221				}
222				if occupancy.CallerPaneID != "" && pane.ID == occupancy.CallerPaneID {
223					continue
224				}
225				status := strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus)
226				if status == "" {
227					status = "unknown"
228				}
229				blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent pane %s (%s)", pane.ID, status))
230			}
231		}
232		if len(blockers) > 0 {
233			return fmt.Errorf("checkout is occupied by %s", strings.Join(blockers, ", "))
234		}
235		return nil
236	}
237	
238	func adoptSessionShellOnly(session runtime.OccupancySession) bool {
239		if strings.TrimSpace(session.Runtime.AgentStatus) != "" || len(session.Runtime.AgentSessions) != 0 {
240			return false
241		}
242		panes := session.Runtime.Panes
243		if len(panes) == 0 {
244			panes = session.Panes
245		}
246		for _, pane := range panes {
247			if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) != "" {
248				return false
249			}
250		}
251		return true
252	}

329	func adoptIdentityConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
330		if !observed.worktreeFound {
331			verdict := VerdictBlocked
332			evidence := "the exact checkout is not registered"
333			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !errors.Is(observed.worktreeErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
334				verdict = VerdictError
335				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
336			}
337			return []Condition{
338				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "refresh exact worktree topology"),
339				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout identity is unavailable", "refresh exact worktree topology"),
340				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unavailable", "select a registered linked checkout"),
341				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree flags are unavailable", "refresh exact worktree topology"),
342				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "branch identity is unavailable", "select a named non-detached checkout"),
343				condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "local branch ref is unavailable", "restore the exact local branch"),
344				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git status is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
345				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git operation state is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
346				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory, "checkout bytes were not inspected", "refresh the exact checkout"),
347				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "harness ownership is unavailable", "refresh the exact checkout path"),
348			}
349		}
350	
351		exactVerdict := VerdictMet
352		exactEvidence := "selected path, repository, Git common directory, registry HEAD, and live HEAD are exact"
353		switch {
354		case observed.worktreesErr != nil:
355			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.worktreesErr.Error()
356		case observed.worktree.Path != observed.checkout:
357			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered path differs from selected checkout"
358		case observed.worktree.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir:
359			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered repository identity differs from selected repository"
360		case observed.headErr != nil:
361			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
362		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head:
363			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
364		case observed.locator.HeadOID != observed.head:
365			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("selected HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
366		}
367	
368		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
369		kindEvidence := "registered non-main, non-bare linked worktree"
370		if !observed.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree() {
371			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
372			kindEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("main=%t bare=%t; canonical and bare records are never adoptable", observed.worktree.Worktree.Main, observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare)
373		}
374	
375		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
376		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and non-prunable"
377		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked || observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable {
378			flagVerdict = VerdictBlocked
379			flagEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("locked=%t prunable=%t", observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked, observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable)
380		}
381	
382		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
383		branchEvidence := "registry and status identify named branch " + observed.locator.Branch
384		switch {
385		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch == "":
386			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered worktree is detached or unnamed"
387		case observed.statusErr != nil:
388			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
389		case observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.locator.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.locator.Branch:
390			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q selected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.locator.Branch)
391		}
392	
393		branchRefVerdict := VerdictMet
394		branchRefEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("local %s is exactly selected HEAD %s", observed.branchRef, observed.locator.HeadOID)
395		switch {
396		case !observed.branchExists:
397			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "exact local branch ref does not exist"
398		case observed.branchOIDErr != nil:
399			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictError, observed.branchOIDErr.Error()
400		case observed.branchOID != observed.locator.HeadOID || observed.branchOID != observed.head:
401			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("branch OID=%q selected HEAD=%q live HEAD=%q", observed.branchOID, observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
402		}
403	
404		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
405		statusEvidence := observed.status.Summary()
406		if observed.statusErr != nil {
407			statusVerdict, statusEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
408		}
409		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
410		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
411		if observed.operationErr != nil {
412			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictError, observed.operationErr.Error()
413		} else if observed.inProgress {
414			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "Git operation "+observed.operation+" is in progress"
415		}
416		cleanVerdict := VerdictMet
417		cleanEvidence := "checkout is clean; adoption writes metadata only"
418		if observed.statusErr != nil {
419			cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictUnknown, "checkout cleanliness is unavailable; required Git status already blocks adoption"
420		} else if observed.status.Dirty() {
421			cleanEvidence = observed.status.Breakdown() + "; dirty bytes are allowed and remain untouched"
422		}
423	
424		harnessVerdict := VerdictMet
425		harnessEvidence := "no strict harness path evidence"
426		if observed.isHarness {
427			harnessVerdict = VerdictBlocked
428			harnessEvidence = "checkout is strictly under harness root " + observed.harness.Root
429		}
430		return []Condition{
431			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
432			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "refresh the exact checkout locator"),
433			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "select a non-main linked checkout"),
434			condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, flagVerdict, RequirementRequired, flagEvidence, "unlock or repair the registration; pruning is never implicit"),
435			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named non-detached checkout"),
436			condition(ConditionBranchRef, branchRefVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchRefEvidence, "restore the exact local branch ref at selected HEAD"),
437			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
438			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
439			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementAdvisory, cleanEvidence, "commit later if desired; adoption never changes checkout bytes"),
440			condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, harnessVerdict, RequirementRequired, harnessEvidence, "let the harness own its checkout"),
441		}
442	}

444	func adoptBaseCondition(observed adoptObservation) Condition {
445		switch {
446		case observed.base == "":
447			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
448				"no explicit base was supplied and the repository default is unavailable", "supply an existing base ref")
449		case !observed.baseExists:
450			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
451				"base ref "+observed.base+" does not exist", "restore or select an existing base ref")
452		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
453			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
454				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair exact base-ref observation")
455		case observed.baseOID == "":
456			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
457				"base resolved to no commit", "restore the named base ref")
458		default:
459			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
460				fmt.Sprintf("base %s is exactly %s", observed.base, observed.baseOID), "")
461		}
462	}

464	func adoptTaskInventoryConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {

471		case len(observed.taskIncomplete) > 0:

553	func (s *lifecycleService) applyAdopt(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
554		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
555			return Result{}, err
556		}
557		if approved.Action != Adopt {
558			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "adopt handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
559		}
560		if err := validateAdoptLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
561			return Result{}, err
562		}
563		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
564		if err != nil {
565			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
566		}
567	
568		var result Result
569		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
570			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
571				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeAdopt(ctx, approved.Request, tx.ListRecords)
572				if observeErr != nil {
573					return observeErr
574				}
575				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
576				if buildErr != nil {
577					return buildErr
578				}
579				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
580					return &StalePlanError{
581						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
582						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
583						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
584						Reason:                       "fresh unmanaged Git, worktree, task, base, runtime, agent, or harness authority differs",
585					}
586				}
587				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
588					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
589					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh adoption conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
590				}
591				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx}
592				result, observeErr = execution.executeAdopt(observed)
593				return observeErr
594			})
595		})
596		return result, err
597	}
598	
599	func (e *executionState) executeAdopt(observed adoptObservation) (Result, error) {
600		effects := e.plan.Effects()
601		if len(effects) != 1 || effects[0].Code != EffectCreateTask {
602			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "Adopt must contain exactly one create-task effect"})
603		}
604		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
605			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "runtime none left occupancy unobserved; the adopted task is WARM")
606		}
607	
608		effect := effects[0]
609		expected := observed.candidate
610		expected.Tags = append([]string(nil), observed.candidate.Tags...)
611		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
612			candidate := expected
613			candidate.Tags = append([]string(nil), expected.Tags...)
614			created, createErr := e.service.taskCreate(e.tx, &candidate)
615			if createErr != nil {
616				return "task create made no authorized non-task change", fmt.Errorf("create adopted task %s: %w", expected.ID, createErr)
617			}
618			if created == nil || created.Revision == "" {
619				return "task create returned no revision", errors.New("create adopted task returned no revision")
620			}
621			if adoptTaskAuthority(created.Task) != adoptTaskAuthority(expected) {
622				return "task create returned different metadata", errors.New("created task does not match the approved adoption metadata")
623			}
624			persisted, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(expected.ID)
625			if verifyErr != nil {
626				return "task create was not verified", fmt.Errorf("verify created adopted task %s: %w", expected.ID, verifyErr)
627			}
628			if persisted.Revision != created.Revision || adoptTaskAuthority(persisted.Task) != adoptTaskAuthority(expected) {
629				return "task create revision or metadata was not verified", errors.New("persisted adopted task differs from the task create result")
630			}
631			e.snapshot = "task:" + persisted.Revision
632			e.milestone = MilestoneAdopted
633			return "created task " + persisted.Task.ID + " at revision " + persisted.Revision, nil
634		})
635		if err != nil {
636			return e.fail(err, "the checkout, branch, runtime, and Git bytes were not changed; repair the task-store failure and refresh adoption")
637		}
638		if e.milestone != MilestoneAdopted || e.snapshot == "" {
639			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "adoption ended without a created task revision"})
640		}
641		return e.result(), nil
642	}
```

```text
366	+func parseAzureReviewCandidates(out string) ([]reviewCandidate, error) {
367	+	var raw []struct {
368	+		PullRequestID       *int   `json:"pullRequestId"`
369	+		Status              string `json:"status"`
370	+		IsDraft             *bool  `json:"isDraft"`
371	+		SourceRefName       string `json:"sourceRefName"`
372	+		TargetRefName       string `json:"targetRefName"`
373	+		RemoteURL           string `json:"remoteUrl"`
374	+		RepositoryRemoteURL string `json:"repositoryRemoteUrl"`
375	+	}
376	+	if err := decodeReviewJSON(AzureDevOps, out, &raw); err != nil {
377	+		return nil, err
378	+	}
379	+	candidates := make([]reviewCandidate, 0, len(raw))
380	+	for _, item := range raw {
381	+		id, number := "", 0
382	+		if item.PullRequestID != nil {
383	+			number = *item.PullRequestID
384	+			id = strconv.Itoa(number)
385	+		}
386	+		reviewURL := item.RemoteURL
387	+		if !validReviewURL(reviewURL) && item.RepositoryRemoteURL != "" && number > 0 {
388	+			if _, repositoryURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(item.RepositoryRemoteURL); ok {
389	+				reviewURL = strings.TrimRight(repositoryURL, "/") + "/pullrequest/" + strconv.Itoa(number)
390	+			}
391	+		}
392	+		candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
393	+			ID: id, Number: number, State: item.Status, Draft: item.IsDraft,
394	+			URL: reviewURL, Head: azureReviewBranch(item.SourceRefName), Base: azureReviewBranch(item.TargetRefName),
395	+		})
396	+	}
397	+	return candidates, nil
398	+}

400	+func azureReviewBranch(ref string) string {
401	+	return strings.TrimPrefix(ref, "refs/heads/")

404	+func normalizeAzureReviewState(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error) {

413	+	case "abandoned":
414	+		return ReviewClosed, nil
415	+	default:
416	+		return "", errors.New("unrecognized Azure DevOps review state")
417	+	}
418	+}

543	+// QueryReview manually observes an exact GitLab merge request relationship.
544	+func (g *glab) QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
545	+	if !g.Available() {
546	+		return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitLab, Bin: "glab"}
547	+	}
548	+	if err := validateReviewQuery(query); err != nil {
549	+		return nil, err
550	+	}
551	+
552	+	const pageSize = 100
553	+	var candidates []reviewCandidate
554	+	for page := 1; ; page++ {
555	+		out, err := reviewRunner(ctx, "glab", dir,
556	+			"mr", "list", "--repo", query.Repository,
557	+			"--source-branch", query.Head, "--target-branch", query.Base,
558	+			"--all", "--output", "json", "--per-page", strconv.Itoa(pageSize),
559	+			"--page", strconv.Itoa(page))
560	+		if err != nil {
561	+			return nil, err
562	+		}
563	+		pageCandidates, err := parseGitLabReviewCandidates(out)
564	+		if err != nil {
565	+			return nil, err
566	+		}
567	+		candidates = append(candidates, pageCandidates...)
568	+		if len(pageCandidates) < pageSize {
569	+			break
570	+		}
571	+	}
572	+	return selectExactReview(GitLab, query, candidates, normalizeGitLabReviewState)
573	+}

575	+func parseGitLabReviewCandidates(out string) ([]reviewCandidate, error) {
576	+	var raw []struct {
577	+		ID             *int   `json:"id"`
578	+		IID            *int   `json:"iid"`
579	+		State          string `json:"state"`
580	+		Draft          *bool  `json:"draft"`
581	+		WorkInProgress *bool  `json:"work_in_progress"`
582	+		WebURL         string `json:"web_url"`
583	+		SourceBranch   string `json:"source_branch"`
584	+		TargetBranch   string `json:"target_branch"`
585	+	}
586	+	if err := decodeReviewJSON(GitLab, out, &raw); err != nil {
587	+		return nil, err
588	+	}
589	+	candidates := make([]reviewCandidate, 0, len(raw))
590	+	for _, item := range raw {
591	+		id := ""
592	+		if item.ID != nil {
593	+			id = strconv.Itoa(*item.ID)
594	+		}
595	+		number := 0
596	+		if item.IID != nil {
597	+			number = *item.IID
598	+		}
599	+		draft := item.Draft
600	+		if draft == nil {
601	+			draft = item.WorkInProgress
602	+		} else if item.WorkInProgress != nil && *draft != *item.WorkInProgress {
603	+			draft = nil
604	+		}
605	+		candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
606	+			ID: id, Number: number, State: item.State, Draft: draft,
607	+			URL: item.WebURL, Head: item.SourceBranch, Base: item.TargetBranch,
608	+		})
609	+	}
610	+	return candidates, nil
611	+}

657	+// RegisteredWorktree is an identity snapshot from Git's worktree registry.
658	+// Worktree preserves the complete parsed Git record; the other fields are canonical
659	+// filesystem identities suitable for exact comparison across symlink and macOS
660	+// path aliases. A snapshot proves registration, not permission to remove it.
661	+type RegisteredWorktree struct {
662	+	Worktree       Worktree
663	+	RepositoryPath string
664	+	GitCommonDir   string
665	+	Path           string
666	+}
667	+
668	+// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether the record is a linked checkout rather than
669	+// Git's main checkout or a bare repository. It is classification, not a removal
670	+// safety decision.
671	+func (w RegisteredWorktree) IsLinkedWorktree() bool {
672	+	return !w.Worktree.Main && !w.Worktree.Bare
673	+}
674	+
675	+// ResolveRegisteredWorktree resolves exactPath against a fresh authoritative
676	+// `git worktree list --porcelain` query for the repository containing repoPath.
677	+// Matching is exclusively by canonical filesystem identity, never by branch.
678	+// It performs no prune, removal, or other mutation.
679	+func ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx context.Context, repoPath, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
680	+	worktrees, err := Worktrees(ctx, repoPath)
681	+	if err != nil {
682	+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("query registered worktrees: %w", err)
683	+	}
684	+	commonDir, err := run(ctx, repoPath, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir")
685	+	if err != nil {
686	+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve Git common directory: %w", err)
687	+	}
688	+	return resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees, commonDir, exactPath)
689	+}

691	+func resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees []Worktree, commonDir, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
692	+	path, err := pathx.Canonical(exactPath)
693	+	if err != nil {
694	+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize requested worktree %q: %w", exactPath, err)
695	+	}
696	+	canonicalCommonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
697	+	if err != nil {
698	+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory %q: %w", commonDir, err)
699	+	}
700	+
701	+	type match struct {
702	+		worktree Worktree
703	+		path     string
704	+	}
705	+	var (
706	+		repositoryPath string
707	+		matches        []match
708	+	)
709	+	for _, worktree := range worktrees {
710	+		canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
711	+		if canonicalErr != nil {
712	+			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize registered worktree %q: %w", worktree.Path, canonicalErr)
713	+		}
714	+		if worktree.Main {
715	+			repositoryPath = canonicalPath
716	+		}
717	+		if sameCanonicalPath(path, canonicalPath) {
718	+			matches = append(matches, match{worktree: worktree, path: canonicalPath})
719	+		}
720	+	}
721	+
722	+	switch len(matches) {
723	+	case 0:
724	+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrWorktreeNotFound, path)
725	+	case 1:
726	+		if repositoryPath == "" {
727	+			return RegisteredWorktree{}, errors.New("registered worktree query has no main repository record")
728	+		}
729	+		return RegisteredWorktree{
730	+			Worktree:       matches[0].worktree,
731	+			RepositoryPath: repositoryPath,
732	+			GitCommonDir:   canonicalCommonDir,
733	+			Path:           matches[0].path,
734	+		}, nil
735	+	default:
736	+		return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s resolves to %d records", ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, path, len(matches))
737	+	}
738	+}
739	+
740	+func sameCanonicalPath(left, right string) bool {
741	+	if left == right {
742	+		return true
743	+	}
744	+	leftInfo, leftErr := os.Stat(left)
745	+	rightInfo, rightErr := os.Stat(right)
746	+	return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && os.SameFile(leftInfo, rightInfo)
747	+}
```

```text
779	+func sortedUniqueTasks(tasks []*task.Task) []*task.Task {
780	+	ordered := append([]*task.Task(nil), tasks...)
781	+	sort.SliceStable(ordered, func(i, j int) bool {
782	+		if ordered[i] == nil {
783	+			return false
784	+		}
785	+		if ordered[j] == nil {
786	+			return true
787	+		}
788	+		return ordered[i].ID < ordered[j].ID
789	+	})
790	+	seen := map[string]bool{}
791	+	out := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(ordered))
792	+	for _, tracked := range ordered {
793	+		if tracked == nil {
794	+			continue
795	+		}
796	+		if tracked.ID != "" && seen[tracked.ID] {
797	+			continue
798	+		}
799	+		if tracked.ID != "" {
800	+			seen[tracked.ID] = true
801	+		}
802	+		out = append(out, tracked)
803	+	}
804	+	return out
805	+}

807	+func movedPathReason(tracked *task.Task, checkout RepoCheckout) TopologyReason {
808	+	if tracked.WorktreePath == "" {

810	+			Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
811	+			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no recorded worktree path; branch %s is registered at %s",
812	+				tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
813	+		}
814	+	}
815	+	return TopologyReason{
816	+		Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
817	+		Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s records %s; branch %s is registered at %s",
818	+			tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
819	+	}

822	+func annotateBoundTask(binding TaskBinding, checkout RepoCheckout) TaskBinding {

829	+			Code: ReasonCheckoutUnavailable,
830	+			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout %s is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable",
831	+				checkout.Worktree.Path),
832	+		})
833	+	}
834	+	if checkout.Branch() != tracked.Branch {
835	+		binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
836	+			Code: ReasonBranchMismatch,
837	+			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s; registered checkout is on %s",
838	+				tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, displayBranch(checkout)),
839	+		})
840	+	}
841	+	mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
842	+	switch {
843	+	case mode == task.ModeWorktree && checkout.Worktree.Main:
844	+		binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
845	+			Code:   ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
846	+			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("worktree task %s resolved to Git main", tracked.ID),
847	+		})
848	+	case mode != task.ModeWorktree && !checkout.Worktree.Main:
849	+		binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
850	+			Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
851	+			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s resolved to linked worktree %s",
852	+				mode, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
853	+		})
854	+	}
855	+	if mode != task.ModeWorktree && tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
856	+		binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{

858	+			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
859	+				mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
860	+		})
861	+	}
862	+	if !taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
863	+		binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{

872	+func taskExpectsCheckout(tracked *task.Task) bool {

877	+		return tracked.WorktreePath != ""

879	+	return true
```

```text
65	// Store is a directory of one-TOML-file-per-task.
66	//
67	// One file per task, rather than a single registry document, is a deliberate
68	// choice: the state directory is meant to be syncable across machines (it can
69	// simply be a git repo), and a shared central file would conflict on every
70	// parallel edit while separate files merge cleanly.

75	// conditional write without another dev process changing task intent between
76	// those steps.

84	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
85	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
86		clean := func(s string) string {
87			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
88			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
89				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
90			}
91			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
92		}
93		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
94		if r == "" {
95			r = "repo"
96		}
97		if b == "" {
98			b = "branch"
99		}
100		return r + "__" + b
101	}

154	// List loads every task, sorted by state (hot first) then most recent. Corrupt
155	// records retain the historical warning behavior; ListRecords exposes them as
156	// typed diagnostics to callers that need to aggregate or retain the failures.
157	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Task, error) {

178	// listRecordsUnlocked implements both the public read-only inventory and the
179	// transaction-scoped inventory. Callers using it for mutation authority must
180	// hold the store lock through the guarded operation.
181	func (s *Store) listRecordsUnlocked() ([]Record, []Diagnostic, error) {
182		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
183		if err != nil {
184			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
185				return nil, nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
186			}
187			return nil, nil, err
188		}
189		var records []Record
190		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
191		for _, entry := range entries {
192			name := entry.Name()
193			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
194				continue
195			}
196			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
197			record, err := s.getRecordUnlocked(id)
198			if err != nil {
199				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
200					ID: id, Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err,
201				})
202				continue
203			}
204			records = append(records, *record)
205		}
206		sortRecords(records)
207		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
208		return records, diagnostics, nil
209	}

260	// Create writes a task only when its derived ID is not already present.
261	func (tx *Tx) Create(t *Task) (*Record, error) {
262		if t == nil {
263			return nil, errors.New("create nil task")
264		}
265		candidate := cloneTask(*t)
266		if candidate.ID == "" {
267			candidate.ID = MakeID(candidate.Repo, candidate.Branch)
268		}
269		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
270			return nil, err
271		}
272		if _, err := os.Lstat(tx.store.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
273			return nil, fmt.Errorf("task %q: %w", candidate.ID, ErrAlreadyExists)
274		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
275			return nil, fmt.Errorf("check task %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
276		}
277		record, err := tx.store.saveUnlocked(&candidate)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, err
280		}
281		*t = cloneTask(candidate)
282		return record, nil
283	}

285	// Update replaces a task only when the expected revision is still current.
286	func (tx *Tx) Update(t *Task, expectedRevision string) (*Record, error) {
287		if t == nil {
288			return nil, errors.New("update nil task")
289		}
290		candidate := cloneTask(*t)
291		if candidate.ID == "" {
292			candidate.ID = MakeID(candidate.Repo, candidate.Branch)
293		}
294		current, err := tx.store.getRecordUnlocked(candidate.ID)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		if current.Revision != expectedRevision {
299			return nil, &StaleRevisionError{
300				ID: candidate.ID, Expected: expectedRevision, Actual: current.Revision,
301			}
302		}
303		record, err := tx.store.saveUnlocked(&candidate)
304		if err != nil {
305			return nil, err
306		}
307		*t = cloneTask(candidate)
308		return record, nil
309	}

311	// Delete removes a task unconditionally inside a compatibility transaction.
312	func (tx *Tx) Delete(id string) error {

314	}

316	// DeleteIfRevision removes a task only while its revision remains current.
317	func (tx *Tx) DeleteIfRevision(id, expectedRevision string) error {
318		current, err := tx.store.getRecordUnlocked(id)
319		if err != nil {
320			return err
321		}
322		if current.Revision != expectedRevision {
323			return &StaleRevisionError{ID: id, Expected: expectedRevision, Actual: current.Revision}
324		}

328	// saveUnlocked atomically persists t. The caller must hold the store lock.
329	func (s *Store) saveUnlocked(t *Task) (*Record, error) {
330		if t.ID == "" {
331			t.ID = MakeID(t.Repo, t.Branch)
332		}
333		if err := t.Validate(); err != nil {
334			return nil, err
335		}
336		now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
337		if t.Created.IsZero() {
338			t.Created = now
339		}
340		t.Updated = now
341	
342		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
343			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create state dir: %w", err)
344		}
345		var encoded bytes.Buffer
346		if err := toml.NewEncoder(&encoded).Encode(t); err != nil {
347			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
348		}
349		data := encoded.Bytes()
350	
351		// Write to a temp file and rename, so an interrupted write can never leave
352		// a half-parsed task behind.
353		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+t.ID+".*.tmp")
354		if err != nil {
355			return nil, err
356		}
357		defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
358		if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
359			_ = tmp.Close()
360			return nil, fmt.Errorf("write task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
361		}
362		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
363			return nil, err
364		}
365		if err := os.Chmod(tmp.Name(), 0o644); err != nil {
366			return nil, err
367		}
368		if err := os.Rename(tmp.Name(), s.path(t.ID)); err != nil {
369			return nil, err
370		}
371		return &Record{Task: cloneTask(*t), Revision: revisionFor(t.ID, data)}, nil
372	}
373	
374	// getRecordUnlocked reads a complete record without taking the mutation lock.
375	// Atomic rename makes concurrent reads see either the previous or next bytes.
376	func (s *Store) getRecordUnlocked(id string) (*Record, error) {
377		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
378		if err != nil {
379			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
380				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
381			}
382			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
383		}
384		var t Task
385		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &t); err != nil {
386			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
387		}
388		t.ID = id
389		return &Record{Task: t, Revision: revisionFor(id, data)}, nil
390	}
391	
392	// deleteUnlocked removes one record. The caller must hold the store lock.
393	func (s *Store) deleteUnlocked(id string) error {
394		err := os.Remove(s.path(id))
395		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
396			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
397		}
398		return err
399	}

401	// revisionFor hashes the task ID, a NUL domain separator, and the exact bytes
402	// persisted in the task file. A byte-for-byte rewrite keeps the revision;
403	// any byte or filename-ID change produces a different optimistic token.
404	func revisionFor(id string, data []byte) string {
405		payload := make([]byte, 0, len(id)+1+len(data))
406		payload = append(payload, id...)
407		payload = append(payload, 0)
408		payload = append(payload, data...)
409		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(payload))
410	}
411	
412	func cloneTask(t Task) Task {
413		t.Tags = append([]string(nil), t.Tags...)
414		return t
415	}
416	
417	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
418	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
419	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather
420	// than a silent pick.
421	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
422		if ref == "" {
423			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty task reference: %w", ErrNotFound)
424		}
425		all, err := s.List()
426		if err != nil {
427			return nil, err
428		}
429		for _, t := range all {
430			if t.ID == ref || t.Branch == ref {
431				return t, nil
432			}
433		}
434		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
435		var hits []*Task
436		for _, t := range all {
437			hay := strings.ToLower(t.ID + " " + t.Name + " " + t.Branch + " " + t.Repo)
438			if strings.Contains(hay, needle) {
439				hits = append(hits, t)
440			}
441		}
442		switch len(hits) {
443		case 1:
444			return hits[0], nil
445		case 0:
446			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", ref, ErrNotFound)
447		default:
448			names := make([]string, len(hits))
449			for i, t := range hits {
450				names[i] = t.ID
451			}
452			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))
453		}
454	}

456	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
457	//
458	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
459	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
460	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
461	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
462	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
463	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
464		all, err := s.List()
465		if err != nil {
466			return nil, err
467		}
468		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
469			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
470		}
471		var best *Task
472		var bestLen int
473		for _, t := range all {
474			root := t.WorktreePath
475			if root == "" {
476				root = t.RepoPath
477			}
478			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
479				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
480			}
481		}
482		if best == nil {
483			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
484		}
485		return best, nil
486	}

488	// stateRank orders states so the inventory reads as an attention queue.
489	func stateRank(s State) int {
490		switch s {
491		case Hot:
492			return 0
493		case Warm:
494			return 1
495		case Cold:
496			return 2
497		case Done:
498			return 3
499		}
500		return 4
501	}

503	// Sort orders tasks hot-first, then by most recently updated.
504	func Sort(ts []*Task) {
505		sort.SliceStable(ts, func(i, j int) bool {
506			return taskLess(*ts[i], *ts[j])
507		})
508	}
509	
510	func sortRecords(records []Record) {
511		sort.SliceStable(records, func(i, j int) bool {
512			return taskLess(records[i].Task, records[j].Task)
513		})
514	}
515	
516	func taskLess(left, right Task) bool {
517		rl, rr := stateRank(left.State), stateRank(right.State)
518		if rl != rr {
519			return rl < rr
520		}
521		if !left.Updated.Equal(right.Updated) {
522			return left.Updated.After(right.Updated)
523		}
524		return left.ID < right.ID
525	}
526
```

```text
2060	+func sweepPlanBlocker(plan flow.Plan, err error) string {
2061	+	if err != nil {

2063	+	}
2064	+	var parts []string

2066	+		parts = append(parts, string(condition.Code)+": "+condition.Evidence)
2067	+	}
2068	+	if len(parts) == 0 {
2069	+		return "guarded plan is " + string(plan.Availability)
2070	+	}
2071	+	return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
2072	+}
```

```text
162		model.loadRequest = requestState{generation: 1, repoKey: preselected.RepoKey, loading: true}
163		return model
164	}

166	// NewPicker constructs a model which discovers repositories asynchronously.
167	func NewPicker(actions Actions) Model { return New(actions, nil) }

169	// NewRepository constructs a model focused on one exact repository key.
170	func NewRepository(actions Actions, repository RepositoryRow) Model {
171		return New(actions, &repository)
172	}

174	// WithContext bounds cancelable list/load/plan callbacks to one TUI run. Apply
175	// deliberately uses a cancellation-detached child so queued quit cannot abort a
176	// mutation whose result ledger must be retained.
177	func (m Model) WithContext(ctx context.Context) Model {
178		m.runContext = ctx
179		return m
180	}

182	func (m Model) baseContext() context.Context {
183		if m.runContext != nil {
184			return m.runContext
185		}
186		return context.Background()
187	}

189	// Init implements tea.Model without doing synchronous repository work.
190	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
191		var commands []tea.Cmd
192		switch m.screen {
193		case screenRepository:
194			if m.loadRequest.loading {
195				commands = append(commands, m.loadRepositoryCmd(m.loadRequest.generation, m.loadRequest.repoKey, m.baseContext()))
196			}
197		case screenPicker:
198			if m.listRequest.loading {
199				commands = append(commands, m.listRepositoriesCmd(m.listRequest.generation, m.baseContext()))
200			}
201		}
202		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
203			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
204		}
205		switch len(commands) {
206		case 0:
207			return nil
208		case 1:
209			return commands[0]
210		default:
211			return tea.Batch(commands...)
212		}
213	}

215	func (m Model) signalFirstView() {

217			m.firstViewOnce.Do(func() { close(m.firstViewReady) })
218		}

221	func (m Model) runAfterFirstView() tea.Cmd {
222		return func() tea.Msg {
223			select {
224			case <-m.baseContext().Done():
225				return nil
226			case <-m.firstViewReady:
227				m.actions.AfterFirstView(m.baseContext())
228				return nil
229			}
230		}

275	// Update implements tea.Model.
276	func (m Model) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
277		switch message := message.(type) {
278		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
279			m.width, m.height = message.Width, message.Height
280			return m, nil
281		case repositoryListMsg:
282			return m.acceptRepositoryList(message)
283		case repositoryLoadMsg:
284			return m.acceptRepositoryLoad(message)
285		case planMsg:
286			return m.acceptPlan(message)
287		case applyMsg:
288			return m.acceptApply(message)
289		case tea.KeyMsg:
290			if m.applyRunning {
291				return m.updateApplying(message)
292			}
293			if m.filterActive {
294				return m.updateFilter(message)
295			}
296			if m.overlay != overlayNone {
297				return m.updateOverlay(message)
298			}
299			if m.screen == screenPicker {
300				return m.updatePicker(message)
301			}
302			return m.updateRepository(message)
303		}
304		return m, nil
305	}

307	func (m Model) updatePicker(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
308		switch message.String() {
309		case "q", "ctrl+c":
310			return m.quit()
311		case "esc":
312			if m.filter.Value() != "" {
313				m.filter.SetValue("")
314				m.repoCursor = 0
315				return m, nil
316			}
317			return m.quit()
318		case "j", "down":
319			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor + 1)
320		case "k", "up":
321			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor - 1)
322		case "/":
323			m.filterActive = true
324			m.filter.CursorEnd()
325			return m, m.filter.Focus()
326		case "?":
327			m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
328			m.overlay = overlayHelp
329			return m, nil
330		case "r":
331			return m.beginRepositoryList()
332		case "enter":
333			row, ok := m.currentRepository()
334			if !ok {
335				return m, nil
336			}
337			return m.selectRepository(row)
338		}
339		return m, nil
340	}

342	func (m Model) updateFilter(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
343		switch message.String() {
344		case "ctrl+c":
345			return m.quit()
346		case "esc":
347			m.filterActive = false
348			m.filter.Blur()
349			m.filter.SetValue("")
350			m.repoCursor = 0
351			return m, nil
352		case "enter":
353			m.filterActive = false
354			m.filter.Blur()
355			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor)
356			return m, nil
357		}
358		var command tea.Cmd
359		m.filter, command = m.filter.Update(message)
360		m.repoCursor = 0
361		return m, command
362	}

364	func (m Model) updateRepository(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
365		switch message.String() {
366		case "q", "ctrl+c":
367			return m.quit()
368		case "esc":
369			m.cancelRepositoryRead()
370			m.screen = screenPicker
371			m.overlay = overlayNone
372			return m.beginRepositoryList()
373		case "j", "down":
374			m.setRowCursor(m.rowCursor + 1)
375		case "k", "up":
376			m.setRowCursor(m.rowCursor - 1)
377		case "l", "right":
378			m.moveAction(1)
379		case "h", "left":
380			m.moveAction(-1)
381		case "tab":
382			m.focus = FocusPane((int(m.focus) + 1) % 3)
383		case "shift+tab":
384			m.focus = FocusPane((int(m.focus) + 2) % 3)
385		case "?":
386			m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
387			m.overlay = overlayHelp
388		case "r":
389			return m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
390		case "R":
391			return m.openRemoteMenu()
392		case "enter":
393			choice, ok := m.currentAction()
394			if !ok {
395				return m, nil
396			}
397			return m.beginPlan(choice)
398		}
399		return m, nil
400	}

402	func (m Model) updateApplying(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {

430	func (m Model) filteredRepositories() []RepositoryRow {
431		query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m.filter.Value()))
432		terms := strings.Fields(query)
433		out := make([]RepositoryRow, 0, len(m.repositories))
434		for _, row := range m.repositories {
435			haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{row.RepoKey, row.Name, row.Path, row.Error}, " "))
436			matched := true
437			for _, term := range terms {
438				if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
439					matched = false
440					break
441				}
442			}
443			if matched {
444				out = append(out, row)
445			}
446		}
447		return out
448	}

450	func (m Model) currentRepository() (RepositoryRow, bool) {
451		rows := m.filteredRepositories()
452		if m.repoCursor < 0 || m.repoCursor >= len(rows) {
453			return RepositoryRow{}, false
454		}
455		return rows[m.repoCursor], true
456	}

459		count := len(m.filteredRepositories())
460		switch {
461		case count == 0:
462			index = 0
463		case index < 0:
464			index = 0
465		case index >= count:
466			index = count - 1
467		}
468		m.repoCursor = index
469	}

472		if !m.hasSnapshot {
473			return SurfaceRow{}, false
474		}

476		if m.rowCursor < 0 || m.rowCursor >= len(rows) {
477			return SurfaceRow{}, false

482	func (m Model) currentAction() (ActionChoice, bool) {
483		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
484		if !ok {
485			return ActionChoice{}, false
486		}
487		actions := row.Actions.Values()
488		if m.actionCursor < 0 || m.actionCursor >= len(actions) {
489			return ActionChoice{}, false
490		}
491		if !actions[m.actionCursor].Valid() {
492			return ActionChoice{}, false
493		}
494		return actions[m.actionCursor], true
495	}
496	
497	func (m *Model) setRowCursor(index int) {
498		count := 0
499		if m.hasSnapshot {
500			count = m.snapshot.Surfaces.Len()
501		}
502		switch {
503		case count == 0:
504			index = 0
505		case index < 0:
506			index = 0
507		case index >= count:
508			index = count - 1
509		}
510		if index != m.rowCursor {
511			m.rowCursor = index
512			m.actionCursor = 0
513		} else {
514			m.rowCursor = index
515		}
516		m.clampActionCursor()
517	}
518	
519	func (m *Model) clampActionCursor() {
520		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
521		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
522			m.actionCursor = 0
523			return
524		}
525		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
526			m.actionCursor = 0
527		}
528		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
529			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
530		}
531	}
532	
533	func (m *Model) moveAction(delta int) {
534		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
535		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
536			m.actionCursor = 0
537			return
538		}
539		m.actionCursor += delta
540		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
541			m.actionCursor = 0
542		}
543		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
544			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
545		}
546		m.focus = FocusActions
547	}
548	
549	func (m Model) selectRepository(row RepositoryRow) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
550		m.cancelRepositoryListRead()
551		m.screen = screenRepository
552		m.repository = row
553		m.desiredFocus = row.FocusTarget
554		m.hasSnapshot = false
555		m.snapshot = Snapshot{}
556		m.remote = OptionalRemoteObservation{}
557		m.rowCursor, m.actionCursor = 0, 0
558		m.overlay = overlayNone
559		m.hasPlan, m.planErr = false, nil
560		m.hasLastResult, m.lastResultErr = false, nil
561		m.hasHandoff = false
562		return m.beginRepositoryLoad(true)
563	}

565	func combineError(label string, err error) error {
566		if err == nil {
567			return nil
568		}
569		if label == "" {
570			return err
571		}
572		return errors.New(label + ": " + err.Error())
573	}
```

```text
225	func (m Model) acceptRepositoryList(message repositoryListMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
226		if message.generation != m.listRequest.generation ||
227			message.repoKey != pickerRequestKey || m.listRequest.repoKey != pickerRequestKey {
228			return m, nil
229		}
230		if m.listRequest.cancel != nil {
231			m.listRequest.cancel()

234		m.listRequest.loading = false
235		m.listRequest.err = message.err

237		selectedKey := ""

239			selectedKey = selected.RepoKey

241		oldIndex := m.repoCursor

243			m.listRequest.stale = len(m.repositories) > 0
244			m.status = ""

246		}

249		m.listRequest.stale = false

251		m.repoCursor = nearestRepositoryIndex(m.filteredRepositories(), selectedKey, oldIndex)
252		return m, nil

255	func nearestRepositoryIndex(rows []RepositoryRow, repoKey string, oldIndex int) int {
256		if repoKey != "" {
257			for index, row := range rows {
258				if row.RepoKey == repoKey {
259					return index
260				}
261			}
262		}
263		if len(rows) == 0 {
264			return 0
265		}
266		if oldIndex < 0 {
267			return 0
268		}
269		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
270			return len(rows) - 1
271		}
272		return oldIndex
273	}

279		}
280		if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
281			m.loadRequest.cancel()
282		}
283		m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
284		m.loadRequest.loading = false
285	
286		if message.err == nil && message.snapshot.Repository.RepoKey != message.repoKey {
287			message.err = fmt.Errorf(
288				"loaded snapshot repository key %q does not match requested key %q",
289				message.snapshot.Repository.RepoKey, message.repoKey,
290			)
291		}
292		if message.err != nil {
293			m.loadRequest.err = message.err
294			m.loadRequest.stale = m.hasSnapshot
295			if m.hasSnapshot {
296				m.snapshot.Freshness = FreshnessStale
297			}
298			m.status = ""
299			return m, nil
300		}
301	
302		oldRow, hadOldRow := m.currentSurface()
303		oldIndex := m.rowCursor
304		oldActionID := ""
305		if choice, ok := m.currentAction(); ok {
306			oldActionID = choice.ID
307		}
308	
309		accepted := message.snapshot.Clone()
310		if accepted.Freshness == "" {
311			accepted.Freshness = FreshnessFresh
312		}
313		m.snapshot = accepted
314		m.hasSnapshot = true
315		m.loadRequest.err = nil
316		m.loadRequest.stale = accepted.Freshness != FreshnessFresh || accepted.Error != ""
317		m.repository = accepted.Repository
318		if remote, ok := accepted.Remote.RemoteObservation(); ok {
319			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
320		}
321	
322		rows := accepted.Surfaces.Values()
323		m.rowCursor = retainedSurfaceIndex(rows, oldRow, hadOldRow, oldIndex, m.desiredFocus)
324		m.desiredFocus = ""
325		m.actionCursor = retainedActionIndex(rows, m.rowCursor, oldActionID)
326		m.clampActionCursor()
327		m.status = ""
328		return m, nil
329	}
330	
331	func retainedSurfaceIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, previous SurfaceRow, hadPrevious bool, oldIndex int, focus string) int {
332		if len(rows) == 0 {
333			return 0
334		}
335		if hadPrevious {
336			for index, row := range rows {
337				if row.RowKey == previous.RowKey {
338					return index
339				}
340			}
341			if previous.Locator.TaskID != "" {
342				for index, row := range rows {
343					if row.Locator.TaskID == previous.Locator.TaskID {
344						return index
345					}
346				}
347			}
348			for index, row := range rows {
349				if locatorsReferToSameSurface(previous.Locator, row.Locator) {
350					return index
351				}
352			}
353		}
354		if focus != "" {
355			for index, row := range rows {
356				if row.RowKey == focus || row.Locator.RowKey == focus {
357					return index
358				}
359			}
360			for index, row := range rows {
361				if row.Locator.TaskID == focus {
362					return index
363				}
364			}
365			for index, row := range rows {
366				if row.Locator.CheckoutPath == focus {
367					return index
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		if oldIndex < 0 {
372			return 0
373		}
374		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
375			return len(rows) - 1
376		}
377		return oldIndex
378	}
379	
380	func retainedActionIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, rowIndex int, actionID string) int {
381		if actionID == "" || rowIndex < 0 || rowIndex >= len(rows) {
382			return 0
383		}
384		for index, action := range rows[rowIndex].Actions.Values() {
385			if action.ID == actionID {
386				return index
387			}
388		}
389		return 0
390	}
391	
392	func locatorsReferToSameSurface(left, right taskflow.Locator) bool {
393		if left.RepositoryID != "" && right.RepositoryID != "" && left.RepositoryID != right.RepositoryID {
394			return false
395		}
396		if left.CheckoutPath != "" && right.CheckoutPath != "" {
397			return left.CheckoutPath == right.CheckoutPath
398		}
399		if left.TaskID != "" && right.TaskID != "" {
400			return left.TaskID == right.TaskID
401		}
402		return left.RepoKey != "" && left.RepoKey == right.RepoKey &&
403			left.Branch != "" && left.Branch == right.Branch && left.Base == right.Base
404	}
405	
406	func (m Model) acceptPlan(message planMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
407		if message.generation != m.planRequest.generation ||
408			message.repoKey != m.planRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey ||
409			message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey || message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
410			return m, nil
411		}
412		if m.planRequest.cancel != nil {
413			m.planRequest.cancel()
414		}
415		m.planRequest.cancel = nil
416		m.planRequest.loading = false
417		m.planRequest.err = message.err
418		m.overlay = overlayPlan
419		m.status = ""
420	
421		if message.plan.PlanID != "" {
422			m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
423			m.hasPlan = true
424		}
425		if message.err != nil {
426			m.planErr = message.err
427			return m, nil
428		}
429		if err := message.plan.Validate(); err != nil {
430			m.planErr = combineError("invalid plan returned by callback", err)
431			return m, nil
432		}
433		if message.plan.Locator != m.planTarget.locator {
434			m.planErr = errors.New("plan locator does not match the exact selected surface")
435			return m, nil
436		}
437		if message.plan.Action != m.planTarget.choice.Action() {
438			m.planErr = errors.New("plan action does not match the exact selected action options")
439			return m, nil
440		}
441		expected, err := taskflow.NewRequest(m.planTarget.locator, m.planTarget.choice.Options())
442		if err != nil {
443			m.planErr = combineError("selected action options are invalid", err)
444			return m, nil
445		}
446		if !reflect.DeepEqual(message.plan.Request.Options, expected.Options) {
447			m.planErr = errors.New("plan was built with different concrete action options than the selected choice")
448			return m, nil
449		}
450		m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
451		m.hasPlan = true
452		m.planErr = nil
453		if m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady && m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
454			m.confirm.SetValue("")
455			m.confirm.CursorEnd()
456			return m, m.confirm.Focus()
457		}
458		return m, nil
459	}
460	
461	func (m Model) acceptApply(message applyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
462		if !m.applyRunning || message.generation != m.applyGeneration ||
463			message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey || message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey ||
464			message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
465			return m, nil
466		}
467		m.applyRunning = false
468		m.overlay = overlayResult
469		m.lastResult = message.result.Clone()
470		m.hasLastResult = true
471		m.lastResultErr = message.err
472		m.status = ""
473		if remote, ok := message.result.RemoteObservation(); ok {
474			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
475		}
476		if message.err == nil {
477			if handoff, ok := message.result.Handoff(); ok {
478				m.finalHandoff = handoff
479				m.hasHandoff = true
480			}
481		}
482	
483		queuedQuit := m.queuedQuit
484		m.queuedQuit, m.queuedRefresh = false, false
485		updated, command := m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
486		m = updated.(Model)
487		if queuedQuit {
488			// The fresh generation is established before honoring the queued quit. It
489			// cannot authorize anything and the mutation ledger remains in final Model.
490			if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
491				m.loadRequest.cancel()
492				m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
493			}
494			m.quitting = true
495			return m, tea.Quit
496		}
497		return m, command
498	}
```

```text
10	func (m Model) openRemoteMenu() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
11		if m.loadRequest.loading {
12			m.status = "wait for the current local reload before planning remote work"
13			return m, nil
14		}
15		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
16		if !ok {
17			return m, nil
18		}
19		choices := make([]ActionChoice, 0, row.Actions.Len())
20		for _, choice := range row.Actions.Values() {
21			if choice.Valid() && choice.Action() == taskflow.RefreshRemote {
22				choices = append(choices, choice)
23			}
24		}
25		if len(choices) == 0 {
26			m.status = "no remote action choices are available for this surface"
27			return m, nil
28		}
29		m.remoteChoices = NewActionList(choices...)
30		m.remoteCursor = 0
31		m.overlay = overlayRemoteMenu
32		m.status = ""
33		return m, nil
34	}
35	
36	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
37		switch m.overlay {
38		case overlayHelp:
39			switch message.String() {
40			case "esc", "?":
41				m.overlay = m.overlayReturn
42				m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
43				return m, nil
44			case "q", "ctrl+c":
45				return m.quit()
46			}
47			return m, nil
48	
49		case overlayRemoteMenu:
50			switch message.String() {
51			case "q", "ctrl+c":
52				return m.quit()
53			case "esc", "R":
54				m.overlay = overlayNone
55				return m, nil
56			case "j", "down":
57				if m.remoteCursor+1 < m.remoteChoices.Len() {
58					m.remoteCursor++
59				}
60			case "k", "up":
61				if m.remoteCursor > 0 {
62					m.remoteCursor--
63				}
64			case "enter":
65				choices := m.remoteChoices.Values()
66				if m.remoteCursor >= 0 && m.remoteCursor < len(choices) {
67					return m.beginPlan(choices[m.remoteCursor])
68				}
69			}
70			return m, nil
71	
72		case overlayPlanLoading:
73			switch message.String() {
74			case "q", "ctrl+c":
75				m.cancelPlanRead()
76				return m.quit()
77			case "esc":
78				m.cancelPlanRead()
79				m.overlay = overlayNone
80				m.status = ""
81			}
82			return m, nil
83	
84		case overlayPlan:
85			if message.String() == "ctrl+c" {
86				return m.quit()
87			}
88			if message.String() == "esc" {
89				m.confirm.Blur()
90				m.overlay = overlayNone
91				m.status = ""
92				return m, nil
93			}
94			if !m.planCanApply() {
95				if message.String() == "q" {
96					return m.quit()

98				return m, nil

100			if m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
101				if message.String() == "enter" {

103					if token != m.plan.Confirmation.Token {
104						m.status = "confirmation token does not match exactly"
105						return m, nil
106					}
107					return m.startApply(taskflow.ApproveWithToken(m.plan.PlanID, token))
108				}

111				return m, command

113			switch message.String() {

115				return m.quit()
116			case "y", "Y":
117				return m.startApply(taskflow.Approve(m.plan.PlanID))
118			}
119			return m, nil
120

126				m.overlay = overlayNone

128				return m, nil
129			case "r":

137		}

140	
141	func (m Model) planCanApply() bool {
142		return m.hasPlan && m.planErr == nil && m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady
143	}
144	
145	func (m Model) startApply(approval taskflow.Approval) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
146		if !m.planCanApply() {
147			return m, nil
148		}
149		if err := m.plan.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
150			m.status = fmt.Sprintf("approval rejected: %v", err)
151			return m, nil
152		}
153		m.applyGeneration++
154		m.applyRunning = true
155		m.overlay = overlayApplying
156		m.status = "Apply in progress; quit and refresh will be queued"
157		m.hasHandoff = false
158		m.finalHandoff = taskflow.Handoff{}
159		m.hasLastResult = false
160		m.lastResult = taskflow.Result{}
161		m.lastResultErr = nil
162		return m, m.applyCmd(m.applyGeneration, m.planTarget, m.plan, approval)
163	}
```

```text
280	func lifecycleRail(mode task.CheckoutMode, current task.State) string {

375	func renderWidePanels(leftTitle string, left []string, middleTitle string, middle []string, rightTitle string, right []string, width int) string {
376		gutter := " | "
377		usable := width - 2*lipgloss.Width(gutter)
378		if usable < 60 {
379			usable = 60
380		}
381		leftWidth := usable * 30 / 100
382		middleWidth := usable * 36 / 100
383		rightWidth := usable - leftWidth - middleWidth
384		left = append([]string{leftTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, leftWidth))}, left...)
385		middle = append([]string{middleTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, middleWidth))}, middle...)
386		right = append([]string{rightTitle, strings.Repeat("-", max(1, rightWidth))}, right...)
387		count := max(len(left), len(middle), len(right))
388		var builder strings.Builder
389		for index := 0; index < count; index++ {
390			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(left, index), leftWidth))
391			builder.WriteString(gutter)
392			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(middle, index), middleWidth))
393			builder.WriteString(gutter)
394			builder.WriteString(fitPanelLine(lineAt(right, index), rightWidth))
395			if index+1 < count {
396				builder.WriteByte('\n')
397			}
398		}
399		return builder.String()
400	}
401	
402	func renderNarrowPanel(title string, lines []string) string {
403		return title + "\n" + strings.Repeat("-", max(1, lipgloss.Width(title))) + "\n" + strings.Join(lines, "\n")
404	}

406	func lineAt(lines []string, index int) string {

409		}

413	func fitPanelLine(value string, width int) string {
414		value = truncateDisplay(value, width)
415		missing := width - lipgloss.Width(value)
416		if missing > 0 {
417			value += strings.Repeat(" ", missing)
418		}
419		return value
420	}

583		builder.WriteString("fallback command: ")

585			builder.WriteString("(none supplied)\n")
586		} else {
587			builder.WriteString(m.plan.FallbackCommand + "\n")
588		}
589	
590		builder.WriteString("\n")
591		switch {
592		case applying:
593			builder.WriteString("APPLYING: conflicting navigation and refresh are disabled. q/r are queued.\n")
594		case !m.planCanApply():
595			builder.WriteString("NO APPLY PATH: only READY plans can be approved; this plan remains inspectable.\n")
596		case m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped:
597			prompt := m.plan.Confirmation.Prompt
598			if prompt == "" {
599				prompt = "Type the exact confirmation token"
600			}
601			builder.WriteString(prompt + "\n")
602			builder.WriteString("required exact token: " + m.plan.Confirmation.Token + "\n")
603			builder.WriteString("confirmation: " + m.confirm.View() + "\n")
604			builder.WriteString("Enter validates and applies; any mismatch remains non-mutating.\n")
605		default:
606			prompt := m.plan.Confirmation.Prompt
607			if prompt != "" {
608				builder.WriteString(prompt + "\n")
609			}
610			builder.WriteString("Press y to approve this exact PlanID. Enter never applies.\n")
611		}
612		if m.status != "" {
613			builder.WriteString("STATUS: " + m.status + "\n")
614		}
615		if !applying {
616			builder.WriteString(styleMuted.Render("Esc back | q quit"))
617		}
618		return builder.String()
619	}

621	func availabilityLabel(value taskflow.Availability) string {
622		if value == "" {
623			return "UNKNOWN"
624		}
625		return strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(string(value), "-", " "))
626	}

628	func milestoneLabel(value taskflow.Milestone) string {
629		switch value {
630		case taskflow.MilestoneReviewReady:
631			return "REVIEW"
632		case taskflow.MilestoneMerged:
633			return "MERGED"
634		case taskflow.MilestoneRetired:
```
