644	
645	func (m Model) renderResult() string {
646		var builder strings.Builder
647		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev flow  RESULT") + "\n\n")
648		builder.WriteString("choice: " + m.planTarget.actionID + " — " + m.planTarget.choice.Label + "\n")
649		if m.lastResultErr != nil {
650			builder.WriteString(styleBad.Render("APPLY ERROR: "+m.lastResultErr.Error()) + "\n")
651		} else {
652			builder.WriteString(styleGood.Render("APPLY COMPLETED") + "\n")
653		}
654		if m.lastResult.PartialSuccess {
655			builder.WriteString("PARTIAL SUCCESS: completed effects remain completed; no rollback is implied.\n")
656		}
657		if milestone := milestoneLabel(m.lastResult.Milestone); milestone != "" {
658			builder.WriteString("result milestone: " + milestone + " (not a persisted state)\n")
659		}
660	
661		builder.WriteString("\nSTEP LEDGER\n")
662		steps := m.lastResult.AttemptedSteps()
663		if len(steps) == 0 {
664			builder.WriteString("  (no effect was attempted)\n")
665		}
666		for index, step := range steps {
667			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %d. [%s] %s — %s", index+1,
668				strings.ToUpper(string(step.Status)), step.Effect.Code, step.Effect.Description))
669			if step.Detail != "" {
670				builder.WriteString(" | " + step.Detail)
671			}
672			if step.Failure != "" {
673				builder.WriteString(" | FAILURE: " + step.Failure)
674			}
675			builder.WriteString("\n")
676		}
677		builder.WriteString("\nWARNINGS\n")
678		writeStringSection(&builder, m.lastResult.Warnings())
679		builder.WriteString("RECOVERY\n")
680		writeStringSection(&builder, m.lastResult.Recovery())
681		if remote, ok := m.lastResult.RemoteObservation(); ok {
682			builder.WriteString("REMOTE OBSERVATION (run-local)\n")
683			for _, line := range remoteObservationLines(remote) {
684				builder.WriteString("  " + line + "\n")
685			}
686		}
687		if handoff, ok := m.lastResult.Handoff(); ok {
688			builder.WriteString("HANDOFF (available after alternate-screen exit)\n")
689			builder.WriteString("  " + handoffDescription(handoff) + "\n")
690		}
691		if m.loadRequest.loading {
692			builder.WriteString("\nREFRESHING: a new local generation is loading; state was not changed optimistically.\n")
693		} else if m.loadRequest.err != nil {
694			builder.WriteString("\nSTALE: post-Apply local reload failed: " + m.loadRequest.err.Error() + "\n")
695		}
696		if m.status != "" {
697			builder.WriteString("STATUS: " + m.status + "\n")
698		}
699		builder.WriteString("\n" + styleMuted.Render("Esc return to repository | r reload again | ? help | q quit"))
700		return builder.String()
701	}

703	func writeStringSection(builder *strings.Builder, values []string) {
704		if len(values) == 0 {
705			builder.WriteString("  (none)\n")
706			return
707		}
708		for _, value := range values {
709			builder.WriteString("  - " + value + "\n")
710		}
711	}
712	
713	func handoffDescription(handoff taskflow.Handoff) string {
714		parts := []string{strings.ToUpper(string(handoff.Kind))}
715		for _, value := range []string{handoff.Path, handoff.Runtime, handoff.RuntimeHandle, handoff.URL, handoff.Label} {
716			if value != "" {
717				parts = append(parts, value)
718			}
719		}
720		return strings.Join(parts, " | ")
721	}
722	
723	func remoteObservationLines(remote taskflow.RemoteObservation) []string {
724		lines := []string{"REMOTE: " + remote.RemoteName}
725		if remote.Provider != "" {
726			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE PROVIDER: "+strings.ToUpper(string(remote.Provider)))
727		}
728		if remote.Repository != "" {
729			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REPOSITORY: "+remote.Repository)
730		}
731		if remote.Head != "" || remote.Base != "" {
732			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BRANCHES: "+remote.Head+" -> "+remote.Base)
733		}
734		lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BEFORE REFS: "+refsSummary(remote.BeforeRefs))
735		if !remote.BeforeRefs.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
736			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE BEFORE OBSERVED: "+formatTime(remote.BeforeRefs.ObservedAt))
737		}
738		if remote.HasAfterRefs {
739			lines = append(lines, "REMOTE AFTER REFS: "+refsSummary(remote.AfterRefs))
740			if !remote.AfterRefs.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
741				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE AFTER OBSERVED: "+formatTime(remote.AfterRefs.ObservedAt))
742			}
743		}
744		if remote.HasReview {
745			review := remote.Review
746			switch {
747			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationError:
748				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW ERROR: "+string(review.FailureKind)+" — "+review.Failure)
749			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationKnown && !review.Exists:
750				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW: NONE (known)")
751			case review.State == taskflow.ObservationKnown:
752				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("REMOTE REVIEW: #%d %s %s", review.Number, strings.ToUpper(string(review.ReviewState)), review.URL))
753			default:
754				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW: "+strings.ToUpper(string(review.State)))
755			}
756			if !review.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
757				lines = append(lines, "REMOTE REVIEW OBSERVED: "+formatTime(review.ObservedAt))
758			}
759		}
760		return lines
761	}
762	
763	func refsSummary(refs taskflow.RemoteRefsObservation) string {
764		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
765		for _, ref := range []taskflow.NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
766			if ref.Ref == "" {
767				continue
768			}
769			switch {
770			case ref.Failure != "":
771				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"=ERROR("+ref.Failure+")")
772			case ref.Exists:
773				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"="+ref.OID)
774			default:
775				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"=ABSENT")
776			}
777		}
778		if len(parts) == 0 {
779			return "no named refs observed"
780		}
781		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
782	}
783	
784	func formatTime(value time.Time) string {
785		return value.Local().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05 MST")
786	}

55	// BuildPlan validates graph legality, derives availability, and seals a plan's
56	// deterministic authority fingerprint and PlanID.
57	func BuildPlan(request Request, spec PlanSpec) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid request", Cause: err}
61		}
62		if err := spec.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
63			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
64		}
65		conditions := append([]Condition(nil), spec.Conditions...)
66		if err := validateConditions(conditions); err != nil {
67			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
68		}
69		effects := cloneEffects(spec.Effects)
70		if err := validateEffects(effects); err != nil {
71			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
72		}
73		authority := NewFields(spec.Authority)
74		if err := validateAuthority(authority); err != nil {
75			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
76		}
77	
78		plan := Plan{
79			Request: normalized.Clone(), Locator: normalized.Locator, Action: normalized.Action,
80			Source:       normalized.Locator.State,
81			Availability: AvailabilityFor(conditions), Confirmation: spec.Confirmation,
82			FallbackCommand: spec.FallbackCommand, Summary: spec.Summary, DisplayedAt: spec.DisplayedAt,
83			authority: authority, conditions: conditions, effects: effects,
84			retained: NewStringList(spec.RetainedResources...),
85		}
86		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
87			rule, transitionErr := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
88			if transitionErr != nil {
89				return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid transition", Cause: transitionErr}
90			}
91			plan.HasPersistedTransition = true
92			plan.Target = rule.Target
93			plan.StatePreserving = rule.StatePreserving
94			plan.RemovesTask = rule.RemovesTask
95			plan.ExpectedMilestone = rule.Milestone
96		} else {
97			switch plan.Action {
98			case Adopt:
99				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
100			case Reconcile:
101				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
102			}
103		}
104		plan.AuthorityFingerprint, plan.PlanID = computePlanIdentity(plan)
105		return plan.Clone(), nil
106	}

108	// Clone returns a plan with independent request, map, and slice storage.
109	func (p Plan) Clone() Plan {
110		p.Request = p.Request.Clone()
111		p.authority = p.authority.clone()
112		p.conditions = append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...)
113		p.effects = cloneEffects(p.effects)
114		p.retained = p.retained.clone()
115		return p
116	}

123

154	// Validate proves that a plan is structurally consistent and still carries its
155	// original deterministic identity. It performs no live observations.
156	func (p Plan) Validate() error {
157		if p.PlanID == "" || p.AuthorityFingerprint == "" {
158			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan identity is missing"}
159		}
160		if !p.Action.Valid() {
161			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown action %q", p.Action)}
162		}
163		if p.Request.Action != p.Action {
164			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request action and plan action differ"}
165		}
166		if p.Request.Locator != p.Locator {
167			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request locator and plan locator differ"}
168		}
169		if p.Request.Options == nil {
170			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "normalized request options are missing"}
171		}
172		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(p.Request)
173		if err != nil {
174			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request is no longer valid", Cause: err}
175		}
176		if requestIdentity(normalized) != requestIdentity(p.Request) {
177			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request options are not normalized"}
178		}
179		if err := p.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
180			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
181		}
182		if err := validateConditions(p.conditions); err != nil {
183			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
184		}
185		if err := validateEffects(p.effects); err != nil {
186			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
187		}
188		if err := validateAuthority(p.authority); err != nil {
189			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
190		}
191		if err := validatePlanTransition(p); err != nil {
192			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "transition metadata is inconsistent", Cause: err}
193		}
194	
195		authorityFingerprint, planID := computePlanIdentity(p)
196		if authorityFingerprint != p.AuthorityFingerprint {
197			return &StalePlanError{
198				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
199				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
200				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
201				Reason:                       "authority fields, effects, or conditions changed",
202			}
203		}
204		if planID != p.PlanID {
205			return &StalePlanError{
206				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
207				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
208				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
209				Reason:                       "PlanID does not match its authority fingerprint",
210			}
211		}
212		if availability := AvailabilityFor(p.conditions); availability != p.Availability {
213			return &InvalidPlanError{
214				PlanID: p.PlanID,
215				Reason: fmt.Sprintf("availability is %s, want derived %s", p.Availability, availability),
216			}
217		}
218		return nil
219	}

221	// ValidateApproval binds affirmative approval and any typed token to this exact
222	// plan. It never changes plan readiness or condition verdicts.
223	func (p Plan) ValidateApproval(approval Approval) error {
224		if err := p.Validate(); err != nil {
225			return err
226		}
227		if !approval.Granted {
228			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "affirmative approval was not granted", Cause: ErrApprovalRequired}
229		}
230		if approval.PlanID != p.PlanID {
231			return &StalePlanError{
232				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: approval.PlanID,
233				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
234				Reason:                       "approval names a different plan",
235			}
236		}
237		if p.Confirmation.Kind == ConfirmationTyped {
238			if approval.Token != p.Confirmation.Token {
239				return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "typed confirmation token does not match", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
240			}
241		} else if approval.Token != "" {
242			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan does not accept a typed confirmation token", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
243		}
244		return nil
245	}
246	
247	func validatePlanTransition(plan Plan) error {
248		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
249			rule, err := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
250			if err != nil {
251				return err
252			}
253			if !plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Source != rule.Source || plan.Target != rule.Target ||
254				plan.StatePreserving != rule.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask != rule.RemovesTask ||
255				plan.ExpectedMilestone != rule.Milestone {
256				return fmt.Errorf("plan does not match the transition table")
257			}
258			return nil
259		}
260		expectedMilestone := MilestoneNone
261		switch plan.Action {
262		case Adopt:
263			expectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
264		case Reconcile:
265			expectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
266		}
267		if plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Target != "" || plan.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask ||
268			plan.Source != plan.Locator.State || plan.ExpectedMilestone != expectedMilestone {
269			return fmt.Errorf("domain action is represented as a persisted-state edge")
270		}
271		return nil
272	}
273	
274	func validateConditions(conditions []Condition) error {
275		seen := make(map[ConditionCode]bool, len(conditions))
276		for index, condition := range conditions {
277			if err := condition.Validate(); err != nil {
278				return fmt.Errorf("condition %d: %w", index, err)
279			}
280			if seen[condition.Code] {
281				return fmt.Errorf("condition code %q is duplicated", condition.Code)
282			}
283			seen[condition.Code] = true
284		}
285		return nil
286	}
287	
288	func validateEffects(effects []Effect) error {
289		for index, effect := range effects {
290			if err := effect.Validate(); err != nil {
291				return fmt.Errorf("effect %d: %w", index, err)
292			}
293		}
294		return nil
295	}
296	
297	func validateAuthority(authority Fields) error {
298		for _, field := range authority.entries {
299			if field.Key == "" {
300				return fmt.Errorf("authority field key is empty")
301			}
302		}
303		return nil
304	}
305	
306	func cloneEffects(effects []Effect) []Effect {
307		out := make([]Effect, len(effects))
308		for index, effect := range effects {
309			out[index] = effect.Clone()
310		}
311		return out

314	func filterConditions(conditions []Condition, keep func(Condition) bool) []Condition {
315		out := make([]Condition, 0, len(conditions))
316		for _, condition := range conditions {
317			if keep(condition) {
318				out = append(out, condition)

107	// Collect builds the enriched inventory. Git probes run concurrently: each is
108	// a handful of process spawns, and a machine with dozens of tasks would
109	// otherwise make `dev ls` feel slow.
110	func Collect(ctx context.Context, tasks []*task.Task, rt runtime.Runtime, opts Options) []Row {
111		rows := make([]Row, len(tasks))
112	
113		sessions := opts.Sessions
114		tracked := opts.SessionsTracked
115		if !opts.SessionsSet && !opts.SkipRuntime && rt != nil && rt.Name() != "none" {
116			if s, err := rt.List(ctx); err == nil {
117				sessions, tracked = s, true
118			}
119		}
120	
121		var wg sync.WaitGroup
122		// Bound concurrency: git is process-heavy and an unbounded fan-out over a
123		// large inventory would thrash. Coordinated TUI loads share this limiter with
124		// repository enrichment.
125		limiter := opts.Limiter
126		if limiter == nil {
127			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
128		}
129	
130		for i, t := range tasks {
131			rows[i].Task = t
132			rows[i].Checkout = checkoutOf(t)
133	
134			if opts.SkipGit || rows[i].Checkout == "" {
135				continue
136			}
137			wg.Add(1)
138			go func(i int) {
139				defer wg.Done()
140				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
141				if !ok {
142					return
143				}
144				defer release()
145				enrich(ctx, &rows[i])
146			}(i)
147		}
148		wg.Wait()
149	
150		for i := range rows {
151			rows[i].Session = matchSession(sessions, rows[i])
152			rows[i].sessionsTracked = tracked
153		}
154		return rows
155	}

157	func checkoutOf(t *task.Task) string {
158		if t.WorktreePath != "" {
159			return t.WorktreePath
160		}
161		return t.RepoPath
162	}

164	func enrich(ctx context.Context, r *Row) {
165		info, err := os.Stat(r.Checkout)
166		r.CheckoutExists = err == nil && info.IsDir()
167		if !r.CheckoutExists {
168			if r.Task.WorktreePath != "" {
169				r.WorktreeMissing = true
170			}
171			return
172		}
173		if st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Checkout); err != nil {
174			r.StatusErr = err
175		} else {
176			r.Status = st
177		}
178		if unix, _, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, r.Checkout); err == nil && unix > 0 {
179			r.LastCommit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
180		}
181		// A recorded worktree that git no longer knows about is drift worth
182		// surfacing: the directory may exist while the administrative entry is gone.
183		if r.Task.WorktreePath != "" {
184			if _, ok, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, r.Task.RepoPath, r.Task.Branch); err == nil && !ok {
185				r.WorktreeMissing = true
186			}
187		}
188	}

190	// matchSession picks the runtime session hosting a row's checkout. An exact
191	// directory match is preferred over a containing one, so a worktree's own
192	// session always wins over the parent repo's.
193	func matchSession(sessions []runtime.Session, r Row) *runtime.Session {
194		if r.Checkout == "" {
195			return nil
196		}
197		var contains *runtime.Session
198		for i := range sessions {
199			for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
200				if d == r.Checkout {
201					return &sessions[i]
202				}
203				if strings.HasPrefix(d, r.Checkout+"/") && contains == nil {
204					contains = &sessions[i]
205				}
206			}
207		}
208		return contains
209	}
210	
211	// Filter narrows rows by state and repo. An empty filter matches everything.
212	type Filter struct {
213		States []task.State
214		Repo   string
215		// LiveOnly keeps only tasks with a runtime session.
216		LiveOnly bool
217		// DirtyOnly keeps only tasks with uncommitted work.
218		DirtyOnly bool
219	}
220	
221	// Apply returns the rows matching f.
222	func (f Filter) Apply(rows []Row) []Row {
223		out := rows[:0:0]
224		for _, r := range rows {
225			if len(f.States) > 0 && !containsState(f.States, r.Task.State) {
226				continue
227			}
228			if f.Repo != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Task.Repo), strings.ToLower(f.Repo)) {
229				continue
230			}
231			if f.LiveOnly && !r.Live() {
232				continue
233			}
234			if f.DirtyOnly && !r.Status.Dirty() {
235				continue
236			}
237			out = append(out, r)
238		}
239		return out
240	}
241	
242	func containsState(list []task.State, s task.State) bool {
243		for _, v := range list {
244			if v == s {
245				return true
246			}
247		}
248		return false
249	}
250	
251	// Orphans reports live runtime sessions that no task claims — the "I opened
252	// this and never wrote it down" case that makes a sidebar grow without bound.
253	func Orphans(sessions []runtime.Session, rows []Row) []runtime.Session {
254		claimed := map[string]bool{}
255		for _, r := range rows {
256			if r.Session != nil {
257				claimed[r.Session.Handle] = true
258			}
259		}
260		var out []runtime.Session
261		for _, s := range sessions {
262			if !claimed[s.Handle] {
263				out = append(out, s)
264			}
265		}
266		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Label < out[j].Label })
267		return out
268	}

987	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
988	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
989	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
990	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
991		for _, session := range sessions {
992			assigned := map[int]bool{}
993			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
994				best, bestLen := -1, -1
995				for i := range out.Checkouts {
996					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Checkouts[i]) {
997						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(normalizePath(root)) > bestLen {
998							best, bestLen = i, len(normalizePath(root))
999						}
1000					}
1001				}
1002				if best >= 0 {
1003					assigned[best] = true
1004				}
1005			}
1006			for i := range assigned {
1007				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
1008			}
1009		}

1016	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {

1020		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))

1023		}
1024		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))

672	func assertStaleAdoptApply(t *testing.T, service *Service, store *task.Store, locator Locator, plan Plan) {
673		t.Helper()
674		result, err := service.Apply(context.Background(), plan, Approve(plan.PlanID))
675		if !errors.Is(err, ErrStalePlan) {
676			t.Fatalf("Apply error=%v steps=%+v, want ErrStalePlan", err, result.AttemptedSteps())
677		}
678		if len(result.AttemptedSteps()) != 0 || result.Milestone != MilestoneNone || result.PartialSuccess {
679			t.Fatalf("stale result milestone=%s partial=%t steps=%+v", result.Milestone, result.PartialSuccess, result.AttemptedSteps())
680		}
681		assertTaskMissing(t, store, task.MakeID("example", locator.Branch))
682	}

742	func TestAdoptPlanAndApplyHoldRepositoryThenTaskStoreLock(t *testing.T) {
743		fixture, locator, _ := newAdoptGitFixture(t, "lock-order")
744		var repoHeld atomic.Bool
745		var repoCalls atomic.Int32
746		var occupancyUnderBoth atomic.Int32
747		var createUnderBoth atomic.Bool
748		probeTaskLock := func() bool {
749			probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 25*time.Millisecond)
750			defer cancel()
751			err := fixture.tasks.WithLock(probeCtx, func(*task.Tx) error { return nil })
752			return errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded)
753		}
754		service := fixture.serviceWith(t, runtime.None{}, fixture.root, LifecycleHooks{
755			RepoLock: func(_ context.Context, _ string, operation func() error) error {
756				repoCalls.Add(1)
757				if !repoHeld.CompareAndSwap(false, true) {
758					return errors.New("repository lock re-entered")
759				}
760				defer repoHeld.Store(false)
761				return operation()
762			},
763			InspectOccupancy: func(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, options runtime.OccupancyOptions) (runtime.Occupancy, error) {
764				if repoHeld.Load() && probeTaskLock() {
765					occupancyUnderBoth.Add(1)
766				}
767				return runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, target, options)
768			},
769			TaskCreate: func(tx *task.Tx, candidate *task.Task) (*task.Record, error) {
770				createUnderBoth.Store(repoHeld.Load() && probeTaskLock())
771				return tx.Create(candidate)
772			},
773		})
774		plan, err := service.Plan(context.Background(), newAdoptRequest(t, locator, AdoptOptions{}))
775		if err != nil {
776			t.Fatalf("Plan: %v", err)
777		}
778		if repoCalls.Load() != 1 || occupancyUnderBoth.Load() != 1 {
779			t.Fatalf("after Plan repo-calls=%d occupancy-under-both=%d", repoCalls.Load(), occupancyUnderBoth.Load())
780		}
781		if _, err := service.Apply(context.Background(), plan, Approve(plan.PlanID)); err != nil {
782			t.Fatalf("Apply: %v", err)
783		}
784		if repoCalls.Load() != 2 || occupancyUnderBoth.Load() != 2 || !createUnderBoth.Load() {
785			t.Fatalf("repo-calls=%d occupancy-under-both=%d create-under-both=%t",
786				repoCalls.Load(), occupancyUnderBoth.Load(), createUnderBoth.Load())
787		}
788	}

19	func TestCompletionRealGitDirectCommitPushAndHookOrder(t *testing.T) {
20		fixture := newLifecycleGitFixture(t, task.ModeDirect, task.Hot)
21		fakeRuntime := newLifecycleFakeRuntime()
22		updateFixtureTask(t, fixture, func(candidate *task.Task) {
23			candidate.RuntimeName = "fake"
24			candidate.RuntimeHandle = "retained-runtime"
25		})
26		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(fixture.repo, "tracked.txt"), []byte("direct completion\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
27			t.Fatal(err)
28		}
29		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(fixture.repo, "untracked.txt"), []byte("included\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
30			t.Fatal(err)
31		}
32	
33		var (
34			mu    sync.Mutex
35			calls []string
36		)
37		record := func(value string) {
38			mu.Lock()
39			calls = append(calls, value)
40			mu.Unlock()
41		}
42		service := fixture.serviceWith(t, fakeRuntime, fixture.root, LifecycleHooks{
43			AnalyzeFinish: func(ctx context.Context, dir, base, branch string) (gitx.FinishAnalysis, error) {
44				record("analyze")
45				return gitx.AnalyzeFinish(ctx, dir, base, branch)
46			},
47			CommitAll: func(ctx context.Context, dir, message string) error {
48				record("commit")
49				return gitx.CommitAllChanges(ctx, dir, message)
50			},
51			GitRun: func(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
52				if len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "push" {
53					record("push")
54				}
55				return gitx.Run(ctx, dir, args...)
56			},
57			TaskUpdate: func(tx *task.Tx, candidate *task.Task, revision string) (*task.Record, error) {
58				record("update")
59				return tx.Update(candidate, revision)
60			},
61		})
62		plan, err := service.Plan(context.Background(), fixture.request(t, CompleteDirectOptions{
63			Dirty: DirtyCommit, CommitMessage: "feat: complete directly", Push: true,
64		}))
65		if err != nil {
66			t.Fatalf("Plan: %v", err)
67		}
68		if got := effectCodes(plan); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []EffectCode{EffectCommitAll, EffectPushBranch, EffectUpdateTask}) {
69			t.Fatalf("effects=%v", got)
70		}
71		mu.Lock()
72		calls = nil
73		mu.Unlock()
74		result, err := service.Apply(context.Background(), plan, Approve(plan.PlanID))
75		if err != nil {
76			t.Fatalf("Apply: %v steps=%+v recovery=%v", err, result.AttemptedSteps(), result.Recovery())
77		}
78		mu.Lock()
79		gotCalls := append([]string(nil), calls...)
80		mu.Unlock()
81		commitAt, pushAt, updateAt := indexOfString(gotCalls, "commit"), indexOfString(gotCalls, "push"), indexOfString(gotCalls, "update")
82		if commitAt < 1 || pushAt <= commitAt || updateAt <= pushAt ||
83			!sliceContains(gotCalls[:commitAt], "analyze") || !sliceContains(gotCalls[commitAt+1:pushAt], "analyze") ||
84			!sliceContains(gotCalls[pushAt+1:updateAt], "analyze") {
85			t.Fatalf("hook order=%v", gotCalls)
86		}
87		if result.Milestone != MilestoneMerged || result.PartialSuccess {
88			t.Fatalf("milestone=%s partial=%t", result.Milestone, result.PartialSuccess)
89		}
90		if got := mustGitCommand(t, fixture.repo, "show", "HEAD:untracked.txt"); got != "included" {
91			t.Fatalf("committed untracked content=%q", got)
92		}
93		if local, remote := mustGitCommand(t, fixture.repo, "rev-parse", "main"), mustGitCommand(t, fixture.repo, "rev-parse", "origin/main"); local != remote {
94			t.Fatalf("direct push local=%s remote=%s", local, remote)
95		}
96		assertResourcesRetained(t, fixture, fixture.repo, "main")
97		_, closes := fakeRuntime.counts()
98		if closes != 0 {
99			t.Fatalf("completion closed runtime %d time(s)", closes)
100		}
101	}

243	func TestCompletionRejectsUnexpectedDirtyFinalizationRelation(t *testing.T) {
244		tests := []struct {
245			name    string
246			options CompleteDirectOptions
247			hooks   func(context.Context, string) error
248		}{
249			{
250				name:    "commit creates extra commit",
251				options: CompleteDirectOptions{Dirty: DirtyCommit, CommitMessage: "feat: expected commit"},
252				hooks: func(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {
253					if err := gitx.CommitAllChanges(ctx, dir, "feat: expected commit"); err != nil {
254						return err
255					}
256					_, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "commit", "--allow-empty", "-m", "injected extra commit")
257					return err
258				},
259			},
260			{
261				name:    "discard changes branch",
262				options: CompleteDirectOptions{Dirty: DirtyDiscard},
263				hooks: func(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {
264					return gitx.CommitAllChanges(ctx, dir, "injected instead of discard")
265				},
266			},
267		}
268		for _, test := range tests {
269			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
270				fixture := newLifecycleGitFixture(t, task.ModeDirect, task.Hot)
271				if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(fixture.repo, "tracked.txt"), []byte("dirty\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
272					t.Fatal(err)
273				}
274				hooks := LifecycleHooks{}
275				if test.options.Dirty == DirtyCommit {
276					hooks.CommitAll = func(ctx context.Context, dir, _ string) error { return test.hooks(ctx, dir) }
277				} else {
278					hooks.DiscardAll = test.hooks
279				}
280				service := fixture.serviceWith(t, runtime.None{}, fixture.root, hooks)
281				plan, err := service.Plan(context.Background(), fixture.request(t, test.options))
282				if err != nil {
283					t.Fatalf("Plan: %v", err)
284				}
285				approval := Approve(plan.PlanID)
286				if test.options.Dirty == DirtyDiscard {
287					approval = ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, "DROP")
288				}
289				result, err := service.Apply(context.Background(), plan, approval)
290				if !errors.Is(err, ErrStalePlan) {
291					t.Fatalf("Apply error=%v steps=%+v", err, result.AttemptedSteps())
292				}
293				if len(result.CompletedSteps()) != 1 || !result.PartialSuccess || result.Milestone != MilestoneNone {
294					t.Fatalf("steps=%+v partial=%t milestone=%s", result.AttemptedSteps(), result.PartialSuccess, result.Milestone)
295				}
296				updated, _ := fixture.tasks.Get(fixture.record.Task.ID)
297				if updated.State != task.Hot {
298					t.Fatalf("unexpected finalization wrote state=%s", updated.State)
299				}
300			})
301		}
302	}

13	// OccupancyProfile selects the policy applied to recognized-agent evidence.
14	// Session, pane, and activity observations are retained identically in every
15	// profile; only Blocking changes.
16	type OccupancyProfile uint8
17	
18	const (
19		// OccupancyStrict is for claiming a checkout for writing or adoption. Every
20		// recognized agent except the current caller is blocking, regardless of state.
21		// It is the zero value so an omitted profile fails toward exclusive ownership.
22		OccupancyStrict OccupancyProfile = iota
23		// OccupancyCleanup permits closeable idle and done agents. Unknown activity
24		// remains blocking unless CloseUnknown is set.
25		OccupancyCleanup
26	)
27	
28	// OccupancyOptions supplies live caller identity and action-specific policy.
29	// CallerWorkspaceID and CallerPaneID must describe the invoking runtime, not a
30	// handle remembered in durable task state.
31	type OccupancyOptions struct {
32		Profile           OccupancyProfile
33		CallerWorkspaceID string
34		CallerPaneID      string
35		CloseUnknown      bool
36	}
37	
38	// OccupancyObservation distinguishes an observed empty inventory from evidence
39	// that was unsupported, unattempted, or failed.
40	type OccupancyObservation struct {
41		Supported bool
42		Attempted bool
43		Err       error
44	}
45	
46	// Observed reports whether the observation completed successfully.
47	func (o OccupancyObservation) Observed() bool {
48		return o.Supported && o.Attempted && o.Err == nil
49	}
50	
51	// Unknown reports whether this evidence was not successfully observed.
52	func (o OccupancyObservation) Unknown() bool { return !o.Observed() }
53	
54	// OccupancySession is one live session whose panes cover the target checkout.
55	type OccupancySession struct {
56		Runtime  Session
57		Panes    []Pane
58		Mixed    []Pane
59		IsCaller bool
60	}
61	
62	// OccupancyAgent is one recognized agent whose cwd covers the target checkout.

64		Activity      AgentActivity
65		Status        string
66		SessionHandle string
67		IsCaller      bool
68		Blocking      bool
69	}
70

72	// runtime handle is deliberately absent: Sessions and Agents are selected only
73	// from fresh canonical checkout coverage.
74	type Occupancy struct {

87	}

89	// InspectOccupancy collects independent runtime, recognized-agent, and caller
90	// evidence for target. Initial target canonicalization errors are returned;
91	// observation failures are retained in their corresponding fields so each
92	// action can apply its own fail-closed acknowledgement policy.
93	func InspectOccupancy(ctx context.Context, rt Runtime, target string, opts OccupancyOptions) (Occupancy, error) {
94		checkout, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, target)
95		if err != nil {
96			return Occupancy{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize occupancy target: %w", err)
97		}
98		result := Occupancy{
99			Target:               checkout.path,
100			Backend:              "none",
101			Profile:              opts.Profile,
102			CallerWorkspaceID:    opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
103			ReportedCallerPaneID: opts.CallerPaneID,
104			CallerPaneID:         opts.CallerPaneID,
105		}
106		if rt == nil {
107			return result, nil
108		}
109		result.Backend = rt.Name()
110		if result.Backend == "none" {
111			return result, nil
112		}
113	
114		result.SessionList.Supported = true
115		resolver, resolvesCurrentPane := rt.(CurrentPaneResolver)
116		result.CurrentPane.Supported = resolvesCurrentPane
117		if resolvesCurrentPane && opts.CallerPaneID != "" {
118			result.CurrentPane.Attempted = true
119			result.CallerPaneID = ""
120			paneID, resolveErr := resolver.CurrentPaneID(ctx)
121			if resolveErr != nil {
122				result.CurrentPane.Err = resolveErr
123			} else if paneID == "" {
124				result.CurrentPane.Err = fmt.Errorf("current pane resolver returned an empty pane id")
125			} else {
126				result.CallerPaneID = paneID
127			}
128		}
129	
130		result.SessionList.Attempted = true
131		sessions, listErr := rt.List(ctx)
132		if listErr != nil {
133			result.SessionList.Err = listErr
134		} else {
135			for _, observed := range sessions {
136				covering, mixed, classifyErr := classifyOccupancySession(ctx, checkout, observed)
137				if classifyErr != nil {
138					result.SessionCoverageErr = classifyErr
139					result.Sessions = nil
140					break
141				}
142				if len(covering) == 0 {
143					continue
144				}
145				result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, OccupancySession{
146					Runtime: observed,
147					Panes:   covering,
148					Mixed:   mixed,
149					IsCaller: observed.Handle == opts.CallerWorkspaceID ||
150						occupancyPanePresent(observed.Panes, result.CallerPaneID),
151				})
152			}
153		}
154	
155		lister, listsAgents := rt.(AgentActivityLister)
156		result.AgentActivityList.Supported = listsAgents
157		if !listsAgents {
158			// Some backends can identify an agent on a pane without providing the
159			// richer recognized-agent inventory. Preserve that live evidence as the
160			// strict-profile fallback rather than treating an unsupported lister as an
161			// observed empty list.
162			for _, session := range result.Sessions {
163				for _, pane := range session.Panes {
164					if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" {
165						continue
166					}
167					cwd := pane.CWD
168					if cwd == "" {
169						cwd = pane.ShellCWD
170					}
171					activity := AgentActivity{
172						PaneID: pane.ID, WorkspaceID: session.Runtime.Handle,
173						Agent: pane.Agent, Status: pane.AgentStatus, CWD: cwd,
174					}
175					if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
176						result.SessionCoverageErr = coverageErr
177						result.Agents = nil
178						return result, nil
179					}
180				}
181			}
182			return result, nil
183		}
184		result.AgentActivityList.Attempted = true
185		activities, activityErr := lister.AgentActivities(ctx)
186		if activityErr != nil {
187			result.AgentActivityList.Err = activityErr
188			return result, nil
189		}
190		for _, activity := range activities {
191			if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
192				result.AgentActivityList.Err = coverageErr
193				result.Agents = nil
194				return result, nil
195			}
196		}
197		return result, nil
198	}
199	
200	func appendOccupancyAgent(ctx context.Context, result *Occupancy, checkout checkoutIdentity, opts OccupancyOptions, activity AgentActivity) error {
201		covered, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, checkout, activity.CWD)
202		if err != nil {
203			return fmt.Errorf("classify recognized agent pane %s: %w", activity.PaneID, err)
204		}
205		if !covered {
206			return nil
207		}
208		status := normalizeOccupancyStatus(activity.Status)
209		caller := result.CallerPaneID != "" && activity.PaneID == result.CallerPaneID
210		handle := correlatedSession(result.Sessions, activity)
211		result.Agents = append(result.Agents, OccupancyAgent{
212			Activity:      activity,
213			Status:        status,
214			SessionHandle: handle,
215			IsCaller:      caller,
216			Blocking:      occupancyAgentBlocks(opts, status, caller, handle != ""),
217		})
218		return nil
219	}
220	
221	type checkoutIdentity struct {
222		path string
223		git  bool
224	}
225	
226	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
227		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
228		if err != nil {
229			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
230		}
231		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
232		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
233			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
234			if canonicalErr != nil {
235				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
236			}
237			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true}, nil
238		}
239		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
240			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
241		}
242		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string) (bool, error) {
246		if cwd == "" {
247			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
248		}
249		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
250		if err != nil {
251			return false, err
252		}
253		if target.git && activity.git {
254			return target.path == activity.path, nil
255		}
256		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
257	}
258	
259	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
260		panes := session.Panes
261		if len(panes) == 0 {
262			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
263				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
264			}
265		}
266		var covering, mixed []Pane
267		for _, pane := range panes {
268			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
269			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
270				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
271			}
272			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
273			for _, path := range paths {
274				if path == "" {
275					continue
276				}
277				observed = true
278				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path)
279				if err != nil {
280					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
281				}
282				if inside {
283					paneCovers = true
284				} else {
285					paneOutside = true
286				}
287			}
288			if paneCovers {
289				covering = append(covering, pane)
290			}
291			if paneOutside || !observed {
292				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
293			}
294		}
295		return covering, mixed, nil
296	}
297	
298	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
299		if id == "" {
300			return false
301		}
302		for _, pane := range panes {
303			if pane.ID == id {
304				return true
305			}
306		}
307		return false
308	}
309	
310	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
311		for _, session := range sessions {
312			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
313				return session.Runtime.Handle
314			}
315			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
316				return session.Runtime.Handle
317			}
318		}
319		return ""
320	}
321	
322	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
323		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
324		if status == "" {
325			return "unknown"
326		}
327		return status
328	}
329	
330	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
331		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
332			return !caller
333		}
334		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
335		// with a freshly listed covering session.
336		if caller || !correlated {
337			return true
338		}
339		switch status {
340		case "idle", "done":
341			return false
342		case "unknown":
343			return !opts.CloseUnknown
344		default:
345			return true
346		}
347	}

450	func mustGitCommand(t *testing.T, dir string, args ...string) string {
451		t.Helper()
452		var command *exec.Cmd
453		if len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "init" && len(args) >= 3 && args[1] == "--bare" {
454			command = exec.Command("git", args...)
455			command.Dir = dir
456		} else if len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "init" && len(args) >= 3 && args[1] == "-b" {
457			command = exec.Command("git", args...)
458			command.Dir = dir
459		} else {
460			commandArgs := append([]string{"-C", dir}, args...)
461			command = exec.Command("git", commandArgs...)
462		}
463		output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
464		if err != nil {
465			t.Fatalf("git in %s %s: %v\n%s", dir, strings.Join(args, " "), err, output)
466		}
467		return strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
468	}

83		}

406	func TestLifecycleApplyUsesFixedLockAndEffectOrder(t *testing.T) {
407		fixture := newLifecycleGitFixture(t, task.ModeWorktree, task.Hot)
408		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(fixture.worktree, "tracked.txt"), []byte("ordered\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
409			t.Fatal(err)
410		}
411		fake := newLifecycleFakeRuntime()
412		fake.setSessions(idleRuntimeSession("ordered-runtime", fixture.worktree))
413	
414		var (
415			mu           sync.Mutex
416			calls        []string
417			taskLockHeld atomic.Bool
418		)
419		record := func(value string) {
420			mu.Lock()
421			calls = append(calls, value)
422			mu.Unlock()
423		}
424		hooks := LifecycleHooks{
425			RepoLock: func(_ context.Context, _ string, operation func() error) error {
426				record("repo-lock")
427				return operation()
428			},
429			WIPCommit: func(ctx context.Context, dir, message string) (bool, error) {
430				record("wip")
431				return gitx.WipCommit(ctx, dir, message)
432			},
433			GitRun: func(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
434				if len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "push" {
435					record("push")
436				}
437				return gitx.Run(ctx, dir, args...)
438			},
439			CloseAndWait: func(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, path string, options retire.Options) (retire.Inspection, error) {
440				record("close")
441				return retire.CloseAndWait(ctx, rt, path, options)
442			},
443			RemoveWorktree: func(ctx context.Context, repo, path string, force bool) error {
444				record("remove")
445				return gitx.RemoveWorktree(ctx, repo, path, force)
446			},
447			TaskUpdate: func(tx *task.Tx, candidate *task.Task, revision string) (*task.Record, error) {
448				record("update")
449				probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 25*time.Millisecond)
450				defer cancel()
451				probeDone := make(chan error, 1)
452				go func() {
453					probeDone <- fixture.tasks.WithLock(probeCtx, func(*task.Tx) error { return nil })
454				}()
455				if probeErr := <-probeDone; probeErr != nil {
456					taskLockHeld.Store(true)
457				}
458				return tx.Update(candidate, revision)
459			},
460		}
461		service := fixture.serviceWith(t, fake, fixture.root, hooks)
462		plan, err := service.Plan(context.Background(), fixture.request(t, ParkColdOptions{CommitWIP: true, Push: true}))
463		if err != nil {
464			t.Fatalf("Plan: %v", err)
465		}
466		mu.Lock()
467		calls = nil
468		mu.Unlock()
469		result, err := service.Apply(context.Background(), plan, Approve(plan.PlanID))
470		if err != nil {
471			t.Fatalf("Apply: %v steps=%+v", err, result.AttemptedSteps())
472		}
473		mu.Lock()
474		got := append([]string(nil), calls...)
475		mu.Unlock()
476		want := []string{"repo-lock", "wip", "push", "close", "remove", "update"}
477		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
478			t.Fatalf("order=%v want=%v", got, want)
479		}
480		if !taskLockHeld.Load() {
481			t.Fatal("TaskUpdate did not run while task Store.WithLock was held")
482		}
483		if gotCodes := stepCodes(result); !reflect.DeepEqual(gotCodes,
484			[]EffectCode{EffectCommitWIP, EffectPushBranch, EffectCloseRuntime, EffectRemoveWorktree, EffectUpdateTask}) {
485			t.Fatalf("ledger=%v", gotCodes)
486		}
487	}

790	func idleRuntimeSession(handle, checkout string) runtime.Session {
791		return runtime.Session{
792			Handle: handle, Dirs: []string{checkout}, AgentStatus: "idle",
793			Panes: []runtime.Pane{{
794				ID: handle + ":pane", CWD: checkout,
795				Agent: "claude", AgentStatus: "idle", AgentSession: "claude:1234567890abcdef",
796			}},
797		}
798	}
799	
800	func stepCodes(result Result) []EffectCode {
801		steps := result.AttemptedSteps()
802		codes := make([]EffectCode, len(steps))
803		for index, step := range steps {
804			codes[index] = step.Effect.Code
805		}
806		return codes
807	}
808	
809	func containsMessage(messages []string, substring string) bool {
810		for _, message := range messages {
811			if strings.Contains(message, substring) {
812				return true
813			}
814		}
815		return false
816	}

353		if !errors.Is(err, ErrStalePlan) {
354			t.Fatalf("stale validation error = %v, want ErrStalePlan", err)
355		}
356		var stale *StalePlanError
357		if !errors.As(err, &stale) {
358			t.Fatalf("stale validation type = %T, want *StalePlanError", err)
359		}
360	
361		invalidPlan := plan.Clone()
362		invalidPlan.Availability = AvailabilityBlocked
363		err = invalidPlan.Validate()
364		if !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidPlan) {
365			t.Fatalf("invalid validation error = %v, want ErrInvalidPlan", err)
366		}
367		var invalid *InvalidPlanError
368		if !errors.As(err, &invalid) {
369			t.Fatalf("invalid validation type = %T, want *InvalidPlanError", err)
370		}
371	}

1	package forge
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"encoding/json"
6		"errors"
7		"fmt"
8		"net/url"
9		"strings"
10		"time"
11	)
12	
13	// ReviewQuery identifies one exact head/base relationship in one repository.
14	// Repository is the forge's stable repository identity: owner/repository for
15	// GitHub, group/repository for GitLab, or organization/project/repository for
16	// Azure DevOps. Adapters must still verify the returned branches because CLI
17	// filters are not sufficient evidence on their own.
18	type ReviewQuery struct {
19		Repository string `json:"repository"`
20		Head       string `json:"head"`
21		Base       string `json:"base"`
22	}
23	
24	// ReviewState is the portable lifecycle state observed for a provider review.
25	type ReviewState string
26	
27	const (
28		ReviewOpen   ReviewState = "open"
29		ReviewDraft  ReviewState = "draft"
30		ReviewMerged ReviewState = "merged"
31		ReviewClosed ReviewState = "closed"
32	)
33	
34	// Valid reports whether s has defined portable review semantics.
35	func (s ReviewState) Valid() bool {
36		switch s {
37		case ReviewOpen, ReviewDraft, ReviewMerged, ReviewClosed:
38			return true
39		default:
40			return false
41		}
42	}
43	
44	// Review is the minimal provider evidence for an exact head/base relationship.
45	// ID is the provider-stable identity and Number is the repository-local human
46	// identifier. Head, Base, State and Draft are observations from the provider
47	// response rather than values copied from ReviewQuery.
48	type Review struct {
49		Provider   Kind        `json:"provider"`
50		Repository string      `json:"repository"`
51		ID         string      `json:"id"`
52		Number     int         `json:"number"`
53		State      ReviewState `json:"state"`
54		Draft      bool        `json:"draft"`
55		URL        string      `json:"url"`
56		Head       string      `json:"head"`
57		Base       string      `json:"base"`
58		ObservedAt time.Time   `json:"observed_at"`
59	}
60	
61	// ReviewQuerier is an optional forge capability. A nil Review and nil error is
62	// a successful observation that no exact review exists. One exact match returns
63	// provider evidence; multiple exact matches fail with AmbiguousReviewError.
64	type ReviewQuerier interface {
65		QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error)
66	}
67	
68	var (
69		// ErrAmbiguousReview identifies a query with multiple exact head/base
70		// matches. Callers must not select one by recency or provider ordering.
71		ErrAmbiguousReview = errors.New("multiple reviews match")
72		// ErrMalformedReviewResponse identifies provider JSON that cannot supply the
73		// critical portable fields without guessing.
74		ErrMalformedReviewResponse = errors.New("malformed review response")
75	)
76	
77	// AmbiguousReviewError carries every exact match while keeping Error text free
78	// of provider response values such as private URLs and branch names.
79	type AmbiguousReviewError struct {
80		Provider Kind
81		Query    ReviewQuery
82		Matches  []Review
83	}
84	
85	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Error() string {
86		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review query returned %d exact matches", e.Provider, len(e.Matches))
87	}
88	
89	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguousReview }
90	
91	// MalformedReviewResponseError identifies the unusable response field without
92	// embedding its value or the response body. Index is zero-based and is -1 when
93	// the whole JSON document is malformed. Err retains safe decoder diagnostics.
94	type MalformedReviewResponseError struct {
95		Provider Kind
96		Index    int
97		Field    string
98		Err      error
99	}
100	
101	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Error() string {
102		location := "response"
103		if e.Index >= 0 {
104			location = fmt.Sprintf("response item %d", e.Index+1)
105		}
106		detail := "missing or invalid " + e.Field
107		if e.Err != nil {
108			detail = e.Err.Error()
109		}
110		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review %s is malformed: %s", e.Provider, location, detail)
111	}
112	
113	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
114	
115	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Is(target error) bool {
116		return target == ErrMalformedReviewResponse
117	}
118	
119	// QueryReview invokes the optional capability without widening Forge. It never
120	// caches or initiates a query unless a caller explicitly calls this function.
121	func QueryReview(ctx context.Context, f Forge, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
122		querier, ok := f.(ReviewQuerier)
123		if !ok {
124			return nil, &ErrUnsupported{Kind: f.Kind(), Operation: "review queries"}
125		}
126		return querier.QueryReview(ctx, dir, query)
127	}
128	
129	type reviewCandidate struct {
130		ID     string
131		Number int
132		State  string
133		Draft  *bool
134		URL    string
135		Head   string
136		Base   string
137	}
138	
139	type reviewStateNormalizer func(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error)
140	
141	func validateReviewQuery(query ReviewQuery) error {
142		switch {
143		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Repository) == "":
144			return errors.New("review query repository is required")
145		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Head) == "":
146			return errors.New("review query head is required")
147		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Base) == "":
148			return errors.New("review query base is required")
149		default:
150			return nil
151		}
152	}
153	
154	func decodeReviewJSON(provider Kind, out string, target any) error {
155		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(out)
156		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
157			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON array", nil)
158		}
159		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), target); err != nil {
160			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON", err)
161		}
162		return nil
163	}
164	
165	func selectExactReview(provider Kind, query ReviewQuery, candidates []reviewCandidate, normalize reviewStateNormalizer) (*Review, error) {
166		matches := make([]Review, 0, 1)
167		observedAt := time.Now().UTC()
168		for index, candidate := range candidates {
169			if candidate.Head == "" {
170				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "head branch", nil)
171			}
172			if candidate.Base == "" {
173				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "base branch", nil)
174			}
175			if candidate.Head != query.Head || candidate.Base != query.Base {
176				continue
177			}
178			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate.ID) == "" {
179				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "identifier", nil)
180			}
181			if candidate.Number <= 0 {
182				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "number", nil)
183			}
184			if candidate.Draft == nil {
185				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "draft flag", nil)
186			}
187			if !validReviewURL(candidate.URL) {
188				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "URL", nil)
189			}
190			state, err := normalize(candidate.State, *candidate.Draft)
191			if err != nil {
192				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "state", err)
193			}
194			matches = append(matches, Review{
195				Provider: provider, Repository: query.Repository,
196				ID: candidate.ID, Number: candidate.Number,
197				State: state, Draft: *candidate.Draft, URL: candidate.URL,
198				Head: candidate.Head, Base: candidate.Base, ObservedAt: observedAt,
199			})
200		}
201	
202		switch len(matches) {
203		case 0:
204			return nil, nil
205		case 1:
206			return &matches[0], nil
207		default:
208			return nil, &AmbiguousReviewError{
209				Provider: provider, Query: query,
210				Matches: append([]Review(nil), matches...),
211			}
212		}
213	}
214	
215	func malformedReviewResponse(provider Kind, index int, field string, err error) error {
216		return &MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: index, Field: field, Err: err}
217	}
218	
219	func validReviewURL(raw string) bool {
220		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
221		if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" {
222			return false
223		}
224		return parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http"
225	}
226

12	// gh drives the GitHub CLI.
13	type gh struct{}
14	
15	func (g *gh) Kind() Kind      { return GitHub }
16	func (g *gh) Bin() string     { return "gh" }
17	func (g *gh) Available() bool { return have("gh") }
18	
19	// CreatePR opens a GitHub pull request.
20	func (g *gh) CreatePR(ctx context.Context, dir string, req PRRequest) (string, error) {
21		if !g.Available() {
22			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
23		}
24		args := []string{"pr", "create", "--base", req.Base, "--head", req.Head}
25		switch {
26		case req.Title != "":
27			args = append(args, "--title", req.Title, "--body", req.Body)
28		default:
29			// --fill derives title and body from the branch's commits, which is
30			// the right default for a solo workflow where the commits already say
31			// what happened.
32			args = append(args, "--fill")
33		}
34		if req.Draft {
35			args = append(args, "--draft")
36		}
37		if req.Web {
38			args = append(args, "--web")
39		}
40		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
41		return lastURL(out), err
42	}
43	
44	// QueryReview manually observes an exact GitHub pull request relationship.
45	func (g *gh) QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
46		if !g.Available() {
47			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
48		}
49		if err := validateReviewQuery(query); err != nil {
50			return nil, err
51		}
52		out, err := reviewRunner(ctx, "gh", dir,
53			"pr", "list", "--repo", query.Repository,
54			"--head", query.Head, "--base", query.Base, "--state", "all",
55			"--limit", "1000",
56			"--json", "id,number,state,isDraft,url,headRefName,baseRefName")
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, err
59		}
60		return parseGitHubReviews(out, query)
61	}
62	
63	func parseGitHubReviews(out string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
64		var raw []struct {
65			ID          string `json:"id"`
66			Number      *int   `json:"number"`
67			State       string `json:"state"`
68			IsDraft     *bool  `json:"isDraft"`
69			URL         string `json:"url"`
70			HeadRefName string `json:"headRefName"`
71			BaseRefName string `json:"baseRefName"`
72		}
73		if err := decodeReviewJSON(GitHub, out, &raw); err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		candidates := make([]reviewCandidate, 0, len(raw))
77		for _, item := range raw {
78			number := 0
79			if item.Number != nil {
80				number = *item.Number
81			}
82			candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
83				ID: item.ID, Number: number, State: item.State, Draft: item.IsDraft,
84				URL: item.URL, Head: item.HeadRefName, Base: item.BaseRefName,
85			})
86		}
87		return selectExactReview(GitHub, query, candidates, normalizeGitHubReviewState)
88	}
89	
90	func normalizeGitHubReviewState(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error) {
91		switch strings.ToUpper(state) {
92		case "OPEN":
93			if draft {
94				return ReviewDraft, nil
95			}
96			return ReviewOpen, nil
97		case "MERGED":
98			return ReviewMerged, nil
99		case "CLOSED":
100			return ReviewClosed, nil
101		default:
102			return "", errors.New("unrecognized GitHub review state")
103		}
104	}
105	
106	// CreateRepo creates a GitHub repository from the local checkout.
107	func (g *gh) CreateRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (string, error) {
108		if !g.Available() {
109			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
110		}
111		target, err := resolveRepoRequest(req)
112		if err != nil {
113			return "", err
114		}
115		args := []string{"repo", "create", target.fullName, "--source", ".", "--remote", target.remoteName,
116			visibilityFlag(target.visibility)}
117		if req.Description != "" {
118			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
119		}
120		if req.Push {
121			args = append(args, "--push")
122		}
123		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
124		return lastURL(out), err
125	}
126	
127	// PublishRepo creates an empty GitHub repository. Unlike CreateRepo it does
128	// not pass --source, --remote or --push, leaving all local Git mutations to the
129	// shared caller-side transaction.
130	func (g *gh) PublishRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (CreateRepoResult, error) {
131		if !g.Available() {
132			return CreateRepoResult{}, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
133		}
134		target, err := resolveRepoRequest(req)
135		if err != nil {
136			return CreateRepoResult{}, err
137		}
138		args := []string{"repo", "create", target.fullName, visibilityFlag(target.visibility)}
139		if req.Description != "" {
140			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
141		}
142		out, err := publishRunner(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
143		if err != nil {
144			return createRepoResult(GitHub, target, out, false), err
145		}
146		result := createRepoResult(GitHub, target, out, true)
147		if result.RemoteURL == "" {
148			return result, fmt.Errorf("gh created %q but did not report a repository URL", target.fullName)
149		}
150		return result, nil
151	}
152	
153	// CloneURL renders a clone target. gh accepts a bare owner/name, so a
154	// shorthand reference is passed through untouched.
155	func (g *gh) CloneURL(ref string) string {
156		if strings.Contains(ref, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "git@") {
157			return ref
158		}
159		return "https://github.com/" + strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git") + ".git"
160	}
161	
162	// lastURL picks the URL out of a CLI's chatter, which may print progress
163	// lines before the created resource's address.
164	func lastURL(out string) string {
165		found := lastHTTPURL(out)
166		if found == "" {
167			return strings.TrimSpace(out)
168		}
169		return found
170	}
171	
172	// ListRepos lists GitHub repositories visible to the authenticated user —
173	// owned, collaborated on, and organisation membership — most recently pushed
174	// first. gh api is intentionally used instead of a custom HTTP client:
175	// authentication and token refresh stay owned by the forge CLI.
176	func (g *gh) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
177		if !g.Available() {
178			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
179		}
180		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 60*time.Second)
181		defer cancel()
182		const pageSize = 100
183		var result []RemoteRepo
184		for page := 1; ; page++ {
185			out, err := run(ctx, "gh", "", "api", "user/repos", "--method", "GET",
186				"-f", "per_page=100", "-f", fmt.Sprintf("page=%d", page),
187				"-f", "sort=pushed", "-f", "direction=desc")
188			if err != nil {
189				return result, err
190			}
191			repos, err := parseGitHubRepos(out)
192			if err != nil {
193				return result, err
194			}
195			result = append(result, repos...)
196			if len(repos) < pageSize {
197				break
198			}
199		}
200		return result, nil
201	}
202	
203	func parseGitHubRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
204		var raw []struct {
205			Name          string `json:"name"`
206			FullName      string `json:"full_name"`
207			Description   string `json:"description"`
208			URL           string `json:"html_url"`
209			CloneURL      string `json:"clone_url"`
210			SSHURL        string `json:"ssh_url"`
211			Visibility    string `json:"visibility"`
212			Fork          bool   `json:"fork"`
213			Archived      bool   `json:"archived"`
214			PushedAt      string `json:"pushed_at"`
215			DefaultBranch string `json:"default_branch"`
216		}
217		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
218			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode gh api user/repos: %w", err)
219		}
220		result := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
221		for _, r := range raw {
222			updated, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.PushedAt)
223			result = append(result, RemoteRepo{
224				Forge: GitHub, Name: r.Name, FullName: r.FullName,
225				Description: r.Description, URL: r.URL,
226				CloneURL: r.CloneURL, SSHURL: r.SSHURL,
227				Visibility: r.Visibility, DefaultBranch: r.DefaultBranch,
228				Archived: r.Archived, Fork: r.Fork, UpdatedAt: updated,
229			})
230		}
231		return result, nil
232	}

27		}

29		switch {

134	func (g *glab) CreateRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (string, error) {
135		if !g.Available() {
136			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitLab, Bin: "glab"}
137		}
138		target, err := resolveRepoRequest(req)
139		if err != nil {
140			return "", err
141		}
142		args := []string{"repo", "create"}
143		if req.FullName == "" && req.Namespace == "" && !strings.Contains(req.Name, "/") {
144			// Preserve the original invocation for existing callers such as Try
145			// graduation; glab uses the current checkout and adds the requested
146			// remote as before.
147			args = append(args, target.name)
148		} else {
149			args = append(args, "--name", target.name)
150			if target.namespace != "" {
151				args = append(args, "--group", target.namespace)
152			}
153		}
154		args = append(args, "--remoteName", target.remoteName, visibilityFlag(target.visibility))
155		if req.Description != "" {
156			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
157		}
158		out, err := run(ctx, "glab", dir, args...)
159		return lastURL(out), err
160	}

162	// PublishRepo creates an empty GitLab project while --skipGitInit prevents
163	// glab from initializing, cloning or changing the local checkout.
164	func (g *glab) PublishRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (CreateRepoResult, error) {
165		if !g.Available() {

169		if err != nil {

173			visibilityFlag(target.visibility)}
174		if target.namespace != "" {
175			args = append(args, "--group", target.namespace)
176		}

179		}

181		if err != nil {
182			return createRepoResult(GitLab, target, out, false), err

184		result := createRepoResult(GitLab, target, out, true)
185		if result.RemoteURL == "" {
186			return result, fmt.Errorf("glab created %q but did not report a repository URL", target.fullName)
187		}

202		if strings.Contains(ref, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "git@") {
203			return ref
204		}

208	// ListRepos lists every GitLab project of which the authenticated user is a
209	// member, most recently active first. glab owns authentication; dev passes an
210	// explicit GITLAB_HOST/GLAB_HOST (default gitlab.com) so inventory and cache
211	// identity never depend on the process's current Git repository.
212	func (g *glab) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
213		if !g.Available() {
214			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitLab, Bin: "glab"}
215		}
216		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 60*time.Second)
217		defer cancel()
218		const pageSize = 100
219		var result []RemoteRepo
220		for page := 1; ; page++ {
221			out, err := run(ctx, "glab", "", "api", "--hostname", gitLabHost(), "projects", "--method", "GET",
222				"-f", "membership=true", "-f", "simple=true", "-f", "per_page=100",
223				"-f", fmt.Sprintf("page=%d", page), "-f", "order_by=last_activity_at", "-f", "sort=desc")
224			if err != nil {
225				return result, err
226			}
227			repos, err := parseGitLabRepos(out)
228			if err != nil {
229				return result, err
230			}
231			result = append(result, repos...)
232			if len(repos) < pageSize {
233				break
234			}
235		}
236		return result, nil
237	}

239	func parseGitLabRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
240		var raw []struct {
241			Name              string `json:"name"`
242			PathWithNamespace string `json:"path_with_namespace"`
243			Description       string `json:"description"`
244			DefaultBranch     string `json:"default_branch"`
245			Visibility        string `json:"visibility"`
246			SSHURL            string `json:"ssh_url_to_repo"`
247			HTTPURL           string `json:"http_url_to_repo"`
248			WebURL            string `json:"web_url"`
249			Archived          bool   `json:"archived"`
250			ForkedFrom        any    `json:"forked_from_project"`
251			LastActivityAt    string `json:"last_activity_at"`
252		}
253		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
254			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode glab api projects: %w", err)
255		}
256		result := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
257		for _, r := range raw {
258			updated, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, r.LastActivityAt)
259			result = append(result, RemoteRepo{
260				Forge: GitLab, Name: r.Name, FullName: r.PathWithNamespace,
261				Description: r.Description, URL: r.WebURL,
262				CloneURL: r.HTTPURL, SSHURL: r.SSHURL,
263				Visibility: r.Visibility, DefaultBranch: r.DefaultBranch,
264				Archived: r.Archived, Fork: r.ForkedFrom != nil, UpdatedAt: updated,
265			})
266		}
267		return result, nil
268	}

294	// ListRepos queries every configured organization/project concurrently. Azure
295	// CLI already returns every repository in the selected team project.
296	func (a *az) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
297		if len(a.targets) == 0 {
298			return nil, errors.New("Azure DevOps remote inventory needs at least one [[forge.azure_devops]] target")
299		}
300		if err := a.ensureExtension(ctx); err != nil {
301			return nil, err
302		}
303		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
304		defer cancel()
305	
306		type result struct {
307			repos []RemoteRepo
308			err   error
309		}
310		ch := make(chan result, len(a.targets))
311		var wg sync.WaitGroup
312		for _, target := range a.targets {
313			target := target
314			wg.Add(1)
315			go func() {
316				defer wg.Done()
317				out, err := run(ctx, "az", "", "repos", "list", "--detect", "false",
318					"--organization", target.Organization, "--project", target.Project,
319					"--output", "json", "--only-show-errors")
320				if err != nil {
321					ch <- result{err: fmt.Errorf("Azure DevOps %s / %s: %w", target.Organization, target.Project, err)}
322					return
323				}
324				repos, err := parseAzureDevOpsRepos(out)
325				if err != nil {
326					err = fmt.Errorf("Azure DevOps %s / %s: %w", target.Organization, target.Project, err)
327				}
328				ch <- result{repos: repos, err: err}
329			}()
330		}
331		wg.Wait()
332		close(ch)
333	
334		var repos []RemoteRepo
335		var errs []error
336		for item := range ch {
337			repos = append(repos, item.repos...)
338			if item.err != nil {
339				errs = append(errs, item.err)
340			}
341		}
342		sort.Slice(repos, func(i, j int) bool { return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label() })
343		unique := repos[:0]
344		seen := map[string]bool{}
345		for _, repo := range repos {
346			key := strings.ToLower(repo.Label())
347			if seen[key] {
348				continue
349			}
350			seen[key] = true
351			unique = append(unique, repo)
352		}
353		return unique, errors.Join(errs...)
354	}

388	// parseAzureDevOpsRemote returns the provider identity and browser-safe HTTPS
389	// repository URL for supported Azure DevOps Services clone URL forms.
390	func parseAzureDevOpsRemote(raw string) (identity, webURL string, ok bool) {
391		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
392		if raw == "" {
393			return "", "", false
394		}
395		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
396			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
397			if err != nil || u.Fragment != "" || u.RawQuery != "" {
398				return "", "", false
399			}
400			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
401			case "https":
402				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
403					return "", "", false
404				}
405				return parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u)
406			case "ssh":
407				if u.User == nil || (u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22") {
408					return "", "", false
409				}
410				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
411					return "", "", false
412				}
413				return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(u.User.Username(), strings.ToLower(u.Hostname()), escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath()))
414			default:
415				return "", "", false
416			}
417		}
418		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
419		if at <= 0 {
420			return "", "", false
421		}
422		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
423		if colon < 0 {
424			return "", "", false
425		}
426		colon += at + 1
427		return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(raw[:at], strings.ToLower(raw[at+1:colon]), decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(raw[colon+1:], "/"), "/")))
428	}
429	
430	func parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u *url.URL) (string, string, bool) {
431		if u.User != nil {
432			if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
433				return "", "", false
434			}
435		}
436		host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
437		segments := escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath())
438		var organization, project, repo string
439		switch {
440		case host == "dev.azure.com":
441			if len(segments) != 4 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[2], "_git") {
442				return "", "", false
443			}
444			organization, project, repo = segments[0], segments[1], segments[3]
445			if u.User != nil && !strings.EqualFold(u.User.Username(), organization) {
446				return "", "", false
447			}
448		case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com") && host != "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com":
449			if len(segments) < 3 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[len(segments)-2], "_git") || u.User != nil {
450				return "", "", false
451			}
452			organization = strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")
453			project, repo = segments[len(segments)-3], segments[len(segments)-1]
454		default:
455			return "", "", false
456		}
457		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
458		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
459			return "", "", false
460		}
461		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
462		webURL := azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo)
463		return identity, webURL, true
464	}

466	func parseAzureDevOpsSSH(user, host string, segments []string) (string, string, bool) {
467		var organization, project, repo string
468		switch {
469		case host == "ssh.dev.azure.com" && strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && len(segments) == 4 && strings.EqualFold(segments[0], "v3"):
470			organization, project, repo = segments[1], segments[2], segments[3]
471			host = "dev.azure.com"
472		case host == "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com" && len(segments) == 3 && strings.EqualFold(segments[1], "_ssh"):
473			organization, project, repo = user, segments[0], segments[2]
474			host = strings.ToLower(organization) + ".visualstudio.com"
475		default:
476			return "", "", false
477		}
478		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
479		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
480			return "", "", false
481		}
482		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
483		return identity, azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo), true
484	}
485	
486	func azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo string) string {
487		if host == "dev.azure.com" {
488			return "https://dev.azure.com/" + url.PathEscape(organization) + "/" + url.PathEscape(project) + "/_git/" + url.PathEscape(repo)
489		}
490		return "https://" + host + "/" + url.PathEscape(project) + "/_git/" + url.PathEscape(repo)
491	}
492	
493	func escapedSegments(path string) []string {
494		return decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(path, "/"), "/"))
495	}
496	
497	func decodeSegments(segments []string) []string {
498		if len(segments) == 1 && segments[0] == "" {
499			return nil
500		}
501		out := make([]string, 0, len(segments))
502		for _, segment := range segments {
503			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(segment)
504			if err != nil || decoded == "" || strings.Contains(decoded, "/") {
505				return nil
506			}
507			out = append(out, decoded)
508		}
509		return out
510	}

250	// ProbeForge is Probe for an already-selected adapter.
251	func ProbeForge(ctx context.Context, f Forge) Readiness {
252		result := Readiness{Forge: f.Kind(), Bin: f.Bin()}
253		if !f.Available() {
254			result.Status = ReadinessMissingCLI
255			result.Detail = fmt.Sprintf("%s is not installed", f.Bin())
256			result.Action = installAndLoginAction(f.Kind())
257			return result
258		}
259		result.Installed = true
260	
261		args, action, ok := authProbe(f.Kind())
262		if !ok {
263			result.Status = ReadinessUnsupported
264			result.Detail = fmt.Sprintf("%s authentication probing is not supported", f.Kind())
265			return result
266		}
267		probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
268		defer cancel()
269		if _, err := probeRunner(probeCtx, f.Bin(), "", args...); err != nil {
270			if probeCtx.Err() != nil {
271				result.Status = ReadinessProbeFailed
272				result.Detail = probeCtx.Err().Error()
273				result.Action = "run `" + f.Bin() + " auth status` to diagnose the provider CLI"
274				return result
275			}
276			result.Status = ReadinessUnauthenticated
277			result.Detail = err.Error()
278			result.Action = action
279			return result
280		}
281		result.Status = ReadinessReady
282		result.Authenticated = true
283		return result
284	}

342	func resolveRepoRequest(req RepoRequest) (repoTarget, error) {
343		fullName := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.FullName), "/")
344		name := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.Name), "/")
345		namespace := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.Namespace), "/")
346		if fullName == "" {
347			fullName = name
348			if namespace != "" && !strings.Contains(name, "/") {
349				fullName = namespace + "/" + name
350			}
351		}
352		if fullName == "" {
353			return repoTarget{}, errors.New("repository name is required")
354		}
355		if strings.Contains(fullName, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(fullName, "git@") {
356			return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("repository name %q must not be a URL", fullName)
357		}
358		parts := strings.Split(fullName, "/")
359		for _, part := range parts {
360			if part == "" || part == "." || part == ".." {
361				return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid repository name %q", fullName)
362			}
363		}
364		name = parts[len(parts)-1]
365		if len(parts) > 1 {
366			namespace = strings.Join(parts[:len(parts)-1], "/")
367		}
368	
369		visibility := req.Visibility
370		if visibility == "" {
371			if req.Private {
372				visibility = VisibilityPrivate
373			} else {
374				visibility = VisibilityPublic
375			}
376		}
377		switch visibility {
378		case VisibilityPublic, VisibilityPrivate, VisibilityInternal:
379		default:
380			return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported repository visibility %q", visibility)
381		}
382		remoteName := strings.TrimSpace(req.RemoteName)
383		if remoteName == "" {
384			remoteName = "origin"
385		}
386		return repoTarget{
387			name: name, namespace: namespace, fullName: fullName,
388			visibility: visibility, remoteName: remoteName,
389		}, nil
390	}

444	type cliRunner func(context.Context, string, string, ...string) (string, error)
445	
446	// Separate hooks keep readiness, publishing and review-query tests
447	// platform-independent; production uses the same subprocess runner as the
448	// legacy adapter methods.
449	var (
450		probeRunner   cliRunner = run
451		publishRunner cliRunner = runCombined
452		reviewRunner  cliRunner = run
453		lookupPath              = exec.LookPath
454	)
455	
456	// run executes a forge CLI, streaming stderr through so the user sees the
457	// CLI's own authentication prompts and error messages verbatim.
458	func run(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
459		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
460		cmd.Dir = dir
461		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
462		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
463		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
464		cmd.Stdin = os.Stdin
465		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
466			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
467			if detail != "" {
468				return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
469					bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
470			}
471			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
472		}
473		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
474	}
475	
476	// runCombined is used for non-interactive publishing because gh/glab versions
477	// differ on whether the created repository URL is written to stdout or stderr.
478	// Stdin is deliberately left closed so a supposedly complete publish request
479	// cannot unexpectedly drop into a second provider-owned wizard.
480	func runCombined(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
481		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
482		cmd.Dir = dir
483		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
484		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
485		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
486		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
487			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
488			if detail != "" {
489				return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
490					bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
491			}
492			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
493		}
494		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()) + "\n" + strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())), nil

502	func lastHTTPURL(out string) string {
503		var found string
504		for _, field := range strings.Fields(out) {
505			candidate := strings.Trim(field, "<>()[]{}\"',;.")
506			if strings.HasPrefix(candidate, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(candidate, "https://") {
507				found = candidate
508			}
509		}
510		return found
511	}
