1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}
88	
89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104	
105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
106		if err != nil {
107			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
108			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
109			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
110			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
111		}
112		switch {
113		case rel == ".":
114			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
115		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
116			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
117		default:
118			return canonicalCandidate, nil
119		}
120	}
121	
122	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
123	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
124	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
125		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
126		if err == nil {
127			return true, nil
128		}
129		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
130			return false, nil
131		}
132		return false, err
133	}
134	
135	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
136	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
137		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
138		if err != nil {
139			return false, err
140		}
141		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
142		if err != nil {
143			return false, err
144		}
145		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
146			return true, nil
147		}
148		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
149	}
150	
151	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
152	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
153	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
154	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
155		switch {
156		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
157			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
158		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
159			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
160		case component == "." || component == "..":
161			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
162		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
163			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
164		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
165			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
166		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
167			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
168		default:
169			return nil
170		}
171	}
172	
173	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
174	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
175	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
176	// single component.
177	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
178		if len(components) == 0 {
179			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
180		}
181		for i, component := range components {
182			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
183				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
184			}
185		}
186		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
187		if err != nil {
188			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
189		}
190		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
191	}
192	
193	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
194		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
195			return false
196		}
197		letter := component[0]
198		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
199	}
200	
201	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
202		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
203			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
204		}) {
205			if component == ".." {
206				return true

28		}
29	
30		var result Result
31		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
32			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
33				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
34				if loadErr != nil {
35					return &StalePlanError{
36						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID,

45					return planErr
46				}
47				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)

49					actual := ""
50					if current != nil {

52					}

54				}
55				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
56					return &StalePlanError{

58						ActualPlanID:                 fresh.PlanID,
59						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,

92			})

889		if !options.IncludeTries {

891			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
892			for index, repository := range repos {
893				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
894					continue
895				}

921			}

924			}
925		}

927		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
928		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising
929		// ~3*56 git processes was the measured 4.2s startup bottleneck; eight
930		// workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once. TUI callers
931		// share the limiter with task enrichment.

941				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)

944				}
945				defer release()
946	
947				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: assets[i]}

950					row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
951					if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
952						row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
953					}
954				}
955				if r.HasGit {

957				}
958				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
959				if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
960					row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
961				}
962				row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
963				row.LastActivity = row.Context.LastActivity
964				row.Worktrees = row.Context.WorktreeCount
965				if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
966					row.Status = main.Status
967				}
968				if !r.Bare {
969					row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
970				}
971				if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
972					row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
973					row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
974				}
975				if r.HasGit {

978						MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
979					}, row.Worktrees)
980				} else {

982				}
983				out[i] = row
984			}(i, r)

140	func installReviewTestRunner(t *testing.T, output string) *[]reviewInvocation {
141		t.Helper()
142		calls := []reviewInvocation{}
143		installReviewTestSeams(t, func(_ context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
144			calls = append(calls, reviewInvocation{bin: bin, dir: dir, args: append([]string(nil), args...)})
145			if bin == "az" && len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "extension" {

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}
88	
89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104	
105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
106		if err != nil {
107			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
108			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
109			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
110			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
111		}
112		switch {
113		case rel == ".":
114			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
115		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
116			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
117		default:
118			return canonicalCandidate, nil
119		}
120	}
121	
122	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
123	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
124	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
125		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
126		if err == nil {
127			return true, nil
128		}
129		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
130			return false, nil
131		}
132		return false, err
133	}
134	
135	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
136	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
137		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
138		if err != nil {
139			return false, err
140		}
141		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
142		if err != nil {
143			return false, err
144		}
145		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
146			return true, nil
147		}
148		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
149	}
150	
151	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
152	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
153	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
154	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
155		switch {
156		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
157			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
158		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
159			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
160		case component == "." || component == "..":
161			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
162		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
163			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
164		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
165			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
166		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
167			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
168		default:
169			return nil
170		}
171	}

299	// Main returns Git's actual primary record. The first-row fallback preserves
300	// compatibility with manually constructed contexts which predate Worktree.Main.
301	func (c RepoContext) Main() (RepoCheckout, bool) {
302		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
303			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
304				return checkout, true
305			}
306		}
307		if len(c.Checkouts) == 0 {
308			return RepoCheckout{}, false
309		}
310		return c.Checkouts[0], true
311	}

313	// Linked returns every Git-registered non-main worktree.
314	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
315		hasMarkedMain := false
316		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
317			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
318				hasMarkedMain = true
319				break
320			}
321		}
322		if !hasMarkedMain {
323			if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
324				return nil
325			}
326			return c.Checkouts[1:]
327		}
328		out := make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(c.Checkouts)-1)
329		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
330			if !checkout.Worktree.Main {
331				out = append(out, checkout)
332			}
333		}
334		return out
335	}

337	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
338	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
339	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
340		seen := map[string]bool{}
341		var out []runtime.Session
342		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
343			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
344				key := session.Handle
345				if key == "" {
346					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
347				}
348				if seen[key] {
349					continue
350				}
351				seen[key] = true
352				out = append(out, session)
353			}
354		}
355		return out
356	}

380	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions builds repository topology from Git's complete
381	// registered worktree list. It never synthesizes a main checkout after a Git
382	// query failure.
383	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
384		opts RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
385		if ctx == nil {
386			ctx = context.Background()
387		}
388		out := RepoContext{
389			Repo: r, Runtime: opts.Runtime,
390			WorktreeObservation: TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved},
391			RuntimeObservation:  runtimeObservation(opts),
392		}
393		queryPath := repoQueryPath(r)
394		out.RepositoryID, out.IdentityErr = canonicalRepositoryID(ctx, r, queryPath)
395		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
396	
397		var (
398			worktrees []gitx.Worktree
399			err       error
400		)
401		if queryPath == "" {
402			err = fmt.Errorf("repository has no Git query path")
403		} else {
404			worktrees, err = gitx.Worktrees(ctx, queryPath)
405		}
406		if err != nil {
407			listErr := &WorktreeListError{Path: queryPath, Err: err}
408			out.WorktreeErr = listErr
409			out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: listErr}
410			assignTasksWithoutTopology(&out, tasks)
411			finishRepoContext(&out)
412			return out
413		}
414		out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
415		out.WorktreeCount = 0
416		out.Checkouts = make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(worktrees))
417		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
418			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
419			if canonicalPath == "" {
420				canonicalPath = filepath.Clean(worktree.Path)
421			}
422			checkout := RepoCheckout{
423				ID: canonicalPath, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
424				IdentityErr: canonicalErr,
425				Worktree:    worktree, Exists: pathIsDir(worktree.Path),
426				RuntimeObservation: out.RuntimeObservation,
427				Ownership:          CheckoutExternal,
428			}
429			if canonicalErr != nil {
430				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
431					Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: canonicalErr.Error(),
432				})
433			}
434			if worktree.Main {
435				checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
436					Kind: OwnershipEvidenceGitMain, Path: canonicalPath,
437				})
438			} else {
439				out.WorktreeCount++
440			}
441			out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
442		}
443	
444		enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx, out.Checkouts, opts.Limiter)
445		assignHarnessEvidence(&out)
446		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
447		if out.RuntimeObservation.Available() {
448			assignSessions(&out, opts.Sessions)
449		}
450		finishRepoContext(&out)
451		return out
452	}

454	func runtimeObservation(opts RepoContextOptions) TopologyObservation {
455		if opts.RuntimeErr != nil {
456			err := &RuntimeListError{Runtime: opts.Runtime, Err: opts.RuntimeErr}
457			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: err}
458		}
459		if opts.RuntimeObserved {
460			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
461		}
462		return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved}
463	}

465	func repoQueryPath(r repo.Repo) string {
466		for _, candidate := range []string{r.Path, r.RealPath, r.MainRoot, r.CommonDir} {
467			if candidate != "" {
468				return candidate
469			}
470		}
471		return ""

474	func canonicalRepositoryID(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, queryPath string) (string, error) {
475		commonDir := r.CommonDir
476		if commonDir == "" && r.Bare {
477			commonDir = queryPath
478		}
479		if commonDir == "" && queryPath != "" {
480			if discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, queryPath); err == nil {
481				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
482			}
483		}
484		if commonDir == "" {
485			err := fmt.Errorf("Git common directory is empty")
486			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
487		}
488		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
489		if err != nil {
490			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
491		}
492		return canonical, nil
493	}

495	func enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx context.Context, checkouts []RepoCheckout, limiter *Limiter) {
496		if limiter == nil {
497			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
498		}
499		var wg sync.WaitGroup
500		for i := range checkouts {
501			if checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare || checkouts[i].Worktree.Prunable || !checkouts[i].Exists {
502				continue
503			}
504			wg.Add(1)
505			go func(index int) {
506				defer wg.Done()
507				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
508				if !ok {
509					checkouts[index].StatusErr = ctx.Err()
510					return
511				}
512				defer release()
513				checkout := &checkouts[index]
514				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
515				checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(
516					ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status,
517				)
518			}(i)
519		}
520		wg.Wait()
521	}

524		mainRoot := ""

526			if out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Main && !out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare {
527				mainRoot = out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path
528				break
529			}

531		if mainRoot == "" {
532			return

541				continue

582	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
583		latest := status.LatestChange
584		var commit time.Time
585		var subject string
586		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
587			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
588			if commit.After(latest) {
589				latest = commit
590			}
591			subject = lastSubject
592		}
593		return latest, commit, subject
594	}

610	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
611		paths := map[string][]int{}
612		branches := map[string][]int{}
613		mainIndex := -1
614		for i := range out.Checkouts {
615			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
616			if checkout.ID != "" {
617				paths[checkout.ID] = append(paths[checkout.ID], i)
618			}
619			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" && !checkout.Worktree.Bare {
620				branches[branch] = append(branches[branch], i)
621			}
622			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
623				mainIndex = i
624			}
625		}
626	
627		for _, tracked := range sortedUniqueTasks(tasks) {
628			binding := TaskBinding{Task: tracked, Kind: TaskBindingUnbound}
629			mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
630			var recordedPathIssue *TopologyReason
631			if tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
632				canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(tracked.WorktreePath)
633				if err != nil {
634					reason := TopologyReason{Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: err.Error()}
635					recordedPathIssue = &reason
636				} else if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
637					if matches := paths[canonical]; len(matches) > 0 {
638						if len(matches) == 1 {
639							binding.Kind = TaskBindingExactPath
640							bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
641							continue
642						}
643						reason := TopologyReason{
644							Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
645							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s path matches %d registered checkout records", tracked.ID, len(matches)),
646						}
647						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
648						for _, index := range matches {
649							out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
650						}
651						appendOtherTask(out, binding)
652						continue
653					}
654				}
655				if mode != task.ModeWorktree {
656					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
657						Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
658						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
659							mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
660					})
661				}
662			}
663	
664			if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
665				matches := branches[tracked.Branch]
666				switch len(matches) {
667				case 1:
668					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMovedPath
669					binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, movedPathReason(tracked, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
670					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
671						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
672					}
673					bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
674					continue
675				case 0:
676					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
677						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
678					}
679					if tracked.WorktreePath != "" || taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
680						binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
681							Code:   ReasonWorktreePathMissing,
682							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no registered checkout for branch %s", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch),
683						})
684					}
685				default:
686					reason := TopologyReason{
687						Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
688						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s branch %s matches %d registered checkouts", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, len(matches)),
689					}
690					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
691					for _, index := range matches {
692						out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
693					}
694				}
695				appendOtherTask(out, binding)
696				continue
697			}
698	
699			if mainIndex >= 0 {
700				main := out.Checkouts[mainIndex]
701				if checkoutActionable(main) && main.Branch() == tracked.Branch {
702					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMainBranch
703					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
704						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
705					}
706					bindTask(out, mainIndex, annotateBoundTask(binding, main))
707					continue
708				}
709			}
710	
711			if recordedPathIssue != nil {
712				binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
713			}
714			for _, index := range branches[tracked.Branch] {
715				if index == mainIndex {

717				}

720					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s branch is checked out outside Git main at %s",

746	func sortedUniqueTasks(tasks []*task.Task) []*task.Task {
747		ordered := append([]*task.Task(nil), tasks...)
748		sort.SliceStable(ordered, func(i, j int) bool {
749			if ordered[i] == nil {
750				return false
751			}
752			if ordered[j] == nil {
753				return true
754			}
755			return ordered[i].ID < ordered[j].ID
756		})
757		seen := map[string]bool{}
758		out := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(ordered))
759		for _, tracked := range ordered {
760			if tracked == nil {
761				continue
762			}
763			if tracked.ID != "" && seen[tracked.ID] {
764				continue
765			}
766			if tracked.ID != "" {
767				seen[tracked.ID] = true
768			}
769			out = append(out, tracked)
770		}
771		return out
772	}

774	func movedPathReason(tracked *task.Task, checkout RepoCheckout) TopologyReason {

776			return TopologyReason{

778				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no recorded worktree path; branch %s is registered at %s",
779					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
780			}
781		}
782		return TopologyReason{
783			Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
784			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s records %s; branch %s is registered at %s",
785				tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
786		}

824				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
825				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
826					mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
827			})
828		}
829		if !taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
830			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
831				Code: ReasonUnexpectedCheckout,
832				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s still has registered checkout %s",
833					tracked.State, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
834			})
835		}
836		return binding

839	func taskExpectsCheckout(tracked *task.Task) bool {
840		if tracked == nil || tracked.State == task.Cold {
841			return false
842		}
843		if tracked.State == task.Done && tracked.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
844			return tracked.WorktreePath != ""
845		}
846		return true
847	}

849	func checkoutActionable(checkout RepoCheckout) bool {

853	func bindTask(out *RepoContext, index int, binding TaskBinding) {
854		checkout := &out.Checkouts[index]
855		binding.CheckoutID = checkout.ID
856		checkout.TaskBindings = append(checkout.TaskBindings, binding)
857		checkout.Tasks = append(checkout.Tasks, binding.Task)
858		if binding.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
859			checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
860				Kind: OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask, Path: checkout.ID,

871	func finalizeCheckoutClaims(out *RepoContext) {
872		for i := range out.Checkouts {
873			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
874			sort.SliceStable(checkout.TaskBindings, func(a, b int) bool {
875				return checkout.TaskBindings[a].Task.ID < checkout.TaskBindings[b].Task.ID
876			})
877			sort.SliceStable(checkout.Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
878				return checkout.Tasks[a].ID < checkout.Tasks[b].ID
879			})
880			if len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 1 {
881				ids := make([]string, len(checkout.TaskBindings))
882				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
883					ids[j] = checkout.TaskBindings[j].Task.ID
884				}
885				reason := TopologyReason{
886					Code:   ReasonMultipleTaskClaims,
887					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout is claimed by tasks %s", strings.Join(ids, ", ")),
888				}
889				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
890				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
891					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
892						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
893					)
894				}
895			}
896			if checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil && len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 0 {
897				reason := TopologyReason{
898					Code: ReasonHarnessTaskConflict,
899					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("checkout has Claude harness evidence and %d managed task claim(s)",
900						len(checkout.TaskBindings)),
901				}
902				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
903				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
904					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
905						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
906					)
907				}
908			}
909			for _, binding := range checkout.TaskBindings {
910				for _, reason := range binding.DriftReasons {
911					checkout.DriftReasons = appendReason(checkout.DriftReasons, reason)
912				}
913				for _, reason := range binding.ConflictReasons {
914					checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
915				}
916			}
917			checkout.Ownership = displayOwnership(*checkout)
918		}
919	}

921	func displayOwnership(checkout RepoCheckout) CheckoutOwnership {
922		if checkout.Worktree.Main {
923			return CheckoutCanonical
924		}
925		if checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil {
926			return CheckoutEphemeral
927		}
928		for _, evidence := range checkout.OwnershipEvidence {
929			if evidence.Kind == OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask {
930				return CheckoutDev
931			}
932		}
933		return CheckoutExternal

940			}
941		}
942		return append(reasons, candidate)

987	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
988	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
989	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
990	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
991		for _, session := range sessions {
992			assigned := map[int]bool{}
993			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
994				best, bestLen := -1, -1
995				for i := range out.Checkouts {
996					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Checkouts[i]) {
997						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(normalizePath(root)) > bestLen {
998							best, bestLen = i, len(normalizePath(root))
999						}
1000					}
1001				}
1002				if best >= 0 {
1003					assigned[best] = true
1004				}
1005			}
1006			for i := range assigned {
1007				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
1008			}
1009		}
1010	}
1011	
1012	func checkoutRoots(checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
1013		return []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
1014	}
1015	
1016	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
1017		if root == "" || path == "" {
1018			return false
1019		}
1020		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
1021		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
1022			return false
1023		}
1024		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
1025	}
1026	
1027	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
1028	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
1029	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
1030	// is not sufficient.
1031	func normalizePath(path string) string {
1032		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
1033			return canonical
1034		}
1035		return filepath.Clean(path)
1036	}
1037	
1038	// FormatRepoContext renders the deterministic Markdown used by both the CLI
1039	// and the TUI's yy binding. checkoutIndex < 0 means the whole repository.
1040	func FormatRepoContext(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
1041		var b strings.Builder
1042		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
1043			checkout := c.Checkouts[checkoutIndex]
1044			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev worktree context: %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout))
1045			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, false)
1046			return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"

406	func (m Model) acceptPlan(message planMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
407		if message.generation != m.planRequest.generation ||
408			message.repoKey != m.planRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey ||
409			message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey || message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
410			return m, nil
411		}
412		if m.planRequest.cancel != nil {
413			m.planRequest.cancel()
414		}
415		m.planRequest.cancel = nil
416		m.planRequest.loading = false
417		m.planRequest.err = message.err
418		m.overlay = overlayPlan
419		m.status = ""
420	
421		if message.plan.PlanID != "" {
422			m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
423			m.hasPlan = true
424		}
425		if message.err != nil {
426			m.planErr = message.err
427			return m, nil
428		}
429		if err := message.plan.Validate(); err != nil {
430			m.planErr = combineError("invalid plan returned by callback", err)
431			return m, nil
432		}
433		if message.plan.Locator != m.planTarget.locator {
434			m.planErr = errors.New("plan locator does not match the exact selected surface")
435			return m, nil
436		}
437		if message.plan.Action != m.planTarget.choice.Action() {
438			m.planErr = errors.New("plan action does not match the exact selected action options")
439			return m, nil
440		}
441		expected, err := taskflow.NewRequest(m.planTarget.locator, m.planTarget.choice.Options())
442		if err != nil {
443			m.planErr = combineError("selected action options are invalid", err)
444			return m, nil
445		}
446		if !reflect.DeepEqual(message.plan.Request.Options, expected.Options) {
447			m.planErr = errors.New("plan was built with different concrete action options than the selected choice")
448			return m, nil
449		}
450		m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
451		m.hasPlan = true
452		m.planErr = nil
453		if m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady && m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
454			m.confirm.SetValue("")
455			m.confirm.CursorEnd()
456			return m, m.confirm.Focus()
457		}
458		return m, nil
459	}
460	
461	func (m Model) acceptApply(message applyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
462		if !m.applyRunning || message.generation != m.applyGeneration ||
463			message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey || message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey ||
464			message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
465			return m, nil
466		}
467		m.applyRunning = false
468		m.overlay = overlayResult
469		m.lastResult = message.result.Clone()
470		m.hasLastResult = true
471		m.lastResultErr = message.err
472		m.status = ""
473		if remote, ok := message.result.RemoteObservation(); ok {
474			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
475		}
476		if message.err == nil {
477			if handoff, ok := message.result.Handoff(); ok {
478				m.finalHandoff = handoff
479				m.hasHandoff = true
480			}
481		}
482	
483		queuedQuit := m.queuedQuit
484		m.queuedQuit, m.queuedRefresh = false, false
485		updated, command := m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
486		m = updated.(Model)
487		if queuedQuit {
488			// The fresh generation is established before honoring the queued quit. It
489			// cannot authorize anything and the mutation ledger remains in final Model.
490			if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
491				m.loadRequest.cancel()
492				m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
493			}
494			m.quitting = true
495			return m, tea.Quit
496		}
497		return m, command
498	}

21	type PrepareRequest struct {

39	type Scanner func(context.Context, string, []string) error
40	
41	// Service coordinates Git with the durable intent store.
42	type Service struct {
43		Store      *Store
44		ScanStaged Scanner
45		LargeLimit int64
46	}
47	
48	// ReadinessState classifies one intent without changing its durable record.
49	type ReadinessState string
50	
51	const (
52		ReadinessPending              ReadinessState = "pending"
53		ReadinessFailed               ReadinessState = "failed"
54		ReadinessDiscarded            ReadinessState = "discarded"
55		ReadinessFinalizedReachable   ReadinessState = "finalized-reachable"
56		ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable ReadinessState = "finalized-unreachable"
57		ReadinessObservationError     ReadinessState = "observation-error"
58	)
59	
60	// IntentReadiness is the read-only finalization evidence for one intent whose
61	// recorded worktree is the exact checkout being inspected.
62	type IntentReadiness struct {
63		Intent           Intent
64		State            ReadinessState
65		Finalized        bool
66		ReceiptReachable bool
67		ObservationError error
68	}
69	
70	// ReadinessInspection is a complete read-only observation for one exact
71	// checkout. KnownEmpty is true only when the store was read successfully and no
72	// intent matched the checkout; it distinguishes absence from failed observation.
73	type ReadinessInspection struct {
74		Checkout         string
75		KnownEmpty       bool
76		Intents          []IntentReadiness
77		ObservationError error
78	}
79	
80	// Ready applies only the existing artifact finalization contract: an exact
81	// checkout is ready when it has no intents, or every intent was explicitly
82	// discarded or has a finalized receipt that is still reachable. Missing or
83	// incomplete evidence fails closed.
84	func (i ReadinessInspection) Ready() bool {
85		if i.ObservationError != nil {
86			return false
87		}
88		if len(i.Intents) == 0 {
89			return i.KnownEmpty
90		}
91		if i.KnownEmpty {
92			return false
93		}
94		for _, intent := range i.Intents {
95			if intent.ObservationError != nil {
96				return false
97			}
98			switch intent.State {
99			case ReadinessDiscarded:
100				// Discard is the existing explicit operator escape hatch.
101			case ReadinessFinalizedReachable:
102				if !intent.Finalized || !intent.ReceiptReachable {
103					return false
104				}
105			default:
106				return false
107			}
108		}
109		return true
110	}
111	
112	// InspectReadiness gathers artifact finalization evidence for one exact
113	// checkout. It never reconciles receipts, finalizes intents, or writes either
114	// source files or intent records. The returned inspection retains partial
115	// evidence and the same wrapped error returned separately to ordinary callers.
116	func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
117		inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
118		if ctx == nil {
119			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")
120			inspection.ObservationError = err
121			return inspection, err
122		}
123		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
124			inspection.ObservationError = err
125			return inspection, err
126		}
127		if store == nil {
128			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a store")
129			inspection.ObservationError = err
130			return inspection, err
131		}
132	
133		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
134		if err != nil {
135			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
136			inspection.ObservationError = err
137			return inspection, err
138		}
139		inspection.Checkout = canonical
140	
141		intents, err := store.List()
142		if err != nil {
143			err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
144			inspection.ObservationError = err
145			return inspection, err
146		}
147		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
148			inspection.ObservationError = err
149			return inspection, err
150		}
151	
152		for _, intent := range intents {
153			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
154				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
155				break
156			}
157			intentCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
158			if err != nil {
159				err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, err)
160				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
161				continue
162			}
163			if intentCheckout != canonical {
164				continue
165			}
166	
167			evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
168			switch intent.Status {
169			case Armed, Finalizing:
170				evidence.State = ReadinessPending
171			case Failed:
172				evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
173			case Discarded:
174				evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
175			case Finalized:
176				evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, canonical, intent)
177				switch {
178				case err != nil:
179					err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
180					evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
181					evidence.ObservationError = err
182					inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
183				case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
184					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
185				default:
186					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
187				}
188			default:
189				// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
190				// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
191				err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
192				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
193				evidence.ObservationError = err
194				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
195			}
196			inspection.Intents = append(inspection.Intents, evidence)
197		}
198	
199		inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
200		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
201	}
202	
203	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
204		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
205			return false, nil
206		}
207		candidates := []struct {
208			dir string
209			ref string
210		}{
211			{checkout, "HEAD"},
212			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
213			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
214		}
215		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
216		var observationErr error
217		for _, candidate := range candidates {
218			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
219				continue
220			}
221			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
222			if seen[key] {
223				continue
224			}
225			seen[key] = true
226			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
227				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
228			}
229			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
230				return true, nil
231			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
232				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
233					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
234			}
235		}
236		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
237			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
238		}
239		return false, observationErr
240	}
241	
242	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
243		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
244		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
245	}
246	
247	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
248		if current == nil {
249			return next
250		}
251		if next == nil {
252			return current
253		}
254		return errors.Join(current, next)
255	}

257	func (s *Service) Prepare(ctx context.Context, request PrepareRequest) (*Intent, error) {
258		if s.Store == nil {
259			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
260		}
261		provider, sessionID, err := ParseSession(request.Session)
262		if err != nil {
263			return nil, err
264		}
265		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, request.Worktree)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, err
268		}
269		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
270		if err != nil {
271			return nil, err
272		}
273		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
274			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires a named branch")
275		}
276		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
277			return nil, err
278		} else if active {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation refuses Git operation %s in progress", operation)
280		}

408	func artifactCommitReachable(intent artifact.Intent) bool {
409		refs := []struct {
410			dir string
411			ref string
412		}{
413			{intent.WorktreePath, "HEAD"},
414			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
415			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
416		}
417		for _, candidate := range refs {
418			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
419				continue
420			}
421			if _, err := gitx.Run(context.Background(), candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
422				return true
423			}
424		}
425		return false
426	}

428	func artifactStatuses(app *App) (map[string]string, error) {
429		intents, err := artifactStore(app).List()
430		if err != nil {
431			return nil, err
432		}
433		statuses := make(map[string]string)
434		priority := map[artifact.Status]int{artifact.Discarded: 1, artifact.Finalized: 1, artifact.Armed: 2, artifact.Finalizing: 3, artifact.Failed: 4}
435		for _, intent := range intents {
436			path, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
437			if err != nil {
438				continue
439			}
440			current := artifact.Status(statuses[path])
441			if priority[intent.Status] >= priority[current] {
442				statuses[path] = string(intent.Status)
443			}
444		}
445		return statuses, nil
446	}

232	func availableFlowRepository(discovered gitx.Repo, preferred *repo.Repo, focus string) (flowRepository, error) {
233		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(discovered.GitCommonDir)
234		if err != nil {
235			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository identity: %w", err)
236		}
237		mainRoot := discovered.MainRoot
238		if mainRoot == "" && discovered.Bare {
239			mainRoot = discovered.GitCommonDir
240		}
241		mainRoot, err = pathx.Canonical(mainRoot)
242		if err != nil {
243			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository root: %w", err)
244		}
245		focusTarget := ""
246		if focus != "" {
247			focusTarget, err = pathx.Canonical(focus)
248			if err != nil {
249				return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow focus: %w", err)
250			}
251		}
252	
253		r := repo.Repo{
254			Name: discovered.Name, Path: mainRoot, RealPath: mainRoot,
255			CommonDir: commonDir, MainRoot: mainRoot, Bare: discovered.Bare, HasGit: true,
256		}
257		name := discovered.Name
258		if preferred != nil {
259			if preferred.Name != "" {
260				r.Name = preferred.Name
261			}
262			r.Root = preferred.Root
263			r.Category = preferred.Category
264			name = preferred.Display()
265			if name == "" {
266				name = r.Name
267			}
268		}
269		return flowRepository{
270			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
271				RepoKey: commonDir, Name: name, Path: mainRoot, Available: true,
272				FocusTarget: focusTarget,
273			},
274			repository: r,
275			available:  true,
276		}, nil
277	}

279	func unavailableFlowRepository(record task.Record, cause error) flowRepository {

282			path = canonical
283		} else if absolute, absErr := filepath.Abs(path); absErr == nil {
284			path = filepath.Clean(absolute)
285		}
286		name := record.Task.Repo
287		if name == "" {
288			name = filepath.Base(path)

292			message += ": " + cause.Error()
293		}
294		return flowRepository{

298			},

301		}

255		cold := saveFlowTask(t, app.Tasks, task.Task{

302			seen[row.RowKey]++

309			t.Fatal(err)

311		if unavailableSnapshot.Repository.Available || unavailableSnapshot.Authoritative() || unavailableSnapshot.Surfaces.Len() != 1 ||
312			unavailableSnapshot.Surfaces.Values()[0].RowKey != missing.ID {
313			t.Fatalf("unavailable snapshot = %+v rows=%+v", unavailableSnapshot, unavailableSnapshot.Surfaces.Values())
314		}

323			t.Fatal(err)
324		}
325		for _, item := range []struct{ path, branch string }{
326			{managedPath, "feat/managed"}, {externalPath, "feat/external"}, {harnessPath, "worktree-turn-1"},
327		} {
328			if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), repository.Root, item.path, item.branch, "main"); err != nil {
329				t.Fatal(err)
330			}
331		}

333		app := newFlowTestApp(t, nil, rt)
334		saveFlowTask(t, app.Tasks, task.Task{
335			ID: "managed", Name: "managed", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root,
336			Branch: "feat/managed", Base: "main", WorktreePath: managedPath,
337			Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Warm,
338		})
339		loader := newFlowLoader(app, &flowStaticResolver{rt: rt}, repository.Root)
340		registered := registerFlowTestRepository(t, loader, repository.Root, managedPath)
341	
342		snapshot, err := loader.LoadRepository(context.Background(), registered.row.RepoKey)
343		if err != nil {
344			t.Fatal(err)
345		}
346		if snapshot.Surfaces.Len() != 4 {
347			t.Fatalf("surface count = %d, want every Git row exactly once", snapshot.Surfaces.Len())
348		}
349		byPath := map[string]flowtui.SurfaceRow{}
350		seen := map[string]int{}
351		for _, row := range snapshot.Surfaces.Values() {
352			seen[row.RowKey]++
353			byPath[row.Path] = row
354		}
355		for key, count := range seen {
356			if count != 1 {
357				t.Errorf("row %q appears %d times", key, count)
358			}
359		}
360		mainCanonical, _ := pathx.Canonical(repository.Root)
361		managedCanonical, _ := pathx.Canonical(managedPath)
362		externalCanonical, _ := pathx.Canonical(externalPath)
363		harnessCanonical, _ := pathx.Canonical(harnessPath)
364		for path, kind := range map[string]flowtui.SurfaceKind{
365			mainCanonical: flowtui.SurfaceCanonical, managedCanonical: flowtui.SurfaceManaged,
366			externalCanonical: flowtui.SurfaceUnmanaged, harnessCanonical: flowtui.SurfaceHarness,
367		} {
368			if row, ok := byPath[path]; !ok || row.Kind != kind {
369				t.Errorf("path %s row=%+v want kind=%s", path, row, kind)
370			}
371		}
372		assertFlowActionIDs(t, byPath[managedCanonical], "park-warm", "park-cold", "park-cold-push", "resume", "complete-ff", "review-handoff", "verify-merged", "remote-fetch", "remote-review", "remote-both")
373		assertFlowActionIDs(t, byPath[externalCanonical], "adopt", "remove-checkout", "remote-fetch", "remote-review", "remote-both")
374		assertFlowActionIDs(t, byPath[harnessCanonical], "remote-fetch", "remote-review", "remote-both")
375	
376		saveFlowTask(t, app.Tasks, task.Task{
377			ID: "managed-duplicate", Name: "duplicate", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root,
378			Branch: "feat/managed", Base: "main", WorktreePath: managedPath,
379			Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Hot,
380		})
381		saveFlowTask(t, app.Tasks, task.Task{
382			ID: "harness-claim", Name: "harness", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root,
383			Branch: "worktree-turn-1", Base: "main", WorktreePath: harnessPath,
384			Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Hot,
385		})
386		snapshot, err = loader.LoadRepository(context.Background(), registered.row.RepoKey)
387		if err != nil {
388			t.Fatal(err)
389		}
390		byPath = map[string]flowtui.SurfaceRow{}
391		for _, row := range snapshot.Surfaces.Values() {
392			byPath[row.Path] = row
393		}
394		if byPath[managedCanonical].Kind != flowtui.SurfaceConflict || !containsFlowLine(byPath[managedCanonical].Conflicts.Values(), "multiple-task-claims") {
395			t.Errorf("duplicate binding did not win as conflict: %+v", byPath[managedCanonical])
396		}
397		if byPath[harnessCanonical].Kind != flowtui.SurfaceConflict || !containsFlowLine(byPath[harnessCanonical].Conflicts.Values(), "harness-task-conflict") {
398			t.Errorf("harness/task conflict precedence = %+v", byPath[harnessCanonical])
399		}
400		assertFlowActionIDs(t, byPath[managedCanonical], "remote-fetch", "remote-review", "remote-both")
401		assertFlowActionIDs(t, byPath[harnessCanonical], "remote-fetch", "remote-review", "remote-both")
402	}

503		}{

506			{task.ModeWorktree, task.Cold, []string{"resume"}},
507			{task.ModeWorktree, task.Done, []string{"retire-keep-branch", "retire-delete-branch"}},

509			{task.ModeBranch, task.Warm, []string{"park-warm", "park-cold", "park-cold-push", "resume", "complete-ff", "review-handoff", "verify-merged"}},
510			{task.ModeBranch, task.Cold, []string{"resume"}},
511			{task.ModeBranch, task.Done, []string{"retire-keep-branch", "retire-delete-branch"}},
512			{task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, []string{"park-warm", "complete-direct"}},
513			{task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, []string{"park-warm", "resume", "complete-direct"}},
514			{task.ModeDirect, task.Cold, nil},
515			{task.ModeDirect, task.Done, []string{"retire-keep-branch"}},
516		}
517		for _, test := range tests {

531			})

536			t.Fatalf("unmanaged choices = %v", got)
537		}
538		for _, choice := range append(unmanaged, remoteFlowChoices()...) {
539			assertSafeFlowOptions(t, choice.Options())
540		}
541		remote := remoteFlowChoices()
542		if got := flowChoiceIDs(remote); strings.Join(got, ",") != "remote-fetch,remote-review,remote-both" {
543			t.Fatalf("remote variants = %v", got)
544		}

547	func assertSafeFlowOptions(t *testing.T, options taskflow.ActionOptions) {
548		t.Helper()
549		switch value := options.(type) {
550		case taskflow.ParkWarmOptions:
551			if value.CommitWIP || value.Push || value.KeepSession || value.CloseUnknown || value.AssumeNoRuntime {
552				t.Fatalf("unsafe ParkWarm options: %+v", value)
553			}
554		case taskflow.ParkColdOptions:
555			if value.CommitWIP || value.CloseUnknown || value.AssumeNoRuntime {
556				t.Fatalf("unsafe ParkCold options: %+v", value)
557			}
558		case taskflow.ResumeOptions:
559			if !value.FetchRefs || value.TakeOwnership || value.NoProvision {
560				t.Fatalf("unsafe Resume options: %+v", value)
561			}
562		case taskflow.CompleteDirectOptions:
563			if value.Dirty != taskflow.DirtyFail || value.CommitMessage != "" || value.Push {
564				t.Fatalf("unsafe CompleteDirect options: %+v", value)
565			}
566		case taskflow.CompleteFFOptions:
567			if value.Dirty != taskflow.DirtyFail || value.CommitMessage != "" || value.PushBase {
568				t.Fatalf("unsafe CompleteFF options: %+v", value)
569			}
570		case taskflow.ReviewHandoffOptions:
571			if value.Dirty != taskflow.DirtyFail || value.CommitMessage != "" {
572				t.Fatalf("unsafe ReviewHandoff options: %+v", value)
573			}
574		case taskflow.VerifyMergedOptions:
575			if value.Dirty != taskflow.DirtyFail || value.CommitMessage != "" || value.PushBase {
576				t.Fatalf("unsafe VerifyMerged options: %+v", value)
577			}
578		case taskflow.RetireOptions:
579			if value.CloseUnknown || value.AssumeNoRuntime {
580				t.Fatalf("unsafe Retire options: %+v", value)
581			}
582		case taskflow.AdoptOptions:
583			if value.Mode != task.ModeWorktree || value.Base == "" || value.Owner != "" || value.State != "" {
584				t.Fatalf("unsafe Adopt options: %+v", value)
585			}
586		case taskflow.RemoveCheckoutOptions:
587			if value.DiscardDirty || value.CloseUnknown || value.AssumeNoRuntime {
588				t.Fatalf("unsafe RemoveCheckout options: %+v", value)
589			}
590		case taskflow.RefreshRemoteOptions:
591			if !value.FetchRefs && !value.QueryReview {
592				t.Fatalf("empty remote options: %+v", value)
593			}
594		default:
595			t.Fatalf("unexpected flow options %T", options)
596		}
597	}

599	func TestFlowPlanApplyRequireExactRepositoryRowActionLocatorOptionsAndPlan(t *testing.T) {
600		rt := &flowTestRuntime{name: "flow-test", available: true}
601		app := newFlowTestApp(t, nil, rt)
602		resolver := &flowStaticResolver{rt: rt}
603		loader := newFlowLoader(app, resolver, t.TempDir())
604		var serviceBuilds, applies int
605		remote := taskflow.RemoteObservation{RemoteName: "origin", Head: "feat/exact", Base: "main"}
606		loader.service = func(got runtime.Runtime) (*taskflow.Service, error) {
607			serviceBuilds++
608			if got != rt {

12	func TestMigratedLifecycleHandlersUseTaskflowMutationBoundary(t *testing.T) {
13		files := map[string][]string{
14			"park.go":      {"executeTaskLifecycle(", "flow.ParkWarmOptions", "flow.ParkColdOptions"},
15			"resume.go":    {"executeTaskLifecycle(", "flow.ResumeOptions"},
16			"done_flow.go": {"session.plan(", "session.apply("},
17			"retire.go":    {"session.plan(", "session.apply(", "executeNonTaskLifecycle(", "flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions"},
18			"adopt.go":     {"executeNonTaskLifecycle(", "flow.AdoptOptions"},
19			"worktree.go":  {"executeNonTaskLifecycle(", "flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions"},
20			"sweep.go":     {"sweepTaskPlan(", "session.apply("},
21		}
22		for name, required := range files {
23			t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
24				source, err := os.ReadFile(name)
25				if err != nil {
26					t.Fatal(err)
27				}
28				text := string(source)
29				for _, boundary := range required {
30					if !strings.Contains(text, boundary) {
31						t.Errorf("%s does not use taskflow boundary %q", name, boundary)
32					}
33				}
34				for _, forbidden := range []string{
35					"Tasks.Save(", "Tasks.Update(", "Tasks.Delete(",
36					"gitx.RemoveWorktree(", "retirement.Service{", "retire.Service{",
37				} {
38					if strings.Contains(text, forbidden) {
39						t.Errorf("%s contains direct lifecycle mutation %q", name, forbidden)
40					}
41				}
42	
43				fileSet := token.NewFileSet()
44				parsed, err := parser.ParseFile(fileSet, name, source, 0)
45				if err != nil {
46					t.Fatal(err)
47				}
48				ast.Inspect(parsed, func(node ast.Node) bool {
49					assignment, ok := node.(*ast.AssignStmt)
50					if !ok {
51						return true
52					}
53					for _, expression := range assignment.Lhs {
54						selector, ok := expression.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
55						if ok && (selector.Sel.Name == "State" || selector.Sel.Name == "WorktreePath") {
56							t.Errorf("%s directly assigns lifecycle field %s at %s", name, selector.Sel.Name,
57								fileSet.Position(selector.Pos()))
58						}
59					}
60					return true
61				})
62			})
63		}

66	func TestDashboardLifecycleCallbacksKeepGuardedBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
67		source, err := os.ReadFile("tui.go")
68		if err != nil {
69			t.Fatal(err)
70		}

72		parkStart := strings.Index(text, "Park: func(")
73		setNextStart := strings.Index(text, "SetNext: func(")
74		startStart := -1
75		if setNextStart >= 0 {
76			if relative := strings.Index(text[setNextStart:], "Start: func("); relative >= 0 {
77				startStart = setNextStart + relative
78			}
79		}
80		if parkStart < 0 || setNextStart <= parkStart || startStart <= setNextStart {
81			t.Fatalf("could not isolate dashboard Park and SetNext callbacks")
82		}
83		park := text[parkStart:setNextStart]
84		for _, required := range []string{"executeTaskLifecycle(", "flow.ParkWarmOptions"} {
85			if !strings.Contains(park, required) {
86				t.Errorf("dashboard Park callback does not use %q", required)
87			}
88		}

588	func TestApplyErrorRetainsPartialLedgerWithoutOptimisticState(t *testing.T) {
589		row := managedSurface("row-partial", "task-partial", task.ModeWorktree, task.Hot, parkChoice("park"))
590		applyErr := errors.New("task write failed")
591		var planned taskflow.Plan
592		actions := Actions{
593			Plan: func(_ context.Context, _, _, _ string, locator taskflow.Locator, options taskflow.ActionOptions) (taskflow.Plan, error) {
594				planned = readyPlan(t, locator, options)
595				return planned, nil
596			},
597			Apply: func(context.Context, string, string, string, taskflow.Locator, taskflow.ActionOptions, taskflow.Plan, taskflow.Approval) (taskflow.Result, error) {
598				effects := planned.Effects()
599				return taskflow.NewResult(taskflow.ResultSpec{
600					Steps: []taskflow.StepResult{
601						{Effect: effects[0], Status: taskflow.StepCompleted, Detail: "runtime closed"},
602						{Effect: effects[1], Status: taskflow.StepFailed, Failure: applyErr.Error()},
603					},
604					Warnings: []string{"runtime was already absent"},
605					Recovery: []string{"reload the task revision before retrying"},
606				}), applyErr
607			},
608		}
609		model := openPlan(t, loadedModel(t, actions, freshSnapshot(row)))
610		model, applyCommand := press(t, model, "y")
611		model, reloadCommand := execute(t, model, applyCommand)
612		if reloadCommand == nil || model.overlay != overlayResult || !model.loadRequest.loading {
613			t.Fatalf("Apply completion did not start fresh local generation: overlay=%v loading=%v command=%v", model.overlay, model.loadRequest.loading, reloadCommand)
614		}
615		result, err, ok := model.LastResult()
616		if !ok || !errors.Is(err, applyErr) || !result.PartialSuccess || len(result.AttemptedSteps()) != 2 {
617			t.Fatalf("retained result ok=%v err=%v partial=%v steps=%d", ok, err, result.PartialSuccess, len(result.AttemptedSteps()))
618		}
619		current, _ := model.CurrentSnapshot()
620		if got := current.Surfaces.Values()[0].State; got != task.Hot {
621			t.Fatalf("model optimistically changed state to %s", got)
622		}
623		view := model.View()
624		for _, text := range []string{"APPLY ERROR", "PARTIAL SUCCESS", "[COMPLETED]", "[FAILED]", "runtime was already absent", "reload the task revision", "state was not changed optimistically"} {
625			if !strings.Contains(view, text) {
626				t.Errorf("result view missing %q:\n%s", text, view)
627			}
628		}
629		if _, ok := model.Handoff(); ok {
630			t.Fatal("failed Apply exposed a final handoff")
631		}
632	}

698	func TestApplyQueuesRefreshAndQuitWithoutCancelingMutation(t *testing.T) {
699		newActions := func(applyCalls *int) Actions {
700			return Actions{
701				Plan: func(_ context.Context, _, _, _ string, locator taskflow.Locator, options taskflow.ActionOptions) (taskflow.Plan, error) {
702					return readyPlan(t, locator, options), nil
703				},
704				Apply: func(ctx context.Context, _ string, _ string, _ string, _ taskflow.Locator, _ taskflow.ActionOptions, _ taskflow.Plan, _ taskflow.Approval) (taskflow.Result, error) {
705					*applyCalls++
706					if ctx.Err() != nil {
707						t.Fatalf("Apply context was canceled: %v", ctx.Err())
708					}
709					return taskflow.NewResult(taskflow.ResultSpec{}), nil
710				},
711			}
712		}
713	
714		t.Run("refresh", func(t *testing.T) {
715			calls := 0
716			row := managedSurface("row-queue", "task-queue", task.ModeWorktree, task.Hot, parkChoice("park"))
717			model := openPlan(t, loadedModel(t, newActions(&calls), freshSnapshot(row)))
718			model, applyCommand := press(t, model, "y")
719			generation := model.loadRequest.generation
720			model, refreshCommand := press(t, model, "r")
721			if refreshCommand != nil || !model.queuedRefresh || !model.applyRunning {
722				t.Fatalf("refresh was not queued: command=%v queued=%v running=%v", refreshCommand, model.queuedRefresh, model.applyRunning)
723			}
724			model, reloadCommand := execute(t, model, applyCommand)
725			if calls != 1 || reloadCommand == nil || model.loadRequest.generation <= generation || model.applyRunning {
726				t.Fatalf("queued refresh result calls=%d command=%v generation=%d->%d running=%v", calls, reloadCommand, generation, model.loadRequest.generation, model.applyRunning)
727			}
728		})
729	
730		t.Run("quit", func(t *testing.T) {
731			calls := 0
732			row := managedSurface("row-quit", "task-quit", task.ModeWorktree, task.Hot, parkChoice("park"))
733			model := openPlan(t, loadedModel(t, newActions(&calls), freshSnapshot(row)))
734			model, applyCommand := press(t, model, "y")
735			model, quitCommand := press(t, model, "q")
736			if quitCommand != nil || !model.queuedQuit || !model.applyRunning {
737				t.Fatalf("quit was not queued: command=%v queued=%v running=%v", quitCommand, model.queuedQuit, model.applyRunning)
738			}
739			model, finalCommand := execute(t, model, applyCommand)
740			if calls != 1 || finalCommand == nil || !model.quitting || model.applyRunning {
741				t.Fatalf("queued quit result calls=%d command=%v quitting=%v running=%v", calls, finalCommand, model.quitting, model.applyRunning)
742			}
743			if _, ok := finalCommand().(tea.QuitMsg); !ok {
744				t.Fatalf("queued quit command emitted %T", finalCommand())
745			}
746			if _, _, ok := model.LastResult(); !ok || model.loadRequest.generation == 0 {
747				t.Fatalf("queued quit discarded result or fresh generation: result=%v generation=%d", ok, model.loadRequest.generation)
748			}
749		})
750	}

70	// ReadinessInspection is a complete read-only observation for one exact
71	// checkout. KnownEmpty is true only when the store was read successfully and no
72	// intent matched the checkout; it distinguishes absence from failed observation.
73	type ReadinessInspection struct {
74		Checkout         string
75		KnownEmpty       bool
76		Intents          []IntentReadiness
77		ObservationError error
78	}

80	// Ready applies only the existing artifact finalization contract: an exact
81	// checkout is ready when it has no intents, or every intent was explicitly
82	// discarded or has a finalized receipt that is still reachable. Missing or
83	// incomplete evidence fails closed.
84	func (i ReadinessInspection) Ready() bool {
85		if i.ObservationError != nil {
86			return false
87		}
88		if len(i.Intents) == 0 {
89			return i.KnownEmpty
90		}
91		if i.KnownEmpty {
92			return false
93		}
94		for _, intent := range i.Intents {
95			if intent.ObservationError != nil {
96				return false
97			}
98			switch intent.State {
99			case ReadinessDiscarded:
100				// Discard is the existing explicit operator escape hatch.
101			case ReadinessFinalizedReachable:
102				if !intent.Finalized || !intent.ReceiptReachable {
103					return false
104				}
105			default:
106				return false
107			}
108		}
109		return true
110	}

112	// InspectReadiness gathers artifact finalization evidence for one exact
113	// checkout. It never reconciles receipts, finalizes intents, or writes either
114	// source files or intent records. The returned inspection retains partial
115	// evidence and the same wrapped error returned separately to ordinary callers.
116	func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
117		inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
118		if ctx == nil {
119			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")
120			inspection.ObservationError = err
121			return inspection, err
122		}
123		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
124			inspection.ObservationError = err
125			return inspection, err
126		}
127		if store == nil {
128			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a store")
129			inspection.ObservationError = err
130			return inspection, err
131		}
132	
133		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
134		if err != nil {
135			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
136			inspection.ObservationError = err
137			return inspection, err
138		}
139		inspection.Checkout = canonical
140	
141		intents, err := store.List()
142		if err != nil {
143			err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
144			inspection.ObservationError = err
145			return inspection, err
146		}
147		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
148			inspection.ObservationError = err
149			return inspection, err
150		}
151	
152		for _, intent := range intents {
153			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
154				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
155				break
156			}
157			intentCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
158			if err != nil {
159				err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, err)
160				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
161				continue
162			}
163			if intentCheckout != canonical {
164				continue
165			}
166	
167			evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
168			switch intent.Status {
169			case Armed, Finalizing:
170				evidence.State = ReadinessPending
171			case Failed:
172				evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
173			case Discarded:
174				evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
175			case Finalized:
176				evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, canonical, intent)
177				switch {
178				case err != nil:
179					err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
180					evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
181					evidence.ObservationError = err
182					inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
183				case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
184					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
185				default:
186					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
187				}
188			default:
189				// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
190				// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
191				err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
192				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
193				evidence.ObservationError = err
194				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
195			}
196			inspection.Intents = append(inspection.Intents, evidence)
197		}
198	
199		inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
200		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
201	}

203	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
204		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
205			return false, nil
206		}
207		candidates := []struct {
208			dir string
209			ref string
210		}{
211			{checkout, "HEAD"},
212			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
213			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
214		}
215		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
216		var observationErr error
217		for _, candidate := range candidates {
218			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
219				continue
220			}
221			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
222			if seen[key] {
223				continue
224			}
225			seen[key] = true
226			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
227				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
228			}
229			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
230				return true, nil
231			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
232				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
233					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
234			}
235		}
236		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
237			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
238		}
239		return false, observationErr
240	}
241	
242	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
243		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
244		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
245	}
246	
247	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
248		if current == nil {
249			return next
250		}
251		if next == nil {
252			return current
253		}
254		return errors.Join(current, next)
255	}

270		if err != nil {
271			return nil, err
272		}
273		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
274			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires a named branch")
275		}
276		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
277			return nil, err

280		}
281		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
282		if err != nil {
283			return nil, err
284		}
285		changes, err := statusPaths(ctx, repository.Root)
286		if err != nil {
287			return nil, err
288		}
289		var unrelated []string
290		for _, change := range changes {
291			if change.Staged {
292				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires an empty index; staged path: %s", change.Path)
293			}
294			if !isRecognizedArtifact(change.Path) {
295				return nil, fmt.Errorf("commit product changes before prepare; dirty path: %s", change.Path)
296			}

299		transcript, err := FindTranscript(repository.Root, provider, sessionID)

311		limit := s.LargeLimit

315		if !tracked && info.Size() > limit && !request.AllowLarge {

317		}
318		plans, err := normalizePlans(repository.Root, request.Plans)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		runID := request.RunID
323		if runID == "" {
324			runID = os.Getenv("DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID")

326		if runID == "" {

329		selected := make(map[string]bool, len(plans)+1)
330		relTranscript, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, transcript.Path)
331		selected[filepath.ToSlash(relTranscript)] = true
332		for _, plan := range plans {

336		filtered := unrelated[:0]

342		intent := &Intent{

344			RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, GitCommonDir: repository.GitCommonDir,
345			WorktreePath: repository.Root, Branch: status.Branch, Base: request.Base,
346			Head: head, PlanPaths: plans, UnrelatedArtifacts: filtered, AllowLarge: request.AllowLarge,
347		}
348		if err := s.Store.Create(ctx, intent); err != nil {

354	func (s *Service) ObserveSessionEnd(ctx context.Context, runID string, when time.Time) error {

368	func (s *Service) Finalize(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
369		if s.Store == nil {
370			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
371		}
372		intent, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
373		if err != nil {
374			return nil, err
375		}
376		lockDir := filepath.Join(intent.GitCommonDir, "dev-artifact-finalize")
377		var finalized *Intent
378		err = catalog.NewStore(lockDir).WithLock(ctx, func() error {
379			current, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
380			if err != nil {
381				return err
382			}
383			finalized, err = s.finalizeLocked(ctx, request, current)
384			return err
385		})
386		return finalized, err
387	}
