389	func (s *Service) finalizeLocked(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest, intent *Intent) (*Intent, error) {
390		if intent.Status == Finalized {
391			if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok && commit != intent.ArtifactCommit {
392				if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
393					return nil, err
394				}
395				return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
396			}
397			return intent, nil
398		}
399		if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok {
400			if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
401				return nil, err
402			}
403			return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
404		}
405		if s.ScanStaged == nil {
406			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scanner-missing", fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization requires a staged secret scanner"))
407		}
408		if err := s.revalidate(ctx, intent); err != nil {
409			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "git-drift", err)
410		}
411		if intent.SessionEndedAt.IsZero() && !request.WriterStopped {
412			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-unproven",
413				fmt.Errorf("finalization requires SessionEnd observation or explicit post-writer proof"))
414		}
415		transcript, err := FindTranscript(intent.WorktreePath, intent.Provider, intent.SessionID)
416		if err != nil {
417			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "transcript-missing", err)
418		}
419		if err := s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
420			candidate.Status = Finalizing
421			candidate.TranscriptPath = transcript.Path
422			candidate.FailureCode = ""
423			return nil
424		}); err != nil {
425			return nil, err
426		}
427		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
428			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
429		}
430		paths := append([]string{transcript.Path}, intent.PlanPaths...)
431		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, nil); err != nil {
432			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-not-empty", err)
433		}
434		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"add", "--"}, paths...)...); err != nil {
435			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "stage-failed", err)
436		}
437		cleanup := func() {
438			_, _ = gitx.Run(context.Background(), intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"reset", "--"}, paths...)...)
439		}
440		if err := s.ScanStaged(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
441			cleanup()
442			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scan-failed", err)
443		}
444		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
445			cleanup()
446			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
447		}
448		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
449			cleanup()
450			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
451		}
452		if err := stagedFilesMatch(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
453			cleanup()
454			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
455		}
456		message := fmt.Sprintf("chore: finalize %s agent session", intent.Provider)
457		trailers := fmt.Sprintf("Agent-Artifact-Session: %s:%s\nDev-Artifact-Intent: %s", intent.Provider, intent.SessionID, intent.ID)
458		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "commit", "-m", message, "-m", trailers); err != nil {
459			cleanup()
460			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "commit-failed", err)
461		}
462		commit, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
463		if err != nil {
464			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "receipt-failed", err)
465		}
466		if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, transcript.Path, commit); err != nil {
467			return nil, err
468		}
469		return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
470	}

472	func (s *Service) resolveIntent(request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
473		if request.IntentID != "" {
474			return s.Store.Get(request.IntentID)
475		}
476		if request.RunID != "" {
477			return s.Store.FindByRunID(request.RunID)
478		}
479		return nil, fmt.Errorf("finalize requires an intent or run id")
480	}

482	func (s *Service) revalidate(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
483		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
484		if err != nil {
485			return err
486		}
487		if repository.GitCommonDir != intent.GitCommonDir {
488			return fmt.Errorf("Git common-dir changed")
489		}
490		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
491		if err != nil {
492			return err
493		}
494		if status.Branch != intent.Branch || status.Detached {
495			return fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
496		}
497		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(intent.WorktreePath); err != nil {
498			return err
499		} else if active {
500			return fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
501		}
502		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
503		if err != nil {
504			return err
505		}
506		if head != intent.Head {
507			return fmt.Errorf("HEAD changed from %s to %s", intent.Head, head)
508		}
509		return nil
510	}
511	
512	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, id, code string, cause error) error {
513		_ = s.Store.Update(ctx, id, func(intent *Intent) error {
514			intent.Status = Failed
515			intent.FailureCode = code
516			return nil
517		})
518		return fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization %s: %w", code, cause)
519	}

522		return s.Store.Update(ctx, id, func(intent *Intent) error {
523			intent.Status = Finalized
524			intent.TranscriptPath = transcript
525			intent.ArtifactCommit = commit
526			intent.FailureCode = ""
527			return nil
528		})
529	}

531	type statusPath struct {
532		Path   string

536	func statusPaths(ctx context.Context, repo string) ([]statusPath, error) {
537		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
538		if err != nil {
539			return nil, err
540		}
541		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
542		var paths []statusPath
543		for i := 0; i < len(fields); i++ {
544			entry := fields[i]
545			if len(entry) < 4 {
546				continue
547			}
548			code, path := entry[:2], filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:])
549			paths = append(paths, statusPath{Path: path, Staged: code[0] != ' ' && code[0] != '?'})
550			if code[0] == 'R' || code[0] == 'C' {
551				i++ // porcelain -z emits the source path as the next field.
552			}
553		}
554		return paths, nil
555	}
556	
557	func isRecognizedArtifact(path string) bool {
558		path = filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(path, "./"))
559		for _, prefix := range []string{
560			".specstory/history/", ".claude/plans/", ".cursor/plans/", ".cursor/rules/",
561			".opencode/plans/", ".specify/", ".codex/",
562		} {
563			if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
564				return true
565			}
566		}
567		return path == ".specstory/statistics.json"
568	}
569	
570	func normalizePlans(root string, paths []string) ([]string, error) {
571		var out []string
572		for _, path := range paths {
573			if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
574				path = filepath.Join(root, path)
575			}
576			inside, err := pathx.Contains(filepath.Join(root, ".claude", "plans"), path)
577			if err != nil || !inside {
578				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is outside .claude/plans", path)
579			}
580			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
581			if err != nil {
582				return nil, err
583			}
584			info, err := os.Stat(canonical)
585			if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
586				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is not a regular file", path)
587			}
588			out = append(out, canonical)
589		}
590		sort.Strings(out)
591		return out, nil
592	}
593	
594	func gitTracked(ctx context.Context, repo, path string) (bool, error) {
595		rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
596		if err != nil {
597			return false, err
598		}
599		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", "--", rel)
600		if err == nil {
601			return true, nil
602		}
603		var gitErr *gitx.Error
604		if errors.As(err, &gitErr) {
605			return false, nil
606		}
607		return false, err
608	}
609	
610	func ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx context.Context, repo string, allowed []string) error {
611		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z")
612		if err != nil {
613			return err
614		}
615		allow := make(map[string]bool, len(allowed))
616		for _, path := range allowed {
617			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
618			allow[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
619		}
620		for _, path := range strings.Split(out, "\x00") {
621			if path != "" && !allow[filepath.ToSlash(path)] {
622				return fmt.Errorf("index contains unrelated path %s", path)
623			}
624		}
625		return nil
626	}
627	
628	func stagedFilesMatch(ctx context.Context, repo string, paths []string) error {
629		for _, path := range paths {
630			rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
631			if err != nil {
632				return err
633			}
634			workingBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "hash-object", "--", rel)
635			if err != nil {
636				return err
637			}
638			stagedBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "rev-parse", ":"+filepath.ToSlash(rel))
639			if err != nil {
640				return err
641			}
642			if workingBlob != stagedBlob {
643				return fmt.Errorf("staged artifact %s no longer matches scanned working bytes", filepath.ToSlash(rel))
644			}
645		}
646		return nil
647	}
648	
649	func findReceipt(ctx context.Context, repo, intentID string) (string, bool) {
650		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "log", "-n", "100", "--format=%H%x00%B%x00")
651		if err != nil {
652			return "", false
653		}
654		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
655		for i := 0; i+1 < len(fields); i += 2 {
656			if strings.Contains(fields[i+1], "Dev-Artifact-Intent: "+intentID) {
657				return fields[i], true
658			}
659		}
660		return "", false
661	}

3	import (

13	// Worktree is one entry of `git worktree list --porcelain`.
14	type Worktree struct {
15		Path string
16		// Head is the commit the worktree is checked out at.
17		Head string
18		// Branch is the short branch name, empty when detached.
19		Branch   string
20		Detached bool
21		Bare     bool
22		// Locked reports a `git worktree lock`; Prunable reports a checkout whose
23		// directory has gone missing. Both block a plain remove.
24		Locked         bool
25		LockedReason   string
26		Prunable       bool
27		PrunableReason string
28		// Main reports the primary (non-linked) checkout.
29		Main bool
30	}
31	
32	var (
33		// ErrWorktreeNotFound reports that Git's current registry has no worktree at
34		// the requested canonical path.
35		ErrWorktreeNotFound = errors.New("registered worktree not found")
36		// ErrWorktreeAmbiguous reports that multiple Git records resolve to the same
37		// canonical path. Callers must not choose one of the aliases implicitly.
38		ErrWorktreeAmbiguous = errors.New("registered worktree path is ambiguous")
39	)
40	
41	// RegisteredWorktree is an identity snapshot from Git's worktree registry.
42	// Worktree preserves the complete parsed Git record; the other fields are canonical
43	// filesystem identities suitable for exact comparison across symlink and macOS
44	// path aliases. A snapshot proves registration, not permission to remove it.
45	type RegisteredWorktree struct {
46		Worktree       Worktree
47		RepositoryPath string
48		GitCommonDir   string
49		Path           string
50	}
51	
52	// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether the record is a linked checkout rather than
53	// Git's main checkout or a bare repository. It is classification, not a removal
54	// safety decision.
55	func (w RegisteredWorktree) IsLinkedWorktree() bool {
56		return !w.Worktree.Main && !w.Worktree.Bare
57	}
58	
59	// ResolveRegisteredWorktree resolves exactPath against a fresh authoritative
60	// `git worktree list --porcelain` query for the repository containing repoPath.
61	// Matching is exclusively by canonical filesystem identity, never by branch.
62	// It performs no prune, removal, or other mutation.
63	func ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx context.Context, repoPath, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
64		worktrees, err := Worktrees(ctx, repoPath)
65		if err != nil {
66			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("query registered worktrees: %w", err)
67		}
68		commonDir, err := run(ctx, repoPath, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir")
69		if err != nil {
70			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve Git common directory: %w", err)
71		}
72		return resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees, commonDir, exactPath)
73	}
74	
75	func resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees []Worktree, commonDir, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
76		path, err := pathx.Canonical(exactPath)
77		if err != nil {
78			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize requested worktree %q: %w", exactPath, err)
79		}
80		canonicalCommonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
81		if err != nil {
82			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory %q: %w", commonDir, err)
83		}
84	
85		type match struct {
86			worktree Worktree
87			path     string
88		}
89		var (
90			repositoryPath string
91			matches        []match
92		)
93		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
94			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
95			if canonicalErr != nil {
96				return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize registered worktree %q: %w", worktree.Path, canonicalErr)
97			}
98			if worktree.Main {
99				repositoryPath = canonicalPath
100			}
101			if sameCanonicalPath(path, canonicalPath) {
102				matches = append(matches, match{worktree: worktree, path: canonicalPath})
103			}
104		}
105	
106		switch len(matches) {
107		case 0:
108			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrWorktreeNotFound, path)
109		case 1:
110			if repositoryPath == "" {
111				return RegisteredWorktree{}, errors.New("registered worktree query has no main repository record")
112			}
113			return RegisteredWorktree{
114				Worktree:       matches[0].worktree,
115				RepositoryPath: repositoryPath,
116				GitCommonDir:   canonicalCommonDir,
117				Path:           matches[0].path,
118			}, nil
119		default:
120			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s resolves to %d records", ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, path, len(matches))
121		}
122	}
123	
124	func sameCanonicalPath(left, right string) bool {
125		if left == right {
126			return true
127		}
128		leftInfo, leftErr := os.Stat(left)
129		rightInfo, rightErr := os.Stat(right)
130		return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && os.SameFile(leftInfo, rightInfo)
131	}
132	
133	// Worktrees lists every worktree of the repository containing dir, in git's
134	// own order: the main checkout first, then linked worktrees.
135	func Worktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]Worktree, error) {
136		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		var (
141			list []Worktree
142			cur  *Worktree
143		)
144		flush := func() {
145			if cur != nil {
146				list = append(list, *cur)
147				cur = nil
148			}
149		}
150		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
151			if line == "" { // records are blank-line separated
152				flush()
153				continue
154			}
155			key, val, _ := strings.Cut(line, " ")
156			switch key {
157			case "worktree":
158				flush()
159				cur = &Worktree{Path: val, Main: len(list) == 0}
160			case "HEAD":
161				if cur != nil {
162					cur.Head = val
163				}
164			case "branch":
165				if cur != nil {
166					cur.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(val, "refs/heads/")
167				}
168			case "detached":
169				if cur != nil {
170					cur.Detached = true
171				}
172			case "bare":
173				if cur != nil {
174					cur.Bare = true
175				}
176			case "locked":
177				if cur != nil {
178					cur.Locked, cur.LockedReason = true, val
179				}
180			case "prunable":
181				if cur != nil {
182					cur.Prunable, cur.PrunableReason = true, val
183				}
184			}
185		}
186		flush()
187		return list, nil
188	}
189	
190	// WorktreeFor finds the first worktree checked out on branch, if any. Git
191	// normally refuses duplicate branch checkouts, but --force can create them;
192	// identity-sensitive callers must use ResolveRegisteredWorktree instead.
193	func WorktreeFor(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) (Worktree, bool, error) {
194		list, err := Worktrees(ctx, dir)
195		if err != nil {
196			return Worktree{}, false, err
197		}
198		for _, w := range list {
199			if w.Branch == branch {
200				return w, true, nil
201			}
202		}
203		return Worktree{}, false, nil
204	}
205	
206	// AddWorktree creates a linked worktree at path.
207	//
208	// When branch already exists it is checked out; otherwise it is created from
209	// base. Passing an explicit base matters: without one git branches from the
210	// *current* HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on feature/A would
211	// silently inherit feature/A's commits.
212	func AddWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path, branch, base string) error {
213		exists := BranchExists(ctx, dir, branch)
214		args := []string{"worktree", "add"}
215		if exists {
216			args = append(args, path, branch)
217		} else {
218			args = append(args, "-b", branch, path)
219			if base != "" {
220				args = append(args, base)
221			}
222		}
223		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
224		return err
225	}
226	
227	// MoveWorktree relocates a linked worktree through Git so the shared
228	// administrative metadata keeps pointing at the checkout's new path. dir may
229	// be any checkout of the same repository.
230	func MoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, source, destination string) error {
231		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "move", source, destination)
232		return err
233	}
234	
235	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
236	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
237	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
238		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
239		if err != nil {
240			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current directory before removing worktree: %w", err)
241		}
242		inside, err := pathx.Contains(path, cwd)
243		if err != nil {
244			return fmt.Errorf("compare current directory with worktree %s: %w", path, err)
245		}
246		if inside {
247			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to remove worktree %s while the caller is inside it", path)
248		}
249		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
250		if force {
251			args = append(args, "--force")
252		}
253		args = append(args, path)
254		_, err = run(ctx, dir, args...)
255		return err
256	}
257	
258	// PruneWorktrees clears administrative entries for checkouts whose directories
259	// were deleted behind git's back.
260	func PruneWorktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {
261		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "prune")
262		return err
263	}
264	
265	// BranchExists reports whether a local branch of that name exists.
266	func BranchExists(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) bool {
267		if branch == "" {
268			return false
269		}
270		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+branch)
271		return err == nil
272	}
273	
274	// RefExists reports whether any ref or commit-ish resolves.
275	func RefExists(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) bool {
276		if ref == "" {
277			return false
278		}
279		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")
280		return err == nil
281	}

1	// Package retire coordinates destructive cleanup from outside the runtime and
2	// worktree being retired.
3	package retire
4	
5	import (
6		"context"
7		"fmt"
8		"os"
9		"sort"
10		"strings"
11		"time"
12	
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
15	)
16	
17	// Options controls only fail-closed observations. Caller protection and active
18	// agent states are never bypassable.
19	type Options struct {
20		CWD               string
21		CallerWorkspaceID string
22		CallerPaneID      string
23		CloseUnknown      bool
24		AssumeNoRuntime   bool
25		PollInterval      time.Duration
26		Timeout           time.Duration
27	}
28	
29	// Session is one runtime session that currently covers the target checkout.
30	type Session struct {
31		Runtime runtime.Session
32		Panes   []runtime.Pane
33		Mixed   []runtime.Pane
34	}
35	
36	// Inspection is a fresh view of every runtime surface covering a checkout.
37	type Inspection struct {
38		Target          string
39		Sessions        []Session
40		ClosedSessions  int
41		Blockers        []string
42		RuntimeUnknown  bool
43		CallerContained bool
44	}
45	
46	// Ready reports whether destructive cleanup may proceed.
47	func (i Inspection) Ready() bool { return len(i.Blockers) == 0 }
48	
49	// Inspect discovers covering sessions and applies caller, mixed-workspace, and
50	// agent-state safety policy.
51	func Inspect(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
52		runtimeName := ""
53		if rt != nil {
54			runtimeName = rt.Name()
55		}
56		if opts.CallerWorkspaceID == "" && runtimeName != "tmux" && runtimeName != "zellij" && runtimeName != "none" {
57			opts.CallerWorkspaceID = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
58		}
59		if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
60			switch runtimeName {
61			case "herdr":
62				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
63			case "tmux":
64				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
65			case "zellij", "none":
66			default:
67				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
68				if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
69					opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
70				}
71			}
72		}
73		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, target, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
74			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyCleanup,
75			CallerWorkspaceID: opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
76			CallerPaneID:      opts.CallerPaneID,
77			CloseUnknown:      opts.CloseUnknown,
78		})
79		if err != nil {
80			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect retirement occupancy: %w", err)
81		}
82		result := Inspection{Target: evidence.Target}
83		cwd := opts.CWD
84		if cwd == "" {
85			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
86			if err != nil {
87				return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve caller directory: %w", err)
88			}
89		}
90		if inside, compareErr := pathx.Contains(evidence.Target, cwd); compareErr != nil {
91			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("compare caller directory: %w", compareErr)
92		} else if inside {
93			result.CallerContained = true
94			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
95				fmt.Sprintf("caller is inside target checkout %s", evidence.Target))
96		}
97	
98		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
99			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve current %s runtime pane: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
100		}
101		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
102			return Inspection{}, evidence.SessionCoverageErr
103		}
104		if !evidence.SessionList.Supported {
105			return dedupe(result), nil
106		}
107		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
108			if !opts.AssumeNoRuntime {
109				return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("list %s runtime sessions: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.SessionList.Err)
110			}
111			result.RuntimeUnknown = true
112		}
113		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
114			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("list %s recognized agents: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
115		}
116		for _, observed := range evidence.Sessions {
117			result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, Session{
118				Runtime: observed.Runtime,
119				Panes:   observed.Panes,
120				Mixed:   observed.Mixed,
121			})
122			if observed.IsCaller {
123				result.CallerContained = true
124				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
125					fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", observed.Runtime.Handle))
126			}
127			if len(observed.Mixed) > 0 {
128				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
129					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s also contains %d pane(s) outside the target", observed.Runtime.Handle, len(observed.Mixed)))
130			}
131			for _, status := range coveringAgentStatuses(observed.Panes, observed.Runtime.AgentStatus) {
132				appendAgentStatusBlocker(&result, observed.Runtime.Handle, status, opts.CloseUnknown)
133			}
134		}
135		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
136			if !agent.Blocking {
137				continue
138			}
139			if agent.IsCaller {
140				result.CallerContained = true
141				if agent.SessionHandle != "" {
142					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
143						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", agent.SessionHandle))
144				} else {
145					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
146						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime pane %s contains the target checkout", agent.Activity.PaneID))
147				}
148				continue
149			}
150			if agent.SessionHandle == "" {
151				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
152					fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent in pane %s covers the target without a closeable runtime session", agent.Activity.PaneID))
153				continue
154			}
155			appendAgentStatusBlocker(&result, agent.SessionHandle, agent.Status, opts.CloseUnknown)
156		}
157		return dedupe(result), nil
158	}
159	
160	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
161	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
162	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
163		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
164		if err != nil {
165			return inspection, err
166		}
167		if !inspection.Ready() {
168			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
169		}
170		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
171			return inspection, nil
172		}
173		interval := opts.PollInterval
174		if interval <= 0 {
175			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
176		}
177		timeout := opts.Timeout
178		if timeout <= 0 {
179			timeout = 5 * time.Second
180		}
181		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
182		closed := make(map[string]bool)
183		for {
184			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
185			if inspectErr != nil {
186				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
187			}
188			if !fresh.Ready() {
189				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
190			}
191			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
192				inspection.Sessions = nil
193				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
194				return inspection, nil
195			}
196			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
197				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
198					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
199			}
200			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
201				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
202				if closed[handle] {
203					continue
204				}
205				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
206					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
207				}
208				closed[handle] = true
209				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
210			}
211			select {
212			case <-ctx.Done():
213				return inspection, ctx.Err()
214			case <-time.After(interval):
215			}
216		}
217	}
218	
219	func coveringAgentStatuses(panes []runtime.Pane, fallback string) []string {
220		set := make(map[string]bool)
221		for _, pane := range panes {
222			if pane.Agent != "" || pane.AgentSession != "" || pane.AgentStatus != "" {
223				set[strings.ToLower(pane.AgentStatus)] = true
224			}
225		}
226		if len(set) == 0 {
227			set[strings.ToLower(fallback)] = true
228		}
229		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
230		for status := range set {
231			out = append(out, status)
232		}
233		sort.Strings(out)
234		return out
235	}
236	
237	func appendAgentStatusBlocker(result *Inspection, handle, rawStatus string, closeUnknown bool) {
238		status := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawStatus))
239		switch status {
240		case "idle", "done":
241			// Eligible after all structural checks pass.
242		case "working", "running", "busy", "blocked", "waiting":
243			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
244				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has agent status %s", handle, status))
245		case "", "unknown":
246			if !closeUnknown {
247				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
248					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unknown agent status; pass --close-unknown from outside it", handle))
249			}
250		default:
251			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
252				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unrecognized agent status %s", handle, status))
253		}
254	}
255	
256	func dedupe(inspection Inspection) Inspection {
257		seen := make(map[string]bool)
258		out := inspection.Blockers[:0]
259		for _, blocker := range inspection.Blockers {
260			if !seen[blocker] {
261				seen[blocker] = true
262				out = append(out, blocker)
263			}
264		}
265		inspection.Blockers = out
266		return inspection
267	}
268

65	// Store is a directory of one-TOML-file-per-task.

67	// One file per task, rather than a single registry document, is a deliberate
68	// choice: the state directory is meant to be syncable across machines (it can
69	// simply be a git repo), and a shared central file would conflict on every
70	// parallel edit while separate files merge cleanly.
71	type Store struct{ Dir string }

74	// lock. It lets a lifecycle operation reload, revalidate and perform its final
75	// conditional write without another dev process changing task intent between

84	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
85	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
86		clean := func(s string) string {
87			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
88			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
89				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
90			}
91			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
92		}
93		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
94		if r == "" {
95			r = "repo"
96		}
97		if b == "" {
98			b = "branch"
99		}
100		return r + "__" + b
101	}

108	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {

155	// records retain the historical warning behavior; ListRecords exposes them as

157	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Task, error) {
158		records, diagnostics, err := s.ListRecords()

164		}

173	// file that could not be read or decoded. Directory-level failures are fatal.

175		return s.listRecordsUnlocked()
176	}

178	// listRecordsUnlocked implements both the public read-only inventory and the
179	// transaction-scoped inventory. Callers using it for mutation authority must
180	// hold the store lock through the guarded operation.
181	func (s *Store) listRecordsUnlocked() ([]Record, []Diagnostic, error) {
182		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
183		if err != nil {
184			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
185				return nil, nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
186			}
187			return nil, nil, err
188		}
189		var records []Record
190		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
191		for _, entry := range entries {
192			name := entry.Name()
193			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
194				continue
195			}
196			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
197			record, err := s.getRecordUnlocked(id)
198			if err != nil {
199				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
200					ID: id, Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err,
201				})
202				continue
203			}
204			records = append(records, *record)
205		}
206		sortRecords(records)
207		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
208		return records, diagnostics, nil
209	}

232		if operation == nil {

234		}

249		return tx.store.listRecordsUnlocked()
250	}

252	// Save performs the compatibility unconditional write inside a transaction.

260	// Create writes a task only when its derived ID is not already present.
261	func (tx *Tx) Create(t *Task) (*Record, error) {
262		if t == nil {
263			return nil, errors.New("create nil task")
264		}
265		candidate := cloneTask(*t)
266		if candidate.ID == "" {
267			candidate.ID = MakeID(candidate.Repo, candidate.Branch)
268		}
269		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
270			return nil, err
271		}
272		if _, err := os.Lstat(tx.store.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
273			return nil, fmt.Errorf("task %q: %w", candidate.ID, ErrAlreadyExists)
274		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
275			return nil, fmt.Errorf("check task %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
276		}
277		record, err := tx.store.saveUnlocked(&candidate)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, err
280		}
281		*t = cloneTask(candidate)
282		return record, nil
283	}
284	
285	// Update replaces a task only when the expected revision is still current.
286	func (tx *Tx) Update(t *Task, expectedRevision string) (*Record, error) {
287		if t == nil {
288			return nil, errors.New("update nil task")
289		}
290		candidate := cloneTask(*t)
291		if candidate.ID == "" {
292			candidate.ID = MakeID(candidate.Repo, candidate.Branch)
293		}
294		current, err := tx.store.getRecordUnlocked(candidate.ID)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		if current.Revision != expectedRevision {
299			return nil, &StaleRevisionError{
300				ID: candidate.ID, Expected: expectedRevision, Actual: current.Revision,
301			}
302		}
303		record, err := tx.store.saveUnlocked(&candidate)
304		if err != nil {
305			return nil, err
306		}
307		*t = cloneTask(candidate)
308		return record, nil
309	}
310	
311	// Delete removes a task unconditionally inside a compatibility transaction.
312	func (tx *Tx) Delete(id string) error {
313		return tx.store.deleteUnlocked(id)
314	}
315	
316	// DeleteIfRevision removes a task only while its revision remains current.
317	func (tx *Tx) DeleteIfRevision(id, expectedRevision string) error {
318		current, err := tx.store.getRecordUnlocked(id)
319		if err != nil {
320			return err
321		}
322		if current.Revision != expectedRevision {
323			return &StaleRevisionError{ID: id, Expected: expectedRevision, Actual: current.Revision}
324		}
325		return tx.store.deleteUnlocked(id)
326	}
327	
328	// saveUnlocked atomically persists t. The caller must hold the store lock.
329	func (s *Store) saveUnlocked(t *Task) (*Record, error) {
330		if t.ID == "" {
331			t.ID = MakeID(t.Repo, t.Branch)
332		}
333		if err := t.Validate(); err != nil {
334			return nil, err
335		}
336		now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
337		if t.Created.IsZero() {
338			t.Created = now
339		}
340		t.Updated = now
341	
342		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
343			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create state dir: %w", err)
344		}
345		var encoded bytes.Buffer
346		if err := toml.NewEncoder(&encoded).Encode(t); err != nil {
347			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
348		}
349		data := encoded.Bytes()
350	
351		// Write to a temp file and rename, so an interrupted write can never leave
352		// a half-parsed task behind.
353		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+t.ID+".*.tmp")
354		if err != nil {
355			return nil, err
356		}
357		defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
358		if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
359			_ = tmp.Close()
360			return nil, fmt.Errorf("write task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
361		}
362		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
363			return nil, err
364		}
365		if err := os.Chmod(tmp.Name(), 0o644); err != nil {
366			return nil, err
367		}
368		if err := os.Rename(tmp.Name(), s.path(t.ID)); err != nil {
369			return nil, err
370		}
371		return &Record{Task: cloneTask(*t), Revision: revisionFor(t.ID, data)}, nil
372	}
373	
374	// getRecordUnlocked reads a complete record without taking the mutation lock.
375	// Atomic rename makes concurrent reads see either the previous or next bytes.
376	func (s *Store) getRecordUnlocked(id string) (*Record, error) {
377		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
378		if err != nil {
379			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
380				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
381			}
382			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
383		}
384		var t Task
385		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &t); err != nil {
386			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
387		}
388		t.ID = id
389		return &Record{Task: t, Revision: revisionFor(id, data)}, nil
390	}
391	
392	// deleteUnlocked removes one record. The caller must hold the store lock.
393	func (s *Store) deleteUnlocked(id string) error {
394		err := os.Remove(s.path(id))
395		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
396			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
397		}
398		return err
399	}
400	
401	// revisionFor hashes the task ID, a NUL domain separator, and the exact bytes
402	// persisted in the task file. A byte-for-byte rewrite keeps the revision;
403	// any byte or filename-ID change produces a different optimistic token.
404	func revisionFor(id string, data []byte) string {
405		payload := make([]byte, 0, len(id)+1+len(data))
406		payload = append(payload, id...)
407		payload = append(payload, 0)
408		payload = append(payload, data...)
409		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(payload))
410	}
411	
412	func cloneTask(t Task) Task {
413		t.Tags = append([]string(nil), t.Tags...)
414		return t
415	}
416	
417	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
418	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
419	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather
420	// than a silent pick.
421	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
422		if ref == "" {
423			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty task reference: %w", ErrNotFound)
424		}
425		all, err := s.List()
426		if err != nil {
427			return nil, err
428		}
429		for _, t := range all {
430			if t.ID == ref || t.Branch == ref {
431				return t, nil
432			}
433		}
434		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
435		var hits []*Task
436		for _, t := range all {
437			hay := strings.ToLower(t.ID + " " + t.Name + " " + t.Branch + " " + t.Repo)
438			if strings.Contains(hay, needle) {
439				hits = append(hits, t)
440			}
441		}
442		switch len(hits) {
443		case 1:
444			return hits[0], nil
445		case 0:
446			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", ref, ErrNotFound)
447		default:
448			names := make([]string, len(hits))
449			for i, t := range hits {
450				names[i] = t.ID
451			}
452			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))
453		}
454	}
455	
456	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
457	//
458	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
459	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
460	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
461	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
462	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
463	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
464		all, err := s.List()
465		if err != nil {
466			return nil, err
467		}
468		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
469			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
470		}
471		var best *Task
472		var bestLen int
473		for _, t := range all {
474			root := t.WorktreePath
475			if root == "" {
476				root = t.RepoPath
477			}
478			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
479				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
480			}
481		}
482		if best == nil {
483			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
484		}
485		return best, nil
486	}
487	
488	// stateRank orders states so the inventory reads as an attention queue.
489	func stateRank(s State) int {
490		switch s {
491		case Hot:
492			return 0
493		case Warm:
494			return 1
495		case Cold:
496			return 2
497		case Done:
498			return 3
499		}
500		return 4
501	}
502	
503	// Sort orders tasks hot-first, then by most recently updated.
504	func Sort(ts []*Task) {
505		sort.SliceStable(ts, func(i, j int) bool {
506			return taskLess(*ts[i], *ts[j])
507		})
508	}
509	
510	func sortRecords(records []Record) {
511		sort.SliceStable(records, func(i, j int) bool {
512			return taskLess(records[i].Task, records[j].Task)
513		})
514	}
515	
516	func taskLess(left, right Task) bool {
517		rl, rr := stateRank(left.State), stateRank(right.State)
518		if rl != rr {
519			return rl < rr
520		}
521		if !left.Updated.Equal(right.Updated) {
522			return left.Updated.After(right.Updated)
523		}
524		return left.ID < right.ID
525	}

49	// Inspect discovers covering sessions and applies caller, mixed-workspace, and

51	func Inspect(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
52		runtimeName := ""
53		if rt != nil {
54			runtimeName = rt.Name()
55		}
56		if opts.CallerWorkspaceID == "" && runtimeName != "tmux" && runtimeName != "zellij" && runtimeName != "none" {

63			case "tmux":
64				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
65			case "zellij", "none":
66			default:
67				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")

76			CallerPaneID:      opts.CallerPaneID,

78		})

80			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect retirement occupancy: %w", err)
81		}

147				}

160	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
161	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
162	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
163		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
164		if err != nil {
165			return inspection, err
166		}
167		if !inspection.Ready() {
168			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
169		}
170		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
171			return inspection, nil
172		}
173		interval := opts.PollInterval
174		if interval <= 0 {
175			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
176		}
177		timeout := opts.Timeout
178		if timeout <= 0 {
179			timeout = 5 * time.Second
180		}
181		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
182		closed := make(map[string]bool)
183		for {
184			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
185			if inspectErr != nil {
186				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
187			}
188			if !fresh.Ready() {
189				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
190			}
191			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
192				inspection.Sessions = nil
193				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
194				return inspection, nil
195			}
196			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
197				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
198					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
199			}
200			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
201				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
202				if closed[handle] {
203					continue
204				}
205				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
206					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
207				}
208				closed[handle] = true
209				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
210			}
211			select {
212			case <-ctx.Done():
213				return inspection, ctx.Err()
214			case <-time.After(interval):
215			}
216		}
217	}
218	
219	func coveringAgentStatuses(panes []runtime.Pane, fallback string) []string {
220		set := make(map[string]bool)
221		for _, pane := range panes {
222			if pane.Agent != "" || pane.AgentSession != "" || pane.AgentStatus != "" {
223				set[strings.ToLower(pane.AgentStatus)] = true
224			}
225		}
226		if len(set) == 0 {
227			set[strings.ToLower(fallback)] = true
228		}
229		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
230		for status := range set {
231			out = append(out, status)
232		}
233		sort.Strings(out)
234		return out
235	}
236	
237	func appendAgentStatusBlocker(result *Inspection, handle, rawStatus string, closeUnknown bool) {
238		status := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawStatus))
239		switch status {
240		case "idle", "done":
241			// Eligible after all structural checks pass.
242		case "working", "running", "busy", "blocked", "waiting":
243			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
244				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has agent status %s", handle, status))
245		case "", "unknown":
246			if !closeUnknown {
247				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
248					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unknown agent status; pass --close-unknown from outside it", handle))
249			}
250		default:
251			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
252				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unrecognized agent status %s", handle, status))
253		}
254	}
255	
256	func dedupe(inspection Inspection) Inspection {
257		seen := make(map[string]bool)
258		out := inspection.Blockers[:0]
259		for _, blocker := range inspection.Blockers {
260			if !seen[blocker] {
261				seen[blocker] = true
262				out = append(out, blocker)
263			}
264		}
265		inspection.Blockers = out
266		return inspection
267	}

44		var scanned []string
45		service := &Service{Store: store, ScanStaged: func(_ context.Context, _ string, paths []string) error {
46			scanned = append([]string(nil), paths...)
47			return nil
48		}}
49		intent, err := service.Prepare(context.Background(), PrepareRequest{
50			Worktree: r.Root, Session: "claude:" + uuid, RunID: "run-finalize", Plans: []string{plan},
51		})
52		if err != nil {
53			t.Fatal(err)
54		}
55		if len(intent.UnrelatedArtifacts) != 2 {
56			t.Fatalf("unrelated artifacts = %q plans=%q", intent.UnrelatedArtifacts, intent.PlanPaths)
57		}
58		finalized, err := service.Finalize(context.Background(), FinalizeRequest{IntentID: intent.ID, Settle: time.Millisecond, WriterStopped: true})
59		if err != nil {
60			t.Fatal(err)
61		}
62		resolvedCurrent, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(current)
63		if err != nil {
64			t.Fatal(err)
65		}
66		if finalized.Status != Finalized || finalized.ArtifactCommit == "" || finalized.TranscriptPath != resolvedCurrent {
67			t.Fatalf("finalized intent = %+v", finalized)
68		}
69		if len(scanned) != 2 {
70			t.Fatalf("scanner paths = %v", scanned)
71		}
72		changed := r.Git("show", "--pretty=", "--name-only", "HEAD")
73		if !strings.Contains(changed, ".specstory/history/current.md") || !strings.Contains(changed, ".claude/plans/retire.md") {
74			t.Fatalf("artifact commit paths:\n%s", changed)
75		}
76		if strings.Contains(changed, "statistics.json") || strings.Contains(changed, "other.md") {
77			t.Fatalf("artifact commit included unrelated files:\n%s", changed)
78		}
79		message := r.Git("log", "-1", "--format=%B")
80		if !strings.Contains(message, "Agent-Artifact-Session: claude:"+uuid) || !strings.Contains(message, "Dev-Artifact-Intent: "+intent.ID) {
81			t.Fatalf("artifact commit trailers:\n%s", message)
82		}
83		before := r.Git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
84		if _, err := service.Finalize(context.Background(), FinalizeRequest{IntentID: intent.ID, Settle: time.Millisecond, WriterStopped: true}); err != nil {
85			t.Fatal(err)
86		}
87		if after := r.Git("rev-parse", "HEAD"); after != before {
88			t.Fatalf("retry created duplicate commit: before=%s after=%s", before, after)
89		}
90		r.Write("post-rewrite.txt", "rebased tree\n")
91		r.Git("add", "post-rewrite.txt")
92		r.Git("commit", "--amend", "--no-edit")
93		rewritten := r.Git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
94		if rewritten == before {
95			t.Fatal("test setup did not rewrite the artifact commit")
96		}
97		reconciled, err := service.Finalize(context.Background(), FinalizeRequest{IntentID: intent.ID})
98		if err != nil {
99			t.Fatal(err)
100		}
101		if reconciled.ArtifactCommit != rewritten {
102			t.Fatalf("rewritten receipt was not reconciled: got=%s want=%s", reconciled.ArtifactCommit, rewritten)
103		}
104	}

268	func TestConcurrentFinalizersShareCommonDirLock(t *testing.T) {
269		isolateGitConfig(t)
270		r := gittest.New(t)
271		uuid := "72b5c55e-d964-45cd-b040-cb29d0d7af05"
272		path := filepath.Join(r.Root, ".specstory", "history", "current.md")
273		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
274			t.Fatal(err)
275		}
276		writeTranscript(t, path, "Claude Code", uuid, "final")
277		store := NewStore(t.TempDir())
278		var scans atomic.Int32
279		service := &Service{Store: store, ScanStaged: func(context.Context, string, []string) error {
280			scans.Add(1)
281			time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
282			return nil
283		}}
284		intent, err := service.Prepare(context.Background(), PrepareRequest{Worktree: r.Root, Session: "claude:" + uuid, RunID: "concurrent"})
285		if err != nil {
286			t.Fatal(err)
287		}
288		var wg sync.WaitGroup
289		errs := make(chan error, 2)
290		for range 2 {
291			wg.Add(1)
292			go func() {
293				defer wg.Done()
294				_, finalizeErr := service.Finalize(context.Background(), FinalizeRequest{
295					IntentID: intent.ID, Settle: time.Millisecond, WriterStopped: true,
296				})
297				errs <- finalizeErr
298			}()
299		}
300		wg.Wait()
301		close(errs)
302		for finalizeErr := range errs {
303			if finalizeErr != nil {
304				t.Fatalf("concurrent finalize: %v", finalizeErr)
305			}
306		}
307		if scans.Load() != 1 {
308			t.Fatalf("scanner ran %d times, want one serialized finalization", scans.Load())
309		}
310		if count := r.Git("rev-list", "--count", "HEAD"); count != "2" {
311			t.Fatalf("concurrent finalizers created duplicate commits: %s", count)
312		}
313	}

315	func TestInspectReadinessClassifiesExactCheckoutIntents(t *testing.T) {
316		isolateGitConfig(t)
317		r := gittest.New(t)
318		reachable := r.Git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
319		r.Commit("orphan.txt", "orphaned receipt\n", "chore: orphan receipt")
320		unreachable := r.Git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
321		r.Git("reset", "--hard", "HEAD^")
322	
323		store := NewStore(t.TempDir())
324		createReadinessIntent(t, store, "intent-armed", r.Root, Armed, "")
325		createReadinessIntent(t, store, "intent-finalizing", r.Root, Finalizing, "")
326		createReadinessIntent(t, store, "intent-failed", r.Root, Failed, "")
327		createReadinessIntent(t, store, "intent-discarded", r.Root, Discarded, "")
328		createReadinessIntent(t, store, "intent-reachable", r.Root, Finalized, reachable)
329		createReadinessIntent(t, store, "intent-unreachable", r.Root, Finalized, unreachable)
330		createReadinessIntent(t, store, "intent-other", t.TempDir(), Armed, "")
331	
332		inspection, err := InspectReadiness(context.Background(), store, r.Root)
333		if err != nil {
334			t.Fatal(err)
335		}
336		if inspection.Checkout != r.Root || inspection.KnownEmpty {
337			t.Fatalf("inspection identity = %+v", inspection)
338		}
339		if len(inspection.Intents) != 6 {
340			t.Fatalf("exact-checkout intents = %d, want 6: %+v", len(inspection.Intents), inspection.Intents)
341		}
342		type wantEvidence struct {
343			state     ReadinessState
344			finalized bool
345			reachable bool
346		}
347		want := map[string]wantEvidence{
348			"intent-armed":       {state: ReadinessPending},
349			"intent-finalizing":  {state: ReadinessPending},
350			"intent-failed":      {state: ReadinessFailed},
351			"intent-discarded":   {state: ReadinessDiscarded},
352			"intent-reachable":   {state: ReadinessFinalizedReachable, finalized: true, reachable: true},
353			"intent-unreachable": {state: ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable, finalized: true},
354		}
355		for _, evidence := range inspection.Intents {
356			expected, ok := want[evidence.Intent.ID]
357			if !ok {
358				t.Errorf("unexpected intent evidence: %+v", evidence)
359				continue
360			}
361			delete(want, evidence.Intent.ID)
362			if evidence.State != expected.state || evidence.Finalized != expected.finalized ||
363				evidence.ReceiptReachable != expected.reachable || evidence.ObservationError != nil {
364				t.Errorf("%s evidence = %+v, want %+v", evidence.Intent.ID, evidence, expected)
365			}
366		}
367		if len(want) != 0 {
368			t.Errorf("missing classifications: %v", want)
369		}
370		if inspection.Ready() {
371			t.Fatal("pending, failed, and unreachable intents must block readiness")
372		}
373	
374		empty, err := InspectReadiness(context.Background(), store, t.TempDir())
375		if err != nil {
376			t.Fatal(err)
377		}
378		if !empty.KnownEmpty || len(empty.Intents) != 0 || !empty.Ready() {
379			t.Fatalf("successful empty observation = %+v", empty)
380		}
381	}

383	func TestReadinessInspectionReadyUsesFinalizationContract(t *testing.T) {
384		observationErr := errors.New("observation failed")
385		discarded := IntentReadiness{State: ReadinessDiscarded}
386		reachable := IntentReadiness{
387			State: ReadinessFinalizedReachable, Finalized: true, ReceiptReachable: true,
388		}
389		tests := []struct {
390			name       string
391			inspection ReadinessInspection
392			want       bool
393		}{
394			{name: "known empty", inspection: ReadinessInspection{KnownEmpty: true}, want: true},
395			{name: "unknown empty", inspection: ReadinessInspection{}},
396			{name: "discarded", inspection: ReadinessInspection{Intents: []IntentReadiness{discarded}}, want: true},
397			{name: "finalized reachable", inspection: ReadinessInspection{Intents: []IntentReadiness{reachable}}, want: true},
398			{name: "ready mixture", inspection: ReadinessInspection{Intents: []IntentReadiness{discarded, reachable}}, want: true},
399			{name: "pending", inspection: ReadinessInspection{Intents: []IntentReadiness{{State: ReadinessPending}}}},
400			{name: "failed", inspection: ReadinessInspection{Intents: []IntentReadiness{{State: ReadinessFailed}}}},
401			{name: "finalized unreachable", inspection: ReadinessInspection{Intents: []IntentReadiness{{State: ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable, Finalized: true}}}},
402			{name: "incomplete finalized evidence", inspection: ReadinessInspection{Intents: []IntentReadiness{{State: ReadinessFinalizedReachable}}}},
403			{name: "intent observation error", inspection: ReadinessInspection{Intents: []IntentReadiness{{State: ReadinessObservationError, ObservationError: observationErr}}}},
404			{name: "global observation error", inspection: ReadinessInspection{ObservationError: observationErr}},
405			{name: "contradictory empty", inspection: ReadinessInspection{KnownEmpty: true, Intents: []IntentReadiness{discarded}}},
406		}
407		for _, test := range tests {
408			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
409				if got := test.inspection.Ready(); got != test.want {
410					t.Errorf("Ready() = %v, want %v", got, test.want)
411				}
412			})
413		}
414	}

416	func TestInspectReadinessIsByteForByteReadOnly(t *testing.T) {
417		isolateGitConfig(t)
418		r := gittest.New(t)
419		const intentID = "intent-read-only"
420		transcript := r.Write(".specstory/history/session.md", "final transcript bytes\n")
421		plan := r.Write(".claude/plans/finish.md", "# exact plan bytes\n")
422		r.Git("add", ".specstory/history/session.md", ".claude/plans/finish.md")
423		r.Git("commit", "-m", "chore: artifact receipt", "-m", "Dev-Artifact-Intent: "+intentID)
424		recordedReceipt := r.Git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
425	
426		store := NewStore(t.TempDir())
427		createReadinessIntent(t, store, intentID, r.Root, Finalized, recordedReceipt)
428		if err := store.Update(context.Background(), intentID, func(intent *Intent) error {
429			intent.TranscriptPath = transcript
430			intent.PlanPaths = []string{plan}
431			return nil
432		}); err != nil {
433			t.Fatal(err)
434		}
435	
436		marker := r.Write("rewrite-marker.txt", "rewritten receipt\n")
437		r.Git("add", "rewrite-marker.txt")
438		r.Git("commit", "--amend", "--no-edit")
439		currentReceipt := r.Git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
440		if currentReceipt == recordedReceipt {
441			t.Fatal("test setup did not rewrite the receipt")
442		}
443		if message := r.Git("log", "-1", "--format=%B"); !strings.Contains(message, "Dev-Artifact-Intent: "+intentID) {
444			t.Fatalf("rewritten receipt lost intent trailer:\n%s", message)
445		}
446	
447		readBytes := func(path string) []byte {
448			t.Helper()
449			body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
450			if err != nil {
451				t.Fatal(err)
452			}
453			return body
454		}
455		sources := []string{transcript, plan, marker}
456		beforeSources := make(map[string][]byte, len(sources))
457		for _, path := range sources {
458			beforeSources[path] = readBytes(path)
459		}
460		intentPath := store.path(intentID)
461		beforeIntent := readBytes(intentPath)
462		beforeStatus := r.Git("status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all")
463	
464		inspection, err := InspectReadiness(context.Background(), store, r.Root)
465		if err != nil {
466			t.Fatal(err)
467		}
468		if len(inspection.Intents) != 1 || inspection.Intents[0].State != ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable || inspection.Ready() {
469			t.Fatalf("stale receipt inspection = %+v", inspection)
470		}
471		if inspection.Intents[0].Intent.ArtifactCommit != recordedReceipt {
472			t.Fatalf("inspection reconciled receipt in memory: %s", inspection.Intents[0].Intent.ArtifactCommit)
473		}
474		for path, before := range beforeSources {
475			if after := readBytes(path); !bytes.Equal(after, before) {
476				t.Errorf("source file %s changed during inspection", path)
477			}
478		}
479		if after := readBytes(intentPath); !bytes.Equal(after, beforeIntent) {
480			t.Fatal("intent record changed during inspection")
481		}
482		if after := r.Git("rev-parse", "HEAD"); after != currentReceipt {
483			t.Fatalf("inspection changed HEAD: got %s want %s", after, currentReceipt)
484		}
485		if after := r.Git("status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"); after != beforeStatus {
486			t.Fatalf("inspection changed index or working tree: before=%q after=%q", beforeStatus, after)
487		}
488		stored, err := store.Get(intentID)
489		if err != nil {
490			t.Fatal(err)
491		}
492		if stored.ArtifactCommit != recordedReceipt {
493			t.Fatalf("inspection reconciled durable receipt: got %s want %s", stored.ArtifactCommit, recordedReceipt)
494		}
495	}

506			var syntaxErr *json.SyntaxError
507			if err == nil || !errors.As(err, &syntaxErr) {
508				t.Fatalf("list error was not retained: %v", err)
509			}
510			syntaxErr = nil
511			if !errors.As(inspection.ObservationError, &syntaxErr) || inspection.KnownEmpty || inspection.Ready() {
512				t.Fatalf("list observation = %+v", inspection)
513			}
514			if after, readErr := os.ReadFile(path); readErr != nil || !bytes.Equal(after, body) {
515				t.Fatalf("failed list changed record: bytes=%q err=%v", after, readErr)
516			}
517		})
518	
519		t.Run("receipt", func(t *testing.T) {
520			isolateGitConfig(t)
521			r := gittest.New(t)
522			store := NewStore(t.TempDir())
523			createReadinessIntent(t, store, "intent-bad-receipt", r.Root, Finalized, "not-a-commit")
524			inspection, err := InspectReadiness(context.Background(), store, r.Root)
525			var gitErr *gitx.Error
526			if err == nil || !errors.As(err, &gitErr) {
527				t.Fatalf("receipt error was not retained: %v", err)
528			}
529			if len(inspection.Intents) != 1 {
530				t.Fatalf("receipt evidence = %+v", inspection)
531			}
532			evidence := inspection.Intents[0]
533			gitErr = nil
534			if evidence.State != ReadinessObservationError || !evidence.Finalized || evidence.ReceiptReachable ||
535				!errors.As(evidence.ObservationError, &gitErr) || inspection.Ready() {
536				t.Fatalf("receipt observation = %+v", inspection)
537			}
538		})
539	
540		t.Run("canceled context", func(t *testing.T) {
541			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
542			cancel()
543			inspection, err := InspectReadiness(ctx, NewStore(t.TempDir()), t.TempDir())
544			if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || !errors.Is(inspection.ObservationError, context.Canceled) ||
545				inspection.KnownEmpty || inspection.Ready() {
546				t.Fatalf("canceled observation = %+v, %v", inspection, err)
547			}
548		})
549	}

551	func createReadinessIntent(t *testing.T, store *Store, id, checkout string, status Status, artifactCommit string) Intent {
552		t.Helper()
553		store.newID = func() string { return id }
554		intent := &Intent{

556			RepoPath: checkout, GitCommonDir: filepath.Join(checkout, ".git"), WorktreePath: checkout,
557			Branch: "main", Base: "main", Head: "[REDACTED:sourcegraph-access-token]",
558		}
559		if err := store.Create(context.Background(), intent); err != nil {
560			t.Fatal(err)
561		}
562		if status != Armed || artifactCommit != "" {
563			if err := store.Update(context.Background(), intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
564				candidate.Status = status
565				candidate.ArtifactCommit = artifactCommit
566				if status == Failed {
567					candidate.FailureCode = "test-failure"
568				}
569				return nil
570			}); err != nil {
571				t.Fatal(err)
572			}
573		}
574		stored, err := store.Get(intent.ID)
575		if err != nil {
576			t.Fatal(err)
577		}
578		return *stored
579	}

24	// harness runs dev commands against an isolated HOME, config and scan root.
25	type harness struct {
26		t          *testing.T
27		home       string
28		configPath string
29		scanRoot   string
30		wtRoot     string
31		repo       *gittest.Repo
32	}
33	
34	func newHarness(t *testing.T) *harness {
35		t.Helper()
36		home := t.TempDir()
37		scanRoot := filepath.Join(home, "Program")
38		wtRoot := filepath.Join(home, "Worktrees")
39		if err := os.MkdirAll(scanRoot, 0o755); err != nil {
40			t.Fatal(err)
41		}
42	
43		// A repo inside the scan root, so `dev` discovers it the way it would in
44		// real use rather than via an absolute path.
45		r := gittest.New(t)
46		dest := filepath.Join(scanRoot, "demo")
47		if err := os.Rename(r.Root, dest); err != nil {
48			t.Fatal(err)
49		}
50		r.Root = dest
51	
52		// Isolate every path dev touches from the developer's real machine.
53		t.Setenv("HOME", home)
54		t.Setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share"))
55		t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".config"))
56		t.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".cache"))
57		gitConfig := "[user]\n\temail = dev@example.test\n\tname = dev test\n[init]\n\tdefaultBranch = main\n"
58		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(home, ".gitconfig"), []byte(gitConfig), 0o644); err != nil {
59			t.Fatal(err)
60		}
61	
62		configPath := filepath.Join(home, "config.toml")
63		// TOML basic strings treat backslash as an escape, so a Windows path like
64		// C:\Users\... is invalid there. Forward slashes are valid TOML and Go
65		// normalizes them back to the OS separator on use.
66		slash := filepath.ToSlash
67		cfg := "" +
68			"[paths]\n" +
69			"scan_roots = [\"" + slash(scanRoot) + "\"]\n" +
70			"project_root = \"" + slash(scanRoot) + "\"\n" +
71			"tries_root = \"" + slash(filepath.Join(home, "tries")) + "\"\n" +
72			"worktree_root = \"" + slash(wtRoot) + "\"\n" +
73			"state_dir = \"" + slash(filepath.Join(home, "state")) + "\"\n" +
74			"\n[runtime]\nbackend = \"none\"\n" +
75			"\n[worktree]\ninclude = [\".env\"]\npost_create = []\n"
76		if err := os.WriteFile(configPath, []byte(cfg), 0o644); err != nil {
77			t.Fatal(err)
78		}
79		return &harness{t: t, home: home, configPath: configPath, scanRoot: scanRoot, wtRoot: wtRoot, repo: r}
80	}

82	// run executes one dev invocation, capturing its output. Commands write
83	// through App, so the writers passed to NewRootCommandWithIO are all that is
84	// needed — no file-descriptor juggling.
85	func (h *harness) run(args ...string) (string, string, error) {
86		h.t.Helper()
87		var out, errBuf bytes.Buffer
88		root := cli.NewRootCommandWithIO(&out, &errBuf)
89		root.SetArgs(append([]string{"--config", h.configPath}, args...))
90		err := root.Execute()
91		return out.String(), errBuf.String(), err
92	}
93	
94	func (h *harness) mustRun(args ...string) string {
95		h.t.Helper()
96		out, errOut, err := h.run(args...)
97		if err != nil {
98			h.t.Fatalf("dev %s: %v\nstderr: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), err, errOut)
99		}
100		return out
101	}

103	func TestLifecycleEndToEnd(t *testing.T) {
104		h := newHarness(t)
105	
106		// An empty inventory should tell the user how to start, not print nothing.
107		out := h.mustRun("ls")
108		if !strings.Contains(out, "No tasks yet") {
109			t.Errorf("empty ls output: %q", out)
110		}
111	
112		// start: branch + worktree + task entry.
113		out = h.mustRun("start", "demo", "--task", "auth", "--branch", "feat/auth", "--base", "main")
114		if !strings.Contains(out, "feat/auth") {
115			t.Fatalf("start output: %q", out)
116		}
117		wtPath := filepath.Join(h.wtRoot, "demo", "feat-auth")
118		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(wtPath, "README.md")); err != nil {
119			t.Fatalf("worktree should exist at the templated path: %v", err)
120		}
121	
122		// The task appears in the inventory as hot.
123		out = h.mustRun("ls")
124		if !strings.Contains(out, "auth") || !strings.Contains(out, "HOT") {
125			t.Errorf("ls after start: %q", out)
126		}
127	
128		// JSON is a stable contract for other tools.
129		out = h.mustRun("ls", "--json")
130		var rows []map[string]any
131		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &rows); err != nil {
132			t.Fatalf("ls --json is not valid JSON: %v\n%s", err, out)
133		}
134		if len(rows) != 1 {
135			t.Fatalf("want 1 row, got %d", len(rows))
136		}
137		if rows[0]["branch"] != "feat/auth" || rows[0]["state"] != "hot" {
138			t.Errorf("json row: %+v", rows[0])
139		}
140	
141		// park: records the next action, closes the session, keeps the worktree.
142		out = h.mustRun("park", "feat/auth", "--next", "add the regression test")
143		if !strings.Contains(out, "WARM") {
144			t.Errorf("park output: %q", out)
145		}
146		out = h.mustRun("ls")
147		if !strings.Contains(out, "WARM") || !strings.Contains(out, "add the regression test") {
148			t.Errorf("ls after park: %q", out)
149		}
150		if _, err := os.Stat(wtPath); err != nil {
151			t.Error("a warm task keeps its worktree")
152		}
153	
154		// resume: back to hot.
155		out = h.mustRun("resume", "auth")
156		if !strings.Contains(out, "feat/auth") {
157			t.Errorf("resume output: %q", out)
158		}
159		out = h.mustRun("ls")
160		if !strings.Contains(out, "HOT") {
161			t.Errorf("ls after resume: %q", out)
162		}
163	
164		// Commit something on the branch so there is work to integrate.
165		h.repo.GitIn(wtPath, "config", "user.email", "dev@example.test")
166		h.repo.GitIn(wtPath, "config", "user.name", "dev test")
167		os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(wtPath, "auth.go"), []byte("package auth\n"), 0o644)
168		h.repo.GitIn(wtPath, "add", "auth.go")
169		h.repo.GitIn(wtPath, "commit", "-m", "feat: add auth")
170	
171		// done --ff integrates but leaves physical cleanup to an external retire.
172		out = h.mustRun("done", "auth", "--ff")
173		if !strings.Contains(out, "merged into main") || !strings.Contains(out, "cleanup pending") {
174			t.Fatalf("done output: %q", out)
175		}
176		if _, err := os.Stat(wtPath); err != nil {
177			t.Fatalf("done should keep the worktree: %v", err)
178		}
179		// The commit is on main, and the history stayed linear.
180		if _, err := gitx.Run(gittest.Ctx(), h.repo.Root, "cat-file", "-e", "main:auth.go"); err != nil {
181			t.Error("the branch's commit should be on main")
182		}
183		merges, _ := gitx.Run(gittest.Ctx(), h.repo.Root, "log", "--merges", "--oneline")
184		if merges != "" {
185			t.Errorf("--ff must not create a merge commit, got:\n%s", merges)
186		}
187		// The branch survives by default: merged is not always finished.
188		if !gitx.BranchExists(gittest.Ctx(), h.repo.Root, "feat/auth") {
189			t.Error("the branch should survive without --delete-branch")
190		}
191	
192		// Sweep reports cleanup pending; retire performs it from outside the target.
193		out = h.mustRun("sweep")
194		if !strings.Contains(out, "retire runtime/worktree") {
195			t.Errorf("sweep should offer to retire a done task: %q", out)
196		}
197		out = h.mustRun("retire", "auth")
198		if !strings.Contains(out, "RETIRED") {
199			t.Fatalf("retire output: %q", out)
200		}
201		if _, err := os.Stat(wtPath); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
202			t.Error("retire should remove the worktree")
203		}
204		if inventory := h.mustRun("ls", "--json"); strings.Contains(inventory, `"name": "auth"`) {
205			t.Fatalf("retired task remained in inventory: %s", inventory)
206		}
207	}

375	func TestTryAndGraduate(t *testing.T) {
376		h := newHarness(t)
377	
378		out := h.mustRun("try", "redis-streams")
379		if !strings.Contains(out, "redis-streams") {
380			t.Fatalf("try output: %q", out)
381		}
382		triesRoot := filepath.Join(h.home, "tries")
383		entries, _ := os.ReadDir(triesRoot)
384		if len(entries) != 1 {
385			t.Fatalf("want one try directory, got %d", len(entries))
386		}
387		tryName := entries[0].Name()
388		if !strings.HasSuffix(tryName, "-redis-streams") || len(tryName) < 21 {
389			t.Errorf("a try should be date-prefixed, got %q", tryName)
390		}
391	
392		// A second `try` with the same name reuses the existing directory rather
393		// than creating a near-duplicate.
394		h.mustRun("try", "redis-streams")
395		entries, _ = os.ReadDir(triesRoot)
396		if len(entries) != 1 {
397			t.Errorf("try should reuse an existing match, got %d directories", len(entries))
398		}
399	
400		out = h.mustRun("graduate", "redis-streams", "--category", "Infra")
401		if !strings.Contains(out, "is now a project") {
402			t.Fatalf("graduate output: %q", out)
403		}
404		dest := filepath.Join(h.scanRoot, "Infra", "redis-streams")
405		if _, err := os.Stat(dest); err != nil {
406			t.Fatalf("graduated project should exist at %s: %v", dest, err)
407		}
408		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(triesRoot, tryName)); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
409			t.Error("the try directory should have been moved, not copied")
410		}
411		// The date prefix is dropped, and it is a repo with history.
412		if _, _, err := gitx.LastCommit(gittest.Ctx(), dest); err != nil {
413			t.Errorf("a graduated project should have a commit: %v", err)
414		}
415	}

633			t.Fatal(err)
634		}
635		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(h.home, ".agents", ".skill-lock.json"), []byte(`{
636	  "version": 3,
637	  "skills": {
638	    "shared": {
639	      "source": "owner/repo/skills",
640	      "sourceType": "github",
641	      "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/owner/repo.git",
642	      "skillPath": "skills/shared/SKILL.md",
643	      "skillFolderHash": "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"
644	    }
645	  }
646	}
647	`), 0o644); err != nil {
648			t.Fatal(err)
649		}
650	
651		bin := t.TempDir()
652		script := `#!/bin/sh
653	if [ "$1" = "--version" ]; then
654	  echo 1.5.23
655	  exit 0
656	fi
657	if [ "$1" = "list" ]; then
658	  scope=project
659	  path="$PWD/.agents/skills/shared"
660	  for arg in "$@"; do

662	      scope=global

664	    fi
665	  done
666	  printf '[{"name":"shared","path":"%s","scope":"%s","agents":["Claude Code","Codex"],"source":"owner/repo","sourceUrl":null,"sourceType":"github"}]\n' "$path" "$scope"
667	  exit 0
668	fi
669	printf '%s|%s\n' "$PWD" "$*"
670	`
671		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(bin, "skills"), []byte(script), 0o755); err != nil {
672			t.Fatal(err)
673		}
674		t.Setenv("PATH", bin+string(os.PathListSeparator)+os.Getenv("PATH"))
675	
676		nested := filepath.Join(h.repo.Root, "nested", "deeper")
677		if err := os.MkdirAll(nested, 0o755); err != nil {
678			t.Fatal(err)
679		}
680		cwd, _ := os.Getwd()
681		if err := os.Chdir(nested); err != nil {
682			t.Fatal(err)
683		}
684		defer os.Chdir(cwd)
685	
686		var rows []map[string]any
687		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(h.mustRun("skill", "list", "--json")), &rows); err != nil {
688			t.Fatal(err)
689		}
690		if len(rows) != 2 || rows[0]["scope"] != "project" || rows[1]["scope"] != "global" {
691			t.Fatalf("skill rows = %+v", rows)
692		}
693		if rows[0]["scope_root"] != projectRoot || rows[0]["managed_by"] != "skills" {
694			t.Errorf("project row = %+v", rows[0])
695		}
696		table := h.mustRun("skill", "list", "--project")
697		if !strings.Contains(table, "project root") || !strings.Contains(table, "shared") || strings.Contains(table, "global") {
698			t.Errorf("project table = %q", table)
699		}
700	
701		add := h.mustRun("skill", "add")
702		if !strings.Contains(add, projectRoot+"|add daviddwlee84/agent-skills/skills") {
703			t.Errorf("add shortcut = %q", add)
704		}
705		if _, _, err := h.run("skill", "update", "shared", "--yes"); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "choose exactly one") {
706			t.Fatalf("unscoped update err = %v", err)

813	func TestAdoptReportsThenApplies(t *testing.T) {
814		h := newHarness(t)
815	
816		// A branch ahead of main, which is exactly the unfinished work adopt is for.
817		h.repo.Branch("feat/in-flight")
818		h.repo.Commit("wip.txt", "half done\n", "feat: in flight")
819		h.repo.Git("switch", "main")
820	
821		out := h.mustRun("adopt")
822		if !strings.Contains(out, "feat/in-flight") {
823			t.Fatalf("adopt should find the unmerged branch:\n%s", out)
824		}
825		if !strings.Contains(out, "--apply") {
826			t.Error("reporting run should say how to act on it")
827		}
828		// Reporting must not have created anything.
829		if ls := h.mustRun("ls"); !strings.Contains(ls, "No tasks yet") {
830			t.Errorf("adopt without --apply must create nothing, got:\n%s", ls)
831		}
832	
833		h.mustRun("adopt", "--apply", "--yes")
834		ls := h.mustRun("ls")
835		if !strings.Contains(ls, "feat/in-flight") {
836			t.Errorf("adopted task should appear in the inventory:\n%s", ls)
837		}
838	
839		// Adopting twice must not duplicate.
840		out = h.mustRun("adopt")
841		if strings.Contains(out, "feat/in-flight") {
842			t.Errorf("an already-tracked branch should not be offered again:\n%s", out)
843		}
844	}

1155	func TestEditCreatesDetectedConfigAndOpensIt(t *testing.T) {
1156		h := newHarness(t)
1157		path := filepath.Join(h.home, "new config.toml")
1158		record := filepath.Join(h.home, "opened-path")
1159		editor := filepath.Join(h.home, "fake-editor")
1160		body := "#!/bin/sh\nprintf '%s' \"$1\" > \"$DEV_EDIT_RECORD\"\nprintf '\\n# opened by test\\n' >> \"$1\"\n"
1161		if err := os.WriteFile(editor, []byte(body), 0o755); err != nil {
1162			t.Fatal(err)
1163		}
1164		t.Setenv("DEV_EDIT_RECORD", record)
1165	
1166		var out, errOut bytes.Buffer
1167		root := cli.NewRootCommandWithIO(&out, &errOut)
1168		root.SetArgs([]string{"--config", path, "edit", "--editor", editor})
1169		if err := root.Execute(); err != nil {
1170			t.Fatalf("edit: %v\nstderr: %s", err, errOut.String())
1171		}
1172		opened, err := os.ReadFile(record)
1173		if err != nil {
1174			t.Fatalf("fake editor was not invoked: %v", err)
1175		}
1176		if string(opened) != path {
1177			t.Errorf("editor opened %q, want %q", opened, path)
1178		}
1179		generated, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1180		if err != nil {
1181			t.Fatal(err)
1182		}
1183		if !strings.Contains(string(generated), "[paths]") ||
1184			!strings.Contains(string(generated), "# opened by test") {
1185			t.Errorf("missing generated template or editor change:\n%s", generated)
1186		}
1187		if !strings.Contains(errOut.String(), "created") {
1188			t.Errorf("user should be told the file was generated: %q", errOut.String())
1189		}
1190	}

1276		// on main must be able to replace it without a manual sweep first.

1351	func TestCacheListAndClearLeavesStatsDataAlone(t *testing.T) {
1352		h := newHarness(t)
1353		remote := filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
1354		notesIndex := filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "notes.db")
1355		size := filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "sizes-v1.json")
1356		gitignore := filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "gitignore", "Go.gitignore")
1357		license := filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "licenses", "mit.json")
1358		os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(remote), 0o755)
1359		os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(gitignore), 0o755)
1360		os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(license), 0o755)
1361		os.WriteFile(remote, []byte("remote cache"), 0o600)
1362		os.WriteFile(notesIndex, []byte("note index"), 0o600)
1363		os.WriteFile(size, []byte("size cache"), 0o600)
1364		os.WriteFile(gitignore, []byte("*.test\n"), 0o644)
1365		os.WriteFile(license, []byte("{}\n"), 0o644)
1366	
1367		// Stats and Markdown notes live under XDG data, not cache.
1368		noteSource := filepath.Join(h.home, "state", "notes", "repo", "note.md")
1369		os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(noteSource), 0o700)
1370		os.WriteFile(noteSource, []byte("durable note"), 0o600)
1371		statsPath := filepath.Join(h.home, "state", "stats.db")
1372		os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(statsPath), 0o755)
1373		os.WriteFile(statsPath, []byte("durable"), 0o600)
1374	
1375		out := h.mustRun("cache", "list")
1376		if !strings.Contains(out, "remote") || !strings.Contains(out, "notes") ||
1377			!strings.Contains(out, "size") || !strings.Contains(out, "gitignore") || !strings.Contains(out, "licenses") || !strings.Contains(out, "not cache") {
1378			t.Errorf("cache list:\n%s", out)
1379		}
1380		h.mustRun("cache", "clear", "all")
1381		if _, err := os.Stat(remote); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
1382			t.Error("remote cache should be gone")
1383		}
1384		if _, err := os.Stat(notesIndex); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
1385			t.Error("notes FTS cache should be gone")
1386		}
1387		if _, err := os.Stat(size); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
1388			t.Error("size cache should be gone")
1389		}
1390		if _, err := os.Stat(gitignore); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
1391			t.Error("gitignore cache should be gone")
1392		}
1393		if _, err := os.Stat(license); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
1394			t.Error("license cache should be gone")
1395		}
1396		if _, err := os.Stat(statsPath); err != nil {
1397			t.Error("cache clear must never touch stats data")
1398		}
1399		if _, err := os.Stat(noteSource); err != nil {
1400			t.Error("cache clear must never touch durable Markdown notes")
1401		}
1402	}

1708	func TestSweepReapsATaskWhoseBranchIsGone(t *testing.T) {

1723			t.Fatalf("sweep did not report the dead branch:\n%s", report)
1724		}
1725		// Report-only until --apply, like every other suggestion.
1726		if listed := h.mustRun("ls", "--json"); !strings.Contains(listed, "landed") {
1727			t.Fatalf("report-only sweep removed the task:\n%s", listed)

1760	func TestSweepRefusesToRemoveAnOrphanHoldingUnsavedTranscripts(t *testing.T) {
1761		h := newHarness(t)
1762		h.mustRun("start", "demo", "--task", "gone", "--branch", "feat/gone", "--base", "main")
1763		wtPath := filepath.Join(h.wtRoot, "demo", "feat-gone")
1764		// Remove it behind dev's back, which is how the real orphan appears: raw
1765		// git from another checkout, leaving dev's record still pointing here.
1766		// Going through `dev wt rm` would clear the recorded path and produce a
1767		// different, already-handled kind of drift.
1768		h.repo.Git("worktree", "remove", "--force", wtPath)
1769	
1770		// The state under test is a task that still records a worktree Git no
1771		// longer registers. Assert it rather than assume it: an earlier version of
1772		// this test removed the worktree through dev, which clears the recorded
1773		// path, and it passed on macOS only because a /private symlink made dev's
1774		// own path match fail there.
1775		if listed := h.mustRun("ls", "--json"); !strings.Contains(listed, `"worktree_path"`) ||
1776			!strings.Contains(listed, filepath.Base(wtPath)) {
1777			t.Fatalf("precondition lost: the task no longer records its worktree:\n%s", listed)
1778		}
1779	
1780		// Recreate the path the way a transcript writer that outlived its worktree
1781		// does: artifacts only, and content the repository has never seen.
1782		history := filepath.Join(wtPath, ".specstory", "history")
1783		if err := os.MkdirAll(history, 0o755); err != nil {
1784			t.Fatal(err)
1785		}
1786		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(history, "session.md"), []byte("the only copy\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
1787			t.Fatal(err)
1788		}
1789	
1790		report := h.mustRun("sweep")

1792			t.Fatalf("sweep did not notice the orphan:\n%s", report)
1793		}

1796		}
1797	
1798		h.mustRun("sweep", "--apply", "--yes")
1799		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(history, "session.md")); err != nil {
1800			t.Fatalf("--apply destroyed an unsalvaged transcript: %v", err)
