211			"",
212			"Flags:",
213			"  -h, --help   help for wt",
214			"      --json   emit a stable machine-readable JSON array",
215			"",
216		}, "\n")
217	
218		colored := renderCobraHelp(body, cliStyle{enabled: true})
219		if stripANSI(colored) != body {
220			t.Fatalf("coloring changed the plain text:\n%q\n%q", stripANSI(colored), body)
221		}
222		style := cliStyle{enabled: true}
223		for _, want := range []string{style.code("create"), style.code("-h, --help"), style.code("--json")} {
224			if !strings.Contains(colored, want) {
225				t.Errorf("help did not color %q:\n%q", stripANSI(want), colored)
226			}
227		}
228		// A description must stay plain, or the whole page reads as one color.
229		if strings.Contains(colored, style.code("Create a worktree at the configured path")) {
230			t.Error("help colored a description")
231		}
232		if plain := renderCobraHelp(body, cliStyle{}); plain != body {
233			t.Error("disabled style rewrote the help body")
234		}
235	}

386	type stagedCloseRuntime struct {
387		*activityRuntime
388		failAt int
389		calls  int
390	}
391	
392	func (r *stagedCloseRuntime) Close(_ context.Context, handle string) error {
393		r.calls++
394		r.closeCalls = append(r.closeCalls, handle)
395		if r.failAt > 0 && r.calls == r.failAt {
396			return errors.New("injected runtime close failure")
397		}
398		for index, session := range r.sessions {
399			if session.Handle == handle {
400				r.sessions = append(r.sessions[:index], r.sessions[index+1:]...)
401				break
402			}
403		}
404		return nil
405	}

92	
93		got, ok, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, r.Root, "feat/auth")
94		if err != nil || !ok {
95			t.Fatalf("WorktreeFor: ok=%v err=%v", ok, err)
96		}
97		if got.Path != resolve(t, wtPath) {
98			t.Errorf("path = %q, want %q", got.Path, wtPath)
99		}
100		if _, ok, _ := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, r.Root, "nope"); ok {
101			t.Error("WorktreeFor should not match a nonexistent branch")
102		}
103	}

455	func TestStatus(t *testing.T) {
456		r := gittest.New(t)
457		ctx := gittest.Ctx()
458	
459		st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Root)
460		if err != nil {
461			t.Fatal(err)
462		}
463		if st.Branch != "main" || st.Dirty() || st.Published() {
464			t.Errorf("fresh repo: %+v", st)
465		}
466		if st.Summary() != "local" {
467			t.Errorf("Summary of an unpublished clean branch = %q, want local", st.Summary())
468		}
469	
470		r.Write("new.txt", "x\n")
471		r.Write("staged.txt", "y\n")
472		r.Git("add", "staged.txt")
473		st, _ = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Root)
474		if st.Untracked != 1 || st.Staged != 1 || st.Changed != 2 {
475			t.Errorf("want 2 unique paths: 1 untracked + 1 staged, got %+v", st)
476		}
477		if st.Summary() != "+1 ?1" {
478			t.Errorf("rich Summary = %q", st.Summary())
479		}
480		if !st.Dirty() {
481			t.Error("should be dirty")
482		}
483	}

506	func TestWipCommit(t *testing.T) {
507		t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL", os.DevNull)
508		t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM", os.DevNull)
509		r := gittest.New(t)
510		ctx := gittest.Ctx()
511	
512		// Clean tree: nothing to check point, and that is not an error.
513		made, err := gitx.WipCommit(ctx, r.Root, "wip: checkpoint")
514		if err != nil || made {
515			t.Fatalf("clean tree: made=%v err=%v", made, err)
516		}
517	
518		r.Write("draft.txt", "half done\n")
519		r.Write(".specstory/history/live.md", "moving transcript\n")
520		made, err = gitx.WipCommit(ctx, r.Root, "wip: checkpoint token refresh")
521		if err != nil || !made {
522			t.Fatalf("dirty tree: made=%v err=%v", made, err)
523		}
524		st, _ := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Root)
525		if !st.Dirty() || st.Untracked != 1 {
526			t.Errorf("only the live artifact should remain dirty: %+v", st)
527		}
528		if changed := r.Git("show", "--pretty=", "--name-only", "HEAD"); !strings.Contains(changed, "draft.txt") || strings.Contains(changed, ".specstory") {
529			t.Fatalf("checkpoint paths:\n%s", changed)
530		}
531		_, subject, _ := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, r.Root)
532		if subject != "wip: checkpoint token refresh" {
533			t.Errorf("subject = %q", subject)
534		}
535	}

564	func TestStatusRichChangeCounts(t *testing.T) {
565		r := gittest.New(t)
566		ctx := gittest.Ctx()
567		r.Commit("modify.txt", "old\n", "chore: add modified fixture")
568		r.Commit("delete.txt", "gone soon\n", "chore: add delete fixture")
569		r.Commit("rename.txt", "move me\n", "chore: add rename fixture")
570	
571		r.Write("modify.txt", "new\n")
572		if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(r.Root, "delete.txt")); err != nil {
573			t.Fatal(err)
574		}
575		r.Git("mv", "rename.txt", "renamed.txt")
576		r.Write("untracked.txt", "new\n")
577	
578		st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Root)
579		if err != nil {
580			t.Fatal(err)
581		}
582		if st.Changed != 4 {
583			t.Errorf("Changed = %d, want 4 unique paths: %+v", st.Changed, st)
584		}
585		if st.Staged != 1 || st.Unstaged != 2 || st.Untracked != 1 {
586			t.Errorf("stage categories wrong: %+v", st)
587		}
588		if st.Modified != 1 || st.Deleted != 1 || st.Renamed != 1 {
589			t.Errorf("change types wrong: %+v", st)
590		}
591		if got := st.Summary(); got != "+1 !2 ?1" {
592			t.Errorf("Summary = %q", got)
593		}
594		if got := st.Breakdown(); got != "4 changed paths (+1 staged, !2 unstaged, ?1 untracked)" {

166	// DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree returns canonical path evidence only when the

168	// branch name or a lexical .claude segment elsewhere on disk is not evidence.
169	func DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(repositoryRoot, checkoutPath string) (ClaudeHarnessEvidence, bool) {

179		if err != nil {

181		}
182		return ClaudeHarnessEvidence{Root: harnessRoot, CheckoutPath: canonicalCheckout}, true

325			}
326			return c.Checkouts[1:]
327		}
328		out := make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(c.Checkouts)-1)
329		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {

331				out = append(out, checkout)

333		}

337	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
338	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
339	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
340		seen := map[string]bool{}
341		var out []runtime.Session
342		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
343			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
344				key := session.Handle
345				if key == "" {
346					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
347				}
348				if seen[key] {
349					continue
350				}
351				seen[key] = true
352				out = append(out, session)
353			}
354		}
355		return out
356	}

358	// RepoContextOptions extends repository collection without changing the
359	// original CollectRepoContext API used by CLI and dashboard callers.
360	type RepoContextOptions struct {
361		Runtime         string
362		Sessions        []runtime.Session
363		RuntimeObserved bool
364		RuntimeErr      error
365		// Limiter shares one process-heavy enrichment bound across collectors.
366		Limiter *Limiter
367	}
368	
369	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository. The
370	// legacy entry point can prove observation only when sessions are present;
371	// callers that need a proven empty observation or typed failure use
372	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions.
373	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
374		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
375		return CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, r, tasks, RepoContextOptions{
376			Runtime: runtimeName, Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: len(sessions) > 0,
377		})
378	}
379	
380	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions builds repository topology from Git's complete
381	// registered worktree list. It never synthesizes a main checkout after a Git
382	// query failure.
383	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
384		opts RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
385		if ctx == nil {
386			ctx = context.Background()
387		}
388		out := RepoContext{
389			Repo: r, Runtime: opts.Runtime,
390			WorktreeObservation: TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved},
391			RuntimeObservation:  runtimeObservation(opts),
392		}
393		queryPath := repoQueryPath(r)
394		out.RepositoryID, out.IdentityErr = canonicalRepositoryID(ctx, r, queryPath)
395		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
396	
397		var (
398			worktrees []gitx.Worktree
399			err       error
400		)
401		if queryPath == "" {
402			err = fmt.Errorf("repository has no Git query path")
403		} else {
404			worktrees, err = gitx.Worktrees(ctx, queryPath)
405		}
406		if err != nil {
407			listErr := &WorktreeListError{Path: queryPath, Err: err}
408			out.WorktreeErr = listErr
409			out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: listErr}
410			assignTasksWithoutTopology(&out, tasks)
411			finishRepoContext(&out)
412			return out
413		}
414		out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
415		out.WorktreeCount = 0
416		out.Checkouts = make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(worktrees))
417		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
418			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
419			if canonicalPath == "" {
420				canonicalPath = filepath.Clean(worktree.Path)
421			}
422			checkout := RepoCheckout{
423				ID: canonicalPath, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
424				IdentityErr: canonicalErr,
425				Worktree:    worktree, Exists: pathIsDir(worktree.Path),
426				RuntimeObservation: out.RuntimeObservation,
427				Ownership:          CheckoutExternal,
428			}
429			if canonicalErr != nil {
430				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
431					Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: canonicalErr.Error(),
432				})
433			}
434			if worktree.Main {
435				checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
436					Kind: OwnershipEvidenceGitMain, Path: canonicalPath,
437				})
438			} else {
439				out.WorktreeCount++
440			}
441			out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
442		}
443	
444		enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx, out.Checkouts, opts.Limiter)
445		assignHarnessEvidence(&out)
446		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
447		if out.RuntimeObservation.Available() {
448			assignSessions(&out, opts.Sessions)
449		}
450		finishRepoContext(&out)
451		return out
452	}
453	
454	func runtimeObservation(opts RepoContextOptions) TopologyObservation {
455		if opts.RuntimeErr != nil {
456			err := &RuntimeListError{Runtime: opts.Runtime, Err: opts.RuntimeErr}
457			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: err}
458		}
459		if opts.RuntimeObserved {
460			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
461		}
462		return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved}
463	}
464	
465	func repoQueryPath(r repo.Repo) string {
466		for _, candidate := range []string{r.Path, r.RealPath, r.MainRoot, r.CommonDir} {
467			if candidate != "" {
468				return candidate
469			}
470		}
471		return ""
472	}
473	
474	func canonicalRepositoryID(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, queryPath string) (string, error) {
475		commonDir := r.CommonDir
476		if commonDir == "" && r.Bare {
477			commonDir = queryPath
478		}
479		if commonDir == "" && queryPath != "" {
480			if discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, queryPath); err == nil {
481				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
482			}
483		}
484		if commonDir == "" {
485			err := fmt.Errorf("Git common directory is empty")
486			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
487		}
488		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
489		if err != nil {
490			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
491		}
492		return canonical, nil
493	}
494	
495	func enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx context.Context, checkouts []RepoCheckout, limiter *Limiter) {
496		if limiter == nil {
497			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
498		}
499		var wg sync.WaitGroup
500		for i := range checkouts {
501			if checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare || checkouts[i].Worktree.Prunable || !checkouts[i].Exists {
502				continue
503			}
504			wg.Add(1)
505			go func(index int) {
506				defer wg.Done()
507				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
508				if !ok {
509					checkouts[index].StatusErr = ctx.Err()
510					return
511				}
512				defer release()
513				checkout := &checkouts[index]
514				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
515				checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(
516					ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status,
517				)
518			}(i)
519		}
520		wg.Wait()

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}
88	
89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104	
105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
106		if err != nil {
107			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
108			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
109			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
110			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
111		}
112		switch {
113		case rel == ".":
114			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
115		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
116			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
117		default:
118			return canonicalCandidate, nil
119		}
120	}
121	
122	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
123	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
124	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
125		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
126		if err == nil {
127			return true, nil
128		}
129		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
130			return false, nil
131		}
132		return false, err
133	}
134	
135	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
136	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
137		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
138		if err != nil {
139			return false, err
140		}
141		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
142		if err != nil {
143			return false, err
144		}
145		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
146			return true, nil
147		}
148		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
149	}
150	
151	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
152	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
153	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
154	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
155		switch {
156		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
157			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
158		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
159			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
160		case component == "." || component == "..":
161			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
162		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
163			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
164		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
165			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
166		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
167			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
168		default:
169			return nil
170		}
171	}
172	
173	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
174	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
175	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
176	// single component.
177	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
178		if len(components) == 0 {
179			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
180		}
181		for i, component := range components {
182			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
183				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
184			}
185		}
186		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
187		if err != nil {
188			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
189		}
190		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
191	}
192	
193	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
194		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
195			return false
196		}
197		letter := component[0]
198		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
199	}
200	
201	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
202		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
203			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
204		}) {
205			if component == ".." {
206				return true
207			}
208		}
209		return false
210	}

746	func sortedUniqueTasks(tasks []*task.Task) []*task.Task {

749			if ordered[i] == nil {
750				return false
751			}
752			if ordered[j] == nil {
753				return true
754			}
755			return ordered[i].ID < ordered[j].ID
756		})
757		seen := map[string]bool{}
758		out := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(ordered))
759		for _, tracked := range ordered {
760			if tracked == nil {
761				continue
762			}
763			if tracked.ID != "" && seen[tracked.ID] {
764				continue
765			}
766			if tracked.ID != "" {
767				seen[tracked.ID] = true
768			}
769			out = append(out, tracked)
770		}
771		return out
772	}

987	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
988	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
989	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
990	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
991		for _, session := range sessions {
992			assigned := map[int]bool{}
993			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
994				best, bestLen := -1, -1
995				for i := range out.Checkouts {
996					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Checkouts[i]) {
997						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(normalizePath(root)) > bestLen {
998							best, bestLen = i, len(normalizePath(root))
999						}
1000					}
1001				}
1002				if best >= 0 {
1003					assigned[best] = true
1004				}
1005			}
1006			for i := range assigned {
1007				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
1008			}
1009		}
1010	}

1012	func checkoutRoots(checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
1013		return []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}

1016	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
1017		if root == "" || path == "" {
1018			return false
1019		}
1020		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
1021		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
1022			return false
1023		}
1024		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
1025	}
1026	
1027	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
1028	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
1029	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
1030	// is not sufficient.
1031	func normalizePath(path string) string {
1032		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
1033			return canonical
1034		}
1035		return filepath.Clean(path)
1036	}

164	// List implements Runtime. Workspaces carry no working directory of their own,
165	// so dev joins them against the pane list — panes are what actually have a cwd.
166	func (h *Herdr) List(ctx context.Context) ([]Session, error) {
167		var ws struct {
168			Workspaces []herdrWorkspace `json:"workspaces"`
169		}
170		if err := h.call(ctx, &ws, "workspace", "list"); err != nil {
171			return nil, err
172		}
173		var ps struct {
174			Panes []herdrPane `json:"panes"`
175		}
176		if err := h.call(ctx, &ps, "pane", "list"); err != nil {
177			return nil, err
178		}
179	
180		dirs := map[string]map[string]bool{}
181		agents := map[string]map[string]bool{}
182		panes := map[string][]Pane{}
183		for _, p := range ps.Panes {
184			cwd := p.ForegroundCWD
185			if cwd == "" {
186				cwd = p.CWD
187			}
188			if dirs[p.WorkspaceID] == nil {
189				dirs[p.WorkspaceID] = map[string]bool{}
190			}
191			for _, dir := range []string{p.CWD, cwd} {
192				if dir != "" {
193					dirs[p.WorkspaceID][dir] = true
194				}
195			}
196			agentSession := ""
197			if p.AgentSession != nil && p.AgentSession.Value != "" {
198				agent := p.AgentSession.Agent
199				if agent == "" {
200					agent = p.Agent
201				}
202				agentSession = agent + ":" + p.AgentSession.Value
203				if agents[p.WorkspaceID] == nil {

84				return nil, nil
85			}

110			if len(f) > 4 && f[3] == "1" && f[4] == "1" {
111				s.Focused = true
112			}
113		}
114		sessions := make([]Session, 0, len(order))

134			}

136		}
137		if _, err := t.run(ctx, "new-session", "-d", "-s", name, "-c", dir); err != nil {
138			return OpenResult{}, err
139		}
140		return OpenResult{Handle: name, Surface: "session", Opened: true, Created: true}, nil
141	}

143	func sameDirectory(a, b string) bool {
144		canonical := func(path string) string {
145			path = filepath.Clean(path)
146			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path); err == nil {
147				return filepath.Clean(resolved)
148			}
149			return path
150		}
151		return canonical(a) == canonical(b)
152	}

66			}

83			sessions = append(sessions, Session{Handle: name, Label: name, Dirs: dirs})

86	}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}
88	
89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104	
105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
106		if err != nil {
107			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
108			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
109			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
110			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
111		}
112		switch {
113		case rel == ".":
114			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
115		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
116			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
117		default:
118			return canonicalCandidate, nil
119		}
120	}
121	
122	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
123	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
124	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
125		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
126		if err == nil {
127			return true, nil
128		}
129		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
130			return false, nil
131		}
132		return false, err
133	}
134	
135	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
136	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
137		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
138		if err != nil {
139			return false, err
140		}
141		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
142		if err != nil {
143			return false, err
144		}
145		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
146			return true, nil
147		}
148		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
149	}
150	
151	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
152	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
153	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
154	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
155		switch {
156		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
157			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
158		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
159			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
160		case component == "." || component == "..":
161			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
162		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
163			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
164		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
165			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
166		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
167			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
168		default:
169			return nil
170		}
171	}
172	
173	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
174	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
175	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
176	// single component.
177	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
178		if len(components) == 0 {
179			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
180		}
181		for i, component := range components {
182			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
183				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
184			}
185		}
186		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
187		if err != nil {
188			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
189		}
190		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
191	}
192	
193	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
194		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
195			return false
196		}
197		letter := component[0]
198		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
199	}
200	
201	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
202		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
203			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
204		}) {
205			if component == ".." {
206				return true
207			}
208		}
209		return false
210	}

294			}
295		case taskflow.RemoveCheckoutOptions:
296			return value

300			}
301		case taskflow.RefreshRemoteOptions:

307		case taskflow.ReconcileOptions:

311			if value != nil {
312				copy := *value
313				copy.Parameters = taskflow.NewFields(value.Parameters.Map())
314				return copy
315			}
316		}

331	func retainedSurfaceIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, previous SurfaceRow, hadPrevious bool, oldIndex int, focus string) int {
332		if len(rows) == 0 {
333			return 0
334		}
335		if hadPrevious {
336			for index, row := range rows {
337				if row.RowKey == previous.RowKey {
338					return index
339				}
340			}
341			if previous.Locator.TaskID != "" {
342				for index, row := range rows {
343					if row.Locator.TaskID == previous.Locator.TaskID {
344						return index
345					}
346				}
347			}
348			for index, row := range rows {
349				if locatorsReferToSameSurface(previous.Locator, row.Locator) {
350					return index
351				}
352			}
353		}
354		if focus != "" {
355			for index, row := range rows {
356				if row.RowKey == focus || row.Locator.RowKey == focus {
357					return index
358				}
359			}
360			for index, row := range rows {
361				if row.Locator.TaskID == focus {
362					return index
363				}
364			}
365			for index, row := range rows {
366				if row.Locator.CheckoutPath == focus {
367					return index
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		if oldIndex < 0 {
372			return 0
373		}
374		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
375			return len(rows) - 1
376		}
377		return oldIndex
378	}
379	
380	func retainedActionIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, rowIndex int, actionID string) int {
381		if actionID == "" || rowIndex < 0 || rowIndex >= len(rows) {
382			return 0
383		}
384		for index, action := range rows[rowIndex].Actions.Values() {
385			if action.ID == actionID {
386				return index
387			}
388		}
389		return 0
390	}

392	func locatorsReferToSameSurface(left, right taskflow.Locator) bool {
393		if left.RepositoryID != "" && right.RepositoryID != "" && left.RepositoryID != right.RepositoryID {
394			return false
395		}
396		if left.CheckoutPath != "" && right.CheckoutPath != "" {
397			return left.CheckoutPath == right.CheckoutPath
398		}
399		if left.TaskID != "" && right.TaskID != "" {
400			return left.TaskID == right.TaskID
401		}
402		return left.RepoKey != "" && left.RepoKey == right.RepoKey &&
403			left.Branch != "" && left.Branch == right.Branch && left.Base == right.Base
404	}

406	func (m Model) acceptPlan(message planMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
407		if message.generation != m.planRequest.generation ||
408			message.repoKey != m.planRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey ||
409			message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey || message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
410			return m, nil
411		}
412		if m.planRequest.cancel != nil {
413			m.planRequest.cancel()
414		}
415		m.planRequest.cancel = nil
416		m.planRequest.loading = false
417		m.planRequest.err = message.err
418		m.overlay = overlayPlan
419		m.status = ""
420	
421		if message.plan.PlanID != "" {
422			m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
423			m.hasPlan = true
424		}
425		if message.err != nil {
426			m.planErr = message.err
427			return m, nil
428		}
429		if err := message.plan.Validate(); err != nil {
430			m.planErr = combineError("invalid plan returned by callback", err)
431			return m, nil
432		}
433		if message.plan.Locator != m.planTarget.locator {
434			m.planErr = errors.New("plan locator does not match the exact selected surface")
435			return m, nil
436		}
437		if message.plan.Action != m.planTarget.choice.Action() {
438			m.planErr = errors.New("plan action does not match the exact selected action options")
439			return m, nil
440		}
441		expected, err := taskflow.NewRequest(m.planTarget.locator, m.planTarget.choice.Options())
442		if err != nil {
443			m.planErr = combineError("selected action options are invalid", err)
444			return m, nil
445		}
446		if !reflect.DeepEqual(message.plan.Request.Options, expected.Options) {
447			m.planErr = errors.New("plan was built with different concrete action options than the selected choice")
448			return m, nil
449		}
450		m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
451		m.hasPlan = true
452		m.planErr = nil
453		if m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady && m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
454			m.confirm.SetValue("")
455			m.confirm.CursorEnd()
456			return m, m.confirm.Focus()
457		}
458		return m, nil
459	}

461	func (m Model) acceptApply(message applyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
462		if !m.applyRunning || message.generation != m.applyGeneration ||
463			message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey || message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey ||
464			message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
465			return m, nil
466		}
467		m.applyRunning = false
468		m.overlay = overlayResult
469		m.lastResult = message.result.Clone()
470		m.hasLastResult = true
471		m.lastResultErr = message.err
472		m.status = ""
473		if remote, ok := message.result.RemoteObservation(); ok {
474			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
475		}
476		if message.err == nil {
477			if handoff, ok := message.result.Handoff(); ok {
478				m.finalHandoff = handoff
479				m.hasHandoff = true
480			}
481		}
482	
483		queuedQuit := m.queuedQuit
484		m.queuedQuit, m.queuedRefresh = false, false
485		updated, command := m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
486		m = updated.(Model)
487		if queuedQuit {
488			// The fresh generation is established before honoring the queued quit. It
489			// cannot authorize anything and the mutation ledger remains in final Model.
490			if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
491				m.loadRequest.cancel()
492				m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
493			}
494			m.quitting = true
495			return m, tea.Quit
496		}
497		return m, command
498	}

135	// New constructs either an asynchronous repository picker (preselected=nil) or
136	// an asynchronous preselected-repository view. No callback runs until Init's
137	// command is executed, so View can return the initial frame immediately.
138	func New(actions Actions, preselected *RepositoryRow) Model {
139		filter := textinput.New()
140		filter.CharLimit = 240
141		filter.Placeholder = "repository filter"
142		confirm := textinput.New()
143		confirm.CharLimit = 300
144		confirm.Placeholder = "exact confirmation token"
145	
146		model := Model{
147			actions:        actions,
148			firstViewReady: make(chan struct{}),
149			firstViewOnce:  &sync.Once{},
150			width:          120, height: 34,
151			filter: filter, confirm: confirm,
152			focus: FocusSurfaces,
153		}
154		if preselected == nil {
155			model.screen = screenPicker
156			model.listRequest = requestState{generation: 1, repoKey: pickerRequestKey, loading: true}
157			return model
158		}
159		model.screen = screenRepository
160		model.repository = *preselected
161		model.desiredFocus = preselected.FocusTarget
162		model.loadRequest = requestState{generation: 1, repoKey: preselected.RepoKey, loading: true}
163		return model
164	}

174	// WithContext bounds cancelable list/load/plan callbacks to one TUI run. Apply
175	// deliberately uses a cancellation-detached child so queued quit cannot abort a
176	// mutation whose result ledger must be retained.
177	func (m Model) WithContext(ctx context.Context) Model {
178		m.runContext = ctx
179		return m
180	}
181	
182	func (m Model) baseContext() context.Context {
183		if m.runContext != nil {
184			return m.runContext
185		}
186		return context.Background()
187	}
188	
189	// Init implements tea.Model without doing synchronous repository work.
190	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
191		var commands []tea.Cmd
192		switch m.screen {
193		case screenRepository:
194			if m.loadRequest.loading {
195				commands = append(commands, m.loadRepositoryCmd(m.loadRequest.generation, m.loadRequest.repoKey, m.baseContext()))
196			}
197		case screenPicker:
198			if m.listRequest.loading {
199				commands = append(commands, m.listRepositoriesCmd(m.listRequest.generation, m.baseContext()))
200			}
201		}
202		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
203			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
204		}
205		switch len(commands) {
206		case 0:
207			return nil
208		case 1:
209			return commands[0]
210		default:
211			return tea.Batch(commands...)
212		}
213	}
214	
215	func (m Model) signalFirstView() {
216		if m.firstViewOnce != nil && m.firstViewReady != nil {
217			m.firstViewOnce.Do(func() { close(m.firstViewReady) })
218		}
219	}
220	
221	func (m Model) runAfterFirstView() tea.Cmd {
222		return func() tea.Msg {
223			select {
224			case <-m.baseContext().Done():
225				return nil
226			case <-m.firstViewReady:
227				m.actions.AfterFirstView(m.baseContext())
228				return nil
229			}
230		}
231	}

233	// Handoff returns the most recent successful Apply handoff. Failed Apply calls,
234	// plans, and exit status alone can never populate it.

236	
237	// LastResult returns the full retained ledger and Apply error.
238	func (m Model) LastResult() (taskflow.Result, error, bool) {
239		return m.lastResult.Clone(), m.lastResultErr, m.hasLastResult
240	}
241	
242	// CurrentSnapshot returns an independent accepted repository snapshot.
243	func (m Model) CurrentSnapshot() (Snapshot, bool) { return m.snapshot.Clone(), m.hasSnapshot }
244	
245	// RemoteObservation returns the run-local remote evidence retained across local
246	// reloads for the current repository.
247	func (m Model) RemoteObservation() (taskflow.RemoteObservation, bool) {

249	}

275	// Update implements tea.Model.
276	func (m Model) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
277		switch message := message.(type) {
278		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
279			m.width, m.height = message.Width, message.Height
280			return m, nil
281		case repositoryListMsg:
282			return m.acceptRepositoryList(message)
283		case repositoryLoadMsg:
284			return m.acceptRepositoryLoad(message)
285		case planMsg:
286			return m.acceptPlan(message)
287		case applyMsg:
288			return m.acceptApply(message)
289		case tea.KeyMsg:
290			if m.applyRunning {
291				return m.updateApplying(message)
292			}
293			if m.filterActive {
294				return m.updateFilter(message)
295			}
296			if m.overlay != overlayNone {
297				return m.updateOverlay(message)
298			}
299			if m.screen == screenPicker {
300				return m.updatePicker(message)
301			}
302			return m.updateRepository(message)
303		}
304		return m, nil
305	}
306	
307	func (m Model) updatePicker(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
308		switch message.String() {
309		case "q", "ctrl+c":
310			return m.quit()
311		case "esc":
312			if m.filter.Value() != "" {
313				m.filter.SetValue("")
314				m.repoCursor = 0
315				return m, nil
316			}
317			return m.quit()
318		case "j", "down":
319			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor + 1)
320		case "k", "up":
321			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor - 1)
322		case "/":
323			m.filterActive = true
324			m.filter.CursorEnd()
325			return m, m.filter.Focus()
326		case "?":
327			m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
328			m.overlay = overlayHelp
329			return m, nil
330		case "r":
331			return m.beginRepositoryList()
332		case "enter":
333			row, ok := m.currentRepository()
334			if !ok {
335				return m, nil
336			}
337			return m.selectRepository(row)
338		}
339		return m, nil
340	}

342	func (m Model) updateFilter(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
343		switch message.String() {
344		case "ctrl+c":
345			return m.quit()
346		case "esc":
347			m.filterActive = false
348			m.filter.Blur()
349			m.filter.SetValue("")
350			m.repoCursor = 0
351			return m, nil
352		case "enter":
353			m.filterActive = false
354			m.filter.Blur()
355			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor)
356			return m, nil
357		}
358		var command tea.Cmd

364	func (m Model) updateRepository(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
365		switch message.String() {
366		case "q", "ctrl+c":
367			return m.quit()
368		case "esc":
369			m.cancelRepositoryRead()
370			m.screen = screenPicker
371			m.overlay = overlayNone
372			return m.beginRepositoryList()
373		case "j", "down":
374			m.setRowCursor(m.rowCursor + 1)
375		case "k", "up":
376			m.setRowCursor(m.rowCursor - 1)
377		case "l", "right":
378			m.moveAction(1)
379		case "h", "left":
380			m.moveAction(-1)
381		case "tab":
382			m.focus = FocusPane((int(m.focus) + 1) % 3)
383		case "shift+tab":
384			m.focus = FocusPane((int(m.focus) + 2) % 3)
385		case "?":
386			m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
387			m.overlay = overlayHelp
388		case "r":
389			return m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
390		case "R":
391			return m.openRemoteMenu()
392		case "enter":
393			choice, ok := m.currentAction()
394			if !ok {
395				return m, nil
396			}
397			return m.beginPlan(choice)
398		}
399		return m, nil
400	}

402	func (m Model) updateApplying(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
403		switch message.String() {
404		case "q", "ctrl+c":
405			m.queuedQuit = true

407		case "r", "R":

409			m.status = "refresh queued; waiting for Apply to finish"
410		default:

412		}

419			m.listRequest.cancel()
420		}
421		if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {

423		}

430	func (m Model) filteredRepositories() []RepositoryRow {
431		query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m.filter.Value()))
432		terms := strings.Fields(query)
433		out := make([]RepositoryRow, 0, len(m.repositories))
434		for _, row := range m.repositories {
435			haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{row.RepoKey, row.Name, row.Path, row.Error}, " "))
436			matched := true
437			for _, term := range terms {
438				if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
439					matched = false
440					break
441				}
442			}
443			if matched {
444				out = append(out, row)
445			}
446		}
447		return out
448	}
449	
450	func (m Model) currentRepository() (RepositoryRow, bool) {
451		rows := m.filteredRepositories()
452		if m.repoCursor < 0 || m.repoCursor >= len(rows) {
453			return RepositoryRow{}, false
454		}
455		return rows[m.repoCursor], true
456	}
457	
458	func (m *Model) setRepoCursor(index int) {
459		count := len(m.filteredRepositories())
460		switch {
461		case count == 0:
462			index = 0
463		case index < 0:
464			index = 0
465		case index >= count:
466			index = count - 1
467		}
468		m.repoCursor = index
469	}
470	
471	func (m Model) currentSurface() (SurfaceRow, bool) {
472		if !m.hasSnapshot {
473			return SurfaceRow{}, false
474		}
475		rows := m.snapshot.Surfaces.Values()
476		if m.rowCursor < 0 || m.rowCursor >= len(rows) {
477			return SurfaceRow{}, false
478		}
479		return rows[m.rowCursor], true
480	}
481	
482	func (m Model) currentAction() (ActionChoice, bool) {
483		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
484		if !ok {
485			return ActionChoice{}, false
486		}
487		actions := row.Actions.Values()
488		if m.actionCursor < 0 || m.actionCursor >= len(actions) {
489			return ActionChoice{}, false
490		}
491		if !actions[m.actionCursor].Valid() {
492			return ActionChoice{}, false
493		}
494		return actions[m.actionCursor], true
495	}
496	
497	func (m *Model) setRowCursor(index int) {
498		count := 0
499		if m.hasSnapshot {
500			count = m.snapshot.Surfaces.Len()
501		}
502		switch {
503		case count == 0:
504			index = 0
505		case index < 0:
506			index = 0
507		case index >= count:
508			index = count - 1
509		}
510		if index != m.rowCursor {
511			m.rowCursor = index
512			m.actionCursor = 0
513		} else {
514			m.rowCursor = index
515		}
516		m.clampActionCursor()
517	}
518	
519	func (m *Model) clampActionCursor() {
520		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
521		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
522			m.actionCursor = 0
523			return
524		}
525		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
526			m.actionCursor = 0
527		}
528		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
529			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
530		}
531	}
532	
533	func (m *Model) moveAction(delta int) {
534		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
535		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
536			m.actionCursor = 0
537			return
538		}
539		m.actionCursor += delta
540		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
541			m.actionCursor = 0
542		}
543		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
544			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
545		}
546		m.focus = FocusActions
547	}
548	
549	func (m Model) selectRepository(row RepositoryRow) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
550		m.cancelRepositoryListRead()
551		m.screen = screenRepository
552		m.repository = row
553		m.desiredFocus = row.FocusTarget
554		m.hasSnapshot = false
555		m.snapshot = Snapshot{}
556		m.remote = OptionalRemoteObservation{}
557		m.rowCursor, m.actionCursor = 0, 0
558		m.overlay = overlayNone
559		m.hasPlan, m.planErr = false, nil
560		m.hasLastResult, m.lastResultErr = false, nil
561		m.hasHandoff = false
562		return m.beginRepositoryLoad(true)
563	}

565	func combineError(label string, err error) error {
566		if err == nil {
567			return nil
568		}
569		if label == "" {
570			return err
571		}
572		return errors.New(label + ": " + err.Error())
573	}

10	func (m Model) openRemoteMenu() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
11		if m.loadRequest.loading {
12			m.status = "wait for the current local reload before planning remote work"
13			return m, nil
14		}
15		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
16		if !ok {
17			return m, nil
18		}
19		choices := make([]ActionChoice, 0, row.Actions.Len())
20		for _, choice := range row.Actions.Values() {
21			if choice.Valid() && choice.Action() == taskflow.RefreshRemote {
22				choices = append(choices, choice)
23			}
24		}
25		if len(choices) == 0 {
26			m.status = "no remote action choices are available for this surface"
27			return m, nil
28		}
29		m.remoteChoices = NewActionList(choices...)
30		m.remoteCursor = 0
31		m.overlay = overlayRemoteMenu
32		m.status = ""
33		return m, nil
34	}

36	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
37		switch m.overlay {
38		case overlayHelp:
39			switch message.String() {
40			case "esc", "?":
41				m.overlay = m.overlayReturn
42				m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
43				return m, nil
44			case "q", "ctrl+c":
45				return m.quit()
46			}
47			return m, nil
48	
49		case overlayRemoteMenu:
50			switch message.String() {
51			case "q", "ctrl+c":
52				return m.quit()
53			case "esc", "R":
54				m.overlay = overlayNone
55				return m, nil
56			case "j", "down":
57				if m.remoteCursor+1 < m.remoteChoices.Len() {
58					m.remoteCursor++
59				}
60			case "k", "up":
61				if m.remoteCursor > 0 {
62					m.remoteCursor--
63				}
64			case "enter":
65				choices := m.remoteChoices.Values()
66				if m.remoteCursor >= 0 && m.remoteCursor < len(choices) {
67					return m.beginPlan(choices[m.remoteCursor])
68				}
69			}
70			return m, nil
71	
72		case overlayPlanLoading:
73			switch message.String() {
74			case "q", "ctrl+c":
75				m.cancelPlanRead()
76				return m.quit()
77			case "esc":
78				m.cancelPlanRead()
79				m.overlay = overlayNone
80				m.status = ""
81			}
82			return m, nil
83	
84		case overlayPlan:
85			if message.String() == "ctrl+c" {
86				return m.quit()
87			}
88			if message.String() == "esc" {
89				m.confirm.Blur()
90				m.overlay = overlayNone
91				m.status = ""
92				return m, nil
93			}
94			if !m.planCanApply() {
95				if message.String() == "q" {
96					return m.quit()
97				}
98				return m, nil
99			}
100			if m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
101				if message.String() == "enter" {
102					token := m.confirm.Value()
103					if token != m.plan.Confirmation.Token {
104						m.status = "confirmation token does not match exactly"
105						return m, nil
106					}
107					return m.startApply(taskflow.ApproveWithToken(m.plan.PlanID, token))
108				}
109				var command tea.Cmd
110				m.confirm, command = m.confirm.Update(message)
111				return m, command
112			}
113			switch message.String() {
114			case "q":
115				return m.quit()
116			case "y", "Y":
117				return m.startApply(taskflow.Approve(m.plan.PlanID))
118			}
119			return m, nil
120	
121		case overlayResult:
122			switch message.String() {
123			case "q", "ctrl+c":
124				return m.quit()
125			case "esc":
126				m.overlay = overlayNone
127				m.status = ""
128				return m, nil
129			case "r":
130				return m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
131			case "?":
132				m.overlayReturn = overlayResult
133				m.overlay = overlayHelp
134				return m, nil
135			}
136			return m, nil
137		}
138		return m, nil
139	}
140	
141	func (m Model) planCanApply() bool {
142		return m.hasPlan && m.planErr == nil && m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady
143	}
144	
145	func (m Model) startApply(approval taskflow.Approval) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
146		if !m.planCanApply() {
147			return m, nil
148		}
149		if err := m.plan.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
150			m.status = fmt.Sprintf("approval rejected: %v", err)
151			return m, nil
152		}
153		m.applyGeneration++
154		m.applyRunning = true
155		m.overlay = overlayApplying
156		m.status = "Apply in progress; quit and refresh will be queued"
157		m.hasHandoff = false
158		m.finalHandoff = taskflow.Handoff{}
159		m.hasLastResult = false
160		m.lastResult = taskflow.Result{}
161		m.lastResultErr = nil
162		return m, m.applyCmd(m.applyGeneration, m.planTarget, m.plan, approval)
163	}

336	func newFlowLoader(app *App, resolver flowRuntimeResolver, cwd string) *flowLoader {
337		loader := &flowLoader{
338			app:          app,
339			runtime:      resolver,

352		}

354			return newFlowLifecycleService(app, rt, cwd)
355		}

359	func newFlowLifecycleService(app *App, resolved runtime.Runtime, cwd string) (*taskflow.Service, error) {
360		if resolved == nil {
361			return nil, errors.New("flow runtime resolver returned no backend")
362		}
363		return taskflow.NewLifecycleService(taskflow.LifecycleConfig{
364			Config: app.Cfg, Tasks: app.Tasks, Artifacts: artifactStore(app),
365			DefaultRuntime: func() runtime.Runtime { return resolved },
366			NamedRuntime: func(name string) runtime.Runtime {
367				if name == "" || name == resolved.Name() {
368					return resolved
369				}
370				return app.runtimeNamed(name)
371			},
372			Host: config.Hostname(), CWD: cwd,
373			// The flow preview deliberately never inherits the expert shared-writer
374			// override. Its normal choices must remain fail-closed.
375			AllowSharedCheckout: false,
376			Logf: func(format string, args ...any) {
377				if app.Err != nil {
378					fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, format+"\n", args...)
379				}
380			},
381		})
382	}

387		l.repositories[repository.row.RepoKey] = repository
388		if pinned {

402	func (l *flowLoader) ListRepositories(ctx context.Context) ([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, error) {
403		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
404			return nil, err
405		}
406		records, _, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
407		if taskErr != nil {
408			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list task-referenced repositories: %w", taskErr)
409		}
410		discovered, err := l.listRepo(ctx, l.app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
411		if err != nil {
412			return nil, err
413		}
414	
415		fresh := make(map[string]flowRepository)
416		l.mu.Lock()
417		for key := range l.pinned {
418			if existing, ok := l.repositories[key]; ok {
419				fresh[key] = existing
420			}
421		}

424		for index := range discovered {

428				continue

430			entry, convertErr := availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, &candidate, "")
431			if convertErr != nil {

433			}
434			if _, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
435				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
436			}
437		}
438	
439		pathResults := make(map[string]struct {
440			repository flowRepository
441			err        error
442		})
443		for _, record := range records {
444			path := record.Task.RepoPath
445			resolved, seen := pathResults[path]
446			if !seen {
447				gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, path)
448				if discoverErr == nil {
449					resolved.repository, discoverErr = availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, nil, "")
450				}
451				resolved.err = discoverErr
452				pathResults[path] = resolved
453			}
454			if resolved.err == nil {
455				if _, exists := fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
456					fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey] = resolved.repository
457				}
458				continue
459			}
460			entry := unavailableFlowRepository(record, resolved.err)
461			if existing, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; exists {
462				existing.unavailableTasks = appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(existing.unavailableTasks, record)
463				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = existing
464			} else {
465				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
466			}
467		}

469		rows := make([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, 0, len(fresh))
470		for _, entry := range fresh {
471			rows = append(rows, entry.row)
472		}
473		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
474			left, right := strings.ToLower(rows[i].Name), strings.ToLower(rows[j].Name)
475			if left != right {
476				return left < right
477			}
478			if rows[i].Path != rows[j].Path {
479				return rows[i].Path < rows[j].Path
480			}
481			return rows[i].RepoKey < rows[j].RepoKey
482		})

484		l.repositories = fresh
485		l.mu.Unlock()

494		}

539			Runtime: rt.Name(), Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: runtimeObserved,

551		taskComplete := taskErr == nil && len(diagnostics) == 0
552		rows, targets, projectionIssues := l.projectRows(ctx, contextSnapshot, service, serviceErr, taskComplete, base)
553	
554		issues := make([]string, 0, 8)
555		if taskErr != nil {
556			issues = append(issues, "task inventory: "+taskErr.Error())
557		}
558		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
559			issues = append(issues, "task diagnostic: "+diagnostic.Error())
560		}
561		if contextSnapshot.IdentityErr != nil {
562			issues = append(issues, "repository identity: "+contextSnapshot.IdentityErr.Error())
563		}
564		if contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr != nil {

566		}
567		if rt.Name() != "none" && runtimeErr != nil {

569		}
570		for _, checkout := range contextSnapshot.Checkouts {
571			if checkout.StatusErr != nil {

573			}
574		}
575		issues = append(issues, projectionIssues...)
576		issues = uniqueStrings(issues)
577	
578		freshness := flowtui.FreshnessFresh
579		if len(issues) > 0 {
580			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
581		}
582		repositoryRow := selected.row
583		repositoryRow.Available = contextSnapshot.RepositoryID == repoKey && contextSnapshot.IdentityErr == nil
584		if contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != "" && contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != repoKey {
585			issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("repository identity changed from %s to %s", repoKey, contextSnapshot.RepositoryID))
586			repositoryRow.Available = false
587			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
588		}
589		snapshot := flowtui.Snapshot{
590			Repository: repositoryRow,
591			Surfaces:   flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
592			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(),

599			snapshot.Remote = flowtui.SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
600		}
601		l.mu.Unlock()
602		return snapshot, nil
603	}

797	func classifyFlowCheckout(checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, tracked *task.Task, managedExact bool, conflicts []string) flowtui.SurfaceKind {
798		switch {
799		case checkout.Worktree.Main:
800			return flowtui.SurfaceCanonical
801		case len(conflicts) > 0:
802			return flowtui.SurfaceConflict
803		case checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil:
804			return flowtui.SurfaceHarness
805		case tracked != nil && managedExact:
806			return flowtui.SurfaceManaged
807		default:
808			return flowtui.SurfaceUnmanaged
809		}
810	}

852	func flowCheckoutEvidence(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) []string {
853		branch := checkout.Branch()
854		if branch == "" {
855			branch = "(detached)"
856		}
857		lines := []string{
858			"path: " + checkout.Worktree.Path,
859			"branch: " + branch,
860			fmt.Sprintf("registered: Main=%t locked=%t prunable=%t bare=%t detached=%t HEAD=%s",
861				checkout.Worktree.Main, checkout.Worktree.Locked, checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
862				checkout.Worktree.Bare, checkout.Worktree.Detached, emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.Head)),
863		}
864		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
865			lines = append(lines, "registered lock reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason))
866		}
867		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
868			lines = append(lines, "registered prunable reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason))
869		}
870		switch {
871		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
872			lines = append(lines, "git: ERROR "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
873		case checkout.Worktree.Bare:
874			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (bare repository)")
875		case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
876			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (checkout unavailable)")
877		default:
878			cleanliness := "clean"
879			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
880				cleanliness = "dirty — " + checkout.Status.Breakdown()
881			}
882			lines = append(lines,
883				"git: "+cleanliness,
884				"upstream: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Status.Upstream),
885				fmt.Sprintf("ahead=%d behind=%d conflicted=%d", checkout.Status.Ahead, checkout.Status.Behind, checkout.Status.Conflicted),
886			)
887		}
888	
889		observation := checkout.RuntimeObservation
890		if observation.State == "" {
891			observation = contextSnapshot.RuntimeObservation
892		}
893		switch observation.State {
894		case inventory.ObservationAvailable:
895			if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
896				lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": observed; no covering sessions")
897			} else {
898				lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": observed")
899				for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
900					status := session.AgentStatus
901					if status == "" {
902						status = "unknown"
903					}
904					line := fmt.Sprintf("runtime session: %s:%s agent-state=%s", contextSnapshot.Runtime, emptyEvidence(session.Handle), status)
905					if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
906						line += " agents=" + strings.Join(session.AgentSessions, ",")
907					}
908					lines = append(lines, line)
909					for _, pane := range session.Panes {
910						if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" && pane.AgentStatus == "" {
911							continue
912						}
913						paneStatus := pane.AgentStatus
914						if paneStatus == "" {
915							paneStatus = "unknown"
916						}
917						lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("runtime agent pane: %s agent=%s state=%s session=%s",
918							emptyEvidence(pane.ID), emptyEvidence(pane.Agent), paneStatus, emptyEvidence(pane.AgentSession)))
919					}
920				}
921			}
922		case inventory.ObservationFailed:
923			message := "runtime observation failed"
924			if observation.Err != nil {
925				message += ": " + observation.Err.Error()
926			}
927			lines = append(lines, message)
928		default:
929			lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": unobserved; state is not known closed")
930		}
931		return lines
932	}

1	// Package lockx provides a cross-platform advisory lock over a directory.
2	//
3	// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction
4	// code need to serialize mutations, and neither should have to depend on the
5	// other to get a lock.
6	package lockx
7	
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"errors"
11		"fmt"
12		"os"
13		"path/filepath"
14	)
15	
16	// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir. The lock file
17	// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
18	// directory being protected. label names the caller in wrapped errors.
19	func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
20		if operation == nil {
21			return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
22		}
23		if ctx == nil {
24			ctx = context.Background()
25		}
26		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
27			return fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
28		}
29		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
32		}
33		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
34		if err != nil {
35			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
36		}
37		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
38		lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
41		}
42		defer func() {
43			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
44				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", label, releaseErr))
45			}
46		}()
47		return operation()
48	}
49

372	func completionGitConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) []Condition {
373		status := observed.status

375		statusEvidence := status.Summary()
376		if observed.statusErr != nil {

378			statusEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()

384		switch {
385		case !observed.hasCheckout():
386			finishVerdict = VerdictUnknown
387			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires the exact checkout"
388		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
389			finishVerdict = VerdictBlocked
390			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires an explicit base ref"
391		case observed.finishErr != nil:
392			finishVerdict = VerdictError
393			finishEvidence = observed.finishErr.Error()
394		case observed.finish.Fingerprint == "":
395			finishVerdict = VerdictError
396			finishEvidence = "finish analysis returned no content fingerprint"
397		}

399		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
400		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
401		if observed.operationErr != nil {
402			operationVerdict = VerdictError
403			operationEvidence = observed.operationErr.Error()
404		} else if observed.inProgress {
405			operationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
406			operationEvidence = "Git operation " + observed.operation + " is in progress"
407		}
408	
409		conflictVerdict := VerdictMet
410		conflictEvidence := "no unmerged paths"
411		if observed.statusErr != nil {
412			conflictVerdict = VerdictError
413			conflictEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
414		} else if observed.status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
415			conflictVerdict = VerdictBlocked
416			conflictEvidence = strconv.Itoa(max(observed.status.Conflicted, observed.finish.Status.Conflicted)) + " conflicted path(s)"
417		}
418	
419		cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence := completionDirtyCondition(observed, dirty, message)
420		return []Condition{
421			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
422			condition(ConditionFinishAnalysis, finishVerdict, RequirementRequired, finishEvidence, "refresh the exact finish analysis"),
423			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
424			condition(ConditionGitConflict, conflictVerdict, RequirementRequired, conflictEvidence, "resolve or abort conflicts before completion"),
425			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementRequired, cleanEvidence, "select fail, commit with a message, or discard"),
426		}

429	func completionDirtyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) (Verdict, string) {
430		if observed.statusErr != nil {
431			return VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
432		}
433		if !observed.status.Dirty() {
434			return VerdictMet, "checkout is clean; dirty policy " + string(dirty) + " causes no content mutation"
435		}
436		evidence := observed.status.Breakdown()
437		if observed.finishErr == nil {
438			evidence += fmt.Sprintf("; %d path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
439				observed.finish.EquivalentDirty(), observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.UniqueDirty())
440		}
441		switch dirty {
442		case DirtyAuto:
443			return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; choose an explicit dirty policy"
444		case DirtyFail:
445			return VerdictBlocked, evidence + "; fail policy refuses dirty completion"
446		case DirtyCommit:
447			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
448				return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; commit-all requires a nonempty message"
449			}
450			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; commit-all was explicitly selected"
451		case DirtyDiscard:
452			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
453				return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires DROP"
454			}
455			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires approval"
456		default:
457			return VerdictError, "unknown dirty policy " + string(dirty)
458		}
459	}

466		case observed.artifactErr != nil:

468				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
469		case observed.artifact.Ready():

471		default:
472			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
473				artifactEvidence(observed), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
474		}

20	func TestRepoContextClassifiesAndMatchesNestedCheckouts(t *testing.T) {
21		r := gittest.New(t)
22		r.Write(".gitignore", ".claude/worktrees/\n")

29		}
30		nestedPath := filepath.Join(r.Root, ".claude", "worktrees", "turn-1")

32			t.Fatal(err)
33		}
34		if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), r.Root, nestedPath, "worktree-turn-1", "main"); err != nil {
35			t.Fatal(err)
36		}
37	
38		tasks := []*task.Task{{
39			ID: "repo__feat-dev", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: r.Root,
40			Branch: "feat/dev", WorktreePath: devPath, State: task.Hot,
41		}}
42		sessions := []runtime.Session{
43			{Handle: "main", Dirs: []string{r.Root}, AgentStatus: "idle"},
44			{Handle: "dev", Dirs: []string{filepath.Join(devPath, "src")}, AgentStatus: "working",
45				AgentSessions: []string{"claude:dev"}},

59			byBranch[checkout.Branch()] = checkout

62			len(got.Sessions) != 1 || got.Sessions[0].Handle != "dev" {
63			t.Errorf("dev checkout = %+v", got)
64		}
65		if got := byBranch["worktree-turn-1"]; got.Ownership != inventory.CheckoutEphemeral ||
66			len(got.Sessions) != 1 || got.Sessions[0].Handle != "nested" {
67			t.Errorf("nested checkout = %+v", got)
68		}
69		main, _ := ctx.Main()

71			t.Errorf("nested session must not leak into main: %+v", main.Sessions)
72		}

74		markdown := inventory.FormatRepoContext(ctx, -1)

76			if !strings.Contains(markdown, want) {
77				t.Errorf("context missing %q:\n%s", want, markdown)
78			}
79		}

93	func TestRepoContextCopyPayloads(t *testing.T) {
94		ctx := inventory.RepoContext{
95			Runtime: "herdr",
96			Checkouts: []inventory.RepoCheckout{
97				{Worktree: gitx.Worktree{Path: "/repo", Branch: "main", Main: true}},
98				{Worktree: gitx.Worktree{Path: "/wt/one", Branch: "feat/one"}, Sessions: []runtime.Session{{
99					Handle: "w1", AgentStatus: "working", AgentSessions: []string{"codex:abc"},
100				}}},
101				{Worktree: gitx.Worktree{Path: "/wt/two", Branch: "feat/two"}},
102			},
103		}
104		if got := inventory.LinkedWorktreePaths(ctx); got != "/wt/one\n/wt/two" {
105			t.Errorf("LinkedWorktreePaths = %q", got)
106		}
107		if got := inventory.FormatSessions(ctx, 1); !strings.Contains(got, "herdr w1") || !strings.Contains(got, "codex:abc") {
108			t.Errorf("FormatSessions = %q", got)
109		}
110		if got := inventory.FormatSessions(ctx, 2); got != "" {
111			t.Errorf("closed checkout sessions = %q", got)
112		}
113	}

115	func TestRepoContextUsesCanonicalIdentityAndAuthoritativeMain(t *testing.T) {
116		repository := gittest.New(t)
117		linkedPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "linked")
118		if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), repository.Root, linkedPath, "feat/linked", "main"); err != nil {
119			t.Fatal(err)
120		}
121		mainRepo := discoveredRepo(t, repository.Root)
122		linkedRepo := discoveredRepo(t, linkedPath)
123		aliasRoot := t.TempDir()
124		aliasPath := filepath.Join(aliasRoot, "repo-alias")
125		if err := os.Symlink(repository.Root, aliasPath); err != nil {
126			t.Fatal(err)
127		}
128		aliasRepo := mainRepo
129		aliasRepo.Path = aliasPath
130		aliasRepo.Symlink = true
131	
132		wantRepositoryID, err := pathx.Canonical(mainRepo.CommonDir)
133		if err != nil {
134			t.Fatal(err)
135		}
136		wantMainID, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.Root)
137		if err != nil {
138			t.Fatal(err)
139		}
140		wantLinkedID, err := pathx.Canonical(linkedPath)
141		if err != nil {
142			t.Fatal(err)
143		}
144	
145		for _, tc := range []struct {
146			name       string
147			repository repo.Repo
148		}{
149			{name: "normal", repository: mainRepo},
150			{name: "linked cwd", repository: linkedRepo},
151			{name: "symlink alias", repository: aliasRepo},
152		} {
153			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
154				ctx := inventory.CollectRepoContext(context.Background(), tc.repository, nil, nil, "none")
155				if ctx.WorktreeErr != nil {
156					t.Fatal(ctx.WorktreeErr)
157				}
158				if ctx.RepositoryID != wantRepositoryID {
159					t.Errorf("RepositoryID = %q, want %q", ctx.RepositoryID, wantRepositoryID)
160				}
161				if len(ctx.Checkouts) != 2 || len(ctx.Rows) != 2 {
162					t.Fatalf("checkouts=%d rows=%d, want two authoritative checkout rows", len(ctx.Checkouts), len(ctx.Rows))
163				}
164				main, ok := ctx.Main()
165				if !ok || !main.Worktree.Main || main.Worktree.Path != wantMainID {
166					t.Fatalf("Main = %+v, want Git's actual main record at %s", main.Worktree, wantMainID)
167				}
168				if ctx.Checkouts[0].Worktree.Path != wantMainID {
169					t.Errorf("first checkout path = %q, selected path was incorrectly synthesized", ctx.Checkouts[0].Worktree.Path)
170				}
171				ids := map[string]bool{}
172				for _, row := range ctx.Rows {
173					if row.Kind != inventory.RepoContextRowCheckout || row.Checkout == nil {
174						t.Fatalf("row = %+v, want checkout row", row)
175					}
176					ids[row.ID] = true
177					if row.RepositoryID != wantRepositoryID {
178						t.Errorf("row repository ID = %q", row.RepositoryID)
179					}
180				}
181				if !ids[wantMainID] || !ids[wantLinkedID] {
182					t.Errorf("row IDs = %v, want canonical registered paths", ids)
183				}
184			})
185		}
186	}

188	func TestRepoContextIncludesBareHubWorktrees(t *testing.T) {
189		source := gittest.New(t)
190		root := t.TempDir()
191		barePath := filepath.Join(root, "project.git")
192		if _, err := gitx.Run(context.Background(), root, "clone", "--bare", source.Root, barePath); err != nil {
193			t.Fatal(err)
194		}
195		linkedPath := filepath.Join(root, "feature")
196		if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), barePath, linkedPath, "feat/hub", "main"); err != nil {
197			t.Fatal(err)
198		}
199	
200		ctx := inventory.CollectRepoContext(context.Background(), repo.Repo{
201			Name: "project", Path: barePath, Bare: true, HasGit: true,
202		}, nil, nil, "none")
203		if ctx.WorktreeErr != nil {
204			t.Fatal(ctx.WorktreeErr)
205		}
206		if len(ctx.Checkouts) != 2 || ctx.WorktreeCount != 1 {
207			t.Fatalf("checkouts=%d linked=%d, want bare record plus linked checkout", len(ctx.Checkouts), ctx.WorktreeCount)
208		}
209		main, ok := ctx.Main()
210		if !ok || !main.Worktree.Main || !main.Worktree.Bare {
211			t.Fatalf("bare hub main record = %+v", main.Worktree)
212		}
213		wantBare, _ := pathx.Canonical(barePath)
214		if main.Worktree.Path != wantBare || main.ID != wantBare {
215			t.Errorf("bare main path/id = %q/%q, want %q", main.Worktree.Path, main.ID, wantBare)
216		}
217		linked := checkoutForBranch(t, &ctx, "feat/hub")
218		if linked.Worktree.Main || linked.Worktree.Bare || !linked.Exists {
219			t.Errorf("linked checkout = %+v", linked)
220		}
221	}
