223	func TestRepoContextRowsKeepCheckoutsAndUnboundTasksExactlyOnce(t *testing.T) {
224		repository := gittest.New(t)
225		managedPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "managed")
226		externalPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "external")
227		if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), repository.Root, managedPath, "feat/managed", "main"); err != nil {
228			t.Fatal(err)
229		}
230		if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), repository.Root, externalPath, "feat/external", "main"); err != nil {
231			t.Fatal(err)
232		}
233		tasks := []*task.Task{
234			{ID: "repo__main", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root, Branch: "main", Mode: task.ModeBranch, State: task.Hot},
235			{ID: "repo__managed", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root, Branch: "feat/managed", WorktreePath: managedPath, Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done},
236			{ID: "repo__cold", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root, Branch: "feat/cold", Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Cold},
237			{ID: "repo__done", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root, Branch: "feat/done", Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done},
238		}
239	
240		ctx := inventory.CollectRepoContext(context.Background(), discoveredRepo(t, repository.Root), tasks, nil, "none")
241		if len(ctx.Checkouts) != 3 || len(ctx.OtherTasks) != 2 || len(ctx.Rows) != 5 {
242			t.Fatalf("checkouts=%d other=%d rows=%d", len(ctx.Checkouts), len(ctx.OtherTasks), len(ctx.Rows))
243		}
244		managed := checkoutForBranch(t, &ctx, "feat/managed")
245		if hasReason(managed.DriftReasons, inventory.ReasonUnexpectedCheckout) {
246			t.Fatalf("normal retained DONE worktree was marked drifted: %+v", managed.DriftReasons)
247		}
248		wantRows := map[string]bool{"repo__cold": true, "repo__done": true}
249		for _, checkout := range ctx.Checkouts {
250			wantRows[checkout.ID] = true
251		}
252		seenRows := map[string]int{}
253		for _, row := range ctx.Rows {
254			seenRows[row.ID]++
255			if row.TaskOnly() && row.ID != row.Task.ID {
256				t.Errorf("task-only row ID = %q, task ID = %q", row.ID, row.Task.ID)
257			}
258		}
259		for id := range wantRows {
260			if seenRows[id] != 1 {
261				t.Errorf("row %q appears %d times", id, seenRows[id])
262			}
263		}
264	
265		occurrences := map[string]int{}
266		for _, checkout := range ctx.Checkouts {
267			for _, binding := range checkout.TaskBindings {
268				occurrences[binding.Task.ID]++
269			}
270		}
271		for _, binding := range ctx.OtherTaskBindings {
272			occurrences[binding.Task.ID]++
273			if binding.Task.State == task.Cold || binding.Task.State == task.Done {
274				if len(binding.DriftReasons) != 0 || len(binding.ConflictReasons) != 0 {
275					t.Errorf("expected %s task %s has issues: %+v %+v", binding.Task.State, binding.Task.ID,
276						binding.DriftReasons, binding.ConflictReasons)
277				}
278			}
279		}
280		for _, tracked := range tasks {
281			if occurrences[tracked.ID] != 1 {
282				t.Errorf("task %s appears in %d bindings", tracked.ID, occurrences[tracked.ID])
283			}
284		}
285	}

323	func TestRepoContextExactPathWinsAndWrongBranchConflicts(t *testing.T) {
324		repository := gittest.New(t)
325		actualPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "actual")
326		expectedPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "expected")
327		if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), repository.Root, actualPath, "feat/actual", "main"); err != nil {
328			t.Fatal(err)
329		}
330		if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), repository.Root, expectedPath, "feat/expected", "main"); err != nil {
331			t.Fatal(err)
332		}
333		r := discoveredRepo(t, repository.Root)
334		tracked := &task.Task{
335			ID: "repo__wrong", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root,
336			Branch: "feat/expected", WorktreePath: actualPath,
337			Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Hot,
338		}
339	
340		ctx := inventory.CollectRepoContext(context.Background(), r, []*task.Task{tracked}, nil, "none")
341		actual := checkoutForBranch(t, &ctx, "feat/actual")
342		expected := checkoutForBranch(t, &ctx, "feat/expected")
343		if len(actual.TaskBindings) != 1 || actual.TaskBindings[0].Kind != inventory.TaskBindingExactPath {
344			t.Fatalf("exact-path checkout bindings = %+v", actual.TaskBindings)
345		}
346		if !hasReason(actual.TaskBindings[0].ConflictReasons, inventory.ReasonBranchMismatch) {
347			t.Errorf("wrong branch lacks conflict: %+v", actual.TaskBindings[0])
348		}
349		if len(expected.TaskBindings) != 0 || len(ctx.OtherTasks) != 0 {
350			t.Errorf("task was rebound or duplicated: expected=%+v other=%+v", expected.TaskBindings, ctx.OtherTasks)
351		}
352	
353		branchTask := &task.Task{
354			ID: "repo__branch", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root,
355			Branch: "feat/expected", WorktreePath: expectedPath,
356			Mode: task.ModeBranch, State: task.Hot,
357		}
358		ctx = inventory.CollectRepoContext(context.Background(), r, []*task.Task{branchTask}, nil, "none")
359		if len(ctx.OtherTaskBindings) != 1 || ctx.OtherTaskBindings[0].Bound() {
360			t.Fatalf("branch task outside main should remain unbound: %+v", ctx.OtherTaskBindings)
361		}
362		if !hasReason(ctx.OtherTaskBindings[0].ConflictReasons, inventory.ReasonTaskModeMismatch) {
363			t.Errorf("branch task outside main lacks conflict: %+v", ctx.OtherTaskBindings[0])
364		}
365	}

393	func TestRepoContextStrictClaudeHarnessEvidenceAndTaskConflict(t *testing.T) {
394		repository := gittest.New(t)
395		harnessPath := filepath.Join(repository.Root, ".claude", "worktrees", "turn-1")
396		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(harnessPath), 0o755); err != nil {
397			t.Fatal(err)
398		}
399		if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), repository.Root, harnessPath, "worktree-turn-1", "main"); err != nil {
400			t.Fatal(err)
401		}
402		externalPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "prefix-only")
403		if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), repository.Root, externalPath, "worktree-prefix-only", "main"); err != nil {
404			t.Fatal(err)
405		}
406		tracked := &task.Task{
407			ID: "repo__harness", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root,
408			Branch: "worktree-turn-1", WorktreePath: harnessPath,
409			Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Hot, Owner: "host-a",
410		}
411	
412		ctx := inventory.CollectRepoContext(context.Background(), discoveredRepo(t, repository.Root), []*task.Task{tracked}, nil, "none")
413		harness := checkoutForBranch(t, &ctx, "worktree-turn-1")
414		if harness.HarnessEvidence == nil || !hasEvidence(harness.OwnershipEvidence, inventory.OwnershipEvidenceClaudeHarness) ||
415			!hasEvidence(harness.OwnershipEvidence, inventory.OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask) {
416			t.Fatalf("harness ownership evidence = %+v", harness.OwnershipEvidence)
417		}
418		managedEvidence := evidenceOfKind(harness.OwnershipEvidence, inventory.OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask)
419		if managedEvidence.TaskID != tracked.ID || managedEvidence.Owner != "host-a" {
420			t.Errorf("managed ownership evidence = %+v", managedEvidence)
421		}
422		if !hasReason(harness.ConflictReasons, inventory.ReasonHarnessTaskConflict) {
423			t.Errorf("harness/task overlap conflicts = %+v", harness.ConflictReasons)
424		}
425		if harness.Ownership != inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
426			t.Errorf("harness safety evidence must win the legacy display label, got %q", harness.Ownership)
427		}
428		formatted := inventory.FormatRepoContext(ctx, -1)
429		if !strings.Contains(formatted, "Conflict: `harness-task-conflict`") {
430			t.Errorf("harness/task conflict is hidden from formatted context:\n%s", formatted)
431		}
432		external := checkoutForBranch(t, &ctx, "worktree-prefix-only")
433		if external.HarnessEvidence != nil || external.Ownership != inventory.CheckoutExternal {
434			t.Errorf("branch prefix became harness proof: %+v", external)
435		}
436		if !inventory.IsEphemeralWorktree("", "worktree-prefix-only") {
437			t.Error("legacy IsEphemeralWorktree branch-prefix compatibility changed")
438		}
439	
440		alias := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "repo-alias")
441		if err := os.Symlink(repository.Root, alias); err != nil {
442			t.Fatal(err)
443		}
444		if evidence, ok := inventory.DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(alias, harnessPath); !ok || evidence.CheckoutPath != harness.ID {
445			t.Errorf("symlink-aware harness evidence = %+v, %v", evidence, ok)
446		}
447		outsideHarness := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), ".claude", "worktrees", "turn")
448		if err := os.MkdirAll(outsideHarness, 0o755); err != nil {
449			t.Fatal(err)
450		}
451		if inventory.IsClaudeHarnessWorktree(repository.Root, outsideHarness) {
452			t.Error("a lexical .claude/worktrees path outside the selected repository was accepted")
453		}
454		escapeTarget := t.TempDir()
455		escapePath := filepath.Join(repository.Root, ".claude", "worktrees", "escape")
456		if err := os.Symlink(escapeTarget, escapePath); err != nil {
457			t.Fatal(err)
458		}
459		if inventory.IsClaudeHarnessWorktree(repository.Root, escapePath) {
460			t.Error("a symlink escaping the harness root was accepted")
461		}
462	}

574	func discoveredRepo(t *testing.T, selectedPath string) repo.Repo {
575		t.Helper()
576		discovered, err := gitx.Discover(context.Background(), selectedPath)
577		if err != nil {
578			t.Fatal(err)
579		}
580		realPath := discovered.Root
581		if realPath == "" {
582			realPath = discovered.MainRoot
583		}
584		return repo.Repo{
585			Name: discovered.Name, Path: selectedPath, RealPath: realPath,
586			GitDir: discovered.GitDir, CommonDir: discovered.GitCommonDir,
587			MainRoot: discovered.MainRoot, Bare: discovered.Bare, HasGit: true,
588		}
589	}
590	
591	func checkoutForBranch(t *testing.T, ctx *inventory.RepoContext, branch string) *inventory.RepoCheckout {
592		t.Helper()
593		for i := range ctx.Checkouts {
594			if ctx.Checkouts[i].Branch() == branch {
595				return &ctx.Checkouts[i]
596			}
597		}
598		t.Fatalf("no checkout for branch %q in %+v", branch, ctx.Checkouts)
599		return nil
600	}
601	
602	func hasReason(reasons []inventory.TopologyReason, code inventory.TopologyReasonCode) bool {
603		for _, reason := range reasons {
604			if reason.Code == code {
605				return true
606			}
607		}
608		return false
609	}
610	
611	func hasEvidence(evidence []inventory.OwnershipEvidence, kind inventory.OwnershipEvidenceKind) bool {
612		return evidenceOfKind(evidence, kind).Kind == kind
613	}
614	
615	func evidenceOfKind(evidence []inventory.OwnershipEvidence, kind inventory.OwnershipEvidenceKind) inventory.OwnershipEvidence {
616		for _, item := range evidence {
617			if item.Kind == kind {
618				return item
619			}
620		}
621		return inventory.OwnershipEvidence{}
622	}

18	func newTask(repo, branch string, st task.State) *task.Task {
19		return &task.Task{
20			Repo:     repo,
21			RepoPath: "/src/" + repo,
22			Branch:   branch,
23			Base:     "main",
24			State:    st,
25			Owner:    "test-host",
26		}
27	}

29	func TestMakeID(t *testing.T) {
30		for _, tc := range []struct{ repo, branch, want string }{
31			{"atp-sipui", "fix/gx-security-recovery", "atp-sipui__fix-gx-security-recovery"},
32			{"My Repo", "feat/a/b", "My-Repo__feat-a-b"},
33			{"", "", "repo__branch"},
34		} {
35			if got := task.MakeID(tc.repo, tc.branch); got != tc.want {
36				t.Errorf("MakeID(%q,%q) = %q, want %q", tc.repo, tc.branch, got, tc.want)
37			}
38		}
39	}

41	func TestSaveGetRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
42		s := task.NewStore(t.TempDir())
43		in := newTask("atp-sipui", "fix/gx-security-recovery", task.Warm)
44		in.Next = "finish refresh regression test"
45		in.Tags = []string{"work", "urgent"}
46		in.AgentSession = "claude:2136a917"
47		in.Mode = task.ModeDirect
48	
49		if err := s.Save(in); err != nil {
50			t.Fatalf("Save: %v", err)
51		}
52		if in.ID != "atp-sipui__fix-gx-security-recovery" {
53			t.Errorf("Save should derive the ID, got %q", in.ID)
54		}
55		if in.Created.IsZero() || in.Updated.IsZero() {
56			t.Error("Save should stamp Created and Updated")
57		}
58	
59		out, err := s.Get(in.ID)
60		if err != nil {
61			t.Fatalf("Get: %v", err)
62		}
63		if out.Next != in.Next || out.Branch != in.Branch || out.State != task.Warm {
64			t.Errorf("round trip mismatch: %+v", out)
65		}
66		if len(out.Tags) != 2 || out.AgentSession != "claude:2136a917" {
67			t.Errorf("tags/session lost: %+v", out)
68		}
69		if out.Mode != task.ModeDirect {
70			t.Errorf("mode lost: saved %q, loaded %q", in.Mode, out.Mode)
71		}
72	}

74	func TestRecordRevisionUsesExactPersistedBytesAndTaskID(t *testing.T) {
75		dir := t.TempDir()
76		s := task.NewStore(dir)
77		tk := newTask("repo", "feat/exact-bytes", task.Hot)
78		if err := s.Save(tk); err != nil {
79			t.Fatal(err)
80		}
81	
82		record, err := s.GetRecord(tk.ID)
83		if err != nil {
84			t.Fatal(err)
85		}
86		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, tk.ID+".toml"))
87		if err != nil {
88			t.Fatal(err)
89		}
90		payload := append([]byte(tk.ID+"\x00"), data...)
91		want := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(payload))
92		if record.Revision != want {
93			t.Fatalf("revision = %q, want exact byte hash %q", record.Revision, want)
94		}
95		if strings.Contains(string(data), "\nrevision =") {
96			t.Fatal("ephemeral revision must not be persisted in task TOML")
97		}
98	
99		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "other-id.toml"), data, 0o644); err != nil {
100			t.Fatal(err)
101		}
102		other, err := s.GetRecord("other-id")
103		if err != nil {
104			t.Fatal(err)
105		}
106		if other.Revision == record.Revision {
107			t.Fatal("identical bytes under different task IDs must have different revisions")
108		}
109	
110		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, tk.ID+".toml"), data, 0o644); err != nil {
111			t.Fatal(err)
112		}
113		same, err := s.GetRecord(tk.ID)
114		if err != nil {
115			t.Fatal(err)
116		}
117		if same.Revision != record.Revision {
118			t.Fatal("a byte-for-byte rewrite must retain its revision")
119		}
120	
121		changedBytes := append(append([]byte(nil), data...), '\n')
122		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, tk.ID+".toml"), changedBytes, 0o644); err != nil {
123			t.Fatal(err)
124		}
125		changed, err := s.GetRecord(tk.ID)
126		if err != nil {
127			t.Fatal(err)
128		}
129		if changed.Revision == record.Revision {
130			t.Fatal("a representation-only byte change must change the revision")
131		}
132		if !changed.Task.Updated.Equal(record.Task.Updated) {
133			t.Fatal("the representation-only change should not rely on Updated")
134		}
135	}

137	func TestSaveRevisionChangesWithinSameSecond(t *testing.T) {
138		s := task.NewStore(t.TempDir())
139		tk := newTask("repo", "feat/same-second", task.Hot)
140	
141		for attempt := 0; attempt < 10; attempt++ {
142			tk.Next = fmt.Sprintf("before-%d", attempt)
143			if err := s.Save(tk); err != nil {
144				t.Fatal(err)
145			}
146			before, err := s.GetRecord(tk.ID)
147			if err != nil {
148				t.Fatal(err)
149			}
150	
151			tk.Next = fmt.Sprintf("after-%d", attempt)
152			if err := s.Save(tk); err != nil {
153				t.Fatal(err)
154			}
155			after, err := s.GetRecord(tk.ID)
156			if err != nil {
157				t.Fatal(err)
158			}
159			if before.Task.Updated.Equal(after.Task.Updated) {
160				if before.Revision == after.Revision {
161					t.Fatal("same-second content writes must receive different revisions")
162				}
163				return
164			}
165		}
166		t.Fatal("could not observe two writes within one timestamp second")
167	}

169	func TestSaveIsAtomicAndPreservesCreated(t *testing.T) {
170		dir := t.TempDir()
171		s := task.NewStore(dir)
172		in := newTask("r", "feat/x", task.Hot)
173		if err := s.Save(in); err != nil {
174			t.Fatal(err)
175		}
176		created := in.Created
177	
178		time.Sleep(1100 * time.Millisecond) // timestamps are second-truncated
179		in.Next = "changed"
180		if err := s.Save(in); err != nil {
181			t.Fatal(err)
182		}
183		if !in.Created.Equal(created) {
184			t.Error("Created must not move on re-save")
185		}
186		if !in.Updated.After(created) {
187			t.Error("Updated should advance on re-save")
188		}
189		// No temp files left behind.
190		entries, _ := os.ReadDir(dir)
191		for _, e := range entries {
192			if strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".tmp") || strings.HasPrefix(e.Name(), ".") {
193				t.Errorf("leftover temp file %q", e.Name())
194			}
195		}
196		info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, in.ID+".toml"))
197		if err != nil {
198			t.Fatal(err)
199		}
200		if got := info.Mode().Perm(); got != 0o644 {
201			t.Errorf("task file mode = %04o, want 0644", got)
202		}
203	}

219	func TestCreateRejectsSanitizedTaskIDCollision(t *testing.T) {
220		s := task.NewStore(t.TempDir())
221		first := newTask("repo", "feat/a", task.Hot)
222		created, err := s.Create(context.Background(), first)
223		if err != nil {
224			t.Fatal(err)
225		}
226		if created.Revision == "" {
227			t.Fatal("Create must return the persisted revision")
228		}
229	
230		second := newTask("repo", "feat-a", task.Warm)
231		if task.MakeID(first.Repo, first.Branch) != task.MakeID(second.Repo, second.Branch) {
232			t.Fatal("test branches must exercise a sanitized ID collision")

238		if err != nil {
239			t.Fatal(err)

246	func TestUpdateAndDeleteRejectStaleRevision(t *testing.T) {
247		s := task.NewStore(t.TempDir())
248		created, err := s.Create(context.Background(), newTask("repo", "feat/revision", task.Hot))
249		if err != nil {
250			t.Fatal(err)
251		}
252	
253		winner := created.Task
254		winner.Next = "winner"
255		updated, err := s.Update(context.Background(), &winner, created.Revision)
256		if err != nil {
257			t.Fatal(err)
258		}
259		if updated.Revision == created.Revision {
260			t.Fatal("successful content update must return a new revision")
261		}
262	
263		stale := created.Task
264		stale.Next = "stale overwrite"
265		_, err = s.Update(context.Background(), &stale, created.Revision)
266		if !errors.Is(err, task.ErrStaleRevision) {
267			t.Fatalf("stale Update = %v, want ErrStaleRevision", err)
268		}
269		var staleErr *task.StaleRevisionError
270		if !errors.As(err, &staleErr) {
271			t.Fatalf("stale Update error type = %T, want *StaleRevisionError", err)
272		}
273		if staleErr.ID != created.Task.ID || staleErr.Expected != created.Revision || staleErr.Actual != updated.Revision {
274			t.Errorf("stale revision detail = %+v", staleErr)
275		}
276		stored, err := s.Get(created.Task.ID)
277		if err != nil {
278			t.Fatal(err)
279		}
280		if stored.Next != "winner" {
281			t.Fatalf("stale update changed persisted task to %q", stored.Next)
282		}
283	
284		if err := s.DeleteIfRevision(context.Background(), created.Task.ID, created.Revision); !errors.Is(err, task.ErrStaleRevision) {
285			t.Fatalf("stale DeleteIfRevision = %v, want ErrStaleRevision", err)
286		}
287		if _, err := s.Get(created.Task.ID); err != nil {
288			t.Fatalf("stale delete removed the task: %v", err)
289		}
290		if err := s.DeleteIfRevision(context.Background(), created.Task.ID, updated.Revision); err != nil {
291			t.Fatalf("current DeleteIfRevision: %v", err)
292		}
293		if _, err := s.Get(created.Task.ID); !errors.Is(err, task.ErrNotFound) {
294			t.Fatalf("deleted task lookup = %v, want ErrNotFound", err)
295		}
296	}

298	func TestCreateHonorsLockCancellation(t *testing.T) {
299		dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "tasks")
300		s := task.NewStore(dir)
301		entered := make(chan struct{})
302		release := make(chan struct{})
303		holderDone := make(chan error, 1)
304		go func() {
305			holderDone <- lockx.WithDir(context.Background(), dir, "task test holder", func() error {
306				close(entered)
307				<-release
308				return nil
309			})
310		}()
311		<-entered
312	
313		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 50*time.Millisecond)
314		_, transactionErr := s.Create(ctx, newTask("repo", "feat/canceled", task.Hot))
315		cancel()
316		close(release)
317		holderErr := <-holderDone
318	
319		if holderErr != nil {
320			t.Fatalf("lock holder: %v", holderErr)
321		}
322		if !errors.Is(transactionErr, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
323			t.Fatalf("contended Create = %v, want context deadline", transactionErr)
324		}
325		if _, err := s.Get(task.MakeID("repo", "feat/canceled")); !errors.Is(err, task.ErrNotFound) {
326			t.Fatalf("canceled transaction persisted a task: %v", err)
327		}
328	}

330	func TestWithLockSerializesCompatibilityWriters(t *testing.T) {
331		s := task.NewStore(t.TempDir())
332		created, err := s.Create(context.Background(), newTask("repo", "feat/transaction", task.Hot))
333		if err != nil {
334			t.Fatal(err)
335		}
336	
337		entered := make(chan struct{})
338		release := make(chan struct{})
339		transactionDone := make(chan error, 1)
340		go func() {
341			transactionDone <- s.WithLock(context.Background(), func(tx *task.Tx) error {
342				current, err := tx.GetRecord(created.Task.ID)
343				if err != nil {
344					return err
345				}
346				close(entered)
347				<-release
348				updated := current.Task
349				updated.Next = "transaction"
350				_, err = tx.Update(&updated, current.Revision)
351				return err
352			})
353		}()
354		<-entered
355	
356		compatibilityDone := make(chan error, 1)
357		compatibility := created.Task
358		compatibility.Next = "compatibility"
359		go func() { compatibilityDone <- s.Save(&compatibility) }()
360		select {
361		case err := <-compatibilityDone:
362			t.Fatalf("compatibility Save escaped the transaction lock: %v", err)
363		case <-time.After(50 * time.Millisecond):
364		}
365		close(release)
366		if err := <-transactionDone; err != nil {
367			t.Fatalf("transaction: %v", err)
368		}
369		if err := <-compatibilityDone; err != nil {
370			t.Fatalf("compatibility Save after transaction: %v", err)
371		}
372	}

533			t.Fatalf("FindByWorktree: %v", err)

574	func TestEffectiveModeInfersLegacyTasksConservatively(t *testing.T) {
575		if got := (task.Task{WorktreePath: "/wt/x"}).EffectiveMode(); got != task.ModeWorktree {
576			t.Errorf("legacy worktree mode = %q", got)
577		}
578		if got := (task.Task{}).EffectiveMode(); got != task.ModeBranch {
579			t.Errorf("legacy no-path task should infer branch, never direct: %q", got)

13	// Worktree is one entry of `git worktree list --porcelain`.
14	type Worktree struct {
15		Path string
16		// Head is the commit the worktree is checked out at.
17		Head string
18		// Branch is the short branch name, empty when detached.
19		Branch   string
20		Detached bool
21		Bare     bool
22		// Locked reports a `git worktree lock`; Prunable reports a checkout whose
23		// directory has gone missing. Both block a plain remove.
24		Locked         bool
25		LockedReason   string
26		Prunable       bool
27		PrunableReason string
28		// Main reports the primary (non-linked) checkout.
29		Main bool
30	}
31	
32	var (
33		// ErrWorktreeNotFound reports that Git's current registry has no worktree at
34		// the requested canonical path.
35		ErrWorktreeNotFound = errors.New("registered worktree not found")
36		// ErrWorktreeAmbiguous reports that multiple Git records resolve to the same
37		// canonical path. Callers must not choose one of the aliases implicitly.
38		ErrWorktreeAmbiguous = errors.New("registered worktree path is ambiguous")
39	)
40	
41	// RegisteredWorktree is an identity snapshot from Git's worktree registry.
42	// Worktree preserves the complete parsed Git record; the other fields are canonical
43	// filesystem identities suitable for exact comparison across symlink and macOS
44	// path aliases. A snapshot proves registration, not permission to remove it.
45	type RegisteredWorktree struct {
46		Worktree       Worktree
47		RepositoryPath string
48		GitCommonDir   string
49		Path           string
50	}
51	
52	// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether the record is a linked checkout rather than
53	// Git's main checkout or a bare repository. It is classification, not a removal
54	// safety decision.
55	func (w RegisteredWorktree) IsLinkedWorktree() bool {
56		return !w.Worktree.Main && !w.Worktree.Bare
57	}
58	
59	// ResolveRegisteredWorktree resolves exactPath against a fresh authoritative
60	// `git worktree list --porcelain` query for the repository containing repoPath.
61	// Matching is exclusively by canonical filesystem identity, never by branch.
62	// It performs no prune, removal, or other mutation.
63	func ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx context.Context, repoPath, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
64		worktrees, err := Worktrees(ctx, repoPath)
65		if err != nil {
66			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("query registered worktrees: %w", err)
67		}
68		commonDir, err := run(ctx, repoPath, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-common-dir")
69		if err != nil {
70			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve Git common directory: %w", err)
71		}
72		return resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees, commonDir, exactPath)
73	}
74	
75	func resolveRegisteredWorktree(worktrees []Worktree, commonDir, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
76		path, err := pathx.Canonical(exactPath)
77		if err != nil {
78			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize requested worktree %q: %w", exactPath, err)
79		}
80		canonicalCommonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
81		if err != nil {
82			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory %q: %w", commonDir, err)
83		}
84	
85		type match struct {
86			worktree Worktree
87			path     string
88		}
89		var (
90			repositoryPath string
91			matches        []match
92		)
93		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
94			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
95			if canonicalErr != nil {
96				return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize registered worktree %q: %w", worktree.Path, canonicalErr)
97			}
98			if worktree.Main {
99				repositoryPath = canonicalPath
100			}
101			if sameCanonicalPath(path, canonicalPath) {
102				matches = append(matches, match{worktree: worktree, path: canonicalPath})
103			}
104		}
105	
106		switch len(matches) {
107		case 0:
108			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrWorktreeNotFound, path)
109		case 1:
110			if repositoryPath == "" {
111				return RegisteredWorktree{}, errors.New("registered worktree query has no main repository record")
112			}
113			return RegisteredWorktree{
114				Worktree:       matches[0].worktree,
115				RepositoryPath: repositoryPath,
116				GitCommonDir:   canonicalCommonDir,
117				Path:           matches[0].path,
118			}, nil
119		default:
120			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s resolves to %d records", ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, path, len(matches))
121		}
122	}
123	
124	func sameCanonicalPath(left, right string) bool {
125		if left == right {
126			return true
127		}
128		leftInfo, leftErr := os.Stat(left)
129		rightInfo, rightErr := os.Stat(right)
130		return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && os.SameFile(leftInfo, rightInfo)
131	}
132	
133	// Worktrees lists every worktree of the repository containing dir, in git's
134	// own order: the main checkout first, then linked worktrees.
135	func Worktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]Worktree, error) {
136		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		var (
141			list []Worktree
142			cur  *Worktree
143		)
144		flush := func() {
145			if cur != nil {
146				list = append(list, *cur)
147				cur = nil
148			}
149		}
150		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
151			if line == "" { // records are blank-line separated
152				flush()
153				continue
154			}
155			key, val, _ := strings.Cut(line, " ")
156			switch key {
157			case "worktree":
158				flush()
159				cur = &Worktree{Path: val, Main: len(list) == 0}
160			case "HEAD":
161				if cur != nil {
162					cur.Head = val
163				}
164			case "branch":
165				if cur != nil {
166					cur.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(val, "refs/heads/")
167				}
168			case "detached":
169				if cur != nil {
170					cur.Detached = true
171				}
172			case "bare":
173				if cur != nil {
174					cur.Bare = true
175				}
176			case "locked":
177				if cur != nil {
178					cur.Locked, cur.LockedReason = true, val
179				}
180			case "prunable":
181				if cur != nil {
182					cur.Prunable, cur.PrunableReason = true, val
183				}
184			}
185		}
186		flush()
187		return list, nil
188	}
189	
190	// WorktreeFor finds the first worktree checked out on branch, if any. Git
191	// normally refuses duplicate branch checkouts, but --force can create them;
192	// identity-sensitive callers must use ResolveRegisteredWorktree instead.
193	func WorktreeFor(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) (Worktree, bool, error) {
194		list, err := Worktrees(ctx, dir)
195		if err != nil {
196			return Worktree{}, false, err
197		}
198		for _, w := range list {
199			if w.Branch == branch {
200				return w, true, nil
201			}
202		}
203		return Worktree{}, false, nil
204	}
205	
206	// AddWorktree creates a linked worktree at path.
207	//
208	// When branch already exists it is checked out; otherwise it is created from
209	// base. Passing an explicit base matters: without one git branches from the
210	// *current* HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on feature/A would
211	// silently inherit feature/A's commits.
212	func AddWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path, branch, base string) error {
213		exists := BranchExists(ctx, dir, branch)
214		args := []string{"worktree", "add"}
215		if exists {
216			args = append(args, path, branch)
217		} else {
218			args = append(args, "-b", branch, path)
219			if base != "" {
220				args = append(args, base)
221			}
222		}
223		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
224		return err
225	}
226	
227	// MoveWorktree relocates a linked worktree through Git so the shared
228	// administrative metadata keeps pointing at the checkout's new path. dir may
229	// be any checkout of the same repository.
230	func MoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, source, destination string) error {
231		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "move", source, destination)
232		return err
233	}
234	
235	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
236	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
237	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
238		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
239		if err != nil {
240			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current directory before removing worktree: %w", err)
241		}
242		inside, err := pathx.Contains(path, cwd)
243		if err != nil {
244			return fmt.Errorf("compare current directory with worktree %s: %w", path, err)
245		}
246		if inside {
247			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to remove worktree %s while the caller is inside it", path)
248		}
249		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
250		if force {
251			args = append(args, "--force")
252		}
253		args = append(args, path)
254		_, err = run(ctx, dir, args...)
255		return err
256	}

259	// were deleted behind git's back.
260	func PruneWorktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {

1	package repo
2	
3	import (
4		"errors"
5		"net/url"
6		"sort"
7		"strings"
8	)
9	
10	// RedactCloneRef removes URL userinfo before a clone source is rendered or
11	// persisted in a result. SSH usernames such as git@host remain visible; an
12	// scp-like prefix containing a password/token separator is redacted.
13	func RedactCloneRef(ref string) string {
14		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
15		parsed, err := url.Parse(ref)
16		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" && parsed.User != nil {
17			parsed.User = nil
18			return parsed.String()
19		}
20		at := strings.LastIndex(ref, "@")
21		if at > 0 && strings.Contains(ref[:at], ":") {
22			return "***@" + ref[at+1:]
23		}
24		return ref
25	}
26	
27	// RedactCloneError returns an error whose displayed message cannot echo
28	// credential-bearing clone references passed to Git.
29	func RedactCloneError(err error, refs ...string) error {
30		if err == nil {
31			return nil
32		}
33		message := err.Error()
34		refs = append([]string(nil), refs...)
35		sort.SliceStable(refs, func(i, j int) bool { return len(refs[i]) > len(refs[j]) })
36		for _, ref := range refs {
37			if ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref); ref != "" {
38				message = strings.ReplaceAll(message, ref, RedactCloneRef(ref))
39			}
40		}
41		return errors.New(message)
42	}
43

44	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshRemoteHandler() Handler {

48	func validateRefreshRemoteLocator(locator Locator) error {
49		switch {
50		case locator.RepoPath == "":
51			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
52		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
53			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
54		case !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Branch):
55			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact head branch %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Branch)
56		case locator.Base != "" && !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Base):
57			return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Base)
58		case locator.HeadOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.HeadOID):
59			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact HEAD OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.HeadOID)
60		case locator.BaseOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.BaseOID):
61			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact base OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.BaseOID)
62		}
63	
64		if locator.TaskID == "" {
65			switch {
66			case locator.TaskRevision != "":
67				return fmt.Errorf("%w: task revision requires a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
68			case locator.HeadOID == "":
69				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged remote refresh requires an exact HEAD OID", ErrInvalidRequest)
70			case locator.Mode != "" && !validMode(locator.Mode):
71				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown checkout mode %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Mode)
72			case locator.State != "" && !validState(locator.State):

238	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRemoteRefNames(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) error {
239		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
240			"head":        "refs/heads/" + head,
241			"remote name": "refs/remotes/" + remote + "/__dev_refresh_probe__",
242		} {
243			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", ref); err != nil {
244				return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not a valid normalized Git name: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, label, err)
245			}
246		}
247		if base != "" {
248			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", "refs/heads/"+base); err != nil {
249				return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base is not a valid normalized Git branch: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
250			}
251		}
252		return nil
253	}
254	
255	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRefreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, locator Locator, observed *remoteRefreshObservation) error {
256		checkout := locator.CheckoutPath
257		if checkout == "" {
258			checkout = locator.RepoPath
259		}
260		canonical, err := s.canonicalPath(checkout)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize selected checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
263		}
264		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, canonical)
265		if err != nil {
266			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout registration changed: " + err.Error()}
267		}
268		if registered.Path != canonical || registered.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
269			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout no longer belongs to the exact repository identity"}
270		}
271		if registered.Worktree.Detached || registered.Worktree.Branch != locator.Branch {
272			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
273				"selected checkout branch changed from %q to %q", locator.Branch, registered.Worktree.Branch,
274			)}
275		}
276		liveHead, err := s.gitRun(ctx, canonical, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
277		if err != nil {
278			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout HEAD is no longer observable: " + err.Error()}
279		}
280		liveHead = strings.TrimSpace(liveHead)
281		if registered.Worktree.Head != liveHead || locator.HeadOID != liveHead {
282			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
283				"selected checkout HEAD changed from %q to registry=%q live=%q", locator.HeadOID, registered.Worktree.Head, liveHead,
284			)}
285		}
286		observed.checkout = canonical
287		observed.worktree = registered
288		return nil
289	}
290	
291	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRemoteRefs(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) RemoteRefsObservation {
292		result := RemoteRefsObservation{ObservedAt: s.now()}
293		result.LocalHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+head)
294		result.RemoteHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+head)
295		if base != "" {
296			result.LocalBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+base)
297			result.RemoteBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
298		}
299		return result
300	}
301	
302	func (s *lifecycleService) observeNamedRef(ctx context.Context, repoPath, ref string) NamedRefObservation {
303		observed := NamedRefObservation{Ref: ref}
304		if !s.gitRefExists(ctx, repoPath, ref) {
305			return observed
306		}
307		observed.Exists = true
308		oid, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, ref)
309		if err != nil {
310			observed.Failure = err.Error()
311			return observed
312		}
313		observed.OID = oid
314		return observed
315	}
316	
317	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshRemoteSpec(request Request, observed remoteRefreshObservation) PlanSpec {
318		options := request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions)
319		conditions := []Condition{
320			refreshTaskCondition(observed),
321			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
322				"Git main "+observed.repoPath+" with common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
323			refreshHeadCondition(observed),
324			refreshRemoteURLCondition(observed),
325			refreshRefsCondition(observed),
326			refreshReviewBaseCondition(observed, options),
327			refreshReviewProviderCondition(observed, options),
328			refreshReviewCapabilityCondition(observed, options),
329			refreshReviewCLICondition(observed, options),
330		}

66			Long: `Preview the repository lifecycle state machine in a full-screen interface.
67	
68	Without an argument, a checkout opens its canonical repository and focuses the
69	exact current worktree. Outside Git, dev opens an asynchronous repository
70	picker. An explicit repository reference always overrides the current directory.

72	Local refreshes do not contact remotes. Enter first builds an exact guarded plan;
73	only the plan's second confirmation can apply it.`,

80				if len(args) == 1 {
81					ref = args[0]
82				}
83				launch, err := resolveFlowLaunch(ctxOf(), app, ref, deps)
84				if err != nil {
85					return err
86				}
87				return runFlow(app, launch, deps.runProgram)
88			},
89		}

92	func resolveFlowLaunch(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string, deps flowCommandDeps) (flowLaunch, error) {
93		var launch flowLaunch
94		if deps.getwd == nil || deps.discover == nil || deps.resolve == nil {
95			return launch, errors.New("flow command dependencies are incomplete")
96		}
97		cwd, err := deps.getwd()
98		if err != nil {
99			return launch, fmt.Errorf("resolve flow caller directory: %w", err)
100		}
101		launch.cwd = cwd
102	
103		if ref != "" {
104			resolved, _, err := deps.resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
105			if err != nil {
106				return launch, err
107			}
108			queryPath := resolved.Path
109			if queryPath == "" {
110				queryPath = resolved.RealPath
111			}
112			discovered, err := deps.discover(ctx, queryPath)
113			if err != nil {
114				return launch, fmt.Errorf("discover explicit repository %s: %w", config.Contract(queryPath), err)
115			}
116			repository, err := availableFlowRepository(discovered, &resolved, discovered.Root)
117			if err != nil {
118				return launch, err
119			}
120			launch.repository = &repository
121			row := repository.row
122			launch.preselected = &row
123			return launch, nil
124		}
125	
126		discovered, err := deps.discover(ctx, cwd)
127		if errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
128			return launch, nil
129		}
130		if err != nil {
131			return launch, fmt.Errorf("discover current repository from %s: %w", config.Contract(cwd), err)
132		}
133		repository, err := availableFlowRepository(discovered, nil, discovered.Root)
134		if err != nil {
135			return launch, err
136		}
137		launch.repository = &repository
138		row := repository.row
139		launch.preselected = &row
140		return launch, nil
141	}

143	func runFlow(app *App, launch flowLaunch, runProgram flowProgramRunner) error {
144		if runProgram == nil {
145			return errors.New("flow program runner is unavailable")
146		}
147		flowtui.SetColorEnabled(app.outStyle().enabled)
148		app.traceTUI = true
149		runCtx, cancelRun := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
150		finishSetup := app.trace.Start(perftrace.TUISetup, perftrace.Fields{})
151		runtimeResolver := newTUIRuntimeResolver(app)
152		loader := newFlowLoader(app, runtimeResolver, launch.cwd)
153		if launch.repository != nil {
154			loader.registerRepository(*launch.repository, true)
155		}
156		actions := loader.actions()
157		if app.deferredReleaseRefresh {
158			actions.AfterFirstView = func(context.Context) { app.refreshReleaseDetached() }
159		}
160		model := flowtui.New(actions, launch.preselected).WithContext(runCtx)
161		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
162		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
163		final, err := runProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen())
164		cancelRun()
165		app.finishTrace()
166		if err != nil {
167			return err
168		}
169		withHandoff, ok := final.(interface {
170			Handoff() (taskflow.Handoff, bool)
171		})
172		if !ok {
173			return nil
174		}
175		handoff, ok := withHandoff.Handoff()
176		if !ok {
177			return nil
178		}
179		return honorFlowHandoff(app, runtimeResolver, handoff)
180	}
181	
182	func honorFlowHandoff(app *App, resolver flowRuntimeResolver, handoff taskflow.Handoff) error {
183		switch handoff.Kind {
184		case taskflow.HandoffDirectory:
185			if handoff.Path == "" {
186				return errors.New("flow returned an empty directory handoff")
187			}
188			return app.cdDirective(handoff.Path)
189		case taskflow.HandoffRuntime:
190			if handoff.Runtime == "" || handoff.RuntimeHandle == "" {
191				return errors.New("flow returned an incomplete runtime handoff")
192			}
193			var rt runtime.Runtime
194			if resolver != nil {
195				resolved, err := resolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
196				if err != nil {
197					return err
198				}
199				if resolved != nil && resolved.Name() == handoff.Runtime {
200					rt = resolved
201				}
202			}
203			if rt == nil {
204				rt = app.runtimeNamed(handoff.Runtime)
205			}
206			if rt == nil || rt.Name() != handoff.Runtime {
207				return fmt.Errorf("flow handoff backend %q is unavailable", handoff.Runtime)
208			}
209			return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
210		case taskflow.HandoffURL:
211			if handoff.URL == "" {
212				return errors.New("flow returned an empty URL handoff")
213			}
214			_, err := fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, handoff.URL)
215			return err
216		default:
217			return fmt.Errorf("flow returned unsupported handoff kind %q", handoff.Kind)
218		}
219	}

232	func availableFlowRepository(discovered gitx.Repo, preferred *repo.Repo, focus string) (flowRepository, error) {
233		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(discovered.GitCommonDir)
234		if err != nil {
235			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository identity: %w", err)
236		}
237		mainRoot := discovered.MainRoot
238		if mainRoot == "" && discovered.Bare {
239			mainRoot = discovered.GitCommonDir
240		}
241		mainRoot, err = pathx.Canonical(mainRoot)
242		if err != nil {
243			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository root: %w", err)
244		}
245		focusTarget := ""
246		if focus != "" {
247			focusTarget, err = pathx.Canonical(focus)
248			if err != nil {
249				return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow focus: %w", err)
250			}
251		}
252	
253		r := repo.Repo{
254			Name: discovered.Name, Path: mainRoot, RealPath: mainRoot,
255			CommonDir: commonDir, MainRoot: mainRoot, Bare: discovered.Bare, HasGit: true,
256		}
257		name := discovered.Name
258		if preferred != nil {
259			if preferred.Name != "" {
260				r.Name = preferred.Name
261			}
262			r.Root = preferred.Root
263			r.Category = preferred.Category
264			name = preferred.Display()
265			if name == "" {
266				name = r.Name
267			}
268		}
269		return flowRepository{
270			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
271				RepoKey: commonDir, Name: name, Path: mainRoot, Available: true,
272				FocusTarget: focusTarget,
273			},
274			repository: r,
275			available:  true,
276		}, nil
277	}

279	func unavailableFlowRepository(record task.Record, cause error) flowRepository {
280		path := record.Task.RepoPath
281		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
282			path = canonical
283		} else if absolute, absErr := filepath.Abs(path); absErr == nil {
284			path = filepath.Clean(absolute)
285		}
286		name := record.Task.Repo
287		if name == "" {
288			name = filepath.Base(path)
289		}
290		message := "repository is unavailable"
291		if cause != nil {
292			message += ": " + cause.Error()
293		}
294		return flowRepository{
295			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
296				RepoKey: "unavailable:" + path, Name: name, Path: path,
297				Available: false, Error: message,
298			},
299			available:        false,
300			unavailableTasks: []task.Record{record},
301		}
302	}

359	func newFlowLifecycleService(app *App, resolved runtime.Runtime, cwd string) (*taskflow.Service, error) {
360		if resolved == nil {
361			return nil, errors.New("flow runtime resolver returned no backend")
362		}

364			Config: app.Cfg, Tasks: app.Tasks, Artifacts: artifactStore(app),
365			DefaultRuntime: func() runtime.Runtime { return resolved },
366			NamedRuntime: func(name string) runtime.Runtime {
367				if name == "" || name == resolved.Name() {
368					return resolved
369				}
370				return app.runtimeNamed(name)
371			},
372			Host: config.Hostname(), CWD: cwd,
373			// The flow preview deliberately never inherits the expert shared-writer
374			// override. Its normal choices must remain fail-closed.
375			AllowSharedCheckout: false,
376			Logf: func(format string, args ...any) {
377				if app.Err != nil {
378					fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, format+"\n", args...)
379				}
380			},
381		})
382	}

647	func (l *flowLoader) projectRows(
648		ctx context.Context,
649		contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext,
650		service *taskflow.Service,
651		serviceErr error,
652		taskInventoryComplete bool,
653		defaultBase string,
654	) ([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, map[string]flowTarget, []string) {
655		rows := make([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, 0, len(contextSnapshot.Rows))
656		targets := make(map[string]flowTarget)
657		var issues []string
658		for _, contextRow := range contextSnapshot.Rows {
659			projected, rowIssues := l.projectRow(ctx, contextSnapshot, contextRow, service, serviceErr, taskInventoryComplete, defaultBase)
660			issues = append(issues, rowIssues...)
661	
662			validChoices := make([]flowtui.ActionChoice, 0, projected.Actions.Len())
663			for _, choice := range projected.Actions.Values() {
664				request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(projected.Locator, choice.Options())
665				if err != nil {
666					issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("row %s action %s: %v", projected.RowKey, choice.ID, err))
667					continue
668				}
669				target := flowTarget{
670					repoKey: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID, rowKey: projected.RowKey,
671					actionID: choice.ID, request: request,
672				}
673				targets[flowTargetKey(target.repoKey, target.rowKey, target.actionID)] = target
674				validChoices = append(validChoices, choice)
675			}
676			projected.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(validChoices...)
677			rows = append(rows, projected)
678		}
679		return rows, targets, issues
680	}

682	func (l *flowLoader) projectRow(
683		ctx context.Context,

711					issues = append(issues, "managed locator "+tracked.ID+": "+err.Error())
712				} else if err := validateProjectedManagedLocator(contextSnapshot, contextRow, tracked, locator); err != nil {
713					conflicts = append(conflicts, "locator-mismatch: "+err.Error())
714					issues = append(issues, "managed locator "+tracked.ID+": "+err.Error())
715				} else {
716					managedLocator, managedExact = locator, true
717				}
718			}
719		}
720	
721		row := flowtui.SurfaceRow{
722			RowKey: contextRow.ID,
723			Kind:   flowtui.SurfaceTaskOnly,
724			Drift:  flowtui.NewLines(uniqueStrings(drift)...),
725			Base:   defaultBase,
726		}
727		if tracked != nil {
728			row.Label = tracked.Title()
729			row.Branch = tracked.Branch
730			row.Base = tracked.Base
731			row.Mode = tracked.EffectiveMode()
732			row.State = tracked.State
733			row.Locator = managedLocator
734		}
735	
736		if contextRow.Checkout != nil {
737			checkout := contextRow.Checkout
738			row.Path = checkout.ID
739			row.Branch = checkout.Branch()
740			row.Kind = classifyFlowCheckout(*checkout, tracked, managedExact, conflicts)
741			row.Label = flowCheckoutLabel(*checkout, tracked, row.Kind)
742			exactGitLocator := flowGitLocator(contextSnapshot, *checkout, defaultBase)

748				inspection, err := l.inspect(ctx, artifactStore(l.app), checkout.Worktree.Path)

752				}
753			}
754		} else if tracked != nil {
755			evidence := append([]string{
756				"repository path: " + tracked.RepoPath,
757				"checkout: no registered checkout is bound to this task",
758			}, flowTaskEvidence(tracked)...)
759			evidence = append(evidence, flowTaskOnlyRuntimeEvidence(contextSnapshot)...)
760			if tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
761				evidence = append(evidence, "recorded checkout: "+tracked.WorktreePath)
762			}
763			row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(evidence...)
764		}
765		if tracked != nil && contextRow.Checkout != nil {
766			row.Evidence = flowtui.NewLines(append(row.Evidence.Values(), flowTaskEvidence(tracked)...)...)
767		}
768	
769		conflicts = uniqueStrings(conflicts)
770		row.Conflicts = flowtui.NewLines(conflicts...)
771		if managedExact && len(conflicts) == 0 {
772			row.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(managedFlowChoices(*tracked)...)
773		} else if row.Kind == flowtui.SurfaceUnmanaged && taskInventoryComplete && exactFlowLocator(row.Locator) {

776		if exactFlowRemoteLocator(row.Locator) {

779		}
780		return row, issues

783	func validateProjectedManagedLocator(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, row inventory.RepoContextRow, tracked *task.Task, locator taskflow.Locator) error {
784		if locator.RepoKey != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID || locator.RepositoryID != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID ||
785			locator.GitCommonDir != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID {
786			return errors.New("locator repository identity differs from inventory")
787		}
788		if locator.TaskID != tracked.ID || locator.Mode != tracked.EffectiveMode() || locator.State != tracked.State {
789			return errors.New("locator task identity, mode, or state differs from inventory")
790		}
791		if row.Checkout != nil && locator.CheckoutPath != row.Checkout.ID {
792			return fmt.Errorf("locator checkout %q differs from row %q", locator.CheckoutPath, row.Checkout.ID)
793		}

797	func classifyFlowCheckout(checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, tracked *task.Task, managedExact bool, conflicts []string) flowtui.SurfaceKind {
798		switch {
799		case checkout.Worktree.Main:
800			return flowtui.SurfaceCanonical
801		case len(conflicts) > 0:
802			return flowtui.SurfaceConflict
803		case checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil:
804			return flowtui.SurfaceHarness
805		case tracked != nil && managedExact:
806			return flowtui.SurfaceManaged
807		default:
808			return flowtui.SurfaceUnmanaged
809		}
810	}

812	func flowCheckoutLabel(checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, tracked *task.Task, kind flowtui.SurfaceKind) string {
813		branch := checkout.Branch()
814		if branch == "" {
815			branch = "detached HEAD"
816		}
817		if tracked != nil {
818			return tracked.Title() + " · " + branch
819		}
820		switch kind {
821		case flowtui.SurfaceCanonical:
822			return "Main · " + branch
823		case flowtui.SurfaceHarness:
824			return "Harness · " + branch
825		case flowtui.SurfaceConflict:
826			return "Conflict · " + branch
827		default:
828			return branch
829		}
830	}

852	func flowCheckoutEvidence(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) []string {
853		branch := checkout.Branch()
854		if branch == "" {
855			branch = "(detached)"
856		}
857		lines := []string{
858			"path: " + checkout.Worktree.Path,
859			"branch: " + branch,
860			fmt.Sprintf("registered: Main=%t locked=%t prunable=%t bare=%t detached=%t HEAD=%s",
861				checkout.Worktree.Main, checkout.Worktree.Locked, checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
862				checkout.Worktree.Bare, checkout.Worktree.Detached, emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.Head)),
863		}
864		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
865			lines = append(lines, "registered lock reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason))
866		}
867		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
868			lines = append(lines, "registered prunable reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason))
869		}
870		switch {
871		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
872			lines = append(lines, "git: ERROR "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
873		case checkout.Worktree.Bare:
874			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (bare repository)")
875		case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
876			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (checkout unavailable)")
877		default:
878			cleanliness := "clean"
879			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
880				cleanliness = "dirty — " + checkout.Status.Breakdown()
881			}
882			lines = append(lines,
883				"git: "+cleanliness,
884				"upstream: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Status.Upstream),

905					if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {

919					}
920				}
921			}

923			message := "runtime observation failed"
924			if observation.Err != nil {

926			}

928		default:

974	func artifactSummary(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection, err error) string {
975		if err != nil {

977		}
978		if inspection.KnownEmpty && len(inspection.Intents) == 0 {
979			return "artifact: ready; no intents"
980		}
981		counts := make(map[artifact.ReadinessState]int)
982		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
983			counts[intent.State]++
984		}
985		states := make([]string, 0, len(counts))
986		for state, count := range counts {
987			states = append(states, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%d", state, count))
988		}
989		sort.Strings(states)
990		readiness := "blocked or unknown"
991		if inspection.Ready() {
992			readiness = "ready"
993		}
994		if len(states) == 0 {
995			states = append(states, "no classified intents")
996		}
997		return "artifact: " + readiness + "; " + strings.Join(states, ", ")
998	}

1054	func (l *flowLoader) Plan(
1055		ctx context.Context,
1056		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1057		locator taskflow.Locator,
1058		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1059	) (taskflow.Plan, error) {
1060		expected, request, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1061		if err != nil {
1062			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1063		}
1064		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1065		if err != nil {
1066			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1067		}
1068		service, err := l.service(rt)
1069		if err != nil {
1070			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1071		}
1072		plan, err := service.Plan(ctx, request)
1073		if err != nil {
1074			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1075		}
1076		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1077			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1078		}
1079		l.mu.Lock()
1080		l.approved[plan.PlanID] = flowApprovedPlan{target: expected, plan: plan.Clone()}
1081		l.mu.Unlock()
1082		return plan, nil
1083	}
1084	
1085	func (l *flowLoader) Apply(
1086		ctx context.Context,
1087		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1088		locator taskflow.Locator,
1089		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1090		plan taskflow.Plan,
1091		approval taskflow.Approval,
1092	) (taskflow.Result, error) {
1093		expected, _, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1094		if err != nil {
1095			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1096		}
1097		l.mu.Lock()
1098		approved, ok := l.approved[plan.PlanID]
1099		l.mu.Unlock()
1100		if !ok {
1101			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply rejected a plan not produced by this run")
1102		}
1103		if !sameFlowTarget(approved.target, expected) {
1104			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply target differs from the approved repository, row, action, locator, or options")
1105		}
1106		if !reflect.DeepEqual(approved.plan.Clone(), plan.Clone()) {
1107			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply plan differs from the exact approved plan")
1108		}
1109		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1110			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1111		}
1112		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1113		if err != nil {
1114			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1115		}
1116		service, err := l.service(rt)
1117		if err != nil {
1118			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1119		}
1120		result, applyErr := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
1121		l.mu.Lock()
1122		delete(l.approved, plan.PlanID)
1123		if remote, exists := result.RemoteObservation(); exists {
1124			l.remote[repoKey] = remote.Clone()
1125		}
1126		l.mu.Unlock()
1127		return result, applyErr
1128	}
1129	
1130	func (l *flowLoader) validateTarget(
1131		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1132		locator taskflow.Locator,
1133		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1134	) (flowTarget, taskflow.Request, error) {
1135		request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(locator, options)
1136		if err != nil {
1137			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, err
1138		}
1139		key := flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID)
1140		l.mu.Lock()
1141		expected, ok := l.targets[repoKey][key]
1142		l.mu.Unlock()
1143		if !ok {
1144			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action no longer matches the current repository snapshot")
1145		}
1146		actual := flowTarget{repoKey: repoKey, rowKey: rowKey, actionID: actionID, request: request}
1147		if !sameFlowTarget(expected, actual) {
1148			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action locator or options differ from the current exact row choice")
1149		}
1150		return expected, request, nil
1151	}
1152	
1153	func validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan taskflow.Plan, expected flowTarget) error {
1154		if err := plan.Validate(); err != nil {
1155			return err
1156		}
1157		if plan.Locator != expected.request.Locator || plan.Request.Locator != expected.request.Locator ||
1158			plan.Action != expected.request.Action || plan.Request.Action != expected.request.Action ||
1159			!reflect.DeepEqual(plan.Request.Options, expected.request.Options) {
1160			return errors.New("taskflow plan does not match the exact flow request identity")
1161		}
1162		return nil
1163	}
1164	
1165	func sameFlowTarget(left, right flowTarget) bool {
1166		return left.repoKey == right.repoKey && left.rowKey == right.rowKey && left.actionID == right.actionID &&
1167			left.request.Locator == right.request.Locator && left.request.Action == right.request.Action &&
1168			reflect.DeepEqual(left.request.Options, right.request.Options)
1169	}
1170	
1171	func flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID string) string {
1172		return repoKey + "\x00" + rowKey + "\x00" + actionID
1173	}

1176		if ctx == nil {

1178		}

1182	func emptyEvidence(value string) string {
1183		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
1184			return "(none)"
1185		}
1186		return value
1187	}

1189	func uniqueStrings(values []string) []string {
1190		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(values))
1191		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
1192		for _, value := range values {
1193			if value == "" || seen[value] {
1194				continue
1195			}
1196			seen[value] = true
1197			out = append(out, value)
1198		}
1199		return out
1200	}

203	func renderLifecycleResult(app *App, plan flow.Plan, result flow.Result) {
204		style := app.outStyle()
205		for _, step := range result.AttemptedSteps() {
206			if step.Status == flow.StepFailed {
207				label := step.Effect.Description
208				if label == "" {
209					label = string(step.Effect.Code)
210				}
211				failure := step.Failure
212				if failure == "" {
213					failure = "operation failed"
214				}
215				app.warnf("%s failed: %s", label, failure)
216				continue
217			}
218			if step.Status != flow.StepCompleted {
219				continue
220			}
221	
222			details := step.Effect.Details.Map()
223			switch step.Effect.Code {
224			case flow.EffectCommitWIP, flow.EffectCommitAll:
225				message := details["message"]
226				if message == "" {
227					message = step.Detail
228				}
229				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("committed"), message)
230			case flow.EffectDiscardAll:
231				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  checkout changes\n", style.label("discarded"))
232			case flow.EffectPushBranch, flow.EffectPushBase:
233				pushed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "pushed ")
234				pushed = strings.TrimPrefix(pushed, "published ")
235				if pushed == step.Detail || pushed == "" {
236					pushed = "origin/" + step.Effect.Target
237				}
238				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("pushed"), pushed)
239			case flow.EffectCloseRuntime:
240				closed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "closed ")
241				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("closed"), closed)
242			case flow.EffectRemoveWorktree:
243				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s removed: %s\n", style.label("worktree"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
244			case flow.EffectDeleteBranch:
245				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s deleted\n", style.label("branch"), step.Effect.Target)
246			case flow.EffectDeleteTask:
247				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s reaped\n", style.label("task"), step.Effect.Target)
248			case flow.EffectRebaseBranch:
249				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebased"), strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "rebased "))
250			case flow.EffectSwitchBase, flow.EffectSwitchBranch:
251				switched := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "switched ")
252				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("switched"), switched)
253			case flow.EffectMergeFF:
254				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("integrated"), step.Detail)
255			case flow.EffectCreateReview:
256				if handoff, ok := result.Handoff(); ok && handoff.Kind == flow.HandoffURL && handoff.URL != "" {
257					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("opened"), handoff.URL)
258				}
259			case flow.EffectVerifyAncestry:
260				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("verified"), step.Detail)
261			case flow.EffectUpdateTask:
262				if isCompletionAction(plan.Action) {
263					state := details["state"]
264					if state == "" {
265						state = "lifecycle state"
266					}
267					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("recorded"), strings.ToUpper(state))
268				}
269			case flow.EffectCreateWorktree:
270				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebuilt"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
271			}
272		}
273		for _, warning := range result.Warnings() {
274			switch warning {
275			case "no next action is recorded":
276				app.warnf("no next action recorded — `dev park --next \"...\"` is what makes resuming cheap")
277			default:
278				app.warnf("%s", warning)
279			}
280		}
281		for _, recovery := range result.Recovery() {
282			app.warnf("recovery: %s", recovery)
283		}
284	}
285	
286	func isCompletionAction(action flow.Action) bool {
287		switch action {
288		case flow.CompleteDirect, flow.CompleteFF, flow.ReviewHandoff, flow.VerifyMerged:
289			return true
290		default:
291			return false
292		}
293	}
294	
295	func presentLifecycleRequestError(selected task.Task, action flow.Action, err error) error {
296		var transition *flow.InvalidTransitionError
297		if !errors.As(err, &transition) {
298			return err
299		}
300		if action == flow.ParkCold && selected.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
301			return fmt.Errorf("direct task %s uses the canonical checkout on %s, so it cannot go cold; park it warm or finish it: %w",
302				selected.Title(), selected.Branch, err)
303		}
304		if action == flow.Retire {
305			return fmt.Errorf("task %s is %s, not merged; run dev done first: %w", selected.ID, selected.State, err)
306		}
307		return err
308	}
309	
310	func presentLifecycleApplyError(plan flow.Plan, err error) error {
311		if !errors.Is(err, flow.ErrPlanNotReady) {
312			return err
313		}
314		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
315		for _, condition := range blocking {
316			switch condition.Code {
317			case flow.ConditionCheckoutClean:
318				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
319					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes (%s).\nCommit them, or re-run with --force to discard them: %w",
320						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
321				}
322				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
323					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes; going cold removes the worktree.\nCommit them, or re-run with --wip to checkpoint automatically: %w",
324						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), err)
325				}
326			case flow.ConditionBranchPublished, flow.ConditionBranchPushed:
327				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
328					return fmt.Errorf("%s is not fully pushed (%s); a cold task must be reconstructible from the remote.\nRun `dev park --cold --push`: %w",
329						plan.Locator.Branch, condition.Evidence, err)
330				}
331			case flow.ConditionTaskClaims:
332				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
333					return fmt.Errorf("%s is claimed by task metadata (%s).\nUse managed dev park/dev retire, or reconcile the task claim before removing this checkout: %w",
334						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
335				}
336			case flow.ConditionTaskInventory:
337				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
338					return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove %s is unmanaged because task inventory is incomplete (%s).\nRepair or reconcile task metadata before using dev park/dev retire or removing this checkout: %w",
339						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
340				}
341			case flow.ConditionOwner:
342				if plan.Action == flow.Resume {
343					owner := plan.AuthorityFields()["task.owner"]
344					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is owned by %s.\nMake sure that machine has pushed its work, then re-run with --force to take ownership: %w",
345						plan.Locator.TaskID, owner, err)
346				}
347			case flow.ConditionAgentOccupancy:
348				if plan.Action == flow.Resume && strings.HasPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ") {
349					occupant := strings.TrimPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ")
350					return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership: %w",
351						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), occupant, err)
352				}
353			}
354		}
355	
356		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
357		for _, condition := range blocking {
358			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
359			if condition.Remediation != "" {
360				message += " (" + condition.Remediation + ")"
361			}
362			parts = append(parts, message)
363		}
364		if len(parts) == 0 {
365			return err
366		}
367		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability, strings.Join(parts, "; "), err)
368	}
369

238	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRemoteRefNames(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) error {
239		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
240			"head":        "refs/heads/" + head,
241			"remote name": "refs/remotes/" + remote + "/__dev_refresh_probe__",
242		} {
243			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", ref); err != nil {
244				return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not a valid normalized Git name: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, label, err)
245			}

250			}

255	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRefreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, locator Locator, observed *remoteRefreshObservation) error {
256		checkout := locator.CheckoutPath
257		if checkout == "" {
258			checkout = locator.RepoPath
259		}
260		canonical, err := s.canonicalPath(checkout)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize selected checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
263		}
264		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, canonical)
265		if err != nil {
266			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout registration changed: " + err.Error()}
267		}
268		if registered.Path != canonical || registered.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
269			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout no longer belongs to the exact repository identity"}
270		}
271		if registered.Worktree.Detached || registered.Worktree.Branch != locator.Branch {
272			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
273				"selected checkout branch changed from %q to %q", locator.Branch, registered.Worktree.Branch,
274			)}
275		}
276		liveHead, err := s.gitRun(ctx, canonical, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
277		if err != nil {
278			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout HEAD is no longer observable: " + err.Error()}

284			)}
285		}
286		observed.checkout = canonical
287		observed.worktree = registered
288		return nil

291	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRemoteRefs(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) RemoteRefsObservation {
292		result := RemoteRefsObservation{ObservedAt: s.now()}
293		result.LocalHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+head)
294		result.RemoteHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+head)
295		if base != "" {
296			result.LocalBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+base)
297			result.RemoteBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
298		}
299		return result
300	}

302	func (s *lifecycleService) observeNamedRef(ctx context.Context, repoPath, ref string) NamedRefObservation {
303		observed := NamedRefObservation{Ref: ref}
304		if !s.gitRefExists(ctx, repoPath, ref) {
305			return observed
306		}
307		observed.Exists = true
308		oid, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, ref)
309		if err != nil {
310			observed.Failure = err.Error()
311			return observed
312		}
313		observed.OID = oid
314		return observed

338					"pre-refs": remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs),
339				},
340			))
341		}
342		if options.QueryReview {

345				map[string]string{

348					"head": observed.head, "base": observed.base,

370	func refreshTaskCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
371		if observed.record == nil {
372			return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
373				"repository/checkout context has no persisted task record", "")
374		}
375		return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
376			"task "+observed.record.Task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision+" is validated without a state write", "")
377	}

379	func refreshHeadCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
380		ref := observed.refs.LocalHead
381		switch {
382		case ref.Failure != "":
383			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, ref.Failure, "repair local head-ref observation")
384		case !ref.Exists:
385			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
386				"local head ref "+ref.Ref+" does not exist", "restore the exact named local branch")
387		case ref.OID == "":
388			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
389				"local head ref resolved without an OID", "repair local head-ref observation")
390		default:
391			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
392				ref.Ref+" is exactly "+ref.OID, "")
393		}
394	}

397		if observed.remoteURL == "" {

399				"remote "+observed.remoteName+" has no configured URL", "configure the exact remote before network refresh")
400		}
401		return condition(ConditionRemoteURL, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,

403	}

406		verdict := VerdictMet

417	}

26		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
27			Profile:      runtime.OccupancyStrict,
28			CallerPaneID: reportedPane,
29		})
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("check live occupancy before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
32		}
33		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
34			return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
35		}
36		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("classify live runtime coverage before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionCoverageErr)
38		}
39		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("list live runtime sessions before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionList.Err)
41		}
42		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
44		}
45	
46		var occupied []string
47		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
48			if !agent.Blocking {
49				continue
50			}
51			activity := agent.Activity
52			label := activity.Agent
53			if activity.Name != "" {
54				label = activity.Name
55			}
56			if label == "" {
57				label = "agent"
58			}
59			occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, activity.PaneID))
60		}
61		if len(occupied) == 0 {
62			return nil
63		}
64		return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
65			config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
66	}
67	
68	// checkoutAgentActivities returns recognized agents whose reported cwd resolves
69	// to the same canonical Git worktree root as checkout. A pane is excluded only
70	// when its exact ID matches excludePane; lifecycle state never makes it free.
71	func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {
72		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{Profile: runtime.OccupancyStrict})
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
77			return nil, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err
78		}
79		out := make([]runtime.AgentActivity, 0, len(evidence.Agents))
80		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
81			if excludePane == "" || agent.Activity.PaneID != excludePane {
82				out = append(out, agent.Activity)
83			}
84		}
85		return out, nil
86	}

519	func remoteRefsEvidence(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
520		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
521		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
522			if ref.Ref == "" {
523				continue
524			}
525			switch {
526			case ref.Failure != "":
527				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" error: "+ref.Failure)
528			case ref.Exists:
529				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"="+ref.OID)
530			default:
531				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" is absent")
532			}
533		}
534		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
535	}

548	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
549		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
550			return Result{}, err
551		}
552		if approved.Action != RefreshRemote {
553			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "refresh-remote handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
554		}
555		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
556			return Result{}, err
557		}
558		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
559		if err != nil {
560			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
561		}
562	
563		var result Result
564		applyLocked := func(tx *task.Tx) error {
565			var record *task.Record
566			if approved.Locator.TaskID != "" {
567				if tx == nil {
568					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "managed remote refresh has no task transaction"}
569				}
570				current, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
571				if loadErr != nil {
572					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before remote refresh"}
573				}
574				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *current); identityErr != nil {
575					return identityErr
576				}
577				record = current
578			}
579	
580			spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, approved.Request, record)
581			if observeErr != nil {
582				return observeErr
583			}
584			fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
585			if buildErr != nil {
586				return buildErr
587			}
588			if record != nil {
589				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
590				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
591					actual := ""
592					if current != nil {
593						actual = current.Revision
594					}
595					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked remote refresh replan")
596				}
597			}
598			if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
599				return &StalePlanError{
600					ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
601					ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
602					ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
603					Reason:                       "fresh task, repository, remote URL, provider, or ref authority differs",
604				}
605			}
606			if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
607				notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
608				return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh remote refresh conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
609			}
610	
611			execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh}
612			result, observeErr = execution.executeRefreshRemote(ctx, observed)
613			return observeErr
614		}
615	
616		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
617			if approved.Locator.TaskID == "" {
618				return applyLocked(nil)
619			}
620			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, applyLocked)
621		})
622		return result, err
623	}
