625	func (e *executionState) executeRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation) (Result, error) {
626		data := RemoteObservation{
627			RemoteName: observed.remoteName, RemoteURL: observed.remoteURL,
628			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
629			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, BeforeRefs: observed.refs,
630		}
631		e.remote = &data
632		fetched := false
633	
634		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
635			switch effect.Code {
636			case EffectFetchRefs:
637				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
638					_, fetchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "--", observed.remoteName)
639					if fetchErr != nil {
640						return "", fmt.Errorf("fetch --prune %s: %w", observed.remoteName, fetchErr)
641					}
642					return "fetched and pruned " + observed.remoteName, nil
643				})
644				if err != nil {
645					recovery := []string{"remote refs were not proven refreshed; repair the exact remote fetch and create a fresh plan"}
646					if e.plan.Request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions).QueryReview {
647						recovery = append(recovery, "review query was not attempted after the failed fetch")
648					}
649					return e.fail(err, recovery...)
650				}
651				fetched = true
652				data.AfterRefs = e.service.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
653				data.HasAfterRefs = true
654	
655			case EffectQueryReview:
656				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
657					if err := e.service.revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx, observed, fetched); err != nil {
658						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
659						return "", err
660					}
661					query := forge.ReviewQuery{Repository: observed.providerRepository, Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base}
662					review, queryErr := e.service.queryReview(ctx, observed.provider, observed.repoPath, query)
663					if queryErr != nil {
664						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, queryErr)
665						return "", queryErr
666					}
667					if review == nil {
668						data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
669							State: ObservationKnown, Exists: false,
670							Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
671							Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
672						}
673						data.HasReview = true
674						return "provider reports no exact review", nil
675					}
676					if err := validateRemoteReview(observed, *review); err != nil {
677						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
678						return "", err
679					}
680					observedAt := review.ObservedAt.UTC()
681					if review.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
682						observedAt = e.service.now()
683					}
684					data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
685						State: ObservationKnown, Exists: true,
686						Provider: review.Provider, Repository: review.Repository,
687						ID: review.ID, Number: review.Number, ReviewState: review.State,
688						Draft: review.Draft, URL: review.URL, Head: review.Head, Base: review.Base,
689						ObservedAt: observedAt,
690					}
691					data.HasReview = true
692					return fmt.Sprintf("observed %s review #%d (%s)", review.Provider, review.Number, review.State), nil
693				})
694				if err != nil {
695					if fetched {
696						return e.fail(err, "fetch completed; review evidence remains an explicit error and may be retried from a fresh query-only plan")
697					}
698					return e.fail(err, "local refs and task state were unchanged; repair provider access or response handling and retry")
699				}
700	
701			default:
702				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RefreshRemote effect " + string(effect.Code)})
703			}
704		}
705		return e.result(), nil
706	}

708	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation, allowFetchedRefs bool) error {
709		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
710		if err != nil {
711			return staleBoundary("repository became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
712		}
713		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
714		if err != nil {
715			return staleBoundary("repository main path became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
716		}
717		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
718		if err != nil {
719			return staleBoundary("Git common directory became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
720		}
721		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
722			return staleBoundary("repository identity changed before review query")
723		}
724		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
725		kind, repositoryIdentity := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)

727			return staleBoundary("remote URL or provider repository identity changed before review query")
728		}
729		if observed.provider == nil || observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind {

732		if _, ok := observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier); !ok {

736			return staleBoundary("review provider CLI became unavailable before query")
737		}

757	func classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err error) RemoteReviewFailureKind {
758		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrAmbiguousReview) {
759			return RemoteReviewFailureAmbiguous
760		}
761		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrMalformedReviewResponse) {
762			return RemoteReviewFailureMalformed
763		}
764		var unsupported *forge.ErrUnsupported
765		if errors.As(err, &unsupported) {
766			return RemoteReviewFailureUnsupported
767		}
768		var missingCLI *forge.ErrNoCLI
769		if errors.As(err, &missingCLI) {
770			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingCLI
771		}
772		var missingExtension *forge.ErrNoExtension
773		if errors.As(err, &missingExtension) {
774			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingExtension
775		}
776		return RemoteReviewFailureProvider
777	}

779	func validateRemoteReview(observed remoteRefreshObservation, review forge.Review) error {
780		switch {
781		case review.Provider != observed.providerKind:
782			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "provider")
783		case review.Repository != observed.providerRepository:
784			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "repository identity")
785		case review.Head != observed.head:
786			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "head branch")
787		case review.Base != observed.base:
788			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "base branch")
789		case strings.TrimSpace(review.ID) == "" || review.ID != strings.TrimSpace(review.ID):
790			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "identifier")
791		case review.Number <= 0:
792			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "number")
793		case !review.State.Valid():
794			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "state")
795		case review.State == forge.ReviewDraft && !review.Draft:
796			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft flag")
797		case review.State == forge.ReviewOpen && review.Draft:
798			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft state")
799		case !validRemoteReviewURL(review.URL):
800			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "URL")
801		}
802		return nil
803	}

1	// Package lockx provides a cross-platform advisory lock over a directory.
2	//
3	// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction
4	// code need to serialize mutations, and neither should have to depend on the
5	// other to get a lock.
6	package lockx
7	
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"errors"
11		"fmt"
12		"os"
13		"path/filepath"
14	)
15	
16	// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir. The lock file
17	// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
18	// directory being protected. label names the caller in wrapped errors.
19	func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
20		if operation == nil {
21			return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
22		}
23		if ctx == nil {
24			ctx = context.Background()
25		}
26		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
27			return fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
28		}
29		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
32		}
33		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
34		if err != nil {
35			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
36		}
37		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
38		lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
41		}
42		defer func() {
43			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
44				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", label, releaseErr))
45			}
46		}()
47		return operation()
48	}
49

65	   branch/base, expected checkout, and runtime hint.

74	`runtime=none` cannot observe session or agent occupancy. That does not turn the
75	observation into “closed,” but a complete local Git/task snapshot can still be

77	
78	## Managed lifecycle choices
79	
80	Actions are concrete variants, not a generic force menu:
81	
82	| Current intent | Flow choices |
83	|---|---|
84	| HOT/WARM worktree or branch task | Park Warm; Park Cold; Park Cold + Push; Complete FF; Review Handoff; Verify Merged |
85	| HOT/WARM direct task | Park Warm; Complete Direct |
86	| WARM task | Resume (with an explicit fetch effect) |
87	| COLD worktree/branch task | Resume and reconstruct/reopen; completion remains unavailable until HOT |
88	| DONE task | Retire (Keep Branch); for eligible non-direct tasks, Retire + Delete Contained Branch |
89	
90	Review Handoff publishes the branch and creates a pull/merge request when the
91	available provider supports it, but preserves HOT/WARM. Direct/FF/verified
92	completion writes DONE last and keeps branch, checkout, and runtime resources.
93	Retire is the separate externally safe close/wait/remove/task-reap operation.
94	
95	The preview always uses a fail-on-dirty completion policy. It intentionally does
96	not expose dirty commit/discard, WIP checkpoint, shared-writer, ownership
97	takeover, force removal, `--close-unknown`, or `--assume-no-runtime` choices.
98	Blocked plans show the precise evidence, remediation, and compatible CLI
99	fallback instead of manufacturing an override.
100	
101	## Keys and approval
102	
103	```text
104	j/k or up/down       select a surface or picker/menu row
105	h/l or left/right    select an already-concrete action
106	Tab / Shift-Tab      move panel focus
107	/                    filter the repository picker
108	Enter                build and inspect a plan; never apply immediately
109	y                    approve a READY non-typed plan

3	import (
4		"context"

12	
13	// ReviewQuery identifies one exact head/base relationship in one repository.
14	// Repository is the forge's stable repository identity: owner/repository for
15	// GitHub, group/repository for GitLab, or organization/project/repository for
16	// Azure DevOps. Adapters must still verify the returned branches because CLI
17	// filters are not sufficient evidence on their own.
18	type ReviewQuery struct {
19		Repository string `json:"repository"`
20		Head       string `json:"head"`
21		Base       string `json:"base"`
22	}
23	
24	// ReviewState is the portable lifecycle state observed for a provider review.
25	type ReviewState string
26	
27	const (
28		ReviewOpen   ReviewState = "open"
29		ReviewDraft  ReviewState = "draft"
30		ReviewMerged ReviewState = "merged"
31		ReviewClosed ReviewState = "closed"
32	)
33	
34	// Valid reports whether s has defined portable review semantics.
35	func (s ReviewState) Valid() bool {
36		switch s {
37		case ReviewOpen, ReviewDraft, ReviewMerged, ReviewClosed:
38			return true
39		default:
40			return false
41		}
42	}
43	
44	// Review is the minimal provider evidence for an exact head/base relationship.
45	// ID is the provider-stable identity and Number is the repository-local human
46	// identifier. Head, Base, State and Draft are observations from the provider
47	// response rather than values copied from ReviewQuery.
48	type Review struct {
49		Provider   Kind        `json:"provider"`
50		Repository string      `json:"repository"`
51		ID         string      `json:"id"`
52		Number     int         `json:"number"`
53		State      ReviewState `json:"state"`
54		Draft      bool        `json:"draft"`
55		URL        string      `json:"url"`
56		Head       string      `json:"head"`
57		Base       string      `json:"base"`
58		ObservedAt time.Time   `json:"observed_at"`
59	}
60	
61	// ReviewQuerier is an optional forge capability. A nil Review and nil error is
62	// a successful observation that no exact review exists. One exact match returns
63	// provider evidence; multiple exact matches fail with AmbiguousReviewError.
64	type ReviewQuerier interface {
65		QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error)
66	}
67	
68	var (
69		// ErrAmbiguousReview identifies a query with multiple exact head/base
70		// matches. Callers must not select one by recency or provider ordering.
71		ErrAmbiguousReview = errors.New("multiple reviews match")
72		// ErrMalformedReviewResponse identifies provider JSON that cannot supply the
73		// critical portable fields without guessing.
74		ErrMalformedReviewResponse = errors.New("malformed review response")
75	)
76	
77	// AmbiguousReviewError carries every exact match while keeping Error text free
78	// of provider response values such as private URLs and branch names.
79	type AmbiguousReviewError struct {
80		Provider Kind
81		Query    ReviewQuery
82		Matches  []Review
83	}
84	
85	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Error() string {
86		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review query returned %d exact matches", e.Provider, len(e.Matches))
87	}
88	
89	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguousReview }
90	
91	// MalformedReviewResponseError identifies the unusable response field without
92	// embedding its value or the response body. Index is zero-based and is -1 when
93	// the whole JSON document is malformed. Err retains safe decoder diagnostics.
94	type MalformedReviewResponseError struct {
95		Provider Kind
96		Index    int
97		Field    string
98		Err      error
99	}
100	
101	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Error() string {
102		location := "response"
103		if e.Index >= 0 {
104			location = fmt.Sprintf("response item %d", e.Index+1)
105		}
106		detail := "missing or invalid " + e.Field
107		if e.Err != nil {
108			detail = e.Err.Error()
109		}
110		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review %s is malformed: %s", e.Provider, location, detail)
111	}
112	
113	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
114	
115	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Is(target error) bool {
116		return target == ErrMalformedReviewResponse
117	}
118	
119	// QueryReview invokes the optional capability without widening Forge. It never
120	// caches or initiates a query unless a caller explicitly calls this function.
121	func QueryReview(ctx context.Context, f Forge, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
122		querier, ok := f.(ReviewQuerier)
123		if !ok {
124			return nil, &ErrUnsupported{Kind: f.Kind(), Operation: "review queries"}
125		}
126		return querier.QueryReview(ctx, dir, query)
127	}
128	
129	type reviewCandidate struct {
130		ID     string
131		Number int
132		State  string
133		Draft  *bool
134		URL    string
135		Head   string
136		Base   string
137	}
138	
139	type reviewStateNormalizer func(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error)
140	
141	func validateReviewQuery(query ReviewQuery) error {
142		switch {
143		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Repository) == "":
144			return errors.New("review query repository is required")
145		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Head) == "":
146			return errors.New("review query head is required")
147		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Base) == "":
148			return errors.New("review query base is required")
149		default:
150			return nil
151		}
152	}
153	
154	func decodeReviewJSON(provider Kind, out string, target any) error {
155		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(out)
156		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
157			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON array", nil)
158		}
159		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), target); err != nil {
160			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON", err)
161		}
162		return nil
163	}
164	
165	func selectExactReview(provider Kind, query ReviewQuery, candidates []reviewCandidate, normalize reviewStateNormalizer) (*Review, error) {
166		matches := make([]Review, 0, 1)
167		observedAt := time.Now().UTC()
168		for index, candidate := range candidates {
169			if candidate.Head == "" {
170				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "head branch", nil)
171			}
172			if candidate.Base == "" {
173				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "base branch", nil)
174			}
175			if candidate.Head != query.Head || candidate.Base != query.Base {
176				continue
177			}
178			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate.ID) == "" {
179				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "identifier", nil)
180			}
181			if candidate.Number <= 0 {
182				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "number", nil)
183			}
184			if candidate.Draft == nil {
185				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "draft flag", nil)
186			}
187			if !validReviewURL(candidate.URL) {
188				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "URL", nil)
189			}
190			state, err := normalize(candidate.State, *candidate.Draft)
191			if err != nil {
192				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "state", err)
193			}
194			matches = append(matches, Review{
195				Provider: provider, Repository: query.Repository,
196				ID: candidate.ID, Number: candidate.Number,
197				State: state, Draft: *candidate.Draft, URL: candidate.URL,
198				Head: candidate.Head, Base: candidate.Base, ObservedAt: observedAt,
199			})
200		}
201	
202		switch len(matches) {
203		case 0:
204			return nil, nil
205		case 1:
206			return &matches[0], nil
207		default:
208			return nil, &AmbiguousReviewError{
209				Provider: provider, Query: query,
210				Matches: append([]Review(nil), matches...),
211			}
212		}
213	}
214	
215	func malformedReviewResponse(provider Kind, index int, field string, err error) error {
216		return &MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: index, Field: field, Err: err}
217	}
218	
219	func validReviewURL(raw string) bool {
220		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
221		if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" {
222			return false
223		}
224		return parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http"
225	}
226

12	// gh drives the GitHub CLI.
13	type gh struct{}
14	
15	func (g *gh) Kind() Kind      { return GitHub }
16	func (g *gh) Bin() string     { return "gh" }
17	func (g *gh) Available() bool { return have("gh") }
18	
19	// CreatePR opens a GitHub pull request.
20	func (g *gh) CreatePR(ctx context.Context, dir string, req PRRequest) (string, error) {
21		if !g.Available() {
22			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
23		}
24		args := []string{"pr", "create", "--base", req.Base, "--head", req.Head}
25		switch {
26		case req.Title != "":
27			args = append(args, "--title", req.Title, "--body", req.Body)
28		default:
29			// --fill derives title and body from the branch's commits, which is
30			// the right default for a solo workflow where the commits already say
31			// what happened.
32			args = append(args, "--fill")
33		}
34		if req.Draft {
35			args = append(args, "--draft")
36		}
37		if req.Web {
38			args = append(args, "--web")
39		}
40		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
41		return lastURL(out), err
42	}
43	
44	// QueryReview manually observes an exact GitHub pull request relationship.
45	func (g *gh) QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
46		if !g.Available() {
47			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
48		}
49		if err := validateReviewQuery(query); err != nil {
50			return nil, err
51		}
52		out, err := reviewRunner(ctx, "gh", dir,
53			"pr", "list", "--repo", query.Repository,
54			"--head", query.Head, "--base", query.Base, "--state", "all",
55			"--limit", "1000",
56			"--json", "id,number,state,isDraft,url,headRefName,baseRefName")
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, err
59		}
60		return parseGitHubReviews(out, query)
61	}
62	
63	func parseGitHubReviews(out string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
64		var raw []struct {
65			ID          string `json:"id"`
66			Number      *int   `json:"number"`
67			State       string `json:"state"`
68			IsDraft     *bool  `json:"isDraft"`
69			URL         string `json:"url"`
70			HeadRefName string `json:"headRefName"`
71			BaseRefName string `json:"baseRefName"`
72		}
73		if err := decodeReviewJSON(GitHub, out, &raw); err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		candidates := make([]reviewCandidate, 0, len(raw))
77		for _, item := range raw {
78			number := 0
79			if item.Number != nil {
80				number = *item.Number
81			}
82			candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
83				ID: item.ID, Number: number, State: item.State, Draft: item.IsDraft,
84				URL: item.URL, Head: item.HeadRefName, Base: item.BaseRefName,
85			})
86		}
87		return selectExactReview(GitHub, query, candidates, normalizeGitHubReviewState)
88	}
89	
90	func normalizeGitHubReviewState(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error) {
91		switch strings.ToUpper(state) {
92		case "OPEN":
93			if draft {
94				return ReviewDraft, nil
95			}
96			return ReviewOpen, nil
97		case "MERGED":
98			return ReviewMerged, nil
99		case "CLOSED":
100			return ReviewClosed, nil
101		default:
102			return "", errors.New("unrecognized GitHub review state")
103		}
104	}
105	
106	// CreateRepo creates a GitHub repository from the local checkout.
107	func (g *gh) CreateRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (string, error) {
108		if !g.Available() {
109			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
110		}
111		target, err := resolveRepoRequest(req)
112		if err != nil {
113			return "", err
114		}
115		args := []string{"repo", "create", target.fullName, "--source", ".", "--remote", target.remoteName,
116			visibilityFlag(target.visibility)}
117		if req.Description != "" {
118			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
119		}
120		if req.Push {
121			args = append(args, "--push")
122		}
123		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
124		return lastURL(out), err
125	}
126	
127	// PublishRepo creates an empty GitHub repository. Unlike CreateRepo it does
128	// not pass --source, --remote or --push, leaving all local Git mutations to the
129	// shared caller-side transaction.
130	func (g *gh) PublishRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (CreateRepoResult, error) {
131		if !g.Available() {
132			return CreateRepoResult{}, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
133		}
134		target, err := resolveRepoRequest(req)
135		if err != nil {
136			return CreateRepoResult{}, err
137		}
138		args := []string{"repo", "create", target.fullName, visibilityFlag(target.visibility)}
139		if req.Description != "" {
140			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
141		}
142		out, err := publishRunner(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
143		if err != nil {
144			return createRepoResult(GitHub, target, out, false), err
145		}
146		result := createRepoResult(GitHub, target, out, true)
147		if result.RemoteURL == "" {
148			return result, fmt.Errorf("gh created %q but did not report a repository URL", target.fullName)
149		}
150		return result, nil
151	}
152	
153	// CloneURL renders a clone target. gh accepts a bare owner/name, so a
154	// shorthand reference is passed through untouched.
155	func (g *gh) CloneURL(ref string) string {
156		if strings.Contains(ref, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "git@") {
157			return ref
158		}
159		return "https://github.com/" + strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git") + ".git"
160	}
161	
162	// lastURL picks the URL out of a CLI's chatter, which may print progress
163	// lines before the created resource's address.
164	func lastURL(out string) string {
165		found := lastHTTPURL(out)
166		if found == "" {
167			return strings.TrimSpace(out)
168		}
169		return found
170	}
171	
172	// ListRepos lists GitHub repositories visible to the authenticated user —
173	// owned, collaborated on, and organisation membership — most recently pushed
174	// first. gh api is intentionally used instead of a custom HTTP client:
175	// authentication and token refresh stay owned by the forge CLI.
176	func (g *gh) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
177		if !g.Available() {
178			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
179		}
180		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 60*time.Second)
181		defer cancel()
182		const pageSize = 100
183		var result []RemoteRepo
184		for page := 1; ; page++ {
185			out, err := run(ctx, "gh", "", "api", "user/repos", "--method", "GET",
186				"-f", "per_page=100", "-f", fmt.Sprintf("page=%d", page),
187				"-f", "sort=pushed", "-f", "direction=desc")
188			if err != nil {
189				return result, err
190			}
191			repos, err := parseGitHubRepos(out)
192			if err != nil {
193				return result, err
194			}
195			result = append(result, repos...)
196			if len(repos) < pageSize {
197				break
198			}
199		}
200		return result, nil
201	}
202	
203	func parseGitHubRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
204		var raw []struct {
205			Name          string `json:"name"`
206			FullName      string `json:"full_name"`
207			Description   string `json:"description"`
208			URL           string `json:"html_url"`
209			CloneURL      string `json:"clone_url"`
210			SSHURL        string `json:"ssh_url"`
211			Visibility    string `json:"visibility"`
212			Fork          bool   `json:"fork"`
213			Archived      bool   `json:"archived"`
214			PushedAt      string `json:"pushed_at"`
215			DefaultBranch string `json:"default_branch"`
216		}
217		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
218			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode gh api user/repos: %w", err)
219		}
220		result := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
221		for _, r := range raw {
222			updated, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.PushedAt)
223			result = append(result, RemoteRepo{
224				Forge: GitHub, Name: r.Name, FullName: r.FullName,
225				Description: r.Description, URL: r.URL,
226				CloneURL: r.CloneURL, SSHURL: r.SSHURL,
227				Visibility: r.Visibility, DefaultBranch: r.DefaultBranch,
228				Archived: r.Archived, Fork: r.Fork, UpdatedAt: updated,
229			})
230		}
231		return result, nil
232	}

106			} else if item.WorkInProgress != nil && *draft != *item.WorkInProgress {
107				draft = nil
108			}
109			candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
110				ID: id, Number: number, State: item.State, Draft: draft,
111				URL: item.WebURL, Head: item.SourceBranch, Base: item.TargetBranch,
112			})
113		}
114		return candidates, nil

117	func normalizeGitLabReviewState(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error) {
118		switch strings.ToLower(state) {

122			}
123			return ReviewOpen, nil
124		case "merged":
125			return ReviewMerged, nil
126		case "closed":
127			return ReviewClosed, nil
128		default:
129			return "", errors.New("unrecognized GitLab review state")

133	// CreateRepo creates a GitLab project from the local checkout.
134	func (g *glab) CreateRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (string, error) {
135		if !g.Available() {
136			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitLab, Bin: "glab"}
137		}
138		target, err := resolveRepoRequest(req)
139		if err != nil {
140			return "", err
141		}
142		args := []string{"repo", "create"}
143		if req.FullName == "" && req.Namespace == "" && !strings.Contains(req.Name, "/") {
144			// Preserve the original invocation for existing callers such as Try
145			// graduation; glab uses the current checkout and adds the requested
146			// remote as before.
147			args = append(args, target.name)
148		} else {
149			args = append(args, "--name", target.name)
150			if target.namespace != "" {
151				args = append(args, "--group", target.namespace)
152			}
153		}
154		args = append(args, "--remoteName", target.remoteName, visibilityFlag(target.visibility))
155		if req.Description != "" {
156			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
157		}
158		out, err := run(ctx, "glab", dir, args...)
159		return lastURL(out), err

203			return ref
204		}
205		return "https://" + gitLabHost() + "/" + strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git") + ".git"

208	// ListRepos lists every GitLab project of which the authenticated user is a
209	// member, most recently active first. glab owns authentication; dev passes an
210	// explicit GITLAB_HOST/GLAB_HOST (default gitlab.com) so inventory and cache
211	// identity never depend on the process's current Git repository.
212	func (g *glab) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
213		if !g.Available() {
214			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitLab, Bin: "glab"}
215		}
216		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 60*time.Second)
217		defer cancel()
218		const pageSize = 100
219		var result []RemoteRepo
220		for page := 1; ; page++ {
221			out, err := run(ctx, "glab", "", "api", "--hostname", gitLabHost(), "projects", "--method", "GET",
222				"-f", "membership=true", "-f", "simple=true", "-f", "per_page=100",
223				"-f", fmt.Sprintf("page=%d", page), "-f", "order_by=last_activity_at", "-f", "sort=desc")
224			if err != nil {
225				return result, err
226			}
227			repos, err := parseGitLabRepos(out)
228			if err != nil {
229				return result, err
230			}
231			result = append(result, repos...)
232			if len(repos) < pageSize {
233				break
234			}
235		}
236		return result, nil
237	}

239	func parseGitLabRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
240		var raw []struct {
241			Name              string `json:"name"`
242			PathWithNamespace string `json:"path_with_namespace"`
243			Description       string `json:"description"`
244			DefaultBranch     string `json:"default_branch"`
245			Visibility        string `json:"visibility"`
246			SSHURL            string `json:"ssh_url_to_repo"`
247			HTTPURL           string `json:"http_url_to_repo"`
248			WebURL            string `json:"web_url"`
249			Archived          bool   `json:"archived"`
250			ForkedFrom        any    `json:"forked_from_project"`
251			LastActivityAt    string `json:"last_activity_at"`
252		}
253		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
254			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode glab api projects: %w", err)
255		}
256		result := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
257		for _, r := range raw {
258			updated, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, r.LastActivityAt)
259			result = append(result, RemoteRepo{
260				Forge: GitLab, Name: r.Name, FullName: r.PathWithNamespace,
261				Description: r.Description, URL: r.WebURL,
262				CloneURL: r.HTTPURL, SSHURL: r.SSHURL,
263				Visibility: r.Visibility, DefaultBranch: r.DefaultBranch,
264				Archived: r.Archived, Fork: r.ForkedFrom != nil, UpdatedAt: updated,
265			})
266		}
267		return result, nil
268	}

207	func azureTargetOrganization(raw string) string {

1	// Package forge wraps the GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps CLIs. All are optional: every
2	// entry point degrades to plain git, because a workflow that hard-depends on a
3	// forge CLI being installed and authenticated stops working on exactly the
4	// machines where you most need it.
5	package forge
6	
7	import (
8		"bytes"
9		"context"
10		"errors"
11		"fmt"
12		"net/url"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16		"sync"
17		"time"
18	
19		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
20	)
21	
22	// Kind identifies a forge.
23	type Kind string
24	
25	const (
26		// GitHub is served by the gh CLI.
27		GitHub Kind = "github"
28		// GitLab is served by the glab CLI.
29		GitLab Kind = "gitlab"
30		// AzureDevOps is served by Azure CLI's azure-devops extension.
31		AzureDevOps Kind = "azure-devops"
32		// Unknown is any other host, or none.
33		Unknown Kind = "unknown"
34	)
35	
36	// ErrNoCLI reports that the forge's CLI is not installed.
37	type ErrNoCLI struct {
38		Kind Kind
39		Bin  string
40	}
41	
42	func (e *ErrNoCLI) Error() string {
43		return fmt.Sprintf("%s support needs the %q CLI, which is not installed", e.Kind, e.Bin)
44	}
45	
46	// Forge is the subset of forge behaviour dev uses.
47	type Forge interface {
48		Kind() Kind
49		// Bin is the CLI binary name.
50		Bin() string
51		Available() bool
52		// CreatePR opens a pull/merge request from head into base.
53		CreatePR(ctx context.Context, dir string, req PRRequest) (string, error)
54		// CreateRepo creates a remote repository from an existing local one.
55		CreateRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (string, error)
56		// CloneURL renders the clone target for an owner/name reference.
57		CloneURL(ref string) string
58		// ListRepos lists every repository visible to the authenticated user.
59		ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error)
60	}
61	
62	// RepoPublisher is implemented by forge adapters that can create an empty
63	// upstream repository without changing the caller's local Git configuration.
64	// Keeping this separate from Forge.CreateRepo preserves the existing graduate
65	// flow, whose compatibility contract lets the provider CLI add a remote and
66	// optionally push it.
67	type RepoPublisher interface {
68		PublishRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (CreateRepoResult, error)
69	}

71	// RemoteRepo is one repository visible through a forge CLI.
72	type RemoteRepo struct {
73		Forge         Kind      `json:"forge"`
74		Name          string    `json:"name"`
75		FullName      string    `json:"full_name"`
76		Description   string    `json:"description,omitempty"`
77		URL           string    `json:"url"`
78		CloneURL      string    `json:"clone_url"`
79		SSHURL        string    `json:"ssh_url,omitempty"`
80		Visibility    string    `json:"visibility,omitempty"`
81		DefaultBranch string    `json:"default_branch,omitempty"`
82		Archived      bool      `json:"archived"`
83		Fork          bool      `json:"fork"`
84		UpdatedAt     time.Time `json:"updated_at,omitempty"`
85	}
86	
87	// Label is the provider-qualified identity shown in a combined list.
88	func (r RemoteRepo) Label() string { return string(r.Forge) + ":" + r.FullName }
89	
90	// All returns the default forge adapters plus any explicitly configured ones.
91	// Azure DevOps is not included by default because its inventory requires an
92	// organization/project target.
93	func All(configured ...Forge) []Forge {
94		return append([]Forge{&gh{}, &glab{}}, configured...)

97	// PRRequest describes a pull/merge request to open.
98	type PRRequest struct {

160	)

162	// Readiness is a non-fatal, read-only forge capability probe. Detail is safe to
163	// show as a diagnostic; Action is the command or next step a user can take.

174	// Ready reports whether the provider CLI is both installed and authenticated.
175	func (r Readiness) Ready() bool { return r.Installed && r.Authenticated }

177	// Detect infers the forge for a checkout from its origin remote. A repo with
178	// no remote, or one on a self-hosted host neither CLI knows, resolves to
179	// Unknown — which callers must treat as "use plain git".
180	func Detect(ctx context.Context, dir string) Kind {
181		return FromURL(gitx.Remote(ctx, dir, "origin"))
182	}
183	
184	// FromURL classifies a remote URL.
185	func FromURL(url string) Kind {
186		if _, _, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(url); ok {
187			return AzureDevOps
188		}
189		u := strings.ToLower(url)
190		switch {
191		case u == "":
192			return Unknown
193		case strings.Contains(u, "github.com"), strings.Contains(u, "github."):
194			return GitHub
195		case strings.Contains(u, "gitlab.com"), strings.Contains(u, "gitlab."):
196			return GitLab
197		}
198		return Unknown
199	}

201	// For returns the adapter for a kind.
202	func For(k Kind) (Forge, error) {
203		switch k {
204		case GitHub:
205			return &gh{}, nil
206		case GitLab:
207			return &glab{}, nil
208		case AzureDevOps:
209			return NewAzureDevOps(nil), nil
210		}
211		return nil, errors.New("no forge CLI for this remote; falling back to plain git")
212	}
213	
214	// Preferred returns the first available forge, for commands like `repo new`
215	// that have no existing remote to infer from.
216	func Preferred() (Forge, error) {
217		for _, f := range []Forge{&gh{}, &glab{}} {
218			if f.Available() {
219				return f, nil
220			}
221		}
222		return nil, errors.New("neither gh nor glab is installed")
223	}
224	
225	// PublishRepo creates an empty upstream through adapters that support the
226	// caller-managed remote/push flow. It never changes local Git configuration.
227	func PublishRepo(ctx context.Context, f Forge, dir string, req RepoRequest) (CreateRepoResult, error) {
228		publisher, ok := f.(RepoPublisher)
229		if !ok {
230			return CreateRepoResult{}, &ErrUnsupported{Kind: f.Kind(), Operation: "caller-managed repository publishing"}
231		}
232		return publisher.PublishRepo(ctx, dir, req)
233	}
234	
235	// Probe checks installation and authentication without turning an optional
236	// integration into a command failure. GitHub and GitLab are intentionally
237	// probed against the host their create commands will use in a repository-less
238	// working directory.
239	func Probe(ctx context.Context, kind Kind) Readiness {
240		f, err := For(kind)
241		if err != nil {
242			return Readiness{
243				Forge: kind, Status: ReadinessUnsupported,
244				Detail: err.Error(), Action: "use a supported forge or add the remote with git",
245			}
246		}
247		return ProbeForge(ctx, f)
248	}
249	
250	// ProbeForge is Probe for an already-selected adapter.
251	func ProbeForge(ctx context.Context, f Forge) Readiness {
252		result := Readiness{Forge: f.Kind(), Bin: f.Bin()}
253		if !f.Available() {
254			result.Status = ReadinessMissingCLI
255			result.Detail = fmt.Sprintf("%s is not installed", f.Bin())
256			result.Action = installAndLoginAction(f.Kind())
257			return result
258		}
259		result.Installed = true
260	
261		args, action, ok := authProbe(f.Kind())
262		if !ok {
263			result.Status = ReadinessUnsupported
264			result.Detail = fmt.Sprintf("%s authentication probing is not supported", f.Kind())
265			return result
266		}
267		probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
268		defer cancel()
269		if _, err := probeRunner(probeCtx, f.Bin(), "", args...); err != nil {
270			if probeCtx.Err() != nil {
271				result.Status = ReadinessProbeFailed
272				result.Detail = probeCtx.Err().Error()
273				result.Action = "run `" + f.Bin() + " auth status` to diagnose the provider CLI"
274				return result
275			}
276			result.Status = ReadinessUnauthenticated
277			result.Detail = err.Error()
278			result.Action = action
279			return result
280		}
281		result.Status = ReadinessReady
282		result.Authenticated = true
283		return result
284	}
285	
286	// ProbeAll returns readiness in stable wizard display order.
287	func ProbeAll(ctx context.Context) []Readiness {
288		kinds := []Kind{GitHub, GitLab}
289		results := make([]Readiness, len(kinds))
290		var wg sync.WaitGroup
291		for i, kind := range kinds {
292			wg.Add(1)
293			go func() {
294				defer wg.Done()
295				results[i] = Probe(ctx, kind)
296			}()
297		}
298		wg.Wait()
299		return results
300	}

302	func authProbe(kind Kind) (args []string, action string, ok bool) {

304		case GitHub:
305			host := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("GH_HOST"))
306			if host == "" {
307				host = "github.com"
308			}
309			return []string{"auth", "status", "--active", "--hostname", host},
310				"run `gh auth login --hostname " + host + "`", true
311		case GitLab:
312			host := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST"))
313			if host == "" {
314				host = "gitlab.com"
315			}
316			return []string{"auth", "status", "--hostname", host},
317				"run `glab auth login --hostname " + host + "`", true
318		default:
319			return nil, "", false
320		}
321	}

326			return "install `gh`, then run `gh auth login`"
327		case GitLab:

334	type repoTarget struct {
335		name       string
336		namespace  string
337		fullName   string
338		visibility Visibility
339		remoteName string
340	}
341	
342	func resolveRepoRequest(req RepoRequest) (repoTarget, error) {
343		fullName := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.FullName), "/")
344		name := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.Name), "/")
345		namespace := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.Namespace), "/")
346		if fullName == "" {
347			fullName = name
348			if namespace != "" && !strings.Contains(name, "/") {
349				fullName = namespace + "/" + name
350			}
351		}
352		if fullName == "" {
353			return repoTarget{}, errors.New("repository name is required")
354		}
355		if strings.Contains(fullName, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(fullName, "git@") {
356			return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("repository name %q must not be a URL", fullName)
357		}
358		parts := strings.Split(fullName, "/")
359		for _, part := range parts {
360			if part == "" || part == "." || part == ".." {
361				return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid repository name %q", fullName)
362			}
363		}
364		name = parts[len(parts)-1]
365		if len(parts) > 1 {
366			namespace = strings.Join(parts[:len(parts)-1], "/")
367		}
368	
369		visibility := req.Visibility
370		if visibility == "" {
371			if req.Private {
372				visibility = VisibilityPrivate
373			} else {
374				visibility = VisibilityPublic
375			}
376		}
377		switch visibility {
378		case VisibilityPublic, VisibilityPrivate, VisibilityInternal:
379		default:
380			return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported repository visibility %q", visibility)
381		}
382		remoteName := strings.TrimSpace(req.RemoteName)
383		if remoteName == "" {
384			remoteName = "origin"
385		}
386		return repoTarget{
387			name: name, namespace: namespace, fullName: fullName,
388			visibility: visibility, remoteName: remoteName,
389		}, nil
390	}
391	
392	func visibilityFlag(visibility Visibility) string { return "--" + string(visibility) }
393	
394	func createRepoResult(kind Kind, target repoTarget, out string, allowFallback bool) CreateRepoResult {
395		webURL := lastHTTPURL(out)
396		fullName := target.fullName
397		if parsed, err := url.Parse(webURL); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
398			if path := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/"); path != "" {
399				fullName = path
400			}
401		}
402		if webURL == "" && allowFallback && strings.Contains(fullName, "/") {
403			host := defaultForgeHost(kind)
404			if host != "" {
405				webURL = "https://" + host + "/" + fullName
406			}
407		}
408		webURL = strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimRight(webURL, "/"), ".git")
409		cloneURL := ""
410		sshURL := ""
411		if parsed, err := url.Parse(webURL); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
412			path := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/")
413			cloneURL = strings.TrimRight(webURL, "/") + ".git"
414			sshURL = "git@" + parsed.Host + ":" + path + ".git"
415		}
416		name := target.name
417		if slash := strings.LastIndex(fullName, "/"); slash >= 0 {
418			name = fullName[slash+1:]
419		}
420		return CreateRepoResult{
421			Forge: kind, Name: name, FullName: fullName, URL: webURL,
422			CloneURL: cloneURL, SSHURL: sshURL, RemoteURL: cloneURL,
423			RemoteName: target.remoteName,
424		}
425	}
426	
427	func defaultForgeHost(kind Kind) string {
428		switch kind {
429		case GitHub:
430			if host := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("GH_HOST")); host != "" {
431				return host
432			}
433			return "github.com"
434		case GitLab:
435			if host := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST")); host != "" {
436				return host
437			}
438			return "gitlab.com"
439		default:
440			return ""
441		}
442	}
443	
444	type cliRunner func(context.Context, string, string, ...string) (string, error)
445	
446	// Separate hooks keep readiness, publishing and review-query tests
447	// platform-independent; production uses the same subprocess runner as the
448	// legacy adapter methods.
449	var (
450		probeRunner   cliRunner = run
451		publishRunner cliRunner = runCombined
452		reviewRunner  cliRunner = run
453		lookupPath              = exec.LookPath
454	)
455	
456	// run executes a forge CLI, streaming stderr through so the user sees the
457	// CLI's own authentication prompts and error messages verbatim.
458	func run(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
459		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
460		cmd.Dir = dir
461		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
462		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
463		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
464		cmd.Stdin = os.Stdin
465		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
466			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
467			if detail != "" {
468				return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
469					bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
470			}
471			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
472		}
473		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
474	}
475	
476	// runCombined is used for non-interactive publishing because gh/glab versions
477	// differ on whether the created repository URL is written to stdout or stderr.
478	// Stdin is deliberately left closed so a supposedly complete publish request
479	// cannot unexpectedly drop into a second provider-owned wizard.
480	func runCombined(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
481		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
482		cmd.Dir = dir
483		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
484		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
485		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
486		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
487			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
488			if detail != "" {
489				return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
490					bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
491			}
492			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
493		}
494		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()) + "\n" + strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())), nil
495	}
496	
497	func have(bin string) bool {
498		_, err := lookupPath(bin)
499		return err == nil
500	}
501	
502	func lastHTTPURL(out string) string {
503		var found string
504		for _, field := range strings.Fields(out) {
505			candidate := strings.Trim(field, "<>()[]{}\"',;.")
506			if strings.HasPrefix(candidate, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(candidate, "https://") {
507				found = candidate
508			}
509		}
510		return found
511	}
512	
513	// IdentityFromURL returns a forge and owner/name identity for an HTTPS or SSH
514	// Git remote. It is used to match remote inventories to local clones without
515	// assuming the checkout directory has the same name.
516	func IdentityFromURL(raw string) (Kind, string) {
517		kind := FromURL(raw)
518		if kind == Unknown {
519			return Unknown, ""
520		}
521		if kind == AzureDevOps {
522			identity, _, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(raw)
523			if !ok {
524				return Unknown, ""
525			}
526			return kind, identity
527		}
528		s := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
529		if strings.Contains(s, "://") {
530			if parsed, err := url.Parse(s); err == nil {
531				s = strings.TrimPrefix(parsed.Path, "/")
532			}
533		} else if at := strings.IndexByte(s, '@'); at >= 0 {
534			// SCP-style SSH: git@github.com:owner/repo.git
535			s = s[at+1:]
536			if colon := strings.IndexByte(s, ':'); colon >= 0 {
537				s = s[colon+1:]
538			}
539		}
540		s = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(s, ".git"), "/")
541		return kind, s
542	}

161	func (a *az) reviewQueryScope(query ReviewQuery) (ReviewQuery, []string) {

181			target := a.targets[0]

199	func splitAzureReviewIdentity(identity string) (organization, project, repository string, ok bool) {

202			return "", "", "", false
203		}

220			}
221			return ""
222		}
223		if !strings.ContainsAny(trimmed, "/:") {
224			return trimmed
225		}
226		return ""
227	}

249			reviewURL := item.RemoteURL
250			if !validReviewURL(reviewURL) && item.RepositoryRemoteURL != "" && number > 0 {
251				if _, repositoryURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(item.RepositoryRemoteURL); ok {
252					reviewURL = strings.TrimRight(repositoryURL, "/") + "/pullrequest/" + strconv.Itoa(number)
253				}
254			}
255			candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
256				ID: id, Number: number, State: item.Status, Draft: item.IsDraft,
257				URL: reviewURL, Head: azureReviewBranch(item.SourceRefName), Base: azureReviewBranch(item.TargetRefName),
258			})
259		}
260		return candidates, nil
261	}

263	func azureReviewBranch(ref string) string {
264		return strings.TrimPrefix(ref, "refs/heads/")
265	}

267	func normalizeAzureReviewState(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error) {
268		switch strings.ToLower(state) {
269		case "active":
270			if draft {
271				return ReviewDraft, nil
272			}
273			return ReviewOpen, nil
274		case "completed":
275			return ReviewMerged, nil
276		case "abandoned":
277			return ReviewClosed, nil
278		default:
279			return "", errors.New("unrecognized Azure DevOps review state")
280		}
281	}

284	// the team project, so dev's current per-repository private/public contract does
285	// not map safely.
286	func (a *az) CreateRepo(context.Context, string, RepoRequest) (string, error) {
287		return "", &ErrUnsupported{Kind: AzureDevOps, Operation: "repository creation"}
288	}

291	// owner/name shorthand because organization and project are both required.
292	func (a *az) CloneURL(ref string) string { return ref }

294	// ListRepos queries every configured organization/project concurrently. Azure
295	// CLI already returns every repository in the selected team project.
296	func (a *az) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
297		if len(a.targets) == 0 {
298			return nil, errors.New("Azure DevOps remote inventory needs at least one [[forge.azure_devops]] target")
299		}
300		if err := a.ensureExtension(ctx); err != nil {
301			return nil, err
302		}
303		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
304		defer cancel()
305	
306		type result struct {
307			repos []RemoteRepo
308			err   error
309		}
310		ch := make(chan result, len(a.targets))
311		var wg sync.WaitGroup
312		for _, target := range a.targets {
313			target := target
314			wg.Add(1)
315			go func() {
316				defer wg.Done()
317				out, err := run(ctx, "az", "", "repos", "list", "--detect", "false",
318					"--organization", target.Organization, "--project", target.Project,
319					"--output", "json", "--only-show-errors")
320				if err != nil {
321					ch <- result{err: fmt.Errorf("Azure DevOps %s / %s: %w", target.Organization, target.Project, err)}
322					return
323				}
324				repos, err := parseAzureDevOpsRepos(out)
325				if err != nil {
326					err = fmt.Errorf("Azure DevOps %s / %s: %w", target.Organization, target.Project, err)
327				}
328				ch <- result{repos: repos, err: err}
329			}()
330		}
331		wg.Wait()
332		close(ch)
333	
334		var repos []RemoteRepo
335		var errs []error
336		for item := range ch {
337			repos = append(repos, item.repos...)
338			if item.err != nil {
339				errs = append(errs, item.err)
340			}
341		}
342		sort.Slice(repos, func(i, j int) bool { return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label() })
343		unique := repos[:0]
344		seen := map[string]bool{}
345		for _, repo := range repos {
346			key := strings.ToLower(repo.Label())
347			if seen[key] {
348				continue
349			}
350			seen[key] = true
351			unique = append(unique, repo)
352		}
353		return unique, errors.Join(errs...)
354	}
355	
356	func parseAzureDevOpsRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
357		var raw []struct {
358			Name          string `json:"name"`
359			DefaultBranch string `json:"defaultBranch"`
360			IsFork        bool   `json:"isFork"`
```

48	func validateRefreshRemoteLocator(locator Locator) error {
49		switch {
50		case locator.RepoPath == "":
51			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
52		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
53			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
54		case !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Branch):
55			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact head branch %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Branch)
56		case locator.Base != "" && !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Base):
57			return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Base)
58		case locator.HeadOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.HeadOID):
59			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact HEAD OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.HeadOID)
60		case locator.BaseOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.BaseOID):
61			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact base OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.BaseOID)
62		}
63	
64		if locator.TaskID == "" {
65			switch {
66			case locator.TaskRevision != "":
67				return fmt.Errorf("%w: task revision requires a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
68			case locator.HeadOID == "":
69				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged remote refresh requires an exact HEAD OID", ErrInvalidRequest)
70			case locator.Mode != "" && !validMode(locator.Mode):
71				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown checkout mode %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Mode)
72			case locator.State != "" && !validState(locator.State):
73				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown task state %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.State)
74			}
75			return nil
76		}
77	
78		switch {
79		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
80			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
81		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
82			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
83		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
84			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
85		case !validState(locator.State):
86			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
87		}
88		return nil
89	}

91	func normalizedRemoteBranch(branch string) bool {
92		return branch != "" && branch == strings.TrimSpace(branch) &&
93			!strings.ContainsRune(branch, '\x00') &&
94			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/heads/") &&
95			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/remotes/")
96	}

98	func normalizeRemoteName(name string) (string, error) {
99		if name == "" {
100			return "origin", nil
101		}
102		if name != strings.TrimSpace(name) || strings.ContainsRune(name, '\x00') || strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") {
103			return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: remote name %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, name)
104		}
105		return name, nil
106	}

108	func (s *lifecycleService) planRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
109		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
110			return PlanSpec{}, err
111		}
112		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
113			return PlanSpec{}, err
114		}
115	
116		if request.Locator.TaskID == "" {
117			spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, nil)
118			return spec, err
119		}
120	
121		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
122		if err != nil {
123			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
124		}
125		spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, record)
126		if err != nil {
127			return PlanSpec{}, err
128		}
129		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning remote refresh"}
132		}
133		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
134			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning remote refresh")
135		}
136		return spec, nil
137	}

238	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRemoteRefNames(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) error {
239		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
240			"head":        "refs/heads/" + head,
241			"remote name": "refs/remotes/" + remote + "/__dev_refresh_probe__",
242		} {
243			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", ref); err != nil {
244				return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not a valid normalized Git name: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, label, err)
245			}
246		}
247		if base != "" {
248			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", "refs/heads/"+base); err != nil {
249				return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base is not a valid normalized Git branch: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
250			}
251		}
252		return nil
253	}

255	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRefreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, locator Locator, observed *remoteRefreshObservation) error {
256		checkout := locator.CheckoutPath
257		if checkout == "" {
258			checkout = locator.RepoPath
259		}
260		canonical, err := s.canonicalPath(checkout)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize selected checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
263		}
264		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, canonical)
265		if err != nil {
266			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout registration changed: " + err.Error()}
267		}
268		if registered.Path != canonical || registered.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
269			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout no longer belongs to the exact repository identity"}
270		}
271		if registered.Worktree.Detached || registered.Worktree.Branch != locator.Branch {
272			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
273				"selected checkout branch changed from %q to %q", locator.Branch, registered.Worktree.Branch,
274			)}
275		}
276		liveHead, err := s.gitRun(ctx, canonical, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
277		if err != nil {
278			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout HEAD is no longer observable: " + err.Error()}
279		}
280		liveHead = strings.TrimSpace(liveHead)
281		if registered.Worktree.Head != liveHead || locator.HeadOID != liveHead {
282			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
283				"selected checkout HEAD changed from %q to registry=%q live=%q", locator.HeadOID, registered.Worktree.Head, liveHead,
284			)}
285		}
286		observed.checkout = canonical
287		observed.worktree = registered
288		return nil
289	}

291	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRemoteRefs(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) RemoteRefsObservation {
292		result := RemoteRefsObservation{ObservedAt: s.now()}
293		result.LocalHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+head)
294		result.RemoteHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+head)
295		if base != "" {
296			result.LocalBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+base)
297			result.RemoteBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
298		}
299		return result
300	}

302	func (s *lifecycleService) observeNamedRef(ctx context.Context, repoPath, ref string) NamedRefObservation {
303		observed := NamedRefObservation{Ref: ref}
304		if !s.gitRefExists(ctx, repoPath, ref) {
305			return observed
306		}

334			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
335				EffectFetchRefs, "fetch and prune the exact configured remote", observed.repoPath, false, true,
336				map[string]string{
337					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
338					"pre-refs": remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs),
339				},
340			))
341		}
342		if options.QueryReview {
343			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
344				EffectQueryReview, "query the exact provider repository and head/base relationship", observed.providerRepository, false, true,
345				map[string]string{
346					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
347					"provider": string(observed.providerKind), "repository": observed.providerRepository,
348					"head": observed.head, "base": observed.base,
349				},
350			))

353		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.head + "@" + observed.refs.LocalHead.OID}

359			Conditions:        conditions,

361			RetainedResources: retained,
362			Confirmation: Confirmation{
363				Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Run the selected explicit remote network operations?",
364			},
365			Summary:     refreshRemoteSummary(observed, options),
366			DisplayedAt: s.now(),
367		}
368	}

370	func refreshTaskCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
371		if observed.record == nil {
372			return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
373				"repository/checkout context has no persisted task record", "")
374		}
375		return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
376			"task "+observed.record.Task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision+" is validated without a state write", "")
377	}
378	
379	func refreshHeadCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
380		ref := observed.refs.LocalHead
381		switch {
382		case ref.Failure != "":
383			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, ref.Failure, "repair local head-ref observation")
384		case !ref.Exists:
385			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
386				"local head ref "+ref.Ref+" does not exist", "restore the exact named local branch")
387		case ref.OID == "":
388			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
389				"local head ref resolved without an OID", "repair local head-ref observation")
390		default:
391			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
392				ref.Ref+" is exactly "+ref.OID, "")
393		}
394	}
395	
396	func refreshRemoteURLCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
397		if observed.remoteURL == "" {
398			return condition(ConditionRemoteURL, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
399				"remote "+observed.remoteName+" has no configured URL", "configure the exact remote before network refresh")
400		}
401		return condition(ConditionRemoteURL, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
402			"remote "+observed.remoteName+" is configured as "+observed.remoteURL, "")
403	}

405	func refreshRefsCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
406		verdict := VerdictMet
407		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{
408			observed.refs.LocalHead, observed.refs.LocalBase, observed.refs.RemoteHead, observed.refs.RemoteBase,
409		} {
410			if ref.Failure != "" {
411				verdict = VerdictError
412				break
413			}
414		}
415		return condition(ConditionRemoteRefs, verdict, RequirementAdvisory,
416			remoteRefsEvidence(observed.refs), "repair local Git ref observation before relying on freshness")
417	}

419	func refreshReviewBaseCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
420		if !options.QueryReview {
421			return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
422				"review query is not selected; an explicit base is not required", "")
423		}
424		if observed.base == "" {
425			return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictNeedsInput, RequirementRequired,
426				"review query requires an exact base branch", "select the base from the current repository context")
427		}
428		return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
429			"review base is "+observed.base, "")
430	}

432	func refreshReviewProviderCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
433		requirement := RequirementAdvisory
434		if options.QueryReview {

436		}
437		if observed.providerKind == forge.Unknown || observed.providerRepository == "" {

519	func remoteRefsEvidence(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
520		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)

522			if ref.Ref == "" {
523				continue
524			}
525			switch {
526			case ref.Failure != "":
527				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" error: "+ref.Failure)
528			case ref.Exists:

530			default:
531				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" is absent")
532			}
533		}
534		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")

548	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
549		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
550			return Result{}, err
551		}
552		if approved.Action != RefreshRemote {
553			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "refresh-remote handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
554		}
555		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
556			return Result{}, err
557		}
558		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
559		if err != nil {
560			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
561		}
562	
563		var result Result
564		applyLocked := func(tx *task.Tx) error {
565			var record *task.Record
566			if approved.Locator.TaskID != "" {
567				if tx == nil {
568					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "managed remote refresh has no task transaction"}
569				}
570				current, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
571				if loadErr != nil {
572					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before remote refresh"}
573				}
574				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *current); identityErr != nil {
575					return identityErr
576				}
577				record = current
578			}
579	
580			spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, approved.Request, record)
581			if observeErr != nil {
582				return observeErr
583			}
584			fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
585			if buildErr != nil {
586				return buildErr
587			}
588			if record != nil {
589				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
590				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
591					actual := ""
592					if current != nil {
593						actual = current.Revision
594					}
595					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked remote refresh replan")
596				}
597			}
598			if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
599				return &StalePlanError{
600					ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
601					ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
602					ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
603					Reason:                       "fresh task, repository, remote URL, provider, or ref authority differs",
604				}
605			}
606			if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
607				notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
608				return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh remote refresh conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
609			}
610	
611			execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh}
612			result, observeErr = execution.executeRefreshRemote(ctx, observed)
613			return observeErr
614		}
615	
616		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
617			if approved.Locator.TaskID == "" {
618				return applyLocked(nil)
619			}
620			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, applyLocked)
621		})
622		return result, err
623	}
624	
625	func (e *executionState) executeRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation) (Result, error) {
626		data := RemoteObservation{
627			RemoteName: observed.remoteName, RemoteURL: observed.remoteURL,
628			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
629			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, BeforeRefs: observed.refs,
630		}
631		e.remote = &data
632		fetched := false
633	
634		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
635			switch effect.Code {
636			case EffectFetchRefs:
637				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
638					_, fetchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "--", observed.remoteName)
639					if fetchErr != nil {
640						return "", fmt.Errorf("fetch --prune %s: %w", observed.remoteName, fetchErr)
641					}
642					return "fetched and pruned " + observed.remoteName, nil
643				})
644				if err != nil {
645					recovery := []string{"remote refs were not proven refreshed; repair the exact remote fetch and create a fresh plan"}
646					if e.plan.Request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions).QueryReview {
647						recovery = append(recovery, "review query was not attempted after the failed fetch")
648					}
649					return e.fail(err, recovery...)
650				}
651				fetched = true
652				data.AfterRefs = e.service.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
653				data.HasAfterRefs = true
654	
655			case EffectQueryReview:
656				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
657					if err := e.service.revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx, observed, fetched); err != nil {
658						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
659						return "", err
660					}
661					query := forge.ReviewQuery{Repository: observed.providerRepository, Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base}
662					review, queryErr := e.service.queryReview(ctx, observed.provider, observed.repoPath, query)
663					if queryErr != nil {
664						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, queryErr)
665						return "", queryErr
666					}
667					if review == nil {
668						data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
669							State: ObservationKnown, Exists: false,
670							Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
671							Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
672						}
673						data.HasReview = true
674						return "provider reports no exact review", nil
675					}
676					if err := validateRemoteReview(observed, *review); err != nil {
677						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
678						return "", err
679					}
680					observedAt := review.ObservedAt.UTC()
681					if review.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
682						observedAt = e.service.now()
683					}
684					data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
685						State: ObservationKnown, Exists: true,
686						Provider: review.Provider, Repository: review.Repository,
687						ID: review.ID, Number: review.Number, ReviewState: review.State,
688						Draft: review.Draft, URL: review.URL, Head: review.Head, Base: review.Base,
689						ObservedAt: observedAt,
690					}
691					data.HasReview = true
692					return fmt.Sprintf("observed %s review #%d (%s)", review.Provider, review.Number, review.State), nil
693				})
694				if err != nil {
695					if fetched {
696						return e.fail(err, "fetch completed; review evidence remains an explicit error and may be retried from a fresh query-only plan")
697					}
698					return e.fail(err, "local refs and task state were unchanged; repair provider access or response handling and retry")
699				}
700	
701			default:
702				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RefreshRemote effect " + string(effect.Code)})
703			}
704		}
705		return e.result(), nil
706	}
707	
708	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation, allowFetchedRefs bool) error {
709		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
710		if err != nil {
711			return staleBoundary("repository became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
712		}
713		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
714		if err != nil {
715			return staleBoundary("repository main path became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
716		}
717		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
718		if err != nil {
719			return staleBoundary("Git common directory became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
720		}
721		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
722			return staleBoundary("repository identity changed before review query")
723		}
724		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
725		kind, repositoryIdentity := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
726		if remoteURL != observed.remoteURL || kind != observed.providerKind || repositoryIdentity != observed.providerRepository {
727			return staleBoundary("remote URL or provider repository identity changed before review query")
728		}
729		if observed.provider == nil || observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind {
730			return staleBoundary("review provider identity changed before query")
731		}
732		if _, ok := observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier); !ok {
733			return staleBoundary("review provider capability changed before query")
734		}
735		if !observed.provider.Available() {
736			return staleBoundary("review provider CLI became unavailable before query")
737		}
738		if !allowFetchedRefs {
739			freshRefs := s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
740			if remoteRefsAuthority(freshRefs) != remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs) {
741				return staleBoundary("local or remote-tracking ref authority changed before query")
742			}
743		}
744		return nil
745	}

747	func (e *executionState) setRemoteReviewFailure(data *RemoteObservation, observed remoteRefreshObservation, err error) {
748		data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
749			State: ObservationError, Exists: false,
750			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
751			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
752			FailureKind: classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err), Failure: err.Error(),
753		}
754		data.HasReview = true
755	}
756	
757	func classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err error) RemoteReviewFailureKind {
758		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrAmbiguousReview) {
759			return RemoteReviewFailureAmbiguous
760		}
761		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrMalformedReviewResponse) {
762			return RemoteReviewFailureMalformed
763		}
764		var unsupported *forge.ErrUnsupported
765		if errors.As(err, &unsupported) {
766			return RemoteReviewFailureUnsupported
767		}
768		var missingCLI *forge.ErrNoCLI
769		if errors.As(err, &missingCLI) {
770			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingCLI
771		}
772		var missingExtension *forge.ErrNoExtension
773		if errors.As(err, &missingExtension) {
774			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingExtension
775		}
776		return RemoteReviewFailureProvider
777	}
778	
779	func validateRemoteReview(observed remoteRefreshObservation, review forge.Review) error {
780		switch {
781		case review.Provider != observed.providerKind:
782			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "provider")
783		case review.Repository != observed.providerRepository:
784			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "repository identity")
785		case review.Head != observed.head:
786			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "head branch")
787		case review.Base != observed.base:
788			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "base branch")
789		case strings.TrimSpace(review.ID) == "" || review.ID != strings.TrimSpace(review.ID):
790			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "identifier")
791		case review.Number <= 0:
792			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "number")
793		case !review.State.Valid():
794			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "state")
795		case review.State == forge.ReviewDraft && !review.Draft:
796			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft flag")
797		case review.State == forge.ReviewOpen && review.Draft:
798			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft state")
799		case !validRemoteReviewURL(review.URL):
800			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "URL")
801		}
802		return nil
803	}
804	
805	func malformedRemoteReview(provider forge.Kind, field string) error {
806		return &forge.MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: 0, Field: field}
807	}
808	
809	func validRemoteReviewURL(raw string) bool {
810		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
811		return err == nil && parsed.Host != "" && (parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http")
812	}
813	
814	func remoteRefCount(refs RemoteRefsObservation) int {
815		count := 0
816		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
817			if ref.Exists && ref.Failure == "" && ref.OID != "" {
818				count++
819			}
820		}
821		return count
822	}
823	
824	func remoteRefSummary(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
825		return strconv.Itoa(remoteRefCount(refs)) + " named ref OID(s) observed"
826	}

16	type OccupancyProfile uint8

93	func InspectOccupancy(ctx context.Context, rt Runtime, target string, opts OccupancyOptions) (Occupancy, error) {
94		checkout, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, target)
95		if err != nil {

97		}

107			return result, nil

200	func appendOccupancyAgent(ctx context.Context, result *Occupancy, checkout checkoutIdentity, opts OccupancyOptions, activity AgentActivity) error {
201		covered, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, checkout, activity.CWD)
