221	type checkoutIdentity struct {
222		path string
223		git  bool
224	}
225	
226	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
227		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
228		if err != nil {
229			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
230		}
231		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
232		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
233			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
234			if canonicalErr != nil {
235				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
236			}
237			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true}, nil
238		}
239		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
240			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
241		}
242		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string) (bool, error) {
246		if cwd == "" {
247			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
248		}
249		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
250		if err != nil {
251			return false, err
252		}
253		if target.git && activity.git {
254			return target.path == activity.path, nil
255		}
256		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
257	}
258	
259	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
260		panes := session.Panes
261		if len(panes) == 0 {
262			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
263				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
264			}
265		}
266		var covering, mixed []Pane
267		for _, pane := range panes {
268			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
269			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
270				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
271			}
272			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
273			for _, path := range paths {
274				if path == "" {
275					continue
276				}
277				observed = true
278				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path)
279				if err != nil {
280					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
281				}
282				if inside {
283					paneCovers = true
284				} else {
285					paneOutside = true
286				}
287			}
288			if paneCovers {
289				covering = append(covering, pane)
290			}
291			if paneOutside || !observed {
292				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
293			}
294		}
295		return covering, mixed, nil
296	}
297	
298	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
299		if id == "" {
300			return false
301		}
302		for _, pane := range panes {
303			if pane.ID == id {
304				return true
305			}
306		}
307		return false
308	}
309	
310	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
311		for _, session := range sessions {
312			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
313				return session.Runtime.Handle
314			}
315			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
316				return session.Runtime.Handle
317			}
318		}
319		return ""
320	}
321	
322	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
323		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
324		if status == "" {
325			return "unknown"
326		}
327		return status
328	}
329	
330	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
331		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
332			return !caller
333		}
334		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
335		// with a freshly listed covering session.
336		if caller || !correlated {
337			return true
338		}
339		switch status {
340		case "idle", "done":
341			return false
342		case "unknown":
343			return !opts.CloseUnknown
344		default:
345			return true
346		}
347	}

251					return e.fail(stepErr, "the branch is published and task state is unchanged; open the review manually or retry provider creation")

352	func (e *executionState) applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx context.Context, effect Effect) error {
353		observed := &e.observed
354		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
355			return err
356		}
357		before := observed.finish
358		beforeBranchOID := observed.completionBranchOID
359		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
360			switch effect.Code {
361			case EffectCommitAll:
362				message := effect.Details.Map()["message"]
363				if commitErr := e.service.commitAll(ctx, observed.checkout, message); commitErr != nil {
364					return "commit-all may have changed the index", fmt.Errorf("commit all checkout changes: %w", commitErr)
365				}
366				return "committed all checkout changes", nil
367			case EffectDiscardAll:
368				if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, observed.checkout); discardErr != nil {
369					return "discard-all may have partially reset checkout content", fmt.Errorf("discard all checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
370				}
371				return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
372			default:
373				return "", &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected dirty effect " + string(effect.Code)}
374			}
375		})
376		if err != nil {
377			e.partial = true
378			return err
379		}
380		allowBaseMove := observed.mode == task.ModeDirect && effect.Code == EffectCommitAll
381		if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, allowBaseMove); err != nil {
382			return fmt.Errorf("refresh after %s: %w", effect.Code, err)
383		}
384		if observed.finish.Status.Dirty() || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.inProgress {
385			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again after %s: %s", effect.Code, observed.finish.Status.Breakdown())
386		}
387		switch effect.Code {
388		case EffectCommitAll:
389			parent, parentErr := e.service.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBranchOID+"^")
390			if parentErr != nil || parent != beforeBranchOID {
391				return staleBoundary("commit-all did not create exactly one normal commit from the approved branch OID")
392			}
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeDirect {
394				if observed.finish.Relation != (gitx.BranchRelation{}) {
395					return staleBoundary("direct commit changed the self-relation unexpectedly")
396				}
397			} else if observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly != before.Relation.BaseOnly ||
398				observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly != before.Relation.BranchOnly+1 {
399				return staleBoundary("commit-all changed branch relation by more than the declared single commit")
400			}
401		case EffectDiscardAll:
402			if observed.completionBranchOID != beforeBranchOID || observed.finish.Relation != before.Relation {
403				return staleBoundary("discard-all unexpectedly changed committed branch identity or relation")
404			}
405		}
406		if observed.proofRef == observed.task.Branch {
407			observed.proofOID = observed.completionBranchOID
408		}
409		return nil
410	}

412	func (e *executionState) writeCompletionDone(effect Effect) error {
413		return e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
414			candidate := e.observed.task
415			candidate.State = task.Done
416			updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
417			if updateErr != nil {
418				return "", fmt.Errorf("write DONE task state: %w", updateErr)
419			}
420			if updated == nil {
421				return "", errors.New("write DONE task state returned no revision")
422			}
423			e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
424			e.observed.task = updated.Task
425			e.milestone = MilestoneMerged
426			return "recorded DONE at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
427		})
428	}

430	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateReviewRemote(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
431		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, "origin"))
432		identityKind, repository := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
433		kind := s.detectForge(ctx, observed.repoPath)
434		if identityKind != forge.Unknown {
435			if kind != forge.Unknown && kind != identityKind {
436				return staleBoundary("detected forge no longer matches origin repository identity")
437			}
438			kind = identityKind
439		}
440		if remoteURL != observed.reviewRemoteURL || kind != observed.reviewKind || repository != observed.reviewRepository {
441			return staleBoundary("origin URL or forge repository identity changed after planning")
442		}
443		return nil
444	}

446	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
447		if err := s.revalidateRepository(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
448			return err
449		}
450		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
451			return err
452		}
453		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.completionBranch ||
454			observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.completionBranch {
455			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("completion checkout branch changed: registry=%q status=%q expected=%q",
456				observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.completionBranch))

17	// Options controls only fail-closed observations. Caller protection and active
18	// agent states are never bypassable.
19	type Options struct {
20		CWD               string
21		CallerWorkspaceID string
22		CallerPaneID      string
23		CloseUnknown      bool
24		AssumeNoRuntime   bool
25		PollInterval      time.Duration
26		Timeout           time.Duration

29	// Session is one runtime session that currently covers the target checkout.
30	type Session struct {
31		Runtime runtime.Session
32		Panes   []runtime.Pane
33		Mixed   []runtime.Pane
34	}
35	
36	// Inspection is a fresh view of every runtime surface covering a checkout.
37	type Inspection struct {
38		Target          string
39		Sessions        []Session
40		ClosedSessions  int
41		Blockers        []string
42		RuntimeUnknown  bool
43		CallerContained bool
44	}
45	
46	// Ready reports whether destructive cleanup may proceed.
47	func (i Inspection) Ready() bool { return len(i.Blockers) == 0 }
48	
49	// Inspect discovers covering sessions and applies caller, mixed-workspace, and
50	// agent-state safety policy.
51	func Inspect(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
52		runtimeName := ""
53		if rt != nil {
54			runtimeName = rt.Name()
55		}
56		if opts.CallerWorkspaceID == "" && runtimeName != "tmux" && runtimeName != "zellij" && runtimeName != "none" {
57			opts.CallerWorkspaceID = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
58		}
59		if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
60			switch runtimeName {
61			case "herdr":
62				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
63			case "tmux":
64				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
65			case "zellij", "none":
66			default:
67				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
68				if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
69					opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
70				}
71			}
72		}
73		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, target, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
74			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyCleanup,
75			CallerWorkspaceID: opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
76			CallerPaneID:      opts.CallerPaneID,
77			CloseUnknown:      opts.CloseUnknown,
78		})
79		if err != nil {
80			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect retirement occupancy: %w", err)
81		}
82		result := Inspection{Target: evidence.Target}
83		cwd := opts.CWD
84		if cwd == "" {
85			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
86			if err != nil {
87				return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve caller directory: %w", err)
88			}
89		}
90		if inside, compareErr := pathx.Contains(evidence.Target, cwd); compareErr != nil {
91			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("compare caller directory: %w", compareErr)
92		} else if inside {
93			result.CallerContained = true
94			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
95				fmt.Sprintf("caller is inside target checkout %s", evidence.Target))
96		}
97	
98		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
99			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve current %s runtime pane: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
100		}
101		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
102			return Inspection{}, evidence.SessionCoverageErr
103		}
104		if !evidence.SessionList.Supported {
105			return dedupe(result), nil
106		}
107		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
108			if !opts.AssumeNoRuntime {
109				return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("list %s runtime sessions: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.SessionList.Err)
110			}
111			result.RuntimeUnknown = true
112		}
113		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
114			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("list %s recognized agents: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
115		}
116		for _, observed := range evidence.Sessions {
117			result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, Session{
118				Runtime: observed.Runtime,
119				Panes:   observed.Panes,
120				Mixed:   observed.Mixed,
121			})
122			if observed.IsCaller {
123				result.CallerContained = true
124				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
125					fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", observed.Runtime.Handle))
126			}
127			if len(observed.Mixed) > 0 {
128				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
129					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s also contains %d pane(s) outside the target", observed.Runtime.Handle, len(observed.Mixed)))
130			}
131			for _, status := range coveringAgentStatuses(observed.Panes, observed.Runtime.AgentStatus) {
132				appendAgentStatusBlocker(&result, observed.Runtime.Handle, status, opts.CloseUnknown)
133			}
134		}
135		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
136			if !agent.Blocking {
137				continue
138			}
139			if agent.IsCaller {
140				result.CallerContained = true
141				if agent.SessionHandle != "" {
142					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
143						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", agent.SessionHandle))
144				} else {
145					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
146						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime pane %s contains the target checkout", agent.Activity.PaneID))
147				}
148				continue
149			}
150			if agent.SessionHandle == "" {
151				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
152					fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent in pane %s covers the target without a closeable runtime session", agent.Activity.PaneID))
153				continue
154			}
155			appendAgentStatusBlocker(&result, agent.SessionHandle, agent.Status, opts.CloseUnknown)
156		}
157		return dedupe(result), nil
158	}

160	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
161	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
162	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
163		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
164		if err != nil {
165			return inspection, err
166		}
167		if !inspection.Ready() {
168			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
169		}
170		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
171			return inspection, nil
172		}
173		interval := opts.PollInterval
174		if interval <= 0 {
175			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
176		}
177		timeout := opts.Timeout
178		if timeout <= 0 {
179			timeout = 5 * time.Second
180		}
181		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
182		closed := make(map[string]bool)
183		for {
184			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
185			if inspectErr != nil {
186				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
187			}
188			if !fresh.Ready() {
189				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
190			}
191			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
192				inspection.Sessions = nil
193				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
194				return inspection, nil
195			}
196			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
197				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
198					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
199			}
200			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
201				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
202				if closed[handle] {
203					continue
204				}
205				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
206					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
207				}
208				closed[handle] = true
209				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
210			}
211			select {
212			case <-ctx.Done():
213				return inspection, ctx.Err()
214			case <-time.After(interval):
215			}
216		}
217	}
218	
219	func coveringAgentStatuses(panes []runtime.Pane, fallback string) []string {
220		set := make(map[string]bool)
221		for _, pane := range panes {
222			if pane.Agent != "" || pane.AgentSession != "" || pane.AgentStatus != "" {
223				set[strings.ToLower(pane.AgentStatus)] = true
224			}
225		}
226		if len(set) == 0 {
227			set[strings.ToLower(fallback)] = true
228		}
229		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
230		for status := range set {
231			out = append(out, status)
232		}
233		sort.Strings(out)
234		return out
235	}
236	
237	func appendAgentStatusBlocker(result *Inspection, handle, rawStatus string, closeUnknown bool) {
238		status := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawStatus))
239		switch status {
240		case "idle", "done":
241			// Eligible after all structural checks pass.
242		case "working", "running", "busy", "blocked", "waiting":
243			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
244				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has agent status %s", handle, status))
245		case "", "unknown":
246			if !closeUnknown {
247				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
248					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unknown agent status; pass --close-unknown from outside it", handle))
249			}
250		default:
251			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
252				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unrecognized agent status %s", handle, status))
253		}
254	}
255	
256	func dedupe(inspection Inspection) Inspection {
257		seen := make(map[string]bool)
258		out := inspection.Blockers[:0]
259		for _, blocker := range inspection.Blockers {
260			if !seen[blocker] {
261				seen[blocker] = true
262				out = append(out, blocker)
263			}
264		}
265		inspection.Blockers = out
266		return inspection
267	}

226	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx context.Context, observed *destructiveObservation) {
227		for _, diagnostic := range observed.taskDiagnostics {
228			observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete, diagnostic.Error())
229		}
230		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
231			candidate := record.Task
232			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
233				observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
234					fmt.Sprintf("task %s is invalid: %v", candidate.ID, err))
235				continue
236			}
237	
238			pathClaim := false
239			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
240				path, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
241				if err != nil {
242					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
243						fmt.Sprintf("task %s checkout identity is unavailable: %v", candidate.ID, err))
244				} else {
245					pathClaim = path == observed.checkout
246				}
247			}
248	
249			branchClaim := false
250			if candidate.Branch == observed.locator.Branch {
251				repoMatches, complete, detail := s.taskRepositoryMatches(ctx, candidate, *observed)
252				if !complete {
253					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
254						fmt.Sprintf("task %s repository identity is unavailable: %s", candidate.ID, detail))
255				} else {
256					branchClaim = repoMatches
257				}
258			}
259	
260			if pathClaim {
261				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
262					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "exact checkout path",
263				})
264			}
265			if branchClaim {
266				reason := "exact branch in selected repository"
267				if pathClaim {
268					reason = "exact checkout path and branch in selected repository"
269					observed.taskClaims[len(observed.taskClaims)-1].Reason = reason
270					continue
271				}
272				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
273					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: reason,
274				})
275			}
276		}
277		sort.Slice(observed.taskClaims, func(i, j int) bool {
278			if observed.taskClaims[i].ID != observed.taskClaims[j].ID {
279				return observed.taskClaims[i].ID < observed.taskClaims[j].ID
280			}
281			return observed.taskClaims[i].Reason < observed.taskClaims[j].Reason
282		})
283		sort.Strings(observed.taskIncomplete)
284	}

286	func (s *lifecycleService) taskRepositoryMatches(ctx context.Context, candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation) (bool, bool, string) {
287		candidatePath, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)

408	func artifactEvidenceFromInspection(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection) string {
409		if inspection.KnownEmpty {
410			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
411		}
412		states := make([]string, 0, len(inspection.Intents))
413		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
414			states = append(states, intent.Intent.ID+"="+string(intent.State))
415		}
416		if len(states) == 0 {
417			return "artifact readiness is incomplete"
418		}
419		return strings.Join(states, ", ")

26		reason string

28		apply func() error

31	type sweepRetireOptions struct {
32		closeUnknown    bool
33		assumeNoRuntime bool

37	func newSweepCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
38		var (
39			apply           bool
40			staleDays       int
41			yes             bool
42			mergedWorktrees bool
43			baseRef         string
44			closeUnknown    bool
45			assumeNoRuntime bool
46			deleteBranches  bool
47		)
48		cmd := &cobra.Command{
49			Use:   "sweep",
50			Short: "Review stale tasks and drifted state, and act on them",
51			Long: `Show which tasks have gone stale or drifted, and what dev would do about it.
52	
53	Cleanup usually fails not because people are unwilling but because there is no
54	trustworthy way to be sure the work is recoverable. So sweep reports first and
55	only changes things with --apply, confirming each one unless you pass --yes.
56	Nothing here ever deletes uncommitted work.`,
57			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
58			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
59				ctx := ctxOf()
60				style := app.outStyle()
61				tasks, err := app.Tasks.List()
62				if err != nil {
63					return err
64				}
65				rt := app.Runtime()
66				rows := inventory.Collect(ctx, tasks, rt, inventory.Options{})
67				stale := time.Duration(staleDays) * 24 * time.Hour
68				retireOptions := sweepRetireOptions{
69					closeUnknown: closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranches: deleteBranches,
70				}
71	
72				var sugg []suggestion
73				if mergedWorktrees {
74					merged, err := suggestMergedWorktrees(app, ctx, rows, baseRef, retireOptions)
75					if err != nil {
76						return err
77					}
78					sugg = append(sugg, merged...)
79				} else {
80					for _, r := range rows {
81						sugg = append(sugg, suggestFor(app, ctx, r, stale, retireOptions)...)
82					}
83				}
84	
85				// Live sessions no task claims: the other half of a crowded sidebar.
86				if !mergedWorktrees {
87					if sessions, err := rt.List(ctx); err == nil {
88						if orphans := inventory.Orphans(sessions, rows); len(orphans) > 0 {
89							fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%d live session(s) with no task recorded:\n", len(orphans))
90							for _, s := range orphans {
91								dir := "—"
92								if len(s.Dirs) > 0 {
93									dir = config.Contract(s.Dirs[0])
94								}
95								fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %-24s %s\n", truncate(s.Label, 24), style.dim(dir))
96							}
97							fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("  → `dev start` in one of those directories to track it, or just close it."))
98						}
99					}
100				}
101	
102				if len(sugg) == 0 {
103					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.success("\nNothing to sweep")+" — no task drift or eligible merged worktree was found.")
104					return nil
105				}
106	
107				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%s\n\n", style.title(fmt.Sprintf("%d suggestion(s):", len(sugg))))
108				for _, s := range sugg {
109					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %-28s %s\n", s.row.Task.State.Icon(),
110						truncate(s.row.Task.Title(), 28), style.warning(s.reason))
111					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "     → %s\n", s.action)
112				}
113	
114				if !apply {
115					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nRe-run with --apply to act on these (each is confirmed individually)."))
116					return nil
117				}
118	
119				in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
120				for _, s := range sugg {
121					if s.apply == nil {
122						continue
123					}
124					if !yes && !confirm(app, in, s.action) {
125						continue
126					}
127					if err := s.apply(); err != nil {
128						app.warnf("%s: %v", s.row.Task.ID, err)
129						continue
130					}
131					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s\n", style.success("done:"), s.action)
132				}
133				return nil
134			},
135		}
136		f := cmd.Flags()
137		f.BoolVar(&apply, "apply", false, "act on the suggestions instead of only reporting")
138		f.IntVar(&staleDays, "stale-days", 14, "days without a commit before a task counts as stale")
139		f.BoolVar(&yes, "yes", false, "with --apply, do not confirm each change")
140		f.BoolVar(&mergedWorktrees, "merged-worktrees", false, "focus on linked worktrees whose branches are contained in the main branch")
141		f.StringVar(&baseRef, "base", "", "containment base for --merged-worktrees (default: the repository default branch)")
142		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow external closure of unknown runtime status during retirement")
143		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails during retirement")
144		f.BoolVar(&deleteBranches, "delete-branches", false, "also delete contained local branches after worktree retirement")
145		return cmd
146	}
147	
148	func suggestFor(app *App, ctx context.Context, r inventory.Row, stale time.Duration, retireOptions sweepRetireOptions) []suggestion {
149		t := r.Task
150		var out []suggestion
151		current, currentErr := app.Tasks.GetRecord(t.ID)
152		if currentErr != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(current.Task, *t) {
153			detail := "task changed after the sweep inventory snapshot"
154			if currentErr != nil {
155				detail = "task could not be reloaded after the sweep inventory snapshot: " + currentErr.Error()
156			}
157			return []suggestion{{
158				row: r, reason: detail,
159				action: "rerun sweep to inspect the current task revision — not changed automatically",
160			}}
161		}
162		revision := current.Revision
163	
164		// A task whose repository is gone cannot be finished, resumed, parked or
165		// retired: every one of those resolves the repository first, and `dev done`
166		// refuses outright once the checkout is missing. Nothing else in this
167		// function reaches it either — the dead-branch rule below excludes direct
168		// mode, and the stale-worktree rule needs a recorded worktree path. Left
169		// alone, the record is unreachable by any command in the binary.
170		//
171		// Reaping removes dev's record of intent and nothing else; the branch, the
172		// commits and the remote are untouched. A live session proves the directory
173		// is there, so it is the one condition that rules this out.
174		if t.RepoPath != "" && !r.Live() && !dirExists(t.RepoPath) {
175			out = append(out, suggestion{
176				row:    r,
177				reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository %s no longer exists", config.Contract(t.RepoPath)),
178				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s (Git keeps any work; this drops only dev's record)", t.ID),
179				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
180			})
181			return out
182		}
183	
184		out = append(out, orphanSuggestions(app, r)...)
185	
186		switch {
187		// A hot task with no live session is the commonest drift: the session was
188		// closed (or the machine rebooted) without parking.
189		case t.State == task.Hot && r.StateDrift() == "no live session":
190			reason := fmt.Sprintf("hot but no live session, idle %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
191			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkWarmOptions{})
192			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
193				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded warm parking is blocked",
194					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})
195				break
196			}
197			out = append(out, suggestion{
198				row: r, reason: reason, action: fmt.Sprintf("mark %s warm", t.ID),
199				apply: func() error {
200					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
201					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
202					return err
203				},
204			})
205	
206		// A warm task nobody has touched in weeks is a candidate for cold: keeping
207		// the worktree costs disk and clutters every listing.
208		case t.State == task.Warm && r.Age() > stale:
209			reason := fmt.Sprintf("warm and untouched for %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
210			if t.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
211				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but direct tasks cannot go cold",
212					action: "keep it warm or finish it — not changed automatically"})
213				break
214			}
215			if r.Status.Dirty() {
216				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but has uncommitted work",
217					action: "commit or `dev park --wip` before going cold — not changed automatically"})
218				break
219			}
220			if !r.Status.Synced() {
221				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + fmt.Sprintf(", not pushed (%s)", r.Status.Summary()),
222					action: fmt.Sprintf("push %s so it can go cold: dev park %s --cold --push", t.Branch, t.ID)})
223				break
224			}
225			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkColdOptions{})
226			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
227				detail := sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)
228				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded cold parking is blocked",
229					action: detail + " — not changed automatically"})
230				break
231			}
232			out = append(out, suggestion{
233				row:    r,
234				reason: reason + ", clean and pushed",
235				action: fmt.Sprintf("go cold: remove %s (branch and remote keep the work)", config.Contract(r.Checkout)),
236				apply: func() error {
237					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
238					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
239					return err
240				},
241			})
242	
243		// DONE means integrated; runtime/worktree cleanup is a separate,
244		// externally coordinated retirement step.
245		case t.State == task.Done:
246			action := fmt.Sprintf("retire runtime/worktree for %s", t.ID)
247			if retireOptions.deleteBranches && t.Branch != "" && t.Branch != t.Base {
248				action += fmt.Sprintf(" and delete %s", t.Branch)
249			}
250			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.RetireOptions{
251				CloseUnknown: retireOptions.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: retireOptions.assumeNoRuntime,
252				DeleteBranch: retireOptions.deleteBranches,
253			})
254			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
255				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: "merged, but guarded retirement is blocked",
256					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})
257				break
258			}
259			out = append(out, suggestion{
260				row: r, reason: "merged, cleanup pending", action: action,
261				apply: func() error {
262					approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
263					if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
264						approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
265					}
266					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, approval)
267					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
268					return err
269				},
270			})
271		}
272	
273		// A branch-backed task whose branch git no longer has is dead: the branch
274		// was deleted after integration, so the record holds intent for work that
275		// no longer exists anywhere. It cannot be finished, resumed, or retired,
276		// because every one of those paths resolves the branch first.
277		noCheckout := t.WorktreePath == "" || r.WorktreeMissing
278		if noCheckout && t.Branch != "" && t.RepoPath != "" &&
279			t.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeDirect && !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, t.RepoPath, t.Branch) {
280			out = append(out, suggestion{
281				row:    r,
282				reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch %s no longer exists", t.Branch),
283				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s", t.ID),
284				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
285			})
286			return out
287		}
288	
289		// A cold task keeps no checkout by definition: that is what going cold
290		// means. One still on disk is drift inventory already reports and nothing
291		// could act on.
292		if t.State == task.Cold && t.WorktreePath != "" && r.CheckoutExists && !r.WorktreeMissing &&
293			!r.Live() && !r.Status.Dirty() && r.Status.Synced() {
294			out = append(out, suggestion{
295				row:    r,
296				reason: "cold, but its worktree is still on disk",
297				action: fmt.Sprintf("reconcile %s with an exact guarded plan — not changed automatically", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
298			})
299		}
300	
301		// Drift that is independent of the lifecycle stage.
302		if r.WorktreeMissing && t.WorktreePath != "" {
303			wtPath := t.WorktreePath
304			out = append(out, suggestion{
305				row:    r,
306				reason: "records a worktree that git no longer knows about",
307				action: fmt.Sprintf("inspect repository-wide prune scope before clearing %s — not changed automatically", config.Contract(wtPath)),
308			})
309		}
310		return out
311	}
312	
313	func sweepTaskPlan(ctx context.Context, app *App, id string, options flow.ActionOptions) (lifecycleSession, flow.Plan, error) {
314		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
315			return app.Tasks.Get(id)
316		})
317		if err != nil {
318			return lifecycleSession{}, flow.Plan{}, err
319		}
320		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
321		return session, plan, err
322	}
323	
324	func sweepPlanBlocker(plan flow.Plan, err error) string {
325		if err != nil {
326			return err.Error()
327		}
328		var parts []string
329		for _, condition := range append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...) {
330			parts = append(parts, string(condition.Code)+": "+condition.Evidence)
331		}
332		if len(parts) == 0 {
333			return "guarded plan is " + string(plan.Availability)
334		}
335		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
336	}
337	
338	func sweepDeleteTask(ctx context.Context, store *task.Store, id, revision string) error {
339		if revision == "" {
340			return fmt.Errorf("task %s had no report-time revision; rerun sweep", id)
341		}
342		return store.DeleteIfRevision(ctx, id, revision)
343	}
344	
345	// dirExists reports whether path is a directory that can be read right now.
346	func dirExists(path string) bool {
347		info, err := os.Stat(path)
348		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
349	}
350	
351	// orphanSuggestions handles the residue of a worktree removed while its
352	// transcript writer was still running: the path exists, Git has no record of
353	// it, and it holds only agent artifacts. Removing it is offered only once every
354	// file in it is proven byte-identical to one the repository already has.
355	func orphanSuggestions(app *App, r inventory.Row) []suggestion {
356		t := r.Task
357		if t.WorktreePath == "" || !r.WorktreeMissing || !r.CheckoutExists {
358			return nil
359		}
360		orphan, ok, err := retirement.InspectOrphan(t.WorktreePath)
361		if err != nil || !ok {
362			return nil
363		}
364		unsalvaged, err := retirement.Unsalvaged(orphan, t.RepoPath)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil
367		}
368		if len(unsalvaged) > 0 {
369			return []suggestion{{
370				row: r,
371				reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace holding %d file(s) the repository does not have",
372					config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(unsalvaged)),
373				action: fmt.Sprintf("salvage %s first — not removed automatically", strings.Join(unsalvaged, ", ")),
374			}}
375		}
376		return []suggestion{{
377			row:    r,
378			reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace git does not know", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
379			action: fmt.Sprintf("remove the empty shell %s (its %d artifact file(s) are already in the repository)",
380				config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(orphan.Files)),
381			apply: func() error { return os.RemoveAll(t.WorktreePath) },
382		}}
383	}

385	func suggestMergedWorktrees(app *App, ctx context.Context, rows []inventory.Row, requestedBase string, options sweepRetireOptions) ([]suggestion, error) {
386		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, mustGetwd())
387		if err != nil {
388			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees requires a Git repository: %w", err)
389		}
390		if repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
391			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees must run from the canonical checkout, not linked worktree %s", config.Contract(repository.Root))
392		}
393		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, err
396		}
397		base := requestedBase
398		if base == "" {
399			base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.Root)
400			if status.Branch != base {
401				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees defaults to %s; switch the canonical checkout to it or pass --base explicitly", base)
402			}
403		}
404		if !gitx.RefExists(ctx, repository.Root, base) {
405			return nil, fmt.Errorf("merged-worktree base %s does not resolve to a commit", base)
406		}
407	
408		claimed := make(map[string]inventory.Row)
409		for _, row := range rows {
410			if row.Task == nil || row.Checkout == "" {
411				continue
412			}
413			canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(row.Checkout)
414			if canonicalErr == nil {
415				claimed[canonical] = row
416			}
417		}
418		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, repository.Root)
419		if err != nil {
420			return nil, err
421		}
422		var suggestions []suggestion
423		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
424			if worktree.Main || worktree.Bare || worktree.Detached || worktree.Branch == "" || worktree.Branch == base {
425				continue
426			}
427			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", worktree.Branch, base); err != nil {
428				continue
429			}
430			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
431			if err != nil {
432				continue
433			}
434			if row, ok := claimed[canonical]; ok {
435				if row.Task.State == task.Done {
436					suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestFor(app, ctx, row, 0, options)...)
437					continue
438				}
439				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
440					fmt.Sprintf("task is %s; verify integration with `dev done --merged` first", row.Task.State)))
441				continue
442			}
443	
444			displayTask := &task.Task{
445				ID: task.MakeID(repository.Name, worktree.Branch), Name: worktree.Branch,
446				Repo: repository.Name, RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, Branch: worktree.Branch,
447				Base: base, WorktreePath: canonical, Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done,
448			}
449			row := inventory.Row{Task: displayTask, Checkout: canonical, CheckoutExists: true}
450			if inventory.IsClaudeHarnessWorktree(repository.Root, canonical) {
451				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
452					"checkout is owned by the Claude harness"))
453				continue
454			}
455			locator, locateErr := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, canonical)
456			if locateErr != nil {
457				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, locateErr.Error()))
458				continue
459			}
460			service, serviceErr := newCLILifecycleService(app)
461			if serviceErr != nil {
462				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, serviceErr.Error()))
463				continue
464			}
465			request, requestErr := flow.NewRequest(locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
466				RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base,
467				DeleteContainedBranch: options.deleteBranches,
468				CloseUnknown:          options.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.assumeNoRuntime,
469			})
470			if requestErr != nil {
471				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, requestErr.Error()))
472				continue
473			}
474			plan, planErr := service.Plan(ctx, request)
475			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
476				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)))
477				continue
478			}
479			branch := worktree.Branch
480			action := fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s (branch %s kept)",
481				config.Contract(canonical), branch)
482			if options.deleteBranches {
483				action = fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s and delete contained branch %s",
484					config.Contract(canonical), branch)
485			}
486			suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestion{
487				row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("untracked worktree branch is contained in %s", base), action: action,
488				apply: func() error {
489					approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
490					if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
491						approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
492					}
493					result, err := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
494					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
495					return err
496				},
497			})
498		}
499		return suggestions, nil
500	}
501	
502	func mergedWorktreeBlocker(row inventory.Row, base, blocker string) suggestion {
503		return suggestion{
504			row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch is contained in %s, but retirement is blocked", base),
505			action: blocker + " — not changed automatically",
506		}
507	}
508	
509	func confirm(app *App, in *bufio.Reader, action string) bool {
510		s := app.outStyle()
511		prompt := s.prompt(action + "?")
512		lower := strings.ToLower(action)
513		if strings.Contains(lower, "delete") || strings.Contains(lower, "remove") ||
514			strings.Contains(lower, "discard") || strings.Contains(lower, "drop") {
515			prompt = s.danger(action + "?")
516		}
517		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s ", prompt, s.dim("[y/N]"))
518		line, err := in.ReadString('\n')
519		if err != nil {
520			return false
521		}
522		answer := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
523		return answer == "y" || answer == "yes"
524	}
525

444	// renderPlan prints a provisioning plan as a table plus its warnings.
445	func renderPlan(app *App, plan wt.Plan, repoPath string) {
446		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s\n\n", config.Contract(repoPath))
447	
448		if len(plan.Ecosystems) == 0 {
449			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No project type detected — only gitignored files will be carried over.")
450		} else {
451			t := app.newTable("PROJECT", "MANAGER", "FROM", "DEPENDENCIES", "TOOL")
452			style := app.outStyle()
453			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
454				deps := "—"
455				if len(e.DepDirs) > 0 {
456					deps = strings.Join(e.DepDirs, ", ")
457				} else {
458					deps = "global cache"
459				}
460				tool := "installed"
461				if !e.ToolInstalled() {
462					tool = style.danger("MISSING: " + e.Tool)
463				} else {
464					tool = style.success(tool)
465				}
466				t.Add(e.Name, e.Manager, e.Marker, deps, tool)
467			}
468			t.Render(app.Out)
469		}
470	
471		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out)
472		if len(plan.Steps) == 0 {
473			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Nothing to provision.")
474		} else {
475			st := app.newTable("", "ACTION", "WHAT", "WHY")
476			style := app.outStyle()
477			for _, s := range plan.Steps {
478				mark := "✓"
479				if s.Skipped {
480					mark = style.dim("·")
481				} else {
482					mark = style.success(mark)
483				}
484				st.Add(mark, string(s.Kind), truncate(s.What, 34), s.Why)
485			}
486			st.Render(app.Out)
487		}
488	
489		for _, w := range plan.Warnings {
490			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%s %s\n", app.errStyle().warning("warning:"), w)
491		}
492		if plan.Empty() {
493			fmt.Fprintln(app.Err, "\nNothing would run. If a new worktree comes up broken, add what it needs to "+
494				"worktree.post_create, or commit .dev-cli/config.toml with `dev wt plan --write`.")
495		}
496	}
497	
498	// writeRepoTemplate seeds .dev-cli/config.toml from the detected plan.
499	//
500	// Committing it is what makes a project's worktree setup reproducible: the
501	// next machine, and the next person, get the same one without having to
502	// rediscover it.
503	func writeRepoTemplate(app *App, repoPath string, plan wt.Plan, set wt.Settings) error {
504		path, err := projectconfig.ConfigPath(repoPath)
505		if err != nil {
506			return err
507		}
508		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
509			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists — edit it directly", config.Contract(path))
510		}
511		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
512			return err
513		}
514	
515		var b strings.Builder
516		b.WriteString("# dev project configuration (versioned with this repository).\n")
517		b.WriteString("version = 1\n\n")
518		b.WriteString("#\n")
519		b.WriteString("# Committed on purpose: a worktree is a clean checkout, so without this a\n")
520		b.WriteString("# new one comes up with no dependencies and none of the gitignored files the\n")
521		b.WriteString("# project needs. Seeded by `dev wt plan --write`; edit freely.\n\n")
522		b.WriteString("[worktree]\n")
523	
524		b.WriteString("# Gitignored files to carry into a new worktree. Only files that are BOTH\n")
525		b.WriteString("# listed here AND gitignored are copied — a tracked file is already in the\n")
526		b.WriteString("# checkout on the correct branch.\n")
527		b.WriteString("include = [")
528		for i, inc := range set.Include {
529			if i > 0 {
530				b.WriteString(", ")
531			}
532			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%q", inc)
533		}
534		b.WriteString("]\n\n")
535	
536		if len(plan.Ecosystems) > 0 {
537			b.WriteString("# Detected in this repository:\n")
538			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
539				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "#   %-8s %-8s (%s) → %s\n", e.Name, e.Manager, e.Marker, e.Install)
540			}
541			b.WriteString("#\n")
542			b.WriteString("# \"auto\" runs those install commands. Replace with an explicit list if this\n")
543			b.WriteString("# project needs something else:  post_create = [\"make bootstrap\"]\n")
544			b.WriteString("post_create = \"auto\"\n\n")
545	
546			b.WriteString("# How each project type gets its dependencies:\n")
547			b.WriteString("#   reinstall  run the install command (correct, the default)\n")
548			b.WriteString("#   copy       duplicate the directory from the source checkout (fast)\n")
549			b.WriteString("#   link       share one directory between checkouts (fastest, risky)\n")
550			b.WriteString("#   skip       leave the worktree without dependencies\n")
551			b.WriteString("[worktree.strategies]\n")
552			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
553				switch {
554				case len(e.DepDirs) == 0:
555					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# %-8s = \"reinstall\"  # %s uses a global cache; nothing to copy\n",
556						e.Name, e.Manager)
557				case e.CopySafe:
558					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%-10s = \"reinstall\"  # \"copy\" is sound here and much faster\n", e.Name)
559				default:
560					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%-10s = \"reinstall\"  # copy/link unsupported: %s\n", e.Name, e.Hazard)
561				}
562			}
563		} else {
564			b.WriteString("# No project type detected. Add the commands a fresh checkout needs:\n")
565			b.WriteString("# post_create = [\"make bootstrap\"]\n")
566			b.WriteString("post_create = \"auto\"\n")
567		}
568	
569		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(b.String()), 0o644); err != nil {
570			return err
571		}
572		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "wrote %s\n", config.Contract(path))
573		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Commit it so every machine provisions worktrees the same way.")
574		return nil
575	}
576

395	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
396		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
397			return Result{}, err
398		}
399		if approved.Action != RemoveCheckout {
400			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "remove-checkout handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
401		}
402		if err := validateRemoveCheckoutLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
403			return Result{}, err
404		}
405		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
406		if err != nil {
407			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
408		}
409	
410		var result Result
411		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
412			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
413				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, approved.Request, tx.ListRecords)
414				if observeErr != nil {
415					return observeErr
416				}
417				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
418				if buildErr != nil {
419					return buildErr
420				}
421				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
422					return &StalePlanError{
423						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
424						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
425						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
426						Reason:                       "fresh unmanaged Git, worktree, task, artifact, runtime, or harness authority differs",
427					}
428				}
429				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
430					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
431					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh unmanaged removal conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
432				}
433				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx}
434				result, observeErr = execution.executeRemoveCheckout(ctx, observed)
435				return observeErr
436			})
437		})
438		return result, err
439	}

441	func (e *executionState) executeRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
442		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RemoveCheckoutOptions)
443		closedRuntime := false
444	
445		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
446			switch effect.Code {
447			case EffectDiscardAll:
448				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, false)
449				if err != nil {
450					return e.fail(err, "refresh unmanaged removal before discarding bytes")
451				}
452				baseline = fresh
453				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
454					if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, baseline.checkout); discardErr != nil {
455						return "dirty discard may be partial", fmt.Errorf("discard exact checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
456					}
457					return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
458				})
459				if err != nil {
460					e.partial = true
461					return e.fail(err, "inspect every checkout byte before retrying removal")
462				}
463				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, true, false)
464				if err != nil {
465					return e.fail(err, "discard completed but a safety source changed; preserve the checkout and refresh")
466				}
467				baseline = fresh
468	
469			case EffectCloseRuntime:
470				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, false)
471				if err != nil {
472					return e.fail(err, "refresh unmanaged removal before closing any runtime")
473				}
474				baseline = fresh
475				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
476					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
477						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
478						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
479					})
480					if closeErr != nil {
481						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
482					}
483					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil
484				})
485				if err != nil {
486					e.partial = true
487					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and branch remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
488				}
489				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, true)
490				if err != nil {
491					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh removal")
492				}
493				baseline = fresh
494				closedRuntime = true
495	
496			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
497				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, closedRuntime)
498				if err != nil {
499					return e.fail(err, "the checkout was preserved; refresh every safety source")
500				}
501				baseline = fresh
502				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
503					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
504						return "checkout removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact unmanaged checkout %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
505					}
506					return "removed exact clean linked checkout without force; branch preserved", nil
507				})
508				if err != nil {
509					e.partial = true
510					return e.fail(err, "inspect the exact worktree registration and preserved branch before retrying")
511				}
512				if err := e.verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
513					return e.fail(err, "checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact preserved local branch")
514				}
515				e.snapshot = "checkout:removed:" + baseline.checkout + ":" + baseline.branchOID
516	
517			case EffectDeleteBranch:
518				if e.snapshot == "" {
519					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before verified checkout removal"})
520				}
521				if err := e.revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
522					return e.fail(err, "the checkout was removed but the branch and task inventory changed; keep the branch and refresh")
523				}
524				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
525					if _, deleteErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, baseline.repoPath, "branch", "-d", "--", baseline.locator.Branch); deleteErr != nil {
526						return "contained branch deletion failed", deleteErr
527					}
528					return "deleted contained local branch " + baseline.locator.Branch, nil
529				})
530				if err != nil {
531					e.partial = true
532					return e.fail(err, "checkout removal remains complete; inspect the retained branch and retry")
533				}
534				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
535					return e.fail(errors.New("local branch still exists after successful deletion"), "inspect the branch before retrying")
536				}
537				e.snapshot += ":branch-deleted"

539			default:
540				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RemoveCheckout effect " + string(effect.Code)})
541			}
542		}
543		if e.snapshot == "" {
544			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unmanaged removal ended without verified checkout removal"})
545		}
546		return e.result(), nil
547	}

549	func (e *executionState) reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation, allowDiscard, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
550		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, e.plan.Request, e.tx.ListRecords)
551		if err != nil {
552			return fresh, err
553		}
554		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
555			return fresh, err
556		}
557		for _, check := range []struct {
558			name          string
559			before, after string
560		}{
561			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
562			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
563			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
564			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
565			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
566			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
567			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
568		} {
569			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
570				return fresh, err
571			}
572		}
573		if allowDiscard {
574			if err := comparePostDiscardGit(baseline, fresh); err != nil {
575				return fresh, err
576			}
577		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()); err != nil {
578			return fresh, err
579		}
580		if allowRuntimeChange {
581			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
582				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
583			}
584		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
585			return fresh, err
586		}
587		return fresh, nil
588	}
589	
590	func comparePostDiscardGit(before, after destructiveObservation) error {
591		if after.statusErr != nil || after.status.Dirty() {
592			return staleBoundary("checkout is not clean after explicit discard")
593		}
594		beforeStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
595			before.status.Branch, boolString(before.status.Detached), before.status.Upstream,
596			fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Behind),
597			before.head, errorString(before.headErr), before.operation, boolString(before.inProgress), errorString(before.operationErr),
598		)
599		afterStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
600			after.status.Branch, boolString(after.status.Detached), after.status.Upstream,
601			fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Behind),
602			after.head, errorString(after.headErr), after.operation, boolString(after.inProgress), errorString(after.operationErr),
603		)
604		return compareAuthorityCategory("post-discard Git identity", beforeStable, afterStable)
605	}
606	
607	func (e *executionState) revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
608		records, diagnostics, err := e.tx.ListRecords()
609		if err != nil {
610			return err
611		}
612		claims := baseline
613		claims.taskRecords = records
614		claims.taskDiagnostics = diagnostics
615		claims.taskClaims = nil
616		claims.taskIncomplete = nil
617		e.service.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &claims)
618		if len(claims.taskIncomplete) > 0 {
619			return staleBoundary("task inventory became incomplete before branch deletion")
620		}
621		if len(claims.taskClaims) > 0 {
622			return staleBoundary("a task claimed the checkout path or branch before branch deletion")
623		}
624		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
625		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
626		if fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID || fresh.baseOID != baseline.baseOID ||
627			fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.baseOIDErr != nil || fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
628			return staleBoundary("branch or containment-base authority changed before branch deletion")
629		}
630		worktrees, err := e.service.gitWorktrees(ctx, baseline.repoPath)
631		if err != nil {
632			return err
633		}
634		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
635			if worktree.Branch == baseline.locator.Branch {
636				return staleBoundary("branch acquired another checkout before deletion")
637			}
638		}
639		return nil
640	}
641	
642	func (e *executionState) verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
643		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
644		if err == nil {
645			return staleBoundary("exact unmanaged checkout remains registered after removal")
646		}
647		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
648			return fmt.Errorf("verify exact unmanaged checkout removal: %w", err)
649		}
650		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
651		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, "")
652		if !fresh.branchExists || fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID {
653			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("preserved local branch changed from %s to %s", baseline.branchOID, fresh.branchOID))
654		}
655		return nil
656	}

123	func (s *lifecycleService) locateRegisteredCheckout(
124		ctx context.Context,
125		candidate task.Task,
126		repoPath string,
127		expectedCheckout string,
128	) (gitx.RegisteredWorktree, bool) {
129		if expectedCheckout != "" {
130			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
131			return registered, err == nil
132		}
133		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree || candidate.State != task.Cold {
134			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
135		}
136	
137		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, repoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
140		}
141		match := ""
142		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
143			if worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch {
144				continue
145			}
146			if match != "" {
147				return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
148			}
149			match = worktree.Path
150		}
151		if match == "" {
152			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
153		}
154		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, match)
155		return registered, err == nil
156	}
157	
158	func (s *lifecycleService) branchUpstream(ctx context.Context, repoPath, branch string) string {
159		if branch == "" {
160			return ""
161		}
162		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath,
163			"for-each-ref", "--format=%(upstream:short)", localBranchRef(branch),
164		)
165		if err != nil {
166			return ""
167		}
168		return strings.TrimSpace(value)
169	}

32	func (s *lifecycleService) planRetire(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
33		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		if err := validateRetireLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
37			return PlanSpec{}, err
38		}
39		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
40		if err != nil {
41			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
42		}
43		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, *record); err != nil {
44			return PlanSpec{}, err
45		}
46		spec, _, err := s.observeRetire(ctx, request, *record, s.tasks.ListRecords)
47		if err != nil {
48			return PlanSpec{}, err
49		}
50		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
51		if err != nil {
52			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning retirement"}
53		}
54		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
55			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning retirement")
56		}
57		return spec, nil
58	}

562	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRetire(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
563		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
564			return Result{}, err
565		}
566		if approved.Action != Retire {
567			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "retire handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
568		}
569		if err := validateRetireLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
570			return Result{}, err
571		}
572		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
573		if err != nil {
574			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
575		}
576	
577		var result Result
578		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
579			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
580				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
581				if loadErr != nil {
582					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before retirement apply"}
583				}
584				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
585					return identityErr
586				}
587				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRetire(ctx, approved.Request, *record, tx.ListRecords)
588				if observeErr != nil {
589					return observeErr
590				}
591				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
592				if buildErr != nil {
593					return buildErr
594				}
595				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
596				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
597					actual := ""
598					if current != nil {
599						actual = current.Revision
600					}
601					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked retirement replan")
602				}
603				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
604					return &StalePlanError{
605						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
606						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
607						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
608						Reason:                       "fresh retirement task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or ref authority differs",
609					}
610				}
611				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
612					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
613					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh retirement conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
614				}
615	
616				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision}
617				result, observeErr = execution.executeRetire(ctx, *record, observed)
618				return observeErr
619			})
620		})

14	func newParkCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
15		var (
16			next            string
17			note            string
18			wip             bool
19			push            bool
20			cold            bool
21			keepRT          bool
22			closeUnknown    bool
23			assumeNoRuntime bool

25		)
26		cmd := &cobra.Command{
27			Use:   "park [task]",
28			Short: "Stop working on a task without losing the thread",
29			Long: `Park the current task (or the one named) so its runtime session can close.
30	
31	Parking is the missing move that makes a crowded sidebar shrink. It records
32	what to do next, optionally checkpoints uncommitted work, and closes the
33	runtime session — while leaving the branch and the worktree exactly where they
34	are. Closing a session is not abandoning a task.
35	
36	  warm (default)  worktree and branch stay; session closes. Back within days.
37	  cold (--cold)   work is committed and pushed, session closed, worktree
38	                  removed. Reconstruct it anywhere later with dev resume.
39	
40	--cold and --keep-session are incompatible: a runtime cannot stay pointed at a
41	checkout that cold parking removes.
42	
43	A checkpoint commit is preferred over git stash: a stash is invisible in the
44	log, easy to forget, and cannot be pushed — so it can never reach another
45	machine, which is exactly what parking needs to support.`,
46			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
47			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
48				ctx := ctxOf()
49				if cold && keepRT {
50					return fmt.Errorf("--cold and --keep-session cannot be combined: a session must not remain pointed at a removed checkout")
51				}
52	
53				var options taskflow.ActionOptions
54				if cold {
55					options = taskflow.ParkColdOptions{
56						Next: next, Note: note, CommitWIP: wip, Push: push,
57						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
58					}
59				} else {
60					options = taskflow.ParkWarmOptions{
61						Next: next, Note: note, CommitWIP: wip, Push: push, KeepSession: keepRT,
62						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
63					}
64				}
65				execution, err := executeTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
66					return resolveTask(app, args)
67				}, options)
68				if err != nil {
69					return err
70				}
71	
72				parked := &execution.Task
73				style := app.outStyle()
74				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s is %s", parked.State.Icon(), parked.Title(),
75					style.taskStateFor(string(parked.State), parked.State.Label()))
76				if parked.Next != "" {
77					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, " — %s %s", style.label("next:"), parked.Next)
78				}
79				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out)
80				return nil
81			},
82		}
83		f := cmd.Flags()
84		f.StringVarP(&next, "next", "n", "", "what to do when you come back")
85		f.StringVar(&note, "note", "", "free-form note")
86		f.BoolVar(&wip, "wip", false, "checkpoint uncommitted work as a wip: commit")
87		f.BoolVar(&push, "push", false, "push the branch so another machine can pick it up")

91		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails")

97	// resolveTask picks the task an argument names, or infers it from the current
98	// directory when no argument is given.
99	func resolveTask(app *App, args []string) (*task.Task, error) {
100		if len(args) == 1 {
101			return app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
102		}
103		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, err
106		}
107		t, err := app.Tasks.FindByWorktree(cwd)
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no task for %s — name one explicitly, or run this inside a task's checkout",
110				config.Contract(cwd))
111		}
112		return t, nil
113	}

27	identity.

30	machines writing the same branch is the one way to make this workflow produce
31	a conflict, so dev asks before doing it.`,

76					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s      %s\n", style.label("next"), resumed.Next)
77				}
78				if resumed.AgentSession != "" {
79					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s (resumable)\n", style.label("agent"), resumed.AgentSession)
80				}
81				if st, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout); statusErr == nil {
82					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s       %s\n", style.label("git"), style.git(st.Summary()))
83					if st.Behind > 0 {
84						app.warnf("branch is %d behind upstream — `git pull --ff-only` before you start", st.Behind)
85					}
86				}
87				if handoff.Kind == taskflow.HandoffDirectory {
88					return app.cdDirective(checkout)
89				}
90				return activateRuntime(ctx, activationRuntime, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
91			},
92		}

94		f.BoolVar(&noProvision, "no-provision", false, "skip dependency install when rebuilding a worktree")
95		f.BoolVar(&fetch, "fetch", true, "fetch from origin first")
96		f.BoolVar(&force, "force", false, "take ownership of a task owned by another machine")
97		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Warm, task.Cold)

17	type retireCommandTarget struct {

19		Path string
20	}

22	func newRetireCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
23		var (
24			closeUnknown    bool
25			assumeNoRuntime bool
26			deleteBranch    bool
27			timeout         time.Duration
28		)
29		cmd := &cobra.Command{
30			Use:   "retire [task-or-worktree]",
31			Short: "Close runtime state and safely remove an integrated worktree",
32			Long: `Retire local execution state after a change has been integrated.
33	
34	Run this from outside the target worktree and runtime. dev re-resolves every
35	covering session, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, waits for
36	runtime closure, revalidates Git state, and only then removes a linked worktree
37	without force. A task is deleted only after every requested cleanup step works.
38	
39	Unknown runtime status fails closed. An external coordinator may acknowledge it
40	with --close-unknown; working, blocked and waiting agents are never overridden.`,
41			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
42			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
43				ctx := ctxOf()
44				target, err := resolveRetireCommandTarget(ctx, app, args)
45				if err != nil {
46					return err
47				}
48				if target.Task != nil {
49					return retireTaskWithTaskflow(ctx, app, target.Task, flow.RetireOptions{
50						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime,
51						DeleteBranch: deleteBranch, Timeout: timeout,
52					}, cmd.Flags().Changed("delete-branch") && deleteBranch)
53				}
54				return retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility(ctx, app, target.Path, closeUnknown,
55					assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranch, timeout)
56			},
57		}
58		f := cmd.Flags()
59		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow an external caller to close unknown/empty runtime status")
60		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails (external callers only)")
61		f.BoolVar(&deleteBranch, "delete-branch", false, "delete the contained local branch after worktree removal")
62		f.DurationVar(&timeout, "timeout", 5*time.Second, "maximum time to wait for runtime sessions to close")
63		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Done)
64		return cmd
65	}
66	
67	func resolveRetireCommandTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (retireCommandTarget, error) {
68		if len(args) == 1 {
69			expanded := config.Expand(args[0])
70			if info, statErr := os.Stat(expanded); statErr == nil && info.IsDir() {
71				return retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx, app, expanded)
72			}
73			candidate, err := app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
74			if err != nil {
75				return retireCommandTarget{}, err
76			}
77			return retireCommandTarget{Task: candidate}, nil
78		}
79	
80		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
81		if err != nil {
82			return retireCommandTarget{}, err
83		}
84		return retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx, app, cwd)
85	}
86	
87	func retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx context.Context, app *App, path string) (retireCommandTarget, error) {
88		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
89		if err != nil {
90			return retireCommandTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
91		}
92		candidate, err := exactTaskForRetirementCheckout(app, repository.Root)
93		if err != nil {
94			return retireCommandTarget{}, err
95		}
96		if candidate != nil {
97			return retireCommandTarget{Task: candidate}, nil
98		}
99		return retireCommandTarget{Path: repository.Root}, nil
100	}
101	
102	func exactTaskForRetirementCheckout(app *App, checkout string) (*task.Task, error) {
103		canonicalCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize retirement checkout %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
106		}
107		records, _, err := app.Tasks.ListRecords()
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111		var matched *task.Task
112		for _, record := range records {
113			candidate := record.Task
114			if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == "" {
115				// A COLD/DONE worktree task with no checkout does not claim the
116				// canonical repository merely because checkoutOf falls back there.
117				continue
118			}
119			candidateCheckout, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(checkoutOf(&candidate))
120			if canonicalErr != nil || candidateCheckout != canonicalCheckout {
121				continue
122			}
123			if matched != nil {
124				return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkout %s is claimed by multiple tasks (%s, %s); name one explicitly or reconcile task metadata",
125					config.Contract(canonicalCheckout), matched.ID, candidate.ID)
126			}
127			matched = &candidate
128		}
129		return matched, nil
130	}
131	
132	func retireTaskWithTaskflow(
133		ctx context.Context,
134		app *App,
135		selected *task.Task,
136		options flow.RetireOptions,
137		authorizeBranchDeletion bool,
138	) error {
139		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) { return selected, nil })
140		if err != nil {
141			return err
142		}
143		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
144		if err != nil {
145			return err
146		}
147		approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
148		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
149			if !authorizeBranchDeletion {
150				return fmt.Errorf("%s requires its exact typed confirmation", plan.Summary)
151			}
152			approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
153		}
154		result, applyErr := session.apply(ctx, plan, approval)
155		if applyErr != nil {
156			renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
157			return presentLifecycleApplyError(plan, applyErr)
158		}
159		if err := session.requireRetired(app, result); err != nil {
160			return err
161		}
162	
163		style := app.outStyle()
164		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", style.success("RETIRED"), config.Contract(checkoutOf(selected)))
165		renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
166		return nil
167	}
168	
169	// retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility preserves the contained-only path contract
170	// while routing every mutation through taskflow's exact unmanaged transaction.
171	func retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility(
172		ctx context.Context,
173		app *App,
174		path string,
175		closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranch bool,
176		timeout time.Duration,
177	) error {
178		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
179		if err != nil {
180			return fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
181		}
182		if !repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
183			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a linked worktree; retire explicit paths only from their linked checkout", config.Contract(path))
184		}
185		locator, err := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, repository.Root)
186		if err != nil {
187			return err
188		}
189		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.MainRoot)
190		if base == "" {
191			return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove unmanaged retirement without an explicit repository default branch")
192		}
193		execution, err := executeNonTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
194			RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base, DeleteContainedBranch: deleteBranch,
195			CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
196		}, deleteBranch)
197		if err != nil {
198			return err
199		}
200		if execution.Result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneNone {
201			return fmt.Errorf("unmanaged retirement returned unexpected milestone %s", execution.Result.Milestone)
202		}
203		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", app.outStyle().success("RETIRED"), config.Contract(locator.CheckoutPath))
204		return nil
205	}
