444	// renderPlan prints a provisioning plan as a table plus its warnings.
445	func renderPlan(app *App, plan wt.Plan, repoPath string) {
446		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s\n\n", config.Contract(repoPath))
447	
448		if len(plan.Ecosystems) == 0 {
449			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No project type detected — only gitignored files will be carried over.")
450		} else {
451			t := app.newTable("PROJECT", "MANAGER", "FROM", "DEPENDENCIES", "TOOL")
452			style := app.outStyle()
453			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
454				deps := "—"
455				if len(e.DepDirs) > 0 {
456					deps = strings.Join(e.DepDirs, ", ")
457				} else {
458					deps = "global cache"
459				}
460				tool := "installed"
461				if !e.ToolInstalled() {
462					tool = style.danger("MISSING: " + e.Tool)
463				} else {
464					tool = style.success(tool)
465				}
466				t.Add(e.Name, e.Manager, e.Marker, deps, tool)
467			}
468			t.Render(app.Out)
469		}
470	
471		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out)
472		if len(plan.Steps) == 0 {
473			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Nothing to provision.")
474		} else {
475			st := app.newTable("", "ACTION", "WHAT", "WHY")
476			style := app.outStyle()
477			for _, s := range plan.Steps {
478				mark := "✓"
479				if s.Skipped {
480					mark = style.dim("·")
481				} else {
482					mark = style.success(mark)
483				}
484				st.Add(mark, string(s.Kind), truncate(s.What, 34), s.Why)
485			}
486			st.Render(app.Out)
487		}
488	
489		for _, w := range plan.Warnings {
490			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "\n%s %s\n", app.errStyle().warning("warning:"), w)
491		}
492		if plan.Empty() {
493			fmt.Fprintln(app.Err, "\nNothing would run. If a new worktree comes up broken, add what it needs to "+
494				"worktree.post_create, or commit .dev-cli/config.toml with `dev wt plan --write`.")
495		}
496	}
497	
498	// writeRepoTemplate seeds .dev-cli/config.toml from the detected plan.
499	//
500	// Committing it is what makes a project's worktree setup reproducible: the
501	// next machine, and the next person, get the same one without having to
502	// rediscover it.
503	func writeRepoTemplate(app *App, repoPath string, plan wt.Plan, set wt.Settings) error {
504		path, err := projectconfig.ConfigPath(repoPath)
505		if err != nil {
506			return err
507		}
508		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
509			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists — edit it directly", config.Contract(path))
510		}
511		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
512			return err
513		}
514	
515		var b strings.Builder
516		b.WriteString("# dev project configuration (versioned with this repository).\n")
517		b.WriteString("version = 1\n\n")
518		b.WriteString("#\n")
519		b.WriteString("# Committed on purpose: a worktree is a clean checkout, so without this a\n")
520		b.WriteString("# new one comes up with no dependencies and none of the gitignored files the\n")
521		b.WriteString("# project needs. Seeded by `dev wt plan --write`; edit freely.\n\n")
522		b.WriteString("[worktree]\n")
523	
524		b.WriteString("# Gitignored files to carry into a new worktree. Only files that are BOTH\n")
525		b.WriteString("# listed here AND gitignored are copied — a tracked file is already in the\n")
526		b.WriteString("# checkout on the correct branch.\n")
527		b.WriteString("include = [")
528		for i, inc := range set.Include {
529			if i > 0 {
530				b.WriteString(", ")
531			}
532			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%q", inc)
533		}
534		b.WriteString("]\n\n")
535	
536		if len(plan.Ecosystems) > 0 {
537			b.WriteString("# Detected in this repository:\n")
538			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
539				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "#   %-8s %-8s (%s) → %s\n", e.Name, e.Manager, e.Marker, e.Install)
540			}
541			b.WriteString("#\n")
542			b.WriteString("# \"auto\" runs those install commands. Replace with an explicit list if this\n")
543			b.WriteString("# project needs something else:  post_create = [\"make bootstrap\"]\n")
544			b.WriteString("post_create = \"auto\"\n\n")
545	
546			b.WriteString("# How each project type gets its dependencies:\n")
547			b.WriteString("#   reinstall  run the install command (correct, the default)\n")
548			b.WriteString("#   copy       duplicate the directory from the source checkout (fast)\n")
549			b.WriteString("#   link       share one directory between checkouts (fastest, risky)\n")
550			b.WriteString("#   skip       leave the worktree without dependencies\n")
551			b.WriteString("[worktree.strategies]\n")
552			for _, e := range plan.Ecosystems {
553				switch {
554				case len(e.DepDirs) == 0:
555					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# %-8s = \"reinstall\"  # %s uses a global cache; nothing to copy\n",
556						e.Name, e.Manager)
557				case e.CopySafe:
558					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%-10s = \"reinstall\"  # \"copy\" is sound here and much faster\n", e.Name)
559				default:
560					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%-10s = \"reinstall\"  # copy/link unsupported: %s\n", e.Name, e.Hazard)
561				}
562			}
563		} else {
564			b.WriteString("# No project type detected. Add the commands a fresh checkout needs:\n")
565			b.WriteString("# post_create = [\"make bootstrap\"]\n")
566			b.WriteString("post_create = \"auto\"\n")
567		}
568	
569		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(b.String()), 0o644); err != nil {
570			return err
571		}
572		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "wrote %s\n", config.Contract(path))
573		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Commit it so every machine provisions worktrees the same way.")
574		return nil
575	}

13	func guardSharedCheckout(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout string) error {
14		if app.allowSharedCheckout {
15			return nil
16		}
17		reportedPane := ""
18		if rt != nil {
19			switch rt.Name() {
20			case "herdr":
21				reportedPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
22			case "tmux":
23				reportedPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
24			}
25		}
26		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
27			Profile:      runtime.OccupancyStrict,
28			CallerPaneID: reportedPane,
29		})
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("check live occupancy before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
32		}
33		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
34			return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
35		}
36		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("classify live runtime coverage before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionCoverageErr)
38		}
39		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("list live runtime sessions before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionList.Err)
41		}
42		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
44		}
45	
46		var occupied []string
47		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
48			if !agent.Blocking {
49				continue
50			}
51			activity := agent.Activity
52			label := activity.Agent
53			if activity.Name != "" {
54				label = activity.Name
55			}
56			if label == "" {
57				label = "agent"
58			}
59			occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, activity.PaneID))
60		}
61		if len(occupied) == 0 {
62			return nil
63		}
64		return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
65			config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
66	}

68	// checkoutAgentActivities returns recognized agents whose reported cwd resolves
69	// to the same canonical Git worktree root as checkout. A pane is excluded only
70	// when its exact ID matches excludePane; lifecycle state never makes it free.
71	func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {
72		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{Profile: runtime.OccupancyStrict})
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
77			return nil, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err
78		}
79		out := make([]runtime.AgentActivity, 0, len(evidence.Agents))
80		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
81			if excludePane == "" || agent.Activity.PaneID != excludePane {
82				out = append(out, agent.Activity)
83			}
84		}
85		return out, nil
86	}

625		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RetireOptions)
626		candidate := record.Task
627		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()

631		deletedBranch := false

638					return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before closing any runtime")
639				}

188		case !observed.occupancy.SessionList.Observed():
189			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime sessions were not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
190		case !observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed():
191			return task.Warm, "", "", "recognized-agent activity was not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
192		case len(observed.occupancy.Sessions) != 1:
193			return task.Warm, "", "", fmt.Sprintf("fresh runtime coverage contains %d sessions, not exactly one; adoption remains WARM", len(observed.occupancy.Sessions))
194		case len(observed.occupancy.Agents) != 0:
195			return task.Warm, "", "", "a recognized agent occupies the checkout; adoption remains WARM"
196		}
197	
198		session := observed.occupancy.Sessions[0]
199		handle := session.Runtime.Handle
200		if strings.TrimSpace(handle) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(handle) != handle || strings.ContainsRune(handle, '\x00') {
201			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session has no stable nonempty handle; adoption remains WARM"
202		}
203		if !adoptSessionShellOnly(session) {
204			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session is not shell-only; adoption remains WARM"
205		}
206		return task.Hot, rt.Name(), handle, "exactly one freshly observed shell-only runtime session covers the checkout with stable handle " + handle
207	}
208	
209	func adoptStrictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
210		if occupancyErr := strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err); occupancyErr != nil {
211			return occupancyErr
212		}
213		var blockers []string
214		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
215			// OccupancySession.Panes contains only panes whose live cwd covers the
216			// checkout. A mixed session may also host an unrelated agent elsewhere;
217			// that agent is not a writer claim on this checkout.
218			for _, pane := range session.Panes {
219				if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) == "" && strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) == "" {
220					continue
221				}
222				if occupancy.CallerPaneID != "" && pane.ID == occupancy.CallerPaneID {
223					continue
224				}
225				status := strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus)
226				if status == "" {
227					status = "unknown"
228				}
229				blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent pane %s (%s)", pane.ID, status))
230			}
231		}
232		if len(blockers) > 0 {
233			return fmt.Errorf("checkout is occupied by %s", strings.Join(blockers, ", "))
234		}
235		return nil
236	}
237	
238	func adoptSessionShellOnly(session runtime.OccupancySession) bool {
239		if strings.TrimSpace(session.Runtime.AgentStatus) != "" || len(session.Runtime.AgentSessions) != 0 {
240			return false
241		}
242		panes := session.Runtime.Panes
243		if len(panes) == 0 {
244			panes = session.Panes
245		}
246		for _, pane := range panes {
247			if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) != "" {
248				return false
249			}
250		}
251		return true
252	}

257		conditions = append(conditions, adoptBaseCondition(observed))

259		conditions = append(conditions, adoptRuntimeConditions(observed)...)
260		conditions = append(conditions, adoptStateCondition(request.Options.(AdoptOptions), observed))
261		conditions = append(conditions, condition(

263			"adoption assigns checkout ownership to host "+s.host, "",
264		))
265	
266		details := map[string]string{
267			"id": observed.taskID, "repo": observed.candidate.Repo,
268			"repo-path": observed.candidate.RepoPath, "checkout": observed.candidate.WorktreePath,
269			"branch": observed.candidate.Branch, "head": observed.locator.HeadOID,
270			"base": observed.candidate.Base, "base-oid": observed.baseOID,
271			"mode": string(observed.candidate.Mode), "state": string(observed.candidate.State),
272			"owner": observed.candidate.Owner, "runtime": observed.candidate.RuntimeName,
273			"runtime-handle": observed.candidate.RuntimeHandle,
274		}
275		effect := NewEffect(
276			EffectCreateTask, "create one task record for the exact unmanaged linked checkout",
277			observed.taskID, false, false, details,
278		)
279		retained := []string{
280			"checkout:" + observed.checkout,
281			"branch:" + observed.locator.Branch + "@" + observed.branchOID,
282		}
283		if observed.derivedState == task.Hot {
284			retained = append(retained, "runtime:"+observed.runtimeName+":"+observed.runtimeHandle)
285		}
286		return PlanSpec{
287			Authority:         adoptAuthority(observed),
288			Conditions:        conditions,

290			RetainedResources: retained,
291			Confirmation: Confirmation{

293				Prompt: "Adopt this exact unmanaged checkout as a " + strings.ToUpper(string(observed.derivedState)) + " worktree task?",
294			},
295			FallbackCommand: "dev adopt --apply --state " + shellQuote(string(observed.derivedState)),
296			Summary:         "Adopt unmanaged checkout " + observed.checkout,
297			DisplayedAt:     s.now(),
298		}

329	func adoptIdentityConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
330		if !observed.worktreeFound {
331			verdict := VerdictBlocked
332			evidence := "the exact checkout is not registered"
333			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !errors.Is(observed.worktreeErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
334				verdict = VerdictError
335				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
336			}
337			return []Condition{
338				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "refresh exact worktree topology"),
339				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout identity is unavailable", "refresh exact worktree topology"),
340				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unavailable", "select a registered linked checkout"),
341				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree flags are unavailable", "refresh exact worktree topology"),
342				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "branch identity is unavailable", "select a named non-detached checkout"),
343				condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "local branch ref is unavailable", "restore the exact local branch"),
344				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git status is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
345				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git operation state is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
346				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory, "checkout bytes were not inspected", "refresh the exact checkout"),
347				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "harness ownership is unavailable", "refresh the exact checkout path"),
348			}
349		}
350	
351		exactVerdict := VerdictMet
352		exactEvidence := "selected path, repository, Git common directory, registry HEAD, and live HEAD are exact"
353		switch {
354		case observed.worktreesErr != nil:
355			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.worktreesErr.Error()
356		case observed.worktree.Path != observed.checkout:
357			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered path differs from selected checkout"
358		case observed.worktree.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir:
359			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered repository identity differs from selected repository"
360		case observed.headErr != nil:
361			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
362		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head:
363			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
364		case observed.locator.HeadOID != observed.head:
365			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("selected HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
366		}
367	
368		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
369		kindEvidence := "registered non-main, non-bare linked worktree"
370		if !observed.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree() {
371			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
372			kindEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("main=%t bare=%t; canonical and bare records are never adoptable", observed.worktree.Worktree.Main, observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare)
373		}
374	
375		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
376		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and non-prunable"
377		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked || observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable {
378			flagVerdict = VerdictBlocked
379			flagEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("locked=%t prunable=%t", observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked, observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable)
380		}
381	
382		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
383		branchEvidence := "registry and status identify named branch " + observed.locator.Branch
384		switch {
385		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch == "":
386			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered worktree is detached or unnamed"
387		case observed.statusErr != nil:
388			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
389		case observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.locator.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.locator.Branch:
390			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q selected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.locator.Branch)
391		}
392	
393		branchRefVerdict := VerdictMet
394		branchRefEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("local %s is exactly selected HEAD %s", observed.branchRef, observed.locator.HeadOID)
395		switch {
396		case !observed.branchExists:
397			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "exact local branch ref does not exist"
398		case observed.branchOIDErr != nil:
399			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictError, observed.branchOIDErr.Error()
400		case observed.branchOID != observed.locator.HeadOID || observed.branchOID != observed.head:
401			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("branch OID=%q selected HEAD=%q live HEAD=%q", observed.branchOID, observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
402		}
403	
404		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
405		statusEvidence := observed.status.Summary()
406		if observed.statusErr != nil {
407			statusVerdict, statusEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
408		}
409		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
410		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
411		if observed.operationErr != nil {
412			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictError, observed.operationErr.Error()
413		} else if observed.inProgress {
414			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "Git operation "+observed.operation+" is in progress"
415		}
416		cleanVerdict := VerdictMet
417		cleanEvidence := "checkout is clean; adoption writes metadata only"
418		if observed.statusErr != nil {
419			cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictUnknown, "checkout cleanliness is unavailable; required Git status already blocks adoption"
420		} else if observed.status.Dirty() {
421			cleanEvidence = observed.status.Breakdown() + "; dirty bytes are allowed and remain untouched"
422		}
423	
424		harnessVerdict := VerdictMet
425		harnessEvidence := "no strict harness path evidence"
426		if observed.isHarness {
427			harnessVerdict = VerdictBlocked
428			harnessEvidence = "checkout is strictly under harness root " + observed.harness.Root
429		}
430		return []Condition{
431			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
432			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "refresh the exact checkout locator"),
433			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "select a non-main linked checkout"),
434			condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, flagVerdict, RequirementRequired, flagEvidence, "unlock or repair the registration; pruning is never implicit"),
435			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named non-detached checkout"),
436			condition(ConditionBranchRef, branchRefVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchRefEvidence, "restore the exact local branch ref at selected HEAD"),
437			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
438			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
439			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementAdvisory, cleanEvidence, "commit later if desired; adoption never changes checkout bytes"),
440			condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, harnessVerdict, RequirementRequired, harnessEvidence, "let the harness own its checkout"),
441		}
442	}

444	func adoptBaseCondition(observed adoptObservation) Condition {
445		switch {
446		case observed.base == "":
447			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
448				"no explicit base was supplied and the repository default is unavailable", "supply an existing base ref")
449		case !observed.baseExists:
450			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
451				"base ref "+observed.base+" does not exist", "restore or select an existing base ref")
452		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
453			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
454				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair exact base-ref observation")
455		case observed.baseOID == "":
456			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
457				"base resolved to no commit", "restore the named base ref")
458		default:
459			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
460				fmt.Sprintf("base %s is exactly %s", observed.base, observed.baseOID), "")
461		}
462	}

464	func adoptTaskInventoryConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
465		inventoryCondition := condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
466			"task inventory is complete, including a successful empty inventory", "")
467		switch {
468		case observed.taskInventoryErr != nil:
469			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
470				observed.taskInventoryErr.Error(), "repair task-store inventory before proving unmanaged ownership")
471		case len(observed.taskIncomplete) > 0:
472			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
473				strings.Join(observed.taskIncomplete, "; "), "repair every corrupt or unresolvable task record")
474		}
475		claimsCondition := condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
476			"no task claims the exact checkout path, repository branch, or derived task ID", "")
477		if len(observed.taskClaims) > 0 {
478			claims := make([]string, len(observed.taskClaims))
479			for index, claim := range observed.taskClaims {
480				claims[index] = claim.ID + " (" + claim.Reason + ")"
481			}
482			claimsCondition = condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
483				"claimed by "+strings.Join(claims, ", "), "use managed lifecycle or resolve every task claim")
484		}
485		return []Condition{inventoryCondition, claimsCondition}
486	}

488	func adoptRuntimeConditions(observed adoptObservation) []Condition {
489		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
490			return []Condition{
491				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
492					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
493				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
494					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime session and recognized-agent observation"),
495			}
496		}
497		if observed.runtime == nil || observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
498			return []Condition{
499				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
500					"runtime none performs no session operation", ""),
501				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory,
502					"runtime none leaves session and recognized-agent occupancy unobserved; metadata-only adoption is retained as WARM", "inspect occupancy with a capable runtime if HOT metadata is required"),
503			}
504		}
505	
506		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
507		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is available for fresh strict inspection"
508		if !observed.runtimeAvailable {
509			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
510			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
511		}
512		occupancyVerdict := VerdictUnknown
513		occupancyEvidence := "exact checkout was unavailable for strict occupancy inspection"
514		if observed.worktreeFound {
515			occupancyErr := adoptStrictOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr)
516			if occupancyErr == nil {
517				occupancyVerdict = VerdictMet
518				occupancyEvidence = "no recognized agent other than the exact caller occupies the checkout"
519				if !observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed() {
520					occupancyEvidence += "; recognized-agent absence was not strong enough to derive HOT"
521				}
522			} else {
523				occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
524				occupancyEvidence = occupancyErr.Error()
525				if observed.occupancyErr != nil || observed.occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil ||
526					observed.occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil || observed.occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil ||
527					observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
528					occupancyVerdict = VerdictError
529				}
530			}
531		}
532		return []Condition{
533			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired,
534				availableEvidence, "select or restore an available runtime backend"),
535			condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired,
536				occupancyEvidence, "stop every other recognized agent or use another checkout"),
537		}

540	func adoptStateCondition(options AdoptOptions, observed adoptObservation) Condition {
541		evidence := fmt.Sprintf("derived %s: %s", strings.ToUpper(string(observed.derivedState)), observed.stateEvidence)
542		if options.State != "" && options.State != observed.derivedState {
543			return condition(ConditionAdoptState, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,

553	func (s *lifecycleService) applyAdopt(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
554		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
555			return Result{}, err
556		}
557		if approved.Action != Adopt {
558			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "adopt handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
559		}
560		if err := validateAdoptLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
561			return Result{}, err
562		}
563		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
564		if err != nil {
565			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
566		}
567	
568		var result Result
569		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
570			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
571				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeAdopt(ctx, approved.Request, tx.ListRecords)
572				if observeErr != nil {
573					return observeErr
574				}
575				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
576				if buildErr != nil {
577					return buildErr
578				}
579				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
580					return &StalePlanError{
581						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
582						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
583						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
584						Reason:                       "fresh unmanaged Git, worktree, task, base, runtime, agent, or harness authority differs",
585					}
586				}
587				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
588					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
589					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh adoption conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
590				}
591				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx}
592				result, observeErr = execution.executeAdopt(observed)
593				return observeErr
594			})
595		})
596		return result, err
597	}
598	
599	func (e *executionState) executeAdopt(observed adoptObservation) (Result, error) {
600		effects := e.plan.Effects()
601		if len(effects) != 1 || effects[0].Code != EffectCreateTask {
602			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "Adopt must contain exactly one create-task effect"})
603		}
604		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
605			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "runtime none left occupancy unobserved; the adopted task is WARM")
606		}
607	
608		effect := effects[0]
609		expected := observed.candidate
610		expected.Tags = append([]string(nil), observed.candidate.Tags...)
611		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
612			candidate := expected
613			candidate.Tags = append([]string(nil), expected.Tags...)
614			created, createErr := e.service.taskCreate(e.tx, &candidate)
615			if createErr != nil {
616				return "task create made no authorized non-task change", fmt.Errorf("create adopted task %s: %w", expected.ID, createErr)
617			}
618			if created == nil || created.Revision == "" {
619				return "task create returned no revision", errors.New("create adopted task returned no revision")
620			}
621			if adoptTaskAuthority(created.Task) != adoptTaskAuthority(expected) {
622				return "task create returned different metadata", errors.New("created task does not match the approved adoption metadata")
623			}
624			persisted, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(expected.ID)
625			if verifyErr != nil {
626				return "task create was not verified", fmt.Errorf("verify created adopted task %s: %w", expected.ID, verifyErr)
627			}
628			if persisted.Revision != created.Revision || adoptTaskAuthority(persisted.Task) != adoptTaskAuthority(expected) {
629				return "task create revision or metadata was not verified", errors.New("persisted adopted task differs from the task create result")
630			}
631			e.snapshot = "task:" + persisted.Revision
632			e.milestone = MilestoneAdopted
633			return "created task " + persisted.Task.ID + " at revision " + persisted.Revision, nil
634		})
635		if err != nil {
636			return e.fail(err, "the checkout, branch, runtime, and Git bytes were not changed; repair the task-store failure and refresh adoption")
637		}
638		if e.milestone != MilestoneAdopted || e.snapshot == "" {
639			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "adoption ended without a created task revision"})
640		}
641		return e.result(), nil
642	}

package cli

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
)

func guardSharedCheckout(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout string) error {
	if app.allowSharedCheckout {
		return nil
	}
	excludePane, err := callerPaneID(ctx, rt)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
	}
	activities, err := checkoutAgentActivities(ctx, rt, checkout, excludePane)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
	}
	if len(activities) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	var occupied []string
	for _, activity := range activities {
		label := activity.Agent
		if activity.Name != "" {
			label = activity.Name
		}
		if label == "" {
			label = "agent"
		}
		state := activity.Status
		if state == "" {
			state = "unknown"
		}
		occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, state, activity.PaneID))
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
		config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
}

func callerPaneID(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime) (string, error) {
	inherited := os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
	if inherited == "" {
		return "", nil
	}
	if resolver, ok := rt.(runtime.CurrentPaneResolver); ok {
		return resolver.CurrentPaneID(ctx)
	}
	return inherited, nil
}

// checkoutAgentActivities returns recognized agents whose reported cwd resolves
// to the same canonical Git worktree root as checkout. A pane is excluded only
// when its exact ID matches excludePane; lifecycle state never makes it free.
func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {
	lister, ok := rt.(runtime.AgentActivityLister)
	if !ok {
		return nil, nil
	}
	target, ok := canonicalWorktreeRoot(ctx, checkout)
	if !ok {
		return nil, nil
	}
	activities, err := lister.AgentActivities(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := make([]runtime.AgentActivity, 0, len(activities))
	for _, activity := range activities {
		if excludePane != "" && activity.PaneID == excludePane {
			continue
		}
		root, ok := canonicalWorktreeRoot(ctx, activity.CWD)
		if ok && root == target {
			out = append(out, activity)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

func canonicalWorktreeRoot(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, bool) {
	if dir == "" {
		return "", false
	}
	repo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, dir)
	if err != nil || repo.Root == "" {
		return "", false
	}
	root := filepath.Clean(repo.Root)
	if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(root); err == nil {
		root = filepath.Clean(resolved)
	}
	return root, true
}

148	func suggestFor(app *App, ctx context.Context, r inventory.Row, stale time.Duration, retireOptions sweepRetireOptions) []suggestion {
149		t := r.Task
150		var out []suggestion
151		current, currentErr := app.Tasks.GetRecord(t.ID)
152		if currentErr != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(current.Task, *t) {
153			detail := "task changed after the sweep inventory snapshot"
154			if currentErr != nil {
155				detail = "task could not be reloaded after the sweep inventory snapshot: " + currentErr.Error()
156			}
157			return []suggestion{{
158				row: r, reason: detail,
159				action: "rerun sweep to inspect the current task revision — not changed automatically",
160			}}
161		}
162		revision := current.Revision
163	
164		// A task whose repository is gone cannot be finished, resumed, parked or
165		// retired: every one of those resolves the repository first, and `dev done`
166		// refuses outright once the checkout is missing. Nothing else in this
167		// function reaches it either — the dead-branch rule below excludes direct
168		// mode, and the stale-worktree rule needs a recorded worktree path. Left
169		// alone, the record is unreachable by any command in the binary.
170		//
171		// Reaping removes dev's record of intent and nothing else; the branch, the
172		// commits and the remote are untouched. A live session proves the directory
173		// is there, so it is the one condition that rules this out.
174		if t.RepoPath != "" && !r.Live() && !dirExists(t.RepoPath) {
175			out = append(out, suggestion{
176				row:    r,
177				reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository %s no longer exists", config.Contract(t.RepoPath)),
178				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s (Git keeps any work; this drops only dev's record)", t.ID),
179				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
180			})
181			return out
182		}
183	
184		out = append(out, orphanSuggestions(app, r)...)
185	
186		switch {
187		// A hot task with no live session is the commonest drift: the session was
188		// closed (or the machine rebooted) without parking.
189		case t.State == task.Hot && r.StateDrift() == "no live session":
190			reason := fmt.Sprintf("hot but no live session, idle %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
191			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkWarmOptions{})
192			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
193				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded warm parking is blocked",
194					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})
195				break
196			}
197			out = append(out, suggestion{
198				row: r, reason: reason, action: fmt.Sprintf("mark %s warm", t.ID),
199				apply: func() error {
200					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
201					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
202					return err
203				},
204			})
205	
206		// A warm task nobody has touched in weeks is a candidate for cold: keeping
207		// the worktree costs disk and clutters every listing.
208		case t.State == task.Warm && r.Age() > stale:
209			reason := fmt.Sprintf("warm and untouched for %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
210			if t.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
211				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but direct tasks cannot go cold",
212					action: "keep it warm or finish it — not changed automatically"})
213				break
214			}
215			if r.Status.Dirty() {
216				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but has uncommitted work",
217					action: "commit or `dev park --wip` before going cold — not changed automatically"})
218				break
219			}
220			if !r.Status.Synced() {
221				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + fmt.Sprintf(", not pushed (%s)", r.Status.Summary()),
222					action: fmt.Sprintf("push %s so it can go cold: dev park %s --cold --push", t.Branch, t.ID)})
223				break
224			}
225			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkColdOptions{})
226			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
227				detail := sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)
228				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded cold parking is blocked",
229					action: detail + " — not changed automatically"})
230				break
231			}
232			out = append(out, suggestion{
233				row:    r,
234				reason: reason + ", clean and pushed",
235				action: fmt.Sprintf("go cold: remove %s (branch and remote keep the work)", config.Contract(r.Checkout)),
236				apply: func() error {
237					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
238					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
239					return err
240				},
241			})
242	
243		// DONE means integrated; runtime/worktree cleanup is a separate,
244		// externally coordinated retirement step.
245		case t.State == task.Done:
246			action := fmt.Sprintf("retire runtime/worktree for %s", t.ID)
247			if retireOptions.deleteBranches && t.Branch != "" && t.Branch != t.Base {
248				action += fmt.Sprintf(" and delete %s", t.Branch)
249			}
250			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.RetireOptions{
251				CloseUnknown: retireOptions.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: retireOptions.assumeNoRuntime,
252				DeleteBranch: retireOptions.deleteBranches,
253			})
254			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
255				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: "merged, but guarded retirement is blocked",
256					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})
257				break
258			}
259			out = append(out, suggestion{
260				row: r, reason: "merged, cleanup pending", action: action,
261				apply: func() error {
262					approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
263					if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
264						approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
265					}
266					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, approval)
267					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
268					return err
269				},
270			})
271		}
272	
273		// A branch-backed task whose branch git no longer has is dead: the branch
274		// was deleted after integration, so the record holds intent for work that
275		// no longer exists anywhere. It cannot be finished, resumed, or retired,
276		// because every one of those paths resolves the branch first.
277		noCheckout := t.WorktreePath == "" || r.WorktreeMissing
278		if noCheckout && t.Branch != "" && t.RepoPath != "" &&
279			t.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeDirect && !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, t.RepoPath, t.Branch) {
280			out = append(out, suggestion{
281				row:    r,
282				reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch %s no longer exists", t.Branch),
283				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s", t.ID),
284				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
285			})
286			return out
287		}
288	
289		// A cold task keeps no checkout by definition: that is what going cold
290		// means. One still on disk is drift inventory already reports and nothing
291		// could act on.
292		if t.State == task.Cold && t.WorktreePath != "" && r.CheckoutExists && !r.WorktreeMissing &&
293			!r.Live() && !r.Status.Dirty() && r.Status.Synced() {
294			out = append(out, suggestion{
295				row:    r,
296				reason: "cold, but its worktree is still on disk",
297				action: fmt.Sprintf("reconcile %s with an exact guarded plan — not changed automatically", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
298			})
299		}
300	
301		// Drift that is independent of the lifecycle stage.
302		if r.WorktreeMissing && t.WorktreePath != "" {
303			wtPath := t.WorktreePath
304			out = append(out, suggestion{
305				row:    r,
306				reason: "records a worktree that git no longer knows about",
307				action: fmt.Sprintf("inspect repository-wide prune scope before clearing %s — not changed automatically", config.Contract(wtPath)),
308			})
309		}
310		return out
311	}

313	func sweepTaskPlan(ctx context.Context, app *App, id string, options flow.ActionOptions) (lifecycleSession, flow.Plan, error) {
314		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
315			return app.Tasks.Get(id)
316		})
317		if err != nil {
318			return lifecycleSession{}, flow.Plan{}, err
319		}
320		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
321		return session, plan, err
322	}
323	
324	func sweepPlanBlocker(plan flow.Plan, err error) string {
325		if err != nil {
326			return err.Error()
327		}
328		var parts []string
329		for _, condition := range append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...) {
330			parts = append(parts, string(condition.Code)+": "+condition.Evidence)
331		}
332		if len(parts) == 0 {
333			return "guarded plan is " + string(plan.Availability)
334		}
335		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
336	}
337	
338	func sweepDeleteTask(ctx context.Context, store *task.Store, id, revision string) error {
339		if revision == "" {
340			return fmt.Errorf("task %s had no report-time revision; rerun sweep", id)
341		}
342		return store.DeleteIfRevision(ctx, id, revision)
343	}

345	// dirExists reports whether path is a directory that can be read right now.
346	func dirExists(path string) bool {
347		info, err := os.Stat(path)
348		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
349	}

351	// orphanSuggestions handles the residue of a worktree removed while its
352	// transcript writer was still running: the path exists, Git has no record of
353	// it, and it holds only agent artifacts. Removing it is offered only once every
354	// file in it is proven byte-identical to one the repository already has.
355	func orphanSuggestions(app *App, r inventory.Row) []suggestion {
356		t := r.Task
357		if t.WorktreePath == "" || !r.WorktreeMissing || !r.CheckoutExists {
358			return nil
359		}
360		orphan, ok, err := retirement.InspectOrphan(t.WorktreePath)
361		if err != nil || !ok {
362			return nil
363		}
364		unsalvaged, err := retirement.Unsalvaged(orphan, t.RepoPath)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil
367		}
368		if len(unsalvaged) > 0 {
369			return []suggestion{{
370				row: r,
371				reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace holding %d file(s) the repository does not have",
372					config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(unsalvaged)),
373				action: fmt.Sprintf("salvage %s first — not removed automatically", strings.Join(unsalvaged, ", ")),
374			}}
375		}
376		return []suggestion{{
377			row:    r,
378			reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace git does not know", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
379			action: fmt.Sprintf("remove the empty shell %s (its %d artifact file(s) are already in the repository)",
380				config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(orphan.Files)),
381			apply: func() error { return os.RemoveAll(t.WorktreePath) },
382		}}
383	}

385	func suggestMergedWorktrees(app *App, ctx context.Context, rows []inventory.Row, requestedBase string, options sweepRetireOptions) ([]suggestion, error) {
386		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, mustGetwd())
387		if err != nil {
388			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees requires a Git repository: %w", err)
389		}
390		if repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
391			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees must run from the canonical checkout, not linked worktree %s", config.Contract(repository.Root))
392		}
393		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, err
396		}
397		base := requestedBase
398		if base == "" {
399			base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.Root)
400			if status.Branch != base {
401				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees defaults to %s; switch the canonical checkout to it or pass --base explicitly", base)
402			}
403		}
404		if !gitx.RefExists(ctx, repository.Root, base) {
405			return nil, fmt.Errorf("merged-worktree base %s does not resolve to a commit", base)
406		}
407	
408		claimed := make(map[string]inventory.Row)
409		for _, row := range rows {
410			if row.Task == nil || row.Checkout == "" {
411				continue
412			}
413			canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(row.Checkout)
414			if canonicalErr == nil {
415				claimed[canonical] = row
416			}
417		}
418		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, repository.Root)
419		if err != nil {
420			return nil, err
421		}
422		var suggestions []suggestion
423		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
424			if worktree.Main || worktree.Bare || worktree.Detached || worktree.Branch == "" || worktree.Branch == base {
425				continue
426			}
427			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", worktree.Branch, base); err != nil {
428				continue
429			}
430			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
431			if err != nil {
432				continue
433			}
434			if row, ok := claimed[canonical]; ok {
435				if row.Task.State == task.Done {
436					suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestFor(app, ctx, row, 0, options)...)
437					continue
438				}
439				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
440					fmt.Sprintf("task is %s; verify integration with `dev done --merged` first", row.Task.State)))
441				continue
442			}
443	
444			displayTask := &task.Task{
445				ID: task.MakeID(repository.Name, worktree.Branch), Name: worktree.Branch,
446				Repo: repository.Name, RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, Branch: worktree.Branch,
447				Base: base, WorktreePath: canonical, Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done,
448			}
449			row := inventory.Row{Task: displayTask, Checkout: canonical, CheckoutExists: true}
450			if inventory.IsClaudeHarnessWorktree(repository.Root, canonical) {
451				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
452					"checkout is owned by the Claude harness"))
453				continue
454			}
455			locator, locateErr := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, canonical)
456			if locateErr != nil {
457				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, locateErr.Error()))
458				continue
459			}
460			service, serviceErr := newCLILifecycleService(app)
461			if serviceErr != nil {
462				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, serviceErr.Error()))
463				continue
464			}
465			request, requestErr := flow.NewRequest(locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
466				RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base,
467				DeleteContainedBranch: options.deleteBranches,
468				CloseUnknown:          options.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.assumeNoRuntime,
469			})
470			if requestErr != nil {
471				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, requestErr.Error()))
472				continue
473			}
474			plan, planErr := service.Plan(ctx, request)
475			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
476				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)))
477				continue
478			}
479			branch := worktree.Branch
480			action := fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s (branch %s kept)",
481				config.Contract(canonical), branch)
482			if options.deleteBranches {
483				action = fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s and delete contained branch %s",
484					config.Contract(canonical), branch)
485			}
486			suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestion{
487				row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("untracked worktree branch is contained in %s", base), action: action,
488				apply: func() error {
489					approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
490					if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
491						approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
492					}
493					result, err := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
494					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
495					return err
496				},
497			})
498		}
499		return suggestions, nil
500	}
501	
502	func mergedWorktreeBlocker(row inventory.Row, base, blocker string) suggestion {
503		return suggestion{
504			row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch is contained in %s, but retirement is blocked", base),
505			action: blocker + " — not changed automatically",
506		}
507	}

509	func confirm(app *App, in *bufio.Reader, action string) bool {
510		s := app.outStyle()
511		prompt := s.prompt(action + "?")
512		lower := strings.ToLower(action)
513		if strings.Contains(lower, "delete") || strings.Contains(lower, "remove") ||
514			strings.Contains(lower, "discard") || strings.Contains(lower, "drop") {
515			prompt = s.danger(action + "?")
516		}
517		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s ", prompt, s.dim("[y/N]"))
518		line, err := in.ReadString('\n')
519		if err != nil {
520			return false
521		}
522		answer := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
523		return answer == "y" || answer == "yes"
524	}

1	// Package runtime abstracts the terminal multiplexer that hosts a checkout.
2	//
3	// dev deliberately owns no terminal state of its own. A runtime is where a
4	// task is *live*; the durable facts live in git and in the task registry. That
5	// separation is the whole point: closing a runtime session must never feel
6	// like abandoning a task, so every adapter here is expected to be lossy and
7	// re-derivable.
8	package runtime
9	
10	import (
11		"context"
12		"fmt"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16	
17		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
18	)
19	
20	// Pane is one terminal surface inside a runtime session.
21	type Pane struct {
22		ID           string
23		CWD          string
24		ShellCWD     string
25		Agent        string
26		AgentStatus  string
27		AgentSession string
28	}
29	
30	// Session is one live workspace/session of a runtime backend.
31	type Session struct {
32		// Handle is the backend's own identifier (a herdr workspace id, a tmux
33		// session name). Opaque to the rest of dev.
34		Handle string
35		Label  string
36		// Dirs lists the working directories observed in this session. A session
37		// can span several (multiple panes), which is why this is not a single
38		// value.
39		Dirs []string
40		// AgentStatus is the backend's view of agent activity, when it has one:
41		// "working", "idle", "done", "waiting". Empty when unsupported.
42		AgentStatus string
43		// AgentSessions lists resumable agent context ids, e.g. "claude:<uuid>".
44		AgentSessions []string
45		// Panes retain the exact runtime IDs and cwd values used for caller and
46		// mixed-workspace retirement checks.
47		Panes   []Pane
48		Focused bool
49	}
50	
51	// Covers reports whether the session has a pane rooted at or under dir.
52	func (s Session) Covers(dir string) bool {
53		for _, d := range s.Dirs {
54			// A pane inside the repository makes it live. The inverse is not
55			// true: a generic pane at $HOME does not make every repository below
56			// $HOME active.
57			if inside, err := pathx.Contains(dir, d); err == nil && inside {
58				return true
59			}
60		}
61		return false
62	}
63	
64	// OpenResult is the transient result of making a checkout live. Handle may be
65	// persisted by callers, but the pane belongs to this one creation response and
66	// must never be treated as durable state.
67	type OpenResult struct {
68		Handle     string
69		Surface    string
70		Opened     bool
71		Created    bool
72		RootPaneID string
73	}
74	
75	// AgentActivity is one recognized live coding agent occupying a runtime pane.
76	// Every activity returned by a backend is occupied regardless of Status; idle,
77	// done and unknown describe lifecycle state, not permission to share a checkout.
78	type AgentActivity struct {
79		PaneID      string
80		WorkspaceID string
81		Agent       string
82		Name        string
83		Status      string
84		CWD         string
85	}
86	
87	// AgentActivityLister is an optional runtime capability. Core runtimes need not
88	// know about agents; Herdr implements it because its pane model can identify the
89	// exact process and checkout involved.
90	type AgentActivityLister interface {
91		AgentActivities(ctx context.Context) ([]AgentActivity, error)
92	}
93	
94	// CurrentPaneResolver is an optional runtime capability for resolving the live
95	// pane behind inherited caller context. Herdr pane IDs can change after a move,
96	// so collision exclusions must not trust HERDR_PANE_ID alone.
97	type CurrentPaneResolver interface {
98		CurrentPaneID(ctx context.Context) (string, error)
99	}
100	
101	// Activator is the optional interactive half of opening a runtime surface.
102	// Open deliberately remains detached so creation commands can run in the
103	// background. Navigation commands call Activate after their own terminal UI
104	// has been torn down: inside a multiplexer this switches the current client;
105	// outside it attaches a new client and blocks until the user detaches.
106	type Activator interface {
107		Activate(ctx context.Context, handle string) error
108	}
109	
110	// PaneRunner is the optional exact-pane command surface. The command is shell
111	// text for the pane's existing interactive shell, not argv for a child process
112	// started by dev. Implementations must not include command text in errors.
113	type PaneRunner interface {

115	}

120	type Runtime interface {
121		// Name is the backend identifier used in config and in `dev doctor`.

1	// Package gitx wraps the git porcelain commands dev depends on. Every helper
2	// shells out to git rather than linking a Go implementation: git is already a
3	// hard dependency, its porcelain formats are stable and documented, and this
4	// keeps dev's behaviour identical to what the user sees when they run the same
5	// command by hand.
6	package gitx
7	
8	import (
9		"bytes"
10		"context"
11		"errors"
12		"fmt"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16	)
17	
18	// ErrNotARepo is returned when a directory is not inside a git working tree.
19	var ErrNotARepo = errors.New("not a git repository")
20	
21	// Error carries the failing command and git's own stderr, which is almost
22	// always more useful than the exit status alone.
23	type Error struct {
24		Args   []string
25		Dir    string
26		Stderr string
27		Err    error
28	}
29	
30	func (e *Error) Error() string {
31		msg := strings.TrimSpace(e.Stderr)
32		if msg == "" {
33			msg = e.Err.Error()
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("git %s: %s", strings.Join(e.Args, " "), msg)
36	}
37	
38	func (e *Error) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
39	
40	// run executes git in dir and returns trimmed stdout.
41	func run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
42		return runEnv(ctx, dir, nil, args...)
43	}
44	
45	// runEnv executes git with task-scoped environment overrides. It is used for
46	// alternate-index analysis that must never touch the user's real index.
47	func runEnv(ctx context.Context, dir string, overrides []string, args ...string) (string, error) {
48		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than
49		// octal-escaped, which matters for the Chinese-named files in these repos.
50		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
51		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
52		cmd.Dir = dir
53		if len(overrides) > 0 {
54			keys := make(map[string]bool, len(overrides))
55			for _, override := range overrides {
56				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(override, "=")
57				keys[key] = true
58			}
59			env := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+len(overrides))
60			for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
61				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
62				if !keys[key] {
63					env = append(env, entry)
64				}
65			}
66			env = append(env, overrides...)
67			cmd.Env = env
68		}
69		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
70		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
71		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
72		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
73			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
74			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {
75				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", dir, ErrNotARepo)
76			}
77			return "", gerr
78		}
79		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
80	}
81	
82	// Run executes an arbitrary git command in dir. Exported for the few callers
83	// (park's wip commit, done's merge) that need a one-off command.
84	func Run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
85		return run(ctx, dir, args...)
86	}
87	
88	// lines splits git output into non-empty lines.
89	func lines(s string) []string {
90		if s == "" {
91			return nil
92		}
93		out := strings.Split(s, "\n")
94		filtered := out[:0]
95		for _, l := range out {
96			if l != "" {
97				filtered = append(filtered, l)
98			}
99		}
100		return filtered

25		if handle == "" {
26			return nil
27		}

29			_, err := t.run(ctx, "switch-client", "-t", "="+handle)

45	func (t *Tmux) run(ctx context.Context, args ...string) (string, error) {
46		if t.runCommand != nil {
47			return t.runCommand(ctx, args...)
48		}
49		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, t.bin, args...)
50		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
51		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
52		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
53			msg := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
54			if msg == "" {
55				msg = err.Error()
56			}
57			return "", fmt.Errorf("tmux %s: %s", strings.Join(args, " "), msg)
58		}

60	}

81		if err != nil {
82			// "no server running on ..." is the normal idle case.
83			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "no server running") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "error connecting") {
84				return nil, nil
85			}
86			return nil, err

13	// State is where a change stream sits in its lifecycle.

15

18		Hot State = "hot"
19		// Warm: worktree and branch kept, runtime closed. Back within days.
20		Warm State = "warm"
21		// Cold: committed and pushed, worktree removed. Reconstructible anywhere.
22		Cold State = "cold"
23		// Done: merged. Kept only until the entry is reaped.
24		Done State = "done"

27	// States lists the lifecycle in order, for help text and validation.

29	
30	// ParseState validates a user-supplied state name.
31	func ParseState(s string) (State, error) {
32		got := State(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s)))
33		for _, valid := range States {
34			if got == valid {
35				return got, nil
36			}
37		}
38		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown state %q: want one of %s", s, JoinStates(", "))
39	}
40	
41	// JoinStates renders the valid state names.
42	func JoinStates(sep string) string {
43		parts := make([]string, len(States))
44		for i, s := range States {
45			parts[i] = string(s)
46		}
47		return strings.Join(parts, sep)
48	}
49	
50	// Icon is the glyph shown in the inventory.

56			return "🌤"

130	// modes were recorded, a path meant worktree and no path meant a canonical
131	// branch task; direct mode is never guessed because it changes integration
132	// semantics and must be explicit.
133	func (t Task) EffectiveMode() CheckoutMode {
134		if t.Mode != "" {
135			return t.Mode
136		}
137		if t.WorktreePath != "" {
138			return ModeWorktree
139		}
140		return ModeBranch
141	}
142	
143	// Title is the display name, falling back to the branch when unnamed.
144	func (t Task) Title() string {
145		if t.Name != "" {
146			return t.Name
147		}
148		return t.Branch
149	}
150	
151	// OwnedBy reports whether host is this task's owner. An empty owner means
152	// unclaimed, which counts as owned by anyone.
153	func (t Task) OwnedBy(host string) bool { return t.Owner == "" || t.Owner == host }
154	
155	// Validate rejects a task that could not be acted on later.
156	func (t Task) Validate() error {
157		switch {
158		case t.Repo == "":
159			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo is required", t.ID)
160		case t.Branch == "":
161			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: branch is required", t.ID)
162		case t.RepoPath == "":
163			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo_path is required", t.ID)
164		}
165		if _, err := ParseState(string(t.State)); err != nil {
166			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
167		}
168		switch t.Mode {
169		case "", ModeWorktree, ModeBranch, ModeDirect:
170		default:
171			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: unknown mode %q", t.ID, t.Mode)
172		}
173		return nil
174	}

163	// scanRepo collects everything in one repository that looks like work in
164	// flight but is not yet recorded.
165	func scanRepo(ctx context.Context, app *App, r repo.Repo, sessions []runtime.Session,
166		known map[string]bool, target task.State, doWorktrees, doSessions, doBranches bool) []candidate {
167	
168		var out []candidate
169		seen := map[string]bool{}
170	
171		add := func(branch, worktree, reason string, state task.State) {
172			if branch == "" || seen[branch] {
173				return
174			}
175			id := task.MakeID(r.Name, branch)
176			if known[id] {
177				return
178			}
179			seen[branch] = true
180			mode := task.ModeBranch
181			if worktree != "" {
182				mode = task.ModeWorktree
183			}
184			out = append(out, candidate{
185				Reason: reason,
186				Task: &task.Task{
187					ID:           id,
188					Name:         branch,
189					Repo:         r.Name,
190					RepoPath:     r.Path,
191					Branch:       branch,
192					Base:         gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, r.Path),
193					WorktreePath: worktree,
194					Mode:         mode,
195					State:        state,
196					Owner:        config.Hostname(),
197				},
198			})
199		}
200	
201		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
202		if err != nil {
203			return nil
204		}
205	
206		if doWorktrees {
207			for _, w := range worktrees {
208				if w.Main || w.Branch == "" || w.Prunable {
209					continue
210				}
211				// A harness's turn-scoped worktree is not a change stream a human
212				// tracks; adopting those would fill the inventory with noise that
213				// the harness will delete on its own.
214				if inventory.IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
215					continue
216				}
217				state := target
218				reason := "existing worktree"
219				if sessionAt(sessions, w.Path) != nil {
220					state, reason = task.Hot, "worktree with a live session"
221				}
222				add(w.Branch, w.Path, reason, state)
223			}
224		}
225	
226		if doSessions {
227			for i := range sessions {
228				for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
229					if d != r.Path {
230						continue
231					}
232					st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
233					if err != nil || st.Branch == "" {
234						continue
235					}
236					add(st.Branch, "", "live session in the main checkout", task.Hot)
237				}
238			}
239		}
240	
241		if doBranches {
242			for _, branch := range unmergedBranches(ctx, r.Path) {
243				add(branch, worktreePathFor(worktrees, branch), "branch ahead of the base", target)
244			}
245		}
246		return out
247	}
248	
249	func sessionAt(sessions []runtime.Session, dir string) *runtime.Session {
250		for i := range sessions {
251			for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
252				if d == dir {
253					return &sessions[i]
254				}
255			}
256		}
257		return nil
258	}
259	
260	func worktreePathFor(worktrees []gitx.Worktree, branch string) string {
261		for _, w := range worktrees {
262			if w.Branch == branch && !w.Main {
263				return w.Path
264			}
265		}
266		return ""
267	}
268	
269	// unmergedBranches lists local branches carrying commits the default branch
270	// does not — unfinished work that would otherwise be invisible to dev.
271	func unmergedBranches(ctx context.Context, repoPath string) []string {
272		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repoPath)
273		if base == "" {
274			return nil
275		}
276		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname:short)", "refs/heads/")
277		if err != nil {
278			return nil
279		}
280		var branches []string
281		for _, b := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
282			b = strings.TrimSpace(b)
283			if b == "" || b == base || inventory.IsEphemeralWorktree("", b) {
284				continue
285			}
286			// Contained in the base means the work has already landed.
287			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", b, base); err == nil {
288				continue
289			}
290			branches = append(branches, b)
291		}
292		return branches
293	}

238			result.hasHandoff = true

240		if spec.Remote != nil {

242			result.hasRemote = true
243		}
244		if !result.PartialSuccess && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 && len(result.FailedSteps()) > 0 {
245			result.PartialSuccess = true
246		}
247		return result
248	}

5	// TransitionRule is one cell in the exhaustive persisted lifecycle table. An
6	// empty Target on an allowed rule means the task record is removed rather than
7	// assigned another persisted state.
8	type TransitionRule struct {
9		Mode            task.CheckoutMode
10		Source          task.State
11		Action          Action
12		Target          task.State
13		Allowed         bool
14		StatePreserving bool
15		RemovesTask     bool

18	}

22

24		mode   task.CheckoutMode
25		state  task.State

31			task.ModeWorktree,
32			task.ModeBranch,
33			task.ModeDirect,
34		}
35		stateOrder = []task.State{
36			task.Hot,
37			task.Warm,
38			task.Cold,
39			task.Done,
40		}
41		transitionActionOrder = []Action{
42			ParkWarm,
43			ParkCold,
44			Resume,
45			CompleteDirect,
46			CompleteFF,
47			ReviewHandoff,
48			VerifyMerged,
49			Retire,
50		}
51		transitionTable = buildTransitionTable()
52	)
53	
54	// TransitionActions returns the actions represented in every mode/state row.
55	// Adopt, RemoveCheckout, RefreshRemote, and Reconcile are deliberately absent
56	// because they operate on row ownership, repository context, or drift rather
57	// than persisted-state edges.
58	func TransitionActions() []Action {
59		return append([]Action(nil), transitionActionOrder...)
60	}
61	
62	// PersistedLifecycleActions is the stable action dimension of the lifecycle
63	// table, including state-preserving review handoff but excluding repository
64	// context actions such as remote refresh.
65	func PersistedLifecycleActions() []Action { return TransitionActions() }
66	
67	// Transitions returns all table cells in mode, state, and action order. Denied
68	// cells are retained so additions cannot silently fall through a switch.
69	func Transitions() []TransitionRule {
70		out := make([]TransitionRule, 0, len(modeOrder)*len(stateOrder)*len(transitionActionOrder))
71		for _, mode := range modeOrder {
72			for _, state := range stateOrder {
73				for _, action := range transitionActionOrder {
74					out = append(out, transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: state, action: action}])
75				}
76			}
77		}
78		return out
79	}
80	
81	// LookupTransition returns the exhaustive table cell for known dimensions.
82	func LookupTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, bool) {
83		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(source) || !isTransitionAction(action) {
84			return TransitionRule{Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action}, false
85		}
86		rule, ok := transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}]
87		return rule, ok
88	}
89	
90	// RequireTransition returns the allowed table cell or a typed graph error.
91	func RequireTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, error) {
92		rule, found := LookupTransition(mode, source, action)
93		if !found {
94			rule.Reason = "unknown mode, state, or non-transition action"
95			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
96		}
97		if !rule.Allowed {
98			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
99		}
100		return rule, nil
101	}
102	
103	func isTransitionAction(action Action) bool {
104		for _, candidate := range transitionActionOrder {
105			if action == candidate {
106				return true
107			}
108		}
109		return false
110	}
111	
112	func validMode(mode task.CheckoutMode) bool {
113		for _, candidate := range modeOrder {
114			if mode == candidate {
115				return true
116			}
117		}
118		return false
119	}
120	
121	func validState(state task.State) bool {
122		for _, candidate := range stateOrder {
123			if state == candidate {
124				return true
125			}
126		}
127		return false
128	}
129	
130	func buildTransitionTable() map[transitionKey]TransitionRule {
131		table := make(map[transitionKey]TransitionRule, len(modeOrder)*len(stateOrder)*len(transitionActionOrder))
132		for _, mode := range modeOrder {
133			for _, source := range stateOrder {
134				for _, action := range transitionActionOrder {
135					rule := TransitionRule{
136						Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action,
137						Reason: deniedTransitionReason(mode, source, action),
138					}
139					table[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}] = rule
140				}
141			}
142		}
143	
144		allow := func(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action, target task.State, preserving, removes bool, milestone Milestone) {
145			key := transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}
146			table[key] = TransitionRule{
147				Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action, Target: target,
148				Allowed: true, StatePreserving: preserving, RemovesTask: removes,
149				Milestone: milestone,
150			}
151		}
152	
153		for _, mode := range []task.CheckoutMode{task.ModeWorktree, task.ModeBranch} {
154			allow(mode, task.Hot, ParkWarm, task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
155			// Existing park accepts WARM tasks so it can update parking metadata and
156			// close a residual runtime without manufacturing a backward transition.
157			allow(mode, task.Warm, ParkWarm, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
158			allow(mode, task.Hot, ParkCold, task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
159			allow(mode, task.Warm, ParkCold, task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
160			allow(mode, task.Warm, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
161			allow(mode, task.Cold, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
162			allow(mode, task.Hot, CompleteFF, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
163			allow(mode, task.Warm, CompleteFF, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
164			allow(mode, task.Hot, VerifyMerged, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
165			allow(mode, task.Warm, VerifyMerged, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
166			allow(mode, task.Hot, ReviewHandoff, task.Hot, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
167			allow(mode, task.Warm, ReviewHandoff, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
168			allow(mode, task.Done, Retire, "", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
169		}
170	
171		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, ParkWarm, task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
172		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, ParkWarm, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
173		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
174		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, CompleteDirect, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
175		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, CompleteDirect, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
176		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Done, Retire, "", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
177	
178		return table
179	}
180	
181	func deniedTransitionReason(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) string {
182		if mode == task.ModeDirect && source == task.Cold {
183			return "direct tasks cannot be COLD"
184		}
185		if action == ParkCold && mode == task.ModeDirect {
186			return "direct tasks use the canonical checkout and cannot be parked COLD"
187		}
188		if source == task.Done {
189			return "DONE tasks can only be retired through the persisted lifecycle graph"
190		}
191		if source == task.Cold {
192			return "COLD tasks must resume before any completion or review action"
193		}
194		if action == CompleteDirect && mode != task.ModeDirect {
195			return "direct completion is only valid for direct tasks"
196		}
197		if (action == CompleteFF || action == ReviewHandoff || action == VerifyMerged) && mode == task.ModeDirect {
198			return "direct tasks have no separate branch to integrate or hand off"
199		}
200		return "the edge is not in the approved lifecycle graph"
201	}
202

262	func doneActionOptions(selected task.Task, selection doneSelection, opts doneOptions) flow.ActionOptions {

266			}

268		switch selection.Integration {
269		case doneIntegrationPR:
270			return flow.ReviewHandoffOptions{Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message}
271		case doneIntegrationMerged:
272			return flow.VerifyMergedOptions{
273				Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message,
274				BaseRef: opts.BaseRef, SquashCommit: opts.ConfirmSquash, PushBase: opts.Push,
275			}
276		default:
277			return flow.CompleteFFOptions{
278				Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message, PushBase: opts.Push,
279			}
280		}
281	}

283	func replanDone(
284		ctx context.Context,
285		session lifecycleSession,
286		previous flow.Plan,
287		options flow.ActionOptions,
288	) (flow.Plan, error) {
289		fresh, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
290		if err != nil {
291			if errors.Is(err, flow.ErrStalePlan) {
292				return flow.Plan{}, presentDoneApplyError(flow.Result{}, err)
293			}
294			return flow.Plan{}, err
295		}
296		if changed := changedDoneAuthority(previous, fresh); changed != "" {
297			stale := &flow.StalePlanError{
298				ExpectedPlanID: previous.PlanID,
299				ActualPlanID:   fresh.PlanID,
300				Reason:         changed + " changed while the finish plan was open",
301			}
302			return flow.Plan{}, presentDoneApplyError(flow.Result{}, stale)
303		}
304		return fresh, nil
305	}

308		before := previous.AuthorityFields()
309		after := fresh.AuthorityFields()
310		for _, key := range []string{
311			"task.revision", "task.mode", "task.state", "task.repo-path", "task.branch", "task.base", "task.worktree-path",
312			"repo.git-common-dir", "worktree.fingerprint",
313			"git.status-error", "git.branch", "git.detached", "git.upstream", "git.ahead", "git.behind",
314			"git.changed", "git.staged", "git.unstaged", "git.untracked", "git.conflicted", "git.head",
315			"git.base-oid", "git.upstream-oid", "git.operation", "git.operation-active", "git.operation-error",
316			"artifact.fingerprint", "finish.authority", "completion.base-ref", "completion.base-oid",
317			"completion.expected-branch", "completion.branch-oid", "runtime.backend", "runtime.available",
318			"runtime.occupancy-fingerprint", "runtime.occupancy-error",
319		} {
320			if before[key] != after[key] {
321				return key
322			}
323		}

387		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
388		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
389		for _, condition := range blocking {
390			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
391			if condition.Remediation != "" {

393			}
394			parts = append(parts, message)
395		}
396		if len(parts) == 0 {
397			return fmt.Errorf("finish plan is %s: %w", plan.Availability, flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
398		}
399		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability,
400			strings.Join(parts, "; "), flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
401	}
