335	func doneFatalPreflightError(selected task.Task, plan flow.Plan) error {
336		view := doneView(plan)
337		if view.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
338			return fmt.Errorf("%s has %d conflicted path(s); resolve or abort the merge/rebase before finishing",
339				config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), view.Status.Conflicted)
340		}
341		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionCheckoutPresent); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
342			return fmt.Errorf("%s no longer exists — resume the task first", config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath))
343		}
344		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionExplicitBase); ok &&
345			condition.Requirement == flow.RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
346			return fmt.Errorf("cannot determine the base branch for %s — pass --base when starting a task", selected.Repo)
347		}
348		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionFinishAnalysis); ok && condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictError {
349			return errors.New(condition.Evidence)
350		}
351		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionArtifactReady); ok &&
352			(condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictBlocked || condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictError) {
353			return fmt.Errorf("artifact readiness for %s is blocked: %s; finalize or discard the intent before integration",
354				config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence)
355		}
356		return nil
357	}
358	
359	func donePlanReadinessError(selected task.Task, plan flow.Plan, selection doneSelection) error {
360		if plan.Availability == flow.AvailabilityReady {
361			return nil
362		}
363		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionCheckoutClean); ok &&
364			condition.Requirement == flow.RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
365			switch selection.Dirty {
366			case flow.DirtyAuto, flow.DirtyFail:
367				return dirtyFinishError(selected, plan)
368			case flow.DirtyCommit:
369				if strings.TrimSpace(selection.Message) == "" {
370					return errors.New("--message is required with --dirty=commit outside an interactive terminal")
371				}
372			}
373		}
374		if plan.Action == flow.ReviewHandoff {
375			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionBranchRelation); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
376				base := doneView(plan).Base
377				return fmt.Errorf("%s is already contained in %s; use --ff to finalize cleanup instead of opening a PR",
378					selected.Branch, base)
379			}
380		}
381		if plan.Action == flow.VerifyMerged {
382			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionMergeProof); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
383				fields := plan.AuthorityFields()
384				return fmt.Errorf("cannot verify %s is contained in %s", fields["completion.proof-ref"], fields["completion.base-ref"])
385			}
386		}
387		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
388		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
389		for _, condition := range blocking {
390			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
391			if condition.Remediation != "" {
392				message += " (" + condition.Remediation + ")"
393			}
394			parts = append(parts, message)
395		}
396		if len(parts) == 0 {
397			return fmt.Errorf("finish plan is %s: %w", plan.Availability, flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
398		}
399		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability,
400			strings.Join(parts, "; "), flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
401	}
402	
403	func dirtyFinishError(t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) error {
404		view := doneView(plan)
405		return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes: %s; branch relation to %s is behind %d, ahead %d; "+
406			"%d dirty path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
407			config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), view.Status.Breakdown(), view.Base,
408			view.BaseOnly, view.BranchOnly, view.Equivalent, view.Base, view.Unique)
409	}
410	
411	func renderDonePreflight(app *App, t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) {
412		view := doneView(plan)
413		s := app.outStyle()
414		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", s.title("Finish"), t.Title())
415		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s      %s\n", s.label("branch"), t.Branch)
416		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s        %s\n", s.label("base"), view.Base)
417		switch {
418		case view.BaseOnly == 0 && view.BranchOnly == 0:
419			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already equal to %s (behind 0, ahead 0)", view.Base)))
420		case view.contained():
421			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already contained in %s (behind %d, ahead 0)", view.Base, view.BaseOnly)))
422		default:
423			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("behind %d, ahead %d relative to %s",
424				view.BaseOnly, view.BranchOnly, view.Base)))
425		}
426		if !view.Status.Dirty() {
427			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.success("clean"))
428			return
429		}
430		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.warning(view.Status.Breakdown()))
431		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s, %s\n", s.label("contents"),
432			s.success(fmt.Sprintf("%d match %s", view.Equivalent, view.Base)),
433			s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("%d unique", view.Unique)))
434		for _, change := range view.Changes {
435			marker := s.warning("unique")
436			if change.BaseEquivalent {
437				marker = s.success("matches " + view.Base)
438			}
439			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s%s %s\n", marker,
440				strings.Repeat(" ", max(0, 12-width(marker))), change.Path)
441		}
442	}
443	
444	func confirmDonePlan(app *App, p *prompter, t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) (bool, string, error) {
445		view := doneView(plan)
446		s := app.outStyle()
447		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\n"+s.title("Summary"))
448		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s        %s\n", s.label("task"), t.Title())
449		switch {
450		case donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectCommitAll):
451			message := doneEffectDetails(plan, flow.EffectCommitAll)["message"]
452			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("commit all as %q", message)))
453		case donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectDiscardAll):
454			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.danger("discard all staged, unstaged and untracked changes"))
455		default:
456			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.success("none"))
457		}
458		switch {
459		case plan.Action == flow.ReviewHandoff:
460			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.review("open a PR into "+view.Base))
461		case plan.Action == flow.VerifyMerged:
462			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("verify merge into "+view.Base))
463		case !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectMergeFF) && !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectRebaseBranch):
464			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("already contained in "+view.Base+"; cleanup only"))
465		default:
466			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("fast-forward into "+view.Base))
467		}
468		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
469			label := plan.Confirmation.Prompt
470			if view.Unique > 0 {
471				label = fmt.Sprintf("Type %s to discard %d unique path(s)", plan.Confirmation.Token, view.Unique)
472			}
473			value, err := p.dangerLine(label)
474			if err != nil {
475				return false, "", err
476			}
477			return value == plan.Confirmation.Token, value, nil
478		}
479		confirmed, err := p.confirm("Proceed with this finish plan?", false)
480		return confirmed, "", err
481	}
482	
483	func presentDoneApplyError(result flow.Result, err error) error {
484		for _, step := range result.FailedSteps() {
485			switch step.Effect.Code {
486			case flow.EffectCommitAll:
487				return fmt.Errorf("commit dirty checkout: %w", err)
488			case flow.EffectDiscardAll:
489				return fmt.Errorf("discard dirty checkout: %w", err)
490			}
491		}
492		if errors.Is(err, flow.ErrStalePlan) {
493			for _, step := range result.CompletedSteps() {
494				if step.Effect.Code == flow.EffectCommitAll || step.Effect.Code == flow.EffectDiscardAll {
495					return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again during finalization; stop the active writer and rerun dev done: %w", err)
496				}
497			}
498			return fmt.Errorf("checkout or branch changed while the finish plan was open; review the new state and rerun dev done: %w", err)
499		}
500		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "changed again after") {
501			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again during finalization; stop the active writer and rerun dev done: %w", err)
502		}
503		return err
504	}
505	
506	func renderDoneSuccess(app *App, selected, final task.Task, plan flow.Plan, result flow.Result, initial donePlanView) error {
507		switch plan.Action {
508		case flow.ReviewHandoff:
509			if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneReviewReady {
510				return fmt.Errorf("review handoff completed without the review-ready milestone")
511			}
512			if final.State != selected.State {
513				return fmt.Errorf("review handoff changed task state from %s to %s", selected.State, final.State)
514			}
515			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nREADY FOR REVIEW · runtime and worktree kept")
516			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "After merge: dev done --merged --base-ref origin/"+doneView(plan).Base)
517			return nil
518		case flow.CompleteDirect, flow.CompleteFF, flow.VerifyMerged:
519			if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneMerged || final.State != task.Done {
520				return fmt.Errorf("completion returned milestone %s and task state %s; want merged and DONE",
521					result.Milestone, final.State)
522			}
523		default:
524			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported completion result action %s", plan.Action)
525		}
526	
527		if plan.Action == flow.CompleteDirect {
528			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s completed directly on %s\n", task.Done.Icon(), final.Title(), final.Branch)
529			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   no branch or worktree was created or removed")
530			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · cleanup pending: run dev retire from outside this runtime")
531			return nil
532		}
533		view := doneView(plan)
534		if plan.Action == flow.CompleteFF && initial.contained() &&
535			!donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectRebaseBranch) && !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectMergeFF) {
536			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   already merged  %s is contained in %s\n", final.Branch, view.Base)
537		}
538		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s merged into %s\n", task.Done.Icon(), final.Title(), view.Base)
539		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · runtime and worktree kept")
540		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   cleanup pending · run `dev retire %s` from outside its workspace\n", final.ID)
541		return nil
542	}
543	
544	func doneView(plan flow.Plan) donePlanView {
545		fields := plan.AuthorityFields()
546		view := donePlanView{
547			Base:       fields["completion.base-ref"],
548			BaseOnly:   authorityInt(fields, "finish.base-only"),
549			BranchOnly: authorityInt(fields, "finish.branch-only"),
550			Equivalent: authorityInt(fields, "finish.equivalent-dirty"),
551			Unique:     authorityInt(fields, "finish.unique-dirty"),
552			Status: gitx.Status{
553				Branch: fields["git.branch"], Upstream: fields["git.upstream"],
554				Ahead: authorityInt(fields, "git.ahead"), Behind: authorityInt(fields, "git.behind"),
555				Changed: authorityIntFirst(fields, "finish.status-changed", "git.changed"),
556				Staged:  authorityIntFirst(fields, "finish.status-staged", "git.staged"),
557				Unstaged: authorityIntFirst(fields,
558					"finish.status-unstaged", "git.unstaged"),
559				Untracked: authorityIntFirst(fields,
560					"finish.status-untracked", "git.untracked"),
561				Conflicted: authorityIntFirst(fields,
562					"finish.status-conflicted", "git.conflicted"),
563			},
564		}
565		for index := 0; index < authorityInt(fields, "finish.change-count"); index++ {
566			prefix := fmt.Sprintf("finish.change.%d.", index)
567			view.Changes = append(view.Changes, doneChangeView{
568				Path: fields[prefix+"path"], BaseEquivalent: fields[prefix+"base-equivalent"] == "true",
569			})
570		}
571		return view
572	}
573	
574	func authorityInt(fields map[string]string, key string) int {
575		value, _ := strconv.Atoi(fields[key])
576		return value
577	}
578	
579	func authorityIntFirst(fields map[string]string, keys ...string) int {
580		for _, key := range keys {
581			if _, ok := fields[key]; ok {
582				return authorityInt(fields, key)
583			}
584		}
585		return 0
586	}
587	
588	func doneCondition(plan flow.Plan, code flow.ConditionCode) (flow.Condition, bool) {
589		for _, condition := range plan.Conditions() {
590			if condition.Code == code {
591				return condition, true
592			}
593		}
594		return flow.Condition{}, false
595	}
596	
597	func donePlanHasEffect(plan flow.Plan, code flow.EffectCode) bool {
598		for _, effect := range plan.Effects() {
599			if effect.Code == code {
600				return true
601			}
602		}
603		return false
604	}
605	
606	func doneEffectDetails(plan flow.Plan, code flow.EffectCode) map[string]string {
607		for _, effect := range plan.Effects() {
608			if effect.Code == code {
609				return effect.Details.Map()
610			}
611		}
612		return nil
613	}
614

86	+
87	+`dev flow [repo]` is a preview-labelled, full-screen, TTY-only state-machine UI.
88	+It is independent of the six-view `dev tui` dashboard. From a canonical or linked
89	+checkout, `dev flow` resolves the canonical repository and focuses that exact
90	+surface; outside Git it opens a filterable repository picker. An explicit
91	+`dev flow api` overrides cwd.
92	+
93	+The left panel is the union of Git's registered worktrees and task records that
94	+have no checkout, including normal COLD and DONE tasks. Rows are labelled
95	+`canonical`, `managed`, `unmanaged`, `harness`, `task-only`, or `conflict`.
96	+Canonical worktrees are never removable; harness-owned and ambiguous/conflicting
97	+rows have no destructive path. An exact unmanaged linked checkout can be
98	+**Adopted** by creating task metadata without changing Git bytes, or **Removed**
99	+only when clean and safe; removal is non-force and always preserves the branch.
100	+
101	+The center distinguishes persisted task intent (`HOT`, `WARM`, `COLD`, `DONE`)
102	+from observed Git/worktree/runtime/artifact facts. Unknown, failed, loading, or
103	+stale evidence never becomes a false clean/closed fact. `runtime=none` leaves
104	+session occupancy unobserved, but the local Git/task snapshot can still be fresh;
105	+metadata-only adoption then remains WARM.

108	+direct or fast-forward completion, review handoff, verified-merge completion,
109	+and DONE retirement where legal. The preview deliberately excludes dirty

364	+## Flow 中的 DONE 與 Retire
365	+
366	+`dev flow` 把 persisted `DONE` intent 與 live cleanup evidence 分開。DONE/MERGED row 仍可顯示 runtime、worktree、branch 與 task record；只有 Retire result 完成最後的 CAS task deletion 才是 RETIRED。UNMANAGED row 使用的是永遠保留 branch 的 Remove Checkout，不會製造 DONE/RETIRED task milestone；canonical 與 harness row 不能 Remove Checkout。
367	+
368	+Flow TUI 沒有 `--close-unknown`、`--assume-no-runtime`、dirty discard 或 generic force。`runtime=none` 會保留「session/agent unobserved」，不冒充已證明 closed。需要 expert acknowledgement 時，離開 Flow 並明確執行 plan 顯示的 fallback CLI，再接受該 command 自己的 guards。完整 row/action matrix 見 [Repository Flow 預覽](repository-flow.zh-TW.md)。

375	 `--close-unknown` 與 `--assume-no-runtime` 只放寬 fail-closed 的*觀測結果*（無法讀取的 status、無法列舉的 runtime list）。這兩個 flag 都絕不會 bypass caller containment 或 active-agent state。`retirement.Service.Retire` 在 runtime session 關閉後，也會重新驗證 target identity、Git ancestry、進行中的 Git operation（`gitx.InProgress`，檢查 `MERGE_HEAD`、`CHERRY_PICK_HEAD`、`REVERT_HEAD`、`rebase-merge`、`rebase-apply`、`sequencer`；不含 `REBASE_HEAD`，因為 Git 在 rebase 完成後仍會保留它）以及 worktree 是否 clean——因為 runtime draining 期間現實可能已改變，先前的驗證結果不會跨越這個邊界沿用。

41			yes             bool
42			mergedWorktrees bool
43			baseRef         string
44			closeUnknown    bool
45			assumeNoRuntime bool
46			deleteBranches  bool
47		)
48		cmd := &cobra.Command{
49			Use:   "sweep",
50			Short: "Review stale tasks and drifted state, and act on them",
51			Long: `Show which tasks have gone stale or drifted, and what dev would do about it.
52	
53	Cleanup usually fails not because people are unwilling but because there is no
54	trustworthy way to be sure the work is recoverable. So sweep reports first and
55	only changes things with --apply, confirming each one unless you pass --yes.
56	Nothing here ever deletes uncommitted work.`,
57			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
58			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
59				ctx := ctxOf()
60				style := app.outStyle()
61				tasks, err := app.Tasks.List()
62				if err != nil {
63					return err
64				}
65				rt := app.Runtime()
66				rows := inventory.Collect(ctx, tasks, rt, inventory.Options{})
67				stale := time.Duration(staleDays) * 24 * time.Hour
68				retireOptions := sweepRetireOptions{
69					closeUnknown: closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranches: deleteBranches,
70				}
71	
72				var sugg []suggestion
73				if mergedWorktrees {
74					merged, err := suggestMergedWorktrees(app, ctx, rows, baseRef, retireOptions)

76						return err
77					}
78					sugg = append(sugg, merged...)
79				} else {

82					}
83				}
84	
85				// Live sessions no task claims: the other half of a crowded sidebar.
86				if !mergedWorktrees {
87					if sessions, err := rt.List(ctx); err == nil {
88						if orphans := inventory.Orphans(sessions, rows); len(orphans) > 0 {
89							fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%d live session(s) with no task recorded:\n", len(orphans))
90							for _, s := range orphans {
91								dir := "—"
92								if len(s.Dirs) > 0 {
93									dir = config.Contract(s.Dirs[0])
94								}
95								fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %-24s %s\n", truncate(s.Label, 24), style.dim(dir))
96							}
97							fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("  → `dev start` in one of those directories to track it, or just close it."))
98						}
99					}
100				}
101	
102				if len(sugg) == 0 {
103					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.success("\nNothing to sweep")+" — no task drift or eligible merged worktree was found.")
104					return nil
105				}
106	
107				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%s\n\n", style.title(fmt.Sprintf("%d suggestion(s):", len(sugg))))
108				for _, s := range sugg {

110						truncate(s.row.Task.Title(), 28), style.warning(s.reason))
111					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "     → %s\n", s.action)
112				}
113	
114				if !apply {
115					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nRe-run with --apply to act on these (each is confirmed individually)."))
116					return nil
117				}
118	
119				in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
120				for _, s := range sugg {
121					if s.apply == nil {
122						continue
123					}
124					if !yes && !confirm(app, in, s.action) {
125						continue
126					}
127					if err := s.apply(); err != nil {

129						continue
130					}
131					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s\n", style.success("done:"), s.action)
132				}
133				return nil
134			},
135		}

137		f.BoolVar(&apply, "apply", false, "act on the suggestions instead of only reporting")
138		f.IntVar(&staleDays, "stale-days", 14, "days without a commit before a task counts as stale")
139		f.BoolVar(&yes, "yes", false, "with --apply, do not confirm each change")

141		f.StringVar(&baseRef, "base", "", "containment base for --merged-worktrees (default: the repository default branch)")

143		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails during retirement")
144		f.BoolVar(&deleteBranches, "delete-branches", false, "also delete contained local branches after worktree retirement")
145		return cmd

148	func suggestFor(app *App, ctx context.Context, r inventory.Row, stale time.Duration, retireOptions sweepRetireOptions) []suggestion {
149		t := r.Task
150		var out []suggestion
151		current, currentErr := app.Tasks.GetRecord(t.ID)
152		if currentErr != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(current.Task, *t) {
153			detail := "task changed after the sweep inventory snapshot"
154			if currentErr != nil {
155				detail = "task could not be reloaded after the sweep inventory snapshot: " + currentErr.Error()
156			}
157			return []suggestion{{
158				row: r, reason: detail,
159				action: "rerun sweep to inspect the current task revision — not changed automatically",
160			}}
161		}
162		revision := current.Revision
163	
164		// A task whose repository is gone cannot be finished, resumed, parked or
165		// retired: every one of those resolves the repository first, and `dev done`
166		// refuses outright once the checkout is missing. Nothing else in this
167		// function reaches it either — the dead-branch rule below excludes direct
168		// mode, and the stale-worktree rule needs a recorded worktree path. Left
169		// alone, the record is unreachable by any command in the binary.
170		//
171		// Reaping removes dev's record of intent and nothing else; the branch, the
172		// commits and the remote are untouched. A live session proves the directory
173		// is there, so it is the one condition that rules this out.
174		if t.RepoPath != "" && !r.Live() && !dirExists(t.RepoPath) {
175			out = append(out, suggestion{
176				row:    r,
177				reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository %s no longer exists", config.Contract(t.RepoPath)),
178				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s (Git keeps any work; this drops only dev's record)", t.ID),
179				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
180			})
181			return out
182		}
183	
184		out = append(out, orphanSuggestions(app, r)...)
185	
186		switch {
187		// A hot task with no live session is the commonest drift: the session was
188		// closed (or the machine rebooted) without parking.
189		case t.State == task.Hot && r.StateDrift() == "no live session":
190			reason := fmt.Sprintf("hot but no live session, idle %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
191			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkWarmOptions{})
192			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
193				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded warm parking is blocked",
194					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})
195				break
196			}
197			out = append(out, suggestion{
198				row: r, reason: reason, action: fmt.Sprintf("mark %s warm", t.ID),
199				apply: func() error {
200					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
201					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
202					return err
203				},
204			})
205	
206		// A warm task nobody has touched in weeks is a candidate for cold: keeping
207		// the worktree costs disk and clutters every listing.
208		case t.State == task.Warm && r.Age() > stale:
209			reason := fmt.Sprintf("warm and untouched for %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
210			if t.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
211				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but direct tasks cannot go cold",
212					action: "keep it warm or finish it — not changed automatically"})
213				break
214			}
215			if r.Status.Dirty() {
216				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but has uncommitted work",
217					action: "commit or `dev park --wip` before going cold — not changed automatically"})
218				break
219			}
220			if !r.Status.Synced() {
221				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + fmt.Sprintf(", not pushed (%s)", r.Status.Summary()),
222					action: fmt.Sprintf("push %s so it can go cold: dev park %s --cold --push", t.Branch, t.ID)})
223				break
224			}
225			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkColdOptions{})
226			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
227				detail := sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)
228				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded cold parking is blocked",
229					action: detail + " — not changed automatically"})
230				break
231			}
232			out = append(out, suggestion{
233				row:    r,
234				reason: reason + ", clean and pushed",
235				action: fmt.Sprintf("go cold: remove %s (branch and remote keep the work)", config.Contract(r.Checkout)),
236				apply: func() error {
237					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
238					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
239					return err
240				},
241			})
242	
243		// DONE means integrated; runtime/worktree cleanup is a separate,
244		// externally coordinated retirement step.
245		case t.State == task.Done:
246			action := fmt.Sprintf("retire runtime/worktree for %s", t.ID)
247			if retireOptions.deleteBranches && t.Branch != "" && t.Branch != t.Base {
248				action += fmt.Sprintf(" and delete %s", t.Branch)
249			}
250			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.RetireOptions{
251				CloseUnknown: retireOptions.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: retireOptions.assumeNoRuntime,
252				DeleteBranch: retireOptions.deleteBranches,
253			})
254			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
255				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: "merged, but guarded retirement is blocked",
256					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})
257				break
258			}
259			out = append(out, suggestion{
260				row: r, reason: "merged, cleanup pending", action: action,
261				apply: func() error {
262					approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
263					if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
264						approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
265					}
266					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, approval)
267					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
268					return err
269				},
270			})
271		}
272	
273		// A branch-backed task whose branch git no longer has is dead: the branch
274		// was deleted after integration, so the record holds intent for work that
275		// no longer exists anywhere. It cannot be finished, resumed, or retired,
276		// because every one of those paths resolves the branch first.
277		noCheckout := t.WorktreePath == "" || r.WorktreeMissing
278		if noCheckout && t.Branch != "" && t.RepoPath != "" &&
279			t.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeDirect && !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, t.RepoPath, t.Branch) {
280			out = append(out, suggestion{
281				row:    r,
282				reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch %s no longer exists", t.Branch),
283				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s", t.ID),
284				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
285			})
286			return out
287		}
288	
289		// A cold task keeps no checkout by definition: that is what going cold
290		// means. One still on disk is drift inventory already reports and nothing
291		// could act on.
292		if t.State == task.Cold && t.WorktreePath != "" && r.CheckoutExists && !r.WorktreeMissing &&
293			!r.Live() && !r.Status.Dirty() && r.Status.Synced() {
294			out = append(out, suggestion{
295				row:    r,
296				reason: "cold, but its worktree is still on disk",
297				action: fmt.Sprintf("reconcile %s with an exact guarded plan — not changed automatically", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
298			})
299		}
300	
301		// Drift that is independent of the lifecycle stage.
302		if r.WorktreeMissing && t.WorktreePath != "" {
303			wtPath := t.WorktreePath
304			out = append(out, suggestion{
305				row:    r,
306				reason: "records a worktree that git no longer knows about",
307				action: fmt.Sprintf("inspect repository-wide prune scope before clearing %s — not changed automatically", config.Contract(wtPath)),
308			})
309		}
310		return out
311	}
312	
313	func sweepTaskPlan(ctx context.Context, app *App, id string, options flow.ActionOptions) (lifecycleSession, flow.Plan, error) {
314		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
315			return app.Tasks.Get(id)
316		})
317		if err != nil {
318			return lifecycleSession{}, flow.Plan{}, err
319		}
320		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
321		return session, plan, err
322	}
323	
324	func sweepPlanBlocker(plan flow.Plan, err error) string {
325		if err != nil {
326			return err.Error()
327		}
328		var parts []string
329		for _, condition := range append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...) {
330			parts = append(parts, string(condition.Code)+": "+condition.Evidence)
331		}
332		if len(parts) == 0 {
333			return "guarded plan is " + string(plan.Availability)
334		}
335		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
336	}
337	
338	func sweepDeleteTask(ctx context.Context, store *task.Store, id, revision string) error {
339		if revision == "" {
340			return fmt.Errorf("task %s had no report-time revision; rerun sweep", id)
341		}
342		return store.DeleteIfRevision(ctx, id, revision)
343	}
344	
345	// dirExists reports whether path is a directory that can be read right now.
346	func dirExists(path string) bool {
347		info, err := os.Stat(path)
348		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
349	}
350	
351	// orphanSuggestions handles the residue of a worktree removed while its
352	// transcript writer was still running: the path exists, Git has no record of
353	// it, and it holds only agent artifacts. Removing it is offered only once every
354	// file in it is proven byte-identical to one the repository already has.
355	func orphanSuggestions(app *App, r inventory.Row) []suggestion {
356		t := r.Task
357		if t.WorktreePath == "" || !r.WorktreeMissing || !r.CheckoutExists {
358			return nil
359		}
360		orphan, ok, err := retirement.InspectOrphan(t.WorktreePath)
361		if err != nil || !ok {
362			return nil
363		}
364		unsalvaged, err := retirement.Unsalvaged(orphan, t.RepoPath)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil
367		}
368		if len(unsalvaged) > 0 {
369			return []suggestion{{
370				row: r,
371				reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace holding %d file(s) the repository does not have",
372					config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(unsalvaged)),
373				action: fmt.Sprintf("salvage %s first — not removed automatically", strings.Join(unsalvaged, ", ")),
374			}}
375		}
376		return []suggestion{{
377			row:    r,
378			reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace git does not know", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
379			action: fmt.Sprintf("remove the empty shell %s (its %d artifact file(s) are already in the repository)",
380				config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(orphan.Files)),
381			apply: func() error { return os.RemoveAll(t.WorktreePath) },
382		}}
383	}
384	
385	func suggestMergedWorktrees(app *App, ctx context.Context, rows []inventory.Row, requestedBase string, options sweepRetireOptions) ([]suggestion, error) {
386		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, mustGetwd())
387		if err != nil {
388			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees requires a Git repository: %w", err)
389		}
390		if repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
391			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees must run from the canonical checkout, not linked worktree %s", config.Contract(repository.Root))
392		}
393		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, err
396		}
397		base := requestedBase
398		if base == "" {
399			base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.Root)
400			if status.Branch != base {
401				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees defaults to %s; switch the canonical checkout to it or pass --base explicitly", base)
402			}
403		}
404		if !gitx.RefExists(ctx, repository.Root, base) {
405			return nil, fmt.Errorf("merged-worktree base %s does not resolve to a commit", base)
406		}
407	
408		claimed := make(map[string]inventory.Row)
409		for _, row := range rows {
410			if row.Task == nil || row.Checkout == "" {
411				continue
412			}
413			canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(row.Checkout)
414			if canonicalErr == nil {
415				claimed[canonical] = row
416			}
417		}
418		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, repository.Root)
419		if err != nil {
420			return nil, err
421		}
422		var suggestions []suggestion
423		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
424			if worktree.Main || worktree.Bare || worktree.Detached || worktree.Branch == "" || worktree.Branch == base {
425				continue
426			}
427			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", worktree.Branch, base); err != nil {
428				continue
429			}
430			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
431			if err != nil {
432				continue
433			}
434			if row, ok := claimed[canonical]; ok {
435				if row.Task.State == task.Done {
436					suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestFor(app, ctx, row, 0, options)...)
437					continue
438				}
439				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
440					fmt.Sprintf("task is %s; verify integration with `dev done --merged` first", row.Task.State)))
441				continue
442			}
443	
444			displayTask := &task.Task{
445				ID: task.MakeID(repository.Name, worktree.Branch), Name: worktree.Branch,
446				Repo: repository.Name, RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, Branch: worktree.Branch,
447				Base: base, WorktreePath: canonical, Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done,
448			}
449			row := inventory.Row{Task: displayTask, Checkout: canonical, CheckoutExists: true}
450			if inventory.IsClaudeHarnessWorktree(repository.Root, canonical) {
451				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
452					"checkout is owned by the Claude harness"))
453				continue
454			}
455			locator, locateErr := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, canonical)
456			if locateErr != nil {
457				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, locateErr.Error()))
458				continue
459			}
460			service, serviceErr := newCLILifecycleService(app)
461			if serviceErr != nil {
462				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, serviceErr.Error()))
463				continue
464			}
465			request, requestErr := flow.NewRequest(locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
466				RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base,
467				DeleteContainedBranch: options.deleteBranches,
468				CloseUnknown:          options.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.assumeNoRuntime,
469			})
470			if requestErr != nil {
471				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, requestErr.Error()))
472				continue
473			}
474			plan, planErr := service.Plan(ctx, request)
475			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
476				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)))
477				continue
478			}
479			branch := worktree.Branch
480			action := fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s (branch %s kept)",
481				config.Contract(canonical), branch)
482			if options.deleteBranches {
483				action = fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s and delete contained branch %s",
484					config.Contract(canonical), branch)
485			}
486			suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestion{
487				row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("untracked worktree branch is contained in %s", base), action: action,
488				apply: func() error {
489					approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
490					if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
491						approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
492					}
493					result, err := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
494					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
495					return err
496				},
497			})
498		}
499		return suggestions, nil
500	}
501	
502	func mergedWorktreeBlocker(row inventory.Row, base, blocker string) suggestion {
503		return suggestion{
504			row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch is contained in %s, but retirement is blocked", base),
505			action: blocker + " — not changed automatically",
506		}
507	}
508	
509	func confirm(app *App, in *bufio.Reader, action string) bool {
510		s := app.outStyle()
511		prompt := s.prompt(action + "?")
512		lower := strings.ToLower(action)
513		if strings.Contains(lower, "delete") || strings.Contains(lower, "remove") ||
514			strings.Contains(lower, "discard") || strings.Contains(lower, "drop") {
515			prompt = s.danger(action + "?")
516		}
517		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s ", prompt, s.dim("[y/N]"))
518		line, err := in.ReadString('\n')
519		if err != nil {
520			return false
521		}
522		answer := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
523		return answer == "y" || answer == "yes"
524	}
525

1446	+### Plan it by repository
1447	+
1448	+`dev flow [repo]` is an independent preview-labelled, full-screen TUI, not a mode
1449	+of the dashboard. From a canonical or linked checkout it opens the canonical
1450	+repository and focuses that exact surface; outside Git it opens a repository
1451	+picker. It projects every Git-registered worktree plus task-only records such as
1452	+COLD/DONE tasks without a checkout.
1453	+
1454	+The UI shows three layers separately:
1455	+
1456	+1. persisted task intent: mode, HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE, owner, next, branch/base, and
1457	+   expected checkout;
1458	+2. observed facts: exact worktree identity, Git status/operation/refs, runtime and
1459	+   agent occupancy, artifact readiness, each kept as known/unknown/error/skipped/
1460	+   loading rather than converting probe failure into false;
1461	+3. a guarded plan: availability, evidence/remediation, ordered effects, retained
1462	+   resources, confirmation, exact fallback, task revision, and PlanID.
1463	+
1464	+Enter creates the plan; it never applies. READY non-typed plans need `y`; typed
1465	+plans need the displayed token plus Enter. Apply locks and reloads the task
1466	+revision and exact repository/worktree/ref/runtime/artifact authority. If any
1467	+identity changed, it rejects the stale plan before a new effect. Apply itself is
1468	+not canceled by row movement/refresh/quit; the UI retains completed/failed steps
1469	+and recovery, then starts a new local read.
1470	+
1471	+The preview offers the normal managed choices but no dirty commit/discard, WIP,
1472	+shared-writer, ownership takeover, or unknown-runtime acknowledgement. Blocked
1473	+plans point to the compatible CLI fallback instead of adding a force path.
1474	+`r` reads local state only; `R` explicitly plans fetch, portable review query, or
1475	+both. Remote evidence is run-local and limited to named refs plus review
1476	+existence/state/draft/URL/provider/time—not checks or review decisions.
1477	+
1478	 **A machine should hold roughly three to seven hot tasks.** That is a
1479	 cognitive limit, not a technical one. Everything else belongs in `dev ls`.

132							Name: c.Task.Name, Base: c.Task.Base, Owner: c.Task.Owner,
133							Next: c.Task.Next, Note: c.Task.Note, Tags: flow.NewStringList(c.Task.Tags...),
134						}, false)
135						if applyErr != nil {
136							app.warnf("%s: %v", c.Task.Branch, applyErr)
137							continue
138						}
139					} else if _, createErr := app.Tasks.Create(ctx, c.Task); createErr != nil {
140						app.warnf("%s: %v", c.Task.Branch, createErr)
141						continue
142					}
143					adopted++
144				}
145				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\nadopted %d task(s) — see them with `dev ls`\n", adopted)

163	// scanRepo collects everything in one repository that looks like work in
164	// flight but is not yet recorded.
165	func scanRepo(ctx context.Context, app *App, r repo.Repo, sessions []runtime.Session,
166		known map[string]bool, target task.State, doWorktrees, doSessions, doBranches bool) []candidate {
167	
168		var out []candidate
169		seen := map[string]bool{}
170	
171		add := func(branch, worktree, reason string, state task.State) {
172			if branch == "" || seen[branch] {
173				return
174			}
175			id := task.MakeID(r.Name, branch)
176			if known[id] {
177				return
178			}
179			seen[branch] = true
180			mode := task.ModeBranch
181			if worktree != "" {
182				mode = task.ModeWorktree
183			}
184			out = append(out, candidate{
185				Reason: reason,
186				Task: &task.Task{
187					ID:           id,
188					Name:         branch,
189					Repo:         r.Name,
190					RepoPath:     r.Path,
191					Branch:       branch,
192					Base:         gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, r.Path),
193					WorktreePath: worktree,
194					Mode:         mode,
195					State:        state,
196					Owner:        config.Hostname(),
197				},
198			})
199		}
200	
201		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
202		if err != nil {
203			return nil
204		}
205	
206		if doWorktrees {
207			for _, w := range worktrees {
208				if w.Main || w.Branch == "" || w.Prunable {
209					continue
210				}
211				// A harness's turn-scoped worktree is not a change stream a human
212				// tracks; adopting those would fill the inventory with noise that
213				// the harness will delete on its own.
214				if inventory.IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
215					continue
216				}
217				state := target
218				reason := "existing worktree"
219				if sessionAt(sessions, w.Path) != nil {
220					state, reason = task.Hot, "worktree with a live session"
221				}
222				add(w.Branch, w.Path, reason, state)
223			}
224		}
225	
226		if doSessions {
227			for i := range sessions {
228				for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
229					if d != r.Path {
230						continue
231					}
232					st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
233					if err != nil || st.Branch == "" {
234						continue
235					}
236					add(st.Branch, "", "live session in the main checkout", task.Hot)
237				}
238			}
239		}
240	
241		if doBranches {
242			for _, branch := range unmergedBranches(ctx, r.Path) {
243				add(branch, worktreePathFor(worktrees, branch), "branch ahead of the base", target)
244			}
245		}
246		return out
247	}

249	func sessionAt(sessions []runtime.Session, dir string) *runtime.Session {
250		for i := range sessions {
251			for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
252				if d == dir {
253					return &sessions[i]
254				}
255			}
256		}
257		return nil
258	}

260	func worktreePathFor(worktrees []gitx.Worktree, branch string) string {
261		for _, w := range worktrees {
262			if w.Branch == branch && !w.Main {
263				return w.Path
264			}

490			return fmt.Errorf("list %s recognized agents: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err)
491		}

493	}

496		if observationErr := occupancyObservationError(occupancy, err); observationErr != nil {
497			return observationErr

499		var blockers []string

1	---
2	description: Use the preview dev flow interface to inspect one repository and apply revision-bound lifecycle, adoption, removal, retirement, and remote-evidence plans.
3	authority: project
4	status: evolving
5	verified_on: 2026-09-01
6	---
7	
8	# Repository lifecycle flow
9	
10	`dev flow [repo]` is a preview-labelled, full-screen, TTY-only interface for one
11	repository's lifecycle. It is independent of the six-view `dev tui` dashboard:
12	its only job is to show repository surfaces, observed evidence, and exact guarded
13	actions.
14	
15	```bash
16	dev flow              # current repository, or a picker outside Git
17	dev flow api          # explicit repository overrides cwd
18	```
19	
20	From either the canonical checkout or a linked worktree, bare `dev flow` resolves
21	the canonical Git common-directory identity and focuses the exact current
22	surface. Outside Git it loads a filterable repository picker asynchronously. A
23	repository that is referenced by task metadata but temporarily unavailable
24	remains inspectable as unavailable task-only rows.
25	
26	## Repository surfaces
27	
28	The left panel starts from every record in `git worktree list --porcelain`, then
29	adds task records that have no checkout. Normal COLD and DONE tasks therefore do
30	not disappear merely because no directory exists.
31	
32	| Row kind | Meaning | Guarded actions |
33	|---|---|---|
34	| `canonical` | the worktree Git marks Main, regardless of branch name | legal task actions when exactly bound; never checkout removal |
35	| `managed` | a non-main checkout with one exact task binding | mode/state lifecycle actions |
36	| `unmanaged` | a registered linked checkout with no task or harness claim | Adopt; clean branch-preserving Remove Checkout |
37	| `harness` | strict path evidence places it under `.claude/worktrees` | inspect and eligible remote evidence only; harness owns cleanup |
38	| `task-only` | task metadata has no registered checkout, normally COLD or DONE | Resume or Retire only when exact task identity permits it |
39	| `conflict` | duplicate claims, mismatched identity, incomplete inventory, or other ambiguity | inspect/remediate; destructive actions fail closed |
40	
41	A branch name prefix is not harness ownership proof. Canonical, harness-owned,
42	locked/prunable, detached, ambiguously claimed, or incompletely observed rows are
43	never treated as removable merely because they look inactive.
44	
45	For an eligible unmanaged row:
46	
47	- **Adopt** creates one worktree-mode task record and does not change checkout
48	  content, refs, runtime layout, or path. A dirty checkout may be adopted because
49	  its bytes remain untouched. Fresh strict runtime evidence may derive HOT only
50	  for one stable shell-only covering session with no recognized agent; otherwise
51	  adoption is WARM. `runtime=none` is unobserved, so it derives WARM.
52	- **Remove Checkout** requires an exact named clean linked checkout, complete task
53	  inventory with no claims, ready artifacts, safe external runtime cleanup, and
54	  no harness evidence. It uses non-force removal and verifies that the local
55	  branch remains at the same OID.
56	
57	Repository-wide prune and drift reconciliation are not hidden Remove variants.
58	The flow reports those conditions and leaves them for explicit recovery.
59	
60	## Intent, facts, and plans
61	
62	The three panels keep different kinds of truth separate:
63	
64	1. **Persisted intent** — task mode, HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE, owner, next action,
65	   branch/base, expected checkout, and runtime hint.
66	2. **Observed facts** — repository/worktree identity, HEAD and refs, Git status and
67	   in-progress operations, artifact readiness, runtime sessions, and recognized
68	   agents. A fact remains known, unknown, error, skipped, loading, or stale; a
69	   failed observation never becomes false, clean, or closed.
70	3. **Guarded plan** — legal source/target edge, READY/NEEDS INPUT/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN/
71	   ERROR availability, ordered conditions and effects, remediation, resources
72	   retained, confirmation class, PlanID, and CLI fallback.
73	
74	`runtime=none` cannot observe session or agent occupancy. That does not turn the
75	observation into “closed,” but a complete local Git/task snapshot can still be
76	fresh and useful for non-runtime facts.
77	
78	## Managed lifecycle choices
79	
80	Actions are concrete variants, not a generic force menu:
81	
82	| Current intent | Flow choices |
83	|---|---|
84	| HOT/WARM worktree or branch task | Park Warm; Park Cold; Park Cold + Push; Complete FF; Review Handoff; Verify Merged |
85	| HOT/WARM direct task | Park Warm; Complete Direct |
86	| WARM task | Resume (with an explicit fetch effect) |
87	| COLD worktree/branch task | Resume and reconstruct/reopen; completion remains unavailable until HOT |
88	| DONE task | Retire (Keep Branch); for eligible non-direct tasks, Retire + Delete Contained Branch |
89	
90	Review Handoff publishes the branch and creates a pull/merge request when the
91	available provider supports it, but preserves HOT/WARM. Direct/FF/verified
92	completion writes DONE last and keeps branch, checkout, and runtime resources.
93	Retire is the separate externally safe close/wait/remove/task-reap operation.
94	
95	The preview always uses a fail-on-dirty completion policy. It intentionally does
96	not expose dirty commit/discard, WIP checkpoint, shared-writer, ownership
97	takeover, force removal, `--close-unknown`, or `--assume-no-runtime` choices.
98	Blocked plans show the precise evidence, remediation, and compatible CLI
99	fallback instead of manufacturing an override.
100	
101	## Keys and approval
102	
103	```text
104	j/k or up/down       select a surface or picker/menu row
105	h/l or left/right    select an already-concrete action
106	Tab / Shift-Tab      move panel focus
107	/                    filter the repository picker
108	Enter                build and inspect a plan; never apply immediately
109	y                    approve a READY non-typed plan
110	r                    reload local facts only
111	R                    choose Fetch Refs, Query Review, or Both
112	?                    show evidence and key semantics
113	Esc                  back out
114	q                    quit; while Apply runs, queue quit until its ledger returns
115	```
116	
117	Typed retirement displays the exact `DELETE <branch>` token; type it and press
118	Enter. A mismatch remains non-mutating. Plans that are not READY have no Apply
119	path and remain open for inspection.
120	
121	## Local and manual remote evidence
122	
123	Startup and `r` do not fetch or contact a forge. Network work happens only in a
124	confirmed action that declares it: Resume fetch, Park Cold + Push, Review
125	Handoff, or one of the `R` choices.
126	
127	`R` supplies three independent plan variants:
128	
129	- **Fetch Refs** runs `git fetch --prune` for the exact configured remote.
130	- **Query Review** asks the supported GitHub, GitLab, or Azure CLI for the exact
131	  head/base relationship without fetching.
132	- **Both** fetches first, then queries; if fetch fails, review is not attempted.
133	
134	Remote results live only for the current flow run. Ref evidence contains exact
135	named-ref OIDs or explicit absence/error. Portable review evidence contains only
136	existence, provider state (open/draft/merged/closed), draft flag, URL, provider,
137	and observation time. Unsupported providers, missing CLIs/extensions,
138	authentication/provider failures, malformed or multiple matches, and
139	not-yet-requested evidence stay UNKNOWN or ERROR. The flow does not query or
140	infer review decisions, approvals, comments, or checks.
141	
142	## Plan and Apply revalidation
143	
144	Planning is side-effect-free. A plan seals the task record revision and exact
145	repository, Git common directory, checkout path/branch/HEAD, refs, status,
146	runtime/agent occupancy, artifacts, remote identity, concrete options, and
147	ordered effects into an authority fingerprint and PlanID.
148	
149	Apply accepts only a plan produced by the current flow run and an approval bound
150	to that PlanID. It locks repository then task state, reloads the task revision,
151	re-observes authority, and rejects any difference before a new effect. Safety-
152	critical checks repeat after runtime closure and immediately before checkout or
153	branch removal. Task state is written last; retirement deletes the DONE record
154	last.
155	
156	Apply is not canceled by refresh, row switching, or quit. Conflicting navigation
157	is disabled, and quit/refresh waits for the result. The result ledger preserves
158	every attempted/completed/failed effect plus warnings and recovery. Partial
159	success means completed effects remain completed; no rollback is implied. A new
160	local generation loads afterward, and directory/runtime/URL handoff occurs only
161	after the alternate screen exits.
162	
163	## Compatibility boundary
164	
165	The same `internal/taskflow` authority backs normal task-managed park, resume,
166	completion, and retirement commands plus exact unmanaged linked-checkout Adopt
167	and Remove paths. Existing CLI flags and structured output remain compatible,
168	including expert acknowledgements that the preview does not offer.
169	
170	This is not a claim that every historical cleanup path has migrated. Explicit
171	unmanaged path retirement remains an isolated compatibility implementation, and
172	`sweep` retains record-only, orphan-salvage, and other narrowly scoped
173	reconciliation paths outside taskflow. `sweep` still reports before applying.
174	
175	Raw Git and configured external TUI tools do not participate in dev's task locks,
176	PlanID approval, identity revalidation, or result ledger. They remain available,
177	but they are outside dev-mediated safety guarantees.
178

22	
23	## Repository surfaces
24	
25	左側 panel 先採用 `git worktree list --porcelain` 的每一筆 record，再加入沒有 checkout 的 task records。因此，正常 COLD 與 DONE tasks 不會只因 directory 不存在就消失。
26	
27	| Row kind | 意義 | Guarded actions |
28	|---|---|---|
29	| `canonical` | Git 標示為 Main 的 worktree，不受 branch name 影響 | Exact 綁定時提供合法 task actions；絕不移除 checkout |
30	| `managed` | 有一筆 exact task binding 的 non-main checkout | 依 mode/state 提供 lifecycle actions |
31	| `unmanaged` | 沒有 task 或 harness claim 的 registered linked checkout | Adopt；對 clean checkout 執行保留 branch 的 Remove Checkout |
32	| `harness` | Strict path evidence 顯示它位於 `.claude/worktrees` 下 | 僅供 inspect，以及符合條件時取得 remote evidence；cleanup 由 harness 負責 |
33	| `task-only` | Task metadata 沒有 registered checkout，通常是 COLD 或 DONE | 只有 exact task identity 允許時才能 Resume 或 Retire |
34	| `conflict` | Duplicate claims、mismatched identity、incomplete inventory 或其他 ambiguity | Inspect/remediate；destructive actions fail closed |
35	
36	Branch name prefix 不是 harness ownership proof。Canonical、harness-owned、locked/prunable、detached、被 ambiguous claim 或 observation 不完整的 row，不會只因看似 inactive 就被視為可移除。
37	
38	符合條件的 unmanaged row：
39	
40	- **Adopt** 建立一筆 worktree-mode task record，不改 checkout content、refs、runtime layout 或 path。Dirty checkout 仍可 adopt，因為其 bytes 保持原狀。只有 fresh strict runtime evidence 證明恰有一個 stable、shell-only covering session，且沒有 recognized agent 時，才能 derive HOT；其他情況 adoption 都是 WARM。`runtime=none` 屬於 unobserved，因此 derive WARM。
41	- **Remove Checkout** 要求 exact named clean linked checkout、完整且沒有 claim 的 task inventory、ready artifacts、可從外部安全 cleanup 的 runtime，以及沒有 harness evidence。它以 non-force 方式移除，並驗證 local branch 仍在相同 OID。
42	
43	Repository-wide prune 與 drift reconciliation 不是隱藏的 Remove variants。Flow 會回報這些 conditions，留待明確 recovery。
44	
45	## Intent、facts 與 plans
46	
47	三個 panels 刻意分開不同種類的 truth：
48	
49	1. **Persisted intent** — task mode、HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE、owner、next action、branch/base、expected checkout 與 runtime hint。
50	2. **Observed facts** — repository/worktree identity、HEAD 與 refs、Git status 與進行中的 operations、artifact readiness、runtime sessions 與 recognized agents。Fact 會維持 known、unknown、error、skipped、loading 或 stale；failed observation 絕不會變成 false、clean 或 closed。
51	3. **Guarded plan** — 合法的 source/target edge、READY/NEEDS INPUT/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN/ERROR availability、ordered conditions/effects、remediation、retained resources、confirmation class、PlanID 與 CLI fallback。
52	
53	`runtime=none` 無法觀察 session 或 agent occupancy。這不會把 observation 變成「closed」，但完整的 local Git/task snapshot 仍可對 non-runtime facts 提供 fresh 且有用的資訊。
54	
55	## Managed lifecycle choices
56	
57	Actions 是具體 variants，不是 generic force menu：
58	
59	| Current intent | Flow choices |
60	|---|---|
61	| HOT/WARM worktree 或 branch task | Park Warm；Park Cold；Park Cold + Push；Complete FF；Review Handoff；Verify Merged |
62	| HOT/WARM direct task | Park Warm；Complete Direct |
63	| WARM task | Resume（包含明確 fetch effect） |
64	| COLD worktree/branch task | Resume 並 reconstruct/reopen；回到 HOT 前不能 completion |
65	| DONE task | Retire (Keep Branch)；符合條件的 non-direct task 另有 Retire + Delete Contained Branch |
66	
67	Review Handoff 會 publish branch，且 available provider 支援時會建立 pull/merge request，但仍保留 HOT/WARM。Direct/FF/verified completion 最後寫入 DONE，並保留 branch、checkout 與 runtime resources。Retire 才是另一個可從外部安全執行的 close/wait/remove/task-reap operation。
68	
69	Preview 一律使用 dirty 時 fail 的 completion policy。它刻意不提供 dirty commit/discard、WIP checkpoint、shared-writer、ownership takeover、force removal、`--close-unknown` 或 `--assume-no-runtime` choices。Blocked plan 會顯示精確 evidence、remediation 與相容的 CLI fallback，不會憑空製造 override。
70	
71	## Keys 與 approval
72	
73	```text
74	j/k 或 up/down         選擇 surface 或 picker/menu row
75	h/l 或 left/right      選擇已具體化的 action
76	Tab / Shift-Tab        移動 panel focus
77	/                      過濾 repository picker
78	Enter                  建立並檢查 plan；絕不立即 apply
79	y                      核准 READY 且非 typed 的 plan
80	r                      只重新載入 local facts
81	R                      選擇 Fetch Refs、Query Review 或 Both
82	?                      顯示 evidence 與 key semantics
83	Esc                    返回上一層
84	q                      離開；Apply 執行中會排隊，等 ledger 返回後才離開
85	```
86	
87	Typed retirement 會顯示 exact `DELETE <branch>` token；輸入後按 Enter。任何 mismatch 都不會 mutation。不是 READY 的 plans 沒有 Apply path，但仍維持開啟供檢查。
88	
89	## Local 與 manual remote evidence
90	
91	Startup 與 `r` 不會 fetch 或聯絡 forge。只有已確認且明確宣告的 action 才執行 network work：Resume fetch、Park Cold + Push、Review Handoff，或其中一個 `R` choice。
92	
93	`R` 提供三種獨立 plan variant：
94	
95	- **Fetch Refs** 對 exact configured remote 執行 `git fetch --prune`。
96	- **Query Review** 不 fetch，向支援的 GitHub、GitLab 或 Azure CLI 查詢 exact head/base relationship。
97	- **Both** 先 fetch 再 query；fetch 失敗時不會嘗試 review query。
98	
99	Remote result 只存在於目前 flow run。Ref evidence 包含 exact named-ref OIDs，或明確 absence/error。Portable review evidence 只包含 existence、provider state（open/draft/merged/closed）、draft flag、URL、provider 與 observation time。Unsupported provider、missing CLI/extension、authentication/provider failure、malformed 或 multiple matches，以及尚未要求取得的 evidence，都維持 UNKNOWN 或 ERROR。Flow 不會 query 或推斷 review decisions、approvals、comments 或 checks。
100	
101	## Plan 與 Apply revalidation
102	
103	Planning 不產生 side effect。Plan 會將 task record revision，以及 exact repository、Git common directory、checkout path/branch/HEAD、refs、status、runtime/agent occupancy、artifacts、remote identity、concrete options 與 ordered effects，封入 authority fingerprint 與 PlanID。
104	
105	Apply 只接受目前 flow run 產生的 plan，以及綁定該 PlanID 的 approval。它依序鎖定 repository 與 task state、重新載入 task revision、重新 observe authority，且只要出現差異，就會在新 effect 前拒絕。Safety-critical checks 會在 runtime closure 後，以及 checkout 或 branch removal 前立即重做。Task state 最後才寫入；retirement 最後才刪除 DONE record。
106	
107	Refresh、切換 row 或 quit 都不會取消 Apply。互相衝突的 navigation 會停用，quit/refresh 則等待 result。Result ledger 保存每一個 attempted/completed/failed effect，以及 warnings 與 recovery。Partial success 表示 completed effects 維持完成；不暗示 rollback。之後會載入新的 local generation，directory/runtime/URL handoff 也只在 alternate screen 結束後發生。
108	
109	## Compatibility boundary
110	
111	同一個 `internal/taskflow` authority 支援一般 task-managed park、resume、completion 與 retirement commands，以及 exact unmanaged linked-checkout 的 Adopt/Remove paths。既有 CLI flags 與 structured output 維持相容，包括 preview 不提供的 expert acknowledgements。
112	
113	這不表示每一條 historical cleanup path 都已 migrate。Explicit unmanaged path retirement 仍是隔離的 compatibility implementation；`sweep` 的 record-only、orphan-salvage 與其他 narrowly scoped reconciliation paths 也仍在 taskflow 之外。`sweep` 仍維持先回報再套用。
114	
115	Raw Git 與 configured external TUI tools 不參與 dev 的 task locks、PlanID approval、identity revalidation 或 result ledger。這些工具仍可使用，但位於 dev-mediated safety guarantees 之外。

140	+### Repository lifecycle flow
141	+
142	+Source: https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/guides/repository-flow/
143	+
144	+> Use the preview dev flow interface to inspect one repository and apply revision-bound lifecycle, adoption, removal, retirement, and remote-evidence plans.
145	+
146	+`dev flow [repo]` is a preview-labelled, full-screen, TTY-only interface for one
147	+repository's lifecycle. It is independent of the six-view `dev tui` dashboard:
148	+its only job is to show repository surfaces, observed evidence, and exact guarded
149	+actions.
150	+
151	+```bash
152	+dev flow              # current repository, or a picker outside Git
153	+dev flow api          # explicit repository overrides cwd
154	+```
155	+
156	+From either the canonical checkout or a linked worktree, bare `dev flow` resolves
157	+the canonical Git common-directory identity and focuses the exact current
158	+surface. Outside Git it loads a filterable repository picker asynchronously. A
159	+repository that is referenced by task metadata but temporarily unavailable
160	+remains inspectable as unavailable task-only rows.
161	+
162	+## Repository surfaces
163	+
164	+The left panel starts from every record in `git worktree list --porcelain`, then
165	+adds task records that have no checkout. Normal COLD and DONE tasks therefore do
166	+not disappear merely because no directory exists.
167	+
168	+| Row kind | Meaning | Guarded actions |
169	+|---|---|---|
170	+| `canonical` | the worktree Git marks Main, regardless of branch name | legal task actions when exactly bound; never checkout removal |
171	+| `managed` | a non-main checkout with one exact task binding | mode/state lifecycle actions |
172	+| `unmanaged` | a registered linked checkout with no task or harness claim | Adopt; clean branch-preserving Remove Checkout |
173	+| `harness` | strict path evidence places it under `.claude/worktrees` | inspect and eligible remote evidence only; harness owns cleanup |
174	+| `task-only` | task metadata has no registered checkout, normally COLD or DONE | Resume or Retire only when exact task identity permits it |
175	+| `conflict` | duplicate claims, mismatched identity, incomplete inventory, or other ambiguity | inspect/remediate; destructive actions fail closed |
176	+
177	+A branch name prefix is not harness ownership proof. Canonical, harness-owned,
178	+locked/prunable, detached, ambiguously claimed, or incompletely observed rows are
179	+never treated as removable merely because they look inactive.
180	+
181	+For an eligible unmanaged row:
182	+
183	+- **Adopt** creates one worktree-mode task record and does not change checkout
184	+  content, refs, runtime layout, or path. A dirty checkout may be adopted because
185	+  its bytes remain untouched. Fresh strict runtime evidence may derive HOT only
186	+  for one stable shell-only covering session with no recognized agent; otherwise
187	+  adoption is WARM. `runtime=none` is unobserved, so it derives WARM.
188	+- **Remove Checkout** requires an exact named clean linked checkout, complete task
189	+  inventory with no claims, ready artifacts, safe external runtime cleanup, and
190	+  no harness evidence. It uses non-force removal and verifies that the local
191	+  branch remains at the same OID.
192	+
193	+Repository-wide prune and drift reconciliation are not hidden Remove variants.
194	+The flow reports those conditions and leaves them for explicit recovery.
195	+
196	+## Intent, facts, and plans
197	+
198	+The three panels keep different kinds of truth separate:
199	+
200	+1. **Persisted intent** — task mode, HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE, owner, next action,
201	+   branch/base, expected checkout, and runtime hint.
202	+2. **Observed facts** — repository/worktree identity, HEAD and refs, Git status and
203	+   in-progress operations, artifact readiness, runtime sessions, and recognized
204	+   agents. A fact remains known, unknown, error, skipped, loading, or stale; a
205	+   failed observation never becomes false, clean, or closed.
206	+3. **Guarded plan** — legal source/target edge, READY/NEEDS INPUT/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN/
207	+   ERROR availability, ordered conditions and effects, remediation, resources
208	+   retained, confirmation class, PlanID, and CLI fallback.
209	+
210	+`runtime=none` cannot observe session or agent occupancy. That does not turn the
211	+observation into “closed,” but a complete local Git/task snapshot can still be
212	+fresh and useful for non-runtime facts.
213	+
214	+## Managed lifecycle choices
215	+
216	+Actions are concrete variants, not a generic force menu:
217	+
218	+| Current intent | Flow choices |
219	+|---|---|
220	+| HOT/WARM worktree or branch task | Park Warm; Park Cold; Park Cold + Push; Complete FF; Review Handoff; Verify Merged |
221	+| HOT/WARM direct task | Park Warm; Complete Direct |
222	+| WARM task | Resume (with an explicit fetch effect) |
223	+| COLD worktree/branch task | Resume and reconstruct/reopen; completion remains unavailable until HOT |
224	+| DONE task | Retire (Keep Branch); for eligible non-direct tasks, Retire + Delete Contained Branch |
225	+
226	+Review Handoff publishes the branch and creates a pull/merge request when the
227	+available provider supports it, but preserves HOT/WARM. Direct/FF/verified
228	+completion writes DONE last and keeps branch, checkout, and runtime resources.
229	+Retire is the separate externally safe close/wait/remove/task-reap operation.
230	+
231	+The preview always uses a fail-on-dirty completion policy. It intentionally does
232	+not expose dirty commit/discard, WIP checkpoint, shared-writer, ownership
233	+takeover, force removal, `--close-unknown`, or `--assume-no-runtime` choices.
234	+Blocked plans show the precise evidence, remediation, and compatible CLI
235	+fallback instead of manufacturing an override.
236	+
237	+## Keys and approval
238	+
239	+```text
240	+j/k or up/down       select a surface or picker/menu row
241	+h/l or left/right    select an already-concrete action
242	+Tab / Shift-Tab      move panel focus
243	+/                    filter the repository picker
244	+Enter                build and inspect a plan; never apply immediately
245	+y                    approve a READY non-typed plan
246	+r                    reload local facts only
247	+R                    choose Fetch Refs, Query Review, or Both
248	+?                    show evidence and key semantics
249	+Esc                  back out
250	+q                    quit; while Apply runs, queue quit until its ledger returns
251	+```
252	+
253	+Typed retirement displays the exact `DELETE <branch>` token; type it and press
254	+Enter. A mismatch remains non-mutating. Plans that are not READY have no Apply
255	+path and remain open for inspection.
256	+
257	+## Local and manual remote evidence
258	+
259	+Startup and `r` do not fetch or contact a forge. Network work happens only in a
260	+confirmed action that declares it: Resume fetch, Park Cold + Push, Review
261	+Handoff, or one of the `R` choices.
262	+
263	+`R` supplies three independent plan variants:
264	+
265	+- **Fetch Refs** runs `git fetch --prune` for the exact configured remote.
266	+- **Query Review** asks the supported GitHub, GitLab, or Azure CLI for the exact
267	+  head/base relationship without fetching.
268	+- **Both** fetches first, then queries; if fetch fails, review is not attempted.
269	+
270	+Remote results live only for the current flow run. Ref evidence contains exact
271	+named-ref OIDs or explicit absence/error. Portable review evidence contains only
272	+existence, provider state (open/draft/merged/closed), draft flag, URL, provider,
273	+and observation time. Unsupported providers, missing CLIs/extensions,
274	+authentication/provider failures, malformed or multiple matches, and
275	+not-yet-requested evidence stay UNKNOWN or ERROR. The flow does not query or
276	+infer review decisions, approvals, comments, or checks.
277	+
278	+## Plan and Apply revalidation
279	+
280	+Planning is side-effect-free. A plan seals the task record revision and exact
281	+repository, Git common directory, checkout path/branch/HEAD, refs, status,
282	+runtime/agent occupancy, artifacts, remote identity, concrete options, and
283	+ordered effects into an authority fingerprint and PlanID.
284	+
285	+Apply accepts only a plan produced by the current flow run and an approval bound
286	+to that PlanID. It locks repository then task state, reloads the task revision,
287	+re-observes authority, and rejects any difference before a new effect. Safety-
288	+critical checks repeat after runtime closure and immediately before checkout or
289	+branch removal. Task state is written last; retirement deletes the DONE record
290	+last.
291	+
292	+Apply is not canceled by refresh, row switching, or quit. Conflicting navigation
293	+is disabled, and quit/refresh waits for the result. The result ledger preserves
294	+every attempted/completed/failed effect plus warnings and recovery. Partial
295	+success means completed effects remain completed; no rollback is implied. A new
296	+local generation loads afterward, and directory/runtime/URL handoff occurs only
297	+after the alternate screen exits.
298	+
299	+## Compatibility boundary
300	+
301	+The same `internal/taskflow` authority backs normal task-managed park, resume,
302	+completion, and retirement commands plus exact unmanaged linked-checkout Adopt
303	+and Remove paths. Existing CLI flags and structured output remain compatible,
304	+including expert acknowledgements that the preview does not offer.
305	+
306	+This is not a claim that every historical cleanup path has migrated. Explicit
307	+unmanaged path retirement remains an isolated compatibility implementation, and
308	+`sweep` retains record-only, orphan-salvage, and other narrowly scoped
309	+reconciliation paths outside taskflow. `sweep` still reports before applying.
310	+
311	+Raw Git and configured external TUI tools do not participate in dev's task locks,
312	+PlanID approval, identity revalidation, or result ledger. They remain available,
313	+but they are outside dev-mediated safety guarantees.
314	+

567	+## Intent、evidence 與 action readiness
568	+
569	+Lifecycle state 只保存人類意圖，不會吸收所有外部事實。`dev flow [repo]` 把三層並列：recorded `HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE` intent、具 freshness 的 Git/runtime/agent/artifact/remote evidence，以及綁定 exact identity 的 guarded plan。`READY` 是某份 plan 的 action readiness；`REVIEW`、`MERGED` 與 `RETIRED` 是 result milestones，皆不是額外 TOML state。UNKNOWN/ERROR evidence 不會被當成 clean、closed 或 absent。完整操作方式見 [Repository Flow 預覽](https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/zh-TW/guides/repository-flow/)。

739	+
740	+| Row kind | 意義 | Guarded actions |
741	+|---|---|---|
742	+| `canonical` | Git 標示為 Main 的 worktree，不受 branch name 影響 | Exact 綁定時提供合法 task actions；絕不移除 checkout |
743	+| `managed` | 有一筆 exact task binding 的 non-main checkout | 依 mode/state 提供 lifecycle actions |
744	+| `unmanaged` | 沒有 task 或 harness claim 的 registered linked checkout | Adopt；對 clean checkout 執行保留 branch 的 Remove Checkout |
745	+| `harness` | Strict path evidence 顯示它位於 `.claude/worktrees` 下 | 僅供 inspect，以及符合條件時取得 remote evidence；cleanup 由 harness 負責 |
746	+| `task-only` | Task metadata 沒有 registered checkout，通常是 COLD 或 DONE | 只有 exact task identity 允許時才能 Resume 或 Retire |
747	+| `conflict` | Duplicate claims、mismatched identity、incomplete inventory 或其他 ambiguity | Inspect/remediate；destructive actions fail closed |

749	+Branch name prefix 不是 harness ownership proof。Canonical、harness-owned、locked/prunable、detached、被 ambiguous claim 或 observation 不完整的 row，不會只因看似 inactive 就被視為可移除。

22	func newRetireCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

33	
34	Run this from outside the target worktree and runtime. dev re-resolves every
35	covering session, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, waits for
36	runtime closure, revalidates Git state, and only then removes a linked worktree
37	without force. A task is deleted only after every requested cleanup step works.
38	
39	Unknown runtime status fails closed. An external coordinator may acknowledge it
40	with --close-unknown; working, blocked and waiting agents are never overridden.`,

45				if err != nil {
46					return err
47				}
48				if target.Task != nil {
49					return retireTaskWithTaskflow(ctx, app, target.Task, flow.RetireOptions{
50						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime,
51						DeleteBranch: deleteBranch, Timeout: timeout,
52					}, cmd.Flags().Changed("delete-branch") && deleteBranch)
53				}
54				return retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility(ctx, app, target.Path, closeUnknown,
55					assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranch, timeout)
56			},

67	func resolveRetireCommandTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (retireCommandTarget, error) {
68		if len(args) == 1 {
69			expanded := config.Expand(args[0])
70			if info, statErr := os.Stat(expanded); statErr == nil && info.IsDir() {
71				return retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx, app, expanded)
72			}
73			candidate, err := app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
74			if err != nil {
75				return retireCommandTarget{}, err
76			}
77			return retireCommandTarget{Task: candidate}, nil
78		}
79	
80		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
81		if err != nil {
82			return retireCommandTarget{}, err
83		}
84		return retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx, app, cwd)
85	}
86	
87	func retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx context.Context, app *App, path string) (retireCommandTarget, error) {
88		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
89		if err != nil {
90			return retireCommandTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
91		}
92		candidate, err := exactTaskForRetirementCheckout(app, repository.Root)
93		if err != nil {
94			return retireCommandTarget{}, err
95		}
96		if candidate != nil {
97			return retireCommandTarget{Task: candidate}, nil
98		}
99		return retireCommandTarget{Path: repository.Root}, nil
100	}
101	
102	func exactTaskForRetirementCheckout(app *App, checkout string) (*task.Task, error) {
103		canonicalCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize retirement checkout %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
106		}
107		records, _, err := app.Tasks.ListRecords()
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111		var matched *task.Task
112		for _, record := range records {
113			candidate := record.Task
114			if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == "" {
115				// A COLD/DONE worktree task with no checkout does not claim the
116				// canonical repository merely because checkoutOf falls back there.
117				continue
118			}
119			candidateCheckout, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(checkoutOf(&candidate))
120			if canonicalErr != nil || candidateCheckout != canonicalCheckout {
121				continue
122			}
123			if matched != nil {
124				return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkout %s is claimed by multiple tasks (%s, %s); name one explicitly or reconcile task metadata",
125					config.Contract(canonicalCheckout), matched.ID, candidate.ID)
126			}
127			matched = &candidate
128		}
129		return matched, nil
130	}
131	
132	func retireTaskWithTaskflow(
133		ctx context.Context,
134		app *App,
135		selected *task.Task,
136		options flow.RetireOptions,
137		authorizeBranchDeletion bool,
138	) error {
139		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) { return selected, nil })
140		if err != nil {
141			return err
142		}
143		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
144		if err != nil {
145			return err
146		}
147		approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
148		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
149			if !authorizeBranchDeletion {
150				return fmt.Errorf("%s requires its exact typed confirmation", plan.Summary)
151			}
152			approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
153		}
154		result, applyErr := session.apply(ctx, plan, approval)
155		if applyErr != nil {
156			renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
157			return presentLifecycleApplyError(plan, applyErr)
158		}
159		if err := session.requireRetired(app, result); err != nil {
160			return err
161		}
162	
163		style := app.outStyle()
164		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", style.success("RETIRED"), config.Contract(checkoutOf(selected)))
165		renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
166		return nil
167	}
168	
169	// retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility preserves the contained-only path contract
170	// while routing every mutation through taskflow's exact unmanaged transaction.
171	func retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility(
172		ctx context.Context,
173		app *App,
174		path string,
175		closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranch bool,
176		timeout time.Duration,
177	) error {
178		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
179		if err != nil {
180			return fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
181		}
182		if !repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
183			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a linked worktree; retire explicit paths only from their linked checkout", config.Contract(path))
184		}
185		locator, err := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, repository.Root)
186		if err != nil {
187			return err
188		}
189		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.MainRoot)
190		if base == "" {
191			return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove unmanaged retirement without an explicit repository default branch")
192		}
193		execution, err := executeNonTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
194			RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base, DeleteContainedBranch: deleteBranch,
195			CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
196		}, deleteBranch)
197		if err != nil {
198			return err
199		}
200		if execution.Result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneNone {
201			return fmt.Errorf("unmanaged retirement returned unexpected milestone %s", execution.Result.Milestone)
202		}
203		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", app.outStyle().success("RETIRED"), config.Contract(locator.CheckoutPath))
204		return nil
205	}

751	+符合條件的 unmanaged row：

753	+- **Adopt** 建立一筆 worktree-mode task record，不改 checkout content、refs、runtime layout 或 path。Dirty checkout 仍可 adopt，因為其 bytes 保持原狀。只有 fresh strict runtime evidence 證明恰有一個 stable、shell-only covering session，且沒有 recognized agent 時，才能 derive HOT；其他情況 adoption 都是 WARM。`runtime=none` 屬於 unobserved，因此 derive WARM。
754	+- **Remove Checkout** 要求 exact named clean linked checkout、完整且沒有 claim 的 task inventory、ready artifacts、可從外部安全 cleanup 的 runtime，以及沒有 harness evidence。它以 non-force 方式移除，並驗證 local branch 仍在相同 OID。
755	+
756	+Repository-wide prune 與 drift reconciliation 不是隱藏的 Remove variants。Flow 會回報這些 conditions，留待明確 recovery。
757	+
758	+## Intent、facts 與 plans
759	+
760	+三個 panels 刻意分開不同種類的 truth：
761	+
762	+1. **Persisted intent** — task mode、HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE、owner、next action、branch/base、expected checkout 與 runtime hint。
763	+2. **Observed facts** — repository/worktree identity、HEAD 與 refs、Git status 與進行中的 operations、artifact readiness、runtime sessions 與 recognized agents。Fact 會維持 known、unknown、error、skipped、loading 或 stale；failed observation 絕不會變成 false、clean 或 closed。
764	+3. **Guarded plan** — 合法的 source/target edge、READY/NEEDS INPUT/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN/ERROR availability、ordered conditions/effects、remediation、retained resources、confirmation class、PlanID 與 CLI fallback。
765	+
766	+`runtime=none` 無法觀察 session 或 agent occupancy。這不會把 observation 變成「closed」，但完整的 local Git/task snapshot 仍可對 non-runtime facts 提供 fresh 且有用的資訊。
767	+
768	+## Managed lifecycle choices
769	+
770	+Actions 是具體 variants，不是 generic force menu：
771	+
772	+| Current intent | Flow choices |
773	+|---|---|
774	+| HOT/WARM worktree 或 branch task | Park Warm；Park Cold；Park Cold + Push；Complete FF；Review Handoff；Verify Merged |
775	+| HOT/WARM direct task | Park Warm；Complete Direct |
776	+| WARM task | Resume（包含明確 fetch effect） |
777	+| COLD worktree/branch task | Resume 並 reconstruct/reopen；回到 HOT 前不能 completion |
778	+| DONE task | Retire (Keep Branch)；符合條件的 non-direct task 另有 Retire + Delete Contained Branch |
779	+
780	+Review Handoff 會 publish branch，且 available provider 支援時會建立 pull/merge request，但仍保留 HOT/WARM。Direct/FF/verified completion 最後寫入 DONE，並保留 branch、checkout 與 runtime resources。Retire 才是另一個可從外部安全執行的 close/wait/remove/task-reap operation。
781	+
782	+Preview 一律使用 dirty 時 fail 的 completion policy。它刻意不提供 dirty commit/discard、WIP checkpoint、shared-writer、ownership takeover、force removal、`--close-unknown` 或 `--assume-no-runtime` choices。Blocked plan 會顯示精確 evidence、remediation 與相容的 CLI fallback，不會憑空製造 override。

785	+

787	+j/k 或 up/down         選擇 surface 或 picker/menu row

793	+r                      只重新載入 local facts
794	+R                      選擇 Fetch Refs、Query Review 或 Both
795	+?                      顯示 evidence 與 key semantics
796	+Esc                    返回上一層
797	+q                      離開；Apply 執行中會排隊，等 ledger 返回後才離開
