802	+## Local 與 manual remote evidence
803	+
804	+Startup 與 `r` 不會 fetch 或聯絡 forge。只有已確認且明確宣告的 action 才執行 network work：Resume fetch、Park Cold + Push、Review Handoff，或其中一個 `R` choice。
805	+

808	+- **Fetch Refs** 對 exact configured remote 執行 `git fetch --prune`。

810	+- **Both** 先 fetch 再 query；fetch 失敗時不會嘗試 review query。
811	+
812	+Remote result 只存在於目前 flow run。Ref evidence 包含 exact named-ref OIDs，或明確 absence/error。Portable review evidence 只包含 existence、provider state（open/draft/merged/closed）、draft flag、URL、provider 與 observation time。Unsupported provider、missing CLI/extension、authentication/provider failure、malformed 或 multiple matches，以及尚未要求取得的 evidence，都維持 UNKNOWN 或 ERROR。Flow 不會 query 或推斷 review decisions、approvals、comments 或 checks。

815	+
816	+Planning 不產生 side effect。Plan 會將 task record revision，以及 exact repository、Git common directory、checkout path/branch/HEAD、refs、status、runtime/agent occupancy、artifacts、remote identity、concrete options 與 ordered effects，封入 authority fingerprint 與 PlanID。

824	+同一個 `internal/taskflow` authority 支援一般 task-managed park、resume、completion 與 retirement commands，以及 exact unmanaged linked-checkout 的 Adopt/Remove paths。既有 CLI flags 與 structured output 維持相容，包括 preview 不提供的 expert acknowledgements。

893	+## Flow 中的 DONE 與 Retire
894	+
895	+`dev flow` 把 persisted `DONE` intent 與 live cleanup evidence 分開。DONE/MERGED row 仍可顯示 runtime、worktree、branch 與 task record；只有 Retire result 完成最後的 CAS task deletion 才是 RETIRED。UNMANAGED row 使用的是永遠保留 branch 的 Remove Checkout，不會製造 DONE/RETIRED task milestone；canonical 與 harness row 不能 Remove Checkout。
896	+
897	+Flow TUI 沒有 `--close-unknown`、`--assume-no-runtime`、dirty discard 或 generic force。`runtime=none` 會保留「session/agent unobserved」，不冒充已證明 closed。需要 expert acknowledgement 時，離開 Flow 並明確執行 plan 顯示的 fallback CLI，再接受該 command 自己的 guards。完整 row/action matrix 見 [Repository Flow 預覽](https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/zh-TW/guides/repository-flow/)。

904	 `--close-unknown` 與 `--assume-no-runtime` 只放寬 fail-closed 的*觀測結果*（無法讀取的 status、無法列舉的 runtime list）。這兩個 flag 都絕不會 bypass caller containment 或 active-agent state。`retirement.Service.Retire` 在 runtime session 關閉後，也會重新驗證 target identity、Git ancestry、進行中的 Git operation（`gitx.InProgress`，檢查 `MERGE_HEAD`、`CHERRY_PICK_HEAD`、`REVERT_HEAD`、`rebase-merge`、`rebase-apply`、`sequencer`；不含 `REBASE_HEAD`，因為 Git 在 rebase 完成後仍會保留它）以及 worktree 是否 clean——因為 runtime draining 期間現實可能已改變，先前的驗證結果不會跨越這個邊界沿用。

```text
package cli

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/wt"
	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

func newResumeCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var (
		noProvision bool
		fetch       bool
		force       bool
	)
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "resume <task>",
		Short: "Pick a task back up, rebuilding whatever is missing",
		Long: `Make a parked task hot again.

Warm tasks still have their worktree, so this just reopens a runtime session.
Cold tasks do not: the worktree is rebuilt from the branch, which is why going
cold is safe in the first place — the branch, not the directory, is the task's
identity.

If the task is owned by another machine, resuming here takes ownership. Two
machines writing the same branch is the one way to make this workflow produce
a conflict, so dev asks before doing it.`,
		Args: cobra.ExactArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			ctx := ctxOf()
			t, err := app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			host := config.Hostname()
			if !t.OwnedBy(host) && !force {
				return fmt.Errorf("task %s is owned by %s.\n"+
					"Make sure that machine has pushed its work, then re-run with --force to take ownership",
					t.ID, t.Owner)
			}

			if fetch {
				if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, t.RepoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "origin"); err != nil {
					app.warnf("fetch failed: %v", err)
				}
			}

			rt := runtimeForTask(app, t)
			mode := t.EffectiveMode()
			checkout := checkoutOf(t)

			switch mode {
			case task.ModeWorktree:
				_, statErr := os.Stat(checkout)
				if t.WorktreePath != "" && statErr == nil {
					if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, checkout); err != nil {
						return err
					}
				}
				// Rebuild the worktree when it is gone — the cold-to-hot path.
				if t.WorktreePath == "" || statErr != nil {
					base := t.Base
					// Prefer the published branch: a cold task's work lives on
					// the remote, and a stale local ref could drop it.
					if remote := "origin/" + t.Branch; gitx.RefExists(ctx, t.RepoPath, remote) {
						base = remote
					}
					m := &wt.Manager{Cfg: app.Cfg, Runtime: rt, Log: app.Err}
					res, err := m.Create(ctx, wt.CreateRequest{
						RepoPath: t.RepoPath, RepoName: t.Repo, Branch: t.Branch,
						Base: base, Label: worktreeRuntimeLabel(t.Repo, t.Branch), NoProvision: noProvision,
					})
					if err != nil {
						var exists *wt.ErrExists
						if asError(err, &exists) {
							t.WorktreePath = exists.Path
							if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, exists.Path); err != nil {
								return err
							}
						} else {
							return err
						}
					} else {
						t.WorktreePath = res.Path
						setTaskRuntime(t, rt, res.Runtime)
						reportProvision(app, res)
						fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", app.outStyle().label("rebuilt"), config.Contract(res.Path))
					}
					checkout = t.WorktreePath
				}

			case task.ModeBranch:
				checkout = t.RepoPath
				if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, checkout); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if st.Branch != t.Branch {
					if st.Dirty() {
						return fmt.Errorf("cannot switch the canonical checkout from %s to %s: %s",
							st.Branch, t.Branch, st.Breakdown())
					}
					if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "switch", t.Branch); err != nil {
						return err
					}
				}

			case task.ModeDirect:
				checkout = t.RepoPath
				if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, checkout); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if st.Branch != t.Branch {
					return fmt.Errorf("direct task %s tracks %s, but the canonical checkout is on %s; "+
						"switch back explicitly or start a worktree task", t.Title(), t.Branch, st.Branch)
				}
			}
			if t.RuntimeHandle != "" {
				live, err := runtimeHandleCovers(ctx, rt, t.RuntimeHandle, checkout)
				if err != nil {
					return fmt.Errorf("validate saved %s runtime session %s: %w", rt.Name(), t.RuntimeHandle, err)
				}
				if !live {
					clearTaskRuntime(t)
				}
			}
			if t.RuntimeHandle == "" {
				label := t.Title()
				if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
					label = worktreeRuntimeLabel(t.Repo, t.Branch)
				}
				opened, err := openCheckout(ctx, rt, checkout, label)
				if err != nil {
					app.warnf("could not open a runtime session: %v", err)
				}
				setTaskRuntime(t, rt, opened)
			}

			t.State = task.Hot
			t.Owner = host
			if err := app.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			annotate(app, rt, t)

			style := app.outStyle()
			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s  %s on %s (%s)\n",
				task.Hot.Icon(), t.Title(), t.Repo, t.Branch, style.dim(string(mode)))
			if t.Next != "" {
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s      %s\n", style.label("next"), t.Next)
			}
			if t.AgentSession != "" {
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s (resumable)\n", style.label("agent"), t.AgentSession)
			}
			if st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout); err == nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s       %s\n", style.label("git"), style.git(st.Summary()))
				if st.Behind > 0 {
					app.warnf("branch is %d behind upstream — `git pull --ff-only` before you start", st.Behind)
				}
			}
			if rt.Name() == "none" {
				return app.cdDirective(checkout)
			}
			return activateRuntime(ctx, rt, t.RuntimeHandle)
		},
	}
	f := cmd.Flags()
	f.BoolVar(&noProvision, "no-provision", false, "skip dependency install when rebuilding a worktree")
	f.BoolVar(&fetch, "fetch", true, "fetch from origin first")
	f.BoolVar(&force, "force", false, "take ownership of a task owned by another machine")
	cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Warm, task.Cold)
	return cmd
}
```

```text
388	+	}
389	+	repoAlias := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "repo-alias")
390	+	if err := os.Symlink(r.Root, repoAlias); err != nil {
391	+		t.Skipf("symlinks unavailable: %v", err)
392	+	}
393	+
394	+	got, err := gitx.ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx, repoAlias, worktreeAlias)
395	+	if err != nil {
396	+		t.Fatalf("ResolveRegisteredWorktree through aliases: %v", err)
397	+	}
398	+	if got.Path != resolve(t, wtPath) {
399	+		t.Errorf("Path = %q, want physical path %q", got.Path, resolve(t, wtPath))
400	+	}
401	+	if got.Worktree.Path != resolve(t, wtPath) {
402	+		t.Errorf("Git record path = %q, want %q", got.Worktree.Path, resolve(t, wtPath))
403	+	}

569	+	repository := gittest.New(t)
570	+	linkedPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "linked")
571	+	if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), repository.Root, linkedPath, "feat/linked", "main"); err != nil {
572	+		t.Fatal(err)
573	+	}
574	+	mainRepo := discoveredRepo(t, repository.Root)
575	+	linkedRepo := discoveredRepo(t, linkedPath)
576	+	aliasRoot := t.TempDir()
577	+	aliasPath := filepath.Join(aliasRoot, "repo-alias")
578	+	if err := os.Symlink(repository.Root, aliasPath); err != nil {
579	+		t.Fatal(err)
580	+	}
581	+	aliasRepo := mainRepo
582	+	aliasRepo.Path = aliasPath
583	+	aliasRepo.Symlink = true
584	+
585	+	wantRepositoryID, err := pathx.Canonical(mainRepo.CommonDir)
586	+	if err != nil {
587	+		t.Fatal(err)
588	+	}
589	+	wantMainID, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.Root)
590	+	if err != nil {
591	+		t.Fatal(err)
592	+	}
593	+	wantLinkedID, err := pathx.Canonical(linkedPath)
594	+	if err != nil {
595	+		t.Fatal(err)
596	+	}
597	+
598	+	for _, tc := range []struct {
599	+		name       string
600	+		repository repo.Repo
601	+	}{
602	+		{name: "normal", repository: mainRepo},
603	+		{name: "linked cwd", repository: linkedRepo},
604	+		{name: "symlink alias", repository: aliasRepo},
605	+	} {
606	+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
607	+			ctx := inventory.CollectRepoContext(context.Background(), tc.repository, nil, nil, "none")
608	+			if ctx.WorktreeErr != nil {
609	+				t.Fatal(ctx.WorktreeErr)
610	+			}
611	+			if ctx.RepositoryID != wantRepositoryID {
612	+				t.Errorf("RepositoryID = %q, want %q", ctx.RepositoryID, wantRepositoryID)
613	+			}
614	+			if len(ctx.Checkouts) != 2 || len(ctx.Rows) != 2 {
615	+				t.Fatalf("checkouts=%d rows=%d, want two authoritative checkout rows", len(ctx.Checkouts), len(ctx.Rows))
616	+			}
617	+			main, ok := ctx.Main()
618	+			if !ok || !main.Worktree.Main || main.Worktree.Path != wantMainID {
619	+				t.Fatalf("Main = %+v, want Git's actual main record at %s", main.Worktree, wantMainID)
620	+			}
621	+			if ctx.Checkouts[0].Worktree.Path != wantMainID {
622	+				t.Errorf("first checkout path = %q, selected path was incorrectly synthesized", ctx.Checkouts[0].Worktree.Path)
623	+			}
624	+			ids := map[string]bool{}
625	+			for _, row := range ctx.Rows {
626	+				if row.Kind != inventory.RepoContextRowCheckout || row.Checkout == nil {
627	+					t.Fatalf("row = %+v, want checkout row", row)
628	+				}
629	+				ids[row.ID] = true
630	+				if row.RepositoryID != wantRepositoryID {
631	+					t.Errorf("row repository ID = %q", row.RepositoryID)
632	+				}
633	+			}
634	+			if !ids[wantMainID] || !ids[wantLinkedID] {
635	+				t.Errorf("row IDs = %v, want canonical registered paths", ids)
636	+			}
637	+		})
638	+	}

683	+	if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), repository.Root, externalPath, "feat/external", "main"); err != nil {
684	+		t.Fatal(err)
685	+	}
686	+	tasks := []*task.Task{
687	+		{ID: "repo__main", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root, Branch: "main", Mode: task.ModeBranch, State: task.Hot},
688	+		{ID: "repo__managed", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root, Branch: "feat/managed", WorktreePath: managedPath, Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done},
689	+		{ID: "repo__cold", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root, Branch: "feat/cold", Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Cold},
690	+		{ID: "repo__done", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root, Branch: "feat/done", Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done},
691	+	}
692	+
693	+	ctx := inventory.CollectRepoContext(context.Background(), discoveredRepo(t, repository.Root), tasks, nil, "none")
694	+	if len(ctx.Checkouts) != 3 || len(ctx.OtherTasks) != 2 || len(ctx.Rows) != 5 {
695	+		t.Fatalf("checkouts=%d other=%d rows=%d", len(ctx.Checkouts), len(ctx.OtherTasks), len(ctx.Rows))
696	+	}
697	+	managed := checkoutForBranch(t, &ctx, "feat/managed")
698	+	if hasReason(managed.DriftReasons, inventory.ReasonUnexpectedCheckout) {
699	+		t.Fatalf("normal retained DONE worktree was marked drifted: %+v", managed.DriftReasons)
700	+	}
701	+	wantRows := map[string]bool{"repo__cold": true, "repo__done": true}
702	+	for _, checkout := range ctx.Checkouts {
703	+		wantRows[checkout.ID] = true
704	+	}
705	+	seenRows := map[string]int{}
706	+	for _, row := range ctx.Rows {
707	+		seenRows[row.ID]++
708	+		if row.TaskOnly() && row.ID != row.Task.ID {
709	+			t.Errorf("task-only row ID = %q, task ID = %q", row.ID, row.Task.ID)
710	+		}
711	+	}
712	+	for id := range wantRows {
713	+		if seenRows[id] != 1 {
714	+			t.Errorf("row %q appears %d times", id, seenRows[id])
715	+		}
716	+	}
717	+
718	+	occurrences := map[string]int{}
719	+	for _, checkout := range ctx.Checkouts {
720	+		for _, binding := range checkout.TaskBindings {
721	+			occurrences[binding.Task.ID]++
722	+		}
723	+	}
724	+	for _, binding := range ctx.OtherTaskBindings {
725	+		occurrences[binding.Task.ID]++
726	+		if binding.Task.State == task.Cold || binding.Task.State == task.Done {
727	+			if len(binding.DriftReasons) != 0 || len(binding.ConflictReasons) != 0 {
728	+				t.Errorf("expected %s task %s has issues: %+v %+v", binding.Task.State, binding.Task.ID,
729	+					binding.DriftReasons, binding.ConflictReasons)
730	+			}
731	+		}
732	+	}
733	+	for _, tracked := range tasks {
734	+		if occurrences[tracked.ID] != 1 {
735	+			t.Errorf("task %s appears in %d bindings", tracked.ID, occurrences[tracked.ID])
736	+		}
737	+	}
738	+}
```

```text
1	package cli

3	import (
4		"fmt"

8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"

11		"github.com/spf13/cobra"
12	)
13	
14	func newParkCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
15		var (
16			next            string
17			note            string
18			wip             bool
19			push            bool
20			cold            bool
21			keepRT          bool
22			closeUnknown    bool
23			assumeNoRuntime bool
24			timeout         time.Duration
25		)
26		cmd := &cobra.Command{
27			Use:   "park [task]",
28			Short: "Stop working on a task without losing the thread",
29			Long: `Park the current task (or the one named) so its runtime session can close.
30	
31	Parking is the missing move that makes a crowded sidebar shrink. It records
32	what to do next, optionally checkpoints uncommitted work, and closes the
33	runtime session — while leaving the branch and the worktree exactly where they
34	are. Closing a session is not abandoning a task.
35	
36	  warm (default)  worktree and branch stay; session closes. Back within days.
37	  cold (--cold)   work is committed and pushed, session closed, worktree
38	                  removed. Reconstruct it anywhere later with dev resume.
39	
40	--cold and --keep-session are incompatible: a runtime cannot stay pointed at a
41	checkout that cold parking removes.
42	
43	A checkpoint commit is preferred over git stash: a stash is invisible in the
44	log, easy to forget, and cannot be pushed — so it can never reach another
45	machine, which is exactly what parking needs to support.`,
46			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
47			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
48				ctx := ctxOf()
49				if cold && keepRT {
50					return fmt.Errorf("--cold and --keep-session cannot be combined: a session must not remain pointed at a removed checkout")
51				}
52	
53				var options taskflow.ActionOptions
54				if cold {
55					options = taskflow.ParkColdOptions{
56						Next: next, Note: note, CommitWIP: wip, Push: push,
57						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
58					}
59				} else {
60					options = taskflow.ParkWarmOptions{
61						Next: next, Note: note, CommitWIP: wip, Push: push, KeepSession: keepRT,
62						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
63					}
64				}
65				execution, err := executeTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
66					return resolveTask(app, args)
67				}, options)
68				if err != nil {
69					return err
70				}
71	
72				parked := &execution.Task
73				style := app.outStyle()
74				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s is %s", parked.State.Icon(), parked.Title(),
75					style.taskStateFor(string(parked.State), parked.State.Label()))
76				if parked.Next != "" {
77					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, " — %s %s", style.label("next:"), parked.Next)
78				}
79				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out)
80				return nil
81			},
82		}
83		f := cmd.Flags()
84		f.StringVarP(&next, "next", "n", "", "what to do when you come back")
85		f.StringVar(&note, "note", "", "free-form note")
86		f.BoolVar(&wip, "wip", false, "checkpoint uncommitted work as a wip: commit")
87		f.BoolVar(&push, "push", false, "push the branch so another machine can pick it up")
88		f.BoolVar(&cold, "cold", false, "go cold: remove the worktree after confirming everything is pushed")
89		f.BoolVar(&keepRT, "keep-session", false, "leave the runtime session open")
90		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow external closure of unknown runtime status")
91		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails")
92		f.DurationVar(&timeout, "timeout", 5*time.Second, "maximum time to wait for runtime closure")
93		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Hot, task.Warm)
94		return cmd
95	}
96	
97	// resolveTask picks the task an argument names, or infers it from the current
98	// directory when no argument is given.
99	func resolveTask(app *App, args []string) (*task.Task, error) {
100		if len(args) == 1 {
101			return app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
102		}
103		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, err
106		}
107		t, err := app.Tasks.FindByWorktree(cwd)
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no task for %s — name one explicitly, or run this inside a task's checkout",
110				config.Contract(cwd))
111		}
112		return t, nil
113	}
```

```text
12	
13	func newResumeCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
14		var (
15			noProvision bool
16			fetch       bool
17			force       bool
18		)
19		cmd := &cobra.Command{
20			Use:   "resume <task>",
21			Short: "Pick a task back up, rebuilding whatever is missing",
22			Long: `Make a parked task hot again.
23	
24	Warm tasks still have their worktree, so this just reopens a runtime session.
25	Cold tasks do not: the worktree is rebuilt from the branch, which is why going
26	cold is safe in the first place — the branch, not the directory, is the task's
27	identity.
28	
29	If the task is owned by another machine, resuming here takes ownership. Two
30	machines writing the same branch is the one way to make this workflow produce
31	a conflict, so dev asks before doing it.`,
32			Args: cobra.ExactArgs(1),
33			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
34				ctx := ctxOf()
35				execution, err := executeTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
36					return app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
37				}, taskflow.ResumeOptions{
38					FetchRefs: fetch, NoProvision: noProvision, TakeOwnership: force,
39				})
40				if err != nil {
41					return err
42				}
43	
44				resumed := &execution.Task
45				handoff, ok := execution.Result.Handoff()
46				if !ok || handoff.Path == "" {
47					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is HOT, but resume returned no activation handoff", resumed.ID)
48				}
49				checkout := handoff.Path
50				var activationRuntime runtime.Runtime
51				switch handoff.Kind {
52				case taskflow.HandoffDirectory:
53					if resumed.RuntimeName != "" || resumed.RuntimeHandle != "" {
54						return fmt.Errorf("task %s returned a directory handoff with persisted runtime %s/%s",
55							resumed.ID, resumed.RuntimeName, resumed.RuntimeHandle)
56					}
57				case taskflow.HandoffRuntime:
58					activationRuntime = app.runtimeNamed(handoff.Runtime)
59					if activationRuntime == nil || activationRuntime.Name() != handoff.Runtime {
60						return fmt.Errorf("resume handoff backend %q is unavailable", handoff.Runtime)
61					}
62					if resumed.RuntimeName != handoff.Runtime || resumed.RuntimeHandle != handoff.RuntimeHandle {
63						return fmt.Errorf("task %s persisted runtime %s/%s, but resume handed off %s/%s",
64							resumed.ID, resumed.RuntimeName, resumed.RuntimeHandle, handoff.Runtime, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
65					}
66					annotate(app, activationRuntime, resumed)
67				default:
68					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is HOT, but resume returned unsupported %s handoff", resumed.ID, handoff.Kind)
69				}
70	
71				mode := resumed.EffectiveMode()
72				style := app.outStyle()
73				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s  %s on %s (%s)\n",
74					task.Hot.Icon(), resumed.Title(), resumed.Repo, resumed.Branch, style.dim(string(mode)))
75				if resumed.Next != "" {
76					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s      %s\n", style.label("next"), resumed.Next)
77				}
78				if resumed.AgentSession != "" {
79					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s (resumable)\n", style.label("agent"), resumed.AgentSession)
80				}
81				if st, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout); statusErr == nil {
82					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s       %s\n", style.label("git"), style.git(st.Summary()))
83					if st.Behind > 0 {
84						app.warnf("branch is %d behind upstream — `git pull --ff-only` before you start", st.Behind)
85					}
86				}
87				if handoff.Kind == taskflow.HandoffDirectory {
88					return app.cdDirective(checkout)
89				}
90				return activateRuntime(ctx, activationRuntime, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
91			},
92		}
93		f := cmd.Flags()
94		f.BoolVar(&noProvision, "no-provision", false, "skip dependency install when rebuilding a worktree")
95		f.BoolVar(&fetch, "fetch", true, "fetch from origin first")
96		f.BoolVar(&force, "force", false, "take ownership of a task owned by another machine")
97		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Warm, task.Cold)
98		return cmd
99	}
100
```

```text
10	func newDoneCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

27			Long: `Finish integration while leaving runtime and filesystem cleanup to an
28	external coordinator.
29	
30	  --ff       rebase onto the base and fast-forward it locally. Use when the
31	             branch's commits are worth keeping in the base's history.
32	  --pr       push and open a pull/merge request with the detected forge CLI,
33	             leaving the merge to review and CI.
34	  --merged   verify an externally merged branch against --base-ref, for a merge
35	             performed outside dev.
36	
37	For branch/worktree tasks, omitting every mode opens a finish wizard on an
38	interactive terminal. A non-interactive caller still gets a report and must
39	pass a mode explicitly. Direct tasks need no integration mode.
40	
41	A dirty checkout is analyzed against the base, not rejected as one opaque
42	condition. Interactive use can commit everything, discard everything, or
43	cancel. Unique content requires typing DROP before discard. Scripts select an
44	explicit --dirty policy; destructive discard also requires --yes.
45	
46	A successful local or externally verified merge records DONE, meaning MERGED
47	with cleanup possibly pending. It never closes the invoking runtime, removes a
48	worktree, or deletes a branch. Run dev retire later from outside the workspace.`,
49			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
50			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
51				modes := 0
52				for _, selected := range []bool{ff, pr, merged} {
53					if selected {
54						modes++
55					}
56				}
57				if modes > 1 {
58					return fmt.Errorf("--ff, --pr and --merged are alternatives; pick one")
59				}
60				if !merged && (baseRef != "" || confirmSquash != "") {
61					return fmt.Errorf("--base-ref and --confirm-squash require --merged")
62				}
63				if deleteBranch {
64					return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branch is cleanup; run dev retire --delete-branch after integration")
65				}
66				if keepWorktree {
67					app.warnf("--keep-worktree is deprecated: dev done always keeps runtime and worktree state")
68				}
69				integration := doneIntegrationNone
70				switch {
71				case ff:
72					integration = doneIntegrationFF
73				case pr:
74					integration = doneIntegrationPR
75				case merged:
76					integration = doneIntegrationMerged
77				}
78				return runDone(ctxOf(), app, args, doneOptions{
79					Integration: integration, DirtyPolicy: doneDirtyPolicy(dirtyPolicy),
80					Message: message, Yes: yes, Push: push,
81					BaseRef: baseRef, ConfirmSquash: confirmSquash,

88		f.BoolVar(&merged, "merged", false, "verify an externally merged branch and mark the task done")
89		f.StringVar(&baseRef, "base-ref", "", "base ref used to verify --merged (default: recorded base)")
90		f.StringVar(&confirmSquash, "confirm-squash", "", "attest that this contained commit represents a squash merge")
```

```text
1	package artifact
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"crypto/rand"
6		"encoding/hex"
7		"encoding/json"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"

11		"io/fs"

13		"path/filepath"
14		"sort"
15		"strings"
16		"time"
17	
18		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/lockx"
19	)
20	
21	var ErrIntentNotFound = errors.New("artifact intent not found")
22	
23	// Store keeps one strict JSON intent per finalization handoff.
24	type Store struct {
25		Dir   string
26		clock func() time.Time
27		newID func() string
28	}
29	
30	func NewStore(dir string) *Store {
31		return &Store{Dir: dir, clock: time.Now, newID: randomID}
32	}
33	
34	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".json") }
35	
36	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
37		if intent == nil {
38			return fmt.Errorf("create nil artifact intent")
39		}
40		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
41			candidate := *intent
42			if candidate.ID == "" {
43				candidate.ID = s.newID()
44			}
45			candidate.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
46			candidate.Status = Armed
47			now := s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
48			candidate.CreatedAt, candidate.UpdatedAt = now, now
49			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
50				return err
51			}
52			if _, err := os.Stat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
53				return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s already exists", candidate.ID)
54			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return err
56			}
57			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {
58				return err
59			}
60			*intent = candidate
61			return nil
62		})
63	}
64	
65	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Intent, error) {
66		if !idPattern.MatchString(id) {
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent id %q", id)
68		}
69		file, err := os.Open(s.path(id))
70		if err != nil {
71			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
72				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s: %w", id, ErrIntentNotFound)
73			}
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		defer file.Close()
77		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
78		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
79		var intent Intent
80		if err := decoder.Decode(&intent); err != nil {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
82		}
83		if err := ensureJSONEOF(decoder); err != nil {
84			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
85		}
86		if intent.ID != id {
87			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent filename %s disagrees with id %s", id, intent.ID)
88		}
89		if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
90			return nil, err
91		}
92		return &intent, nil
93	}
94	
95	func (s *Store) List() ([]Intent, error) {
96		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
97		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
98			return nil, nil
99		}
100		if err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		var intents []Intent
104		for _, entry := range entries {
105			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
106				continue
107			}
108			intent, err := s.Get(strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json"))
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			intents = append(intents, *intent)
113		}
114		sort.Slice(intents, func(i, j int) bool { return intents[i].CreatedAt.Before(intents[j].CreatedAt) })
115		return intents, nil
116	}
117	
118	func (s *Store) FindByRunID(runID string) (*Intent, error) {
119		intents, err := s.List()
120		if err != nil {
121			return nil, err
122		}
123		for i := range intents {
124			if intents[i].RunID == runID {
125				return &intents[i], nil
126			}
127		}
128		return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact run %s: %w", runID, ErrIntentNotFound)
129	}
130	
131	func (s *Store) Update(ctx context.Context, id string, mutate func(*Intent) error) error {
132		if mutate == nil {
133			return fmt.Errorf("artifact update needs a mutation")
134		}
135		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
136			intent, err := s.Get(id)
137			if err != nil {
138				return err
139			}
140			if err := mutate(intent); err != nil {
141				return err
142			}
143			intent.UpdatedAt = s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
144			if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
145				return err
146			}
147			return s.write(*intent)
148		})
149	}
150	
151	func (s *Store) write(intent Intent) error {
152		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o700); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, ".intent-*.tmp")
156		if err != nil {
157			return err
158		}
159		name := tmp.Name()
160		defer os.Remove(name)
161		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
162			tmp.Close()
163			return err
164		}
165		encoder := json.NewEncoder(tmp)
166		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
167		if err := encoder.Encode(intent); err != nil {
168			tmp.Close()
169			return err
170		}
171		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
172			tmp.Close()
173			return err
174		}
175		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
176			return err
177		}
178		return os.Rename(name, s.path(intent.ID))
179	}
180	
181	func ensureJSONEOF(decoder *json.Decoder) error {
182		var extra any
183		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
184			return nil
185		} else if err != nil {
186			return err
187		}
188		return fmt.Errorf("multiple JSON values")
189	}
190	
191	func randomID() string {
192		var raw [12]byte
193		if _, err := rand.Read(raw[:]); err != nil {
194			return fmt.Sprintf("intent-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
195		}
196		return "intent-" + hex.EncodeToString(raw[:])
197	}
```

```text
279	
280	func lifecycleRail(mode task.CheckoutMode, current task.State) string {
281		states := []task.State{task.Hot, task.Warm, task.Cold, task.Done}
282		if mode == task.ModeDirect {
283			states = []task.State{task.Hot, task.Warm, task.Done}
284		}
285		parts := make([]string, 0, len(states))
286		for _, state := range states {
287			label := strings.ToUpper(string(state))
288			if state == current {
289				label = "[" + label + " CURRENT]"
290			}
291			parts = append(parts, colourState(state, label))
292		}
293		return strings.Join(parts, " -> ")
294	}
295	
296	func colourState(state task.State, value string) string {
297		switch state {
298		case task.Hot:
299			return styleHot.Render(value)
300		case task.Warm:
301			return styleWarm.Render(value)
302		case task.Cold:
303			return styleCold.Render(value)
304		case task.Done:
305			return styleDone.Render(value)
306		default:
307			return value
308		}
309	}
```

```text
351	+func TestParkNamedDoneOrColdRejectedBeforeEffects(t *testing.T) {
352	+	for _, state := range []task.State{task.Done, task.Cold} {
353	+		t.Run(string(state), func(t *testing.T) {
354	+			r := gittest.New(t)
355	+			branch := "feat/park-" + string(state)
356	+			r.Git("branch", branch, "main")
357	+			cfg := lifecycleConfig(t)
358	+			cfg.Paths.StateDir = filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state")
359	+			store := task.NewStore(cfg.TasksDir())
360	+			candidate := &task.Task{
361	+				Name: "park " + string(state), Repo: "repo", RepoPath: r.Root,
362	+				Branch: branch, Base: "main", Mode: task.ModeWorktree,
363	+				State: state, Owner: config.Hostname(),
364	+			}
365	+			if err := store.Save(candidate); err != nil {
366	+				t.Fatal(err)
367	+			}
368	+			before, err := store.GetRecord(candidate.ID)
369	+			if err != nil {
370	+				t.Fatal(err)
371	+			}
372	+			head := r.Git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
373	+			rt := &activityRuntime{}
374	+			app := &App{Cfg: cfg, Tasks: store, Out: &bytes.Buffer{}, Err: &bytes.Buffer{}, runtimeInstance: rt}
375	+			cmd := newParkCmd(app)
376	+			cmd.SilenceErrors, cmd.SilenceUsage = true, true
377	+			cmd.SetArgs([]string{candidate.ID})
378	+			err = cmd.Execute()
379	+			if !errors.Is(err, taskflow.ErrInvalidTransition) {
380	+				t.Fatalf("named %s park error = %v, want ErrInvalidTransition", state, err)
381	+			}
382	+			after, getErr := store.GetRecord(candidate.ID)
383	+			if getErr != nil {
384	+				t.Fatal(getErr)
385	+			}
386	+			if after.Revision != before.Revision || after.Task.State != state {
387	+				t.Fatalf("named %s park changed task: before=%+v after=%+v", state, before, after)
388	+			}
389	+			if got := r.Git("rev-parse", "HEAD"); got != head {
390	+				t.Fatalf("named %s park changed Git HEAD from %s to %s", state, head, got)
391	+			}
392	+			if rt.openCalls != 0 || len(rt.closeCalls) != 0 || rt.activityCalls != 0 {
393	+				t.Fatalf("named %s park reached runtime effects: open=%d close=%v activity=%d",
394	+					state, rt.openCalls, rt.closeCalls, rt.activityCalls)
395	+			}
396	+		})
397	+	}
398	+}

605	+type stagedCloseRuntime struct {
606	+	*activityRuntime
607	+	failAt int
608	+	calls  int
609	+}
610	+
611	+func (r *stagedCloseRuntime) Close(_ context.Context, handle string) error {
612	+	r.calls++
613	+	r.closeCalls = append(r.closeCalls, handle)
614	+	if r.failAt > 0 && r.calls == r.failAt {
615	+		return errors.New("injected runtime close failure")
616	+	}
617	+	for index, session := range r.sessions {
618	+		if session.Handle == handle {
619	+			r.sessions = append(r.sessions[:index], r.sessions[index+1:]...)
620	+			break
621	+		}
622	+	}
623	+	return nil
624	+}
```

```text
462		commit, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
463		if err != nil {
464			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "receipt-failed", err)
465		}
466		if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, transcript.Path, commit); err != nil {
467			return nil, err
468		}
469		return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
470	}
471	
472	func (s *Service) resolveIntent(request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
473		if request.IntentID != "" {
474			return s.Store.Get(request.IntentID)
475		}
476		if request.RunID != "" {
477			return s.Store.FindByRunID(request.RunID)
478		}
479		return nil, fmt.Errorf("finalize requires an intent or run id")
480	}
481	
482	func (s *Service) revalidate(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
483		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
484		if err != nil {
485			return err
486		}
487		if repository.GitCommonDir != intent.GitCommonDir {
488			return fmt.Errorf("Git common-dir changed")
489		}
490		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
491		if err != nil {
492			return err
493		}
494		if status.Branch != intent.Branch || status.Detached {
495			return fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
496		}
```

```text
1	// Package lockx provides a cross-platform advisory lock over a directory.
2	//
3	// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction
4	// code need to serialize mutations, and neither should have to depend on the
5	// other to get a lock.
6	package lockx
7	
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"errors"
11		"fmt"
12		"os"
13		"path/filepath"
14	)
15	
16	// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir. The lock file
17	// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
18	// directory being protected. label names the caller in wrapped errors.
19	func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
20		if operation == nil {
21			return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
22		}
23		if ctx == nil {
24			ctx = context.Background()
25		}
26		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
27			return fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
28		}
29		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
32		}
33		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
34		if err != nil {
35			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
36		}
37		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
38		lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
41		}
42		defer func() {
43			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
44				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", label, releaseErr))
45			}
46		}()
47		return operation()
48	}
49
```

```text
 func defaultForgeHost(kind Kind) string {

 	case GitLab:

 // run executes a forge CLI, streaming stderr through so the user sees the
 // CLI's own authentication prompts and error messages verbatim.
 func run(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
 	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
 	cmd.Dir = dir
 	var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
 	cmd.Stdout = &stdout
 	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
 	cmd.Stdin = os.Stdin
 	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
 		detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
 		if detail != "" {
 			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
 				bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
 		}
 		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
 	}
 	return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
 }
 
 // runCombined is used for non-interactive publishing because gh/glab versions
 // differ on whether the created repository URL is written to stdout or stderr.
 // Stdin is deliberately left closed so a supposedly complete publish request
 // cannot unexpectedly drop into a second provider-owned wizard.
 func runCombined(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
 	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
 	cmd.Dir = dir
 	var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
 	cmd.Stdout = &stdout
 	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
 	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
 		detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
 		if detail != "" {
 			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
 				bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
 		}
 		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
 	}
 	return strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()) + "\n" + strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())), nil
 }

 	return err == nil
 }
```

```text
+func (a *az) reviewQueryScope(query ReviewQuery) (ReviewQuery, []string) {

+		query.Head = azureReviewBranch(query.Head)
+		query.Base = azureReviewBranch(query.Base)

+func splitAzureReviewIdentity(identity string) (organization, project, repository string, ok bool) {
+	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(identity, "/"), "/")
+	if len(parts) != 3 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" || parts[2] == "" {
+		return "", "", "", false
+	}
+	return parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], true
+}
+
+func azureTargetOrganization(raw string) string {
+	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
+	parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed)
+	if err == nil && parsed.Hostname() != "" {
+		host := strings.ToLower(parsed.Hostname())
+		switch {
+		case host == "dev.azure.com":
+			segments := escapedSegments(parsed.EscapedPath())
+			if len(segments) == 1 {
+				return segments[0]
+			}
+		case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com"):
+			return strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")
+		}
+		return ""
+	}
+	if !strings.ContainsAny(trimmed, "/:") {
+		return trimmed
+	}
+	return ""
+}

+func parseAzureReviewCandidates(out string) ([]reviewCandidate, error) {
+	var raw []struct {
+		PullRequestID       *int   `json:"pullRequestId"`
+		Status              string `json:"status"`
+		IsDraft             *bool  `json:"isDraft"`
+		SourceRefName       string `json:"sourceRefName"`
+		TargetRefName       string `json:"targetRefName"`
+		RemoteURL           string `json:"remoteUrl"`
+		RepositoryRemoteURL string `json:"repositoryRemoteUrl"`
+	}
+	if err := decodeReviewJSON(AzureDevOps, out, &raw); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	candidates := make([]reviewCandidate, 0, len(raw))
+	for _, item := range raw {
+		id, number := "", 0
+		if item.PullRequestID != nil {
+			number = *item.PullRequestID
+			id = strconv.Itoa(number)
+		}
+		reviewURL := item.RemoteURL
+		if !validReviewURL(reviewURL) && item.RepositoryRemoteURL != "" && number > 0 {
+			if _, repositoryURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(item.RepositoryRemoteURL); ok {
+				reviewURL = strings.TrimRight(repositoryURL, "/") + "/pullrequest/" + strconv.Itoa(number)
+			}
+		}
+		candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
+			ID: id, Number: number, State: item.Status, Draft: item.IsDraft,
+			URL: reviewURL, Head: azureReviewBranch(item.SourceRefName), Base: azureReviewBranch(item.TargetRefName),
+		})
+	}
+	return candidates, nil
+}
+
+func azureReviewBranch(ref string) string {
+	return strings.TrimPrefix(ref, "refs/heads/")
+}
+
+func normalizeAzureReviewState(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error) {
+	switch strings.ToLower(state) {
+	case "active":
+		if draft {
+			return ReviewDraft, nil
+		}
+		return ReviewOpen, nil
+	case "completed":
+		return ReviewMerged, nil
+	case "abandoned":
+		return ReviewClosed, nil
+	default:
+		return "", errors.New("unrecognized Azure DevOps review state")
+	}
+}
```

```text
97					locator.HeadOID = head
98				}
99			}
100		}
101		if locator.HeadOID == "" {
102			locator.HeadOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, localBranchRef(candidate.Branch))
103		}
104		if locator.Upstream == "" && (!found || mode == task.ModeWorktree) {
105			locator.Upstream = s.branchUpstream(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Branch)
106		}
107		locator.BaseOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Base)
108		locator.UpstreamOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, locator.Upstream)
109	
110		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)
111		if err != nil {
112			return Locator{}, &StalePlanError{
113				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
114				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while locating",
115			}
116		}
117		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
118			return Locator{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while locating")
119		}
120		return locator, nil
121	}
122	
123	func (s *lifecycleService) locateRegisteredCheckout(
124		ctx context.Context,
125		candidate task.Task,
126		repoPath string,
127		expectedCheckout string,
128	) (gitx.RegisteredWorktree, bool) {
129		if expectedCheckout != "" {
130			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
131			return registered, err == nil
132		}
133		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree || candidate.State != task.Cold {
134			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
135		}
136	
137		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, repoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
140		}
141		match := ""
142		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
143			if worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch {
144				continue
145			}
146			if match != "" {
147				return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
148			}
149			match = worktree.Path
150		}
151		if match == "" {
152			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
153		}
154		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, match)
155		return registered, err == nil
156	}
157	
158	func (s *lifecycleService) branchUpstream(ctx context.Context, repoPath, branch string) string {
159		if branch == "" {
160			return ""
161		}
162		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath,
163			"for-each-ref", "--format=%(upstream:short)", localBranchRef(branch),
164		)
165		if err != nil {
166			return ""
167		}
168		return strings.TrimSpace(value)
169	}
```

```text
345	func resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
346		return observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && observed.hasCheckout() && observed.statusErr == nil &&
347			!observed.status.Detached && observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch
348	}
349	
350	func shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
351		return observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.savedRuntimeLive
352	}
353	
354	func resumeEffectCheckout(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
355		if observed.hasCheckout() {
356			return observed.checkout
357		}
358		return observed.desiredWorktree
359	}
360	
361	func resumeRuntimeLabel(candidate task.Task) string {
362		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
363			return candidate.Repo + "/" + candidate.Branch
364		}
365		return candidate.Title()
366	}
367	
368	func resumeFallback(id string, options ResumeOptions) string {
369		parts := []string{"dev", "resume", shellQuote(id)}
370		if !options.FetchRefs {
371			parts = append(parts, "--fetch=false")
372		}
373		if options.NoProvision {
374			parts = append(parts, "--no-provision")
375		}
376		if options.TakeOwnership {
377			parts = append(parts, "--force")
378		}
379		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
380	}
```

```text
1	//go:build unix
2	
3	package lockx
4	
5	import (
6		"context"
7		"errors"
8		"os"
9		"time"
10	
11		"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
12	)
13	
14	type fileLock struct {
15		file *os.File
16	}
17	
18	func acquire(ctx context.Context, path string) (*fileLock, error) {
19		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
20			return nil, err
21		}
22		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
23		if err != nil {
24			return nil, err
25		}
26		lock := &fileLock{file: file}
27		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
28		defer ticker.Stop()
29		for {
30			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
31				_ = file.Close()
32				return nil, err
33			}
34			err = unix.Flock(int(file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_EX|unix.LOCK_NB)
35			if err == nil {
36				return lock, nil
37			}
38			if !errors.Is(err, unix.EWOULDBLOCK) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EAGAIN) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EINTR) {
39				_ = file.Close()
40				return nil, err
41			}
42			select {
43			case <-ctx.Done():
44				_ = file.Close()
45				return nil, ctx.Err()
46			case <-ticker.C:
47			}
48		}
49	}
50	
51	func (l *fileLock) Close() error {
52		unlockErr := unix.Flock(int(l.file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_UN)
53		return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
54	}
55
```

```text
317	func checkoutExactVerdict(observed lifecycleObservation) (Verdict, string) {
318		if observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
319			return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("worktree common directory %q differs from %q", observed.worktree.GitCommonDir, observed.gitCommonDir)
320		}
321		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
322			if observed.task.WorktreePath == "" {
323				if observed.task.State != task.Cold || observed.branchMatches != 1 {
324					return VerdictBlocked, "the task has no exact persisted checkout identity"
325				}
326			} else {
327				// ResolveRegisteredWorktree matched the recorded hint by canonical path;
328				// subsequent operations use only the returned registered identity.
329				if observed.worktree.Path == "" {
330					return VerdictBlocked, "the exact registered worktree path is empty"
331				}
332			}
333		} else {
334			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
335				return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("%s task unexpectedly retains worktree path %q", observed.mode, observed.task.WorktreePath)
336			}
337			if observed.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath {
338				return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registered main path %q differs from %q", observed.worktree.Path, observed.repoPath)
339			}
340		}
341		if observed.headErr != nil {
342			return VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
343		}
344		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head {
345			return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
346		}
347		return VerdictMet, "exact path, Git common directory, and HEAD match"
348	}

351		if required {
352			return RequirementRequired
353		}
354		return RequirementAdvisory
355	}
```

```text
143	func runFlow(app *App, launch flowLaunch, runProgram flowProgramRunner) error {
144		if runProgram == nil {
145			return errors.New("flow program runner is unavailable")
146		}
147		flowtui.SetColorEnabled(app.outStyle().enabled)
148		app.traceTUI = true
149		runCtx, cancelRun := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
150		finishSetup := app.trace.Start(perftrace.TUISetup, perftrace.Fields{})
151		runtimeResolver := newTUIRuntimeResolver(app)
152		loader := newFlowLoader(app, runtimeResolver, launch.cwd)
153		if launch.repository != nil {
154			loader.registerRepository(*launch.repository, true)
155		}
156		actions := loader.actions()
157		if app.deferredReleaseRefresh {
158			actions.AfterFirstView = func(context.Context) { app.refreshReleaseDetached() }
159		}
160		model := flowtui.New(actions, launch.preselected).WithContext(runCtx)
161		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
162		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
163		final, err := runProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen())
164		cancelRun()
165		app.finishTrace()
166		if err != nil {
167			return err
168		}
169		withHandoff, ok := final.(interface {
170			Handoff() (taskflow.Handoff, bool)
171		})
172		if !ok {
173			return nil
174		}
175		handoff, ok := withHandoff.Handoff()
176		if !ok {
177			return nil
178		}
179		return honorFlowHandoff(app, runtimeResolver, handoff)
180	}
181	
182	func honorFlowHandoff(app *App, resolver flowRuntimeResolver, handoff taskflow.Handoff) error {
183		switch handoff.Kind {
184		case taskflow.HandoffDirectory:
185			if handoff.Path == "" {
186				return errors.New("flow returned an empty directory handoff")
187			}
188			return app.cdDirective(handoff.Path)
189		case taskflow.HandoffRuntime:
190			if handoff.Runtime == "" || handoff.RuntimeHandle == "" {
191				return errors.New("flow returned an incomplete runtime handoff")
192			}
193			var rt runtime.Runtime
194			if resolver != nil {
195				resolved, err := resolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
196				if err != nil {
197					return err
198				}
199				if resolved != nil && resolved.Name() == handoff.Runtime {
200					rt = resolved
201				}
202			}
203			if rt == nil {
204				rt = app.runtimeNamed(handoff.Runtime)
205			}
206			if rt == nil || rt.Name() != handoff.Runtime {
207				return fmt.Errorf("flow handoff backend %q is unavailable", handoff.Runtime)
208			}
209			return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
210		case taskflow.HandoffURL:
211			if handoff.URL == "" {
212				return errors.New("flow returned an empty URL handoff")
213			}
214			_, err := fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, handoff.URL)
215			return err
216		default:
217			return fmt.Errorf("flow returned unsupported handoff kind %q", handoff.Kind)
218		}
219	}

232	func availableFlowRepository(discovered gitx.Repo, preferred *repo.Repo, focus string) (flowRepository, error) {
233		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(discovered.GitCommonDir)
234		if err != nil {
235			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository identity: %w", err)
236		}
237		mainRoot := discovered.MainRoot
238		if mainRoot == "" && discovered.Bare {
239			mainRoot = discovered.GitCommonDir
240		}
241		mainRoot, err = pathx.Canonical(mainRoot)
242		if err != nil {
243			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository root: %w", err)
244		}
245		focusTarget := ""
246		if focus != "" {
247			focusTarget, err = pathx.Canonical(focus)
248			if err != nil {
249				return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow focus: %w", err)
250			}
251		}
252	
253		r := repo.Repo{
254			Name: discovered.Name, Path: mainRoot, RealPath: mainRoot,
255			CommonDir: commonDir, MainRoot: mainRoot, Bare: discovered.Bare, HasGit: true,
256		}
257		name := discovered.Name
258		if preferred != nil {
259			if preferred.Name != "" {
260				r.Name = preferred.Name
261			}
262			r.Root = preferred.Root
263			r.Category = preferred.Category
264			name = preferred.Display()
265			if name == "" {
266				name = r.Name
267			}
268		}
269		return flowRepository{
270			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
271				RepoKey: commonDir, Name: name, Path: mainRoot, Available: true,
272				FocusTarget: focusTarget,
273			},
274			repository: r,
275			available:  true,
276		}, nil
277	}
278	
279	func unavailableFlowRepository(record task.Record, cause error) flowRepository {
280		path := record.Task.RepoPath
281		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
282			path = canonical
283		} else if absolute, absErr := filepath.Abs(path); absErr == nil {
284			path = filepath.Clean(absolute)
285		}
286		name := record.Task.Repo
287		if name == "" {
288			name = filepath.Base(path)
289		}
290		message := "repository is unavailable"
291		if cause != nil {
292			message += ": " + cause.Error()
293		}
294		return flowRepository{
295			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
296				RepoKey: "unavailable:" + path, Name: name, Path: path,
297				Available: false, Error: message,
298			},
299			available:        false,
300			unavailableTasks: []task.Record{record},
301		}
302	}
```

```text
40	// run executes git in dir and returns trimmed stdout.
41	func run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
42		return runEnv(ctx, dir, nil, args...)
43	}
44	
45	// runEnv executes git with task-scoped environment overrides. It is used for
46	// alternate-index analysis that must never touch the user's real index.
47	func runEnv(ctx context.Context, dir string, overrides []string, args ...string) (string, error) {
48		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than
49		// octal-escaped, which matters for the Chinese-named files in these repos.
50		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
51		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
52		cmd.Dir = dir
53		if len(overrides) > 0 {
54			keys := make(map[string]bool, len(overrides))
55			for _, override := range overrides {
56				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(override, "=")
57				keys[key] = true
58			}
59			env := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+len(overrides))
60			for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
61				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
62				if !keys[key] {
63					env = append(env, entry)
64				}
65			}
66			env = append(env, overrides...)
67			cmd.Env = env
68		}
69		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
70		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
71		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
72		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
73			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
74			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {
75				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", dir, ErrNotARepo)
76			}
77			return "", gerr
78		}
79		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
80	}

83	// (park's wip commit, done's merge) that need a one-off command.
```

```text
98	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructive(ctx context.Context, input destructiveInspectInput) (destructiveObservation, error) {
99		observed := destructiveObservation{locator: input.locator, runtime: input.runtime, runtimeErr: input.rtErr}
100		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
101			return observed, err
102		}
103	
104		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, input.locator.RepoPath)
105		if err != nil {
106			observed.repoErr = err
107			return observed, nil
108		}
109		observed.repo = repository
110		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
111		if err != nil {
112			observed.repoErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git main checkout: %w", err)
113			return observed, nil
114		}
115		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
116		if err != nil {
117			observed.repoErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory: %w", err)
118			return observed, nil
119		}
120		requestedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.RepoPath)
121		if err != nil {
122			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
123		}
124		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.GitCommonDir)
125		if err != nil {
126			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
127		}
128		if requestedRepo != observed.repoPath || requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
129			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
130				"selected repository identity changed: main %q -> %q, common directory %q -> %q",
131				requestedRepo, observed.repoPath, requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir,
132			)}
133		}
134		if filepath.IsAbs(input.locator.RepoKey) {
135			key, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.RepoKey)
136			if keyErr != nil {
137				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
138			}
139			if key != observed.gitCommonDir {
140				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected repository key no longer names the Git common directory"}
141			}
142		}
143	
144		observed.worktrees, observed.worktreesErr = s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
145		if !input.noCheckout {
146			observed.checkout, err = s.canonicalPath(input.locator.CheckoutPath)
147			if err != nil {
148				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize selected checkout: %w", err)
149			} else {
150				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
151				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
152					observed.worktreeFound = true
153					observed.observeCheckoutFacts(ctx, s)
154					if input.inspectContent && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() {
155						analysis, contentErr := s.analyzeFinish(ctx, observed.checkout, input.locator.Branch, input.locator.Branch)
156						observed.contentFingerprint = analysis.Fingerprint
157						observed.contentErr = contentErr
158					}
159					observed.harness, observed.isHarness = inventory.DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
160				}
161			}
162		}
163	
164		observed.observeRefs(ctx, s, input.locator.Branch, input.base)
165		if input.inspectArtifacts && observed.worktreeFound {
166			observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
167		}
168		if !input.noCheckout && !input.skipCleanup {
169			if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
170				if observed.runtime == nil || strings.TrimSpace(observed.runtime.Name()) == "" {
171					observed.runtimeErr = errors.New("destructive inspection has no runtime backend")
172				} else {
173					observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
174					observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, input.cleanup)
175				}
176			}
177		}
178		if input.inspectTasks {
179			if input.loadTasks == nil {
180				observed.taskInventoryErr = errors.New("task inventory loader is unavailable")
181			} else {
182				observed.taskRecords, observed.taskDiagnostics, observed.taskInventoryErr = input.loadTasks()
183				if observed.taskInventoryErr == nil {
184					s.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &observed)
185				}
186			}
187		}
188		return observed, nil
189	}

191	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeCheckoutFacts(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService) {
192		o.status, o.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, o.checkout)

194		o.head = strings.TrimSpace(o.head)
195		o.operation, o.inProgress, o.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, o.checkout)

198	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeRefs(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService, branch, base string) {
199		o.branchRef = localBranchRef(branch)
200		if o.repoPath != "" && o.branchRef != "" {
201			o.branchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchRef)
202			if o.branchExists {
203				o.branchOID, o.branchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchRef)
204			}
205		}
206		o.baseRef = localBranchRef(base)
207		if o.repoPath != "" && o.baseRef != "" {
208			o.baseExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, o.repoPath, o.baseRef)
209			if o.baseExists {
210				o.baseOID, o.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, o.repoPath, o.baseRef)
211			}
212		}
213		if o.branchExists && o.branchOIDErr == nil && o.branchOID != "" &&
214			o.baseExists && o.baseOIDErr == nil && o.baseOID != "" {
215			o.contained, o.containedErr = s.isAncestor(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchOID, o.baseOID)
216		}
217	}

226	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx context.Context, observed *destructiveObservation) {
227		for _, diagnostic := range observed.taskDiagnostics {
228			observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete, diagnostic.Error())
229		}
230		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
231			candidate := record.Task
232			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
233				observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
234					fmt.Sprintf("task %s is invalid: %v", candidate.ID, err))
235				continue
236			}
237	
238			pathClaim := false
239			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
240				path, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
241				if err != nil {
242					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
243						fmt.Sprintf("task %s checkout identity is unavailable: %v", candidate.ID, err))
244				} else {
245					pathClaim = path == observed.checkout
246				}
247			}
248	
249			branchClaim := false
250			if candidate.Branch == observed.locator.Branch {
251				repoMatches, complete, detail := s.taskRepositoryMatches(ctx, candidate, *observed)
252				if !complete {
253					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
254						fmt.Sprintf("task %s repository identity is unavailable: %s", candidate.ID, detail))
255				} else {
256					branchClaim = repoMatches
257				}
258			}
259	
260			if pathClaim {
261				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
262					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "exact checkout path",
263				})
264			}
265			if branchClaim {
266				reason := "exact branch in selected repository"
267				if pathClaim {
268					reason = "exact checkout path and branch in selected repository"
269					observed.taskClaims[len(observed.taskClaims)-1].Reason = reason
270					continue
271				}
272				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
273					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: reason,
274				})
275			}
276		}
277		sort.Slice(observed.taskClaims, func(i, j int) bool {
278			if observed.taskClaims[i].ID != observed.taskClaims[j].ID {
279				return observed.taskClaims[i].ID < observed.taskClaims[j].ID
280			}
281			return observed.taskClaims[i].Reason < observed.taskClaims[j].Reason
282		})
283		sort.Strings(observed.taskIncomplete)
284	}
285	
286	func (s *lifecycleService) taskRepositoryMatches(ctx context.Context, candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation) (bool, bool, string) {
287		candidatePath, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
288		if err != nil {
289			return false, false, err.Error()
290		}
291		if candidatePath == observed.repoPath {
292			return true, true, ""
293		}
294		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return false, false, err.Error()
297		}
298		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
299		if err != nil {
300			return false, false, err.Error()
301		}
302		return commonDir == observed.gitCommonDir, true, ""
303	}

305	func (o destructiveObservation) branchCheckoutPaths(excludeTarget bool) ([]string, error) {
306		if o.worktreesErr != nil {
307			return nil, o.worktreesErr
308		}
309		var paths []string
310		for _, worktree := range o.worktrees {
311			if worktree.Bare || worktree.Branch != o.locator.Branch {
312				continue
313			}
314			path := worktree.Path
315			if canonical, err := filepath.Abs(path); err == nil {
316				path = filepath.Clean(canonical)
317			}
318			if excludeTarget && o.checkout != "" {
319				candidate, err := filepath.Abs(o.checkout)
320				if err == nil && filepath.Clean(candidate) == path {
321					continue
322				}
323			}
324			paths = append(paths, path)
325		}
326		sort.Strings(paths)
327		return paths, nil
328	}

333			claims = append(claims, strings.Join([]string{claim.ID, claim.Revision, claim.Reason}, "\x00"))
334		}
335		authority := map[string]string{
336			"destructive.repo":                    o.repositoryAuthority(),
337			"destructive.checkout":                o.checkoutAuthority(),

339			"destructive.refs":                    o.refsAuthority(),

342			"destructive.runtime-backend":         runtimeName(o.runtime),
343			"destructive.runtime-error":           errorString(o.runtimeErr),
344			"destructive.runtime-available":       boolString(o.runtimeAvailable),
345			"destructive.harness":                 boolString(o.isHarness),

347			"destructive.task-inventory":          o.taskInventoryAuthority(),
348			"destructive.task-inventory-error":    errorString(o.taskInventoryErr),

350			"destructive.task-incomplete":         strings.Join(o.taskIncomplete, "\x01"),
351			"destructive.worktree-list-error":     errorString(o.worktreesErr),
352			"destructive.worktree-list-authority": o.worktreeListAuthority(),

408	func artifactEvidenceFromInspection(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection) string {
409		if inspection.KnownEmpty {
410			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
411		}
412		states := make([]string, 0, len(inspection.Intents))
413		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
414			states = append(states, intent.Intent.ID+"="+string(intent.State))
415		}
416		if len(states) == 0 {
417			return "artifact readiness is incomplete"
418		}
419		return strings.Join(states, ", ")
420	}

422	func mergeAuthority(base, additional map[string]string) map[string]string {
423		out := make(map[string]string, len(base)+len(additional))
424		for key, value := range base {
425			out[key] = value
426		}
427		for key, value := range additional {
428			out[key] = value
429		}
430		return out
431	}

433	func destructiveConditionsReady(conditions []Condition) error {
434		if availability := AvailabilityFor(conditions); availability != AvailabilityReady {
435			var evidence []string
436			for _, current := range conditions {
437				if current.Requirement == RequirementRequired && current.Verdict != VerdictMet {
438					evidence = append(evidence, string(current.Code)+": "+current.Evidence)
439				}
440			}
441			return staleBoundary("destructive safety is no longer ready (" + strings.Join(evidence, "; ") + ")")
442		}
443		return nil
444	}

449		}
```

```text
302			return m.updateRepository(message)

304		return m, nil

430	func (m Model) filteredRepositories() []RepositoryRow {
431		query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m.filter.Value()))
432		terms := strings.Fields(query)
433		out := make([]RepositoryRow, 0, len(m.repositories))
434		for _, row := range m.repositories {
435			haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{row.RepoKey, row.Name, row.Path, row.Error}, " "))
436			matched := true
437			for _, term := range terms {
438				if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
439					matched = false
440					break
441				}
442			}
443			if matched {
444				out = append(out, row)
445			}
446		}
447		return out
448	}
```

```text
}

func resolveRetirementTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (retirement.Target, runtime.Runtime, error) {
	if len(args) == 1 {
		expanded := config.Expand(args[0])
		if info, statErr := os.Stat(expanded); statErr == nil && info.IsDir() {
			return retirementTargetForPath(ctx, app, expanded)
		}
		t, err := app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
		if err != nil {
			return retirement.Target{}, nil, err
		}
		return retirementTargetForTask(ctx, app, t)
	}
	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	if err != nil {
		return retirement.Target{}, nil, err
	}
	if t, taskErr := app.Tasks.FindByWorktree(cwd); taskErr == nil {
		return retirementTargetForTask(ctx, app, t)
	}
	return retirementTargetForPath(ctx, app, cwd)
}

func retirementTargetForTask(ctx context.Context, app *App, t *task.Task) (retirement.Target, runtime.Runtime, error) {
	if t.State != task.Done {
		return retirement.Target{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("task %s is %s, not merged; run dev done first", t.ID, t.State)
	}
	base := t.Base
	if base == "" {
		base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, t.RepoPath)
	}
	checkout := t.RepoPath
	linked := false
	rt := runtimeForTask(app, t)
	if t.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
		if t.WorktreePath != "" {
			checkout, linked = t.WorktreePath, true
		} else {
			if t.RuntimeHandle != "" {
				return retirement.Target{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("task %s has a runtime handle but no worktree path; reconcile it before retirement", t.ID)
			}
			rt = runtime.None{}
		}
	}
	return retirement.Target{
		TaskID: t.ID, RepoPath: t.RepoPath, CheckoutPath: checkout,
		Branch: t.Branch, Base: base, LinkedWorktree: linked,
	}, rt, nil
}

func retirementTargetForPath(ctx context.Context, app *App, path string) (retirement.Target, runtime.Runtime, error) {
	repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
	if err != nil {
		return retirement.Target{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
	}
	if !repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
		return retirement.Target{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not a linked worktree; retire explicit paths only from their linked checkout", config.Contract(path))
	}
	status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return retirement.Target{}, nil, err
	}
	if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
		return retirement.Target{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing to retire detached worktree %s; preserve or branch its commit first", config.Contract(path))
	}
	base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.MainRoot)
	target := retirement.Target{
		RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, CheckoutPath: repository.Root,
		Branch: status.Branch, Base: base, LinkedWorktree: true,
	}
	// Retiring by path used to leave the task record behind, because only the
	// by-task form set TaskID and Service.Retire reaps nothing without it. The
	// same checkout is the same work however it was named, so claim the record
	// when one points at this path; validateTaskIdentity still refuses to reap
	// a task that is not DONE.
	if t, err := app.Tasks.FindByWorktree(repository.Root); err == nil && t != nil && t.State == task.Done {
		target.TaskID = t.ID
	}
	return target, app.Runtime(), nil
}

func safeRemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, repoPath, path string, force bool,
	closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool, timeout time.Duration,
) error {
	if _, err := retirement.CloseAndWait(ctx, rt, path, retirement.Options{
		CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if dirty, status, err := wt.DirtyCheck(ctx, path); err != nil {
		return err
	} else if dirty && !force {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes (%s)", config.Contract(path), status.Breakdown())
	}
	return gitx.RemoveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, path, force)
}
```

```text
// pushBranch publishes a branch, setting upstream on first push.
func pushBranch(ctx context.Context, app *App, dir, branch string) error {
	if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", branch); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", branch, err)
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     origin/%s\n", app.outStyle().label("pushed"), branch)
	return nil
}

// resolveTask picks the task an argument names, or infers it from the current
// directory when no argument is given.
func resolveTask(app *App, args []string) (*task.Task, error) {
	if len(args) == 1 {
		return app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
	}
	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	t, err := app.Tasks.FindByWorktree(cwd)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no task for %s — name one explicitly, or run this inside a task's checkout",
			config.Contract(cwd))
	}
	return t, nil
}
```

```text
1	// Package lockx provides a cross-platform advisory lock over a directory.
2	//
3	// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction
4	// code need to serialize mutations, and neither should have to depend on the
5	// other to get a lock.
6	package lockx
7	
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"errors"
11		"fmt"
12		"os"
13		"path/filepath"
14	)
15	
16	// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir. The lock file
17	// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
18	// directory being protected. label names the caller in wrapped errors.
19	func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
20		if operation == nil {
21			return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
22		}
23		if ctx == nil {
24			ctx = context.Background()
25		}
26		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
27			return fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
28		}
29		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
32		}
33		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
34		if err != nil {
35			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
36		}
37		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
38		lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
41		}
42		defer func() {
43			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
44				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", label, releaseErr))
45			}
46		}()
47		return operation()
48	}
49
```

```text
229	// CurrentPaneID implements CurrentPaneResolver without changing focus. --current
230	// resolves Herdr's inherited caller context even when a pane move changed its
231	// public ID after this process started.
232	func (h *Herdr) CurrentPaneID(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
233		var res struct {
234			Pane herdrPane `json:"pane"`
235		}
236		if err := h.call(ctx, &res, "pane", "current", "--current"); err != nil {
237			return "", err
238		}
239		if res.Pane.PaneID == "" {
240			return "", fmt.Errorf("herdr pane current --current: response has no pane id")
241		}
242		return res.Pane.PaneID, nil
243	}
244	
245	// AgentActivities implements AgentActivityLister using Herdr's recognized-agent
246	// inventory. Every returned row is occupied; lifecycle state is descriptive and
247	// is deliberately not used to decide whether another agent may share its cwd.
248	func (h *Herdr) AgentActivities(ctx context.Context) ([]AgentActivity, error) {
249		var res struct {
250			Agents *[]herdrPane `json:"agents"`
251		}
252		if err := h.call(ctx, &res, "agent", "list"); err != nil {
253			return nil, err
254		}
255		if res.Agents == nil {
256			return nil, fmt.Errorf("herdr agent list: response has no agents array")
257		}
258		out := make([]AgentActivity, 0, len(*res.Agents))
259		for _, p := range *res.Agents {
260			cwd := p.ForegroundCWD
261			if cwd == "" {
262				cwd = p.CWD
263			}
264			if cwd == "" {
265				return nil, fmt.Errorf("herdr agent list: recognized agent in pane %s has no cwd", p.PaneID)
266			}
267			out = append(out, AgentActivity{
268				PaneID: p.PaneID, WorkspaceID: p.WorkspaceID,
269				Agent: p.Agent, Name: p.Name, Status: p.AgentStatus, CWD: cwd,
270			})
271		}
272		return out, nil
273	}
274	
275	// Open implements Runtime. An already-open directory is reused rather than
276	// opened twice. It remains detached; explicit navigation calls Activate.
277	func (h *Herdr) Open(ctx context.Context, dir, label string) (OpenResult, error) {
278		existing, err := h.List(ctx)
279		if err != nil {
280			return OpenResult{}, err
281		}
282		for _, s := range existing {
283			if s.Covers(dir) {
284				return OpenResult{Handle: s.Handle, Surface: "workspace", Opened: true}, nil
285			}
286		}
287		args := []string{"workspace", "create", "--cwd", dir, "--no-focus"}
288		if label != "" {
289			args = append(args, "--label", label)
290		}
291		var res struct {
292			Workspace herdrWorkspace `json:"workspace"`
293			RootPane  herdrPane      `json:"root_pane"`
294		}
295		if err := h.call(ctx, &res, args...); err != nil {
296			return OpenResult{}, err
297		}
298		if res.Workspace.WorkspaceID == "" {
299			return OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("herdr workspace create: response has no workspace id")
300		}
301		if res.RootPane.PaneID == "" || res.RootPane.WorkspaceID != res.Workspace.WorkspaceID {
302			return OpenResult{}, h.rejectCreatedWorkspace(ctx, res.Workspace.WorkspaceID,
303				"herdr workspace create: response has no correlated root pane")
304		}
305		return OpenResult{
306			Handle: res.Workspace.WorkspaceID, Surface: "workspace", Opened: true,
307			Created: true, RootPaneID: res.RootPane.PaneID,
308		}, nil
309	}
```
