498	func (l *flowLoader) LoadRepository(ctx context.Context, repoKey string) (flowtui.Snapshot, error) {
499		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
500			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
501		}
502		l.mu.Lock()
503		selected, ok := l.repositories[repoKey]
504		l.mu.Unlock()
505		if !ok {
506			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is not in the current flow inventory", repoKey)
507		}
508		if !selected.available {
509			return l.unavailableSnapshot(selected), nil
510		}
511	
512		records, diagnostics, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
513		selectedTasks := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(records))
514		for index := range records {
515			record := records[index]
516			resolved, err := l.discover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
517			if err != nil {
518				continue
519			}
520			commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(resolved.GitCommonDir)
521			if err != nil || commonDir != repoKey {
522				continue
523			}
524			copy := record.Task
525			copy.Tags = append([]string(nil), record.Task.Tags...)
526			selectedTasks = append(selectedTasks, &copy)
527		}
528	
529		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
530		if err != nil {
531			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
532		}
533		if rt == nil {
534			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, errors.New("flow runtime resolver returned no backend")
535		}
536		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
537		runtimeObserved := runtimeErr == nil && rt.Name() != "none"
538		contextSnapshot := inventory.CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, selected.repository, selectedTasks, inventory.RepoContextOptions{
539			Runtime: rt.Name(), Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: runtimeObserved,
540			RuntimeErr: runtimeErr, Limiter: l.limiter,
541		})
542		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
543			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
544		}
545	
546		service, serviceErr := l.service(rt)
547		base := ""
548		if queryPath := flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot); queryPath != "" {
549			base = l.base(ctx, queryPath)
550		}
551		taskComplete := taskErr == nil && len(diagnostics) == 0
552		rows, targets, projectionIssues := l.projectRows(ctx, contextSnapshot, service, serviceErr, taskComplete, base)
553	
554		issues := make([]string, 0, 8)
555		if taskErr != nil {
556			issues = append(issues, "task inventory: "+taskErr.Error())
557		}
558		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
559			issues = append(issues, "task diagnostic: "+diagnostic.Error())
560		}
561		if contextSnapshot.IdentityErr != nil {
562			issues = append(issues, "repository identity: "+contextSnapshot.IdentityErr.Error())
563		}
564		if contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr != nil {
565			issues = append(issues, "worktree inventory: "+contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr.Error())
566		}
567		if rt.Name() != "none" && runtimeErr != nil {
568			issues = append(issues, "runtime observation: "+runtimeErr.Error())
569		}
570		for _, checkout := range contextSnapshot.Checkouts {
571			if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
572				issues = append(issues, "Git status "+checkout.Worktree.Path+": "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
573			}
574		}
575		issues = append(issues, projectionIssues...)
576		issues = uniqueStrings(issues)
577	
578		freshness := flowtui.FreshnessFresh
579		if len(issues) > 0 {
580			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
581		}
582		repositoryRow := selected.row
583		repositoryRow.Available = contextSnapshot.RepositoryID == repoKey && contextSnapshot.IdentityErr == nil
584		if contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != "" && contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != repoKey {
585			issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("repository identity changed from %s to %s", repoKey, contextSnapshot.RepositoryID))
586			repositoryRow.Available = false
587			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
588		}
589		snapshot := flowtui.Snapshot{
590			Repository: repositoryRow,
591			Surfaces:   flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
592			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(),
593			Freshness:  freshness,
594			Error:      strings.Join(uniqueStrings(issues), "; "),
595		}
596		l.mu.Lock()
597		l.targets[repoKey] = targets
598		if remote, exists := l.remote[repoKey]; exists {
599			snapshot.Remote = flowtui.SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
600		}
601		l.mu.Unlock()
602		return snapshot, nil
603	}

660			issues = append(issues, rowIssues...)

662			validChoices := make([]flowtui.ActionChoice, 0, projected.Actions.Len())
663			for _, choice := range projected.Actions.Values() {
664				request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(projected.Locator, choice.Options())
665				if err != nil {

671					actionID: choice.ID, request: request,
672				}
673				targets[flowTargetKey(target.repoKey, target.rowKey, target.actionID)] = target
674				validChoices = append(validChoices, choice)
675			}
676			projected.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(validChoices...)
677			rows = append(rows, projected)
678		}
679		return rows, targets, issues

163	// scanRepo collects everything in one repository that looks like work in
164	// flight but is not yet recorded.
165	func scanRepo(ctx context.Context, app *App, r repo.Repo, sessions []runtime.Session,
166		known map[string]bool, target task.State, doWorktrees, doSessions, doBranches bool) []candidate {
167	
168		var out []candidate
169		seen := map[string]bool{}
170	
171		add := func(branch, worktree, reason string, state task.State) {
172			if branch == "" || seen[branch] {
173				return
174			}
175			id := task.MakeID(r.Name, branch)
176			if known[id] {
177				return
178			}
179			seen[branch] = true
180			mode := task.ModeBranch
181			if worktree != "" {
182				mode = task.ModeWorktree
183			}
184			out = append(out, candidate{
185				Reason: reason,
186				Task: &task.Task{
187					ID:           id,
188					Name:         branch,
189					Repo:         r.Name,
190					RepoPath:     r.Path,
191					Branch:       branch,
192					Base:         gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, r.Path),
193					WorktreePath: worktree,
194					Mode:         mode,
195					State:        state,
196					Owner:        config.Hostname(),
197				},
198			})
199		}
200	
201		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
202		if err != nil {
203			return nil
204		}
205	
206		if doWorktrees {
207			for _, w := range worktrees {
208				if w.Main || w.Branch == "" || w.Prunable {
209					continue
210				}
211				// A harness's turn-scoped worktree is not a change stream a human
212				// tracks; adopting those would fill the inventory with noise that
213				// the harness will delete on its own.
214				if inventory.IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
215					continue
216				}
217				state := target
218				reason := "existing worktree"
219				if sessionAt(sessions, w.Path) != nil {
220					state, reason = task.Hot, "worktree with a live session"
221				}
222				add(w.Branch, w.Path, reason, state)
223			}
224		}
225	
226		if doSessions {
227			for i := range sessions {
228				for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
229					if d != r.Path {
230						continue
231					}
232					st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
233					if err != nil || st.Branch == "" {
234						continue
235					}
236					add(st.Branch, "", "live session in the main checkout", task.Hot)
237				}
238			}
239		}
240	
241		if doBranches {
242			for _, branch := range unmergedBranches(ctx, r.Path) {
243				add(branch, worktreePathFor(worktrees, branch), "branch ahead of the base", target)
244			}
245		}
246		return out
247	}
248	
249	func sessionAt(sessions []runtime.Session, dir string) *runtime.Session {
250		for i := range sessions {
251			for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
252				if d == dir {
253					return &sessions[i]
254				}
255			}
256		}
257		return nil
258	}
259	
260	func worktreePathFor(worktrees []gitx.Worktree, branch string) string {
261		for _, w := range worktrees {
262			if w.Branch == branch && !w.Main {
263				return w.Path
264			}
265		}
266		return ""
267	}
268	
269	// unmergedBranches lists local branches carrying commits the default branch
270	// does not — unfinished work that would otherwise be invisible to dev.
271	func unmergedBranches(ctx context.Context, repoPath string) []string {
272		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repoPath)
273		if base == "" {
274			return nil
275		}
276		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname:short)", "refs/heads/")
277		if err != nil {
278			return nil
279		}
280		var branches []string
281		for _, b := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
282			b = strings.TrimSpace(b)
283			if b == "" || b == base || inventory.IsEphemeralWorktree("", b) {
284				continue
285			}
286			// Contained in the base means the work has already landed.
287			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", b, base); err == nil {
288				continue
289			}
290			branches = append(branches, b)
291		}
292		return branches
293	}

 package cli
 
 import (
 	"bufio"
 	"context"
 	"fmt"
 	"os"
 	"sort"
 	"strings"
 
 	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
 	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
 	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/inventory"
 	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
 	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
 	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
+	flow "github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/taskflow"
 	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
 )
 
 // candidate is something already on the machine that could become a task.
 type candidate struct {
 	Task   *task.Task
 	Reason string
 }
 
 func newAdoptCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
 	var (
 		apply       bool
 		yes         bool
 		noWorktrees bool
 		noSessions  bool
 		noBranches  bool
 		state       string
 	)
 	cmd := &cobra.Command{
 		Use:   "adopt",
 		Short: "Import existing worktrees, sessions and branches as tasks",
 		Long: `Bring what is already on this machine under dev's inventory.
 
 There is nothing to migrate to start using dev — repositories are discovered
 wherever your scan roots point, and no directory is moved or renamed. What is
 worth importing is the work already in flight: linked worktrees created by
 hand or by another tool, runtime sessions sitting in a repo, and local
 branches that are ahead of their base.
 
 Reports by default. Nothing is created without --apply, and nothing on disk is
 ever moved, renamed or deleted by this command.`,
 		Args: cobra.NoArgs,
 		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
 			ctx := ctxOf()
 
 			target, err := task.ParseState(state)
 			if err != nil {
 				return err
 			}
 
 			repos, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
 			if err != nil {
 				return err
 			}
 			existing, err := app.Tasks.List()
 			if err != nil {
 				return err
 			}
 			known := map[string]bool{}
 			for _, t := range existing {
 				known[t.ID] = true
 			}
 
 			rt := app.Runtime()
 			var sessions []runtime.Session
 			if !noSessions {
 				sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
 			}
 
 			var found []candidate
 			for _, r := range repos {
 				if r.Bare {
 					continue
 				}
 				found = append(found, scanRepo(ctx, app, r, sessions, known, target,
 					!noWorktrees, !noSessions, !noBranches)...)
 			}
 
 			if len(found) == 0 {
 				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Nothing to adopt — everything in flight is already tracked.")
 				return nil
 			}
 
 			sort.Slice(found, func(i, j int) bool {
 				if found[i].Task.Repo != found[j].Task.Repo {
 					return found[i].Task.Repo < found[j].Task.Repo
 				}

 // scanRepo collects everything in one repository that looks like work in
 // flight but is not yet recorded.
 func scanRepo(ctx context.Context, app *App, r repo.Repo, sessions []runtime.Session,
 	known map[string]bool, target task.State, doWorktrees, doSessions, doBranches bool) []candidate {
 
 	var out []candidate
 	seen := map[string]bool{}
 
 	add := func(branch, worktree, reason string, state task.State) {
 		if branch == "" || seen[branch] {
 			return
 		}
 		id := task.MakeID(r.Name, branch)
 		if known[id] {
 			return
 		}
 		seen[branch] = true
+		mode := task.ModeBranch
+		if worktree != "" {
+			mode = task.ModeWorktree
+		}
 		out = append(out, candidate{
 			Reason: reason,
 			Task: &task.Task{
 				ID:           id,
 				Name:         branch,
 				Repo:         r.Name,
 				RepoPath:     r.Path,
 				Branch:       branch,
 				Base:         gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, r.Path),
 				WorktreePath: worktree,
+				Mode:         mode,
 				State:        state,
 				Owner:        config.Hostname(),
 			},
 		})
 	}
 
 	worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
 	if err != nil {
 		return nil
 	}
 
 	if doWorktrees {
 		for _, w := range worktrees {
 			if w.Main || w.Branch == "" || w.Prunable {
 				continue
 			}
 			// A harness's turn-scoped worktree is not a change stream a human
 			// tracks; adopting those would fill the inventory with noise that
 			// the harness will delete on its own.
 			if inventory.IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
 				continue
 			}
 			state := target
 			reason := "existing worktree"
 			if sessionAt(sessions, w.Path) != nil {
 				state, reason = task.Hot, "worktree with a live session"
 			}
 			add(w.Branch, w.Path, reason, state)
 		}
 	}
 
 	if doSessions {
 		for i := range sessions {
 			for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
 				if d != r.Path {
 					continue
 				}
 				st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
 				if err != nil || st.Branch == "" {
 					continue
 				}
 				add(st.Branch, "", "live session in the main checkout", task.Hot)
 			}
 		}
 	}
 
 	if doBranches {
 		for _, branch := range unmergedBranches(ctx, r.Path) {
 			add(branch, worktreePathFor(worktrees, branch), "branch ahead of the base", target)
 		}
 	}
 	return out
 }
 
 func sessionAt(sessions []runtime.Session, dir string) *runtime.Session {
 	for i := range sessions {
 		for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
 			if d == dir {
 				return &sessions[i]
 			}
 		}
 	}
 	return nil
 }
 
 func worktreePathFor(worktrees []gitx.Worktree, branch string) string {
 	for _, w := range worktrees {
 		if w.Branch == branch && !w.Main {
 			return w.Path
 		}
 	}
 	return ""
 }

283	func replanDone(
284		ctx context.Context,

289		fresh, err := session.plan(ctx, options)

304		return fresh, nil

335	func doneFatalPreflightError(selected task.Task, plan flow.Plan) error {
336		view := doneView(plan)
337		if view.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
338			return fmt.Errorf("%s has %d conflicted path(s); resolve or abort the merge/rebase before finishing",
339				config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), view.Status.Conflicted)
340		}
341		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionCheckoutPresent); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
342			return fmt.Errorf("%s no longer exists — resume the task first", config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath))
343		}
344		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionExplicitBase); ok &&
345			condition.Requirement == flow.RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
346			return fmt.Errorf("cannot determine the base branch for %s — pass --base when starting a task", selected.Repo)
347		}
348		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionFinishAnalysis); ok && condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictError {
349			return errors.New(condition.Evidence)
350		}
351		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionArtifactReady); ok &&
352			(condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictBlocked || condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictError) {
353			return fmt.Errorf("artifact readiness for %s is blocked: %s; finalize or discard the intent before integration",
354				config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence)
355		}
356		return nil
357	}

359	func donePlanReadinessError(selected task.Task, plan flow.Plan, selection doneSelection) error {
360		if plan.Availability == flow.AvailabilityReady {
361			return nil
362		}
363		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionCheckoutClean); ok &&
364			condition.Requirement == flow.RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
365			switch selection.Dirty {
366			case flow.DirtyAuto, flow.DirtyFail:
367				return dirtyFinishError(selected, plan)
368			case flow.DirtyCommit:
369				if strings.TrimSpace(selection.Message) == "" {
370					return errors.New("--message is required with --dirty=commit outside an interactive terminal")
371				}
372			}
373		}
374		if plan.Action == flow.ReviewHandoff {
375			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionBranchRelation); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
376				base := doneView(plan).Base
377				return fmt.Errorf("%s is already contained in %s; use --ff to finalize cleanup instead of opening a PR",
378					selected.Branch, base)
379			}
380		}
381		if plan.Action == flow.VerifyMerged {
382			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionMergeProof); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
383				fields := plan.AuthorityFields()
384				return fmt.Errorf("cannot verify %s is contained in %s", fields["completion.proof-ref"], fields["completion.base-ref"])
385			}
386		}
387		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
388		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
389		for _, condition := range blocking {
390			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
391			if condition.Remediation != "" {
392				message += " (" + condition.Remediation + ")"
393			}
394			parts = append(parts, message)
395		}
396		if len(parts) == 0 {
397			return fmt.Errorf("finish plan is %s: %w", plan.Availability, flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
398		}
399		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability,
400			strings.Join(parts, "; "), flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
401	}

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}

49	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAndSpecify(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (PlanSpec, lifecycleObservation, error) {
50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:
64			spec = s.resumeSpec(request, observed)
65		case CompleteDirect:
66			spec = s.completeDirectSpec(request, observed)
67		case CompleteFF:
68			spec = s.completeFFSpec(request, observed)
69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}
76		return spec, observed, nil
77	}

81		if err != nil {
82			return Plan{}, observed, err

88	func validateLifecycleLocator(locator Locator) error {
89		switch {
90		case locator.TaskID == "":
91			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact TaskID is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
92		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
93			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
94		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
95			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
96		case locator.RepoPath == "":
97			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
98		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
99			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
100		case locator.Branch == "":
101			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
102		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
103			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
104		case !validState(locator.State):
105			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
106		}
107		return nil
108	}
109	
110	func validateRecordIdentity(locator Locator, record task.Record) error {
111		candidate := record.Task
112		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
113		if record.Revision != locator.TaskRevision {
114			return staleTaskRevision(locator.TaskRevision, record.Revision, "task revision no longer matches the selected row")
115		}
116		checks := []struct {
117			name     string
118			expected string
119			actual   string
120		}{
121			{"TaskID", locator.TaskID, candidate.ID},
122			{"mode", string(locator.Mode), string(mode)},
123			{"state", string(locator.State), string(candidate.State)},
124			{"branch", locator.Branch, candidate.Branch},
125			{"base", locator.Base, candidate.Base},
126		}
127		for _, check := range checks {
128			if check.expected != check.actual {
129				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
130			}
131		}
132	
133		selectedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(locator.RepoPath)
134		if err != nil {
135			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.RepoPath, err)}
136		}
137		recordedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate.RepoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.RepoPath, err)}
140		}
141		if selectedRepo != recordedRepo {
142			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task repository path changed from %q to %q", selectedRepo, recordedRepo)}
143		}
144	
145		expectedCheckout := recordedRepo
146		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
147			expectedCheckout = ""
148			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
149				expectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(candidate.WorktreePath)
150				if err != nil {
151					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.WorktreePath, err)}
152				}
153			}
154		}
155		selectedCheckout := ""
156		if locator.CheckoutPath != "" {
157			selectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(locator.CheckoutPath)
158			if err != nil {
159				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.CheckoutPath, err)}
160			}
161		}
162		if selectedCheckout != expectedCheckout {
163			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task checkout path changed from %q to %q", selectedCheckout, expectedCheckout)}
164		}
165		return nil
166	}

168	func staleTaskRevision(expected, actual, reason string) error {
169		return &StalePlanError{
170			ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: expected,
171			ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   actual,
172			Reason:                       reason,
173		}
174	}

176	func (s *lifecycleService) observeLifecycle(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (lifecycleObservation, error) {
177		observed := lifecycleObservation{record: record, task: record.Task, mode: record.Task.EffectiveMode()}
178		observed.setCaller(s.host, s.cwd, s.callerWorkspace, s.callerPane)
179	
180		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
181		if err != nil {
182			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, record.Task.ID, err)
183		}
184		observed.repo = repository
185		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
186		if err != nil {
187			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
188		}
189		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
190		if err != nil {
191			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
192		}
193		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(record.Task.RepoPath)
194		if err != nil {
195			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
196		}
197		if recordedRepo != observed.repoPath {
198			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q", record.Task.RepoPath, recordedRepo, observed.repoPath)}
199		}
200		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
201		if err != nil {
202			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
203		}
204		if requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
205			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("Git common directory changed from %q to %q", requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir)}
206		}
207		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
208			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
209			if keyErr != nil {
210				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
211			}
212			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
213				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository key changed from %q to %q", requestedKey, observed.gitCommonDir)}
214			}
215		}
216	
217		s.observeCheckout(ctx, request, &observed)
218		if observed.hasCheckout() {
219			observed.status, observed.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
220			if observed.statusErr == nil {
221				observed.head, observed.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
222				observed.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.head)
223				observed.baseOID, observed.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
224				observed.upstreamOID, observed.upstreamOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.status.Upstream)
225				observed.operation, observed.inProgress, observed.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
226			}
227		}
228		s.observeActionRefs(ctx, request, &observed)
229		if err := validateLiveLocator(request.Locator, observed); err != nil {
230			return observed, err
231		}
232	
233		if isCompletionAction(request.Action) {
234			s.observeCompletionFacts(ctx, request, &observed)
235		}
236		observed.runtime, observed.runtimeErr = s.runtimeFor(observed.task)
237		if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
238			observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
239			s.observeActionRuntime(ctx, request, &observed)
240		}
241		return observed, nil
242	}

244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
248			observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
249			if err == nil {
250				observed.worktreeFound = true
251				observed.checkout = registered.Path
252			}
253		case task.ModeWorktree:
254			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
255				registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.WorktreePath)
256				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
257				if err == nil {
258					observed.worktreeFound = true
259					observed.checkout = registered.Path
260				}
261			}
262			if observed.worktreeFound || request.Action != Resume ||
263				(observed.task.State != task.Warm && observed.task.State != task.Cold) {
264				return
265			}
266			worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
267			if err != nil {
268				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("list worktrees for parked-task resume: %w", err)
269				return
270			}
271			var candidate string
272			for _, worktree := range worktrees {
273				if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
274					observed.branchMatches++
275					candidate = worktree.Path
276				}
277			}
278			switch observed.branchMatches {
279			case 0:
280				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
281					observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has no checkout", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, observed.task.Branch)
282				}
283			case 1:
284				registered, resolveErr := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, candidate)
285				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, resolveErr
286				if resolveErr == nil {
287					observed.worktreeFound = true
288					observed.checkout = registered.Path
289				}
290			default:
291				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has %d registered checkouts", gitx.ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, observed.task.Branch, observed.branchMatches)
292			}
293		}
294	}

296	func validateLiveLocator(locator Locator, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
297		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.hasCheckout() {
298			checks := []struct {
299				name     string
300				expected string
301				actual   string
302				required bool
303			}{
304				{"upstream", locator.Upstream, observed.status.Upstream, true},
305				{"HEAD", locator.HeadOID, observed.head, locator.HeadOID != ""},
306				{"base OID", locator.BaseOID, observed.baseOID, locator.BaseOID != ""},
307				{"upstream OID", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.upstreamOID, locator.UpstreamOID != ""},
308			}
309			for _, check := range checks {
310				if check.required && check.expected != check.actual {
311					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
312				}
313			}
314			return nil
315		}
316		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.HeadOID != "" {
317			if observed.localBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.HeadOID != observed.localBranchOID {
318				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected local branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.HeadOID, observed.localBranchOID)}
319			}
320		}
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.UpstreamOID != "" && locator.Upstream == observed.remoteBranch {
322			if observed.remoteBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.UpstreamOID != observed.remoteBranchOID {
323				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected remote branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.remoteBranchOID)}
324			}
325		}
326		return nil
327	}

329	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRuntime(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
330		switch options := request.Options.(type) {
331		case ParkWarmOptions:
332			if options.KeepSession || !observed.hasCheckout() {
333				return
334			}
335			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
336			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
337		case ParkColdOptions:
338			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
339				return
340			}
341			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
342			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
343			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
344				observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
345			}
346		case ResumeOptions:
347			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
348				return
349			}
350			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
351				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
352				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
353				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
354			})
355			if s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) == nil {
356				observed.savedRuntimeLive = savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
357			}
358		case CompleteDirectOptions, CompleteFFOptions, ReviewHandoffOptions, VerifyMergedOptions:
359			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
360				return
361			}
362			occupancyOptions := runtime.OccupancyOptions{
363				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
364				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
365				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
366			}
367			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, occupancyOptions)
368			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
369				observed.integration.occupancy = observed.occupancy
370				observed.integration.occupancyErr = observed.occupancyErr
371			}
372			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.integration.worktreeFound {
373				observed.integration.occupancy, observed.integration.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(
374					ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, occupancyOptions,
375				)
376			}
377		}
378	}

380	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRefs(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
381		observed.localBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
382		if observed.localBranchExists {
383			observed.localBranchOID, observed.localBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
384		}
385		observed.remoteBranch = "origin/" + observed.task.Branch
386		observed.remoteBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
387		if observed.remoteBranchExists {
388			observed.remoteBranchOID, observed.remoteBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)

390	
391		switch request.Action {
392		case ParkCold:
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
394				observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
395				if observed.baseRef == "" {
396					observed.baseRef = s.gitDefaultBranch(ctx, observed.repoPath)
397				}
398				observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
399			}
400		case Resume:
401			observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
402			if observed.remoteBranchExists {
403				observed.baseRef = observed.remoteBranch

405			observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)

408				if observed.task.State == task.Warm && observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {

--- exact rule ---
85-- A taskflow Plan is bound to the exact task revision and repository/worktree/ref/runtime/artifact identities shown at Plan time. Apply must lock, reload, and revalidate those identities; a changed revision or authority produces a stale-plan result with no new effect.
86-- Managed rows receive only legal mode/state lifecycle actions. An unmanaged linked checkout may be adopted by metadata-only task creation or removed only when exact, clean, unclaimed, non-harness, and branch-preserving; canonical, harness-owned, ambiguous/conflicting, locked, prunable, or incompletely observed rows fail closed for destructive actions.
87:- Local repository refresh must not contact remotes. Fetching refs and querying a forge are explicit network actions, and review evidence is run-local manual evidence limited to portable existence/state/draft/URL/provider/time fields; never infer review decisions or checks.
88-- Reconciliation flows such as `sweep`, command-level `adopt`, and bootstrap organization plans report before applying changes. Direct actions such as `wt rm`, `tries archive`, and `cache clear` mutate immediately after their own safety checks; do not treat them as previews. `dev flow` is plan-first regardless of the adapted command's normal CLI interaction.
89-- Raw Git and configured external tools remain outside dev-mediated locks, revalidation, and safety guarantees. Existing expert CLI flags remain compatibility surface even when the preview flow deliberately omits them.

48	func validateRefreshRemoteLocator(locator Locator) error {
49		switch {
50		case locator.RepoPath == "":
51			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
52		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
53			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
54		case !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Branch):
55			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact head branch %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Branch)
56		case locator.Base != "" && !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Base):
57			return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Base)
58		case locator.HeadOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.HeadOID):
59			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact HEAD OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.HeadOID)
60		case locator.BaseOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.BaseOID):
61			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact base OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.BaseOID)
62		}
63	
64		if locator.TaskID == "" {
65			switch {
66			case locator.TaskRevision != "":
67				return fmt.Errorf("%w: task revision requires a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
68			case locator.HeadOID == "":
69				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged remote refresh requires an exact HEAD OID", ErrInvalidRequest)
70			case locator.Mode != "" && !validMode(locator.Mode):
71				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown checkout mode %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Mode)
72			case locator.State != "" && !validState(locator.State):
73				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown task state %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.State)
74			}
75			return nil
76		}
77	
78		switch {
79		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
80			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
81		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
82			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
83		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
84			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
85		case !validState(locator.State):
86			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
87		}
88		return nil
89	}

91	func normalizedRemoteBranch(branch string) bool {
92		return branch != "" && branch == strings.TrimSpace(branch) &&
93			!strings.ContainsRune(branch, '\x00') &&
94			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/heads/") &&
95			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/remotes/")
96	}
97	
98	func normalizeRemoteName(name string) (string, error) {
99		if name == "" {
100			return "origin", nil
101		}
102		if name != strings.TrimSpace(name) || strings.ContainsRune(name, '\x00') || strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") {
103			return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: remote name %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, name)
104		}
105		return name, nil
106	}

108	func (s *lifecycleService) planRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
109		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
110			return PlanSpec{}, err
111		}
112		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
113			return PlanSpec{}, err
114		}
115	
116		if request.Locator.TaskID == "" {
117			spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, nil)
118			return spec, err
119		}
120	
121		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
122		if err != nil {
123			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
124		}
125		spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, record)
126		if err != nil {
127			return PlanSpec{}, err
128		}
129		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning remote refresh"}
132		}
133		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
134			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning remote refresh")
135		}
136		return spec, nil
137	}

140		observed := remoteRefreshObservation{record: record, head: request.Locator.Branch, base: request.Locator.Base}

178			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
179				"selected repository identity changed: main %q -> %q, common directory %q -> %q",
180				requestedRepo, observed.repoPath, requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir,

199			}

201	
202		observed.remoteURL = strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
203		observed.providerKind, observed.providerRepository = forge.IdentityFromURL(observed.remoteURL)
204		options := request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions)
205		if options.QueryReview && observed.remoteURL != "" && observed.providerKind != forge.Unknown && observed.providerRepository != "" {
206			observed.provider, observed.providerResolveErr = s.resolveForge(observed.providerKind)
207			if observed.providerResolveErr == nil {
208				switch {
209				case observed.provider == nil:

211				case observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind:
212					observed.providerResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("forge resolver returned %s for %s remote", observed.provider.Kind(), observed.providerKind)
213				default:

215					observed.providerAvailable = observed.provider.Available()

238	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRemoteRefNames(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) error {
239		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
240			"head":        "refs/heads/" + head,
241			"remote name": "refs/remotes/" + remote + "/__dev_refresh_probe__",
242		} {
243			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", ref); err != nil {
244				return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not a valid normalized Git name: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, label, err)
245			}
246		}
247		if base != "" {
248			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", "refs/heads/"+base); err != nil {
249				return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base is not a valid normalized Git branch: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
250			}
251		}
252		return nil
253	}

255	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRefreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, locator Locator, observed *remoteRefreshObservation) error {
256		checkout := locator.CheckoutPath
257		if checkout == "" {
258			checkout = locator.RepoPath
259		}
260		canonical, err := s.canonicalPath(checkout)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize selected checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
263		}
264		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, canonical)
265		if err != nil {
266			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout registration changed: " + err.Error()}
267		}
268		if registered.Path != canonical || registered.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
269			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout no longer belongs to the exact repository identity"}
270		}
271		if registered.Worktree.Detached || registered.Worktree.Branch != locator.Branch {
272			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
273				"selected checkout branch changed from %q to %q", locator.Branch, registered.Worktree.Branch,
274			)}
275		}
276		liveHead, err := s.gitRun(ctx, canonical, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
277		if err != nil {
278			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout HEAD is no longer observable: " + err.Error()}
279		}
280		liveHead = strings.TrimSpace(liveHead)
281		if registered.Worktree.Head != liveHead || locator.HeadOID != liveHead {
282			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
283				"selected checkout HEAD changed from %q to registry=%q live=%q", locator.HeadOID, registered.Worktree.Head, liveHead,
284			)}
285		}
286		observed.checkout = canonical
287		observed.worktree = registered
288		return nil
289	}

291	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRemoteRefs(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) RemoteRefsObservation {

379	func refreshHeadCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {

384		case !ref.Exists:

387		case ref.OID == "":

390		default:

392				ref.Ref+" is exactly "+ref.OID, "")

511	func remoteRefsAuthority(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
512		values := make([]string, 0, 16)
513		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {

519	func remoteRefsEvidence(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
520		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
521		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
522			if ref.Ref == "" {
523				continue
524			}
525			switch {
526			case ref.Failure != "":
527				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" error: "+ref.Failure)
528			case ref.Exists:
529				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"="+ref.OID)
530			default:
531				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" is absent")
532			}
533		}
534		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
535	}

548	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
549		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
550			return Result{}, err
551		}
552		if approved.Action != RefreshRemote {
553			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "refresh-remote handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
554		}
555		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
556			return Result{}, err
557		}
558		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
559		if err != nil {
560			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
561		}
562	
563		var result Result
564		applyLocked := func(tx *task.Tx) error {
565			var record *task.Record
566			if approved.Locator.TaskID != "" {
567				if tx == nil {
568					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "managed remote refresh has no task transaction"}
569				}
570				current, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
571				if loadErr != nil {
572					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before remote refresh"}
573				}
574				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *current); identityErr != nil {
575					return identityErr
576				}
577				record = current
578			}
579	
580			spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, approved.Request, record)
581			if observeErr != nil {
582				return observeErr
583			}
584			fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
585			if buildErr != nil {
586				return buildErr
587			}
588			if record != nil {
589				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
590				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
591					actual := ""
592					if current != nil {
593						actual = current.Revision
594					}
595					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked remote refresh replan")
596				}
597			}
598			if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
599				return &StalePlanError{
600					ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
601					ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
602					ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
603					Reason:                       "fresh task, repository, remote URL, provider, or ref authority differs",
604				}
605			}
606			if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
607				notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
608				return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh remote refresh conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
609			}
610	
611			execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh}
612			result, observeErr = execution.executeRefreshRemote(ctx, observed)
613			return observeErr
614		}
615	
616		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
617			if approved.Locator.TaskID == "" {
618				return applyLocked(nil)
619			}
620			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, applyLocked)
621		})
622		return result, err
623	}
624	
625	func (e *executionState) executeRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation) (Result, error) {
626		data := RemoteObservation{
627			RemoteName: observed.remoteName, RemoteURL: observed.remoteURL,
628			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
629			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, BeforeRefs: observed.refs,
630		}
631		e.remote = &data
632		fetched := false
633	
634		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
635			switch effect.Code {
636			case EffectFetchRefs:
637				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
638					_, fetchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "--", observed.remoteName)
639					if fetchErr != nil {
640						return "", fmt.Errorf("fetch --prune %s: %w", observed.remoteName, fetchErr)
641					}
642					return "fetched and pruned " + observed.remoteName, nil
643				})
644				if err != nil {
645					recovery := []string{"remote refs were not proven refreshed; repair the exact remote fetch and create a fresh plan"}
646					if e.plan.Request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions).QueryReview {
647						recovery = append(recovery, "review query was not attempted after the failed fetch")
648					}
649					return e.fail(err, recovery...)
650				}

36	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
37		if intent == nil {
38			return fmt.Errorf("create nil artifact intent")
39		}
40		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
41			candidate := *intent
42			if candidate.ID == "" {
43				candidate.ID = s.newID()

45			candidate.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
46			candidate.Status = Armed
47			now := s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
48			candidate.CreatedAt, candidate.UpdatedAt = now, now
49			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
50				return err
51			}
52			if _, err := os.Stat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
53				return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s already exists", candidate.ID)
54			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return err
56			}
57			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {

59			}
60			*intent = candidate

173			return err
174		}
175		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
176			return err
177		}
178		return os.Rename(name, s.path(intent.ID))
179	}

181	func ensureJSONEOF(decoder *json.Decoder) error {
182		var extra any
183		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
184			return nil
185		} else if err != nil {
186			return err
187		}
188		return fmt.Errorf("multiple JSON values")
189	}
190	
191	func randomID() string {
192		var raw [12]byte
193		if _, err := rand.Read(raw[:]); err != nil {
194			return fmt.Sprintf("intent-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
195		}
196		return "intent-" + hex.EncodeToString(raw[:])
197	}

1	// Package artifact finalizes agent transcripts only after their writer exits.
2	package artifact
3	
4	import (
5		"fmt"
6		"regexp"
7		"strings"
8		"time"
9	)
10	
11	const SchemaVersion = 1
12	
13	type Status string
14	
15	const (
16		Armed      Status = "armed"
17		Finalizing Status = "finalizing"
18		Finalized  Status = "finalized"
19		Failed     Status = "failed"
20		// Discarded records an operator's explicit decision that an intent can
21		// never be finalized — its transcript is gone, or its HEAD no longer
22		// exists. It is deliberately distinct from Finalized: nothing was
23		// committed, and the record survives to say so.
24		Discarded Status = "discarded"
25	)
26	
27	// Intent is a durable handoff from an active agent to an external finalizer.
28	type Intent struct {
29		SchemaVersion      int      `json:"schema_version"`
30		ID                 string   `json:"id"`
31		RunID              string   `json:"run_id"`
32		Provider           string   `json:"provider"`
33		SessionID          string   `json:"session_id"`
34		TaskID             string   `json:"task_id,omitempty"`
35		RepoPath           string   `json:"repo_path"`
36		GitCommonDir       string   `json:"git_common_dir"`
37		WorktreePath       string   `json:"worktree_path"`
38		Branch             string   `json:"branch"`
39		Base               string   `json:"base,omitempty"`
40		Head               string   `json:"head"`
41		PlanPaths          []string `json:"plan_paths,omitempty"`
42		UnrelatedArtifacts []string `json:"unrelated_artifacts,omitempty"`
43		AllowLarge         bool     `json:"allow_large,omitempty"`
44	
45		Status         Status    `json:"status"`
46		TranscriptPath string    `json:"transcript_path,omitempty"`
47		ArtifactCommit string    `json:"artifact_commit,omitempty"`
48		FailureCode    string    `json:"failure_code,omitempty"`
49		SessionEndedAt time.Time `json:"session_ended_at,omitempty"`
50		CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`
51		UpdatedAt      time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
52	}
53	
54	var (
55		idPattern      = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$`)
56		sessionPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+:[0-9a-fA-F-]{16,}$`)
57	)
58	
59	func (i Intent) Validate() error {
60		switch {
61		case i.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion:
62			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported artifact intent schema %d", i.SchemaVersion)
63		case !idPattern.MatchString(i.ID):
64			return fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent id %q", i.ID)
65		case i.RunID == "" || !idPattern.MatchString(i.RunID):
66			return fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact run id %q", i.RunID)
67		case i.Provider == "" || i.SessionID == "":
68			return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent needs provider and session id")
69		case i.RepoPath == "" || i.WorktreePath == "" || i.GitCommonDir == "":
70			return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent needs repository, worktree and git common-dir paths")
71		case i.Branch == "" || i.Head == "":
72			return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent needs branch and head")
73		}
74		if !sessionPattern.MatchString(i.Provider + ":" + i.SessionID) {
75			return fmt.Errorf("invalid agent session %q", i.Provider+":"+i.SessionID)
76		}
77		switch i.Status {
78		case Armed, Finalizing, Finalized, Failed, Discarded:
79			return nil
80		default:
81			return fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent status %q", i.Status)
82		}
83	}
84	
85	func ParseSession(value string) (provider, sessionID string, err error) {
86		provider, sessionID, ok := strings.Cut(strings.TrimSpace(value), ":")
87		provider = strings.ToLower(provider)
88		if !ok || !sessionPattern.MatchString(provider+":"+sessionID) {
89			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("invalid session %q: want provider:uuid", value)
90		}
91		return provider, sessionID, nil
92	}
93

 Code、history 或 plans 需要保持可 review，或人之後可能回來時，使用 `dev`。不要把長期 `dev` worktree 巢狀放在 repository 內；外層 checkout 的 file watcher、language server、backup tool 與搜尋會看到第二份 tree。
 
 `dev` 使用 Git 在設定路徑建立 checkout；Herdr 只開啟現有 path，因此沒有 Herdr 的機器仍維持相同 placement policy。
 
+`dev flow [repo]` 以 Git 的 authoritative worktree records 顯示 canonical、managed、unmanaged 與 strict `.claude/worktrees/` harness rows，另加入沒有 checkout 的 task-only rows。它不以 `worktree-*` branch prefix 猜 ownership；path/task binding 有歧義時標示 CONFLICT 並停止 lifecycle mutation。詳見 [Repository Flow 預覽](repository-flow.zh-TW.md)。

 移除 worktree 與刪除 branch 是兩個決定。`dev wt rm` 會保留 branch，且沒有 explicit force 時拒絕 dirty checkout。Directory 若在 Git 之外消失，它會 prune stale administrative entry。
 
+在 `dev flow` 中，UNMANAGED row 的 Remove Checkout 只對 exact、clean、unlocked、non-prunable、non-harness linked checkout 出現，並在移除前後 revalidate task claims、Git/agent/runtime/artifact facts；branch 與其 OID 必須保留。Flow 不提供 force/dirty-discard/unknown-runtime override。Managed DONE row 不是 Remove Checkout，而是最後才 reap task record 的 Retire plan；可選 branch deletion 是另一個 typed confirmation。Raw `git worktree remove --force` 會繞過這些 guarantees。

 ### Handoff
 
 `stay` 只輸出結果；`cd` 透過受信任的 `shell-init` wrapper 改變 parent shell；
 `open` 開啟 configured Herdr/tmux/Zellij runtime，runtime 為 `none` 時退回 `cd`；
 `start` 會固定此 repository 並接續現有 task wizard。Setup 留下 uncommitted files、
 導致新 worktree 會遺漏它們時，`start` 不可用。Repository bootstrap 與
 預設的 `dev start` 都不會啟動 coding agent。明確使用 worktree mode 的
 `dev start --run '<shell command>'` 時，只有本次新建 first-class Herdr worktree
 回傳 exact root pane 才會 dispatch command；之後是否轉跳仍由 `--focus` 獨立控制。
 
 Repository、task-start 與 finish wizard 共用的 TTY text fields 都使用 inline editor：
 Left/Right、Home/End、Delete/Backspace、cursor 位置插入與 Esc/Ctrl-C cancellation 會
 被解讀為 terminal actions，不會成為 raw escape bytes。Buffered 或 piped non-TTY input
 仍維持 line-oriented behavior。
 
+## `dev flow [repo]` preview
+
+`dev flow [repo]` 是獨立 full-screen command，只接受 interactive TTY；它沒有 JSON/non-interactive contract。省略 `repo` 時，canonical/linked checkout 會開啟同一 Git common-directory repository 並 focus exact current surface；Git 之外則非同步開 repository picker。明確 `repo` 會覆蓋 cwd。
+
+Startup 與 `r` 只載入 local topology/evidence。`R` 才提供 Fetch refs、Refresh PR/MR 或 Both；每個 choice 都先產生 exact guarded plan，再要求 approval。Provider review observation 只在 current run 保存最低限度的 existence、`open`/`draft`/`merged`/`closed`、URL、provider 與 observed time，不代表 CI checks 或 approvals。`runtime=none` 保持 unobserved，也不提供 `--assume-no-runtime` 等 expert override。詳細 keys、row kinds、partial ledger 與 escape boundary 見 [Repository Flow 預覽](../guides/repository-flow.zh-TW.md)。
+
 ## `dev done` finish flags
 
-`dev done` 對 branch/worktree task 只透過下列其中一種方式 integrate：`--ff`（rebase 到 base 再 fast-forward）或 `--pr`（push 並開啟 pull/merge request）。兩者都省略時，在 TTY 上會開啟 interactive finish wizard —— 提示內容見[變更流工作流程](../guides/change-stream-workflow.zh-TW.md)。
+`dev done` 對 branch/worktree task 透過 `--ff`（rebase 到 base 再 fast-forward）、`--pr`（push 並開啟 pull/merge request）或 `--merged`（依 `--base-ref` 驗證外部 integration）處理。未指定 integration choice 時，在 TTY 上會開啟 interactive finish wizard —— 提示內容見[變更流工作流程](../guides/change-stream-workflow.zh-TW.md)。
 
 Dirty checkout 由 `--dirty <auto|fail|commit|discard>` 處理（預設 `auto`）：
 
 | 值 | 行為 |
 |---|---|
 | `auto` | interactive：提示 commit 或 discard；non-interactive：直接失敗，等同 `fail` |
 | `fail` | dirty checkout 時拒絕 finish |
 | `commit` | 用 `--message`/`-m` commit 全部變更（未指定時 interactive 會提示輸入） |
 | `discard` | reset tracked 變更並移除 untracked files；具破壞性，沒有 TTY 時需要 `--yes` |
 
-`--yes`/`-y` 用來確認選定的 finish plan；non-interactive 的 `--dirty discard` 必須要有它，其他情況則是跳過 interactive 確認步驟。`--keep-worktree` 讓 `--ff` integration 後仍保留 worktree（預設 merge 後移除），`--push` 會一併 push 產生的 branch，`--delete-branch` 只在 branch 的 commits 已被 base 包含時才刪除它 —— 有 unpushed commits 的 branch 永遠不會被刪除。
+`--yes`/`-y` 用來確認選定的 finish plan；non-interactive 的 `--dirty discard` 必須要有它，其他情況則是跳過 interactive 確認步驟。`--push` 會依 selected integration push 對應 branch/base。成功的 local 或 externally verified integration 只記錄 DONE/MERGED，永遠保留 runtime、worktree 與 branch 給獨立的 `dev retire`；`--keep-worktree` 只保留為 no-op compatibility warning，`--delete-branch` 則會報錯並指向 `dev retire --delete-branch`。`--merged` 可用 `--confirm-squash <merge-commit>` 對 squash result 作明確 operator attestation，不能由 provider status 自動推斷。
 
 ## Configuration
 
 ```bash
 dev config init
 dev config show
 dev config path
 dev config scaffolds init
 dev config scaffolds show
 dev config scaffolds path
 dev config scaffolds edit
 ```
 
 `config init` 偵測 local roots 並寫出 explicit defaults。Config file 不存在仍可運作；built-in defaults 讓核心 Git behavior 可用，但 generated config 能讓 machine policy 可 review，因此較推薦。
 
 主要 sections：
 
 | Section | 控制內容 |
 |---|---|
 | `[paths]` | scan roots、project/tries/worktree roots、worktree template、state path |
 | `[runtime]` | `auto`、Herdr、tmux、Zellij 或 none，以及 metadata settings |
 | `[worktree]` | ignored includes、linked dirs、setup commands、strategies、timeout |
 | `[forge]` / `[[forge.azure_devops]]` | 完整 remote inventory 的 cache TTL，以及 opt-in Azure organization/project targets |
 | `[bootstrap]` | recursion、symlink handling、index/layout policy |
 | `[tui]` / `[[tui.tools]]` | columns、sorting 與 external-tool bindings |
 | `[stats]` | sampler 與 optional WakaTime import |
 | `[update]` | `check`（預設 `true`）— 允許每天一次的「有新版」提示與其背景 cache refresh；`DEV_NO_UPDATE_CHECK` 可覆寫 |
 
 `DEV_TUI_TRACE=/absolute/new-file.json` 會啟用單次 TUI startup/readiness trace。
 Target 必須是 absolute 且尚不存在；dev 絕不 overwrite。Private、bounded document
 在 TUI teardown 後才寫入，只包含 relative categorical timings 與 aggregate row
 counts，不包含 names、paths 或 raw payloads；它不是 configuration、cache、durable
 stats、stdout 或 network telemetry。
-TUI invocation 的 optional update-cache network refresh 也會延後到 initial view
-return 之後。
+Dashboard 與 `dev flow` 這類 full-screen invocation 的 optional update-cache network refresh 也會延後到 initial view return 之後；這不會把 Flow 自己的 local `r` 變成 remote refresh。
 
 Repository quick-note Markdown 是 configured `paths.state_dir/notes` 下的 durable data；該路徑預設為 `$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/notes`。`$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` 的 full-text index 是 disposable，會從 Markdown 重建；調整 `paths.state_dir` 不會移動 cache。

19	// CreatePR opens a GitHub pull request.
20	func (g *gh) CreatePR(ctx context.Context, dir string, req PRRequest) (string, error) {
21		if !g.Available() {
22			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
23		}
24		args := []string{"pr", "create", "--base", req.Base, "--head", req.Head}
25		switch {
26		case req.Title != "":
27			args = append(args, "--title", req.Title, "--body", req.Body)
28		default:
29			// --fill derives title and body from the branch's commits, which is
30			// the right default for a solo workflow where the commits already say
31			// what happened.
32			args = append(args, "--fill")
33		}
34		if req.Draft {
35			args = append(args, "--draft")
36		}
37		if req.Web {
38			args = append(args, "--web")
39		}
40		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
41		return lastURL(out), err
42	}

44	// QueryReview manually observes an exact GitHub pull request relationship.
45	func (g *gh) QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
46		if !g.Available() {
47			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
48		}
49		if err := validateReviewQuery(query); err != nil {
50			return nil, err
51		}
52		out, err := reviewRunner(ctx, "gh", dir,
53			"pr", "list", "--repo", query.Repository,
54			"--head", query.Head, "--base", query.Base, "--state", "all",
55			"--limit", "1000",
56			"--json", "id,number,state,isDraft,url,headRefName,baseRefName")
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, err
59		}

61	}

63	func parseGitHubReviews(out string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {

68			IsDraft     *bool  `json:"isDraft"`

74			return nil, err
75		}

82			candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
83				ID: item.ID, Number: number, State: item.State, Draft: item.IsDraft,
84				URL: item.URL, Head: item.HeadRefName, Base: item.BaseRefName,
85			})
86		}

95			}
96			return ReviewOpen, nil

106	// CreateRepo creates a GitHub repository from the local checkout.
107	func (g *gh) CreateRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (string, error) {

109			return "", &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
110		}
111		target, err := resolveRepoRequest(req)
112		if err != nil {
113			return "", err
114		}
115		args := []string{"repo", "create", target.fullName, "--source", ".", "--remote", target.remoteName,
116			visibilityFlag(target.visibility)}
117		if req.Description != "" {
118			args = append(args, "--description", req.Description)
119		}
120		if req.Push {
121			args = append(args, "--push")
122		}
123		out, err := run(ctx, "gh", dir, args...)
124		return lastURL(out), err
125	}

128	// not pass --source, --remote or --push, leaving all local Git mutations to the

130	func (g *gh) PublishRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string, req RepoRequest) (CreateRepoResult, error) {
131		if !g.Available() {

133		}

145		}

147		if result.RemoteURL == "" {
148			return result, fmt.Errorf("gh created %q but did not report a repository URL", target.fullName)
149		}
150		return result, nil
151	}

153	// CloneURL renders a clone target. gh accepts a bare owner/name, so a
154	// shorthand reference is passed through untouched.
155	func (g *gh) CloneURL(ref string) string {
156		if strings.Contains(ref, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "git@") {
157			return ref
158		}
159		return "https://github.com/" + strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git") + ".git"
160	}

162	// lastURL picks the URL out of a CLI's chatter, which may print progress
163	// lines before the created resource's address.
164	func lastURL(out string) string {
165		found := lastHTTPURL(out)
166		if found == "" {
167			return strings.TrimSpace(out)
168		}
169		return found
170	}

172	// ListRepos lists GitHub repositories visible to the authenticated user —
173	// owned, collaborated on, and organisation membership — most recently pushed
174	// first. gh api is intentionally used instead of a custom HTTP client:
175	// authentication and token refresh stay owned by the forge CLI.
176	func (g *gh) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
177		if !g.Available() {
178			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitHub, Bin: "gh"}
179		}
180		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 60*time.Second)
181		defer cancel()
182		const pageSize = 100
183		var result []RemoteRepo
184		for page := 1; ; page++ {
185			out, err := run(ctx, "gh", "", "api", "user/repos", "--method", "GET",
186				"-f", "per_page=100", "-f", fmt.Sprintf("page=%d", page),
187				"-f", "sort=pushed", "-f", "direction=desc")
188			if err != nil {
189				return result, err
190			}
191			repos, err := parseGitHubRepos(out)
192			if err != nil {
193				return result, err
194			}
195			result = append(result, repos...)
196			if len(repos) < pageSize {
197				break
198			}
199		}
200		return result, nil
201	}
202	
203	func parseGitHubRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
204		var raw []struct {
205			Name          string `json:"name"`
206			FullName      string `json:"full_name"`
207			Description   string `json:"description"`
208			URL           string `json:"html_url"`
209			CloneURL      string `json:"clone_url"`
210			SSHURL        string `json:"ssh_url"`
211			Visibility    string `json:"visibility"`
212			Fork          bool   `json:"fork"`
213			Archived      bool   `json:"archived"`
214			PushedAt      string `json:"pushed_at"`
215			DefaultBranch string `json:"default_branch"`
216		}
217		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
218			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode gh api user/repos: %w", err)
219		}
220		result := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
221		for _, r := range raw {
222			updated, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.PushedAt)
223			result = append(result, RemoteRepo{
224				Forge: GitHub, Name: r.Name, FullName: r.FullName,
225				Description: r.Description, URL: r.URL,
226				CloneURL: r.CloneURL, SSHURL: r.SSHURL,
227				Visibility: r.Visibility, DefaultBranch: r.DefaultBranch,
228				Archived: r.Archived, Fork: r.Fork, UpdatedAt: updated,
229			})
230		}
231		return result, nil
232	}

191	func gitLabHost() string {
192		for _, name := range []string{"GITLAB_HOST", "GLAB_HOST"} {
193			if host := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name)); host != "" {
194				return host
195			}
196		}
197		return "gitlab.com"
198	}
199	
200	// CloneURL renders a clone target.
201	func (g *glab) CloneURL(ref string) string {
202		if strings.Contains(ref, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(ref, "git@") {
203			return ref
204		}
205		return "https://" + gitLabHost() + "/" + strings.TrimSuffix(ref, ".git") + ".git"
206	}
207	
208	// ListRepos lists every GitLab project of which the authenticated user is a
209	// member, most recently active first. glab owns authentication; dev passes an
210	// explicit GITLAB_HOST/GLAB_HOST (default gitlab.com) so inventory and cache
211	// identity never depend on the process's current Git repository.
212	func (g *glab) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
213		if !g.Available() {
214			return nil, &ErrNoCLI{Kind: GitLab, Bin: "glab"}
215		}
216		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 60*time.Second)
217		defer cancel()
218		const pageSize = 100
219		var result []RemoteRepo
220		for page := 1; ; page++ {
221			out, err := run(ctx, "glab", "", "api", "--hostname", gitLabHost(), "projects", "--method", "GET",
222				"-f", "membership=true", "-f", "simple=true", "-f", "per_page=100",
223				"-f", fmt.Sprintf("page=%d", page), "-f", "order_by=last_activity_at", "-f", "sort=desc")
224			if err != nil {
225				return result, err
226			}
227			repos, err := parseGitLabRepos(out)
228			if err != nil {
229				return result, err
230			}
231			result = append(result, repos...)
232			if len(repos) < pageSize {
233				break
234			}
235		}
236		return result, nil
237	}
238	
239	func parseGitLabRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
240		var raw []struct {
241			Name              string `json:"name"`
242			PathWithNamespace string `json:"path_with_namespace"`
243			Description       string `json:"description"`
244			DefaultBranch     string `json:"default_branch"`
245			Visibility        string `json:"visibility"`
246			SSHURL            string `json:"ssh_url_to_repo"`
247			HTTPURL           string `json:"http_url_to_repo"`
248			WebURL            string `json:"web_url"`
249			Archived          bool   `json:"archived"`
250			ForkedFrom        any    `json:"forked_from_project"`
251			LastActivityAt    string `json:"last_activity_at"`
252		}
253		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
254			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode glab api projects: %w", err)
255		}
256		result := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
257		for _, r := range raw {
258			updated, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, r.LastActivityAt)
259			result = append(result, RemoteRepo{
260				Forge: GitLab, Name: r.Name, FullName: r.PathWithNamespace,
261				Description: r.Description, URL: r.WebURL,
262				CloneURL: r.HTTPURL, SSHURL: r.SSHURL,
263				Visibility: r.Visibility, DefaultBranch: r.DefaultBranch,
264				Archived: r.Archived, Fork: r.ForkedFrom != nil, UpdatedAt: updated,
265			})
266		}
267		return result, nil
268	}

126	// QueryReview manually observes an exact Azure Repos pull request relationship.
127	func (a *az) QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
128		if err := validateReviewQuery(query); err != nil {
129			return nil, err
130		}
131		if err := a.ensureExtensionWithRunner(ctx, reviewRunner); err != nil {
132			return nil, err
133		}
134	
135		effectiveQuery, scopeArgs := a.reviewQueryScope(query)
136		const pageSize = 100
137		var candidates []reviewCandidate
138		for skip := 0; ; skip += pageSize {
139			args := []string{"repos", "pr", "list"}
140			args = append(args, scopeArgs...)
141			args = append(args,
142				"--source-branch", query.Head, "--target-branch", query.Base,
143				"--status", "all", "--top", strconv.Itoa(pageSize), "--skip", strconv.Itoa(skip),
144				"--query", azureReviewJSONQuery, "--output", "json", "--only-show-errors")
145			out, err := reviewRunner(ctx, "az", dir, args...)
146			if err != nil {
147				return nil, err
148			}
149			pageCandidates, err := parseAzureReviewCandidates(out)
150			if err != nil {
151				return nil, err
152			}
153			candidates = append(candidates, pageCandidates...)
154			if len(pageCandidates) < pageSize {
155				break
156			}
157		}
158		return selectExactReview(AzureDevOps, effectiveQuery, candidates, normalizeAzureReviewState)
159	}

161	func (a *az) reviewQueryScope(query ReviewQuery) (ReviewQuery, []string) {
162		organization, project, repository, fullIdentity := splitAzureReviewIdentity(query.Repository)
163		if fullIdentity {
164			organizationURL := "https://dev.azure.com/" + url.PathEscape(organization)
165			for _, target := range a.targets {
166				if strings.EqualFold(target.Project, project) && strings.EqualFold(azureTargetOrganization(target.Organization), organization) {
167					organizationURL = target.Organization
168					break
169				}
170			}
171			query.Repository = strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repository}, "/")
172			query.Head = azureReviewBranch(query.Head)
173			query.Base = azureReviewBranch(query.Base)
174			return query, []string{
175				"--detect", "false", "--organization", organizationURL,
176				"--project", project, "--repository", repository,
177			}
178		}
179	
180		if len(a.targets) == 1 {
181			target := a.targets[0]
182			repository := strings.Trim(query.Repository, "/")
183			if organization := azureTargetOrganization(target.Organization); organization != "" {
184				query.Repository = strings.Join([]string{organization, target.Project, repository}, "/")
185			}
186			query.Head = azureReviewBranch(query.Head)
187			query.Base = azureReviewBranch(query.Base)
188			return query, []string{
189				"--detect", "false", "--organization", target.Organization,
190				"--project", target.Project, "--repository", repository,
191			}
192		}
193	
194		query.Head = azureReviewBranch(query.Head)
195		query.Base = azureReviewBranch(query.Base)
196		return query, []string{"--detect", "true", "--repository", query.Repository}
197	}
198	
199	func splitAzureReviewIdentity(identity string) (organization, project, repository string, ok bool) {
200		parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(identity, "/"), "/")
201		if len(parts) != 3 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" || parts[2] == "" {
202			return "", "", "", false
203		}
204		return parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], true
205	}
206	
207	func azureTargetOrganization(raw string) string {
208		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
209		parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed)
210		if err == nil && parsed.Hostname() != "" {
211			host := strings.ToLower(parsed.Hostname())
212			switch {
213			case host == "dev.azure.com":
214				segments := escapedSegments(parsed.EscapedPath())
215				if len(segments) == 1 {
216					return segments[0]
217				}
218			case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com"):
219				return strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")
220			}
221			return ""
222		}
223		if !strings.ContainsAny(trimmed, "/:") {
224			return trimmed
225		}
226		return ""
227	}

229	func parseAzureReviewCandidates(out string) ([]reviewCandidate, error) {
230		var raw []struct {
231			PullRequestID       *int   `json:"pullRequestId"`
232			Status              string `json:"status"`
233			IsDraft             *bool  `json:"isDraft"`
234			SourceRefName       string `json:"sourceRefName"`
235			TargetRefName       string `json:"targetRefName"`
236			RemoteURL           string `json:"remoteUrl"`
237			RepositoryRemoteURL string `json:"repositoryRemoteUrl"`
238		}
239		if err := decodeReviewJSON(AzureDevOps, out, &raw); err != nil {
240			return nil, err
241		}
242		candidates := make([]reviewCandidate, 0, len(raw))
243		for _, item := range raw {
244			id, number := "", 0
245			if item.PullRequestID != nil {
246				number = *item.PullRequestID
247				id = strconv.Itoa(number)
248			}
249			reviewURL := item.RemoteURL
250			if !validReviewURL(reviewURL) && item.RepositoryRemoteURL != "" && number > 0 {
251				if _, repositoryURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(item.RepositoryRemoteURL); ok {
252					reviewURL = strings.TrimRight(repositoryURL, "/") + "/pullrequest/" + strconv.Itoa(number)
253				}
254			}
255			candidates = append(candidates, reviewCandidate{
256				ID: id, Number: number, State: item.Status, Draft: item.IsDraft,
257				URL: reviewURL, Head: azureReviewBranch(item.SourceRefName), Base: azureReviewBranch(item.TargetRefName),
258			})
259		}
260		return candidates, nil
261	}
262	
263	func azureReviewBranch(ref string) string {
264		return strings.TrimPrefix(ref, "refs/heads/")
265	}
266	
267	func normalizeAzureReviewState(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error) {
268		switch strings.ToLower(state) {
269		case "active":
270			if draft {
271				return ReviewDraft, nil
272			}
273			return ReviewOpen, nil
274		case "completed":
275			return ReviewMerged, nil
276		case "abandoned":
277			return ReviewClosed, nil
278		default:
279			return "", errors.New("unrecognized Azure DevOps review state")
280		}
281	}

1	package taskflow
2	
3	import "github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
4	
5	// TransitionRule is one cell in the exhaustive persisted lifecycle table. An
6	// empty Target on an allowed rule means the task record is removed rather than
7	// assigned another persisted state.
8	type TransitionRule struct {
9		Mode            task.CheckoutMode
10		Source          task.State
11		Action          Action
12		Target          task.State
13		Allowed         bool
14		StatePreserving bool
15		RemovesTask     bool
16		Milestone       Milestone
17		Reason          string
18	}
19	
20	// HasTarget reports whether an allowed edge writes a persisted target state.
21	func (r TransitionRule) HasTarget() bool { return r.Allowed && r.Target != "" }
22	
23	type transitionKey struct {
24		mode   task.CheckoutMode
25		state  task.State
26		action Action
27	}
28	
29	var (
30		modeOrder = []task.CheckoutMode{
31			task.ModeWorktree,
32			task.ModeBranch,
33			task.ModeDirect,
34		}
35		stateOrder = []task.State{
36			task.Hot,
37			task.Warm,
38			task.Cold,
39			task.Done,
40		}
41		transitionActionOrder = []Action{
42			ParkWarm,
43			ParkCold,
44			Resume,
45			CompleteDirect,
46			CompleteFF,
47			ReviewHandoff,
48			VerifyMerged,
49			Retire,
50		}
51		transitionTable = buildTransitionTable()
52	)
53	
54	// TransitionActions returns the actions represented in every mode/state row.
55	// Adopt, RemoveCheckout, RefreshRemote, and Reconcile are deliberately absent
56	// because they operate on row ownership, repository context, or drift rather
57	// than persisted-state edges.
58	func TransitionActions() []Action {
59		return append([]Action(nil), transitionActionOrder...)
60	}
61	
62	// PersistedLifecycleActions is the stable action dimension of the lifecycle
63	// table, including state-preserving review handoff but excluding repository
64	// context actions such as remote refresh.
65	func PersistedLifecycleActions() []Action { return TransitionActions() }
66	
67	// Transitions returns all table cells in mode, state, and action order. Denied
68	// cells are retained so additions cannot silently fall through a switch.
69	func Transitions() []TransitionRule {
70		out := make([]TransitionRule, 0, len(modeOrder)*len(stateOrder)*len(transitionActionOrder))
71		for _, mode := range modeOrder {
72			for _, state := range stateOrder {
73				for _, action := range transitionActionOrder {
74					out = append(out, transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: state, action: action}])
75				}
76			}
77		}
78		return out
79	}
80	
81	// LookupTransition returns the exhaustive table cell for known dimensions.
82	func LookupTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, bool) {
83		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(source) || !isTransitionAction(action) {
84			return TransitionRule{Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action}, false
85		}
86		rule, ok := transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}]
87		return rule, ok
88	}
89	
90	// RequireTransition returns the allowed table cell or a typed graph error.
91	func RequireTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, error) {
92		rule, found := LookupTransition(mode, source, action)
93		if !found {
94			rule.Reason = "unknown mode, state, or non-transition action"
95			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
96		}
97		if !rule.Allowed {
98			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
99		}
100		return rule, nil

67	
68	Without an argument, a checkout opens its canonical repository and focuses the

92	func resolveFlowLaunch(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string, deps flowCommandDeps) (flowLaunch, error) {
