388	
389	The left panel is the union of Git's registered worktrees and task records that
390	have no checkout, including normal COLD and DONE tasks. Rows are labelled
391	`canonical`, `managed`, `unmanaged`, `harness`, `task-only`, or `conflict`.
392	Canonical worktrees are never removable; harness-owned and ambiguous/conflicting
393	rows have no destructive path. An exact unmanaged linked checkout can be
394	**Adopted** by creating task metadata without changing Git bytes, or **Removed**
395	only when clean and safe; removal is non-force and always preserves the branch.
396	
397	The center distinguishes persisted task intent (`HOT`, `WARM`, `COLD`, `DONE`)
398	from observed Git/worktree/runtime/artifact facts. Unknown, failed, loading, or
399	stale evidence never becomes a false clean/closed fact. `runtime=none` leaves
400	session occupancy unobserved, but the local Git/task snapshot can still be fresh;
401	metadata-only adoption then remains WARM.
402	
403	The right panel offers concrete mode/state actions: warm/cold park, resume,
404	direct or fast-forward completion, review handoff, verified-merge completion,
405	and DONE retirement where legal. The preview deliberately excludes dirty
406	commit/discard, WIP checkpoint, shared-writer, ownership-takeover, and unknown-
407	runtime overrides. A blocked plan shows its exact evidence, remediation, and CLI
408	fallback; existing command flags remain available outside the preview.

33				"rebuild the missing linked worktree", observed.desiredWorktree, false, false,
34				map[string]string{
35					"repo": observed.repoPath, "branch": observed.task.Branch,
36					"preferred-base": observed.remoteBranch, "fallback-base": observed.task.Base,
37					"selected-base": observed.baseRef,
38					"provision":     boolString(!options.NoProvision), "runtime": "false",
39				}))
40		}
41		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
42			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectSwitchBranch,
43				"switch the clean canonical checkout to the task branch", observed.repoPath, false, false,
44				map[string]string{"from": observed.status.Branch, "to": observed.task.Branch}))
45		}
46		if shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed) {
47			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectOpenRuntime,
48				"open a runtime surface for the checkout", resumeEffectCheckout(observed), false, false,
49				map[string]string{"backend": runtimeName(observed.runtime), "label": resumeRuntimeLabel(observed.task)}))
50		}
51		runtimeDisposition := "clear"
52		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" {
53			if observed.savedRuntimeLive {
54				runtimeDisposition = "reuse:" + observed.runtime.Name() + ":" + observed.task.RuntimeHandle
55			} else {
56				runtimeDisposition = "open:" + observed.runtime.Name()
57			}
58		}
59		path := observed.task.WorktreePath
60		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
61			if observed.hasCheckout() {
62				path = observed.checkout
63			} else {
64				path = observed.desiredWorktree
65			}
66		} else {
67			path = ""
68		}
69		effects = append(effects, taskUpdateEffect(observed, task.Hot, path, runtimeDisposition,
70			observed.task.Next, observed.task.Note))
71	
72		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.task.Branch}
73		if checkout := resumeEffectCheckout(observed); checkout != "" {
74			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+checkout)
75		}
76		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" {
77			retained = append(retained, "runtime:"+observed.runtime.Name())
78		}
79		return PlanSpec{
80			Authority:         s.baseAuthority(request, observed),
81			Conditions:        conditions,
82			Effects:           effects,
83			RetainedResources: retained,
84			Confirmation:      Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Resume this task and claim its checkout?"},
85			FallbackCommand:   resumeFallback(observed.task.ID, options),
86			Summary:           "Resume " + observed.task.Title() + " HOT",
87			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
88		}
89	}

91	func resumeOwnerCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, options ResumeOptions) Condition {
92		if observed.task.OwnedBy(observed.taskflowHost) {
93			owner := observed.task.Owner
94			if owner == "" {
95				owner = "unclaimed"
96			}
97			return condition(ConditionOwner, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "task owner is "+owner, "")
98		}
99		if options.TakeOwnership {
100			return condition(ConditionOwner, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
101				"ownership transfer from "+observed.task.Owner+" was explicitly requested", "")
102		}
103		return condition(ConditionOwner, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
104			"task is owned by "+observed.task.Owner, "confirm the other machine pushed its work, then take ownership explicitly")
105	}

24			return err
25		}
26		if locator.Mode == task.ModeWorktree && locator.CheckoutPath != "" && locator.HeadOID == "" {

29		return nil

32	func (s *lifecycleService) planRetire(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
33		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		if err := validateRetireLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
37			return PlanSpec{}, err
38		}
39		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
40		if err != nil {
41			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
42		}
43		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, *record); err != nil {
44			return PlanSpec{}, err
45		}
46		spec, _, err := s.observeRetire(ctx, request, *record, s.tasks.ListRecords)
47		if err != nil {
48			return PlanSpec{}, err
49		}
50		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
51		if err != nil {
52			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning retirement"}
53		}
54		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
55			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning retirement")
56		}
57		return spec, nil
58	}

61		candidate := record.Task

64		var (

66			rtErr error

69			rt = runtime.None{}
70		} else {
71			rt, rtErr = s.runtimeFor(candidate)

73		options := request.Options.(RetireOptions)
74		cleanup := retire.Options{
75			CWD: s.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: s.callerPane,
76			CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
77		}
78		observed, err := s.inspectDestructive(ctx, destructiveInspectInput{
79			locator: request.Locator, base: candidate.Base, runtime: rt, rtErr: rtErr, cleanup: cleanup,

365	func retireRefConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {

388					"local task branch is already absent for a persisted DONE task with no checkout", "")
389			} else {
390				branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
391					"local task branch "+observed.branchRef+" is missing", "restore the task branch before retiring its checkout")

396		} else if observed.branchOID == "" {
397			branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
398				"local task branch resolved to no commit", "restore the local task branch")
399		}
400	
401		relationCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
402			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID), "")
403		switch {
404		case !observed.branchExists && noCheckout:
405			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
406				"missing branch is accepted only because persisted DONE records no checkout", "")
407		case observed.containedErr != nil:
408			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
409				observed.containedErr.Error(), "repair local containment observation")
410		case observed.branchExists && observed.baseExists && observed.branchOIDErr == nil && observed.baseOIDErr == nil && !observed.contained:
411			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
412				fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is not contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID),
413				"integrate the task branch into the named local base first")
414		case !observed.branchExists || !observed.baseExists || observed.branchOID == "" || observed.baseOID == "":
415			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
416				"containment cannot be proved from exact local branch and base OIDs", "restore both local refs")
417		}

504	func retireBranchDeletionCondition(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool, options RetireOptions) Condition {
505		if !options.DeleteBranch {
506			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
507				"local task branch will be retained", "")
508		}
509		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
510			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
511				"direct tasks never delete their branch", "retire without branch deletion")
512		}
513		if candidate.Branch == candidate.Base {
514			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
515				"task branch is the explicit base branch", "retire without deleting the base")
516		}
517		if !observed.branchExists && noCheckout {
518			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
519				"local task branch is already absent", "")
520		}
521		paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout)
522		if err != nil {
523			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
524				err.Error(), "refresh registered worktrees before branch deletion")
525		}
526		if len(paths) > 0 {
527			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
528				"branch is checked out at "+strings.Join(paths, ", "), "switch or remove those exact checkouts first")
529		}
530		return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
531			"ordinary git branch -d will delete only the freshly contained local branch", "")
532	}

754	func (e *executionState) reinspectRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
755		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
756		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
757			actual := ""
758			if current != nil {
759				actual = current.Revision
760			}
761			return destructiveObservation{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed at a retirement boundary")
762		}
763		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRetire(ctx, e.plan.Request, *current, e.tx.ListRecords)
764		if err != nil {
765			return fresh, err
766		}
767		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
768			return fresh, err
769		}
770		for _, check := range []struct {
771			name          string
772			before, after string
773		}{
774			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
775			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
776			{"Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()},
777			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
778			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
779			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
780			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
781			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
782		} {
783			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
784				return fresh, err
785			}
786		}
787		if allowRuntimeChange {
788			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
789				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
790			}
791		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
792			return fresh, err
793		}
794		return fresh, nil
795	}

822			authorityHash("branch", fresh.branchRef, boolString(fresh.branchExists), fresh.branchOID, errorString(fresh.branchOIDErr))); err != nil {

840	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch bool) error {
841		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
842		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
843			actual := ""
844			if current != nil {
845				actual = current.Revision
846			}
847			return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed before terminal retirement reap")
848		}
849		mode := record.Task.EffectiveMode()
850		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && record.Task.WorktreePath == ""
851		if removedWorktree {
852			if _, resolveErr := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout); resolveErr == nil {
853				return staleBoundary("removed linked checkout became registered again")
854			} else if !errors.Is(resolveErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
855				return resolveErr
856			}
857			if deletedBranch {
858				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
859					return staleBoundary("deleted task branch reappeared")
860				}
861				return e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline)
862			}
863			return e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, noCheckout && !baseline.branchExists)
864		}
865		if deletedBranch {
866			return e.revalidateRetireAfterBranchDelete(ctx, record, baseline)
867		}
868		_, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
869		return err

872	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireAfterBranchDelete(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
873		if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {

880		if err != nil {
881			return err
882		}
883		for _, check := range []struct {
884			name          string
885			before, after string
886		}{
887			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
888			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},

892			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
893			{"runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)},
894		} {
895			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
896				return err
897			}
898		}
899		return nil

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}
48	
49	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAndSpecify(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (PlanSpec, lifecycleObservation, error) {
50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:
64			spec = s.resumeSpec(request, observed)
65		case CompleteDirect:
66			spec = s.completeDirectSpec(request, observed)
67		case CompleteFF:
68			spec = s.completeFFSpec(request, observed)
69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}
76		return spec, observed, nil
77	}

79	func (s *lifecycleService) freshPlan(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (Plan, lifecycleObservation, error) {
80		spec, observed, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, record)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Plan{}, observed, err
83		}
84		plan, err := BuildPlan(request, spec)
85		return plan, observed, err
86	}

88	func validateLifecycleLocator(locator Locator) error {
89		switch {
90		case locator.TaskID == "":
91			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact TaskID is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
92		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
93			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
94		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
95			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
96		case locator.RepoPath == "":
97			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
98		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
99			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
100		case locator.Branch == "":
101			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
102		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
103			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
104		case !validState(locator.State):
105			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
106		}
107		return nil
108	}
109	
110	func validateRecordIdentity(locator Locator, record task.Record) error {
111		candidate := record.Task
112		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
113		if record.Revision != locator.TaskRevision {
114			return staleTaskRevision(locator.TaskRevision, record.Revision, "task revision no longer matches the selected row")
115		}
116		checks := []struct {
117			name     string
118			expected string
119			actual   string
120		}{
121			{"TaskID", locator.TaskID, candidate.ID},
122			{"mode", string(locator.Mode), string(mode)},
123			{"state", string(locator.State), string(candidate.State)},
124			{"branch", locator.Branch, candidate.Branch},
125			{"base", locator.Base, candidate.Base},
126		}
127		for _, check := range checks {
128			if check.expected != check.actual {
129				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
130			}
131		}
132	
133		selectedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(locator.RepoPath)
134		if err != nil {
135			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.RepoPath, err)}
136		}
137		recordedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate.RepoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.RepoPath, err)}
140		}
141		if selectedRepo != recordedRepo {
142			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task repository path changed from %q to %q", selectedRepo, recordedRepo)}
143		}
144	
145		expectedCheckout := recordedRepo
146		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
147			expectedCheckout = ""
148			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
149				expectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(candidate.WorktreePath)
150				if err != nil {
151					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.WorktreePath, err)}
152				}
153			}
154		}
155		selectedCheckout := ""
156		if locator.CheckoutPath != "" {
157			selectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(locator.CheckoutPath)
158			if err != nil {
159				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.CheckoutPath, err)}
160			}
161		}
162		if selectedCheckout != expectedCheckout {
163			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task checkout path changed from %q to %q", selectedCheckout, expectedCheckout)}
164		}
165		return nil
166	}
167	
168	func staleTaskRevision(expected, actual, reason string) error {
169		return &StalePlanError{
170			ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: expected,
171			ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   actual,
172			Reason:                       reason,
173		}
174	}
175	
176	func (s *lifecycleService) observeLifecycle(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (lifecycleObservation, error) {
177		observed := lifecycleObservation{record: record, task: record.Task, mode: record.Task.EffectiveMode()}
178		observed.setCaller(s.host, s.cwd, s.callerWorkspace, s.callerPane)
179	
180		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
181		if err != nil {
182			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, record.Task.ID, err)
183		}
184		observed.repo = repository
185		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
186		if err != nil {
187			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
188		}
189		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
190		if err != nil {
191			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
192		}
193		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(record.Task.RepoPath)
194		if err != nil {
195			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
196		}
197		if recordedRepo != observed.repoPath {
198			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q", record.Task.RepoPath, recordedRepo, observed.repoPath)}
199		}
200		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
201		if err != nil {
202			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
203		}
204		if requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
205			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("Git common directory changed from %q to %q", requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir)}
206		}
207		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
208			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
209			if keyErr != nil {
210				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
211			}
212			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
213				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository key changed from %q to %q", requestedKey, observed.gitCommonDir)}
214			}
215		}
216	
217		s.observeCheckout(ctx, request, &observed)
218		if observed.hasCheckout() {
219			observed.status, observed.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
220			if observed.statusErr == nil {
221				observed.head, observed.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
222				observed.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.head)
223				observed.baseOID, observed.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
224				observed.upstreamOID, observed.upstreamOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.status.Upstream)
225				observed.operation, observed.inProgress, observed.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
226			}
227		}
228		s.observeActionRefs(ctx, request, &observed)
229		if err := validateLiveLocator(request.Locator, observed); err != nil {
230			return observed, err
231		}
232	
233		if isCompletionAction(request.Action) {
234			s.observeCompletionFacts(ctx, request, &observed)
235		}
236		observed.runtime, observed.runtimeErr = s.runtimeFor(observed.task)
237		if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
238			observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
239			s.observeActionRuntime(ctx, request, &observed)
240		}

1	package taskflow

3	import "context"
4	
5	// PlanHook performs action-specific observation and returns only construction
6	// input. BuildPlan remains the single graph, availability, and identity
7	// authority.
8	type PlanHook func(context.Context, Request) (PlanSpec, error)
9	
10	// ApplyHook executes one already validated plan and may return a partial Result
11	// together with an error.
12	type ApplyHook func(context.Context, Plan) (Result, error)
13	
14	// Handler contains the narrow hooks for one exact action. Either hook may be
15	// omitted; no production or unsafe fallback is installed.
16	type Handler struct {
17		Plan  PlanHook
18		Apply ApplyHook
19	}
20	
21	// Handlers maps stable action codes to injected behavior.
22	type Handlers map[Action]Handler
23	
24	// LocateTaskHook builds one exact managed-task locator from fresh durable and
25	// Git evidence. It is intentionally not accepted by NewService: only the
26	// guarded lifecycle constructor may install it.
27	type LocateTaskHook func(context.Context, string) (Locator, error)
28	
29	// Service is the UI-agnostic locate/plan/apply dispatcher.
30	type Service struct {
31		handlers   map[Action]Handler
32		locateTask LocateTaskHook
33	}
34	
35	// NewService copies handlers so later mutation of the caller's map cannot
36	// redirect a planned action.
37	func NewService(handlers Handlers) *Service {
38		copied := make(map[Action]Handler, len(handlers))
39		for action, handler := range handlers {
40			copied[action] = handler
41		}
42		return &Service{handlers: copied}
43	}
44	
45	// LocateTask returns an exact locator only when this service came from
46	// NewLifecycleService. Generic dispatch services deliberately have no fallback
47	// locator because guessing task, repository, or checkout identity is unsafe.
48	func (s *Service) LocateTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
49		if s == nil || s.locateTask == nil {
50			return Locator{}, ErrLocatorUnavailable
51		}
52		return s.locateTask(ctx, taskID)
53	}
54	
55	// Plan validates and freezes a request, delegates action-specific observations,
56	// then centrally builds the immutable plan.
57	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, err
61		}
62		handler, ok := s.handlers[normalized.Action]
63		if !ok || handler.Plan == nil {
64			return Plan{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: normalized.Action, Stage: "plan"}
65		}
66		spec, err := handler.Plan(ctx, normalized.Clone())
67		if err != nil {
68			return Plan{}, err
69		}
70		return BuildPlan(normalized, spec)
71	}
72	
73	// Apply validates identity and approval, rejects every status except READY, and
74	// delegates only to the handler registered for the plan's exact action. A
75	// handler's partial Result is returned unchanged in meaning alongside errors.
76	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, plan Plan, approval Approval) (Result, error) {
77		frozen := plan.Clone()
78		if err := frozen.Validate(); err != nil {
79			return Result{}, err
80		}
81		if err := frozen.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
82			return Result{}, err
83		}
84		if frozen.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
85			notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{
86				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Availability: frozen.Availability,
87				conditions: frozen.Conditions(),
88			}
89			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{
90				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Reason: "required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady,
91			}
92		}
93		handler, ok := s.handlers[frozen.Action]
94		if !ok || handler.Apply == nil {
95			return Result{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: frozen.Action, Stage: "apply"}
96		}
97		result, err := handler.Apply(ctx, frozen.Clone())
98		result = result.Clone()
99		if err != nil && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 {
100			result.PartialSuccess = true
101		}
102		return result, err
103	}

18			dirtyPolicy   string
19			message       string
20			yes           bool
21			baseRef       string
22			confirmSquash string
23		)
24		cmd := &cobra.Command{
25			Use:   "done [task]",
26			Short: "Integrate a finished change stream without destroying its workspace",
27			Long: `Finish integration while leaving runtime and filesystem cleanup to an
28	external coordinator.
29	
30	  --ff       rebase onto the base and fast-forward it locally. Use when the
31	             branch's commits are worth keeping in the base's history.
32	  --pr       push and open a pull/merge request with the detected forge CLI,
33	             leaving the merge to review and CI.
34	  --merged   verify an externally merged branch against --base-ref, for a merge
35	             performed outside dev.
36	
37	For branch/worktree tasks, omitting every mode opens a finish wizard on an
38	interactive terminal. A non-interactive caller still gets a report and must
39	pass a mode explicitly. Direct tasks need no integration mode.
40	
41	A dirty checkout is analyzed against the base, not rejected as one opaque
42	condition. Interactive use can commit everything, discard everything, or
43	cancel. Unique content requires typing DROP before discard. Scripts select an
44	explicit --dirty policy; destructive discard also requires --yes.
45	
46	A successful local or externally verified merge records DONE, meaning MERGED
47	with cleanup possibly pending. It never closes the invoking runtime, removes a
48	worktree, or deletes a branch. Run dev retire later from outside the workspace.`,
49			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
50			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
51				modes := 0
52				for _, selected := range []bool{ff, pr, merged} {
53					if selected {
54						modes++
55					}
56				}
57				if modes > 1 {
58					return fmt.Errorf("--ff, --pr and --merged are alternatives; pick one")
59				}
60				if !merged && (baseRef != "" || confirmSquash != "") {
61					return fmt.Errorf("--base-ref and --confirm-squash require --merged")
62				}
63				if deleteBranch {
64					return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branch is cleanup; run dev retire --delete-branch after integration")
65				}
66				if keepWorktree {
67					app.warnf("--keep-worktree is deprecated: dev done always keeps runtime and worktree state")
68				}
69				integration := doneIntegrationNone
70				switch {
71				case ff:
72					integration = doneIntegrationFF
73				case pr:
74					integration = doneIntegrationPR
75				case merged:
76					integration = doneIntegrationMerged
77				}
78				return runDone(ctxOf(), app, args, doneOptions{
79					Integration: integration, DirtyPolicy: doneDirtyPolicy(dirtyPolicy),
80					Message: message, Yes: yes, Push: push,
81					BaseRef: baseRef, ConfirmSquash: confirmSquash,
82				})
83			},
84		}
85		f := cmd.Flags()

87		f.BoolVar(&pr, "pr", false, "push and open a pull/merge request instead of merging locally")
88		f.BoolVar(&merged, "merged", false, "verify an externally merged branch and mark the task done")

94		f.BoolVarP(&yes, "yes", "y", false, "confirm the selected finish plan (required for non-interactive discard)")

67	func runDone(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string, opts doneOptions) error {
68		if opts.DirtyPolicy == "" {
69			opts.DirtyPolicy = doneDirtyAuto
70		}
71		switch opts.DirtyPolicy {
72		case doneDirtyAuto, doneDirtyFail, doneDirtyCommit, doneDirtyDiscard:
73		default:
74			return fmt.Errorf("--dirty %q: want auto, fail, commit or discard", opts.DirtyPolicy)
75		}
76		if opts.Message != "" && opts.DirtyPolicy != doneDirtyCommit && opts.DirtyPolicy != doneDirtyAuto {
77			return errors.New("--message is only used with --dirty=commit")
78		}
79	
80		resolved, err := resolveTask(app, args)
81		if err != nil {
82			return err
83		}
84		selected := *resolved
85		mode := selected.EffectiveMode()
86		if mode == task.ModeDirect && opts.Integration != doneIntegrationNone {
87			return fmt.Errorf("direct task %s is already on %s; it has no branch/worktree to integrate. "+
88				"Run `dev done` without --ff/--pr/--merged", selected.Title(), selected.Branch)
89		}
90		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) { return resolved, nil })
91		if err != nil {
92			return err
93		}
94	
95		selection := doneSelection{
96			Integration: opts.Integration,
97			Dirty:       flow.DirtyPolicy(opts.DirtyPolicy),
98			Message:     strings.TrimSpace(opts.Message),
99		}
100		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, doneActionOptions(selected, selection, opts))
101		if err != nil {
102			return err
103		}
104		if err := doneFatalPreflightError(selected, plan); err != nil {
105			return err
106		}
107		initial := plan
108		view := doneView(plan)
109		interactive := app.interactive()
110		var p *prompter
111		if interactive {
112			p = newPrompter(app)
113			if opts.Integration == doneIntegrationNone || view.Status.Dirty() {
114				renderDonePreflight(app, selected, plan)
115			}
116		}
117		if mode != task.ModeDirect && opts.Integration == doneIntegrationNone && !interactive {
118			renderDonePreflight(app, selected, plan)
119			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Nothing done. Choose an integration mode:")
120			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "  dev done --ff      rebase when needed, then fast-forward "+view.Base)
121			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "  dev done --pr      push and open a pull request")
122			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "  dev done --merged  verify a branch that was merged outside dev")
123			return nil
124		}
125	
126		prompted := false
127		if view.Status.Dirty() {
128			switch selection.Dirty {
129			case flow.DirtyFail:
130				return dirtyFinishError(selected, plan)
131			case flow.DirtyAuto:
132				if !interactive {
133					return dirtyFinishError(selected, plan)
134				}
135				choice, promptErr := p.choice("Dirty changes (c=commit, d=discard, q=cancel)", "cancel",
136					"commit (c), discard (d), cancel (q)", map[string]string{
137						"c": "commit", "commit": "commit",
138						"d": "discard", "discard": "discard", "drop": "discard",
139						"q": "cancel", "cancel": "cancel",
140					})
141				if canceledDone(app, promptErr, choice == "cancel") {
142					return nil
143				}
144				if promptErr != nil {
145					return promptErr
146				}
147				selection.Dirty = flow.DirtyPolicy(choice)
148				prompted = true
149				plan, err = replanDone(ctx, session, plan, doneActionOptions(selected, selection, opts))
150				if err != nil {
151					return err
152				}
153				if err := doneFatalPreflightError(selected, plan); err != nil {
154					return err
155				}
156			}
157	
158			if selection.Dirty == flow.DirtyCommit && strings.TrimSpace(selection.Message) == "" {
159				if !interactive {
160					return errors.New("--message is required with --dirty=commit outside an interactive terminal")
161				}
162				message, promptErr := p.line("Commit message", "chore: finalize "+selected.Title())
163				if canceledDone(app, promptErr, false) {
164					return nil
165				}
166				if promptErr != nil {
167					return promptErr
168				}
169				selection.Message = strings.TrimSpace(message)
170				if selection.Message == "" {
171					return errors.New("commit message must not be empty")
172				}
173				prompted = true
174				plan, err = replanDone(ctx, session, plan, doneActionOptions(selected, selection, opts))
175				if err != nil {

177				}
178				if err := doneFatalPreflightError(selected, plan); err != nil {

17	func isCompletionAction(action Action) bool {
18		switch action {
19		case CompleteDirect, CompleteFF, ReviewHandoff, VerifyMerged:
20			return true
21		default:
22			return false
23		}
24	}

26	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCompletionFacts(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
27		observed.completionBranch = observed.task.Branch
28		if observed.hasCheckout() && observed.headErr == nil {
29			observed.completionBranchOID = observed.head
30		}
31		if observed.completionBaseRef != "" {
32			observed.completionBaseOID, observed.completionBaseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(
33				ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef,
34			)
35		}
36		if observed.hasCheckout() {
37			observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
38			if observed.completionBaseRef != "" {
39				observed.finish, observed.finishErr = s.analyzeFinish(
40					ctx, observed.checkout, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.task.Branch,
41				)
42			}
43		}
44	
45		switch request.Action {
46		case CompleteFF:
47			s.observeIntegrationFacts(ctx, observed)
48		case ReviewHandoff:
49			observed.reviewRemoteURL = strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, "origin"))
50			identityKind, identity := forge.IdentityFromURL(observed.reviewRemoteURL)
51			observed.reviewKind = s.detectForge(ctx, observed.repoPath)
52			if identityKind != forge.Unknown {
53				if observed.reviewKind != forge.Unknown && observed.reviewKind != identityKind {
54					observed.reviewResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("detected forge %s differs from origin identity %s", observed.reviewKind, identityKind)
55				}
56				observed.reviewKind = identityKind
57				observed.reviewRepository = identity
58			}
59			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil {
60				observed.reviewProvider, observed.reviewResolveErr = s.resolveForge(observed.reviewKind)
61			}
62			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil {
63				switch {
64				case observed.reviewProvider == nil:
65					observed.reviewResolveErr = errors.New("forge resolver returned no provider")
66				case observed.reviewProvider.Kind() != observed.reviewKind:
67					observed.reviewResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("forge resolver returned %s for detected %s remote",
68						observed.reviewProvider.Kind(), observed.reviewKind)
69				default:
70					observed.reviewAvailable = observed.reviewProvider.Available()
71				}
72			}
73		case VerifyMerged:
74			options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
75			observed.proofRef = options.SquashCommit
76			if observed.proofRef == "" {
77				observed.proofRef = observed.task.Branch
78			}
79			if observed.proofRef != "" {
80				observed.proofOID, observed.proofOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofRef)
81			}

83				observed.proofOIDErr == nil && observed.proofOID != "" {

85					ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseOID,
86				)
87			}
88		}
89	}

91	func (s *lifecycleService) observeIntegrationFacts(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) {

94				worktree: observed.worktree, worktreeFound: observed.worktreeFound, worktreeErr: observed.worktreeErr,
95				status: observed.status, statusErr: observed.statusErr,
96				head: observed.head, headErr: observed.headErr,
97				operation: observed.operation, inProgress: observed.inProgress, operationErr: observed.operationErr,
98			}
99			return
100		}
101	
102		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
103		observed.integration.worktree, observed.integration.worktreeErr = registered, err
104		if err != nil {

106		}

118	func (s *lifecycleService) completeDirectSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
119		options := request.Options.(CompleteDirectOptions)

139			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage, options.Push, "", ""),
140			"Complete "+observed.task.Title()+" directly on "+observed.task.Branch,
141		)

144	func (s *lifecycleService) completeFFSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
145		options := request.Options.(CompleteFFOptions)
146		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
147		relation := effectiveCompletionRelation(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
148		if !relation.Contained() {
149			conditions = append(conditions, completionIntegrationCondition(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage))
150			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {

152			}
153		}

155		relationEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%s is behind %d and ahead %d relative to %s",
156			observed.task.Branch, relation.BaseOnly, relation.BranchOnly, observed.completionBaseRef)
157		if relation.Contained() {
158			relationEvidence = observed.task.Branch + " is already contained in " + observed.completionBaseRef
159		}
160		conditions = append(conditions, condition(

162		))
163

176						map[string]string{"base": observed.completionBaseRef, "task-branch": observed.task.Branch},
177					),

180						map[string]string{"base": observed.completionBaseRef, "branch": observed.task.Branch, "strategy": "ff-only"},
181					),
182				)
183			}
184			if options.PushBase {

186			}
187			effects = append(effects, completionTaskUpdateEffect(observed))
188		}
189		return s.completionPlanSpec(
190			request, observed, conditions, effects,
191			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Integrate this task with fast-forward only?"),
192			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--ff", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage, options.PushBase, "", ""),
193			"Fast-forward "+observed.task.Title()+" into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
194		)
195	}

197	func (s *lifecycleService) reviewHandoffSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
198		options := request.Options.(ReviewHandoffOptions)
199		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
200		relation := effectiveCompletionRelation(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
201		relationVerdict := VerdictMet
202		relationEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d commit(s) not in %s", observed.task.Branch, relation.BranchOnly, observed.completionBaseRef)
203		if relation.Contained() {
204			if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() &&

209				relationEvidence = observed.task.Branch + " is already contained in " + observed.completionBaseRef
210			}

213			condition(ConditionBranchRelation, relationVerdict, RequirementRequired, relationEvidence,
214				"use fast-forward completion or add reviewable task-branch commits"),
215			completionReviewProviderCondition(observed),
216		)

218		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
219		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {

225				},
226			))
227			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil && observed.reviewProvider != nil && observed.reviewAvailable {
228				effects = append(effects, NewEffect(

35		}
36		if err := validateRetireLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {

38		}

43		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, *record); err != nil {
44			return PlanSpec{}, err
45		}
46		spec, _, err := s.observeRetire(ctx, request, *record, s.tasks.ListRecords)
47		if err != nil {

49		}
50		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
51		if err != nil {
52			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning retirement"}
53		}
54		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
55			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning retirement")
56		}

27		observed.completionBranch = observed.task.Branch

29			observed.completionBranchOID = observed.head
30		}

42			}

46		case CompleteFF:

49			observed.reviewRemoteURL = strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, "origin"))

51			observed.reviewKind = s.detectForge(ctx, observed.repoPath)
52			if identityKind != forge.Unknown {

55				}
56				observed.reviewKind = identityKind

61			}

63				switch {
64				case observed.reviewProvider == nil:
65					observed.reviewResolveErr = errors.New("forge resolver returned no provider")
66				case observed.reviewProvider.Kind() != observed.reviewKind:
67					observed.reviewResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("forge resolver returned %s for detected %s remote",

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}

49	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAndSpecify(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (PlanSpec, lifecycleObservation, error) {
50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:
64			spec = s.resumeSpec(request, observed)
65		case CompleteDirect:
66			spec = s.completeDirectSpec(request, observed)
67		case CompleteFF:
68			spec = s.completeFFSpec(request, observed)
69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}
76		return spec, observed, nil
77	}

154	// Validate proves that a plan is structurally consistent and still carries its
155	// original deterministic identity. It performs no live observations.
156	func (p Plan) Validate() error {
157		if p.PlanID == "" || p.AuthorityFingerprint == "" {
158			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan identity is missing"}
159		}
160		if !p.Action.Valid() {
161			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown action %q", p.Action)}
162		}
163		if p.Request.Action != p.Action {
164			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request action and plan action differ"}
165		}
166		if p.Request.Locator != p.Locator {
167			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request locator and plan locator differ"}
168		}
169		if p.Request.Options == nil {
170			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "normalized request options are missing"}
171		}
172		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(p.Request)
173		if err != nil {
174			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request is no longer valid", Cause: err}
175		}
176		if requestIdentity(normalized) != requestIdentity(p.Request) {
177			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request options are not normalized"}
178		}
179		if err := p.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
180			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
181		}
182		if err := validateConditions(p.conditions); err != nil {
183			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
184		}
185		if err := validateEffects(p.effects); err != nil {
186			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
187		}
188		if err := validateAuthority(p.authority); err != nil {
189			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
190		}
191		if err := validatePlanTransition(p); err != nil {
192			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "transition metadata is inconsistent", Cause: err}
193		}
194	
195		authorityFingerprint, planID := computePlanIdentity(p)
196		if authorityFingerprint != p.AuthorityFingerprint {
197			return &StalePlanError{
198				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
199				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
200				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
201				Reason:                       "authority fields, effects, or conditions changed",
202			}
203		}
204		if planID != p.PlanID {
205			return &StalePlanError{
206				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
207				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
208				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
209				Reason:                       "PlanID does not match its authority fingerprint",
210			}
211		}
212		if availability := AvailabilityFor(p.conditions); availability != p.Availability {
213			return &InvalidPlanError{
214				PlanID: p.PlanID,
215				Reason: fmt.Sprintf("availability is %s, want derived %s", p.Availability, availability),
216			}
217		}
218		return nil
219	}

221	// ValidateApproval binds affirmative approval and any typed token to this exact
222	// plan. It never changes plan readiness or condition verdicts.
223	func (p Plan) ValidateApproval(approval Approval) error {
224		if err := p.Validate(); err != nil {
225			return err
226		}
227		if !approval.Granted {
228			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "affirmative approval was not granted", Cause: ErrApprovalRequired}
229		}
230		if approval.PlanID != p.PlanID {
231			return &StalePlanError{
232				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: approval.PlanID,
233				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
234				Reason:                       "approval names a different plan",
235			}
236		}
237		if p.Confirmation.Kind == ConfirmationTyped {
238			if approval.Token != p.Confirmation.Token {
239				return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "typed confirmation token does not match", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
240			}
241		} else if approval.Token != "" {
242			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan does not accept a typed confirmation token", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
243		}
244		return nil
245	}

247	func validatePlanTransition(plan Plan) error {
248		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
249			rule, err := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
250			if err != nil {
251				return err
252			}
253			if !plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Source != rule.Source || plan.Target != rule.Target ||
254				plan.StatePreserving != rule.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask != rule.RemovesTask ||
255				plan.ExpectedMilestone != rule.Milestone {
256				return fmt.Errorf("plan does not match the transition table")
257			}
258			return nil
259		}
260		expectedMilestone := MilestoneNone
261		switch plan.Action {
262		case Adopt:
263			expectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
264		case Reconcile:
265			expectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
266		}
267		if plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Target != "" || plan.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask ||
268			plan.Source != plan.Locator.State || plan.ExpectedMilestone != expectedMilestone {
269			return fmt.Errorf("domain action is represented as a persisted-state edge")
270		}
271		return nil
272	}

274	func validateConditions(conditions []Condition) error {
275		seen := make(map[ConditionCode]bool, len(conditions))
276		for index, condition := range conditions {
277			if err := condition.Validate(); err != nil {
278				return fmt.Errorf("condition %d: %w", index, err)
279			}
280			if seen[condition.Code] {
281				return fmt.Errorf("condition code %q is duplicated", condition.Code)
282			}
283			seen[condition.Code] = true
284		}
285		return nil
286	}

177		}

179	}

35	| `dev retire [task-or-worktree] [--close-unknown] [--assume-no-runtime] [--delete-branch] [--timeout <duration>]` | Re-resolves every covering runtime session, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, waits for closure, revalidates Git state, and only then removes the linked worktree without force. Deletes the task record only after every requested step succeeds. |
36	| `dev flow [repo]` | Preview UI for an exact DONE task: Enter builds a revision-bound Retire plan, then approval applies it. Branch deletion requires the displayed typed token. |
37	| `dev sweep --merged-worktrees [--base <ref>] [--apply] [--yes] [--close-unknown] [--assume-no-runtime] [--delete-branches]` | From the canonical checkout, reports (and, with `--apply`, retires) both task-tracked and unmanaged linked worktrees whose branches are already contained in the base. |
38	
39	A dirty checkout does not fail here: `dev done` classifies it against the base
40	first, offering commit or discard interactively, or taking an explicit
41	`--dirty` policy from a script. See
42	[Change-stream workflow](change-stream-workflow.md) for that wizard. The
43	`--keep-worktree` and `--delete-branch` flags remain accepted on `dev done`
44	only to fail loudly and point at `dev retire`.
45

51	# Commit product changes first. Do not stage the moving transcript.

53	# Exit the agent normally so SpecStory can write its final Markdown.
54	```

60	```

199	func newLifecycleImplementation(input LifecycleConfig) (*lifecycleService, error) {
200		if input.Tasks == nil {

202		}
203		if input.Artifacts == nil {

205		}

207			return nil, fmt.Errorf("taskflow lifecycle config: %w", err)
208		}

210		host := strings.TrimSpace(input.Host)
211		if host == "" {
212			host = config.Hostname()
213		}
214		if host == "" || host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
215			return nil, errors.New("taskflow lifecycle host must be normalized")
216		}
217		cwd := input.CWD
218		if cwd == "" {
219			var err error
220			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
221			if err != nil {
222				return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve taskflow caller directory: %w", err)
223			}
224		}
225		callerWorkspace := input.CallerWorkspaceID
226		if callerWorkspace == "" {
227			callerWorkspace = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
228		}
229		callerPane := input.CallerPaneID
230		if callerPane == "" {
231			callerPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
232			if callerPane == "" {
233				callerPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
234			}
235		}
236		clock := input.Clock
237		if clock == nil {

239		}
240		logf := input.Logf
241		if logf == nil {

243		}
244	
245		defaultRuntime := input.DefaultRuntime
246		if defaultRuntime == nil {
247			defaultRuntime = func() runtime.Runtime {
248				return configuredRuntime(input.Config, input.Config.Runtime.Backend)
249			}
250		}
251		namedRuntime := input.NamedRuntime
252		if namedRuntime == nil {
253			namedRuntime = func(name string) runtime.Runtime {
254				return configuredRuntime(input.Config, name)
255			}
256		}
257	
258		s := &lifecycleService{
259			cfg: input.Config, tasks: input.Tasks, artifacts: input.Artifacts,
260			defaultRuntime: defaultRuntime, namedRuntime: namedRuntime,
261			host: host, cwd: cwd,

267			},
268			gitDiscover: gitx.Discover,
269			gitStatus:   gitx.StatusOf,

278			gitRefExists:     gitx.RefExists,
279			gitDefaultBranch: gitx.DefaultBranch,

283			analyzeFinish:    gitx.AnalyzeFinish,
284			commitAll:        gitx.CommitAllChanges,

562	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRetire(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
563		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
564			return Result{}, err
565		}
566		if approved.Action != Retire {
567			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "retire handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
568		}
569		if err := validateRetireLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
570			return Result{}, err
571		}
572		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
573		if err != nil {
574			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
575		}
576	
577		var result Result
578		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
579			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
580				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
581				if loadErr != nil {
582					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before retirement apply"}
583				}
584				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
585					return identityErr
586				}
587				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRetire(ctx, approved.Request, *record, tx.ListRecords)
588				if observeErr != nil {
589					return observeErr
590				}
591				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
592				if buildErr != nil {
593					return buildErr
594				}
595				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
596				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
597					actual := ""
598					if current != nil {
599						actual = current.Revision
600					}
601					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked retirement replan")
602				}
603				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
604					return &StalePlanError{
605						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
606						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
607						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
608						Reason:                       "fresh retirement task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or ref authority differs",
609					}
610				}
611				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
612					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
613					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh retirement conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
614				}
615	
616				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision}
617				result, observeErr = execution.executeRetire(ctx, *record, observed)
618				return observeErr
619			})
620		})
621		return result, err
622	}

624	func (e *executionState) executeRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
625		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RetireOptions)
626		candidate := record.Task
627		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
628		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == ""
629		closedRuntime := false
630		removedWorktree := false
631		deletedBranch := false
632	
633		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
634			switch effect.Code {
635			case EffectCloseRuntime:
636				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, false)
637				if err != nil {
638					return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before closing any runtime")
639				}
640				baseline = fresh
641				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
642					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
643						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
644						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
645					})
646					if closeErr != nil {
647						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
648					}
649					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil
650				})
651				if err != nil {
652					e.partial = true
653					return e.fail(err, "the task and checkout remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
654				}
655				fresh, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, true)
656				if err != nil {
657					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh retirement")
658				}
659				baseline = fresh
660				closedRuntime = true
661	
662			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
663				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
664				if err != nil {
665					return e.fail(err, "the worktree was preserved; refresh every retirement safety source")
666				}
667				baseline = fresh
668				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
669					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
670						return "worktree removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact worktree %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
671					}
672					return "removed exact linked worktree without force; branch retained", nil
673				})
674				if err != nil {
675					e.partial = true
676					return e.fail(err, "inspect Git worktree registration and retained branch before retrying")
677				}
678				removedWorktree = true
679				if err := e.verifyRemovedCheckout(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
680					return e.fail(err, "the checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact retained branch before reaping the task")
681				}
682	
683			case EffectDeleteBranch:
684				if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && !removedWorktree {
685					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before linked worktree removal"})
686				}
687				if mode != task.ModeWorktree || noCheckout {
688					fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
689					if err != nil {
690						return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before deleting the contained branch")
691					}
692					baseline = fresh
693				}
694				if err := e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, false); err != nil {
695					return e.fail(err, "branch or base authority changed; refresh retirement")
696				}
697				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
698					_, deleteErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, baseline.repoPath, "branch", "-d", "--", candidate.Branch)
699					if deleteErr != nil {
700						return "ordinary contained-branch deletion failed", fmt.Errorf("delete contained branch %s: %w", candidate.Branch, deleteErr)
701					}
702					return "deleted contained local branch " + candidate.Branch, nil
703				})
704				if err != nil {
705					e.partial = true
706					return e.fail(err, "the task record remains DONE; inspect the local branch and retry")
707				}
708				deletedBranch = true
709				if e.service.gitRefExists(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef) {
710					return e.fail(errors.New("local branch still exists after successful branch deletion"), "the task remains DONE; inspect Git refs before retrying")
711				}
712				if err := e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
713					return e.fail(err, "the branch deletion completed; restore or inspect the explicit base before task reaping")
714				}

590	func comparePostDiscardGit(before, after destructiveObservation) error {
591		if after.statusErr != nil || after.status.Dirty() {
592			return staleBoundary("checkout is not clean after explicit discard")
593		}
594		beforeStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
595			before.status.Branch, boolString(before.status.Detached), before.status.Upstream,
596			fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Behind),
597			before.head, errorString(before.headErr), before.operation, boolString(before.inProgress), errorString(before.operationErr),
598		)
599		afterStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
600			after.status.Branch, boolString(after.status.Detached), after.status.Upstream,
601			fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Behind),
602			after.head, errorString(after.headErr), after.operation, boolString(after.inProgress), errorString(after.operationErr),
603		)
604		return compareAuthorityCategory("post-discard Git identity", beforeStable, afterStable)
605	}

607	func (e *executionState) revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
608		records, diagnostics, err := e.tx.ListRecords()
609		if err != nil {
610			return err
611		}
612		claims := baseline
613		claims.taskRecords = records
614		claims.taskDiagnostics = diagnostics
615		claims.taskClaims = nil
616		claims.taskIncomplete = nil
617		e.service.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &claims)
618		if len(claims.taskIncomplete) > 0 {
619			return staleBoundary("task inventory became incomplete before branch deletion")
620		}
621		if len(claims.taskClaims) > 0 {
622			return staleBoundary("a task claimed the checkout path or branch before branch deletion")
623		}
624		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
625		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
626		if fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID || fresh.baseOID != baseline.baseOID ||
627			fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.baseOIDErr != nil || fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
628			return staleBoundary("branch or containment-base authority changed before branch deletion")
629		}
630		worktrees, err := e.service.gitWorktrees(ctx, baseline.repoPath)
631		if err != nil {
632			return err
633		}
634		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
635			if worktree.Branch == baseline.locator.Branch {
636				return staleBoundary("branch acquired another checkout before deletion")
637			}
638		}
639		return nil
640	}

643		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
644		if err == nil {
645			return staleBoundary("exact unmanaged checkout remains registered after removal")
646		}
647		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {

649		}

651		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, "")
652		if !fresh.branchExists || fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID {
653			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("preserved local branch changed from %s to %s", baseline.branchOID, fresh.branchOID))
654		}
655		return nil
656	}

9	
10	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
11	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
12	type Repo struct {
13		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
14		Root string
15		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory. A linked worktree has
16		// its own entry below the shared common directory.
17		GitDir string
18		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
19		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
20		GitCommonDir string
21		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
22		Name string
23		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
24		// the main checkout.
25		IsLinkedWorktree bool
26		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
27		MainRoot string
28		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
29		Bare bool
30	}
31	
32	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
33	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
34	
35	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
36	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
37		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
38		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
39		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
40			"rev-parse",
41			"--path-format=absolute",
42			"--show-toplevel",
43			"--git-dir",
44			"--git-common-dir",
45			"--is-bare-repository",
46		)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Repo{}, err
49		}
50		f := lines(out)
51		r := Repo{}
52		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
53		switch len(f) {
54		case 4:
55			r.Root = f[0]
56			r.GitDir = f[1]
57			r.GitCommonDir = f[2]
58			r.Bare = f[3] == "true"
59		case 3:
60			r.GitDir = f[0]
61			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
62			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
63		default:
64			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
65		}
66	
67		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
68		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
69		if r.Bare {
70			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
71		} else if r.GitDir == r.GitCommonDir {
72			// A normal checkout may use --separate-git-dir, so the common directory's
73			// parent is not necessarily the working-tree root.
74			r.MainRoot = r.Root
75		} else {
76			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
77		}
78		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.GitDir != r.GitCommonDir
79		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
80		if r.Bare {
81			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
82			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
83			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
84				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
85			}
86		}
87		return r, nil
88	}
89	
90	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
91	// a full Discover.
92	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
93		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
94		return err == nil
95	}

173	func deriveAdoptState(observed adoptObservation) (task.State, string, string, string) {
174		rt := observed.runtime
175		switch {
176		case observed.runtimeErr != nil:
177			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend resolution failed; adoption remains WARM"
178		case rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "":
179			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
180		case rt.Name() == "none":
181			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime none leaves session and recognized-agent evidence unobserved; adoption remains WARM"
182		case !observed.runtimeAvailable:
183			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
184		case !observed.worktreeFound:
185			return task.Warm, "", "", "exact checkout is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
186		case adoptStrictOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) != nil:
187			return task.Warm, "", "", "strict runtime occupancy is not ready; adoption remains WARM"
188		case !observed.occupancy.SessionList.Observed():
189			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime sessions were not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
190		case !observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed():
191			return task.Warm, "", "", "recognized-agent activity was not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
192		case len(observed.occupancy.Sessions) != 1:
193			return task.Warm, "", "", fmt.Sprintf("fresh runtime coverage contains %d sessions, not exactly one; adoption remains WARM", len(observed.occupancy.Sessions))
194		case len(observed.occupancy.Agents) != 0:
195			return task.Warm, "", "", "a recognized agent occupies the checkout; adoption remains WARM"
196		}
197	
198		session := observed.occupancy.Sessions[0]
199		handle := session.Runtime.Handle
200		if strings.TrimSpace(handle) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(handle) != handle || strings.ContainsRune(handle, '\x00') {
201			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session has no stable nonempty handle; adoption remains WARM"
202		}
203		if !adoptSessionShellOnly(session) {
204			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session is not shell-only; adoption remains WARM"
205		}
206		return task.Hot, rt.Name(), handle, "exactly one freshly observed shell-only runtime session covers the checkout with stable handle " + handle
207	}

209	func adoptStrictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
210		if occupancyErr := strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err); occupancyErr != nil {
211			return occupancyErr
212		}
213		var blockers []string
214		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
215			// OccupancySession.Panes contains only panes whose live cwd covers the
216			// checkout. A mixed session may also host an unrelated agent elsewhere;
217			// that agent is not a writer claim on this checkout.
218			for _, pane := range session.Panes {
219				if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) == "" && strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) == "" {
220					continue
221				}
222				if occupancy.CallerPaneID != "" && pane.ID == occupancy.CallerPaneID {
223					continue
224				}
225				status := strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus)
226				if status == "" {
227					status = "unknown"
228				}
229				blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent pane %s (%s)", pane.ID, status))

102		location := "response"

106		detail := "missing or invalid " + e.Field
107		if e.Err != nil {
108			detail = e.Err.Error()
109		}

708	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation, allowFetchedRefs bool) error {
709		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
710		if err != nil {
711			return staleBoundary("repository became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
712		}
713		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
714		if err != nil {
715			return staleBoundary("repository main path became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
716		}
717		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
718		if err != nil {
719			return staleBoundary("Git common directory became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
720		}
721		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
722			return staleBoundary("repository identity changed before review query")
723		}
724		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
725		kind, repositoryIdentity := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
726		if remoteURL != observed.remoteURL || kind != observed.providerKind || repositoryIdentity != observed.providerRepository {
727			return staleBoundary("remote URL or provider repository identity changed before review query")
728		}
729		if observed.provider == nil || observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind {
730			return staleBoundary("review provider identity changed before query")
731		}
732		if _, ok := observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier); !ok {
733			return staleBoundary("review provider capability changed before query")
734		}
735		if !observed.provider.Available() {
736			return staleBoundary("review provider CLI became unavailable before query")
737		}
738		if !allowFetchedRefs {
739			freshRefs := s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
740			if remoteRefsAuthority(freshRefs) != remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs) {
741				return staleBoundary("local or remote-tracking ref authority changed before query")
742			}
743		}
744		return nil
745	}
746	
747	func (e *executionState) setRemoteReviewFailure(data *RemoteObservation, observed remoteRefreshObservation, err error) {
748		data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
749			State: ObservationError, Exists: false,
750			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
751			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
752			FailureKind: classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err), Failure: err.Error(),
753		}
754		data.HasReview = true
755	}
756	
757	func classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err error) RemoteReviewFailureKind {
758		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrAmbiguousReview) {
759			return RemoteReviewFailureAmbiguous
760		}
761		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrMalformedReviewResponse) {
762			return RemoteReviewFailureMalformed
763		}
764		var unsupported *forge.ErrUnsupported
765		if errors.As(err, &unsupported) {
766			return RemoteReviewFailureUnsupported
767		}
768		var missingCLI *forge.ErrNoCLI
769		if errors.As(err, &missingCLI) {
770			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingCLI
771		}
772		var missingExtension *forge.ErrNoExtension
773		if errors.As(err, &missingExtension) {
774			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingExtension
775		}
776		return RemoteReviewFailureProvider
777	}
778	
779	func validateRemoteReview(observed remoteRefreshObservation, review forge.Review) error {
780		switch {
781		case review.Provider != observed.providerKind:
782			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "provider")
783		case review.Repository != observed.providerRepository:
784			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "repository identity")
785		case review.Head != observed.head:
786			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "head branch")
787		case review.Base != observed.base:
788			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "base branch")
789		case strings.TrimSpace(review.ID) == "" || review.ID != strings.TrimSpace(review.ID):
790			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "identifier")
791		case review.Number <= 0:
792			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "number")
793		case !review.State.Valid():
794			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "state")
795		case review.State == forge.ReviewDraft && !review.Draft:
796			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft flag")
797		case review.State == forge.ReviewOpen && review.Draft:
798			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft state")
799		case !validRemoteReviewURL(review.URL):
800			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "URL")
801		}
802		return nil
803	}

212	func AddWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path, branch, base string) error {
213		exists := BranchExists(ctx, dir, branch)
214		args := []string{"worktree", "add"}
215		if exists {
216			args = append(args, path, branch)
217		} else {
218			args = append(args, "-b", branch, path)
219			if base != "" {

222		}

229	// be any checkout of the same repository.

231		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "move", source, destination)

235	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
236	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
237	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
238		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
239		if err != nil {
240			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current directory before removing worktree: %w", err)
241		}
242		inside, err := pathx.Contains(path, cwd)
243		if err != nil {
244			return fmt.Errorf("compare current directory with worktree %s: %w", path, err)
245		}
246		if inside {
247			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to remove worktree %s while the caller is inside it", path)
248		}
249		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
250		if force {
251			args = append(args, "--force")
252		}
253		args = append(args, path)
254		_, err = run(ctx, dir, args...)

631			return fmt.Errorf("%s is no longer a linked worktree with a separate main checkout", source)
632		}
633		// Run from the stable main checkout rather than from the directory Git is
634		// moving. This avoids platform-specific failures when a process has its own
635		// current working directory open inside the linked worktree.
636		return s.moveWorktree(ctx, repository.MainRoot, source, destination)
