456	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
457	//
458	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
459	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
460	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
461	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
462	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
463	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
464		all, err := s.List()
465		if err != nil {
466			return nil, err
467		}
468		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
469			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
470		}
471		var best *Task
472		var bestLen int
473		for _, t := range all {
474			root := t.WorktreePath
475			if root == "" {
476				root = t.RepoPath
477			}
478			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
479				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
480			}
481		}
482		if best == nil {
483			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
484		}
485		return best, nil
486	}

518		requirement := RequirementRequired
519		if observed.mode == task.ModeDirect {
520			requirement = RequirementAdvisory
521		}
522		switch {
523		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
524			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, requirement,
525				"completion has no explicit base ref", "record or select an explicit base ref")
526		case observed.completionBaseOIDErr != nil:
527			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, requirement,
528				observed.completionBaseOIDErr.Error(), "restore the exact base ref")
529		case observed.completionBaseOID == "":
530			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, requirement,
531				"base ref "+observed.completionBaseRef+" resolved to no commit", "restore the exact base ref")
532		default:
533			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, requirement,
534				fmt.Sprintf("base %s at %s", observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID), "")
535		}
536	}
537	
538	func completionIntegrationCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) Condition {
539		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
540			verdict, _ := completionDirtyCondition(observed, dirty, message)
541			if verdict == VerdictMet {
542				return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
543					"the exact canonical task checkout will be clean before switching to "+observed.completionBaseRef, "")
544			}
545			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, verdict, RequirementRequired,
546				"the canonical task checkout is not yet switchable", "finalize its dirty policy")
547		}
548		integration := observed.integration
549		switch {
550		case integration.worktreeErr != nil:
551			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
552				integration.worktreeErr.Error(), "repair canonical main worktree identity")
553		case !integration.worktreeFound:
554			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
555				"canonical main checkout is not registered", "restore the canonical main checkout")
556		case integration.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath || integration.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
557			!integration.worktree.Worktree.Main || integration.worktree.Worktree.Bare:
558			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
559				"integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout", "repair worktree topology")
560		case integration.statusErr != nil:
561			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
562				integration.statusErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout status observation")
563		case integration.headErr != nil:
564			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
565				integration.headErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout HEAD observation")
566		case integration.operationErr != nil:
567			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
568				integration.operationErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout Git-operation observation")
569		case integration.inProgress:
570			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
571				"canonical checkout has Git operation "+integration.operation+" in progress", "finish or abort it")
572		case integration.status.Conflicted > 0:
573			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
574				fmt.Sprintf("canonical checkout has %d conflicted path(s)", integration.status.Conflicted), "resolve or abort conflicts")
575		case integration.status.Dirty():
576			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
577				"canonical checkout is dirty: "+integration.status.Breakdown(), "preserve its unrelated bytes before integration")
578		case integration.worktree.Worktree.Head != integration.head:
579			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
580				"canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD", "refresh worktree topology")
581		default:
582			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
583				"canonical main checkout is exact, clean, conflict-free, and switchable", "")
584		}
585	}
586	
587	func (s *lifecycleService) completionIntegrationOccupancyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
588		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
589			return condition(ConditionIntegrationOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
590				observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution")
591		}
592		verdict, evidence := s.completionOccupancyVerdict(observed.integration.occupancy, observed.integration.occupancyErr)
593		return condition(ConditionIntegrationOccupancy, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence,
594			"stop every other recognized agent in the canonical integration checkout")
595	}
596	
597	func completionReviewProviderCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
598		switch {
599		case observed.reviewResolveErr != nil:
600			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementAdvisory,
601				observed.reviewResolveErr.Error()+"; a successful branch push remains a valid publication", "open the review manually")
602		case observed.reviewProvider == nil:
603			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementAdvisory,
604				"no forge provider was resolved; a successful branch push remains a valid publication", "open the review manually")
605		case !observed.reviewAvailable:
606			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementAdvisory,
607				fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is unavailable; a successful branch push remains a valid publication",
608					observed.reviewKind, observed.reviewProvider.Bin()), "install or authenticate the provider CLI, or open the review manually")
609		default:
610			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
611				fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s will create the review", observed.reviewKind, observed.reviewProvider.Bin()), "")
612		}
613	}
614	
615	func completionProofCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
616		switch {
617		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
618			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
619				"merge proof requires an exact base ref", "select a local or explicit remote-tracking base ref")
620		case observed.completionBaseOIDErr != nil:
621			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
622				observed.completionBaseOIDErr.Error(), "restore the selected base ref")
623		case observed.completionBaseOID == "":
624			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
625				"merge proof requires an exact base OID", "restore the selected base ref")
626		case observed.proofRef == "":
627			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
628				"merge proof ref is empty", "restore the task branch or name an exact squash commit")
629		case observed.proofOIDErr != nil:
630			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
631				observed.proofOIDErr.Error(), "restore the exact proof ref")
632		case observed.proofOID == "":
633			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
634				"proof ref "+observed.proofRef+" resolved to no commit", "restore the exact proof commit")
635		case observed.proofErr != nil:
636			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
637				observed.proofErr.Error(), "repair local ancestry observation")
638		case !observed.proofContained:
639			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
640				fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is not an ancestor of %s (%s)",
641					observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID),
642				"fetch explicitly if desired, then select the freshly observed ref; no fetch is assumed")
643		default:

645				fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is an ancestor of %s (%s)",
646					observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID), "")
647		}

974	func artifactSummary(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection, err error) string {
975		if err != nil {

977		}
978		if inspection.KnownEmpty && len(inspection.Intents) == 0 {
979			return "artifact: ready; no intents"
980		}
981		counts := make(map[artifact.ReadinessState]int)
982		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
983			counts[intent.State]++
984		}
985		states := make([]string, 0, len(counts))
986		for state, count := range counts {
987			states = append(states, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%d", state, count))
988		}
989		sort.Strings(states)
990		readiness := "blocked or unknown"
991		if inspection.Ready() {
992			readiness = "ready"
993		}
994		if len(states) == 0 {
995			states = append(states, "no classified intents")
996		}
997		return "artifact: " + readiness + "; " + strings.Join(states, ", ")
998	}

1130	func (l *flowLoader) validateTarget(
1131		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1132		locator taskflow.Locator,
1133		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1134	) (flowTarget, taskflow.Request, error) {
1135		request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(locator, options)

1142		l.mu.Unlock()

1145		}
1146		actual := flowTarget{repoKey: repoKey, rowKey: rowKey, actionID: actionID, request: request}
1147		if !sameFlowTarget(expected, actual) {

1149		}
1150		return expected, request, nil
1151	}

1167			left.request.Locator == right.request.Locator && left.request.Action == right.request.Action &&
1168			reflect.DeepEqual(left.request.Options, right.request.Options)

```text
90	```bash
91	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main --confirm-squash <merge-commit>
92	```
93	
94	This proves only that the named squash commit is contained in the base; the operator is asserting that it actually represents the feature branch.
95	
96	## Refusal conditions
97	
98	`retire.Inspect` refuses to proceed whenever any of the following hold, and it re-checks after closing sessions rather than trusting a stale view:
99	
100	- the caller's current directory is the target checkout or below it;
101	- the caller's `HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID`, `HERDR_PANE_ID`, or `TMUX_PANE` identifies a runtime session that covers the target;
102	- a covering runtime workspace also contains panes outside the target (mixed-purpose workspace);
103	- any covering agent status is `working`, `running`, `busy`, `blocked`, or `waiting` — **never overridable, by any flag**;
104	- agent status is empty or `unknown`, **unless** the caller passes `--close-unknown` from outside the target;
105	- agent status is unrecognized (anything outside the known set) — always blocks;
106	- runtime enumeration itself fails, **unless** the caller passes `--assume-no-runtime`.
107	
108	`--close-unknown` and `--assume-no-runtime` only relax fail-closed *observations* (an unreadable status, a runtime list that could not be enumerated). Neither flag ever bypasses caller containment or an active-agent state. `retirement.Service.Retire` also revalidates the target's identity, Git ancestry, in-progress Git operations (`gitx.InProgress`, checking `MERGE_HEAD`, `CHERRY_PICK_HEAD`, `REVERT_HEAD`, `rebase-merge`, `rebase-apply`, `sequencer` — not `REBASE_HEAD`, which Git leaves behind after a rebase completes), and worktree cleanliness after runtime sessions close — reality may have changed while a runtime was draining, so no earlier proof carries across that boundary.
109	
110	## Periodic cleanup with sweep
111	
112	```bash
113	dev sweep --merged-worktrees
114	# Present the exact candidates/blockers to the user and ask for approval.
```

174	// NewLifecycleService installs the concrete guarded parking, resume, and
175	// completion handlers. Actions without complete policy implementations remain
176	// unavailable rather than falling back to an unsafe generic executor.
177	func NewLifecycleService(input LifecycleConfig) (*Service, error) {
178		implementation, err := newLifecycleImplementation(input)
179		if err != nil {
180			return nil, err
181		}
182		service := NewService(Handlers{
183			ParkWarm:       implementation.handler(ParkWarm),
184			ParkCold:       implementation.handler(ParkCold),
185			Resume:         implementation.handler(Resume),
186			CompleteDirect: implementation.handler(CompleteDirect),
187			CompleteFF:     implementation.handler(CompleteFF),
188			ReviewHandoff:  implementation.handler(ReviewHandoff),
189			VerifyMerged:   implementation.handler(VerifyMerged),
190			Retire:         implementation.retireHandler(),
191			Adopt:          implementation.adoptHandler(),
192			RemoveCheckout: implementation.removeCheckoutHandler(),
193			RefreshRemote:  implementation.refreshRemoteHandler(),
194		})
195		service.locateTask = implementation.locateExactTask
196		return service, nil
197	}

199	func newLifecycleImplementation(input LifecycleConfig) (*lifecycleService, error) {

223			}
224		}
225		callerWorkspace := input.CallerWorkspaceID
226		if callerWorkspace == "" {
227			callerWorkspace = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
228		}
229		callerPane := input.CallerPaneID
230		if callerPane == "" {
231			callerPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
232			if callerPane == "" {
233				callerPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
234			}
235		}
236		clock := input.Clock
237		if clock == nil {
238			clock = time.Now
239		}
240		logf := input.Logf
241		if logf == nil {
242			logf = func(string, ...any) {}
243		}
244	
245		defaultRuntime := input.DefaultRuntime
246		if defaultRuntime == nil {
247			defaultRuntime = func() runtime.Runtime {

249			}
250		}
251		namedRuntime := input.NamedRuntime
252		if namedRuntime == nil {
253			namedRuntime = func(name string) runtime.Runtime {
254				return configuredRuntime(input.Config, name)
255			}
256		}
257	
258		s := &lifecycleService{
259			cfg: input.Config, tasks: input.Tasks, artifacts: input.Artifacts,

277			gitRemote:        gitx.Remote,
278			gitRefExists:     gitx.RefExists,

282			wipCommit:        gitx.WipCommit,
283			analyzeFinish:    gitx.AnalyzeFinish,

288			inspectArtifacts: artifact.InspectReadiness,

290			inspectCleanup:   retire.Inspect,

292			openRuntime:      openRuntimeSurface,

296				if provider == nil {
297					return "", errors.New("create review: no forge provider")

299				return provider.CreatePR(ctx, dir, request)

301			queryReview: func(ctx context.Context, provider forge.Forge, dir string, query forge.ReviewQuery) (*forge.Review, error) {

318		s.createWorktree = func(ctx context.Context, request wt.CreateRequest) (*wt.CreateResult, error) {

320			return manager.Create(ctx, request)
321		}
322		applyLifecycleHooks(s, input.Hooks)

402	func (l *flowLoader) ListRepositories(ctx context.Context) ([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, error) {
403		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
404			return nil, err
405		}
406		records, _, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
407		if taskErr != nil {
408			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list task-referenced repositories: %w", taskErr)
409		}
410		discovered, err := l.listRepo(ctx, l.app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
411		if err != nil {
412			return nil, err
413		}
414	
415		fresh := make(map[string]flowRepository)
416		l.mu.Lock()
417		for key := range l.pinned {
418			if existing, ok := l.repositories[key]; ok {
419				fresh[key] = existing
420			}
421		}
422		l.mu.Unlock()
423	
424		for index := range discovered {
425			candidate := discovered[index]
426			gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, candidate.Path)
427			if discoverErr != nil {
428				continue
429			}
430			entry, convertErr := availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, &candidate, "")
431			if convertErr != nil {
432				continue
433			}
434			if _, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
435				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
436			}
437		}
438	
439		pathResults := make(map[string]struct {
440			repository flowRepository
441			err        error
442		})
443		for _, record := range records {
444			path := record.Task.RepoPath
445			resolved, seen := pathResults[path]
446			if !seen {
447				gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, path)
448				if discoverErr == nil {
449					resolved.repository, discoverErr = availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, nil, "")
450				}
451				resolved.err = discoverErr
452				pathResults[path] = resolved
453			}
454			if resolved.err == nil {
455				if _, exists := fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
456					fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey] = resolved.repository
457				}
458				continue
459			}
460			entry := unavailableFlowRepository(record, resolved.err)
461			if existing, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; exists {
462				existing.unavailableTasks = appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(existing.unavailableTasks, record)
463				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = existing
464			} else {
465				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
466			}
467		}
468	
469		rows := make([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, 0, len(fresh))
470		for _, entry := range fresh {
471			rows = append(rows, entry.row)
472		}
473		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
474			left, right := strings.ToLower(rows[i].Name), strings.ToLower(rows[j].Name)
475			if left != right {
476				return left < right
477			}
478			if rows[i].Path != rows[j].Path {
479				return rows[i].Path < rows[j].Path
480			}
481			return rows[i].RepoKey < rows[j].RepoKey
482		})
483		l.mu.Lock()
484		l.repositories = fresh
485		l.mu.Unlock()
486		return rows, nil
487	}

489	func appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(records []task.Record, candidate task.Record) []task.Record {

492				return records
493			}
494		}
495		return append(records, candidate)

498	func (l *flowLoader) LoadRepository(ctx context.Context, repoKey string) (flowtui.Snapshot, error) {
499		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
500			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
501		}
502		l.mu.Lock()
503		selected, ok := l.repositories[repoKey]
504		l.mu.Unlock()
505		if !ok {
506			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is not in the current flow inventory", repoKey)
507		}
508		if !selected.available {
509			return l.unavailableSnapshot(selected), nil
510		}
511	
512		records, diagnostics, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
513		selectedTasks := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(records))
514		for index := range records {
515			record := records[index]
516			resolved, err := l.discover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
517			if err != nil {
518				continue
519			}
520			commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(resolved.GitCommonDir)
521			if err != nil || commonDir != repoKey {
522				continue
523			}
524			copy := record.Task
525			copy.Tags = append([]string(nil), record.Task.Tags...)
526			selectedTasks = append(selectedTasks, &copy)
527		}
528	
529		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
530		if err != nil {
531			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
532		}
533		if rt == nil {
534			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, errors.New("flow runtime resolver returned no backend")
535		}
536		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
537		runtimeObserved := runtimeErr == nil && rt.Name() != "none"
538		contextSnapshot := inventory.CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, selected.repository, selectedTasks, inventory.RepoContextOptions{
539			Runtime: rt.Name(), Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: runtimeObserved,
540			RuntimeErr: runtimeErr, Limiter: l.limiter,
541		})
542		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
543			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
544		}
545	
546		service, serviceErr := l.service(rt)
547		base := ""
548		if queryPath := flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot); queryPath != "" {
549			base = l.base(ctx, queryPath)
550		}
551		taskComplete := taskErr == nil && len(diagnostics) == 0
552		rows, targets, projectionIssues := l.projectRows(ctx, contextSnapshot, service, serviceErr, taskComplete, base)
553	
554		issues := make([]string, 0, 8)
555		if taskErr != nil {
556			issues = append(issues, "task inventory: "+taskErr.Error())
557		}
558		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
559			issues = append(issues, "task diagnostic: "+diagnostic.Error())
560		}
561		if contextSnapshot.IdentityErr != nil {
562			issues = append(issues, "repository identity: "+contextSnapshot.IdentityErr.Error())
563		}
564		if contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr != nil {
565			issues = append(issues, "worktree inventory: "+contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr.Error())
566		}
567		if rt.Name() != "none" && runtimeErr != nil {
568			issues = append(issues, "runtime observation: "+runtimeErr.Error())
569		}
570		for _, checkout := range contextSnapshot.Checkouts {
571			if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
572				issues = append(issues, "Git status "+checkout.Worktree.Path+": "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
573			}
574		}
575		issues = append(issues, projectionIssues...)
576		issues = uniqueStrings(issues)
577	
578		freshness := flowtui.FreshnessFresh
579		if len(issues) > 0 {
580			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
581		}
582		repositoryRow := selected.row
583		repositoryRow.Available = contextSnapshot.RepositoryID == repoKey && contextSnapshot.IdentityErr == nil
584		if contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != "" && contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != repoKey {
585			issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("repository identity changed from %s to %s", repoKey, contextSnapshot.RepositoryID))
586			repositoryRow.Available = false
587			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
588		}
589		snapshot := flowtui.Snapshot{
590			Repository: repositoryRow,
591			Surfaces:   flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
592			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(),
593			Freshness:  freshness,
594			Error:      strings.Join(uniqueStrings(issues), "; "),
595		}
596		l.mu.Lock()
597		l.targets[repoKey] = targets
598		if remote, exists := l.remote[repoKey]; exists {
599			snapshot.Remote = flowtui.SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
600		}
601		l.mu.Unlock()
602		return snapshot, nil
603	}

617				),

73		if err != nil {
74			return task.Task{}, fmt.Errorf("load final exact task %s: %w", s.Locator.TaskID, err)
75		}
76		return final.Task, nil

79	func (s lifecycleSession) requireRetired(app *App, result flow.Result) error {
80		if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneRetired {
81			return fmt.Errorf("task %s retirement returned milestone %s, want %s",
82				s.Locator.TaskID, result.Milestone, flow.MilestoneRetired)
83		}
84		if _, err := app.Tasks.GetRecord(s.Locator.TaskID); !errors.Is(err, task.ErrNotFound) {
85			if err == nil {
86				return fmt.Errorf("task %s retirement completed but the task record still exists", s.Locator.TaskID)
87			}
88			return fmt.Errorf("verify retired task %s is absent: %w", s.Locator.TaskID, err)
89		}
90		return nil
91	}

93	func executeTaskLifecycle(
94		ctx context.Context,
95		app *App,
96		resolve lifecycleTaskResolver,
97		options flow.ActionOptions,
98	) (lifecycleExecution, error) {
99		var execution lifecycleExecution
100		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, resolve)
101		if err != nil {
102			return execution, err
103		}
104		execution.Selected = session.Selected
105		execution.Plan, err = session.plan(ctx, options)
106		if err != nil {
107			return execution, err
108		}
109		execution.Result, err = session.apply(ctx, execution.Plan, flow.Approve(execution.Plan.PlanID))
110		renderLifecycleResult(app, execution.Plan, execution.Result)
111		if err != nil {
112			return execution, presentLifecycleApplyError(execution.Plan, err)
113		}
114	
115		execution.Task, err = session.finalTask(app)
116		if err != nil {
117			return execution, err
118		}
119		return execution, nil
120	}

177		}

Concrete scenario: `dev adopt --apply` reports an ahead branch `feat/x`; while the confirmation prompt is open, another process deletes `feat/x`; answering yes still executes line 139 and creates a branch-mode task naming a nonexistent branch. 21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}
48	
49	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAndSpecify(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (PlanSpec, lifecycleObservation, error) {
50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:
64			spec = s.resumeSpec(request, observed)
65		case CompleteDirect:
66			spec = s.completeDirectSpec(request, observed)
67		case CompleteFF:
68			spec = s.completeFFSpec(request, observed)
69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}
76		return spec, observed, nil
77	}
78	
79	func (s *lifecycleService) freshPlan(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (Plan, lifecycleObservation, error) {
80		spec, observed, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, record)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Plan{}, observed, err
83		}
84		plan, err := BuildPlan(request, spec)
85		return plan, observed, err
86	}

254	func (e *executionState) run(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error)) error {
255		step := StepResult{Effect: effect.Clone(), Status: StepAttempted, StartedAt: e.service.now()}
256		detail, err := operation()
257		step.FinishedAt = e.service.now()
258		step.Detail = detail
259		if err != nil {
260			step.Status = StepFailed
261			step.Failure = err.Error()
262			e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
263			return err
264		}
265		step.Status = StepCompleted
266		e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
267		return nil
268	}
269	
270	func (e *executionState) runWarning(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error), warningPrefix string) {
271		err := e.run(effect, operation)
272		if err != nil {
273			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, warningPrefix+": "+err.Error())
274		}
275	}
276	
277	func (e *executionState) result() Result {
278		spec := ResultSpec{
279			Steps: e.steps, Warnings: e.warnings, Recovery: e.recovery,
280			PartialSuccess: e.partial,
281			Milestone:      e.milestone, Handoff: e.handoff, Remote: e.remote, FreshSnapshotRef: e.snapshot,
282		}
283		for _, step := range e.steps {
284			if step.Status == StepCompleted {
285				spec.PartialSuccess = true
286				break
287			}
288		}
289		if len(e.steps) > 0 && e.steps[len(e.steps)-1].Status == StepCompleted &&
290			(e.snapshot != "" || e.remote != nil) && len(e.recovery) == 0 {
291			// Successful completion is not partial merely because it had effects.
292			// Remote refresh is intentionally run-local and therefore completes with
293			// structured data rather than a persisted snapshot reference.
294			spec.PartialSuccess = false
295		}
296		return NewResult(spec)
297	}

299	func (e *executionState) fail(err error, recovery ...string) (Result, error) {
300		e.recovery = append(e.recovery, recovery...)
301		return e.result(), err
302	}

1	package taskflow

4		"context"

15	func (s *lifecycleService) applyGuarded(ctx context.Context, action Action, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
16		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
17			return Result{}, err
18		}
19		if approved.Action != action {
20			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("handler %s received %s", action, approved.Action)}
21		}
22		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
23			return Result{}, err
24		}
25		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
28		}
29	
30		var result Result
31		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
32			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
33				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
34				if loadErr != nil {
35					return &StalePlanError{
36						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID,
37						Reason:         "task record disappeared before apply",
38					}
39				}
40				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
41					return identityErr
42				}
43				fresh, observed, planErr := s.freshPlan(ctx, approved.Request, *record)
44				if planErr != nil {
45					return planErr
46				}
47				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
48				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
49					actual := ""
50					if current != nil {
51						actual = current.Revision
52					}
53					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked plan rebuild")
54				}
55				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
56					return &StalePlanError{
57						ExpectedPlanID:               approved.PlanID,
58						ActualPlanID:                 fresh.PlanID,
59						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
60						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
61						Reason:                       "fresh task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or option authority differs",
62					}
63				}
64				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
65					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
66					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
67				}
68	
69				execution := &executionState{
70					service: s, plan: fresh, observed: observed, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision,
71				}
72				var applyErr error
73				switch action {
74				case ParkWarm:
75					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkWarm(ctx)
76				case ParkCold:
77					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkCold(ctx)
78				case Resume:
79					result, applyErr = execution.applyResume(ctx)
80				case CompleteDirect:
81					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteDirect(ctx)
82				case CompleteFF:
83					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteFF(ctx)
84				case ReviewHandoff:
85					result, applyErr = execution.applyReviewHandoff(ctx)
86				case VerifyMerged:
87					result, applyErr = execution.applyVerifyMerged(ctx)
88				default:
89					applyErr = &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: action, Stage: "apply"}
90				}
91				return applyErr
92			})
93		})
94		return result, err
95	}
96	
97	func (e *executionState) applyParkWarm(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
98		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ParkWarmOptions)
99		observed := &e.observed
100		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() && !options.CommitWIP {
101			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, observed.checkout+" has uncommitted changes; bytes remain in place")
102		}
103		if observed.desiredNext(options) == "" {
104			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "no next action is recorded")
105		}
106		if !options.KeepSession && observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
107			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "runtime remains active because the caller is contained; exit normally and reconcile later")
108		}
109	
110		closedRuntime := false
111		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
112			switch effect.Code {
113			case EffectCommitWIP:
114				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
115					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task and retry warm parking")
116				}
117				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
118					made, commitErr := e.service.wipCommit(ctx, observed.checkout, effect.Details.Map()["message"])
119					if commitErr != nil {
120						return "", fmt.Errorf("checkpoint WIP: %w", commitErr)
121					}
122					if !made {
123						return "no product changes required a checkpoint", nil
124					}
125					return "created WIP checkpoint", nil
126				})
127				if err != nil {
128					return e.fail(err, "preserve the checkout and retry after fixing the checkpoint failure")
129				}
130				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
131					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after WIP checkpoint: %w", err), "inspect the committed checkpoint before retrying")
132				}
133			case EffectPushBranch:
134				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
135					return e.fail(err, "inspect the checkout and retry the push")

536			m.actionCursor = 0

538		}

550		m.cancelRepositoryListRead()
551		m.screen = screenRepository

554		m.hasSnapshot = false

560		m.hasLastResult, m.lastResultErr = false, nil
561		m.hasHandoff = false

102	func (m Model) applyCmd(generation uint64, target actionTarget, plan taskflow.Plan, approval taskflow.Approval) tea.Cmd {
103		target = target.clone()
104		plan = plan.Clone()
105		callback := m.actions.Apply
106		// Apply is intentionally detached from the run's cancellation signal. The UI
107		// queues quit/refresh and waits for this command's ledger instead of claiming a
108		// mutation was canceled or discarding its completion message.
109		ctx := context.WithoutCancel(m.baseContext())
110		return func() tea.Msg {
111			if callback == nil {

114					err: errors.New("Apply is unavailable"),
115				}

117			result, err := callback(

119				target.locator, target.choice.Options(), plan.Clone(), approval,
120			)
121			return applyMsg{
122				generation: generation, repoKey: target.repoKey, rowKey: target.rowKey, actionID: target.actionID,
123				result: result.Clone(), err: err,
124			}
125		}
126	}

166	// NewPicker constructs a model which discovers repositories asynchronously.
167	func NewPicker(actions Actions) Model { return New(actions, nil) }

169	// NewRepository constructs a model focused on one exact repository key.
170	func NewRepository(actions Actions, repository RepositoryRow) Model {
171		return New(actions, &repository)
172	}

174	// WithContext bounds cancelable list/load/plan callbacks to one TUI run. Apply
175	// deliberately uses a cancellation-detached child so queued quit cannot abort a
176	// mutation whose result ledger must be retained.
177	func (m Model) WithContext(ctx context.Context) Model {
178		m.runContext = ctx
179		return m
180	}
181	
182	func (m Model) baseContext() context.Context {
183		if m.runContext != nil {
184			return m.runContext
185		}
186		return context.Background()
187	}
188	
189	// Init implements tea.Model without doing synchronous repository work.
190	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
191		var commands []tea.Cmd
192		switch m.screen {
193		case screenRepository:
194			if m.loadRequest.loading {
195				commands = append(commands, m.loadRepositoryCmd(m.loadRequest.generation, m.loadRequest.repoKey, m.baseContext()))
196			}
197		case screenPicker:
198			if m.listRequest.loading {
199				commands = append(commands, m.listRepositoriesCmd(m.listRequest.generation, m.baseContext()))
200			}
201		}
202		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
203			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
204		}
205		switch len(commands) {
206		case 0:
207			return nil
208		case 1:
209			return commands[0]
210		default:
211			return tea.Batch(commands...)
212		}
213	}

13	// locateExactTask builds a managed locator from one exact task record and a
14	// fresh view of its repository. Missing checkout evidence is retained as an
15	// expected path (or an intentionally empty COLD path) so Plan can explain the

17	func (s *lifecycleService) locateExactTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
18		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {

24

123	func (s *lifecycleService) locateRegisteredCheckout(
124		ctx context.Context,
125		candidate task.Task,
126		repoPath string,
127		expectedCheckout string,
128	) (gitx.RegisteredWorktree, bool) {
129		if expectedCheckout != "" {
130			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
131			return registered, err == nil
132		}
133		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree || candidate.State != task.Cold {
134			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
135		}
136	
137		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, repoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
140		}
141		match := ""
142		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
143			if worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch {
144				continue
145			}
146			if match != "" {
147				return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
148			}
149			match = worktree.Path
150		}
151		if match == "" {
152			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
153		}
154		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, match)
155		return registered, err == nil
156	}
157	
158	func (s *lifecycleService) branchUpstream(ctx context.Context, repoPath, branch string) string {
159		if branch == "" {
160			return ""
161		}
162		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath,
163			"for-each-ref", "--format=%(upstream:short)", localBranchRef(branch),
164		)
165		if err != nil {
166			return ""
167		}
168		return strings.TrimSpace(value)
169	}

1	package runtime

5	// None is the no-multiplexer backend. It is always available, which is what
6	// guarantees dev's core inventory and worktree commands work on a bare machine
7	// with nothing but git installed.
8	//
9	// Open returns the directory itself as the handle: the shell wrapper installed
10	// by `dev shell-init` turns that into a cd in the calling shell, since a child
11	// process can never change its parent's working directory.
12	type None struct{}
13	
14	// Name implements Runtime.
15	func (None) Name() string { return "none" }
16	
17	// Available implements Runtime; the null backend always is.
18	func (None) Available() bool { return true }
19	
20	// Open implements Runtime by reporting the directory to change into. None does
21	// not open a runtime surface, so the result is never launchable.
22	func (None) Open(_ context.Context, dir, _ string) (OpenResult, error) {
23		return OpenResult{Handle: dir}, nil
24	}
25	
26	// Close implements Runtime as a no-op: there is no session to end.
27	func (None) Close(context.Context, string) error { return nil }
28	
29	// List implements Runtime; without a multiplexer nothing is tracked as live.
30	func (None) List(context.Context) ([]Session, error) { return nil, nil }
31	
32	// Annotate implements Runtime as a no-op.
33	func (None) Annotate(context.Context, string, map[string]string) error { return nil }

89		// another worktree works, but the relative paths and the base ref get

97		// this branch is a reuse, not an error the user needs to resolve.

116		branchExisted := gitx.BranchExists(ctx, repoPath, req.Branch)
117		if !branchExisted {
118			if base == "" {
119				base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repoPath)
120			}
121			if base != "" && !gitx.RefExists(ctx, repoPath, base) {
122				return nil, fmt.Errorf("base ref %q does not exist in %s", base, repoPath)
123			}
124		}
125		var provisionSettings Settings
126		if !req.NoProvision {
127			provisionSettings, err = SettingsForTrusted(ctx, m.Cfg, repoPath)
128			if err != nil {
129				return nil, err
130			}
131		}
132	
133		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
134			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create worktree parent: %w", err)
135		}
136		if err := gitx.AddWorktree(ctx, repoPath, path, req.Branch, base); err != nil {
137			return nil, err
138		}
139		m.logf("worktree %s -> %s", req.Branch, config.Contract(path))
140	
141		res := &CreateResult{Path: path, Branch: req.Branch, BranchCreated: !branchExisted}
142	
143		if !req.NoProvision {
144			// Trusted settings fold in the repository's portable project config.
145			p := &Provisioner{
146				Settings: provisionSettings,
147				Timeout:  provisionSettings.ProvisionTimeout,
148				Log:      m.Log,
149			}
150			pr, err := p.Provision(ctx, repoPath, path)
151			if err != nil {
152				// The checkout exists and is usable; provisioning is best-effort.
153				m.logf("warning: provisioning: %v", err)
154			}
155			res.Provision = pr
156		}
157	
158		if !req.NoRuntime && m.Runtime != nil {
159			label := req.Label
160			if label == "" {
161				label = req.RepoName + "/" + req.Branch
162			}
163			opened, err := m.surface(ctx, path, label)
164			if err != nil {
165				m.logf("warning: could not open a runtime session: %v", err)
166			} else {
167				res.Runtime = opened
168				res.RuntimeName = m.Runtime.Name()
169			}
170		}
171		return res, nil
172	}
173	
174	// surface registers the checkout with the runtime. When the backend
175	// understands git worktrees it is asked to open it as one, which is what makes
176	// the checkout appear grouped under its parent repo with its own branch and
177	// ahead/behind row rather than as an unrelated directory.
178	func (m *Manager) surface(ctx context.Context, path, label string) (runtime.OpenResult, error) {
179		if wo, ok := m.Runtime.(runtime.WorktreeOpener); ok {
180			return wo.OpenWorktree(ctx, path, label)
181		}
182		return m.Runtime.Open(ctx, path, label)
183	}
184

641	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, expectedBranch string) error {

645		}
646		if registered.Path != observed.checkout || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {

648		}
649		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !registered.IsLinkedWorktree() {

652		if observed.mode != task.ModeWorktree && (!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare) {

662		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")

666		head = strings.TrimSpace(head)

668			return fmt.Errorf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", registered.Worktree.Head, head)

670		baseOID, baseOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
671		upstreamOID, upstreamOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
672		operation, active, operationErr := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
673		if operationErr != nil {
674			return operationErr
675		}
676		observed.worktree = registered
677		observed.status = status
678		observed.statusErr = nil
679		observed.head = head
680		observed.headErr = nil
681		observed.baseOID = baseOID
682		observed.baseOIDErr = baseOIDErr
683		observed.upstreamOID = upstreamOID
684		observed.upstreamOIDErr = upstreamOIDErr

701	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureColdGitReady(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
702		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {

```text
40	
41	A branch name prefix is not harness ownership proof. Canonical, harness-owned,
42	locked/prunable, detached, ambiguously claimed, or incompletely observed rows are
43	never treated as removable merely because they look inactive.
44	
45	For an eligible unmanaged row:
46	
47	- **Adopt** creates one worktree-mode task record and does not change checkout
48	  content, refs, runtime layout, or path. A dirty checkout may be adopted because
49	  its bytes remain untouched. Fresh strict runtime evidence may derive HOT only
50	  for one stable shell-only covering session with no recognized agent; otherwise
51	  adoption is WARM. `runtime=none` is unobserved, so it derives WARM.
52	- **Remove Checkout** requires an exact named clean linked checkout, complete task
53	  inventory with no claims, ready artifacts, safe external runtime cleanup, and
54	  no harness evidence. It uses non-force removal and verifies that the local
55	  branch remains at the same OID.
56	
57	Repository-wide prune and drift reconciliation are not hidden Remove variants.
58	The flow reports those conditions and leaves them for explicit recovery.
59	
60	## Intent, facts, and plans
61	
62	The three panels keep different kinds of truth separate:
63	
64	1. **Persisted intent** — task mode, HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE, owner, next action,
65	   branch/base, expected checkout, and runtime hint.
66	2. **Observed facts** — repository/worktree identity, HEAD and refs, Git status and
67	   in-progress operations, artifact readiness, runtime sessions, and recognized
68	   agents. A fact remains known, unknown, error, skipped, loading, or stale; a
69	   failed observation never becomes false, clean, or closed.
70	3. **Guarded plan** — legal source/target edge, READY/NEEDS INPUT/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN/
71	   ERROR availability, ordered conditions and effects, remediation, resources
72	   retained, confirmation class, PlanID, and CLI fallback.
73	
74	`runtime=none` cannot observe session or agent occupancy. That does not turn the
75	observation into “closed,” but a complete local Git/task snapshot can still be
76	fresh and useful for non-runtime facts.
77	
78	## Managed lifecycle choices
79	
80	Actions are concrete variants, not a generic force menu:
81	
82	| Current intent | Flow choices |
83	|---|---|
84	| HOT/WARM worktree or branch task | Park Warm; Park Cold; Park Cold + Push; Complete FF; Review Handoff; Verify Merged |
85	| HOT/WARM direct task | Park Warm; Complete Direct |
86	| WARM task | Resume (with an explicit fetch effect) |
87	| COLD worktree/branch task | Resume and reconstruct/reopen; completion remains unavailable until HOT |
88	| DONE task | Retire (Keep Branch); for eligible non-direct tasks, Retire + Delete Contained Branch |
89	
90	Review Handoff publishes the branch and creates a pull/merge request when the
91	available provider supports it, but preserves HOT/WARM. Direct/FF/verified
92	completion writes DONE last and keeps branch, checkout, and runtime resources.
93	Retire is the separate externally safe close/wait/remove/task-reap operation.
94	
95	The preview always uses a fail-on-dirty completion policy. It intentionally does
96	not expose dirty commit/discard, WIP checkpoint, shared-writer, ownership
97	takeover, force removal, `--close-unknown`, or `--assume-no-runtime` choices.
98	Blocked plans show the precise evidence, remediation, and compatible CLI
99	fallback instead of manufacturing an override.
100	
101	## Keys and approval
102	
103	```text
104	j/k or up/down       select a surface or picker/menu row
105	h/l or left/right    select an already-concrete action
106	Tab / Shift-Tab      move panel focus
107	/                    filter the repository picker
108	Enter                build and inspect a plan; never apply immediately
109	y                    approve a READY non-typed plan
```

447		}
448		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
449			cleanup()
450			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
451		}
452		if err := stagedFilesMatch(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
453			cleanup()
454			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
455		}
456		message := fmt.Sprintf("chore: finalize %s agent session", intent.Provider)

458		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "commit", "-m", message, "-m", trailers); err != nil {
459			cleanup()

461		}

465		}

472	func (s *Service) resolveIntent(request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
473		if request.IntentID != "" {
474			return s.Store.Get(request.IntentID)
475		}
476		if request.RunID != "" {
477			return s.Store.FindByRunID(request.RunID)
478		}
479		return nil, fmt.Errorf("finalize requires an intent or run id")
480	}
481	
482	func (s *Service) revalidate(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
483		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
484		if err != nil {
485			return err
486		}
487		if repository.GitCommonDir != intent.GitCommonDir {
488			return fmt.Errorf("Git common-dir changed")
489		}
490		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
491		if err != nil {
492			return err
493		}
494		if status.Branch != intent.Branch || status.Detached {
495			return fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
496		}
497		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(intent.WorktreePath); err != nil {
498			return err
499		} else if active {
500			return fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
501		}
502		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
503		if err != nil {
504			return err
505		}
506		if head != intent.Head {
507			return fmt.Errorf("HEAD changed from %s to %s", intent.Head, head)
508		}
509		return nil
510	}
511	
512	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, id, code string, cause error) error {
513		_ = s.Store.Update(ctx, id, func(intent *Intent) error {
514			intent.Status = Failed
515			intent.FailureCode = code
516			return nil
517		})
518		return fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization %s: %w", code, cause)
519	}

195	### Handoff
196	
197	`stay` prints the result only. `cd` uses the trusted `shell-init` wrapper to
198	change the parent shell. `open` opens the configured Herdr/tmux/Zellij runtime
199	and falls back to `cd` when runtime is `none`. `start` continues into the
200	existing task wizard with the repository fixed, and is unavailable when setup
201	leaves uncommitted files that a new worktree would omit. Neither repository
202	bootstrap nor a default `dev start` launches a coding agent. Explicit
203	worktree-mode `dev start --run '<shell command>'` dispatches one command only
204	when a newly created first-class Herdr worktree returns its exact root pane;
205	`--focus` independently controls navigation afterward.
206	
207	All shared TTY text fields in the repository, task-start, and finish wizards
208	use an inline editor: Left/Right, Home/End, Delete/Backspace, insertion at the
209	cursor, and Esc/Ctrl-C cancellation work as terminal actions rather than being
210	inserted as raw escape bytes. Buffered and piped non-TTY input retains its
211	line-oriented behavior.
212	
213	## `dev done` finish flags
214	
215	`dev done` for branch/worktree tasks integrates through exactly one of `--ff` (rebase onto the base, then fast-forward it) or `--pr` (push and open a pull/merge request). Omitting both opens the interactive finish wizard on a TTY — see [Change-stream workflow](../guides/change-stream-workflow.md) for the prompts.
216	
217	A dirty checkout is handled by `--dirty <auto|fail|commit|discard>` (default `auto`):
218	
219	| Value | Behavior |
220	|---|---|
221	| `auto` | interactive: prompts to commit or discard; non-interactive: fails, same as `fail` |
222	| `fail` | refuses to finish with a dirty checkout |
223	| `commit` | commits everything with `--message`/`-m` (prompted interactively if omitted) |
224	| `discard` | resets tracked changes and removes untracked files; destructive, requires `--yes` outside a TTY |
225	
226	`--yes`/`-y` confirms the selected finish plan; it is mandatory for a non-interactive `--dirty discard` and otherwise skips the interactive confirmation step. `--keep-worktree` keeps the worktree after `--ff` integration (default: removed once merged), `--push` also pushes the resulting branch, and `--delete-branch` deletes the branch once its commits are contained in the base — never a branch with unpushed commits.
227	
228	## Configuration
229	
230	```bash
231	dev config init
232	dev config show
233	dev config path
234	dev config scaffolds init
235	dev config scaffolds show
236	dev config scaffolds path
237	dev config scaffolds edit
238	```
239	
240	`config init` detects local roots and writes explicit defaults. A missing config file is allowed; the built-in defaults keep core Git behavior usable, but generated config is recommended because it makes machine policy reviewable.
241	
242	Key sections:
243	
244	| Section | Controls |
245	|---|---|
246	| `[paths]` | scan roots, project/tries/worktree roots, worktree template, state path |
247	| `[runtime]` | `auto`, Herdr, tmux, Zellij, or none plus metadata settings |
248	| `[worktree]` | ignored includes, linked dirs, setup commands, strategies, timeout |
249	| `[forge]` / `[[forge.azure_devops]]` | complete remote inventory cache TTL and opt-in Azure organization/project targets |
250	| `[bootstrap]` | recursion, symlink handling, index/layout policy |
251	| `[tui]` / `[[tui.tools]]` | columns, sorting, and external-tool bindings |
252	| `[stats]` | sampler and optional WakaTime import |
253	| `[update]` | `check` (default `true`) — allow the once-a-day "newer release available" hint and its background cache refresh; `DEV_NO_UPDATE_CHECK` overrides it |
254	
255	`DEV_TUI_TRACE=/absolute/new-file.json` enables a one-run TUI startup/readiness
256	trace. The target must be absolute and must not exist; dev never overwrites it.
257	The private bounded document is written after TUI teardown and contains relative
258	categorical timings plus aggregate row counts rather than names, paths, or raw
259	payloads. It is not configuration,
```

204	
205	| 值 | 行為 |
206	|---|---|
207	| `auto` | interactive：提示 commit 或 discard；non-interactive：直接失敗，等同 `fail` |

209	| `commit` | 用 `--message`/`-m` commit 全部變更（未指定時 interactive 會提示輸入） |
210	| `discard` | reset tracked 變更並移除 untracked files；具破壞性，沒有 TTY 時需要 `--yes` |
211	
212	`--yes`/`-y` 用來確認選定的 finish plan；non-interactive 的 `--dirty discard` 必須要有它，其他情況則是跳過 interactive 確認步驟。`--push` 會依 selected integration push 對應 branch/base。成功的 local 或 externally verified integration 只記錄 DONE/MERGED，永遠保留 runtime、worktree 與 branch 給獨立的 `dev retire`；`--keep-worktree` 只保留為 no-op compatibility warning，`--delete-branch` 則會報錯並指向 `dev retire --delete-branch`。`--merged` 可用 `--confirm-squash <merge-commit>` 對 squash result 作明確 operator attestation，不能由 provider status 自動推斷。

29	
30	  --ff       rebase onto the base and fast-forward it locally. Use when the

43	cancel. Unique content requires typing DROP before discard. Scripts select an
44	explicit --dirty policy; destructive discard also requires --yes.
45	
46	A successful local or externally verified merge records DONE, meaning MERGED
47	with cleanup possibly pending. It never closes the invoking runtime, removes a
48	worktree, or deletes a branch. Run dev retire later from outside the workspace.`,
49			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),

53					if selected {
54						modes++
55					}
56				}
57				if modes > 1 {
58					return fmt.Errorf("--ff, --pr and --merged are alternatives; pick one")
59				}
60				if !merged && (baseRef != "" || confirmSquash != "") {
61					return fmt.Errorf("--base-ref and --confirm-squash require --merged")
62				}

64					return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branch is cleanup; run dev retire --delete-branch after integration")

68				}
69				integration := doneIntegrationNone
70				switch {
71				case ff:
72					integration = doneIntegrationFF
73				case pr:
74					integration = doneIntegrationPR
75				case merged:
76					integration = doneIntegrationMerged
77				}
78				return runDone(ctxOf(), app, args, doneOptions{
79					Integration: integration, DirtyPolicy: doneDirtyPolicy(dirtyPolicy),
80					Message: message, Yes: yes, Push: push,
81					BaseRef: baseRef, ConfirmSquash: confirmSquash,
82				})

299	// Main returns Git's actual primary record. The first-row fallback preserves

301	func (c RepoContext) Main() (RepoCheckout, bool) {
302		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {

304				return checkout, true
305			}

314	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
315		hasMarkedMain := false
316		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
317			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
318				hasMarkedMain = true
319				break
320			}
321		}
322		if !hasMarkedMain {
323			if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
324				return nil
325			}
326			return c.Checkouts[1:]
327		}
328		out := make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(c.Checkouts)-1)
329		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
330			if !checkout.Worktree.Main {
331				out = append(out, checkout)
332			}
333		}
334		return out
335	}

337	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout

339	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
340		seen := map[string]bool{}
341		var out []runtime.Session
342		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
343			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
344				key := session.Handle
345				if key == "" {
346					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
347				}
348				if seen[key] {
349					continue
350				}
351				seen[key] = true
352				out = append(out, session)
353			}
354		}

356	}

369	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository. The
370	// legacy entry point can prove observation only when sessions are present;
371	// callers that need a proven empty observation or typed failure use
372	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions.
373	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
374		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
375		return CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, r, tasks, RepoContextOptions{
376			Runtime: runtimeName, Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: len(sessions) > 0,
377		})
378	}
379	
380	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions builds repository topology from Git's complete
381	// registered worktree list. It never synthesizes a main checkout after a Git
382	// query failure.
383	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
384		opts RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
385		if ctx == nil {
386			ctx = context.Background()
387		}
388		out := RepoContext{
389			Repo: r, Runtime: opts.Runtime,
390			WorktreeObservation: TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved},
391			RuntimeObservation:  runtimeObservation(opts),
392		}
393		queryPath := repoQueryPath(r)
394		out.RepositoryID, out.IdentityErr = canonicalRepositoryID(ctx, r, queryPath)
395		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
396	
397		var (
398			worktrees []gitx.Worktree
399			err       error
400		)
401		if queryPath == "" {
402			err = fmt.Errorf("repository has no Git query path")
403		} else {
404			worktrees, err = gitx.Worktrees(ctx, queryPath)
405		}
406		if err != nil {
407			listErr := &WorktreeListError{Path: queryPath, Err: err}
408			out.WorktreeErr = listErr
409			out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: listErr}
410			assignTasksWithoutTopology(&out, tasks)
411			finishRepoContext(&out)
412			return out
413		}
414		out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
415		out.WorktreeCount = 0
416		out.Checkouts = make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(worktrees))
417		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
418			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
419			if canonicalPath == "" {
420				canonicalPath = filepath.Clean(worktree.Path)
421			}
422			checkout := RepoCheckout{
423				ID: canonicalPath, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
424				IdentityErr: canonicalErr,
425				Worktree:    worktree, Exists: pathIsDir(worktree.Path),
426				RuntimeObservation: out.RuntimeObservation,
427				Ownership:          CheckoutExternal,
428			}
429			if canonicalErr != nil {
430				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
431					Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: canonicalErr.Error(),
432				})
433			}
434			if worktree.Main {
435				checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
436					Kind: OwnershipEvidenceGitMain, Path: canonicalPath,
437				})
438			} else {
439				out.WorktreeCount++
440			}
441			out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
442		}
443	
444		enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx, out.Checkouts, opts.Limiter)
445		assignHarnessEvidence(&out)
446		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
447		if out.RuntimeObservation.Available() {
448			assignSessions(&out, opts.Sessions)
449		}
450		finishRepoContext(&out)
451		return out
452	}
453	
454	func runtimeObservation(opts RepoContextOptions) TopologyObservation {
455		if opts.RuntimeErr != nil {
456			err := &RuntimeListError{Runtime: opts.Runtime, Err: opts.RuntimeErr}
457			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: err}
458		}
459		if opts.RuntimeObserved {
460			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
461		}
462		return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved}
463	}
464	
465	func repoQueryPath(r repo.Repo) string {
466		for _, candidate := range []string{r.Path, r.RealPath, r.MainRoot, r.CommonDir} {
467			if candidate != "" {
468				return candidate
469			}
470		}
471		return ""
472	}
473	
474	func canonicalRepositoryID(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, queryPath string) (string, error) {
475		commonDir := r.CommonDir
476		if commonDir == "" && r.Bare {
477			commonDir = queryPath
478		}
479		if commonDir == "" && queryPath != "" {
480			if discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, queryPath); err == nil {
481				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
482			}
483		}
484		if commonDir == "" {
485			err := fmt.Errorf("Git common directory is empty")
486			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
487		}
488		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
489		if err != nil {
490			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
491		}
492		return canonical, nil
493	}
494	
495	func enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx context.Context, checkouts []RepoCheckout, limiter *Limiter) {
496		if limiter == nil {
497			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
498		}
499		var wg sync.WaitGroup
500		for i := range checkouts {
501			if checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare || checkouts[i].Worktree.Prunable || !checkouts[i].Exists {
502				continue
503			}
504			wg.Add(1)
505			go func(index int) {
506				defer wg.Done()
507				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
508				if !ok {
509					checkouts[index].StatusErr = ctx.Err()
510					return
511				}
512				defer release()
513				checkout := &checkouts[index]
514				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
515				checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(
516					ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status,
517				)
518			}(i)
519		}
520		wg.Wait()
521	}
522

527				mainRoot = out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path

529			}
530		}
531		if mainRoot == "" {

533		}

552	// uses DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree: a worktree-* branch alone is not ownership
553	// evidence.
554	func IsEphemeralWorktree(path, branch string) bool {
555		slashPath := filepath.ToSlash(path)
556		return strings.Contains(slashPath, "/.claude/worktrees/") ||
557			strings.HasPrefix(branch, "worktree-")
558	}

15	func (e *executionState) applyCompleteDirect(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
16		observed := &e.observed
17		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
18			switch effect.Code {
19			case EffectCommitAll, EffectDiscardAll:
20				if err := e.applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx, effect); err != nil {
21					return e.fail(err, "the task checkout and lifecycle state were retained; inspect the content finalization before retrying")
22				}
23			case EffectPushBranch:
24				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
25					return e.fail(err, "refresh direct completion before pushing")
26				}
27				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
28					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
29					if pushErr != nil {
30						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
31					}
32					return "pushed origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
33				})
34				if err != nil {
35					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and task remain active; resolve the push and retry")
36				}
37				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, false); err != nil {
38					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after direct push: %w", err), "inspect the pushed branch before retrying")
39				}
40			case EffectUpdateTask:
41				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
42					return e.fail(err, "refresh direct completion before recording DONE")
43				}
44				if err := e.writeCompletionDone(effect); err != nil {
45					return e.fail(err, "Git effects may already be complete; reload the task and retry the idempotent DONE write")
46				}
47			default:
48				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected CompleteDirect effect " + string(effect.Code)})
49			}
50		}
51		return e.result(), nil
52	}

205	func (e *executionState) applyReviewHandoff(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {

230				})
231				if err != nil {
232					return e.fail(err, "the task state and resources remain unchanged; resolve the push and retry")
233				}
234				pushed = true
235				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, false); err != nil {

237				}
238			case EffectCreateReview:

241				}

244				}

271			}

313					}
314					return fmt.Sprintf("verified %s (%s) is an ancestor of %s (%s)",
315						observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID), nil
316				})
317				if err != nil {
318					return e.fail(err, "no remote freshness was assumed; refresh or select the exact ref and retry while the task remains active")
319				}
320				verified = true
321			case EffectPushBase:
322				if !verified {
323					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "base push reached before merge proof"})
324				}
325				if err := e.service.revalidateVerifiedCompletion(ctx, observed); err != nil {
326					return e.fail(err, "refresh exact merge proof before the optional base push")
327				}
328				e.runWarning(effect, func() (string, error) {
329					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "push", "origin", observed.completionBaseRef)
330					if pushErr != nil {
331						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.completionBaseRef, pushErr)
332					}
333					return "pushed origin/" + observed.completionBaseRef, nil
334				}, "optional base push failed")
335			case EffectUpdateTask:
336				if !verified {
337					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "DONE update reached before merge proof"})
338				}
339				if err := e.service.revalidateVerifiedCompletion(ctx, observed); err != nil {
340					return e.fail(err, "merge proof changed before recording DONE")
341				}
342				if err := e.writeCompletionDone(effect); err != nil {
343					return e.fail(err, "the verified refs and resources remain; reload the task and retry the DONE write")
344				}
345			default:
346				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected VerifyMerged effect " + string(effect.Code)})
347			}
348		}
349		return e.result(), nil
350	}

352	func (e *executionState) applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx context.Context, effect Effect) error {
353		observed := &e.observed
354		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
355			return err
356		}
357		before := observed.finish
358		beforeBranchOID := observed.completionBranchOID
359		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
360			switch effect.Code {
361			case EffectCommitAll:
362				message := effect.Details.Map()["message"]
363				if commitErr := e.service.commitAll(ctx, observed.checkout, message); commitErr != nil {
364					return "commit-all may have changed the index", fmt.Errorf("commit all checkout changes: %w", commitErr)
365				}
366				return "committed all checkout changes", nil
367			case EffectDiscardAll:
368				if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, observed.checkout); discardErr != nil {
369					return "discard-all may have partially reset checkout content", fmt.Errorf("discard all checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
370				}
371				return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
372			default:
373				return "", &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected dirty effect " + string(effect.Code)}
374			}
375		})
376		if err != nil {
377			e.partial = true
378			return err
379		}
380		allowBaseMove := observed.mode == task.ModeDirect && effect.Code == EffectCommitAll
381		if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, allowBaseMove); err != nil {
382			return fmt.Errorf("refresh after %s: %w", effect.Code, err)
383		}
384		if observed.finish.Status.Dirty() || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.inProgress {
385			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again after %s: %s", effect.Code, observed.finish.Status.Breakdown())
386		}
387		switch effect.Code {
388		case EffectCommitAll:
389			parent, parentErr := e.service.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBranchOID+"^")
390			if parentErr != nil || parent != beforeBranchOID {
391				return staleBoundary("commit-all did not create exactly one normal commit from the approved branch OID")
392			}
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeDirect {
394				if observed.finish.Relation != (gitx.BranchRelation{}) {
395					return staleBoundary("direct commit changed the self-relation unexpectedly")
396				}
397			} else if observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly != before.Relation.BaseOnly ||
398				observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly != before.Relation.BranchOnly+1 {
399				return staleBoundary("commit-all changed branch relation by more than the declared single commit")
400			}
401		case EffectDiscardAll:
402			if observed.completionBranchOID != beforeBranchOID || observed.finish.Relation != before.Relation {
403				return staleBoundary("discard-all unexpectedly changed committed branch identity or relation")
404			}
405		}
406		if observed.proofRef == observed.task.Branch {
407			observed.proofOID = observed.completionBranchOID
408		}
409		return nil
410	}

412	func (e *executionState) writeCompletionDone(effect Effect) error {
413		return e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
414			candidate := e.observed.task
415			candidate.State = task.Done
416			updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
417			if updateErr != nil {
418				return "", fmt.Errorf("write DONE task state: %w", updateErr)
419			}
420			if updated == nil {
421				return "", errors.New("write DONE task state returned no revision")
422			}
423			e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
424			e.observed.task = updated.Task
425			e.milestone = MilestoneMerged
426			return "recorded DONE at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
427		})
428	}

432		identityKind, repository := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
433		kind := s.detectForge(ctx, observed.repoPath)

436				return staleBoundary("detected forge no longer matches origin repository identity")
437			}
438			kind = identityKind
439		}
440		if remoteURL != observed.reviewRemoteURL || kind != observed.reviewKind || repository != observed.reviewRepository {
441			return staleBoundary("origin URL or forge repository identity changed after planning")
442		}

447		if err := s.revalidateRepository(ctx, *observed); err != nil {

449		}

452		}

454			observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.completionBranch {

456				observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.completionBranch))
457		}

464		}

466			return staleBoundary("finish content fingerprint or branch relation changed")
467		}

471		}
472		if err := s.revalidateCompletionArtifacts(ctx, observed); err != nil {
473			return err
474		}
475		if err := s.revalidateCompletionOccupancy(ctx, observed); err != nil {
476			return err
477		}

657	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectIntegrationTarget(
658		ctx context.Context,
659		observed *lifecycleObservation,
660	) (completionIntegrationObservation, error) {
661		var fresh completionIntegrationObservation
662		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
663		fresh.worktree, fresh.worktreeErr = registered, err
664		if err != nil {
665			return fresh, err
666		}
667		fresh.worktreeFound = true
668		if registered.Path != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
669			!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare {
670			return fresh, errors.New("integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout")
671		}
672		fresh.status, fresh.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
673		if fresh.statusErr != nil {
674			return fresh, fresh.statusErr
675		}
676		if fresh.status.Dirty() || fresh.status.Conflicted > 0 {
677			return fresh, fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout is not clean: %s", fresh.status.Breakdown())
678		}
679		fresh.head, fresh.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
680		if fresh.headErr != nil {
681			return fresh, fresh.headErr
682		}
683		fresh.head = strings.TrimSpace(fresh.head)
684		if registered.Worktree.Head != fresh.head {
685			return fresh, errors.New("canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD")
686		}
687		fresh.operation, fresh.inProgress, fresh.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
688		if fresh.operationErr != nil {
689			return fresh, fresh.operationErr
690		}
691		if fresh.inProgress {
692			return fresh, errors.New("canonical integration checkout has Git operation " + fresh.operation + " in progress")
693		}
694		fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
695			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
696			CallerWorkspaceID: observed.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
697			CallerPaneID:      observed.taskflowCallerPane,
698		})
699		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr); occupancyErr != nil {
700			return fresh, occupancyErr
701		}
702		return fresh, nil
703	}

15	func (e *executionState) applyCompleteDirect(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
16		observed := &e.observed
17		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
18			switch effect.Code {
19			case EffectCommitAll, EffectDiscardAll:
20				if err := e.applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx, effect); err != nil {
21					return e.fail(err, "the task checkout and lifecycle state were retained; inspect the content finalization before retrying")
22				}
23			case EffectPushBranch:
24				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
25					return e.fail(err, "refresh direct completion before pushing")
26				}
27				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
28					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
29					if pushErr != nil {
30						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
31					}
32					return "pushed origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
33				})
34				if err != nil {
35					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and task remain active; resolve the push and retry")
36				}
37				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, false); err != nil {
38					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after direct push: %w", err), "inspect the pushed branch before retrying")
39				}
40			case EffectUpdateTask:
41				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
42					return e.fail(err, "refresh direct completion before recording DONE")
43				}
44				if err := e.writeCompletionDone(effect); err != nil {
45					return e.fail(err, "Git effects may already be complete; reload the task and retry the idempotent DONE write")
46				}
47			default:
48				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected CompleteDirect effect " + string(effect.Code)})
49			}
50		}
51		return e.result(), nil
52	}
