67					syncBranchIntegration(observed)
68				}
69			case EffectRebaseBranch:
70				if err := e.service.revalidateFFBeforeIntegration(ctx, observed, integrationTouched); err != nil {
71					return e.fail(err, "refresh branch and canonical checkout authority before rebasing")
72				}
73				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
74					_, rebaseErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rebase", observed.completionBaseRef)
75					if rebaseErr != nil {
76						return "rebase may have left an operation in progress", fmt.Errorf("rebase %s onto %s: %w",
77							observed.task.Branch, observed.completionBaseRef, rebaseErr)
78					}
79					return "rebased " + observed.task.Branch + " onto " + observed.completionBaseRef, nil
80				})
81				if err != nil {
82					e.partial = true
83					return e.fail(err, "resolve or abort the rebase in the retained checkout; the task state remains unchanged")
84				}
85				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, false); err != nil {
86					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after rebase: %w", err), "inspect the rebased task branch before retrying")
87				}
88				if observed.finish.Status.Dirty() || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly != 0 {
89					return e.fail(errors.New("rebase did not produce a clean branch based on the exact base"),
90						"inspect the retained branch and rerun completion from a fresh plan")
91				}
92				if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
93					syncBranchIntegration(observed)
94				}
95			case EffectSwitchBase:
96				if err := e.service.revalidateFFBeforeIntegration(ctx, observed, integrationTouched); err != nil {
97					return e.fail(err, "refresh both checkouts before switching the canonical main checkout")
98				}
99				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
100					_, switchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "switch", observed.completionBaseRef)
101					if switchErr != nil {
102						return "", fmt.Errorf("switch canonical checkout to %s: %w", observed.completionBaseRef, switchErr)
103					}
104					return "switched canonical checkout to " + observed.completionBaseRef, nil
105				})
106				if err != nil {
107					return e.fail(err, "the task branch is retained; inspect the canonical checkout and retry")
108				}
109				integrationTouched = true
110				if err := e.service.refreshIntegrationTarget(ctx, observed, observed.completionBaseRef); err != nil {
111					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify canonical base switch: %w", err), "inspect the canonical checkout before merging")
112				}
113				if observed.integration.head != observed.completionBaseOID {
114					return e.fail(staleBoundary("canonical base HEAD differs from the approved base OID after switch"),
115						"refresh fast-forward completion")
116				}
117				if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
118					e.service.syncPrimaryFromIntegration(ctx, observed)
119				}
120				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionAnalysis(ctx, observed, false); err != nil {
121					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh branch relation after base switch: %w", err), "refresh fast-forward completion")
122				}
123			case EffectMergeFF:
124				if err := e.service.revalidateFFMergeBoundary(ctx, observed); err != nil {
125					return e.fail(err, "refresh exact branch and base authority before the fast-forward merge")
126				}
127				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
128					_, mergeErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "merge", "--ff-only", observed.task.Branch)
129					if mergeErr != nil {
130						return "", fmt.Errorf("fast-forward %s into %s: %w",
131							observed.task.Branch, observed.completionBaseRef, mergeErr)
132					}
133					return "fast-forwarded " + observed.completionBaseRef + " to " + observed.task.Branch, nil
134				})
135				if err != nil {
136					return e.fail(err, "the canonical checkout remains on the explicit base and the task branch is retained; refresh and retry")
137				}
138				if err := e.service.refreshIntegrationTarget(ctx, observed, observed.completionBaseRef); err != nil {
139					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify fast-forward merge: %w", err), "inspect the integrated base before recording DONE")
140				}
141				branchOID, err := e.service.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
142				if err != nil {
143					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("resolve task branch after fast-forward: %w", err), "restore the retained branch before recording DONE")
144				}
145				if observed.integration.head != branchOID {
146					return e.fail(staleBoundary("fast-forward base HEAD does not equal the exact task branch OID"),
147						"inspect concurrent branch movement and refresh completion")
148				}
149				observed.completionBaseOID = observed.integration.head
150				observed.completionBranchOID = branchOID
151				if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
152					e.service.syncPrimaryFromIntegration(ctx, observed)
153				}
154				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionAnalysis(ctx, observed, true); err != nil {
155					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after fast-forward merge: %w", err), "inspect the integrated refs before recording DONE")
156				}
157				if !observed.finish.Relation.Contained() {
158					return e.fail(errors.New("task branch is not contained after fast-forward merge"), "refresh and inspect the retained refs")
159				}
160				integrated = true
161			case EffectPushBase:
162				if !integrated {
163					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "base push reached before integration"})
164				}
165				if err := e.service.revalidateFFCompleted(ctx, observed, integrationTouched); err != nil {
166					return e.fail(err, "refresh integrated authority before the optional base push")
167				}
168				pushedBase := false
169				e.runWarning(effect, func() (string, error) {
170					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "push", "origin", observed.completionBaseRef)
171					if pushErr != nil {
172						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.completionBaseRef, pushErr)
173					}
174					pushedBase = true
175					return "pushed origin/" + observed.completionBaseRef, nil
176				}, "optional base push failed")
177				if pushedBase && integrationTouched {
178					if err := e.service.refreshIntegrationTarget(ctx, observed, observed.completionBaseRef); err != nil {
179						return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after optional base push: %w", err), "inspect the pushed base before recording DONE")
180					}
181					if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
182						e.service.syncPrimaryFromIntegration(ctx, observed)
183						if err := e.service.refreshCompletionAnalysis(ctx, observed, false); err != nil {
184							return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh branch relation after optional base push: %w", err), "inspect the pushed base")
185						}
186					}
187				}
188			case EffectUpdateTask:
189				if !integrated {
190					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "DONE update reached before integration proof"})
191				}
192				if err := e.service.revalidateFFCompleted(ctx, observed, integrationTouched); err != nil {
193					return e.fail(err, "refresh exact containment before recording DONE")
194				}
195				if err := e.writeCompletionDone(effect); err != nil {
196					return e.fail(err, "integration is retained; reload the task and retry the now-contained DONE write")
197				}
198			default:
199				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected CompleteFF effect " + string(effect.Code)})
200			}
201		}
202		return e.result(), nil
203	}
204	
205	func (e *executionState) applyReviewHandoff(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
206		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ReviewHandoffOptions)
207		observed := &e.observed
208		pushed := false
209		created := false
210	
211		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
212			switch effect.Code {
213			case EffectCommitAll, EffectDiscardAll:
214				if err := e.applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx, effect); err != nil {
215					return e.fail(err, "the task remains active; inspect content finalization and refresh review handoff")
216				}
217			case EffectPushBranch:
218				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
219					return e.fail(err, "refresh review handoff before publishing the branch")
220				}
221				if err := e.service.revalidateReviewRemote(ctx, observed); err != nil {
222					return e.fail(err, "origin changed; refresh review handoff before publishing")
223				}
224				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
225					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
226					if pushErr != nil {
227						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s for review: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
228					}
229					return "published origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
230				})
231				if err != nil {
232					return e.fail(err, "the task state and resources remain unchanged; resolve the push and retry")
233				}
234				pushed = true
235				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, false); err != nil {
236					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after review push: %w", err), "inspect the published branch before retrying")
237				}
238			case EffectCreateReview:
239				if !pushed {
240					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "review creation reached before branch publication"})
241				}
242				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
243					return e.fail(err, "refresh checkout authority after the successful push before creating review")
244				}
245				if err := e.service.revalidateReviewRemote(ctx, observed); err != nil {
246					return e.fail(err, "origin changed after publication; do not create review against a different repository")
247				}
248				if observed.reviewProvider == nil || !observed.reviewAvailable || !observed.reviewProvider.Available() {
249					err := errors.New("approved forge provider became unavailable after branch publication")
250					stepErr := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) { return "", err })
251					return e.fail(stepErr, "the branch is published and task state is unchanged; open the review manually or retry provider creation")
252				}
253				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
254					url, createErr := e.service.createPR(ctx, observed.reviewProvider, observed.checkout,
255						completionReviewRequest(*observed, options))
256					if createErr != nil {
257						return "", fmt.Errorf("create %s review: %w", observed.reviewKind, createErr)
258					}
259					created = true
260					if strings.TrimSpace(url) != "" {
261						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffURL, URL: strings.TrimSpace(url), Label: observed.task.Title()}
262						return "created review at " + strings.TrimSpace(url), nil
263					}
264					return "provider reported successful review creation without a URL", nil
265				})
266				if err != nil {
267					return e.fail(err, "the branch is published and task state is unchanged; retry review creation or open it manually")
268				}
269			default:
270				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ReviewHandoff effect " + string(effect.Code)})
271			}
272		}
273		if !pushed {
274			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "review handoff completed without publishing the branch"})
275		}
276		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
277			return e.fail(err, "the branch is published; refresh local safety evidence before reporting review readiness")
278		}
279		if !created {
280			if warning := reviewProviderWarning(*observed); warning != "" {
281				e.warnings = append(e.warnings, warning)
282			}
283		}
284		e.milestone = MilestoneReviewReady
285		e.snapshot = "task:" + e.revision
286		return e.result(), nil
287	}
288	
289	func (e *executionState) applyVerifyMerged(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
290		observed := &e.observed
291		verified := false
292		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
293			switch effect.Code {
294			case EffectCommitAll, EffectDiscardAll:
295				if err := e.applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx, effect); err != nil {
296					return e.fail(err, "the task remains active; inspect content finalization and refresh merge verification")
297				}
298				if observed.proofRef == observed.task.Branch {
299					observed.proofOID = observed.completionBranchOID
300				}
301			case EffectVerifyAncestry:
302				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
303					return e.fail(err, "refresh checkout authority before verifying merge ancestry")
304				}
305				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
306					contained, proofErr := e.service.revalidateMergeProof(ctx, observed)
307					if proofErr != nil {
308						return "", proofErr
309					}
310					if !contained {
311						return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot verify %s (%s) is an ancestor of %s (%s)",
312							observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID)
313					}
314					return fmt.Sprintf("verified %s (%s) is an ancestor of %s (%s)",
315						observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID), nil
316				})
317				if err != nil {
318					return e.fail(err, "no remote freshness was assumed; refresh or select the exact ref and retry while the task remains active")
319				}
320				verified = true
321			case EffectPushBase:
322				if !verified {
323					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "base push reached before merge proof"})
324				}
325				if err := e.service.revalidateVerifiedCompletion(ctx, observed); err != nil {
326					return e.fail(err, "refresh exact merge proof before the optional base push")
327				}
328				e.runWarning(effect, func() (string, error) {
329					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "push", "origin", observed.completionBaseRef)
330					if pushErr != nil {
331						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.completionBaseRef, pushErr)
332					}
333					return "pushed origin/" + observed.completionBaseRef, nil
334				}, "optional base push failed")
335			case EffectUpdateTask:
336				if !verified {
337					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "DONE update reached before merge proof"})
338				}
339				if err := e.service.revalidateVerifiedCompletion(ctx, observed); err != nil {
340					return e.fail(err, "merge proof changed before recording DONE")
341				}
342				if err := e.writeCompletionDone(effect); err != nil {
343					return e.fail(err, "the verified refs and resources remain; reload the task and retry the DONE write")
344				}
345			default:
346				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected VerifyMerged effect " + string(effect.Code)})
347			}
348		}
349		return e.result(), nil
350	}
351	
352	func (e *executionState) applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx context.Context, effect Effect) error {
353		observed := &e.observed
354		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
355			return err
356		}
357		before := observed.finish
358		beforeBranchOID := observed.completionBranchOID
359		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
360			switch effect.Code {
361			case EffectCommitAll:
362				message := effect.Details.Map()["message"]
363				if commitErr := e.service.commitAll(ctx, observed.checkout, message); commitErr != nil {
364					return "commit-all may have changed the index", fmt.Errorf("commit all checkout changes: %w", commitErr)
365				}
366				return "committed all checkout changes", nil
367			case EffectDiscardAll:
368				if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, observed.checkout); discardErr != nil {
369					return "discard-all may have partially reset checkout content", fmt.Errorf("discard all checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
370				}
371				return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
372			default:
373				return "", &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected dirty effect " + string(effect.Code)}
374			}
375		})
376		if err != nil {
377			e.partial = true
378			return err
379		}
380		allowBaseMove := observed.mode == task.ModeDirect && effect.Code == EffectCommitAll
381		if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, allowBaseMove); err != nil {
382			return fmt.Errorf("refresh after %s: %w", effect.Code, err)
383		}
384		if observed.finish.Status.Dirty() || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.inProgress {
385			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again after %s: %s", effect.Code, observed.finish.Status.Breakdown())
386		}
387		switch effect.Code {
388		case EffectCommitAll:
389			parent, parentErr := e.service.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBranchOID+"^")
390			if parentErr != nil || parent != beforeBranchOID {
391				return staleBoundary("commit-all did not create exactly one normal commit from the approved branch OID")
392			}
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeDirect {
394				if observed.finish.Relation != (gitx.BranchRelation{}) {
395					return staleBoundary("direct commit changed the self-relation unexpectedly")
396				}
397			} else if observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly != before.Relation.BaseOnly ||
398				observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly != before.Relation.BranchOnly+1 {
399				return staleBoundary("commit-all changed branch relation by more than the declared single commit")
400			}
401		case EffectDiscardAll:
402			if observed.completionBranchOID != beforeBranchOID || observed.finish.Relation != before.Relation {
403				return staleBoundary("discard-all unexpectedly changed committed branch identity or relation")
404			}
405		}
406		if observed.proofRef == observed.task.Branch {
407			observed.proofOID = observed.completionBranchOID
408		}
409		return nil
410	}
411	
412	func (e *executionState) writeCompletionDone(effect Effect) error {
413		return e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
414			candidate := e.observed.task
415			candidate.State = task.Done
416			updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
417			if updateErr != nil {
418				return "", fmt.Errorf("write DONE task state: %w", updateErr)
419			}
420			if updated == nil {
421				return "", errors.New("write DONE task state returned no revision")
422			}
423			e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
424			e.observed.task = updated.Task
425			e.milestone = MilestoneMerged
426			return "recorded DONE at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
427		})
428	}
429	
430	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateReviewRemote(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
431		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, "origin"))
432		identityKind, repository := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
433		kind := s.detectForge(ctx, observed.repoPath)
434		if identityKind != forge.Unknown {
435			if kind != forge.Unknown && kind != identityKind {
436				return staleBoundary("detected forge no longer matches origin repository identity")
437			}
438			kind = identityKind
439		}
440		if remoteURL != observed.reviewRemoteURL || kind != observed.reviewKind || repository != observed.reviewRepository {
441			return staleBoundary("origin URL or forge repository identity changed after planning")
442		}
443		return nil
444	}
445	
446	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
447		if err := s.revalidateRepository(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
448			return err
449		}
450		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
451			return err
452		}
453		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.completionBranch ||
454			observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.completionBranch {
455			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("completion checkout branch changed: registry=%q status=%q expected=%q",
456				observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.completionBranch))
457		}
458		if observed.inProgress || observed.operationErr != nil || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
459			return errors.New("completion checkout acquired a Git operation or conflict")
460		}
461		freshFinish, err := s.analyzeFinish(ctx, observed.checkout, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.task.Branch)
462		if err != nil {
463			return staleBoundary("finish analysis failed during revalidation: " + err.Error())
464		}
465		if finishAuthority(freshFinish, nil) != finishAuthority(observed.finish, observed.finishErr) {
466			return staleBoundary("finish content fingerprint or branch relation changed")
467		}
468		baseOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef)
469		if err != nil || baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {
470			return staleBoundary("completion base ref or OID changed")
471		}
472		if err := s.revalidateCompletionArtifacts(ctx, observed); err != nil {
473			return err
474		}
475		if err := s.revalidateCompletionOccupancy(ctx, observed); err != nil {
476			return err
477		}
478		return nil
479	}
480	
481	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshCompletionCheckout(
482		ctx context.Context,
483		observed *lifecycleObservation,
484		expectedBranch string,
485		allowBaseMove bool,
486	) error {
487		if err := s.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, expectedBranch); err != nil {
488			return err
489		}
490		observed.completionBranch = expectedBranch
491		if err := s.refreshCompletionAnalysis(ctx, observed, allowBaseMove); err != nil {
492			return err
493		}
494		branchOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
495		if err != nil {
496			return err
497		}
498		observed.completionBranchOID = branchOID
499		return nil
500	}
501	
502	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshCompletionAnalysis(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, allowBaseMove bool) error {
503		baseOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef)
504		if err != nil {
505			return err
506		}
507		if !allowBaseMove && baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {
508			return staleBoundary("completion base OID changed outside a declared integration effect")
509		}
510		analysis, err := s.analyzeFinish(ctx, observed.checkout, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.task.Branch)
511		if err != nil {
512			return err
513		}
514		observed.completionBaseOID = baseOID
515		if observed.completionBaseRef == observed.task.Base {
516			observed.baseOID = baseOID
517			observed.baseOIDErr = nil
518		}
519		observed.finish = analysis
520		observed.finishErr = nil
521		return nil
522	}
523	
524	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateCompletionArtifacts(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
525		fresh, err := s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
526		if err != nil {
527			return err
528		}
529		if !fresh.Ready() {
530			return errors.New("artifact readiness changed to blocked")
531		}
532		if artifactAuthority(fresh, nil) != artifactAuthority(observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr) {
533			return staleBoundary("artifact intent or receipt authority changed")
534		}
535		observed.artifact = fresh
536		observed.artifactErr = nil
537		return nil
538	}
539	
540	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateCompletionOccupancy(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
541		if observed.runtime == nil {
542			return errors.New("completion runtime is unavailable")
543		}
544		if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtime.Available() {
545			return errors.New("completion runtime became unavailable")
546		}
547		fresh, err := s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
548			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
549			CallerWorkspaceID: observed.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
550			CallerPaneID:      observed.taskflowCallerPane,
551		})
552		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh, err); occupancyErr != nil {
553			return occupancyErr
554		}
555		observed.occupancy = fresh
556		observed.occupancyErr = nil
557		return nil
558	}
559	
560	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateFFBeforeIntegration(
561		ctx context.Context,
562		observed *lifecycleObservation,
563		integrationTouched bool,
564	) error {
565		if err := s.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
566			return err
567		}
568		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
569			return s.revalidateIntegrationTarget(ctx, observed, !integrationTouched, "")
570		}
571		return nil
572	}
573	
574	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateFFMergeBoundary(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
575		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
576			if err := s.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
577				return err
578			}
579		}
580		if err := s.revalidateIntegrationTarget(ctx, observed, true, observed.completionBaseRef); err != nil {
581			return err
582		}
583		branchOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
584		if err != nil {
585			return err
586		}
587		if branchOID != observed.completionBranchOID {
588			return staleBoundary("task branch OID changed before fast-forward merge")
589		}
590		baseOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef)
591		if err != nil || baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {
592			return staleBoundary("base OID changed before fast-forward merge")
593		}
594		analysis, err := s.analyzeFinish(ctx, observed.checkout, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.task.Branch)
595		if err != nil {
596			return err
597		}
598		if analysis.Relation.BaseOnly != 0 || analysis.Status.Dirty() || analysis.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
599			return errors.New("task branch is not a clean fast-forward descendant of the explicit base")
600		}
601		return nil
602	}

604	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateFFCompleted(
605		ctx context.Context,
606		observed *lifecycleObservation,
607		integrationTouched bool,
608	) error {
609		if err := s.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
610			return err
611		}
612		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && integrationTouched {
613			if err := s.revalidateIntegrationTarget(ctx, observed, true, observed.completionBaseRef); err != nil {
614				return err
615			}
616		}
617		branchOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
618		if err != nil || branchOID != observed.completionBranchOID {
619			return staleBoundary("task branch OID changed after integration")
620		}
621		baseOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef)
622		if err != nil || baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {
623			return staleBoundary("base OID changed after integration")
624		}
625		contained, err := s.isAncestor(ctx, observed.repoPath, branchOID, baseOID)
626		if err != nil {
627			return err
628		}
629		if !contained {
630			return errors.New("task branch is no longer contained in the exact base")
631		}
632		return nil
633	}

635	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateIntegrationTarget(
636		ctx context.Context,
637		observed *lifecycleObservation,
638		compareAuthority bool,
639		expectedBranch string,
640	) error {
641		fresh, err := s.inspectIntegrationTarget(ctx, observed)
642		if err != nil {
643			return err
644		}
645		if compareAuthority && integrationAuthority(fresh) != integrationAuthority(observed.integration) {
646			return staleBoundary("canonical integration checkout or occupancy changed")
647		}
648		if expectedBranch != "" && (fresh.status.Detached || fresh.status.Branch != expectedBranch ||
649			fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch != expectedBranch) {
650			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("canonical integration checkout is on %q/%q, expected %q",
651				fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch, fresh.status.Branch, expectedBranch))
652		}
653		observed.integration = fresh
654		return nil
655	}

657	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectIntegrationTarget(
658		ctx context.Context,
659		observed *lifecycleObservation,
660	) (completionIntegrationObservation, error) {
661		var fresh completionIntegrationObservation
662		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
663		fresh.worktree, fresh.worktreeErr = registered, err
664		if err != nil {
665			return fresh, err
666		}
667		fresh.worktreeFound = true
668		if registered.Path != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
669			!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare {
670			return fresh, errors.New("integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout")
671		}
672		fresh.status, fresh.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
673		if fresh.statusErr != nil {
674			return fresh, fresh.statusErr
675		}
676		if fresh.status.Dirty() || fresh.status.Conflicted > 0 {
677			return fresh, fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout is not clean: %s", fresh.status.Breakdown())
678		}
679		fresh.head, fresh.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
680		if fresh.headErr != nil {
681			return fresh, fresh.headErr
682		}
683		fresh.head = strings.TrimSpace(fresh.head)
684		if registered.Worktree.Head != fresh.head {
685			return fresh, errors.New("canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD")
686		}
687		fresh.operation, fresh.inProgress, fresh.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
688		if fresh.operationErr != nil {
689			return fresh, fresh.operationErr
690		}
691		if fresh.inProgress {
692			return fresh, errors.New("canonical integration checkout has Git operation " + fresh.operation + " in progress")
693		}
694		fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
695			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
696			CallerWorkspaceID: observed.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
697			CallerPaneID:      observed.taskflowCallerPane,
698		})
699		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr); occupancyErr != nil {
700			return fresh, occupancyErr
701		}
702		return fresh, nil
703	}
704	
705	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshIntegrationTarget(
706		ctx context.Context,
707		observed *lifecycleObservation,
708		expectedBranch string,
709	) error {
710		fresh, err := s.inspectIntegrationTarget(ctx, observed)
711		if err != nil {
712			return err
713		}
714		if fresh.status.Detached || fresh.status.Branch != expectedBranch || fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch != expectedBranch {
715			return fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout branch is registry=%q status=%q expected=%q",
716				fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch, fresh.status.Branch, expectedBranch)
717		}
718		observed.integration = fresh
719		return nil
720	}

751	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateMergeProof(
752		ctx context.Context,
753		observed *lifecycleObservation,
754	) (bool, error) {
755		baseOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef)
756		if err != nil {
757			return false, err
758		}
759		if baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {
760			return false, staleBoundary("verification base ref moved from its approved OID")
761		}
762		proofOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofRef)
763		if err != nil {
764			return false, err
765		}
766		if proofOID != observed.proofOID {
767			return false, staleBoundary("verification proof ref moved from its expected OID")
768		}
769		contained, err := s.isAncestor(ctx, observed.repoPath, proofOID, baseOID)
770		if err != nil {
771			return false, err
772		}
773		observed.proofContained = contained
774		observed.proofErr = nil
775		return contained, nil
776	}

779		if err := s.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {

783		if err != nil {

785		}
786		if !contained {
787			return errors.New("exact merge proof is no longer contained in the selected base")
788		}
789		return nil
790	}

45	// runEnv executes git with task-scoped environment overrides. It is used for

47	func runEnv(ctx context.Context, dir string, overrides []string, args ...string) (string, error) {
48		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than

52		cmd.Dir = dir
53		if len(overrides) > 0 {
54			keys := make(map[string]bool, len(overrides))
55			for _, override := range overrides {
56				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(override, "=")

59			env := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+len(overrides))

63					env = append(env, entry)
64				}
65			}
66			env = append(env, overrides...)
67			cmd.Env = env
68		}
69		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
70		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
71		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
72		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
73			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
74			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {

389	// repository URL for supported Azure DevOps Services clone URL forms.
390	func parseAzureDevOpsRemote(raw string) (identity, webURL string, ok bool) {
391		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
392		if raw == "" {
393			return "", "", false
394		}
395		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
396			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
397			if err != nil || u.Fragment != "" || u.RawQuery != "" {
398				return "", "", false
399			}
400			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
401			case "https":
402				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
403					return "", "", false
404				}
405				return parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u)
406			case "ssh":
407				if u.User == nil || (u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22") {
408					return "", "", false
409				}
410				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
411					return "", "", false
412				}
413				return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(u.User.Username(), strings.ToLower(u.Hostname()), escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath()))
414			default:
415				return "", "", false
416			}
417		}
418		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
419		if at <= 0 {
420			return "", "", false
421		}
422		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
423		if colon < 0 {
424			return "", "", false
425		}
426		colon += at + 1
427		return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(raw[:at], strings.ToLower(raw[at+1:colon]), decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(raw[colon+1:], "/"), "/")))
428	}

430	func parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u *url.URL) (string, string, bool) {
431		if u.User != nil {
432			if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
433				return "", "", false
434			}
435		}
436		host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
437		segments := escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath())
438		var organization, project, repo string
439		switch {
440		case host == "dev.azure.com":
441			if len(segments) != 4 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[2], "_git") {
442				return "", "", false
443			}
444			organization, project, repo = segments[0], segments[1], segments[3]
445			if u.User != nil && !strings.EqualFold(u.User.Username(), organization) {
446				return "", "", false
447			}
448		case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com") && host != "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com":
449			if len(segments) < 3 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[len(segments)-2], "_git") || u.User != nil {

451			}
452			organization = strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")

456		}
457		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
458		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
459			return "", "", false
460		}
461		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
462		webURL := azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo)
463		return identity, webURL, true
464	}

489		}

501		out := make([]string, 0, len(segments))
502		for _, segment := range segments {

504			if err != nil || decoded == "" || strings.Contains(decoded, "/") {
505				return nil

564		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(commonDir, "worktrees"))
565		if err != nil {
566			return 0
567		}
568		n := 0
569		for _, entry := range entries {
570			if entry.IsDir() {
571				n++
572			}
573		}
574		return n
575	}

582	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
583		latest := status.LatestChange
584		var commit time.Time
585		var subject string
586		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
587			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
588			if commit.After(latest) {
589				latest = commit
590			}
591			subject = lastSubject
592		}
593		return latest, commit, subject
594	}

596	func assignTasksWithoutTopology(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
597		for _, tracked := range sortedUniqueTasks(tasks) {
598			binding := TaskBinding{
599				Task: tracked, Kind: TaskBindingUnbound,
600				ConflictReasons: []TopologyReason{{
601					Code:   ReasonWorktreeInventoryUnavailable,
602					Detail: "registered worktrees could not be observed",
603				}},
604			}
605			out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, tracked)
606			out.OtherTaskBindings = append(out.OtherTaskBindings, binding)
607		}
608	}

610	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
611		paths := map[string][]int{}
612		branches := map[string][]int{}
613		mainIndex := -1
614		for i := range out.Checkouts {
615			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
616			if checkout.ID != "" {
617				paths[checkout.ID] = append(paths[checkout.ID], i)
618			}
619			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" && !checkout.Worktree.Bare {
620				branches[branch] = append(branches[branch], i)
621			}
622			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
623				mainIndex = i
624			}
625		}
626	
627		for _, tracked := range sortedUniqueTasks(tasks) {
628			binding := TaskBinding{Task: tracked, Kind: TaskBindingUnbound}
629			mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
630			var recordedPathIssue *TopologyReason
631			if tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
632				canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(tracked.WorktreePath)
633				if err != nil {
634					reason := TopologyReason{Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: err.Error()}
635					recordedPathIssue = &reason
636				} else if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
637					if matches := paths[canonical]; len(matches) > 0 {
638						if len(matches) == 1 {
639							binding.Kind = TaskBindingExactPath
640							bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
641							continue
642						}
643						reason := TopologyReason{
644							Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
645							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s path matches %d registered checkout records", tracked.ID, len(matches)),
646						}
647						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
648						for _, index := range matches {
649							out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
650						}
651						appendOtherTask(out, binding)
652						continue
653					}
654				}
655				if mode != task.ModeWorktree {
656					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
657						Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
658						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
659							mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
660					})
661				}
662			}
663	
664			if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
665				matches := branches[tracked.Branch]
666				switch len(matches) {
667				case 1:
668					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMovedPath
669					binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, movedPathReason(tracked, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
670					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
671						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
672					}
673					bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
674					continue
675				case 0:
676					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
677						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
678					}
679					if tracked.WorktreePath != "" || taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
680						binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
681							Code:   ReasonWorktreePathMissing,
682							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no registered checkout for branch %s", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch),
683						})
684					}
685				default:
686					reason := TopologyReason{
687						Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
688						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s branch %s matches %d registered checkouts", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, len(matches)),
689					}
690					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
691					for _, index := range matches {
692						out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
693					}
694				}
695				appendOtherTask(out, binding)
696				continue
697			}
698	
699			if mainIndex >= 0 {
700				main := out.Checkouts[mainIndex]
701				if checkoutActionable(main) && main.Branch() == tracked.Branch {
702					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMainBranch
703					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
704						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
705					}
706					bindTask(out, mainIndex, annotateBoundTask(binding, main))
707					continue
708				}
709			}
710	
711			if recordedPathIssue != nil {
712				binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
713			}
714			for _, index := range branches[tracked.Branch] {
715				if index == mainIndex {
716					continue
717				}
718				reason := TopologyReason{
719					Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
720					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s branch is checked out outside Git main at %s",
721						mode, tracked.ID, out.Checkouts[index].Worktree.Path),
722				}
723				binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
724				out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
725			}
726			if taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
727				detail := fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s in Git main", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch)
728				switch {
729				case mainIndex < 0:
730					detail += ", but no Git main record exists"
731				case !checkoutActionable(out.Checkouts[mainIndex]):
732					detail += ", but Git main is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable"
733				default:
734					detail += fmt.Sprintf(", which is on %s", displayBranch(out.Checkouts[mainIndex]))
735				}
736				binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
737					Code: ReasonMainBranchMismatch, Detail: detail,
738				})
739			}
740			appendOtherTask(out, binding)
741		}
742	
743		finalizeCheckoutClaims(out)
744	}

746	func sortedUniqueTasks(tasks []*task.Task) []*task.Task {
747		ordered := append([]*task.Task(nil), tasks...)
748		sort.SliceStable(ordered, func(i, j int) bool {
749			if ordered[i] == nil {
750				return false
751			}
752			if ordered[j] == nil {
753				return true
754			}
755			return ordered[i].ID < ordered[j].ID
756		})
757		seen := map[string]bool{}
758		out := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(ordered))
759		for _, tracked := range ordered {
760			if tracked == nil {
761				continue
762			}
763			if tracked.ID != "" && seen[tracked.ID] {
764				continue
765			}
766			if tracked.ID != "" {
767				seen[tracked.ID] = true
768			}
769			out = append(out, tracked)
770		}
771		return out
772	}
773	
774	func movedPathReason(tracked *task.Task, checkout RepoCheckout) TopologyReason {
775		if tracked.WorktreePath == "" {
776			return TopologyReason{
777				Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
778				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no recorded worktree path; branch %s is registered at %s",
779					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
780			}
781		}
782		return TopologyReason{
783			Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
784			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s records %s; branch %s is registered at %s",
785				tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
786		}
787	}

789	func annotateBoundTask(binding TaskBinding, checkout RepoCheckout) TaskBinding {
790		tracked := binding.Task
791		if tracked == nil {
792			return binding
793		}
794		if !checkoutActionable(checkout) {
795			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
796				Code: ReasonCheckoutUnavailable,
797				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout %s is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable",
798					checkout.Worktree.Path),
799			})
800		}
801		if checkout.Branch() != tracked.Branch {
802			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
803				Code: ReasonBranchMismatch,
804				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s; registered checkout is on %s",
805					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, displayBranch(checkout)),
806			})
807		}
808		mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
809		switch {
810		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && checkout.Worktree.Main:
811			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
812				Code:   ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
813				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("worktree task %s resolved to Git main", tracked.ID),
814			})
815		case mode != task.ModeWorktree && !checkout.Worktree.Main:
816			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
817				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
818				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s resolved to linked worktree %s",
819					mode, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
820			})
821		}
822		if mode != task.ModeWorktree && tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
823			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
824				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
825				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
826					mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
827			})
828		}
829		if !taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
830			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
831				Code: ReasonUnexpectedCheckout,
832				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s still has registered checkout %s",
833					tracked.State, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
834			})
835		}
836		return binding
837	}

839	func taskExpectsCheckout(tracked *task.Task) bool {
840		if tracked == nil || tracked.State == task.Cold {
841			return false
842		}
843		if tracked.State == task.Done && tracked.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
844			return tracked.WorktreePath != ""
845		}
846		return true
847	}

209	// Result is a value-safe execution ledger. It deliberately has no rollback
210	// field: completed effects remain completed and recovery describes the next
211	// safe action instead of claiming reversal.

226	// NewResult defensively copies a result specification.
227	func NewResult(spec ResultSpec) Result {
228		result := Result{
229			PartialSuccess:   spec.PartialSuccess,
230			Milestone:        spec.Milestone,
231			warnings:         append([]string(nil), spec.Warnings...),
232			recovery:         append([]string(nil), spec.Recovery...),
233			freshSnapshotRef: spec.FreshSnapshotRef,
234		}
235		result.steps = cloneSteps(spec.Steps)
236		if spec.Handoff != nil {
237			result.handoff = *spec.Handoff
238			result.hasHandoff = true
239		}
240		if spec.Remote != nil {
241			result.remote = spec.Remote.Clone()
242			result.hasRemote = true
243		}
244		if !result.PartialSuccess && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 && len(result.FailedSteps()) > 0 {
245			result.PartialSuccess = true
246		}
247		return result
248	}

250	// Clone returns a result with independent ledger and message slices.
251	func (r Result) Clone() Result {
252		r.steps = cloneSteps(r.steps)

254		r.recovery = append([]string(nil), r.recovery...)
255		return r

121	## Local and manual remote evidence
122	
123	Startup and `r` do not fetch or contact a forge. Network work happens only in a
124	confirmed action that declares it: Resume fetch, Park Cold + Push, Review
125	Handoff, or one of the `R` choices.
126	
127	`R` supplies three independent plan variants:
128	
129	- **Fetch Refs** runs `git fetch --prune` for the exact configured remote.
130	- **Query Review** asks the supported GitHub, GitLab, or Azure CLI for the exact
131	  head/base relationship without fetching.
132	- **Both** fetches first, then queries; if fetch fails, review is not attempted.
133	
134	Remote results live only for the current flow run. Ref evidence contains exact
135	named-ref OIDs or explicit absence/error. Portable review evidence contains only
136	existence, provider state (open/draft/merged/closed), draft flag, URL, provider,
137	and observation time. Unsupported providers, missing CLIs/extensions,
138	authentication/provider failures, malformed or multiple matches, and
139	not-yet-requested evidence stay UNKNOWN or ERROR. The flow does not query or
140	infer review decisions, approvals, comments, or checks.
141	
142	## Plan and Apply revalidation
143	
144	Planning is side-effect-free. A plan seals the task record revision and exact
145	repository, Git common directory, checkout path/branch/HEAD, refs, status,
146	runtime/agent occupancy, artifacts, remote identity, concrete options, and
147	ordered effects into an authority fingerprint and PlanID.
148	
149	Apply accepts only a plan produced by the current flow run and an approval bound
150	to that PlanID. It locks repository then task state, reloads the task revision,
151	re-observes authority, and rejects any difference before a new effect. Safety-
152	critical checks repeat after runtime closure and immediately before checkout or
153	branch removal. Task state is written last; retirement deletes the DONE record
154	last.
155	
156	Apply is not canceled by refresh, row switching, or quit. Conflicting navigation
157	is disabled, and quit/refresh waits for the result. The result ledger preserves

159	success means completed effects remain completed; no rollback is implied. A new

65		conditions := append([]Condition(nil), spec.Conditions...)
66		if err := validateConditions(conditions); err != nil {
67			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
68		}
69		effects := cloneEffects(spec.Effects)
70		if err := validateEffects(effects); err != nil {
71			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
72		}
73		authority := NewFields(spec.Authority)
74		if err := validateAuthority(authority); err != nil {
75			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
76		}
77	
78		plan := Plan{
79			Request: normalized.Clone(), Locator: normalized.Locator, Action: normalized.Action,
80			Source:       normalized.Locator.State,
81			Availability: AvailabilityFor(conditions), Confirmation: spec.Confirmation,
82			FallbackCommand: spec.FallbackCommand, Summary: spec.Summary, DisplayedAt: spec.DisplayedAt,
83			authority: authority, conditions: conditions, effects: effects,
84			retained: NewStringList(spec.RetainedResources...),
85		}
86		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
87			rule, transitionErr := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
88			if transitionErr != nil {
89				return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid transition", Cause: transitionErr}
90			}
91			plan.HasPersistedTransition = true
92			plan.Target = rule.Target
93			plan.StatePreserving = rule.StatePreserving
94			plan.RemovesTask = rule.RemovesTask
95			plan.ExpectedMilestone = rule.Milestone
96		} else {
97			switch plan.Action {
98			case Adopt:
99				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
100			case Reconcile:
101				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
102			}
103		}
104		plan.AuthorityFingerprint, plan.PlanID = computePlanIdentity(plan)
105		return plan.Clone(), nil
106	}

108	// Clone returns a plan with independent request, map, and slice storage.
109	func (p Plan) Clone() Plan {
110		p.Request = p.Request.Clone()
111		p.authority = p.authority.clone()
112		p.conditions = append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...)
113		p.effects = cloneEffects(p.effects)
114		p.retained = p.retained.clone()
115		return p
116	}
117	
118	// AuthorityFields returns a mutable copy of the extra authority identities.
119	func (p Plan) AuthorityFields() map[string]string { return p.authority.Map() }
120	
121	// Conditions returns the ordered conditions as a mutable copy.
122	func (p Plan) Conditions() []Condition { return append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...) }
123	
124	// Effects returns independent copies of the ordered effects.
125	func (p Plan) Effects() []Effect { return cloneEffects(p.effects) }
126	
127	// RetainedResources returns the resources intentionally left after Apply.
128	func (p Plan) RetainedResources() []string { return p.retained.Values() }
129	
130	// InputConditions returns required operator input without conflating it with a
131	// safety override.
132	func (p Plan) InputConditions() []Condition {
133		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
134			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict == VerdictNeedsInput
135		})
136	}
137	
138	// BlockingConditions returns every required, non-input condition that prevents
139	// READY. Advisory conditions are intentionally absent.
140	func (p Plan) BlockingConditions() []Condition {
141		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
142			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired &&
143				condition.Verdict != VerdictMet && condition.Verdict != VerdictNeedsInput
144		})
145	}
146	
147	// AdvisoryConditions returns non-authorizing evidence for display.
148	func (p Plan) AdvisoryConditions() []Condition {
149		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
150			return condition.Requirement == RequirementAdvisory
151		})
152	}
153	
154	// Validate proves that a plan is structurally consistent and still carries its
155	// original deterministic identity. It performs no live observations.
156	func (p Plan) Validate() error {
157		if p.PlanID == "" || p.AuthorityFingerprint == "" {
158			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan identity is missing"}
159		}
160		if !p.Action.Valid() {
161			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown action %q", p.Action)}
162		}
163		if p.Request.Action != p.Action {
164			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request action and plan action differ"}
165		}
166		if p.Request.Locator != p.Locator {
167			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request locator and plan locator differ"}
168		}
169		if p.Request.Options == nil {
170			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "normalized request options are missing"}
171		}
172		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(p.Request)
173		if err != nil {
174			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request is no longer valid", Cause: err}
175		}
176		if requestIdentity(normalized) != requestIdentity(p.Request) {
177			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request options are not normalized"}
178		}
179		if err := p.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
180			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
181		}
182		if err := validateConditions(p.conditions); err != nil {
183			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
184		}
185		if err := validateEffects(p.effects); err != nil {
186			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
187		}
188		if err := validateAuthority(p.authority); err != nil {
189			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
190		}
191		if err := validatePlanTransition(p); err != nil {
192			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "transition metadata is inconsistent", Cause: err}
193		}
194	
195		authorityFingerprint, planID := computePlanIdentity(p)
196		if authorityFingerprint != p.AuthorityFingerprint {
197			return &StalePlanError{
198				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
199				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
200				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
201				Reason:                       "authority fields, effects, or conditions changed",
202			}
203		}
204		if planID != p.PlanID {
205			return &StalePlanError{
206				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
207				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
208				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
209				Reason:                       "PlanID does not match its authority fingerprint",
210			}
211		}
212		if availability := AvailabilityFor(p.conditions); availability != p.Availability {
213			return &InvalidPlanError{
214				PlanID: p.PlanID,
215				Reason: fmt.Sprintf("availability is %s, want derived %s", p.Availability, availability),
216			}
217		}
218		return nil
219	}

221	// ValidateApproval binds affirmative approval and any typed token to this exact
222	// plan. It never changes plan readiness or condition verdicts.
223	func (p Plan) ValidateApproval(approval Approval) error {
224		if err := p.Validate(); err != nil {
225			return err
226		}
227		if !approval.Granted {
228			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "affirmative approval was not granted", Cause: ErrApprovalRequired}
229		}
230		if approval.PlanID != p.PlanID {
231			return &StalePlanError{
232				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: approval.PlanID,
233				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
234				Reason:                       "approval names a different plan",
235			}
236		}
237		if p.Confirmation.Kind == ConfirmationTyped {
238			if approval.Token != p.Confirmation.Token {
239				return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "typed confirmation token does not match", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
240			}
241		} else if approval.Token != "" {
242			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan does not accept a typed confirmation token", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
243		}
244		return nil
245	}

247	func validatePlanTransition(plan Plan) error {

256				return fmt.Errorf("plan does not match the transition table")
257			}
258			return nil
259		}
260		expectedMilestone := MilestoneNone

1	// Package retire coordinates destructive cleanup from outside the runtime and

17	// Options controls only fail-closed observations. Caller protection and active
18	// agent states are never bypassable.
19	type Options struct {
20		CWD               string
21		CallerWorkspaceID string
22		CallerPaneID      string
23		CloseUnknown      bool
24		AssumeNoRuntime   bool
25		PollInterval      time.Duration
26		Timeout           time.Duration
27	}

29	// Session is one runtime session that currently covers the target checkout.
30	type Session struct {
31		Runtime runtime.Session
32		Panes   []runtime.Pane
33		Mixed   []runtime.Pane
34	}
35	
36	// Inspection is a fresh view of every runtime surface covering a checkout.
37	type Inspection struct {
38		Target          string

40		ClosedSessions  int
41		Blockers        []string
42		RuntimeUnknown  bool
43		CallerContained bool
44	}
45	
46	// Ready reports whether destructive cleanup may proceed.
47	func (i Inspection) Ready() bool { return len(i.Blockers) == 0 }
48	
49	// Inspect discovers covering sessions and applies caller, mixed-workspace, and
50	// agent-state safety policy.
51	func Inspect(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
52		runtimeName := ""
53		if rt != nil {
54			runtimeName = rt.Name()
55		}
56		if opts.CallerWorkspaceID == "" && runtimeName != "tmux" && runtimeName != "zellij" && runtimeName != "none" {
57			opts.CallerWorkspaceID = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
58		}
59		if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
60			switch runtimeName {
61			case "herdr":
62				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
63			case "tmux":
64				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
65			case "zellij", "none":
66			default:
67				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
68				if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
69					opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
70				}
71			}
72		}
73		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, target, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
74			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyCleanup,
75			CallerWorkspaceID: opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
76			CallerPaneID:      opts.CallerPaneID,
77			CloseUnknown:      opts.CloseUnknown,
78		})
79		if err != nil {
80			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect retirement occupancy: %w", err)
81		}
82		result := Inspection{Target: evidence.Target}
83		cwd := opts.CWD
84		if cwd == "" {
85			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
86			if err != nil {
87				return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve caller directory: %w", err)
88			}
89		}

91			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("compare caller directory: %w", compareErr)
92		} else if inside {

133			}

135		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {

138			}
139			if agent.IsCaller {
140				result.CallerContained = true

142					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,

144				} else {

147				}

160	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
161	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
162	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
163		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
164		if err != nil {
165			return inspection, err
166		}
167		if !inspection.Ready() {
168			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
169		}
170		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
171			return inspection, nil
172		}
173		interval := opts.PollInterval
174		if interval <= 0 {
175			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
176		}
177		timeout := opts.Timeout
178		if timeout <= 0 {
179			timeout = 5 * time.Second
180		}
181		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
182		closed := make(map[string]bool)
183		for {
184			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
185			if inspectErr != nil {
186				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
187			}
188			if !fresh.Ready() {
189				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
190			}
191			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
192				inspection.Sessions = nil
193				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
194				return inspection, nil
195			}
196			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
197				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
198					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
199			}
200			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
201				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
202				if closed[handle] {
203					continue
204				}
205				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
206					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
207				}
208				closed[handle] = true
209				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
210			}
211			select {
212			case <-ctx.Done():
213				return inspection, ctx.Err()
214			case <-time.After(interval):
215			}
216		}
217	}
218	
219	func coveringAgentStatuses(panes []runtime.Pane, fallback string) []string {
220		set := make(map[string]bool)
221		for _, pane := range panes {
222			if pane.Agent != "" || pane.AgentSession != "" || pane.AgentStatus != "" {
223				set[strings.ToLower(pane.AgentStatus)] = true
224			}
225		}
226		if len(set) == 0 {
227			set[strings.ToLower(fallback)] = true
228		}
229		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
230		for status := range set {
231			out = append(out, status)
232		}
233		sort.Strings(out)
234		return out
235	}
236	
237	func appendAgentStatusBlocker(result *Inspection, handle, rawStatus string, closeUnknown bool) {
238		status := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawStatus))
239		switch status {
240		case "idle", "done":
241			// Eligible after all structural checks pass.
242		case "working", "running", "busy", "blocked", "waiting":
243			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
244				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has agent status %s", handle, status))
245		case "", "unknown":
246			if !closeUnknown {
247				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
248					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unknown agent status; pass --close-unknown from outside it", handle))
249			}
250		default:
251			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
252				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unrecognized agent status %s", handle, status))
253		}
254	}
255	
256	func dedupe(inspection Inspection) Inspection {
257		seen := make(map[string]bool)
258		out := inspection.Blockers[:0]
259		for _, blocker := range inspection.Blockers {
260			if !seen[blocker] {
261				seen[blocker] = true
262				out = append(out, blocker)
263			}
264		}
265		inspection.Blockers = out
266		return inspection
267	}

13	// locateExactTask builds a managed locator from one exact task record and a
14	// fresh view of its repository. Missing checkout evidence is retained as an
15	// expected path (or an intentionally empty COLD path) so Plan can explain the
16	// drift instead of losing the task before transition validation.
17	func (s *lifecycleService) locateExactTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
18		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
19			return Locator{}, err
20		}
21		if !exactTaskID.MatchString(taskID) || filepath.Base(taskID) != taskID || taskID == "." || taskID == ".." {
22			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID)
23		}
24	
25		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
28		}
29		candidate := record.Task
30		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
31			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q is invalid: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
32		}
33		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
34		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(candidate.State) {
35			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q has invalid mode or state", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID)
36		}
37	
38		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
41		}
42		repoPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
43		if err != nil {
44			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
45		}
46		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
49		}
50		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
51		if err != nil {
52			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
53		}
54		if recordedRepo != repoPath {
55			return Locator{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
56				"recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q",
57				candidate.RepoPath, recordedRepo, repoPath,
58			)}
59		}
60	
61		expectedCheckout := repoPath
62		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
63			expectedCheckout = ""
64			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
65				expectedCheckout, err = s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
66				if err != nil {
67					return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize expected checkout for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
68				}
69			}
70		}
71	
72		locator := Locator{
73			RepoKey:      commonDir,
74			RowKey:       taskID,
75			RowKind:      "task",
76			RepositoryID: commonDir,
77			GitCommonDir: commonDir,
78			TaskID:       taskID,
79			TaskRevision: record.Revision,
80			RepoPath:     repoPath,
81			CheckoutPath: expectedCheckout,
82			Branch:       candidate.Branch,
83			Base:         candidate.Base,
84			Remote:       "origin",
85			Mode:         mode,
86			State:        candidate.State,
87		}
88	
89		registered, found := s.locateRegisteredCheckout(ctx, candidate, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
90		if found {
91			locator.RowKey = registered.Path
92			locator.RowKind = "checkout"
93			locator.HeadOID = strings.TrimSpace(registered.Worktree.Head)
94			if status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, registered.Path); statusErr == nil {
95				locator.Upstream = status.Upstream
96				if head, headErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, registered.Path, "HEAD"); headErr == nil {
97					locator.HeadOID = head
98				}
99			}
100		}
101		if locator.HeadOID == "" {
102			locator.HeadOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, localBranchRef(candidate.Branch))
103		}
104		if locator.Upstream == "" && (!found || mode == task.ModeWorktree) {
105			locator.Upstream = s.branchUpstream(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Branch)
106		}
107		locator.BaseOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Base)
108		locator.UpstreamOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, locator.Upstream)
109	
110		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)
111		if err != nil {

114				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while locating",
115			}

118			return Locator{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while locating")
119		}

123	func (s *lifecycleService) locateRegisteredCheckout(
124		ctx context.Context,
125		candidate task.Task,
126		repoPath string,
127		expectedCheckout string,
128	) (gitx.RegisteredWorktree, bool) {
129		if expectedCheckout != "" {
130			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
131			return registered, err == nil
132		}
133		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree || candidate.State != task.Cold {
134			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
135		}
136	
137		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, repoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
140		}
141		match := ""
142		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
143			if worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch {
144				continue
145			}
146			if match != "" {
147				return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
148			}
149			match = worktree.Path
150		}
151		if match == "" {
152			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
153		}
154		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, match)
155		return registered, err == nil
156	}
157	
158	func (s *lifecycleService) branchUpstream(ctx context.Context, repoPath, branch string) string {
159		if branch == "" {
160			return ""
161		}
162		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath,
163			"for-each-ref", "--format=%(upstream:short)", localBranchRef(branch),
164		)
165		if err != nil {
166			return ""
167		}
168		return strings.TrimSpace(value)
169	}

```text
1	// Package gitx wraps the git porcelain commands dev depends on. Every helper
2	// shells out to git rather than linking a Go implementation: git is already a
3	// hard dependency, its porcelain formats are stable and documented, and this
4	// keeps dev's behaviour identical to what the user sees when they run the same
5	// command by hand.
6	package gitx
7	
8	import (
9		"bytes"
10		"context"
11		"errors"
12		"fmt"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16	)
17	
18	// ErrNotARepo is returned when a directory is not inside a git working tree.
19	var ErrNotARepo = errors.New("not a git repository")
20	
21	// Error carries the failing command and git's own stderr, which is almost
22	// always more useful than the exit status alone.
23	type Error struct {
24		Args   []string
25		Dir    string
26		Stderr string
27		Err    error
28	}
29	
30	func (e *Error) Error() string {
31		msg := strings.TrimSpace(e.Stderr)
32		if msg == "" {
33			msg = e.Err.Error()
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("git %s: %s", strings.Join(e.Args, " "), msg)
36	}
37	
38	func (e *Error) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
39	
40	// run executes git in dir and returns trimmed stdout.
41	func run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
42		return runEnv(ctx, dir, nil, args...)
43	}
44	
45	// runEnv executes git with task-scoped environment overrides. It is used for
46	// alternate-index analysis that must never touch the user's real index.
47	func runEnv(ctx context.Context, dir string, overrides []string, args ...string) (string, error) {
48		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than
49		// octal-escaped, which matters for the Chinese-named files in these repos.
50		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
51		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
52		cmd.Dir = dir
53		if len(overrides) > 0 {
54			keys := make(map[string]bool, len(overrides))
55			for _, override := range overrides {
56				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(override, "=")
57				keys[key] = true
58			}
59			env := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+len(overrides))
60			for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
61				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
62				if !keys[key] {
63					env = append(env, entry)
64				}
65			}
66			env = append(env, overrides...)
67			cmd.Env = env
68		}
69		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
70		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
71		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
72		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
73			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
74			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {
75				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", dir, ErrNotARepo)
76			}
77			return "", gerr
78		}
79		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
80	}
81	
82	// Run executes an arbitrary git command in dir. Exported for the few callers
83	// (park's wip commit, done's merge) that need a one-off command.
84	func Run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
85		return run(ctx, dir, args...)
86	}
87	
88	// lines splits git output into non-empty lines.
89	func lines(s string) []string {
90		if s == "" {
91			return nil
92		}
93		out := strings.Split(s, "\n")
94		filtered := out[:0]
95		for _, l := range out {
96			if l != "" {
97				filtered = append(filtered, l)
98			}
99		}
100		return filtered

1	---
2	description: Choose the owner and location of each worktree, then provision ignored files and dependencies safely.
3	authority: project
4	status: stable
5	verified_on: 2026-08-29
6	---
7	
8	# Worktrees and provisioning
9	
10	A Git worktree begins as a clean checkout. `dev` owns durable change-stream worktrees and builds an inspectable plan for the ignored files and dependencies needed to make them usable.
11	
12	## Choose one lifecycle owner
13	
14	| Worktree kind | Owner | Typical location | Lifetime |
15	|---|---|---|---|
16	| feature, fix, experiment, cross-machine handoff | `dev` | configured `paths.worktree_path` | until `dev done`, `dev wt rm`, or an approved sweep |
17	| harness-scoped isolation | Claude Code or another harness | harness-owned directory such as `.claude/worktrees/<name>/` | governed by that harness's retention and safe-cleanup rules |
18	| externally created linked worktree | external until adopted | tool-specific | visible to `dev`, unmanaged until explicit adoption |
19	
20	Use `dev` when code, history, or plans must remain reviewable or a human may return later. Do not nest a long-lived `dev` worktree inside a repository; file watchers, language servers, backup tools, and searches in the outer checkout would see a second copy of the tree.
21	
22	`dev` creates the checkout with Git at its configured path. Herdr only opens that existing path, so worktree placement remains identical on machines without Herdr.
23	
24	## Inspect before creating
25	
26	```bash
27	dev wt plan
28	dev wt plan --write          # seed repository-owned .dev-cli/config.toml
29	dev wt create feat/auth --base main
30	dev wt list
31	```
32	
33	`dev wt plan` reads lockfiles, tool availability, configured include/link rules, and Git ignore state without changing the checkout. The resulting plan shows every runnable or skipped step and any safety downgrade.
34	
35	## Carry ignored files by allowlist
36	
37	```toml
38	[worktree]
39	include = [".env", ".env.local", "config/local.json"]
40	link = []
41	post_create = "auto"
42	strategy = "reinstall"
43	```
44	
45	Only paths that are both listed and confirmed by Git as ignored are copied. A tracked file already arrives through the branch; copying a different checkout's version over it would violate branch isolation.
46	
47	Included files are copied as files, not logged. Current provisioning also rechecks the source and destination path shape while opening/copying so source swaps and symlinked destination parents are refused.
48	
49	Do not add `.claude/settings.local.json` globally. Include that exact file only for a deliberately chosen launcher whose behavior depends on it, and verify the copy in the plan.
50	
51	## Select dependency strategy by correctness
52	
53	| Strategy | Effect | Guidance |
54	|---|---|---|
55	| `reinstall` | run the lockfile-derived install command | safe default |
```
</details></tool-use>

155	In `stage` mode, dev best-effort writes `LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT` in the exact

160	This is an implementation-detail adapter, not `commit.template`.
161	
162	Staging is the durable outcome: if the optional lazygit draft cannot be
163	written, dev emits a warning and retains the staged index instead of rolling it
164	back.
165	
166	Staged setup cannot create an upstream, and `handoff=start` requires committed
167	setup because a new worktree would omit the staged files. `stay`, `cd`, and
168	`open` remain available for review. `repo setup --commit` is retained as a
169	compatibility alias for `--check-in=commit`; `--message` applies to both commit
