171	`staged_paths`, `commit_message`, `commit_draft_provider`, and a content-free
172	`template` summary where applicable.
173	
174	### Upstream publishing
175	
176	Before offering publication, dev probes `gh` and `glab` without changing
177	state. A provider is offered only when its CLI is installed and authenticated;
178	otherwise the wizard gives the relevant installation or login guidance.
179	Local-only is the default, and a newly published repository defaults private.
180	
181	Publishing uses the local repository name and configured description, then asks
182	for the provider namespace/owner, visibility, and whether to push the
183	initial/current branch. Dev creates the empty GitHub or GitLab repository after
184	required local setup and commit steps succeed, then adds/verifies `origin` and
185	optionally pushes with upstream tracking. A
186	provider, name-conflict, or push failure never deletes the local checkout or
187	an upstream that was already created.
188	
189	Publishing from `repo setup` requires `--check-in=commit` (or the compatible
190	`--commit` flag), so the newly created upstream cannot omit the generated setup
191	changes. `--check-in=stage` is incompatible with any new upstream; for a new
192	repository, `none` may create an intentionally empty upstream only with
193	`--push=false`.
194	
195	### Handoff
196	
197	`stay` prints the result only. `cd` uses the trusted `shell-init` wrapper to
198	change the parent shell. `open` opens the configured Herdr/tmux/Zellij runtime
199	and falls back to `cd` when runtime is `none`. `start` continues into the
200	existing task wizard with the repository fixed, and is unavailable when setup
201	leaves uncommitted files that a new worktree would omit. Neither repository
202	bootstrap nor a default `dev start` launches a coding agent. Explicit
203	worktree-mode `dev start --run '<shell command>'` dispatches one command only
204	when a newly created first-class Herdr worktree returns its exact root pane;
205	`--focus` independently controls navigation afterward.
206	
207	All shared TTY text fields in the repository, task-start, and finish wizards
208	use an inline editor: Left/Right, Home/End, Delete/Backspace, insertion at the
209	cursor, and Esc/Ctrl-C cancellation work as terminal actions rather than being
210	inserted as raw escape bytes. Buffered and piped non-TTY input retains its
211	line-oriented behavior.
212	
213	## `dev done` finish flags
214	
215	`dev done` for branch/worktree tasks integrates through exactly one of `--ff` (rebase onto the base, then fast-forward it) or `--pr` (push and open a pull/merge request). Omitting both opens the interactive finish wizard on a TTY — see [Change-stream workflow](../guides/change-stream-workflow.md) for the prompts.
216	
217	A dirty checkout is handled by `--dirty <auto|fail|commit|discard>` (default `auto`):
218	
219	| Value | Behavior |
220	|---|---|
221	| `auto` | interactive: prompts to commit or discard; non-interactive: fails, same as `fail` |
222	| `fail` | refuses to finish with a dirty checkout |
223	| `commit` | commits everything with `--message`/`-m` (prompted interactively if omitted) |
224	| `discard` | resets tracked changes and removes untracked files; destructive, requires `--yes` outside a TTY |
225	
226	`--yes`/`-y` confirms the selected finish plan; it is mandatory for a non-interactive `--dirty discard` and otherwise skips the interactive confirmation step. `--keep-worktree` keeps the worktree after `--ff` integration (default: removed once merged), `--push` also pushes the resulting branch, and `--delete-branch` deletes the branch once its commits are contained in the base — never a branch with unpushed commits.

228	## Configuration

230	```bash
231	dev config init
232	dev config show
233	dev config path
234	dev config scaffolds init
```

65	// EquivalentDirty counts dirty paths whose index and worktree snapshots both
66	// agree with the base.
67	func (a FinishAnalysis) EquivalentDirty() int {
68		return len(a.Changes) - a.UniqueDirty()
69	}
70	
71	// AnalyzeFinish compares both committed history and every uncommitted layer
72	// without changing the real index. The alternate index models the exact tree
73	// produced by `git add -A`, including untracked files but excluding ignored
74	// files according to Git's normal rules.
75	func AnalyzeFinish(ctx context.Context, dir, base, branch string) (FinishAnalysis, error) {
76		relation, err := compareBranches(ctx, dir, base, branch)
77		if err != nil {
78			return FinishAnalysis{}, err
79		}
80		changes, status, rawStatus, err := finishDirtyPaths(ctx, dir)
81		if err != nil {
82			return FinishAnalysis{}, err
83		}
84		analysis := FinishAnalysis{Status: status, Relation: relation, Changes: changes}
85		if status.Conflicted > 0 {
86			analysis.Fingerprint = finishFingerprint(rawStatus, "conflicted", "conflicted")
87			return analysis, nil
88		}
89	
90		indexTree, worktreeTree, indexDiff, worktreeDiff, err := finishTrees(ctx, dir, base)
91		if err != nil {
92			return FinishAnalysis{}, err
93		}
94		for i := range analysis.Changes {
95			change := &analysis.Changes[i]
96			unique := worktreeDiff[change.Path]
97			if change.Staged {
98				unique = unique || indexDiff[change.Path]
99			}
100			if change.OldPath != "" {
101				unique = unique || worktreeDiff[change.OldPath]
102				if change.Staged {
103					unique = unique || indexDiff[change.OldPath]
104				}
105			}
106			change.BaseEquivalent = !unique
107		}
108		analysis.Fingerprint = finishFingerprint(rawStatus, indexTree, worktreeTree)
109		return analysis, nil
110	}
111	
112	func compareBranches(ctx context.Context, dir, base, branch string) (BranchRelation, error) {
113		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-list", "--left-right", "--count", base+"..."+branch)
114		if err != nil {
115			return BranchRelation{}, err
116		}
117		fields := strings.Fields(out)
118		if len(fields) != 2 {
119			return BranchRelation{}, fmt.Errorf("git rev-list returned %q, want two counts", out)
120		}
121		baseOnly, err := strconv.Atoi(fields[0])
122		if err != nil {
123			return BranchRelation{}, fmt.Errorf("parse base-only count %q: %w", fields[0], err)
124		}
125		branchOnly, err := strconv.Atoi(fields[1])
126		if err != nil {
127			return BranchRelation{}, fmt.Errorf("parse branch-only count %q: %w", fields[1], err)
128		}
129		return BranchRelation{BaseOnly: baseOnly, BranchOnly: branchOnly}, nil
130	}

132	func finishDirtyPaths(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]DirtyPath, Status, string, error) {
133		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=all", "-z")
134		if err != nil {
135			return nil, Status{}, "", err
136		}
137		records := nulLines(out)
138		changes := make([]DirtyPath, 0, len(records))
139		for i := 0; i < len(records); i++ {
140			rec := records[i]
141			if rec == "" {
142				continue
143			}
144			var change DirtyPath
145			switch rec[0] {
146			case '1', '2':
147				fields := strings.Fields(rec)
148				if len(fields) < 2 || len(fields[1]) < 2 {
149					continue
150				}
151				change.Path = statusPath(rec)
152				change.Staged = fields[1][0] != '.'
153				change.Unstaged = fields[1][1] != '.'
154				if rec[0] == '2' && i+1 < len(records) {
155					i++
156					change.OldPath = records[i]
157				}
158			case 'u':
159				change.Path, change.Conflicted = statusPath(rec), true
160			case '?':
161				change.Path = strings.TrimPrefix(rec, "? ")
162				change.Untracked = true
163			default:
164				continue
165			}
166			if change.Path != "" {
167				changes = append(changes, change)
168			}
169		}
170		sort.Slice(changes, func(i, j int) bool { return changes[i].DisplayPath() < changes[j].DisplayPath() })
171		return changes, statusFromOutput(dir, out), out, nil
172	}
173	
174	func finishTrees(ctx context.Context, dir, base string) (string, string, map[string]bool, map[string]bool, error) {
175		tempDir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "dev-finish-index-*")
176		if err != nil {
177			return "", "", nil, nil, err
178		}
179		defer os.RemoveAll(tempDir)
180		objectDir := filepath.Join(tempDir, "objects")
181		if err := os.MkdirAll(objectDir, 0o755); err != nil {
182			return "", "", nil, nil, err
183		}
184		commonDir, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
185		if err != nil {
186			return "", "", nil, nil, err
187		}
188		if !filepath.IsAbs(commonDir) {
189			commonDir = filepath.Join(dir, commonDir)
190		}
191		repoObjects := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(commonDir, "objects"))
192		alternates := repoObjects
193		if inherited := os.Getenv("GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES"); inherited != "" {
194			alternates += string(os.PathListSeparator) + inherited
195		}
196		objectEnv := []string{
197			"GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY=" + objectDir,
198			"GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES=" + alternates,
199		}
200		indexSource, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "index")
201		if err != nil {
202			return "", "", nil, nil, err
203		}
204		if !filepath.IsAbs(indexSource) {
205			indexSource = filepath.Join(dir, indexSource)
206		}
207		indexBytes, err := os.ReadFile(indexSource)
208		if err != nil {
209			return "", "", nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read index snapshot: %w", err)
210		}
211		index := filepath.Join(tempDir, "index")
212		if err := os.WriteFile(index, indexBytes, 0o600); err != nil {
213			return "", "", nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("copy index snapshot: %w", err)
214		}
215		env := append(append([]string(nil), objectEnv...), "GIT_INDEX_FILE="+index)
216		indexTree, err := runEnv(ctx, dir, env, "write-tree")
217		if err != nil {
218			return "", "", nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("snapshot index: %w", err)
219		}
220		indexDiff, err := treeDiffPaths(ctx, dir, env, base, indexTree)
221		if err != nil {
222			return "", "", nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare index snapshot: %w", err)
223		}
224	
225		if _, err := runEnv(ctx, dir, env, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
226			return "", "", nil, nil, err
227		}
228		worktreeTree, err := runEnv(ctx, dir, env, "write-tree")
229		if err != nil {
230			return "", "", nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("snapshot worktree: %w", err)
231		}
232		worktreeDiff, err := treeDiffPaths(ctx, dir, env, base, worktreeTree)
233		if err != nil {
234			return "", "", nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare worktree snapshot: %w", err)
235		}
236		return indexTree, worktreeTree, indexDiff, worktreeDiff, nil
237	}
238	
239	func treeDiffPaths(ctx context.Context, dir string, env []string, base, tree string) (map[string]bool, error) {
240		out, err := runEnv(ctx, dir, env, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", "-z", base, tree)
241		if err != nil {
242			return nil, err
243		}
244		paths := make(map[string]bool)
245		for _, path := range nulLines(out) {
246			if path != "" {
247				paths[path] = true
248			}
249		}
250		return paths, nil
251	}
252	
253	func finishFingerprint(status, indexTree, worktreeTree string) string {
254		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(status + "\x00" + indexTree + "\x00" + worktreeTree))
255		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
256	}
257	
258	// CommitAllChanges creates a normal user commit, preserving configured hooks.
259	func CommitAllChanges(ctx context.Context, dir, message string) error {
260		if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
261			return errors.New("commit message is required")
262		}
263		if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "add", "--all"); err != nil {
264			return err
265		}
266		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "commit", "-m", message)
267		return err
268	}
269	
270	// DiscardAllChanges restores tracked/index state and removes non-ignored
271	// untracked files. Callers must obtain explicit destructive confirmation.
272	func DiscardAllChanges(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {
273		if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "reset", "--hard", "HEAD"); err != nil {
274			return err
275		}
276		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "clean", "-fd")
277		return err
278	}

91	func (s *lifecycleService) observeIntegrationFacts(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
92		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
93			observed.integration = completionIntegrationObservation{
94				worktree: observed.worktree, worktreeFound: observed.worktreeFound, worktreeErr: observed.worktreeErr,
95				status: observed.status, statusErr: observed.statusErr,
96				head: observed.head, headErr: observed.headErr,
97				operation: observed.operation, inProgress: observed.inProgress, operationErr: observed.operationErr,
98			}
99			return
100		}
101	
102		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
103		observed.integration.worktree, observed.integration.worktreeErr = registered, err
104		if err != nil {
105			return
106		}
107		observed.integration.worktreeFound = true
108		observed.integration.status, observed.integration.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
109		if observed.integration.statusErr != nil {
110			return
111		}
112		observed.integration.head, observed.integration.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
113		observed.integration.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.integration.head)
114		observed.integration.operation, observed.integration.inProgress, observed.integration.operationErr =
115			s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
116	}

301	func (s *lifecycleService) completionConditions(
302		observed lifecycleObservation,
303		dirty DirtyPolicy,
304		message string,
305	) []Condition {
306		conditions := []Condition{
307			condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
308				"task "+observed.task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision, ""),
309			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
310				"Git common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
311		}
312		conditions = append(conditions, completionCheckoutConditions(observed)...)
313		conditions = append(conditions, completionGitConditions(observed, dirty, message)...)
314		conditions = append(conditions, completionArtifactCondition(observed))
315		conditions = append(conditions, s.completionRuntimeConditions(observed)...)
316		conditions = append(conditions, completionBaseCondition(observed))
317		return conditions
318	}

320	func completionCheckoutConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() {
322			verdict := VerdictBlocked
323			evidence := "the exact task checkout is not registered"
324			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !isWorktreeNotFound(observed.worktreeErr) {
325				verdict = VerdictError
326				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
327			}
328			return []Condition{
329				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "resume or reconcile the exact checkout"),
330				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout identity is unavailable", "refresh worktree topology"),
331				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unavailable", "refresh worktree topology"),
332				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout branch is unavailable", "restore the named task branch"),
333			}
334		}
335	
336		exactVerdict, exactEvidence := checkoutExactVerdict(observed)
337		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
338		kindEvidence := "canonical main checkout"
339		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
340			kindEvidence = "exact linked worktree"
341			if !observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
342				kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
343				kindEvidence = "worktree task does not resolve to a linked checkout"
344			}
345		} else if !observed.worktree.Worktree.Main || observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare {
346			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
347			kindEvidence = "branch or direct task does not resolve to Git's canonical main checkout"
348		}
349	
350		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
351		branchEvidence := "checkout and registry name task branch " + observed.task.Branch
352		if observed.task.Branch == "" || observed.statusErr != nil || observed.status.Detached ||
353			observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached ||
354			observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
355			branchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
356			branchEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q expected=%q detached=%t",
357				observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.task.Branch,
358				observed.status.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached)
359			if observed.statusErr != nil {
360				branchVerdict = VerdictError
361				branchEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
362			}
363		}
364		return []Condition{
365			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
366			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "reconcile task and worktree identity"),
367			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "reconcile the task checkout mode"),
368			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named task branch"),
369		}
370	}

372	func completionGitConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) []Condition {
373		status := observed.status
374		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
375		statusEvidence := status.Summary()
376		if observed.statusErr != nil {
377			statusVerdict = VerdictError
378			statusEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
379		}
380	
381		finishVerdict := VerdictMet
382		finishEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("fingerprint %s; base-only=%d branch-only=%d",
383			observed.finish.Fingerprint, observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly, observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly)
384		switch {
385		case !observed.hasCheckout():
386			finishVerdict = VerdictUnknown
387			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires the exact checkout"
388		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
389			finishVerdict = VerdictBlocked
390			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires an explicit base ref"
391		case observed.finishErr != nil:
392			finishVerdict = VerdictError
393			finishEvidence = observed.finishErr.Error()
394		case observed.finish.Fingerprint == "":
395			finishVerdict = VerdictError
396			finishEvidence = "finish analysis returned no content fingerprint"
397		}
398	
399		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
400		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
401		if observed.operationErr != nil {
402			operationVerdict = VerdictError
403			operationEvidence = observed.operationErr.Error()
404		} else if observed.inProgress {
405			operationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
406			operationEvidence = "Git operation " + observed.operation + " is in progress"
407		}
408	
409		conflictVerdict := VerdictMet
410		conflictEvidence := "no unmerged paths"
411		if observed.statusErr != nil {
412			conflictVerdict = VerdictError
413			conflictEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
414		} else if observed.status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
415			conflictVerdict = VerdictBlocked
416			conflictEvidence = strconv.Itoa(max(observed.status.Conflicted, observed.finish.Status.Conflicted)) + " conflicted path(s)"
417		}
418	
419		cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence := completionDirtyCondition(observed, dirty, message)
420		return []Condition{
421			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
422			condition(ConditionFinishAnalysis, finishVerdict, RequirementRequired, finishEvidence, "refresh the exact finish analysis"),
423			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
424			condition(ConditionGitConflict, conflictVerdict, RequirementRequired, conflictEvidence, "resolve or abort conflicts before completion"),
425			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementRequired, cleanEvidence, "select fail, commit with a message, or discard"),
426		}

429	func completionDirtyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) (Verdict, string) {
430		if observed.statusErr != nil {
431			return VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
432		}
433		if !observed.status.Dirty() {
434			return VerdictMet, "checkout is clean; dirty policy " + string(dirty) + " causes no content mutation"
435		}
436		evidence := observed.status.Breakdown()
437		if observed.finishErr == nil {
438			evidence += fmt.Sprintf("; %d path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
439				observed.finish.EquivalentDirty(), observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.UniqueDirty())
440		}
441		switch dirty {
442		case DirtyAuto:
443			return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; choose an explicit dirty policy"
444		case DirtyFail:
445			return VerdictBlocked, evidence + "; fail policy refuses dirty completion"
446		case DirtyCommit:
447			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
448				return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; commit-all requires a nonempty message"
449			}
450			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; commit-all was explicitly selected"
451		case DirtyDiscard:
452			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
453				return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires DROP"
454			}
455			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires approval"
456		default:
457			return VerdictError, "unknown dirty policy " + string(dirty)
458		}
459	}

461	func completionArtifactCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
462		switch {
463		case !observed.hasCheckout():
464			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
465				"artifact readiness requires the exact checkout", "restore the checkout")
466		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
467			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
468				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
469		case observed.artifact.Ready():
470			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, artifactEvidence(observed), "")
471		default:
472			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
473				artifactEvidence(observed), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
474		}
475	}

479			return []Condition{

481					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),

483					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair recognized-agent observation"),
484			}
485		}
486		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
487		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + runtimeName(observed.runtime) + " was available for strict inspection"
488		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
489			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked

491		}
492		occupancyVerdict, occupancyEvidence := s.completionOccupancyVerdict(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr)
493		return []Condition{
494			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired,
495				availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
496			condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired,
497				occupancyEvidence, "stop every other recognized agent or use another checkout"),
498		}

501	func (s *lifecycleService) completionOccupancyVerdict(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) (Verdict, string) {
502		occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(occupancy, err)
503		if occupancyErr == nil {
504			if s.allowSharedCheckout {
505				return VerdictMet, "shared-checkout override accepts the freshly observed agent occupancy"
506			}
507			return VerdictMet, "no other recognized agent occupies the checkout; only the exact caller pane is excluded"
508		}
509		verdict := VerdictBlocked
510		if err != nil || occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil || occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil ||
511			occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil || occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
512			verdict = VerdictError
513		}
514		return verdict, occupancyErr.Error()
515	}

538	func completionIntegrationCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) Condition {
539		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
540			verdict, _ := completionDirtyCondition(observed, dirty, message)
541			if verdict == VerdictMet {
542				return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
543					"the exact canonical task checkout will be clean before switching to "+observed.completionBaseRef, "")
544			}
545			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, verdict, RequirementRequired,
546				"the canonical task checkout is not yet switchable", "finalize its dirty policy")
547		}
548		integration := observed.integration
549		switch {
550		case integration.worktreeErr != nil:
551			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
552				integration.worktreeErr.Error(), "repair canonical main worktree identity")
553		case !integration.worktreeFound:
554			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
555				"canonical main checkout is not registered", "restore the canonical main checkout")
556		case integration.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath || integration.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
557			!integration.worktree.Worktree.Main || integration.worktree.Worktree.Bare:
558			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
559				"integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout", "repair worktree topology")
560		case integration.statusErr != nil:
561			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
562				integration.statusErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout status observation")
563		case integration.headErr != nil:
564			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
565				integration.headErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout HEAD observation")
566		case integration.operationErr != nil:
567			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
568				integration.operationErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout Git-operation observation")
569		case integration.inProgress:
570			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
571				"canonical checkout has Git operation "+integration.operation+" in progress", "finish or abort it")
572		case integration.status.Conflicted > 0:
573			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
574				fmt.Sprintf("canonical checkout has %d conflicted path(s)", integration.status.Conflicted), "resolve or abort conflicts")
575		case integration.status.Dirty():
576			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
577				"canonical checkout is dirty: "+integration.status.Breakdown(), "preserve its unrelated bytes before integration")
578		case integration.worktree.Worktree.Head != integration.head:
579			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
580				"canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD", "refresh worktree topology")
581		default:
582			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
583				"canonical main checkout is exact, clean, conflict-free, and switchable", "")
584		}
585	}

650	func (s *lifecycleService) completionDirtyEffects(
651		observed lifecycleObservation,
652		dirty DirtyPolicy,
653		message string,
654	) []Effect {
655		if observed.statusErr != nil || !observed.status.Dirty() {
656			return nil
657		}
658		switch dirty {
659		case DirtyCommit:
660			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
661				return nil
662			}
663			return []Effect{NewEffect(
664				EffectCommitAll, "commit every staged, unstaged, and untracked change", observed.checkout, false, false,
665				map[string]string{"message": strings.TrimSpace(message), "scope": "all"},
666			)}
667		case DirtyDiscard:
668			details := map[string]string{"scope": "all", "finish-fingerprint": observed.finish.Fingerprint}
669			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
670				details["token"] = "DROP"
671			}
672			return []Effect{NewEffect(
673				EffectDiscardAll, "discard every staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked change", observed.checkout, true, false,
674				details,
675			)}
676		default:
677			return nil
678		}
679	}

743	func completionFallback(id, mode string, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string, push bool, baseRef, squash string) string {
744		parts := []string{"dev", "done", shellQuote(id)}
745		if mode != "" {
746			parts = append(parts, mode)
747		}
748		if dirty != DirtyAuto {
749			parts = append(parts, "--dirty="+string(dirty))
750		}
751		if dirty == DirtyCommit && strings.TrimSpace(message) != "" {
752			parts = append(parts, "--message", shellQuote(strings.TrimSpace(message)))
753		}
754		if baseRef != "" {
755			parts = append(parts, "--base-ref", shellQuote(baseRef))
756		}
757		if squash != "" {
758			parts = append(parts, "--confirm-squash", shellQuote(squash))
759		}
760		if push {
761			parts = append(parts, "--push")
762		}
763		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
764	}

766	func gitIsAncestor(ctx context.Context, dir, ancestor, descendant string) (bool, error) {
767		_, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", ancestor, descendant)
768		if err == nil {
769			return true, nil
770		}
771		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
772		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 {
773			return false, nil
774		}
775		return false, err
776	}

11	// DirtyPolicy is the explicitly selected treatment of checkout changes during
12	// completion planning.
13	type DirtyPolicy string
14	
15	const (
16		DirtyAuto    DirtyPolicy = "auto"
17		DirtyFail    DirtyPolicy = "fail"
18		DirtyCommit  DirtyPolicy = "commit"
19		DirtyDiscard DirtyPolicy = "discard"
20	)
21	
22	func normalizeDirty(policy DirtyPolicy) DirtyPolicy {
23		if policy == "" {
24			return DirtyAuto
25		}
26		return policy
27	}
28	
29	func validateDirty(policy DirtyPolicy, message string) error {
30		policy = normalizeDirty(policy)
31		switch policy {
32		case DirtyAuto, DirtyFail, DirtyCommit, DirtyDiscard:
33		default:
34			return fmt.Errorf("unknown dirty policy %q", policy)
35		}
36		if message != "" && policy != DirtyAuto && policy != DirtyCommit {
37			return fmt.Errorf("commit message requires dirty policy auto or commit")
38		}
39		return nil
40	}

203	func (ReconcileOptions) Action() Action   { return Reconcile }
204	func (ReconcileOptions) isActionOptions() {}
205	
206	// Request binds one action and its typed options to an exact selected locator.
207	// DisplayedAt may be used by a caller but does not contribute to plan identity.
208	type Request struct {
209		Locator     Locator
210		Action      Action
211		Options     ActionOptions
212		DisplayedAt time.Time
213	}
214	
215	// NewRequest infers the action from options and returns a normalized value.
216	func NewRequest(locator Locator, options ActionOptions) (Request, error) {
217		if options == nil {
218			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action options are required", ErrInvalidRequest)
219		}
220		normalized, err := cloneActionOptions(options, "")
221		if err != nil {
222			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
223		}
224		request := Request{Locator: locator, Action: normalized.Action(), Options: normalized}
225		return normalizeRequest(request)
226	}
227	
228	// Clone returns a request whose option-owned collection values are independent.
229	func (r Request) Clone() Request {
230		options, err := cloneActionOptions(r.Options, r.Action)
231		if err == nil {
232			r.Options = options
233		}
234		return r
235	}
236	
237	// Validate checks option/action agreement and graph legality without performing
238	// observations or side effects.
239	func (r Request) Validate() error {
240		_, err := normalizeRequest(r)
241		return err
242	}
243	
244	func normalizeRequest(request Request) (Request, error) {
245		if !request.Action.Valid() {
246			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown action %q", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action)
247		}
248		options, err := cloneActionOptions(request.Options, request.Action)
249		if err != nil {
250			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
251		}
252		if options.Action() != request.Action {
253			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action %s cannot use %s options", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, options.Action())
254		}
255		if err := validateActionOptions(options); err != nil {
256			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, err)
257		}
258		request.Options = options
259		if isTransitionAction(request.Action) {
260			if _, err := RequireTransition(request.Locator.Mode, request.Locator.State, request.Action); err != nil {
261				return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
262			}
263		}
264		return request, nil
265	}
266	
267	func cloneActionOptions(options ActionOptions, action Action) (ActionOptions, error) {
268		if options == nil {
269			return defaultActionOptions(action)
270		}
271		switch value := options.(type) {
272		case ParkWarmOptions:
273			return value, nil
274		case *ParkWarmOptions:
275			if value == nil {
276				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil park-warm options")
277			}
278			return *value, nil
279		case ParkColdOptions:
280			return value, nil
281		case *ParkColdOptions:
282			if value == nil {
283				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil park-cold options")
284			}
285			return *value, nil
286		case ResumeOptions:
287			return value, nil
288		case *ResumeOptions:
289			if value == nil {
290				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil resume options")
291			}
292			return *value, nil
293		case CompleteDirectOptions:
294			value.Dirty = normalizeDirty(value.Dirty)
295			return value, nil
296		case *CompleteDirectOptions:
297			if value == nil {
298				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil complete-direct options")
299			}
300			copy := *value
301			copy.Dirty = normalizeDirty(copy.Dirty)
302			return copy, nil
303		case CompleteFFOptions:
304			value.Dirty = normalizeDirty(value.Dirty)
305			return value, nil
306		case *CompleteFFOptions:
307			if value == nil {
308				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil complete-ff options")
309			}
310			copy := *value
311			copy.Dirty = normalizeDirty(copy.Dirty)
312			return copy, nil
313		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
314			value.Dirty = normalizeDirty(value.Dirty)
315			return value, nil
316		case *ReviewHandoffOptions:
317			if value == nil {
318				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil review-handoff options")
319			}
320			copy := *value
321			copy.Dirty = normalizeDirty(copy.Dirty)
322			return copy, nil
323		case VerifyMergedOptions:
324			value.Dirty = normalizeDirty(value.Dirty)
325			return value, nil
326		case *VerifyMergedOptions:
327			if value == nil {
328				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil verify-merged options")
329			}
330			copy := *value
331			copy.Dirty = normalizeDirty(copy.Dirty)
332			return copy, nil
333		case RetireOptions:
334			return value, nil
335		case *RetireOptions:
336			if value == nil {
337				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil retire options")
338			}
339			return *value, nil
340		case AdoptOptions:
341			value.Tags = value.Tags.clone()
342			return value, nil
343		case *AdoptOptions:
344			if value == nil {
345				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil adopt options")
346			}
347			copy := *value
348			copy.Tags = copy.Tags.clone()
349			return copy, nil
350		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
351			return value, nil
352		case *RemoveCheckoutOptions:
353			if value == nil {
354				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil remove-checkout options")
355			}
356			return *value, nil
357		case RefreshRemoteOptions:
358			return value, nil
359		case *RefreshRemoteOptions:
360			if value == nil {
361				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil refresh-remote options")
362			}
363			return *value, nil
364		case ReconcileOptions:
365			value.Parameters = value.Parameters.clone()
366			return value, nil
367		case *ReconcileOptions:
368			if value == nil {
369				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil reconcile options")
370			}
371			copy := *value
372			copy.Parameters = copy.Parameters.clone()
373			return copy, nil
374		default:
375			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported options type %T", options)
376		}
377	}

379	func defaultActionOptions(action Action) (ActionOptions, error) {
380		switch action {
381		case ParkWarm:
382			return ParkWarmOptions{}, nil
383		case ParkCold:
384			return ParkColdOptions{}, nil
385		case Resume:
386			return ResumeOptions{}, nil
387		case CompleteDirect:
388			return CompleteDirectOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
389		case CompleteFF:
390			return CompleteFFOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
391		case ReviewHandoff:
392			return ReviewHandoffOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
393		case VerifyMerged:
394			return VerifyMergedOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
395		case Retire:
396			return RetireOptions{}, nil
397		case Adopt:
398			return AdoptOptions{}, nil
399		case RemoveCheckout:
400			return RemoveCheckoutOptions{}, nil
401		case RefreshRemote:
402			return RefreshRemoteOptions{}, nil
403		case Reconcile:
404			return ReconcileOptions{}, nil
405		default:
406			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown action %q", action)
407		}
408	}
409	
410	func validateActionOptions(options ActionOptions) error {
411		switch value := options.(type) {
412		case ParkWarmOptions:
413			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
414		case ParkColdOptions:
415			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
416		case ResumeOptions:
417			return nil
418		case CompleteDirectOptions:
419			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
420		case CompleteFFOptions:
421			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
422		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
423			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
424		case VerifyMergedOptions:
425			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
426		case RetireOptions:
427			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
428		case AdoptOptions:
429			if value.Mode != "" && value.Mode != task.ModeWorktree {
430				return fmt.Errorf("adopted checkout mode must be empty or %q, got %q", task.ModeWorktree, value.Mode)
431			}
432			if value.State != "" && !validState(value.State) {
433				return fmt.Errorf("unknown adopted task state %q", value.State)
434			}
435			if value.Base != strings.TrimSpace(value.Base) || strings.ContainsRune(value.Base, '\x00') {
436				return fmt.Errorf("adopted base must be normalized")
437			}
438			return nil
439		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
440			if err := validateTimeout(value.Timeout); err != nil {
441				return err
442			}
443			if value.DeleteContainedBranch && !value.RequireContained {
444				return fmt.Errorf("contained branch deletion requires containment proof")
445			}
446			if value.RequireContained {
447				if value.ContainmentBase == "" || value.ContainmentBase != strings.TrimSpace(value.ContainmentBase) ||
448					strings.ContainsRune(value.ContainmentBase, '\x00') {
449					return fmt.Errorf("containment base must be a normalized nonempty branch")
450				}
451			} else if value.ContainmentBase != "" {
452				return fmt.Errorf("containment base requires containment proof")
453			}
454			return nil
455		case RefreshRemoteOptions:
456			if !value.FetchRefs && !value.QueryReview {
457				return fmt.Errorf("select fetch refs, query review, or both")
458			}
459			return nil
460		case ReconcileOptions:
461			if strings.TrimSpace(value.Name) == "" {
462				return fmt.Errorf("a named reconciliation is required")
463			}
464			if value.Name != strings.TrimSpace(value.Name) {
465				return fmt.Errorf("reconciliation name must be normalized")
466			}
467			return nil
468		default:
469			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported options type %T", options)
470		}
471	}
472	
473	func validateTimeout(timeout time.Duration) error {
474		if timeout < 0 {
475			return fmt.Errorf("timeout cannot be negative")
476		}
477		return nil
478	}

480	func appendOptionsIdentity(writer *identityWriter, options ActionOptions) {
481		writer.addString("options.action", string(options.Action()))
482		switch value := options.(type) {
483		case ParkWarmOptions:
484			writer.addString("next", value.Next)
485			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
486			writer.addBool("commit-wip", value.CommitWIP)
487			writer.addBool("push", value.Push)
488			writer.addBool("keep-session", value.KeepSession)
489			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
490		case ParkColdOptions:
491			writer.addString("next", value.Next)
492			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
493			writer.addBool("commit-wip", value.CommitWIP)
494			writer.addBool("push", value.Push)
495			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
496		case ResumeOptions:
497			writer.addBool("fetch-refs", value.FetchRefs)
498			writer.addBool("no-provision", value.NoProvision)
499			writer.addBool("take-ownership", value.TakeOwnership)
500		case CompleteDirectOptions:
501			appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage, value.Push)
502		case CompleteFFOptions:
503			appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage, value.PushBase)
504		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
505			writer.addString("dirty", string(value.Dirty))
506			writer.addString("commit-message", value.CommitMessage)
507			writer.addBool("draft", value.Draft)
508			writer.addString("title", value.Title)
509			writer.addString("body", value.Body)
510		case VerifyMergedOptions:
511			writer.addString("dirty", string(value.Dirty))
512			writer.addString("commit-message", value.CommitMessage)
513			writer.addString("base-ref", value.BaseRef)
514			writer.addString("squash-commit", value.SquashCommit)
515			writer.addBool("push-base", value.PushBase)
516		case RetireOptions:
517			writer.addBool("delete-branch", value.DeleteBranch)
518			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
519		case AdoptOptions:
520			writer.addString("mode", string(value.Mode))
521			writer.addString("state", string(value.State))
522			writer.addString("name", value.Name)
523			writer.addString("base", value.Base)
524			writer.addString("owner", value.Owner)
525			writer.addString("next", value.Next)
526			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
527			writer.addStrings("tags", value.Tags.values)
528		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
529			writer.addBool("discard-dirty", value.DiscardDirty)
530			writer.addBool("require-contained", value.RequireContained)
531			writer.addString("containment-base", value.ContainmentBase)
532			writer.addBool("delete-contained-branch", value.DeleteContainedBranch)
533			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
534		case RefreshRemoteOptions:
535			writer.addBool("fetch-refs", value.FetchRefs)
536			writer.addBool("query-review", value.QueryReview)
537		case ReconcileOptions:
538			writer.addString("name", value.Name)
539			writer.addFields("parameters", value.Parameters)
540		}
541	}
542	
543	func appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer *identityWriter, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string, push bool) {
544		writer.addString("dirty", string(dirty))
545		writer.addString("commit-message", message)
546		writer.addBool("push", push)
547	}
548	
549	func appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer *identityWriter, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool, timeout time.Duration) {
550		writer.addBool("close-unknown", closeUnknown)
551		writer.addBool("assume-no-runtime", assumeNoRuntime)
552		writer.addInt64("timeout", int64(timeout))
553	}

244		tests := []struct {

247			hooks   func(context.Context, string) error

255					}

257					return err
258				},
259			},
260			{
261				name:    "discard changes branch",
262				options: CompleteDirectOptions{Dirty: DirtyDiscard},
263				hooks: func(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {

267		}

272					t.Fatal(err)
273				}
274				hooks := LifecycleHooks{}
275				if test.options.Dirty == DirtyCommit {
276					hooks.CommitAll = func(ctx context.Context, dir, _ string) error { return test.hooks(ctx, dir) }
277				} else {
278					hooks.DiscardAll = test.hooks
279				}

290				if !errors.Is(err, ErrStalePlan) {
291					t.Fatalf("Apply error=%v steps=%+v", err, result.AttemptedSteps())
292				}
293				if len(result.CompletedSteps()) != 1 || !result.PartialSuccess || result.Milestone != MilestoneNone {

298					t.Fatalf("unexpected finalization wrote state=%s", updated.State)

583	func indexOfString(values []string, want string) int {
584		for index, value := range values {
585			if value == want {
586				return index
587			}
588		}
589		return -1
590	}
591	
592	func sliceContains(values []string, want string) bool { return indexOfString(values, want) >= 0 }

 // Package retire coordinates destructive cleanup from outside the runtime and

 // CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
 // runtime surface still covers target before returning.
 func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
 	inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
 	if err != nil {
 		return inspection, err
 	}
 	if !inspection.Ready() {
 		return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
 	}
 	if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
 		return inspection, nil
 	}
 	interval := opts.PollInterval
 	if interval <= 0 {
 		interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
 	}
 	timeout := opts.Timeout
 	if timeout <= 0 {
 		timeout = 5 * time.Second
 	}
 	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
 	closed := make(map[string]bool)
 	for {
 		fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
 		if inspectErr != nil {
 			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
 		}
 		if !fresh.Ready() {
 			return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
 		}
 		if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
 			inspection.Sessions = nil
 			inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
 			return inspection, nil
 		}
 		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
 			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
 				len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
 		}
 		for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
 			handle := session.Runtime.Handle
 			if closed[handle] {
 				continue
 			}
 			if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
 				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
 			}
 			closed[handle] = true
 			break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
 		}
 		select {
 		case <-ctx.Done():
 			return inspection, ctx.Err()
 		case <-time.After(interval):
 		}
 	}
 }

 func coveringAgentStatuses(panes []runtime.Pane, fallback string) []string {
 	set := make(map[string]bool)
 	for _, pane := range panes {
 		if pane.Agent != "" || pane.AgentSession != "" || pane.AgentStatus != "" {
 			set[strings.ToLower(pane.AgentStatus)] = true
 		}
 	}
 	if len(set) == 0 {
 		set[strings.ToLower(fallback)] = true
 	}
 	out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
 	for status := range set {
 		out = append(out, status)
 	}
 	sort.Strings(out)
 	return out
 }

 func dedupe(inspection Inspection) Inspection {
 	seen := make(map[string]bool)
 	out := inspection.Blockers[:0]
 	for _, blocker := range inspection.Blockers {
 		if !seen[blocker] {
 			seen[blocker] = true
 			out = append(out, blocker)
 		}
 	}
 	inspection.Blockers = out
 	return inspection
 }

226	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
227		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
228		if err != nil {
229			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
230		}
231		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
232		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
233			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
234			if canonicalErr != nil {

236			}
237			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true}, nil
238		}
239		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
240			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
241		}
242		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
243	}

245	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string) (bool, error) {
246		if cwd == "" {
247			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
248		}
249		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
250		if err != nil {
251			return false, err
252		}
253		if target.git && activity.git {
254			return target.path == activity.path, nil
255		}
256		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)

311		for _, session := range sessions {
312			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
313				return session.Runtime.Handle

323		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))

330	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
331		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
332			return !caller
333		}
334		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
335		// with a freshly listed covering session.
336		if caller || !correlated {
337			return true
338		}
339		switch status {
340		case "idle", "done":
341			return false
342		case "unknown":
343			return !opts.CloseUnknown
344		default:
345			return true
346		}
347	}

56		return !w.Worktree.Main && !w.Worktree.Bare

63	func ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx context.Context, repoPath, exactPath string) (RegisteredWorktree, error) {
64		worktrees, err := Worktrees(ctx, repoPath)
65		if err != nil {
66			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("query registered worktrees: %w", err)

77		if err != nil {

79		}

81		if err != nil {
82			return RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory %q: %w", commonDir, err)
83		}
84	
85		type match struct {
86			worktree Worktree
87			path     string

89		var (
90			repositoryPath string
91			matches        []match

95			if canonicalErr != nil {

130	// StatusOf reads the porcelain v2 status of the checkout at dir. Porcelain v2
131	// is the documented machine-readable format: it reports branch, upstream and
132	// ahead/behind in the same pass as the file states, so one process gives dev
133	// everything it needs.
134	func StatusOf(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Status, error) {
135		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=normal", "-z")
136		if err != nil {
137			return Status{}, err
138		}

140	}
141	
142	func statusFromOutput(dir, out string) Status {
143		var s Status
144		for _, rec := range nulLines(out) {
145			if rec == "" {
146				continue
147			}
148			switch rec[0] {
149			case '#':
150				parseBranchHeader(rec, &s)
151			case '1', '2':
152				// "1 XY ..." ordinary change, "2 XY ..." rename/copy. X is
153				// staged, Y unstaged. This record is one unique changed path even
154				// when both sides are non-dot.
155				f := strings.Fields(rec)
156				if len(f) < 2 || len(f[1]) < 2 {
157					continue
158				}
159				s.Changed++
160				x, y := f[1][0], f[1][1]
161				if x != '.' {
162					s.Staged++
163				}
164				if y != '.' {
165					s.Unstaged++
166				}
167				classifyChange(x, &s)
168				classifyChange(y, &s)
169				updateLatestChange(dir, statusPath(rec), &s)
170			case 'u':
171				s.Changed++
172				s.Conflicted++
173				updateLatestChange(dir, statusPath(rec), &s)
174			case '?':
175				s.Changed++
176				s.Untracked++
177				updateLatestChange(dir, strings.TrimPrefix(rec, "? "), &s)
178			}
179		}
180		return s
181	}

184	// preserving spaces in it. Rename records have one extra score field; their

186	func statusPath(rec string) string {
187		if rec == "" {
188			return ""
189		}
190		var fields int
191		switch rec[0] {
192		case '1':
193			fields = 9
194		case '2':
195			fields = 10
196		case 'u':
197			fields = 11
198		default:
199			return ""
200		}
201		parts := strings.SplitN(rec, " ", fields)
202		if len(parts) != fields {
203			return ""
204		}
205		return parts[fields-1]
206	}

21	// Error carries the failing command and git's own stderr, which is almost
22	// always more useful than the exit status alone.
23	type Error struct {
24		Args   []string
25		Dir    string
26		Stderr string
27		Err    error
28	}
29	
30	func (e *Error) Error() string {
31		msg := strings.TrimSpace(e.Stderr)
32		if msg == "" {
33			msg = e.Err.Error()
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("git %s: %s", strings.Join(e.Args, " "), msg)
36	}
37	
38	func (e *Error) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
39	
40	// run executes git in dir and returns trimmed stdout.
41	func run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
42		return runEnv(ctx, dir, nil, args...)
43	}
44	
45	// runEnv executes git with task-scoped environment overrides. It is used for
46	// alternate-index analysis that must never touch the user's real index.
47	func runEnv(ctx context.Context, dir string, overrides []string, args ...string) (string, error) {
48		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than
49		// octal-escaped, which matters for the Chinese-named files in these repos.
50		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
51		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
52		cmd.Dir = dir
53		if len(overrides) > 0 {
54			keys := make(map[string]bool, len(overrides))
55			for _, override := range overrides {
56				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(override, "=")
57				keys[key] = true
58			}
59			env := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+len(overrides))
60			for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
61				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
62				if !keys[key] {
63					env = append(env, entry)
64				}
65			}
66			env = append(env, overrides...)
67			cmd.Env = env
68		}
69		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
70		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
71		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
72		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
73			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
74			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {
75				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", dir, ErrNotARepo)
76			}
77			return "", gerr
78		}
79		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
80	}
81	
82	// Run executes an arbitrary git command in dir. Exported for the few callers
83	// (park's wip commit, done's merge) that need a one-off command.
84	func Run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
85		return run(ctx, dir, args...)
86	}
87	
88	// lines splits git output into non-empty lines.
89	func lines(s string) []string {
90		if s == "" {
91			return nil
92		}
93		out := strings.Split(s, "\n")
94		filtered := out[:0]
95		for _, l := range out {
96			if l != "" {
97				filtered = append(filtered, l)
98			}
99		}
100		return filtered
101	}
102	
103	// nulLines splits NUL-delimited git output (-z forms).
104	func nulLines(s string) []string {
105		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\x00")
106		if s == "" {
107			return nil
108		}
109		return strings.Split(s, "\x00")
110	}
111

13	// OccupancyProfile selects the policy applied to recognized-agent evidence.
14	// Session, pane, and activity observations are retained identically in every
15	// profile; only Blocking changes.
16	type OccupancyProfile uint8
17	
18	const (
19		// OccupancyStrict is for claiming a checkout for writing or adoption. Every
20		// recognized agent except the current caller is blocking, regardless of state.
21		// It is the zero value so an omitted profile fails toward exclusive ownership.
22		OccupancyStrict OccupancyProfile = iota
23		// OccupancyCleanup permits closeable idle and done agents. Unknown activity
24		// remains blocking unless CloseUnknown is set.
25		OccupancyCleanup

28	// OccupancyOptions supplies live caller identity and action-specific policy.

32		Profile           OccupancyProfile

46	// Observed reports whether the observation completed successfully.

48		return o.Supported && o.Attempted && o.Err == nil
49	}
50	
51	// Unknown reports whether this evidence was not successfully observed.
52	func (o OccupancyObservation) Unknown() bool { return !o.Observed() }

71	// Occupancy is structured, read-only evidence about one checkout. A remembered
72	// runtime handle is deliberately absent: Sessions and Agents are selected only
73	// from fresh canonical checkout coverage.
74	type Occupancy struct {
75		Target               string
76		Backend              string
77		Profile              OccupancyProfile
78		CallerWorkspaceID    string
79		ReportedCallerPaneID string
80		CallerPaneID         string

82		AgentActivityList    OccupancyObservation

89	// InspectOccupancy collects independent runtime, recognized-agent, and caller
90	// evidence for target. Initial target canonicalization errors are returned;
91	// observation failures are retained in their corresponding fields so each
92	// action can apply its own fail-closed acknowledgement policy.
93	func InspectOccupancy(ctx context.Context, rt Runtime, target string, opts OccupancyOptions) (Occupancy, error) {
94		checkout, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, target)
95		if err != nil {
96			return Occupancy{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize occupancy target: %w", err)
97		}
98		result := Occupancy{
99			Target:               checkout.path,
100			Backend:              "none",
101			Profile:              opts.Profile,
102			CallerWorkspaceID:    opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
103			ReportedCallerPaneID: opts.CallerPaneID,
104			CallerPaneID:         opts.CallerPaneID,
105		}
106		if rt == nil {
107			return result, nil
108		}
109		result.Backend = rt.Name()
110		if result.Backend == "none" {
111			return result, nil
112		}
113	
114		result.SessionList.Supported = true
115		resolver, resolvesCurrentPane := rt.(CurrentPaneResolver)
116		result.CurrentPane.Supported = resolvesCurrentPane
117		if resolvesCurrentPane && opts.CallerPaneID != "" {
118			result.CurrentPane.Attempted = true
119			result.CallerPaneID = ""
120			paneID, resolveErr := resolver.CurrentPaneID(ctx)
121			if resolveErr != nil {
122				result.CurrentPane.Err = resolveErr
123			} else if paneID == "" {
124				result.CurrentPane.Err = fmt.Errorf("current pane resolver returned an empty pane id")
125			} else {
126				result.CallerPaneID = paneID
127			}
128		}
129	
130		result.SessionList.Attempted = true
131		sessions, listErr := rt.List(ctx)
132		if listErr != nil {
133			result.SessionList.Err = listErr
134		} else {
135			for _, observed := range sessions {
136				covering, mixed, classifyErr := classifyOccupancySession(ctx, checkout, observed)
137				if classifyErr != nil {
138					result.SessionCoverageErr = classifyErr
139					result.Sessions = nil
140					break
141				}
142				if len(covering) == 0 {
143					continue
144				}
145				result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, OccupancySession{
146					Runtime: observed,
147					Panes:   covering,
148					Mixed:   mixed,
149					IsCaller: observed.Handle == opts.CallerWorkspaceID ||
150						occupancyPanePresent(observed.Panes, result.CallerPaneID),
151				})
152			}
153		}
154	
155		lister, listsAgents := rt.(AgentActivityLister)
156		result.AgentActivityList.Supported = listsAgents
157		if !listsAgents {
158			// Some backends can identify an agent on a pane without providing the
159			// richer recognized-agent inventory. Preserve that live evidence as the
160			// strict-profile fallback rather than treating an unsupported lister as an
161			// observed empty list.
162			for _, session := range result.Sessions {
163				for _, pane := range session.Panes {
164					if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" {
165						continue
166					}
167					cwd := pane.CWD
168					if cwd == "" {
169						cwd = pane.ShellCWD
170					}
171					activity := AgentActivity{
172						PaneID: pane.ID, WorkspaceID: session.Runtime.Handle,
173						Agent: pane.Agent, Status: pane.AgentStatus, CWD: cwd,
174					}
175					if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
176						result.SessionCoverageErr = coverageErr
177						result.Agents = nil
178						return result, nil
179					}
180				}
181			}
182			return result, nil
183		}
184		result.AgentActivityList.Attempted = true
185		activities, activityErr := lister.AgentActivities(ctx)
186		if activityErr != nil {
187			result.AgentActivityList.Err = activityErr
188			return result, nil
189		}
190		for _, activity := range activities {
191			if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
192				result.AgentActivityList.Err = coverageErr
193				result.Agents = nil
194				return result, nil
195			}
196		}
197		return result, nil
198	}

200	func appendOccupancyAgent(ctx context.Context, result *Occupancy, checkout checkoutIdentity, opts OccupancyOptions, activity AgentActivity) error {
201		covered, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, checkout, activity.CWD)
202		if err != nil {
203			return fmt.Errorf("classify recognized agent pane %s: %w", activity.PaneID, err)
204		}
205		if !covered {
206			return nil
207		}
208		status := normalizeOccupancyStatus(activity.Status)
209		caller := result.CallerPaneID != "" && activity.PaneID == result.CallerPaneID
210		handle := correlatedSession(result.Sessions, activity)
211		result.Agents = append(result.Agents, OccupancyAgent{
212			Activity:      activity,
213			Status:        status,
214			SessionHandle: handle,
215			IsCaller:      caller,
216			Blocking:      occupancyAgentBlocks(opts, status, caller, handle != ""),
217		})
218		return nil
219	}

221	type checkoutIdentity struct {
222		path string
223		git  bool
224	}
225	
226	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
227		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
228		if err != nil {
229			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
230		}
231		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
232		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
233			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
234			if canonicalErr != nil {
235				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
236			}
237			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true}, nil
238		}
239		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
240			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
241		}
242		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string) (bool, error) {
246		if cwd == "" {
247			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
248		}
249		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
250		if err != nil {
251			return false, err
252		}
253		if target.git && activity.git {
254			return target.path == activity.path, nil
255		}
256		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
257	}
258	
259	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
260		panes := session.Panes
261		if len(panes) == 0 {
262			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
263				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
264			}
265		}
266		var covering, mixed []Pane
267		for _, pane := range panes {
268			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
269			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
270				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
271			}
272			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
273			for _, path := range paths {
274				if path == "" {
275					continue
276				}
277				observed = true
278				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path)
279				if err != nil {
280					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
281				}
282				if inside {
283					paneCovers = true
284				} else {
285					paneOutside = true
286				}
287			}
288			if paneCovers {
289				covering = append(covering, pane)
290			}
291			if paneOutside || !observed {
292				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
293			}
294		}
295		return covering, mixed, nil
296	}
297	
298	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
299		if id == "" {
300			return false
301		}
302		for _, pane := range panes {
303			if pane.ID == id {
304				return true
305			}
306		}
307		return false
308	}
309	
310	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
311		for _, session := range sessions {
312			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
313				return session.Runtime.Handle
314			}
315			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
316				return session.Runtime.Handle
317			}
318		}
319		return ""
320	}
321	
322	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
323		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
324		if status == "" {
325			return "unknown"
326		}
327		return status
328	}
329	
330	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
331		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
332			return !caller
333		}
334		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
335		// with a freshly listed covering session.
336		if caller || !correlated {
337			return true
338		}
339		switch status {
340		case "idle", "done":
341			return false
342		case "unknown":
343			return !opts.CloseUnknown
344		default:
345			return true
346		}
347	}

1	// Package runtime abstracts the terminal multiplexer that hosts a checkout.
2	//
3	// dev deliberately owns no terminal state of its own. A runtime is where a
4	// task is *live*; the durable facts live in git and in the task registry. That
5	// separation is the whole point: closing a runtime session must never feel
6	// like abandoning a task, so every adapter here is expected to be lossy and
7	// re-derivable.
8	package runtime
9	
10	import (
11		"context"
12		"fmt"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16	
17		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
18	)
19	
20	// Pane is one terminal surface inside a runtime session.
21	type Pane struct {
22		ID           string
23		CWD          string
24		ShellCWD     string
25		Agent        string
26		AgentStatus  string
27		AgentSession string
28	}
29	
30	// Session is one live workspace/session of a runtime backend.
31	type Session struct {
32		// Handle is the backend's own identifier (a herdr workspace id, a tmux
33		// session name). Opaque to the rest of dev.
34		Handle string
35		Label  string
36		// Dirs lists the working directories observed in this session. A session
37		// can span several (multiple panes), which is why this is not a single
38		// value.
39		Dirs []string
40		// AgentStatus is the backend's view of agent activity, when it has one:
41		// "working", "idle", "done", "waiting". Empty when unsupported.
42		AgentStatus string
43		// AgentSessions lists resumable agent context ids, e.g. "claude:<uuid>".
44		AgentSessions []string
45		// Panes retain the exact runtime IDs and cwd values used for caller and
46		// mixed-workspace retirement checks.
47		Panes   []Pane
48		Focused bool
49	}
50	
51	// Covers reports whether the session has a pane rooted at or under dir.
52	func (s Session) Covers(dir string) bool {
53		for _, d := range s.Dirs {
54			// A pane inside the repository makes it live. The inverse is not
55			// true: a generic pane at $HOME does not make every repository below
56			// $HOME active.
57			if inside, err := pathx.Contains(dir, d); err == nil && inside {
58				return true
59			}
60		}
61		return false
62	}
63	
64	// OpenResult is the transient result of making a checkout live. Handle may be
65	// persisted by callers, but the pane belongs to this one creation response and
66	// must never be treated as durable state.
67	type OpenResult struct {
68		Handle     string
69		Surface    string
70		Opened     bool
71		Created    bool
72		RootPaneID string
73	}
74	
75	// AgentActivity is one recognized live coding agent occupying a runtime pane.
76	// Every activity returned by a backend is occupied regardless of Status; idle,
77	// done and unknown describe lifecycle state, not permission to share a checkout.
78	type AgentActivity struct {
79		PaneID      string
80		WorkspaceID string
81		Agent       string
82		Name        string
83		Status      string
84		CWD         string
85	}
86	
87	// AgentActivityLister is an optional runtime capability. Core runtimes need not
88	// know about agents; Herdr implements it because its pane model can identify the
89	// exact process and checkout involved.
90	type AgentActivityLister interface {
91		AgentActivities(ctx context.Context) ([]AgentActivity, error)
92	}
93	
94	// CurrentPaneResolver is an optional runtime capability for resolving the live
95	// pane behind inherited caller context. Herdr pane IDs can change after a move,
96	// so collision exclusions must not trust HERDR_PANE_ID alone.
97	type CurrentPaneResolver interface {
98		CurrentPaneID(ctx context.Context) (string, error)
99	}
100	
101	// Activator is the optional interactive half of opening a runtime surface.
102	// Open deliberately remains detached so creation commands can run in the
103	// background. Navigation commands call Activate after their own terminal UI
104	// has been torn down: inside a multiplexer this switches the current client;
105	// outside it attaches a new client and blocks until the user detaches.
106	type Activator interface {
107		Activate(ctx context.Context, handle string) error
108	}
109	
110	// PaneRunner is the optional exact-pane command surface. The command is shell
111	// text for the pane's existing interactive shell, not argv for a child process
112	// started by dev. Implementations must not include command text in errors.
113	type PaneRunner interface {
114		RunInPane(ctx context.Context, paneID, command string) error
115	}
116	
117	// Runtime is the contract every backend satisfies. Adapters must degrade
118	// gracefully: an unavailable backend returns errors rather than panicking, and
119	// List on an idle backend returns an empty slice, not an error.
120	type Runtime interface {
121		// Name is the backend identifier used in config and in `dev doctor`.
122		Name() string
123		// Available reports whether this backend can be used on this machine right
124		// now (binary installed and, where relevant, a server reachable).
125		Available() bool
126		// Open makes dir live. Its result distinguishes a newly created surface from
127		// a reused one and may carry a root pane proven by that same create response.
128		Open(ctx context.Context, dir, label string) (OpenResult, error)
129		// Close ends the session without touching the checkout, the branch or the
130		// task entry.
131		Close(ctx context.Context, handle string) error
132		// List enumerates live sessions.
133		List(ctx context.Context) ([]Session, error)
134		// Annotate attaches display-only metadata to a session (state, next
135		// action). Backends without a metadata channel implement this as a no-op.
136		Annotate(ctx context.Context, handle string, kv map[string]string) error
137	}
138	
139	// WorktreeOpener is implemented by backends that understand git worktrees and
140	// can present one as a first-class session grouped under its parent repo.
141	// dev always creates the worktree itself — this only surfaces it.
142	type WorktreeOpener interface {
143		OpenWorktree(ctx context.Context, path, label string) (OpenResult, error)
144	}
145	
146	// ErrUnavailable reports a backend that is not usable on this machine.
147	type ErrUnavailable struct{ Backend, Reason string }
148	
149	func (e *ErrUnavailable) Error() string {
150		return fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s unavailable: %s", e.Backend, e.Reason)
151	}
152	
153	// Select resolves a configured backend name to a Runtime.
154	//
155	// "auto" prefers the richest backend that is actually available: herdr (which
156	// models workspaces, worktrees and agent sessions), then tmux, then zellij,
157	// then None.
158	// None is always available so dev never hard-fails for lack of a multiplexer.
159	func Select(backend string) Runtime {
160		herdr, tmux, zellij, none := NewHerdr(), NewTmux(), NewZellij(), None{}
161		switch backend {
162		case "herdr":
163			return herdr
164		case "tmux":
165			return tmux
166		case "zellij":
167			return zellij
168		case "none":
169			return none
170		case "", "auto":
171			if herdr.Available() {
172				return herdr
173			}
174			if tmux.Available() {
175				return tmux
176			}
177			if zellij.Available() {
178				return zellij
179			}
180			return none
181		}
182		return none
183	}
184	
185	// All returns every backend, for `dev doctor` to report on.
186	func All() []Runtime { return []Runtime{NewHerdr(), NewTmux(), NewZellij(), None{}} }
187	
188	// haveBinary reports whether name is on PATH.
189	func haveBinary(name string) bool {
190		_, err := exec.LookPath(name)
191		return err == nil
192	}
193	
194	// runInteractive connects a multiplexer client directly to dev's terminal.
195	// Runtime protocol calls use captured stdout/stderr; attach clients must not,
196	// because they own the terminal until the user detaches.
197	func runInteractive(ctx context.Context, bin string, args ...string) error {
198		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
199		cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
200		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
201			return fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
202		}
203		return nil
204	}

1	package runtime

5	// None is the no-multiplexer backend. It is always available, which is what
6	// guarantees dev's core inventory and worktree commands work on a bare machine
7	// with nothing but git installed.
8	//
9	// Open returns the directory itself as the handle: the shell wrapper installed
10	// by `dev shell-init` turns that into a cd in the calling shell, since a child
11	// process can never change its parent's working directory.
12	type None struct{}
13	
14	// Name implements Runtime.
15	func (None) Name() string { return "none" }
16	
17	// Available implements Runtime; the null backend always is.
18	func (None) Available() bool { return true }
19	
20	// Open implements Runtime by reporting the directory to change into. None does
21	// not open a runtime surface, so the result is never launchable.
22	func (None) Open(_ context.Context, dir, _ string) (OpenResult, error) {
23		return OpenResult{Handle: dir}, nil
24	}
25	
26	// Close implements Runtime as a no-op: there is no session to end.
27	func (None) Close(context.Context, string) error { return nil }
28	
29	// List implements Runtime; without a multiplexer nothing is tracked as live.
30	func (None) List(context.Context) ([]Session, error) { return nil, nil }
31	
32	// Annotate implements Runtime as a no-op.
33	func (None) Annotate(context.Context, string, map[string]string) error { return nil }

90	// evidence for target. Initial target canonicalization errors are returned;
91	// observation failures are retained in their corresponding fields so each

93	func InspectOccupancy(ctx context.Context, rt Runtime, target string, opts OccupancyOptions) (Occupancy, error) {
94		checkout, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, target)
95		if err != nil {
96			return Occupancy{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize occupancy target: %w", err)
97		}
98		result := Occupancy{

100			Backend:              "none",
101			Profile:              opts.Profile,
102			CallerWorkspaceID:    opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
103			ReportedCallerPaneID: opts.CallerPaneID,
104			CallerPaneID:         opts.CallerPaneID,
105		}
106		if rt == nil {
107			return result, nil
108		}
109		result.Backend = rt.Name()
110		if result.Backend == "none" {
111			return result, nil
112		}
113	
114		result.SessionList.Supported = true
115		resolver, resolvesCurrentPane := rt.(CurrentPaneResolver)
116		result.CurrentPane.Supported = resolvesCurrentPane
117		if resolvesCurrentPane && opts.CallerPaneID != "" {
118			result.CurrentPane.Attempted = true
119			result.CallerPaneID = ""
120			paneID, resolveErr := resolver.CurrentPaneID(ctx)
121			if resolveErr != nil {
122				result.CurrentPane.Err = resolveErr
123			} else if paneID == "" {
124				result.CurrentPane.Err = fmt.Errorf("current pane resolver returned an empty pane id")
125			} else {
126				result.CallerPaneID = paneID
127			}
128		}
129	
130		result.SessionList.Attempted = true
131		sessions, listErr := rt.List(ctx)
132		if listErr != nil {
133			result.SessionList.Err = listErr
134		} else {
135			for _, observed := range sessions {
136				covering, mixed, classifyErr := classifyOccupancySession(ctx, checkout, observed)
137				if classifyErr != nil {
138					result.SessionCoverageErr = classifyErr
139					result.Sessions = nil
140					break
141				}
142				if len(covering) == 0 {
143					continue
144				}
145				result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, OccupancySession{
146					Runtime: observed,
147					Panes:   covering,
148					Mixed:   mixed,
149					IsCaller: observed.Handle == opts.CallerWorkspaceID ||
150						occupancyPanePresent(observed.Panes, result.CallerPaneID),
151				})
152			}
153		}
154	
155		lister, listsAgents := rt.(AgentActivityLister)
156		result.AgentActivityList.Supported = listsAgents
157		if !listsAgents {
158			// Some backends can identify an agent on a pane without providing the
159			// richer recognized-agent inventory. Preserve that live evidence as the
160			// strict-profile fallback rather than treating an unsupported lister as an
161			// observed empty list.
162			for _, session := range result.Sessions {
163				for _, pane := range session.Panes {
164					if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" {
165						continue
166					}
167					cwd := pane.CWD
168					if cwd == "" {
169						cwd = pane.ShellCWD
170					}
171					activity := AgentActivity{
172						PaneID: pane.ID, WorkspaceID: session.Runtime.Handle,
173						Agent: pane.Agent, Status: pane.AgentStatus, CWD: cwd,
174					}
175					if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
176						result.SessionCoverageErr = coverageErr
177						result.Agents = nil
178						return result, nil
179					}
180				}
181			}
182			return result, nil
183		}
184		result.AgentActivityList.Attempted = true
185		activities, activityErr := lister.AgentActivities(ctx)
186		if activityErr != nil {
187			result.AgentActivityList.Err = activityErr
188			return result, nil
189		}
190		for _, activity := range activities {
191			if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
192				result.AgentActivityList.Err = coverageErr
193				result.Agents = nil
194				return result, nil
195			}
196		}
197		return result, nil
198	}

200	func appendOccupancyAgent(ctx context.Context, result *Occupancy, checkout checkoutIdentity, opts OccupancyOptions, activity AgentActivity) error {
201		covered, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, checkout, activity.CWD)
202		if err != nil {
203			return fmt.Errorf("classify recognized agent pane %s: %w", activity.PaneID, err)
204		}
205		if !covered {
206			return nil
207		}
208		status := normalizeOccupancyStatus(activity.Status)
209		caller := result.CallerPaneID != "" && activity.PaneID == result.CallerPaneID
210		handle := correlatedSession(result.Sessions, activity)
211		result.Agents = append(result.Agents, OccupancyAgent{
212			Activity:      activity,
213			Status:        status,
214			SessionHandle: handle,
215			IsCaller:      caller,
216			Blocking:      occupancyAgentBlocks(opts, status, caller, handle != ""),
217		})
218		return nil
219	}
