221	type checkoutIdentity struct {
222		path string
223		git  bool
224	}
225	
226	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
227		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
228		if err != nil {
229			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
230		}
231		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
232		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
233			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
234			if canonicalErr != nil {
235				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
236			}
237			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true}, nil
238		}
239		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
240			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
241		}
242		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string) (bool, error) {
246		if cwd == "" {
247			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
248		}
249		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
250		if err != nil {
251			return false, err
252		}
253		if target.git && activity.git {
254			return target.path == activity.path, nil
255		}
256		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
257	}
258	
259	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
260		panes := session.Panes
261		if len(panes) == 0 {
262			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
263				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
264			}
265		}
266		var covering, mixed []Pane
267		for _, pane := range panes {
268			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
269			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
270				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
271			}
272			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
273			for _, path := range paths {
274				if path == "" {
275					continue
276				}
277				observed = true
278				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path)
279				if err != nil {
280					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
281				}
282				if inside {
283					paneCovers = true
284				} else {
285					paneOutside = true
286				}
287			}
288			if paneCovers {
289				covering = append(covering, pane)
290			}
291			if paneOutside || !observed {
292				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
293			}
294		}
295		return covering, mixed, nil
296	}
297	
298	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
299		if id == "" {
300			return false
301		}
302		for _, pane := range panes {
303			if pane.ID == id {
304				return true
305			}
306		}
307		return false
308	}
309	
310	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
311		for _, session := range sessions {
312			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
313				return session.Runtime.Handle
314			}
315			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
316				return session.Runtime.Handle
317			}
318		}
319		return ""
320	}
321	
322	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
323		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
324		if status == "" {
325			return "unknown"
326		}
327		return status
328	}
329	
330	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
331		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
332			return !caller
333		}
334		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
335		// with a freshly listed covering session.
336		if caller || !correlated {
337			return true
338		}
339		switch status {
340		case "idle", "done":
341			return false
342		case "unknown":
343			return !opts.CloseUnknown
344		default:
345			return true
346		}
347	}

30	  --ff       rebase onto the base and fast-forward it locally. Use when the

43	cancel. Unique content requires typing DROP before discard. Scripts select an
44	explicit --dirty policy; destructive discard also requires --yes.
45	
46	A successful local or externally verified merge records DONE, meaning MERGED

283	func replanDone(
284		ctx context.Context,

294			return flow.Plan{}, err

296		if changed := changedDoneAuthority(previous, fresh); changed != "" {
297			stale := &flow.StalePlanError{
298				ExpectedPlanID: previous.PlanID,
299				ActualPlanID:   fresh.PlanID,
300				Reason:         changed + " changed while the finish plan was open",
301			}
302			return flow.Plan{}, presentDoneApplyError(flow.Result{}, stale)
303		}
304		return fresh, nil
305	}

359	func donePlanReadinessError(selected task.Task, plan flow.Plan, selection doneSelection) error {
360		if plan.Availability == flow.AvailabilityReady {
361			return nil
362		}
363		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionCheckoutClean); ok &&
364			condition.Requirement == flow.RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
365			switch selection.Dirty {
366			case flow.DirtyAuto, flow.DirtyFail:
367				return dirtyFinishError(selected, plan)
368			case flow.DirtyCommit:
369				if strings.TrimSpace(selection.Message) == "" {
370					return errors.New("--message is required with --dirty=commit outside an interactive terminal")
371				}
372			}
373		}
374		if plan.Action == flow.ReviewHandoff {
375			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionBranchRelation); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
376				base := doneView(plan).Base
377				return fmt.Errorf("%s is already contained in %s; use --ff to finalize cleanup instead of opening a PR",
378					selected.Branch, base)
379			}
380		}
381		if plan.Action == flow.VerifyMerged {
382			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionMergeProof); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
383				fields := plan.AuthorityFields()
384				return fmt.Errorf("cannot verify %s is contained in %s", fields["completion.proof-ref"], fields["completion.base-ref"])
385			}
386		}
387		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
388		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
389		for _, condition := range blocking {
390			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
391			if condition.Remediation != "" {
392				message += " (" + condition.Remediation + ")"
393			}
394			parts = append(parts, message)
395		}
396		if len(parts) == 0 {
397			return fmt.Errorf("finish plan is %s: %w", plan.Availability, flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
398		}
399		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability,
400			strings.Join(parts, "; "), flow.ErrPlanNotReady)

411	func renderDonePreflight(app *App, t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) {

414		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", s.title("Finish"), t.Title())
415		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s      %s\n", s.label("branch"), t.Branch)
416		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s        %s\n", s.label("base"), view.Base)
417		switch {
418		case view.BaseOnly == 0 && view.BranchOnly == 0:
419			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already equal to %s (behind 0, ahead 0)", view.Base)))
420		case view.contained():
421			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already contained in %s (behind %d, ahead 0)", view.Base, view.BaseOnly)))
422		default:
423			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("behind %d, ahead %d relative to %s",
424				view.BaseOnly, view.BranchOnly, view.Base)))
425		}
426		if !view.Status.Dirty() {
427			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.success("clean"))

429		}
430		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.warning(view.Status.Breakdown()))
431		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s, %s\n", s.label("contents"),
432			s.success(fmt.Sprintf("%d match %s", view.Equivalent, view.Base)),
433			s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("%d unique", view.Unique)))
434		for _, change := range view.Changes {
435			marker := s.warning("unique")
436			if change.BaseEquivalent {
437				marker = s.success("matches " + view.Base)
438			}
439			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s%s %s\n", marker,
440				strings.Repeat(" ", max(0, 12-width(marker))), change.Path)
441		}
442	}

444	func confirmDonePlan(app *App, p *prompter, t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) (bool, string, error) {
445		view := doneView(plan)
446		s := app.outStyle()
447		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\n"+s.title("Summary"))
448		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s        %s\n", s.label("task"), t.Title())
449		switch {
450		case donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectCommitAll):
451			message := doneEffectDetails(plan, flow.EffectCommitAll)["message"]
452			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("commit all as %q", message)))
453		case donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectDiscardAll):
454			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.danger("discard all staged, unstaged and untracked changes"))
455		default:
456			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.success("none"))
457		}
458		switch {
459		case plan.Action == flow.ReviewHandoff:
460			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.review("open a PR into "+view.Base))
461		case plan.Action == flow.VerifyMerged:
462			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("verify merge into "+view.Base))
463		case !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectMergeFF) && !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectRebaseBranch):
464			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("already contained in "+view.Base+"; cleanup only"))
465		default:
466			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("fast-forward into "+view.Base))
467		}
468		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
469			label := plan.Confirmation.Prompt
470			if view.Unique > 0 {
471				label = fmt.Sprintf("Type %s to discard %d unique path(s)", plan.Confirmation.Token, view.Unique)
472			}
473			value, err := p.dangerLine(label)
474			if err != nil {
475				return false, "", err
476			}
477			return value == plan.Confirmation.Token, value, nil
478		}
479		confirmed, err := p.confirm("Proceed with this finish plan?", false)
480		return confirmed, "", err
481	}
482	
483	func presentDoneApplyError(result flow.Result, err error) error {
484		for _, step := range result.FailedSteps() {
485			switch step.Effect.Code {
486			case flow.EffectCommitAll:
487				return fmt.Errorf("commit dirty checkout: %w", err)
488			case flow.EffectDiscardAll:
489				return fmt.Errorf("discard dirty checkout: %w", err)
490			}
491		}
492		if errors.Is(err, flow.ErrStalePlan) {
493			for _, step := range result.CompletedSteps() {
494				if step.Effect.Code == flow.EffectCommitAll || step.Effect.Code == flow.EffectDiscardAll {
495					return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again during finalization; stop the active writer and rerun dev done: %w", err)
496				}
497			}
498			return fmt.Errorf("checkout or branch changed while the finish plan was open; review the new state and rerun dev done: %w", err)
499		}
500		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "changed again after") {
501			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again during finalization; stop the active writer and rerun dev done: %w", err)
502		}
503		return err
504	}
505	
506	func renderDoneSuccess(app *App, selected, final task.Task, plan flow.Plan, result flow.Result, initial donePlanView) error {
507		switch plan.Action {
508		case flow.ReviewHandoff:
509			if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneReviewReady {
510				return fmt.Errorf("review handoff completed without the review-ready milestone")
511			}
512			if final.State != selected.State {
513				return fmt.Errorf("review handoff changed task state from %s to %s", selected.State, final.State)
514			}
515			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nREADY FOR REVIEW · runtime and worktree kept")
516			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "After merge: dev done --merged --base-ref origin/"+doneView(plan).Base)
517			return nil
518		case flow.CompleteDirect, flow.CompleteFF, flow.VerifyMerged:
519			if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneMerged || final.State != task.Done {
520				return fmt.Errorf("completion returned milestone %s and task state %s; want merged and DONE",
521					result.Milestone, final.State)
522			}
523		default:
524			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported completion result action %s", plan.Action)
525		}
526	
527		if plan.Action == flow.CompleteDirect {
528			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s completed directly on %s\n", task.Done.Icon(), final.Title(), final.Branch)
529			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   no branch or worktree was created or removed")
530			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · cleanup pending: run dev retire from outside this runtime")
531			return nil
532		}
533		view := doneView(plan)
534		if plan.Action == flow.CompleteFF && initial.contained() &&
535			!donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectRebaseBranch) && !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectMergeFF) {
536			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   already merged  %s is contained in %s\n", final.Branch, view.Base)
537		}
538		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s merged into %s\n", task.Done.Icon(), final.Title(), view.Base)
539		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · runtime and worktree kept")

15	func (s *lifecycleService) applyGuarded(ctx context.Context, action Action, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
16		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
17			return Result{}, err
18		}
19		if approved.Action != action {
20			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("handler %s received %s", action, approved.Action)}
21		}
22		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
23			return Result{}, err
24		}
25		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
28		}
29	
30		var result Result
31		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
32			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
33				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
34				if loadErr != nil {
35					return &StalePlanError{
36						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID,
37						Reason:         "task record disappeared before apply",
38					}
39				}
40				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
41					return identityErr
42				}
43				fresh, observed, planErr := s.freshPlan(ctx, approved.Request, *record)
44				if planErr != nil {
45					return planErr
46				}
47				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
48				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
49					actual := ""
50					if current != nil {
51						actual = current.Revision
52					}
53					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked plan rebuild")
54				}
55				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
56					return &StalePlanError{
57						ExpectedPlanID:               approved.PlanID,
58						ActualPlanID:                 fresh.PlanID,
59						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
60						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
61						Reason:                       "fresh task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or option authority differs",
62					}
63				}
64				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
65					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
66					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
67				}
68	
69				execution := &executionState{
70					service: s, plan: fresh, observed: observed, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision,
71				}
72				var applyErr error

74				case ParkWarm:
75					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkWarm(ctx)
76				case ParkCold:

89					applyErr = &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: action, Stage: "apply"}
90				}
91				return applyErr

112	// InspectReadiness gathers artifact finalization evidence for one exact
113	// checkout. It never reconciles receipts, finalizes intents, or writes either
114	// source files or intent records. The returned inspection retains partial
115	// evidence and the same wrapped error returned separately to ordinary callers.
116	func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
117		inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
118		if ctx == nil {
119			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")
120			inspection.ObservationError = err
121			return inspection, err
122		}
123		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
124			inspection.ObservationError = err
125			return inspection, err
126		}
127		if store == nil {
128			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a store")
129			inspection.ObservationError = err
130			return inspection, err
131		}
132	
133		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
134		if err != nil {
135			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
136			inspection.ObservationError = err
137			return inspection, err
138		}
139		inspection.Checkout = canonical
140	
141		intents, err := store.List()
142		if err != nil {
143			err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
144			inspection.ObservationError = err
145			return inspection, err
146		}
147		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
148			inspection.ObservationError = err
149			return inspection, err
150		}
151	
152		for _, intent := range intents {
153			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
154				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
155				break
156			}
157			intentCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
158			if err != nil {
159				err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, err)
160				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
161				continue
162			}
163			if intentCheckout != canonical {
164				continue
165			}
166	
167			evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
168			switch intent.Status {
169			case Armed, Finalizing:
170				evidence.State = ReadinessPending
171			case Failed:
172				evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
173			case Discarded:
174				evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
175			case Finalized:
176				evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, canonical, intent)
177				switch {
178				case err != nil:
179					err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
180					evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
181					evidence.ObservationError = err
182					inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
183				case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
184					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
185				default:
186					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
187				}
188			default:
189				// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
190				// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
191				err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
192				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
193				evidence.ObservationError = err
194				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
195			}
196			inspection.Intents = append(inspection.Intents, evidence)
197		}
198	
199		inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
200		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
201	}

36	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
37		if intent == nil {
38			return fmt.Errorf("create nil artifact intent")
39		}
40		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
41			candidate := *intent
42			if candidate.ID == "" {
43				candidate.ID = s.newID()

45			candidate.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
46			candidate.Status = Armed
47			now := s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
48			candidate.CreatedAt, candidate.UpdatedAt = now, now
49			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
50				return err
51			}
52			if _, err := os.Stat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
53				return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s already exists", candidate.ID)
54			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return err
56			}
57			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {
58				return err
59			}
60			*intent = candidate
61			return nil
62		})
63	}

65	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Intent, error) {
66		if !idPattern.MatchString(id) {
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent id %q", id)
68		}
69		file, err := os.Open(s.path(id))
70		if err != nil {
71			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
72				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s: %w", id, ErrIntentNotFound)
73			}
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		defer file.Close()
77		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
78		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
79		var intent Intent
80		if err := decoder.Decode(&intent); err != nil {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
82		}
83		if err := ensureJSONEOF(decoder); err != nil {
84			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
85		}
86		if intent.ID != id {
87			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent filename %s disagrees with id %s", id, intent.ID)
88		}
89		if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
90			return nil, err
91		}
92		return &intent, nil
93	}
94	
95	func (s *Store) List() ([]Intent, error) {
96		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
97		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
98			return nil, nil
99		}
100		if err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		var intents []Intent
104		for _, entry := range entries {
105			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
106				continue
107			}
108			intent, err := s.Get(strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json"))
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			intents = append(intents, *intent)
113		}
114		sort.Slice(intents, func(i, j int) bool { return intents[i].CreatedAt.Before(intents[j].CreatedAt) })
115		return intents, nil
116	}
117	
118	func (s *Store) FindByRunID(runID string) (*Intent, error) {
119		intents, err := s.List()
120		if err != nil {
121			return nil, err
122		}
123		for i := range intents {
124			if intents[i].RunID == runID {
125				return &intents[i], nil
126			}
127		}
128		return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact run %s: %w", runID, ErrIntentNotFound)
129	}
130	
131	func (s *Store) Update(ctx context.Context, id string, mutate func(*Intent) error) error {
132		if mutate == nil {
133			return fmt.Errorf("artifact update needs a mutation")
134		}
135		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
136			intent, err := s.Get(id)
137			if err != nil {
138				return err
139			}
140			if err := mutate(intent); err != nil {
141				return err
142			}
143			intent.UpdatedAt = s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
144			if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
145				return err
146			}
147			return s.write(*intent)
148		})
149	}
150	
151	func (s *Store) write(intent Intent) error {
152		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o700); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, ".intent-*.tmp")
156		if err != nil {
157			return err
158		}
159		name := tmp.Name()
160		defer os.Remove(name)
161		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
162			tmp.Close()
163			return err
164		}
165		encoder := json.NewEncoder(tmp)
166		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
167		if err := encoder.Encode(intent); err != nil {
168			tmp.Close()
169			return err
170		}
171		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
172			tmp.Close()
173			return err
174		}
175		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
176			return err
177		}
178		return os.Rename(name, s.path(intent.ID))
179	}
180	
181	func ensureJSONEOF(decoder *json.Decoder) error {
182		var extra any
183		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
184			return nil
185		} else if err != nil {
186			return err
187		}
188		return fmt.Errorf("multiple JSON values")
189	}
190	
191	func randomID() string {
192		var raw [12]byte
193		if _, err := rand.Read(raw[:]); err != nil {
194			return fmt.Sprintf("intent-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
195		}
196		return "intent-" + hex.EncodeToString(raw[:])
197	}

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}

49	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAndSpecify(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (PlanSpec, lifecycleObservation, error) {
50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}

60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)

62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)

73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}

98		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":

100		case locator.Branch == "":

141		if selectedRepo != recordedRepo {

144	
145		expectedCheckout := recordedRepo

153			}

164		}

176	func (s *lifecycleService) observeLifecycle(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (lifecycleObservation, error) {

183		}
184		observed.repo = repository
185		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
186		if err != nil {
187			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
188		}
189		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
190		if err != nil {
191			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
192		}
193		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(record.Task.RepoPath)
194		if err != nil {
195			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
196		}
197		if recordedRepo != observed.repoPath {
198			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q", record.Task.RepoPath, recordedRepo, observed.repoPath)}
199		}
200		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
201		if err != nil {
202			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
203		}
204		if requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {

206		}
207		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
208			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
209			if keyErr != nil {

211			}
212			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
213				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository key changed from %q to %q", requestedKey, observed.gitCommonDir)}
214			}
215		}

217		s.observeCheckout(ctx, request, &observed)
218		if observed.hasCheckout() {

223				observed.baseOID, observed.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)

244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)

21	
22	func validateRetireLocator(locator Locator) error {
23		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(locator); err != nil {
24			return err
25		}
26		if locator.Mode == task.ModeWorktree && locator.CheckoutPath != "" && locator.HeadOID == "" {
27			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact linked-checkout HEAD is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
28		}
29		return nil
30	}
31	
32	func (s *lifecycleService) planRetire(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
33		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		if err := validateRetireLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
37			return PlanSpec{}, err
38		}
39		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
40		if err != nil {
41			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
42		}
43		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, *record); err != nil {
44			return PlanSpec{}, err
45		}
46		spec, _, err := s.observeRetire(ctx, request, *record, s.tasks.ListRecords)
47		if err != nil {
48			return PlanSpec{}, err
49		}
50		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
51		if err != nil {
52			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning retirement"}
53		}
54		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
55			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning retirement")
56		}
57		return spec, nil
58	}
59	
60	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRetire(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record, loadTasks taskInventoryLoader) (PlanSpec, destructiveObservation, error) {
61		candidate := record.Task
62		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
63		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == ""
64		var (
65			rt    runtime.Runtime
66			rtErr error
67		)
68		if noCheckout && candidate.RuntimeName == "" && candidate.RuntimeHandle == "" {
69			rt = runtime.None{}
70		} else {
71			rt, rtErr = s.runtimeFor(candidate)
72		}
73		options := request.Options.(RetireOptions)
74		cleanup := retire.Options{
75			CWD: s.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: s.callerPane,
76			CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
77		}
78		observed, err := s.inspectDestructive(ctx, destructiveInspectInput{
79			locator: request.Locator, base: candidate.Base, runtime: rt, rtErr: rtErr, cleanup: cleanup,
80			noCheckout: noCheckout, inspectArtifacts: !noCheckout,
81			inspectTasks: true, loadTasks: loadTasks,
82		})
83		if err != nil {
84			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
85		}
86		return s.retireSpec(request, record, observed), observed, nil
87	}

89	func (s *lifecycleService) retireSpec(request Request, record task.Record, observed destructiveObservation) PlanSpec {
90		options := request.Options.(RetireOptions)
91		candidate := record.Task
92		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
93		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == ""
94		conditions := []Condition{
95			condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
96				"DONE task "+candidate.ID+" revision "+record.Revision, ""),
97			retireRepositoryCondition(observed),
98		}
99		conditions = append(conditions, retireTaskClaimConditions(candidate, observed)...)
100		conditions = append(conditions, retireCheckoutConditions(candidate, observed, noCheckout)...)
101		conditions = append(conditions, retireRefConditions(candidate, observed, noCheckout)...)
102		conditions = append(conditions, retireArtifactCondition(observed, noCheckout))
103		conditions = append(conditions, retireRuntimeConditions(candidate, observed, noCheckout)...)
104		conditions = append(conditions, retireBranchDeletionCondition(candidate, observed, noCheckout, options))
105	
106		var effects []Effect
107		if !noCheckout && observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.cleanupErr == nil && len(observed.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
108			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
109				EffectCloseRuntime, "close eligible runtime sessions covering the checkout", observed.checkout, true, false,
110				map[string]string{"backend": runtimeName(observed.runtime), "sessions": fmt.Sprintf("%d", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions))},
111			))
112		}
113		if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout {
114			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
115				EffectRemoveWorktree, "remove the exact clean linked worktree without force", observed.checkout, true, false,
116				map[string]string{"repo": observed.repoPath, "branch": candidate.Branch, "head": observed.head, "force": "false"},
117			))
118		}
119		if options.DeleteBranch && mode != task.ModeDirect && candidate.Branch != candidate.Base && observed.branchExists {
120			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
121				EffectDeleteBranch, "delete the freshly contained local task branch", candidate.Branch, true, false,
122				map[string]string{"branch-ref": observed.branchRef, "branch-oid": observed.branchOID, "base-ref": observed.baseRef, "base-oid": observed.baseOID},
123			))
124		}
125		effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
126			EffectDeleteTask, "CAS-delete the DONE task record last", candidate.ID, true, false,
127			map[string]string{"expected-revision": record.Revision},
128		))

130		confirmation := Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Retire this DONE task and its eligible local resources?"}

175	// completion handlers. Actions without complete policy implementations remain
176	// unavailable rather than falling back to an unsafe generic executor.
177	func NewLifecycleService(input LifecycleConfig) (*Service, error) {
178		implementation, err := newLifecycleImplementation(input)
179		if err != nil {
180			return nil, err
181		}
182		service := NewService(Handlers{
183			ParkWarm:       implementation.handler(ParkWarm),
184			ParkCold:       implementation.handler(ParkCold),
185			Resume:         implementation.handler(Resume),
186			CompleteDirect: implementation.handler(CompleteDirect),
187			CompleteFF:     implementation.handler(CompleteFF),
188			ReviewHandoff:  implementation.handler(ReviewHandoff),
189			VerifyMerged:   implementation.handler(VerifyMerged),
190			Retire:         implementation.retireHandler(),
191			Adopt:          implementation.adoptHandler(),
192			RemoveCheckout: implementation.removeCheckoutHandler(),
193			RefreshRemote:  implementation.refreshRemoteHandler(),
194		})
195		service.locateTask = implementation.locateExactTask
196		return service, nil
197	}
198	
199	func newLifecycleImplementation(input LifecycleConfig) (*lifecycleService, error) {
200		if input.Tasks == nil {
201			return nil, errors.New("taskflow lifecycle service requires a task store")
202		}
203		if input.Artifacts == nil {
204			return nil, errors.New("taskflow lifecycle service requires an artifact store")
205		}
206		if err := input.Config.Validate(); err != nil {
207			return nil, fmt.Errorf("taskflow lifecycle config: %w", err)
208		}
209	
210		host := strings.TrimSpace(input.Host)
211		if host == "" {
212			host = config.Hostname()
213		}
214		if host == "" || host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
215			return nil, errors.New("taskflow lifecycle host must be normalized")
216		}
217		cwd := input.CWD
218		if cwd == "" {
219			var err error
220			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
221			if err != nil {
222				return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve taskflow caller directory: %w", err)
223			}
224		}
225		callerWorkspace := input.CallerWorkspaceID
226		if callerWorkspace == "" {
227			callerWorkspace = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
228		}
229		callerPane := input.CallerPaneID
230		if callerPane == "" {
231			callerPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
232			if callerPane == "" {
233				callerPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
234			}
235		}
236		clock := input.Clock
237		if clock == nil {
238			clock = time.Now
239		}
240		logf := input.Logf
241		if logf == nil {
242			logf = func(string, ...any) {}
243		}
244	
245		defaultRuntime := input.DefaultRuntime
246		if defaultRuntime == nil {
247			defaultRuntime = func() runtime.Runtime {
248				return configuredRuntime(input.Config, input.Config.Runtime.Backend)
249			}
250		}
251		namedRuntime := input.NamedRuntime
252		if namedRuntime == nil {
253			namedRuntime = func(name string) runtime.Runtime {
254				return configuredRuntime(input.Config, name)
255			}
256		}
257	
258		s := &lifecycleService{
259			cfg: input.Config, tasks: input.Tasks, artifacts: input.Artifacts,
260			defaultRuntime: defaultRuntime, namedRuntime: namedRuntime,
261			host: host, cwd: cwd,
262			callerWorkspace: callerWorkspace, callerPane: callerPane,
263			allowSharedCheckout: input.AllowSharedCheckout,
264			clock:               clock, logf: logf,
265			repoLock: func(ctx context.Context, commonDir string, operation func() error) error {
266				return lockx.WithDir(ctx, filepath.Join(commonDir, "dev-taskflow"), "taskflow repository", operation)
267			},
268			gitDiscover: gitx.Discover,
269			gitStatus:   gitx.StatusOf,
270			gitInProgress: func(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, bool, error) {
271				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
272					return "", false, err
273				}
274				return gitx.InProgress(dir)
275			},
276			gitRun:           gitx.Run,
277			gitRemote:        gitx.Remote,
278			gitRefExists:     gitx.RefExists,
279			gitDefaultBranch: gitx.DefaultBranch,
280			gitWorktrees:     gitx.Worktrees,
281			resolveWorktree:  gitx.ResolveRegisteredWorktree,
282			wipCommit:        gitx.WipCommit,
283			analyzeFinish:    gitx.AnalyzeFinish,
284			commitAll:        gitx.CommitAllChanges,
285			discardAll:       gitx.DiscardAllChanges,
286			isAncestor:       gitIsAncestor,
287			removeWorktree:   gitx.RemoveWorktree,
288			inspectArtifacts: artifact.InspectReadiness,
289			inspectOccupancy: runtime.InspectOccupancy,
290			inspectCleanup:   retire.Inspect,
291			closeAndWait:     retire.CloseAndWait,
292			openRuntime:      openRuntimeSurface,
293			detectForge:      forge.Detect,
294			resolveForge:     forge.For,
295			createPR: func(ctx context.Context, provider forge.Forge, dir string, request forge.PRRequest) (string, error) {
296				if provider == nil {
297					return "", errors.New("create review: no forge provider")
298				}
299				return provider.CreatePR(ctx, dir, request)
300			},
301			queryReview: func(ctx context.Context, provider forge.Forge, dir string, query forge.ReviewQuery) (*forge.Review, error) {
302				if provider == nil {
303					return nil, errors.New("query review: no forge provider")
304				}
305				return forge.QueryReview(ctx, provider, dir, query)
306			},
307			taskCreate: func(tx *task.Tx, candidate *task.Task) (*task.Record, error) {
308				return tx.Create(candidate)
309			},
310			taskUpdate: func(tx *task.Tx, candidate *task.Task, revision string) (*task.Record, error) {
311				return tx.Update(candidate, revision)
312			},
313			taskDelete: func(tx *task.Tx, id, revision string) error {
314				return tx.DeleteIfRevision(id, revision)
315			},
316			canonicalPath: pathx.Canonical,
317		}
318		s.createWorktree = func(ctx context.Context, request wt.CreateRequest) (*wt.CreateResult, error) {
319			manager := &wt.Manager{Cfg: s.cfg, Log: lifecycleLogWriter{s.logf}}
320			return manager.Create(ctx, request)
321		}
322		applyLifecycleHooks(s, input.Hooks)
323		return s, nil
324	}
325	
326	func configuredRuntime(cfg config.Config, name string) runtime.Runtime {
327		rt := runtime.Select(name)
328		if herdr, ok := rt.(*runtime.Herdr); ok {
329			return herdr.WithMetadataSource(cfg.Runtime.MetadataSource)
330		}
```

65	// Store is a directory of one-TOML-file-per-task.
66	//
67	// One file per task, rather than a single registry document, is a deliberate
68	// choice: the state directory is meant to be syncable across machines (it can
69	// simply be a git repo), and a shared central file would conflict on every
70	// parallel edit while separate files merge cleanly.
71	type Store struct{ Dir string }
72	
73	// Tx is a task-store transaction whose caller holds the store's cross-process
74	// lock. It lets a lifecycle operation reload, revalidate and perform its final
75	// conditional write without another dev process changing task intent between
76	// those steps.
77	type Tx struct{ store *Store }
78	
79	// NewStore returns a store rooted at dir.

82	var idUnsafe = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+`)

84	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
85	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
86		clean := func(s string) string {
87			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
88			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
89				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
90			}
91			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
92		}
93		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
94		if r == "" {
95			r = "repo"
96		}
97		if b == "" {
98			b = "branch"
99		}
100		return r + "__" + b
101	}

106	// compatibility upsert; callers that need collision or lost-update protection
107	// should use Create or Update.
108	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {
109		return s.WithLock(context.Background(), func(tx *Tx) error {
110			_, err := tx.Save(t)
111			return err
112		})
113	}

115	// Create atomically writes t only when its derived ID is unused. The caller's

118		var created *Record

181	func (s *Store) listRecordsUnlocked() ([]Record, []Diagnostic, error) {
182		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)

757	func classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err error) RemoteReviewFailureKind {
758		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrAmbiguousReview) {
759			return RemoteReviewFailureAmbiguous
760		}
761		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrMalformedReviewResponse) {
762			return RemoteReviewFailureMalformed
763		}
764		var unsupported *forge.ErrUnsupported
765		if errors.As(err, &unsupported) {
766			return RemoteReviewFailureUnsupported
767		}
768		var missingCLI *forge.ErrNoCLI
769		if errors.As(err, &missingCLI) {
770			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingCLI
771		}
772		var missingExtension *forge.ErrNoExtension
773		if errors.As(err, &missingExtension) {
774			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingExtension
775		}
776		return RemoteReviewFailureProvider
777	}

791		case review.Number <= 0:

795		case review.State == forge.ReviewDraft && !review.Draft:
796			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft flag")
797		case review.State == forge.ReviewOpen && review.Draft:
798			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft state")
799		case !validRemoteReviewURL(review.URL):
800			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "URL")
801		}
802		return nil
803	}

11	func runtimeForTask(app *App, t *task.Task) runtime.Runtime {
12		if t.RuntimeHandle == "" {
13			t.RuntimeName = ""
14			return app.Runtime()
15		}
16		if t.RuntimeName != "" {
17			return app.runtimeNamed(t.RuntimeName)
18		}
19		return app.Runtime()
20	}
21	
22	func setTaskRuntime(t *task.Task, rt runtime.Runtime, opened runtime.OpenResult) {
23		t.RuntimeHandle = persistedRuntimeHandle(rt, opened)
24		if t.RuntimeHandle == "" {
25			t.RuntimeName = ""
26			return
27		}
28		t.RuntimeName = rt.Name()
29	}
30	
31	func clearTaskRuntime(t *task.Task) {
32		t.RuntimeHandle = ""
33		t.RuntimeName = ""
34	}
35	
36	func runtimeHandleCovers(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, handle, checkout string) (bool, error) {
37		if handle == "" || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
38			return false, nil
39		}
40		sessions, err := rt.List(ctx)
41		if err != nil {
42			return false, err
43		}
44		for _, session := range sessions {
45			if session.Handle == handle && session.Covers(checkout) {
46				return true, nil
47			}
48		}
49		return false, nil
50	}
51	
52	// closeTaskRuntime validates an opaque persisted handle before sending it back
53	// to its recorded backend. A stale handle is cleared without being fed to a
54	// different backend; a close error leaves both provenance fields intact.
55	func closeTaskRuntime(ctx context.Context, app *App, t *task.Task, checkout string) (runtime.Runtime, bool, error) {
56		rt := runtimeForTask(app, t)
57		if t.RuntimeHandle == "" {
58			return rt, false, nil
59		}
60		live, err := runtimeHandleCovers(ctx, rt, t.RuntimeHandle, checkout)
61		if err != nil {
62			return rt, false, fmt.Errorf("validate %s runtime session %s: %w", rt.Name(), t.RuntimeHandle, err)
63		}
64		if !live {
65			if t.RuntimeName == "" {
66				return rt, false, fmt.Errorf("legacy runtime handle %s has no backend provenance and is not live in %s; reconcile it before cleanup", t.RuntimeHandle, rt.Name())
67			}
68			clearTaskRuntime(t)
69			return rt, false, nil
70		}
71		if err := rt.Close(ctx, t.RuntimeHandle); err != nil {
72			return rt, false, err
73		}
74		clearTaskRuntime(t)
75		return rt, true, nil
76	}
77

136		return s.adoptSpec(request, observed), observed, nil
137	}
138	
139	func appendAdoptIDClaim(observed *destructiveObservation, taskID string) {
140		if observed == nil || taskID == "" {
141			return
142		}
143		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
144			if record.Task.ID != taskID {
145				continue
146			}
147			for index := range observed.taskClaims {
148				if observed.taskClaims[index].ID == taskID {
149					if !strings.Contains(observed.taskClaims[index].Reason, "derived task ID") {
150						observed.taskClaims[index].Reason += " and derived task ID"
151					}
152					sortAdoptClaims(observed.taskClaims)
153					return
154				}
155			}
156			observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
157				ID: taskID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "derived task ID",
158			})
159			sortAdoptClaims(observed.taskClaims)
160			return
161		}
162	}
163	
164	func sortAdoptClaims(claims []destructiveTaskClaim) {
165		sort.Slice(claims, func(i, j int) bool {
166			if claims[i].ID != claims[j].ID {
167				return claims[i].ID < claims[j].ID
168			}
169			return claims[i].Reason < claims[j].Reason
170		})
171	}
172	
173	func deriveAdoptState(observed adoptObservation) (task.State, string, string, string) {
174		rt := observed.runtime
175		switch {
176		case observed.runtimeErr != nil:
177			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend resolution failed; adoption remains WARM"
178		case rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "":
179			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
180		case rt.Name() == "none":
181			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime none leaves session and recognized-agent evidence unobserved; adoption remains WARM"
182		case !observed.runtimeAvailable:
183			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime backend is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
184		case !observed.worktreeFound:
185			return task.Warm, "", "", "exact checkout is unavailable; adoption remains WARM"
186		case adoptStrictOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) != nil:
187			return task.Warm, "", "", "strict runtime occupancy is not ready; adoption remains WARM"
188		case !observed.occupancy.SessionList.Observed():
189			return task.Warm, "", "", "runtime sessions were not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
190		case !observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed():
191			return task.Warm, "", "", "recognized-agent activity was not freshly observed; adoption remains WARM"
192		case len(observed.occupancy.Sessions) != 1:
193			return task.Warm, "", "", fmt.Sprintf("fresh runtime coverage contains %d sessions, not exactly one; adoption remains WARM", len(observed.occupancy.Sessions))
194		case len(observed.occupancy.Agents) != 0:
195			return task.Warm, "", "", "a recognized agent occupies the checkout; adoption remains WARM"
196		}
197	
198		session := observed.occupancy.Sessions[0]
199		handle := session.Runtime.Handle
200		if strings.TrimSpace(handle) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(handle) != handle || strings.ContainsRune(handle, '\x00') {
201			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session has no stable nonempty handle; adoption remains WARM"
202		}
203		if !adoptSessionShellOnly(session) {
204			return task.Warm, "", "", "the sole covering runtime session is not shell-only; adoption remains WARM"
205		}
206		return task.Hot, rt.Name(), handle, "exactly one freshly observed shell-only runtime session covers the checkout with stable handle " + handle
207	}
208	
209	func adoptStrictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
210		if occupancyErr := strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err); occupancyErr != nil {
211			return occupancyErr
212		}
213		var blockers []string
214		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
215			// OccupancySession.Panes contains only panes whose live cwd covers the
216			// checkout. A mixed session may also host an unrelated agent elsewhere;
217			// that agent is not a writer claim on this checkout.
218			for _, pane := range session.Panes {
219				if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) == "" && strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) == "" {
220					continue
221				}
222				if occupancy.CallerPaneID != "" && pane.ID == occupancy.CallerPaneID {
223					continue
224				}
225				status := strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus)
226				if status == "" {
227					status = "unknown"
228				}
229				blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent pane %s (%s)", pane.ID, status))
230			}
231		}
232		if len(blockers) > 0 {
233			return fmt.Errorf("checkout is occupied by %s", strings.Join(blockers, ", "))
234		}
235		return nil
236	}
237	
238	func adoptSessionShellOnly(session runtime.OccupancySession) bool {
239		if strings.TrimSpace(session.Runtime.AgentStatus) != "" || len(session.Runtime.AgentSessions) != 0 {
240			return false
241		}
242		panes := session.Runtime.Panes
243		if len(panes) == 0 {
244			panes = session.Panes
245		}
246		for _, pane := range panes {
247			if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) != "" {
248				return false
249			}
250		}
251		return true
252	}
253	
254	func (s *lifecycleService) adoptSpec(request Request, observed adoptObservation) PlanSpec {
255		conditions := []Condition{retireRepositoryCondition(observed.destructiveObservation)}
256		conditions = append(conditions, adoptIdentityConditions(observed.destructiveObservation)...)
257		conditions = append(conditions, adoptBaseCondition(observed))
258		conditions = append(conditions, adoptTaskInventoryConditions(observed.destructiveObservation)...)
259		conditions = append(conditions, adoptRuntimeConditions(observed)...)
260		conditions = append(conditions, adoptStateCondition(request.Options.(AdoptOptions), observed))
261		conditions = append(conditions, condition(
262			ConditionOwner, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
263			"adoption assigns checkout ownership to host "+s.host, "",
264		))
265	
266		details := map[string]string{
267			"id": observed.taskID, "repo": observed.candidate.Repo,
268			"repo-path": observed.candidate.RepoPath, "checkout": observed.candidate.WorktreePath,
269			"branch": observed.candidate.Branch, "head": observed.locator.HeadOID,

75	
76	## Checkout modes
77	
78	A task records intent; it does not always require a linked worktree.
79	
80	| Mode | Use | Lifecycle limit |
81	|---|---|---|
82	| direct | one small change in the canonical checkout | HOT ↔ WARM; canonical checkout cannot be removed |
83	| branch-only | isolated history without a second directory | can go COLD after push and switching the canonical checkout away |
84	| worktree | independent mutation, parallel streams, durable feature work | full lifecycle |
85	
86	The mode is selected by collision and recovery needs, not by ceremony.
87	
88	## Runtime is deliberately lossy
89	
90	`runtime.Runtime` exposes `Open`, `Close`, `List`, and `Annotate`. `auto` selects Herdr when available, then tmux, then Zellij, then the always-available `none` backend. Closing any backend must not remove the checkout, branch, or task entry.
91	
92	This separation is why rebooting, closing a multiplexer, or changing runtime backend does not abandon work. `dev sweep` can compare the registry with live Git/runtime facts and report drift.
93	
94	## Cross-machine handoff
95	
96	The branch is the transport boundary:
97	
98	```bash
99	# machine A
100	dev park --cold --push
101	
102	# machine B
103	dev resume <task> --fetch
104	```
```

91	
92	`runtime.Runtime` 提供 `Open`、`Close`、`List` 與 `Annotate`。`auto` 會依序選 Herdr、tmux、Zellij，最後使用永遠可用的 `none` backend。關閉任何 backend 都不能移除 checkout、branch 或 task entry。

94	`none` 只表示沒有可觀察的 multiplexer backend，不等於已證明「沒有 session 或 agent」。需要 occupancy/absence proof 的 guarded action 必須保留 unobserved evidence；`dev flow` 不會把它顯示成已關閉，也不提供 `--assume-no-runtime` expert override。
95	
96	因此 reboot、關閉 multiplexer 或更換 runtime backend 都不代表放棄工作。`dev sweep` 能比較 registry 與即時 Git/runtime facts 並回報 drift。

443			rt = s.namedRuntime(candidate.RuntimeName)
444			if rt == nil {
445				return nil, fmt.Errorf("recorded runtime backend %q is unavailable", candidate.RuntimeName)
446			}
447			if rt.Name() != candidate.RuntimeName {
448				return nil, fmt.Errorf("recorded runtime backend %q resolved to %q", candidate.RuntimeName, rt.Name())
449			}
450		} else {
451			rt = s.defaultRuntime()
452		}
453		if rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "" {
454			return nil, errors.New("taskflow runtime resolver returned no backend")
455		}

 description: Understand dev-cli as durable Git history, scoped intent and catalog state, repository quick-note sidecars, disposable worktrees, and replaceable runtimes.

 # Mental model and lifecycle
 
 `dev` treats a unit of work as a **change stream** whose durable identity is its Git branch. The checkout and runtime are replaceable projections of that stream.
 
 ## Four responsibilities
 
 ```text
 Git remote + branch  durable history and cross-machine handoff
         ↓
 worktree             local files, index, and checked-out HEAD
         ↓
 runtime              Herdr workspace, tmux session, or current shell
         ↓
 dev registry         human intent and reconstruction metadata
 ```
 
 Sidecar state has deliberately separate scopes:
 
 - each task stores checkout mode, repository/branch/base, lifecycle state, owner host, next executable action, task context, runtime hint, and timestamps;
 - the catalog stores stable repository/Try identity, tags, one metadata summary, experiment lifecycle, and host-local locations;
 - configured `paths.state_dir/notes` stores multiple durable Markdown observations keyed by catalog repository ID;
 - `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` is only the rebuildable full-text index for those Markdown files.
 
 The catalog ID keeps a quick note attached across linked worktrees, symlink indexes, path moves, and synchronized host state. `dev` does not itself synchronize notes or catalog files. Live Git status, ahead/behind, and runtime availability are derived again instead of treated as authoritative cached truth.
 
 ## The four lifecycle states
 
 | State | Git and checkout | Runtime | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|---|
 | 🔥 `hot` | branch plus checkout | open | active now |
 | 🌤 `warm` | branch plus checkout kept | closed | likely to return within days |
 | ❄️ `cold` | committed and pushed branch; worktree absent | none | paused and reconstructible elsewhere |
-| ✅ `done` | integrated | none | retained until cleanup reaps the entry |
+| ✅ `done` | integrated; branch/checkout may remain | may remain open | MERGED, pending explicit retirement |
 
 ```mermaid
 flowchart TD
     accTitle: dev-cli lifecycle states
-    accDescr: Tasks move between HOT, WARM, and eligible COLD states; direct or locally integrated work reaches DONE; review leaves the current state unchanged; and sweep reaps only an already completed entry.
+    accDescr: Tasks move between HOT, WARM, and eligible COLD states; direct or verified integrated work reaches DONE while resources remain; review leaves the current state unchanged; and external retirement reaps only an already completed entry.
 
     Start["dev start"] --> Hot["HOT"]
     Hot -->|dev park --next| Warm["WARM"]
     Warm -->|dev resume| Hot
     Hot -->|branch/worktree: dev park --cold --push| Cold["COLD"]
     Warm -->|branch/worktree: dev park --cold --push| Cold
     Cold -->|dev resume --fetch| Hot
 
     Hot -->|direct: dev done| Done["DONE"]
     Warm -->|direct: dev done| Done
     Hot -->|branch/worktree: dev done --ff| Done
     Warm -->|branch/worktree: dev done --ff| Done
 
     Hot -.->|branch/worktree: dev done --pr; state unchanged| Review["push / review handoff"]
     Warm -.->|branch/worktree: dev done --pr; state unchanged| Review
     Review -.->|feedback: dev resume if WARM| Hot
 
-    Done -->|dev sweep: report| Report["cleanup candidate"]
-    Report -->|dev sweep --apply| Reaped["entry reaped"]
+    Done -->|dev retire from outside target| Reaped["RETIRED: resources cleaned; entry reaped"]
+    Done -.->|dev sweep: report candidate| Report["cleanup report"]
+    Report -.->|approved apply| Reaped
 ```
 
-For branch/worktree tasks, `dev done --pr` is intentionally not a HOT/WARM → DONE transition. It hands off a pushed branch (opening review when supported) and leaves state and cleanup unchanged; remote merge reconciliation remains manual.
+For branch/worktree tasks, `dev done --pr` is intentionally not a HOT/WARM → DONE transition. It hands off a pushed branch (opening review when supported) and leaves state and cleanup unchanged. `dev flow` can manually query portable review existence/state/draft/URL evidence, but never infers DONE; integration still needs an explicit local ancestry proof.
+
+`dev flow [repo]` makes the underlying hybrid model visible: persisted intent,
+typed live observations, and a revision-bound guarded plan are distinct. Errors,
+unknowns, and stale facts do not become false; Apply revalidates exact task/Git/
+worktree/runtime/artifact identity before mutation. See [Repository lifecycle
+flow](../guides/repository-flow.md).
 
 ## Checkout modes
 
 A task records intent; it does not always require a linked worktree.
 
 | Mode | Use | Lifecycle limit |
 |---|---|---|
 | direct | one small change in the canonical checkout | HOT ↔ WARM; canonical checkout cannot be removed |
 | branch-only | isolated history without a second directory | can go COLD after push and switching the canonical checkout away |
 | worktree | independent mutation, parallel streams, durable feature work | full lifecycle |
 
 The mode is selected by collision and recovery needs, not by ceremony.
 
 ## Runtime is deliberately lossy
 
 `runtime.Runtime` exposes `Open`, `Close`, `List`, and `Annotate`. `auto` selects Herdr when available, then tmux, then Zellij, then the always-available `none` backend. Closing any backend must not remove the checkout, branch, or task entry.
 
 This separation is why rebooting, closing a multiplexer, or changing runtime backend does not abandon work. `dev sweep` can compare the registry with live Git/runtime facts and report drift.
 
 ## Cross-machine handoff
 
 The branch is the transport boundary:
 
 ```bash
 # machine A
 dev park --cold --push
 
 # machine B
 dev resume <task> --fetch
 ```
 
 One writer owns a branch at a time. If two machines or agents need to mutate the same feature concurrently, split the change stream and integrate afterwards.

 # 心智模型與生命週期
 
 !!! note "術語規則"
     有公認中文譯名且本文使用中文時，首次以「中文 (English original)」呈現。產品名稱與 Git／CLI／agent domain terms 可直接保留英文；沒有公認譯名不得自創。程式碼、API／tool 名稱、CLI flag、套件名與路徑一律不翻譯。
 
 `dev` 把一個工作單位視為變更流 (change stream)，而它的持久身分是 Git branch。Checkout 與執行環境 (runtime) 都只是可替換的投影。
 
 ## 四種責任
 
 ```text
 Git remote + branch  持久 history 與跨機器 handoff
         ↓
 worktree             本機 files、index 與 checked-out HEAD
         ↓
 runtime              Herdr workspace、tmux session 或目前 shell
         ↓
 dev registry         人類意圖與重建 metadata
 ```
 
 Sidecar state 刻意分成不同 scope：
 
 - 每個 task 保存 checkout mode、repository/branch/base、lifecycle state、owner host、下一個 executable action、task context、runtime hint 與 timestamps；
 - catalog 保存穩定的 repository/Try identity、tags、一筆 metadata summary、experiment lifecycle 與 host-local locations；
 - configured `paths.state_dir/notes` 保存多筆 durable Markdown observations，並以 catalog repository ID 為 key；
 - `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` 只是這些 Markdown files 的可重建 full-text index。
 
 Catalog ID 讓 quick note 在 linked worktrees、symlink indexes、path moves 與已同步的 host state 之間維持 attachment。`dev` 本身不會同步 notes 或 catalog files。即時 Git status、ahead/behind 與 runtime availability 會重新推導，不會被當成權威 cache。
 
 ## 四個 lifecycle state
 
 | State | Git 與 checkout | Runtime | 意義 |
 |---|---|---|---|
 | 🔥 `hot` | branch 加 checkout | 開啟 | 正在處理 |
 | 🌤 `warm` | 保留 branch 與 checkout | 關閉 | 幾天內會回來 |
 | ❄️ `cold` | branch 已 commit、push；worktree 不存在 | 無 | 已暫停，可在別處重建 |
-| ✅ `done` | 已整合 | 無 | 等待 cleanup 回收 entry |
+| ✅ `done` | 已具名的整合證據；checkout/branch 可能仍存在 | 可能仍存在 | MERGED，等待獨立 Retire cleanup |
 
 ```mermaid
 flowchart TD
     accTitle: dev-cli lifecycle states
-    accDescr: Task 會在 HOT、WARM 與符合條件的 COLD state 之間移動；direct 或本機整合完成的工作會進入 DONE；review 不改變目前 state；sweep 只回收已完成的 entry。
+    accDescr: Task 會在 HOT、WARM 與符合條件的 COLD state 之間移動；direct completion、本機 fast-forward 或具名 ancestry verification 會進入 DONE；review 不改變目前 state；Retire 才回收 local resources 與 task entry。
 
     Start["dev start"] --> Hot["HOT"]
     Hot -->|dev park --next| Warm["WARM"]
     Warm -->|dev resume| Hot
     Hot -->|branch/worktree: dev park --cold --push| Cold["COLD"]
     Warm -->|branch/worktree: dev park --cold --push| Cold
     Cold -->|dev resume --fetch| Hot
 
-    Hot -->|direct: dev done| Done["DONE"]
+    Hot -->|direct: dev done| Done["DONE / MERGED"]
     Warm -->|direct: dev done| Done
     Hot -->|branch/worktree: dev done --ff| Done
     Warm -->|branch/worktree: dev done --ff| Done
 
     Hot -.->|branch/worktree: dev done --pr；state 不變| Review["push / review handoff"]
     Warm -.->|branch/worktree: dev done --pr；state 不變| Review
     Review -.->|feedback：若為 WARM 先 dev resume| Hot
+    Review -->|dev done --merged --base-ref REF| Done
 
-    Done -->|dev sweep：只回報| Report["cleanup candidate"]
-    Report -->|dev sweep --apply| Reaped["已回收 entry"]
+    Done -->|dev retire；或先由 dev sweep 回報| Retire["guarded Retire plan"]
+    Retire --> Reaped["RETIRED：runtime/worktree/task 已回收"]
 ```
 
-對 branch/worktree task 而言，`dev done --pr` 刻意不是 HOT/WARM → DONE transition。它會 handoff 已 push 的 branch（支援時建立 review），並保留原 state 與 cleanup 狀態；remote merge reconciliation 目前仍需手動處理。
+對 branch/worktree task 而言，`dev done --pr` 刻意不是 HOT/WARM → DONE transition。它會 handoff 已 push 的 branch（支援時建立 review），並保留原 state 與 cleanup 狀態。外部 merge 不會被自動推斷；請以 `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref>` 或 `dev flow` 的 Verify Merged action 明確證明 named ancestry，再以獨立 Retire plan cleanup。
+
+## Intent、evidence 與 action readiness
+
+Lifecycle state 只保存人類意圖，不會吸收所有外部事實。`dev flow [repo]` 把三層並列：recorded `HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE` intent、具 freshness 的 Git/runtime/agent/artifact/remote evidence，以及綁定 exact identity 的 guarded plan。`READY` 是某份 plan 的 action readiness；`REVIEW`、`MERGED` 與 `RETIRED` 是 result milestones，皆不是額外 TOML state。UNKNOWN/ERROR evidence 不會被當成 clean、closed 或 absent。完整操作方式見 [Repository Flow 預覽](../guides/repository-flow.zh-TW.md)。
 
 ## Checkout mode
 
 Task 記錄的是意圖，不一定要有 linked worktree。
 
 | Mode | 適用情境 | Lifecycle 限制 |
 |---|---|---|
 | direct | canonical checkout 中的一個小變更 | HOT ↔ WARM；canonical checkout 不能移除 |
 | branch-only | 只需要 history isolation，不需要第二個 directory | push 且 canonical checkout 切離後可進 COLD |
 | worktree | 獨立寫入、平行 stream、長期 feature | 完整 lifecycle |
 
 選擇 mode 的依據是碰撞與復原需求，不是儀式感。
 
 ## Runtime 刻意是可丟失的
 
 `runtime.Runtime` 提供 `Open`、`Close`、`List` 與 `Annotate`。`auto` 會依序選 Herdr、tmux、Zellij，最後使用永遠可用的 `none` backend。關閉任何 backend 都不能移除 checkout、branch 或 task entry。
 
+`none` 只表示沒有可觀察的 multiplexer backend，不等於已證明「沒有 session 或 agent」。需要 occupancy/absence proof 的 guarded action 必須保留 unobserved evidence；`dev flow` 不會把它顯示成已關閉，也不提供 `--assume-no-runtime` expert override。
+
 因此 reboot、關閉 multiplexer 或更換 runtime backend 都不代表放棄工作。`dev sweep` 能比較 registry 與即時 Git/runtime facts 並回報 drift。
 
 ## 跨機器 handoff
 
 Branch 是傳輸邊界：
 
 ```bash
 # machine A
 dev park --cold --push
 
 # machine B
 dev resume <task> --fetch
 ```
 
 每個 branch 同時只有一位 writer。若兩台機器或兩個 agent 必須同時修改同一 feature，應拆成不同 change stream，再於之後整合。

590	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRepository(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
591		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
592		if err != nil {
593			return staleBoundary("canonical repository is no longer discoverable: " + err.Error())
594		}
595		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
596		if err != nil {
597			return staleBoundary("canonical repository path is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
598		}
599		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
600		if err != nil {
601			return staleBoundary("Git common directory is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
602		}
603		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
604			return staleBoundary("canonical repository or Git common directory changed")
605		}
606		return nil
607	}
608	
609	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateGitBaseline(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
610		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
611		if err != nil {
612			return staleBoundary("exact worktree registration changed: " + err.Error())
613		}
614		if registered != observed.worktree {
615			return staleBoundary("exact worktree path, branch, HEAD, Main, locked, or prunable flags changed")
616		}
617		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
618		if err != nil {
619			return staleBoundary("Git status observation changed: " + err.Error())
620		}
621		if !sameStatus(status, observed.status) {
622			return staleBoundary("Git status, branch, upstream, ahead, behind, dirty, or conflict evidence changed")
623		}
624		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
625		if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(head) != observed.head {
626			return staleBoundary("checkout HEAD changed")
627		}
628		baseOID, baseErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
629		upstreamOID, upstreamErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
630		if errorString(baseErr) != errorString(observed.baseOIDErr) || baseOID != observed.baseOID ||
631			errorString(upstreamErr) != errorString(observed.upstreamOIDErr) || upstreamOID != observed.upstreamOID {
632			return staleBoundary("base or upstream ref OID changed")
633		}
634		operation, active, err := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
635		if err != nil || operation != observed.operation || active != observed.inProgress {
636			return staleBoundary("Git operation evidence changed")
637		}
638		return nil
639	}

641	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, expectedBranch string) error {
642		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
643		if err != nil {
644			return err
645		}
646		if registered.Path != observed.checkout || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
647			return errors.New("checkout path or Git common directory changed")
648		}
649		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !registered.IsLinkedWorktree() {
650			return errors.New("worktree task no longer resolves to a linked checkout")
651		}
652		if observed.mode != task.ModeWorktree && (!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare) {
653			return errors.New("canonical task no longer resolves to the main checkout")
654		}
655		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
656		if err != nil {
657			return err
658		}
659		if status.Detached || expectedBranch != "" && status.Branch != expectedBranch || registered.Worktree.Branch != status.Branch {
660			return fmt.Errorf("checkout branch changed: registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", registered.Worktree.Branch, status.Branch, expectedBranch)
661		}
662		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
663		if err != nil {
664			return err
665		}
666		head = strings.TrimSpace(head)
667		if registered.Worktree.Head != head {
668			return fmt.Errorf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", registered.Worktree.Head, head)
669		}
670		baseOID, baseOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
671		upstreamOID, upstreamOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
672		operation, active, operationErr := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
673		if operationErr != nil {
674			return operationErr
675		}
676		observed.worktree = registered
677		observed.status = status
678		observed.statusErr = nil
679		observed.head = head
680		observed.headErr = nil
681		observed.baseOID = baseOID
682		observed.baseOIDErr = baseOIDErr
683		observed.upstreamOID = upstreamOID
684		observed.upstreamOIDErr = upstreamOIDErr
685		observed.operation = operation
686		observed.inProgress = active
687		observed.operationErr = nil
688		return nil
689	}

1	// Package gitx wraps the git porcelain commands dev depends on. Every helper
2	// shells out to git rather than linking a Go implementation: git is already a
3	// hard dependency, its porcelain formats are stable and documented, and this
4	// keeps dev's behaviour identical to what the user sees when they run the same
5	// command by hand.
6	package gitx
7	
8	import (
9		"bytes"
10		"context"
11		"errors"
12		"fmt"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16	)
17	
18	// ErrNotARepo is returned when a directory is not inside a git working tree.
19	var ErrNotARepo = errors.New("not a git repository")
20	
21	// Error carries the failing command and git's own stderr, which is almost
22	// always more useful than the exit status alone.
23	type Error struct {
24		Args   []string
25		Dir    string
26		Stderr string
27		Err    error
28	}
29	
30	func (e *Error) Error() string {
31		msg := strings.TrimSpace(e.Stderr)
32		if msg == "" {
33			msg = e.Err.Error()
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("git %s: %s", strings.Join(e.Args, " "), msg)
36	}
37	
38	func (e *Error) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
39	
40	// run executes git in dir and returns trimmed stdout.
41	func run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
42		return runEnv(ctx, dir, nil, args...)
43	}
44	
45	// runEnv executes git with task-scoped environment overrides. It is used for
46	// alternate-index analysis that must never touch the user's real index.
47	func runEnv(ctx context.Context, dir string, overrides []string, args ...string) (string, error) {
48		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than
49		// octal-escaped, which matters for the Chinese-named files in these repos.
50		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
51		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
52		cmd.Dir = dir
53		if len(overrides) > 0 {
54			keys := make(map[string]bool, len(overrides))
55			for _, override := range overrides {
56				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(override, "=")
57				keys[key] = true
58			}
59			env := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+len(overrides))
60			for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
61				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
62				if !keys[key] {
63					env = append(env, entry)
64				}
65			}
66			env = append(env, overrides...)
67			cmd.Env = env
68		}
69		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
70		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
71		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
72		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
73			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
74			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {
75				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", dir, ErrNotARepo)
76			}
77			return "", gerr
78		}
79		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
80	}
81	
82	// Run executes an arbitrary git command in dir. Exported for the few callers
83	// (park's wip commit, done's merge) that need a one-off command.
84	func Run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
85		return run(ctx, dir, args...)
86	}
87	
88	// lines splits git output into non-empty lines.
89	func lines(s string) []string {
90		if s == "" {
91			return nil
92		}
93		out := strings.Split(s, "\n")
94		filtered := out[:0]
95		for _, l := range out {
96			if l != "" {
97				filtered = append(filtered, l)
98			}
99		}
100		return filtered
101	}
102	
103	// nulLines splits NUL-delimited git output (-z forms).
104	func nulLines(s string) []string {
105		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\x00")
106		if s == "" {
107			return nil
108		}
109		return strings.Split(s, "\x00")
110	}
111

708	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation, allowFetchedRefs bool) error {
709		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
710		if err != nil {
711			return staleBoundary("repository became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
712		}
713		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
714		if err != nil {
715			return staleBoundary("repository main path became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
716		}
717		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
718		if err != nil {
719			return staleBoundary("Git common directory became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
720		}
721		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
722			return staleBoundary("repository identity changed before review query")
723		}
724		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
725		kind, repositoryIdentity := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
726		if remoteURL != observed.remoteURL || kind != observed.providerKind || repositoryIdentity != observed.providerRepository {
727			return staleBoundary("remote URL or provider repository identity changed before review query")
728		}
729		if observed.provider == nil || observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind {
730			return staleBoundary("review provider identity changed before query")
731		}
732		if _, ok := observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier); !ok {
733			return staleBoundary("review provider capability changed before query")
734		}
735		if !observed.provider.Available() {
736			return staleBoundary("review provider CLI became unavailable before query")
737		}
738		if !allowFetchedRefs {
739			freshRefs := s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
740			if remoteRefsAuthority(freshRefs) != remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs) {
741				return staleBoundary("local or remote-tracking ref authority changed before query")
742			}
743		}
744		return nil
745	}

13	func guardSharedCheckout(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout string) error {
14		if app.allowSharedCheckout {
15			return nil
16		}
17		reportedPane := ""
18		if rt != nil {
19			switch rt.Name() {
20			case "herdr":
21				reportedPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
22			case "tmux":
23				reportedPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
24			}
25		}
26		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
27			Profile:      runtime.OccupancyStrict,
28			CallerPaneID: reportedPane,
29		})
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("check live occupancy before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
32		}
33		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
34			return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
35		}
36		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("classify live runtime coverage before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionCoverageErr)
38		}
39		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("list live runtime sessions before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionList.Err)
41		}
42		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
44		}
45	
46		var occupied []string
47		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
48			if !agent.Blocking {
49				continue
50			}
51			activity := agent.Activity
52			label := activity.Agent
53			if activity.Name != "" {
54				label = activity.Name
55			}
56			if label == "" {
57				label = "agent"
58			}
59			occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, activity.PaneID))
60		}
61		if len(occupied) == 0 {
62			return nil
63		}
64		return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
65			config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
66	}

68	// checkoutAgentActivities returns recognized agents whose reported cwd resolves
69	// to the same canonical Git worktree root as checkout. A pane is excluded only
70	// when its exact ID matches excludePane; lifecycle state never makes it free.
71	func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {
72		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{Profile: runtime.OccupancyStrict})
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
77			return nil, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err
78		}
79		out := make([]runtime.AgentActivity, 0, len(evidence.Agents))
80		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
81			if excludePane == "" || agent.Activity.PaneID != excludePane {
82				out = append(out, agent.Activity)
83			}
84		}
85		return out, nil
86	}

307	func (m Model) updatePicker(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
308		switch message.String() {
309		case "q", "ctrl+c":

343		switch message.String() {

347			m.filterActive = false

349			m.filter.SetValue("")

365		switch message.String() {
366		case "q", "ctrl+c":
367			return m.quit()
368		case "esc":

371			m.overlay = overlayNone
372			return m.beginRepositoryList()

381		case "tab":

383		case "shift+tab":
384			m.focus = FocusPane((int(m.focus) + 2) % 3)
385		case "?":
386			m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
387			m.overlay = overlayHelp
388		case "r":
389			return m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
390		case "R":
391			return m.openRemoteMenu()
392		case "enter":
393			choice, ok := m.currentAction()
394			if !ok {
395				return m, nil
396			}
397			return m.beginPlan(choice)
398		}
399		return m, nil
400	}

402	func (m Model) updateApplying(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
403		switch message.String() {
404		case "q", "ctrl+c":
405			m.queuedQuit = true
406			m.status = "quit queued; waiting for Apply to finish"
407		case "r", "R":
408			m.queuedRefresh = true
409			m.status = "refresh queued; waiting for Apply to finish"
410		default:
411			m.status = "Apply is running; navigation is disabled"
412		}
413		return m, nil
414	}
