514			writer.addString("squash-commit", value.SquashCommit)
515			writer.addBool("push-base", value.PushBase)
516		case RetireOptions:
517			writer.addBool("delete-branch", value.DeleteBranch)
518			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
519		case AdoptOptions:
520			writer.addString("mode", string(value.Mode))
521			writer.addString("state", string(value.State))
522			writer.addString("name", value.Name)
523			writer.addString("base", value.Base)

525			writer.addString("next", value.Next)
526			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
527			writer.addStrings("tags", value.Tags.values)
528		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
529			writer.addBool("discard-dirty", value.DiscardDirty)
530			writer.addBool("require-contained", value.RequireContained)
531			writer.addString("containment-base", value.ContainmentBase)
532			writer.addBool("delete-contained-branch", value.DeleteContainedBranch)
533			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
534		case RefreshRemoteOptions:
535			writer.addBool("fetch-refs", value.FetchRefs)
536			writer.addBool("query-review", value.QueryReview)
537		case ReconcileOptions:
538			writer.addString("name", value.Name)
539			writer.addFields("parameters", value.Parameters)
540		}
541	}

543	func appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer *identityWriter, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string, push bool) {
544		writer.addString("dirty", string(dirty))
545		writer.addString("commit-message", message)
546		writer.addBool("push", push)

551		writer.addBool("assume-no-runtime", assumeNoRuntime)
552		writer.addInt64("timeout", int64(timeout))

254	func (e *executionState) run(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error)) error {
255		step := StepResult{Effect: effect.Clone(), Status: StepAttempted, StartedAt: e.service.now()}
256		detail, err := operation()
257		step.FinishedAt = e.service.now()
258		step.Detail = detail
259		if err != nil {
260			step.Status = StepFailed
261			step.Failure = err.Error()
262			e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
263			return err
264		}
265		step.Status = StepCompleted
266		e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
267		return nil
268	}
269	
270	func (e *executionState) runWarning(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error), warningPrefix string) {
271		err := e.run(effect, operation)
272		if err != nil {
273			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, warningPrefix+": "+err.Error())
274		}
275	}
276	
277	func (e *executionState) result() Result {
278		spec := ResultSpec{
279			Steps: e.steps, Warnings: e.warnings, Recovery: e.recovery,
280			PartialSuccess: e.partial,
281			Milestone:      e.milestone, Handoff: e.handoff, Remote: e.remote, FreshSnapshotRef: e.snapshot,
282		}
283		for _, step := range e.steps {
284			if step.Status == StepCompleted {
285				spec.PartialSuccess = true
286				break
287			}
288		}
289		if len(e.steps) > 0 && e.steps[len(e.steps)-1].Status == StepCompleted &&
290			(e.snapshot != "" || e.remote != nil) && len(e.recovery) == 0 {
291			// Successful completion is not partial merely because it had effects.
292			// Remote refresh is intentionally run-local and therefore completes with
293			// structured data rather than a persisted snapshot reference.
294			spec.PartialSuccess = false
295		}
296		return NewResult(spec)
297	}

476	func occupancyObservationError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
477		if err != nil {
478			return err
479		}
480		if occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
481			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current %s runtime pane: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.CurrentPane.Err)
482		}
483		if occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
484			return fmt.Errorf("classify %s checkout coverage: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.SessionCoverageErr)
485		}
486		if occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil {
487			return fmt.Errorf("list %s runtime sessions: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.SessionList.Err)
488		}
489		if occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
490			return fmt.Errorf("list %s recognized agents: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err)
491		}
492		return nil
493	}
494	
495	func strictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
496		if observationErr := occupancyObservationError(occupancy, err); observationErr != nil {
497			return observationErr
498		}
499		var blockers []string
500		for _, agent := range occupancy.Agents {
501			if !agent.Blocking {
502				continue
503			}
504			label := agent.Activity.Name
505			if label == "" {
506				label = agent.Activity.Agent
507			}
508			if label == "" {
509				label = "agent"
510			}
511			blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, agent.Activity.PaneID))
512		}
513		if len(blockers) > 0 {
514			return fmt.Errorf("checkout is occupied by %s", strings.Join(blockers, ", "))
515		}
516		return nil
517	}
518	
519	func (s *lifecycleService) writerOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
520		if s.allowSharedCheckout {
521			return occupancyObservationError(occupancy, err)
522		}
523		return strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err)
524	}

532				return true
533			}
534		}

536	}

19	var exactTaskID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`)
20	
21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}
48	
49	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAndSpecify(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (PlanSpec, lifecycleObservation, error) {
50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:
64			spec = s.resumeSpec(request, observed)
65		case CompleteDirect:
66			spec = s.completeDirectSpec(request, observed)
67		case CompleteFF:
68			spec = s.completeFFSpec(request, observed)
69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}
76		return spec, observed, nil
77	}
78	
79	func (s *lifecycleService) freshPlan(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (Plan, lifecycleObservation, error) {
80		spec, observed, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, record)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Plan{}, observed, err
83		}
84		plan, err := BuildPlan(request, spec)
85		return plan, observed, err
86	}
87	
88	func validateLifecycleLocator(locator Locator) error {
89		switch {
90		case locator.TaskID == "":
91			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact TaskID is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
92		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
93			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
94		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
95			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
96		case locator.RepoPath == "":
97			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
98		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
99			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
100		case locator.Branch == "":
101			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
102		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
103			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
104		case !validState(locator.State):
105			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
106		}
107		return nil
108	}
109	
110	func validateRecordIdentity(locator Locator, record task.Record) error {
111		candidate := record.Task
112		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
113		if record.Revision != locator.TaskRevision {
114			return staleTaskRevision(locator.TaskRevision, record.Revision, "task revision no longer matches the selected row")
115		}
116		checks := []struct {
117			name     string
118			expected string
119			actual   string
120		}{
121			{"TaskID", locator.TaskID, candidate.ID},
122			{"mode", string(locator.Mode), string(mode)},
123			{"state", string(locator.State), string(candidate.State)},
124			{"branch", locator.Branch, candidate.Branch},
125			{"base", locator.Base, candidate.Base},
126		}
127		for _, check := range checks {
128			if check.expected != check.actual {
129				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
130			}
131		}
132	
133		selectedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(locator.RepoPath)
134		if err != nil {
135			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.RepoPath, err)}
136		}
137		recordedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate.RepoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.RepoPath, err)}
140		}
141		if selectedRepo != recordedRepo {
142			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task repository path changed from %q to %q", selectedRepo, recordedRepo)}
143		}
144	
145		expectedCheckout := recordedRepo
146		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
147			expectedCheckout = ""
148			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
149				expectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(candidate.WorktreePath)
150				if err != nil {
151					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.WorktreePath, err)}
152				}
153			}
154		}
155		selectedCheckout := ""
156		if locator.CheckoutPath != "" {
157			selectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(locator.CheckoutPath)
158			if err != nil {
159				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.CheckoutPath, err)}
160			}
161		}
162		if selectedCheckout != expectedCheckout {
163			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task checkout path changed from %q to %q", selectedCheckout, expectedCheckout)}
164		}
165		return nil
166	}
167	
168	func staleTaskRevision(expected, actual, reason string) error {
169		return &StalePlanError{
170			ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: expected,
171			ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   actual,
172			Reason:                       reason,
173		}
174	}
175	
176	func (s *lifecycleService) observeLifecycle(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (lifecycleObservation, error) {
177		observed := lifecycleObservation{record: record, task: record.Task, mode: record.Task.EffectiveMode()}
178		observed.setCaller(s.host, s.cwd, s.callerWorkspace, s.callerPane)
179	
180		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
181		if err != nil {
182			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, record.Task.ID, err)
183		}
184		observed.repo = repository
185		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
186		if err != nil {
187			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
188		}
189		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
190		if err != nil {
191			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
192		}
193		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(record.Task.RepoPath)
194		if err != nil {
195			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
196		}
197		if recordedRepo != observed.repoPath {
198			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q", record.Task.RepoPath, recordedRepo, observed.repoPath)}
199		}
200		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
201		if err != nil {
202			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
203		}
204		if requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
205			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("Git common directory changed from %q to %q", requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir)}
206		}
207		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
208			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
209			if keyErr != nil {
210				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
211			}
212			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
213				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository key changed from %q to %q", requestedKey, observed.gitCommonDir)}
214			}
215		}
216	
217		s.observeCheckout(ctx, request, &observed)
218		if observed.hasCheckout() {
219			observed.status, observed.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
220			if observed.statusErr == nil {
221				observed.head, observed.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
222				observed.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.head)
223				observed.baseOID, observed.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
224				observed.upstreamOID, observed.upstreamOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.status.Upstream)
225				observed.operation, observed.inProgress, observed.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
226			}
227		}
228		s.observeActionRefs(ctx, request, &observed)
229		if err := validateLiveLocator(request.Locator, observed); err != nil {
230			return observed, err
231		}
232	
233		if isCompletionAction(request.Action) {
234			s.observeCompletionFacts(ctx, request, &observed)
235		}
236		observed.runtime, observed.runtimeErr = s.runtimeFor(observed.task)
237		if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
238			observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
239			s.observeActionRuntime(ctx, request, &observed)
240		}
241		return observed, nil
242	}
243	
244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
248			observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
249			if err == nil {
250				observed.worktreeFound = true
251				observed.checkout = registered.Path
252			}
253		case task.ModeWorktree:
254			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
255				registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.WorktreePath)
256				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
257				if err == nil {
258					observed.worktreeFound = true
259					observed.checkout = registered.Path
260				}
261			}
262			if observed.worktreeFound || request.Action != Resume ||
263				(observed.task.State != task.Warm && observed.task.State != task.Cold) {
264				return
265			}
266			worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
267			if err != nil {
268				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("list worktrees for parked-task resume: %w", err)
269				return
270			}
271			var candidate string
272			for _, worktree := range worktrees {
273				if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
274					observed.branchMatches++
275					candidate = worktree.Path
276				}
277			}
278			switch observed.branchMatches {
279			case 0:
280				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
281					observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has no checkout", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, observed.task.Branch)
282				}
283			case 1:
284				registered, resolveErr := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, candidate)
285				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, resolveErr
286				if resolveErr == nil {
287					observed.worktreeFound = true
288					observed.checkout = registered.Path
289				}
290			default:
291				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has %d registered checkouts", gitx.ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, observed.task.Branch, observed.branchMatches)
292			}
293		}
294	}
295	
296	func validateLiveLocator(locator Locator, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
297		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.hasCheckout() {
298			checks := []struct {
299				name     string
300				expected string
301				actual   string
302				required bool
303			}{
304				{"upstream", locator.Upstream, observed.status.Upstream, true},
305				{"HEAD", locator.HeadOID, observed.head, locator.HeadOID != ""},
306				{"base OID", locator.BaseOID, observed.baseOID, locator.BaseOID != ""},
307				{"upstream OID", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.upstreamOID, locator.UpstreamOID != ""},
308			}
309			for _, check := range checks {
310				if check.required && check.expected != check.actual {
311					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
312				}
313			}
314			return nil
315		}
316		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.HeadOID != "" {
317			if observed.localBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.HeadOID != observed.localBranchOID {
318				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected local branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.HeadOID, observed.localBranchOID)}
319			}
320		}
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.UpstreamOID != "" && locator.Upstream == observed.remoteBranch {
322			if observed.remoteBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.UpstreamOID != observed.remoteBranchOID {
323				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected remote branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.remoteBranchOID)}
324			}
325		}
326		return nil
327	}

329	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRuntime(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
330		switch options := request.Options.(type) {
331		case ParkWarmOptions:
332			if options.KeepSession || !observed.hasCheckout() {
333				return
334			}
335			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
336			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
337		case ParkColdOptions:
338			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
339				return
340			}
341			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
342			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
343			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
344				observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
345			}
346		case ResumeOptions:
347			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
348				return
349			}
350			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
351				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
352				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
353				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
354			})
355			if s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) == nil {
356				observed.savedRuntimeLive = savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
357			}
358		case CompleteDirectOptions, CompleteFFOptions, ReviewHandoffOptions, VerifyMergedOptions:
359			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
360				return
361			}
362			occupancyOptions := runtime.OccupancyOptions{
363				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
364				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
365				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
366			}
367			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, occupancyOptions)
368			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
369				observed.integration.occupancy = observed.occupancy
370				observed.integration.occupancyErr = observed.occupancyErr
371			}
372			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.integration.worktreeFound {
373				observed.integration.occupancy, observed.integration.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(
374					ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, occupancyOptions,
375				)
376			}
377		}
378	}
379	
380	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRefs(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
381		observed.localBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
382		if observed.localBranchExists {
383			observed.localBranchOID, observed.localBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
384		}
385		observed.remoteBranch = "origin/" + observed.task.Branch
386		observed.remoteBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
387		if observed.remoteBranchExists {
388			observed.remoteBranchOID, observed.remoteBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
389		}
390	
391		switch request.Action {
392		case ParkCold:
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
394				observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
395				if observed.baseRef == "" {
396					observed.baseRef = s.gitDefaultBranch(ctx, observed.repoPath)
397				}
398				observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
399			}
400		case Resume:
401			observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
402			if observed.remoteBranchExists {
403				observed.baseRef = observed.remoteBranch
404			}
405			observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
406			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !observed.hasCheckout() &&
407				(observed.task.State == task.Warm || observed.task.State == task.Cold) {
408				if observed.task.State == task.Warm && observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
409					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.canonicalPath(observed.task.WorktreePath)
410				} else {
411					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.renderWorktreePath(observed.task)
412				}
413				if observed.desiredWorktreeErr == nil {
414					observed.desiredWorktreeErr = wt.ValidateTarget(observed.desiredWorktree, observed.repoPath)
415				}
416			}
417		case CompleteDirect:
418			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Branch
419		case CompleteFF, ReviewHandoff:
420			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
421		case VerifyMerged:
422			options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
423			observed.completionBaseRef = options.BaseRef
424			if observed.completionBaseRef == "" {
425				observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
426			}
427		}
428	}

430	func (s *lifecycleService) renderWorktreePath(candidate task.Task) (string, error) {
431		values := config.Vars{
432			"worktree_root": config.Expand(s.cfg.Paths.WorktreeRoot),
433			"repo":          candidate.Repo,
434			"repo_path":     candidate.RepoPath,
435			"branch":        candidate.Branch,
436			"category":      "",
437			"host":          s.host,
438			"date":          s.now().Format("2006-01-02"),
439		}
440		rendered, err := config.Render(s.cfg.Paths.WorktreePath, values)
441		if err != nil {
442			return "", err
443		}
444		return s.canonicalPath(config.Expand(rendered))
445	}

447	func (s *lifecycleService) baseAuthority(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) map[string]string {
448		authority := map[string]string{
449			"task.id":                       observed.task.ID,
450			"task.revision":                 observed.record.Revision,
451			"task.mode":                     string(observed.mode),
452			"task.state":                    string(observed.task.State),
453			"task.repo":                     observed.task.Repo,
454			"task.repo-path":                observed.task.RepoPath,
455			"task.branch":                   observed.task.Branch,
456			"task.base":                     observed.task.Base,
457			"task.worktree-path":            observed.task.WorktreePath,
458			"task.owner":                    observed.task.Owner,
459			"task.runtime-name":             observed.task.RuntimeName,
460			"task.runtime-handle":           observed.task.RuntimeHandle,
461			"repo.main-path":                observed.repoPath,
462			"repo.git-common-dir":           observed.gitCommonDir,
463			"worktree.fingerprint":          worktreeAuthority(observed.worktree, observed.worktreeFound, observed.worktreeErr, observed.branchMatches),
464			"worktree.present":              boolString(observed.worktreeFound),
465			"worktree.path":                 observed.worktree.Path,
466			"worktree.branch":               observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch,
467			"worktree.head":                 observed.worktree.Worktree.Head,
468			"worktree.main":                 boolString(observed.worktree.Worktree.Main),
469			"worktree.locked":               boolString(observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked),
470			"worktree.locked-reason":        observed.worktree.Worktree.LockedReason,
471			"worktree.prunable":             boolString(observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable),
472			"worktree.prunable-reason":      observed.worktree.Worktree.PrunableReason,
473			"git.status-error":              errorString(observed.statusErr),
474			"git.branch":                    observed.status.Branch,
475			"git.detached":                  boolString(observed.status.Detached),
476			"git.upstream":                  observed.status.Upstream,
477			"git.ahead":                     strconv.Itoa(observed.status.Ahead),
478			"git.behind":                    strconv.Itoa(observed.status.Behind),
479			"git.changed":                   strconv.Itoa(observed.status.Changed),
480			"git.staged":                    strconv.Itoa(observed.status.Staged),
481			"git.unstaged":                  strconv.Itoa(observed.status.Unstaged),
482			"git.untracked":                 strconv.Itoa(observed.status.Untracked),
483			"git.conflicted":                strconv.Itoa(observed.status.Conflicted),
484			"git.head":                      observed.head,
485			"git.head-error":                errorString(observed.headErr),
486			"git.base-oid":                  observed.baseOID,
487			"git.base-oid-error":            errorString(observed.baseOIDErr),
488			"git.upstream-oid":              observed.upstreamOID,
489			"git.upstream-oid-error":        errorString(observed.upstreamOIDErr),
490			"git.operation":                 observed.operation,
491			"git.operation-active":          boolString(observed.inProgress),
492			"git.operation-error":           errorString(observed.operationErr),
493			"git.local-branch-exists":       boolString(observed.localBranchExists),
494			"git.local-branch-oid":          observed.localBranchOID,
495			"git.local-branch-oid-error":    errorString(observed.localBranchOIDErr),
496			"git.remote-branch":             observed.remoteBranch,
497			"git.remote-branch-exists":      boolString(observed.remoteBranchExists),
498			"git.remote-branch-oid":         observed.remoteBranchOID,
499			"git.remote-branch-oid-error":   errorString(observed.remoteBranchOIDErr),
500			"runtime.error":                 errorString(observed.runtimeErr),
501			"runtime.backend":               runtimeName(observed.runtime),
502			"runtime.available":             boolString(observed.runtimeAvailable),
503			"runtime.cleanup-fingerprint":   cleanupAuthority(observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr),

1	// Package gitx wraps the git porcelain commands dev depends on. Every helper
2	// shells out to git rather than linking a Go implementation: git is already a
3	// hard dependency, its porcelain formats are stable and documented, and this
4	// keeps dev's behaviour identical to what the user sees when they run the same
5	// command by hand.
6	package gitx
7	
8	import (
9		"bytes"
10		"context"
11		"errors"
12		"fmt"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16	)
17	
18	// ErrNotARepo is returned when a directory is not inside a git working tree.
19	var ErrNotARepo = errors.New("not a git repository")
20	
21	// Error carries the failing command and git's own stderr, which is almost
22	// always more useful than the exit status alone.
23	type Error struct {
24		Args   []string
25		Dir    string
26		Stderr string
27		Err    error
28	}
29	
30	func (e *Error) Error() string {
31		msg := strings.TrimSpace(e.Stderr)
32		if msg == "" {
33			msg = e.Err.Error()
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("git %s: %s", strings.Join(e.Args, " "), msg)
36	}
37	
38	func (e *Error) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
39	
40	// run executes git in dir and returns trimmed stdout.
41	func run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
42		return runEnv(ctx, dir, nil, args...)
43	}
44	
45	// runEnv executes git with task-scoped environment overrides. It is used for
46	// alternate-index analysis that must never touch the user's real index.
47	func runEnv(ctx context.Context, dir string, overrides []string, args ...string) (string, error) {
48		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than
49		// octal-escaped, which matters for the Chinese-named files in these repos.
50		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
51		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
52		cmd.Dir = dir
53		if len(overrides) > 0 {
54			keys := make(map[string]bool, len(overrides))
55			for _, override := range overrides {
56				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(override, "=")
57				keys[key] = true
58			}
59			env := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+len(overrides))
60			for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
61				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
62				if !keys[key] {
63					env = append(env, entry)
64				}
65			}
66			env = append(env, overrides...)
67			cmd.Env = env
68		}
69		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
70		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
71		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
72		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
73			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
74			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {
75				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", dir, ErrNotARepo)
76			}
77			return "", gerr
78		}
79		return strings.TrimRight(stdout.String(), "\n"), nil
80	}
81	
82	// Run executes an arbitrary git command in dir. Exported for the few callers
83	// (park's wip commit, done's merge) that need a one-off command.
84	func Run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
85		return run(ctx, dir, args...)
86	}

88	// lines splits git output into non-empty lines.
89	func lines(s string) []string {
90		if s == "" {
91			return nil
92		}
93		out := strings.Split(s, "\n")
94		filtered := out[:0]
95		for _, l := range out {
96			if l != "" {
97				filtered = append(filtered, l)
98			}
99		}
100		return filtered
101	}

29	// Plan is an immutable-by-interface proposal bound to one request and one
30	// authority fingerprint. Collection accessors always return copies.
31	type Plan struct {
32		PlanID                 string
33		AuthorityFingerprint   string

55	// BuildPlan validates graph legality, derives availability, and seals a plan's
56	// deterministic authority fingerprint and PlanID.
57	func BuildPlan(request Request, spec PlanSpec) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid request", Cause: err}
61		}
62		if err := spec.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
63			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
64		}
65		conditions := append([]Condition(nil), spec.Conditions...)
66		if err := validateConditions(conditions); err != nil {
67			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
68		}
69		effects := cloneEffects(spec.Effects)
70		if err := validateEffects(effects); err != nil {
71			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
72		}
73		authority := NewFields(spec.Authority)
74		if err := validateAuthority(authority); err != nil {
75			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
76		}
77	
78		plan := Plan{
79			Request: normalized.Clone(), Locator: normalized.Locator, Action: normalized.Action,
80			Source:       normalized.Locator.State,
81			Availability: AvailabilityFor(conditions), Confirmation: spec.Confirmation,
82			FallbackCommand: spec.FallbackCommand, Summary: spec.Summary, DisplayedAt: spec.DisplayedAt,
83			authority: authority, conditions: conditions, effects: effects,
84			retained: NewStringList(spec.RetainedResources...),
85		}
86		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
87			rule, transitionErr := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
88			if transitionErr != nil {
89				return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid transition", Cause: transitionErr}
90			}
91			plan.HasPersistedTransition = true
92			plan.Target = rule.Target
93			plan.StatePreserving = rule.StatePreserving
94			plan.RemovesTask = rule.RemovesTask
95			plan.ExpectedMilestone = rule.Milestone
96		} else {
97			switch plan.Action {
98			case Adopt:
99				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
100			case Reconcile:
101				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
102			}
103		}
104		plan.AuthorityFingerprint, plan.PlanID = computePlanIdentity(plan)
105		return plan.Clone(), nil
106	}
107	
108	// Clone returns a plan with independent request, map, and slice storage.
109	func (p Plan) Clone() Plan {
110		p.Request = p.Request.Clone()
111		p.authority = p.authority.clone()
112		p.conditions = append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...)
113		p.effects = cloneEffects(p.effects)
114		p.retained = p.retained.clone()
115		return p
116	}

118	// AuthorityFields returns a mutable copy of the extra authority identities.
119	func (p Plan) AuthorityFields() map[string]string { return p.authority.Map() }

121	// Conditions returns the ordered conditions as a mutable copy.
122	func (p Plan) Conditions() []Condition { return append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...) }
123	
124	// Effects returns independent copies of the ordered effects.
125	func (p Plan) Effects() []Effect { return cloneEffects(p.effects) }

127	// RetainedResources returns the resources intentionally left after Apply.

130	// InputConditions returns required operator input without conflating it with a

132	func (p Plan) InputConditions() []Condition {

138	// BlockingConditions returns every required, non-input condition that prevents

140	func (p Plan) BlockingConditions() []Condition {
141		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
142			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired &&
143				condition.Verdict != VerdictMet && condition.Verdict != VerdictNeedsInput
144		})

154	// Validate proves that a plan is structurally consistent and still carries its
155	// original deterministic identity. It performs no live observations.
156	func (p Plan) Validate() error {
157		if p.PlanID == "" || p.AuthorityFingerprint == "" {
158			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan identity is missing"}
159		}
160		if !p.Action.Valid() {
161			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown action %q", p.Action)}
162		}
163		if p.Request.Action != p.Action {
164			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request action and plan action differ"}
165		}
166		if p.Request.Locator != p.Locator {
167			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request locator and plan locator differ"}
168		}
169		if p.Request.Options == nil {
170			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "normalized request options are missing"}
171		}
172		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(p.Request)
173		if err != nil {
174			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request is no longer valid", Cause: err}
175		}
176		if requestIdentity(normalized) != requestIdentity(p.Request) {
177			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request options are not normalized"}
178		}
179		if err := p.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
180			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
181		}
182		if err := validateConditions(p.conditions); err != nil {
183			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
184		}
185		if err := validateEffects(p.effects); err != nil {
186			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
187		}
188		if err := validateAuthority(p.authority); err != nil {
189			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
190		}
191		if err := validatePlanTransition(p); err != nil {
192			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "transition metadata is inconsistent", Cause: err}
193		}
194	
195		authorityFingerprint, planID := computePlanIdentity(p)
196		if authorityFingerprint != p.AuthorityFingerprint {
197			return &StalePlanError{
198				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
199				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
200				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
201				Reason:                       "authority fields, effects, or conditions changed",
202			}
203		}
204		if planID != p.PlanID {
205			return &StalePlanError{
206				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
207				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
208				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
209				Reason:                       "PlanID does not match its authority fingerprint",
210			}
211		}
212		if availability := AvailabilityFor(p.conditions); availability != p.Availability {
213			return &InvalidPlanError{
214				PlanID: p.PlanID,
215				Reason: fmt.Sprintf("availability is %s, want derived %s", p.Availability, availability),
216			}
217		}
218		return nil
219	}

221	// ValidateApproval binds affirmative approval and any typed token to this exact
222	// plan. It never changes plan readiness or condition verdicts.
223	func (p Plan) ValidateApproval(approval Approval) error {
224		if err := p.Validate(); err != nil {
225			return err
226		}
227		if !approval.Granted {
228			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "affirmative approval was not granted", Cause: ErrApprovalRequired}
229		}
230		if approval.PlanID != p.PlanID {
231			return &StalePlanError{
232				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: approval.PlanID,
233				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
234				Reason:                       "approval names a different plan",
235			}
236		}
237		if p.Confirmation.Kind == ConfirmationTyped {
238			if approval.Token != p.Confirmation.Token {
239				return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "typed confirmation token does not match", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
240			}
241		} else if approval.Token != "" {
242			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan does not accept a typed confirmation token", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
243		}
244		return nil
245	}

247	func validatePlanTransition(plan Plan) error {
248		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
249			rule, err := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
250			if err != nil {
251				return err
252			}
253			if !plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Source != rule.Source || plan.Target != rule.Target ||
254				plan.StatePreserving != rule.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask != rule.RemovesTask ||
255				plan.ExpectedMilestone != rule.Milestone {
256				return fmt.Errorf("plan does not match the transition table")
257			}
258			return nil
259		}
260		expectedMilestone := MilestoneNone
261		switch plan.Action {
262		case Adopt:
263			expectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
264		case Reconcile:
265			expectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
266		}
267		if plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Target != "" || plan.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask ||
268			plan.Source != plan.Locator.State || plan.ExpectedMilestone != expectedMilestone {
269			return fmt.Errorf("domain action is represented as a persisted-state edge")
270		}
271		return nil
272	}
273	
274	func validateConditions(conditions []Condition) error {
275		seen := make(map[ConditionCode]bool, len(conditions))
276		for index, condition := range conditions {
277			if err := condition.Validate(); err != nil {
278				return fmt.Errorf("condition %d: %w", index, err)
279			}
280			if seen[condition.Code] {
281				return fmt.Errorf("condition code %q is duplicated", condition.Code)
282			}
283			seen[condition.Code] = true
284		}
285		return nil
286	}
287	
288	func validateEffects(effects []Effect) error {
289		for index, effect := range effects {
290			if err := effect.Validate(); err != nil {
291				return fmt.Errorf("effect %d: %w", index, err)
292			}
293		}
294		return nil
295	}
296	
297	func validateAuthority(authority Fields) error {
298		for _, field := range authority.entries {
299			if field.Key == "" {
300				return fmt.Errorf("authority field key is empty")
301			}
302		}
303		return nil
304	}

306	func cloneEffects(effects []Effect) []Effect {
307		out := make([]Effect, len(effects))
308		for index, effect := range effects {
309			out[index] = effect.Clone()
310		}
311		return out
312	}

314	func filterConditions(conditions []Condition, keep func(Condition) bool) []Condition {
315		out := make([]Condition, 0, len(conditions))
316		for _, condition := range conditions {
317			if keep(condition) {
318				out = append(out, condition)
319			}
320		}
321		return out
322	}

324	func requestIdentity(request Request) string {
325		writer := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-request-v1")
326		appendRequestIdentity(writer, request)
327		return writer.sumHex()
328	}

330	func computePlanIdentity(plan Plan) (string, string) {
331		writer := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-authority-v1")
332		appendRequestIdentity(writer, plan.Request)
333		writer.addString("plan.action", string(plan.Action))
334		writer.addString("plan.source", string(plan.Source))
335		writer.addString("plan.target", string(plan.Target))
336		writer.addBool("plan.has-persisted-transition", plan.HasPersistedTransition)
337		writer.addBool("plan.state-preserving", plan.StatePreserving)
338		writer.addBool("plan.removes-task", plan.RemovesTask)
339		writer.addString("plan.expected-milestone", string(plan.ExpectedMilestone))
340		writer.addFields("plan.authority", plan.authority)
341		writer.addInt64("plan.condition-count", int64(len(plan.conditions)))
342		for index, condition := range plan.conditions {
343			prefix := "plan.condition." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
344			writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(condition.Code))
345			writer.addString(prefix+"verdict", string(condition.Verdict))
346			writer.addString(prefix+"requirement", string(condition.Requirement))
347			writer.addString(prefix+"evidence", condition.Evidence)
348			writer.addString(prefix+"remediation", condition.Remediation)
349		}
350		writer.addInt64("plan.effect-count", int64(len(plan.effects)))
351		for index, effect := range plan.effects {
352			prefix := "plan.effect." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
353			writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(effect.Code))
354			writer.addString(prefix+"description", effect.Description)
355			writer.addString(prefix+"target", effect.Target)
356			writer.addBool(prefix+"destructive", effect.Destructive)
357			writer.addBool(prefix+"network", effect.Network)
358			writer.addFields(prefix+"details", effect.Details)
359		}
360		writer.addStrings("plan.retained", plan.retained.values)
361		writer.addString("plan.confirmation-kind", string(plan.Confirmation.Kind))
362		writer.addString("plan.confirmation-token", plan.Confirmation.Token)
363		authorityFingerprint := "sha256:" + writer.sumHex()
364	
365		planWriter := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-plan-v1")
366		planWriter.addString("authority-fingerprint", authorityFingerprint)
367		return authorityFingerprint, "plan:" + planWriter.sumHex()
368	}

418		w.addInt64(label+".count", int64(len(values)))

421		}
422	}
423	
424	func (w *identityWriter) addFields(label string, fields Fields) {
425		w.addInt64(label+".count", int64(len(fields.entries)))
426		for index, field := range fields.entries {
427			prefix := label + "." + strconv.Itoa(index)
428			w.addString(prefix+".key", field.Key)
429			w.addString(prefix+".value", field.Value)
430		}
431	}
432	
433	func (w *identityWriter) addBytes(value []byte) {
434		var length [8]byte
435		binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(value)))
436		_, _ = w.buffer.Write(length[:])
437		_, _ = w.buffer.Write(value)
438	}
439	
440	func (w *identityWriter) sumHex() string {
441		sum := sha256.Sum256(w.buffer.Bytes())
442		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
443	}

```text
365	confirms dispatch, never waits for command completion or reports its exit code;
366	add `--focus` when the caller should switch or attach after dispatch.
367	
368	Herdr-aware writer claims—`start --direct`, `start --branch-only`, and
369	`resume`—reject another recognized agent in the same canonical Git worktree.
370	Every state, including `idle`, `done`, and `unknown`, is occupied. Pure
371	`repo open`, `wt open`, and TUI Enter reuse/focus the live owner without
372	claiming another writer. `--allow-shared-checkout` is only for explicitly
373	coordinated disjoint ownership; normal new-worktree creation remains allowed.
374	
375	Task runtime handles carry their backend name and are validated against live
376	checkout coverage before reuse or close. Destructive cleanup additionally
377	resolves every covering pane. A caller inside the target, a mixed workspace, or
378	a working/blocked/waiting agent always stops retirement; unknown status needs an
379	external `--close-unknown`. `dev done` never closes or removes anything.
380	
381	### Repository flow preview
382	
383	`dev flow [repo]` is a preview-labelled, full-screen, TTY-only state-machine UI.
384	It is independent of the six-view `dev tui` dashboard. From a canonical or linked
385	checkout, `dev flow` resolves the canonical repository and focuses that exact
386	surface; outside Git it opens a filterable repository picker. An explicit
387	`dev flow api` overrides cwd.
388	
389	The left panel is the union of Git's registered worktrees and task records that
390	have no checkout, including normal COLD and DONE tasks. Rows are labelled
391	`canonical`, `managed`, `unmanaged`, `harness`, `task-only`, or `conflict`.
392	Canonical worktrees are never removable; harness-owned and ambiguous/conflicting
393	rows have no destructive path. An exact unmanaged linked checkout can be
394	**Adopted** by creating task metadata without changing Git bytes, or **Removed**
395	only when clean and safe; removal is non-force and always preserves the branch.
396	
397	The center distinguishes persisted task intent (`HOT`, `WARM`, `COLD`, `DONE`)
398	from observed Git/worktree/runtime/artifact facts. Unknown, failed, loading, or
399	stale evidence never becomes a false clean/closed fact. `runtime=none` leaves
400	session occupancy unobserved, but the local Git/task snapshot can still be fresh;
401	metadata-only adoption then remains WARM.
402	
403	The right panel offers concrete mode/state actions: warm/cold park, resume,
404	direct or fast-forward completion, review handoff, verified-merge completion,
405	and DONE retirement where legal. The preview deliberately excludes dirty
406	commit/discard, WIP checkpoint, shared-writer, ownership-takeover, and unknown-
407	runtime overrides. A blocked plan shows its exact evidence, remediation, and CLI
408	fallback; existing command flags remain available outside the preview.
409	
410	```text
411	j/k or ↑/↓       choose a surface      h/l or ←/→     choose an action
412	Tab/Shift-Tab    move panel focus       Enter          build a plan, never apply
413	r                reload local facts    R              Fetch refs / Query review / Both
414	Esc              back out              ?              evidence and key help
415	```
416	
417	A READY plan shows ordered conditions/effects, retained resources, network and
418	destructive markers, and its exact PlanID. Press `y` only for a non-typed plan;
419	typed branch deletion requires the displayed token and `Enter`. Apply locks and
420	reloads the task revision plus repository, checkout, refs, runtime, artifact, and
421	remote identities. Any change rejects the stale plan before a new effect. Once an
422	effect starts, quit/refresh waits for the retained step ledger; partial success
423	means completed effects remain completed and recovery is explicit.
424	
425	Startup and `r` never fetch or query a forge. `R` runs only the confirmed choice
426	and keeps its evidence in this TUI run: named ref OIDs plus portable review
427	existence, open/draft/merged/closed state, URL, provider, and observation time.
428	It does not query review decisions or checks. Completion records DONE while
429	keeping branch, checkout, and runtime resources; Retire cleans them from outside
430	the target. Raw Git and configured external tools remain outside these
431	`dev`-mediated locks and safety checks.
432	
433	### The dashboard
434	
435	Bare `dev` (or `dev tui`) opens six lists, switched with `tab`:
436	
437	- **TASKS** — the change streams dev is tracking. What am I working on.
438	- **REPOS** — durable repositories under the scan roots, with branch, dirty
439	  state, owned size, runtime, worktrees and task tally. What do I have here.
440	- **FLEET** — repository and activity facts from configured remote machines.
441	  The TUI hides this machine by default because REPOS already shows it; `a`
442	  includes local rows. Enter opens the remote checkout through Herdr when
443	  possible, then SSH. `dev fleet list` continues to include this machine.
444	- **TRY** — dated scratch experiments, including non-Git folders, with durable
445	  tags/notes and explicit active/deprecated/archived/graduated state.
446	- **REMOTE** — repositories visible through authenticated forge CLIs, including
447	  configured Azure DevOps projects, marked when a local repo or Try exists.
448	  What can I open or clone.
449	- **SKILLS** — project and global agent skills, their target agents, source and
450	  explicitly checked update state.
451	
452	The first view is constructed before runtime auto-detection, project-root lookup,
453	cache decoding, shell-based tool checks, or the optional release refresh can
454	finish. TASKS, REPOS, and TRY then publish independently from one shared local
455	load cycle; REMOTE, FLEET, and SKILLS remain lazy. A cached REMOTE/FLEET snapshot
456	is immediately usable but is tracked separately from a current live result.
457	Every requested view has its own generation, so `r` cancels the old read, a late
458	result cannot replace a newer one, a failed refresh keeps usable rows visible,
459	and a successful empty result clears obsolete rows.
460	
461	TASKS, REPOS and TRY use the same services as their non-interactive commands.
462	Git-backed Tries appear in TRY rather than being duplicated in REPOS; REMOTE
463	still knows that local checkout exists. The repo list matters on day one: with
464	forty repositories and no tasks recorded yet, a task-only dashboard would just
465	be empty.
466	
467	Navigation is vim-style, arrows alongside:
468	
469	```
470	j k        move                 ctrl+d ctrl+u   half a page
471	g G        top / bottom         h l / tab       previous / next view
472	/          filter as you type   esc             clear, then quit
473	```
474	
475	`enter` opens a selected row only when its checkout is currently valid. Inside Herdr/tmux/Zellij it
476	switches the current client; outside it exits the dashboard and attaches to
477	the target session. A COLD worktree task requires `dev resume`; a missing or
478	unregistered worktree requires `dev sweep` first so artifacts can be salvaged
479	before the task is resumed or reaped. In TASKS, `p` parks and prompts
```

203	func (ReconcileOptions) Action() Action   { return Reconcile }
204	func (ReconcileOptions) isActionOptions() {}
205	
206	// Request binds one action and its typed options to an exact selected locator.
207	// DisplayedAt may be used by a caller but does not contribute to plan identity.
208	type Request struct {
209		Locator     Locator
210		Action      Action
211		Options     ActionOptions
212		DisplayedAt time.Time
213	}
214	
215	// NewRequest infers the action from options and returns a normalized value.
216	func NewRequest(locator Locator, options ActionOptions) (Request, error) {
217		if options == nil {
218			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action options are required", ErrInvalidRequest)
219		}
220		normalized, err := cloneActionOptions(options, "")
221		if err != nil {
222			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
223		}
224		request := Request{Locator: locator, Action: normalized.Action(), Options: normalized}
225		return normalizeRequest(request)
226	}
227	
228	// Clone returns a request whose option-owned collection values are independent.
229	func (r Request) Clone() Request {
230		options, err := cloneActionOptions(r.Options, r.Action)
231		if err == nil {
232			r.Options = options
233		}
234		return r
235	}
236	
237	// Validate checks option/action agreement and graph legality without performing
238	// observations or side effects.
239	func (r Request) Validate() error {
240		_, err := normalizeRequest(r)
241		return err
242	}
243	
244	func normalizeRequest(request Request) (Request, error) {
245		if !request.Action.Valid() {
246			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown action %q", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action)
247		}
248		options, err := cloneActionOptions(request.Options, request.Action)
249		if err != nil {
250			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
251		}
252		if options.Action() != request.Action {
253			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action %s cannot use %s options", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, options.Action())
254		}
255		if err := validateActionOptions(options); err != nil {
256			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, err)
257		}
258		request.Options = options
259		if isTransitionAction(request.Action) {
260			if _, err := RequireTransition(request.Locator.Mode, request.Locator.State, request.Action); err != nil {
261				return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
262			}
263		}
264		return request, nil
265	}
266	
267	func cloneActionOptions(options ActionOptions, action Action) (ActionOptions, error) {
268		if options == nil {
269			return defaultActionOptions(action)
270		}
271		switch value := options.(type) {
272		case ParkWarmOptions:
273			return value, nil
274		case *ParkWarmOptions:
275			if value == nil {
276				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil park-warm options")
277			}
278			return *value, nil
279		case ParkColdOptions:
280			return value, nil
281		case *ParkColdOptions:
282			if value == nil {
283				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil park-cold options")
284			}
285			return *value, nil
286		case ResumeOptions:
287			return value, nil
288		case *ResumeOptions:
289			if value == nil {
290				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil resume options")
291			}
292			return *value, nil
293		case CompleteDirectOptions:
294			value.Dirty = normalizeDirty(value.Dirty)
295			return value, nil
296		case *CompleteDirectOptions:
297			if value == nil {
298				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil complete-direct options")
299			}

375		}
376		if options.TakeOwnership {
377			parts = append(parts, "--force")
378		}
379		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
380	}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}
88	
89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104	
105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
106		if err != nil {
107			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
108			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
109			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
110			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
111		}
112		switch {
113		case rel == ".":
114			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
115		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
116			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
117		default:
118			return canonicalCandidate, nil
119		}
120	}
121	
122	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
123	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
124	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
125		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
126		if err == nil {
127			return true, nil
128		}
129		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
130			return false, nil
131		}
132		return false, err
133	}
134	
135	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
136	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
137		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
138		if err != nil {
139			return false, err
140		}
141		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
142		if err != nil {
143			return false, err
144		}
145		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
146			return true, nil
147		}
148		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
149	}
150	
151	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
152	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
153	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
154	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
155		switch {
156		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
157			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
158		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
159			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
160		case component == "." || component == "..":
161			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
162		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
163			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
164		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
165			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
166		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
167			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
168		default:
169			return nil
170		}
171	}

158	}

160	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
161	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
162	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
163		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
164		if err != nil {
165			return inspection, err
166		}
167		if !inspection.Ready() {
168			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
169		}
170		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
171			return inspection, nil
172		}
173		interval := opts.PollInterval
174		if interval <= 0 {
175			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
176		}
177		timeout := opts.Timeout
178		if timeout <= 0 {
179			timeout = 5 * time.Second
180		}
181		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
182		closed := make(map[string]bool)
183		for {
184			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
185			if inspectErr != nil {
186				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
187			}
188			if !fresh.Ready() {
189				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
190			}
191			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
192				inspection.Sessions = nil
193				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
194				return inspection, nil
195			}
196			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
197				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
198					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
199			}
200			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
201				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
202				if closed[handle] {
203					continue
204				}
205				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
206					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
207				}
208				closed[handle] = true
209				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
210			}
211			select {
212			case <-ctx.Done():
213				return inspection, ctx.Err()
214			case <-time.After(interval):
215			}
216		}
217	}
218	
219	func coveringAgentStatuses(panes []runtime.Pane, fallback string) []string {
220		set := make(map[string]bool)
221		for _, pane := range panes {
222			if pane.Agent != "" || pane.AgentSession != "" || pane.AgentStatus != "" {
223				set[strings.ToLower(pane.AgentStatus)] = true
224			}
225		}
226		if len(set) == 0 {
227			set[strings.ToLower(fallback)] = true
228		}
229		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
230		for status := range set {
231			out = append(out, status)
232		}
233		sort.Strings(out)
234		return out
235	}

237	func appendAgentStatusBlocker(result *Inspection, handle, rawStatus string, closeUnknown bool) {
238		status := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawStatus))
239		switch status {
240		case "idle", "done":
241			// Eligible after all structural checks pass.
242		case "working", "running", "busy", "blocked", "waiting":
243			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
244				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has agent status %s", handle, status))
245		case "", "unknown":
246			if !closeUnknown {
247				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
248					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unknown agent status; pass --close-unknown from outside it", handle))
249			}
250		default:
251			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
252				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unrecognized agent status %s", handle, status))
253		}
254	}
255	
256	func dedupe(inspection Inspection) Inspection {
257		seen := make(map[string]bool)
258		out := inspection.Blockers[:0]
259		for _, blocker := range inspection.Blockers {
260			if !seen[blocker] {
261				seen[blocker] = true
262				out = append(out, blocker)
263			}
264		}
265		inspection.Blockers = out
266		return inspection
267	}
268

14	// Handler contains the narrow hooks for one exact action. Either hook may be
15	// omitted; no production or unsafe fallback is installed.
16	type Handler struct {
17		Plan  PlanHook
18		Apply ApplyHook
19	}
20	
21	// Handlers maps stable action codes to injected behavior.
22	type Handlers map[Action]Handler
23	
24	// LocateTaskHook builds one exact managed-task locator from fresh durable and
25	// Git evidence. It is intentionally not accepted by NewService: only the
26	// guarded lifecycle constructor may install it.
27	type LocateTaskHook func(context.Context, string) (Locator, error)
28	
29	// Service is the UI-agnostic locate/plan/apply dispatcher.
30	type Service struct {
31		handlers   map[Action]Handler
32		locateTask LocateTaskHook
33	}
34	
35	// NewService copies handlers so later mutation of the caller's map cannot
36	// redirect a planned action.
37	func NewService(handlers Handlers) *Service {
38		copied := make(map[Action]Handler, len(handlers))
39		for action, handler := range handlers {
40			copied[action] = handler
41		}
42		return &Service{handlers: copied}
43	}
44	
45	// LocateTask returns an exact locator only when this service came from
46	// NewLifecycleService. Generic dispatch services deliberately have no fallback
47	// locator because guessing task, repository, or checkout identity is unsafe.
48	func (s *Service) LocateTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
49		if s == nil || s.locateTask == nil {
50			return Locator{}, ErrLocatorUnavailable
51		}
52		return s.locateTask(ctx, taskID)
53	}
54	
55	// Plan validates and freezes a request, delegates action-specific observations,
56	// then centrally builds the immutable plan.
57	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, err
61		}
62		handler, ok := s.handlers[normalized.Action]
63		if !ok || handler.Plan == nil {
64			return Plan{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: normalized.Action, Stage: "plan"}
65		}
66		spec, err := handler.Plan(ctx, normalized.Clone())
67		if err != nil {
68			return Plan{}, err
69		}
70		return BuildPlan(normalized, spec)
71	}
72	
73	// Apply validates identity and approval, rejects every status except READY, and
74	// delegates only to the handler registered for the plan's exact action. A
75	// handler's partial Result is returned unchanged in meaning alongside errors.
76	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, plan Plan, approval Approval) (Result, error) {
77		frozen := plan.Clone()
78		if err := frozen.Validate(); err != nil {
79			return Result{}, err
80		}
81		if err := frozen.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
82			return Result{}, err
83		}
84		if frozen.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
85			notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{
86				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Availability: frozen.Availability,
87				conditions: frozen.Conditions(),
88			}
89			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{
90				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Reason: "required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady,
91			}
92		}
93		handler, ok := s.handlers[frozen.Action]
94		if !ok || handler.Apply == nil {
95			return Result{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: frozen.Action, Stage: "apply"}
96		}
97		result, err := handler.Apply(ctx, frozen.Clone())
98		result = result.Clone()
99		if err != nil && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 {
100			result.PartialSuccess = true
101		}
102		return result, err
103	}
104

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}

50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:

65		case CompleteDirect:

67		case CompleteFF:

69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}

88	func validateLifecycleLocator(locator Locator) error {
89		switch {
90		case locator.TaskID == "":
91			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact TaskID is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
92		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
93			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
94		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
95			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
96		case locator.RepoPath == "":
97			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
98		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
99			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
100		case locator.Branch == "":
101			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
102		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
103			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
104		case !validState(locator.State):
105			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
106		}
107		return nil
108	}
109	
110	func validateRecordIdentity(locator Locator, record task.Record) error {
111		candidate := record.Task
112		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
113		if record.Revision != locator.TaskRevision {
114			return staleTaskRevision(locator.TaskRevision, record.Revision, "task revision no longer matches the selected row")
115		}
116		checks := []struct {
117			name     string
118			expected string
119			actual   string
120		}{
121			{"TaskID", locator.TaskID, candidate.ID},
122			{"mode", string(locator.Mode), string(mode)},
123			{"state", string(locator.State), string(candidate.State)},
124			{"branch", locator.Branch, candidate.Branch},
125			{"base", locator.Base, candidate.Base},
126		}
127		for _, check := range checks {
128			if check.expected != check.actual {
129				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
130			}
131		}
132	
133		selectedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(locator.RepoPath)
134		if err != nil {
135			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.RepoPath, err)}
136		}
137		recordedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate.RepoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.RepoPath, err)}
140		}
141		if selectedRepo != recordedRepo {
142			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task repository path changed from %q to %q", selectedRepo, recordedRepo)}
143		}
144	
145		expectedCheckout := recordedRepo
146		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
147			expectedCheckout = ""
148			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
149				expectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(candidate.WorktreePath)
150				if err != nil {
151					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.WorktreePath, err)}
152				}
153			}
154		}
155		selectedCheckout := ""
156		if locator.CheckoutPath != "" {
157			selectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(locator.CheckoutPath)
158			if err != nil {
159				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.CheckoutPath, err)}
160			}
161		}
162		if selectedCheckout != expectedCheckout {
163			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task checkout path changed from %q to %q", selectedCheckout, expectedCheckout)}
164		}
165		return nil
166	}

168	func staleTaskRevision(expected, actual, reason string) error {
169		return &StalePlanError{
170			ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: expected,
171			ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   actual,
172			Reason:                       reason,
173		}
174	}
