```text
176	func (s *lifecycleService) observeLifecycle(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (lifecycleObservation, error) {
177		observed := lifecycleObservation{record: record, task: record.Task, mode: record.Task.EffectiveMode()}
178		observed.setCaller(s.host, s.cwd, s.callerWorkspace, s.callerPane)
179	
180		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
181		if err != nil {
182			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, record.Task.ID, err)
183		}
184		observed.repo = repository
185		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
186		if err != nil {
187			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
188		}
189		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
190		if err != nil {
191			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
192		}
193		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(record.Task.RepoPath)
194		if err != nil {
195			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
196		}
197		if recordedRepo != observed.repoPath {
198			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q", record.Task.RepoPath, recordedRepo, observed.repoPath)}
199		}
200		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
201		if err != nil {
202			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
203		}
204		if requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
205			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("Git common directory changed from %q to %q", requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir)}
206		}
207		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
208			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
209			if keyErr != nil {
210				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
211			}
212			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
213				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository key changed from %q to %q", requestedKey, observed.gitCommonDir)}
214			}
215		}
216	
217		s.observeCheckout(ctx, request, &observed)
218		if observed.hasCheckout() {
219			observed.status, observed.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
220			if observed.statusErr == nil {
221				observed.head, observed.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
222				observed.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.head)
223				observed.baseOID, observed.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
224				observed.upstreamOID, observed.upstreamOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.status.Upstream)
225				observed.operation, observed.inProgress, observed.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
226			}
227		}
228		s.observeActionRefs(ctx, request, &observed)
229		if err := validateLiveLocator(request.Locator, observed); err != nil {
230			return observed, err
231		}
232	
233		if isCompletionAction(request.Action) {
234			s.observeCompletionFacts(ctx, request, &observed)
235		}
236		observed.runtime, observed.runtimeErr = s.runtimeFor(observed.task)
237		if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
238			observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
239			s.observeActionRuntime(ctx, request, &observed)
240		}
241		return observed, nil
242	}
243	
244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
248			observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
249			if err == nil {
250				observed.worktreeFound = true
251				observed.checkout = registered.Path
252			}
253		case task.ModeWorktree:
254			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
255				registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.WorktreePath)
256				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
257				if err == nil {
258					observed.worktreeFound = true
259					observed.checkout = registered.Path
260				}
261			}
262			if observed.worktreeFound || request.Action != Resume ||
263				(observed.task.State != task.Warm && observed.task.State != task.Cold) {
264				return
265			}
266			worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
267			if err != nil {
268				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("list worktrees for parked-task resume: %w", err)
269				return
270			}
271			var candidate string
272			for _, worktree := range worktrees {
273				if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
274					observed.branchMatches++
275					candidate = worktree.Path
276				}
277			}
278			switch observed.branchMatches {
279			case 0:
280				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
281					observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has no checkout", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, observed.task.Branch)
282				}
283			case 1:
284				registered, resolveErr := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, candidate)
285				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, resolveErr
286				if resolveErr == nil {
287					observed.worktreeFound = true
288					observed.checkout = registered.Path
289				}
290			default:
291				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has %d registered checkouts", gitx.ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, observed.task.Branch, observed.branchMatches)
292			}
293		}
294	}

296	func validateLiveLocator(locator Locator, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
297		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.hasCheckout() {
298			checks := []struct {
299				name     string
300				expected string
301				actual   string
302				required bool
303			}{
304				{"upstream", locator.Upstream, observed.status.Upstream, true},
305				{"HEAD", locator.HeadOID, observed.head, locator.HeadOID != ""},
306				{"base OID", locator.BaseOID, observed.baseOID, locator.BaseOID != ""},
307				{"upstream OID", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.upstreamOID, locator.UpstreamOID != ""},
308			}
309			for _, check := range checks {
310				if check.required && check.expected != check.actual {
311					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
312				}
313			}
314			return nil
315		}
316		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.HeadOID != "" {
317			if observed.localBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.HeadOID != observed.localBranchOID {
318				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected local branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.HeadOID, observed.localBranchOID)}
319			}
320		}
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.UpstreamOID != "" && locator.Upstream == observed.remoteBranch {
322			if observed.remoteBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.UpstreamOID != observed.remoteBranchOID {
323				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected remote branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.remoteBranchOID)}
324			}
325		}
326		return nil
327	}

329	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRuntime(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
330		switch options := request.Options.(type) {
331		case ParkWarmOptions:
332			if options.KeepSession || !observed.hasCheckout() {
333				return
334			}
335			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
336			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
337		case ParkColdOptions:
338			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
339				return
340			}
341			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
342			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
343			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
344				observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
345			}
346		case ResumeOptions:
347			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
348				return
349			}
350			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
351				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
352				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
353				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
354			})
355			if s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) == nil {
356				observed.savedRuntimeLive = savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
357			}
358		case CompleteDirectOptions, CompleteFFOptions, ReviewHandoffOptions, VerifyMergedOptions:
359			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
360				return
361			}
362			occupancyOptions := runtime.OccupancyOptions{
363				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
364				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
365				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
366			}
367			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, occupancyOptions)
368			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
369				observed.integration.occupancy = observed.occupancy
370				observed.integration.occupancyErr = observed.occupancyErr
371			}
372			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.integration.worktreeFound {
373				observed.integration.occupancy, observed.integration.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(
374					ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, occupancyOptions,
375				)
376			}
377		}
378	}

380	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRefs(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
381		observed.localBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
382		if observed.localBranchExists {
383			observed.localBranchOID, observed.localBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Branch)
384		}
385		observed.remoteBranch = "origin/" + observed.task.Branch
386		observed.remoteBranchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
387		if observed.remoteBranchExists {
388			observed.remoteBranchOID, observed.remoteBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
389		}
390	
391		switch request.Action {
392		case ParkCold:
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
394				observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
395				if observed.baseRef == "" {
396					observed.baseRef = s.gitDefaultBranch(ctx, observed.repoPath)
397				}
398				observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
399			}
400		case Resume:
401			observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
402			if observed.remoteBranchExists {
403				observed.baseRef = observed.remoteBranch
404			}
405			observed.baseRefExists = observed.baseRef != "" && s.gitRefExists(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
406			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !observed.hasCheckout() &&
407				(observed.task.State == task.Warm || observed.task.State == task.Cold) {
408				if observed.task.State == task.Warm && observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
409					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.canonicalPath(observed.task.WorktreePath)
410				} else {
411					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.renderWorktreePath(observed.task)
412				}
413				if observed.desiredWorktreeErr == nil {
414					observed.desiredWorktreeErr = wt.ValidateTarget(observed.desiredWorktree, observed.repoPath)
415				}
416			}
417		case CompleteDirect:
418			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Branch
419		case CompleteFF, ReviewHandoff:
420			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
421		case VerifyMerged:
422			options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
423			observed.completionBaseRef = options.BaseRef
424			if observed.completionBaseRef == "" {
425				observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
426			}
427		}
428	}

430	func (s *lifecycleService) renderWorktreePath(candidate task.Task) (string, error) {
431		values := config.Vars{
432			"worktree_root": config.Expand(s.cfg.Paths.WorktreeRoot),
433			"repo":          candidate.Repo,
434			"repo_path":     candidate.RepoPath,
435			"branch":        candidate.Branch,
436			"category":      "",
437			"host":          s.host,
438			"date":          s.now().Format("2006-01-02"),
439		}
440		rendered, err := config.Render(s.cfg.Paths.WorktreePath, values)
441		if err != nil {
```

```text
15	func (s *lifecycleService) applyGuarded(ctx context.Context, action Action, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
16		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
17			return Result{}, err
18		}
19		if approved.Action != action {
20			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("handler %s received %s", action, approved.Action)}
21		}
22		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
23			return Result{}, err
24		}
25		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
28		}
29	
30		var result Result
31		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
32			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
33				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
34				if loadErr != nil {
35					return &StalePlanError{
36						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID,
37						Reason:         "task record disappeared before apply",
38					}
39				}
40				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
41					return identityErr
42				}
43				fresh, observed, planErr := s.freshPlan(ctx, approved.Request, *record)
44				if planErr != nil {
45					return planErr
46				}
47				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
48				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
49					actual := ""
50					if current != nil {
51						actual = current.Revision
52					}
53					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked plan rebuild")
54				}
55				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
56					return &StalePlanError{
57						ExpectedPlanID:               approved.PlanID,
58						ActualPlanID:                 fresh.PlanID,
59						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
60						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
61						Reason:                       "fresh task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or option authority differs",
62					}
63				}
64				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
65					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
66					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
67				}
68	
69				execution := &executionState{
70					service: s, plan: fresh, observed: observed, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision,
71				}
72				var applyErr error
73				switch action {
74				case ParkWarm:
75					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkWarm(ctx)
76				case ParkCold:
77					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkCold(ctx)
78				case Resume:
79					result, applyErr = execution.applyResume(ctx)
80				case CompleteDirect:
81					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteDirect(ctx)
82				case CompleteFF:
83					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteFF(ctx)
84				case ReviewHandoff:
85					result, applyErr = execution.applyReviewHandoff(ctx)
86				case VerifyMerged:
87					result, applyErr = execution.applyVerifyMerged(ctx)
88				default:
89					applyErr = &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: action, Stage: "apply"}
90				}
91				return applyErr
92			})
93		})
94		return result, err
95	}

97	func (e *executionState) applyParkWarm(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
98		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ParkWarmOptions)
99		observed := &e.observed
```

```text
283	func replanDone(
284		ctx context.Context,
```

```text
551						candidate.WorktreePath = ""
552					}
553					if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
554						candidate.RuntimeName = ""
555						candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
556					} else {
557						candidate.RuntimeName = e.resumeRuntimeName
558						candidate.RuntimeHandle = e.resumeRuntimeHandle
559						if candidate.RuntimeName == "" || candidate.RuntimeHandle == "" {
560							return "", errors.New("HOT task requires the validated or newly opened runtime handle")
561						}
562					}
563					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
564					if updateErr != nil {
565						return "", fmt.Errorf("write HOT task state: %w", updateErr)
566					}
567					if updated == nil {
568						return "", errors.New("write HOT task state returned no revision")
569					}
570					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
571					observed.task = updated.Task
572					if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
573						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffDirectory, Path: observed.checkout, Label: candidate.Title()}
574					} else {
575						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffRuntime, Path: observed.checkout,
576							Runtime: candidate.RuntimeName, RuntimeHandle: candidate.RuntimeHandle, Label: candidate.Title()}
577					}
578					return "recorded HOT at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
579				})
580				if err != nil {
581					return e.fail(err, "checkout/runtime preparation may be complete; reload and reconcile task ownership, path, and runtime")
582				}
583			default:
584				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected Resume effect " + string(effect.Code)})
585			}
586		}
587		return e.result(), nil
588	}

590	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRepository(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
591		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
592		if err != nil {
593			return staleBoundary("canonical repository is no longer discoverable: " + err.Error())
594		}
595		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
596		if err != nil {
597			return staleBoundary("canonical repository path is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
598		}
599		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
600		if err != nil {
601			return staleBoundary("Git common directory is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
602		}
603		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
604			return staleBoundary("canonical repository or Git common directory changed")
605		}
606		return nil
607	}

609	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateGitBaseline(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
610		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
611		if err != nil {
612			return staleBoundary("exact worktree registration changed: " + err.Error())
613		}
614		if registered != observed.worktree {
615			return staleBoundary("exact worktree path, branch, HEAD, Main, locked, or prunable flags changed")
616		}
617		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
618		if err != nil {
619			return staleBoundary("Git status observation changed: " + err.Error())
620		}
621		if !sameStatus(status, observed.status) {
622			return staleBoundary("Git status, branch, upstream, ahead, behind, dirty, or conflict evidence changed")
623		}
624		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
625		if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(head) != observed.head {
626			return staleBoundary("checkout HEAD changed")
627		}
628		baseOID, baseErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
629		upstreamOID, upstreamErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
630		if errorString(baseErr) != errorString(observed.baseOIDErr) || baseOID != observed.baseOID ||
631			errorString(upstreamErr) != errorString(observed.upstreamOIDErr) || upstreamOID != observed.upstreamOID {
632			return staleBoundary("base or upstream ref OID changed")
633		}
634		operation, active, err := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
635		if err != nil || operation != observed.operation || active != observed.inProgress {
636			return staleBoundary("Git operation evidence changed")
637		}
638		return nil
639	}

641	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, expectedBranch string) error {
642		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
643		if err != nil {
644			return err
645		}
646		if registered.Path != observed.checkout || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
647			return errors.New("checkout path or Git common directory changed")
648		}
649		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !registered.IsLinkedWorktree() {
650			return errors.New("worktree task no longer resolves to a linked checkout")
651		}
652		if observed.mode != task.ModeWorktree && (!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare) {
653			return errors.New("canonical task no longer resolves to the main checkout")
654		}
655		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
656		if err != nil {
657			return err
658		}
659		if status.Detached || expectedBranch != "" && status.Branch != expectedBranch || registered.Worktree.Branch != status.Branch {
660			return fmt.Errorf("checkout branch changed: registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", registered.Worktree.Branch, status.Branch, expectedBranch)
661		}
662		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
663		if err != nil {
664			return err
665		}
666		head = strings.TrimSpace(head)
667		if registered.Worktree.Head != head {
668			return fmt.Errorf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", registered.Worktree.Head, head)
669		}
670		baseOID, baseOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
671		upstreamOID, upstreamOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
672		operation, active, operationErr := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
673		if operationErr != nil {
674			return operationErr
675		}
676		observed.worktree = registered
677		observed.status = status
678		observed.statusErr = nil
679		observed.head = head
680		observed.headErr = nil
681		observed.baseOID = baseOID
682		observed.baseOIDErr = baseOIDErr
683		observed.upstreamOID = upstreamOID
684		observed.upstreamOIDErr = upstreamOIDErr
685		observed.operation = operation
686		observed.inProgress = active
687		observed.operationErr = nil
688		return nil
689	}

691	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureParkBranchIdentity(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
692		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
693			return err
694		}
695		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch || observed.inProgress || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
696			return staleBoundary("task branch, conflict, or Git operation evidence changed before push")
697		}
698		return nil
699	}

701	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureColdGitReady(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
702		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
703			return err
704		}
705		if observed.status.Dirty() {
706			return fmt.Errorf("cold parking requires a clean checkout: %s", observed.status.Breakdown())
707		}
708		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
709			return errors.New("cold parking checkout is no longer on the task branch")
710		}
711		if observed.inProgress || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
712			return errors.New("cold parking refuses an active Git operation or unresolved conflict")
713		}
714		if !observed.status.Published() || observed.status.Ahead != 0 {
715			return fmt.Errorf("cold parking requires a published ahead=0 branch; status is %s", observed.status.Summary())
716		}
717		return nil
718	}

720	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateColdArtifact(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
721		if observed.mode != task.ModeWorktree {
722			return nil
723		}
724		fresh, err := s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
725		if err != nil {
726			return err
727		}
728		if !fresh.Ready() {
729			return errors.New("artifact readiness changed to blocked")
730		}
731		if artifactAuthority(fresh, nil) != artifactAuthority(observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr) {
732			return staleBoundary("artifact intent or receipt authority changed")
733		}
734		return nil
735	}

738		options := observed.cleanupOptions(closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, timeout)
739		fresh, err := s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, options)
740		if err != nil {
741			return err
742		}
743		if cleanupAuthority(fresh, nil) != cleanupAuthority(observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr) {
744			return staleBoundary("runtime occupancy, caller, agent, or session evidence changed")
745		}
746		return nil

749	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool, timeout time.Duration) error {
750		fresh, err := s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
751			observed.cleanupOptions(closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, timeout))
752		if err != nil {
753			return err
754		}
755		if !fresh.Ready() || fresh.CallerContained || len(fresh.Sessions) > 0 {
756			return errors.New("runtime coverage reappeared after closure")
757		}
758		observed.cleanup = fresh
759		observed.cleanupErr = nil

763	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureColdRemovalBoundary(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, options ParkColdOptions, runtimeWasClosed bool) error {
764		if err := s.ensureColdGitReady(ctx, observed); err != nil {
765			return err
766		}
767		if err := s.revalidateColdArtifact(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
768			return err
769		}
770		fresh, err := s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
771			observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout))
772		if err != nil {
773			return err
774		}
775		if !fresh.Ready() || fresh.CallerContained || len(fresh.Sessions) > 0 {
776			return errors.New("cleanup occupancy is no longer empty and safe")
777		}
778		if !runtimeWasClosed && cleanupAuthority(fresh, nil) != cleanupAuthority(observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr) {
779			return staleBoundary("runtime occupancy changed before cleanup")
780		}
781		observed.cleanup = fresh
782		observed.cleanupErr = nil
783		return nil
```

```text
793			Panes: []runtime.Pane{{
794				ID: handle + ":pane", CWD: checkout,

800	func stepCodes(result Result) []EffectCode {
801		steps := result.AttemptedSteps()
802		codes := make([]EffectCode, len(steps))
803		for index, step := range steps {
804			codes[index] = step.Effect.Code
805		}
806		return codes
807	}

810		for _, message := range messages {

812				return true
813			}
814		}
815		return false
816	}
```

```text
13	func newResumeCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
14		var (
15			noProvision bool
16			fetch       bool
17			force       bool
18		)
19		cmd := &cobra.Command{
20			Use:   "resume <task>",
21			Short: "Pick a task back up, rebuilding whatever is missing",
22			Long: `Make a parked task hot again.
23	
24	Warm tasks still have their worktree, so this just reopens a runtime session.
25	Cold tasks do not: the worktree is rebuilt from the branch, which is why going
26	cold is safe in the first place — the branch, not the directory, is the task's
27	identity.
28	
29	If the task is owned by another machine, resuming here takes ownership. Two
30	machines writing the same branch is the one way to make this workflow produce
31	a conflict, so dev asks before doing it.`,
32			Args: cobra.ExactArgs(1),
33			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
34				ctx := ctxOf()
35				execution, err := executeTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
36					return app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
37				}, taskflow.ResumeOptions{
38					FetchRefs: fetch, NoProvision: noProvision, TakeOwnership: force,
39				})
40				if err != nil {
41					return err
42				}
43	
44				resumed := &execution.Task
45				handoff, ok := execution.Result.Handoff()
46				if !ok || handoff.Path == "" {
47					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is HOT, but resume returned no activation handoff", resumed.ID)
48				}
49				checkout := handoff.Path
50				var activationRuntime runtime.Runtime
51				switch handoff.Kind {
52				case taskflow.HandoffDirectory:
53					if resumed.RuntimeName != "" || resumed.RuntimeHandle != "" {
54						return fmt.Errorf("task %s returned a directory handoff with persisted runtime %s/%s",
55							resumed.ID, resumed.RuntimeName, resumed.RuntimeHandle)
56					}
57				case taskflow.HandoffRuntime:
58					activationRuntime = app.runtimeNamed(handoff.Runtime)
59					if activationRuntime == nil || activationRuntime.Name() != handoff.Runtime {
60						return fmt.Errorf("resume handoff backend %q is unavailable", handoff.Runtime)
61					}
62					if resumed.RuntimeName != handoff.Runtime || resumed.RuntimeHandle != handoff.RuntimeHandle {
63						return fmt.Errorf("task %s persisted runtime %s/%s, but resume handed off %s/%s",
64							resumed.ID, resumed.RuntimeName, resumed.RuntimeHandle, handoff.Runtime, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
65					}
66					annotate(app, activationRuntime, resumed)
67				default:
68					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is HOT, but resume returned unsupported %s handoff", resumed.ID, handoff.Kind)
69				}
70	
71				mode := resumed.EffectiveMode()
72				style := app.outStyle()
73				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s  %s on %s (%s)\n",
74					task.Hot.Icon(), resumed.Title(), resumed.Repo, resumed.Branch, style.dim(string(mode)))
75				if resumed.Next != "" {
76					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s      %s\n", style.label("next"), resumed.Next)
77				}
78				if resumed.AgentSession != "" {
79					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s (resumable)\n", style.label("agent"), resumed.AgentSession)
80				}
81				if st, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout); statusErr == nil {
82					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s       %s\n", style.label("git"), style.git(st.Summary()))
83					if st.Behind > 0 {
84						app.warnf("branch is %d behind upstream — `git pull --ff-only` before you start", st.Behind)
85					}
86				}
87				if handoff.Kind == taskflow.HandoffDirectory {
88					return app.cdDirective(checkout)
89				}
90				return activateRuntime(ctx, activationRuntime, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
91			},
92		}
93		f := cmd.Flags()
94		f.BoolVar(&noProvision, "no-provision", false, "skip dependency install when rebuilding a worktree")
95		f.BoolVar(&fetch, "fetch", true, "fetch from origin first")
96		f.BoolVar(&force, "force", false, "take ownership of a task owned by another machine")
97		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Warm, task.Cold)
98		return cmd
99	}
```

```text
381	// Bubble Tea messages, update the model and triggers redraws.
382	func (p *Program) eventLoop(model Model, cmds chan Cmd) (Model, error) {
383		for {
384			select {

387

390

395				}
396				if msg == nil {
397					continue
398				}
399	
400				// Handle special internal messages.
401				switch msg := msg.(type) {
402				case QuitMsg:
403					return model, nil
404	
405				case InterruptMsg:
406					return model, ErrInterrupted
407	
408				case SuspendMsg:
409					if suspendSupported {
410						p.suspend()
411					}
412	
413				case clearScreenMsg:
414					p.renderer.clearScreen()
415	
416				case enterAltScreenMsg:
417					p.renderer.enterAltScreen()
418

421

423					switch msg.(type) {

426					case enableMouseAllMotionMsg:
427						p.renderer.enableMouseAllMotion()
428					}
429					// mouse mode (1006) is a no-op if the terminal doesn't support it.
430					p.renderer.enableMouseSGRMode()
431	
432					// XXX: This is used to enable mouse mode on Windows. We need
433					// to reinitialize the cancel reader to get the mouse events to
434					// work.
435					if runtime.GOOS == "windows" && !p.mouseMode {
436						p.mouseMode = true
437						p.initCancelReader(true) //nolint:errcheck,gosec
438					}
439	
440				case disableMouseMsg:
441					p.disableMouse()
442	
443					// XXX: On Windows, mouse mode is enabled on the input reader
444					// level. We need to instruct the input reader to stop reading
445					// mouse events.

447						p.mouseMode = false

479					continue
```

```text
1	package taskflow
2	
3	import "github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
4	
5	// TransitionRule is one cell in the exhaustive persisted lifecycle table. An
6	// empty Target on an allowed rule means the task record is removed rather than
7	// assigned another persisted state.
8	type TransitionRule struct {
9		Mode            task.CheckoutMode
10		Source          task.State
11		Action          Action
12		Target          task.State
13		Allowed         bool
14		StatePreserving bool
15		RemovesTask     bool
16		Milestone       Milestone
17		Reason          string
18	}
19	
20	// HasTarget reports whether an allowed edge writes a persisted target state.
21	func (r TransitionRule) HasTarget() bool { return r.Allowed && r.Target != "" }
22	
23	type transitionKey struct {
24		mode   task.CheckoutMode
25		state  task.State
26		action Action
27	}
28	
29	var (
30		modeOrder = []task.CheckoutMode{
31			task.ModeWorktree,
32			task.ModeBranch,
33			task.ModeDirect,
34		}
35		stateOrder = []task.State{
36			task.Hot,
37			task.Warm,
38			task.Cold,
39			task.Done,
40		}
41		transitionActionOrder = []Action{
42			ParkWarm,
43			ParkCold,
44			Resume,
45			CompleteDirect,
46			CompleteFF,
47			ReviewHandoff,
48			VerifyMerged,
49			Retire,
50		}
51		transitionTable = buildTransitionTable()
52	)
53	
54	// TransitionActions returns the actions represented in every mode/state row.
55	// Adopt, RemoveCheckout, RefreshRemote, and Reconcile are deliberately absent
56	// because they operate on row ownership, repository context, or drift rather
57	// than persisted-state edges.
58	func TransitionActions() []Action {
59		return append([]Action(nil), transitionActionOrder...)
60	}
61	
62	// PersistedLifecycleActions is the stable action dimension of the lifecycle
63	// table, including state-preserving review handoff but excluding repository
64	// context actions such as remote refresh.
65	func PersistedLifecycleActions() []Action { return TransitionActions() }
66	
67	// Transitions returns all table cells in mode, state, and action order. Denied
68	// cells are retained so additions cannot silently fall through a switch.
69	func Transitions() []TransitionRule {
70		out := make([]TransitionRule, 0, len(modeOrder)*len(stateOrder)*len(transitionActionOrder))
71		for _, mode := range modeOrder {
72			for _, state := range stateOrder {
73				for _, action := range transitionActionOrder {
74					out = append(out, transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: state, action: action}])
75				}
76			}
77		}
78		return out
79	}
80	
81	// LookupTransition returns the exhaustive table cell for known dimensions.
82	func LookupTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, bool) {
83		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(source) || !isTransitionAction(action) {
84			return TransitionRule{Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action}, false
85		}
86		rule, ok := transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}]
87		return rule, ok
88	}
89	
90	// RequireTransition returns the allowed table cell or a typed graph error.
91	func RequireTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, error) {
92		rule, found := LookupTransition(mode, source, action)
93		if !found {
94			rule.Reason = "unknown mode, state, or non-transition action"
95			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
96		}
97		if !rule.Allowed {
98			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
99		}
100		return rule, nil
101	}
102	
103	func isTransitionAction(action Action) bool {
104		for _, candidate := range transitionActionOrder {
105			if action == candidate {
106				return true
107			}
108		}
109		return false
110	}
111	
112	func validMode(mode task.CheckoutMode) bool {
113		for _, candidate := range modeOrder {
114			if mode == candidate {
115				return true
116			}
117		}
118		return false
119	}
120	
121	func validState(state task.State) bool {
122		for _, candidate := range stateOrder {
123			if state == candidate {
124				return true
125			}
126		}
127		return false
128	}
129	
130	func buildTransitionTable() map[transitionKey]TransitionRule {
131		table := make(map[transitionKey]TransitionRule, len(modeOrder)*len(stateOrder)*len(transitionActionOrder))
132		for _, mode := range modeOrder {
133			for _, source := range stateOrder {
134				for _, action := range transitionActionOrder {
135					rule := TransitionRule{
136						Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action,
137						Reason: deniedTransitionReason(mode, source, action),
138					}
139					table[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}] = rule
140				}
141			}
142		}
143	
144		allow := func(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action, target task.State, preserving, removes bool, milestone Milestone) {
145			key := transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}
146			table[key] = TransitionRule{
147				Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action, Target: target,
148				Allowed: true, StatePreserving: preserving, RemovesTask: removes,
149				Milestone: milestone,
150			}
151		}
152	
153		for _, mode := range []task.CheckoutMode{task.ModeWorktree, task.ModeBranch} {
154			allow(mode, task.Hot, ParkWarm, task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
155			// Existing park accepts WARM tasks so it can update parking metadata and
156			// close a residual runtime without manufacturing a backward transition.
157			allow(mode, task.Warm, ParkWarm, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
158			allow(mode, task.Hot, ParkCold, task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
159			allow(mode, task.Warm, ParkCold, task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
160			allow(mode, task.Warm, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
161			allow(mode, task.Cold, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
162			allow(mode, task.Hot, CompleteFF, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
163			allow(mode, task.Warm, CompleteFF, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
164			allow(mode, task.Hot, VerifyMerged, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
165			allow(mode, task.Warm, VerifyMerged, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
166			allow(mode, task.Hot, ReviewHandoff, task.Hot, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
167			allow(mode, task.Warm, ReviewHandoff, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
168			allow(mode, task.Done, Retire, "", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
169		}
170	
171		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, ParkWarm, task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
172		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, ParkWarm, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
173		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
174		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, CompleteDirect, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
175		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, CompleteDirect, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
176		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Done, Retire, "", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
177	
178		return table
179	}
180	
181	func deniedTransitionReason(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) string {
182		if mode == task.ModeDirect && source == task.Cold {
183			return "direct tasks cannot be COLD"
184		}
185		if action == ParkCold && mode == task.ModeDirect {
186			return "direct tasks use the canonical checkout and cannot be parked COLD"
187		}
188		if source == task.Done {
189			return "DONE tasks can only be retired through the persisted lifecycle graph"
190		}
191		if source == task.Cold {
192			return "COLD tasks must resume before any completion or review action"
193		}
194		if action == CompleteDirect && mode != task.ModeDirect {
195			return "direct completion is only valid for direct tasks"
196		}
197		if (action == CompleteFF || action == ReviewHandoff || action == VerifyMerged) && mode == task.ModeDirect {
198			return "direct tasks have no separate branch to integrate or hand off"
199		}
200		return "the edge is not in the approved lifecycle graph"
201	}
```

```text
1	// Package taskflow defines the side-effect-free lifecycle graph and the values
2	// exchanged between lifecycle planners, callers, and action executors.
3	package taskflow
4	
5	import (
6		"fmt"
7		"regexp"
8		"sort"
9		"strings"
10		"time"
11	
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
13	)
14	
15	// Field is one stable key/value member of an immutable Fields value.
16	type Field struct {
17		Key   string
18		Value string
19	}
20	
21	// Fields is a map-shaped value whose backing storage is not exposed. Entries
22	// are kept in key order so fingerprints do not depend on map iteration order.
23	type Fields struct {
24		entries []Field
25	}
26	
27	// NewFields copies values into a deterministic immutable representation.
28	func NewFields(values map[string]string) Fields {
29		entries := make([]Field, 0, len(values))
30		for key, value := range values {
31			entries = append(entries, Field{Key: key, Value: value})
32		}
33		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Key < entries[j].Key })
34		return Fields{entries: entries}
35	}
36	
37	// Entries returns a copy in stable key order.
38	func (f Fields) Entries() []Field {
39		return append([]Field(nil), f.entries...)
40	}
41	
42	// Map returns a mutable copy of the fields.
43	func (f Fields) Map() map[string]string {
44		out := make(map[string]string, len(f.entries))
45		for _, entry := range f.entries {
46			out[entry.Key] = entry.Value
47		}
48		return out
49	}
50	
51	func (f Fields) clone() Fields { return Fields{entries: f.Entries()} }
52	
53	// StringList is an ordered string value whose backing slice is not exposed.
54	type StringList struct {
55		values []string
56	}
57	
58	// NewStringList copies values without changing their order.
59	func NewStringList(values ...string) StringList {
60		return StringList{values: append([]string(nil), values...)}
61	}
62	
63	// Values returns a mutable copy of the strings.
64	func (s StringList) Values() []string { return append([]string(nil), s.values...) }
65	
66	func (s StringList) clone() StringList { return NewStringList(s.values...) }
67	
68	// Action names one guarded operation. Values are stable external identifiers,
69	// not presentation labels.
70	type Action string
71	
72	const (
73		ParkWarm       Action = "park-warm"
74		ParkCold       Action = "park-cold"
75		Resume         Action = "resume"
76		CompleteDirect Action = "complete-direct"
77		CompleteFF     Action = "complete-ff"
78		ReviewHandoff  Action = "review-handoff"
79		VerifyMerged   Action = "verify-merged"
80		Retire         Action = "retire"
81		Adopt          Action = "adopt"
82		RemoveCheckout Action = "remove-checkout"
83		RefreshRemote  Action = "refresh-remote"
84		Reconcile      Action = "reconcile"
85	)
86	
87	var actionOrder = []Action{
88		ParkWarm,
89		ParkCold,
90		Resume,
91		CompleteDirect,
92		CompleteFF,
93		ReviewHandoff,
94		VerifyMerged,
95		Retire,
96		Adopt,
97		RemoveCheckout,
98		RefreshRemote,
99		Reconcile,
100	}
101	
102	// Actions returns every supported action in stable display order.
103	func Actions() []Action { return append([]Action(nil), actionOrder...) }
104	
105	// Valid reports whether the action is part of this protocol version.
106	func (a Action) Valid() bool {
107		for _, candidate := range actionOrder {
108			if a == candidate {
109				return true
```

```text
215	// NewRequest infers the action from options and returns a normalized value.
216	func NewRequest(locator Locator, options ActionOptions) (Request, error) {
217		if options == nil {
218			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action options are required", ErrInvalidRequest)
219		}
220		normalized, err := cloneActionOptions(options, "")
221		if err != nil {
222			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
223		}
224		request := Request{Locator: locator, Action: normalized.Action(), Options: normalized}
225		return normalizeRequest(request)
226	}
227	
228	// Clone returns a request whose option-owned collection values are independent.
229	func (r Request) Clone() Request {
230		options, err := cloneActionOptions(r.Options, r.Action)
231		if err == nil {
232			r.Options = options
233		}
234		return r
235	}
236	
237	// Validate checks option/action agreement and graph legality without performing
238	// observations or side effects.
239	func (r Request) Validate() error {
240		_, err := normalizeRequest(r)
241		return err
242	}

244	func normalizeRequest(request Request) (Request, error) {
245		if !request.Action.Valid() {
246			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown action %q", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action)
247		}
248		options, err := cloneActionOptions(request.Options, request.Action)
249		if err != nil {
250			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
251		}
252		if options.Action() != request.Action {
253			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action %s cannot use %s options", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, options.Action())
254		}
255		if err := validateActionOptions(options); err != nil {
256			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, err)
257		}
258		request.Options = options
259		if isTransitionAction(request.Action) {
260			if _, err := RequireTransition(request.Locator.Mode, request.Locator.State, request.Action); err != nil {
261				return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
262			}
263		}
264		return request, nil
265	}
```

```text
103		raw, err := h.runDisplayed(ctx, display, args...)

164	// List implements Runtime. Workspaces carry no working directory of their own,
165	// so dev joins them against the pane list — panes are what actually have a cwd.
166	func (h *Herdr) List(ctx context.Context) ([]Session, error) {
167		var ws struct {
168			Workspaces []herdrWorkspace `json:"workspaces"`
169		}
170		if err := h.call(ctx, &ws, "workspace", "list"); err != nil {
171			return nil, err
172		}
173		var ps struct {
174			Panes []herdrPane `json:"panes"`
175		}
176		if err := h.call(ctx, &ps, "pane", "list"); err != nil {
177			return nil, err
178		}
179	
180		dirs := map[string]map[string]bool{}
181		agents := map[string]map[string]bool{}
182		panes := map[string][]Pane{}
183		for _, p := range ps.Panes {
184			cwd := p.ForegroundCWD
185			if cwd == "" {
186				cwd = p.CWD
187			}
188			if dirs[p.WorkspaceID] == nil {
189				dirs[p.WorkspaceID] = map[string]bool{}
190			}
191			for _, dir := range []string{p.CWD, cwd} {
192				if dir != "" {
193					dirs[p.WorkspaceID][dir] = true
194				}
195			}
196			agentSession := ""
197			if p.AgentSession != nil && p.AgentSession.Value != "" {
198				agent := p.AgentSession.Agent
199				if agent == "" {
200					agent = p.Agent
201				}
202				agentSession = agent + ":" + p.AgentSession.Value
203				if agents[p.WorkspaceID] == nil {
204					agents[p.WorkspaceID] = map[string]bool{}
205				}
206				agents[p.WorkspaceID][agentSession] = true
207			}
208			panes[p.WorkspaceID] = append(panes[p.WorkspaceID], Pane{
209				ID: p.PaneID, CWD: cwd, ShellCWD: p.CWD, Agent: p.Agent,
210				AgentStatus: p.AgentStatus, AgentSession: agentSession,
211			})
212		}
213	
214		out := make([]Session, 0, len(ws.Workspaces))
215		for _, w := range ws.Workspaces {
216			out = append(out, Session{
217				Handle:        w.WorkspaceID,
218				Label:         w.Label,
219				Dirs:          keys(dirs[w.WorkspaceID]),
220				AgentSessions: keys(agents[w.WorkspaceID]),
221				AgentStatus:   w.AgentStatus,
222				Panes:         panes[w.WorkspaceID],
223				Focused:       w.Focused,
224			})
225		}
226		return out, nil
227	}

275	// Open implements Runtime. An already-open directory is reused rather than
276	// opened twice. It remains detached; explicit navigation calls Activate.
277	func (h *Herdr) Open(ctx context.Context, dir, label string) (OpenResult, error) {
278		existing, err := h.List(ctx)
279		if err != nil {
280			return OpenResult{}, err
281		}
282		for _, s := range existing {
283			if s.Covers(dir) {
284				return OpenResult{Handle: s.Handle, Surface: "workspace", Opened: true}, nil
285			}
286		}
287		args := []string{"workspace", "create", "--cwd", dir, "--no-focus"}
288		if label != "" {
289			args = append(args, "--label", label)
290		}
291		var res struct {
292			Workspace herdrWorkspace `json:"workspace"`
293			RootPane  herdrPane      `json:"root_pane"`
294		}
295		if err := h.call(ctx, &res, args...); err != nil {
296			return OpenResult{}, err
297		}
298		if res.Workspace.WorkspaceID == "" {
299			return OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("herdr workspace create: response has no workspace id")
300		}
301		if res.RootPane.PaneID == "" || res.RootPane.WorkspaceID != res.Workspace.WorkspaceID {
302			return OpenResult{}, h.rejectCreatedWorkspace(ctx, res.Workspace.WorkspaceID,
303				"herdr workspace create: response has no correlated root pane")
304		}
305		return OpenResult{
306			Handle: res.Workspace.WorkspaceID, Surface: "workspace", Opened: true,
307			Created: true, RootPaneID: res.RootPane.PaneID,
308		}, nil
309	}
```

```text
429	func completionDirtyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) (Verdict, string) {
430		if observed.statusErr != nil {
431			return VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
432		}
433		if !observed.status.Dirty() {
434			return VerdictMet, "checkout is clean; dirty policy " + string(dirty) + " causes no content mutation"
435		}
436		evidence := observed.status.Breakdown()
437		if observed.finishErr == nil {
438			evidence += fmt.Sprintf("; %d path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
439				observed.finish.EquivalentDirty(), observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.UniqueDirty())
440		}
441		switch dirty {
442		case DirtyAuto:
443			return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; choose an explicit dirty policy"
444		case DirtyFail:
445			return VerdictBlocked, evidence + "; fail policy refuses dirty completion"
446		case DirtyCommit:
447			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
448				return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; commit-all requires a nonempty message"
449			}
450			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; commit-all was explicitly selected"
451		case DirtyDiscard:
452			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
453				return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires DROP"
454			}
455			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires approval"
456		default:
457			return VerdictError, "unknown dirty policy " + string(dirty)
458		}
459	}
```

```text
659		observed *lifecycleObservation,
660	) (completionIntegrationObservation, error) {
661		var fresh completionIntegrationObservation
662		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
663		fresh.worktree, fresh.worktreeErr = registered, err
664		if err != nil {
665			return fresh, err
666		}
667		fresh.worktreeFound = true
668		if registered.Path != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
669			!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare {
670			return fresh, errors.New("integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout")
671		}
672		fresh.status, fresh.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
673		if fresh.statusErr != nil {
674			return fresh, fresh.statusErr
675		}
676		if fresh.status.Dirty() || fresh.status.Conflicted > 0 {
677			return fresh, fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout is not clean: %s", fresh.status.Breakdown())
678		}
679		fresh.head, fresh.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
680		if fresh.headErr != nil {
681			return fresh, fresh.headErr
682		}
683		fresh.head = strings.TrimSpace(fresh.head)
684		if registered.Worktree.Head != fresh.head {
685			return fresh, errors.New("canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD")
686		}
687		fresh.operation, fresh.inProgress, fresh.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
688		if fresh.operationErr != nil {
689			return fresh, fresh.operationErr
690		}
691		if fresh.inProgress {
692			return fresh, errors.New("canonical integration checkout has Git operation " + fresh.operation + " in progress")
693		}
694		fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
695			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
696			CallerWorkspaceID: observed.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
697			CallerPaneID:      observed.taskflowCallerPane,
698		})
699		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr); occupancyErr != nil {
700			return fresh, occupancyErr
701		}
702		return fresh, nil
703	}
704	
705	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshIntegrationTarget(
706		ctx context.Context,
707		observed *lifecycleObservation,
708		expectedBranch string,
709	) error {
710		fresh, err := s.inspectIntegrationTarget(ctx, observed)
711		if err != nil {
712			return err
713		}
714		if fresh.status.Detached || fresh.status.Branch != expectedBranch || fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch != expectedBranch {
715			return fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout branch is registry=%q status=%q expected=%q",
716				fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch, fresh.status.Branch, expectedBranch)
717		}
718		observed.integration = fresh
719		return nil
720	}
721	
722	func syncBranchIntegration(observed *lifecycleObservation) {
723		observed.integration = completionIntegrationObservation{
724			worktree: observed.worktree, worktreeFound: observed.worktreeFound, worktreeErr: observed.worktreeErr,
725			status: observed.status, statusErr: observed.statusErr,
726			head: observed.head, headErr: observed.headErr,
727			operation: observed.operation, inProgress: observed.inProgress, operationErr: observed.operationErr,
728			occupancy: observed.occupancy, occupancyErr: observed.occupancyErr,
729		}
730	}

744		observed.occupancy = observed.integration.occupancy

748		observed.upstreamOID, observed.upstreamOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.status.Upstream)

750	
751	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateMergeProof(
752		ctx context.Context,
753		observed *lifecycleObservation,
754	) (bool, error) {
755		baseOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef)
756		if err != nil {
757			return false, err
758		}
759		if baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {
760			return false, staleBoundary("verification base ref moved from its approved OID")
761		}
762		proofOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofRef)
763		if err != nil {
764			return false, err
765		}
766		if proofOID != observed.proofOID {
767			return false, staleBoundary("verification proof ref moved from its expected OID")
768		}
769		contained, err := s.isAncestor(ctx, observed.repoPath, proofOID, baseOID)
770		if err != nil {
771			return false, err
772		}
773		observed.proofContained = contained
774		observed.proofErr = nil
775		return contained, nil
776	}
777	
778	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateVerifiedCompletion(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
779		if err := s.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
780			return err
781		}
782		contained, err := s.revalidateMergeProof(ctx, observed)
783		if err != nil {
784			return err
785		}
786		if !contained {
787			return errors.New("exact merge proof is no longer contained in the selected base")
788		}
789		return nil
```

```text
57		ReadinessObservationError     ReadinessState = "observation-error"
58	)
59	
60	// IntentReadiness is the read-only finalization evidence for one intent whose
61	// recorded worktree is the exact checkout being inspected.
62	type IntentReadiness struct {
63		Intent           Intent
64		State            ReadinessState
65		Finalized        bool
66		ReceiptReachable bool
67		ObservationError error
68	}
69	
70	// ReadinessInspection is a complete read-only observation for one exact
71	// checkout. KnownEmpty is true only when the store was read successfully and no
72	// intent matched the checkout; it distinguishes absence from failed observation.
73	type ReadinessInspection struct {
74		Checkout         string
75		KnownEmpty       bool
76		Intents          []IntentReadiness
77		ObservationError error
78	}
79	
80	// Ready applies only the existing artifact finalization contract: an exact
81	// checkout is ready when it has no intents, or every intent was explicitly
82	// discarded or has a finalized receipt that is still reachable. Missing or
83	// incomplete evidence fails closed.
84	func (i ReadinessInspection) Ready() bool {
85		if i.ObservationError != nil {
86			return false
87		}
88		if len(i.Intents) == 0 {
89			return i.KnownEmpty
90		}
91		if i.KnownEmpty {
92			return false
93		}
94		for _, intent := range i.Intents {
95			if intent.ObservationError != nil {
96				return false
97			}
98			switch intent.State {
99			case ReadinessDiscarded:
100				// Discard is the existing explicit operator escape hatch.
101			case ReadinessFinalizedReachable:
102				if !intent.Finalized || !intent.ReceiptReachable {
103					return false
104				}
105			default:
106				return false
107			}
108		}
109		return true
110	}
111	
112	// InspectReadiness gathers artifact finalization evidence for one exact
113	// checkout. It never reconciles receipts, finalizes intents, or writes either
114	// source files or intent records. The returned inspection retains partial
115	// evidence and the same wrapped error returned separately to ordinary callers.
116	func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
117		inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
118		if ctx == nil {
119			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")
120			inspection.ObservationError = err
121			return inspection, err
122		}
123		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
124			inspection.ObservationError = err
125			return inspection, err
126		}
127		if store == nil {
128			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a store")
129			inspection.ObservationError = err
130			return inspection, err
131		}
132	
133		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
134		if err != nil {
135			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
136			inspection.ObservationError = err
137			return inspection, err
138		}
139		inspection.Checkout = canonical
140	
141		intents, err := store.List()
142		if err != nil {
143			err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
144			inspection.ObservationError = err
145			return inspection, err
146		}
147		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
148			inspection.ObservationError = err
149			return inspection, err
150		}
151	
152		for _, intent := range intents {
153			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
154				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
155				break
156			}
157			intentCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
158			if err != nil {
159				err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, err)
160				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
161				continue
162			}
163			if intentCheckout != canonical {
164				continue
165			}
166	
167			evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
168			switch intent.Status {
169			case Armed, Finalizing:
170				evidence.State = ReadinessPending
171			case Failed:
172				evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
173			case Discarded:
174				evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
175			case Finalized:
176				evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, canonical, intent)
177				switch {
178				case err != nil:
179					err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
180					evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
181					evidence.ObservationError = err
182					inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
183				case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
184					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
185				default:
186					evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
187				}
188			default:
189				// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
190				// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
191				err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
192				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
193				evidence.ObservationError = err
194				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
195			}
196			inspection.Intents = append(inspection.Intents, evidence)
197		}
198	
199		inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
200		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
201	}
202	
203	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
204		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
205			return false, nil
206		}
207		candidates := []struct {
208			dir string
209			ref string
210		}{
211			{checkout, "HEAD"},
212			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
213			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
214		}
215		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
216		var observationErr error
217		for _, candidate := range candidates {
218			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
219				continue
220			}
```

```text
429	func completionDirtyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) (Verdict, string) {
430		if observed.statusErr != nil {
431			return VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
432		}
433		if !observed.status.Dirty() {
434			return VerdictMet, "checkout is clean; dirty policy " + string(dirty) + " causes no content mutation"
435		}
436		evidence := observed.status.Breakdown()
437		if observed.finishErr == nil {
438			evidence += fmt.Sprintf("; %d path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
439				observed.finish.EquivalentDirty(), observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.UniqueDirty())
440		}
441		switch dirty {
442		case DirtyAuto:
443			return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; choose an explicit dirty policy"
444		case DirtyFail:
445			return VerdictBlocked, evidence + "; fail policy refuses dirty completion"
446		case DirtyCommit:
447			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
448				return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; commit-all requires a nonempty message"
449			}
450			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; commit-all was explicitly selected"
451		case DirtyDiscard:
452			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
453				return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires DROP"
454			}
455			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires approval"
456		default:
457			return VerdictError, "unknown dirty policy " + string(dirty)
458		}
459	}
```

```text
46	const rootLong = `dev is a thin glue layer over git, worktrees, forges and agent runtimes.
47	
48	It exists to keep four things separate that otherwise collapse into one:
49	
50	  git remote      durable code state, the source of truth
51	  git worktree    a disposable local checkout
52	  herdr / tmux / zellij
53	                  a per-host live runtime
54	  dev             human intent: what am I working on, and what is next
55	
56	Everything derivable from git or the runtime is derived live. dev persists only
57	human intent Git cannot answer — task state/owner/next action and asset identity,
58	tags, notes and experiment lifecycle — so closing a runtime session or moving a
59	Try never means losing the thread. Transient pane data is not persisted.
60	
61	` + workflowTLDR

71	// descriptors.
72	func NewRootCommandWithIO(out, errOut io.Writer) *cobra.Command {
73		return newRootCommand(&App{In: os.Stdin, Out: out, Err: errOut})
74	}

184			return asUsageError(err)

202	// Execute runs the CLI and maps errors to exit codes. SilenceErrors and
203	// SilenceUsage are set on the root, so nothing reaches the terminal unless it
204	// is printed here; ExecuteC hands back the command that failed so a usage
205	// mistake can be answered with that command's usage rather than the root's.
206	func Execute() int {
207		trace, tracePath, traceErr := traceFromEnvironment()
208		app := &App{
209			In: os.Stdin, Out: os.Stdout, Err: os.Stderr,

216		defer app.finishTrace()
```

```text
36	func newLifecycleSession(ctx context.Context, app *App, resolve lifecycleTaskResolver) (lifecycleSession, error) {

56		return session, nil

125	func exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx context.Context, repoPath, checkoutPath string) (flow.Locator, error) {

127		if err != nil {

129		}

135			GitCommonDir: registered.GitCommonDir,
136			RepoPath:     registered.RepositoryPath,
137			CheckoutPath: registered.Path,
138			Branch:       registered.Worktree.Branch,

203	func renderLifecycleResult(app *App, plan flow.Plan, result flow.Result) {
204		style := app.outStyle()
205		for _, step := range result.AttemptedSteps() {
206			if step.Status == flow.StepFailed {
207				label := step.Effect.Description
208				if label == "" {
209					label = string(step.Effect.Code)
210				}
211				failure := step.Failure
212				if failure == "" {
213					failure = "operation failed"
214				}
215				app.warnf("%s failed: %s", label, failure)
216				continue
217			}
218			if step.Status != flow.StepCompleted {
219				continue
220			}
221	
222			details := step.Effect.Details.Map()
223			switch step.Effect.Code {
224			case flow.EffectCommitWIP, flow.EffectCommitAll:
225				message := details["message"]
226				if message == "" {
227					message = step.Detail
228				}
229				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("committed"), message)
230			case flow.EffectDiscardAll:
231				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  checkout changes\n", style.label("discarded"))
232			case flow.EffectPushBranch, flow.EffectPushBase:
233				pushed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "pushed ")
234				pushed = strings.TrimPrefix(pushed, "published ")
235				if pushed == step.Detail || pushed == "" {
236					pushed = "origin/" + step.Effect.Target
237				}
238				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("pushed"), pushed)
239			case flow.EffectCloseRuntime:
240				closed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "closed ")
241				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("closed"), closed)
242			case flow.EffectRemoveWorktree:
243				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s removed: %s\n", style.label("worktree"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
244			case flow.EffectDeleteBranch:
245				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s deleted\n", style.label("branch"), step.Effect.Target)
246			case flow.EffectDeleteTask:
247				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s reaped\n", style.label("task"), step.Effect.Target)
248			case flow.EffectRebaseBranch:
249				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebased"), strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "rebased "))
250			case flow.EffectSwitchBase, flow.EffectSwitchBranch:
251				switched := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "switched ")
252				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("switched"), switched)
253			case flow.EffectMergeFF:
254				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("integrated"), step.Detail)
255			case flow.EffectCreateReview:
256				if handoff, ok := result.Handoff(); ok && handoff.Kind == flow.HandoffURL && handoff.URL != "" {
257					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("opened"), handoff.URL)
258				}
259			case flow.EffectVerifyAncestry:
260				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("verified"), step.Detail)
261			case flow.EffectUpdateTask:
262				if isCompletionAction(plan.Action) {
263					state := details["state"]
264					if state == "" {
265						state = "lifecycle state"
266					}
267					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("recorded"), strings.ToUpper(state))
268				}
269			case flow.EffectCreateWorktree:
270				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebuilt"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
271			}
272		}
273		for _, warning := range result.Warnings() {
274			switch warning {
275			case "no next action is recorded":
276				app.warnf("no next action recorded — `dev park --next \"...\"` is what makes resuming cheap")
277			default:
278				app.warnf("%s", warning)
279			}
280		}
281		for _, recovery := range result.Recovery() {
282			app.warnf("recovery: %s", recovery)
283		}
284	}
285	
286	func isCompletionAction(action flow.Action) bool {
287		switch action {
288		case flow.CompleteDirect, flow.CompleteFF, flow.ReviewHandoff, flow.VerifyMerged:
289			return true
290		default:
291			return false
292		}
293	}

295	func presentLifecycleRequestError(selected task.Task, action flow.Action, err error) error {
296		var transition *flow.InvalidTransitionError

299		}
300		if action == flow.ParkCold && selected.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {

302				selected.Title(), selected.Branch, err)

304		if action == flow.Retire {
305			return fmt.Errorf("task %s is %s, not merged; run dev done first: %w", selected.ID, selected.State, err)
306		}
307		return err
308	}
```

```text
53	// ActionChoice is one already-concrete operation variant supplied by the
54	// caller. The options value is normalized to an independent value at both the
55	// constructor and accessor boundaries.
56	type ActionChoice struct {

58		Label       string
59		Description string

61		options taskflow.ActionOptions
62	}
63	
64	// NewActionChoice copies the concrete action options. A nil/typed-nil option is
65	// retained as unavailable input and will never be sent to Plan.
66	func NewActionChoice(id, label, description string, options taskflow.ActionOptions) ActionChoice {
67		return ActionChoice{

69			options: cloneActionOptions(options),
70		}
71	}

73	// Action returns the stable taskflow action represented by this choice.

75		options := cloneActionOptions(c.options)
76		if options == nil {
77			return ""
78		}
79		return options.Action()

82	// Options returns a defensive copy of the concrete options value.

85	// Valid reports whether a choice carries stable UI identity and concrete
86	// taskflow options.
87	func (c ActionChoice) Valid() bool {
88		return c.ID != "" && c.Label != "" && c.Action().Valid() && c.Options() != nil
89	}

92		c.options = cloneActionOptions(c.options)

122	// SurfaceRow is one exact checkout or task-only row. Mode and State are empty
123	// for untracked rows. Drift, conflicts, evidence, and actions are ordered,
124	// immutable-by-interface values so copying a row cannot expose shared mutation.
125	type SurfaceRow struct {
126		RowKey string
127		Kind   SurfaceKind
128		Label  string
129		Path   string
130		Branch string
131		Base   string
132	
133		Mode  task.CheckoutMode
134		State task.State
135	
136		Drift     Lines
137		Conflicts Lines
138		Evidence  Lines
139		Locator   taskflow.Locator
140		Actions   ActionList
141	}
142	
143	func (r SurfaceRow) clone() SurfaceRow {
144		r.Drift = NewLines(r.Drift.Values()...)
145		r.Conflicts = NewLines(r.Conflicts.Values()...)
146		r.Evidence = NewLines(r.Evidence.Values()...)
147		r.Actions = NewActionList(r.Actions.Values()...)
148		return r
149	}
150	
151	// SurfaceList is an ordered, immutable-by-interface surface collection.
152	type SurfaceList struct {
153		values []SurfaceRow
154	}
155	
156	// NewSurfaceList copies rows and every collection they own.
157	func NewSurfaceList(values ...SurfaceRow) SurfaceList {
158		out := SurfaceList{values: make([]SurfaceRow, len(values))}
159		for index, value := range values {
160			out.values[index] = value.clone()
161		}
162		return out
163	}
164	
165	// Values returns independent rows in caller-supplied order.
166	func (l SurfaceList) Values() []SurfaceRow {
167		out := make([]SurfaceRow, len(l.values))
168		for index, value := range l.values {
169			out[index] = value.clone()
170		}
171		return out
172	}
173	
174	// Len returns the number of projected surfaces.
175	func (l SurfaceList) Len() int { return len(l.values) }
176	
177	// OptionalRemoteObservation is a value-safe optional run-local remote result.
178	type OptionalRemoteObservation struct {
179		value taskflow.RemoteObservation
180		set   bool
181	}
182	
183	// SomeRemoteObservation constructs a present optional observation.
184	func SomeRemoteObservation(value taskflow.RemoteObservation) OptionalRemoteObservation {
185		return OptionalRemoteObservation{value: value.Clone(), set: true}
186	}
187	
188	// RemoteObservation returns an independent value when present.
189	func (o OptionalRemoteObservation) RemoteObservation() (taskflow.RemoteObservation, bool) {
190		return o.value.Clone(), o.set
191	}
192	
193	// Snapshot is one repository-local observation. Error is part of a valid
194	// snapshot (for example incomplete enrichment); a callback error instead means
195	// the refresh failed and the previous snapshot must be retained.
196	type Snapshot struct {
197		Repository RepositoryRow
198		Surfaces   SurfaceList
199		ObservedAt time.Time
200		Freshness  Freshness
201		Error      string
202		Remote     OptionalRemoteObservation
203	}
204	
205	// Clone returns a snapshot with independent surface/action storage.
206	func (s Snapshot) Clone() Snapshot {
207		s.Surfaces = NewSurfaceList(s.Surfaces.Values()...)
208		if remote, ok := s.Remote.RemoteObservation(); ok {
209			s.Remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
210		}
211		return s
212	}
213	
214	// Authoritative reports whether the displayed local observation is fresh,
215	// complete, and associated with an available repository.
216	func (s Snapshot) Authoritative() bool {
217		return s.Freshness == FreshnessFresh && s.Error == "" && s.Repository.Available
218	}
```

```text
705		if observed.status.Dirty() {

717		return nil
```

```text
203	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
204		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
205			return false, nil
206		}
207		candidates := []struct {
208			dir string
209			ref string
210		}{
211			{checkout, "HEAD"},
212			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
213			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
214		}
215		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
216		var observationErr error
217		for _, candidate := range candidates {
218			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
219				continue
220			}
221			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
222			if seen[key] {
223				continue
224			}
225			seen[key] = true
226			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
227				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
228			}
229			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
230				return true, nil
231			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
232				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
233					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
234			}
235		}
236		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
237			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
238		}
239		return false, observationErr
240	}

242	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
243		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
244		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
245	}

247	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
248		if current == nil {
249			return next
250		}
251		if next == nil {
252			return current
253		}
254		return errors.Join(current, next)
255	}
```

```text
36	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
37		if intent == nil {
38			return fmt.Errorf("create nil artifact intent")
39		}

50				return err

53				return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s already exists", candidate.ID)

55				return err
56			}

59			}

63	}

72				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s: %w", id, ErrIntentNotFound)

79		var intent Intent
80		if err := decoder.Decode(&intent); err != nil {

83		if err := ensureJSONEOF(decoder); err != nil {
84			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
85		}
```

```text
24		cmd := &cobra.Command{
25			Use:   "done [task]",
26			Short: "Integrate a finished change stream without destroying its workspace",
27			Long: `Finish integration while leaving runtime and filesystem cleanup to an
28	external coordinator.
29	
30	  --ff       rebase onto the base and fast-forward it locally. Use when the
31	             branch's commits are worth keeping in the base's history.
32	  --pr       push and open a pull/merge request with the detected forge CLI,
33	             leaving the merge to review and CI.
34	  --merged   verify an externally merged branch against --base-ref, for a merge
35	             performed outside dev.
36	
37	For branch/worktree tasks, omitting every mode opens a finish wizard on an
38	interactive terminal. A non-interactive caller still gets a report and must
39	pass a mode explicitly. Direct tasks need no integration mode.
40	
41	A dirty checkout is analyzed against the base, not rejected as one opaque
42	condition. Interactive use can commit everything, discard everything, or
43	cancel. Unique content requires typing DROP before discard. Scripts select an
44	explicit --dirty policy; destructive discard also requires --yes.
45	
46	A successful local or externally verified merge records DONE, meaning MERGED
47	with cleanup possibly pending. It never closes the invoking runtime, removes a
48	worktree, or deletes a branch. Run dev retire later from outside the workspace.`,
49			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
50			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
51				modes := 0
52				for _, selected := range []bool{ff, pr, merged} {
53					if selected {
54						modes++
55					}
56				}
57				if modes > 1 {
58					return fmt.Errorf("--ff, --pr and --merged are alternatives; pick one")
59				}
60				if !merged && (baseRef != "" || confirmSquash != "") {
61					return fmt.Errorf("--base-ref and --confirm-squash require --merged")
62				}
63				if deleteBranch {
64					return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branch is cleanup; run dev retire --delete-branch after integration")
65				}
66				if keepWorktree {
67					app.warnf("--keep-worktree is deprecated: dev done always keeps runtime and worktree state")
68				}
69				integration := doneIntegrationNone
70				switch {
71				case ff:
72					integration = doneIntegrationFF
73				case pr:
74					integration = doneIntegrationPR
75				case merged:
76					integration = doneIntegrationMerged
77				}
78				return runDone(ctxOf(), app, args, doneOptions{
79					Integration: integration, DirtyPolicy: doneDirtyPolicy(dirtyPolicy),
80					Message: message, Yes: yes, Push: push,
81					BaseRef: baseRef, ConfirmSquash: confirmSquash,
82				})
83			},
84		}
```
