221	type checkoutIdentity struct {
222		path string
223		git  bool
224	}
225	
226	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
227		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
228		if err != nil {
229			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
230		}
231		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
232		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
233			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
234			if canonicalErr != nil {
235				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
236			}
237			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true}, nil
238		}
239		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
240			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
241		}
242		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
243	}
244	
245	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string) (bool, error) {
246		if cwd == "" {
247			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
248		}
249		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
250		if err != nil {
251			return false, err
252		}
253		if target.git && activity.git {
254			return target.path == activity.path, nil
255		}
256		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
257	}
258	
259	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
260		panes := session.Panes
261		if len(panes) == 0 {
262			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
263				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
264			}
265		}
266		var covering, mixed []Pane
267		for _, pane := range panes {
268			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
269			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
270				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
271			}
272			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
273			for _, path := range paths {
274				if path == "" {
275					continue
276				}
277				observed = true
278				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path)
279				if err != nil {
280					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
281				}
282				if inside {
283					paneCovers = true
284				} else {
285					paneOutside = true
286				}
287			}
288			if paneCovers {
289				covering = append(covering, pane)
290			}
291			if paneOutside || !observed {
292				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
293			}
294		}
295		return covering, mixed, nil
296	}
297	
298	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
299		if id == "" {
300			return false
301		}
302		for _, pane := range panes {
303			if pane.ID == id {
304				return true
305			}
306		}
307		return false
308	}
309	
310	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
311		for _, session := range sessions {
312			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
313				return session.Runtime.Handle
314			}
315			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
316				return session.Runtime.Handle
317			}
318		}
319		return ""
320	}
321	
322	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
323		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
324		if status == "" {
325			return "unknown"
326		}
327		return status
328	}

14	// Repo is a scratch repository under t.TempDir().
15	type Repo struct {

17		Root string
18	}
19	
20	// New initialises a repository with one commit on branch "main".
21	func New(t *testing.T) *Repo {
22		t.Helper()
23		// Windows hands back an 8.3 short path (C:\Users\RUNNER~1\...) that git then
24		// reports in its long form, so canonicalize once up front.
25		tempDir := t.TempDir()
26		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(tempDir); err == nil {
27			tempDir = resolved
28		}
29		root := filepath.Join(tempDir, "repo")
30		if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o755); err != nil {
31			t.Fatal(err)
32		}
33		r := &Repo{T: t, Root: root}
34		r.Git("init", "--initial-branch=main")
35		// Identity and signing are configured locally so the test never depends on
36		// (or is broken by) the developer's global git config.
37		r.Git("config", "user.email", "dev@example.test")
38		r.Git("config", "user.name", "dev test")
39		r.Git("config", "commit.gpgsign", "false")
40		// Keep line endings and symlinks byte-for-byte on every platform; the
41		// Windows CI runner defaults core.autocrlf to true.
42		r.Git("config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
43		r.Git("config", "core.symlinks", "true")
44		r.Write("README.md", "# test repo\n")
45		r.Git("add", "README.md")
46		r.Git("commit", "-m", "chore: initial commit")
47		return r
48	}
49	
50	// Git runs a git command in the repo root and fails the test on error.

54	}

56	// GitIn runs a git command in an arbitrary directory (e.g. a linked worktree).
57	func (r *Repo) GitIn(dir string, args ...string) string {
58		r.T.Helper()
59		cmd := exec.Command("git", args...)
60		cmd.Dir = dir
61		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
62			"GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="+os.DevNull, // ignore the developer's ~/.gitconfig
63			"GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM="+os.DevNull,
64			"GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
65			"GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
66		)
67		out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
68		if err != nil {
69			r.T.Fatalf("git %s in %s: %v\n%s", strings.Join(args, " "), dir, err, out)
70		}
71		return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))

182	func (m Model) baseContext() context.Context {

189	// Init implements tea.Model without doing synchronous repository work.
190	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
191		var commands []tea.Cmd
192		switch m.screen {
193		case screenRepository:
194			if m.loadRequest.loading {
195				commands = append(commands, m.loadRepositoryCmd(m.loadRequest.generation, m.loadRequest.repoKey, m.baseContext()))
196			}
197		case screenPicker:
198			if m.listRequest.loading {
199				commands = append(commands, m.listRepositoriesCmd(m.listRequest.generation, m.baseContext()))
200			}
201		}
202		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
203			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
204		}
205		switch len(commands) {
206		case 0:
207			return nil
208		case 1:
209			return commands[0]
210		default:
211			return tea.Batch(commands...)
212		}
213	}

222		return func() tea.Msg {

226			case <-m.firstViewReady:
227				m.actions.AfterFirstView(m.baseContext())
228				return nil
229			}
230		}

191	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeCheckoutFacts(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService) {
192		o.status, o.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, o.checkout)
193		o.head, o.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, o.checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
194		o.head = strings.TrimSpace(o.head)
195		o.operation, o.inProgress, o.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, o.checkout)
196	}

198	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeRefs(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService, branch, base string) {
199		o.branchRef = localBranchRef(branch)
200		if o.repoPath != "" && o.branchRef != "" {
201			o.branchExists = s.gitRefExists(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchRef)
202			if o.branchExists {
203				o.branchOID, o.branchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchRef)
204			}
205		}
206		o.baseRef = localBranchRef(base)
207		if o.repoPath != "" && o.baseRef != "" {

209			if o.baseExists {
210				o.baseOID, o.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, o.repoPath, o.baseRef)
211			}
212		}
213		if o.branchExists && o.branchOIDErr == nil && o.branchOID != "" &&
214			o.baseExists && o.baseOIDErr == nil && o.baseOID != "" {
215			o.contained, o.containedErr = s.isAncestor(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchOID, o.baseOID)

219	func localBranchRef(branch string) string {

222		}

226	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx context.Context, observed *destructiveObservation) {
227		for _, diagnostic := range observed.taskDiagnostics {

230		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {

1084	func writeCheckoutMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, c RepoContext, checkout RepoCheckout, canonical bool) {
1085		label := string(checkout.Ownership)
1086		if canonical {
1087			label = "canonical"
1088		}
1089		fmt.Fprintf(b, "### %s — %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout), label)
1090		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Path: `%s`\n", checkout.Worktree.Path)
1091		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Branch: `%s`\n", displayBranch(checkout))
1092		if checkout.Worktree.Bare {
1093			b.WriteString("- Git: bare repository\n")
1094		} else if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
1095			b.WriteString("- Git: unavailable (checkout path is missing)\n")
1096		} else if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
1097			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.StatusErr)
1098		} else {
1099			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: %s", checkout.Status.Summary())
1100			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
1101				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", checkout.Status.Breakdown())
1102			}
1103			b.WriteString("\n")
1104			if checkout.Status.Upstream != "" {
1105				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Upstream: `%s`\n", checkout.Status.Upstream)
1106			} else {
1107				b.WriteString("- Upstream: not published\n")
1108			}
1109		}
1110		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
1111			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)
1112			if reason == "" {
1113				reason = "no reason recorded"
1114			}
1115			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: locked — %s\n", reason)
1116		}
1117		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
1118			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)
1119			if reason == "" {
1120				reason = "checkout path is missing"
1121			}
1122			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: prunable — %s\n", reason)
1123		}
1124		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
1125			b.WriteString("- Runtime: closed\n")
1126		} else {
1127			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
1128				status := session.AgentStatus
1129				if status == "" {
1130					status = "unknown"
1131				}
1132				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: `%s %s` (%s)\n", c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
1133				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
1134					fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Agent sessions: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
1135				}
1136			}
1137		}
1138		if len(checkout.Tasks) == 0 {
1139			b.WriteString("- Task: untracked\n")
1140		} else {
1141			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
1142				writeTaskMarkdown(b, tracked)
1143			}
1144		}
1145		writeTopologyReasons(b, checkout.DriftReasons, checkout.ConflictReasons)
1146	}

1148	func writeTopologyReasons(b *strings.Builder, drift, conflicts []TopologyReason) {

1151		}

1153			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Conflict: `%s` — %s\n", reason.Code, reason.Detail)
1154		}
1155	}

1157	func writeTaskMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, tracked *task.Task) {

1161		}

14	const wideLayoutWidth = 96

16	// View implements tea.Model. It performs no callback or probe work.
17	func (m Model) View() string {
18		m.signalFirstView()
19		if m.quitting {
20			return ""
21		}
22		switch m.overlay {
23		case overlayHelp:
24			return m.renderHelp()
25		case overlayRemoteMenu:
26			return m.renderRemoteMenu()
27		case overlayPlanLoading:
28			return m.renderPlanLoading()
29		case overlayPlan:
30			return m.renderPlan(false)
31		case overlayApplying:
32			return m.renderPlan(true)
33		case overlayResult:
34			return m.renderResult()
35		}
36		if m.screen == screenPicker {
37			return m.renderPicker()
38		}
39		return m.renderRepository()
40	}
41	
42	func (m Model) renderPicker() string {
43		var builder strings.Builder
44		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev flow  REPOSITORIES"))
45		status := ""
46		switch {
47		case m.listRequest.loading:
48			status = "LOADING"
49		case m.listRequest.err != nil && m.listRequest.stale:
50			status = "STALE"
51		case m.listRequest.err != nil:
52			status = "ERROR"
53		}
54		if status != "" {
55			builder.WriteString("  [" + status + "]")
56		}
57		builder.WriteString("\n\n")
58		if m.filterActive {
59			builder.WriteString("filter: " + m.filter.View() + "\n\n")
60		} else if m.filter.Value() != "" {
61			builder.WriteString("filter: /" + m.filter.Value() + "\n\n")
62		}
63		if m.listRequest.err != nil {
64			builder.WriteString(styleBad.Render("ERROR: "+m.listRequest.err.Error()) + "\n")
65			if m.listRequest.stale {
66				builder.WriteString("STALE: retaining the prior repository list; it is non-authoritative.\n")
67			}
68		}
69		rows := m.filteredRepositories()
70		if len(rows) == 0 {
71			switch {
72			case m.listRequest.loading:
73				builder.WriteString("Loading local repositories asynchronously...\n")
74			case m.listRequest.err != nil:
75				builder.WriteString("No authoritative repository list is available.\n")
76			case m.filter.Value() != "":
77				builder.WriteString("No repository matches the current filter.\n")
78			default:
79				builder.WriteString("No repositories found.\n")
80			}
81		} else {
82			for index, row := range rows {
83				marker := "  "
84				if index == m.repoCursor {
85					marker = "> "
86				}
87				availability := "AVAILABLE"
88				if !row.Available {
89					availability = "UNAVAILABLE"
90				}
91				line := fmt.Sprintf("%s [%s] %s", marker, availability, repositoryLabel(row))
92				if index == m.repoCursor {
93					line = styleSelected.Render(line)
94				}
95				builder.WriteString(line + "\n")
96				if row.Path != "" {
97					builder.WriteString("    " + row.Path + "\n")
98				}
99				if row.Error != "" {
100					builder.WriteString("    ERROR: " + row.Error + "\n")
101				}
102			}
103		}
104		builder.WriteString("\n")
105		if m.status != "" {
106			builder.WriteString("STATUS: " + m.status + "\n")
107		}
108		builder.WriteString(styleMuted.Render("j/k or arrows move | / filter | Enter select | r reload | ? help | q quit"))
109		return builder.String()
110	}
111	
112	func repositoryLabel(row RepositoryRow) string {
113		if row.Name != "" {
114			return row.Name
115		}
116		if row.Path != "" {
117			return row.Path
118		}
119		return row.RepoKey
120	}

10	func (m Model) openRemoteMenu() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
11		if m.loadRequest.loading {
12			m.status = "wait for the current local reload before planning remote work"
13			return m, nil
14		}
15		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
16		if !ok {
17			return m, nil
18		}
19		choices := make([]ActionChoice, 0, row.Actions.Len())
20		for _, choice := range row.Actions.Values() {
21			if choice.Valid() && choice.Action() == taskflow.RefreshRemote {
22				choices = append(choices, choice)
23			}
24		}
25		if len(choices) == 0 {
26			m.status = "no remote action choices are available for this surface"
27			return m, nil
28		}
29		m.remoteChoices = NewActionList(choices...)
30		m.remoteCursor = 0
31		m.overlay = overlayRemoteMenu
32		m.status = ""
33		return m, nil
34	}
35	
36	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
37		switch m.overlay {
38		case overlayHelp:
39			switch message.String() {
40			case "esc", "?":
41				m.overlay = m.overlayReturn
42				m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
43				return m, nil
44			case "q", "ctrl+c":
45				return m.quit()
46			}
47			return m, nil
48	
49		case overlayRemoteMenu:
50			switch message.String() {
51			case "q", "ctrl+c":
52				return m.quit()
53			case "esc", "R":
54				m.overlay = overlayNone
55				return m, nil
56			case "j", "down":
57				if m.remoteCursor+1 < m.remoteChoices.Len() {
58					m.remoteCursor++
59				}
60			case "k", "up":
61				if m.remoteCursor > 0 {
62					m.remoteCursor--
63				}
64			case "enter":
65				choices := m.remoteChoices.Values()
66				if m.remoteCursor >= 0 && m.remoteCursor < len(choices) {
67					return m.beginPlan(choices[m.remoteCursor])
68				}
69			}
70			return m, nil
71	
72		case overlayPlanLoading:
73			switch message.String() {
74			case "q", "ctrl+c":
75				m.cancelPlanRead()
76				return m.quit()
77			case "esc":
78				m.cancelPlanRead()
79				m.overlay = overlayNone
80				m.status = ""
81			}
82			return m, nil
83	
84		case overlayPlan:
85			if message.String() == "ctrl+c" {
86				return m.quit()
87			}
88			if message.String() == "esc" {
89				m.confirm.Blur()
90				m.overlay = overlayNone
91				m.status = ""
92				return m, nil
93			}
94			if !m.planCanApply() {
95				if message.String() == "q" {
96					return m.quit()
97				}
98				return m, nil
99			}
100			if m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
101				if message.String() == "enter" {
102					token := m.confirm.Value()
103					if token != m.plan.Confirmation.Token {
104						m.status = "confirmation token does not match exactly"
105						return m, nil
106					}
107					return m.startApply(taskflow.ApproveWithToken(m.plan.PlanID, token))
108				}
109				var command tea.Cmd
110				m.confirm, command = m.confirm.Update(message)
111				return m, command
112			}
113			switch message.String() {
114			case "q":
115				return m.quit()
116			case "y", "Y":
117				return m.startApply(taskflow.Approve(m.plan.PlanID))
118			}
119			return m, nil
120	
121		case overlayResult:
122			switch message.String() {
123			case "q", "ctrl+c":
124				return m.quit()
125			case "esc":
126				m.overlay = overlayNone
127				m.status = ""
128				return m, nil
129			case "r":
130				return m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
131			case "?":
132				m.overlayReturn = overlayResult
133				m.overlay = overlayHelp
134				return m, nil
135			}
136			return m, nil
137		}
138		return m, nil
139	}
140	
141	func (m Model) planCanApply() bool {
142		return m.hasPlan && m.planErr == nil && m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady
143	}
144	
145	func (m Model) startApply(approval taskflow.Approval) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
146		if !m.planCanApply() {
147			return m, nil
148		}
149		if err := m.plan.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
150			m.status = fmt.Sprintf("approval rejected: %v", err)
151			return m, nil
152		}
153		m.applyGeneration++
154		m.applyRunning = true
155		m.overlay = overlayApplying
156		m.status = "Apply in progress; quit and refresh will be queued"
157		m.hasHandoff = false
158		m.finalHandoff = taskflow.Handoff{}
159		m.hasLastResult = false
160		m.lastResult = taskflow.Result{}
161		m.lastResultErr = nil
162		return m, m.applyCmd(m.applyGeneration, m.planTarget, m.plan, approval)
163	}

169	func DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(repositoryRoot, checkoutPath string) (ClaudeHarnessEvidence, bool) {

181		}

299	// Main returns Git's actual primary record. The first-row fallback preserves
300	// compatibility with manually constructed contexts which predate Worktree.Main.
301	func (c RepoContext) Main() (RepoCheckout, bool) {
302		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
303			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
304				return checkout, true
305			}
306		}
307		if len(c.Checkouts) == 0 {
308			return RepoCheckout{}, false
309		}
310		return c.Checkouts[0], true
311	}

313	// Linked returns every Git-registered non-main worktree.
314	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
315		hasMarkedMain := false
316		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
317			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
318				hasMarkedMain = true
319				break
320			}
321		}
322		if !hasMarkedMain {
323			if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
324				return nil
325			}
326			return c.Checkouts[1:]
327		}
328		out := make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(c.Checkouts)-1)
329		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
330			if !checkout.Worktree.Main {
331				out = append(out, checkout)
332			}
333		}
334		return out
335	}

337	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
338	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
339	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
340		seen := map[string]bool{}
341		var out []runtime.Session
342		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
343			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
344				key := session.Handle
345				if key == "" {
346					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
347				}
348				if seen[key] {
349					continue
350				}
351				seen[key] = true
352				out = append(out, session)
353			}
354		}
355		return out
356	}

380	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions builds repository topology from Git's complete

383	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
384		opts RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
385		if ctx == nil {
386			ctx = context.Background()
387		}
388		out := RepoContext{
389			Repo: r, Runtime: opts.Runtime,
390			WorktreeObservation: TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved},

393		queryPath := repoQueryPath(r)

395		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)

397		var (

401		if queryPath == "" {

406		if err != nil {

414		out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}

68				retireOptions := sweepRetireOptions{

70				}
71	
72				var sugg []suggestion
73				if mergedWorktrees {
74					merged, err := suggestMergedWorktrees(app, ctx, rows, baseRef, retireOptions)
75					if err != nil {
76						return err
77					}
78					sugg = append(sugg, merged...)
79				} else {
80					for _, r := range rows {
81						sugg = append(sugg, suggestFor(app, ctx, r, stale, retireOptions)...)
82					}
83				}
84	
85				// Live sessions no task claims: the other half of a crowded sidebar.
86				if !mergedWorktrees {
87					if sessions, err := rt.List(ctx); err == nil {
88						if orphans := inventory.Orphans(sessions, rows); len(orphans) > 0 {
89							fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%d live session(s) with no task recorded:\n", len(orphans))
90							for _, s := range orphans {
91								dir := "—"
92								if len(s.Dirs) > 0 {
93									dir = config.Contract(s.Dirs[0])
94								}
95								fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %-24s %s\n", truncate(s.Label, 24), style.dim(dir))
96							}
97							fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("  → `dev start` in one of those directories to track it, or just close it."))
98						}
99					}
100				}
101	
102				if len(sugg) == 0 {
103					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.success("\nNothing to sweep")+" — no task drift or eligible merged worktree was found.")
104					return nil
105				}
106	
107				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%s\n\n", style.title(fmt.Sprintf("%d suggestion(s):", len(sugg))))
108				for _, s := range sugg {
109					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %-28s %s\n", s.row.Task.State.Icon(),
110						truncate(s.row.Task.Title(), 28), style.warning(s.reason))
111					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "     → %s\n", s.action)
112				}
113	
114				if !apply {
115					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nRe-run with --apply to act on these (each is confirmed individually)."))
116					return nil
117				}
118	
119				in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
120				for _, s := range sugg {
121					if s.apply == nil {
122						continue
123					}
124					if !yes && !confirm(app, in, s.action) {
125						continue
126					}
127					if err := s.apply(); err != nil {
128						app.warnf("%s: %v", s.row.Task.ID, err)
129						continue
130					}
131					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s\n", style.success("done:"), s.action)
132				}
133				return nil
134			},
135		}
136		f := cmd.Flags()
137		f.BoolVar(&apply, "apply", false, "act on the suggestions instead of only reporting")
138		f.IntVar(&staleDays, "stale-days", 14, "days without a commit before a task counts as stale")
139		f.BoolVar(&yes, "yes", false, "with --apply, do not confirm each change")
140		f.BoolVar(&mergedWorktrees, "merged-worktrees", false, "focus on linked worktrees whose branches are contained in the main branch")
141		f.StringVar(&baseRef, "base", "", "containment base for --merged-worktrees (default: the repository default branch)")
142		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow external closure of unknown runtime status during retirement")
143		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails during retirement")
144		f.BoolVar(&deleteBranches, "delete-branches", false, "also delete contained local branches after worktree retirement")
145		return cmd
146	}
147	
148	func suggestFor(app *App, ctx context.Context, r inventory.Row, stale time.Duration, retireOptions sweepRetireOptions) []suggestion {
149		t := r.Task
150		var out []suggestion
151		current, currentErr := app.Tasks.GetRecord(t.ID)
152		if currentErr != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(current.Task, *t) {
153			detail := "task changed after the sweep inventory snapshot"
154			if currentErr != nil {
155				detail = "task could not be reloaded after the sweep inventory snapshot: " + currentErr.Error()
156			}
157			return []suggestion{{
158				row: r, reason: detail,
159				action: "rerun sweep to inspect the current task revision — not changed automatically",
160			}}
161		}
162		revision := current.Revision
163	
164		// A task whose repository is gone cannot be finished, resumed, parked or
165		// retired: every one of those resolves the repository first, and `dev done`
166		// refuses outright once the checkout is missing. Nothing else in this
167		// function reaches it either — the dead-branch rule below excludes direct
168		// mode, and the stale-worktree rule needs a recorded worktree path. Left
169		// alone, the record is unreachable by any command in the binary.
170		//
171		// Reaping removes dev's record of intent and nothing else; the branch, the
172		// commits and the remote are untouched. A live session proves the directory
173		// is there, so it is the one condition that rules this out.
174		if t.RepoPath != "" && !r.Live() && !dirExists(t.RepoPath) {
175			out = append(out, suggestion{
176				row:    r,
177				reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository %s no longer exists", config.Contract(t.RepoPath)),
178				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s (Git keeps any work; this drops only dev's record)", t.ID),
179				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
180			})

345	func resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
346		return observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && observed.hasCheckout() && observed.statusErr == nil &&
347			!observed.status.Detached && observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch
348	}
349	
350	func shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
351		return observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.savedRuntimeLive
352	}
353	
354	func resumeEffectCheckout(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
355		if observed.hasCheckout() {
356			return observed.checkout
357		}
358		return observed.desiredWorktree
359	}
360	
361	func resumeRuntimeLabel(candidate task.Task) string {
362		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
363			return candidate.Repo + "/" + candidate.Branch
364		}
365		return candidate.Title()
366	}
367	
368	func resumeFallback(id string, options ResumeOptions) string {
369		parts := []string{"dev", "resume", shellQuote(id)}
370		if !options.FetchRefs {
371			parts = append(parts, "--fetch=false")
372		}
373		if options.NoProvision {
374			parts = append(parts, "--no-provision")
375		}
376		if options.TakeOwnership {
377			parts = append(parts, "--force")
378		}
379		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
380	}

11	// DirtyPolicy is the explicitly selected treatment of checkout changes during
12	// completion planning.
13	type DirtyPolicy string
14	
15	const (
16		DirtyAuto    DirtyPolicy = "auto"
17		DirtyFail    DirtyPolicy = "fail"
18		DirtyCommit  DirtyPolicy = "commit"
19		DirtyDiscard DirtyPolicy = "discard"
20	)
21	
22	func normalizeDirty(policy DirtyPolicy) DirtyPolicy {
23		if policy == "" {
24			return DirtyAuto
25		}
26		return policy
27	}
28	
29	func validateDirty(policy DirtyPolicy, message string) error {
30		policy = normalizeDirty(policy)
31		switch policy {
32		case DirtyAuto, DirtyFail, DirtyCommit, DirtyDiscard:
33		default:
34			return fmt.Errorf("unknown dirty policy %q", policy)
35		}
36		if message != "" && policy != DirtyAuto && policy != DirtyCommit {
37			return fmt.Errorf("commit message requires dirty policy auto or commit")
38		}
39		return nil
40	}

206	// Request binds one action and its typed options to an exact selected locator.
207	// DisplayedAt may be used by a caller but does not contribute to plan identity.
208	type Request struct {
209		Locator     Locator
210		Action      Action
211		Options     ActionOptions
212		DisplayedAt time.Time
213	}
214	
215	// NewRequest infers the action from options and returns a normalized value.
216	func NewRequest(locator Locator, options ActionOptions) (Request, error) {
217		if options == nil {
218			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action options are required", ErrInvalidRequest)
219		}
220		normalized, err := cloneActionOptions(options, "")
221		if err != nil {
222			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
223		}
224		request := Request{Locator: locator, Action: normalized.Action(), Options: normalized}
225		return normalizeRequest(request)
226	}
227	
228	// Clone returns a request whose option-owned collection values are independent.
229	func (r Request) Clone() Request {
230		options, err := cloneActionOptions(r.Options, r.Action)
231		if err == nil {
232			r.Options = options
233		}
234		return r
235	}
236	
237	// Validate checks option/action agreement and graph legality without performing
238	// observations or side effects.
239	func (r Request) Validate() error {
240		_, err := normalizeRequest(r)
241		return err
242	}
243	
244	func normalizeRequest(request Request) (Request, error) {
245		if !request.Action.Valid() {
246			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown action %q", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action)
247		}
248		options, err := cloneActionOptions(request.Options, request.Action)
249		if err != nil {
250			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
251		}
252		if options.Action() != request.Action {
253			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: action %s cannot use %s options", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, options.Action())
254		}
255		if err := validateActionOptions(options); err != nil {
256			return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Action, err)
257		}
258		request.Options = options
259		if isTransitionAction(request.Action) {
260			if _, err := RequireTransition(request.Locator.Mode, request.Locator.State, request.Action); err != nil {
261				return Request{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
262			}
263		}
264		return request, nil
265	}
266	
267	func cloneActionOptions(options ActionOptions, action Action) (ActionOptions, error) {
268		if options == nil {
269			return defaultActionOptions(action)
270		}
271		switch value := options.(type) {
272		case ParkWarmOptions:
273			return value, nil
274		case *ParkWarmOptions:
275			if value == nil {
276				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil park-warm options")
277			}
278			return *value, nil
279		case ParkColdOptions:
280			return value, nil
281		case *ParkColdOptions:
282			if value == nil {
283				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil park-cold options")
284			}
285			return *value, nil
286		case ResumeOptions:
287			return value, nil
288		case *ResumeOptions:
289			if value == nil {
290				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil resume options")
291			}
292			return *value, nil
293		case CompleteDirectOptions:
294			value.Dirty = normalizeDirty(value.Dirty)
295			return value, nil
296		case *CompleteDirectOptions:
297			if value == nil {
298				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil complete-direct options")
299			}
300			copy := *value
301			copy.Dirty = normalizeDirty(copy.Dirty)
302			return copy, nil
303		case CompleteFFOptions:
304			value.Dirty = normalizeDirty(value.Dirty)
305			return value, nil
306		case *CompleteFFOptions:
307			if value == nil {
308				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil complete-ff options")
309			}
310			copy := *value
311			copy.Dirty = normalizeDirty(copy.Dirty)
312			return copy, nil
313		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
314			value.Dirty = normalizeDirty(value.Dirty)
315			return value, nil
316		case *ReviewHandoffOptions:
317			if value == nil {
318				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil review-handoff options")
319			}
320			copy := *value
321			copy.Dirty = normalizeDirty(copy.Dirty)
322			return copy, nil
323		case VerifyMergedOptions:
324			value.Dirty = normalizeDirty(value.Dirty)
325			return value, nil
326		case *VerifyMergedOptions:
327			if value == nil {
328				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil verify-merged options")
329			}
330			copy := *value
331			copy.Dirty = normalizeDirty(copy.Dirty)
332			return copy, nil
333		case RetireOptions:
334			return value, nil
335		case *RetireOptions:
336			if value == nil {
337				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil retire options")
338			}
339			return *value, nil
340		case AdoptOptions:
341			value.Tags = value.Tags.clone()
342			return value, nil
343		case *AdoptOptions:
344			if value == nil {
345				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil adopt options")
346			}
347			copy := *value
348			copy.Tags = copy.Tags.clone()
349			return copy, nil
350		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
351			return value, nil
352		case *RemoveCheckoutOptions:
353			if value == nil {
354				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil remove-checkout options")
355			}
356			return *value, nil
357		case RefreshRemoteOptions:
358			return value, nil
359		case *RefreshRemoteOptions:
360			if value == nil {
361				return nil, fmt.Errorf("nil refresh-remote options")
362			}
363			return *value, nil
364		case ReconcileOptions:
365			value.Parameters = value.Parameters.clone()
366			return value, nil
367		case *ReconcileOptions:

379	func defaultActionOptions(action Action) (ActionOptions, error) {
380		switch action {
381		case ParkWarm:
382			return ParkWarmOptions{}, nil
383		case ParkCold:
384			return ParkColdOptions{}, nil
385		case Resume:
386			return ResumeOptions{}, nil
387		case CompleteDirect:
388			return CompleteDirectOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
389		case CompleteFF:
390			return CompleteFFOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
391		case ReviewHandoff:
392			return ReviewHandoffOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
393		case VerifyMerged:
394			return VerifyMergedOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
395		case Retire:
396			return RetireOptions{}, nil
397		case Adopt:
398			return AdoptOptions{}, nil
399		case RemoveCheckout:
400			return RemoveCheckoutOptions{}, nil
401		case RefreshRemote:
402			return RefreshRemoteOptions{}, nil
403		case Reconcile:
404			return ReconcileOptions{}, nil
405		default:
406			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown action %q", action)
407		}
408	}

410	func validateActionOptions(options ActionOptions) error {
411		switch value := options.(type) {
412		case ParkWarmOptions:
413			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
414		case ParkColdOptions:
415			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
416		case ResumeOptions:
417			return nil
418		case CompleteDirectOptions:
419			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
420		case CompleteFFOptions:
421			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
422		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
423			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
424		case VerifyMergedOptions:
425			return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
426		case RetireOptions:
427			return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
428		case AdoptOptions:
429			if value.Mode != "" && value.Mode != task.ModeWorktree {
430				return fmt.Errorf("adopted checkout mode must be empty or %q, got %q", task.ModeWorktree, value.Mode)
431			}
432			if value.State != "" && !validState(value.State) {
433				return fmt.Errorf("unknown adopted task state %q", value.State)
434			}
435			if value.Base != strings.TrimSpace(value.Base) || strings.ContainsRune(value.Base, '\x00') {
436				return fmt.Errorf("adopted base must be normalized")
437			}
438			return nil
439		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
440			if err := validateTimeout(value.Timeout); err != nil {
441				return err
442			}
443			if value.DeleteContainedBranch && !value.RequireContained {
444				return fmt.Errorf("contained branch deletion requires containment proof")
445			}
446			if value.RequireContained {
447				if value.ContainmentBase == "" || value.ContainmentBase != strings.TrimSpace(value.ContainmentBase) ||
448					strings.ContainsRune(value.ContainmentBase, '\x00') {
449					return fmt.Errorf("containment base must be a normalized nonempty branch")
450				}
451			} else if value.ContainmentBase != "" {
452				return fmt.Errorf("containment base requires containment proof")
453			}
454			return nil
455		case RefreshRemoteOptions:
456			if !value.FetchRefs && !value.QueryReview {
457				return fmt.Errorf("select fetch refs, query review, or both")
458			}
459			return nil
460		case ReconcileOptions:
461			if strings.TrimSpace(value.Name) == "" {
462				return fmt.Errorf("a named reconciliation is required")
463			}
464			if value.Name != strings.TrimSpace(value.Name) {
465				return fmt.Errorf("reconciliation name must be normalized")
466			}
467			return nil
468		default:
469			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported options type %T", options)
470		}
471	}
472	
473	func validateTimeout(timeout time.Duration) error {
474		if timeout < 0 {
475			return fmt.Errorf("timeout cannot be negative")
476		}
477		return nil
478	}

480	func appendOptionsIdentity(writer *identityWriter, options ActionOptions) {
481		writer.addString("options.action", string(options.Action()))
482		switch value := options.(type) {
483		case ParkWarmOptions:
484			writer.addString("next", value.Next)
485			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
486			writer.addBool("commit-wip", value.CommitWIP)
487			writer.addBool("push", value.Push)
488			writer.addBool("keep-session", value.KeepSession)
489			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
490		case ParkColdOptions:
491			writer.addString("next", value.Next)
492			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
493			writer.addBool("commit-wip", value.CommitWIP)
494			writer.addBool("push", value.Push)
495			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
496		case ResumeOptions:
497			writer.addBool("fetch-refs", value.FetchRefs)
498			writer.addBool("no-provision", value.NoProvision)
499			writer.addBool("take-ownership", value.TakeOwnership)
500		case CompleteDirectOptions:
501			appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage, value.Push)
502		case CompleteFFOptions:
503			appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage, value.PushBase)
504		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
505			writer.addString("dirty", string(value.Dirty))
506			writer.addString("commit-message", value.CommitMessage)
507			writer.addBool("draft", value.Draft)
508			writer.addString("title", value.Title)
509			writer.addString("body", value.Body)
510		case VerifyMergedOptions:
511			writer.addString("dirty", string(value.Dirty))
512			writer.addString("commit-message", value.CommitMessage)
513			writer.addString("base-ref", value.BaseRef)
514			writer.addString("squash-commit", value.SquashCommit)
515			writer.addBool("push-base", value.PushBase)
516		case RetireOptions:
517			writer.addBool("delete-branch", value.DeleteBranch)
518			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
519		case AdoptOptions:
520			writer.addString("mode", string(value.Mode))
521			writer.addString("state", string(value.State))
522			writer.addString("name", value.Name)
523			writer.addString("base", value.Base)
524			writer.addString("owner", value.Owner)
525			writer.addString("next", value.Next)
526			writer.addString("note", value.Note)
527			writer.addStrings("tags", value.Tags.values)
528		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
529			writer.addBool("discard-dirty", value.DiscardDirty)
530			writer.addBool("require-contained", value.RequireContained)
531			writer.addString("containment-base", value.ContainmentBase)
532			writer.addBool("delete-contained-branch", value.DeleteContainedBranch)
533			appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
534		case RefreshRemoteOptions:
535			writer.addBool("fetch-refs", value.FetchRefs)
536			writer.addBool("query-review", value.QueryReview)
537		case ReconcileOptions:
538			writer.addString("name", value.Name)
539			writer.addFields("parameters", value.Parameters)
540		}
541	}

543	func appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer *identityWriter, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string, push bool) {
544		writer.addString("dirty", string(dirty))
545		writer.addString("commit-message", message)
546		writer.addBool("push", push)
547	}

549	func appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer *identityWriter, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool, timeout time.Duration) {
550		writer.addBool("close-unknown", closeUnknown)

552		writer.addInt64("timeout", int64(timeout))

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}
48	
49	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAndSpecify(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (PlanSpec, lifecycleObservation, error) {
50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:
64			spec = s.resumeSpec(request, observed)
65		case CompleteDirect:
66			spec = s.completeDirectSpec(request, observed)
67		case CompleteFF:
68			spec = s.completeFFSpec(request, observed)
69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}
76		return spec, observed, nil
77	}

79	func (s *lifecycleService) freshPlan(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (Plan, lifecycleObservation, error) {
80		spec, observed, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, record)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Plan{}, observed, err
83		}
84		plan, err := BuildPlan(request, spec)
85		return plan, observed, err
86	}

88	func validateLifecycleLocator(locator Locator) error {
89		switch {
90		case locator.TaskID == "":
91			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact TaskID is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
92		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
93			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
94		case locator.TaskRevision == "":

124			{"branch", locator.Branch, candidate.Branch},

142			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task repository path changed from %q to %q", selectedRepo, recordedRepo)}

150				if err != nil {
151					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.WorktreePath, err)}
152				}
153			}
154		}
155		selectedCheckout := ""
156		if locator.CheckoutPath != "" {

158			if err != nil {

164		}

244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
248			observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
249			if err == nil {
250				observed.worktreeFound = true
251				observed.checkout = registered.Path
252			}
253		case task.ModeWorktree:
254			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
255				registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.WorktreePath)
256				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
257				if err == nil {
258					observed.worktreeFound = true
259					observed.checkout = registered.Path
260				}
261			}
262			if observed.worktreeFound || request.Action != Resume ||
263				(observed.task.State != task.Warm && observed.task.State != task.Cold) {
264				return
265			}
266			worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
267			if err != nil {
268				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("list worktrees for parked-task resume: %w", err)
269				return
270			}
271			var candidate string
272			for _, worktree := range worktrees {
273				if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
274					observed.branchMatches++
275					candidate = worktree.Path
276				}
277			}
278			switch observed.branchMatches {
279			case 0:
280				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
281					observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has no checkout", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, observed.task.Branch)
282				}
283			case 1:
284				registered, resolveErr := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, candidate)
285				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, resolveErr
286				if resolveErr == nil {
287					observed.worktreeFound = true
288					observed.checkout = registered.Path
289				}
290			default:
291				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has %d registered checkouts", gitx.ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, observed.task.Branch, observed.branchMatches)
292			}
293		}
294	}

331		}
332		if len(parts) == 0 {
333			return "guarded plan is " + string(plan.Availability)
334		}
335		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
336	}

30	func NewStore(dir string) *Store {
31		return &Store{Dir: dir, clock: time.Now, newID: randomID}

34	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".json") }

36	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
37		if intent == nil {
38			return fmt.Errorf("create nil artifact intent")
39		}
40		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
41			candidate := *intent
42			if candidate.ID == "" {
43				candidate.ID = s.newID()
44			}
45			candidate.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
46			candidate.Status = Armed
47			now := s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
48			candidate.CreatedAt, candidate.UpdatedAt = now, now
49			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
50				return err
51			}
52			if _, err := os.Stat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
53				return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s already exists", candidate.ID)
54			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return err
56			}
57			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {
58				return err
59			}
60			*intent = candidate
61			return nil
62		})
63	}
64	
65	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Intent, error) {
66		if !idPattern.MatchString(id) {
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent id %q", id)
68		}
69		file, err := os.Open(s.path(id))
70		if err != nil {
71			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
72				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s: %w", id, ErrIntentNotFound)
73			}
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		defer file.Close()
77		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
78		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
79		var intent Intent
80		if err := decoder.Decode(&intent); err != nil {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
82		}
83		if err := ensureJSONEOF(decoder); err != nil {
84			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
85		}
86		if intent.ID != id {
87			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent filename %s disagrees with id %s", id, intent.ID)
88		}
89		if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
90			return nil, err
91		}
92		return &intent, nil
93	}
94	
95	func (s *Store) List() ([]Intent, error) {
96		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
97		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
98			return nil, nil
99		}
100		if err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		var intents []Intent
104		for _, entry := range entries {
105			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
106				continue
107			}
108			intent, err := s.Get(strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json"))
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			intents = append(intents, *intent)
113		}
114		sort.Slice(intents, func(i, j int) bool { return intents[i].CreatedAt.Before(intents[j].CreatedAt) })
115		return intents, nil
116	}
117	
118	func (s *Store) FindByRunID(runID string) (*Intent, error) {
119		intents, err := s.List()
120		if err != nil {
121			return nil, err
122		}
123		for i := range intents {
124			if intents[i].RunID == runID {
125				return &intents[i], nil
126			}
127		}
128		return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact run %s: %w", runID, ErrIntentNotFound)
129	}
130	
131	func (s *Store) Update(ctx context.Context, id string, mutate func(*Intent) error) error {
132		if mutate == nil {
133			return fmt.Errorf("artifact update needs a mutation")
134		}
135		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
136			intent, err := s.Get(id)
137			if err != nil {
138				return err
139			}
140			if err := mutate(intent); err != nil {
141				return err
142			}
143			intent.UpdatedAt = s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
144			if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
145				return err
146			}
147			return s.write(*intent)
148		})
149	}
150	
151	func (s *Store) write(intent Intent) error {
152		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o700); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, ".intent-*.tmp")
156		if err != nil {
157			return err
158		}
159		name := tmp.Name()
160		defer os.Remove(name)
161		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
162			tmp.Close()
163			return err
164		}
165		encoder := json.NewEncoder(tmp)
166		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
167		if err := encoder.Encode(intent); err != nil {
168			tmp.Close()
169			return err
170		}
171		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
172			tmp.Close()
173			return err
174		}
175		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
176			return err
177		}
178		return os.Rename(name, s.path(intent.ID))
179	}
180	
181	func ensureJSONEOF(decoder *json.Decoder) error {
182		var extra any
183		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
184			return nil
185		} else if err != nil {
186			return err
187		}
188		return fmt.Errorf("multiple JSON values")
189	}
190	
191	func randomID() string {
192		var raw [12]byte
193		if _, err := rand.Read(raw[:]); err != nil {
194			return fmt.Sprintf("intent-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
195		}
196		return "intent-" + hex.EncodeToString(raw[:])
197	}

100	func expectedTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, state task.State, action Action) TransitionRule {
101		rule := TransitionRule{Mode: mode, Source: state, Action: action}
102		allow := func(target task.State, preserving, removes bool, milestone Milestone) TransitionRule {
103			rule.Allowed = true
104			rule.Target = target
105			rule.StatePreserving = preserving
106			rule.RemovesTask = removes
107			rule.Milestone = milestone
108			return rule
109		}
110	
111		if mode == task.ModeDirect && state == task.Cold {
112			return rule
113		}
114		if action == Retire && state == task.Done {
115			return allow("", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
116		}
117		if state == task.Done || state == task.Cold && action != Resume {
118			return rule
119		}
120	
121		switch action {
122		case ParkWarm:
123			if state == task.Hot {
124				return allow(task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
125			}
126			if state == task.Warm {
127				return allow(task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
128			}
129		case ParkCold:
130			if mode != task.ModeDirect && (state == task.Hot || state == task.Warm) {
131				return allow(task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
132			}
133		case Resume:
134			if state == task.Warm || mode != task.ModeDirect && state == task.Cold {
135				return allow(task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
136			}
137		case CompleteDirect:
138			if mode == task.ModeDirect && (state == task.Hot || state == task.Warm) {
139				return allow(task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
140			}
141		case CompleteFF, VerifyMerged:
142			if mode != task.ModeDirect && (state == task.Hot || state == task.Warm) {
143				return allow(task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
144			}
145		case ReviewHandoff:
146			if mode != task.ModeDirect && (state == task.Hot || state == task.Warm) {
147				return allow(state, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
148			}
149		}
150		return rule
151	}

441	func effectCodes(plan Plan) []EffectCode {
442		effects := plan.Effects()
443		codes := make([]EffectCode, len(effects))
444		for index, effect := range effects {
445			codes[index] = effect.Code
446		}
447		return codes
448	}

450	func mustGitCommand(t *testing.T, dir string, args ...string) string {
451		t.Helper()
452		var command *exec.Cmd
453		if len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "init" && len(args) >= 3 && args[1] == "--bare" {
454			command = exec.Command("git", args...)
455			command.Dir = dir
456		} else if len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "init" && len(args) >= 3 && args[1] == "-b" {
457			command = exec.Command("git", args...)
458			command.Dir = dir
459		} else {
460			commandArgs := append([]string{"-C", dir}, args...)
461			command = exec.Command("git", commandArgs...)
462		}
463		output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
464		if err != nil {
465			t.Fatalf("git in %s %s: %v\n%s", dir, strings.Join(args, " "), err, output)
466		}
467		return strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
468	}

1	package runtime

3	import "context"
4	
5	// None is the no-multiplexer backend. It is always available, which is what
6	// guarantees dev's core inventory and worktree commands work on a bare machine
7	// with nothing but git installed.
8	//
9	// Open returns the directory itself as the handle: the shell wrapper installed
10	// by `dev shell-init` turns that into a cd in the calling shell, since a child
11	// process can never change its parent's working directory.
12	type None struct{}
13	
14	// Name implements Runtime.
15	func (None) Name() string { return "none" }
16	
17	// Available implements Runtime; the null backend always is.
18	func (None) Available() bool { return true }
19	
20	// Open implements Runtime by reporting the directory to change into. None does
21	// not open a runtime surface, so the result is never launchable.
22	func (None) Open(_ context.Context, dir, _ string) (OpenResult, error) {
23		return OpenResult{Handle: dir}, nil
24	}
25	
26	// Close implements Runtime as a no-op: there is no session to end.
27	func (None) Close(context.Context, string) error { return nil }
28	
29	// List implements Runtime; without a multiplexer nothing is tracked as live.
30	func (None) List(context.Context) ([]Session, error) { return nil, nil }
31	
32	// Annotate implements Runtime as a no-op.
33	func (None) Annotate(context.Context, string, map[string]string) error { return nil }

161	func (r *standardRenderer) flush() {
162		r.mtx.Lock()
163		defer r.mtx.Unlock()
164	
165		if r.buf.Len() == 0 || r.buf.String() == r.lastRender {
166			// Nothing to do.
167			return
168		}
169	
170		// Output buffer.
171		buf := &bytes.Buffer{}
172	
173		// Moving to the beginning of the section, that we rendered.
174		if r.altScreenActive {

176		} else if r.linesRendered > 1 {
177			buf.WriteString(ansi.CursorUp(r.linesRendered - 1))
178		}
179	
180		newLines := strings.Split(r.buf.String(), "\n")
181

183		// lines we can render. We drop lines from the top of the render buffer if
184		// necessary, as we can't navigate the cursor into the terminal's scrollback
185		// buffer.
186		if r.height > 0 && len(newLines) > r.height {
187			newLines = newLines[len(newLines)-r.height:]
188		}
189	
190		flushQueuedMessages := len(r.queuedMessageLines) > 0 && !r.altScreenActive
191	
192		if flushQueuedMessages {
193			// Dump the lines we've queued up for printing.
194			for _, line := range r.queuedMessageLines {
195				if ansi.StringWidth(line) < r.width {
196					// We only erase the rest of the line when the line is shorter than
197					// the width of the terminal. When the cursor reaches the end of
198					// the line, any escape sequences that follow will only affect the
199					// last cell of the line.
200	
201					// Removing previously rendered content at the end of line.
202					line = line + ansi.EraseLineRight
203				}
204	
205				_, _ = buf.WriteString(line)
206				_, _ = buf.WriteString("\r\n")
207			}
208			// Clear the queued message lines.
209			r.queuedMessageLines = []string{}
210		}
211	
212		// Paint new lines.
213		for i := 0; i < len(newLines); i++ {
214			canSkip := !flushQueuedMessages && // Queuing messages triggers repaint -> we don't have access to previous frame content.
215				len(r.lastRenderedLines) > i && r.lastRenderedLines[i] == newLines[i] // Previously rendered line is the same.

238			// program initialization, so after a resize this won't perform

240			if r.width > 0 {

169	// retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility preserves the contained-only path contract
170	// while routing every mutation through taskflow's exact unmanaged transaction.
171	func retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility(
172		ctx context.Context,
173		app *App,
174		path string,
175		closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranch bool,
176		timeout time.Duration,
177	) error {
178		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
179		if err != nil {
180			return fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
181		}
182		if !repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
183			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a linked worktree; retire explicit paths only from their linked checkout", config.Contract(path))
184		}
185		locator, err := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, repository.Root)
186		if err != nil {
187			return err
188		}
189		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.MainRoot)
190		if base == "" {
191			return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove unmanaged retirement without an explicit repository default branch")
192		}
193		execution, err := executeNonTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
194			RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base, DeleteContainedBranch: deleteBranch,
195			CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
196		}, deleteBranch)
197		if err != nil {
198			return err
199		}
200		if execution.Result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneNone {
201			return fmt.Errorf("unmanaged retirement returned unexpected milestone %s", execution.Result.Milestone)
202		}
203		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", app.outStyle().success("RETIRED"), config.Contract(locator.CheckoutPath))
204		return nil
205	}

13	// locateExactTask builds a managed locator from one exact task record and a
14	// fresh view of its repository. Missing checkout evidence is retained as an
15	// expected path (or an intentionally empty COLD path) so Plan can explain the
16	// drift instead of losing the task before transition validation.
17	func (s *lifecycleService) locateExactTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
18		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
19			return Locator{}, err
20		}
21		if !exactTaskID.MatchString(taskID) || filepath.Base(taskID) != taskID || taskID == "." || taskID == ".." {
22			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID)
23		}
24	
25		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
28		}
29		candidate := record.Task
30		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
31			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q is invalid: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
32		}
33		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
34		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(candidate.State) {
35			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q has invalid mode or state", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID)
36		}
37	
38		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
41		}
42		repoPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
43		if err != nil {
44			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
45		}
46		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
49		}
50		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
51		if err != nil {
52			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
53		}
54		if recordedRepo != repoPath {
55			return Locator{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
56				"recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q",
57				candidate.RepoPath, recordedRepo, repoPath,
58			)}
59		}
60	
61		expectedCheckout := repoPath
62		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
63			expectedCheckout = ""
64			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
65				expectedCheckout, err = s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
66				if err != nil {
67					return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize expected checkout for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
68				}
69			}
70		}

72		locator := Locator{

75			RowKind:      "task",
76			RepositoryID: commonDir,
77			GitCommonDir: commonDir,
78			TaskID:       taskID,
79			TaskRevision: record.Revision,
80			RepoPath:     repoPath,
81			CheckoutPath: expectedCheckout,
82			Branch:       candidate.Branch,
83			Base:         candidate.Base,
84			Remote:       "origin",
85			Mode:         mode,
86			State:        candidate.State,
87		}
88	
89		registered, found := s.locateRegisteredCheckout(ctx, candidate, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
90		if found {
91			locator.RowKey = registered.Path
92			locator.RowKind = "checkout"
93			locator.HeadOID = strings.TrimSpace(registered.Worktree.Head)
94			if status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, registered.Path); statusErr == nil {
95				locator.Upstream = status.Upstream
96				if head, headErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, registered.Path, "HEAD"); headErr == nil {
97					locator.HeadOID = head
98				}
99			}
100		}
101		if locator.HeadOID == "" {
102			locator.HeadOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, localBranchRef(candidate.Branch))
103		}
104		if locator.Upstream == "" && (!found || mode == task.ModeWorktree) {
105			locator.Upstream = s.branchUpstream(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Branch)
106		}
107		locator.BaseOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Base)
108		locator.UpstreamOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, locator.Upstream)
109	
110		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)
111		if err != nil {

117		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
118			return Locator{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while locating")
119		}
120		return locator, nil

123	func (s *lifecycleService) locateRegisteredCheckout(
124		ctx context.Context,
125		candidate task.Task,
126		repoPath string,
127		expectedCheckout string,
128	) (gitx.RegisteredWorktree, bool) {
129		if expectedCheckout != "" {
130			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
131			return registered, err == nil
132		}
133		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree || candidate.State != task.Cold {
134			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
135		}

49	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAndSpecify(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (PlanSpec, lifecycleObservation, error) {
50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:
64			spec = s.resumeSpec(request, observed)
65		case CompleteDirect:
66			spec = s.completeDirectSpec(request, observed)
67		case CompleteFF:
68			spec = s.completeFFSpec(request, observed)
69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}
76		return spec, observed, nil
77	}
78	
79	func (s *lifecycleService) freshPlan(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (Plan, lifecycleObservation, error) {
80		spec, observed, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, record)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Plan{}, observed, err
83		}
84		plan, err := BuildPlan(request, spec)
85		return plan, observed, err
86	}

88	func validateLifecycleLocator(locator Locator) error {
89		switch {
90		case locator.TaskID == "":
91			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact TaskID is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
92		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
93			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
94		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
95			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
96		case locator.RepoPath == "":
97			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
98		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
99			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
100		case locator.Branch == "":
101			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
102		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
103			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
104		case !validState(locator.State):
105			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
106		}
107		return nil
108	}

110	func validateRecordIdentity(locator Locator, record task.Record) error {
111		candidate := record.Task
112		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
113		if record.Revision != locator.TaskRevision {
114			return staleTaskRevision(locator.TaskRevision, record.Revision, "task revision no longer matches the selected row")
115		}
116		checks := []struct {
117			name     string
118			expected string
119			actual   string
120		}{
121			{"TaskID", locator.TaskID, candidate.ID},
122			{"mode", string(locator.Mode), string(mode)},
123			{"state", string(locator.State), string(candidate.State)},
124			{"branch", locator.Branch, candidate.Branch},
125			{"base", locator.Base, candidate.Base},
126		}
127		for _, check := range checks {
128			if check.expected != check.actual {
129				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
130			}
131		}
132	
133		selectedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(locator.RepoPath)
134		if err != nil {
135			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.RepoPath, err)}
136		}
137		recordedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate.RepoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.RepoPath, err)}
140		}
141		if selectedRepo != recordedRepo {
142			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task repository path changed from %q to %q", selectedRepo, recordedRepo)}
143		}
144	
145		expectedCheckout := recordedRepo
146		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
147			expectedCheckout = ""
148			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
149				expectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(candidate.WorktreePath)
150				if err != nil {
151					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.WorktreePath, err)}
152				}
153			}
154		}
155		selectedCheckout := ""
156		if locator.CheckoutPath != "" {
157			selectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(locator.CheckoutPath)
158			if err != nil {
159				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.CheckoutPath, err)}
160			}
161		}
162		if selectedCheckout != expectedCheckout {
163			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task checkout path changed from %q to %q", selectedCheckout, expectedCheckout)}
164		}
165		return nil
166	}
167	
168	func staleTaskRevision(expected, actual, reason string) error {
169		return &StalePlanError{
170			ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: expected,
171			ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   actual,
172			Reason:                       reason,
173		}
174	}

91	func resumeOwnerCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, options ResumeOptions) Condition {
92		if observed.task.OwnedBy(observed.taskflowHost) {

230				branchEvidence = "canonical checkout is detached"
231			} else if observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
232				branchEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("canonical checkout will switch from %q to %q", observed.status.Branch, observed.task.Branch)
233			}
234		}
235		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired,
236			branchEvidence, "switch or reconcile the exact task branch"))
237	
238		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
239		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
240		if observed.operationErr != nil {
241			operationVerdict = VerdictError
242			operationEvidence = observed.operationErr.Error()
243		} else if observed.inProgress {
244			operationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
245			operationEvidence = "Git operation " + observed.operation + " is in progress"
246		}
247		operationRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
248		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
249			operationRequirement = RequirementRequired
250		}
251		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, operationRequirement,
252			operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation before switching branches"))
253	
254		conflictVerdict := VerdictMet
255		conflictEvidence := "no unmerged paths"
256		if observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
257			conflictEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("%d unmerged path(s)", observed.status.Conflicted)
258			if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
259				conflictVerdict = VerdictBlocked
260			}
261		}
262		conflictRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
263		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
264			conflictRequirement = RequirementRequired
265		}
266		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionGitConflict, conflictVerdict, conflictRequirement,
267			conflictEvidence, "resolve conflicts before switching branches"))
268	
269		switchVerdict := VerdictMet
270		switchEvidence := "no branch switch is needed"
271		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
272			switchEvidence = "canonical checkout is clean and may switch branches"
273			if observed.status.Dirty() {
274				switchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
275				switchEvidence = observed.status.Breakdown()
276			}
277		}
278		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionSwitchSafe, switchVerdict, RequirementRequired,
279			switchEvidence, "commit or preserve canonical checkout changes before switching"))
280	
281		targetVerdict := VerdictMet
282		targetEvidence := "target branch " + observed.task.Branch + " exists"
283		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) && !observed.localBranchExists {
284			targetVerdict = VerdictBlocked
285			targetEvidence = "target branch " + observed.task.Branch + " does not exist"
286		}
287		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionTargetBranch, targetVerdict, RequirementRequired,
288			targetEvidence, "restore the local task branch"))
289		return conditions
290	}

292	func (s *lifecycleService) resumeRuntimeConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
293		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
294			return []Condition{
295				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
296				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),

299		}
300		availableVerdict := VerdictMet

322			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked

17	func isCompletionAction(action Action) bool {

22			return false

26	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCompletionFacts(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
27		observed.completionBranch = observed.task.Branch
28		if observed.hasCheckout() && observed.headErr == nil {
29			observed.completionBranchOID = observed.head
30		}
31		if observed.completionBaseRef != "" {
32			observed.completionBaseOID, observed.completionBaseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(
33				ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef,
34			)
35		}
36		if observed.hasCheckout() {
37			observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
38			if observed.completionBaseRef != "" {
39				observed.finish, observed.finishErr = s.analyzeFinish(
40					ctx, observed.checkout, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.task.Branch,
41				)
42			}
43		}
44	
45		switch request.Action {
46		case CompleteFF:
47			s.observeIntegrationFacts(ctx, observed)
48		case ReviewHandoff:
49			observed.reviewRemoteURL = strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, "origin"))
50			identityKind, identity := forge.IdentityFromURL(observed.reviewRemoteURL)
51			observed.reviewKind = s.detectForge(ctx, observed.repoPath)
52			if identityKind != forge.Unknown {
53				if observed.reviewKind != forge.Unknown && observed.reviewKind != identityKind {
54					observed.reviewResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("detected forge %s differs from origin identity %s", observed.reviewKind, identityKind)
55				}
56				observed.reviewKind = identityKind
57				observed.reviewRepository = identity
58			}
59			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil {
60				observed.reviewProvider, observed.reviewResolveErr = s.resolveForge(observed.reviewKind)
61			}
62			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil {
63				switch {
64				case observed.reviewProvider == nil:
65					observed.reviewResolveErr = errors.New("forge resolver returned no provider")
66				case observed.reviewProvider.Kind() != observed.reviewKind:
67					observed.reviewResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("forge resolver returned %s for detected %s remote",
68						observed.reviewProvider.Kind(), observed.reviewKind)
69				default:
70					observed.reviewAvailable = observed.reviewProvider.Available()
71				}
72			}
73		case VerifyMerged:
74			options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
75			observed.proofRef = options.SquashCommit
76			if observed.proofRef == "" {
77				observed.proofRef = observed.task.Branch
78			}
79			if observed.proofRef != "" {
80				observed.proofOID, observed.proofOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofRef)
81			}
82			if observed.completionBaseOIDErr == nil && observed.completionBaseOID != "" &&
83				observed.proofOIDErr == nil && observed.proofOID != "" {

85					ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseOID,
86				)
87			}
88		}

94				worktree: observed.worktree, worktreeFound: observed.worktreeFound, worktreeErr: observed.worktreeErr,
95				status: observed.status, statusErr: observed.statusErr,

113		observed.integration.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.integration.head)
114		observed.integration.operation, observed.integration.inProgress, observed.integration.operationErr =
115			s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)

244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
248			observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
249			if err == nil {
250				observed.worktreeFound = true
251				observed.checkout = registered.Path
252			}
253		case task.ModeWorktree:
254			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
255				registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.WorktreePath)
256				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
257				if err == nil {
258					observed.worktreeFound = true
259					observed.checkout = registered.Path
260				}
261			}
262			if observed.worktreeFound || request.Action != Resume ||
263				(observed.task.State != task.Warm && observed.task.State != task.Cold) {
264				return
265			}
266			worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
267			if err != nil {
268				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("list worktrees for parked-task resume: %w", err)
269				return
270			}
271			var candidate string
272			for _, worktree := range worktrees {
273				if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
274					observed.branchMatches++
275					candidate = worktree.Path
276				}
277			}
278			switch observed.branchMatches {
279			case 0:
280				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
281					observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has no checkout", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, observed.task.Branch)
282				}
283			case 1:
284				registered, resolveErr := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, candidate)
285				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, resolveErr
286				if resolveErr == nil {
287					observed.worktreeFound = true
288					observed.checkout = registered.Path

290			default:

292			}
293		}
