776	func gitIsAncestor(ctx context.Context, dir, ancestor, descendant string) (bool, error) {
777		_, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", ancestor, descendant)
778		if err == nil {
779			return true, nil
780		}
781		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
782		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 {
783			return false, nil
784		}
785		return false, err
786	}
787	
788	func reviewProviderBin(provider forge.Forge) string {
789		if provider == nil {
790			return ""
791		}
792		return provider.Bin()
793	}
794	
795	func reviewProviderWarning(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
796		switch {
797		case observed.reviewResolveErr != nil:
798			return observed.reviewResolveErr.Error() + "; branch was pushed, but no review URL was observed"
799		case observed.reviewProvider == nil:
800			return "no forge provider was resolved; branch was pushed, but no review URL was observed"
801		case !observed.reviewAvailable:
802			return fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is unavailable; branch was pushed, but no review URL was observed",
803				observed.reviewKind, observed.reviewProvider.Bin())
804		default:
805			return ""
806		}
807	}

809	func completionReviewRequest(observed lifecycleObservation, options ReviewHandoffOptions) forge.PRRequest {
810		return forge.PRRequest{
811			Base: observed.completionBaseRef, Head: observed.task.Branch,
812			Title: options.Title, Body: options.Body, Draft: options.Draft,
813			Fill: options.Title == "", Web: false,
814		}
815	}

205	func (e *executionState) applyReviewHandoff(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
206		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ReviewHandoffOptions)
207		observed := &e.observed
208		pushed := false
209		created := false
210	
211		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
212			switch effect.Code {
213			case EffectCommitAll, EffectDiscardAll:
214				if err := e.applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx, effect); err != nil {
215					return e.fail(err, "the task remains active; inspect content finalization and refresh review handoff")
216				}
217			case EffectPushBranch:
218				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
219					return e.fail(err, "refresh review handoff before publishing the branch")
220				}
221				if err := e.service.revalidateReviewRemote(ctx, observed); err != nil {
222					return e.fail(err, "origin changed; refresh review handoff before publishing")
223				}
224				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
225					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
226					if pushErr != nil {
227						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s for review: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
228					}
229					return "published origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
230				})
231				if err != nil {
232					return e.fail(err, "the task state and resources remain unchanged; resolve the push and retry")
233				}
234				pushed = true
235				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, false); err != nil {
236					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after review push: %w", err), "inspect the published branch before retrying")
237				}
238			case EffectCreateReview:
239				if !pushed {
240					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "review creation reached before branch publication"})
241				}
242				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
243					return e.fail(err, "refresh checkout authority after the successful push before creating review")
244				}
245				if err := e.service.revalidateReviewRemote(ctx, observed); err != nil {
246					return e.fail(err, "origin changed after publication; do not create review against a different repository")
247				}
248				if observed.reviewProvider == nil || !observed.reviewAvailable || !observed.reviewProvider.Available() {
249					err := errors.New("approved forge provider became unavailable after branch publication")
250					stepErr := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) { return "", err })
251					return e.fail(stepErr, "the branch is published and task state is unchanged; open the review manually or retry provider creation")
252				}
253				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
254					url, createErr := e.service.createPR(ctx, observed.reviewProvider, observed.checkout,
255						completionReviewRequest(*observed, options))
256					if createErr != nil {
257						return "", fmt.Errorf("create %s review: %w", observed.reviewKind, createErr)
258					}
259					created = true
260					if strings.TrimSpace(url) != "" {
261						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffURL, URL: strings.TrimSpace(url), Label: observed.task.Title()}
262						return "created review at " + strings.TrimSpace(url), nil
263					}
264					return "provider reported successful review creation without a URL", nil
265				})
266				if err != nil {
267					return e.fail(err, "the branch is published and task state is unchanged; retry review creation or open it manually")
268				}
269			default:
270				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ReviewHandoff effect " + string(effect.Code)})
271			}
272		}
273		if !pushed {
274			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "review handoff completed without publishing the branch"})
275		}
276		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
277			return e.fail(err, "the branch is published; refresh local safety evidence before reporting review readiness")
278		}
279		if !created {
280			if warning := reviewProviderWarning(*observed); warning != "" {
281				e.warnings = append(e.warnings, warning)
282			}
283		}
284		e.milestone = MilestoneReviewReady
285		e.snapshot = "task:" + e.revision
286		return e.result(), nil
287	}

334				}, "optional base push failed")

352	func (e *executionState) applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx context.Context, effect Effect) error {
353		observed := &e.observed
354		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
355			return err
356		}
357		before := observed.finish
358		beforeBranchOID := observed.completionBranchOID
359		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
360			switch effect.Code {
361			case EffectCommitAll:
362				message := effect.Details.Map()["message"]
363				if commitErr := e.service.commitAll(ctx, observed.checkout, message); commitErr != nil {
364					return "commit-all may have changed the index", fmt.Errorf("commit all checkout changes: %w", commitErr)
365				}
366				return "committed all checkout changes", nil
367			case EffectDiscardAll:
368				if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, observed.checkout); discardErr != nil {
369					return "discard-all may have partially reset checkout content", fmt.Errorf("discard all checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
370				}
371				return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
372			default:
373				return "", &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected dirty effect " + string(effect.Code)}
374			}
375		})
376		if err != nil {
377			e.partial = true
378			return err
379		}
380		allowBaseMove := observed.mode == task.ModeDirect && effect.Code == EffectCommitAll
381		if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, allowBaseMove); err != nil {
382			return fmt.Errorf("refresh after %s: %w", effect.Code, err)
383		}
384		if observed.finish.Status.Dirty() || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.inProgress {
385			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again after %s: %s", effect.Code, observed.finish.Status.Breakdown())
386		}
387		switch effect.Code {
388		case EffectCommitAll:
389			parent, parentErr := e.service.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBranchOID+"^")
390			if parentErr != nil || parent != beforeBranchOID {
391				return staleBoundary("commit-all did not create exactly one normal commit from the approved branch OID")
392			}
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeDirect {
394				if observed.finish.Relation != (gitx.BranchRelation{}) {
395					return staleBoundary("direct commit changed the self-relation unexpectedly")
396				}
397			} else if observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly != before.Relation.BaseOnly ||
398				observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly != before.Relation.BranchOnly+1 {
399				return staleBoundary("commit-all changed branch relation by more than the declared single commit")
400			}
401		case EffectDiscardAll:
402			if observed.completionBranchOID != beforeBranchOID || observed.finish.Relation != before.Relation {
403				return staleBoundary("discard-all unexpectedly changed committed branch identity or relation")
404			}
405		}
406		if observed.proofRef == observed.task.Branch {
407			observed.proofOID = observed.completionBranchOID
408		} else if e.plan.Action == VerifyMerged && effect.Code == EffectCommitAll {
409			return staleBoundary("dirty commit created a new task tip that is not represented by the approved merge proof")
410		}
411		return nil
412	}

414	func (e *executionState) writeCompletionDone(effect Effect) error {
415		return e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
416			candidate := e.observed.task
417			candidate.State = task.Done
418			updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
419			if updateErr != nil {
420				return "", fmt.Errorf("write DONE task state: %w", updateErr)
421			}
422			if updated == nil {
423				return "", errors.New("write DONE task state returned no revision")
424			}
425			e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
426			e.observed.task = updated.Task
427			e.milestone = MilestoneMerged
428			return "recorded DONE at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
429		})
430	}

432	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateReviewRemote(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
433		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, "origin"))
434		identityKind, repository := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
435		kind := s.detectForge(ctx, observed.repoPath)
436		if identityKind != forge.Unknown {
437			if kind != forge.Unknown && kind != identityKind {
438				return staleBoundary("detected forge no longer matches origin repository identity")
439			}
440			kind = identityKind
441		}
442		if remoteURL != observed.reviewRemoteURL || kind != observed.reviewKind || repository != observed.reviewRepository {
443			return staleBoundary("origin URL or forge repository identity changed after planning")
444		}
445		return nil
446	}

448	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
449		if err := s.revalidateRepository(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
450			return err
451		}
452		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
453			return err
454		}
455		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.completionBranch ||
456			observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.completionBranch {
457			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("completion checkout branch changed: registry=%q status=%q expected=%q",
458				observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.completionBranch))
459		}
460		if observed.inProgress || observed.operationErr != nil || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
461			return errors.New("completion checkout acquired a Git operation or conflict")
462		}
463		freshFinish, err := s.analyzeFinish(ctx, observed.checkout, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.task.Branch)
464		if err != nil {
465			return staleBoundary("finish analysis failed during revalidation: " + err.Error())
466		}
467		if finishAuthority(freshFinish, nil) != finishAuthority(observed.finish, observed.finishErr) {
468			return staleBoundary("finish content fingerprint or branch relation changed")
469		}
470		baseOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef)
471		if err != nil || baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {
472			return staleBoundary("completion base ref or OID changed")
473		}
474		if err := s.revalidateCompletionArtifacts(ctx, observed); err != nil {
475			return err
476		}
477		if err := s.revalidateCompletionOccupancy(ctx, observed); err != nil {
478			return err
479		}
480		return nil
481	}

508		}

542	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateCompletionOccupancy(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
543		if observed.runtime == nil {
544			return errors.New("completion runtime is unavailable")
545		}
546		if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtime.Available() {
547			return errors.New("completion runtime became unavailable")
548		}
549		fresh, err := s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
550			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
551			CallerWorkspaceID: observed.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
552			CallerPaneID:      observed.taskflowCallerPane,
553		})
554		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh, err); occupancyErr != nil {
555			return occupancyErr
556		}
557		observed.occupancy = fresh
558		observed.occupancyErr = nil
559		return nil

630		}

637	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateIntegrationTarget(
638		ctx context.Context,
639		observed *lifecycleObservation,
640		compareAuthority bool,
641		expectedBranch string,
642	) error {
643		fresh, err := s.inspectIntegrationTarget(ctx, observed)
644		if err != nil {
645			return err
646		}
647		if compareAuthority && integrationAuthority(fresh) != integrationAuthority(observed.integration) {
648			return staleBoundary("canonical integration checkout or occupancy changed")
649		}
650		if expectedBranch != "" && (fresh.status.Detached || fresh.status.Branch != expectedBranch ||
651			fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch != expectedBranch) {
652			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("canonical integration checkout is on %q/%q, expected %q",
653				fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch, fresh.status.Branch, expectedBranch))
654		}
655		observed.integration = fresh
656		return nil
657	}

659	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectIntegrationTarget(
660		ctx context.Context,
661		observed *lifecycleObservation,
662	) (completionIntegrationObservation, error) {
663		var fresh completionIntegrationObservation
664		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
665		fresh.worktree, fresh.worktreeErr = registered, err
666		if err != nil {
667			return fresh, err
668		}
669		fresh.worktreeFound = true
670		if registered.Path != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
671			!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare {
672			return fresh, errors.New("integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout")
673		}
674		fresh.status, fresh.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
675		if fresh.statusErr != nil {
676			return fresh, fresh.statusErr
677		}
678		if fresh.status.Dirty() || fresh.status.Conflicted > 0 {
679			return fresh, fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout is not clean: %s", fresh.status.Breakdown())
680		}
681		fresh.head, fresh.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
682		if fresh.headErr != nil {
683			return fresh, fresh.headErr
684		}
685		fresh.head = strings.TrimSpace(fresh.head)
686		if registered.Worktree.Head != fresh.head {
687			return fresh, errors.New("canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD")
688		}
689		fresh.operation, fresh.inProgress, fresh.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
690		if fresh.operationErr != nil {
691			return fresh, fresh.operationErr
692		}
693		if fresh.inProgress {
694			return fresh, errors.New("canonical integration checkout has Git operation " + fresh.operation + " in progress")
695		}
696		fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
697			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
698			CallerWorkspaceID: observed.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
699			CallerPaneID:      observed.taskflowCallerPane,
700		})
701		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr); occupancyErr != nil {
702			return fresh, occupancyErr
703		}
704		return fresh, nil
705	}

714			return err
715		}
716		if fresh.status.Detached || fresh.status.Branch != expectedBranch || fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch != expectedBranch {
717			return fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout branch is registry=%q status=%q expected=%q",
718				fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch, fresh.status.Branch, expectedBranch)
719		}
720		observed.integration = fresh
721		return nil
722	}

753	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateMergeProof(
754		ctx context.Context,
755		observed *lifecycleObservation,
756	) (bool, error) {

760		}

765		if err != nil {
766			return false, err
767		}

770		}
771		contained, err := s.isAncestor(ctx, observed.repoPath, proofOID, baseOID)
772		if err != nil {
773			return false, err
774		}
775		observed.proofContained = contained
776		observed.proofErr = nil
777		return contained, nil

11	// DirtyPolicy is the explicitly selected treatment of checkout changes during
12	// completion planning.

14	
15	const (
16		DirtyAuto    DirtyPolicy = "auto"
17		DirtyFail    DirtyPolicy = "fail"
18		DirtyCommit  DirtyPolicy = "commit"
19		DirtyDiscard DirtyPolicy = "discard"

22	func normalizeDirty(policy DirtyPolicy) DirtyPolicy {
23		if policy == "" {
24			return DirtyAuto
25		}
26		return policy
27	}
28	
29	func validateDirty(policy DirtyPolicy, message string) error {
30		policy = normalizeDirty(policy)
31		switch policy {
32		case DirtyAuto, DirtyFail, DirtyCommit, DirtyDiscard:
33		default:
34			return fmt.Errorf("unknown dirty policy %q", policy)
35		}
36		if message != "" && policy != DirtyAuto && policy != DirtyCommit {
37			return fmt.Errorf("commit message requires dirty policy auto or commit")
38		}
39		return nil
40	}

15	// PlanSpec is action-handler construction input. Authority holds additional
16	// exact identities such as status, runtime, artifact, or remote fingerprints.
17	// BuildPlan copies every map and slice.
18	type PlanSpec struct {
19		Authority         map[string]string

29	// Plan is an immutable-by-interface proposal bound to one request and one
30	// authority fingerprint. Collection accessors always return copies.
31	type Plan struct {
32		PlanID                 string
33		AuthorityFingerprint   string
34		Request                Request
35		Locator                Locator
36		Action                 Action
37		Source                 task.State
38		Target                 task.State
39		HasPersistedTransition bool
40		StatePreserving        bool
41		RemovesTask            bool
42		Availability           Availability
43		Confirmation           Confirmation
44		ExpectedMilestone      Milestone
45		FallbackCommand        string
46		Summary                string
47		DisplayedAt            time.Time
48	
49		authority  Fields
50		conditions []Condition
51		effects    []Effect
52		retained   StringList
53	}
54	
55	// BuildPlan validates graph legality, derives availability, and seals a plan's
56	// deterministic authority fingerprint and PlanID.
57	func BuildPlan(request Request, spec PlanSpec) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid request", Cause: err}
61		}
62		if err := spec.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
63			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
64		}
65		conditions := append([]Condition(nil), spec.Conditions...)
66		if err := validateConditions(conditions); err != nil {
67			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
68		}
69		effects := cloneEffects(spec.Effects)
70		if err := validateEffects(effects); err != nil {
71			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
72		}
73		authority := NewFields(spec.Authority)
74		if err := validateAuthority(authority); err != nil {
75			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
76		}
77	
78		plan := Plan{
79			Request: normalized.Clone(), Locator: normalized.Locator, Action: normalized.Action,
80			Source:       normalized.Locator.State,
81			Availability: AvailabilityFor(conditions), Confirmation: spec.Confirmation,
82			FallbackCommand: spec.FallbackCommand, Summary: spec.Summary, DisplayedAt: spec.DisplayedAt,
83			authority: authority, conditions: conditions, effects: effects,
84			retained: NewStringList(spec.RetainedResources...),
85		}
86		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
87			rule, transitionErr := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
88			if transitionErr != nil {
89				return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid transition", Cause: transitionErr}
90			}
91			plan.HasPersistedTransition = true
92			plan.Target = rule.Target
93			plan.StatePreserving = rule.StatePreserving
94			plan.RemovesTask = rule.RemovesTask
95			plan.ExpectedMilestone = rule.Milestone
96		} else {
97			switch plan.Action {
98			case Adopt:
99				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
100			case Reconcile:
101				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
102			}
103		}
104		plan.AuthorityFingerprint, plan.PlanID = computePlanIdentity(plan)
105		return plan.Clone(), nil
106	}
107	
108	// Clone returns a plan with independent request, map, and slice storage.
109	func (p Plan) Clone() Plan {
110		p.Request = p.Request.Clone()
111		p.authority = p.authority.clone()
112		p.conditions = append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...)
113		p.effects = cloneEffects(p.effects)
114		p.retained = p.retained.clone()
115		return p
116	}

118	// AuthorityFields returns a mutable copy of the extra authority identities.
119	func (p Plan) AuthorityFields() map[string]string { return p.authority.Map() }
120	
121	// Conditions returns the ordered conditions as a mutable copy.
122	func (p Plan) Conditions() []Condition { return append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...) }
123	
124	// Effects returns independent copies of the ordered effects.
125	func (p Plan) Effects() []Effect { return cloneEffects(p.effects) }
126	
127	// RetainedResources returns the resources intentionally left after Apply.
128	func (p Plan) RetainedResources() []string { return p.retained.Values() }

131	// safety override.

135		})
136	}

138	// BlockingConditions returns every required, non-input condition that prevents
139	// READY. Advisory conditions are intentionally absent.
140	func (p Plan) BlockingConditions() []Condition {
141		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
142			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired &&
143				condition.Verdict != VerdictMet && condition.Verdict != VerdictNeedsInput
144		})
145	}

151		})

153	
154	// Validate proves that a plan is structurally consistent and still carries its
155	// original deterministic identity. It performs no live observations.
156	func (p Plan) Validate() error {
157		if p.PlanID == "" || p.AuthorityFingerprint == "" {
158			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan identity is missing"}
159		}
160		if !p.Action.Valid() {
161			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown action %q", p.Action)}
162		}
163		if p.Request.Action != p.Action {
164			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request action and plan action differ"}
165		}
166		if p.Request.Locator != p.Locator {
167			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request locator and plan locator differ"}
168		}
169		if p.Request.Options == nil {
170			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "normalized request options are missing"}
171		}
172		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(p.Request)
173		if err != nil {
174			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request is no longer valid", Cause: err}
175		}
176		if requestIdentity(normalized) != requestIdentity(p.Request) {
177			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request options are not normalized"}
178		}
179		if err := p.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
180			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
181		}
182		if err := validateConditions(p.conditions); err != nil {
183			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
184		}
185		if err := validateEffects(p.effects); err != nil {
186			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
187		}
188		if err := validateAuthority(p.authority); err != nil {
189			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
190		}
191		if err := validatePlanTransition(p); err != nil {
192			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "transition metadata is inconsistent", Cause: err}
193		}
194	
195		authorityFingerprint, planID := computePlanIdentity(p)
196		if authorityFingerprint != p.AuthorityFingerprint {
197			return &StalePlanError{
198				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
199				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
200				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
201				Reason:                       "authority fields, effects, or conditions changed",
202			}
203		}
204		if planID != p.PlanID {
205			return &StalePlanError{
206				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
207				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
208				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
209				Reason:                       "PlanID does not match its authority fingerprint",
210			}
211		}
212		if availability := AvailabilityFor(p.conditions); availability != p.Availability {
213			return &InvalidPlanError{
214				PlanID: p.PlanID,
215				Reason: fmt.Sprintf("availability is %s, want derived %s", p.Availability, availability),
216			}
217		}
218		return nil
219	}

221	// ValidateApproval binds affirmative approval and any typed token to this exact
222	// plan. It never changes plan readiness or condition verdicts.
223	func (p Plan) ValidateApproval(approval Approval) error {
224		if err := p.Validate(); err != nil {
225			return err
226		}
227		if !approval.Granted {
228			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "affirmative approval was not granted", Cause: ErrApprovalRequired}
229		}
230		if approval.PlanID != p.PlanID {
231			return &StalePlanError{
232				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: approval.PlanID,
233				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
234				Reason:                       "approval names a different plan",
235			}
236		}
237		if p.Confirmation.Kind == ConfirmationTyped {
238			if approval.Token != p.Confirmation.Token {
239				return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "typed confirmation token does not match", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
240			}
241		} else if approval.Token != "" {
242			return &ApprovalError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan does not accept a typed confirmation token", Cause: ErrInvalidApproval}
243		}
244		return nil
245	}
246	
247	func validatePlanTransition(plan Plan) error {
248		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
249			rule, err := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
250			if err != nil {
251				return err
252			}
253			if !plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Source != rule.Source || plan.Target != rule.Target ||
254				plan.StatePreserving != rule.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask != rule.RemovesTask ||
255				plan.ExpectedMilestone != rule.Milestone {
256				return fmt.Errorf("plan does not match the transition table")
257			}
258			return nil
259		}
260		expectedMilestone := MilestoneNone
261		switch plan.Action {
262		case Adopt:
263			expectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
264		case Reconcile:
265			expectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
266		}
267		if plan.HasPersistedTransition || plan.Target != "" || plan.StatePreserving || plan.RemovesTask ||
268			plan.Source != plan.Locator.State || plan.ExpectedMilestone != expectedMilestone {
269			return fmt.Errorf("domain action is represented as a persisted-state edge")
270		}
271		return nil
272	}
273	
274	func validateConditions(conditions []Condition) error {
275		seen := make(map[ConditionCode]bool, len(conditions))
276		for index, condition := range conditions {
277			if err := condition.Validate(); err != nil {
278				return fmt.Errorf("condition %d: %w", index, err)
279			}
280			if seen[condition.Code] {
281				return fmt.Errorf("condition code %q is duplicated", condition.Code)
282			}
283			seen[condition.Code] = true
284		}
285		return nil
286	}
287	
288	func validateEffects(effects []Effect) error {
289		for index, effect := range effects {
290			if err := effect.Validate(); err != nil {
291				return fmt.Errorf("effect %d: %w", index, err)
292			}
293		}
294		return nil
295	}
296	
297	func validateAuthority(authority Fields) error {
298		for _, field := range authority.entries {
299			if field.Key == "" {
300				return fmt.Errorf("authority field key is empty")
301			}
302		}
303		return nil
304	}
305	
306	func cloneEffects(effects []Effect) []Effect {
307		out := make([]Effect, len(effects))
308		for index, effect := range effects {
309			out[index] = effect.Clone()
310		}
311		return out
312	}
313	
314	func filterConditions(conditions []Condition, keep func(Condition) bool) []Condition {
315		out := make([]Condition, 0, len(conditions))
316		for _, condition := range conditions {
317			if keep(condition) {
318				out = append(out, condition)
319			}
320		}
321		return out
322	}
323	
324	func requestIdentity(request Request) string {
325		writer := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-request-v1")
326		appendRequestIdentity(writer, request)
327		return writer.sumHex()
328	}
329	
330	func computePlanIdentity(plan Plan) (string, string) {
331		writer := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-authority-v1")
332		appendRequestIdentity(writer, plan.Request)
333		writer.addString("plan.action", string(plan.Action))
334		writer.addString("plan.source", string(plan.Source))
335		writer.addString("plan.target", string(plan.Target))
336		writer.addBool("plan.has-persisted-transition", plan.HasPersistedTransition)
337		writer.addBool("plan.state-preserving", plan.StatePreserving)
338		writer.addBool("plan.removes-task", plan.RemovesTask)
339		writer.addString("plan.expected-milestone", string(plan.ExpectedMilestone))
340		writer.addFields("plan.authority", plan.authority)
341		writer.addInt64("plan.condition-count", int64(len(plan.conditions)))
342		for index, condition := range plan.conditions {
343			prefix := "plan.condition." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
344			writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(condition.Code))
345			writer.addString(prefix+"verdict", string(condition.Verdict))
346			writer.addString(prefix+"requirement", string(condition.Requirement))
347			writer.addString(prefix+"evidence", condition.Evidence)
348			writer.addString(prefix+"remediation", condition.Remediation)
349		}
350		writer.addInt64("plan.effect-count", int64(len(plan.effects)))
351		for index, effect := range plan.effects {
352			prefix := "plan.effect." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
353			writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(effect.Code))
354			writer.addString(prefix+"description", effect.Description)
355			writer.addString(prefix+"target", effect.Target)
356			writer.addBool(prefix+"destructive", effect.Destructive)
357			writer.addBool(prefix+"network", effect.Network)
358			writer.addFields(prefix+"details", effect.Details)
359		}
360		writer.addStrings("plan.retained", plan.retained.values)
361		writer.addString("plan.confirmation-kind", string(plan.Confirmation.Kind))
362		writer.addString("plan.confirmation-token", plan.Confirmation.Token)
363		authorityFingerprint := "sha256:" + writer.sumHex()
364	
365		planWriter := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-plan-v1")
366		planWriter.addString("authority-fingerprint", authorityFingerprint)
367		return authorityFingerprint, "plan:" + planWriter.sumHex()
368	}

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}
48	
49	func (s *lifecycleService) observeAndSpecify(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (PlanSpec, lifecycleObservation, error) {
50		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, record); err != nil {
51			return PlanSpec{}, lifecycleObservation{}, err
52		}
53		observed, err := s.observeLifecycle(ctx, request, record)
54		if err != nil {
55			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
56		}
57		var spec PlanSpec
58		switch request.Action {
59		case ParkWarm:
60			spec = s.parkWarmSpec(request, observed)
61		case ParkCold:
62			spec = s.parkColdSpec(request, observed)
63		case Resume:
64			spec = s.resumeSpec(request, observed)
65		case CompleteDirect:
66			spec = s.completeDirectSpec(request, observed)
67		case CompleteFF:
68			spec = s.completeFFSpec(request, observed)
69		case ReviewHandoff:
70			spec = s.reviewHandoffSpec(request, observed)
71		case VerifyMerged:
72			spec = s.verifyMergedSpec(request, observed)
73		default:
74			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: request.Action, Stage: "plan"}
75		}
76		return spec, observed, nil
77	}

79	func (s *lifecycleService) freshPlan(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (Plan, lifecycleObservation, error) {

81		if err != nil {
82			return Plan{}, observed, err
83		}
84		plan, err := BuildPlan(request, spec)
85		return plan, observed, err

88	func validateLifecycleLocator(locator Locator) error {
89		switch {
90		case locator.TaskID == "":
91			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact TaskID is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
92		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
93			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
94		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
95			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
96		case locator.RepoPath == "":
97			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
98		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
99			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
100		case locator.Branch == "":
101			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
102		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
103			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
104		case !validState(locator.State):
105			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
106		}
107		return nil
108	}
109	
110	func validateRecordIdentity(locator Locator, record task.Record) error {
111		candidate := record.Task
112		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
113		if record.Revision != locator.TaskRevision {
114			return staleTaskRevision(locator.TaskRevision, record.Revision, "task revision no longer matches the selected row")
115		}
116		checks := []struct {
117			name     string
118			expected string
119			actual   string
120		}{
121			{"TaskID", locator.TaskID, candidate.ID},
122			{"mode", string(locator.Mode), string(mode)},
123			{"state", string(locator.State), string(candidate.State)},
124			{"branch", locator.Branch, candidate.Branch},
125			{"base", locator.Base, candidate.Base},
126		}
127		for _, check := range checks {
128			if check.expected != check.actual {
129				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
130			}
131		}
132	
133		selectedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(locator.RepoPath)
134		if err != nil {
135			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.RepoPath, err)}
136		}
137		recordedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate.RepoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.RepoPath, err)}
140		}
141		if selectedRepo != recordedRepo {
142			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task repository path changed from %q to %q", selectedRepo, recordedRepo)}
143		}
144	
145		expectedCheckout := recordedRepo
146		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
147			expectedCheckout = ""
148			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
149				expectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(candidate.WorktreePath)
150				if err != nil {
151					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.WorktreePath, err)}
152				}
153			}
154		}
155		selectedCheckout := ""
156		if locator.CheckoutPath != "" {
157			selectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(locator.CheckoutPath)
158			if err != nil {
159				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.CheckoutPath, err)}
160			}
161		}
162		if selectedCheckout != expectedCheckout {
163			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task checkout path changed from %q to %q", selectedCheckout, expectedCheckout)}
164		}
165		return nil
166	}

1	package taskflow
2	
3	import "context"
4	
5	// PlanHook performs action-specific observation and returns only construction
6	// input. BuildPlan remains the single graph, availability, and identity
7	// authority.
8	type PlanHook func(context.Context, Request) (PlanSpec, error)
9	
10	// ApplyHook executes one already validated plan and may return a partial Result
11	// together with an error.
12	type ApplyHook func(context.Context, Plan) (Result, error)
13	
14	// Handler contains the narrow hooks for one exact action. Either hook may be
15	// omitted; no production or unsafe fallback is installed.
16	type Handler struct {
17		Plan  PlanHook
18		Apply ApplyHook
19	}
20	
21	// Handlers maps stable action codes to injected behavior.
22	type Handlers map[Action]Handler
23	
24	// LocateTaskHook builds one exact managed-task locator from fresh durable and
25	// Git evidence. It is intentionally not accepted by NewService: only the
26	// guarded lifecycle constructor may install it.
27	type LocateTaskHook func(context.Context, string) (Locator, error)
28	
29	// Service is the UI-agnostic locate/plan/apply dispatcher.
30	type Service struct {
31		handlers   map[Action]Handler
32		locateTask LocateTaskHook
33	}
34	
35	// NewService copies handlers so later mutation of the caller's map cannot
36	// redirect a planned action.
37	func NewService(handlers Handlers) *Service {
38		copied := make(map[Action]Handler, len(handlers))
39		for action, handler := range handlers {
40			copied[action] = handler
41		}
42		return &Service{handlers: copied}
43	}
44	
45	// LocateTask returns an exact locator only when this service came from
46	// NewLifecycleService. Generic dispatch services deliberately have no fallback
47	// locator because guessing task, repository, or checkout identity is unsafe.
48	func (s *Service) LocateTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
49		if s == nil || s.locateTask == nil {
50			return Locator{}, ErrLocatorUnavailable
51		}
52		return s.locateTask(ctx, taskID)
53	}
54	
55	// Plan validates and freezes a request, delegates action-specific observations,
56	// then centrally builds the immutable plan.
57	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, err
61		}
62		handler, ok := s.handlers[normalized.Action]
63		if !ok || handler.Plan == nil {
64			return Plan{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: normalized.Action, Stage: "plan"}
65		}
66		spec, err := handler.Plan(ctx, normalized.Clone())
67		if err != nil {
68			return Plan{}, err
69		}
70		return BuildPlan(normalized, spec)
71	}
72	
73	// Apply validates identity and approval, rejects every status except READY, and
74	// delegates only to the handler registered for the plan's exact action. A
75	// handler's partial Result is returned unchanged in meaning alongside errors.
76	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, plan Plan, approval Approval) (Result, error) {
77		frozen := plan.Clone()
78		if err := frozen.Validate(); err != nil {
79			return Result{}, err
80		}
81		if err := frozen.ValidateApproval(approval); err != nil {
82			return Result{}, err
83		}
84		if frozen.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
85			notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{
86				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Availability: frozen.Availability,
87				conditions: frozen.Conditions(),
88			}
89			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{
90				PlanID: frozen.PlanID, Reason: "required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady,
91			}
92		}
93		handler, ok := s.handlers[frozen.Action]
94		if !ok || handler.Apply == nil {
95			return Result{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: frozen.Action, Stage: "apply"}
96		}
97		result, err := handler.Apply(ctx, frozen.Clone())
98		result = result.Clone()
99		if err != nil && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 {
100			result.PartialSuccess = true
101		}
102		return result, err
103	}

26			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectFetchRefs,
27				"fetch and prune origin before resuming", observed.repoPath, false, true,
28				map[string]string{"remote": "origin", "warning-on-failure": "true"}))
29		}
30		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !observed.hasCheckout() &&
31			(observed.task.State == task.Warm || observed.task.State == task.Cold) {
32			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectCreateWorktree,
33				"rebuild the missing linked worktree", observed.desiredWorktree, false, false,
34				map[string]string{
35					"repo": observed.repoPath, "branch": observed.task.Branch,
36					"preferred-base": observed.remoteBranch, "fallback-base": observed.task.Base,
37					"selected-base": observed.baseRef,
38					"provision":     boolString(!options.NoProvision), "runtime": "false",
39				}))
40		}
41		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
42			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectSwitchBranch,
43				"switch the clean canonical checkout to the task branch", observed.repoPath, false, false,
44				map[string]string{"from": observed.status.Branch, "to": observed.task.Branch}))
45		}
46		if shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed) {
47			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectOpenRuntime,
48				"open a runtime surface for the checkout", resumeEffectCheckout(observed), false, false,
49				map[string]string{"backend": runtimeName(observed.runtime), "label": resumeRuntimeLabel(observed.task)}))
50		}
51		runtimeDisposition := "clear"
52		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" {
53			if observed.savedRuntimeLive {
54				runtimeDisposition = "reuse:" + observed.runtime.Name() + ":" + observed.task.RuntimeHandle
55			} else {
56				runtimeDisposition = "open:" + observed.runtime.Name()
57			}
58		}
59		path := observed.task.WorktreePath
60		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
61			if observed.hasCheckout() {
62				path = observed.checkout
63			} else {
64				path = observed.desiredWorktree
65			}
66		} else {
67			path = ""
68		}
69		effects = append(effects, taskUpdateEffect(observed, task.Hot, path, runtimeDisposition,
70			observed.task.Next, observed.task.Note))
71	
72		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.task.Branch}
73		if checkout := resumeEffectCheckout(observed); checkout != "" {
74			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+checkout)
75		}
76		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" {
77			retained = append(retained, "runtime:"+observed.runtime.Name())
78		}
79		return PlanSpec{
80			Authority:         s.baseAuthority(request, observed),
81			Conditions:        conditions,
82			Effects:           effects,
83			RetainedResources: retained,
84			Confirmation:      Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Resume this task and claim its checkout?"},
85			FallbackCommand:   resumeFallback(observed.task.ID, options),
86			Summary:           "Resume " + observed.task.Title() + " HOT",
87			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
88		}
89	}

91	func resumeOwnerCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, options ResumeOptions) Condition {
92		if observed.task.OwnedBy(observed.taskflowHost) {
93			owner := observed.task.Owner
94			if owner == "" {
95				owner = "unclaimed"
96			}
97			return condition(ConditionOwner, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "task owner is "+owner, "")
98		}
99		if options.TakeOwnership {
100			return condition(ConditionOwner, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
101				"ownership transfer from "+observed.task.Owner+" was explicitly requested", "")
102		}
103		return condition(ConditionOwner, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
104			"task is owned by "+observed.task.Owner, "confirm the other machine pushed its work, then take ownership explicitly")
105	}

107	func (s *lifecycleService) resumeCheckoutConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, options ResumeOptions) []Condition {
108		conditions := make([]Condition, 0, 12)
109		if !observed.hasCheckout() {
110			missingVerdict := VerdictBlocked
111			missingEvidence := "the task checkout is not registered"
112			rebuildAllowed := observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree &&
113				(observed.task.State == task.Warm || observed.task.State == task.Cold) &&
114				(observed.worktreeErr == nil || errors.Is(observed.worktreeErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound))
115			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !errors.Is(observed.worktreeErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
116				missingVerdict = VerdictError
117				missingEvidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
118			}
119			if rebuildAllowed {
120				missingVerdict = VerdictMet
121				missingEvidence = strings.ToUpper(string(observed.task.State)) + " worktree is absent and will be rebuilt"
122			}
123			conditions = append(conditions,
124				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, missingVerdict, RequirementRequired, missingEvidence, "restore or rebuild the exact checkout"),
125				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, missingVerdict, RequirementRequired, missingEvidence, "refresh repository topology"),
126				condition(ConditionResumeCheckout, missingVerdict, RequirementRequired, missingEvidence, "resume COLD or reconcile the missing WARM checkout"),
127			)
128			branchVerdict := VerdictMet
129			branchEvidence := "local task branch is available for reconstruction"
130			switch {
131			case observed.localBranchOIDErr != nil:
132				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.localBranchOIDErr.Error()
133			case observed.localBranchExists:
134			case observed.remoteBranchOIDErr != nil:
135				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.remoteBranchOIDErr.Error()
136			case observed.remoteBranchExists:
137				branchEvidence = "published task branch is available for reconstruction"
138			case options.FetchRefs:
139				branchEvidence = "published task branch must appear after the declared fetch"
140			default:
141				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "neither local nor published task branch exists"
142			}
143			conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionBranchRef, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired,
144				branchEvidence, "restore or fetch the exact task branch before reconstruction"))
145			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree &&
146				(observed.task.State == task.Warm || observed.task.State == task.Cold) {
147				switch {
148				case observed.desiredWorktreeErr != nil:
149					conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
150						observed.desiredWorktreeErr.Error(), "choose a valid managed worktree destination"))
151				case observed.desiredWorktree == "":
152					conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
153						"managed worktree destination is empty", "configure paths.worktree_path"))
154				default:
155					conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
156						"managed linked worktree will be created at "+observed.desiredWorktree, ""))
157				}
158				if observed.baseRef == "" {
159					conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
160						"neither origin/"+observed.task.Branch+" nor the recorded base is available", "record an explicit base or fetch the published branch"))
161				} else if observed.baseRefExistsErr != nil {
162					conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
163						observed.baseRefExistsErr.Error(), "repair reconstruction base observation"))
164				} else if !observed.baseRefExists && !options.FetchRefs {
165					conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
166						"explicit reconstruction base "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "fetch refs or restore the explicit base"))
167				} else {
168					evidence := "reconstruction base " + observed.baseRef
169					if options.FetchRefs && !observed.baseRefExists {
170						evidence += " will be revalidated after fetch"
171					}
172					conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, evidence, ""))
173				}
174			} else {
175				conditions = append(conditions,
176					condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired, "resume requires a present checkout", "reconcile the task checkout"),
177					condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "no reconstruction is planned", ""),
178				)
179			}
180			deferredVerdict := VerdictUnknown
181			deferredEvidence := "checkout is absent"
182			if rebuildAllowed {
183				deferredVerdict = VerdictMet
184				deferredEvidence = "exact branch and status will be checked immediately after reconstruction"
185			}
186			conditions = append(conditions,
187				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, deferredVerdict, RequirementRequired, deferredEvidence, "restore the checkout"),
188				condition(ConditionGitStatus, deferredVerdict, RequirementRequired, deferredEvidence, "restore the checkout"),
189				condition(ConditionGitOperation, deferredVerdict, RequirementAdvisory, deferredEvidence, "restore the checkout"),
190				condition(ConditionGitConflict, deferredVerdict, RequirementAdvisory, deferredEvidence, "restore the checkout"),
191				condition(ConditionSwitchSafe, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "no canonical branch switch is planned", ""),
192				condition(ConditionTargetBranch, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "worktree creation names the exact task branch", ""),
193			)
194			return conditions
195		}
196	
197		conditions = append(conditions,
198			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""))
199		exactVerdict, exactEvidence := checkoutExactVerdict(observed)
200		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired,
201			exactEvidence, "reconcile the task and Git worktree identities"))
202	
203		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
204		kindEvidence := "canonical main checkout"
205		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
206			kindEvidence = "exact linked worktree"
207			if !observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
208				kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
209				kindEvidence = "worktree task resolves to the main or bare checkout"
210			}
211		} else if !observed.worktree.Worktree.Main || observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare {
212			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
213			kindEvidence = "branch/direct task does not resolve to Git's main checkout"
214		}
215		conditions = append(conditions,
216			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "reconcile the checkout mode"),
217			condition(ConditionResumeCheckout, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, "fresh exact checkout will be reused", "reconcile the checkout mode"),
218			condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "no reconstruction is needed", ""),
219		)
220	
221		if observed.statusErr != nil {
222			conditions = append(conditions,
223				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
224				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
225				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictError, RequirementAdvisory, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
226				condition(ConditionGitConflict, VerdictError, RequirementAdvisory, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
227				condition(ConditionSwitchSafe, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
228				condition(ConditionTargetBranch, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.statusErr.Error(), "repair Git status observation"),
229			)
230			return conditions
231		}
232		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, observed.status.Summary(), ""))
233	
234		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
235		branchEvidence := "checkout is on task branch " + observed.task.Branch
236		switch observed.mode {
237		case task.ModeWorktree:
238			if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
239				branchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
240				branchEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.task.Branch)
241			}
242		case task.ModeDirect:
243			if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
244				branchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
245				branchEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("direct checkout is on %q, expected %q", observed.status.Branch, observed.task.Branch)
246			}
247		case task.ModeBranch:
248			if observed.status.Detached {
249				branchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
250				branchEvidence = "canonical checkout is detached"
251			} else if observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
252				branchEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("canonical checkout will switch from %q to %q", observed.status.Branch, observed.task.Branch)
253			}
254		}
255		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired,
256			branchEvidence, "switch or reconcile the exact task branch"))
257	
258		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
259		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
260		if observed.operationErr != nil {
261			operationVerdict = VerdictError
262			operationEvidence = observed.operationErr.Error()
263		} else if observed.inProgress {
264			operationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
265			operationEvidence = "Git operation " + observed.operation + " is in progress"
266		}
267		operationRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
268		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
269			operationRequirement = RequirementRequired
270		}
271		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, operationRequirement,
272			operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation before switching branches"))
273	
274		conflictVerdict := VerdictMet
275		conflictEvidence := "no unmerged paths"
276		if observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
277			conflictEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("%d unmerged path(s)", observed.status.Conflicted)
278			if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
279				conflictVerdict = VerdictBlocked
280			}
281		}
282		conflictRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
283		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
284			conflictRequirement = RequirementRequired
285		}
286		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionGitConflict, conflictVerdict, conflictRequirement,
287			conflictEvidence, "resolve conflicts before switching branches"))
288	
289		switchVerdict := VerdictMet
290		switchEvidence := "no branch switch is needed"
291		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
292			switchEvidence = "canonical checkout is clean and may switch branches"
293			if observed.status.Dirty() {
294				switchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
295				switchEvidence = observed.status.Breakdown()
296			}
297		}
298		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionSwitchSafe, switchVerdict, RequirementRequired,
299			switchEvidence, "commit or preserve canonical checkout changes before switching"))
300	
301		targetVerdict := VerdictMet
302		targetEvidence := "target branch " + observed.task.Branch + " exists"
303		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) && !observed.localBranchExists {
304			targetVerdict = VerdictBlocked
305			targetEvidence = "target branch " + observed.task.Branch + " does not exist"
306		}
307		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionTargetBranch, targetVerdict, RequirementRequired,
308			targetEvidence, "restore the local task branch"))
309		return conditions
310	}

312	func (s *lifecycleService) resumeRuntimeConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
313		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
314			return []Condition{
315				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
316				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
317				condition(ConditionSavedRuntime, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory, "saved runtime was not validated", "refresh runtime state"),
318			}
319		}
320		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
321		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is available"
322		if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
323			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
324			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
325		}
326		if !observed.hasCheckout() {
327			occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
328			occupancyEvidence := "missing checkout cannot be occupied; strict occupancy will be checked after reconstruction"
329			if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" && !s.allowSharedCheckout {
330				occupancyVerdict = VerdictError
331				occupancyEvidence = "runtime=none cannot observe writers after checkout reconstruction"
332			}
333			return []Condition{
334				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
335				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired,
336					occupancyEvidence, "select an observable runtime backend before reconstructing the checkout"),
337				condition(ConditionSavedRuntime, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
338					"saved runtime hint will be revalidated after reconstruction", ""),
339			}
340		}
341		occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr)
342		occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
343		occupancyEvidence := "no other recognized agent occupies the checkout"
344		if s.allowSharedCheckout && occupancyErr == nil {
345			occupancyEvidence = "shared-checkout override accepts the observed or explicitly unobserved runtime occupancy"
346		}
347		if occupancyErr != nil {
348			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
349			occupancyEvidence = occupancyErr.Error()
350			if observed.occupancyErr != nil || observed.occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil ||
351				observed.occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil || observed.occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil ||
352				observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil || occupancyObservationIncomplete(observed.occupancy) {
353				occupancyVerdict = VerdictError
354			}
355		}
356		savedEvidence := "no saved runtime handle"
357		if observed.task.RuntimeHandle != "" {
358			if observed.savedRuntimeLive {
359				savedEvidence = "saved " + observed.runtime.Name() + " handle " + observed.task.RuntimeHandle + " covers the exact checkout"
360			} else {
361				savedEvidence = "saved runtime handle is stale and will be replaced or cleared"
362			}
363		}
364		return []Condition{
365			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
366			condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop the other recognized agent or use another checkout"),
367			condition(ConditionSavedRuntime, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, savedEvidence, ""),
368		}
369	}

371	func resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
372		return observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && observed.hasCheckout() && observed.statusErr == nil &&
373			!observed.status.Detached && observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch
374	}
375	
376	func shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
377		return observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.savedRuntimeLive
378	}
379	
380	func resumeEffectCheckout(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
381		if observed.hasCheckout() {
382			return observed.checkout
383		}
384		return observed.desiredWorktree
385	}
386	
387	func resumeRuntimeLabel(candidate task.Task) string {
388		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
389			return candidate.Repo + "/" + candidate.Branch
390		}
391		return candidate.Title()
392	}
393	
394	func resumeFallback(id string, options ResumeOptions) string {
395		parts := []string{"dev", "resume", shellQuote(id)}
396		if !options.FetchRefs {
397			parts = append(parts, "--fetch=false")
398		}
399		if options.NoProvision {
400			parts = append(parts, "--no-provision")
401		}
402		if options.TakeOwnership {
403			parts = append(parts, "--force")
404		}
405		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
406	}

244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
248			observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
249			if err == nil {
250				observed.worktreeFound = true
251				observed.checkout = registered.Path
252			}
253		case task.ModeWorktree:
254			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
255				registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.WorktreePath)
256				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
257				if err == nil {
258					observed.worktreeFound = true
259					observed.checkout = registered.Path
260				}
261			}
262			if observed.worktreeFound || request.Action != Resume ||
263				(observed.task.State != task.Warm && observed.task.State != task.Cold) {
264				return
265			}
266			worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
267			if err != nil {
268				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("list worktrees for parked-task resume: %w", err)
269				return
270			}
271			var candidate string
272			for _, worktree := range worktrees {
273				if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
274					observed.branchMatches++
275					candidate = worktree.Path
276				}
277			}
278			switch observed.branchMatches {
279			case 0:
280				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
281					observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has no checkout", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, observed.task.Branch)
282				}
283			case 1:
284				registered, resolveErr := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, candidate)
285				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, resolveErr
286				if resolveErr == nil {
287					observed.worktreeFound = true
288					observed.checkout = registered.Path
289				}
290			default:
291				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has %d registered checkouts", gitx.ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, observed.task.Branch, observed.branchMatches)
292			}
293		}
294	}

296	func validateLiveLocator(locator Locator, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
297		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.hasCheckout() {
298			checks := []struct {
299				name     string
300				expected string
301				actual   string
302				required bool
303			}{
304				{"upstream", locator.Upstream, observed.status.Upstream, true},
305				{"HEAD", locator.HeadOID, observed.head, locator.HeadOID != ""},
306				{"base OID", locator.BaseOID, observed.baseOID, locator.BaseOID != ""},
307				{"upstream OID", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.upstreamOID, locator.UpstreamOID != ""},
308			}
309			for _, check := range checks {
310				if check.required && check.expected != check.actual {
311					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
312				}
313			}
314			return nil
315		}
316		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.HeadOID != "" {
317			if observed.localBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.HeadOID != observed.localBranchOID {
318				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected local branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.HeadOID, observed.localBranchOID)}
319			}
320		}
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.UpstreamOID != "" && locator.Upstream == observed.remoteBranch {
322			if observed.remoteBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.UpstreamOID != observed.remoteBranchOID {
323				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected remote branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.remoteBranchOID)}
324			}
325		}
326		return nil
327	}

329	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRuntime(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
330		switch options := request.Options.(type) {
331		case ParkWarmOptions:
332			if options.KeepSession || !observed.hasCheckout() {
333				return
334			}
335			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
336			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
337		case ParkColdOptions:
338			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
339				return
340			}
341			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
342			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
343			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
344				observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
345			}
346		case ResumeOptions:
347			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
348				return
349			}
350			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
351				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
352				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
353				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
354			})
355			if s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) == nil {
356				observed.savedRuntimeLive = savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
357			}

211	func inspectReadinessCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout string) (readinessCheckoutIdentity, bool, error) {
212		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, checkout)
213		if errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
214			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, nil
215		}
216		if err != nil {
217			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, fmt.Errorf("discover artifact readiness checkout identity: %w", err)
218		}
219		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
220		if err != nil {
221			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness Git common directory: %w", err)
222		}
223		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
224		if err != nil {
225			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, fmt.Errorf("observe artifact readiness checkout branch: %w", err)
226		}
227		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
228			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, errors.New("artifact readiness checkout is detached; moved intent identity is ambiguous")
229		}
230		return readinessCheckoutIdentity{commonDir: commonDir, branch: status.Branch}, true, nil
231	}

246			case err != nil:
247				err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
248				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
249				evidence.ObservationError = err
250			case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
251				evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
252			default:
253				evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
254			}
255		default:
256			// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
257			// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
258			err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
259			evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
260			evidence.ObservationError = err
261		}
262		return evidence, err
263	}
264	
265	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
266		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
267			return false, nil
268		}
269		candidates := []struct {
270			dir string
271			ref string
272		}{
273			{checkout, "HEAD"},
274			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
275			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
276		}
277		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
278		var observationErr error
279		for _, candidate := range candidates {
280			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
281				continue
282			}
283			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
284			if seen[key] {
285				continue
286			}
287			seen[key] = true
288			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
289				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
290			}
291			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
292				return true, nil
293			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
294				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
295					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
296			}
297		}
298		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
299			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
300		}
301		return false, observationErr
302	}
303	
304	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
305		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
306		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
307	}
308	
309	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
310		if current == nil {
311			return next
312		}
313		if next == nil {
314			return current
315		}
316		return errors.Join(current, next)
317	}

319	func (s *Service) Prepare(ctx context.Context, request PrepareRequest) (*Intent, error) {
320		if s.Store == nil {
321			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
322		}
323		provider, sessionID, err := ParseSession(request.Session)
324		if err != nil {
325			return nil, err
326		}
327		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, request.Worktree)
328		if err != nil {
329			return nil, err
330		}
331		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
332		if err != nil {
333			return nil, err
334		}
335		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
336			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires a named branch")
337		}
338		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
339			return nil, err
340		} else if active {
341			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation refuses Git operation %s in progress", operation)
342		}
343		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
344		if err != nil {
345			return nil, err
346		}
347		changes, err := statusPaths(ctx, repository.Root)
348		if err != nil {
349			return nil, err
350		}
351		var unrelated []string
352		for _, change := range changes {
353			if change.Staged {
354				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires an empty index; staged path: %s", change.Path)
355			}
356			if !isRecognizedArtifact(change.Path) {
357				return nil, fmt.Errorf("commit product changes before prepare; dirty path: %s", change.Path)
358			}
359			unrelated = append(unrelated, change.Path)
360		}
361		transcript, err := FindTranscript(repository.Root, provider, sessionID)
362		if err != nil {
363			return nil, err
364		}
365		tracked, err := gitTracked(ctx, repository.Root, transcript.Path)
366		if err != nil {
367			return nil, err
368		}
369		info, err := os.Stat(transcript.Path)
370		if err != nil {
371			return nil, err
372		}
373		limit := s.LargeLimit
374		if limit <= 0 {
375			limit = DefaultLargeLimit
376		}
377		if !tracked && info.Size() > limit && !request.AllowLarge {
378			return nil, fmt.Errorf("untracked transcript is %d bytes; re-run with --allow-large after reviewing repository growth", info.Size())
379		}
380		plans, err := normalizePlans(repository.Root, request.Plans)
381		if err != nil {
382			return nil, err
383		}
384		runID := request.RunID
385		if runID == "" {
386			runID = os.Getenv("DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID")
387		}
388		if runID == "" {
389			runID = fmt.Sprintf("run-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
390		}
391		selected := make(map[string]bool, len(plans)+1)
392		relTranscript, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, transcript.Path)
393		selected[filepath.ToSlash(relTranscript)] = true
394		for _, plan := range plans {
395			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, plan)
396			selected[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
397		}
398		filtered := unrelated[:0]
399		for _, path := range unrelated {
400			if !selected[path] {
401				filtered = append(filtered, path)
402			}
403		}
404		intent := &Intent{
405			RunID: runID, Provider: provider, SessionID: sessionID, TaskID: request.TaskID,
406			RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, GitCommonDir: repository.GitCommonDir,
407			WorktreePath: repository.Root, Branch: status.Branch, Base: request.Base,
408			Head: strings.TrimSpace(head), PlanPaths: plans, UnrelatedArtifacts: filtered, AllowLarge: request.AllowLarge,
409		}
410		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
411		if err != nil {
412			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact repository lock identity: %w", err)
413		}
414		if s.beforeIntentCreate != nil {
415			s.beforeIntentCreate()
416		}
417		if err := lockx.WithDir(ctx, filepath.Join(commonDir, "dev-taskflow"), "taskflow repository", func() error {
418			if err := revalidatePreparedIntent(ctx, intent); err != nil {
419				return err
420			}
421			return s.Store.Create(ctx, intent)
422		}); err != nil {
423			return nil, err
424		}
425		return intent, nil
426	}
427	
428	func revalidatePreparedIntent(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
429		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
430		if err != nil {
431			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout before arming intent: %w", err)
432		}
433		checkout, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.Root)
434		if err != nil {
435			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize revalidated artifact checkout: %w", err)
436		}
437		expectedCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
438		if err != nil {
439			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize prepared artifact checkout: %w", err)
440		}
441		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
442		if err != nil {
443			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize revalidated artifact Git common directory: %w", err)
444		}
445		expectedCommon, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.GitCommonDir)
446		if err != nil {
447			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize prepared artifact Git common directory: %w", err)
448		}
449		if checkout != expectedCheckout || commonDir != expectedCommon {
450			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout identity changed before intent creation")
451		}
452		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
453		if err != nil {
454			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout status: %w", err)
455		}
456		if status.Detached || status.Branch != intent.Branch {
457			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout branch changed from %s to %s before intent creation", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
458		}
459		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(checkout); err != nil {
460			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact Git operation: %w", err)
461		} else if active {
462			return fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation refuses Git operation %s that started before intent creation", operation)
463		}
464		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
465		if err != nil {
466			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout HEAD: %w", err)
467		}
468		if strings.TrimSpace(head) != strings.TrimSpace(intent.Head) {
469			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout HEAD changed before intent creation")
470		}
471		return nil
472	}

474	func (s *Service) ObserveSessionEnd(ctx context.Context, runID string, when time.Time) error {
475		intent, err := s.Store.FindByRunID(runID)
476		if err != nil {
477			return nil // SessionEnd without an armed intent is deliberately a no-op.
478		}
479		if when.IsZero() {
480			when = time.Now()
481		}
482		return s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
483			candidate.SessionEndedAt = when.UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
484			return nil
485		})
486	}

488	func (s *Service) Finalize(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
489		if s.Store == nil {
490			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
491		}
492		intent, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
493		if err != nil {
494			return nil, err
495		}
496		lockDir := filepath.Join(intent.GitCommonDir, "dev-artifact-finalize")
497		var finalized *Intent
498		err = catalog.NewStore(lockDir).WithLock(ctx, func() error {
499			current, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
500			if err != nil {
501				return err
502			}
503			finalized, err = s.finalizeLocked(ctx, request, current)
504			return err
505		})
506		return finalized, err
507	}
