509	func (s *Service) finalizeLocked(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest, intent *Intent) (*Intent, error) {
510		if intent.Status == Finalized {
511			if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok && commit != intent.ArtifactCommit {
512				if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
513					return nil, err
514				}
515				return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
516			}
517			return intent, nil
518		}
519		if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok {
520			if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
521				return nil, err
522			}
523			return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
524		}
525		if s.ScanStaged == nil {
526			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scanner-missing", fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization requires a staged secret scanner"))
527		}
528		if err := s.revalidate(ctx, intent); err != nil {
529			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "git-drift", err)
530		}
531		if intent.SessionEndedAt.IsZero() && !request.WriterStopped {
532			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-unproven",
533				fmt.Errorf("finalization requires SessionEnd observation or explicit post-writer proof"))
534		}
535		transcript, err := FindTranscript(intent.WorktreePath, intent.Provider, intent.SessionID)
536		if err != nil {
537			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "transcript-missing", err)
538		}
539		if err := s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
540			candidate.Status = Finalizing
541			candidate.TranscriptPath = transcript.Path
542			candidate.FailureCode = ""
543			return nil
544		}); err != nil {
545			return nil, err
546		}
547		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
548			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
549		}
550		paths := append([]string{transcript.Path}, intent.PlanPaths...)
551		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, nil); err != nil {
552			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-not-empty", err)
553		}
554		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"add", "--"}, paths...)...); err != nil {
555			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "stage-failed", err)
556		}
557		cleanup := func() {
558			_, _ = gitx.Run(context.Background(), intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"reset", "--"}, paths...)...)
559		}
560		if err := s.ScanStaged(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
561			cleanup()
562			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scan-failed", err)
563		}
564		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
565			cleanup()
566			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
567		}
568		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
569			cleanup()
570			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
571		}
572		if err := stagedFilesMatch(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
573			cleanup()
574			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
575		}
576		message := fmt.Sprintf("chore: finalize %s agent session", intent.Provider)
577		trailers := fmt.Sprintf("Agent-Artifact-Session: %s:%s\nDev-Artifact-Intent: %s", intent.Provider, intent.SessionID, intent.ID)
578		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "commit", "-m", message, "-m", trailers); err != nil {
579			cleanup()
580			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "commit-failed", err)
581		}
582		commit, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
583		if err != nil {
584			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "receipt-failed", err)
585		}
586		if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, transcript.Path, commit); err != nil {
587			return nil, err
588		}
589		return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
590	}

592	func (s *Service) resolveIntent(request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
593		if request.IntentID != "" {
594			return s.Store.Get(request.IntentID)
595		}
596		if request.RunID != "" {
597			return s.Store.FindByRunID(request.RunID)
598		}
599		return nil, fmt.Errorf("finalize requires an intent or run id")
600	}

602	func (s *Service) revalidate(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
603		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
604		if err != nil {
605			return err
606		}
607		if repository.GitCommonDir != intent.GitCommonDir {
608			return fmt.Errorf("Git common-dir changed")
609		}
610		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
611		if err != nil {
612			return err
613		}
614		if status.Branch != intent.Branch || status.Detached {
615			return fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
616		}
617		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(intent.WorktreePath); err != nil {
618			return err
619		} else if active {
620			return fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
621		}
622		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
623		if err != nil {
624			return err
625		}
626		if head != intent.Head {
627			return fmt.Errorf("HEAD changed from %s to %s", intent.Head, head)
628		}
629		return nil
630	}

651	type statusPath struct {
652		Path   string
653		Staged bool
654	}
655	
656	func statusPaths(ctx context.Context, repo string) ([]statusPath, error) {
657		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
658		if err != nil {
659			return nil, err
660		}
661		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
662		var paths []statusPath
663		for i := 0; i < len(fields); i++ {
664			entry := fields[i]
665			if len(entry) < 4 {
666				continue
667			}
668			code, path := entry[:2], filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:])
669			paths = append(paths, statusPath{Path: path, Staged: code[0] != ' ' && code[0] != '?'})
670			if code[0] == 'R' || code[0] == 'C' {
671				i++ // porcelain -z emits the source path as the next field.
672			}
673		}
674		return paths, nil
675	}
676	
677	func isRecognizedArtifact(path string) bool {
678		path = filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(path, "./"))
679		for _, prefix := range []string{
680			".specstory/history/", ".claude/plans/", ".cursor/plans/", ".cursor/rules/",
681			".opencode/plans/", ".specify/", ".codex/",
682		} {
683			if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
684				return true
685			}
686		}
687		return path == ".specstory/statistics.json"
688	}
689	
690	func normalizePlans(root string, paths []string) ([]string, error) {
691		var out []string
692		for _, path := range paths {
693			if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
694				path = filepath.Join(root, path)
695			}
696			inside, err := pathx.Contains(filepath.Join(root, ".claude", "plans"), path)
697			if err != nil || !inside {
698				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is outside .claude/plans", path)
699			}
700			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
701			if err != nil {
702				return nil, err
703			}
704			info, err := os.Stat(canonical)
705			if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
706				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is not a regular file", path)
707			}
708			out = append(out, canonical)
709		}
710		sort.Strings(out)
711		return out, nil
712	}
713	
714	func gitTracked(ctx context.Context, repo, path string) (bool, error) {
715		rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
716		if err != nil {
717			return false, err
718		}
719		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", "--", rel)
720		if err == nil {
721			return true, nil
722		}
723		var gitErr *gitx.Error
724		if errors.As(err, &gitErr) {
725			return false, nil
726		}
727		return false, err
728	}
729	
730	func ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx context.Context, repo string, allowed []string) error {
731		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z")
732		if err != nil {
733			return err
734		}
735		allow := make(map[string]bool, len(allowed))
736		for _, path := range allowed {
737			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
738			allow[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
739		}
740		for _, path := range strings.Split(out, "\x00") {
741			if path != "" && !allow[filepath.ToSlash(path)] {
742				return fmt.Errorf("index contains unrelated path %s", path)
743			}
744		}
745		return nil
746	}
747	
748	func stagedFilesMatch(ctx context.Context, repo string, paths []string) error {
749		for _, path := range paths {
750			rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
751			if err != nil {
752				return err
753			}
754			workingBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "hash-object", "--", rel)
755			if err != nil {
756				return err
757			}
758			stagedBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "rev-parse", ":"+filepath.ToSlash(rel))
759			if err != nil {
760				return err
761			}
762			if workingBlob != stagedBlob {
763				return fmt.Errorf("staged artifact %s no longer matches scanned working bytes", filepath.ToSlash(rel))
764			}
765		}
766		return nil
767	}
768	
769	func findReceipt(ctx context.Context, repo, intentID string) (string, bool) {
770		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "log", "-n", "100", "--format=%H%x00%B%x00")
771		if err != nil {
772			return "", false
773		}
774		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
775		for i := 0; i+1 < len(fields); i += 2 {
776			if strings.Contains(fields[i+1], "Dev-Artifact-Intent: "+intentID) {
777				return fields[i], true
778			}
779		}
780		return "", false
781	}

1	package cli

13	func guardSharedCheckout(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout string) error {
14		if app.allowSharedCheckout {
15			return nil
16		}
17		reportedPane := ""
18		if rt != nil {
19			switch rt.Name() {
20			case "herdr":
21				reportedPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
22			case "tmux":
23				reportedPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
24			}
25		}
26		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
27			Profile:      runtime.OccupancyStrict,
28			CallerPaneID: reportedPane,
29		})
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("check live occupancy before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
32		}
33		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
34			return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
35		}
36		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("classify live runtime coverage before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionCoverageErr)
38		}
39		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("list live runtime sessions before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionList.Err)
41		}
42		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
44		}
45	
46		var occupied []string
47		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
48			if !agent.Blocking {
49				continue
50			}
51			activity := agent.Activity
52			label := activity.Agent
53			if activity.Name != "" {
54				label = activity.Name
55			}
56			if label == "" {
57				label = "agent"
58			}
59			occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, activity.PaneID))
60		}
61		if len(occupied) == 0 {
62			return nil
63		}
64		return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
65			config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
66	}
67	
68	// checkoutAgentActivities returns recognized agents whose reported cwd resolves
69	// to the same canonical Git worktree root as checkout. A pane is excluded only
70	// when its exact ID matches excludePane; lifecycle state never makes it free.
71	func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {
72		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{Profile: runtime.OccupancyStrict})
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
77			return nil, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err
78		}
79		out := make([]runtime.AgentActivity, 0, len(evidence.Agents))
80		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
81			if excludePane == "" || agent.Activity.PaneID != excludePane {
82				out = append(out, agent.Activity)
83			}
84		}
85		return out, nil
86	}

20	// ObservationState distinguishes an observation that was not attempted from a
21	// successful empty observation and a failed observation. In particular, an
22	// empty successful runtime observation proves that no session covered a row;
23	// an unobserved or failed runtime does not.
24	type ObservationState string
25	
26	const (
27		ObservationUnobserved ObservationState = "unobserved"
28		ObservationAvailable  ObservationState = "available"
29		ObservationFailed     ObservationState = "failed"
30	)
31	
32	// TopologyObservation records whether one source of repository topology was
33	// observed and retains the typed failure when it was not.
34	type TopologyObservation struct {
35		State ObservationState
36		Err   error
37	}
38	
39	// Available reports that the observation completed, even when its result was
40	// empty.
41	func (o TopologyObservation) Available() bool { return o.State == ObservationAvailable }
42	
43	// Failed reports that the observation was attempted but failed.
44	func (o TopologyObservation) Failed() bool { return o.State == ObservationFailed }
45	
46	// WorktreeListError is the typed failure returned when Git's registered

53	func (e *WorktreeListError) Error() string {
54		return fmt.Sprintf("list registered worktrees from %s: %v", e.Path, e.Err)
55	}

57	func (e *WorktreeListError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }

59	// RuntimeListError is the typed failure retained when runtime sessions could

72	}

74	func (e *RuntimeListError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }

76	// RepositoryIdentityError reports that the shared Git common directory could

78	// cannot claim a stable repository identity.

80		Path string
81		Err  error
82	}

85		return fmt.Sprintf("canonicalize Git common directory %s: %v", e.Path, e.Err)
86	}

90	// TopologyReasonCode is a stable machine-readable explanation of topology
91	// drift or conflict. Drift describes recoverable disagreement with recorded
92	// intent; conflict means the evidence is not sufficient to authorize action.
93	type TopologyReasonCode string
94	
95	const (
96		ReasonWorktreePathMoved            TopologyReasonCode = "worktree-path-moved"
97		ReasonWorktreePathMissing          TopologyReasonCode = "worktree-path-missing"
98		ReasonCheckoutUnavailable          TopologyReasonCode = "checkout-unavailable"
99		ReasonUnexpectedCheckout           TopologyReasonCode = "unexpected-checkout"
100		ReasonBranchMismatch               TopologyReasonCode = "branch-mismatch"
101		ReasonMainBranchMismatch           TopologyReasonCode = "main-branch-mismatch"
102		ReasonTaskModeMismatch             TopologyReasonCode = "task-mode-mismatch"
103		ReasonAmbiguousCheckout            TopologyReasonCode = "ambiguous-checkout"
104		ReasonMultipleTaskClaims           TopologyReasonCode = "multiple-task-claims"
105		ReasonHarnessTaskConflict          TopologyReasonCode = "harness-task-conflict"
106		ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable     TopologyReasonCode = "canonical-path-unavailable"
107		ReasonWorktreeInventoryUnavailable TopologyReasonCode = "worktree-inventory-unavailable"
108	)
109	
110	// TopologyReason couples a stable reason code with human-readable evidence.
111	type TopologyReason struct {
112		Code   TopologyReasonCode
113		Detail string
114	}
115	
116	// TaskBindingKind explains why a task was associated with a registered
117	// checkout. It is evidence, not permission to mutate that checkout.
118	type TaskBindingKind string
119	
120	const (
121		TaskBindingExactPath  TaskBindingKind = "exact-path"
122		TaskBindingMovedPath  TaskBindingKind = "moved-path"
123		TaskBindingMainBranch TaskBindingKind = "main-branch"
124		TaskBindingUnbound    TaskBindingKind = "unbound"
125	)
126	
127	// TaskBinding records one task's single topology association, including any
128	// drift or conflict discovered while making it.
129	type TaskBinding struct {
130		Task            *task.Task
131		Kind            TaskBindingKind
132		CheckoutID      string
133		DriftReasons    []TopologyReason
134		ConflictReasons []TopologyReason
135	}
136	
137	// Bound reports whether this binding names a registered checkout.
138	func (b TaskBinding) Bound() bool { return b.CheckoutID != "" && b.Kind != TaskBindingUnbound }
139	
140	// OwnershipEvidenceKind identifies a fact that contributes to the display
141	// ownership classification. Consumers must inspect all evidence and conflicts;
142	// CheckoutOwnership alone is never authorization to mutate a checkout.
143	type OwnershipEvidenceKind string
144	
145	const (
146		OwnershipEvidenceGitMain       OwnershipEvidenceKind = "git-main"
147		OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask   OwnershipEvidenceKind = "managed-task"
148		OwnershipEvidenceClaudeHarness OwnershipEvidenceKind = "claude-harness"
149	)
150	
151	// OwnershipEvidence is one independently observed ownership fact.
152	type OwnershipEvidence struct {
153		Kind   OwnershipEvidenceKind
154		Path   string
155		TaskID string
156		Owner  string
157	}
158	
159	// ClaudeHarnessEvidence proves that a registered checkout is canonically below
160	// the selected repository's own .claude/worktrees directory.
161	type ClaudeHarnessEvidence struct {
162		Root         string
163		CheckoutPath string
164	}
165	
166	// DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree returns canonical path evidence only when the
167	// checkout is strictly below <repositoryRoot>/.claude/worktrees. A matching
168	// branch name or a lexical .claude segment elsewhere on disk is not evidence.
169	func DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(repositoryRoot, checkoutPath string) (ClaudeHarnessEvidence, bool) {
170		if repositoryRoot == "" || checkoutPath == "" {
171			return ClaudeHarnessEvidence{}, false
172		}
173		harnessPath := filepath.Join(repositoryRoot, ".claude", "worktrees")
174		canonicalCheckout, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(harnessPath, checkoutPath)
175		if err != nil {
176			return ClaudeHarnessEvidence{}, false
177		}
178		harnessRoot, err := pathx.Canonical(harnessPath)
179		if err != nil {
180			return ClaudeHarnessEvidence{}, false
181		}
182		return ClaudeHarnessEvidence{Root: harnessRoot, CheckoutPath: canonicalCheckout}, true
183	}
184	
185	// IsClaudeHarnessWorktree reports whether strict canonical harness evidence is
186	// available for checkoutPath.
187	func IsClaudeHarnessWorktree(repositoryRoot, checkoutPath string) bool {
188		_, ok := DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(repositoryRoot, checkoutPath)
189		return ok
190	}
191	
192	// CheckoutOwnership is the legacy display classification for a checkout. It is
193	// intentionally retained for CLI and dashboard compatibility, but it is not an
194	// authorization decision; use OwnershipEvidence and ConflictReasons for that.
195	type CheckoutOwnership string
196	
197	const (
198		CheckoutCanonical CheckoutOwnership = "canonical"
199		CheckoutDev       CheckoutOwnership = "dev"
200		CheckoutExternal  CheckoutOwnership = "external"
201		CheckoutEphemeral CheckoutOwnership = "ephemeral"
202	)
203	
204	// RepoCheckout is one Git-registered checkout in a repository context. Git's
205	// Worktree record is retained unchanged; canonical fields are derived beside it
206	// for identity and matching.
207	type RepoCheckout struct {
208		// ID is the stable host-local row identity: the canonical registered path.
209		ID           string
210		RepositoryID string
211		IdentityErr  error
212		Worktree     gitx.Worktree
213		Status       gitx.Status
214		// StatusErr is retained so a prunable or unreadable checkout can remain
215		// visible without pretending its Git state was successfully inspected.
216		StatusErr    error
217		Exists       bool
218		LastActivity time.Time
219		LastCommit   time.Time
220		LastSubject  string
221		Sessions     []runtime.Session
222		Tasks        []*task.Task
223		// TaskBindings is the authoritative association; Tasks is its compatibility
224		// projection for existing callers.
225		TaskBindings       []TaskBinding
226		OwnershipEvidence  []OwnershipEvidence
227		HarnessEvidence    *ClaudeHarnessEvidence
228		DriftReasons       []TopologyReason
229		ConflictReasons    []TopologyReason
230		RuntimeObservation TopologyObservation
231		Ownership          CheckoutOwnership
232	}

234	// Branch returns the named branch from Git's registered worktree record,
235	// falling back to live status for compatibility with manually constructed
236	// RepoCheckout values.
237	func (c RepoCheckout) Branch() string {
238		if c.Worktree.Branch != "" {
239			return c.Worktree.Branch
240		}
241		return c.Status.Branch
242	}

244	// RepoContextRowKind distinguishes a registered checkout row from a task-only
245	// row produced when no checkout can safely bind that task.
246	type RepoContextRowKind string
247	
248	const (
249		RepoContextRowCheckout RepoContextRowKind = "checkout"
250		RepoContextRowTask     RepoContextRowKind = "task"
251	)
252	
253	// RepoContextRow is the authoritative exact-once row projection. Checkout rows
254	// appear in Git order; unmatched task rows follow in task-ID order.
255	type RepoContextRow struct {
256		ID                  string
257		RepositoryID        string
258		Kind                RepoContextRowKind
259		CheckoutIndex       int
260		Checkout            *RepoCheckout
261		Task                *task.Task
262		Binding             TaskBinding
263		DriftReasons        []TopologyReason
264		ConflictReasons     []TopologyReason
265		WorktreeObservation TopologyObservation
266		RuntimeObservation  TopologyObservation
267	}

269	// TaskOnly reports whether the row exists solely to retain an unbound task.
270	func (r RepoContextRow) TaskOnly() bool { return r.Kind == RepoContextRowTask }
271	
272	// RepoContext is the complete operational context for one discovered repo.
273	type RepoContext struct {
274		Repo repo.Repo
275		// RepositoryID is the canonical Git common directory and is stable across
276		// aliases and every linked checkout on this host.
277		RepositoryID string
278		IdentityErr  error
279		// Checkouts contains every authoritative gitx.Worktrees record in Git order.
280		// It remains the compatibility projection used by current CLI/TUI callers.
281		Checkouts []RepoCheckout
282		// Rows is the authoritative exact-once checkout plus task-only projection.
283		Rows []RepoContextRow
284		// OtherTasks are tracked tasks which were not bound to a checkout. It remains
285		// the compatibility projection of OtherTaskBindings.
286		OtherTasks        []*task.Task
287		OtherTaskBindings []TaskBinding
288		Runtime           string
289		// WorktreeCount remains the linked-worktree count expected by existing
290		// callers. On query failure it falls back to the administrative directory
291		// count so the error can explain a previously displayed count.
292		WorktreeCount       int
293		WorktreeErr         error
294		WorktreeObservation TopologyObservation
295		RuntimeObservation  TopologyObservation
296		LastActivity        time.Time
297	}
298	
299	// Main returns Git's actual primary record. The first-row fallback preserves
300	// compatibility with manually constructed contexts which predate Worktree.Main.
301	func (c RepoContext) Main() (RepoCheckout, bool) {
302		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
303			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
304				return checkout, true
305			}
306		}
307		if len(c.Checkouts) == 0 {
308			return RepoCheckout{}, false
309		}
310		return c.Checkouts[0], true
311	}
312	
313	// Linked returns every Git-registered non-main worktree.
314	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
315		hasMarkedMain := false
316		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
317			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
318				hasMarkedMain = true
319				break
320			}
321		}
322		if !hasMarkedMain {
323			if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
324				return nil
325			}
326			return c.Checkouts[1:]
327		}
328		out := make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(c.Checkouts)-1)
329		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
330			if !checkout.Worktree.Main {
331				out = append(out, checkout)
332			}
333		}
334		return out
335	}
336	
337	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
338	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
339	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
340		seen := map[string]bool{}
341		var out []runtime.Session
342		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
343			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
344				key := session.Handle
345				if key == "" {
346					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
347				}
348				if seen[key] {
349					continue
350				}
351				seen[key] = true
352				out = append(out, session)
353			}
354		}
355		return out
356	}
357	
358	// RepoContextOptions extends repository collection without changing the
359	// original CollectRepoContext API used by CLI and dashboard callers.
360	type RepoContextOptions struct {
361		Runtime         string
362		Sessions        []runtime.Session
363		RuntimeObserved bool
364		RuntimeErr      error
365		// Limiter shares one process-heavy enrichment bound across collectors.
366		Limiter *Limiter
367	}
368	
369	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository. The
370	// legacy entry point can prove observation only when sessions are present;
371	// callers that need a proven empty observation or typed failure use
372	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions.
373	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
374		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
375		return CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, r, tasks, RepoContextOptions{
376			Runtime: runtimeName, Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: len(sessions) > 0,
377		})
378	}
379	
380	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions builds repository topology from Git's complete
381	// registered worktree list. It never synthesizes a main checkout after a Git
382	// query failure.
383	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
384		opts RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
385		if ctx == nil {
386			ctx = context.Background()
387		}
388		out := RepoContext{
389			Repo: r, Runtime: opts.Runtime,
390			WorktreeObservation: TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved},
391			RuntimeObservation:  runtimeObservation(opts),
392		}
393		queryPath := repoQueryPath(r)
394		out.RepositoryID, out.IdentityErr = canonicalRepositoryID(ctx, r, queryPath)
395		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
396	
397		var (
398			worktrees []gitx.Worktree
399			err       error
400		)
401		if queryPath == "" {
402			err = fmt.Errorf("repository has no Git query path")
403		} else {
404			worktrees, err = gitx.Worktrees(ctx, queryPath)
405		}
406		if err != nil {
407			listErr := &WorktreeListError{Path: queryPath, Err: err}
408			out.WorktreeErr = listErr
409			out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: listErr}
410			assignTasksWithoutTopology(&out, tasks)
411			finishRepoContext(&out)
412			return out
413		}
414		out.WorktreeObservation = TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
415		out.WorktreeCount = 0
416		out.Checkouts = make([]RepoCheckout, 0, len(worktrees))
417		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
418			canonicalPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
419			if canonicalPath == "" {
420				canonicalPath = filepath.Clean(worktree.Path)
421			}
422			checkout := RepoCheckout{
423				ID: canonicalPath, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
424				IdentityErr: canonicalErr,
425				Worktree:    worktree, Exists: pathIsDir(worktree.Path),
426				RuntimeObservation: out.RuntimeObservation,
427				Ownership:          CheckoutExternal,
428			}
429			if canonicalErr != nil {
430				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
431					Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: canonicalErr.Error(),
432				})
433			}
434			if worktree.Main {
435				checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
436					Kind: OwnershipEvidenceGitMain, Path: canonicalPath,
437				})
438			} else {
439				out.WorktreeCount++
440			}
441			out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
442		}
443	
444		enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx, out.Checkouts, opts.Limiter)
445		assignHarnessEvidence(&out)
446		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
447		if out.RuntimeObservation.Available() {
448			assignSessions(&out, opts.Sessions)
449		}
450		finishRepoContext(&out)
451		return out
452	}
453	
454	func runtimeObservation(opts RepoContextOptions) TopologyObservation {
455		if opts.RuntimeErr != nil {
456			err := &RuntimeListError{Runtime: opts.Runtime, Err: opts.RuntimeErr}
457			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationFailed, Err: err}
458		}
459		if opts.RuntimeObserved {
460			return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationAvailable}
461		}
462		return TopologyObservation{State: ObservationUnobserved}
463	}
464	
465	func repoQueryPath(r repo.Repo) string {
466		for _, candidate := range []string{r.Path, r.RealPath, r.MainRoot, r.CommonDir} {
467			if candidate != "" {
468				return candidate
469			}
470		}
471		return ""
472	}
473	
474	func canonicalRepositoryID(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, queryPath string) (string, error) {
475		commonDir := r.CommonDir
476		if commonDir == "" && r.Bare {
477			commonDir = queryPath
478		}
479		if commonDir == "" && queryPath != "" {
480			if discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, queryPath); err == nil {
481				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
482			}
483		}
484		if commonDir == "" {
485			err := fmt.Errorf("Git common directory is empty")
486			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
487		}
488		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
489		if err != nil {
490			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
491		}
492		return canonical, nil
493	}
494	
495	func enrichRepoCheckouts(ctx context.Context, checkouts []RepoCheckout, limiter *Limiter) {
496		if limiter == nil {
497			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
498		}
499		var wg sync.WaitGroup
500		for i := range checkouts {
501			if checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare || checkouts[i].Worktree.Prunable || !checkouts[i].Exists {
502				continue
503			}
504			wg.Add(1)
505			go func(index int) {
506				defer wg.Done()
507				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
508				if !ok {
509					checkouts[index].StatusErr = ctx.Err()
510					return
511				}
512				defer release()
513				checkout := &checkouts[index]
514				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
515				checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(
516					ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status,
517				)
518			}(i)
519		}
520		wg.Wait()
521	}
522	
523	func assignHarnessEvidence(out *RepoContext) {
524		mainRoot := ""
525		for i := range out.Checkouts {
526			if out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Main && !out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare {
527				mainRoot = out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path
528				break
529			}
530		}
531		if mainRoot == "" {
532			return
533		}
534		for i := range out.Checkouts {
535			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
536			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
537				continue
538			}
539			evidence, ok := DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(mainRoot, checkout.Worktree.Path)
540			if !ok {
541				continue
542			}
543			checkout.HarnessEvidence = &evidence
544			checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
545				Kind: OwnershipEvidenceClaudeHarness, Path: evidence.Root,
546			})
547		}
548	}
549	
550	// IsEphemeralWorktree is the legacy broad display heuristic. Its branch-prefix
551	// compatibility is retained for existing adopters, but authoritative topology
552	// uses DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree: a worktree-* branch alone is not ownership
553	// evidence.
554	func IsEphemeralWorktree(path, branch string) bool {
555		slashPath := filepath.ToSlash(path)
556		return strings.Contains(slashPath, "/.claude/worktrees/") ||
557			strings.HasPrefix(branch, "worktree-")
558	}
559	
560	func linkedAdminCount(commonDir string) int {
561		if commonDir == "" {
562			return 0
563		}
564		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(commonDir, "worktrees"))
565		if err != nil {
566			return 0
567		}
568		n := 0
569		for _, entry := range entries {
570			if entry.IsDir() {
571				n++
572			}
573		}
574		return n
575	}
576	
577	func pathIsDir(path string) bool {
578		info, err := os.Stat(path)
579		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
580	}
581	
582	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
583		latest := status.LatestChange
584		var commit time.Time
585		var subject string
586		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
587			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
588			if commit.After(latest) {
589				latest = commit
590			}
591			subject = lastSubject
592		}
593		return latest, commit, subject
594	}
595	
596	func assignTasksWithoutTopology(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
597		for _, tracked := range sortedUniqueTasks(tasks) {
598			binding := TaskBinding{
599				Task: tracked, Kind: TaskBindingUnbound,
600				ConflictReasons: []TopologyReason{{
601					Code:   ReasonWorktreeInventoryUnavailable,
602					Detail: "registered worktrees could not be observed",
603				}},
604			}
605			out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, tracked)
606			out.OtherTaskBindings = append(out.OtherTaskBindings, binding)
607		}
608	}
609	
610	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
611		paths := map[string][]int{}
612		branches := map[string][]int{}
613		mainIndex := -1
614		for i := range out.Checkouts {
615			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
616			if checkout.ID != "" {
617				paths[checkout.ID] = append(paths[checkout.ID], i)
618			}
619			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" && !checkout.Worktree.Bare {
620				branches[branch] = append(branches[branch], i)
621			}
622			if checkout.Worktree.Main {
623				mainIndex = i
624			}
625		}
626	
627		for _, tracked := range sortedUniqueTasks(tasks) {
628			binding := TaskBinding{Task: tracked, Kind: TaskBindingUnbound}
629			mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
630			var recordedPathIssue *TopologyReason
631			if tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
632				canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(tracked.WorktreePath)
633				if err != nil {
634					reason := TopologyReason{Code: ReasonCanonicalPathUnavailable, Detail: err.Error()}
635					recordedPathIssue = &reason
636				} else if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
637					if matches := paths[canonical]; len(matches) > 0 {
638						if len(matches) == 1 {
639							binding.Kind = TaskBindingExactPath
640							bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
641							continue
642						}
643						reason := TopologyReason{
644							Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
645							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s path matches %d registered checkout records", tracked.ID, len(matches)),
646						}
647						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
648						for _, index := range matches {
649							out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
650						}
651						appendOtherTask(out, binding)
652						continue
653					}
654				}
655				if mode != task.ModeWorktree {
656					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
657						Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
658						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
659							mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
660					})
661				}
662			}
663	
664			if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
665				matches := branches[tracked.Branch]
666				switch len(matches) {
667				case 1:
668					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMovedPath
669					binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, movedPathReason(tracked, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
670					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
671						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
672					}
673					bindTask(out, matches[0], annotateBoundTask(binding, out.Checkouts[matches[0]]))
674					continue
675				case 0:
676					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
677						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
678					}
679					if tracked.WorktreePath != "" || taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
680						binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
681							Code:   ReasonWorktreePathMissing,
682							Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no registered checkout for branch %s", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch),
683						})
684					}
685				default:
686					reason := TopologyReason{
687						Code:   ReasonAmbiguousCheckout,
688						Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s branch %s matches %d registered checkouts", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, len(matches)),
689					}
690					binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
691					for _, index := range matches {
692						out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
693					}
694				}
695				appendOtherTask(out, binding)
696				continue
697			}
698	
699			if mainIndex >= 0 {
700				main := out.Checkouts[mainIndex]
701				if checkoutActionable(main) && main.Branch() == tracked.Branch {
702					binding.Kind = TaskBindingMainBranch
703					if recordedPathIssue != nil {
704						binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
705					}
706					bindTask(out, mainIndex, annotateBoundTask(binding, main))
707					continue
708				}
709			}
710	
711			if recordedPathIssue != nil {
712				binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, *recordedPathIssue)
713			}
714			for _, index := range branches[tracked.Branch] {
715				if index == mainIndex {
716					continue
717				}
718				reason := TopologyReason{
719					Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
720					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s branch is checked out outside Git main at %s",
721						mode, tracked.ID, out.Checkouts[index].Worktree.Path),
722				}
723				binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, reason)
724				out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons = appendReason(out.Checkouts[index].ConflictReasons, reason)
725			}
726			if taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
727				detail := fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s in Git main", tracked.ID, tracked.Branch)
728				switch {
729				case mainIndex < 0:
730					detail += ", but no Git main record exists"
731				case !checkoutActionable(out.Checkouts[mainIndex]):
732					detail += ", but Git main is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable"
733				default:
734					detail += fmt.Sprintf(", which is on %s", displayBranch(out.Checkouts[mainIndex]))
735				}
736				binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
737					Code: ReasonMainBranchMismatch, Detail: detail,
738				})
739			}
740			appendOtherTask(out, binding)
741		}
742	
743		finalizeCheckoutClaims(out)
744	}

746	func sortedUniqueTasks(tasks []*task.Task) []*task.Task {
747		ordered := append([]*task.Task(nil), tasks...)
748		sort.SliceStable(ordered, func(i, j int) bool {
749			if ordered[i] == nil {
750				return false
751			}
752			if ordered[j] == nil {
753				return true
754			}
755			return ordered[i].ID < ordered[j].ID
756		})
757		seen := map[string]bool{}
758		out := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(ordered))
759		for _, tracked := range ordered {
760			if tracked == nil {
761				continue
762			}
763			if tracked.ID != "" && seen[tracked.ID] {
764				continue
765			}
766			if tracked.ID != "" {
767				seen[tracked.ID] = true
768			}
769			out = append(out, tracked)
770		}
771		return out
772	}
773	
774	func movedPathReason(tracked *task.Task, checkout RepoCheckout) TopologyReason {
775		if tracked.WorktreePath == "" {
776			return TopologyReason{
777				Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
778				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s has no recorded worktree path; branch %s is registered at %s",
779					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
780			}
781		}
782		return TopologyReason{
783			Code: ReasonWorktreePathMoved,
784			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s records %s; branch %s is registered at %s",
785				tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath, tracked.Branch, checkout.Worktree.Path),
786		}
787	}

789	func annotateBoundTask(binding TaskBinding, checkout RepoCheckout) TaskBinding {
790		tracked := binding.Task
791		if tracked == nil {
792			return binding
793		}
794		if !checkoutActionable(checkout) {
795			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
796				Code: ReasonCheckoutUnavailable,
797				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout %s is missing, prunable, bare, or unreadable",
798					checkout.Worktree.Path),
799			})
800		}
801		if checkout.Branch() != tracked.Branch {
802			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
803				Code: ReasonBranchMismatch,
804				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("task %s expects branch %s; registered checkout is on %s",
805					tracked.ID, tracked.Branch, displayBranch(checkout)),
806			})
807		}
808		mode := tracked.EffectiveMode()
809		switch {
810		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && checkout.Worktree.Main:
811			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
812				Code:   ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
813				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("worktree task %s resolved to Git main", tracked.ID),
814			})
815		case mode != task.ModeWorktree && !checkout.Worktree.Main:
816			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
817				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
818				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s resolved to linked worktree %s",
819					mode, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
820			})
821		}
822		if mode != task.ModeWorktree && tracked.WorktreePath != "" {
823			binding.ConflictReasons = appendReason(binding.ConflictReasons, TopologyReason{
824				Code: ReasonTaskModeMismatch,
825				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s records worktree_path %s",
826					mode, tracked.ID, tracked.WorktreePath),
827			})
828		}
829		if !taskExpectsCheckout(tracked) {
830			binding.DriftReasons = appendReason(binding.DriftReasons, TopologyReason{
831				Code: ReasonUnexpectedCheckout,
832				Detail: fmt.Sprintf("%s task %s still has registered checkout %s",
833					tracked.State, tracked.ID, checkout.Worktree.Path),
834			})
835		}
836		return binding
837	}
838	
839	func taskExpectsCheckout(tracked *task.Task) bool {
840		if tracked == nil || tracked.State == task.Cold {
841			return false
842		}
843		if tracked.State == task.Done && tracked.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
844			return tracked.WorktreePath != ""
845		}
846		return true
847	}
848	
849	func checkoutActionable(checkout RepoCheckout) bool {
850		return !checkout.Worktree.Bare && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable && checkout.Exists && checkout.StatusErr == nil
851	}

853	func bindTask(out *RepoContext, index int, binding TaskBinding) {
854		checkout := &out.Checkouts[index]
855		binding.CheckoutID = checkout.ID
856		checkout.TaskBindings = append(checkout.TaskBindings, binding)
857		checkout.Tasks = append(checkout.Tasks, binding.Task)
858		if binding.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
859			checkout.OwnershipEvidence = append(checkout.OwnershipEvidence, OwnershipEvidence{
860				Kind: OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask, Path: checkout.ID,
861				TaskID: binding.Task.ID, Owner: binding.Task.Owner,
862			})
863		}
864	}
865	
866	func appendOtherTask(out *RepoContext, binding TaskBinding) {
867		out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, binding.Task)
868		out.OtherTaskBindings = append(out.OtherTaskBindings, binding)
869	}

871	func finalizeCheckoutClaims(out *RepoContext) {
872		for i := range out.Checkouts {
873			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
874			sort.SliceStable(checkout.TaskBindings, func(a, b int) bool {
875				return checkout.TaskBindings[a].Task.ID < checkout.TaskBindings[b].Task.ID
876			})
877			sort.SliceStable(checkout.Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
878				return checkout.Tasks[a].ID < checkout.Tasks[b].ID
879			})
880			if len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 1 {
881				ids := make([]string, len(checkout.TaskBindings))
882				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
883					ids[j] = checkout.TaskBindings[j].Task.ID
884				}
885				reason := TopologyReason{
886					Code:   ReasonMultipleTaskClaims,
887					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("registered checkout is claimed by tasks %s", strings.Join(ids, ", ")),
888				}
889				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
890				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
891					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
892						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
893					)
894				}
895			}
896			if checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil && len(checkout.TaskBindings) > 0 {
897				reason := TopologyReason{
898					Code: ReasonHarnessTaskConflict,
899					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("checkout has Claude harness evidence and %d managed task claim(s)",
900						len(checkout.TaskBindings)),
901				}
902				checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
903				for j := range checkout.TaskBindings {
904					checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons = appendReason(
905						checkout.TaskBindings[j].ConflictReasons, reason,
906					)
907				}
908			}
909			for _, binding := range checkout.TaskBindings {
910				for _, reason := range binding.DriftReasons {
911					checkout.DriftReasons = appendReason(checkout.DriftReasons, reason)
912				}
913				for _, reason := range binding.ConflictReasons {
914					checkout.ConflictReasons = appendReason(checkout.ConflictReasons, reason)
915				}
916			}
917			checkout.Ownership = displayOwnership(*checkout)
918		}
919	}
920	
921	func displayOwnership(checkout RepoCheckout) CheckoutOwnership {
922		if checkout.Worktree.Main {
923			return CheckoutCanonical
924		}
925		if checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil {
926			return CheckoutEphemeral
927		}
928		for _, evidence := range checkout.OwnershipEvidence {
929			if evidence.Kind == OwnershipEvidenceManagedTask {
930				return CheckoutDev
931			}
932		}
933		return CheckoutExternal
934	}

936	func appendReason(reasons []TopologyReason, candidate TopologyReason) []TopologyReason {
937		for _, reason := range reasons {
938			if reason.Code == candidate.Code && reason.Detail == candidate.Detail {
939				return reasons
940			}
941		}
942		return append(reasons, candidate)
943	}

945	func finishRepoContext(out *RepoContext) {
946		for _, checkout := range out.Checkouts {
947			if checkout.LastActivity.After(out.LastActivity) {
948				out.LastActivity = checkout.LastActivity
949			}
950			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {

952					out.LastActivity = tracked.Updated
953				}
954			}
955		}

959			}

961	
962		out.Rows = make([]RepoContextRow, 0, len(out.Checkouts)+len(out.OtherTaskBindings))
963		for i := range out.Checkouts {
964			checkout := &out.Checkouts[i]
965			out.Rows = append(out.Rows, RepoContextRow{
966				ID: checkout.ID, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
967				Kind: RepoContextRowCheckout, CheckoutIndex: i, Checkout: checkout,
968				DriftReasons:        append([]TopologyReason(nil), checkout.DriftReasons...),
969				ConflictReasons:     append([]TopologyReason(nil), checkout.ConflictReasons...),
970				WorktreeObservation: out.WorktreeObservation,
971				RuntimeObservation:  out.RuntimeObservation,
972			})
973		}
974		for _, binding := range out.OtherTaskBindings {
975			out.Rows = append(out.Rows, RepoContextRow{
976				ID: binding.Task.ID, RepositoryID: out.RepositoryID,
977				Kind: RepoContextRowTask, CheckoutIndex: -1,
978				Task: binding.Task, Binding: binding,
979				DriftReasons:        append([]TopologyReason(nil), binding.DriftReasons...),
980				ConflictReasons:     append([]TopologyReason(nil), binding.ConflictReasons...),
981				WorktreeObservation: out.WorktreeObservation,
982				RuntimeObservation:  out.RuntimeObservation,
983			})
984		}

987	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
988	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
989	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
990	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
991		for _, session := range sessions {
992			assigned := map[int]bool{}
993			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
994				best, bestLen := -1, -1
995				for i := range out.Checkouts {
996					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Checkouts[i]) {
997						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(normalizePath(root)) > bestLen {
998							best, bestLen = i, len(normalizePath(root))
999						}
1000					}
1001				}
1002				if best >= 0 {
1003					assigned[best] = true
1004				}
1005			}
1006			for i := range assigned {
1007				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
1008			}
1009		}
1010	}
1011	
1012	func checkoutRoots(checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
1013		return []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
1014	}
1015	
1016	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
1017		if root == "" || path == "" {
1018			return false
1019		}
1020		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
1021		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
1022			return false
1023		}
1024		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
1025	}
1026	
1027	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
1028	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
1029	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
1030	// is not sufficient.
1031	func normalizePath(path string) string {
1032		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
1033			return canonical
1034		}
1035		return filepath.Clean(path)
1036	}

1038	// FormatRepoContext renders the deterministic Markdown used by both the CLI
1039	// and the TUI's yy binding. checkoutIndex < 0 means the whole repository.
1040	func FormatRepoContext(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
1041		var b strings.Builder
1042		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
1043			checkout := c.Checkouts[checkoutIndex]
1044			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev worktree context: %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout))
1045			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, false)
1046			return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
1047		}
1048	
1049		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev repo context: %s\n\n", c.Repo.Display())
1050		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Repository: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Display())
1051		mainPath := c.Repo.Path
1052		if main, ok := c.Main(); ok {
1053			mainPath = main.Worktree.Path
1054		}
1055		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Main path: `%s`\n", mainPath)
1056		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Linked worktrees: %d\n", c.WorktreeCount)
1057		if c.Runtime != "" && c.Runtime != "none" {
1058			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime: `%s`\n", c.Runtime)
1059		}
1060		if c.WorktreeErr != nil {
1061			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Worktree inventory error: %s\n", c.WorktreeErr)
1062		}
1063		b.WriteString("\n## Checkouts\n")
1064		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
1065			b.WriteString("\n")
1066			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, checkout.Worktree.Main)
1067		}
1068		if len(c.OtherTasks) > 0 {
1069			b.WriteString("\n## Other tracked tasks\n\n")
1070			if len(c.OtherTaskBindings) > 0 {
1071				for _, binding := range c.OtherTaskBindings {
1072					writeTaskMarkdown(&b, binding.Task)
1073					writeTopologyReasons(&b, binding.DriftReasons, binding.ConflictReasons)
1074				}
1075			} else {
1076				for _, tracked := range c.OtherTasks {
1077					writeTaskMarkdown(&b, tracked)
1078				}
1079			}
1080		}
1081		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
1082	}
1083	
1084	func writeCheckoutMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, c RepoContext, checkout RepoCheckout, canonical bool) {
1085		label := string(checkout.Ownership)
1086		if canonical {
1087			label = "canonical"
1088		}
1089		fmt.Fprintf(b, "### %s — %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout), label)
1090		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Path: `%s`\n", checkout.Worktree.Path)
1091		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Branch: `%s`\n", displayBranch(checkout))
1092		if checkout.Worktree.Bare {
1093			b.WriteString("- Git: bare repository\n")
1094		} else if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
1095			b.WriteString("- Git: unavailable (checkout path is missing)\n")
1096		} else if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
1097			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.StatusErr)
1098		} else {
1099			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: %s", checkout.Status.Summary())
1100			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
1101				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", checkout.Status.Breakdown())
1102			}
1103			b.WriteString("\n")
1104			if checkout.Status.Upstream != "" {
1105				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Upstream: `%s`\n", checkout.Status.Upstream)
1106			} else {
1107				b.WriteString("- Upstream: not published\n")
1108			}
1109		}
1110		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
1111			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)
1112			if reason == "" {
1113				reason = "no reason recorded"
1114			}
1115			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: locked — %s\n", reason)
1116		}
1117		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
1118			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)
1119			if reason == "" {
1120				reason = "checkout path is missing"
1121			}
1122			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: prunable — %s\n", reason)
1123		}
1124		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
1125			b.WriteString("- Runtime: closed\n")
1126		} else {
1127			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
1128				status := session.AgentStatus
1129				if status == "" {
1130					status = "unknown"
1131				}
1132				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: `%s %s` (%s)\n", c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
1133				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
1134					fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Agent sessions: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
1135				}
1136			}
1137		}
1138		if len(checkout.Tasks) == 0 {
1139			b.WriteString("- Task: untracked\n")
1140		} else {
1141			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
1142				writeTaskMarkdown(b, tracked)
1143			}
1144		}
1145		writeTopologyReasons(b, checkout.DriftReasons, checkout.ConflictReasons)
1146	}
1147	
1148	func writeTopologyReasons(b *strings.Builder, drift, conflicts []TopologyReason) {
1149		for _, reason := range drift {
1150			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Drift: `%s` — %s\n", reason.Code, reason.Detail)
1151		}
1152		for _, reason := range conflicts {
1153			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Conflict: `%s` — %s\n", reason.Code, reason.Detail)
1154		}
1155	}
1156	
1157	func writeTaskMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, tracked *task.Task) {
1158		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: `%s` — %s", tracked.ID, tracked.State)
1159		if tracked.Next != "" {
1160			fmt.Fprintf(b, "; next: %s", tracked.Next)
1161		}
1162		b.WriteString("\n")
1163		if tracked.AgentSession != "" {
1164			fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Recorded agent: `%s`\n", tracked.AgentSession)
1165		}
1166	}
1167	
1168	func displayBranch(checkout RepoCheckout) string {
1169		if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
1170			return branch
1171		}
1172		if checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached {
1173			return "(detached HEAD)"
1174		}
1175		return "(unknown branch)"
1176	}

1178	func markdownCodes(values []string) string {
1179		quoted := make([]string, 0, len(values))
1180		for _, value := range values {
1181			quoted = append(quoted, "`"+value+"`")
1182		}
1183		return strings.Join(quoted, ", ")
1184	}

1186	// FormatSessions renders the ys payload. checkoutIndex < 0 selects the whole
1187	// repository; otherwise it selects one checkout.
1188	func FormatSessions(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
1189		indices := make([]int, 0, len(c.Checkouts))
1190		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
1191			indices = append(indices, checkoutIndex)
1192		} else {
1193			for i := range c.Checkouts {
1194				indices = append(indices, i)
1195			}
1196		}
1197		var b strings.Builder
1198		for _, i := range indices {
1199			checkout := c.Checkouts[i]
1200			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
1201				status := session.AgentStatus
1202				if status == "" {
1203					status = "unknown"
1204				}
1205				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s %s` (%s)\n",
1206					checkout.Worktree.Path, c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
1207				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
1208					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - agents: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
1209				}
1210			}
1211		}
1212		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
1213	}

1215	// LinkedWorktreePaths returns the yw payload: absolute linked-worktree paths,
1216	// one per line. The canonical checkout is intentionally excluded because WT
1217	// counts linked worktrees only.
1218	func LinkedWorktreePaths(c RepoContext) string {
1219		paths := make([]string, 0, len(c.Linked()))
1220		for _, checkout := range c.Linked() {
1221			paths = append(paths, checkout.Worktree.Path)
1222		}
1223		return strings.Join(paths, "\n")

13	// OccupancyProfile selects the policy applied to recognized-agent evidence.
14	// Session, pane, and activity observations are retained identically in every
15	// profile; only Blocking changes.
16	type OccupancyProfile uint8
17	
18	const (
19		// OccupancyStrict is for claiming a checkout for writing or adoption. Every
20		// recognized agent except the current caller is blocking, regardless of state.
21		// It is the zero value so an omitted profile fails toward exclusive ownership.
22		OccupancyStrict OccupancyProfile = iota
23		// OccupancyCleanup permits closeable idle and done agents. Unknown activity
24		// remains blocking unless CloseUnknown is set.
25		OccupancyCleanup
26	)
27	
28	// OccupancyOptions supplies live caller identity and action-specific policy.
29	// CallerWorkspaceID and CallerPaneID must describe the invoking runtime, not a
30	// handle remembered in durable task state.
31	type OccupancyOptions struct {
32		Profile           OccupancyProfile
33		CallerWorkspaceID string
34		CallerPaneID      string
35		CloseUnknown      bool
36	}
37	
38	// OccupancyObservation distinguishes an observed empty inventory from evidence
39	// that was unsupported, unattempted, or failed.
40	type OccupancyObservation struct {
41		Supported bool
42		Attempted bool
43		Err       error
44	}
45	
46	// Observed reports whether the observation completed successfully.
47	func (o OccupancyObservation) Observed() bool {
48		return o.Supported && o.Attempted && o.Err == nil
49	}
50	
51	// Unknown reports whether this evidence was not successfully observed.
52	func (o OccupancyObservation) Unknown() bool { return !o.Observed() }
53	
54	// OccupancySession is one live session whose panes cover the target checkout.
55	type OccupancySession struct {
56		Runtime  Session
57		Panes    []Pane
58		Mixed    []Pane
59		IsCaller bool
60	}
61	
62	// OccupancyAgent is one recognized agent whose cwd covers the target checkout.
63	type OccupancyAgent struct {
64		Activity      AgentActivity
65		Status        string
66		SessionHandle string
67		IsCaller      bool
68		Blocking      bool
69	}
70	
71	// Occupancy is structured, read-only evidence about one checkout. A remembered
72	// runtime handle is deliberately absent: Sessions and Agents are selected only
73	// from fresh canonical checkout coverage.
74	type Occupancy struct {
75		Target               string
76		Backend              string
77		Profile              OccupancyProfile
78		CallerWorkspaceID    string
79		ReportedCallerPaneID string
80		CallerPaneID         string
81		SessionList          OccupancyObservation
82		AgentActivityList    OccupancyObservation
83		CurrentPane          OccupancyObservation
84		SessionCoverageErr   error
85		Sessions             []OccupancySession
86		Agents               []OccupancyAgent
87	}
88	
89	// InspectOccupancy collects independent runtime, recognized-agent, and caller
90	// evidence for target. Initial target canonicalization errors are returned;
91	// observation failures are retained in their corresponding fields so each
92	// action can apply its own fail-closed acknowledgement policy.
93	func InspectOccupancy(ctx context.Context, rt Runtime, target string, opts OccupancyOptions) (Occupancy, error) {
94		checkout, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, target)
95		if err != nil {
96			return Occupancy{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize occupancy target: %w", err)
97		}
98		result := Occupancy{
99			Target:               checkout.path,
100			Backend:              "none",
101			Profile:              opts.Profile,
102			CallerWorkspaceID:    opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
103			ReportedCallerPaneID: opts.CallerPaneID,
104			CallerPaneID:         opts.CallerPaneID,
105		}
106		if rt == nil {
107			return result, nil
108		}
109		result.Backend = rt.Name()
110		if result.Backend == "none" {
111			return result, nil
112		}
113	
114		result.SessionList.Supported = true
115		resolver, resolvesCurrentPane := rt.(CurrentPaneResolver)
116		result.CurrentPane.Supported = resolvesCurrentPane
117		if resolvesCurrentPane && opts.CallerPaneID != "" {
118			result.CurrentPane.Attempted = true
119			result.CallerPaneID = ""
120			paneID, resolveErr := resolver.CurrentPaneID(ctx)
121			if resolveErr != nil {
122				result.CurrentPane.Err = resolveErr
123			} else if paneID == "" {
124				result.CurrentPane.Err = fmt.Errorf("current pane resolver returned an empty pane id")
125			} else {
126				result.CallerPaneID = paneID
127			}
128		}
129	
130		result.SessionList.Attempted = true
131		sessions, listErr := rt.List(ctx)
132		if listErr != nil {
133			result.SessionList.Err = listErr
134		} else {
135			for _, observed := range sessions {
136				covering, mixed, classifyErr := classifyOccupancySession(ctx, checkout, observed, opts.Profile)
137				if classifyErr != nil {
138					result.SessionCoverageErr = classifyErr
139					result.Sessions = nil
140					break
141				}
142				if len(covering) == 0 {
143					continue
144				}
145				result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, OccupancySession{
146					Runtime: observed,
147					Panes:   covering,
148					Mixed:   mixed,
149					IsCaller: observed.Handle == opts.CallerWorkspaceID ||
150						occupancyPanePresent(observed.Panes, result.CallerPaneID),
151				})
152			}
153		}
154	
155		lister, listsAgents := rt.(AgentActivityLister)
156		result.AgentActivityList.Supported = listsAgents
157		if !listsAgents {
158			// Some backends can identify an agent on a pane without providing the
159			// richer recognized-agent inventory. Preserve that live evidence as the
160			// strict-profile fallback rather than treating an unsupported lister as an
161			// observed empty list.
162			for _, session := range result.Sessions {
163				for _, pane := range session.Panes {
164					if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" {
165						continue
166					}
167					cwd := pane.CWD
168					if cwd == "" {
169						cwd = pane.ShellCWD
170					}
171					activity := AgentActivity{
172						PaneID: pane.ID, WorkspaceID: session.Runtime.Handle,
173						Agent: pane.Agent, Status: pane.AgentStatus, CWD: cwd,
174					}
175					if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
176						result.SessionCoverageErr = coverageErr
177						result.Agents = nil
178						return result, nil
179					}
180				}
181			}
182			return result, nil
183		}
184		result.AgentActivityList.Attempted = true
185		activities, activityErr := lister.AgentActivities(ctx)
186		if activityErr != nil {
187			result.AgentActivityList.Err = activityErr
188			return result, nil
189		}
190		for _, activity := range activities {
191			if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
192				result.AgentActivityList.Err = coverageErr
193				result.Agents = nil
194				return result, nil
195			}
196		}
197		return result, nil
198	}
199	
200	func appendOccupancyAgent(ctx context.Context, result *Occupancy, checkout checkoutIdentity, opts OccupancyOptions, activity AgentActivity) error {
201		covered, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, checkout, activity.CWD, opts.Profile)
202		if err != nil {
203			return fmt.Errorf("classify recognized agent pane %s: %w", activity.PaneID, err)
204		}
205		if !covered {
206			return nil
207		}
208		status := normalizeOccupancyStatus(activity.Status)
209		caller := result.CallerPaneID != "" && activity.PaneID == result.CallerPaneID
210		handle := correlatedSession(result.Sessions, activity)
211		result.Agents = append(result.Agents, OccupancyAgent{
212			Activity:      activity,
213			Status:        status,
214			SessionHandle: handle,
215			IsCaller:      caller,
216			Blocking:      occupancyAgentBlocks(opts, status, caller, handle != ""),
217		})
218		return nil
219	}
220	
221	type checkoutIdentity struct {
222		path   string
223		git    bool
224		linked bool
225	}
226	
227	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
228		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
229		if err != nil {
230			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
231		}
232		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
233		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
234			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
235			if canonicalErr != nil {
236				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
237			}
238			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true, linked: repo.IsLinkedWorktree}, nil
239		}
240		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
241			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
242		}
243		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
244	}
245	
246	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string, profile OccupancyProfile) (bool, error) {
247		if cwd == "" {
248			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
249		}
250		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
251		if err != nil {
252			return false, err
253		}
254		if target.git && activity.git {
255			if target.path == activity.path {
256				return true, nil
257			}
258			if profile == OccupancyCleanup && target.linked {
259				return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
260			}
261			return false, nil
262		}
263		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
264	}
265	
266	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session, profile OccupancyProfile) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
267		panes := session.Panes
268		if len(panes) == 0 {
269			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
270				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
271			}
272		}
273		var covering, mixed []Pane
274		for _, pane := range panes {
275			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
276			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
277				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
278			}
279			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
280			for _, path := range paths {
281				if path == "" {
282					continue
283				}
284				observed = true
285				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path, profile)
286				if err != nil {
287					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
288				}
289				if inside {
290					paneCovers = true
291				} else {
292					paneOutside = true
293				}
294			}
295			if paneCovers {
296				covering = append(covering, pane)
297			}
298			if paneOutside || !observed {
299				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
300			}
301		}
302		return covering, mixed, nil
303	}
304	
305	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
306		if id == "" {
307			return false
308		}
309		for _, pane := range panes {
310			if pane.ID == id {
311				return true
312			}
313		}
314		return false
315	}
316	
317	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
318		for _, session := range sessions {
319			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
320				return session.Runtime.Handle
321			}
322			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
323				return session.Runtime.Handle
324			}
325		}
326		return ""
327	}
328	
329	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
330		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
331		if status == "" {
332			return "unknown"
333		}
334		return status
335	}
336	
337	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
338		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
339			return !caller
340		}
341		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
342		// with a freshly listed covering session.
343		if caller || !correlated {
344			return true
345		}
346		switch status {
347		case "idle", "done":
348			return false
349		case "unknown":
350			return !opts.CloseUnknown
351		default:
352			return true
353		}
354	}

49	// Inspect discovers covering sessions and applies caller, mixed-workspace, and

65			case "zellij", "none":
66			default:
67				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")

165	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
166	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
167	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
168		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
169		if err != nil {
170			return inspection, err
171		}
172		if !inspection.Ready() {
173			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
174		}
175		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
176			return inspection, nil
177		}
178		interval := opts.PollInterval
179		if interval <= 0 {
180			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
181		}
182		timeout := opts.Timeout
183		if timeout <= 0 {
184			timeout = 5 * time.Second
185		}
186		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
187		closed := make(map[string]bool)
188		for {
189			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
190			if inspectErr != nil {
191				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
192			}
193			if !fresh.Ready() {
194				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
195			}
196			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
197				inspection.Sessions = nil
198				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
199				return inspection, nil
200			}
201			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
202				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
203					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
204			}
205			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
206				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
207				if closed[handle] {
208					continue
209				}
210				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
211					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
212				}
213				closed[handle] = true
214				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
215			}
216			select {
217			case <-ctx.Done():
218				return inspection, ctx.Err()
219			case <-time.After(interval):
220			}
221		}
222	}
223	
224	func coveringAgentStatuses(panes []runtime.Pane, fallback string) []string {
225		set := make(map[string]bool)
226		for _, pane := range panes {
227			if pane.Agent != "" || pane.AgentSession != "" || pane.AgentStatus != "" {
228				set[strings.ToLower(pane.AgentStatus)] = true
229			}
230		}
231		if len(set) == 0 {
232			set[strings.ToLower(fallback)] = true
233		}
234		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
235		for status := range set {
236			out = append(out, status)
237		}
238		sort.Strings(out)
239		return out
240	}
241	
242	func appendAgentStatusBlocker(result *Inspection, handle, rawStatus string, closeUnknown bool) {
243		status := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawStatus))
244		switch status {
245		case "idle", "done":
246			// Eligible after all structural checks pass.
247		case "working", "running", "busy", "blocked", "waiting":
248			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
249				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has agent status %s", handle, status))
250		case "", "unknown":
251			if !closeUnknown {
252				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
253					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unknown agent status; pass --close-unknown from outside it", handle))
254			}
255		default:
256			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
257				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unrecognized agent status %s", handle, status))
258		}
259	}
260	
261	func dedupe(inspection Inspection) Inspection {
262		seen := make(map[string]bool)
263		out := inspection.Blockers[:0]
264		for _, blocker := range inspection.Blockers {
265			if !seen[blocker] {
266				seen[blocker] = true
267				out = append(out, blocker)
268			}
269		}
270		inspection.Blockers = out
271		return inspection
272	}

278	func RefState(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) (bool, error) {
279		if ref == "" {
280			return false, nil
281		}
282		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")
283		if err == nil {
284			return true, nil
285		}
286		var commandErr *Error
287		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
288		if errors.As(err, &commandErr) && errors.As(commandErr.Err, &exitErr) &&
289			exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 && strings.TrimSpace(commandErr.Stderr) == "" {
290			return false, nil
291		}
292		return false, err
293	}

286	func (s *lifecycleService) taskRepositoryMatches(ctx context.Context, candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation) (bool, bool, string) {
287		candidatePath, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
288		if err != nil {
289			return false, false, err.Error()
290		}
291		if candidatePath == observed.repoPath {
292			return true, true, ""
293		}
294		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return false, false, err.Error()
297		}
298		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
299		if err != nil {
300			return false, false, err.Error()
301		}
302		return commonDir == observed.gitCommonDir, true, ""
303	}

305	func (o destructiveObservation) branchCheckoutPaths(excludeTarget bool) ([]string, error) {
306		if o.worktreesErr != nil {
307			return nil, o.worktreesErr

321					continue
322				}
323			}
324			paths = append(paths, path)
325		}
326		sort.Strings(paths)
327		return paths, nil
328	}
