179			} else if available {
180				for _, intent := range unmatched {
181					intentCommon, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(intent.GitCommonDir)
182					if commonErr != nil {
183						inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError,
184							fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s Git common directory: %w", intent.ID, commonErr))
185						continue
186					}
187					if intentCommon == identity.commonDir && intent.Branch == identity.branch {
188						matched = append(matched, intent)
189					}
190				}
191			}
192		}
193	
194		for _, intent := range matched {
195			evidence, evidenceErr := inspectIntentReadiness(ctx, canonical, intent)
196			if evidenceErr != nil {
197				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, evidenceErr)
198			}
199			inspection.Intents = append(inspection.Intents, evidence)
200		}
201	
202		inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
203		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
204	}
205	
206	type readinessCheckoutIdentity struct {
207		commonDir string
208		branch    string
209	}
210	
211	func inspectReadinessCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout string) (readinessCheckoutIdentity, bool, error) {
212		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, checkout)
213		if errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
214			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, nil
215		}
216		if err != nil {
217			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, fmt.Errorf("discover artifact readiness checkout identity: %w", err)
218		}
219		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
220		if err != nil {
221			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness Git common directory: %w", err)
222		}
223		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
224		if err != nil {
225			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, fmt.Errorf("observe artifact readiness checkout branch: %w", err)
226		}
227		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
228			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, errors.New("artifact readiness checkout is detached; moved intent identity is ambiguous")
229		}
230		return readinessCheckoutIdentity{commonDir: commonDir, branch: status.Branch}, true, nil
231	}
232	
233	func inspectIntentReadiness(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (IntentReadiness, error) {
234		evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
235		var err error
236		switch intent.Status {
237		case Armed, Finalizing:
238			evidence.State = ReadinessPending
239		case Failed:
240			evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
241		case Discarded:
242			evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
243		case Finalized:
244			evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, checkout, intent)
245			switch {
246			case err != nil:
247				err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
248				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
249				evidence.ObservationError = err
250			case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
251				evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
252			default:
253				evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
254			}
255		default:
256			// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
257			// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
258			err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
259			evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
260			evidence.ObservationError = err
261		}
262		return evidence, err
263	}
264	
265	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
266		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
267			return false, nil
268		}
269		candidates := []struct {
270			dir string
271			ref string
272		}{
273			{checkout, "HEAD"},
274			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
275			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
276		}
277		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
278		var observationErr error
279		for _, candidate := range candidates {
280			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
281				continue
282			}
283			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
284			if seen[key] {
285				continue
286			}
287			seen[key] = true
288			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
289				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
290			}
291			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
292				return true, nil
293			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
294				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
295					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
296			}
297		}
298		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
299			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
300		}
301		return false, observationErr
302	}
303	
304	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
305		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
306		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
307	}
308	
309	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
310		if current == nil {
311			return next
312		}
313		if next == nil {
314			return current
315		}
316		return errors.Join(current, next)
317	}
318	
319	func (s *Service) Prepare(ctx context.Context, request PrepareRequest) (*Intent, error) {
320		if s.Store == nil {
321			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
322		}
323		provider, sessionID, err := ParseSession(request.Session)
324		if err != nil {
325			return nil, err
326		}
327		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, request.Worktree)
328		if err != nil {
329			return nil, err
330		}
331		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
332		if err != nil {
333			return nil, err
334		}
335		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
336			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires a named branch")
337		}
338		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
339			return nil, err
340		} else if active {
341			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation refuses Git operation %s in progress", operation)
342		}
343		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
344		if err != nil {
345			return nil, err
346		}
347		changes, err := statusPaths(ctx, repository.Root)
348		if err != nil {
349			return nil, err
350		}
351		var unrelated []string
352		for _, change := range changes {
353			if change.Staged {
354				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires an empty index; staged path: %s", change.Path)
355			}
356			if !isRecognizedArtifact(change.Path) {
357				return nil, fmt.Errorf("commit product changes before prepare; dirty path: %s", change.Path)
358			}
359			unrelated = append(unrelated, change.Path)
360		}
361		transcript, err := FindTranscript(repository.Root, provider, sessionID)
362		if err != nil {
363			return nil, err
364		}
365		tracked, err := gitTracked(ctx, repository.Root, transcript.Path)
366		if err != nil {
367			return nil, err
368		}
369		info, err := os.Stat(transcript.Path)
370		if err != nil {
371			return nil, err
372		}
373		limit := s.LargeLimit
374		if limit <= 0 {
375			limit = DefaultLargeLimit
376		}
377		if !tracked && info.Size() > limit && !request.AllowLarge {
378			return nil, fmt.Errorf("untracked transcript is %d bytes; re-run with --allow-large after reviewing repository growth", info.Size())
379		}
380		plans, err := normalizePlans(repository.Root, request.Plans)
381		if err != nil {
382			return nil, err
383		}
384		runID := request.RunID
385		if runID == "" {
386			runID = os.Getenv("DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID")
387		}
388		if runID == "" {
389			runID = fmt.Sprintf("run-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
390		}
391		selected := make(map[string]bool, len(plans)+1)
392		relTranscript, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, transcript.Path)
393		selected[filepath.ToSlash(relTranscript)] = true
394		for _, plan := range plans {
395			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, plan)
396			selected[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
397		}
398		filtered := unrelated[:0]
399		for _, path := range unrelated {
400			if !selected[path] {
401				filtered = append(filtered, path)
402			}
403		}
404		intent := &Intent{
405			RunID: runID, Provider: provider, SessionID: sessionID, TaskID: request.TaskID,
406			RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, GitCommonDir: repository.GitCommonDir,
407			WorktreePath: repository.Root, Branch: status.Branch, Base: request.Base,
408			Head: strings.TrimSpace(head), PlanPaths: plans, UnrelatedArtifacts: filtered, AllowLarge: request.AllowLarge,
409		}
410		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
411		if err != nil {
412			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact repository lock identity: %w", err)
413		}
414		if s.beforeIntentCreate != nil {
415			s.beforeIntentCreate()
416		}
417		if err := lockx.WithDir(ctx, filepath.Join(commonDir, "dev-taskflow"), "taskflow repository", func() error {
418			if err := revalidatePreparedIntent(ctx, intent); err != nil {
419				return err
420			}

13	func guardSharedCheckout(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout string) error {
14		if app.allowSharedCheckout {
15			return nil
16		}
17		reportedPane := ""
18		if rt != nil {
19			switch rt.Name() {
20			case "herdr":
21				reportedPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
22			case "tmux":
23				reportedPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
24			}
25		}
26		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
27			Profile:      runtime.OccupancyStrict,
28			CallerPaneID: reportedPane,
29		})
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("check live occupancy before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
32		}
33		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
34			return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
35		}
36		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("classify live runtime coverage before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionCoverageErr)
38		}
39		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("list live runtime sessions before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionList.Err)
41		}
42		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
44		}
45	
46		var occupied []string
47		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
48			if !agent.Blocking {
49				continue
50			}
51			activity := agent.Activity
52			label := activity.Agent
53			if activity.Name != "" {
54				label = activity.Name
55			}
56			if label == "" {
57				label = "agent"
58			}
59			occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, activity.PaneID))
60		}
61		if len(occupied) == 0 {
62			return nil
63		}
64		return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
65			config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
66	}

68	// checkoutAgentActivities returns recognized agents whose reported cwd resolves
69	// to the same canonical Git worktree root as checkout. A pane is excluded only
70	// when its exact ID matches excludePane; lifecycle state never makes it free.
71	func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {
72		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{Profile: runtime.OccupancyStrict})
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
77			return nil, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err
78		}
79		out := make([]runtime.AgentActivity, 0, len(evidence.Agents))
80		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
81			if excludePane == "" || agent.Activity.PaneID != excludePane {
82				out = append(out, agent.Activity)
83			}
84		}
85		return out, nil
86	}

13	// OccupancyProfile selects the policy applied to recognized-agent evidence.
14	// Session, pane, and activity observations are retained identically in every
15	// profile; only Blocking changes.
16	type OccupancyProfile uint8
17	
18	const (
19		// OccupancyStrict is for claiming a checkout for writing or adoption. Every
20		// recognized agent except the current caller is blocking, regardless of state.
21		// It is the zero value so an omitted profile fails toward exclusive ownership.
22		OccupancyStrict OccupancyProfile = iota
23		// OccupancyCleanup permits closeable idle and done agents. Unknown activity
24		// remains blocking unless CloseUnknown is set.
25		OccupancyCleanup
26	)
27	
28	// OccupancyOptions supplies live caller identity and action-specific policy.
29	// CallerWorkspaceID and CallerPaneID must describe the invoking runtime, not a
30	// handle remembered in durable task state.
31	type OccupancyOptions struct {
32		Profile           OccupancyProfile
33		CallerWorkspaceID string
34		CallerPaneID      string
35		CloseUnknown      bool
36	}
37	
38	// OccupancyObservation distinguishes an observed empty inventory from evidence
39	// that was unsupported, unattempted, or failed.
40	type OccupancyObservation struct {
41		Supported bool
42		Attempted bool
43		Err       error
44	}
45	
46	// Observed reports whether the observation completed successfully.
47	func (o OccupancyObservation) Observed() bool {
48		return o.Supported && o.Attempted && o.Err == nil
49	}
50	
51	// Unknown reports whether this evidence was not successfully observed.
52	func (o OccupancyObservation) Unknown() bool { return !o.Observed() }
53	
54	// OccupancySession is one live session whose panes cover the target checkout.
55	type OccupancySession struct {
56		Runtime  Session
57		Panes    []Pane
58		Mixed    []Pane
59		IsCaller bool
60	}
61	
62	// OccupancyAgent is one recognized agent whose cwd covers the target checkout.
63	type OccupancyAgent struct {
64		Activity      AgentActivity
65		Status        string
66		SessionHandle string
67		IsCaller      bool
68		Blocking      bool
69	}
70	
71	// Occupancy is structured, read-only evidence about one checkout. A remembered
72	// runtime handle is deliberately absent: Sessions and Agents are selected only
73	// from fresh canonical checkout coverage.
74	type Occupancy struct {
75		Target               string
76		Backend              string
77		Profile              OccupancyProfile
78		CallerWorkspaceID    string
79		ReportedCallerPaneID string
80		CallerPaneID         string
81		SessionList          OccupancyObservation
82		AgentActivityList    OccupancyObservation
83		CurrentPane          OccupancyObservation
84		SessionCoverageErr   error
85		Sessions             []OccupancySession
86		Agents               []OccupancyAgent
87	}
88	
89	// InspectOccupancy collects independent runtime, recognized-agent, and caller
90	// evidence for target. Initial target canonicalization errors are returned;
91	// observation failures are retained in their corresponding fields so each
92	// action can apply its own fail-closed acknowledgement policy.
93	func InspectOccupancy(ctx context.Context, rt Runtime, target string, opts OccupancyOptions) (Occupancy, error) {
94		checkout, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, target)
95		if err != nil {
96			return Occupancy{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize occupancy target: %w", err)
97		}
98		result := Occupancy{
99			Target:               checkout.path,
100			Backend:              "none",
101			Profile:              opts.Profile,
102			CallerWorkspaceID:    opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
103			ReportedCallerPaneID: opts.CallerPaneID,
104			CallerPaneID:         opts.CallerPaneID,
105		}
106		if rt == nil {
107			return result, nil
108		}
109		result.Backend = rt.Name()
110		if result.Backend == "none" {
111			return result, nil
112		}
113	
114		result.SessionList.Supported = true
115		resolver, resolvesCurrentPane := rt.(CurrentPaneResolver)
116		result.CurrentPane.Supported = resolvesCurrentPane
117		if resolvesCurrentPane && opts.CallerPaneID != "" {
118			result.CurrentPane.Attempted = true
119			result.CallerPaneID = ""
120			paneID, resolveErr := resolver.CurrentPaneID(ctx)
121			if resolveErr != nil {
122				result.CurrentPane.Err = resolveErr
123			} else if paneID == "" {
124				result.CurrentPane.Err = fmt.Errorf("current pane resolver returned an empty pane id")
125			} else {
126				result.CallerPaneID = paneID
127			}
128		}
129	
130		result.SessionList.Attempted = true
131		sessions, listErr := rt.List(ctx)
132		if listErr != nil {
133			result.SessionList.Err = listErr
134		} else {
135			for _, observed := range sessions {
136				covering, mixed, classifyErr := classifyOccupancySession(ctx, checkout, observed, opts.Profile)
137				if classifyErr != nil {
138					result.SessionCoverageErr = classifyErr
139					result.Sessions = nil
140					break
141				}
142				if len(covering) == 0 {
143					continue
144				}
145				result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, OccupancySession{
146					Runtime: observed,
147					Panes:   covering,
148					Mixed:   mixed,
149					IsCaller: observed.Handle == opts.CallerWorkspaceID ||
150						occupancyPanePresent(observed.Panes, result.CallerPaneID),
151				})
152			}
153		}
154	
155		lister, listsAgents := rt.(AgentActivityLister)
156		result.AgentActivityList.Supported = listsAgents
157		if !listsAgents {
158			// Some backends can identify an agent on a pane without providing the
159			// richer recognized-agent inventory. Preserve that live evidence as the
160			// strict-profile fallback rather than treating an unsupported lister as an
161			// observed empty list.
162			for _, session := range result.Sessions {
163				for _, pane := range session.Panes {
164					if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" {
165						continue
166					}
167					cwd := pane.CWD
168					if cwd == "" {
169						cwd = pane.ShellCWD
170					}
171					activity := AgentActivity{
172						PaneID: pane.ID, WorkspaceID: session.Runtime.Handle,
173						Agent: pane.Agent, Status: pane.AgentStatus, CWD: cwd,
174					}
175					if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
176						result.SessionCoverageErr = coverageErr
177						result.Agents = nil
178						return result, nil
179					}
180				}
181			}
182			return result, nil
183		}
184		result.AgentActivityList.Attempted = true
185		activities, activityErr := lister.AgentActivities(ctx)
186		if activityErr != nil {
187			result.AgentActivityList.Err = activityErr
188			return result, nil
189		}
190		for _, activity := range activities {
191			if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
192				result.AgentActivityList.Err = coverageErr
193				result.Agents = nil
194				return result, nil
195			}
196		}
197		return result, nil
198	}
199	
200	func appendOccupancyAgent(ctx context.Context, result *Occupancy, checkout checkoutIdentity, opts OccupancyOptions, activity AgentActivity) error {
201		covered, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, checkout, activity.CWD, opts.Profile)
202		if err != nil {
203			return fmt.Errorf("classify recognized agent pane %s: %w", activity.PaneID, err)
204		}
205		if !covered {
206			return nil
207		}
208		status := normalizeOccupancyStatus(activity.Status)
209		caller := result.CallerPaneID != "" && activity.PaneID == result.CallerPaneID
210		handle := correlatedSession(result.Sessions, activity)
211		result.Agents = append(result.Agents, OccupancyAgent{
212			Activity:      activity,
213			Status:        status,
214			SessionHandle: handle,
215			IsCaller:      caller,
216			Blocking:      occupancyAgentBlocks(opts, status, caller, handle != ""),
217		})
218		return nil
219	}
220	
221	type checkoutIdentity struct {
222		path   string
223		git    bool
224		linked bool
225	}
226	
227	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
228		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
229		if err != nil {
230			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
231		}
232		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
233		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
234			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
235			if canonicalErr != nil {
236				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
237			}
238			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true, linked: repo.IsLinkedWorktree}, nil
239		}
240		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
241			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
242		}
243		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
244	}
245	
246	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string, profile OccupancyProfile) (bool, error) {
247		if cwd == "" {
248			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
249		}
250		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
251		if err != nil {
252			return false, err
253		}
254		if target.git && activity.git {
255			if target.path == activity.path {
256				return true, nil
257			}
258			if profile == OccupancyCleanup && target.linked {
259				return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
260			}
261			return false, nil
262		}
263		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
264	}
265	
266	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session, profile OccupancyProfile) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
267		panes := session.Panes
268		if len(panes) == 0 {
269			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
270				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
271			}
272		}
273		var covering, mixed []Pane
274		for _, pane := range panes {
275			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
276			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
277				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
278			}
279			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
280			for _, path := range paths {
281				if path == "" {
282					continue
283				}
284				observed = true
285				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path, profile)
286				if err != nil {
287					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
288				}
289				if inside {
290					paneCovers = true
291				} else {
292					paneOutside = true
293				}
294			}
295			if paneCovers {
296				covering = append(covering, pane)
297			}
298			if paneOutside || !observed {
299				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
300			}
301		}
302		return covering, mixed, nil
303	}
304	
305	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
306		if id == "" {
307			return false
308		}
309		for _, pane := range panes {
310			if pane.ID == id {
311				return true
312			}
313		}
314		return false
315	}
316	
317	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
318		for _, session := range sessions {
319			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
320				return session.Runtime.Handle
321			}
322			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
323				return session.Runtime.Handle
324			}
325		}
326		return ""
327	}
328	
329	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
330		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
331		if status == "" {
332			return "unknown"
333		}
334		return status
335	}
336	
337	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
338		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
339			return !caller
340		}
341		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
342		// with a freshly listed covering session.
343		if caller || !correlated {
344			return true
345		}
346		switch status {
347		case "idle", "done":
348			return false
349		case "unknown":
350			return !opts.CloseUnknown
351		default:
352			return true
353		}
354	}
355

656	func statusPaths(ctx context.Context, repo string) ([]statusPath, error) {
657		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
658		if err != nil {
659			return nil, err
660		}
661		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
662		var paths []statusPath
663		for i := 0; i < len(fields); i++ {
664			entry := fields[i]
665			if len(entry) < 4 {
666				continue
667			}
668			code, path := entry[:2], filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:])
669			paths = append(paths, statusPath{Path: path, Staged: code[0] != ' ' && code[0] != '?'})
670			if code[0] == 'R' || code[0] == 'C' {
671				i++ // porcelain -z emits the source path as the next field.
672			}
673		}

165	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
166	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
167	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
168		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
169		if err != nil {
170			return inspection, err
171		}
172		if !inspection.Ready() {
173			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
174		}
175		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
176			return inspection, nil
177		}
178		interval := opts.PollInterval
179		if interval <= 0 {
180			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
181		}
182		timeout := opts.Timeout
183		if timeout <= 0 {
184			timeout = 5 * time.Second
185		}
186		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
187		closed := make(map[string]bool)
188		for {
189			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
190			if inspectErr != nil {
191				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
192			}
193			if !fresh.Ready() {
194				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
195			}
196			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
197				inspection.Sessions = nil
198				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
199				return inspection, nil
200			}
201			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
202				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
203					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
204			}
205			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
206				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
207				if closed[handle] {
208					continue
209				}
210				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
211					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
212				}
213				closed[handle] = true
214				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
215			}
216			select {
217			case <-ctx.Done():
218				return inspection, ctx.Err()
219			case <-time.After(interval):
220			}

**Analyzing artifact race conditions**

I’m working on fixing the artifact race issue by implementing a shared lock and validation. However, it appears that Finalize is still using a separate lock, which could lead to race conditions if it runs alongside cold park checks. Once an intent is finalized, the cold park can remove it, provided the finalization receipt is reachable. There's a potential severe problem because the code matches all unmatched intents, including older ones, which complicates the intent process, particularly with duplicate branches. **Exploring intent management**

I’m thinking about how intents from an old checkout at A can affect the new checkout at B, especially if A is removed. If there’s a reconstruction at B, it should still bind by identity, but Git allows duplication through force. There could be issues with intent blocking if it’s attached to A during removal. If the finalized receipt is reachable from B, it might allow removal of that intent, but there are challenges with pending bytes and potential false negatives. I need to check runtime occupancy to better understand the situation.

93	func InspectOccupancy(ctx context.Context, rt Runtime, target string, opts OccupancyOptions) (Occupancy, error) {

200	func appendOccupancyAgent(ctx context.Context, result *Occupancy, checkout checkoutIdentity, opts OccupancyOptions, activity AgentActivity) error {
201		covered, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, checkout, activity.CWD, opts.Profile)

210		handle := correlatedSession(result.Sessions, activity)

212			Activity:      activity,
213			Status:        status,
214			SessionHandle: handle,
215			IsCaller:      caller,
216			Blocking:      occupancyAgentBlocks(opts, status, caller, handle != ""),
217		})

219	}

227	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
228		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
229		if err != nil {
230			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
231		}
232		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
233		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
234			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
235			if canonicalErr != nil {
236				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
237			}
238			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true, linked: repo.IsLinkedWorktree}, nil
239		}
240		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
241			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
242		}
243		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
244	}
245	
246	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string, profile OccupancyProfile) (bool, error) {
247		if cwd == "" {
248			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
249		}
250		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
251		if err != nil {
252			return false, err
253		}
254		if target.git && activity.git {
255			if target.path == activity.path {
256				return true, nil
257			}
258			if profile == OccupancyCleanup && target.linked {
259				return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
260			}
261			return false, nil
262		}
263		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
264	}
265	
266	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session, profile OccupancyProfile) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
267		panes := session.Panes
268		if len(panes) == 0 {
269			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
270				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
271			}
272		}
273		var covering, mixed []Pane
274		for _, pane := range panes {
275			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
276			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
277				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
278			}
279			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
280			for _, path := range paths {
281				if path == "" {
282					continue
283				}
284				observed = true
285				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path, profile)
286				if err != nil {
287					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
288				}
289				if inside {
290					paneCovers = true
291				} else {
292					paneOutside = true
293				}
294			}
295			if paneCovers {
296				covering = append(covering, pane)
297			}
298			if paneOutside || !observed {
299				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
300			}
301		}
302		return covering, mixed, nil
303	}
304	
305	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
306		if id == "" {
307			return false
308		}
309		for _, pane := range panes {
310			if pane.ID == id {
311				return true
312			}
313		}
314		return false
315	}
316	
317	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
318		for _, session := range sessions {
319			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
320				return session.Runtime.Handle
321			}
322			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
323				return session.Runtime.Handle
324			}
325		}
326		return ""
327	}
328	
329	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
330		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
331		if status == "" {
332			return "unknown"
333		}
334		return status
335	}
336	
337	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
338		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
339			return !caller
340		}
341		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
342		// with a freshly listed covering session.
343		if caller || !correlated {
344			return true
345		}
346		switch status {
347		case "idle", "done":
348			return false
349		case "unknown":
350			return !opts.CloseUnknown
351		default:
352			return true
353		}
354	}

15	func (s *lifecycleService) removeCheckoutHandler() Handler {
16		return Handler{
17			Plan:  s.planRemoveCheckout,
18			Apply: s.applyRemoveCheckout,
19		}
20	}

22	func validateRemoveCheckoutLocator(locator Locator) error {
23		switch {
24		case locator.TaskID != "":
25			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged removal must not carry a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
26		case locator.TaskRevision != "":
27			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged removal must not carry a task revision", ErrInvalidRequest)
28		case locator.RepoPath == "":
29			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
30		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
31			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
32		case locator.CheckoutPath == "":
33			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
34		case locator.Branch == "":
35			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact named branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
36		case locator.HeadOID == "":
37			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout HEAD is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
38		case strings.TrimSpace(locator.Branch) != locator.Branch || strings.ContainsRune(locator.Branch, '\x00'):
39			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact branch is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest)
40		}
41		return nil
42	}
43	
44	func (s *lifecycleService) planRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
45		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
46			return PlanSpec{}, err
47		}
48		if err := validateRemoveCheckoutLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
49			return PlanSpec{}, err
50		}
51		spec, _, err := s.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, request, s.tasks.ListRecords)
52		return spec, err
53	}

55	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, loader taskInventoryLoader) (PlanSpec, destructiveObservation, error) {
56		options := request.Options.(RemoveCheckoutOptions)
57		rt, rtErr := s.runtimeForUnmanaged()
58		cleanup := retire.Options{
59			CWD: s.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: s.callerPane,
60			CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
61		}
62		observed, err := s.inspectDestructive(ctx, destructiveInspectInput{
63			locator: request.Locator, base: options.ContainmentBase,
64			runtime: rt, rtErr: rtErr, cleanup: cleanup,
65			inspectArtifacts: true, inspectContent: options.DiscardDirty,
66			inspectTasks: true, loadTasks: loader,
67		})
68		if err != nil {
69			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
70		}
71		return s.removeCheckoutSpec(request, observed), observed, nil
72	}
73	
74	func (s *lifecycleService) runtimeForUnmanaged() (runtime.Runtime, error) {
75		rt := s.defaultRuntime()
76		if rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "" {
77			return nil, errors.New("taskflow runtime resolver returned no backend")
78		}
79		return rt, nil
80	}

82	func (s *lifecycleService) removeCheckoutSpec(request Request, observed destructiveObservation) PlanSpec {
83		options := request.Options.(RemoveCheckoutOptions)
84		conditions := []Condition{retireRepositoryCondition(observed)}
85		conditions = append(conditions, removeCheckoutIdentityConditions(observed, options)...)
86		conditions = append(conditions, removeTaskInventoryConditions(observed)...)
87		conditions = append(conditions, removeContainmentConditions(observed, options)...)
88		conditions = append(conditions, removeArtifactCondition(observed))
89		conditions = append(conditions, destructiveRuntimeConditions(observed)...)
90	
91		var effects []Effect
92		if options.DiscardDirty && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() {
93			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
94				EffectDiscardAll, "discard every staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked change", observed.checkout, true, false,
95				map[string]string{
96					"scope": "all", "head": observed.head, "branch": observed.locator.Branch,
97					"content-fingerprint": observed.contentFingerprint,
98				},
99			))
100		}
101		if observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.cleanupErr == nil && len(observed.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
102			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
103				EffectCloseRuntime, "close eligible runtime sessions covering the unmanaged checkout", observed.checkout, true, false,
104				map[string]string{"backend": runtimeName(observed.runtime), "sessions": fmt.Sprintf("%d", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions))},
105			))
106		}
107		effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
108			EffectRemoveWorktree, "remove the exact clean unmanaged linked checkout without force", observed.checkout, true, false,
109			map[string]string{"repo": observed.repoPath, "branch": observed.locator.Branch, "head": observed.locator.HeadOID, "force": "false", "preserve-branch": "true"},
110		))
111		if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
112			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
113				EffectDeleteBranch, "delete the freshly contained unmanaged branch under the same lock", observed.locator.Branch, true, false,
114				map[string]string{"branch-oid": observed.branchOID, "base": options.ContainmentBase, "base-oid": observed.baseOID},
115			))
116		}
117	
118		confirmation := Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Remove this unmanaged checkout while preserving its branch?"}
119		var tokenParts []string
120		if options.DiscardDirty && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() {
121			tokenParts = append(tokenParts, "DISCARD "+observed.checkout)
122		}
123		if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
124			tokenParts = append(tokenParts, "DELETE "+observed.locator.Branch)
125		}
126		if len(tokenParts) > 0 {
127			token := strings.Join(tokenParts, " ")
128			confirmation = Confirmation{
129				Kind: ConfirmationTyped, Token: token,
130				Prompt: "Type " + token + " to approve every destructive effect in this exact plan",
131			}
132		}
133		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.locator.Branch + "@" + observed.branchOID}
134		if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
135			retained = nil
136		}
137		return PlanSpec{
138			Authority:         observed.authority(),
139			Conditions:        conditions,
140			Effects:           effects,
141			RetainedResources: retained,
142			Confirmation:      confirmation,
143			FallbackCommand:   removeCheckoutFallback(observed, options),
144			Summary:           "Remove unmanaged checkout " + observed.checkout,
145			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
146		}
147	}

184		}
185	
186		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
187		kindEvidence := "registered non-main, non-bare linked worktree"
188		if !observed.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree() {
189			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
190			kindEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("main=%t bare=%t; canonical and bare records are never removable", observed.worktree.Worktree.Main, observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare)
191		}
192	
193		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
194		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and non-prunable"

198		}

202		switch {

204			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered worktree is detached or unnamed"
205		case observed.statusErr != nil:

207		case observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.locator.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.locator.Branch:
208			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q selected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.locator.Branch)
209		}
210

213		switch {

216		case !observed.branchExists:

218		case observed.branchOID != observed.locator.HeadOID || observed.branchOID != observed.head:

299	func removeContainmentConditions(observed destructiveObservation, options RemoveCheckoutOptions) []Condition {
300		if !options.RequireContained {
301			return []Condition{
302				condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
303					"unmanaged checkout removal does not require branch integration", ""),
304				condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
305					"branch is preserved regardless of containment", ""),
306				condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
307					"local branch will be retained", ""),
308			}
309		}
310		baseCondition := condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
311			fmt.Sprintf("local base %s is %s", observed.baseRef, observed.baseOID), "")
312		switch {
313		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
314			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
315				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair containment-base observation")
316		case !observed.baseExists:
317			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
318				"containment base "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "restore the exact local base")
319		case observed.baseOID == "":
320			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
321				"containment base resolved without an OID", "repair containment-base observation")
322		}
323		relationCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
324			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is contained in %s (%s)", observed.locator.Branch, observed.branchOID,
325				options.ContainmentBase, observed.baseOID), "")
326		switch {
327		case observed.containedErr != nil:
328			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
329				observed.containedErr.Error(), "repair local ancestry observation")
330		case !observed.branchExists || observed.branchOID == "" || !observed.baseExists || observed.baseOID == "":
331			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
332				"exact branch/base containment cannot be proved", "restore both exact local refs")
333		case !observed.contained:
334			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
335				"branch is not contained in "+options.ContainmentBase, "integrate it before contained retirement")
336		}
337		deletionCondition := condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
338			"local branch will be retained after contained checkout removal", "")
339		if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
340			deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
341				"ordinary git branch -d will run under the same repository/task lock", "")
342			if observed.locator.Branch == options.ContainmentBase {
343				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
344					"selected branch is the containment base", "retain the base branch")
345			} else if paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(true); err != nil {
346				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
347					err.Error(), "refresh worktree topology")
348			} else if len(paths) > 0 {
349				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
350					"branch is also checked out at "+strings.Join(paths, ", "), "remove or switch those checkouts first")
351			}
352		}
353		return []Condition{baseCondition, relationCondition, deletionCondition}
354	}

373	func removeCheckoutFallback(observed destructiveObservation, options RemoveCheckoutOptions) string {
374		parts := []string{"dev", "wt", "rm", shellQuote(observed.locator.Branch)}
375		if options.RequireContained {
376			parts = []string{"dev", "retire", shellQuote(observed.checkout)}
377			if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
378				parts = append(parts, "--delete-branch")
379			}
380		} else if options.DiscardDirty {
381			parts = append(parts, "--force")
382		}
383		if options.CloseUnknown {
384			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
385		}
386		if options.AssumeNoRuntime {
387			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
388		}
389		if options.Timeout > 0 {
390			parts = append(parts, "--timeout", options.Timeout.String())
391		}
392		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
393	}

395	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
396		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
397			return Result{}, err
398		}
399		if approved.Action != RemoveCheckout {
400			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "remove-checkout handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
401		}
402		if err := validateRemoveCheckoutLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
403			return Result{}, err
404		}
405		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
406		if err != nil {
407			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
408		}
409	
410		var result Result
411		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
412			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
413				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, approved.Request, tx.ListRecords)
414				if observeErr != nil {
415					return observeErr
416				}
417				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
418				if buildErr != nil {
419					return buildErr
420				}
421				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
422					return &StalePlanError{
423						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
424						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
425						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
426						Reason:                       "fresh unmanaged Git, worktree, task, artifact, runtime, or harness authority differs",
427					}
428				}
429				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
430					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
431					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh unmanaged removal conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
432				}
433				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx}
434				result, observeErr = execution.executeRemoveCheckout(ctx, observed)
435				return observeErr
436			})
437		})
438		return result, err
439	}

98	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructive(ctx context.Context, input destructiveInspectInput) (destructiveObservation, error) {
99		observed := destructiveObservation{locator: input.locator, runtime: input.runtime, runtimeErr: input.rtErr}
100		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
101			return observed, err
102		}
103	
104		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, input.locator.RepoPath)
105		if err != nil {
106			observed.repoErr = err
107			return observed, nil
108		}
109		observed.repo = repository
110		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
111		if err != nil {
112			observed.repoErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git main checkout: %w", err)
113			return observed, nil
114		}
115		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
116		if err != nil {
117			observed.repoErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory: %w", err)
118			return observed, nil
119		}
120		requestedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.RepoPath)
121		if err != nil {
122			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
123		}
124		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.GitCommonDir)
125		if err != nil {
126			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
127		}
128		if requestedRepo != observed.repoPath || requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
129			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
130				"selected repository identity changed: main %q -> %q, common directory %q -> %q",
131				requestedRepo, observed.repoPath, requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir,
132			)}
133		}
134		if filepath.IsAbs(input.locator.RepoKey) {
135			key, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.RepoKey)
136			if keyErr != nil {
137				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
138			}
139			if key != observed.gitCommonDir {
140				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected repository key no longer names the Git common directory"}
141			}
142		}
143	
144		observed.worktrees, observed.worktreesErr = s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
145		if !input.noCheckout {
146			observed.checkout, err = s.canonicalPath(input.locator.CheckoutPath)
147			if err != nil {
148				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize selected checkout: %w", err)
149			} else {
150				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
151				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
152					observed.worktreeFound = true
153					observed.observeCheckoutFacts(ctx, s)
154					if input.inspectContent && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() {
155						analysis, contentErr := s.analyzeFinish(ctx, observed.checkout, input.locator.Branch, input.locator.Branch)
156						observed.contentFingerprint = analysis.Fingerprint
157						observed.contentErr = contentErr
158					}
159					observed.harness, observed.isHarness = inventory.DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
160				}
161			}
162		}
163	
164		observed.observeRefs(ctx, s, input.locator.Branch, input.base)
165		if input.inspectArtifacts && observed.worktreeFound {
166			observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
167		}
168		if !input.noCheckout && !input.skipCleanup {
169			if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
170				if observed.runtime == nil || strings.TrimSpace(observed.runtime.Name()) == "" {
171					observed.runtimeErr = errors.New("destructive inspection has no runtime backend")
172				} else {
173					observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
174					observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, input.cleanup)
175				}
176			}
177		}
178		if input.inspectTasks {
179			if input.loadTasks == nil {
180				observed.taskInventoryErr = errors.New("task inventory loader is unavailable")
181			} else {
182				observed.taskRecords, observed.taskDiagnostics, observed.taskInventoryErr = input.loadTasks()
183				if observed.taskInventoryErr == nil {
184					s.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &observed)
185				}
186			}
187		}
188		return observed, nil
189	}

191	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeCheckoutFacts(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService) {
192		o.status, o.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, o.checkout)
193		o.head, o.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, o.checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
194		o.head = strings.TrimSpace(o.head)
195		o.operation, o.inProgress, o.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, o.checkout)
196	}

198	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeRefs(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService, branch, base string) {
199		o.branchRef = localBranchRef(branch)
200		if o.repoPath != "" && o.branchRef != "" {
201			o.branchExists, o.branchOIDErr = s.gitRefState(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchRef)
202			if o.branchExists && o.branchOIDErr == nil {
203				o.branchOID, o.branchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchRef)
204			}
205		}
206		o.baseRef = localBranchRef(base)
207		if o.repoPath != "" && o.baseRef != "" {
208			o.baseExists, o.baseOIDErr = s.gitRefState(ctx, o.repoPath, o.baseRef)
209			if o.baseExists && o.baseOIDErr == nil {
210				o.baseOID, o.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, o.repoPath, o.baseRef)
211			}
212		}
213		if o.branchExists && o.branchOIDErr == nil && o.branchOID != "" &&
214			o.baseExists && o.baseOIDErr == nil && o.baseOID != "" {
215			o.contained, o.containedErr = s.isAncestor(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchOID, o.baseOID)
216		}
217	}

219	func localBranchRef(branch string) string {

226	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx context.Context, observed *destructiveObservation) {
227		for _, diagnostic := range observed.taskDiagnostics {
228			observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete, diagnostic.Error())
229		}
230		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
231			candidate := record.Task
232			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
233				observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
234					fmt.Sprintf("task %s is invalid: %v", candidate.ID, err))
235				continue
236			}
237	
238			pathClaim := false
239			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
240				path, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
241				if err != nil {
242					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
243						fmt.Sprintf("task %s checkout identity is unavailable: %v", candidate.ID, err))
244				} else {
245					pathClaim = path == observed.checkout
246				}
247			}
248	
249			branchClaim := false
250			if candidate.Branch == observed.locator.Branch {
251				repoMatches, complete, detail := s.taskRepositoryMatches(ctx, candidate, *observed)
252				if !complete {
253					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
254						fmt.Sprintf("task %s repository identity is unavailable: %s", candidate.ID, detail))
255				} else {
256					branchClaim = repoMatches
257				}
258			}
259	
260			if pathClaim {
261				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
262					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "exact checkout path",
263				})
264			}
265			if branchClaim {
266				reason := "exact branch in selected repository"
267				if pathClaim {
268					reason = "exact checkout path and branch in selected repository"
269					observed.taskClaims[len(observed.taskClaims)-1].Reason = reason
270					continue
271				}
272				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
273					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: reason,
274				})
275			}
276		}
277		sort.Slice(observed.taskClaims, func(i, j int) bool {
278			if observed.taskClaims[i].ID != observed.taskClaims[j].ID {
279				return observed.taskClaims[i].ID < observed.taskClaims[j].ID
280			}
281			return observed.taskClaims[i].Reason < observed.taskClaims[j].Reason
282		})
283		sort.Strings(observed.taskIncomplete)
284	}
285	
286	func (s *lifecycleService) taskRepositoryMatches(ctx context.Context, candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation) (bool, bool, string) {
287		candidatePath, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
288		if err != nil {
289			return false, false, err.Error()
290		}
291		if candidatePath == observed.repoPath {
292			return true, true, ""
293		}
294		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return false, false, err.Error()
297		}
298		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
299		if err != nil {
300			return false, false, err.Error()
301		}
302		return commonDir == observed.gitCommonDir, true, ""
303	}

305	func (o destructiveObservation) branchCheckoutPaths(excludeTarget bool) ([]string, error) {
306		if o.worktreesErr != nil {
307			return nil, o.worktreesErr
308		}
309		var paths []string
310		for _, worktree := range o.worktrees {
311			if worktree.Bare || worktree.Branch != o.locator.Branch {
312				continue
313			}
314			path := worktree.Path
315			if canonical, err := filepath.Abs(path); err == nil {
316				path = filepath.Clean(canonical)
317			}
318			if excludeTarget && o.checkout != "" {
319				candidate, err := filepath.Abs(o.checkout)
320				if err == nil && filepath.Clean(candidate) == path {
321					continue
322				}
323			}
324			paths = append(paths, path)
325		}
326		sort.Strings(paths)
327		return paths, nil
328	}

408	func artifactEvidenceFromInspection(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection) string {
409		if inspection.KnownEmpty {
410			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
411		}
412		states := make([]string, 0, len(inspection.Intents))
413		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
414			states = append(states, intent.Intent.ID+"="+string(intent.State))
415		}
416		if len(states) == 0 {
417			return "artifact readiness is incomplete"
418		}
419		return strings.Join(states, ", ")
420	}

422	func mergeAuthority(base, additional map[string]string) map[string]string {
423		out := make(map[string]string, len(base)+len(additional))
424		for key, value := range base {
425			out[key] = value
426		}
427		for key, value := range additional {
428			out[key] = value
429		}
430		return out

23	// Store keeps one strict JSON intent per finalization handoff.
24	type Store struct {
25		Dir   string
26		clock func() time.Time
27		newID func() string
28	}

30	func NewStore(dir string) *Store {
31		return &Store{Dir: dir, clock: time.Now, newID: randomID}
32	}

34	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".json") }
35	
36	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
37		if intent == nil {
38			return fmt.Errorf("create nil artifact intent")
39		}
40		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
41			candidate := *intent
42			if candidate.ID == "" {
43				candidate.ID = s.newID()
44			}
45			candidate.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
46			candidate.Status = Armed
47			now := s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
48			candidate.CreatedAt, candidate.UpdatedAt = now, now
49			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
50				return err
51			}
52			if _, err := os.Stat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
53				return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s already exists", candidate.ID)
54			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return err
56			}
57			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {
58				return err
59			}
60			*intent = candidate
61			return nil
62		})
63	}
64	
65	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Intent, error) {
66		if !idPattern.MatchString(id) {
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent id %q", id)
68		}
69		file, err := os.Open(s.path(id))
70		if err != nil {
71			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
72				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s: %w", id, ErrIntentNotFound)
73			}
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		defer file.Close()
77		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
78		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
79		var intent Intent
80		if err := decoder.Decode(&intent); err != nil {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
82		}
83		if err := ensureJSONEOF(decoder); err != nil {
84			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
85		}
86		if intent.ID != id {
87			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent filename %s disagrees with id %s", id, intent.ID)
88		}
89		if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
90			return nil, err
91		}
92		return &intent, nil
93	}

95	func (s *Store) List() ([]Intent, error) {
96		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
97		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
98			return nil, nil
99		}
100		if err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		var intents []Intent
104		for _, entry := range entries {
105			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
106				continue
107			}
108			intent, err := s.Get(strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json"))
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			intents = append(intents, *intent)
113		}
114		sort.Slice(intents, func(i, j int) bool { return intents[i].CreatedAt.Before(intents[j].CreatedAt) })
115		return intents, nil
116	}

120		if err != nil {
121			return nil, err
122		}
123		for i := range intents {
124			if intents[i].RunID == runID {
125				return &intents[i], nil
126			}
127		}
128		return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact run %s: %w", runID, ErrIntentNotFound)
129	}

131	func (s *Store) Update(ctx context.Context, id string, mutate func(*Intent) error) error {
132		if mutate == nil {
133			return fmt.Errorf("artifact update needs a mutation")
134		}
135		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
136			intent, err := s.Get(id)
137			if err != nil {
138				return err
139			}
140			if err := mutate(intent); err != nil {
141				return err
142			}
143			intent.UpdatedAt = s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
144			if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
145				return err
146			}
147			return s.write(*intent)
148		})
149	}

151	func (s *Store) write(intent Intent) error {
152		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o700); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, ".intent-*.tmp")
156		if err != nil {
157			return err
158		}
159		name := tmp.Name()
160		defer os.Remove(name)
161		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
162			tmp.Close()
163			return err
164		}
165		encoder := json.NewEncoder(tmp)
166		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
167		if err := encoder.Encode(intent); err != nil {
168			tmp.Close()
169			return err
170		}
171		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
172			tmp.Close()
173			return err
174		}
175		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
176			return err
177		}
178		return os.Rename(name, s.path(intent.ID))
179	}
180	
181	func ensureJSONEOF(decoder *json.Decoder) error {
182		var extra any
183		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
184			return nil
185		} else if err != nil {
186			return err
187		}
188		return fmt.Errorf("multiple JSON values")
189	}

192		var raw [12]byte
193		if _, err := rand.Read(raw[:]); err != nil {
194			return fmt.Sprintf("intent-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
195		}
196		return "intent-" + hex.EncodeToString(raw[:])
197	}

13	// ReviewQuery identifies one exact head/base relationship in one repository.
14	// Repository is the forge's stable repository identity: owner/repository for
15	// GitHub, group/repository for GitLab, or organization/project/repository for
16	// Azure DevOps. Adapters must still verify the returned branches because CLI

18	type ReviewQuery struct {

22	}

24	// ReviewState is the portable lifecycle state observed for a provider review.

26

28		ReviewOpen   ReviewState = "open"
29		ReviewDraft  ReviewState = "draft"
30		ReviewMerged ReviewState = "merged"
31		ReviewClosed ReviewState = "closed"
32	)
33	
34	// Valid reports whether s has defined portable review semantics.
35	func (s ReviewState) Valid() bool {
36		switch s {
37		case ReviewOpen, ReviewDraft, ReviewMerged, ReviewClosed:
38			return true
39		default:
40			return false
41		}
42	}
43	
44	// Review is the minimal provider evidence for an exact head/base relationship.
45	// ID is the provider-stable identity and Number is the repository-local human
46	// identifier. Head, Base, State and Draft are observations from the provider
47	// response rather than values copied from ReviewQuery.
48	type Review struct {
49		Provider   Kind        `json:"provider"`
50		Repository string      `json:"repository"`
51		ID         string      `json:"id"`
52		Number     int         `json:"number"`
53		State      ReviewState `json:"state"`
54		Draft      bool        `json:"draft"`

61	// ReviewQuerier is an optional forge capability. A nil Review and nil error is
62	// a successful observation that no exact review exists. One exact match returns
63	// provider evidence; multiple exact matches fail with AmbiguousReviewError.
64	type ReviewQuerier interface {
65		QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error)
66	}
67	
68	var (
69		// ErrAmbiguousReview identifies a query with multiple exact head/base
70		// matches. Callers must not select one by recency or provider ordering.
71		ErrAmbiguousReview = errors.New("multiple reviews match")
72		// ErrMalformedReviewResponse identifies provider JSON that cannot supply the
73		// critical portable fields without guessing.
74		ErrMalformedReviewResponse = errors.New("malformed review response")
75	)

77	// AmbiguousReviewError carries every exact match while keeping Error text free

148		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Base) == "":
149			return errors.New("review query base is required")
150		default:
151			return nil
152		}
153	}
154	
155	func decodeReviewJSON(provider Kind, out string, target any) error {
156		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(out)
157		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
158			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON array", nil)
159		}
160		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), target); err != nil {
161			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON", err)
162		}
163		return nil
164	}
165	
166	func selectExactReview(provider Kind, query ReviewQuery, candidates []reviewCandidate, normalize reviewStateNormalizer) (*Review, error) {
167		matches := make([]Review, 0, 1)
168		observedAt := time.Now().UTC()
169		for index, candidate := range candidates {
170			if candidate.Head == "" {
171				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "head branch", nil)
172			}
173			if candidate.Base == "" {
174				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "base branch", nil)
175			}
176			if candidate.Head != query.Head || candidate.Base != query.Base {
177				continue
178			}
179			if candidate.SourceMatchesRepository == nil {
180				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "source repository identity", nil)
181			}
182			if !*candidate.SourceMatchesRepository {
183				continue
184			}
185			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate.ID) == "" {
186				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "identifier", nil)
187			}
188			if candidate.Number <= 0 {
189				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "number", nil)
190			}
191			if candidate.Draft == nil {
192				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "draft flag", nil)
193			}
194			if !validReviewURL(candidate.URL) {
195				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "URL", nil)
196			}
197			state, err := normalize(candidate.State, *candidate.Draft)
198			if err != nil {
199				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "state", err)
200			}
201			matches = append(matches, Review{
202				Provider: provider, Repository: query.Repository,
203				ID: candidate.ID, Number: candidate.Number,
204				State: state, Draft: *candidate.Draft, URL: candidate.URL,
205				Head: candidate.Head, Base: candidate.Base, ObservedAt: observedAt,
206			})
207		}
208	
209		switch len(matches) {
210		case 0:
211			return nil, nil
212		case 1:
213			return &matches[0], nil
214		default:
215			return nil, &AmbiguousReviewError{
216				Provider: provider, Query: query,
217				Matches: append([]Review(nil), matches...),
218			}
219		}
220	}
221	
222	func malformedReviewResponse(provider Kind, index int, field string, err error) error {
223		return &MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: index, Field: field, Err: err}
224	}
225	
226	func validReviewURL(raw string) bool {
227		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
228		if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" {
229			return false
230		}
231		return parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http"
232	}

1	// Package runtime abstracts the terminal multiplexer that hosts a checkout.
2	//
3	// dev deliberately owns no terminal state of its own. A runtime is where a
4	// task is *live*; the durable facts live in git and in the task registry. That
5	// separation is the whole point: closing a runtime session must never feel
6	// like abandoning a task, so every adapter here is expected to be lossy and
7	// re-derivable.
8	package runtime
9	
10	import (
11		"context"
12		"fmt"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16	
17		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
18	)
19	
20	// Pane is one terminal surface inside a runtime session.
21	type Pane struct {
22		ID           string
23		CWD          string
24		ShellCWD     string
25		Agent        string
26		AgentStatus  string
27		AgentSession string
28	}
29	
30	// Session is one live workspace/session of a runtime backend.
31	type Session struct {
32		// Handle is the backend's own identifier (a herdr workspace id, a tmux
33		// session name). Opaque to the rest of dev.
34		Handle string
35		Label  string
36		// Dirs lists the working directories observed in this session. A session
37		// can span several (multiple panes), which is why this is not a single
38		// value.
39		Dirs []string
40		// AgentStatus is the backend's view of agent activity, when it has one:
41		// "working", "idle", "done", "waiting". Empty when unsupported.
42		AgentStatus string
43		// AgentSessions lists resumable agent context ids, e.g. "claude:<uuid>".
44		AgentSessions []string
45		// Panes retain the exact runtime IDs and cwd values used for caller and
46		// mixed-workspace retirement checks.
47		Panes   []Pane
48		Focused bool
49	}
50	
51	// Covers reports whether the session has a pane rooted at or under dir.
52	func (s Session) Covers(dir string) bool {
53		for _, d := range s.Dirs {
54			// A pane inside the repository makes it live. The inverse is not
55			// true: a generic pane at $HOME does not make every repository below
56			// $HOME active.
57			if inside, err := pathx.Contains(dir, d); err == nil && inside {
58				return true
59			}
60		}
61		return false
62	}
63	
64	// OpenResult is the transient result of making a checkout live. Handle may be
65	// persisted by callers, but the pane belongs to this one creation response and
66	// must never be treated as durable state.
67	type OpenResult struct {
68		Handle     string
69		Surface    string
70		Opened     bool
71		Created    bool
72		RootPaneID string
73	}
74	
75	// AgentActivity is one recognized live coding agent occupying a runtime pane.
76	// Every activity returned by a backend is occupied regardless of Status; idle,
77	// done and unknown describe lifecycle state, not permission to share a checkout.
78	type AgentActivity struct {
79		PaneID      string
80		WorkspaceID string
81		Agent       string
82		Name        string
83		Status      string
84		CWD         string
85	}
86	
87	// AgentActivityLister is an optional runtime capability. Core runtimes need not
88	// know about agents; Herdr implements it because its pane model can identify the
89	// exact process and checkout involved.
90	type AgentActivityLister interface {
91		AgentActivities(ctx context.Context) ([]AgentActivity, error)
92	}
93	
94	// CurrentPaneResolver is an optional runtime capability for resolving the live
95	// pane behind inherited caller context. Herdr pane IDs can change after a move,
96	// so collision exclusions must not trust HERDR_PANE_ID alone.
97	type CurrentPaneResolver interface {
98		CurrentPaneID(ctx context.Context) (string, error)
99	}
100	
101	// Activator is the optional interactive half of opening a runtime surface.
102	// Open deliberately remains detached so creation commands can run in the
103	// background. Navigation commands call Activate after their own terminal UI
104	// has been torn down: inside a multiplexer this switches the current client;
105	// outside it attaches a new client and blocks until the user detaches.
106	type Activator interface {
107		Activate(ctx context.Context, handle string) error
108	}
109	
110	// PaneRunner is the optional exact-pane command surface. The command is shell
111	// text for the pane's existing interactive shell, not argv for a child process
112	// started by dev. Implementations must not include command text in errors.
113	type PaneRunner interface {
114		RunInPane(ctx context.Context, paneID, command string) error
115	}
116	
117	// Runtime is the contract every backend satisfies. Adapters must degrade
118	// gracefully: an unavailable backend returns errors rather than panicking, and
119	// List on an idle backend returns an empty slice, not an error.
120	type Runtime interface {
121		// Name is the backend identifier used in config and in `dev doctor`.
122		Name() string
123		// Available reports whether this backend can be used on this machine right
124		// now (binary installed and, where relevant, a server reachable).
125		Available() bool
126		// Open makes dir live. Its result distinguishes a newly created surface from
127		// a reused one and may carry a root pane proven by that same create response.
128		Open(ctx context.Context, dir, label string) (OpenResult, error)
129		// Close ends the session without touching the checkout, the branch or the
130		// task entry.
131		Close(ctx context.Context, handle string) error
132		// List enumerates live sessions.
133		List(ctx context.Context) ([]Session, error)
134		// Annotate attaches display-only metadata to a session (state, next
135		// action). Backends without a metadata channel implement this as a no-op.
136		Annotate(ctx context.Context, handle string, kv map[string]string) error
137	}
138	
139	// WorktreeOpener is implemented by backends that understand git worktrees and
140	// can present one as a first-class session grouped under its parent repo.
141	// dev always creates the worktree itself — this only surfaces it.
142	type WorktreeOpener interface {
143		OpenWorktree(ctx context.Context, path, label string) (OpenResult, error)
144	}
145	
146	// ErrUnavailable reports a backend that is not usable on this machine.
147	type ErrUnavailable struct{ Backend, Reason string }
148	
149	func (e *ErrUnavailable) Error() string {
150		return fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s unavailable: %s", e.Backend, e.Reason)
151	}
152	
153	// Select resolves a configured backend name to a Runtime.
154	//
155	// "auto" prefers the richest backend that is actually available: herdr (which
156	// models workspaces, worktrees and agent sessions), then tmux, then zellij,
157	// then None.
158	// None is always available so dev never hard-fails for lack of a multiplexer.
159	func Select(backend string) Runtime {
160		herdr, tmux, zellij, none := NewHerdr(), NewTmux(), NewZellij(), None{}
161		switch backend {
162		case "herdr":
163			return herdr
164		case "tmux":
165			return tmux
166		case "zellij":
167			return zellij
168		case "none":
169			return none
170		case "", "auto":
171			if herdr.Available() {
172				return herdr
173			}
174			if tmux.Available() {
175				return tmux
176			}
177			if zellij.Available() {
178				return zellij
179			}
180			return none
181		}
182		return none
183	}
184	
185	// All returns every backend, for `dev doctor` to report on.
186	func All() []Runtime { return []Runtime{NewHerdr(), NewTmux(), NewZellij(), None{}} }
187	
188	// haveBinary reports whether name is on PATH.
189	func haveBinary(name string) bool {
190		_, err := exec.LookPath(name)
191		return err == nil
192	}
193	
194	// runInteractive connects a multiplexer client directly to dev's terminal.
195	// Runtime protocol calls use captured stdout/stderr; attach clients must not,
196	// because they own the terminal until the user detaches.
197	func runInteractive(ctx context.Context, bin string, args ...string) error {
198		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
199		cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
200		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
201			return fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
202		}
203		return nil
204	}
205

67	func runDone(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string, opts doneOptions) error {
68		if opts.DirtyPolicy == "" {
69			opts.DirtyPolicy = doneDirtyAuto
70		}
71		switch opts.DirtyPolicy {

73		default:

75		}

77			return errors.New("--message is only used with --dirty=commit")
78		}
79	
80		resolved, err := resolveTask(app, args)

90		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) { return resolved, nil })
91		if err != nil {

93		}

262	func doneActionOptions(selected task.Task, selection doneSelection, opts doneOptions) flow.ActionOptions {
263		if selected.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
264			return flow.CompleteDirectOptions{
265				Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message, Push: opts.Push,
266			}
267		}
268		switch selection.Integration {
269		case doneIntegrationPR:
270			return flow.ReviewHandoffOptions{Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message}
271		case doneIntegrationMerged:
272			return flow.VerifyMergedOptions{
273				Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message,
274				BaseRef: opts.BaseRef, SquashCommit: opts.ConfirmSquash, PushBase: opts.Push,
275			}
276		default:
277			return flow.CompleteFFOptions{
278				Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message, PushBase: opts.Push,
279			}
280		}
281	}
282	
283	func replanDone(
284		ctx context.Context,
285		session lifecycleSession,
286		previous flow.Plan,
287		options flow.ActionOptions,
288	) (flow.Plan, error) {
289		fresh, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
290		if err != nil {
291			if errors.Is(err, flow.ErrStalePlan) {
292				return flow.Plan{}, presentDoneApplyError(flow.Result{}, err)
293			}
294			return flow.Plan{}, err
295		}
296		if changed := changedDoneAuthority(previous, fresh); changed != "" {
297			stale := &flow.StalePlanError{
298				ExpectedPlanID: previous.PlanID,
299				ActualPlanID:   fresh.PlanID,
300				Reason:         changed + " changed while the finish plan was open",
301			}
302			return flow.Plan{}, presentDoneApplyError(flow.Result{}, stale)
303		}
304		return fresh, nil
305	}
306	
307	func changedDoneAuthority(previous, fresh flow.Plan) string {
308		before := previous.AuthorityFields()
309		after := fresh.AuthorityFields()
310		keys := []string{
311			"task.revision", "task.mode", "task.state", "task.repo-path", "task.branch", "task.base", "task.worktree-path",
312			"repo.git-common-dir", "worktree.fingerprint",
313			"git.status-error", "git.branch", "git.detached", "git.upstream", "git.ahead", "git.behind",
314			"git.changed", "git.staged", "git.unstaged", "git.untracked", "git.conflicted", "git.head",
315			"git.base-oid", "git.upstream-oid", "git.operation", "git.operation-active", "git.operation-error",
316			"artifact.fingerprint", "finish.authority", "completion.base-ref", "completion.base-oid",
317			"completion.base-oid-error", "completion.expected-branch", "completion.branch-oid",
318			"runtime.backend", "runtime.available", "runtime.occupancy-fingerprint", "runtime.occupancy-error",
319		}
320		if previous.Action == fresh.Action {
321			keys = append(keys,
322				"completion.proof-ref", "completion.proof-oid", "completion.proof-oid-error",
323				"completion.proof-contained", "completion.proof-error", "completion.integration",

344	func doneFatalPreflightError(selected task.Task, plan flow.Plan) error {

348				config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), view.Status.Conflicted)
349		}
350		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionCheckoutPresent); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
351			return fmt.Errorf("%s no longer exists — resume the task first", config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath))
352		}
353		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionExplicitBase); ok &&
354			condition.Requirement == flow.RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
355			return fmt.Errorf("cannot determine the base branch for %s — pass --base when starting a task", selected.Repo)
356		}
357		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionFinishAnalysis); ok && condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictError {
358			return errors.New(condition.Evidence)
359		}
360		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionArtifactReady); ok &&
361			(condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictBlocked || condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictError) {
362			return fmt.Errorf("artifact readiness for %s is blocked: %s; finalize or discard the intent before integration",
363				config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence)
364		}
365		return nil
