368	func donePlanReadinessError(selected task.Task, plan flow.Plan, selection doneSelection) error {
369		if plan.Availability == flow.AvailabilityReady {
370			return nil
371		}
372		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionCheckoutClean); ok &&
373			condition.Requirement == flow.RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
374			switch selection.Dirty {
375			case flow.DirtyAuto, flow.DirtyFail:
376				return dirtyFinishError(selected, plan)
377			case flow.DirtyCommit:
378				if strings.TrimSpace(selection.Message) == "" {
379					return errors.New("--message is required with --dirty=commit outside an interactive terminal")
380				}
381			}
382		}
383		if plan.Action == flow.ReviewHandoff {
384			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionBranchRelation); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
385				base := doneView(plan).Base
386				return fmt.Errorf("%s is already contained in %s; use --ff to finalize cleanup instead of opening a PR",
387					selected.Branch, base)
388			}
389		}
390		if plan.Action == flow.VerifyMerged {
391			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionMergeProof); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
392				fields := plan.AuthorityFields()
393				return fmt.Errorf("cannot verify %s is contained in %s", fields["completion.proof-ref"], fields["completion.base-ref"])
394			}
395		}
396		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
397		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
398		for _, condition := range blocking {
399			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
400			if condition.Remediation != "" {
401				message += " (" + condition.Remediation + ")"
402			}
403			parts = append(parts, message)
404		}
405		if len(parts) == 0 {
406			return fmt.Errorf("finish plan is %s: %w", plan.Availability, flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
407		}
408		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability,
409			strings.Join(parts, "; "), flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
410	}

420	func renderDonePreflight(app *App, t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) {

426		switch {
427		case view.BaseOnly == 0 && view.BranchOnly == 0:
428			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already equal to %s (behind 0, ahead 0)", view.Base)))
429		case view.contained():
430			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already contained in %s (behind %d, ahead 0)", view.Base, view.BaseOnly)))
431		default:
432			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("behind %d, ahead %d relative to %s",
433				view.BaseOnly, view.BranchOnly, view.Base)))
434		}
435		if !view.Status.Dirty() {
436			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.success("clean"))
437			return
438		}
439		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.warning(view.Status.Breakdown()))
440		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s, %s\n", s.label("contents"),
441			s.success(fmt.Sprintf("%d match %s", view.Equivalent, view.Base)),
442			s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("%d unique", view.Unique)))
443		for _, change := range view.Changes {
444			marker := s.warning("unique")
445			if change.BaseEquivalent {
446				marker = s.success("matches " + view.Base)
447			}
448			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s%s %s\n", marker,
449				strings.Repeat(" ", max(0, 12-width(marker))), change.Path)
450		}
451	}

453	func confirmDonePlan(app *App, p *prompter, t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) (bool, string, error) {
454		view := doneView(plan)
455		s := app.outStyle()

462		case donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectDiscardAll):
463			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.danger("discard all staged, unstaged and untracked changes"))
464		default:
465			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.success("none"))
466		}
467		switch {
468		case plan.Action == flow.ReviewHandoff:
469			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.review("open a PR into "+view.Base))
470		case plan.Action == flow.VerifyMerged:
471			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("verify merge into "+view.Base))
472		case !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectMergeFF) && !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectRebaseBranch):
473			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("already contained in "+view.Base+"; cleanup only"))
474		default:
475			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("fast-forward into "+view.Base))
476		}
477		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
478			label := plan.Confirmation.Prompt
479			if view.Unique > 0 {
480				label = fmt.Sprintf("Type %s to discard %d unique path(s)", plan.Confirmation.Token, view.Unique)
481			}
482			value, err := p.dangerLine(label)
483			if err != nil {
484				return false, "", err
485			}
486			return value == plan.Confirmation.Token, value, nil
487		}
488		confirmed, err := p.confirm("Proceed with this finish plan?", false)
489		return confirmed, "", err
490	}

492	func presentDoneApplyError(result flow.Result, err error) error {
493		for _, step := range result.FailedSteps() {
494			switch step.Effect.Code {
495			case flow.EffectCommitAll:
496				return fmt.Errorf("commit dirty checkout: %w", err)
497			case flow.EffectDiscardAll:
498				return fmt.Errorf("discard dirty checkout: %w", err)
499			}
500		}
501		if errors.Is(err, flow.ErrStalePlan) {
502			for _, step := range result.CompletedSteps() {
503				if step.Effect.Code == flow.EffectCommitAll || step.Effect.Code == flow.EffectDiscardAll {
504					return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again during finalization; stop the active writer and rerun dev done: %w", err)
505				}
506			}
507			return fmt.Errorf("checkout or branch changed while the finish plan was open; review the new state and rerun dev done: %w", err)
508		}
509		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "changed again after") {
510			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again during finalization; stop the active writer and rerun dev done: %w", err)
511		}
512		return err
513	}

515	func renderDoneSuccess(app *App, selected, final task.Task, plan flow.Plan, result flow.Result, initial donePlanView) error {
516		switch plan.Action {
517		case flow.ReviewHandoff:
518			if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneReviewReady {
519				return fmt.Errorf("review handoff completed without the review-ready milestone")
520			}
521			if final.State != selected.State {
522				return fmt.Errorf("review handoff changed task state from %s to %s", selected.State, final.State)
523			}
524			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nREADY FOR REVIEW · runtime and worktree kept")
525			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "After merge: dev done --merged --base-ref origin/"+doneView(plan).Base)
526			return nil
527		case flow.CompleteDirect, flow.CompleteFF, flow.VerifyMerged:
528			if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneMerged || final.State != task.Done {
529				return fmt.Errorf("completion returned milestone %s and task state %s; want merged and DONE",
530					result.Milestone, final.State)
531			}
532		default:
533			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported completion result action %s", plan.Action)
534		}
535	
536		if plan.Action == flow.CompleteDirect {
537			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s completed directly on %s\n", task.Done.Icon(), final.Title(), final.Branch)
538			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   no branch or worktree was created or removed")
539			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · cleanup pending: run dev retire from outside this runtime")
540			return nil
541		}
542		view := doneView(plan)
543		if plan.Action == flow.CompleteFF && initial.contained() &&
544			!donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectRebaseBranch) && !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectMergeFF) {
545			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   already merged  %s is contained in %s\n", final.Branch, view.Base)
546		}
547		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s merged into %s\n", task.Done.Icon(), final.Title(), view.Base)
548		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · runtime and worktree kept")
549		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   cleanup pending · run `dev retire %s` from outside its workspace\n", final.ID)
550		return nil
551	}

553	func doneView(plan flow.Plan) donePlanView {
554		fields := plan.AuthorityFields()
555		view := donePlanView{
556			Base:       fields["completion.base-ref"],
557			BaseOnly:   authorityInt(fields, "finish.base-only"),
558			BranchOnly: authorityInt(fields, "finish.branch-only"),
559			Equivalent: authorityInt(fields, "finish.equivalent-dirty"),
560			Unique:     authorityInt(fields, "finish.unique-dirty"),
561			Status: gitx.Status{
562				Branch: fields["git.branch"], Upstream: fields["git.upstream"],
563				Ahead: authorityInt(fields, "git.ahead"), Behind: authorityInt(fields, "git.behind"),
564				Changed: authorityIntFirst(fields, "finish.status-changed", "git.changed"),
565				Staged:  authorityIntFirst(fields, "finish.status-staged", "git.staged"),
566				Unstaged: authorityIntFirst(fields,
567					"finish.status-unstaged", "git.unstaged"),
568				Untracked: authorityIntFirst(fields,
569					"finish.status-untracked", "git.untracked"),
570				Conflicted: authorityIntFirst(fields,
571					"finish.status-conflicted", "git.conflicted"),
572			},
573		}
574		for index := 0; index < authorityInt(fields, "finish.change-count"); index++ {
575			prefix := fmt.Sprintf("finish.change.%d.", index)
576			view.Changes = append(view.Changes, doneChangeView{
577				Path: fields[prefix+"path"], BaseEquivalent: fields[prefix+"base-equivalent"] == "true",
578			})
579		}
580		return view
581	}
582	
583	func authorityInt(fields map[string]string, key string) int {
584		value, _ := strconv.Atoi(fields[key])
585		return value
586	}
587	
588	func authorityIntFirst(fields map[string]string, keys ...string) int {
589		for _, key := range keys {
590			if _, ok := fields[key]; ok {
591				return authorityInt(fields, key)
592			}
593		}
594		return 0
595	}

597	func doneCondition(plan flow.Plan, code flow.ConditionCode) (flow.Condition, bool) {

602		}
603		return flow.Condition{}, false

559			return fresh, err
560		}
561		for _, check := range []struct {
562			name          string
563			before, after string
564		}{
565			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
566			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
567			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
568			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
569			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
570			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
571			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
572		} {
573			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
574				return fresh, err
575			}
576		}
577		if allowDiscard {
578			if err := comparePostDiscardGit(baseline, fresh); err != nil {
579				return fresh, err
580			}
581		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()); err != nil {
582			return fresh, err
583		}
584		if allowRuntimeChange {
585			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
586				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
587			}
588		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
589			return fresh, err
590		}
591		return fresh, nil
592	}

594	func comparePostDiscardGit(before, after destructiveObservation) error {
595		if after.statusErr != nil || after.status.Dirty() {
596			return staleBoundary("checkout is not clean after explicit discard")
597		}
598		beforeStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
599			before.status.Branch, boolString(before.status.Detached), before.status.Upstream,
600			fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Behind),
601			before.head, errorString(before.headErr), before.operation, boolString(before.inProgress), errorString(before.operationErr),
602		)
603		afterStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
604			after.status.Branch, boolString(after.status.Detached), after.status.Upstream,
605			fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Behind),
606			after.head, errorString(after.headErr), after.operation, boolString(after.inProgress), errorString(after.operationErr),
607		)
608		return compareAuthorityCategory("post-discard Git identity", beforeStable, afterStable)
609	}
610	
611	func (e *executionState) revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
612		records, diagnostics, err := e.tx.ListRecords()
613		if err != nil {
614			return err
615		}
616		claims := baseline
617		claims.taskRecords = records
618		claims.taskDiagnostics = diagnostics
619		claims.taskClaims = nil
620		claims.taskIncomplete = nil
621		e.service.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &claims)
622		if len(claims.taskIncomplete) > 0 {
623			return staleBoundary("task inventory became incomplete before branch deletion")
624		}
625		if len(claims.taskClaims) > 0 {
626			return staleBoundary("a task claimed the checkout path or branch before branch deletion")
627		}
628		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
629		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
630		if fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID || fresh.baseOID != baseline.baseOID ||
631			fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.baseOIDErr != nil || fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
632			return staleBoundary("branch or containment-base authority changed before branch deletion")
633		}
634		worktrees, err := e.service.gitWorktrees(ctx, baseline.repoPath)
635		if err != nil {
636			return err
637		}
638		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
639			if worktree.Branch == baseline.locator.Branch {
640				return staleBoundary("branch acquired another checkout before deletion")
641			}
642		}
643		return nil
644	}
645	
646	func (e *executionState) verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
647		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
648		if err == nil {
649			return staleBoundary("exact unmanaged checkout remains registered after removal")
650		}
651		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
652			return fmt.Errorf("verify exact unmanaged checkout removal: %w", err)
653		}
654		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
655		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, "")
656		if !fresh.branchExists || fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID {
657			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("preserved local branch changed from %s to %s", baseline.branchOID, fresh.branchOID))
658		}
659		return nil
660	}

32	func (s *lifecycleService) planRetire(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
33		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		if err := validateRetireLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
37			return PlanSpec{}, err
38		}
39		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
40		if err != nil {
41			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
42		}
43		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, *record); err != nil {
44			return PlanSpec{}, err
45		}
46		spec, _, err := s.observeRetire(ctx, request, *record, s.tasks.ListRecords)
47		if err != nil {
48			return PlanSpec{}, err
49		}
50		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
51		if err != nil {
52			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning retirement"}
53		}
54		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
55			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning retirement")
56		}
57		return spec, nil
58	}

22	func newRetireCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
23		var (
24			closeUnknown    bool
25			assumeNoRuntime bool
26			deleteBranch    bool
27			timeout         time.Duration
28		)
29		cmd := &cobra.Command{
30			Use:   "retire [task-or-worktree]",
31			Short: "Close runtime state and safely remove an integrated worktree",
32			Long: `Retire local execution state after a change has been integrated.
33	
34	Run this from outside the target worktree and runtime. dev re-resolves every
35	covering session, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, waits for
36	runtime closure, revalidates Git state, and only then removes a linked worktree
37	without force. A task is deleted only after every requested cleanup step works.
38	
39	Unknown runtime status fails closed. An external coordinator may acknowledge it
40	with --close-unknown; working, blocked and waiting agents are never overridden.`,
41			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
42			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
43				ctx := ctxOf()
44				target, err := resolveRetireCommandTarget(ctx, app, args)
45				if err != nil {
46					return err
47				}
48				if target.Task != nil {
49					return retireTaskWithTaskflow(ctx, app, target.Task, flow.RetireOptions{
50						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime,
51						DeleteBranch: deleteBranch, Timeout: timeout,
52					}, cmd.Flags().Changed("delete-branch") && deleteBranch)
53				}
54				return retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility(ctx, app, target.Path, closeUnknown,
55					assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranch, timeout)
56			},
57		}
58		f := cmd.Flags()
59		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow an external caller to close unknown/empty runtime status")
60		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails (external callers only)")
61		f.BoolVar(&deleteBranch, "delete-branch", false, "delete the contained local branch after worktree removal")
62		f.DurationVar(&timeout, "timeout", 5*time.Second, "maximum time to wait for runtime sessions to close")
63		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Done)
64		return cmd
65	}
66	
67	func resolveRetireCommandTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (retireCommandTarget, error) {
68		if len(args) == 1 {
69			expanded := config.Expand(args[0])
70			if info, statErr := os.Stat(expanded); statErr == nil && info.IsDir() {
71				return retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx, app, expanded)
72			}
73			candidate, err := app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
74			if err != nil {
75				return retireCommandTarget{}, err
76			}
77			return retireCommandTarget{Task: candidate}, nil
78		}
79	
80		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
81		if err != nil {
82			return retireCommandTarget{}, err
83		}
84		return retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx, app, cwd)
85	}
86	
87	func retireCommandTargetForPath(ctx context.Context, app *App, path string) (retireCommandTarget, error) {
88		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
89		if err != nil {
90			return retireCommandTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
91		}
92		candidate, err := exactTaskForRetirementCheckout(app, repository.Root)
93		if err != nil {
94			return retireCommandTarget{}, err
95		}
96		if candidate != nil {
97			return retireCommandTarget{Task: candidate}, nil
98		}
99		return retireCommandTarget{Path: repository.Root}, nil
100	}
101	
102	func exactTaskForRetirementCheckout(app *App, checkout string) (*task.Task, error) {
103		canonicalCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize retirement checkout %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
106		}
107		records, _, err := app.Tasks.ListRecords()
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111		var matched *task.Task
112		for _, record := range records {
113			candidate := record.Task
114			if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == "" {
115				// A COLD/DONE worktree task with no checkout does not claim the
116				// canonical repository merely because checkoutOf falls back there.
117				continue
118			}
119			candidateCheckout, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(checkoutOf(&candidate))
120			if canonicalErr != nil || candidateCheckout != canonicalCheckout {
121				continue
122			}
123			if matched != nil {
124				return nil, fmt.Errorf("checkout %s is claimed by multiple tasks (%s, %s); name one explicitly or reconcile task metadata",
125					config.Contract(canonicalCheckout), matched.ID, candidate.ID)
126			}
127			matched = &candidate
128		}
129		return matched, nil
130	}
131	
132	func retireTaskWithTaskflow(
133		ctx context.Context,
134		app *App,
135		selected *task.Task,
136		options flow.RetireOptions,
137		authorizeBranchDeletion bool,
138	) error {
139		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) { return selected, nil })
140		if err != nil {
141			return err
142		}
143		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
144		if err != nil {
145			return err
146		}
147		approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
148		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
149			if !authorizeBranchDeletion {
150				return fmt.Errorf("%s requires its exact typed confirmation", plan.Summary)
151			}
152			approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
153		}
154		result, applyErr := session.apply(ctx, plan, approval)
155		if applyErr != nil {
156			renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
157			return presentLifecycleApplyError(plan, applyErr)
158		}
159		if err := session.requireRetired(app, result); err != nil {
160			return err
161		}
162	
163		style := app.outStyle()
164		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", style.success("RETIRED"), config.Contract(checkoutOf(selected)))
165		renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
166		return nil
167	}
168	
169	// retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility preserves the contained-only path contract
170	// while routing every mutation through taskflow's exact unmanaged transaction.
171	func retireUnmanagedPathCompatibility(
172		ctx context.Context,
173		app *App,
174		path string,
175		closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, deleteBranch bool,
176		timeout time.Duration,
177	) error {
178		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
179		if err != nil {
180			return fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
181		}
182		if !repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
183			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a linked worktree; retire explicit paths only from their linked checkout", config.Contract(path))
184		}
185		locator, err := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, repository.Root)
186		if err != nil {
187			return err
188		}
189		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.MainRoot)
190		if base == "" {
191			return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove unmanaged retirement without an explicit repository default branch")
192		}
193		execution, err := executeNonTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
194			RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base, DeleteContainedBranch: deleteBranch,
195			CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
196		}, deleteBranch)
197		if err != nil {
198			return err
199		}
200		if execution.Result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneNone {
201			return fmt.Errorf("unmanaged retirement returned unexpected milestone %s", execution.Result.Milestone)
202		}
203		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", app.outStyle().success("RETIRED"), config.Contract(locator.CheckoutPath))
204		return nil
205	}

14	func newParkCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
15		var (
16			next            string
17			note            string
18			wip             bool
19			push            bool
20			cold            bool
21			keepRT          bool
22			closeUnknown    bool
23			assumeNoRuntime bool
24			timeout         time.Duration
25		)
26		cmd := &cobra.Command{
27			Use:   "park [task]",
28			Short: "Stop working on a task without losing the thread",
29			Long: `Park the current task (or the one named) so its runtime session can close.
30	
31	Parking is the missing move that makes a crowded sidebar shrink. It records
32	what to do next, optionally checkpoints uncommitted work, and closes the
33	runtime session — while leaving the branch and the worktree exactly where they
34	are. Closing a session is not abandoning a task.
35	
36	  warm (default)  worktree and branch stay; session closes. Back within days.
37	  cold (--cold)   work is committed and pushed, session closed, worktree
38	                  removed. Reconstruct it anywhere later with dev resume.
39	
40	--cold and --keep-session are incompatible: a runtime cannot stay pointed at a
41	checkout that cold parking removes.
42	
43	A checkpoint commit is preferred over git stash: a stash is invisible in the
44	log, easy to forget, and cannot be pushed — so it can never reach another
45	machine, which is exactly what parking needs to support.`,
46			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
47			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
48				ctx := ctxOf()
49				if cold && keepRT {
50					return fmt.Errorf("--cold and --keep-session cannot be combined: a session must not remain pointed at a removed checkout")
51				}
52	
53				var options taskflow.ActionOptions
54				if cold {
55					options = taskflow.ParkColdOptions{
56						Next: next, Note: note, CommitWIP: wip, Push: push,
57						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
58					}
59				} else {
60					options = taskflow.ParkWarmOptions{
61						Next: next, Note: note, CommitWIP: wip, Push: push, KeepSession: keepRT,
62						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
63					}
64				}
65				execution, err := executeTaskLifecycle(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
66					return resolveTask(app, args)
67				}, options)
68				if err != nil {
69					return err
70				}
71	
72				parked := &execution.Task
73				style := app.outStyle()
74				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s is %s", parked.State.Icon(), parked.Title(),
75					style.taskStateFor(string(parked.State), parked.State.Label()))
76				if parked.Next != "" {
77					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, " — %s %s", style.label("next:"), parked.Next)
78				}
79				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out)
80				return nil
81			},
82		}
83		f := cmd.Flags()
84		f.StringVarP(&next, "next", "n", "", "what to do when you come back")
85		f.StringVar(&note, "note", "", "free-form note")
86		f.BoolVar(&wip, "wip", false, "checkpoint uncommitted work as a wip: commit")
87		f.BoolVar(&push, "push", false, "push the branch so another machine can pick it up")
88		f.BoolVar(&cold, "cold", false, "go cold: remove the worktree after confirming everything is pushed")
89		f.BoolVar(&keepRT, "keep-session", false, "leave the runtime session open")
90		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow external closure of unknown runtime status")
91		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails")
92		f.DurationVar(&timeout, "timeout", 5*time.Second, "maximum time to wait for runtime closure")
93		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Hot, task.Warm)
94		return cmd
95	}
96	
97	// resolveTask picks the task an argument names, or infers it from the current
98	// directory when no argument is given.
99	func resolveTask(app *App, args []string) (*task.Task, error) {
100		if len(args) == 1 {
101			return app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
102		}
103		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, err
106		}
107		t, err := app.Tasks.FindByWorktree(cwd)
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no task for %s — name one explicitly, or run this inside a task's checkout",
110				config.Contract(cwd))
111		}
112		return t, nil
113	}

18	const worktreeLong = `Manage the linked worktrees dev owns.
19	
20	Who owns which worktree — the rule dev encodes, so nobody has to improvise:
21	
22	  dev            anything you might come back to tomorrow: features, fixes,
23	                 experiments, cross-machine handoffs. Placed at
24	                 paths.worktree_path, outside the repo.
25	  Claude Code    harness-owned turn-scoped subagent isolation in
26	                 .claude/worktrees/ (keep that gitignored); not a history
27	                 relocation guarantee.
28	  herdr          dev does not call "herdr worktree create". It creates the
29	                 worktree with git and asks herdr to open it, so the path
30	                 policy holds on machines without herdr too.
31	
32	A new worktree is a clean checkout: no node_modules, no .venv, none of the
33	gitignored env files the project needs. dev provisions it — see the config's
34	[worktree] section, or a repo's own .dev-cli/config.toml.`

36	func newLifecycleSession(ctx context.Context, app *App, resolve lifecycleTaskResolver) (lifecycleSession, error) {
37		var session lifecycleSession

122	// exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator converts a branch-selected checkout into the

124	// Git registry evidence supplies every authority field used by the plan.
125	func exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx context.Context, repoPath, checkoutPath string) (flow.Locator, error) {
126		registered, err := gitx.ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx, repoPath, checkoutPath)
127		if err != nil {
128			return flow.Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve exact registered worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(checkoutPath), err)
129		}
130		return flow.Locator{
131			RepoKey:      registered.GitCommonDir,
132			RowKey:       registered.Path,
133			RowKind:      "unmanaged",
134			RepositoryID: registered.GitCommonDir,
135			GitCommonDir: registered.GitCommonDir,
136			RepoPath:     registered.RepositoryPath,
137			CheckoutPath: registered.Path,
138			Branch:       registered.Worktree.Branch,
139			HeadOID:      registered.Worktree.Head,
140		}, nil
141	}

203	func renderLifecycleResult(app *App, plan flow.Plan, result flow.Result) {
204		style := app.outStyle()
205		for _, step := range result.AttemptedSteps() {
206			if step.Status == flow.StepFailed {
207				label := step.Effect.Description
208				if label == "" {
209					label = string(step.Effect.Code)
210				}
211				failure := step.Failure
212				if failure == "" {
213					failure = "operation failed"
214				}
215				app.warnf("%s failed: %s", label, failure)
216				continue
217			}
218			if step.Status != flow.StepCompleted {
219				continue
220			}
221	
222			details := step.Effect.Details.Map()
223			switch step.Effect.Code {
224			case flow.EffectCommitWIP, flow.EffectCommitAll:
225				message := details["message"]
226				if message == "" {
227					message = step.Detail
228				}
229				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("committed"), message)
230			case flow.EffectDiscardAll:
231				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  checkout changes\n", style.label("discarded"))
232			case flow.EffectPushBranch, flow.EffectPushBase:
233				pushed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "pushed ")
234				pushed = strings.TrimPrefix(pushed, "published ")
235				if pushed == step.Detail || pushed == "" {
236					pushed = "origin/" + step.Effect.Target
237				}
238				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("pushed"), pushed)
239			case flow.EffectCloseRuntime:
240				closed := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "closed ")
241				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("closed"), closed)
242			case flow.EffectRemoveWorktree:
243				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s removed: %s\n", style.label("worktree"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
244			case flow.EffectDeleteBranch:
245				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s deleted\n", style.label("branch"), step.Effect.Target)
246			case flow.EffectDeleteTask:
247				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s reaped\n", style.label("task"), step.Effect.Target)
248			case flow.EffectRebaseBranch:
249				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebased"), strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "rebased "))
250			case flow.EffectSwitchBase, flow.EffectSwitchBranch:
251				switched := strings.TrimPrefix(step.Detail, "switched ")
252				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("switched"), switched)
253			case flow.EffectMergeFF:
254				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", style.label("integrated"), step.Detail)
255			case flow.EffectCreateReview:
256				if handoff, ok := result.Handoff(); ok && handoff.Kind == flow.HandoffURL && handoff.URL != "" {
257					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s\n", style.label("opened"), handoff.URL)
258				}
259			case flow.EffectVerifyAncestry:
260				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("verified"), step.Detail)
261			case flow.EffectUpdateTask:
262				if isCompletionAction(plan.Action) {
263					state := details["state"]
264					if state == "" {
265						state = "lifecycle state"
266					}
267					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s   %s\n", style.label("recorded"), strings.ToUpper(state))
268				}
269			case flow.EffectCreateWorktree:
270				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", style.label("rebuilt"), config.Contract(step.Effect.Target))
271			}
272		}
273		for _, warning := range result.Warnings() {
274			switch warning {
275			case "no next action is recorded":
276				app.warnf("no next action recorded — `dev park --next \"...\"` is what makes resuming cheap")
277			default:
278				app.warnf("%s", warning)
279			}
280		}
281		for _, recovery := range result.Recovery() {
282			app.warnf("recovery: %s", recovery)
283		}
284	}
285	
286	func isCompletionAction(action flow.Action) bool {
287		switch action {
288		case flow.CompleteDirect, flow.CompleteFF, flow.ReviewHandoff, flow.VerifyMerged:
289			return true
290		default:
291			return false
292		}
293	}
294	
295	func presentLifecycleRequestError(selected task.Task, action flow.Action, err error) error {
296		var transition *flow.InvalidTransitionError
297		if !errors.As(err, &transition) {
298			return err
299		}
300		if action == flow.ParkCold && selected.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
301			return fmt.Errorf("direct task %s uses the canonical checkout on %s, so it cannot go cold; park it warm or finish it: %w",
302				selected.Title(), selected.Branch, err)
303		}
304		if action == flow.Retire {
305			return fmt.Errorf("task %s is %s, not merged; run dev done first: %w", selected.ID, selected.State, err)
306		}
307		return err
308	}
309	
310	func presentLifecycleApplyError(plan flow.Plan, err error) error {
311		if !errors.Is(err, flow.ErrPlanNotReady) {
312			return err
313		}
314		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
315		for _, condition := range blocking {
316			switch condition.Code {
317			case flow.ConditionCheckoutClean:
318				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
319					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes (%s).\nCommit them, or re-run with --force to discard them: %w",
320						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
321				}
322				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
323					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes; going cold removes the worktree.\nCommit them, or re-run with --wip to checkpoint automatically: %w",
324						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), err)
325				}
326			case flow.ConditionBranchPublished, flow.ConditionBranchPushed:
327				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
328					return fmt.Errorf("%s is not fully pushed (%s); a cold task must be reconstructible from the remote.\nRun `dev park --cold --push`: %w",
329						plan.Locator.Branch, condition.Evidence, err)
330				}
331			case flow.ConditionTaskClaims:
332				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
333					return fmt.Errorf("%s is claimed by task metadata (%s).\nUse managed dev park/dev retire, or reconcile the task claim before removing this checkout: %w",
334						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
335				}
336			case flow.ConditionTaskInventory:
337				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
338					return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove %s is unmanaged because task inventory is incomplete (%s).\nRepair or reconcile task metadata before using dev park/dev retire or removing this checkout: %w",
339						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
340				}
341			case flow.ConditionOwner:
342				if plan.Action == flow.Resume {
343					owner := plan.AuthorityFields()["task.owner"]
344					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is owned by %s.\nMake sure that machine has pushed its work, then re-run with --force to take ownership: %w",
345						plan.Locator.TaskID, owner, err)
346				}
347			case flow.ConditionAgentOccupancy:
348				if plan.Action == flow.Resume && strings.HasPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ") {
349					occupant := strings.TrimPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ")
350					return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership: %w",
351						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), occupant, err)
352				}
353			}
354		}
355	
356		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
357		for _, condition := range blocking {
358			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
359			if condition.Remediation != "" {
360				message += " (" + condition.Remediation + ")"
361			}
362			parts = append(parts, message)
363		}
364		if len(parts) == 0 {
365			return err
366		}
367		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability, strings.Join(parts, "; "), err)
368	}

606			after.head, errorString(after.headErr), after.operation, boolString(after.inProgress), errorString(after.operationErr),
607		)
608		return compareAuthorityCategory("post-discard Git identity", beforeStable, afterStable)
609	}

611	func (e *executionState) revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
612		records, diagnostics, err := e.tx.ListRecords()
613		if err != nil {
614			return err
615		}
616		claims := baseline
617		claims.taskRecords = records
618		claims.taskDiagnostics = diagnostics
619		claims.taskClaims = nil
620		claims.taskIncomplete = nil
621		e.service.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &claims)
622		if len(claims.taskIncomplete) > 0 {
623			return staleBoundary("task inventory became incomplete before branch deletion")
624		}
625		if len(claims.taskClaims) > 0 {
626			return staleBoundary("a task claimed the checkout path or branch before branch deletion")
627		}
628		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
629		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
630		if fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID || fresh.baseOID != baseline.baseOID ||
631			fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.baseOIDErr != nil || fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
632			return staleBoundary("branch or containment-base authority changed before branch deletion")
633		}
634		worktrees, err := e.service.gitWorktrees(ctx, baseline.repoPath)
635		if err != nil {
636			return err
637		}
638		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
639			if worktree.Branch == baseline.locator.Branch {
640				return staleBoundary("branch acquired another checkout before deletion")
641			}
642		}
643		return nil
644	}
645	
646	func (e *executionState) verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
647		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
648		if err == nil {
649			return staleBoundary("exact unmanaged checkout remains registered after removal")
650		}
651		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
652			return fmt.Errorf("verify exact unmanaged checkout removal: %w", err)
653		}
654		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
655		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, "")
656		if !fresh.branchExists || fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID {
657			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("preserved local branch changed from %s to %s", baseline.branchOID, fresh.branchOID))
658		}
659		return nil
660	}

443			rt = s.namedRuntime(candidate.RuntimeName)
444			if rt == nil {
445				return nil, fmt.Errorf("recorded runtime backend %q is unavailable", candidate.RuntimeName)
446			}

450		} else {

452		}
453		if rt == nil || strings.TrimSpace(rt.Name()) == "" {
454			return nil, errors.New("taskflow runtime resolver returned no backend")
455		}
456		return rt, nil

459	func openRuntimeSurface(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, path, label string) (runtime.OpenResult, error) {

462		}

464			return worktreeRuntime.OpenWorktree(ctx, path, label)
465		}
466		return rt.Open(ctx, path, label)
467	}

209	func adoptStrictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
210		if occupancyErr := strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err); occupancyErr != nil {
211			return occupancyErr
212		}
213		var blockers []string
214		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
215			// OccupancySession.Panes contains only panes whose live cwd covers the
216			// checkout. A mixed session may also host an unrelated agent elsewhere;
217			// that agent is not a writer claim on this checkout.
218			for _, pane := range session.Panes {
219				if strings.TrimSpace(pane.Agent) == "" && strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentSession) == "" {
220					continue
221				}
222				if occupancy.CallerPaneID != "" && pane.ID == occupancy.CallerPaneID {
223					continue
224				}
225				status := strings.TrimSpace(pane.AgentStatus)
226				if status == "" {
227					status = "unknown"
228				}
229				blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent pane %s (%s)", pane.ID, status))
230			}
231		}
232		if len(blockers) > 0 {
233			return fmt.Errorf("checkout is occupied by %s", strings.Join(blockers, ", "))
234		}
235		return nil
236	}

239		if strings.TrimSpace(session.Runtime.AgentStatus) != "" || len(session.Runtime.AgentSessions) != 0 {
240			return false
241		}
242		panes := session.Runtime.Panes

248				return false

251		return true
252	}

1	package taskflow
2	
3	import "github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
4	
5	// TransitionRule is one cell in the exhaustive persisted lifecycle table. An
6	// empty Target on an allowed rule means the task record is removed rather than
7	// assigned another persisted state.
8	type TransitionRule struct {
9		Mode            task.CheckoutMode
10		Source          task.State
11		Action          Action
12		Target          task.State
13		Allowed         bool
14		StatePreserving bool
15		RemovesTask     bool
16		Milestone       Milestone
17		Reason          string
18	}
19	
20	// HasTarget reports whether an allowed edge writes a persisted target state.
21	func (r TransitionRule) HasTarget() bool { return r.Allowed && r.Target != "" }
22	
23	type transitionKey struct {
24		mode   task.CheckoutMode
25		state  task.State
26		action Action
27	}
28	
29	var (
30		modeOrder = []task.CheckoutMode{
31			task.ModeWorktree,
32			task.ModeBranch,
33			task.ModeDirect,
34		}
35		stateOrder = []task.State{
36			task.Hot,
37			task.Warm,
38			task.Cold,
39			task.Done,
40		}
41		transitionActionOrder = []Action{
42			ParkWarm,
43			ParkCold,
44			Resume,
45			CompleteDirect,
46			CompleteFF,
47			ReviewHandoff,
48			VerifyMerged,
49			Retire,
50		}
51		transitionTable = buildTransitionTable()
52	)
53	
54	// TransitionActions returns the actions represented in every mode/state row.
55	// Adopt, RemoveCheckout, RefreshRemote, and Reconcile are deliberately absent
56	// because they operate on row ownership, repository context, or drift rather
57	// than persisted-state edges.
58	func TransitionActions() []Action {
59		return append([]Action(nil), transitionActionOrder...)
60	}
61	
62	// PersistedLifecycleActions is the stable action dimension of the lifecycle
63	// table, including state-preserving review handoff but excluding repository
64	// context actions such as remote refresh.
65	func PersistedLifecycleActions() []Action { return TransitionActions() }
66	
67	// Transitions returns all table cells in mode, state, and action order. Denied
68	// cells are retained so additions cannot silently fall through a switch.
69	func Transitions() []TransitionRule {
70		out := make([]TransitionRule, 0, len(modeOrder)*len(stateOrder)*len(transitionActionOrder))
71		for _, mode := range modeOrder {
72			for _, state := range stateOrder {
73				for _, action := range transitionActionOrder {
74					out = append(out, transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: state, action: action}])
75				}
76			}
77		}
78		return out
79	}
80	
81	// LookupTransition returns the exhaustive table cell for known dimensions.
82	func LookupTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, bool) {
83		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(source) || !isTransitionAction(action) {
84			return TransitionRule{Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action}, false
85		}
86		rule, ok := transitionTable[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}]
87		return rule, ok
88	}
89	
90	// RequireTransition returns the allowed table cell or a typed graph error.
91	func RequireTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) (TransitionRule, error) {
92		rule, found := LookupTransition(mode, source, action)
93		if !found {
94			rule.Reason = "unknown mode, state, or non-transition action"
95			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
96		}
97		if !rule.Allowed {
98			return rule, &InvalidTransitionError{Rule: rule}
99		}
100		return rule, nil
101	}
102	
103	func isTransitionAction(action Action) bool {
104		for _, candidate := range transitionActionOrder {
105			if action == candidate {
106				return true
107			}
108		}
109		return false
110	}
111	
112	func validMode(mode task.CheckoutMode) bool {
113		for _, candidate := range modeOrder {
114			if mode == candidate {
115				return true
116			}
117		}
118		return false
119	}
120	
121	func validState(state task.State) bool {
122		for _, candidate := range stateOrder {
123			if state == candidate {
124				return true
125			}
126		}
127		return false
128	}
129	
130	func buildTransitionTable() map[transitionKey]TransitionRule {
131		table := make(map[transitionKey]TransitionRule, len(modeOrder)*len(stateOrder)*len(transitionActionOrder))
132		for _, mode := range modeOrder {
133			for _, source := range stateOrder {
134				for _, action := range transitionActionOrder {
135					rule := TransitionRule{
136						Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action,
137						Reason: deniedTransitionReason(mode, source, action),
138					}
139					table[transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}] = rule
140				}
141			}
142		}
143	
144		allow := func(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action, target task.State, preserving, removes bool, milestone Milestone) {
145			key := transitionKey{mode: mode, state: source, action: action}
146			table[key] = TransitionRule{
147				Mode: mode, Source: source, Action: action, Target: target,
148				Allowed: true, StatePreserving: preserving, RemovesTask: removes,
149				Milestone: milestone,
150			}
151		}
152	
153		for _, mode := range []task.CheckoutMode{task.ModeWorktree, task.ModeBranch} {
154			allow(mode, task.Hot, ParkWarm, task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
155			// Existing park accepts WARM tasks so it can update parking metadata and
156			// close a residual runtime without manufacturing a backward transition.
157			allow(mode, task.Warm, ParkWarm, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
158			allow(mode, task.Hot, ParkCold, task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
159			allow(mode, task.Warm, ParkCold, task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
160			allow(mode, task.Warm, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
161			allow(mode, task.Cold, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
162			allow(mode, task.Hot, CompleteFF, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
163			allow(mode, task.Warm, CompleteFF, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
164			allow(mode, task.Hot, VerifyMerged, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
165			allow(mode, task.Warm, VerifyMerged, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
166			allow(mode, task.Hot, ReviewHandoff, task.Hot, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
167			allow(mode, task.Warm, ReviewHandoff, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
168			allow(mode, task.Done, Retire, "", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
169		}
170	
171		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, ParkWarm, task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
172		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, ParkWarm, task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
173		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, Resume, task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
174		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, CompleteDirect, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
175		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, CompleteDirect, task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
176		allow(task.ModeDirect, task.Done, Retire, "", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
177	
178		return table
179	}
180	
181	func deniedTransitionReason(mode task.CheckoutMode, source task.State, action Action) string {
182		if mode == task.ModeDirect && source == task.Cold {
183			return "direct tasks cannot be COLD"
184		}
185		if action == ParkCold && mode == task.ModeDirect {
186			return "direct tasks use the canonical checkout and cannot be parked COLD"
187		}
188		if source == task.Done {
189			return "DONE tasks can only be retired through the persisted lifecycle graph"
190		}
191		if source == task.Cold {
192			return "COLD tasks must resume before any completion or review action"
193		}
194		if action == CompleteDirect && mode != task.ModeDirect {
195			return "direct completion is only valid for direct tasks"
196		}
197		if (action == CompleteFF || action == ReviewHandoff || action == VerifyMerged) && mode == task.ModeDirect {
198			return "direct tasks have no separate branch to integrate or hand off"
199		}
200		return "the edge is not in the approved lifecycle graph"
201	}

255	func (e *executionState) run(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error)) error {
256		step := StepResult{Effect: effect.Clone(), Status: StepAttempted, StartedAt: e.service.now()}
257		detail, err := operation()
258		step.FinishedAt = e.service.now()
259		step.Detail = detail
260		if err != nil {
261			step.Status = StepFailed
262			step.Failure = err.Error()
263			e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
264			return err
265		}
266		step.Status = StepCompleted
267		e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
268		return nil
269	}

278	func (e *executionState) result() Result {
279		spec := ResultSpec{
280			Steps: e.steps, Warnings: e.warnings, Recovery: e.recovery,
281			PartialSuccess: e.partial,
282			Milestone:      e.milestone, Handoff: e.handoff, Remote: e.remote, FreshSnapshotRef: e.snapshot,
283		}
284		for _, step := range e.steps {
285			if step.Status == StepCompleted {
286				spec.PartialSuccess = true
287				break
288			}
289		}
290		if len(e.steps) > 0 && e.steps[len(e.steps)-1].Status == StepCompleted &&
291			(e.snapshot != "" || e.remote != nil) && len(e.recovery) == 0 {
292			// Successful completion is not partial merely because it had effects.
293			// Remote refresh is intentionally run-local and therefore completes with
294			// structured data rather than a persisted snapshot reference.
295			spec.PartialSuccess = false
296		}
297		return NewResult(spec)
298	}
299	
300	func (e *executionState) fail(err error, recovery ...string) (Result, error) {
301		e.recovery = append(e.recovery, recovery...)
302		return e.result(), err
303	}

341		}

477	func occupancyProbeError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
478		if err != nil {
479			return err
480		}
481		if occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
482			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current %s runtime pane: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.CurrentPane.Err)
483		}
484		if occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
485			return fmt.Errorf("classify %s checkout coverage: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.SessionCoverageErr)
486		}
487		if occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil {
488			return fmt.Errorf("list %s runtime sessions: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.SessionList.Err)
489		}
490		if occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
491			return fmt.Errorf("list %s recognized agents: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err)
492		}
493		return nil
494	}
495	
496	func occupancyObservationError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
497		if probeErr := occupancyProbeError(occupancy, err); probeErr != nil {
498			return probeErr
499		}
500		if !occupancy.SessionList.Observed() {
501			return fmt.Errorf("%s runtime session inventory is unsupported or was not attempted", occupancy.Backend)
502		}
503		if occupancy.AgentActivityList.Supported && !occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed() {
504			return fmt.Errorf("%s recognized-agent inventory was not attempted", occupancy.Backend)
505		}
506		if !occupancy.AgentActivityList.Supported && len(occupancy.Sessions) > 0 && len(occupancy.Agents) == 0 {
507			return fmt.Errorf("%s has covering runtime sessions but cannot observe recognized-agent activity", occupancy.Backend)
508		}
509		return nil
510	}
511	
512	func occupancyObservationIncomplete(occupancy runtime.Occupancy) bool {
513		return !occupancy.SessionList.Observed() ||
514			(occupancy.AgentActivityList.Supported && !occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed()) ||
515			(!occupancy.AgentActivityList.Supported && len(occupancy.Sessions) > 0 && len(occupancy.Agents) == 0)
516	}
517	
518	func strictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
519		if observationErr := occupancyObservationError(occupancy, err); observationErr != nil {
520			return observationErr
521		}
522		var blockers []string
523		for _, agent := range occupancy.Agents {
524			if !agent.Blocking {
525				continue
526			}
527			label := agent.Activity.Name
528			if label == "" {
529				label = agent.Activity.Agent
530			}
531			if label == "" {
532				label = "agent"
533			}
534			blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, agent.Activity.PaneID))
535		}
536		if len(blockers) > 0 {
537			return fmt.Errorf("checkout is occupied by %s", strings.Join(blockers, ", "))
538		}
539		return nil
540	}
541	
542	func (s *lifecycleService) writerOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
543		if s.allowSharedCheckout {
544			return occupancyProbeError(occupancy, err)
545		}
546		return strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err)
547	}
548	
549	func savedHandleLive(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, handle string) bool {
550		if handle == "" {
551			return false
552		}
553		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
554			if session.Runtime.Handle == handle {
555				return true
556			}
557		}
558		return false
559	}

561	func staleBoundary(reason string) error {
562		return &StalePlanError{Reason: reason}
563	}
564	
565	func isWorktreeNotFound(err error) bool { return errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) }

567	func contextError(ctx context.Context) error {
568		if ctx == nil {
569			return errors.New("taskflow context is nil")
570		}
571		return ctx.Err()
572	}

659	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectIntegrationTarget(
660		ctx context.Context,
661		observed *lifecycleObservation,
662	) (completionIntegrationObservation, error) {
663		var fresh completionIntegrationObservation
664		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
665		fresh.worktree, fresh.worktreeErr = registered, err
666		if err != nil {
667			return fresh, err
668		}
669		fresh.worktreeFound = true
670		if registered.Path != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
671			!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare {
672			return fresh, errors.New("integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout")
673		}
674		fresh.status, fresh.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
675		if fresh.statusErr != nil {
676			return fresh, fresh.statusErr
677		}
678		if fresh.status.Dirty() || fresh.status.Conflicted > 0 {
679			return fresh, fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout is not clean: %s", fresh.status.Breakdown())
680		}
681		fresh.head, fresh.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
682		if fresh.headErr != nil {
683			return fresh, fresh.headErr
684		}
685		fresh.head = strings.TrimSpace(fresh.head)
686		if registered.Worktree.Head != fresh.head {
687			return fresh, errors.New("canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD")
688		}
689		fresh.operation, fresh.inProgress, fresh.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
690		if fresh.operationErr != nil {
691			return fresh, fresh.operationErr
692		}
693		if fresh.inProgress {
694			return fresh, errors.New("canonical integration checkout has Git operation " + fresh.operation + " in progress")
695		}
696		fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
697			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
698			CallerWorkspaceID: observed.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
699			CallerPaneID:      observed.taskflowCallerPane,
700		})
701		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr); occupancyErr != nil {
702			return fresh, occupancyErr
703		}
704		return fresh, nil
705	}

17	func isCompletionAction(action Action) bool {
18		switch action {
19		case CompleteDirect, CompleteFF, ReviewHandoff, VerifyMerged:
20			return true
21		default:
22			return false
23		}
24	}

26	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCompletionFacts(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
27		observed.completionBranch = observed.task.Branch
28		if observed.hasCheckout() && observed.headErr == nil {
29			observed.completionBranchOID = observed.head
30		}
31		if observed.completionBaseRef != "" {
32			observed.completionBaseOID, observed.completionBaseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(
33				ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef,
34			)
35		}
36		if observed.hasCheckout() {
37			observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
38			if observed.completionBaseRef != "" {
39				observed.finish, observed.finishErr = s.analyzeFinish(
40					ctx, observed.checkout, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.task.Branch,
41				)
42			}
43		}
44	
45		switch request.Action {
46		case CompleteFF:
47			s.observeIntegrationFacts(ctx, observed)
48		case ReviewHandoff:
49			observed.reviewRemoteURL = strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, "origin"))
50			identityKind, identity := forge.IdentityFromURL(observed.reviewRemoteURL)
51			observed.reviewKind = s.detectForge(ctx, observed.repoPath)
52			if identityKind != forge.Unknown {
53				if observed.reviewKind != forge.Unknown && observed.reviewKind != identityKind {
54					observed.reviewResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("detected forge %s differs from origin identity %s", observed.reviewKind, identityKind)
55				}
56				observed.reviewKind = identityKind
57				observed.reviewRepository = identity
58			}
59			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil {
60				observed.reviewProvider, observed.reviewResolveErr = s.resolveForge(observed.reviewKind)
61			}
62			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil {
63				switch {
64				case observed.reviewProvider == nil:
65					observed.reviewResolveErr = errors.New("forge resolver returned no provider")
66				case observed.reviewProvider.Kind() != observed.reviewKind:
67					observed.reviewResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("forge resolver returned %s for detected %s remote",
68						observed.reviewProvider.Kind(), observed.reviewKind)
69				default:
70					observed.reviewAvailable = observed.reviewProvider.Available()
71				}
72			}
73		case VerifyMerged:
74			options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
75			observed.proofRef = options.SquashCommit
76			if observed.proofRef == "" {
77				observed.proofRef = observed.task.Branch
78			}
79			if observed.proofRef != "" {
80				observed.proofOID, observed.proofOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofRef)
81			}
82			if observed.completionBaseOIDErr == nil && observed.completionBaseOID != "" &&
83				observed.proofOIDErr == nil && observed.proofOID != "" {
84				observed.proofContained, observed.proofErr = s.isAncestor(
85					ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseOID,
86				)
87			}
88		}
89	}

91	func (s *lifecycleService) observeIntegrationFacts(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
92		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
93			observed.integration = completionIntegrationObservation{
94				worktree: observed.worktree, worktreeFound: observed.worktreeFound, worktreeErr: observed.worktreeErr,
95				status: observed.status, statusErr: observed.statusErr,
96				head: observed.head, headErr: observed.headErr,
97				operation: observed.operation, inProgress: observed.inProgress, operationErr: observed.operationErr,
98			}
99			return
100		}
101	
102		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
103		observed.integration.worktree, observed.integration.worktreeErr = registered, err
104		if err != nil {
105			return
106		}
107		observed.integration.worktreeFound = true
108		observed.integration.status, observed.integration.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
109		if observed.integration.statusErr != nil {
110			return
111		}
112		observed.integration.head, observed.integration.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
113		observed.integration.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.integration.head)
114		observed.integration.operation, observed.integration.inProgress, observed.integration.operationErr =
115			s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
116	}

118	func (s *lifecycleService) completeDirectSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
119		options := request.Options.(CompleteDirectOptions)
120		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
121		conditions = append(conditions, condition(
122			ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
123			"direct mode records completion on "+observed.task.Branch+" without integrating another branch", "",
124		))
125	
126		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
127		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
128			if options.Push {
129				effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
130					EffectPushBranch, "push the directly completed branch", observed.task.Branch, false, true,
131					map[string]string{"remote": "origin", "checkout": observed.checkout},
132				))
133			}
134			effects = append(effects, completionTaskUpdateEffect(observed))
135		}
136		return s.completionPlanSpec(
137			request, observed, conditions, effects,
138			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Complete this direct task?"),
139			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage, options.Push, "", ""),
140			"Complete "+observed.task.Title()+" directly on "+observed.task.Branch,
141		)
142	}

144	func (s *lifecycleService) completeFFSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
145		options := request.Options.(CompleteFFOptions)
146		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
147		relation := effectiveCompletionRelation(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
148		if !relation.Contained() {
149			conditions = append(conditions, completionIntegrationCondition(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage))
150			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
151				conditions = append(conditions, s.completionIntegrationOccupancyCondition(observed))
152			}
153		}
154	
155		relationEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%s is behind %d and ahead %d relative to %s",
156			observed.task.Branch, relation.BaseOnly, relation.BranchOnly, observed.completionBaseRef)
157		if relation.Contained() {
158			relationEvidence = observed.task.Branch + " is already contained in " + observed.completionBaseRef
159		}
160		conditions = append(conditions, condition(
161			ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, relationEvidence, "",
162		))
163	
164		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
165		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
166			if !relation.Contained() {
167				if relation.BaseOnly > 0 {
168					effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
169						EffectRebaseBranch, "rebase the task branch onto the explicit base", observed.checkout, false, false,
170						map[string]string{"branch": observed.task.Branch, "base": observed.completionBaseRef},
171					))
172				}
173				effects = append(effects,
174					NewEffect(
175						EffectSwitchBase, "switch the canonical main checkout to the explicit base", observed.repoPath, false, false,
176						map[string]string{"base": observed.completionBaseRef, "task-branch": observed.task.Branch},
177					),
178					NewEffect(
179						EffectMergeFF, "fast-forward the explicit base to the task branch", observed.repoPath, false, false,
180						map[string]string{"base": observed.completionBaseRef, "branch": observed.task.Branch, "strategy": "ff-only"},
181					),
182				)
183			}
184			if options.PushBase {
185				effects = append(effects, completionPushBaseEffect(observed))
186			}
187			effects = append(effects, completionTaskUpdateEffect(observed))
188		}
189		return s.completionPlanSpec(
190			request, observed, conditions, effects,
191			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Integrate this task with fast-forward only?"),
192			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--ff", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage, options.PushBase, "", ""),
193			"Fast-forward "+observed.task.Title()+" into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
194		)
195	}

197	func (s *lifecycleService) reviewHandoffSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
198		options := request.Options.(ReviewHandoffOptions)
199		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
200		relation := effectiveCompletionRelation(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
201		relationVerdict := VerdictMet
202		relationEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d commit(s) not in %s", observed.task.Branch, relation.BranchOnly, observed.completionBaseRef)
203		if relation.Contained() {
204			if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() &&
205				(options.Dirty == DirtyAuto || options.Dirty == DirtyCommit && strings.TrimSpace(options.CommitMessage) == "") {
206				relationEvidence = "reviewability will be recomputed after an explicit dirty policy is selected"
207			} else {
208				relationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
209				relationEvidence = observed.task.Branch + " is already contained in " + observed.completionBaseRef
210			}
211		}
212		conditions = append(conditions,
213			condition(ConditionBranchRelation, relationVerdict, RequirementRequired, relationEvidence,
214				"use fast-forward completion or add reviewable task-branch commits"),
215			completionReviewProviderCondition(observed),
216		)
217	
218		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
219		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
220			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
221				EffectPushBranch, "publish the task branch for review", observed.task.Branch, false, true,
222				map[string]string{
223					"remote": "origin", "remote-url": observed.reviewRemoteURL,
224					"repository": observed.reviewRepository, "checkout": observed.checkout,
225				},
226			))
227			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil && observed.reviewProvider != nil && observed.reviewAvailable {
228				effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
229					EffectCreateReview, "create a provider pull or merge request", observed.checkout, false, true,
230					map[string]string{
231						"provider": string(observed.reviewKind), "repository": observed.reviewRepository,
232						"remote-url": observed.reviewRemoteURL, "base": observed.completionBaseRef,
233						"head": observed.task.Branch, "draft": boolString(options.Draft),
234						"title": options.Title, "body": options.Body,
235					},
236				))
237			}
238		}
239		return s.completionPlanSpec(
240			request, observed, conditions, effects,
241			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Publish this task for review?"),
242			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--pr", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage, false, "", ""),
243			"Publish "+observed.task.Title()+" for review into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
244		)

247	func (s *lifecycleService) verifyMergedSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
248		options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
249		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
250		proofCondition := completionProofCondition(observed)
251		proofSurvivesDirtyPolicy := true
252		if options.SquashCommit != "" && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() && options.Dirty == DirtyCommit {
253			proofSurvivesDirtyPolicy = false
254			proofCondition = condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
255				"the squash attestation predates the new commit requested by --dirty=commit",
256				"commit and integrate the dirty work before supplying a fresh squash attestation")
257		}
258		conditions = append(conditions,
259			condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
260				fmt.Sprintf("local relation to %s is behind %d and ahead %d",
261					observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly, observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly), ""),
262			proofCondition,
263		)
264	
265		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
266		if !proofSurvivesDirtyPolicy {
267			effects = nil
268		} else if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
269			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
270				EffectVerifyAncestry, "prove exact merge ancestry", observed.completionBaseRef, false, false,
271				map[string]string{
272					"proof-ref": observed.proofRef, "proof-oid": observed.proofOID,
273					"base-ref": observed.completionBaseRef, "base-oid": observed.completionBaseOID,
274				},
275			))
276			if options.PushBase {
277				effects = append(effects, completionPushBaseEffect(observed))
278			}
279			effects = append(effects, completionTaskUpdateEffect(observed))
280		}
281		return s.completionPlanSpec(
282			request, observed, conditions, effects,
283			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Verify this merge and record DONE?"),
284			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--merged", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage,
285				options.PushBase, options.BaseRef, options.SquashCommit),
286			"Verify "+observed.task.Title()+" merged into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
287		)
288	}

311	func (s *lifecycleService) completionConditions(
312		observed lifecycleObservation,
313		dirty DirtyPolicy,
314		message string,
315	) []Condition {
316		conditions := []Condition{
317			condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
318				"task "+observed.task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision, ""),
319			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
320				"Git common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
321		}
322		conditions = append(conditions, completionCheckoutConditions(observed)...)
323		conditions = append(conditions, completionGitConditions(observed, dirty, message)...)
324		conditions = append(conditions, completionArtifactCondition(observed))
325		conditions = append(conditions, s.completionRuntimeConditions(observed)...)
326		conditions = append(conditions, completionBaseCondition(observed))
327		return conditions
328	}
