330	func completionCheckoutConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
331		if !observed.hasCheckout() {
332			verdict := VerdictBlocked
333			evidence := "the exact task checkout is not registered"
334			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !isWorktreeNotFound(observed.worktreeErr) {
335				verdict = VerdictError
336				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
337			}
338			return []Condition{
339				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "resume or reconcile the exact checkout"),
340				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout identity is unavailable", "refresh worktree topology"),
341				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unavailable", "refresh worktree topology"),
342				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout branch is unavailable", "restore the named task branch"),
343			}
344		}
345	
346		exactVerdict, exactEvidence := checkoutExactVerdict(observed)
347		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
348		kindEvidence := "canonical main checkout"
349		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
350			kindEvidence = "exact linked worktree"
351			if !observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
352				kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
353				kindEvidence = "worktree task does not resolve to a linked checkout"
354			}
355		} else if !observed.worktree.Worktree.Main || observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare {
356			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
357			kindEvidence = "branch or direct task does not resolve to Git's canonical main checkout"
358		}
359	
360		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
361		branchEvidence := "checkout and registry name task branch " + observed.task.Branch
362		if observed.task.Branch == "" || observed.statusErr != nil || observed.status.Detached ||
363			observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached ||
364			observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
365			branchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
366			branchEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q expected=%q detached=%t",
367				observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.task.Branch,
368				observed.status.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached)
369			if observed.statusErr != nil {
370				branchVerdict = VerdictError
371				branchEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
372			}
373		}
374		return []Condition{
375			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
376			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "reconcile task and worktree identity"),
377			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "reconcile the task checkout mode"),
378			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named task branch"),
379		}
380	}
381	
382	func completionGitConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) []Condition {
383		status := observed.status
384		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
385		statusEvidence := status.Summary()
386		if observed.statusErr != nil {
387			statusVerdict = VerdictError
388			statusEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
389		}
390	
391		finishVerdict := VerdictMet
392		finishEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("fingerprint %s; base-only=%d branch-only=%d",
393			observed.finish.Fingerprint, observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly, observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly)
394		switch {
395		case !observed.hasCheckout():
396			finishVerdict = VerdictUnknown
397			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires the exact checkout"
398		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
399			finishVerdict = VerdictBlocked
400			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires an explicit base ref"
401		case observed.finishErr != nil:
402			finishVerdict = VerdictError
403			finishEvidence = observed.finishErr.Error()
404		case observed.finish.Fingerprint == "":
405			finishVerdict = VerdictError
406			finishEvidence = "finish analysis returned no content fingerprint"
407		}
408	
409		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
410		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
411		if observed.operationErr != nil {
412			operationVerdict = VerdictError
413			operationEvidence = observed.operationErr.Error()
414		} else if observed.inProgress {
415			operationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
416			operationEvidence = "Git operation " + observed.operation + " is in progress"
417		}
418	
419		conflictVerdict := VerdictMet
420		conflictEvidence := "no unmerged paths"
421		if observed.statusErr != nil {
422			conflictVerdict = VerdictError
423			conflictEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
424		} else if observed.status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
425			conflictVerdict = VerdictBlocked
426			conflictEvidence = strconv.Itoa(max(observed.status.Conflicted, observed.finish.Status.Conflicted)) + " conflicted path(s)"
427		}
428	
429		cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence := completionDirtyCondition(observed, dirty, message)
430		return []Condition{
431			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
432			condition(ConditionFinishAnalysis, finishVerdict, RequirementRequired, finishEvidence, "refresh the exact finish analysis"),
433			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
434			condition(ConditionGitConflict, conflictVerdict, RequirementRequired, conflictEvidence, "resolve or abort conflicts before completion"),
435			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementRequired, cleanEvidence, "select fail, commit with a message, or discard"),
436		}
437	}
438	
439	func completionDirtyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) (Verdict, string) {
440		if observed.statusErr != nil {
441			return VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
442		}
443		if !observed.status.Dirty() {
444			return VerdictMet, "checkout is clean; dirty policy " + string(dirty) + " causes no content mutation"
445		}
446		evidence := observed.status.Breakdown()
447		if observed.finishErr == nil {
448			evidence += fmt.Sprintf("; %d path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
449				observed.finish.EquivalentDirty(), observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.UniqueDirty())
450		}
451		switch dirty {
452		case DirtyAuto:
453			return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; choose an explicit dirty policy"
454		case DirtyFail:
455			return VerdictBlocked, evidence + "; fail policy refuses dirty completion"
456		case DirtyCommit:
457			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
458				return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; commit-all requires a nonempty message"
459			}
460			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; commit-all was explicitly selected"
461		case DirtyDiscard:
462			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
463				return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires DROP"
464			}
465			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires approval"
466		default:
467			return VerdictError, "unknown dirty policy " + string(dirty)
468		}
469	}
470	
471	func completionArtifactCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
472		switch {
473		case !observed.hasCheckout():
474			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
475				"artifact readiness requires the exact checkout", "restore the checkout")
476		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
477			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
478				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
479		case observed.artifact.Ready():
480			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, artifactEvidence(observed), "")

42	}
43	
44	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshRemoteHandler() Handler {
45		return Handler{Plan: s.planRefreshRemote, Apply: s.applyRefreshRemote}
46	}
47	
48	func validateRefreshRemoteLocator(locator Locator) error {
49		switch {
50		case locator.RepoPath == "":
51			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
52		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
53			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
54		case !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Branch):
55			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact head branch %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Branch)
56		case locator.Base != "" && !normalizedRemoteBranch(locator.Base):
57			return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Base)
58		case locator.HeadOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.HeadOID):
59			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact HEAD OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.HeadOID)
60		case locator.BaseOID != "" && !fullGitOID.MatchString(locator.BaseOID):
61			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact base OID %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.BaseOID)
62		}
63	
64		if locator.TaskID == "" {
65			switch {
66			case locator.TaskRevision != "":
67				return fmt.Errorf("%w: task revision requires a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
68			case locator.HeadOID == "":
69				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged remote refresh requires an exact HEAD OID", ErrInvalidRequest)
70			case locator.Mode != "" && !validMode(locator.Mode):
71				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown checkout mode %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.Mode)
72			case locator.State != "" && !validState(locator.State):
73				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown task state %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.State)
74			}
75			return nil
76		}
77	
78		switch {
79		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
80			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
81		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
82			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
83		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
84			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
85		case !validState(locator.State):
86			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
87		}
88		return nil
89	}
90	
91	func normalizedRemoteBranch(branch string) bool {
92		return branch != "" && branch == strings.TrimSpace(branch) &&
93			!strings.ContainsRune(branch, '\x00') &&
94			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/heads/") &&
95			!strings.HasPrefix(branch, "refs/remotes/")
96	}
97	
98	func normalizeRemoteName(name string) (string, error) {
99		if name == "" {
100			return "origin", nil
101		}
102		if name != strings.TrimSpace(name) || strings.ContainsRune(name, '\x00') || strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") {
103			return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: remote name %q is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest, name)
104		}
105		return name, nil
106	}
107	
108	func (s *lifecycleService) planRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
109		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
110			return PlanSpec{}, err
111		}
112		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
113			return PlanSpec{}, err
114		}
115	
116		if request.Locator.TaskID == "" {
117			spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, nil)
118			return spec, err
119		}
120	
121		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
122		if err != nil {
123			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
124		}
125		spec, _, err := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, request, record)
126		if err != nil {
127			return PlanSpec{}, err
128		}
129		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: "task record disappeared while planning remote refresh"}
132		}
133		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
134			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning remote refresh")
135		}
136		return spec, nil
137	}
138	
139	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, request Request, record *task.Record) (PlanSpec, remoteRefreshObservation, error) {
140		observed := remoteRefreshObservation{record: record, head: request.Locator.Branch, base: request.Locator.Base}
141		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
142			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
143		}
144		if record != nil {
145			if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, *record); err != nil {
146				return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
147			}
148		}
149	
150		remoteName, err := normalizeRemoteName(request.Locator.Remote)
151		if err != nil {
152			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
153		}
154		observed.remoteName = remoteName
155	
156		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, request.Locator.RepoPath)
157		if err != nil {
158			return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover selected repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
159		}
160		observed.repo = repository
161		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
162		if err != nil {
163			return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
164		}
165		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
166		if err != nil {
167			return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
168		}
169		requestedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoPath)
170		if err != nil {
171			return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
172		}
173		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
174		if err != nil {
175			return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
176		}
177		if requestedRepo != observed.repoPath || requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
178			return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
179				"selected repository identity changed: main %q -> %q, common directory %q -> %q",
180				requestedRepo, observed.repoPath, requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir,
181			)}
182		}
183		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
184			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
185			if keyErr != nil {
186				return PlanSpec{}, observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
187			}
188			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
189				return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected repository key no longer names the Git common directory"}
190			}
191		}
192	
193		if err := s.validateRemoteRefNames(ctx, observed.repoPath, remoteName, observed.head, observed.base); err != nil {
194			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
195		}
196		if record == nil {
197			if err := s.validateRefreshCheckout(ctx, request.Locator, &observed); err != nil {
198				return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
199			}
200		}
201	
202		observed.remoteURL = strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
203		observed.providerKind, observed.providerRepository = forge.IdentityFromURL(observed.remoteURL)
204		options := request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions)
205		if options.QueryReview && observed.remoteURL != "" && observed.providerKind != forge.Unknown && observed.providerRepository != "" {
206			observed.provider, observed.providerResolveErr = s.resolveForge(observed.providerKind)
207			if observed.providerResolveErr == nil {
208				switch {
209				case observed.provider == nil:
210					observed.providerResolveErr = errors.New("forge resolver returned no provider")
211				case observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind:
212					observed.providerResolveErr = fmt.Errorf("forge resolver returned %s for %s remote", observed.provider.Kind(), observed.providerKind)
213				default:
214					_, observed.providerCapable = observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier)
215					observed.providerAvailable = observed.provider.Available()
216				}
217			}
218		}
219	
220		observed.refs = s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
221		if request.Locator.HeadOID != "" {
222			if observed.refs.LocalHead.Failure != "" || !observed.refs.LocalHead.Exists || observed.refs.LocalHead.OID != request.Locator.HeadOID {
223				return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
224					"selected head changed from %q to %q", request.Locator.HeadOID, observed.refs.LocalHead.OID,
225				)}
226			}
227		}
228		if request.Locator.BaseOID != "" {
229			if observed.refs.LocalBase.Failure != "" || !observed.refs.LocalBase.Exists || observed.refs.LocalBase.OID != request.Locator.BaseOID {
230				return PlanSpec{}, observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
231					"selected base changed from %q to %q", request.Locator.BaseOID, observed.refs.LocalBase.OID,
232				)}
233			}
234		}
235		return s.refreshRemoteSpec(request, observed), observed, nil
236	}
237	
238	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRemoteRefNames(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) error {
239		for label, ref := range map[string]string{
240			"head":        "refs/heads/" + head,
241			"remote name": "refs/remotes/" + remote + "/__dev_refresh_probe__",
242		} {
243			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", ref); err != nil {
244				return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not a valid normalized Git name: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, label, err)
245			}
246		}
247		if base != "" {
248			if _, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath, "check-ref-format", "refs/heads/"+base); err != nil {
249				return fmt.Errorf("%w: review base is not a valid normalized Git branch: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
250			}
251		}
252		return nil
253	}
254	
255	func (s *lifecycleService) validateRefreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, locator Locator, observed *remoteRefreshObservation) error {
256		checkout := locator.CheckoutPath
257		if checkout == "" {
258			checkout = locator.RepoPath
259		}
260		canonical, err := s.canonicalPath(checkout)
261		if err != nil {
262			return fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize selected checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
263		}
264		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, canonical)
265		if err != nil {
266			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout registration changed: " + err.Error()}
267		}
268		if registered.Path != canonical || registered.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
269			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout no longer belongs to the exact repository identity"}
270		}
271		if registered.Worktree.Detached || registered.Worktree.Branch != locator.Branch {
272			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
273				"selected checkout branch changed from %q to %q", locator.Branch, registered.Worktree.Branch,
274			)}
275		}
276		liveHead, err := s.gitRun(ctx, canonical, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
277		if err != nil {
278			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected checkout HEAD is no longer observable: " + err.Error()}
279		}
280		liveHead = strings.TrimSpace(liveHead)
281		if registered.Worktree.Head != liveHead || locator.HeadOID != liveHead {
282			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
283				"selected checkout HEAD changed from %q to registry=%q live=%q", locator.HeadOID, registered.Worktree.Head, liveHead,
284			)}
285		}
286		observed.checkout = canonical
287		observed.worktree = registered
288		return nil
289	}
290	
291	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRemoteRefs(ctx context.Context, repoPath, remote, head, base string) RemoteRefsObservation {
292		result := RemoteRefsObservation{ObservedAt: s.now()}
293		result.LocalHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+head)
294		result.RemoteHead = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+head)
295		if base != "" {
296			result.LocalBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/heads/"+base)
297			result.RemoteBase = s.observeNamedRef(ctx, repoPath, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base)
298		}
299		return result
300	}
301	
302	func (s *lifecycleService) observeNamedRef(ctx context.Context, repoPath, ref string) NamedRefObservation {
303		observed := NamedRefObservation{Ref: ref}
304		exists, err := s.gitRefState(ctx, repoPath, ref)
305		if err != nil {
306			observed.Failure = err.Error()
307			return observed
308		}
309		if !exists {
310			return observed
311		}
312		observed.Exists = true
313		oid, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, ref)
314		if err != nil {
315			observed.Failure = err.Error()
316			return observed
317		}
318		observed.OID = oid
319		return observed
320	}
321	
322	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshRemoteSpec(request Request, observed remoteRefreshObservation) PlanSpec {
323		options := request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions)
324		conditions := []Condition{
325			refreshTaskCondition(observed),
326			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
327				"Git main "+observed.repoPath+" with common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
328			refreshHeadCondition(observed),
329			refreshRemoteURLCondition(observed),
330			refreshRefsCondition(observed),
331			refreshReviewBaseCondition(observed, options),
332			refreshReviewProviderCondition(observed, options),
333			refreshReviewCapabilityCondition(observed, options),
334			refreshReviewCLICondition(observed, options),
335		}
336	
337		var effects []Effect
338		if options.FetchRefs {
339			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
340				EffectFetchRefs, "fetch and prune the exact configured remote", observed.repoPath, false, true,
341				map[string]string{
342					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
343					"pre-refs": remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs),
344				},
345			))
346		}
347		if options.QueryReview {
348			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
349				EffectQueryReview, "query the exact provider repository and head/base relationship", observed.providerRepository, false, true,
350				map[string]string{
351					"remote": observed.remoteName, "remote-url": observed.remoteURL,
352					"provider": string(observed.providerKind), "repository": observed.providerRepository,
353					"head": observed.head, "base": observed.base,
354				},
355			))
356		}
357	
358		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.head + "@" + observed.refs.LocalHead.OID}
359		if observed.checkout != "" {
360			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+observed.checkout)
361		}
362		return PlanSpec{
363			Authority:         refreshRemoteAuthority(observed),
364			Conditions:        conditions,
365			Effects:           effects,
366			RetainedResources: retained,
367			Confirmation: Confirmation{
368				Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Run the selected explicit remote network operations?",
369			},
370			Summary:     refreshRemoteSummary(observed, options),
371			DisplayedAt: s.now(),
372		}
373	}
374	
375	func refreshTaskCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
376		if observed.record == nil {
377			return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
378				"repository/checkout context has no persisted task record", "")
379		}
380		return condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
381			"task "+observed.record.Task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision+" is validated without a state write", "")
382	}
383	
384	func refreshHeadCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
385		ref := observed.refs.LocalHead
386		switch {
387		case ref.Failure != "":
388			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, ref.Failure, "repair local head-ref observation")
389		case !ref.Exists:
390			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
391				"local head ref "+ref.Ref+" does not exist", "restore the exact named local branch")
392		case ref.OID == "":
393			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
394				"local head ref resolved without an OID", "repair local head-ref observation")
395		default:
396			return condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
397				ref.Ref+" is exactly "+ref.OID, "")
398		}
399	}
400	
401	func refreshRemoteURLCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
402		if observed.remoteURL == "" {
403			return condition(ConditionRemoteURL, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
404				"remote "+observed.remoteName+" has no configured URL", "configure the exact remote before network refresh")
405		}
406		return condition(ConditionRemoteURL, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
407			"remote "+observed.remoteName+" is configured as "+observed.remoteURL, "")
408	}
409	
410	func refreshRefsCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation) Condition {
411		verdict := VerdictMet
412		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{
413			observed.refs.LocalHead, observed.refs.LocalBase, observed.refs.RemoteHead, observed.refs.RemoteBase,
414		} {
415			if ref.Failure != "" {
416				verdict = VerdictError
417				break
418			}
419		}
420		return condition(ConditionRemoteRefs, verdict, RequirementAdvisory,
421			remoteRefsEvidence(observed.refs), "repair local Git ref observation before relying on freshness")
422	}
423	
424	func refreshReviewBaseCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
425		if !options.QueryReview {
426			return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
427				"review query is not selected; an explicit base is not required", "")
428		}
429		if observed.base == "" {
430			return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictNeedsInput, RequirementRequired,
431				"review query requires an exact base branch", "select the base from the current repository context")
432		}
433		return condition(ConditionReviewBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
434			"review base is "+observed.base, "")
435	}
436	
437	func refreshReviewProviderCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
438		requirement := RequirementAdvisory
439		if options.QueryReview {
440			requirement = RequirementRequired
441		}
442		if observed.providerKind == forge.Unknown || observed.providerRepository == "" {
443			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, requirement,
444				"remote URL does not identify a supported GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps repository", "select fetch-only or configure a supported provider remote")
445		}
446		return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictMet, requirement,
447			fmt.Sprintf("%s repository identity %s", observed.providerKind, observed.providerRepository), "")
448	}
449	
450	func refreshReviewCapabilityCondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
451		if !options.QueryReview {
452			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
453				"review query is not selected; forge capability is not required", "")
454		}
455		if observed.providerResolveErr != nil {
456			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
457				observed.providerResolveErr.Error(), "use fetch-only or install support for this provider")
458		}
459		if observed.provider == nil || !observed.providerCapable {
460			return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
461				fmt.Sprintf("%s adapter does not implement review queries", observed.providerKind), "use fetch-only or a review-capable provider")
462		}
463		return condition(ConditionReviewCapability, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
464			fmt.Sprintf("%s adapter implements review queries", observed.providerKind), "")
465	}
466	
467	func refreshReviewCLICondition(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) Condition {
468		if !options.QueryReview {
469			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
470				"review query is not selected; no provider CLI is required", "")
471		}
472		if observed.provider == nil || observed.providerResolveErr != nil || !observed.providerCapable {
473			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
474				"review-capable provider CLI could not be selected", "resolve provider capability first")
475		}
476		if !observed.providerAvailable {
477			return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementRequired,
478				fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is not installed", observed.providerKind, observed.provider.Bin()), "install the provider CLI and retry")
479		}
480		return condition(ConditionReviewCLI, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
481			fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is locally available", observed.providerKind, observed.provider.Bin()), "")
482	}
483	
484	func refreshRemoteAuthority(observed remoteRefreshObservation) map[string]string {
485		authority := map[string]string{
486			"remote.repo-main":          observed.repoPath,
487			"remote.git-common-dir":     observed.gitCommonDir,
488			"remote.checkout":           observed.checkout,
489			"remote.worktree":           worktreeAuthority(observed.worktree, observed.checkout != "", nil, 0),
490			"remote.name":               observed.remoteName,
491			"remote.url":                observed.remoteURL,
492			"remote.head":               observed.head,
493			"remote.base":               observed.base,
494			"remote.provider":           string(observed.providerKind),
495			"remote.repository":         observed.providerRepository,
496			"remote.provider-bin":       reviewProviderBin(observed.provider),
497			"remote.provider-error":     errorString(observed.providerResolveErr),
498			"remote.provider-capable":   boolString(observed.providerCapable),
499			"remote.provider-available": boolString(observed.providerAvailable),
500			"remote.refs":               remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs),
501		}
502		if observed.record != nil {
503			authority["remote.task-id"] = observed.record.Task.ID
504			authority["remote.task-revision"] = observed.record.Revision
505			authority["remote.task-mode"] = string(observed.record.Task.EffectiveMode())
506			authority["remote.task-state"] = string(observed.record.Task.State)
507		} else {
508			authority["remote.task-id"] = ""
509			authority["remote.task-revision"] = ""
510			authority["remote.task-mode"] = ""
511			authority["remote.task-state"] = ""
512		}
513		return authority
514	}
515	
516	func remoteRefsAuthority(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
517		values := make([]string, 0, 16)
518		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
519			values = append(values, ref.Ref, boolString(ref.Exists), ref.OID, ref.Failure)
520		}
521		return authorityHash("taskflow-remote-refs-v1", values...)
522	}
523	
524	func localRemoteRefsAuthority(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
525		values := make([]string, 0, 8)
526		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase} {
527			values = append(values, ref.Ref, boolString(ref.Exists), ref.OID, ref.Failure)
528		}
529		return authorityHash("taskflow-remote-local-refs-v1", values...)
530	}
531	
532	func remoteRefsEvidence(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
533		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
534		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
535			if ref.Ref == "" {
536				continue
537			}
538			switch {
539			case ref.Failure != "":
540				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" error: "+ref.Failure)
541			case ref.Exists:
542				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+"="+ref.OID)
543			default:
544				parts = append(parts, ref.Ref+" is absent")
545			}
546		}
547		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
548	}
549	
550	func refreshRemoteSummary(observed remoteRefreshObservation, options RefreshRemoteOptions) string {
551		operation := "fetch refs and query review"
552		switch {
553		case options.FetchRefs && !options.QueryReview:
554			operation = "fetch refs"
555		case !options.FetchRefs && options.QueryReview:
556			operation = "query review"
557		}
558		return operation + " for " + observed.head + " via " + observed.remoteName
559	}
560	
561	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
562		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
563			return Result{}, err
564		}
565		if approved.Action != RefreshRemote {
566			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "refresh-remote handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
567		}
568		if err := validateRefreshRemoteLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
569			return Result{}, err
570		}
571		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
572		if err != nil {
573			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
574		}
575	
576		var result Result
577		applyLocked := func(tx *task.Tx) error {
578			var record *task.Record
579			if approved.Locator.TaskID != "" {
580				if tx == nil {
581					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "managed remote refresh has no task transaction"}
582				}
583				current, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
584				if loadErr != nil {
585					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before remote refresh"}
586				}
587				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *current); identityErr != nil {
588					return identityErr
589				}
590				record = current
591			}
592	
593			spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRefreshRemote(ctx, approved.Request, record)
594			if observeErr != nil {
595				return observeErr
596			}
597			fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
598			if buildErr != nil {
599				return buildErr
600			}
601			if record != nil {
602				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
603				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
604					actual := ""
605					if current != nil {
606						actual = current.Revision
607					}
608					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked remote refresh replan")
609				}
610			}
611			if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
612				return &StalePlanError{
613					ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
614					ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
615					ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
616					Reason:                       "fresh task, repository, remote URL, provider, or ref authority differs",
617				}
618			}
619			if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
620				notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
621				return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh remote refresh conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
622			}
623	
624			execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh}
625			result, observeErr = execution.executeRefreshRemote(ctx, observed)
626			return observeErr
627		}
628	
629		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
630			if approved.Locator.TaskID == "" {
631				return applyLocked(nil)
632			}
633			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, applyLocked)
634		})
635		return result, err
636	}
637	
638	func (e *executionState) executeRefreshRemote(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation) (Result, error) {
639		data := RemoteObservation{
640			RemoteName: observed.remoteName, RemoteURL: observed.remoteURL,
641			Provider: observed.providerKind, Repository: observed.providerRepository,
642			Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base, BeforeRefs: observed.refs,
643		}
644		e.remote = &data
645		fetched := false
646	
647		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
648			switch effect.Code {
649			case EffectFetchRefs:
650				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
651					_, fetchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "--", observed.remoteName)
652					if fetchErr != nil {
653						return "", fmt.Errorf("fetch --prune %s: %w", observed.remoteName, fetchErr)
654					}
655					return "fetched and pruned " + observed.remoteName, nil
656				})
657				if err != nil {
658					recovery := []string{"remote refs were not proven refreshed; repair the exact remote fetch and create a fresh plan"}
659					if e.plan.Request.Options.(RefreshRemoteOptions).QueryReview {
660						recovery = append(recovery, "review query was not attempted after the failed fetch")
661					}
662					return e.fail(err, recovery...)
663				}
664				fetched = true
665				data.AfterRefs = e.service.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
666				data.HasAfterRefs = true
667	
668			case EffectQueryReview:
669				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
670					if err := e.service.revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx, observed, fetched); err != nil {
671						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
672						return "", err
673					}
674					query := forge.ReviewQuery{Repository: observed.providerRepository, Head: observed.head, Base: observed.base}
675					review, queryErr := e.service.queryReview(ctx, observed.provider, observed.repoPath, query)
676					if queryErr != nil {
677						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, queryErr)
678						return "", queryErr
679					}
680					if review == nil {
681						data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
682							State: ObservationKnown, Exists: false,
683							Provider: observed.providerKind, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
684						}
685						data.HasReview = true
686						return "provider reports no exact review", nil
687					}
688					if err := validateRemoteReview(observed, *review); err != nil {
689						e.setRemoteReviewFailure(&data, observed, err)
690						return "", err
691					}
692					observedAt := review.ObservedAt.UTC()
693					if review.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
694						observedAt = e.service.now()
695					}
696					data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
697						State: ObservationKnown, Exists: true,
698						Provider: review.Provider, ReviewState: review.State,
699						Draft: review.Draft, URL: review.URL, ObservedAt: observedAt,
700					}
701					data.HasReview = true
702					return fmt.Sprintf("observed %s review (%s)", review.Provider, review.State), nil
703				})
704				if err != nil {
705					if fetched {
706						return e.fail(err, "fetch completed; review evidence remains an explicit error and may be retried from a fresh query-only plan")
707					}
708					return e.fail(err, "local refs and task state were unchanged; repair provider access or response handling and retry")
709				}
710	
711			default:
712				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RefreshRemote effect " + string(effect.Code)})
713			}
714		}
715		return e.result(), nil
716	}
717	
718	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRemoteQueryContext(ctx context.Context, observed remoteRefreshObservation, allowFetchedRefs bool) error {
719		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
720		if err != nil {
721			return staleBoundary("repository became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
722		}
723		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
724		if err != nil {
725			return staleBoundary("repository main path became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
726		}
727		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
728		if err != nil {
729			return staleBoundary("Git common directory became unavailable before review query: " + err.Error())
730		}
731		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
732			return staleBoundary("repository identity changed before review query")
733		}
734		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName))
735		kind, repositoryIdentity := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
736		if remoteURL != observed.remoteURL || kind != observed.providerKind || repositoryIdentity != observed.providerRepository {
737			return staleBoundary("remote URL or provider repository identity changed before review query")
738		}
739		if observed.provider == nil || observed.provider.Kind() != observed.providerKind {
740			return staleBoundary("review provider identity changed before query")
741		}
742		if _, ok := observed.provider.(forge.ReviewQuerier); !ok {
743			return staleBoundary("review provider capability changed before query")
744		}
745		if !observed.provider.Available() {
746			return staleBoundary("review provider CLI became unavailable before query")
747		}
748		freshRefs := s.observeRemoteRefs(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteName, observed.head, observed.base)
749		if allowFetchedRefs {
750			if localRemoteRefsAuthority(freshRefs) != localRemoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs) {
751				return staleBoundary("local head or base ref authority changed during fetch")
752			}
753		} else if remoteRefsAuthority(freshRefs) != remoteRefsAuthority(observed.refs) {
754			return staleBoundary("local or remote-tracking ref authority changed before query")
755		}
756		return nil
757	}
758	
759	func (e *executionState) setRemoteReviewFailure(data *RemoteObservation, observed remoteRefreshObservation, err error) {
760		data.Review = RemoteReviewObservation{
761			State: ObservationError, Exists: false,
762			Provider: observed.providerKind, ObservedAt: e.service.now(),
763			FailureKind: classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err), Failure: err.Error(),
764		}
765		data.HasReview = true
766	}
767	
768	func classifyRemoteReviewFailure(err error) RemoteReviewFailureKind {
769		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrAmbiguousReview) {
770			return RemoteReviewFailureAmbiguous
771		}
772		if errors.Is(err, forge.ErrMalformedReviewResponse) {
773			return RemoteReviewFailureMalformed
774		}
775		var unsupported *forge.ErrUnsupported
776		if errors.As(err, &unsupported) {
777			return RemoteReviewFailureUnsupported
778		}
779		var missingCLI *forge.ErrNoCLI
780		if errors.As(err, &missingCLI) {
781			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingCLI
782		}
783		var missingExtension *forge.ErrNoExtension
784		if errors.As(err, &missingExtension) {
785			return RemoteReviewFailureMissingExtension
786		}
787		return RemoteReviewFailureProvider
788	}
789	
790	func validateRemoteReview(observed remoteRefreshObservation, review forge.Review) error {
791		switch {
792		case review.Provider != observed.providerKind:
793			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "provider")
794		case review.Repository != observed.providerRepository:
795			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "repository identity")
796		case review.Head != observed.head:
797			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "head branch")
798		case review.Base != observed.base:
799			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "base branch")
800		case strings.TrimSpace(review.ID) == "" || review.ID != strings.TrimSpace(review.ID):
801			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "identifier")
802		case review.Number <= 0:
803			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "number")
804		case !review.State.Valid():
805			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "state")
806		case review.State == forge.ReviewDraft && !review.Draft:
807			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft flag")
808		case review.State == forge.ReviewOpen && review.Draft:
809			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "draft state")
810		case !validRemoteReviewURL(review.URL):
811			return malformedRemoteReview(observed.providerKind, "URL")
812		}
813		return nil
814	}
815	
816	func malformedRemoteReview(provider forge.Kind, field string) error {
817		return &forge.MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: 0, Field: field}
818	}
819	
820	func validRemoteReviewURL(raw string) bool {
821		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
822		return err == nil && parsed.Host != "" && (parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http")
823	}
824	
825	func remoteRefCount(refs RemoteRefsObservation) int {
826		count := 0
827		for _, ref := range []NamedRefObservation{refs.LocalHead, refs.LocalBase, refs.RemoteHead, refs.RemoteBase} {
828			if ref.Exists && ref.Failure == "" && ref.OID != "" {
829				count++
830			}
831		}
832		return count
833	}
834	
835	func remoteRefSummary(refs RemoteRefsObservation) string {
836		return strconv.Itoa(remoteRefCount(refs)) + " named ref OID(s) observed"
837	}

142			Host: "test-host", CWD: h.repo,
143			Clock: func() time.Time { return h.clock },
144			Hooks: LifecycleHooks{
145				RepoLock: func(_ context.Context, commonDir string, operation func() error) error {
146					h.calls = append(h.calls, "repo-lock:"+commonDir)
147					return operation()

149				GitDiscover: func(_ context.Context, dir string) (gitx.Repo, error) {
150					root := h.discoverAt
151					gitDir := h.common
152					linked := false
153					if dir == h.checkout {
154						root = h.checkout
155						gitDir = filepath.Join(h.common, "worktrees", "topic")
156						linked = true
157					}
158					return gitx.Repo{
159						Root: root, GitDir: gitDir, GitCommonDir: h.common,
160						MainRoot: h.discoverAt, Name: "repo", IsLinkedWorktree: linked,
161					}, nil
162				},
163				GitRun: func(_ context.Context, _ string, args ...string) (string, error) {
164					if len(args) == 0 {
165						return "", errors.New("empty Git invocation")
166					}
167					switch args[0] {
168					case "check-ref-format":
169						if len(args) != 2 || strings.Contains(args[1], "..") || strings.ContainsAny(args[1], " ~^:?*[\\") {
170							return "", errors.New("invalid ref")
171						}
172						return "", nil
173					case "rev-parse":

175							return "", fmt.Errorf("unexpected rev-parse args %q", args)
176						}
177						ref := strings.TrimSuffix(args[2], "^{commit}")

179							ref = "refs/heads/topic"
180						}
181						oid, ok := h.refs[ref]
182						if !ok {
183							return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown ref %s", ref)
184						}
185						return oid, nil
186					case "fetch":
187						h.calls = append(h.calls, "fetch:"+strings.Join(args[1:], " "))
188						if h.fetchErr != nil {
189							return "", h.fetchErr
190						}
191						if h.fetchMutation != nil {
192							h.fetchMutation()
193						}
194						return "", nil
195					default:
196						return "", fmt.Errorf("unexpected Git invocation %q", args)
197					}
198				},
199				GitRemote: func(_ context.Context, _ string, name string) string {
200					h.remoteNames = append(h.remoteNames, name)
201					return h.remoteURL

207				ResolveWorktree: func(_ context.Context, _ string, exact string) (gitx.RegisteredWorktree, error) {
208					want, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(h.checkout)
209					if canonicalErr != nil || exact != want {
210						return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, exact)
211					}
212					repoPath, _ := pathx.Canonical(h.repo)
213					commonDir, _ := pathx.Canonical(h.common)
214					return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{
215						RepositoryPath: repoPath, GitCommonDir: commonDir, Path: want,
216						Worktree: gitx.Worktree{Path: want, Head: h.refs["refs/heads/topic"], Branch: "topic"},
217					}, nil

319				if err != nil {

321				}

324				}

326					t.Fatalf("remote refresh represented as task transition: %+v", plan)

346					"remote.head": "topic", "remote.base": "main",
347				} {
348					if authority[key] != want {

350					}
351				}
352				if managed && authority["remote.task-revision"] == "" {
353					t.Fatal("managed plan omitted task revision authority")
354				}
355				if !managed && authority["remote.task-revision"] != "" {
356					t.Fatal("unmanaged plan acquired task authority")
357				}
358			})
359		}

10	// ConfirmationKind is the second, action-specific confirmation required after
11	// a caller has reviewed an exact PlanID. Apply always also requires affirmative
12	// Approval, including when this value is ConfirmationNone.
13	type ConfirmationKind string
14	
15	const (
16		ConfirmationNone     ConfirmationKind = ""
17		ConfirmationApproval ConfirmationKind = "approval"
18		ConfirmationTyped    ConfirmationKind = "typed"
19	)
20	
21	// Confirmation describes the action-specific prompt. Prompt is presentation;
22	// Token is authority when Kind is ConfirmationTyped.
23	type Confirmation struct {
24		Kind   ConfirmationKind
25		Prompt string
26		Token  string
27	}
28	
29	// Validate checks that typed confirmation has an exact non-empty token and
30	// other classes cannot accidentally retain one.
31	func (c Confirmation) Validate() error {
32		switch c.Kind {
33		case ConfirmationNone, ConfirmationApproval:
34			if c.Token != "" {
35				return fmt.Errorf("confirmation %q cannot carry a typed token", c.Kind)
36			}
37		case ConfirmationTyped:
38			if c.Token == "" {
39				return fmt.Errorf("typed confirmation token is required")
40			}
41		default:
42			return fmt.Errorf("unknown confirmation kind %q", c.Kind)
43		}
44		return nil
45	}
46	
47	// Approval is an affirmative decision bound to one exact PlanID. Granted maps
48	// CLI --yes semantics into the protocol; it does not alter any condition.
49	type Approval struct {
50		PlanID  string
51		Granted bool
52		Token   string
53	}
54	
55	// Approve constructs an affirmative approval without a typed token.
56	func Approve(planID string) Approval { return Approval{PlanID: planID, Granted: true} }
57	
58	// ApproveWithToken constructs an affirmative approval with exact typed text.
59	func ApproveWithToken(planID, token string) Approval {
60		return Approval{PlanID: planID, Granted: true, Token: token}
61	}
62	
63	// Milestone is an outcome overlay, never a persisted task state.
64	type Milestone string
65	
66	const (
67		MilestoneNone        Milestone = ""
68		MilestoneAdopted     Milestone = "adopted"
69		MilestoneReviewReady Milestone = "review-ready"
70		MilestoneMerged      Milestone = "merged"
71		MilestoneRetired     Milestone = "retired"
72		MilestoneReconciled  Milestone = "reconciled"
73	)

76	// UI. A handoff is an outcome, not proof that activation already happened.

100		StepCompleted StepStatus = "completed"
101		StepFailed    StepStatus = "failed"

104	// StepResult is one entry in the ordered execution ledger. Failure is text

115	// Clone returns a step with independent effect detail storage.
116	func (s StepResult) Clone() StepResult {
117		s.Effect = s.Effect.Clone()

121	// NamedRefObservation is one exact local Git ref observation. Missing refs are

127		OID     string

129	}

147		RemoteReviewFailureAmbiguous        RemoteReviewFailureKind = "ambiguous"

152		RemoteReviewFailureProvider         RemoteReviewFailureKind = "provider"

156	// Exists=false is authoritative absence; every provider or decoding failure is
157	// State=error with Failure populated.

160		Exists      bool
161		Provider    forge.Kind
162		ReviewState forge.ReviewState
163		Draft       bool
164		URL         string
165		ObservedAt  time.Time
166		FailureKind RemoteReviewFailureKind

170	// RemoteObservation is the structured, run-local output of RefreshRemote. It is
171	// deliberately not a handoff or persistent cache. All fields are value-only so
172	// Result can return defensive copies without sharing mutable backing storage.
173	type RemoteObservation struct {
174		RemoteName   string
175		RemoteURL    string
176		Provider     forge.Kind
177		Repository   string
178		Head         string
179		Base         string
180		BeforeRefs   RemoteRefsObservation
181		AfterRefs    RemoteRefsObservation
182		HasAfterRefs bool
183		Review       RemoteReviewObservation
184		HasReview    bool
185	}
186	
187	// Clone returns an independent value. The explicit method keeps this contract
188	// stable if collection-valued observation fields are added later.
189	func (o RemoteObservation) Clone() RemoteObservation { return o }
190	
191	// ResultSpec is mutable construction input. NewResult copies every collection
192	// and optional value before returning a Result.
193	type ResultSpec struct {
194		Steps            []StepResult
195		Warnings         []string
196		Recovery         []string
197		PartialSuccess   bool
198		Milestone        Milestone
199		Handoff          *Handoff
200		Remote           *RemoteObservation
201		FreshSnapshotRef string
202	}
203	
204	// Result is a value-safe execution ledger. It deliberately has no rollback
205	// field: completed effects remain completed and recovery describes the next
206	// safe action instead of claiming reversal.
207	type Result struct {
208		PartialSuccess bool
209		Milestone      Milestone
210	
211		steps            []StepResult
212		warnings         []string
213		recovery         []string
214		handoff          Handoff
215		hasHandoff       bool
216		remote           RemoteObservation
217		hasRemote        bool
218		freshSnapshotRef string
219	}
220	
221	// NewResult defensively copies a result specification.
222	func NewResult(spec ResultSpec) Result {
223		result := Result{
224			PartialSuccess:   spec.PartialSuccess,
225			Milestone:        spec.Milestone,
226			warnings:         append([]string(nil), spec.Warnings...),
227			recovery:         append([]string(nil), spec.Recovery...),
228			freshSnapshotRef: spec.FreshSnapshotRef,
229		}
230		result.steps = cloneSteps(spec.Steps)
231		if spec.Handoff != nil {
232			result.handoff = *spec.Handoff
233			result.hasHandoff = true
234		}
235		if spec.Remote != nil {
236			result.remote = spec.Remote.Clone()
237			result.hasRemote = true
238		}
239		if !result.PartialSuccess && len(result.CompletedSteps()) > 0 && len(result.FailedSteps()) > 0 {
240			result.PartialSuccess = true
241		}
242		return result
243	}
244	
245	// Clone returns a result with independent ledger and message slices.
246	func (r Result) Clone() Result {
247		r.steps = cloneSteps(r.steps)
248		r.warnings = append([]string(nil), r.warnings...)
249		r.recovery = append([]string(nil), r.recovery...)
250		return r
251	}
252	
253	// AttemptedSteps returns every effect entered by the executor, in order.
254	func (r Result) AttemptedSteps() []StepResult { return cloneSteps(r.steps) }
255	
256	// CompletedSteps returns completed effects in ledger order.
257	func (r Result) CompletedSteps() []StepResult { return stepsWithStatus(r.steps, StepCompleted) }
258	
259	// FailedSteps returns failed effects in ledger order.
260	func (r Result) FailedSteps() []StepResult { return stepsWithStatus(r.steps, StepFailed) }
261	
262	// Warnings returns non-fatal diagnostics in emission order.
263	func (r Result) Warnings() []string { return append([]string(nil), r.warnings...) }
264	
265	// Recovery returns ordered, safe follow-up instructions after partial work.
266	func (r Result) Recovery() []string { return append([]string(nil), r.recovery...) }
267	
268	// Handoff returns the optional post-UI navigation or activation target.
269	func (r Result) Handoff() (Handoff, bool) { return r.handoff, r.hasHandoff }
270	
271	// RemoteObservation returns the optional run-local remote/ref/review evidence.
272	// The returned value shares no mutable backing storage with Result.
273	func (r Result) RemoteObservation() (RemoteObservation, bool) {
274		return r.remote.Clone(), r.hasRemote
275	}
276	
277	// FreshSnapshotRef returns the optional freshly loaded after-snapshot reference.
278	func (r Result) FreshSnapshotRef() (string, bool) {
279		return r.freshSnapshotRef, r.freshSnapshotRef != ""
280	}
281	
282	func cloneSteps(steps []StepResult) []StepResult {
283		out := make([]StepResult, len(steps))
284		for index, step := range steps {
285			out[index] = step.Clone()
286		}
287		return out
288	}
289	
290	func stepsWithStatus(steps []StepResult, status StepStatus) []StepResult {
291		out := make([]StepResult, 0, len(steps))
292		for _, step := range steps {
293			if step.Status == status {
294				out = append(out, step.Clone())
295			}
296		}
297		return out
298	}

342	func resolveRepoRequest(req RepoRequest) (repoTarget, error) {
343		fullName := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.FullName), "/")
344		name := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.Name), "/")
345		namespace := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.Namespace), "/")
346		if fullName == "" {
347			fullName = name
348			if namespace != "" && !strings.Contains(name, "/") {
349				fullName = namespace + "/" + name
350			}
351		}
352		if fullName == "" {
353			return repoTarget{}, errors.New("repository name is required")
354		}
355		if strings.Contains(fullName, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(fullName, "git@") {
356			return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("repository name %q must not be a URL", fullName)
357		}
358		parts := strings.Split(fullName, "/")
359		for _, part := range parts {
360			if part == "" || part == "." || part == ".." {
361				return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid repository name %q", fullName)
362			}
363		}
364		name = parts[len(parts)-1]
365		if len(parts) > 1 {
366			namespace = strings.Join(parts[:len(parts)-1], "/")
367		}
368	
369		visibility := req.Visibility
370		if visibility == "" {
371			if req.Private {
372				visibility = VisibilityPrivate
373			} else {
374				visibility = VisibilityPublic
375			}
376		}
377		switch visibility {
378		case VisibilityPublic, VisibilityPrivate, VisibilityInternal:
379		default:
380			return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported repository visibility %q", visibility)
381		}
382		remoteName := strings.TrimSpace(req.RemoteName)
383		if remoteName == "" {
384			remoteName = "origin"
385		}
386		return repoTarget{
387			name: name, namespace: namespace, fullName: fullName,
388			visibility: visibility, remoteName: remoteName,
389		}, nil
390	}

281			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
282				continue
283			}
284			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
285			if seen[key] {
286				continue
287			}
288			seen[key] = true
289			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
290				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
291			}
292			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
293				return true, nil
294			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
295				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
296					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
297			}
298		}
299		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
300			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
301		}
302		return false, observationErr
303	}
304	
305	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
306		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
307		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
308	}
309	
310	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
311		if current == nil {
312			return next
313		}
314		if next == nil {
315			return current
316		}
317		return errors.Join(current, next)
318	}
319	
320	func (s *Service) Prepare(ctx context.Context, request PrepareRequest) (*Intent, error) {
321		if s.Store == nil {
322			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
323		}
324		provider, sessionID, err := ParseSession(request.Session)
325		if err != nil {
326			return nil, err
327		}
328		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, request.Worktree)
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
333		if err != nil {
334			return nil, err
335		}
336		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
337			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires a named branch")
338		}
339		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
340			return nil, err
341		} else if active {
342			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation refuses Git operation %s in progress", operation)
343		}
344		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
345		if err != nil {
346			return nil, err
347		}
348		changes, err := statusPaths(ctx, repository.Root)
349		if err != nil {
350			return nil, err
351		}
352		var unrelated []string
353		for _, change := range changes {
354			if change.Staged {
355				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires an empty index; staged path: %s", change.Path)
356			}
357			if !isRecognizedArtifact(change.Path) {
358				return nil, fmt.Errorf("commit product changes before prepare; dirty path: %s", change.Path)
359			}
360			unrelated = append(unrelated, change.Path)
361		}
362		transcript, err := FindTranscript(repository.Root, provider, sessionID)
363		if err != nil {
364			return nil, err
365		}
366		tracked, err := gitTracked(ctx, repository.Root, transcript.Path)
367		if err != nil {
368			return nil, err
369		}

257			Archived          bool   `json:"archived"`

260		}
261		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
262			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode glab api projects: %w", err)
263		}
264		result := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
265		for _, r := range raw {
266			updated, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, r.LastActivityAt)
267			result = append(result, RemoteRepo{
268				Forge: GitLab, Name: r.Name, FullName: r.PathWithNamespace,
269				Description: r.Description, URL: r.WebURL,
270				CloneURL: r.HTTPURL, SSHURL: r.SSHURL,
271				Visibility: r.Visibility, DefaultBranch: r.DefaultBranch,
272				Archived: r.Archived, Fork: r.ForkedFrom != nil, UpdatedAt: updated,
273			})
274		}
275		return result, nil
276	}

326			target := target

329				defer wg.Done()
330				out, err := run(ctx, "az", "", "repos", "list", "--detect", "false",
331					"--organization", target.Organization, "--project", target.Project,

338				if err != nil {

349		for item := range ch {

353			}

355		sort.Slice(repos, func(i, j int) bool { return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label() })
356		unique := repos[:0]
357		seen := map[string]bool{}
358		for _, repo := range repos {
359			key := strings.ToLower(repo.Label())
360			if seen[key] {
361				continue
362			}
363			seen[key] = true
364			unique = append(unique, repo)
365		}
366		return unique, errors.Join(errs...)
367	}

401	// parseAzureDevOpsRemote returns the provider identity and browser-safe HTTPS
402	// repository URL for supported Azure DevOps Services clone URL forms.
403	func parseAzureDevOpsRemote(raw string) (identity, webURL string, ok bool) {
404		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
405		if raw == "" {
406			return "", "", false
407		}
408		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
409			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
410			if err != nil || u.Fragment != "" || u.RawQuery != "" {
411				return "", "", false
412			}
413			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
414			case "https":
415				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
416					return "", "", false
417				}
418				return parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u)
419			case "ssh":
420				if u.User == nil || (u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22") {
421					return "", "", false
422				}
423				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
424					return "", "", false
425				}
426				return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(u.User.Username(), strings.ToLower(u.Hostname()), escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath()))
427			default:
428				return "", "", false
429			}
430		}
431		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
432		if at <= 0 {
433			return "", "", false
434		}
435		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
436		if colon < 0 {
437			return "", "", false
438		}
439		colon += at + 1
440		return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(raw[:at], strings.ToLower(raw[at+1:colon]), decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(raw[colon+1:], "/"), "/")))
441	}
442	
443	func parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u *url.URL) (string, string, bool) {
444		if u.User != nil {
445			if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
446				return "", "", false
447			}
448		}
449		host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
450		segments := escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath())
451		var organization, project, repo string
452		switch {
453		case host == "dev.azure.com":
454			if len(segments) != 4 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[2], "_git") {
455				return "", "", false
456			}
457			organization, project, repo = segments[0], segments[1], segments[3]
458			if u.User != nil && !strings.EqualFold(u.User.Username(), organization) {
459				return "", "", false
460			}
461		case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com") && host != "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com":
462			if len(segments) < 3 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[len(segments)-2], "_git") || u.User != nil {
463				return "", "", false
464			}
465			organization = strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")
466			project, repo = segments[len(segments)-3], segments[len(segments)-1]
467		default:
468			return "", "", false
469		}
470		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
471		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
472			return "", "", false
473		}
474		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
475		webURL := azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo)
476		return identity, webURL, true
477	}
478	
479	func parseAzureDevOpsSSH(user, host string, segments []string) (string, string, bool) {
480		var organization, project, repo string
481		switch {
482		case host == "ssh.dev.azure.com" && strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && len(segments) == 4 && strings.EqualFold(segments[0], "v3"):
483			organization, project, repo = segments[1], segments[2], segments[3]
484			host = "dev.azure.com"
485		case host == "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com" && len(segments) == 3 && strings.EqualFold(segments[1], "_ssh"):
486			organization, project, repo = user, segments[0], segments[2]
487			host = strings.ToLower(organization) + ".visualstudio.com"
488		default:
489			return "", "", false
490		}
491		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
492		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
493			return "", "", false
494		}
495		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
496		return identity, azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo), true
497	}
498	
499	func azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo string) string {
500		if host == "dev.azure.com" {
501			return "https://dev.azure.com/" + url.PathEscape(organization) + "/" + url.PathEscape(project) + "/_git/" + url.PathEscape(repo)
502		}
503		return "https://" + host + "/" + url.PathEscape(project) + "/_git/" + url.PathEscape(repo)
504	}
505	
506	func escapedSegments(path string) []string {
507		return decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(path, "/"), "/"))
508	}
509	
510	func decodeSegments(segments []string) []string {
511		if len(segments) == 1 && segments[0] == "" {
512			return nil
513		}
514		out := make([]string, 0, len(segments))
515		for _, segment := range segments {
516			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(segment)
517			if err != nil || decoded == "" || strings.Contains(decoded, "/") {
518				return nil
519			}
520			out = append(out, decoded)
521		}
522		return out
523	}

13	// ReviewQuery identifies one exact head/base relationship in one repository.
14	// Repository is the forge's stable repository identity: owner/repository for
15	// GitHub, group/repository for GitLab, or organization/project/repository for
16	// Azure DevOps. Adapters must still verify the returned branches because CLI
17	// filters are not sufficient evidence on their own.
18	type ReviewQuery struct {
19		Repository string `json:"repository"`
20		Head       string `json:"head"`
21		Base       string `json:"base"`
22	}
23	
24	// ReviewState is the portable lifecycle state observed for a provider review.
25	type ReviewState string
26	
27	const (
28		ReviewOpen   ReviewState = "open"
29		ReviewDraft  ReviewState = "draft"
30		ReviewMerged ReviewState = "merged"
31		ReviewClosed ReviewState = "closed"
32	)
33	
34	// Valid reports whether s has defined portable review semantics.
35	func (s ReviewState) Valid() bool {
36		switch s {
37		case ReviewOpen, ReviewDraft, ReviewMerged, ReviewClosed:
38			return true
39		default:
40			return false
41		}
42	}
43	
44	// Review is the minimal provider evidence for an exact head/base relationship.
45	// ID is the provider-stable identity and Number is the repository-local human
46	// identifier. Head, Base, State and Draft are observations from the provider
47	// response rather than values copied from ReviewQuery.
48	type Review struct {
49		Provider   Kind        `json:"provider"`
50		Repository string      `json:"repository"`
51		ID         string      `json:"id"`
52		Number     int         `json:"number"`
53		State      ReviewState `json:"state"`
54		Draft      bool        `json:"draft"`
55		URL        string      `json:"url"`
56		Head       string      `json:"head"`
57		Base       string      `json:"base"`
58		ObservedAt time.Time   `json:"observed_at"`
59	}
60	
61	// ReviewQuerier is an optional forge capability. A nil Review and nil error is
62	// a successful observation that no exact review exists. One exact match returns
63	// provider evidence; multiple exact matches fail with AmbiguousReviewError.
64	type ReviewQuerier interface {
65		QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error)
66	}
67	
68	var (
69		// ErrAmbiguousReview identifies a query with multiple exact head/base
70		// matches. Callers must not select one by recency or provider ordering.
71		ErrAmbiguousReview = errors.New("multiple reviews match")
72		// ErrMalformedReviewResponse identifies provider JSON that cannot supply the
73		// critical portable fields without guessing.
74		ErrMalformedReviewResponse = errors.New("malformed review response")
75	)
76	
77	// AmbiguousReviewError carries every exact match while keeping Error text free
78	// of provider response values such as private URLs and branch names.
79	type AmbiguousReviewError struct {
80		Provider Kind
81		Query    ReviewQuery
82		Matches  []Review
83	}
84	
85	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Error() string {
86		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review query returned %d exact matches", e.Provider, len(e.Matches))
87	}
88	
89	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguousReview }
90	
91	// MalformedReviewResponseError identifies the unusable response field without
92	// embedding its value or the response body. Index is zero-based and is -1 when
93	// the whole JSON document is malformed. Err retains safe decoder diagnostics.
94	type MalformedReviewResponseError struct {
95		Provider Kind
96		Index    int
97		Field    string
98		Err      error
99	}
100	
101	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Error() string {
102		location := "response"
103		if e.Index >= 0 {
104			location = fmt.Sprintf("response item %d", e.Index+1)
105		}
106		detail := "missing or invalid " + e.Field
107		if e.Err != nil {
108			detail = e.Err.Error()
109		}
110		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review %s is malformed: %s", e.Provider, location, detail)
111	}
112	
113	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
114	
115	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Is(target error) bool {
116		return target == ErrMalformedReviewResponse
117	}
118	
119	// QueryReview invokes the optional capability without widening Forge. It never
120	// caches or initiates a query unless a caller explicitly calls this function.
121	func QueryReview(ctx context.Context, f Forge, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
122		querier, ok := f.(ReviewQuerier)
123		if !ok {
124			return nil, &ErrUnsupported{Kind: f.Kind(), Operation: "review queries"}
125		}
126		return querier.QueryReview(ctx, dir, query)
127	}
128	
129	type reviewCandidate struct {
130		ID                      string
131		Number                  int
132		State                   string
133		Draft                   *bool
134		URL                     string
135		Head                    string
136		Base                    string
137		SourceMatchesRepository *bool
138	}
139	
140	type reviewStateNormalizer func(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error)
141	
142	func validateReviewQuery(query ReviewQuery) error {
143		switch {
144		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Repository) == "":
145			return errors.New("review query repository is required")
146		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Head) == "":
147			return errors.New("review query head is required")
148		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Base) == "":
149			return errors.New("review query base is required")
150		default:
151			return nil
152		}
153	}
154	
155	func decodeReviewJSON(provider Kind, out string, target any) error {
156		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(out)
157		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
158			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON array", nil)
159		}
160		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), target); err != nil {
161			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON", err)
162		}
163		return nil
164	}
165	
166	func selectExactReview(provider Kind, query ReviewQuery, candidates []reviewCandidate, normalize reviewStateNormalizer) (*Review, error) {
167		matches := make([]Review, 0, 1)
168		observedAt := time.Now().UTC()
169		for index, candidate := range candidates {
170			if candidate.Head == "" {
171				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "head branch", nil)
172			}
173			if candidate.Base == "" {
174				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "base branch", nil)
175			}
176			if candidate.Head != query.Head || candidate.Base != query.Base {
177				continue
178			}
179			if candidate.SourceMatchesRepository == nil {
180				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "source repository identity", nil)
181			}
182			if !*candidate.SourceMatchesRepository {
183				continue
184			}
185			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate.ID) == "" {
186				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "identifier", nil)
187			}
188			if candidate.Number <= 0 {
189				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "number", nil)
190			}
191			if candidate.Draft == nil {
192				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "draft flag", nil)
193			}
194			if !validReviewURL(candidate.URL) {
195				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "URL", nil)
196			}
197			state, err := normalize(candidate.State, *candidate.Draft)
198			if err != nil {
199				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "state", err)
200			}
201			matches = append(matches, Review{
202				Provider: provider, Repository: query.Repository,
203				ID: candidate.ID, Number: candidate.Number,
204				State: state, Draft: *candidate.Draft, URL: candidate.URL,
205				Head: candidate.Head, Base: candidate.Base, ObservedAt: observedAt,
206			})
207		}
208	
209		switch len(matches) {
210		case 0:
211			return nil, nil
212		case 1:
213			return &matches[0], nil
214		default:
215			return nil, &AmbiguousReviewError{
216				Provider: provider, Query: query,
217				Matches: append([]Review(nil), matches...),
218			}
219		}
220	}
221	
222	func malformedReviewResponse(provider Kind, index int, field string, err error) error {
223		return &MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: index, Field: field, Err: err}
224	}
225	
226	func validReviewURL(raw string) bool {
227		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
228		if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" {
229			return false
230		}
231		return parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http"
232	}
233

146	func installReviewTestRunner(t *testing.T, output string) *[]reviewInvocation {
147		t.Helper()
148		calls := []reviewInvocation{}
149		installReviewTestSeams(t, func(_ context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
150			calls = append(calls, reviewInvocation{bin: bin, dir: dir, args: append([]string(nil), args...)})
151			if bin == "az" && len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "extension" {

153			}

163		t.Cleanup(func() {

429	func revalidatePreparedIntent(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
430		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
431		if err != nil {
432			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout before arming intent: %w", err)
433		}
434		checkout, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.Root)
435		if err != nil {
436			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize revalidated artifact checkout: %w", err)
437		}
438		expectedCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
439		if err != nil {
440			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize prepared artifact checkout: %w", err)
441		}
442		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
443		if err != nil {
444			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize revalidated artifact Git common directory: %w", err)
445		}
446		expectedCommon, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.GitCommonDir)
447		if err != nil {
448			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize prepared artifact Git common directory: %w", err)
449		}
450		if checkout != expectedCheckout || commonDir != expectedCommon {
451			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout identity changed before intent creation")
452		}
453		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
454		if err != nil {
455			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout status: %w", err)
456		}
457		if status.Detached || status.Branch != intent.Branch {
458			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout branch changed from %s to %s before intent creation", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
459		}
460		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(checkout); err != nil {
461			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact Git operation: %w", err)
462		} else if active {
463			return fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation refuses Git operation %s that started before intent creation", operation)
464		}
465		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
466		if err != nil {
467			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout HEAD: %w", err)
468		}
469		if strings.TrimSpace(head) != strings.TrimSpace(intent.Head) {
470			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout HEAD changed before intent creation")
471		}
472		return nil
473	}

68	Without an argument, a checkout opens its canonical repository and focuses the

143	func runFlow(app *App, launch flowLaunch, runProgram flowProgramRunner) error {
144		if runProgram == nil {
145			return errors.New("flow program runner is unavailable")
146		}
147		flowtui.SetColorEnabled(app.outStyle().enabled)
148		app.traceTUI = true
149		runCtx, cancelRun := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
150		finishSetup := app.trace.Start(perftrace.TUISetup, perftrace.Fields{})
151		runtimeResolver := newTUIRuntimeResolver(app)
152		loader := newFlowLoader(app, runtimeResolver, launch.cwd)
153		if launch.repository != nil {
154			loader.registerRepository(*launch.repository, true)
155		}
156		actions := loader.actions()
157		if app.deferredReleaseRefresh {
158			actions.AfterFirstView = func(context.Context) { app.refreshReleaseDetached() }
159		}
160		model := flowtui.New(actions, launch.preselected).WithContext(runCtx)
161		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
162		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
163		final, err := runProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen())
164		cancelRun()
165		app.finishTrace()
166		if err != nil {
167			return err
168		}
169		withHandoff, ok := final.(interface {
170			Handoff() (taskflow.Handoff, bool)
171		})
172		if !ok {
173			return nil
174		}
175		handoff, ok := withHandoff.Handoff()
176		if !ok {
177			return nil
178		}
179		return honorFlowHandoff(app, runtimeResolver, handoff)
180	}
