182	func honorFlowHandoff(app *App, resolver flowRuntimeResolver, handoff taskflow.Handoff) error {
183		switch handoff.Kind {
184		case taskflow.HandoffDirectory:
185			if handoff.Path == "" {
186				return errors.New("flow returned an empty directory handoff")
187			}
188			return app.cdDirective(handoff.Path)
189		case taskflow.HandoffRuntime:
190			if handoff.Runtime == "" || handoff.RuntimeHandle == "" {
191				return errors.New("flow returned an incomplete runtime handoff")
192			}
193			var rt runtime.Runtime
194			if resolver != nil {
195				resolved, err := resolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
196				if err != nil {
197					return err
198				}
199				if resolved != nil && resolved.Name() == handoff.Runtime {
200					rt = resolved
201				}
202			}
203			if rt == nil {
204				rt = app.runtimeNamed(handoff.Runtime)
205			}
206			if rt == nil || rt.Name() != handoff.Runtime {
207				return fmt.Errorf("flow handoff backend %q is unavailable", handoff.Runtime)
208			}
209			return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handoff.RuntimeHandle)
210		case taskflow.HandoffURL:
211			if handoff.URL == "" {
212				return errors.New("flow returned an empty URL handoff")
213			}
214			_, err := fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, handoff.URL)
215			return err
216		default:
217			return fmt.Errorf("flow returned unsupported handoff kind %q", handoff.Kind)
218		}
219	}

225	type flowRepository struct {
226		row              flowtui.RepositoryRow
227		repository       repo.Repo
228		available        bool
229		unavailableTasks []task.Record
230	}
231	
232	func availableFlowRepository(discovered gitx.Repo, preferred *repo.Repo, focus string) (flowRepository, error) {
233		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(discovered.GitCommonDir)
234		if err != nil {
235			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository identity: %w", err)
236		}
237		mainRoot := discovered.MainRoot
238		if mainRoot == "" && discovered.Bare {
239			mainRoot = discovered.GitCommonDir
240		}
241		mainRoot, err = pathx.Canonical(mainRoot)
242		if err != nil {
243			return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow repository root: %w", err)
244		}
245		focusTarget := ""
246		if focus != "" {
247			focusTarget, err = pathx.Canonical(focus)
248			if err != nil {
249				return flowRepository{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize flow focus: %w", err)
250			}
251		}
252	
253		r := repo.Repo{
254			Name: discovered.Name, Path: mainRoot, RealPath: mainRoot,
255			CommonDir: commonDir, MainRoot: mainRoot, Bare: discovered.Bare, HasGit: true,
256		}
257		name := discovered.Name
258		if preferred != nil {
259			if preferred.Name != "" {
260				r.Name = preferred.Name
261			}
262			r.Root = preferred.Root
263			r.Category = preferred.Category
264			name = preferred.Display()
265			if name == "" {
266				name = r.Name
267			}
268		}
269		return flowRepository{
270			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
271				RepoKey: commonDir, Name: name, Path: mainRoot, Available: true,
272				FocusTarget: focusTarget,
273			},
274			repository: r,
275			available:  true,
276		}, nil
277	}
278	
279	func unavailableFlowRepository(record task.Record, cause error) flowRepository {
280		path := record.Task.RepoPath
281		if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
282			path = canonical
283		} else if absolute, absErr := filepath.Abs(path); absErr == nil {
284			path = filepath.Clean(absolute)
285		}
286		name := record.Task.Repo
287		if name == "" {
288			name = filepath.Base(path)
289		}
290		message := "repository is unavailable"
291		if cause != nil {
292			message += ": " + cause.Error()
293		}
294		return flowRepository{
295			row: flowtui.RepositoryRow{
296				RepoKey: "unavailable:" + path, Name: name, Path: path,
297				Available: false, Error: message,
298			},
299			available:        false,
300			unavailableTasks: []task.Record{record},
301		}
302	}

338	func newFlowLoader(app *App, resolver flowRuntimeResolver, cwd string) *flowLoader {
339		loader := &flowLoader{
340			app:          app,
341			runtime:      resolver,
342			limiter:      inventory.NewLimiter(8),
343			cwd:          cwd,
344			now:          time.Now,
345			discover:     gitx.Discover,
346			gitRun:       gitx.Run,
347			listRepo:     repo.Discover,
348			inspect:      artifact.InspectReadiness,
349			base:         gitx.DefaultBranch,
350			repositories: make(map[string]flowRepository),
351			repoPathKeys: make(map[string]string),
352			pinned:       make(map[string]bool),
353			targets:      make(map[string]map[string]flowTarget),
354			approved:     make(map[string]flowApprovedPlan),
355			remote:       make(map[string]taskflow.RemoteObservation),
356		}
357		loader.service = func(rt runtime.Runtime) (*taskflow.Service, error) {
358			return newFlowLifecycleService(app, rt, cwd)
359		}
360		return loader

363	func newFlowLifecycleService(app *App, resolved runtime.Runtime, cwd string) (*taskflow.Service, error) {
364		if resolved == nil {
365			return nil, errors.New("flow runtime resolver returned no backend")
366		}
367		return taskflow.NewLifecycleService(taskflow.LifecycleConfig{
368			Config: app.Cfg, Tasks: app.Tasks, Artifacts: artifactStore(app),
369			DefaultRuntime: func() runtime.Runtime { return resolved },
370			NamedRuntime: func(name string) runtime.Runtime {
371				if name == "" || name == resolved.Name() {
372					return resolved
373				}
374				return app.runtimeNamed(name)
375			},
376			Host: config.Hostname(), CWD: cwd,
377			// The flow preview deliberately never inherits the expert shared-writer
378			// override. Its normal choices must remain fail-closed.
379			AllowSharedCheckout: false,
380			Logf: func(format string, args ...any) {
381				if app.Err != nil {
382					fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, format+"\n", args...)
383				}
384			},
385		})
386	}

388	func (l *flowLoader) registerRepository(repository flowRepository, pinned bool) {
389		l.mu.Lock()
390		defer l.mu.Unlock()
391		l.repositories[repository.row.RepoKey] = repository
392		if repository.available && repository.repository.MainRoot != "" {
393			l.repoPathKeys[repository.repository.MainRoot] = repository.row.RepoKey
394		}
395		if pinned {
396			l.pinned[repository.row.RepoKey] = true
397		}
398	}

400	func (l *flowLoader) actions() flowtui.Actions {

402			ListRepositories: l.ListRepositories,

405			Apply:            l.Apply,

408	
409	func (l *flowLoader) ListRepositories(ctx context.Context) ([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, error) {
410		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
411			return nil, err
412		}
413		records, _, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
414		if taskErr != nil {
415			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list task-referenced repositories: %w", taskErr)
416		}
417		discovered, err := l.listRepo(ctx, l.app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
418		if err != nil {
419			return nil, err
420		}
421	
422		fresh := make(map[string]flowRepository)
423		pathKeys := make(map[string]string)
424		l.mu.Lock()
425		for key := range l.pinned {
426			if existing, ok := l.repositories[key]; ok {
427				fresh[key] = existing
428				if existing.available && existing.repository.MainRoot != "" {
429					pathKeys[existing.repository.MainRoot] = key
430				}
431			}
432		}
433		l.mu.Unlock()
434	
435		for index := range discovered {
436			candidate := discovered[index]
437			gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, candidate.Path)
438			if discoverErr != nil {
439				continue
440			}
441			entry, convertErr := availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, &candidate, "")
442			if convertErr != nil {
443				continue
444			}
445			if _, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
446				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
447			}
448			pathKeys[candidate.Path] = entry.row.RepoKey
449		}
450	
451		pathResults := make(map[string]struct {
452			repository flowRepository
453			err        error
454		})
455		for _, record := range records {
456			path := record.Task.RepoPath
457			resolved, seen := pathResults[path]
458			if !seen {
459				gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, path)
460				if discoverErr == nil {
461					resolved.repository, discoverErr = availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, nil, "")
462				}
463				resolved.err = discoverErr
464				pathResults[path] = resolved
465			}
466			if resolved.err == nil {
467				if _, exists := fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
468					fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey] = resolved.repository
469				}
470				pathKeys[path] = resolved.repository.row.RepoKey
471				continue
472			}
473			entry := unavailableFlowRepository(record, resolved.err)
474			if existing, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; exists {
475				existing.unavailableTasks = appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(existing.unavailableTasks, record)
476				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = existing
477			} else {
478				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
479			}
480		}
481	
482		rows := make([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, 0, len(fresh))
483		for _, entry := range fresh {
484			rows = append(rows, entry.row)
485		}
486		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
487			left, right := strings.ToLower(rows[i].Name), strings.ToLower(rows[j].Name)
488			if left != right {
489				return left < right
490			}
491			if rows[i].Path != rows[j].Path {
492				return rows[i].Path < rows[j].Path
493			}
494			return rows[i].RepoKey < rows[j].RepoKey
495		})
496		l.mu.Lock()
497		l.repositories = fresh
498		l.repoPathKeys = pathKeys
499		l.mu.Unlock()
500		return rows, nil
501	}
502	
503	func appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(records []task.Record, candidate task.Record) []task.Record {
504		for _, record := range records {
505			if record.Task.ID == candidate.Task.ID {
506				return records
507			}
508		}
509		return append(records, candidate)
510	}

512	func (l *flowLoader) LoadRepository(ctx context.Context, repoKey string) (flowtui.Snapshot, error) {
513		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
514			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
515		}
516		l.mu.Lock()
517		selected, ok := l.repositories[repoKey]
518		pathKeys := make(map[string]string, len(l.repoPathKeys))
519		for path, key := range l.repoPathKeys {
520			pathKeys[path] = key
521		}
522		l.mu.Unlock()
523		if !ok {
524			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is not in the current flow inventory", repoKey)
525		}
526		if !selected.available {
527			return l.unavailableSnapshot(selected), nil
528		}
529	
530		records, diagnostics, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
531		selectedTasks := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(records))
532		selectedRecords := make(map[string]task.Record)
533		type pathResult struct {
534			repoKey string
535			err     error
536		}
537		resolvedPaths := make(map[string]pathResult)
538		for index := range records {
539			record := records[index]
540			path := record.Task.RepoPath
541			key, cached := pathKeys[path]
542			if !cached {
543				resolved, seen := resolvedPaths[path]
544				if !seen {
545					repository, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, path)
546					if discoverErr == nil {
547						resolved.repoKey, discoverErr = pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
548					}
549					resolved.err = discoverErr
550					resolvedPaths[path] = resolved
551				}
552				if resolved.err != nil {
553					continue
554				}
555				key = resolved.repoKey
556			}
557			if key != repoKey {
558				continue
559			}
560			copy := record.Task
561			copy.Tags = append([]string(nil), record.Task.Tags...)
562			selectedTasks = append(selectedTasks, &copy)
563			record.Task = copy
564			selectedRecords[record.Task.ID] = record
565		}
566	
567		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
568		if err != nil {
569			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
570		}
571		if rt == nil {
572			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, errors.New("flow runtime resolver returned no backend")
573		}
574		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
575		runtimeObserved := runtimeErr == nil && rt.Name() != "none"
576		contextSnapshot := inventory.CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, selected.repository, selectedTasks, inventory.RepoContextOptions{
577			Runtime: rt.Name(), Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: runtimeObserved,
578			RuntimeErr: runtimeErr, Limiter: l.limiter,
579		})
580		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
581			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
582		}
583	
584		base := ""
585		if queryPath := flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot); queryPath != "" {
586			base = l.base(ctx, queryPath)
587		}
588		taskComplete := taskErr == nil && len(diagnostics) == 0
589		locatorBuilder := newFlowManagedLocatorBuilder(l.gitRun, contextSnapshot, selectedRecords)
590		rows, targets, projectionIssues := l.projectRows(ctx, contextSnapshot, locatorBuilder, taskComplete, base)
591	
592		issues := make([]string, 0, 8)
593		if taskErr != nil {
594			issues = append(issues, "task inventory: "+taskErr.Error())
595		}
596		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
597			issues = append(issues, "task diagnostic: "+diagnostic.Error())
598		}
599		if contextSnapshot.IdentityErr != nil {
600			issues = append(issues, "repository identity: "+contextSnapshot.IdentityErr.Error())
601		}
602		if contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr != nil {
603			issues = append(issues, "worktree inventory: "+contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr.Error())
604		}
605		if rt.Name() != "none" && runtimeErr != nil {
606			issues = append(issues, "runtime observation: "+runtimeErr.Error())
607		}
608		for _, checkout := range contextSnapshot.Checkouts {
609			if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
610				issues = append(issues, "Git status "+checkout.Worktree.Path+": "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
611			}
612		}
613		issues = append(issues, projectionIssues...)
614		issues = uniqueStrings(issues)
615	
616		freshness := flowtui.FreshnessFresh
617		if len(issues) > 0 {
618			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
619		}
620		repositoryRow := selected.row
621		repositoryRow.Available = contextSnapshot.RepositoryID == repoKey && contextSnapshot.IdentityErr == nil
622		if contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != "" && contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != repoKey {
623			issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("repository identity changed from %s to %s", repoKey, contextSnapshot.RepositoryID))
624			repositoryRow.Available = false
625			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
626		}
627		snapshot := flowtui.Snapshot{
628			Repository: repositoryRow,
629			Surfaces:   flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
630			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(),
631			Freshness:  freshness,
632			Error:      strings.Join(uniqueStrings(issues), "; "),
633		}
634		l.mu.Lock()
635		l.targets[repoKey] = targets
636		if remote, exists := l.remote[repoKey]; exists {
637			snapshot.Remote = flowtui.SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
638		}
639		l.mu.Unlock()
640		return snapshot, nil
641	}
642	
643	func (l *flowLoader) unavailableSnapshot(selected flowRepository) flowtui.Snapshot {
644		rows := make([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, 0, len(selected.unavailableTasks))
645		for _, record := range selected.unavailableTasks {
646			tracked := record.Task
647			rows = append(rows, flowtui.SurfaceRow{
648				RowKey: tracked.ID, Kind: flowtui.SurfaceTaskOnly,
649				Label: tracked.Title(), Branch: tracked.Branch, Base: tracked.Base,
650				Mode: tracked.EffectiveMode(), State: tracked.State,
651				Drift: flowtui.NewLines("repository-unavailable: " + selected.row.Error),
652				Evidence: flowtui.NewLines(
653					"recorded repository path: "+tracked.RepoPath,
654					fmt.Sprintf("task: %s mode=%s state=%s", tracked.ID, tracked.EffectiveMode(), tracked.State),
655				),
656			})
657		}
658		l.mu.Lock()
659		l.targets[selected.row.RepoKey] = map[string]flowTarget{}
660		l.mu.Unlock()
661		return flowtui.Snapshot{
662			Repository: selected.row, Surfaces: flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
663			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(), Freshness: flowtui.FreshnessStale,
664			Error: selected.row.Error,
665		}
666	}
667	
668	func flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext) string {
669		if main, ok := contextSnapshot.Main(); ok && main.Worktree.Path != "" {
670			return main.Worktree.Path
671		}
672		for _, candidate := range []string{
673			contextSnapshot.Repo.MainRoot,
674			contextSnapshot.Repo.Path,
675			contextSnapshot.Repo.RealPath,
676			contextSnapshot.Repo.CommonDir,
677		} {
678			if candidate != "" {
679				return candidate
680			}
681		}
682		return ""
683	}
684	
685	type flowLocatorValue struct {
686		value string
687		err   error
688	}
689	
690	type flowManagedLocatorBuilder struct {
691		run       func(context.Context, string, ...string) (string, error)
692		repoPath  string
693		repoKey   string
694		records   map[string]task.Record
695		refs      map[string]flowLocatorValue
696		upstreams map[string]flowLocatorValue
697	}
698	
699	func newFlowManagedLocatorBuilder(
700		run func(context.Context, string, ...string) (string, error),
701		contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext,
702		records map[string]task.Record,
703	) *flowManagedLocatorBuilder {
704		return &flowManagedLocatorBuilder{
705			run: run, repoPath: flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot), repoKey: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID,
706			records: records, refs: make(map[string]flowLocatorValue), upstreams: make(map[string]flowLocatorValue),
707		}
708	}
709	
710	func (b *flowManagedLocatorBuilder) locate(ctx context.Context, row inventory.RepoContextRow, taskID string) (taskflow.Locator, error) {
711		record, ok := b.records[taskID]
712		if !ok {
713			return taskflow.Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("task %s is absent from the loaded revision snapshot", taskID)
714		}
715		candidate := record.Task
716		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
717		locator := taskflow.Locator{
718			RepoKey: b.repoKey, RowKey: taskID, RowKind: "task",
719			RepositoryID: b.repoKey, GitCommonDir: b.repoKey,
720			TaskID: taskID, TaskRevision: record.Revision,
721			RepoPath: b.repoPath, Branch: candidate.Branch, Base: candidate.Base, Remote: "origin",
722			Mode: mode, State: candidate.State,
723		}
724		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
725			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
726				expected, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate.WorktreePath)
727				if err != nil {
728					return taskflow.Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize task %s checkout: %w", taskID, err)
729				}
730				locator.CheckoutPath = expected
731			}
732		} else {
733			locator.CheckoutPath = b.repoPath
734		}
735		if row.Checkout != nil {
736			locator.RowKey, locator.RowKind = row.Checkout.ID, "checkout"
737			locator.CheckoutPath = row.Checkout.ID
738			locator.HeadOID = strings.TrimSpace(row.Checkout.Worktree.Head)
739			if row.Checkout.StatusErr == nil {
740				locator.Upstream = row.Checkout.Status.Upstream
741			}
742		}
743		if locator.HeadOID == "" {
744			locator.HeadOID, _ = b.refOID(ctx, "refs/heads/"+candidate.Branch)
745		}
746		if locator.Upstream == "" && (row.Checkout == nil || mode == task.ModeWorktree) {
747			locator.Upstream, _ = b.branchUpstream(ctx, candidate.Branch)
748		}
749		locator.BaseOID, _ = b.refOID(ctx, candidate.Base)
750		locator.UpstreamOID, _ = b.refOID(ctx, locator.Upstream)
751		return locator, nil
752	}
753	
754	func (b *flowManagedLocatorBuilder) refOID(ctx context.Context, ref string) (string, error) {
755		if ref == "" {
756			return "", nil
757		}
758		if cached, ok := b.refs[ref]; ok {
759			return cached.value, cached.err
760		}
761		value, err := b.run(ctx, b.repoPath, "rev-parse", "--verify", ref+"^{commit}")
762		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
763		b.refs[ref] = flowLocatorValue{value: value, err: err}
764		return value, err
765	}
766	
767	func (b *flowManagedLocatorBuilder) branchUpstream(ctx context.Context, branch string) (string, error) {
768		if branch == "" {
769			return "", nil
770		}
771		if cached, ok := b.upstreams[branch]; ok {
772			return cached.value, cached.err
773		}
774		value, err := b.run(ctx, b.repoPath, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(upstream:short)", "refs/heads/"+branch)
775		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
776		b.upstreams[branch] = flowLocatorValue{value: value, err: err}
777		return value, err
778	}
779	
780	func (l *flowLoader) projectRows(
781		ctx context.Context,
782		contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext,
783		locatorBuilder *flowManagedLocatorBuilder,
784		taskInventoryComplete bool,
785		defaultBase string,
786	) ([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, map[string]flowTarget, []string) {
787		rows := make([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, 0, len(contextSnapshot.Rows))
788		targets := make(map[string]flowTarget)
789		var issues []string
790		for _, contextRow := range contextSnapshot.Rows {
791			projected, rowIssues := l.projectRow(ctx, contextSnapshot, contextRow, locatorBuilder, taskInventoryComplete, defaultBase)
792			issues = append(issues, rowIssues...)
793	
794			validChoices := make([]flowtui.ActionChoice, 0, projected.Actions.Len())
795			for _, choice := range projected.Actions.Values() {
796				request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(projected.Locator, choice.Options())
797				if err != nil {
798					issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("row %s action %s: %v", projected.RowKey, choice.ID, err))
799					continue
800				}

40	func newTUICmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
41		cmd := &cobra.Command{
42			Use:   "tui",
43			Short: "Interactive dashboard over the inventory",
44			Long: `Browse and act on your work in progress.
45	
46	Shows exactly what "dev ls" shows, from the same code path, plus the ability
47	to open, park and annotate a task without retyping its name.
48	
49	Six lists, switched with tab:
50	
51	  TASKS   change streams dev is tracking — what am I working on
52	  REPOS   durable repositories under the scan roots — what do I have here
53	  FLEET   repositories and active work across configured SSH machines
54	  TRY     scratch experiments and retained lifecycle history
55	  REMOTE  repositories visible through configured forge CLIs — what can I clone/open
56	  SKILLS  project/global agent skills, agents, sources and update state
57	
58	Navigation is vim-style, with arrows alongside:
59	
60	  j k        move                 ctrl+d ctrl+u   half a page
61	  g G        top / bottom         h l / tab       previous / next view
62	  /          filter as you type   esc             clear, then quit
63	
64	Actions depend on the list:
65	
66	  TASKS   enter open · p park · c edit next
67		  REPOS   enter ad hoc · space worktrees · m metadata · s worktree task · d direct task
68		  FLEET   enter Herdr/SSH open · Git changes are read-only here
69		  TRY     enter open · n create · space lifecycle/metadata actions
70	  REMOTE  enter open local · c clone after confirmation
71	  SKILLS  a interactive add · c check updates · u update selected after confirmation
72	
73	  y       copy menu: yy context · yp path · yb branch · ys sessions · yw WT paths
74	  H       selected repo heatmap; b backfills it when empty
75	  e       edit config; returning live-reloads data, columns, sort and tools
76	  O / R   cycle / reverse REPOS or TRY sort
77	  r       reload config + data     1 / 2 / 3  hot / warm / cold
78	  0       clear filters            a include history  ? help  q quit
79	
80	External tools are configured, not fixed — see [[tui.tools]] in the config,
81	and "dev tui tools" for what is bound here. They run in the selected row's checkout;
82	the dashboard suspends while they do and redraws afterwards, and bindings for
83	programs that are not installed are not offered.`,
84			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
85			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
86				return runTUI(app)
87			},
88		}
89		cmd.AddCommand(newTUIToolsCmd(app))
90		return cmd
91	}
92	
93	func newTUIToolsCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
94		return &cobra.Command{
95			Use:   "tools",
96			Short: "List the external tool bindings and whether each one works here",
97			Long: `Show which programs the dashboard will hand the terminal to.
98	
99	Bindings come from [[tui.tools]] in the config; with none configured, the
100	built-in set applies. A configured list replaces the defaults entirely, so
101	what is bound is always exactly what is written down.
102	
103	Add your own — an editor, a script, anything you already reach for:
104	
105	    [[tui.tools]]
106	    key  = "V"
107	    name = "nvim"
108	    run  = "nvim ."
109	
110	    [[tui.tools]]
111	    key  = "B"
112	    name = "vibe"
113	    run  = "vibe"
114	
115	The command runs through your shell in the selected row's checkout, so
116	arguments, environment variables and your own scripts all behave as typed.
117	Set interactive = true only for aliases/functions from your shell rc; that
118	binding runs through $SHELL -lic and the mode is shown in this listing.`,
119			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
120			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
121				configured := len(app.Cfg.TUI.Tools) > 0
122				source := "built-in defaults"
123				if configured {
124					source = config.Contract(app.Cfg.Source)
125				}
126				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "tool bindings from %s\n\n", source)
127	
128				t := app.newTable("KEY", "NAME", "MODE", "RUNS", "AVAILABLE")
129				style := app.outStyle()
130				configuredTools := app.Cfg.EffectiveTools()
131				for i, tool := range externalTools(app) {
132					status := "yes"
133					if tool.Probe != nil && !tool.Probe(ctxOf()) {
134						status = style.warning("no — not on PATH")
135					} else {
136						status = style.success(status)
137					}
138					// Command is [shell, -c/-lic, run]; show the run itself.
139					run := tool.Command[len(tool.Command)-1]
140					mode := "shell"
141					if i < len(configuredTools) && configuredTools[i].Interactive {
142						mode = "interactive"
143					}
144					t.Add(tool.Key, tool.Name, mode, run, status)
145				}
146				t.Render(app.Out)
147	
148				if !configured {
149					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nOverride them with [[tui.tools]] in your config; see \"dev tui tools --help\".")
150				}
151				fmt.Fprintln(app.Err, "\nA tool cannot take a key the dashboard already uses; dev reports the clash on load.")
152				return nil
153			},
154		}
155	}
156	
157	// interactive reports whether a real terminal is attached. Piping `dev` into
158	// anything must produce the plain listing, not terminal control sequences.
159	func interactive() bool {
160		for _, f := range []*os.File{os.Stdin, os.Stdout} {
161			info, err := f.Stat()
162			if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeCharDevice == 0 {
163				return false
164			}
165		}
166		return true
167	}

187	func tuiRemoteCloneDestination(app *App, name string) (string, error) {
188		projectRoot := config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot)
189		if err := os.MkdirAll(projectRoot, 0o755); err != nil {
190			return "", err
191		}
192		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(projectRoot, name)
193		if err != nil {
194			return "", fmt.Errorf("remote repository name %q is not a safe clone destination: %w", name, err)
195		}
196		return destination, nil
197	}

199	func runTUI(app *App) error {
200		app.traceTUI = true
201		runCtx, cancelRun := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
202		defer cancelRun()
203		finishSetup := app.trace.Start(perftrace.TUISetup, perftrace.Fields{})
204		// --color, NO_COLOR and TERM=dumb governed every other surface but stopped
205		// at the dashboard, which resolved its own palette independently.
206		tui.SetColorEnabled(app.outStyle().enabled)
207		appState := newTUIAppState(app)
208		runtimeResolver := newTUIRuntimeResolver(app)
209		projectRootResolver := newTUIProjectRootResolver(app.trace, runCtx)
210		localLoader := newTUILocalLoader(app, runtimeResolver)
211		localLoader.current = appState.Current
212	
213		reload := func(ctx context.Context) ([]inventory.Row, error) {
214			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
215			if err != nil {
216				return nil, err
217			}
218			tasks, err := appState.Current().Tasks.List()
219			if err != nil {
220				return nil, err
221			}
222			return inventory.Collect(ctx, tasks, rt, inventory.Options{}), nil
223		}
224		reloadRepos := func(ctx context.Context) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
225			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
226			if err != nil {
227				return nil, err
228			}
229			// Keep Try repositories in the model's local snapshot so cached REMOTE
230			// rows can be matched and cleared correctly. The REPOS view filters them.
231			return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, appState.Current(), rt, repoCollectOptions{IncludeTries: true})
232		}
233		reloadRemote := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
234			return collectRemotesForRows(ctx, appState.Current(), locals)
235		}
236		reloadFleet := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.FleetRow, error) {
237			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
238			if err != nil {
239				return nil, err
240			}
241			snapshot := fleetSnapshotFromRepoRows(locals, rt.Name())
242			results, _, err := collectFleet(ctx, appState.Current(), fleetCollectOptions{LocalSnapshot: &snapshot})
243			return fleetRows(results), err
244		}
245		reloadSkills := func(ctx context.Context) ([]agentskill.Skill, error) {
246			projectRoot, err := projectRootResolver.Resolve(ctx)
247			if err != nil {
248				return nil, err
249			}
250			return agentskill.List(ctx, projectRoot, agentskill.ListOptions{})
251		}
252		reloadTries := func(ctx context.Context, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
253			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
254			if err != nil {
255				return nil, err
256			}
257			return collectTries(ctx, appState.Current(), rt, includeAll)
258		}
259		openResolved := func(ctx context.Context, dir, label, statusLabel string) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
260			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
261			if err != nil {
262				return tui.OpenResult{}, err
263			}
264			handle, err := openCheckout(ctx, rt, dir, label)
265			if err != nil {
266				return tui.OpenResult{}, err
267			}
268			if rt.Name() == "none" {
269				return tui.OpenResult{Directory: dir}, nil
270			}
271			if statusLabel == "" {
272				statusLabel = label
273			}
274			return tui.OpenResult{
275				Status:        fmt.Sprintf("%s open in %s (%s)", statusLabel, rt.Name(), handle.Handle),
276				RuntimeHandle: handle.Handle,
277			}, nil
278		}
279	
280		actions := tui.Actions{
281			Reload:                reload,
282			ReloadRepos:           reloadRepos,
283			ReloadRemoteWithRepos: reloadRemote,
284			ReloadFleetWithRepos:  reloadFleet,
285			ReloadSkills:          reloadSkills,
286			LoadRemoteCache: func(context.Context) tui.RemoteCacheResult {
287				rows, found, stale := cachedRemoteRows(appState.Current())
288				return tui.RemoteCacheResult{Rows: rows, Found: found, Stale: stale}
289			},
290			LoadFleetCache: func(context.Context) tui.FleetCacheResult {
291				rows := cachedFleetRows(appState.Current())
292				return tui.FleetCacheResult{Rows: rows, Found: len(rows) > 0}
293			},
294			AfterFirstView: func(context.Context) {
295				if app.deferredReleaseRefresh {
296					app.refreshReleaseDetached()
297				}
298			},
299			CheckSkills: func(ctx context.Context, rows []agentskill.Skill) []agentskill.Skill {
300				return agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, rows)
301			},
302			AddSkill: func() (*exec.Cmd, error) {
303				projectRoot, ok := projectRootResolver.Current()
304				if !ok {
305					return nil, errors.New("project root is still loading")
306				}
307				return agentskill.AddCommand(context.Background(), projectRoot, agentskill.DefaultSource)
308			},
309			UpdateSkill: func(row agentskill.Skill) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
310				projectRoot, ok := projectRootResolver.Current()
311				if !ok {
312					return nil, errors.New("project root is still loading")
313				}
314				return agentskill.UpdateCommand(context.Background(), projectRoot, row.Name, row.Scope)
315			},
316			Repos: tui.RepoActions{
317				Patch: func(ctx context.Context, row tui.RepoRow, tags []string, note string) (string, error) {
318					active := appState.Current()
319					remove := []string(nil)
320					if row.Asset != nil {
321						remove = append(remove, row.Asset.Tags...)
322					}
323					marked, err := patchRepositoryCatalog(ctx, active, row.Repo, tags, remove, &note)
324					if err != nil {
325						return "", err
326					}
327					return "updated metadata for " + marked.Title(), nil
328				},
329			},
330			Tries: tui.TryActions{
331				Reload: reloadTries,
332				Apply: func(ctx context.Context, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
333					rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
334					if err != nil {
335						return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
336					}
337					return applyTryAction(ctx, appState.Current(), rt, request)
338				},
339			},
340			Notes: tui.NoteActions{
341				List: func(ctx context.Context, target tui.NoteTarget) ([]*note.Note, error) {
342					active := appState.Current()
343					entry, _, err := ensureNoteRepository(ctx, active, target)
344					if err != nil {
345						return nil, err
346					}
347					return active.Notes.List(entry.ID)
348				},
349				Search: func(ctx context.Context, target tui.NoteTarget, query string) ([]*note.Note, error) {
350					active := appState.Current()
351					entry, _, err := ensureNoteRepository(ctx, active, target)
352					if err != nil {
353						return nil, err
354					}
355					return active.Notes.Search(query, entry.ID, 100)
356				},
357				Add: func(ctx context.Context, target tui.NoteTarget, body string) (string, error) {
358					active := appState.Current()
359					entry, _, err := ensureNoteRepository(ctx, active, target)
360					if err != nil {
361						return "", err
362					}
363					n, err := active.Notes.Add(ctx, entry.ID, entry.Title(), body, nil)
364					if err != nil {
365						return "", err
366					}
367					return "added note " + n.ID[:8] + " to " + entry.Title(), nil
368				},
369				Delete: func(ctx context.Context, n *note.Note) (string, error) {
370					if err := appState.Current().Notes.Delete(ctx, n.ID); err != nil {
371						return "", err
372					}
373					return "deleted note " + n.ID[:8], nil
374				},
375				Edit: func(n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {
376					return prepareTUINoteEdit(appState.Current(), n)
377				},
378			},
379			Sizes: tui.SizeActions{
380				Start: func(ctx context.Context, targets []diskusage.Target, force bool) diskusage.Load {
381					return appState.Current().Sizes.Start(ctx, targets, force)
382				},
383				Cancel: func(loadID uint64) { appState.Current().Sizes.Cancel(loadID) },
384			},
385			Local:       tui.LocalActions{Start: localLoader.Start},
386			Tools:       externalTools(app),
387			RepoColumns: app.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
388			RepoSort:    app.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
389			RepoReverse: app.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
390			Copy:        clipboard.WriteAll,
391	
392			// Open is navigation-only. The model rejects missing/unregistered and
393			// cold worktree tasks before this callback so reconciliation and writer
394			// ownership remain explicit `dev sweep` / `dev resume` operations.
395			Open: func(ctx context.Context, t *task.Task) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
396				checkout := checkoutOf(t)
397				if _, err := os.Stat(checkout); err != nil {
398					return tui.OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout — run `dev resume %s`", t.Title(), t.ID)
399				}
400				// Enter is navigation only. Claiming a writer is an explicit
401				// `dev resume`/start action with collision checks.
402				return openResolved(ctx, checkout, t.Title(), "")
403			},
404	
405			OpenRepo: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
406				return openResolved(ctx, r.Repo.Path, r.Repo.Name, "")
407			},
408	
409			OpenCheckout: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
410				branch := checkout.Branch()
411				if branch == "" {
412					branch = filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
413				}
414				label := r.Repo.Name + "/" + branch
415				return openResolved(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, label, "")
416			},
417	
418			OpenRemote: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RemoteRow) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
419				if r.LocalPath == "" {
420					return tui.OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%s has no local checkout; press c to clone it", r.Repo.FullName)
421				}
422				return openResolved(ctx, r.LocalPath, r.Repo.Name, r.Repo.FullName)
423			},
424	
425			OpenFleet: func(ctx context.Context, row tui.FleetRow) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
426				active := appState.Current()
427				if row.Repository == nil {
428					return nil, fmt.Errorf("host %s has no repository selected", row.Host)
429				}
430				executable, err := os.Executable()
431				if err != nil {
432					return nil, err
433				}
434				args := []string{}
435				if active.configPath != "" {
436					args = append(args, "--config", active.configPath)
437				}
438				if active.remotesPath != "" {
439					args = append(args, "--remotes", active.remotesPath)
440				}
441				if row.Local {
442					args = append(args, "repo", "open", row.Repository.Path)
443				} else {
444					args = append(args, "fleet", "open", row.Host, row.Repository.Path)
445				}
446				return exec.CommandContext(ctx, executable, args...), nil
447			},
448	
449			CloneRemote: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RemoteRow) (tui.OpenResult, string, error) {
450				dest, err := tuiRemoteCloneDestination(appState.Current(), r.Repo.Name)
451				if err != nil {
452					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", err
453				}
454				if _, err := os.Stat(dest); err == nil {
455					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", fmt.Errorf("%s already exists; add it to scan_roots or clone somewhere explicit",
456						config.Contract(dest))
457				}
458				if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, filepath.Dir(dest), "clone", r.Repo.CloneURL, dest); err != nil {
459					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", err
460				}
461				opened, err := openResolved(ctx, dest, r.Repo.Name, r.Repo.FullName)
462				if err != nil {
463					return tui.OpenResult{}, "", fmt.Errorf("cloned to %s, but could not open it: %w", config.Contract(dest), err)
464				}
465				if opened.Directory != "" {
466					opened.Status = "cloned " + r.Repo.FullName + " to " + config.Contract(dest)
467				} else {
468					opened.Status = fmt.Sprintf("cloned %s to %s; %s", r.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(dest), opened.Status)
469				}
470				return opened, dest, nil
471			},
472	
473			Park: func(ctx context.Context, selected *task.Task, next string) (string, error) {
474				active := appState.Current()
475				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
476				if err != nil {
477					return "", err
478				}
479				actionApp := *active
480				actionApp.runtimeInstance = rt
481				execution, err := executeTaskLifecycle(ctx, &actionApp, func() (*task.Task, error) {
482					return actionApp.Tasks.Get(selected.ID)
483				}, flow.ParkWarmOptions{Next: next})
484				if err != nil {
485					return "", err
486				}
487				return execution.Task.Title() + " parked warm — worktree and branch kept", nil
488			},
489	
490			SetNext: func(ctx context.Context, selected *task.Task, next string) error {
491				active := appState.Current()
492				current, err := active.Tasks.GetRecord(selected.ID)
493				if err != nil {
494					return err
495				}
496				updated := current.Task
497				updated.Next = next
498				persisted, err := active.Tasks.Update(ctx, &updated, current.Revision)
499				if err != nil {
500					return err
501				}
502				annotate(active, runtimeForTask(active, &persisted.Task), &persisted.Task)
503				return nil
504			},
505	
506			// Start is the bridge from "here are my repositories" to "here is what
507			// I am working on" — the step that otherwise means dropping out of the
508			// dashboard to type a command.
509			Start: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
510				active := appState.Current()
511				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
512				if err != nil {
513					return "", err
514				}
515				actionApp := *active
516				actionApp.runtimeInstance = rt
517				spec, err := buildStartSpecForRepository(ctx, &actionApp, r.Repo, startRequest{
518					Name: name, Mode: task.ModeWorktree,
519				})
520				if err != nil {
521					return "", err
522				}
523				started, err := executeStartSpec(ctx, &actionApp, spec, nil)
524				if err != nil {
525					return "", err
526				}
527				return fmt.Sprintf("started %s on %s", name, started.Task.Branch), nil
528			},
529	
530			StartDirect: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
531				active := appState.Current()
532				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
533				if err != nil {
534					return "", err
535				}
536				if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, active, rt, r.Repo.Path); err != nil {
537					return "", err
538				}
539				st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Repo.Path)
540				if err != nil {
541					return "", err
542				}
543				if st.Detached || st.Branch == "" {
544					return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
545				}
546				id := task.MakeID(r.Repo.Name, st.Branch)
547				if existing, err := active.Tasks.Get(id); err == nil && existing.State != task.Done {
548					return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
549				}
550				handle, err := rt.Open(ctx, r.Repo.Path, r.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
551				if err != nil {
552					return "", err
553				}
554				t := &task.Task{
555					Name: name, Repo: r.Repo.Name, RepoPath: r.Repo.Path,
556					Branch: st.Branch, Base: st.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
557					State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),
558				}
559				setTaskRuntime(t, rt, handle)
560				if err := active.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
561					return "", err
562				}
563				annotate(active, rt, t)
564				return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, st.Branch), nil
565			},

567			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
568				active := appState.Current()
569				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
570				if err != nil {
571					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
572				}
573				defer store.Close()
574				until := time.Now()
575				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
576				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
577					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
578				})
579				if err != nil {
580					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
581				}
582				seconds, days := 0, 0
583				for _, value := range totals {
584					seconds += value
585					if value > 0 {
586						days++
587					}
588				}
589				return tui.StatsPanel{
590					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
591					Since: since, Until: until,
592					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
593						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
594					}),
595				}, nil
596			},

598			BackfillStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) error {
599				active := appState.Current()
600				r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, active.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repoName)
601				if err != nil {
602					return err
603				}
604				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
605				if err != nil {
606					return err
607				}
608				defer store.Close()
609				_, err = stats.BackfillGit(ctx, store, []repo.Repo{r}, time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), "")
610				return err

614				proc, _, _, err := configEditorProcess(appState.Current(), "")

618			EditFleetConfig: func() (*exec.Cmd, error) {
619				return fleetConfigEditorProcess(appState.Current(), "")
620			},
621	
622			// loadFleetConfig applies defaults and re-runs the private-mode check,
623			// so an edit that loosens remotes.toml's permissions while it holds a
624			// plaintext password is caught here rather than at the next fan-out.
625			ValidateFleetConfig: func() error {
626				_, err := loadFleetConfig(appState.Current())
627				return err

630			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
631				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
632				if err != nil {
633					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
634				}
635				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
636				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
637				if err != nil {
638					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
639				}
640				status := "config + data reloaded"
641				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
642					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
643				}
644				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
645					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
646					Tools:       externalTools(next),
647					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
648					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
649					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
650				}, status, nil
651			},
652		}
653	
654		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
655		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
656		// while dozens of repos are probed.
657		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
658		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
659		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
660		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
661		cancelRun()
662		app.finishTrace()
663		if err != nil {
664			return err
665		}
666		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
667		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
668		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
669			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
670				return app.cdDirective(dir)
671			}
672			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
673				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
674				if resolveErr != nil {
675					return resolveErr
676				}
677				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
678			}
679		}
680		return nil
681	}

688	func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,
689		sessions []runtime.Session, sessionsSet bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
690		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
691		if err != nil {
692			return nil, err
693		}
694		items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
695		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
696		if !sessionsSet {
697			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
698		}
699		rows := make([]tui.TryRow, 0, len(items))
700		for _, item := range items {
701			row := tui.TryRow{Item: item}
702			if item.Entry != nil {
703				if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname()); ok {
704					copy := location
705					row.Location = &copy
706				}
707			}
708			sizeRepo := item.Live.Repo
709			if sizeRepo == nil && item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
710				if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); discoverErr == nil {
711					sizeRepo = &discovered
712				}
713			}
714			if sizeRepo != nil {
715				worktreeCount := 0
716				if worktrees, worktreeErr := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); worktreeErr == nil && len(worktrees) > 1 {
717					worktreeCount = len(worktrees) - 1
718				}
719				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(*sizeRepo, worktreeCount)
720			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
721				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(item.Live.CurrentPath)
722			}
723			if item.Live.Present && item.Live.Repo != nil {
724				row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
725			}
726			if item.Live.Present {
727				for _, session := range sessions {
728					if session.Covers(item.Live.CurrentPath) ||
729						(item.Live.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(item.Live.RealPath)) {
730						row.Live = true
731						row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
732						break
733					}
734				}
735			}
736			rows = append(rows, row)
737		}
738		return rows, listErr
739	}

741	func applyTryAction(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
742		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
743		if err != nil {
744			return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
745		}
746		resolve := func() (experiment.Item, error) {
747			item, diagnostics, resolveErr := service.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.ID, experiment.ResolveOptions{
748				IncludeDeprecated: true, IncludeArchived: true,
749				IncludeEvicted: true, IncludeGraduated: true,
750			})
751			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
752			return item, resolveErr
753		}
754		open := func(item experiment.Item, status string) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
755			if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
756				return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("Try %s is not present on this host", item.DisplayName())
757			}
758			handle, openErr := openCheckout(ctx, rt, item.Live.CurrentPath, item.DisplayName())
759			if openErr != nil {
760				return tui.TryActionResult{}, openErr
761			}
762			result := tui.TryActionResult{Status: status, RefreshRepos: true}
763			if rt.Name() == "none" {
764				result.CD = item.Live.CurrentPath
765			} else {
766				result.Status += fmt.Sprintf(" in %s (%s)", rt.Name(), handle.Handle)
767				result.RuntimeHandle = handle.Handle
768			}
769			if _, touchErr := service.Touch(ctx, item.ID); touchErr != nil {
770				return result, fmt.Errorf("%s, but could not record activity: %w", status, touchErr)
771			}
772			return result, nil
773		}
774	
775		switch request.Action {
776		case tui.TryOpen:
777			item, resolveErr := resolve()
778			if resolveErr != nil {
779				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
780			}
781			return open(item, "opened "+item.DisplayName())
782	
783		case tui.TryCreate:
784			created, createErr := service.ResolveOrCreate(ctx, experiment.CreateRequest{
785				Name: request.Name, Clone: request.Clone, NoGit: request.NoGit,
786			})
787			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, created.Diagnostics)
788			if created.InitWarning != nil {
789				app.warnf("could not git init: %v", created.InitWarning)
790			}
791			if createErr != nil {
792				return tui.TryActionResult{}, createErr
793			}
794			status := "created " + created.Item.DisplayName()
795			if created.Existing {
796				status = "opened existing " + created.Item.DisplayName()
797			}
798			result, openErr := open(created.Item, status)
799			result.RefreshRepos = true
800			return result, openErr
801	
802		case tui.TryMark:
803			item, resolveErr := resolve()
804			if resolveErr != nil {
805				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
806			}
807			desired := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.Tags)
808			remove := append([]string(nil), item.Tags...)
809			note := request.Note
810			updated, diagnostics, patchErr := service.Patch(ctx, experiment.PatchRequest{
811				Ref: item.ID, AddTags: desired, RemoveTags: remove, Note: &note,
812			})
813			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
814			return tui.TryActionResult{
815				Status: "updated metadata for " + updated.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
816			}, patchErr
817	
818		case tui.TryDeprecate:
819			transition, transitionErr := service.Deprecate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
820			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
821			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "deprecated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
822	
823		case tui.TryReactivate:
824			transition, transitionErr := service.Reactivate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
825			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
826			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "reactivated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
827	
828		case tui.TryArchive:
829			transition, transitionErr := service.Archive(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
830			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
831			return tui.TryActionResult{
832				Status: "archived " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
833			}, transitionErr
834	
835		case tui.TryRestore:
836			transition, transitionErr := service.Restore(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID, To: request.To})
837			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
838			return tui.TryActionResult{
839				Status: "restored " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
840			}, transitionErr
841	
842		case tui.TryGraduate:
843			graduated, graduateErr := service.Graduate(ctx, experiment.GraduateRequest{
844				Ref: request.ID, Category: request.Category, Name: request.Name,
845			})
846			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, graduated.Diagnostics)
847			if graduateErr != nil {
848				return tui.TryActionResult{}, graduateErr
849			}
850			result, openErr := open(graduated.Item, "graduated "+graduated.Plan.Name)
851			result.RefreshRepos = true
852			return result, openErr
853		}
854		return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown Try action %q", request.Action)
855	}

870	// collectRepos builds the default repository view: what exists, plus how much
871	// of it is in flight, excluding cataloged active/deprecated Tries.
872	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
873		return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})

876	func collectReposWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
877		repos := options.Repos
878		var err error
879		if !options.ReposSet {
880			repos, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
881			if err != nil {
882				return nil, err
883			}
884		}
885		assets, catalogComplete, err := joinRepoAssets(app, repos)
886		if err != nil {
887			return nil, err
888		}
889		if !options.IncludeTries {
890			visibleRepos := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(repos))
891			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
892			for index, repository := range repos {
893				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
894					continue
895				}
896				visibleRepos = append(visibleRepos, repository)
897				visibleAssets = append(visibleAssets, assets[index])
898			}
899			repos, assets = visibleRepos, visibleAssets
900		}

135	// New constructs either an asynchronous repository picker (preselected=nil) or
136	// an asynchronous preselected-repository view. No callback runs until Init's
137	// command is executed, so View can return the initial frame immediately.
138	func New(actions Actions, preselected *RepositoryRow) Model {
139		filter := textinput.New()
140		filter.CharLimit = 240
141		filter.Placeholder = "repository filter"
142		confirm := textinput.New()
143		confirm.CharLimit = 300
144		confirm.Placeholder = "exact confirmation token"
145	
146		model := Model{
147			actions:        actions,
148			firstViewReady: make(chan struct{}),
149			firstViewOnce:  &sync.Once{},
150			width:          120, height: 34,
151			filter: filter, confirm: confirm,
152			focus: FocusSurfaces,
153		}
154		if preselected == nil {
155			model.screen = screenPicker
156			model.listRequest = requestState{generation: 1, repoKey: pickerRequestKey, loading: true}
157			return model
158		}
159		model.screen = screenRepository
160		model.repository = *preselected
161		model.desiredFocus = preselected.FocusTarget
162		model.loadRequest = requestState{generation: 1, repoKey: preselected.RepoKey, loading: true}
163		return model
164	}

174	// WithContext bounds cancelable list/load/plan callbacks to one TUI run. Apply
175	// deliberately uses a cancellation-detached child so queued quit cannot abort a

182	func (m Model) baseContext() context.Context {
183		if m.runContext != nil {
184			return m.runContext
185		}
186		return context.Background()
187	}

189	// Init implements tea.Model without doing synchronous repository work.
190	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
191		var commands []tea.Cmd
192		switch m.screen {
193		case screenRepository:
194			if m.loadRequest.loading {
195				commands = append(commands, m.loadRepositoryCmd(m.loadRequest.generation, m.loadRequest.repoKey, m.baseContext()))
196			}
197		case screenPicker:
198			if m.listRequest.loading {
199				commands = append(commands, m.listRepositoriesCmd(m.listRequest.generation, m.baseContext()))
200			}
201		}
202		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
203			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
204		}
205		switch len(commands) {
206		case 0:
207			return nil
208		case 1:
209			return commands[0]
210		default:
211			return tea.Batch(commands...)
212		}
213	}

215	func (m Model) signalFirstView() {
216		if m.firstViewOnce != nil && m.firstViewReady != nil {
217			m.firstViewOnce.Do(func() { close(m.firstViewReady) })
218		}
219	}

221	func (m Model) runAfterFirstView() tea.Cmd {
222		return func() tea.Msg {
223			select {
224			case <-m.baseContext().Done():
225				return nil
226			case <-m.firstViewReady:
227				m.actions.AfterFirstView(m.baseContext())
228				return nil
229			}
230		}
231	}

275	// Update implements tea.Model.
276	func (m Model) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
277		switch message := message.(type) {
278		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
279			m.width, m.height = message.Width, message.Height
280			return m, nil
281		case repositoryListMsg:
282			return m.acceptRepositoryList(message)
283		case repositoryLoadMsg:
284			return m.acceptRepositoryLoad(message)
285		case planMsg:
286			return m.acceptPlan(message)
287		case applyMsg:
288			return m.acceptApply(message)
289		case tea.KeyMsg:
290			if m.applyRunning {
291				return m.updateApplying(message)
292			}
293			if m.filterActive {
294				return m.updateFilter(message)
295			}
296			if m.overlay != overlayNone {
297				return m.updateOverlay(message)
298			}
299			if m.screen == screenPicker {
300				return m.updatePicker(message)
301			}
302			return m.updateRepository(message)
303		}
304		return m, nil
305	}
306	
307	func (m Model) updatePicker(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
308		switch message.String() {
309		case "q", "ctrl+c":
310			return m.quit()
311		case "esc":
312			if m.filter.Value() != "" {
313				m.filter.SetValue("")
314				m.repoCursor = 0
315				return m, nil
316			}
317			return m.quit()
318		case "j", "down":
319			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor + 1)
320		case "k", "up":
321			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor - 1)
322		case "/":
323			m.filterActive = true
324			m.filter.CursorEnd()
325			return m, m.filter.Focus()
326		case "?":
327			m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
328			m.overlay = overlayHelp
329			return m, nil
330		case "r":
331			return m.beginRepositoryList()
332		case "enter":
333			row, ok := m.currentRepository()
334			if !ok {
335				return m, nil
336			}
337			return m.selectRepository(row)
338		}
339		return m, nil
340	}
341	
342	func (m Model) updateFilter(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
343		switch message.String() {
344		case "ctrl+c":
345			return m.quit()
346		case "esc":
347			m.filterActive = false
348			m.filter.Blur()
349			m.filter.SetValue("")
350			m.repoCursor = 0
351			return m, nil
352		case "enter":
353			m.filterActive = false
354			m.filter.Blur()
355			m.setRepoCursor(m.repoCursor)
356			return m, nil
357		}
358		var command tea.Cmd
359		m.filter, command = m.filter.Update(message)
360		m.repoCursor = 0
361		return m, command
362	}
363	
364	func (m Model) updateRepository(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
365		switch message.String() {
366		case "q", "ctrl+c":
367			return m.quit()
368		case "esc":
369			m.cancelRepositoryRead()
370			m.screen = screenPicker
371			m.overlay = overlayNone
372			return m.beginRepositoryList()
373		case "j", "down":
374			m.setRowCursor(m.rowCursor + 1)
375		case "k", "up":
376			m.setRowCursor(m.rowCursor - 1)
377		case "l", "right":
378			m.moveAction(1)
379		case "h", "left":
380			m.moveAction(-1)
381		case "tab":
382			m.focus = FocusPane((int(m.focus) + 1) % 3)
383		case "shift+tab":
384			m.focus = FocusPane((int(m.focus) + 2) % 3)
385		case "?":
386			m.overlayReturn = overlayNone
387			m.overlay = overlayHelp
388		case "r":
389			return m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
390		case "R":
391			return m.openRemoteMenu()
392		case "enter":
393			choice, ok := m.currentAction()
394			if !ok {
395				return m, nil
396			}
397			return m.beginPlan(choice)
398		}
399		return m, nil
400	}
401	
402	func (m Model) updateApplying(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
403		switch message.String() {
404		case "q", "ctrl+c":
405			m.queuedQuit = true
406			m.status = "quit queued; waiting for Apply to finish"
407		case "r", "R":
408			m.queuedRefresh = true
409			m.status = "refresh queued; waiting for Apply to finish"
410		default:
411			m.status = "Apply is running; navigation is disabled"
412		}
413		return m, nil
414	}
415	
416	func (m Model) quit() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
417		m.quitting = true
418		if m.listRequest.cancel != nil {
419			m.listRequest.cancel()
420		}
421		if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
422			m.loadRequest.cancel()
423		}
424		if m.planRequest.cancel != nil {
425			m.planRequest.cancel()
426		}
427		return m, tea.Quit
428	}
429	
430	func (m Model) filteredRepositories() []RepositoryRow {
431		query := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m.filter.Value()))
432		terms := strings.Fields(query)
433		out := make([]RepositoryRow, 0, len(m.repositories))
434		for _, row := range m.repositories {
435			haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{row.RepoKey, row.Name, row.Path, row.Error}, " "))
436			matched := true
437			for _, term := range terms {
438				if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
439					matched = false
440					break
441				}
442			}
443			if matched {
444				out = append(out, row)
445			}
446		}
447		return out
448	}
449	
450	func (m Model) currentRepository() (RepositoryRow, bool) {
451		rows := m.filteredRepositories()
452		if m.repoCursor < 0 || m.repoCursor >= len(rows) {
453			return RepositoryRow{}, false
454		}
455		return rows[m.repoCursor], true
456	}
457	
458	func (m *Model) setRepoCursor(index int) {
459		count := len(m.filteredRepositories())
460		switch {
461		case count == 0:
462			index = 0
463		case index < 0:
464			index = 0
465		case index >= count:
466			index = count - 1
467		}
468		m.repoCursor = index
469	}
470	
471	func (m Model) currentSurface() (SurfaceRow, bool) {
472		if !m.hasSnapshot {
473			return SurfaceRow{}, false
474		}
475		rows := m.snapshot.Surfaces.Values()
476		if m.rowCursor < 0 || m.rowCursor >= len(rows) {
477			return SurfaceRow{}, false
478		}
479		return rows[m.rowCursor], true
480	}
481	
482	func (m Model) currentAction() (ActionChoice, bool) {
483		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
484		if !ok {
485			return ActionChoice{}, false
486		}
487		actions := row.Actions.Values()
488		if m.actionCursor < 0 || m.actionCursor >= len(actions) {
489			return ActionChoice{}, false
490		}
491		if !actions[m.actionCursor].Valid() {
492			return ActionChoice{}, false
493		}
494		return actions[m.actionCursor], true
495	}
496	
497	func (m *Model) setRowCursor(index int) {
498		count := 0
499		if m.hasSnapshot {
500			count = m.snapshot.Surfaces.Len()
501		}
502		switch {
503		case count == 0:
504			index = 0
505		case index < 0:
506			index = 0
507		case index >= count:
508			index = count - 1
509		}
510		if index != m.rowCursor {
511			m.rowCursor = index
512			m.actionCursor = 0
513		} else {
514			m.rowCursor = index
515		}
516		m.clampActionCursor()
517	}
518	
519	func (m *Model) clampActionCursor() {
520		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
521		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
522			m.actionCursor = 0
523			return
524		}
525		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
526			m.actionCursor = 0
527		}
528		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
529			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
530		}
531	}
532	
533	func (m *Model) moveAction(delta int) {
534		row, ok := m.currentSurface()
535		if !ok || row.Actions.Len() == 0 {
536			m.actionCursor = 0
537			return
538		}
539		m.actionCursor += delta
540		if m.actionCursor < 0 {
541			m.actionCursor = 0
542		}
543		if m.actionCursor >= row.Actions.Len() {
544			m.actionCursor = row.Actions.Len() - 1
545		}
546		m.focus = FocusActions
547	}
548	
549	func (m Model) selectRepository(row RepositoryRow) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
550		m.cancelRepositoryListRead()
551		m.screen = screenRepository
552		m.repository = row
553		m.desiredFocus = row.FocusTarget
554		m.hasSnapshot = false
555		m.snapshot = Snapshot{}
556		m.remote = OptionalRemoteObservation{}
557		m.rowCursor, m.actionCursor = 0, 0
558		m.overlay = overlayNone
559		m.hasPlan, m.planErr = false, nil
560		m.hasLastResult, m.lastResultErr = false, nil
561		m.hasHandoff = false
562		return m.beginRepositoryLoad(true)
563	}
564	
565	func combineError(label string, err error) error {
566		if err == nil {
567			return nil
568		}
569		if label == "" {
570			return err
571		}
572		return errors.New(label + ": " + err.Error())
573	}

91	func (r *flowTestRuntime) Activate(_ context.Context, handle string) error {
92		if r.activateCheck != nil {
93			if err := r.activateCheck(); err != nil {
94				return err
95			}
96		}
97		r.mu.Lock()
98		r.activated = append(r.activated, handle)
99		r.mu.Unlock()
100		return nil
101	}
102	func (r *flowTestRuntime) lists() int {
103		r.mu.Lock()
104		defer r.mu.Unlock()
105		return r.listCalls
106	}

108	func newFlowTestApp(t *testing.T, roots []string, rt runtime.Runtime) *App {
109		t.Helper()
110		state := t.TempDir()
111		cfg := config.Default()
112		cfg.Paths.ScanRoots = append([]string(nil), roots...)
113		cfg.Paths.RepoPaths = nil
114		cfg.Paths.StateDir = state
115		cfg.Paths.WorktreeRoot = filepath.Join(state, "worktrees")
116		cfg.Paths.WorktreePath = "{{worktree_root}}/{{repo}}/{{branch|slug}}"
117		cfg.Runtime.Backend = "none"
118		if rt == nil {
119			rt = runtime.None{}
120		}
121		return &App{
122			Cfg: cfg, Tasks: task.NewStore(cfg.TasksDir()),
123			In: strings.NewReader(""), Out: &bytes.Buffer{}, Err: &bytes.Buffer{},
124			runtimeInstance: rt,
125		}
126	}

128	func registerFlowTestRepository(t *testing.T, loader *flowLoader, path, focus string) flowRepository {
129		t.Helper()
130		discovered, err := gitx.Discover(context.Background(), path)
131		if err != nil {
132			t.Fatal(err)
133		}
134		repository, err := availableFlowRepository(discovered, nil, focus)
135		if err != nil {
136			t.Fatal(err)
137		}
138		loader.registerRepository(repository, true)
139		return repository
140	}

143		t.Helper()
144		if err := store.Save(&tracked); err != nil {
145			t.Fatal(err)
146		}
147		return tracked
148	}

157		linkedNested := filepath.Join(linked, "pkg", "nested")
158		for _, path := range []string{mainNested, linkedNested} {
159			if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o755); err != nil {
160				t.Fatal(err)

172		} {

248	func TestFlowRepositoryPickerMergesCommonDirectoryIdentityAndTaskOnlyRepositories(t *testing.T) {
249		first := gittest.New(t)
250		second := gittest.New(t)
251		for _, branch := range []string{"feat/cold", "feat/done"} {
252			first.Git("branch", branch)
253		}
254		rt := &flowTestRuntime{name: "none", available: true}
255		app := newFlowTestApp(t, []string{filepath.Dir(first.Root), filepath.Dir(second.Root)}, rt)
256		cold := saveFlowTask(t, app.Tasks, task.Task{
257			ID: "first-cold", Name: "cold", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: first.Root,
258			Branch: "feat/cold", Base: "main", Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Cold,
259		})
260		done := saveFlowTask(t, app.Tasks, task.Task{
261			ID: "first-done", Name: "done", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: first.Root,
262			Branch: "feat/done", Base: "main", Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done,
263		})
264		missing := saveFlowTask(t, app.Tasks, task.Task{
265			ID: "missing-cold", Name: "missing", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "gone"),
266			Branch: "feat/missing", Base: "main", Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Cold,
267		})
268	
269		loader := newFlowLoader(app, &flowStaticResolver{rt: rt}, first.Root)
270		rows, err := loader.ListRepositories(context.Background())
271		if err != nil {
272			t.Fatal(err)
273		}
274		if len(rows) != 3 {
275			t.Fatalf("picker rows = %d, want two same-name clones plus unavailable task repo: %+v", len(rows), rows)
276		}
277		availableKeys := map[string]bool{}
278		var firstRow, unavailable flowtui.RepositoryRow
279		firstCanonical, _ := pathx.Canonical(first.Root)
280		for _, row := range rows {
281			if row.Available {
282				availableKeys[row.RepoKey] = true
283				if row.Path == firstCanonical {
284					firstRow = row
285				}
286			} else {
287				unavailable = row
288			}
289		}
290		if len(availableKeys) != 2 {
291			t.Fatalf("same-name clones were basename-deduplicated: %+v", rows)
292		}
293		if unavailable.RepoKey == "" || unavailable.Available || !strings.Contains(unavailable.Error, "unavailable") {
294			t.Fatalf("unavailable task repository row = %+v", unavailable)
295		}
296	
297		snapshot, err := loader.LoadRepository(context.Background(), firstRow.RepoKey)
298		if err != nil {
299			t.Fatal(err)
300		}
301		seen := map[string]int{}
302		for _, row := range snapshot.Surfaces.Values() {
303			seen[row.RowKey]++
304		}
305		if seen[cold.ID] != 1 || seen[done.ID] != 1 {
306			t.Fatalf("COLD/DONE task-only rows = %+v", seen)
307		}
308		unavailableSnapshot, err := loader.LoadRepository(context.Background(), unavailable.RepoKey)
309		if err != nil {
310			t.Fatal(err)
311		}
312		if unavailableSnapshot.Repository.Available || unavailableSnapshot.Authoritative() || unavailableSnapshot.Surfaces.Len() != 1 ||
313			unavailableSnapshot.Surfaces.Values()[0].RowKey != missing.ID {
314			t.Fatalf("unavailable snapshot = %+v rows=%+v", unavailableSnapshot, unavailableSnapshot.Surfaces.Values())
315		}
316	}

318	func TestFlowLoadCachesTaskRepositoryAndLocatorGitObservations(t *testing.T) {
319		repository := gittest.New(t)
320		rt := &flowTestRuntime{name: "flow-test", available: true}
321		app := newFlowTestApp(t, nil, rt)
322		const tasks = 6
323		for index := 0; index < tasks; index++ {
324			branch := fmt.Sprintf("feat/cold-%d", index)
325			repository.Git("branch", branch)
326			saveFlowTask(t, app.Tasks, task.Task{
327				ID: fmt.Sprintf("cold-%d", index), Name: branch, Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root,
328				Branch: branch, Base: "main", Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Cold,
329			})
330		}
331		loader := newFlowLoader(app, &flowStaticResolver{rt: rt}, repository.Root)
332		registered := registerFlowTestRepository(t, loader, repository.Root, "")
333		discoverCalls, gitCalls := 0, 0
334		loader.discover = func(ctx context.Context, path string) (gitx.Repo, error) {
335			discoverCalls++
336			return gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
337		}
338		loader.gitRun = func(ctx context.Context, path string, args ...string) (string, error) {
339			gitCalls++
340			return gitx.Run(ctx, path, args...)
341		}
342	
343		snapshot, err := loader.LoadRepository(context.Background(), registered.row.RepoKey)
344		if err != nil {
345			t.Fatal(err)
346		}
347		if discoverCalls != 0 {
348			t.Fatalf("same-path task loading repeated repository discovery %d times", discoverCalls)
349		}
350		if gitCalls > 2*tasks+1 {
351			t.Fatalf("managed locator projection made %d Git calls for %d tasks", gitCalls, tasks)
352		}
353		managed := 0
354		for _, row := range snapshot.Surfaces.Values() {
355			if row.State == task.Cold && row.Locator.TaskRevision != "" {
356				managed++
357			}
358		}
359		if managed != tasks {
360			t.Fatalf("managed task-only rows=%d want=%d rows=%+v", managed, tasks, snapshot.Surfaces.Values())
361		}
362	}

364	func TestFlowProjectionIncludesEveryCheckoutOnceAndHonorsKindPrecedence(t *testing.T) {
365		repository := gittest.New(t)
366		managedPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "managed")
367		externalPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "external")
368		harnessPath := filepath.Join(repository.Root, ".claude", "worktrees", "turn-1")
369		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(harnessPath), 0o755); err != nil {
370			t.Fatal(err)
371		}
372		for _, item := range []struct{ path, branch string }{
373			{managedPath, "feat/managed"}, {externalPath, "feat/external"}, {harnessPath, "worktree-turn-1"},
374		} {
375			if err := gitx.AddWorktree(context.Background(), repository.Root, item.path, item.branch, "main"); err != nil {
376				t.Fatal(err)
377			}
378		}
379		rt := &flowTestRuntime{name: "flow-test", available: true}
380		app := newFlowTestApp(t, nil, rt)
381		saveFlowTask(t, app.Tasks, task.Task{
382			ID: "managed", Name: "managed", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root,
383			Branch: "feat/managed", Base: "main", WorktreePath: managedPath,
384			Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Warm,
385		})
386		loader := newFlowLoader(app, &flowStaticResolver{rt: rt}, repository.Root)
387		registered := registerFlowTestRepository(t, loader, repository.Root, managedPath)
388	
389		snapshot, err := loader.LoadRepository(context.Background(), registered.row.RepoKey)
390		if err != nil {
391			t.Fatal(err)
392		}
393		if snapshot.Surfaces.Len() != 4 {
394			t.Fatalf("surface count = %d, want every Git row exactly once", snapshot.Surfaces.Len())
395		}
396		byPath := map[string]flowtui.SurfaceRow{}
397		seen := map[string]int{}
398		for _, row := range snapshot.Surfaces.Values() {
399			seen[row.RowKey]++
400			byPath[row.Path] = row
401		}
402		for key, count := range seen {
403			if count != 1 {
404				t.Errorf("row %q appears %d times", key, count)
405			}
406		}
407		mainCanonical, _ := pathx.Canonical(repository.Root)
408		managedCanonical, _ := pathx.Canonical(managedPath)
409		externalCanonical, _ := pathx.Canonical(externalPath)
410		harnessCanonical, _ := pathx.Canonical(harnessPath)
411		for path, kind := range map[string]flowtui.SurfaceKind{
412			mainCanonical: flowtui.SurfaceCanonical, managedCanonical: flowtui.SurfaceManaged,
413			externalCanonical: flowtui.SurfaceUnmanaged, harnessCanonical: flowtui.SurfaceHarness,
414		} {
415			if row, ok := byPath[path]; !ok || row.Kind != kind {
416				t.Errorf("path %s row=%+v want kind=%s", path, row, kind)
417			}
418		}
419		assertFlowActionIDs(t, byPath[managedCanonical], "park-warm", "park-cold", "park-cold-push", "resume", "complete-ff", "review-handoff", "verify-merged", "remote-fetch", "remote-review", "remote-both")
420		assertFlowActionIDs(t, byPath[externalCanonical], "adopt", "remove-checkout", "remote-fetch", "remote-review", "remote-both")
421		assertFlowActionIDs(t, byPath[harnessCanonical], "remote-fetch", "remote-review", "remote-both")
422	
423		saveFlowTask(t, app.Tasks, task.Task{
424			ID: "managed-duplicate", Name: "duplicate", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root,
425			Branch: "feat/managed", Base: "main", WorktreePath: managedPath,
426			Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Hot,
427		})
428		saveFlowTask(t, app.Tasks, task.Task{
429			ID: "harness-claim", Name: "harness", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: repository.Root,
430			Branch: "worktree-turn-1", Base: "main", WorktreePath: harnessPath,
431			Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Hot,
432		})
433		snapshot, err = loader.LoadRepository(context.Background(), registered.row.RepoKey)
434		if err != nil {
435			t.Fatal(err)
436		}
437		byPath = map[string]flowtui.SurfaceRow{}
438		for _, row := range snapshot.Surfaces.Values() {
439			byPath[row.Path] = row
440		}
441		if byPath[managedCanonical].Kind != flowtui.SurfaceConflict || !containsFlowLine(byPath[managedCanonical].Conflicts.Values(), "multiple-task-claims") {
442			t.Errorf("duplicate binding did not win as conflict: %+v", byPath[managedCanonical])
443		}
444		if byPath[harnessCanonical].Kind != flowtui.SurfaceConflict || !containsFlowLine(byPath[harnessCanonical].Conflicts.Values(), "harness-task-conflict") {
445			t.Errorf("harness/task conflict precedence = %+v", byPath[harnessCanonical])
446		}
447		assertFlowActionIDs(t, byPath[managedCanonical], "remote-fetch", "remote-review", "remote-both")
448		assertFlowActionIDs(t, byPath[harnessCanonical], "remote-fetch", "remote-review", "remote-both")
449	}

451	func TestFlowTaskDiagnosticsAndWorktreeFailuresAreNonAuthoritative(t *testing.T) {

545	func TestFlowManagedActionMatrixAndOptionsNeverSetExpertOverrides(t *testing.T) {
546		tests := []struct {
547			mode  task.CheckoutMode
548			state task.State
549			ids   []string
550		}{
551			{task.ModeWorktree, task.Hot, []string{"park-warm", "park-cold", "park-cold-push", "complete-ff", "review-handoff", "verify-merged"}},
552			{task.ModeWorktree, task.Warm, []string{"park-warm", "park-cold", "park-cold-push", "resume", "complete-ff", "review-handoff", "verify-merged"}},
553			{task.ModeWorktree, task.Cold, []string{"resume"}},
554			{task.ModeWorktree, task.Done, []string{"retire-keep-branch", "retire-delete-branch"}},
555			{task.ModeBranch, task.Hot, []string{"park-warm", "park-cold", "park-cold-push", "complete-ff", "review-handoff", "verify-merged"}},
556			{task.ModeBranch, task.Warm, []string{"park-warm", "park-cold", "park-cold-push", "resume", "complete-ff", "review-handoff", "verify-merged"}},
557			{task.ModeBranch, task.Cold, []string{"resume"}},
558			{task.ModeBranch, task.Done, []string{"retire-keep-branch", "retire-delete-branch"}},
559			{task.ModeDirect, task.Hot, []string{"park-warm", "complete-direct"}},
560			{task.ModeDirect, task.Warm, []string{"park-warm", "resume", "complete-direct"}},
561			{task.ModeDirect, task.Cold, nil},
562			{task.ModeDirect, task.Done, []string{"retire-keep-branch"}},
563		}
564		for _, test := range tests {
565			t.Run(string(test.mode)+"/"+string(test.state), func(t *testing.T) {
566				tracked := task.Task{Mode: test.mode, State: test.state, Branch: "feature", Base: "main"}
567				if test.mode == task.ModeDirect {
568					tracked.Branch, tracked.Base = "main", "main"
569				}
570				choices := managedFlowChoices(tracked)
571				got := flowChoiceIDs(choices)
572				if strings.Join(got, ",") != strings.Join(test.ids, ",") {
573					t.Fatalf("action IDs = %v, want %v", got, test.ids)
574				}
575				for _, choice := range choices {
576					assertSafeFlowOptions(t, choice.Options())
577				}
578			})
579		}
580	
581		unmanaged := unmanagedFlowChoices("main")
582		if got := flowChoiceIDs(unmanaged); strings.Join(got, ",") != "adopt,remove-checkout" {
583			t.Fatalf("unmanaged choices = %v", got)

594	func assertSafeFlowOptions(t *testing.T, options taskflow.ActionOptions) {
595		t.Helper()
596		switch value := options.(type) {
597		case taskflow.ParkWarmOptions:
598			if value.CommitWIP || value.Push || value.KeepSession || value.CloseUnknown || value.AssumeNoRuntime {
599				t.Fatalf("unsafe ParkWarm options: %+v", value)
600			}
601		case taskflow.ParkColdOptions:
602			if value.CommitWIP || value.CloseUnknown || value.AssumeNoRuntime {
603				t.Fatalf("unsafe ParkCold options: %+v", value)
604			}
605		case taskflow.ResumeOptions:
606			if !value.FetchRefs || value.TakeOwnership || value.NoProvision {
607				t.Fatalf("unsafe Resume options: %+v", value)
608			}
609		case taskflow.CompleteDirectOptions:
610			if value.Dirty != taskflow.DirtyFail || value.CommitMessage != "" || value.Push {
611				t.Fatalf("unsafe CompleteDirect options: %+v", value)
612			}
613		case taskflow.CompleteFFOptions:
614			if value.Dirty != taskflow.DirtyFail || value.CommitMessage != "" || value.PushBase {
615				t.Fatalf("unsafe CompleteFF options: %+v", value)
616			}
617		case taskflow.ReviewHandoffOptions:
618			if value.Dirty != taskflow.DirtyFail || value.CommitMessage != "" {
619				t.Fatalf("unsafe ReviewHandoff options: %+v", value)
620			}
621		case taskflow.VerifyMergedOptions:
622			if value.Dirty != taskflow.DirtyFail || value.CommitMessage != "" || value.PushBase {
623				t.Fatalf("unsafe VerifyMerged options: %+v", value)
624			}
625		case taskflow.RetireOptions:
626			if value.CloseUnknown || value.AssumeNoRuntime {
627				t.Fatalf("unsafe Retire options: %+v", value)
628			}
629		case taskflow.AdoptOptions:
630			if value.Mode != task.ModeWorktree || value.Base == "" || value.Owner != "" || value.State != "" {
631				t.Fatalf("unsafe Adopt options: %+v", value)
632			}
633		case taskflow.RemoveCheckoutOptions:
634			if value.DiscardDirty || value.CloseUnknown || value.AssumeNoRuntime {
635				t.Fatalf("unsafe RemoveCheckout options: %+v", value)
636			}
637		case taskflow.RefreshRemoteOptions:
638			if !value.FetchRefs && !value.QueryReview {
639				t.Fatalf("empty remote options: %+v", value)
640			}
641		default:
642			t.Fatalf("unexpected flow options %T", options)
643		}
644	}
