780	func (l *flowLoader) projectRows(
781		ctx context.Context,

783		locatorBuilder *flowManagedLocatorBuilder,
784		taskInventoryComplete bool,
785		defaultBase string,
786	) ([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, map[string]flowTarget, []string) {

788		targets := make(map[string]flowTarget)
789		var issues []string
790		for _, contextRow := range contextSnapshot.Rows {
791			projected, rowIssues := l.projectRow(ctx, contextSnapshot, contextRow, locatorBuilder, taskInventoryComplete, defaultBase)
792			issues = append(issues, rowIssues...)
793	
794			validChoices := make([]flowtui.ActionChoice, 0, projected.Actions.Len())

809			rows = append(rows, projected)

984	func flowCheckoutEvidence(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) []string {
985		branch := checkout.Branch()
986		if branch == "" {
987			branch = "(detached)"
988		}
989		lines := []string{
990			"path: " + checkout.Worktree.Path,
991			"branch: " + branch,
992			fmt.Sprintf("registered: Main=%t locked=%t prunable=%t bare=%t detached=%t HEAD=%s",
993				checkout.Worktree.Main, checkout.Worktree.Locked, checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
994				checkout.Worktree.Bare, checkout.Worktree.Detached, emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.Head)),
995		}
996		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
997			lines = append(lines, "registered lock reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason))
998		}
999		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
1000			lines = append(lines, "registered prunable reason: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason))
1001		}
1002		switch {
1003		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
1004			lines = append(lines, "git: ERROR "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
1005		case checkout.Worktree.Bare:
1006			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (bare repository)")
1007		case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
1008			lines = append(lines, "git: status unobserved (checkout unavailable)")
1009		default:
1010			cleanliness := "clean"
1011			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
1012				cleanliness = "dirty — " + checkout.Status.Breakdown()
1013			}
1014			lines = append(lines,
1015				"git: "+cleanliness,
1016				"upstream: "+emptyEvidence(checkout.Status.Upstream),
1017				fmt.Sprintf("ahead=%d behind=%d conflicted=%d", checkout.Status.Ahead, checkout.Status.Behind, checkout.Status.Conflicted),
1018			)
1019		}
1020	
1021		observation := checkout.RuntimeObservation
1022		if observation.State == "" {
1023			observation = contextSnapshot.RuntimeObservation
1024		}
1025		switch observation.State {
1026		case inventory.ObservationAvailable:
1027			if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
1028				lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": observed; no covering sessions")
1029			} else {
1030				lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": observed")
1031				for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
1032					status := session.AgentStatus
1033					if status == "" {
1034						status = "unknown"
1035					}
1036					line := fmt.Sprintf("runtime session: %s:%s agent-state=%s", contextSnapshot.Runtime, emptyEvidence(session.Handle), status)
1037					if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
1038						line += " agents=" + strings.Join(session.AgentSessions, ",")
1039					}
1040					lines = append(lines, line)
1041					for _, pane := range session.Panes {
1042						if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" && pane.AgentStatus == "" {
1043							continue
1044						}
1045						paneStatus := pane.AgentStatus
1046						if paneStatus == "" {
1047							paneStatus = "unknown"
1048						}
1049						lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("runtime agent pane: %s agent=%s state=%s session=%s",
1050							emptyEvidence(pane.ID), emptyEvidence(pane.Agent), paneStatus, emptyEvidence(pane.AgentSession)))
1051					}
1052				}
1053			}
1054		case inventory.ObservationFailed:
1055			message := "runtime observation failed"
1056			if observation.Err != nil {
1057				message += ": " + observation.Err.Error()
1058			}
1059			lines = append(lines, message)
1060		default:
1061			lines = append(lines, "runtime "+emptyEvidence(contextSnapshot.Runtime)+": unobserved; state is not known closed")
1062		}
1063		return lines
1064	}

1106	func artifactSummary(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection, err error) string {
1107		if err != nil {
1108			return "artifact: ERROR " + err.Error()
1109		}
1110		if inspection.KnownEmpty && len(inspection.Intents) == 0 {
1111			return "artifact: ready; no intents"
1112		}
1113		counts := make(map[artifact.ReadinessState]int)
1114		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
1115			counts[intent.State]++
1116		}
1117		states := make([]string, 0, len(counts))
1118		for state, count := range counts {
1119			states = append(states, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%d", state, count))
1120		}
1121		sort.Strings(states)
1122		readiness := "blocked or unknown"
1123		if inspection.Ready() {
1124			readiness = "ready"
1125		}
1126		if len(states) == 0 {
1127			states = append(states, "no classified intents")
1128		}
1129		return "artifact: " + readiness + "; " + strings.Join(states, ", ")
1130	}

1132	func managedFlowChoices(tracked task.Task) []flowtui.ActionChoice {

1138			choice("park-cold", "Park Cold", "Require committed, pushed, reconstructible work before checkout cleanup.", taskflow.ParkColdOptions{}),
1139			choice("park-cold-push", "Park Cold + Push", "Push the branch, then park COLD only when every guard is ready.", taskflow.ParkColdOptions{Push: true}),
1140			choice("resume", "Resume", "Fetch refs and rebuild or reopen the exact task checkout.", taskflow.ResumeOptions{FetchRefs: true}),
1141			choice("complete-direct", "Complete Direct", "Record direct work DONE without changing dirty content.", taskflow.CompleteDirectOptions{Dirty: taskflow.DirtyFail}),
1142			choice("complete-ff", "Complete FF", "Fast-forward the explicit base only when dirty content needs no mutation.", taskflow.CompleteFFOptions{Dirty: taskflow.DirtyFail}),
1143			choice("review-handoff", "Review Handoff", "Push and create a review while preserving the current lifecycle state.", taskflow.ReviewHandoffOptions{Dirty: taskflow.DirtyFail}),
1144			choice("verify-merged", "Verify Merged", "Prove external integration before recording DONE.", taskflow.VerifyMergedOptions{Dirty: taskflow.DirtyFail}),
1145			choice("retire-keep-branch", "Retire (Keep Branch)", "Remove local task resources while retaining the branch.", taskflow.RetireOptions{}),
1146		}
1147		if tracked.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeDirect && tracked.Branch != tracked.Base {
1148			candidates = append(candidates,
1149				choice("retire-delete-branch", "Retire + Delete Contained Branch", "Delete the branch only when fresh containment evidence proves it safe.", taskflow.RetireOptions{DeleteBranch: true}),
1150			)
1151		}
1152	
1153		mode, state := tracked.EffectiveMode(), tracked.State
1154		choices := make([]flowtui.ActionChoice, 0, len(candidates))

1157			if found && rule.Allowed {
1158				choices = append(choices, candidate)
1159			}
1160		}
1161		return choices
1162	}

1186	func (l *flowLoader) Plan(
1187		ctx context.Context,
1188		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1189		locator taskflow.Locator,
1190		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1191	) (taskflow.Plan, error) {
1192		expected, request, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1193		if err != nil {
1194			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1195		}
1196		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1197		if err != nil {
1198			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1199		}
1200		service, err := l.service(rt)
1201		if err != nil {
1202			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1203		}
1204		plan, err := service.Plan(ctx, request)
1205		if err != nil {
1206			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1207		}
1208		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1209			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1210		}
1211		l.mu.Lock()
1212		l.approved[plan.PlanID] = flowApprovedPlan{target: expected, plan: plan.Clone()}
1213		l.mu.Unlock()
1214		return plan, nil
1215	}
1216	
1217	func (l *flowLoader) Apply(
1218		ctx context.Context,
1219		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1220		locator taskflow.Locator,
1221		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1222		plan taskflow.Plan,
1223		approval taskflow.Approval,
1224	) (taskflow.Result, error) {
1225		expected, _, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1226		if err != nil {
1227			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1228		}
1229		l.mu.Lock()
1230		approved, ok := l.approved[plan.PlanID]
1231		l.mu.Unlock()
1232		if !ok {
1233			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply rejected a plan not produced by this run")
1234		}
1235		if !sameFlowTarget(approved.target, expected) {
1236			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply target differs from the approved repository, row, action, locator, or options")
1237		}
1238		if !reflect.DeepEqual(approved.plan.Clone(), plan.Clone()) {
1239			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply plan differs from the exact approved plan")
1240		}
1241		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1242			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1243		}
1244		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1245		if err != nil {
1246			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1247		}
1248		service, err := l.service(rt)
1249		if err != nil {
1250			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1251		}
1252		result, applyErr := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
1253		l.mu.Lock()
1254		delete(l.approved, plan.PlanID)
1255		if remote, exists := result.RemoteObservation(); exists {
1256			l.remote[repoKey] = remote.Clone()
1257		}
1258		l.mu.Unlock()
1259		return result, applyErr
1260	}
1261	
1262	func (l *flowLoader) validateTarget(
1263		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1264		locator taskflow.Locator,
1265		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1266	) (flowTarget, taskflow.Request, error) {
1267		request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(locator, options)
1268		if err != nil {
1269			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, err
1270		}
1271		key := flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID)
1272		l.mu.Lock()
1273		expected, ok := l.targets[repoKey][key]
1274		l.mu.Unlock()
1275		if !ok {
1276			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action no longer matches the current repository snapshot")
1277		}
1278		actual := flowTarget{repoKey: repoKey, rowKey: rowKey, actionID: actionID, request: request}
1279		if !sameFlowTarget(expected, actual) {
1280			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action locator or options differ from the current exact row choice")
1281		}
1282		return expected, request, nil
1283	}
1284	
1285	func validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan taskflow.Plan, expected flowTarget) error {
1286		if err := plan.Validate(); err != nil {
1287			return err
1288		}
1289		if plan.Locator != expected.request.Locator || plan.Request.Locator != expected.request.Locator ||
1290			plan.Action != expected.request.Action || plan.Request.Action != expected.request.Action ||
1291			!reflect.DeepEqual(plan.Request.Options, expected.request.Options) {
1292			return errors.New("taskflow plan does not match the exact flow request identity")
1293		}
1294		return nil
1295	}
1296	
1297	func sameFlowTarget(left, right flowTarget) bool {
1298		return left.repoKey == right.repoKey && left.rowKey == right.rowKey && left.actionID == right.actionID &&
1299			left.request.Locator == right.request.Locator && left.request.Action == right.request.Action &&
1300			reflect.DeepEqual(left.request.Options, right.request.Options)
1301	}
1302	
1303	func flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID string) string {
1304		return repoKey + "\x00" + rowKey + "\x00" + actionID
1305	}

1308		if ctx == nil {
1309			return errors.New("flow operation needs a context")
1310		}
1311		return ctx.Err()
1312	}

1314	func emptyEvidence(value string) string {
1315		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
1316			return "(none)"
1317		}
1318		return value
1319	}
1320	
1321	func uniqueStrings(values []string) []string {
1322		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(values))
1323		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
1324		for _, value := range values {
1325			if value == "" || seen[value] {
1326				continue
1327			}
1328			seen[value] = true
1329			out = append(out, value)
1330		}
1331		return out
1332	}

2	description: Understand dev-cli as durable Git history, scoped intent and catalog state, repository quick-note sidecars, disposable worktrees, and replaceable runtimes.
3	authority: project
4	status: stable
5	verified_on: 2026-09-01
6	---
7	
8	# Mental model and lifecycle
9	
10	`dev` treats a unit of work as a **change stream** whose durable identity is its Git branch. The checkout and runtime are replaceable projections of that stream.
11	
12	## Four responsibilities
13	
14	```text
15	Git remote + branch  durable history and cross-machine handoff
16	        ↓
17	worktree             local files, index, and checked-out HEAD
18	        ↓
19	runtime              Herdr workspace, tmux session, or current shell
20	        ↓
21	dev registry         human intent and reconstruction metadata
22	```
23	
24	Sidecar state has deliberately separate scopes:
25	
26	- each task stores checkout mode, repository/branch/base, lifecycle state, owner host, next executable action, task context, runtime hint, and timestamps;
27	- the catalog stores stable repository/Try identity, tags, one metadata summary, experiment lifecycle, and host-local locations;
28	- configured `paths.state_dir/notes` stores multiple durable Markdown observations keyed by catalog repository ID;
29	- `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` is only the rebuildable full-text index for those Markdown files.
30	
31	The catalog ID keeps a quick note attached across linked worktrees, symlink indexes, path moves, and synchronized host state. `dev` does not itself synchronize notes or catalog files. Live Git status, ahead/behind, and runtime availability are derived again instead of treated as authoritative cached truth.
32	
33	## The four lifecycle states
34	
35	| State | Git and checkout | Runtime | Meaning |
36	|---|---|---|---|
37	| 🔥 `hot` | branch plus checkout | open | active now |
38	| 🌤 `warm` | branch plus checkout kept | closed | likely to return within days |
39	| ❄️ `cold` | committed and pushed branch; worktree absent | none | paused and reconstructible elsewhere |
40	| ✅ `done` | integrated; branch/checkout may remain | may remain open | MERGED, pending explicit retirement |
41	
42	```mermaid
43	flowchart TD
44	    accTitle: dev-cli lifecycle states
45	    accDescr: Tasks move between HOT, WARM, and eligible COLD states; direct or verified integrated work reaches DONE while resources remain; review leaves the current state unchanged; and external retirement reaps only an already completed entry.
46	
47	    Start["dev start"] --> Hot["HOT"]
48	    Hot -->|dev park --next| Warm["WARM"]
49	    Warm -->|dev resume| Hot
50	    Hot -->|branch/worktree: dev park --cold --push| Cold["COLD"]
51	    Warm -->|branch/worktree: dev park --cold --push| Cold
52	    Cold -->|dev resume --fetch| Hot
53	
54	    Hot -->|direct: dev done| Done["DONE"]
55	    Warm -->|direct: dev done| Done
56	    Hot -->|branch/worktree: dev done --ff| Done
57	    Warm -->|branch/worktree: dev done --ff| Done
58	
59	    Hot -.->|branch/worktree: dev done --pr; state unchanged| Review["push / review handoff"]
60	    Warm -.->|branch/worktree: dev done --pr; state unchanged| Review
61	    Review -.->|feedback: dev resume if WARM| Hot
62	
63	    Done -->|dev retire from outside target| Reaped["RETIRED: resources cleaned; entry reaped"]
64	    Done -.->|dev sweep: report candidate| Report["cleanup report"]
65	    Report -.->|approved apply| Reaped
66	```
67	
68	For branch/worktree tasks, `dev done --pr` is intentionally not a HOT/WARM → DONE transition. It hands off a pushed branch (opening review when supported) and leaves state and cleanup unchanged. `dev flow` can manually query portable review existence/state/draft/URL evidence, but never infers DONE; integration still needs an explicit local ancestry proof.
69	
70	`dev flow [repo]` makes the underlying hybrid model visible: persisted intent,
71	typed live observations, and a revision-bound guarded plan are distinct. Errors,
72	unknowns, and stale facts do not become false; Apply revalidates exact task/Git/
73	worktree/runtime/artifact identity before mutation. See [Repository lifecycle
74	flow](../guides/repository-flow.md).
75	
76	## Checkout modes
77	
78	A task records intent; it does not always require a linked worktree.
79	
80	| Mode | Use | Lifecycle limit |
81	|---|---|---|
82	| direct | one small change in the canonical checkout | HOT ↔ WARM; canonical checkout cannot be removed |
83	| branch-only | isolated history without a second directory | can go COLD after push and switching the canonical checkout away |
84	| worktree | independent mutation, parallel streams, durable feature work | full lifecycle |
85	
86	The mode is selected by collision and recovery needs, not by ceremony.
87	
88	## Runtime is deliberately lossy
89	
90	`runtime.Runtime` exposes `Open`, `Close`, `List`, and `Annotate`. `auto` selects Herdr when available, then tmux, then Zellij, then the always-available `none` backend. Closing any backend must not remove the checkout, branch, or task entry.
91	
92	This separation is why rebooting, closing a multiplexer, or changing runtime backend does not abandon work. `dev sweep` can compare the registry with live Git/runtime facts and report drift.
93	
94	## Cross-machine handoff
95	
96	The branch is the transport boundary:
97	
98	```bash
99	# machine A
100	dev park --cold --push
101	
102	# machine B
103	dev resume <task> --fetch
104	```
105	
106	One writer owns a branch at a time. If two machines or agents need to mutate the same feature concurrently, split the change stream and integrate afterwards.
107	
108	## Sources
109	
110	- [`internal/task/task.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/task/task.go)
111	- [`internal/catalog/catalog.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/catalog/catalog.go)
112	- [`internal/note/note.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/note/note.go)
113	- [`internal/runtime/runtime.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/runtime/runtime.go)
114	- [`internal/help/topics/parking.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/help/topics/parking.md)
115	- [`internal/cli/done.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/cli/done.go)
116	- [`internal/taskflow`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/tree/main/internal/taskflow)
117	- [`internal/flowtui`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/tree/main/internal/flowtui)
118	- [`internal/cli/sweep.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/cli/sweep.go)
119
```

8	
9	# 心智模型與生命週期
10	
11	!!! note "術語規則"
12	    有公認中文譯名且本文使用中文時，首次以「中文 (English original)」呈現。產品名稱與 Git／CLI／agent domain terms 可直接保留英文；沒有公認譯名不得自創。程式碼、API／tool 名稱、CLI flag、套件名與路徑一律不翻譯。
13	
14	`dev` 把一個工作單位視為變更流 (change stream)，而它的持久身分是 Git branch。Checkout 與執行環境 (runtime) 都只是可替換的投影。
15	
16	## 四種責任
17	
18	```text
19	Git remote + branch  持久 history 與跨機器 handoff
20	        ↓
21	worktree             本機 files、index 與 checked-out HEAD
22	        ↓
23	runtime              Herdr workspace、tmux session 或目前 shell
24	        ↓
25	dev registry         人類意圖與重建 metadata
26	```
27	
28	Sidecar state 刻意分成不同 scope：
29	
30	- 每個 task 保存 checkout mode、repository/branch/base、lifecycle state、owner host、下一個 executable action、task context、runtime hint 與 timestamps；
31	- catalog 保存穩定的 repository/Try identity、tags、一筆 metadata summary、experiment lifecycle 與 host-local locations；
32	- configured `paths.state_dir/notes` 保存多筆 durable Markdown observations，並以 catalog repository ID 為 key；
33	- `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` 只是這些 Markdown files 的可重建 full-text index。
34	
35	Catalog ID 讓 quick note 在 linked worktrees、symlink indexes、path moves 與已同步的 host state 之間維持 attachment。`dev` 本身不會同步 notes 或 catalog files。即時 Git status、ahead/behind 與 runtime availability 會重新推導，不會被當成權威 cache。
36	
37	## 四個 lifecycle state
38	
39	| State | Git 與 checkout | Runtime | 意義 |
40	|---|---|---|---|
41	| 🔥 `hot` | branch 加 checkout | 開啟 | 正在處理 |
42	| 🌤 `warm` | 保留 branch 與 checkout | 關閉 | 幾天內會回來 |
43	| ❄️ `cold` | branch 已 commit、push；worktree 不存在 | 無 | 已暫停，可在別處重建 |
44	| ✅ `done` | 已具名的整合證據；checkout/branch 可能仍存在 | 可能仍存在 | MERGED，等待獨立 Retire cleanup |
45	
46	```mermaid
47	flowchart TD
48	    accTitle: dev-cli lifecycle states
49	    accDescr: Task 會在 HOT、WARM 與符合條件的 COLD state 之間移動；direct completion、本機 fast-forward 或具名 ancestry verification 會進入 DONE；review 不改變目前 state；Retire 才回收 local resources 與 task entry。
50	
51	    Start["dev start"] --> Hot["HOT"]
52	    Hot -->|dev park --next| Warm["WARM"]
53	    Warm -->|dev resume| Hot
54	    Hot -->|branch/worktree: dev park --cold --push| Cold["COLD"]
55	    Warm -->|branch/worktree: dev park --cold --push| Cold
56	    Cold -->|dev resume --fetch| Hot
57	
58	    Hot -->|direct: dev done| Done["DONE / MERGED"]
59	    Warm -->|direct: dev done| Done
60	    Hot -->|branch/worktree: dev done --ff| Done
61	    Warm -->|branch/worktree: dev done --ff| Done
62	
63	    Hot -.->|branch/worktree: dev done --pr；state 不變| Review["push / review handoff"]
64	    Warm -.->|branch/worktree: dev done --pr；state 不變| Review
65	    Review -.->|feedback：若為 WARM 先 dev resume| Hot
66	    Review -->|dev done --merged --base-ref REF| Done
67	
68	    Done -->|dev retire；或先由 dev sweep 回報| Retire["guarded Retire plan"]
69	    Retire --> Reaped["RETIRED：runtime/worktree/task 已回收"]
70	```
71	
72	對 branch/worktree task 而言，`dev done --pr` 刻意不是 HOT/WARM → DONE transition。它會 handoff 已 push 的 branch（支援時建立 review），並保留原 state 與 cleanup 狀態。外部 merge 不會被自動推斷；請以 `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref>` 或 `dev flow` 的 Verify Merged action 明確證明 named ancestry，再以獨立 Retire plan cleanup。
73	
74	## Intent、evidence 與 action readiness
75	
76	Lifecycle state 只保存人類意圖，不會吸收所有外部事實。`dev flow [repo]` 把三層並列：recorded `HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE` intent、具 freshness 的 Git/runtime/agent/artifact/remote evidence，以及綁定 exact identity 的 guarded plan。`READY` 是某份 plan 的 action readiness；`REVIEW`、`MERGED` 與 `RETIRED` 是 result milestones，皆不是額外 TOML state。UNKNOWN/ERROR evidence 不會被當成 clean、closed 或 absent。完整操作方式見 [Repository Flow 預覽](../guides/repository-flow.zh-TW.md)。
77	
78	## Checkout mode
79	
80	Task 記錄的是意圖，不一定要有 linked worktree。
81	
82	| Mode | 適用情境 | Lifecycle 限制 |
83	|---|---|---|
84	| direct | canonical checkout 中的一個小變更 | HOT ↔ WARM；canonical checkout 不能移除 |
85	| branch-only | 只需要 history isolation，不需要第二個 directory | push 且 canonical checkout 切離後可進 COLD |
86	| worktree | 獨立寫入、平行 stream、長期 feature | 完整 lifecycle |
87	
88	選擇 mode 的依據是碰撞與復原需求，不是儀式感。
89	
90	## Runtime 刻意是可丟失的
91	
92	`runtime.Runtime` 提供 `Open`、`Close`、`List` 與 `Annotate`。`auto` 會依序選 Herdr、tmux、Zellij，最後使用永遠可用的 `none` backend。關閉任何 backend 都不能移除 checkout、branch 或 task entry。
93	
94	`none` 只表示沒有可觀察的 multiplexer backend，不等於已證明「沒有 session 或 agent」。需要 occupancy/absence proof 的 guarded action 必須保留 unobserved evidence；`dev flow` 不會把它顯示成已關閉，也不提供 `--assume-no-runtime` expert override。
95	
96	因此 reboot、關閉 multiplexer 或更換 runtime backend 都不代表放棄工作。`dev sweep` 能比較 registry 與即時 Git/runtime facts 並回報 drift。
97	
98	## 跨機器 handoff
99	
100	Branch 是傳輸邊界：
101	
102	```bash
103	# machine A
104	dev park --cold --push
105	
106	# machine B
107	dev resume <task> --fetch
108	```
109	
110	每個 branch 同時只有一位 writer。若兩台機器或兩個 agent 必須同時修改同一 feature，應拆成不同 change stream，再於之後整合。

```text
1	---
2	description: Run a dev-cli change stream through start, park, resume, review or integration, and conservative cleanup.
3	authority: project
4	status: stable
5	verified_on: 2026-09-01
6	---
7	
8	# Change-stream workflow
9	
10	A `dev` task is a durable record of one line of work. Select the checkout mode, make the branch recoverable, and treat runtime sessions as disposable.
11	
12	## Lifecycle at a glance
13	
14	```mermaid
15	flowchart TD
16	    accTitle: dev-cli change-stream workflow
17	    accDescr: A change stream starts in direct, branch-only, or worktree mode and cycles through active, parked, and resumed work. Direct or verified integration reaches DONE while resources remain, review preserves the current state, and external retirement performs cleanup.
18	
19	    Start["dev start"] --> Mode{"checkout mode"}
20	    Mode -->|direct| Direct["HOT: direct work / commit / test"]
21	    Mode -->|branch-only or worktree| Managed["HOT: managed work / commit / test"]
22	
23	    Direct -->|dev park --next| WarmDirect["WARM: checkout kept"]
24	    WarmDirect -->|dev resume| Direct
25	    Managed -->|dev park --next| WarmManaged["WARM: checkout kept"]
26	    WarmManaged -->|dev resume| Managed
27	    Managed -->|dev park --cold --push| Cold["COLD: pushed and reconstructible"]
28	    WarmManaged -->|dev park --cold --push| Cold
29	    Cold -->|dev resume --fetch| Managed
30	
31	    Direct -->|dev done| Done["DONE: integration confirmed"]
32	    WarmDirect -->|dev done| Done
33	    Managed -->|dev done --ff| Done
34	    WarmManaged -->|dev done --ff| Done
35	
36	    Managed -->|dev done --pr| Review["push / review handoff: task stays active"]
37	    WarmManaged -->|dev done --pr| Review
38	    Review -->|feedback: dev resume if WARM| Managed
39	    Review -->|merged externally| Reconcile["dev done --merged: verify exact ancestry"]
40	    Reconcile --> Done
41	
42	    Done -->|dev retire from outside target| Reaped["RETIRED: clean resources and reap task"]
43	    Done -.->|dev sweep| Report["report cleanup candidates"]
44	    Report -.->|approved apply| Reaped
45	    Reaped --> Next["next change stream"]
46	    Next --> Start
47	```
48	
49	The handoff path deliberately stops at manual reconciliation: `dev done --pr` leaves the task active and may only push when no supported forge CLI is available. `dev flow` can explicitly query run-local review existence/state/draft/URL evidence, but neither it nor `sweep` infers DONE from a forge response. Use `dev done --merged` with exact local ancestry evidence.
50	
51	## 1. Select the checkout mode
52	
53	| Mode | Command | Use when |
54	|---|---|---|
55	| direct | `dev start <repo> --task <name> --direct` | one small reversible change in the canonical checkout |
56	| branch-only | `dev start <repo> --task <name> --branch-only --base <ref>` | history isolation is useful but a second directory is not |
57	| worktree | `dev start <repo> --task <name> --base <ref>` | independent mutation, parallel work, or a stream that may outlive the session |
58	
59	Worktree mode is the default. If no branch is supplied, `dev` derives `feat/<task-slug>`; automation should still pass the intended base explicitly.
60	
61	Before changing the canonical checkout in direct or branch-only mode, `dev` guards against sharing it with another active agent/runtime.
62	
63	## 2. Start and inspect
64	
65	```bash
66	dev start api --task "token refresh" --base main --next "reproduce expiry race"
67	dev ls
68	dev status
69	dev flow api   # preview all repository surfaces and exact guarded actions
70	```
71	
72	Starting work resolves the repository, validates branch/base, creates or switches the checkout, provisions a worktree when needed, opens the selected runtime, and saves the task. If the branch is already tracked, use `dev resume` instead of creating a duplicate.
73	
74	## 3. Park intentionally
75	
76	```bash
77	dev park --next "add the failing expiry test"
78	```
79	
80	The normal transition is HOT → WARM: close the runtime but keep the checkout. Choose the field by scope:
81	
82	- `--next` is the next executable task action and removes the need to re-derive the first step;
83	- `dev park --note` preserves free-form context for this one task;
84	- `dev repo mark --note` replaces the catalog's single repository summary;
85	- `dev note` stores multiple durable repository observations outside task lifecycle state.
86	
87	If the tree is dirty:
88	
89	```bash
90	dev park --wip --next "finish the expiry test"
91	```
92	
93	This creates a temporary `wip: checkpoint — …` commit. It is searchable and pushable; rewrite or squash it before integrating if it is not useful product history.
94	
95	To release local disk and hand off across machines:
96	
97	```bash
98	dev park --cold --push
99	```
100	
101	COLD requires recoverable commits on the remote. Direct tasks cannot go cold because the canonical checkout is not disposable.
102	
103	## 4. Resume from live facts
104	
105	```bash
106	dev resume "token refresh" --fetch
107	```
108	
109	- WARM: reuse the checkout and reopen the runtime.
110	- COLD: fetch, recreate the branch/worktree if needed, reprovision, and reopen.
111	- Work owned by another host: refuse unless ownership has been deliberately transferred or overridden.
112	
113	Runtime handles are advisory. `dev` re-resolves live sessions instead of assuming a recorded handle still exists.
114	
115	## 5. Integrate or hand off to review
116	
117	Preserve meaningful construction commits:
118	
119	```bash
120	dev done --ff
121	```
122	
123	This requires a clean tree, rebases the task branch onto the base when needed, and runs a fast-forward-only merge in the canonical checkout. It records DONE last while retaining the runtime, worktree, and branch. Run `dev retire` separately from outside the target.
124	
125	Use review/CI instead:
126	
127	```bash
128	dev done --pr
129	```
130	
131	This pushes the branch and opens a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request when the corresponding CLI is available. It **does not** mark the task DONE or clean up the checkout. Current `dev sweep` also does not infer remote request merges, so confirm integration before finishing the local lifecycle.
132	
133	## The interactive `dev done` finish wizard
134	
135	Running `dev done` with neither `--ff` nor `--pr` on an interactive terminal opens a finish wizard instead of failing. It never guesses which integration mode you want; it walks the actual state of the checkout and asks only what it cannot infer.
136	
137	The wizard runs in up to three steps:
138	
139	1. **Preflight.** It reports the branch, the base, the branch/base commit relation (ahead/behind, or already contained), and — if the checkout is dirty — a path-by-path breakdown of which changes already match the base tree and which are unique.
140	2. **Dirty changes**, only if the checkout is dirty: `c` commits everything with a message you supply, `d` discards everything (tracked and untracked), `q` cancels with nothing changed. Discarding unique content — anything not already equivalent to the base — requires typing `DROP` at a follow-up confirmation; discarding paths that already match the base does not.
141	3. **Integration**, only if neither `--ff` nor `--pr` was passed and the branch is not already fully contained in the base: `f` rebases the branch onto the base and fast-forwards it (same as `--ff`), `p` pushes and opens a pull/merge request (same as `--pr`), `q` cancels. When the branch is already contained in the base, the wizard skips this step and can record DONE; cleanup still belongs to `dev retire`.
142	
143	Passing `--ff` or `--pr` up front answers step 3 for the wizard, so it only prompts for whatever the flags left unresolved — with both a clean tree and an explicit integration flag, nothing is prompted at all. A final summary lists the dirty action and the integration mode before anything runs; confirm it, or add `--yes` to skip that confirmation once the plan is fully specified by flags. If the checkout or branch changes while the plan is open, `dev` detects the drift after confirmation and refuses to apply the stale plan — rerun `dev done` to see the current state.
144	
145	Non-interactively — no TTY, or a script — the wizard never prompts. `dev done` with no integration flag just reports the same preflight and exits; pass `--ff` or `--pr` explicitly. A dirty checkout defaults to failing outside a TTY (`--dirty auto` behaves like `--dirty fail`), so scripts choose an explicit policy:
146	
147	```bash
148	dev done --ff --dirty commit -m "chore: finalize before merge"
149	dev done --pr --dirty discard --yes   # destructive; --yes is mandatory here
150	```
151	
152	`--message`/`-m` only applies with `--dirty commit`. `--dirty discard` outside a TTY requires `--yes`; the `DROP` confirmation is an interactive-only safeguard.
153	
154	## Repository flow preview
155	
156	Use `dev flow [repo]` when the question is not only “what state is this task?”
157	but “which exact action is legal for each checkout?” It is a TTY-only interface
158	independent of the dashboard. It includes every registered worktree plus task-
159	only COLD/DONE rows, separates observed facts from persisted state, and requires
160	Enter-to-plan followed by action-specific approval.
161	
162	Normal managed actions, exact unmanaged metadata-only Adopt/clean branch-
163	preserving Remove, explicit remote fetch/query, revision revalidation, and
164	partial result ledgers are described in [Repository lifecycle
165	flow](repository-flow.md). Flow omits dirty/WIP/shared-writer/takeover/unknown-
166	runtime overrides; use a blocked plan's CLI fallback when those expert flags are
167	actually needed.
168	
169	## 6. Sweep drift and stale state
170	
171	```bash
172	dev sweep                 # report only
173	dev sweep --apply         # confirm each suggested action
174	dev sweep --apply --yes   # automation after reviewing the report
175	```
176	
177	Sweep can propose:
178	
179	- HOT → WARM when no live session exists;
180	- old, clean, pushed WARM → COLD;
181	- removing the registry entry for an already-DONE task;
182	- clearing a worktree path Git no longer knows;
183	- reviewing live runtime sessions no task claims.
184	
185	It never deletes uncommitted work. Reporting first is part of the safety model.
186	
187	## Recovery rules
188	
189	- Rebase conflict: resolve it, run `git rebase --continue`, then retry `dev done --ff`; use `git rebase --abort` to return to the pre-rebase state.
190	- Missing worktree directory: run `dev sweep` or `dev wt rm` to prune stale Git administration, then resume.
191	- Wrong owner host: verify the other writer has stopped and pushed before using an override.
192	- Unsure whether work is merged: keep the branch and task; deletion is cheaper after verification than recovery after guessing.
193	
194	## Sources
195

197	- [`internal/cli/park.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/cli/park.go)

```text
1	---
2	description: 使用 dev-cli 讓變更流依序經過 start、park、resume、review/integration 與保守 cleanup。
3	authority: project
4	status: stable
5	verified_on: 2026-09-01
6	lang: zh-TW
7	---
8	
9	# 變更流工作流程
10	
11	!!! note "術語規則"
12	    有公認中文譯名且本文使用中文時，首次以「中文 (English original)」呈現。產品名稱與 Git／CLI／agent domain terms 可直接保留英文；沒有公認譯名不得自創。程式碼、API／tool 名稱、CLI flag、套件名與路徑一律不翻譯。
13	
14	`dev` task 是一條工作線的持久紀錄。先選 checkout mode、讓 branch 可復原，再把 runtime session 當成可丟棄資源。
15	
16	## Lifecycle 閉環總覽
17	
18	```mermaid
19	flowchart TD
20	    accTitle: dev-cli 變更流工作流程
21	    accDescr: 變更流以 direct、branch-only 或 worktree mode 開始，並在 active work、park 與 resume 之間循環。Direct completion、本機 fast-forward 或明確 merge verification 會進入 DONE；review 保持原 state；Retire 另行 cleanup。
22	
23	    Start["dev start"] --> Mode{"checkout mode"}
24	    Mode -->|direct| Direct["HOT: direct work / commit / test"]
25	    Mode -->|branch-only 或 worktree| Managed["HOT: managed work / commit / test"]
26	
27	    Direct -->|dev park --next| WarmDirect["WARM: 保留 checkout"]
28	    WarmDirect -->|dev resume| Direct
29	    Managed -->|dev park --next| WarmManaged["WARM: 保留 checkout"]
30	    WarmManaged -->|dev resume| Managed
31	    Managed -->|dev park --cold --push| Cold["COLD: 已 push 且可重建"]
32	    WarmManaged -->|dev park --cold --push| Cold
33	    Cold -->|dev resume --fetch| Managed
34	
35	    Direct -->|dev done| Done["DONE / MERGED"]
36	    WarmDirect -->|dev done| Done
37	    Managed -->|dev done --ff| Done
38	    WarmManaged -->|dev done --ff| Done
39	
40	    Managed -->|dev done --pr| Review["push / review handoff: state 不變"]
41	    WarmManaged -->|dev done --pr| Review
42	    Review -->|feedback：若為 WARM 先 dev resume| Managed
43	    Review -->|dev done --merged --base-ref REF| Done
44	
45	    Done -->|dev retire| Retired["RETIRED: guarded cleanup 完成"]
46	    Done -->|dev sweep| Report["先回報 cleanup candidates"]
47	    Report -->|dev sweep --apply| Retired
48	    Retired --> Next["下一條 change stream"]
49	    Next --> Start
50	```
51	
52	Handoff path 刻意保持 state：`dev done --pr` 會讓 task 保持 HOT/WARM；沒有支援的 forge CLI 時也可能只 push。`dev` 不會自動把 provider 的 merged 狀態當成 local DONE。Merge 完成後，以 `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref>` 或 `dev flow` 的 Verify Merged action 驗證 named ancestry；記錄 DONE 之後，再以 Retire 做 cleanup。
53	
54	## 1. 選擇 checkout mode
55	
56	| Mode | 命令 | 適用情境 |
57	|---|---|---|
58	| direct | `dev start <repo> --task <name> --direct` | canonical checkout 中的一個小型可逆變更 |
59	| branch-only | `dev start <repo> --task <name> --branch-only --base <ref>` | 需要 history isolation，但不需要第二個 directory |
60	| worktree | `dev start <repo> --task <name> --base <ref>` | 獨立寫入、平行工作或會比 session 存在更久的變更流 (change stream) |
61	
62	Worktree 是預設 mode。未指定 branch 時，`dev` 會產生 `feat/<task-slug>`；automation 仍應明確傳入預期 base。
63	
64	Direct 或 branch-only mode 在修改 canonical checkout 前，`dev` 會防止它與另一個 active agent/runtime 共用。
65	
66	## 2. Start 與檢查
67	
68	```bash
69	dev start api --task "token refresh" --base main --next "reproduce expiry race"
70	dev ls
71	dev status
72	```
73	
74	Start 會解析 repository、驗證 branch/base、建立或切換 checkout、需要時佈建 worktree、開啟 runtime，再保存 task。Branch 已被追蹤時應使用 `dev resume`，不要建立重複 task。
75	
76	需要把 intent、目前 Git/runtime/artifact evidence 與可執行 action 並排檢查時，可從 TTY 開啟獨立 preview：
77	
78	```bash
79	dev flow              # 目前 checkout 的 canonical repository 與 exact surface
80	dev flow api          # 明確指定 repository
81	```
82	
83	`dev flow` 顯示 Git 註冊的所有 worktrees 與沒有 checkout 的 task-only rows。Enter 只建立 fresh guarded plan；plan 為 READY 且經第二次 approval 後才 Apply。小寫 `r` 只更新 local facts，大寫 `R` 才選擇 fetch refs、query exact PR/MR 或兩者。完整 row/action 與 safety boundary 見 [Repository Flow 預覽](repository-flow.zh-TW.md)。
84	
85	## 3. 有意識地 park
86	
87	```bash
88	dev park --next "add the failing expiry test"
89	```
90	
91	一般 transition 是 HOT → WARM：關閉 runtime，但保留 checkout。請依 scope 選擇欄位：
92	
93	- `--next` 是下一個 executable task action，避免下次重新推導第一步；
94	- `dev park --note` 保存這一個 task 的 free-form context；
95	- `dev repo mark --note` 取代 catalog 的單一 repository summary；
96	- `dev note` 保存多筆 durable repository observations，不屬於 task lifecycle state。
97	
98	Working tree 尚未乾淨時：
99	
100	```bash
101	dev park --wip --next "finish the expiry test"
102	```
103	
104	這會建立暫時的 `wip: checkpoint — …` commit。它可搜尋、可 push；若不適合作為 product history，整合前應 reword 或 squash。
105	
106	需要釋放本機空間並跨機器 handoff 時：
107	
108	```bash
109	dev park --cold --push
110	```
111	
112	進入 COLD 前，commits 必須已在 remote 上可復原。Direct task 因 canonical checkout 不可丟棄，所以不能進入 COLD。
113	
114	## 4. 依即時 facts resume
115	
116	```bash
117	dev resume "token refresh" --fetch
118	```
119	
120	- WARM：重用 checkout 並重新開啟 runtime。
121	- COLD：fetch，需要時重建 branch/worktree、重新 provision，再開啟 runtime。
122	- 由另一台 host 擁有：除非已刻意移交或 override ownership，否則拒絕。
123	
124	Runtime handle 只是 advisory。`dev` 會重新解析 live sessions，不會假設記錄中的 handle 仍存在。
125	
126	## 5. 整合或交給 review
127	
128	保留有價值的 construction commits：
129	
130	```bash
131	dev done --ff
132	```
133	
134	這要求 clean tree，先把 task branch rebase 到 base，再於 canonical checkout 執行 fast-forward-only merge，最後標示 task DONE/MERGED。它不會關閉呼叫端 runtime、移除 worktree 或刪除 branch；請在外部 workspace 另行執行 `dev retire`。
135	
136	改由 review/CI 處理：
137	
138	```bash
139	dev done --pr
140	```
141	
142	這會 push branch，並在對應 CLI 可用時建立 pull/merge request。它**不會**標示 task DONE，也不會清理 checkout。`dev sweep` 不會推斷 remote request 已 merge；`dev flow` 的明確 `R` query 也只保留目前 run 的 provider evidence，不會自動 transition。Merge 後請驗證 exact named ref：
143	
144	```bash
145	git fetch origin
146	dev done --merged --base-ref origin/main
147	dev retire <task> --delete-branch
148	```
149	
150	`--merged` 以 ancestry proof 記錄 DONE/MERGED；squash merge 另需 `--confirm-squash <merge-commit>` operator attestation。Review/CI checks、approvals 或 mergeability 不會由最低限度 provider status 推斷。
151	
152	## 互動式 `dev done` finish wizard
153	
154	在 interactive terminal 上，省略 `--ff` 與 `--pr` 執行 `dev done` 不會直接失敗，而是開啟 finish wizard。它不會猜你要哪種 integration mode，而是先檢視 checkout 的實際狀態，只詢問它無法推斷的部分。
155	
156	Wizard 最多分三步：
157	
158	1. **Preflight。** 回報 branch、base、branch/base 的 commit relation（ahead/behind，或已被 base 包含），以及 — 若 checkout 是 dirty — 逐 path 說明哪些變更已與 base tree 相同、哪些是 unique。
159	2. **Dirty changes**，僅在 checkout 為 dirty 時出現：`c` 用你輸入的訊息 commit 全部變更，`d` discard 全部（tracked 與 untracked），`q` 取消且不做任何變更。Discard unique content — 尚未與 base 等價的內容 — 需在後續確認時輸入 `DROP`；只 discard 與 base 相符的 path 則不需要。
160	3. **Integration**，僅在未傳入 `--ff` 或 `--pr`、且 branch 尚未完全被 base 包含時出現：`f` 把 branch rebase 到 base 再 fast-forward（等同 `--ff`），`p` push 並開啟 pull/merge request（等同 `--pr`），`q` 取消。Branch 已被 base 包含時，wizard 會跳過此步驟，直接記錄 DONE/MERGED；runtime/worktree cleanup 仍留給之後的 `dev retire`。
161	
162	事先傳入 `--ff` 或 `--pr` 等於幫 wizard 回答了第 3 步，因此它只會詢問 flags 未解決的部分 —— 若 tree 乾淨且已明確給出 integration flag，則完全不會詢問。動作執行前會先列出 dirty action 與 integration mode 的摘要；確認它，或在 plan 已由 flags 完全指定時加上 `--yes` 跳過確認。若 plan 開啟期間 checkout 或 branch 發生變化，`dev` 會在確認後偵測到 drift 並拒絕套用過期的 plan —— 重新執行 `dev done` 以取得目前狀態。
163	
164	Non-interactive 情境 —— 沒有 TTY，或在 script 中 —— wizard 完全不會詢問。未指定 integration flag 時 `dev done` 只會回報同樣的 preflight 後結束；請明確傳入 `--ff` 或 `--pr`。Dirty checkout 在沒有 TTY 時預設失敗（`--dirty auto` 等同 `--dirty fail`），因此 script 應選擇明確的 policy：
165	
166	```bash
167	dev done --ff --dirty commit -m "chore: finalize before merge"
168	dev done --pr --dirty discard --yes   # destructive；此處 --yes 為必要
169	```
170	
171	`--message`/`-m` 只在搭配 `--dirty commit` 時使用。`--dirty discard` 在沒有 TTY 時需要 `--yes`；輸入 `DROP` 的確認只存在於 interactive 情境。
172	
173	## 6. 從外部 Retire
174	
175	DONE 只代表 MERGED。離開 target checkout/runtime 後再執行：
176	
177	```bash
178	dev retire <task>                  # 預設保留 branch
179	dev retire <task> --delete-branch  # 另行確認 freshly contained branch deletion
180	```
181	
182	Retire 會重新確認 caller/agent occupancy、關閉符合條件的 runtime、重新驗證 Git/artifact state、以 non-force 移除 worktree，最後才刪除 DONE task record。任一步驟失敗時保留 ordered ledger 與 recovery；已完成的 effects 不會被假裝 rollback。詳細條件見 [Agent-safe retirement](agent-safe-retirement.zh-TW.md)。
183	
184	## 7. Sweep drift 與 stale state
185	
186	```bash
187	dev sweep                 # 只回報
188	dev sweep --apply         # 每個建議個別確認
189	dev sweep --apply --yes   # 已檢查 report 後的 automation
190	```
191	
192	Sweep 可建議：
193	
194	- 沒有 live session 時 HOT → WARM；
195	- 長時間未動、clean 且已 push 的 WARM → COLD；
196	- 移除已經 DONE 的 registry entry；
197	- 清除 Git 不再知道的 worktree path；
198	- 檢查沒有 task 認領的 live runtime sessions。
199	
200	它不會刪除 uncommitted work。先回報再動作就是 safety model 的一部分。
201	
202	## 復原規則
203	
204	- Rebase conflict：解決後執行 `git rebase --continue`，再重跑 `dev done --ff`；要回到 rebase 前狀態則用 `git rebase --abort`。
205	- Worktree directory 消失：先用 `dev sweep` 或 `dev wt rm` 清理 stale Git administration，再 resume。
206	- Owner host 不正確：使用 override 前，先確認另一位 writer 已停止並 push。
207	- 不確定是否已 merge：保留 branch 與 task；驗證後刪除永遠比猜錯後復原便宜。
208

<tool-use data-tool-type="read" data-tool-name="Read"><details>

 `./docs/guides/agent-safe-retirement.md`

```text
1	---
2	description: Retire an integrated dev-cli worktree and runtime safely, from outside the workspace being removed.
3	authority: project
4	status: stable
5	verified_on: 2026-09-01
6	---
7	
8	# Agent-safe retirement
9	
10	A `dev` change stream reaches full retirement only after an external caller closes its runtime and removes its worktree — a feature agent must never destroy the checkout or runtime containing its own process.
11	
12	## Three milestones, not one
13	
14	Completion is three separate milestones, and the persisted task state `done` now means the middle one, not the last:
15	
16	```text
17	READY     exact final transcript committed after the writer exits
18	MERGED    branch integrated; runtime/worktree may still exist
19	RETIRED   runtime absent, worktree removed, optional branch deleted, task reaped
20	```
21	
22	`hot`, `warm`, `cold`, and `done` remain the only persisted task states — `done` means MERGED, with cleanup possibly still pending. It does **not** mean the runtime or worktree has already been deleted.
23	
24	## Commands
25	
26	| Command | What it does |
27	|---|---|
28	| `dev prepare --session <provider:uuid> --plan <path>` | Arms post-writer artifact finalization without closing the running agent. Product changes must already be committed; the transcript itself is deliberately not staged yet. |
29	| `dev artifact finalize --run-id "$DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID" --if-pending --writer-stopped` | Commits the one exact, stable transcript after its writer has stopped. `--if-pending` no-ops silently when no armed intent matches the run id; `--writer-stopped` confirms the outer wrapper has returned. |
30	| `dev done --ff` | Rebases the task branch onto its base and fast-forwards it locally. Records MERGED; never closes the runtime, removes a worktree, or deletes a branch. |
31	| `dev done --pr` | Pushes the branch and opens a pull/merge request through an available forge CLI. The task stays under review, not MERGED. |
32	| `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref>` | Verifies an externally merged branch is contained in `<ref>` and records MERGED. |
33	| `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref> --confirm-squash <merge-commit>` | Same, but for a squash merge: attests that the named commit, already proven contained in `<ref>`, represents the feature branch. This is an operator assertion dev cannot verify on its own. |
34	| `dev artifact discard <intent> --yes` | Records that an intent can never be finalized — its transcript was never written, or its HEAD is gone after a rebase — so it stops blocking integration and retirement. It commits and recovers nothing, prints exactly what is being abandoned, and refuses an intent that is still `armed`, because finalization is the path that preserves a transcript. |
35	| `dev retire [task-or-worktree] [--close-unknown] [--assume-no-runtime] [--delete-branch] [--timeout <duration>]` | Re-resolves every covering runtime session, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, waits for closure, revalidates Git state, and only then removes the linked worktree without force. Deletes the task record only after every requested step succeeds. |
36	| `dev flow [repo]` | Preview UI for an exact DONE task: Enter builds a revision-bound Retire plan, then approval applies it. Branch deletion requires the displayed typed token. |
37	| `dev sweep --merged-worktrees [--base <ref>] [--apply] [--yes] [--close-unknown] [--assume-no-runtime] [--delete-branches]` | From the canonical checkout, reports (and, with `--apply`, retires) both task-tracked and unmanaged linked worktrees whose branches are already contained in the base. |
38	
39	A dirty checkout does not fail here: `dev done` classifies it against the base
40	first, offering commit or discard interactively, or taking an explicit
41	`--dirty` policy from a script. See
42	[Change-stream workflow](change-stream-workflow.md) for that wizard. The
43	`--keep-worktree` and `--delete-branch` flags remain accepted on `dev done`
44	only to fail loudly and point at `dev retire`.
45	
46	## Normal local flow
47	
48	From the feature worktree:
49	
50	```bash
51	# Commit product changes first. Do not stage the moving transcript.
52	dev prepare --session claude:<uuid> --plan .claude/plans/task.md
53	# Exit the agent normally so SpecStory can write its final Markdown.
54	```
55	
56	The outer `specstory run` wrapper then calls:
57	
58	```bash
59	dev artifact finalize --run-id "$DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID" --if-pending --writer-stopped
60	```
61	
62	An external main/integration workspace finishes the job:
63	
64	```bash
65	dev done <task> --ff
66	dev retire <task> --delete-branch
67	```
68	
69	`dev done` only integrates and records MERGED. `dev retire` re-resolves every runtime pane, closes eligible sessions, waits for them to disappear, revalidates Git, and removes the worktree without force.
70	
71	In `dev flow`, Retire shows conditions, effects, retained resources, and the CLI
72	fallback before approval. Apply locks and reloads the task revision plus exact
73	repository/worktree/ref/runtime/artifact authority, repeats safety checks after
74	runtime closure and before removal, and deletes the task record last. A later
75	failure preserves a step ledger and recovery; completed effects are not called
76	rolled back.
77	
78	## Pull-request flow
79	
80	```bash
81	dev done <task> --pr
82	# after CI/review and a commit-preserving merge
83	git fetch origin
84	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main
85	dev retire <task> --delete-branch
86	```
87	
88	A squash merge is not ancestry-equivalent, so it needs an explicit operator attestation:
89	
90	```bash
91	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main --confirm-squash <merge-commit>
92	```
93	
94	This proves only that the named squash commit is contained in the base; the operator is asserting that it actually represents the feature branch.
95	
96	## Refusal conditions
97	
98	`retire.Inspect` refuses to proceed whenever any of the following hold, and it re-checks after closing sessions rather than trusting a stale view:
99	
100	- the caller's current directory is the target checkout or below it;
101	- the caller's `HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID`, `HERDR_PANE_ID`, or `TMUX_PANE` identifies a runtime session that covers the target;
102	- a covering runtime workspace also contains panes outside the target (mixed-purpose workspace);
103	- any covering agent status is `working`, `running`, `busy`, `blocked`, or `waiting` — **never overridable, by any flag**;
104	- agent status is empty or `unknown`, **unless** the caller passes `--close-unknown` from outside the target;
105	- agent status is unrecognized (anything outside the known set) — always blocks;
106	- runtime enumeration itself fails, **unless** the caller passes `--assume-no-runtime`.
107	
108	`--close-unknown` and `--assume-no-runtime` only relax fail-closed *observations* (an unreadable status, a runtime list that could not be enumerated). Neither flag ever bypasses caller containment or an active-agent state. `retirement.Service.Retire` also revalidates the target's identity, Git ancestry, in-progress Git operations (`gitx.InProgress`, checking `MERGE_HEAD`, `CHERRY_PICK_HEAD`, `REVERT_HEAD`, `rebase-merge`, `rebase-apply`, `sequencer` — not `REBASE_HEAD`, which Git leaves behind after a rebase completes), and worktree cleanliness after runtime sessions close — reality may have changed while a runtime was draining, so no earlier proof carries across that boundary.
109	
110	## Periodic cleanup with sweep
111	
112	```bash
113	dev sweep --merged-worktrees
114	# Present the exact candidates/blockers to the user and ask for approval.
115	dev sweep --merged-worktrees --apply --yes
116	```
117	
118	This surfaces both task-tracked DONE worktrees and unmanaged linked worktrees whose named branches are already contained in the base — run it from the canonical checkout. It reports before applying: containment alone is never permission. Dirty Git state, a pending or unreachable artifact, a locked or prunable worktree registration, an in-progress Git operation, and the same runtime refusal conditions as `dev retire` all still block cleanup. Branches remain after retirement by default; pass `--delete-branches` only when the user separately approved deleting them.
119	
120	## Safety boundaries
121	
122	Raw `git worktree remove --force` and configured external tools bypass dev entirely — never run them from an agent that occupies the target. dev's guarantee is only for dev-mediated paths; it cannot stop an operator or script from calling Git directly.
123	
124	Normal task-backed retirement uses `internal/taskflow`. The explicit unmanaged
125	path form of `dev retire` remains an isolated compatibility implementation, and
126	some `sweep` record-only/orphan-salvage actions remain outside taskflow. Existing
127	CLI acknowledgement flags remain compatible; the flow preview intentionally
128	offers none of them.
129	
130	A real Codex session once deleted its own registered worktree and branch from another checkout. Herdr kept the workspace and terminal alive because a Unix process can hold an open cwd inode after the path is unlinked, and SpecStory then recreated the same path containing only `.specstory/` content. The shell looked alive but was no longer a Git checkout:
131	
132	```text
133	failed to reload config: No such file or directory
134	fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
135	```
136	
137	Treat `runtime alive + Git registration absent + artifact-only path` as an orphan that needs transcript salvage and external reconciliation — **never** as RETIRED.
138	
139	`dev sweep` now recognises that shape rather than leaving it to be spotted by eye. When a task records a checkout that exists but Git does not register, and the directory holds nothing but agent artifact folders, sweep reports it as an abandoned agent workspace. It offers to remove it only when every file inside is byte-identical to one the repository already has; anything that differs is listed as salvage work and left untouched, including by `--apply`.
140	
141	Byte equality rather than mere presence is the point. A transcript writer that outlives its worktree usually flushes a longer final version than the copy committed earlier, so a same-named file in the repository is not evidence that the tail was saved.
142	
143	## Sources

1	---
2	description: 安全地從外部 retire dev-cli 已整合的 worktree 與 runtime，而非在被移除的 workspace 內部執行。
3	authority: project
4	status: stable

7	---
8	
9	# Agent-safe retirement
10	
11	!!! note "術語規則"
12	    有公認中文譯名且本文使用中文時，首次以「中文 (English original)」呈現。產品名稱與 Git／CLI／agent domain terms 可直接保留英文；沒有公認譯名不得自創。程式碼、API／tool 名稱、CLI flag、套件名與路徑一律不翻譯。
13	
14	一條 `dev` change stream 只有在外部呼叫者關閉其 runtime、移除其 worktree 之後，才算真正完成 retirement——feature agent 絕不能自行摧毀自己所在的 checkout 或 runtime。
15	
16	## 三個里程碑，不是一個
17	
18	Completion 分成三個獨立里程碑，且目前 persisted task state 的 `done` 對應的是中間那個，不是最後一個：
19	
20	```text
21	READY     writer 離開後，commit 了 exact final transcript
22	MERGED    branch 已整合；runtime/worktree 可能仍存在
23	RETIRED   runtime 已消失、worktree 已移除、可選擇刪除 branch、task 已 reap
24	```
25	
26	`hot`、`warm`、`cold`、`done` 仍是唯一的 persisted task state——`done` 代表 MERGED，cleanup 可能仍待執行，**不代表** runtime 或 worktree 已經被刪除。
27	
28	## 命令
29	
30	| 命令 | 作用 |
31	|---|---|
32	| `dev prepare --session <provider:uuid> --plan <path>` | 在不關閉目前執行中 agent 的情況下，arm post-writer artifact finalization。Product changes 必須已先 commit；transcript 本身刻意尚未 stage。 |
33	| `dev artifact finalize --run-id "$DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID" --if-pending --writer-stopped` | 在 writer 停止後，commit 唯一 exact、stable 的 transcript。`--if-pending` 在沒有對應 armed intent 時靜默 no-op；`--writer-stopped` 確認外層 wrapper 已 return。 |
34	| `dev done --ff` | 把 task branch rebase 到其 base 上並在本機 fast-forward。記錄為 MERGED；不會關閉 runtime、移除 worktree 或刪除 branch。 |
35	| `dev done --pr` | Push branch，並透過可用的 forge CLI 開啟 pull/merge request。Task 保持在 review 狀態，不是 MERGED。 |
36	| `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref>` | 驗證某個已在外部 merge 的 branch 是否被 `<ref>` 包含，並記錄為 MERGED。 |
37	| `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref> --confirm-squash <merge-commit>` | 同上，但用於 squash merge：attest（斷言）已證明被 `<ref>` 包含的該 commit 代表這條 feature branch。這是 dev 無法自行驗證的 operator assertion。 |
38	| `dev flow [repo]` | 在獨立 TTY preview 中顯示 DONE row 的 Retire (Keep Branch) 或 typed Retire + Delete Contained Branch plan；Enter 只規劃，第二次 approval 才套用。 |
39	| `dev artifact discard <intent> --yes` | 記錄某個 intent 永遠無法 finalize——transcript 從未被寫出，或 rebase 之後 HEAD 已不存在——使它不再阻擋 integration 與 retirement。它不會 commit 也不會復原任何東西，會先印出確切將被放棄的內容，並拒絕仍為 `armed` 的 intent，因為 finalize 才是保存 transcript 的路徑。 |
40	| `dev retire [task-or-worktree] [--close-unknown] [--assume-no-runtime] [--delete-branch] [--timeout <duration>]` | 重新解析每一個 covering runtime session，拒絕 active agent 與 mixed-purpose workspace，等待其關閉，重新驗證 Git state，才移除 linked worktree（不使用 force）。只有在所有要求的步驟都成功後，才刪除 task record。 |
41	| `dev sweep --merged-worktrees [--base <ref>] [--apply] [--yes] [--close-unknown] [--assume-no-runtime] [--delete-branches]` | 從 canonical checkout 執行，回報（加上 `--apply` 時則 retire）branch 已被 base 包含的 task-tracked 與 unmanaged linked worktree。 |
42	
43	Dirty checkout 在這裡不會直接失敗：`dev done` 會先把它與 base 比對分類，在
44	interactive 時提供 commit 或 discard，在 script 中則接受明確的 `--dirty`
45	policy。該 wizard 詳見[變更流工作流程](change-stream-workflow.zh-TW.md)。
46	`dev done` 上的 `--keep-worktree` 與 `--delete-branch` 之所以仍被接受，只是為了
47	明確報錯並指向 `dev retire`。
48	
49	## Flow 中的 DONE 與 Retire
50	
51	`dev flow` 把 persisted `DONE` intent 與 live cleanup evidence 分開。DONE/MERGED row 仍可顯示 runtime、worktree、branch 與 task record；只有 Retire result 完成最後的 CAS task deletion 才是 RETIRED。UNMANAGED row 使用的是永遠保留 branch 的 Remove Checkout，不會製造 DONE/RETIRED task milestone；canonical 與 harness row 不能 Remove Checkout。
52	
53	Flow TUI 沒有 `--close-unknown`、`--assume-no-runtime`、dirty discard 或 generic force。`runtime=none` 會保留「session/agent unobserved」，不冒充已證明 closed。需要 expert acknowledgement 時，離開 Flow 並明確執行 plan 顯示的 fallback CLI，再接受該 command 自己的 guards。完整 row/action matrix 見 [Repository Flow 預覽](repository-flow.zh-TW.md)。
54	
55	## 一般 local flow
56	
57	在 feature worktree 中：
58	
59	```bash
60	# 先 commit product changes，不要 stage 仍在變動中的 transcript。
61	dev prepare --session claude:<uuid> --plan .claude/plans/task.md
62	# 正常結束 agent，讓 SpecStory 寫出最終 Markdown。
63	```
64	
65	外層 `specstory run` wrapper 接著呼叫：
66	
67	```bash
68	dev artifact finalize --run-id "$DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID" --if-pending --writer-stopped
69	```
70	
71	外部的 main/integration workspace 完成剩下的工作：
72	
73	```bash
74	dev done <task> --ff
75	dev retire <task> --delete-branch
76	```
77	
78	`dev done` 只負責整合並記錄為 MERGED。`dev retire` 會重新解析每個 runtime pane、關閉符合條件的 session、等待它們消失、重新驗證 Git，再移除 worktree（不使用 force）。
79	
80	## Pull-request 流程
81	
82	```bash
83	dev done <task> --pr
84	# CI/review 完成，且以保留 commit 的方式 merge 之後
85	git fetch origin
86	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main
87	dev retire <task> --delete-branch
88	```
89	
90	Squash merge 並不等同於 ancestry-equivalent，因此需要明確的 operator attestation：
91	
92	```bash
93	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main --confirm-squash <merge-commit>
94	```
95	
96	這只證明所指名的 squash commit 被包含在 base 中；operator 是在斷言它確實代表這條 feature branch。
97	
98	## 拒絕條件
99	
100	只要符合以下任一條件，`retire.Inspect` 就會拒絕繼續執行；且它會在關閉 session 後重新檢查，而不是信任過期的視圖：
101	
102	- 呼叫者目前所在目錄就是 target checkout 或其下層；
103	- 呼叫者的 `HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID`、`HERDR_PANE_ID` 或 `TMUX_PANE` 對應到一個涵蓋 target 的 runtime session；
104	- 某個涵蓋 target 的 runtime workspace 同時也包含 target 以外的 pane（mixed-purpose workspace）；
105	- 任何涵蓋中的 agent status 為 `working`、`running`、`busy`、`blocked` 或 `waiting`——**任何 flag 都無法 override**；
106	- Agent status 為空或 `unknown`，**除非**呼叫者從 target 外部傳入 `--close-unknown`；
107	- Agent status 無法辨識（不在已知集合內）——一律阻擋；
108	- Runtime enumeration 本身失敗，**除非**呼叫者傳入 `--assume-no-runtime`。
109	
110	`--close-unknown` 與 `--assume-no-runtime` 只放寬 fail-closed 的*觀測結果*（無法讀取的 status、無法列舉的 runtime list）。這兩個 flag 都絕不會 bypass caller containment 或 active-agent state。`retirement.Service.Retire` 在 runtime session 關閉後，也會重新驗證 target identity、Git ancestry、進行中的 Git operation（`gitx.InProgress`，檢查 `MERGE_HEAD`、`CHERRY_PICK_HEAD`、`REVERT_HEAD`、`rebase-merge`、`rebase-apply`、`sequencer`；不含 `REBASE_HEAD`，因為 Git 在 rebase 完成後仍會保留它）以及 worktree 是否 clean——因為 runtime draining 期間現實可能已改變，先前的驗證結果不會跨越這個邊界沿用。
111	
112	Taskflow Apply 也不信任畫面時的 snapshot：它鎖定 canonical repository/task store、重新讀取 task revision 與 authority fingerprint，並在 runtime closure、worktree removal、optional branch deletion 與最後 task reap 前逐段 revalidate。Result ledger 依序保留 `ATTEMPTED`/`COMPLETED`/`FAILED`；若前段 cleanup 已完成而後段失敗，會回報 partial success 與 recovery，而不宣稱 rollback。
113	
114	## 用 sweep 做定期 cleanup
115	
116	```bash
117	dev sweep --merged-worktrees
118	# 把確切的 candidates/blockers 呈現給使用者，並徵求核可。
119	dev sweep --merged-worktrees --apply --yes
120	```
121	
122	這會同時列出 task-tracked 的 DONE worktree，以及 named branch 已被 base 包含的 unmanaged linked worktree——請從 canonical checkout 執行。它會先回報再套用：containment 本身絕不等於許可。Dirty 的 Git state、pending 或無法到達的 artifact、locked 或 prunable 的 worktree registration、進行中的 Git operation，以及與 `dev retire` 相同的 runtime 拒絕條件，都仍會阻擋 cleanup。Retirement 完成後預設保留 branch；只有在使用者另外核可刪除時，才加上 `--delete-branches`。
123	
124	## 安全邊界
125	
126	原始的 `git worktree remove --force` 會完全繞過 dev——絕不要在佔用 target 的 agent 中執行它。dev 的保證僅止於：沒有任何 dev-mediated 路徑會執行 forced removal；它無法阻止 operator 或 script 直接呼叫 Git。Bare dashboard 的 configured `[[tui.tools]]` command 同樣是任意 external-tool escape boundary，不會繼承 Flow 的 PlanID、conditions、ledger 或 revalidation。
127	
128	一般 task-backed retirement 使用 `internal/taskflow`。Explicit unmanaged path 形式的 `dev retire` 仍是隔離的 compatibility implementation，部分 `sweep` record-only/orphan-salvage actions 也仍在 taskflow 之外。既有 CLI acknowledgement flags 維持相容，但 Flow preview 不提供其中任何一個；不能把本頁的 shared planner claim 擴張到所有 historical cleanup path。
129	
130	曾經真實發生過：一個 Codex session 從另一個 checkout 刪除了自己已註冊的 worktree 與 branch。Herdr 仍讓該 workspace 與 terminal 保持存活，因為 Unix process 在路徑被 unlink 之後仍可持有開啟中的 cwd inode；接著 SpecStory 又在同一路徑重新建立、但內容只剩 `.specstory/`。這個 shell 看起來還活著，但已經不再是一個 Git checkout：
131	
132	```text
133	failed to reload config: No such file or directory
134	fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
135	```
136	
137	請把「runtime 存活 + Git registration 不存在 + artifact-only path」視為需要 transcript salvage 與外部 reconciliation 的 orphan——**絕不能**視為 RETIRED。
138	
139	`dev sweep` 現在會自行辨識這個形狀，不再只能靠人眼察覺。當某個 task 記錄的 checkout 存在、但 Git 並未註冊它，且該目錄裡只有 agent artifact 資料夾時，sweep 會將它回報為 abandoned agent workspace。只有在其中每個檔案都與 repository 已有的檔案 byte-identical 時，sweep 才會提議移除；任何內容不同的檔案都會被列為 salvage 工作並保持原狀，`--apply` 也不會動它。
140	
141	這裡採用 byte equality 而非僅檢查檔案是否存在，正是重點所在。比 worktree 活得更久的 transcript writer，通常會 flush 出比先前 commit 版本更長的最終稿，因此 repository 中存在同名檔案並不能證明結尾內容已被保存。
142

1	---
2	description: Record dev-cli dependencies, upstream preview status, documentation constraints, and behavior that is intentionally incomplete.

4	status: evolving
5	verified_on: 2026-09-01

8	
9	# Compatibility and known limitations
10	
11	This page separates graceful degradation from real limitations. Reverify it whenever command/runtime code or version-sensitive Claude Code documentation changes.
12	
13	## dev-cli capability matrix
14	
15	| Capability | Dependency | Without it |
16	|---|---|---|
17	| core repository/task/worktree operations | Git | unavailable; Git is the only hard runtime dependency |
18	| rich grouped runtime and agent activity | Herdr server + CLI | `auto` tries tmux, then Zellij, then none |
19	| named terminal session | tmux or compatible Zellij | `none` preserves core behavior and shell navigation |
20	| GitHub pull requests/remotes | `gh` authenticated | branch still pushes when Git works; browser/manual flow may be needed |
21	| GitLab merge requests/remotes | `glab` authenticated | same graceful fallback |
22	| repository bootstrap publishing | authenticated `gh` or `glab` | local repository/scaffold still works; the wizard explains how to log in |
23	| remote repository snapshot template | Git plus network/authentication for the source | validation fails before the destination is created and rendered URL userinfo is redacted; local templates still work |
24	| setup-capable project skills | skills provider plus the entrypoint interpreter | unselected skills are skipped; selected required setup fails before scaffold mutation when its interpreter is unavailable; a clone acquired first is retained |
25	| staged lazygit message prefill | a lazygit version that reads `LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT` | files remain staged and dev prints the suggested message; normal Git commit remains available |
26	| worktree dependency setup | ecosystem manager (`uv`, npm, Cargo, etc.) | plan reports the missing tool and keeps the checkout |
27	| interactive dashboard | terminal input/output | bare `dev` prints the plain task list when piped |
28	| preview repository flow | terminal input/output | `dev flow` refuses non-TTY use and points to `dev repo context` / JSON inventory |
29	| repository-note search | linked `modernc.org/sqlite` with FTS5 | no external `sqlite3` executable is required |
30	| terminal multiplexing on Windows | tmux/Zellij/Herdr (POSIX only) | Windows always uses the `none` backend; `dev shell-init powershell` still moves the shell |
31	| in-place self-update | standalone install (not Homebrew/Scoop/`go install`) | `dev upgrade` prints the package manager's upgrade command instead |
32	
33	## Confirmed project limitations
34	
35	### Note search and filesystem durability vary by text and platform
36	
37	Latin note queries use term-wise prefix FTS and SQLite ranking. Non-ASCII queries use literal term-wise substring matching because SQLite's `unicode61` tokenizer does not segment arbitrary CJK substrings; those results do not use the same FTS ranking.
38	
39	Note writes sync the file and atomically rename it on every supported platform. Unix also syncs the containing directory after rename/delete. The Windows implementation cannot provide that directory-fsync step, so a sudden power loss has a narrower durability guarantee there. Concurrent mutations by cooperating `dev` processes are serialized and each Markdown replacement is atomic; arbitrary external writers do not participate in that lock.
40	
41	### Pull-request completion is not tracked automatically
42	
43	`dev done --pr` pushes and opens a pull/merge request, then leaves the task,
44	runtime, and worktree unchanged because review owns integration. `dev flow` can
45	run an explicit, run-local query for the exact head/base review and report only
46	portable existence, open/draft/merged/closed state, URL, provider, and observation
47	time. It does not query review decisions or checks, persist that evidence, or
48	turn it into DONE. Current `dev sweep` does not query the forge either. Verify
49	integration with exact local ancestry and finish deliberately.
50	
51	### Agent session capture is reserved, not wired
52	
53	The task schema has an `AgentSession` field and Herdr inventory can expose live agent session IDs. The production start/park/resume path does not yet capture or attach that ID. Treat the field and live inventory as observability/future integration, not a promise that `dev resume` restores the coding-agent conversation.
54	
55	### Built-in forge cache TTL differs from generated config
56	
57	`dev config init` writes `forge.cache_ttl = "15m"`. With no config file, the current built-in `Forge.CacheTTL` zero value means an existing valid cache is not rejected by age; explicit `r` refresh still replaces it. Freshness also requires a source fingerprint matching the configured GH/GL hosts and Azure targets, so an endpoint change is never hidden by the zero TTL. Legacy source-less caches remain available only through explicit `--cached` and are reported stale. Run `config init` or set the TTL when freshness matters.
58	
59	Older generated configs may contain `forge.remote_limit = 100`. The field is
60	still accepted, but complete forge inventories are now paginated and it no
61	longer caps synchronization. `dev config init` no longer writes it. The
62	`--limit` flag on `dev repo remote` limits rendered matches after the complete
63	inventory has been searched.
64	
65	### Lazygit staged-message prefill is best effort
66	
67	`repo --check-in=stage` writes a pending message in the exact worktree Git
68	directory. [Lazygit v0.59.0 uses that file for lowercase
69	`c`](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/blob/v0.59.0/pkg/gui/controllers/helpers/working_tree_helper.go#L191-L216), but it is a
70	lazygit implementation detail rather than a Git interface; uppercase `C` and
71	plain `git commit` do not consume it. Dev never overwrites a different existing
72	draft. A draft-write failure is warning-only: staging remains successful and
73	is never rolled back. If the integration changes upstream, the staged index
74	and printed message remain the recovery path.
75	
76	### Windows is a build target, not a full-feature platform
77	
78	`dev` compiles and runs on `windows/amd64` and `windows/arm64`, and every release ships a `.zip` for each. Core repository, task and worktree operations work. What differs:
79	
80	- There is no tmux, Zellij or Herdr, so the runtime backend is always `none`. Grouped runtime/agent activity and named sessions are unavailable; the `cd` directive and PowerShell wrapper still work.
81	- Shell integration is `dev shell-init powershell`. POSIX shells hand the directory back on file descriptor 3; PowerShell cannot inherit it, so the wrapper passes a temp-file path in `DEV_SHELL_CD_FILE` instead.
82	- `dev fleet open` starts a child shell (`%COMSPEC%`) rather than replacing the process, because Windows has no `exec(2)`.
83	- The domain test suites still assume a POSIX filesystem in places, so Windows CI runs the tests advisory-only while compilation, `go vet` and the build are enforced.
84	
85	### Direct mode has a smaller lifecycle
86	
87	A direct task uses the canonical checkout and cannot go COLD, because cold cleanup would remove a directory the repository needs. Use branch-only or worktree mode for cross-machine reconstruction.
88	
89	### Flow intentionally omits expert overrides
90	
91	`dev flow` offers normal managed lifecycle actions, exact unmanaged metadata-only
92	Adopt/clean branch-preserving Remove, and explicit remote evidence. It does not
93	offer dirty commit/discard, WIP, shared-writer, ownership takeover, force, unknown-
94	runtime, or assume-no-runtime choices. A blocked plan shows remediation and the
95	compatible CLI fallback; existing command flags and structured contracts remain
96	available.
97	
98	Task-backed lifecycle and exact unmanaged linked-checkout actions share
99	`internal/taskflow`. Explicit unmanaged path retirement remains an isolated
100	compatibility implementation, while `sweep` retains record-only reaping, orphan
101	salvage, and other narrow reconciliation paths. Do not assume every cleanup path
102	has the same planner. Raw Git and configured external tools also bypass dev's
103	PlanID, locks, revalidation, and result ledger.
104	
105	## Current behaviors that are implemented
106	
107	These were historical gaps and should not be reintroduced as limitations:
108	
109	- `dev repo new|create`, `repo clone`, and `repo setup` share a preset-driven bootstrap pipeline. A plain explicit `repo new NAME` remains minimal, while a clear Git URL, local Git path, or owner/name routes through clone acquisition and preserves source history/remote. The no-argument wizard detects the same reference in its first field; for a new repository, a default-no customization gate keeps the normal `agent-ready` flow concise. Text fields use a TTY inline editor, so cursor keys edit rather than inserting raw escape bytes; non-TTY readers retain line-oriented behavior.
110	- `repo new` can snapshot a local directory/repository or Git source at an optional branch, tag, or commit and confined subdirectory into a fresh history. An unpinned local Git tree includes tracked plus untracked non-ignored files; a non-Git directory includes its full current tree. Source `.git` metadata is excluded, URL userinfo is redacted, unsafe file types/paths fail before destination creation, and held root/file handles confine mutable-path races. Human plans preview paths and warn when the snapshot is live; presets can select catalog-repository subfolders.
111	- Repository setup supports `--check-in=commit|stage|none` (`auto` for preset compatibility). Staged setup runs before-commit setup and `git add -A` without an `after_commit` phase, cannot publish or hand off to `start`, and may prefill lazygit lowercase `c` as described above.
112	- Selected skills with matching source and agent targets share one installer invocation. The `agent-history-hygiene` initializer writes pre-commit/gitleaks policy and merges missing machine-local `.project.json`/`statistics.json` rules into `.specstory/.gitignore`; custom content and transcript history remain trackable.
113	- Project `.dev-cli/config.toml` and `.dev-cli/scaffolds.toml` are constrained to portable setup policy. Executable project configuration is keyed to the canonical Git common directory and an exact content hash; a changed hash is untrusted until approved again.
114	
115	- `dev start --focus` activates the runtime after non-JSON creation.
116	- `dev start --run '<shell command>'` dispatches only to an exact root pane from
117	  a newly created first-class Herdr worktree. It is incompatible with `--json`,
118	  non-worktree modes, and non-Herdr runtimes, and does not wait for command exit.
119	- TUI navigation refuses to open a missing COLD checkout and directs the user to `dev resume`.
120	- Preview-labelled `dev flow [repo]` is an independent full-screen TTY model. It resolves canonical/linked cwd to the exact surface, uses a picker outside Git, shows every registered worktree plus task-only records, and makes every mutation Enter-to-plan then approve. Apply revalidates task revision and exact repository/worktree/ref/runtime/artifact authority and retains partial step results. Local `r` is network-free; `R` explicitly selects fetch/query/both and keeps minimal review evidence run-local.
121	- `DEV_TUI_TRACE` starts at `cli.Execute`; it cannot include OS process loading. `tui.initial_view_returned` measures model construction, not renderer flush or physical terminal paint. Use it for same-profile comparisons rather than universal hardware/network guarantees.
122	- Runtime handles now record backend provenance and are revalidated before cleanup.
123	- `auto` runtime selection includes Zellij between tmux and none.
124	
125	- `dev done` opens an interactive finish wizard on a TTY when `--ff`/`--pr` are both omitted, analyzing a dirty checkout against the base (commit, discard, or cancel) instead of rejecting any uncommitted change outright; a non-interactive caller still passes an explicit `--dirty` policy and `--yes` for a destructive discard.
126	- Human-readable output now carries semantic color (`--color auto|always|never`), automatically disabled when `NO_COLOR` is set, `TERM=dumb`, or stdout/stderr is not a terminal.
127	- `dev done` records MERGED only: it never closes the invoking runtime, removes a worktree, or deletes a branch. Cleanup moved to `dev retire`, which runs from outside the target workspace, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, and revalidates Git state after every runtime closure. `dev done --delete-branch` is now an error pointing at `dev retire --delete-branch`, and `--keep-worktree` warns as a no-op.
128	- `dev sweep --merged-worktrees` enumerates linked worktrees from Git rather than from the task registry, so unmanaged worktrees whose branches are contained in the base become retirable. Containment alone is never permission; dirty state, unfinalized artifacts, in-progress Git operations, and runtime refusals all still block it, and branches survive unless `--delete-branches` is passed.
129	- `dev sweep` reports a branch-backed task whose branch Git no longer has as dead and offers to reap the record. Such a task cannot be finished, resumed, or retired, because every one of those paths resolves the branch first; the suggestion stays report-only until `--apply`.
130	- An unknown command is reported instead of discarded. `dev` silences cobra's own error printing and previously also skipped printing anything whose message began with `unknown command`, so a mistyped command produced no output at all on either stream. The message, cobra's "Did you mean this?" suggestions, and a pointer to `--help` are now printed to stderr with exit status 1.
131	- A stray argument to a command family is an error rather than a silent help render. `dev wt bogus` used to print `dev wt` help and exit 0 because a family has no `Run` of its own; every family node now reports the unknown subcommand and exits 1, while a bare family still prints its help and exits 0.
132	- Argument-count and flag errors print the failing command's usage block. `--color` still governs whether that block is colorized.
133	- Each command family's help carries an ASCII orientation diagram and a `See also: dev help <topic>` pointer, and `dev help <command>` resolves a command name or alias to its topic, so `dev help wt` reaches the worktrees page.
134	- Semantic color covers every human-readable surface, including the interactive dashboard: `dev --color never`, `NO_COLOR` and `TERM=dumb` now disable dashboard color too, which they previously did not.
135	- `dev sweep` reaps a task whose repository directory no longer exists. Such a record was unreachable by every command in the binary: `done`, `resume`, `park` and `retire` all resolve the repository first, the dead-branch rule excludes direct mode, and the stale-worktree rule requires a recorded worktree path. A live runtime session rules the suggestion out, and reaping removes only dev's record of intent.
136	- `dev sweep` reports a task-recorded checkout that exists but Git does not register and that holds nothing but agent artifact directories. Removal is offered only when every file inside is byte-identical to one already in the repository; anything else is reported as salvage work and is never removed, including under `--apply`.
137	- `dev sweep` acts on a cold task whose worktree is still on disk. Inventory has always computed that drift for `dev ls` and the dashboard, but sweep never consulted it, so it was displayed and not actionable.
138	- `dev retire <path>` reaps the matching task record. Only the by-task form set the task identity, so retiring the same checkout by path left the record behind; the DONE-state and identity checks are unchanged.
139	- `dev version` reports whether the running build is a published release, and `dev doctor` carries the same line. Nothing in the tool answered "am I current?" before, and `go install ...@latest` resolves to the newest tag, so an untagged feature was invisible to anyone installing it.
140	- A release publishes platform archives and `SHA256SUMS` and takes its notes from `CHANGELOG.md`. Earlier releases published a GitHub release object and nothing else, so their assets are absent by construction.
141	- A release publishes Windows `.zip` archives alongside the Unix `.tar.gz` set, and refreshes an in-repo Scoop manifest attached to the release (and pushed to the bucket when a token is configured).
142	- `dev upgrade` downloads the current release for this platform, verifies it against the release `SHA256SUMS`, and replaces the running binary with an atomic rename (Windows moves the live `.exe` aside and sweeps it on the next run). It defers to Homebrew, Scoop or `go install` when one of them owns the file.
143	- An interactive `dev` command prints one dim "newer release available" line at most once a day, read from the day-old release cache; it never blocks on the network. For the TUI, a stale-cache background refresh starts only after the initial view returns. `[update] check = false` or `DEV_NO_UPDATE_CHECK` disables it.
144
