38	## 已確認的專案限制
39	
40	### Note search 與 filesystem durability 依文字及平台而異
41	
42	Latin note query 使用 term-wise prefix FTS 與 SQLite ranking。Non-ASCII query 改用 literal term-wise substring matching，因為 SQLite 的 `unicode61` tokenizer 不會切分任意 CJK substrings；這些結果不使用相同的 FTS ranking。
43	
44	所有支援平台的 note write 都會 sync file 並 atomic rename。Unix 也會在 rename/delete 後 sync containing directory。Windows implementation 無法提供 directory-fsync 步驟，因此 sudden power loss 時的 durability guarantee 較窄。Cooperating `dev` processes 的 concurrent mutations 會被 serialized，且每次 Markdown replacement 都是 atomic；任意 external writer 不會參與這個 lock。
45	
46	### Pull request completion 不會自動追蹤
47	
48	`dev done --pr` push 並建立 pull/merge request，之後保留 task、runtime 與 worktree，因為 integration 由 review 負責。`dev sweep` 不會 query forge 推斷 request 後來已 merge。`dev flow` 只有在 operator 明確按 `R` 並核准 Query Review 時，才保留目前 run 的 exact head/base observation；它不會 persistent cache、poll 或自動 transition。
49	
50	Portable provider evidence 僅包含 review 是否存在、provider、`open`/`draft`/`merged`/`closed`、URL 與 observation time。它不涵蓋 CI check conclusions、approvals、mergeability、comments 或 deployment status；unsupported/unauthenticated/ambiguous/malformed/failed query 也不等於 absence。請 fetch/驗證 named ancestry，再用 `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref>` 或 Flow 的 Verify Merged 記錄 DONE。
51	
52	### Agent session capture 只有保留欄位，尚未接線
53	
54	Task schema 有 `AgentSession`，Herdr inventory 也能顯示 live agent session ID；production start/park/resume path 尚未 capture 或 attach 該 ID。這個欄位與 live inventory 只能視為 observability/future integration，不能承諾 `dev resume` 會恢復 coding-agent conversation。
55	
56	### Built-in forge cache TTL 與 generated config 不同
57	
58	`dev config init` 會寫 `forge.cache_ttl = "15m"`。沒有 config file 時，目前 built-in `Forge.CacheTTL` 的 zero value 代表既有 valid cache 不會因 age 被拒絕；explicit `r` 仍會 refresh。Freshness 也要求 source fingerprint 符合 configured GH/GL hosts 與 Azure targets，因此 endpoint change 不會被 zero TTL 隱藏。Legacy source-less cache 只能透過 explicit `--cached` 使用，並會標為 stale。Freshness 重要時請執行 `config init` 或設定 TTL。
59	
60	較舊的 generated config 可能包含 `forge.remote_limit = 100`。此欄位仍可解析，
61	但 forge inventory 現在會完整 pagination，因此不再限制 synchronization。
62	`dev config init` 不再寫入它；`dev repo remote --limit` 只在完整 inventory 搜尋
63	完成後限制 rendered matches。
64	
65	### Lazygit staged-message prefill 是 best effort
66	
67	`repo --check-in=stage` 會在正確的 worktree Git directory 寫入 pending message。
68	[Lazygit v0.59.0 的小寫 `c` 會使用該
69	檔案](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/blob/v0.59.0/pkg/gui/controllers/helpers/working_tree_helper.go#L191-L216)，但這是 lazygit implementation detail，不是 Git
70	interface；大寫 `C` 與一般 `git commit` 不會讀取它。Dev 不會覆寫內容不同的既有
71	draft。Draft write failure 只會產生 warning；staging 仍視為成功且不會 rollback。若
72	upstream integration 日後改變，staged index 與已印出的 message 仍是 recovery path。
73	
74	### Windows 是 build target，不是 full-feature 平台
75	
76	`dev` 可在 `windows/amd64` 與 `windows/arm64` 編譯並執行，每個 release 都會附各自的 `.zip`。核心的 repository、task 與 worktree 操作可用。差異：
77	
78	- 沒有 tmux、Zellij 或 Herdr，因此 runtime backend 一律是 `none`。Grouped runtime/agent activity 與 named session 無法使用；`cd` 指令與 PowerShell wrapper 仍可運作。
79	- Shell integration 是 `dev shell-init powershell`。POSIX shell 透過 file descriptor 3 回傳目錄；PowerShell 無法繼承它，wrapper 改用 `DEV_SHELL_CD_FILE` 傳入 temp-file path。
80	- `dev fleet open` 會啟動子 shell（`%COMSPEC%`），而非取代 process，因為 Windows 沒有 `exec(2)`。
81	- Domain test suites 仍有部分假設 POSIX filesystem，因此 Windows CI 的 test 僅供參考，compilation、`go vet` 與 build 則為強制項。
82	
83	### Direct mode 的 lifecycle 較小
84	
85	Direct task 使用 canonical checkout，不能進入 COLD，因為 cold cleanup 會移除 repository 必需的 directory。需要跨機器 reconstruction 時使用 branch-only 或 worktree mode。
86	
87	### Mediated safety 不涵蓋 raw/configured commands
88	
89	`dev flow` 與 taskflow 的 PlanID、conditions、locks、revalidation 和 partial ledger 只保護 dev-mediated action。Task-backed lifecycle 與 exact unmanaged linked-checkout actions 共用 `internal/taskflow`；但 explicit unmanaged path retirement 仍是隔離的 compatibility implementation，`sweep` 的 record-only reap、orphan salvage 與其他 narrow reconciliation paths 也仍在 taskflow 之外。不能假設每條 historical cleanup path 都已 migrate 或使用同一 planner。
90	
91	Raw `git worktree remove --force`、`git branch -D`、直接 forge CLI、script，以及 bare dashboard 的 configured `[[tui.tools]]` command 都能繞過這個 boundary。它們是刻意保留的 expert/operator escape hatches，不應被描述成自動繼承相同 safety guarantees。

93	## 已實作、不能再列為 limitation 的 behavior
94	
95	以下是歷史缺口，現行版本已實作：
96	
97	- `dev repo new|create`、`repo clone` 與 `repo setup` 共用 preset-driven bootstrap pipeline。Plain explicit `repo new NAME` 仍維持 minimal；清楚的 Git URL、local Git path 或 owner/name 會改走 clone acquisition，保留 source history/remote。無參數 wizard 的第一個欄位也會偵測同樣 reference；建立新 repository 時，預設為 no 的 customization gate 讓正常 `agent-ready` flow 保持精簡。Text fields 使用 TTY inline editor，因此 cursor keys 會編輯內容，不會插入 raw escape bytes；non-TTY reader 維持 line-oriented behavior。
98	- `repo new` 可從 local directory/repository 或 Git source 的 optional branch、tag、commit 與 confined subdirectory 建立 fresh-history snapshot。未 pin 的 local Git tree 包含 tracked 加 untracked non-ignored files；non-Git directory 包含完整 current tree。Source `.git` metadata 會排除、URL userinfo 會 redact，不安全的 file types/paths 會在 destination 建立前失敗，held root/file handles 會限制 mutable-path races。Human plan 會預覽 paths 並警告 live snapshot，preset 也可選擇 catalog-repository subfolder。
99	- Repository setup 支援 `--check-in=commit|stage|none`（`auto` 用於 preset compatibility）。Staged setup 會執行 before-commit setup 與 `git add -A`，但不執行 `after_commit` phase；它不能 publish 或 handoff 到 `start`，並可依前述方式預填 lazygit 小寫 `c`。
100	- Source 與 agent targets 相同的 selected skills 會共用一次 installer invocation。`agent-history-hygiene` initializer 會寫入 pre-commit/gitleaks policy，並將缺少的 machine-local `.project.json`／`statistics.json` 規則 merge 進 `.specstory/.gitignore`；custom content 與 transcript history 都保持可追蹤。
101	- Project `.dev-cli/config.toml` 與 `.dev-cli/scaffolds.toml` 僅能保存 portable setup policy。Executable project configuration 會綁定 canonical Git common directory 與 exact content hash；hash 改變後必須重新信任。
102	
103	- `dev start --focus` 會在 non-JSON creation 後 activate runtime。
104	- `dev start --run '<shell command>'` 只會 dispatch 到本次新建 first-class Herdr
105	  worktree 的 exact root pane。它不能與 `--json`、non-worktree modes 或 non-Herdr
106	  runtimes 併用，也不等待 command exit。
107	- TUI navigation 會拒絕開啟 checkout 不存在的 COLD task，並要求使用 `dev resume`。
108	- `dev flow [repo]` 是與 dashboard 分離的 TTY-only preview。它依 canonical Git common directory 顯示所有 registered worktrees 加 task-only rows；Enter 只建立 plan，`r` 只做 local reload，`R` 才選 fetch/query/both。Flow choices 不含 generic force、dirty discard、`--close-unknown`、`--assume-no-runtime`、shared writer 或 ownership takeover。
109	- Flow Apply 會重新載入 task revision與 Git/worktree/runtime/agent/artifact/remote authority，並在 runtime closure 與 removal 邊界再次驗證。Result 保留 attempted/completed/failed ledger；partial success 不宣稱 rollback。
110	- `DEV_TUI_TRACE` 從 `cli.Execute` 起算，無法涵蓋 OS process loading。`tui.initial_view_returned` 量測 model construction，不是 renderer flush 或 physical terminal paint；它適合同 profile 比較，不是跨硬體／network 的 universal guarantee。
111	- Runtime handle 現在保存 backend provenance，cleanup 前會重新驗證。
112	- `auto` runtime selection 已在 tmux 與 none 之間加入 Zellij。
113	
114	- `dev done` 在省略 `--ff`/`--pr` 且為 TTY 時會開啟 interactive finish wizard，把 dirty checkout 拿去跟 base 比較（commit、discard 或 cancel），不再直接拒絕任何 uncommitted change；non-interactive caller 仍須明確傳入 `--dirty` policy，且 destructive discard 需要 `--yes`。
115	- Human-readable output 現在具備 semantic color（`--color auto|always|never`），在 `NO_COLOR` 已設定、`TERM=dumb`，或 stdout/stderr 不是 terminal 時會自動停用。
116	- `dev done` 只記錄 MERGED：它不會關閉呼叫端 runtime、移除 worktree 或刪除 branch。Cleanup 已移交 `dev retire`，後者必須從目標 workspace 之外執行，會拒絕 active agent 與 mixed-purpose workspace，並在每次關閉 runtime 之後重新驗證 Git state。`dev done --delete-branch` 現在會直接報錯並指向 `dev retire --delete-branch`，`--keep-worktree` 則以 no-op 警告。
117	- `dev sweep --merged-worktrees` 直接從 Git 列舉 linked worktrees，而非從 task registry，因此 branch 已被 base 包含的 unmanaged worktree 也能被 retire。Containment 本身絕不等於許可；dirty state、未 finalize 的 artifact、進行中的 Git operation 與 runtime 拒絕條件都仍會阻擋，且未加 `--delete-branches` 時 branch 一律保留。
118	- `dev sweep` 會把 branch 已不存在於 Git 的 branch-backed task 視為 dead，並提供 reap 該 record 的建議。這種 task 無法 finish、resume 或 retire，因為這些路徑都必須先解析 branch；在 `--apply` 之前該建議仍只是報告。
119	- 未知 command 會被回報，而不是被丟棄。`dev` 關閉了 cobra 自己的 error 輸出，先前又額外略過所有訊息開頭為 `unknown command` 的 error，因此打錯 command 時兩個 stream 都沒有任何輸出。現在會把訊息、cobra 的「Did you mean this?」建議，以及指向 `--help` 的提示寫到 stderr，exit status 為 1。
120	- 對 command family 傳入多餘的 argument 現在是 error，而不是安靜地印出 help。`dev wt bogus` 過去會印出 `dev wt` help 並 exit 0，因為 family 本身沒有 `Run`；現在每個 family node 都會回報未知 subcommand 並 exit 1，而單獨執行 family 仍會印出 help 並 exit 0。
121	- Argument 數量與 flag 錯誤會印出該 command 的 usage block。該 block 是否上色仍由 `--color` 決定。
122	- 每個 command family 的 help 都附上 ASCII orientation diagram 與 `See also: dev help <topic>` 指引，且 `dev help <command>` 會把 command 名稱或 alias 解析成對應 topic，因此 `dev help wt` 會連到 worktrees 頁面。
123	- Semantic color 已覆蓋所有 human-readable 介面，包含 interactive dashboard：`dev --color never`、`NO_COLOR` 與 `TERM=dumb` 現在也會關閉 dashboard 的顏色，先前並不會。
124	- `dev sweep` 會 reap repository 目錄已不存在的 task。這種 record 先前無法被 binary 中任何 command 觸及：`done`、`resume`、`park` 與 `retire` 都會先解析 repository，dead-branch 規則排除 direct mode，stale-worktree 規則又需要有記錄的 worktree path。若有 live runtime session 則不會提出此建議，且 reap 只移除 dev 的 intent record。
125	- `dev sweep` 會回報 task 記錄中存在、但 Git 未註冊，且只包含 agent artifact 目錄的 checkout。只有在其中每個檔案都與 repository 既有檔案 byte-identical 時才提議移除；其餘一律回報為 salvage 工作，即使加上 `--apply` 也絕不移除。
126	- `dev sweep` 會處理 worktree 仍在磁碟上的 cold task。Inventory 一直有為 `dev ls` 與 dashboard 計算這項 drift，但 sweep 從未讀取它，因此只能顯示、無法處理。
127	- `dev retire <path>` 會 reap 對應的 task record。先前只有 by-task 形式會設定 task identity，因此以 path 退休同一個 checkout 會留下 record；DONE 狀態與 identity 檢查維持不變。
128	- `dev version` 會回報目前執行的 build 是否為已發布的 release，`dev doctor` 也帶有同一行資訊。先前工具中沒有任何地方能回答「我是不是最新的？」，而 `go install ...@latest` 只會解析到最新的 tag，因此未 tag 的 feature 對安裝者而言等同不存在。
129	- Release 會發布各平台 archive 與 `SHA256SUMS`，並以 `CHANGELOG.md` 對應段落作為 release notes。先前的 release 只產生 GitHub release 物件，因此那些版本本來就沒有附加檔案。
130	- Release 會在 Unix `.tar.gz` 之外一併發布 Windows `.zip`，並更新附在 release 上的 in-repo Scoop manifest（設定 token 時也會 push 到 bucket）。
131	- `dev upgrade` 會下載此平台目前的 release、以 release `SHA256SUMS` 驗證，再以 atomic rename 取代執行中的 binary（Windows 會把 live `.exe` 移到旁邊，下次執行時清除）。若 Homebrew、Scoop 或 `go install` 擁有該檔案，則改為印出對應指令。
132	- Interactive `dev` command 每天最多印一行 dim 的「有新版」提示，來源是一天內的 release cache，永不因網路而 block。TUI 的 stale-cache background refresh 只會在 initial view return 後啟動。`[update] check = false` 或 `DEV_NO_UPDATE_CHECK` 可停用。

1	---
2	description: Use the preview dev flow interface to inspect one repository and apply revision-bound lifecycle, adoption, removal, retirement, and remote-evidence plans.

7	
8	# Repository lifecycle flow
9	
10	`dev flow [repo]` is a preview-labelled, full-screen, TTY-only interface for one
11	repository's lifecycle. It is independent of the six-view `dev tui` dashboard:
12	its only job is to show repository surfaces, observed evidence, and exact guarded
13	actions.
14	
15	```bash
16	dev flow              # current repository, or a picker outside Git
17	dev flow api          # explicit repository overrides cwd
18	```
19	
20	From either the canonical checkout or a linked worktree, bare `dev flow` resolves
21	the canonical Git common-directory identity and focuses the exact current
22	surface. Outside Git it loads a filterable repository picker asynchronously. A
23	repository that is referenced by task metadata but temporarily unavailable
24	remains inspectable as unavailable task-only rows.
25	
26	## Repository surfaces
27	
28	The left panel starts from every record in `git worktree list --porcelain`, then
29	adds task records that have no checkout. Normal COLD and DONE tasks therefore do
30	not disappear merely because no directory exists.
31	
32	| Row kind | Meaning | Guarded actions |
33	|---|---|---|
34	| `canonical` | the worktree Git marks Main, regardless of branch name | legal task actions when exactly bound; never checkout removal |
35	| `managed` | a non-main checkout with one exact task binding | mode/state lifecycle actions |
36	| `unmanaged` | a registered linked checkout with no task or harness claim | Adopt; clean branch-preserving Remove Checkout |
37	| `harness` | strict path evidence places it under `.claude/worktrees` | inspect and eligible remote evidence only; harness owns cleanup |
38	| `task-only` | task metadata has no registered checkout, normally COLD or DONE | Resume or Retire only when exact task identity permits it |
39	| `conflict` | duplicate claims, mismatched identity, incomplete inventory, or other ambiguity | inspect/remediate; destructive actions fail closed |
40	
41	A branch name prefix is not harness ownership proof. Canonical, harness-owned,
42	locked/prunable, detached, ambiguously claimed, or incompletely observed rows are
43	never treated as removable merely because they look inactive.
44	
45	For an eligible unmanaged row:
46	
47	- **Adopt** creates one worktree-mode task record and does not change checkout
48	  content, refs, runtime layout, or path. A dirty checkout may be adopted because
49	  its bytes remain untouched. Fresh strict runtime evidence may derive HOT only
50	  for one stable shell-only covering session with no recognized agent; otherwise
51	  adoption is WARM. `runtime=none` is unobserved, so it derives WARM.
52	- **Remove Checkout** requires an exact named clean linked checkout, complete task
53	  inventory with no claims, ready artifacts, safe external runtime cleanup, and
54	  no harness evidence. It uses non-force removal and verifies that the local
55	  branch remains at the same OID.
56	
57	Repository-wide prune and drift reconciliation are not hidden Remove variants.
58	The flow reports those conditions and leaves them for explicit recovery.
59	
60	## Intent, facts, and plans
61	
62	The three panels keep different kinds of truth separate:
63	
64	1. **Persisted intent** — task mode, HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE, owner, next action,
65	   branch/base, expected checkout, and runtime hint.
66	2. **Observed facts** — repository/worktree identity, HEAD and refs, Git status and
67	   in-progress operations, artifact readiness, runtime sessions, and recognized
68	   agents. A fact remains known, unknown, error, skipped, loading, or stale; a
69	   failed observation never becomes false, clean, or closed.
70	3. **Guarded plan** — legal source/target edge, READY/NEEDS INPUT/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN/
71	   ERROR availability, ordered conditions and effects, remediation, resources
72	   retained, confirmation class, PlanID, and CLI fallback.
73	
74	`runtime=none` cannot observe session or agent occupancy. That does not turn the
75	observation into “closed,” but a complete local Git/task snapshot can still be
76	fresh and useful for non-runtime facts.
77	
78	## Managed lifecycle choices
79	
80	Actions are concrete variants, not a generic force menu:
81	
82	| Current intent | Flow choices |
83	|---|---|
84	| HOT/WARM worktree or branch task | Park Warm; Park Cold; Park Cold + Push; Complete FF; Review Handoff; Verify Merged |
85	| HOT/WARM direct task | Park Warm; Complete Direct |
86	| WARM task | Resume (with an explicit fetch effect) |
87	| COLD worktree/branch task | Resume and reconstruct/reopen; completion remains unavailable until HOT |
88	| DONE task | Retire (Keep Branch); for eligible non-direct tasks, Retire + Delete Contained Branch |
89	
90	Review Handoff publishes the branch and creates a pull/merge request when the
91	available provider supports it, but preserves HOT/WARM. Direct/FF/verified
92	completion writes DONE last and keeps branch, checkout, and runtime resources.
93	Retire is the separate externally safe close/wait/remove/task-reap operation.
94	
95	The preview always uses a fail-on-dirty completion policy. It intentionally does
96	not expose dirty commit/discard, WIP checkpoint, shared-writer, ownership
97	takeover, force removal, `--close-unknown`, or `--assume-no-runtime` choices.
98	Blocked plans show the precise evidence, remediation, and compatible CLI
99	fallback instead of manufacturing an override.
100	
101	## Keys and approval
102	
103	```text
104	j/k or up/down       select a surface or picker/menu row
105	h/l or left/right    select an already-concrete action
106	Tab / Shift-Tab      move panel focus
107	/                    filter the repository picker
108	Enter                build and inspect a plan; never apply immediately
109	y                    approve a READY non-typed plan
110	r                    reload local facts only
111	R                    choose Fetch Refs, Query Review, or Both
112	?                    show evidence and key semantics
113	Esc                  back out
114	q                    quit; while Apply runs, queue quit until its ledger returns
115	```
116	
117	Typed retirement displays the exact `DELETE <branch>` token; type it and press
118	Enter. A mismatch remains non-mutating. Plans that are not READY have no Apply
119	path and remain open for inspection.
120	
121	## Local and manual remote evidence
122	
123	Startup and `r` do not fetch or contact a forge. Network work happens only in a
124	confirmed action that declares it: Resume fetch, Park Cold + Push, Review
125	Handoff, or one of the `R` choices.
126	
127	`R` supplies three independent plan variants:
128	
129	- **Fetch Refs** runs `git fetch --prune` for the exact configured remote.
130	- **Query Review** asks the supported GitHub, GitLab, or Azure CLI for the exact
131	  head/base relationship without fetching.
132	- **Both** fetches first, then queries; if fetch fails, review is not attempted.
133	
134	Remote results live only for the current flow run. Ref evidence contains exact
135	named-ref OIDs or explicit absence/error. Portable review evidence contains only
136	existence, provider state (open/draft/merged/closed), draft flag, URL, provider,
137	and observation time. Unsupported providers, missing CLIs/extensions,
138	authentication/provider failures, malformed or multiple matches, and
139	not-yet-requested evidence stay UNKNOWN or ERROR. The flow does not query or
140	infer review decisions, approvals, comments, or checks.
141	
142	## Plan and Apply revalidation
143	
144	Planning is side-effect-free. A plan seals the task record revision and exact
145	repository, Git common directory, checkout path/branch/HEAD, refs, status,
146	runtime/agent occupancy, artifacts, remote identity, concrete options, and
147	ordered effects into an authority fingerprint and PlanID.
148	
149	Apply accepts only a plan produced by the current flow run and an approval bound
150	to that PlanID. It locks repository then task state, reloads the task revision,
151	re-observes authority, and rejects any difference before a new effect. Safety-
152	critical checks repeat after runtime closure and immediately before checkout or
153	branch removal. Task state is written last; retirement deletes the DONE record
154	last.
155	
156	Apply is not canceled by refresh, row switching, or quit. Conflicting navigation
157	is disabled, and quit/refresh waits for the result. The result ledger preserves
158	every attempted/completed/failed effect plus warnings and recovery. Partial
159	success means completed effects remain completed; no rollback is implied. A new
160	local generation loads afterward, and directory/runtime/URL handoff occurs only
161	after the alternate screen exits.
162	
163	## Compatibility boundary
164	
165	The same `internal/taskflow` authority backs normal task-managed park, resume,
166	completion, and retirement commands plus exact unmanaged linked-checkout Adopt
167	and Remove paths. Existing CLI flags and structured output remain compatible,
168	including expert acknowledgements that the preview does not offer.
169	
170	This is not a claim that every historical cleanup path has migrated. Explicit
171	unmanaged path retirement remains an isolated compatibility implementation, and
172	`sweep` retains record-only, orphan-salvage, and other narrowly scoped
173	reconciliation paths outside taskflow. `sweep` still reports before applying.
174	
175	Raw Git and configured external TUI tools do not participate in dev's task locks,
176	PlanID approval, identity revalidation, or result ledger. They remain available,
177	but they are outside dev-mediated safety guarantees.
178	
179	## Sources
180	
181	- [`internal/cli/flow.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/cli/flow.go)
182	- [`internal/flowtui`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/tree/main/internal/flowtui)
183	- [`internal/taskflow`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/tree/main/internal/taskflow)
184	- [`internal/inventory/repo_context.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/inventory/repo_context.go)
185	- [`internal/task/store.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/task/store.go)
186	- [`internal/forge/review.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/forge/review.go)

11	!!! note "術語規則"

19	```
20	
21	從 canonical checkout 或 linked worktree 執行不帶 argument 的 `dev flow` 時，它會解析 canonical Git common-directory identity，並 focus 目前所在的 exact surface。在 Git 之外執行時，則非同步載入可過濾的 repository picker。由 task metadata 引用、但暫時 unavailable 的 repository，仍會以 unavailable task-only rows 供檢查。
22	
23	## Repository surfaces
24	
25	左側 panel 先採用 `git worktree list --porcelain` 的每一筆 record，再加入沒有 checkout 的 task records。因此，正常 COLD 與 DONE tasks 不會只因 directory 不存在就消失。
26	
27	| Row kind | 意義 | Guarded actions |
28	|---|---|---|
29	| `canonical` | Git 標示為 Main 的 worktree，不受 branch name 影響 | Exact 綁定時提供合法 task actions；絕不移除 checkout |
30	| `managed` | 有一筆 exact task binding 的 non-main checkout | 依 mode/state 提供 lifecycle actions |
31	| `unmanaged` | 沒有 task 或 harness claim 的 registered linked checkout | Adopt；對 clean checkout 執行保留 branch 的 Remove Checkout |
32	| `harness` | Strict path evidence 顯示它位於 `.claude/worktrees` 下 | 僅供 inspect，以及符合條件時取得 remote evidence；cleanup 由 harness 負責 |
33	| `task-only` | Task metadata 沒有 registered checkout，通常是 COLD 或 DONE | 只有 exact task identity 允許時才能 Resume 或 Retire |
34	| `conflict` | Duplicate claims、mismatched identity、incomplete inventory 或其他 ambiguity | Inspect/remediate；destructive actions fail closed |
35	
36	Branch name prefix 不是 harness ownership proof。Canonical、harness-owned、locked/prunable、detached、被 ambiguous claim 或 observation 不完整的 row，不會只因看似 inactive 就被視為可移除。
37	
38	符合條件的 unmanaged row：
39	
40	- **Adopt** 建立一筆 worktree-mode task record，不改 checkout content、refs、runtime layout 或 path。Dirty checkout 仍可 adopt，因為其 bytes 保持原狀。只有 fresh strict runtime evidence 證明恰有一個 stable、shell-only covering session，且沒有 recognized agent 時，才能 derive HOT；其他情況 adoption 都是 WARM。`runtime=none` 屬於 unobserved，因此 derive WARM。
41	- **Remove Checkout** 要求 exact named clean linked checkout、完整且沒有 claim 的 task inventory、ready artifacts、可從外部安全 cleanup 的 runtime，以及沒有 harness evidence。它以 non-force 方式移除，並驗證 local branch 仍在相同 OID。
42	
43	Repository-wide prune 與 drift reconciliation 不是隱藏的 Remove variants。Flow 會回報這些 conditions，留待明確 recovery。
44	
45	## Intent、facts 與 plans
46	
47	三個 panels 刻意分開不同種類的 truth：
48	
49	1. **Persisted intent** — task mode、HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE、owner、next action、branch/base、expected checkout 與 runtime hint。
50	2. **Observed facts** — repository/worktree identity、HEAD 與 refs、Git status 與進行中的 operations、artifact readiness、runtime sessions 與 recognized agents。Fact 會維持 known、unknown、error、skipped、loading 或 stale；failed observation 絕不會變成 false、clean 或 closed。
51	3. **Guarded plan** — 合法的 source/target edge、READY/NEEDS INPUT/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN/ERROR availability、ordered conditions/effects、remediation、retained resources、confirmation class、PlanID 與 CLI fallback。
52	
53	`runtime=none` 無法觀察 session 或 agent occupancy。這不會把 observation 變成「closed」，但完整的 local Git/task snapshot 仍可對 non-runtime facts 提供 fresh 且有用的資訊。
54	
55	## Managed lifecycle choices
56	
57	Actions 是具體 variants，不是 generic force menu：
58	
59	| Current intent | Flow choices |
60	|---|---|
61	| HOT/WARM worktree 或 branch task | Park Warm；Park Cold；Park Cold + Push；Complete FF；Review Handoff；Verify Merged |
62	| HOT/WARM direct task | Park Warm；Complete Direct |
63	| WARM task | Resume（包含明確 fetch effect） |
64	| COLD worktree/branch task | Resume 並 reconstruct/reopen；回到 HOT 前不能 completion |
65	| DONE task | Retire (Keep Branch)；符合條件的 non-direct task 另有 Retire + Delete Contained Branch |
66	
67	Review Handoff 會 publish branch，且 available provider 支援時會建立 pull/merge request，但仍保留 HOT/WARM。Direct/FF/verified completion 最後寫入 DONE，並保留 branch、checkout 與 runtime resources。Retire 才是另一個可從外部安全執行的 close/wait/remove/task-reap operation。
68	
69	Preview 一律使用 dirty 時 fail 的 completion policy。它刻意不提供 dirty commit/discard、WIP checkpoint、shared-writer、ownership takeover、force removal、`--close-unknown` 或 `--assume-no-runtime` choices。Blocked plan 會顯示精確 evidence、remediation 與相容的 CLI fallback，不會憑空製造 override。
70	
71	## Keys 與 approval
72	
73	```text
74	j/k 或 up/down         選擇 surface 或 picker/menu row
75	h/l 或 left/right      選擇已具體化的 action
76	Tab / Shift-Tab        移動 panel focus
77	/                      過濾 repository picker
78	Enter                  建立並檢查 plan；絕不立即 apply
79	y                      核准 READY 且非 typed 的 plan
80	r                      只重新載入 local facts
81	R                      選擇 Fetch Refs、Query Review 或 Both
82	?                      顯示 evidence 與 key semantics
83	Esc                    返回上一層
84	q                      離開；Apply 執行中會排隊，等 ledger 返回後才離開
85	```
86	
87	Typed retirement 會顯示 exact `DELETE <branch>` token；輸入後按 Enter。任何 mismatch 都不會 mutation。不是 READY 的 plans 沒有 Apply path，但仍維持開啟供檢查。
88	
89	## Local 與 manual remote evidence
90	
91	Startup 與 `r` 不會 fetch 或聯絡 forge。只有已確認且明確宣告的 action 才執行 network work：Resume fetch、Park Cold + Push、Review Handoff，或其中一個 `R` choice。
92	
93	`R` 提供三種獨立 plan variant：
94	
95	- **Fetch Refs** 對 exact configured remote 執行 `git fetch --prune`。
96	- **Query Review** 不 fetch，向支援的 GitHub、GitLab 或 Azure CLI 查詢 exact head/base relationship。
97	- **Both** 先 fetch 再 query；fetch 失敗時不會嘗試 review query。
98	
99	Remote result 只存在於目前 flow run。Ref evidence 包含 exact named-ref OIDs，或明確 absence/error。Portable review evidence 只包含 existence、provider state（open/draft/merged/closed）、draft flag、URL、provider 與 observation time。Unsupported provider、missing CLI/extension、authentication/provider failure、malformed 或 multiple matches，以及尚未要求取得的 evidence，都維持 UNKNOWN 或 ERROR。Flow 不會 query 或推斷 review decisions、approvals、comments 或 checks。
100	
101	## Plan 與 Apply revalidation
102	
103	Planning 不產生 side effect。Plan 會將 task record revision，以及 exact repository、Git common directory、checkout path/branch/HEAD、refs、status、runtime/agent occupancy、artifacts、remote identity、concrete options 與 ordered effects，封入 authority fingerprint 與 PlanID。
104	
105	Apply 只接受目前 flow run 產生的 plan，以及綁定該 PlanID 的 approval。它依序鎖定 repository 與 task state、重新載入 task revision、重新 observe authority，且只要出現差異，就會在新 effect 前拒絕。Safety-critical checks 會在 runtime closure 後，以及 checkout 或 branch removal 前立即重做。Task state 最後才寫入；retirement 最後才刪除 DONE record。
106	
107	Refresh、切換 row 或 quit 都不會取消 Apply。互相衝突的 navigation 會停用，quit/refresh 則等待 result。Result ledger 保存每一個 attempted/completed/failed effect，以及 warnings 與 recovery。Partial success 表示 completed effects 維持完成；不暗示 rollback。之後會載入新的 local generation，directory/runtime/URL handoff 也只在 alternate screen 結束後發生。
108	
109	## Compatibility boundary
110	
111	同一個 `internal/taskflow` authority 支援一般 task-managed park、resume、completion 與 retirement commands，以及 exact unmanaged linked-checkout 的 Adopt/Remove paths。既有 CLI flags 與 structured output 維持相容，包括 preview 不提供的 expert acknowledgements。
112	
113	這不表示每一條 historical cleanup path 都已 migrate。Explicit unmanaged path retirement 仍是隔離的 compatibility implementation；`sweep` 的 record-only、orphan-salvage 與其他 narrowly scoped reconciliation paths 也仍在 taskflow 之外。`sweep` 仍維持先回報再套用。
114	
115	Raw Git 與 configured external TUI tools 不參與 dev 的 task locks、PlanID approval、identity revalidation 或 result ledger。這些工具仍可使用，但位於 dev-mediated safety guarantees 之外。
116	
117	## 來源

119	- [`internal/cli/flow.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/cli/flow.go)
120	- [`internal/flowtui`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/tree/main/internal/flowtui)

124	- [`internal/forge/review.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/forge/review.go)

35	func InProgress(dir string) (string, bool, error) {
36		repository, err := Discover(context.Background(), dir)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", false, err
39		}
40		// REBASE_HEAD is deliberately absent: Git leaves it behind after a rebase
41		// *completes*, so treating it as evidence would permanently block every
42		// worktree that was ever rebased. Only the rebase state directories prove
43		// a rebase is still running.
44		for _, candidate := range []string{
45			"MERGE_HEAD", "CHERRY_PICK_HEAD", "REVERT_HEAD",
46			"rebase-merge", "rebase-apply", "sequencer",
47		} {
48			for _, root := range []string{repository.GitDir, repository.GitCommonDir} {
49				if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(root, candidate)); err == nil {
50					return candidate, true, nil
51				} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
52					return "", false, err
53				}
54			}
55		}
56		return "", false, nil
57	}
58	
59	func Uncommit(ctx context.Context, dir string, rewritePublished bool) (*UncommitReceipt, error) {
60		repository, status, err := transactionPreflight(ctx, dir, rewritePublished)
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, err
63		}
64		if status.Staged > 0 {
65			return nil, fmt.Errorf("uncommit requires an empty index so existing staged work is not mixed")
66		}
67		line, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", "HEAD")
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, err
70		}
71		fields := strings.Fields(line)
72		if len(fields) != 2 {
73			if len(fields) == 1 {
74				return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot uncommit the root commit")
75			}
76			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot uncommit a merge commit; parent topology would be lost")
77		}
78		receipt := &UncommitReceipt{OldOID: fields[0], Parent: fields[1], Branch: status.Branch, Created: time.Now().UTC()}
79		path := uncommitReceiptPath(repository.GitDir)
80		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("an uncommit receipt already exists; run dev git recommit first")
82		} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
83			return nil, err
84		}
85		if err := writeJSONAtomic(path, receipt); err != nil {
86			return nil, err
87		}
88		if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "reset", "--soft", receipt.Parent); err != nil {
89			_ = os.Remove(path)
90			return nil, err
91		}
92		return receipt, nil
93	}
94	
95	func Recommit(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, error) {
96		repository, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", err
99		}
100		if operation, active, err := InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
101			return "", err
102		} else if active {
103			return "", fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
104		}
105		path := uncommitReceiptPath(repository.GitDir)
106		receipt, err := readReceipt(path)
107		if err != nil {
108			return "", err
109		}
110		status, err := StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
111		if err != nil {
112			return "", err
113		}
114		if status.Detached || status.Branch != receipt.Branch {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", receipt.Branch, status.Branch)
116		}
117		if status.Staged == 0 {
118			return "", fmt.Errorf("nothing is staged to recommit")
119		}
120		head, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
121		if err != nil {
122			return "", err
123		}
124		if head != receipt.Parent {
125			return "", fmt.Errorf("HEAD changed since uncommit: expected %s, got %s", receipt.Parent, head)
126		}
127		if !RefExists(ctx, repository.Root, receipt.OldOID) {
128			return "", fmt.Errorf("original commit %s is no longer available", receipt.OldOID)
129		}
130		if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "commit", "-C", receipt.OldOID); err != nil {
131			return "", err
132		}
133		commit, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
134		if err != nil {
135			return "", err
136		}
137		if err := os.Remove(path); err != nil {
138			return "", fmt.Errorf("commit created, but remove uncommit receipt: %w", err)
139		}
140		return commit, nil
141	}
142	
143	func PullRebase(ctx context.Context, dir string) (PullRebaseResult, error) {
144		repository, status, err := transactionPreflight(ctx, dir, true)
145		if err != nil {
146			return PullRebaseResult{}, err
147		}
148		if status.Upstream == "" {
149			return PullRebaseResult{}, fmt.Errorf("branch %s has no upstream", status.Branch)
150		}
151		var result PullRebaseResult
152		lockDir := filepath.Join(repository.GitCommonDir, "dev-git-transactions")
153		err = lockx.WithDir(ctx, lockDir, "git transaction", func() error {
154			current, err := StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
155			if err != nil {
156				return err
157			}
158			if current.Dirty() {
159				result.HadLocalWork = true
160				tag := fmt.Sprintf("dev-pull-rebase-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
161				if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "stash", "push", "--include-untracked", "-m", tag); err != nil {
162					return err
163				}
164				result.StashOID, err = stashOIDForTag(ctx, repository.Root, tag)
165				if err != nil {
166					return fmt.Errorf("capture created stash oid: %w", err)
167				}
168				if result.StashOID == "" {
169					return fmt.Errorf("Git reported local work but created no stash; refusing to reuse an existing stash")
170				}
171			}
172			if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "-c", "rebase.autoStash=false", "pull", "--rebase"); err != nil {
173				return fmt.Errorf("pull --rebase failed; local work remains in stash %s: %w", result.StashOID, err)
174			}
175			if result.StashOID == "" {
176				return nil
177			}
178			if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "stash", "apply", "--index", result.StashOID); err != nil {
179				return fmt.Errorf("restore local work from stash %s failed; stash retained: %w", result.StashOID, err)
180			}
181			result.Restored = true
182			selector, ok, err := stashSelector(ctx, repository.Root, result.StashOID)
183			if err != nil {
184				return err
185			}
186			if !ok {
187				return nil // Applied bytes are safe; retaining an extra stash beats dropping the wrong one.
188			}
189			if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "stash", "drop", selector); err != nil {
190				return fmt.Errorf("local work restored, but exact stash %s was retained: %w", result.StashOID, err)
191			}
192			result.Dropped = true
193			return nil
194		})
195		return result, err
196	}
197

199		repository, _, err := transactionPreflight(ctx, dir, options.RewritePublished)
200		if err != nil {

215					excluded = append(excluded, path)
216				}
217			}
218			sortStrings(excluded)
219		}
220		if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, args...); err != nil {
221			return "", excluded, err
222		}
223		if options.ExcludeArtifacts {
224			resetArgs := append([]string{"reset", "--"}, AgentArtifactPathspecs()...)
225			if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, resetArgs...); err != nil {
226				return "", excluded, fmt.Errorf("unstage excluded agent artifacts: %w", err)
227			}
228		}
229		staged, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only")
230		if err != nil {
231			return "", excluded, err
232		}
233		if strings.TrimSpace(staged) == "" {
234			return "", excluded, fmt.Errorf("nothing is staged to amend")
235		}
236		if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "commit", "--amend", "--no-edit"); err != nil {
237			return "", excluded, err
238		}
239		commit, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
240		return commit, excluded, err
241	}
242	
243	func ChangedPaths(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]string, error) {
244		out, err := Run(ctx, dir, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, err
247		}
248		var paths []string
249		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
250		for i := 0; i < len(fields); i++ {
251			entry := fields[i]
252			if len(entry) < 4 {
253				continue
254			}
255			code := entry[:2]
256			paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:]))
257			if code[0] == 'R' || code[0] == 'C' {
258				i++
259			}
260		}
261		return paths, nil
262	}
263	
264	func IsAgentArtifact(path string) bool {
265		path = filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(path, "./"))
266		for _, prefix := range []string{
267			".specstory/history/", ".claude/plans/", ".cursor/plans/", ".cursor/rules/",
268			".opencode/plans/", ".specify/", ".codex/",
269		} {
270			if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
271				return true
272			}
273		}
274		return path == ".specstory/statistics.json"
275	}
276	
277	func AgentArtifactPathspecs() []string {
278		return []string{
279			".specstory/history/**", ".specstory/statistics.json", ".claude/plans/**",
280			".cursor/plans/**", ".cursor/rules/**", ".opencode/plans/**", ".specify/**", ".codex/**",
281		}
282	}
283	
284	func transactionPreflight(ctx context.Context, dir string, rewritePublished bool) (Repo, Status, error) {
285		repository, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
286		if err != nil {
287			return Repo{}, Status{}, err
288		}
289		if repository.Bare {
290			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("transaction requires a working tree")
291		}
292		status, err := StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
293		if err != nil {
294			return Repo{}, Status{}, err
295		}
296		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
297			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("transaction refuses detached HEAD")
298		}
299		if status.Conflicted > 0 {
300			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("transaction refuses %d conflicted path(s)", status.Conflicted)
```

207	// AddWorktree creates a linked worktree at path.
208	//
209	// When branch already exists it is checked out; otherwise it is created from
210	// base. Passing an explicit base matters: without one git branches from the
211	// *current* HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on feature/A would
212	// silently inherit feature/A's commits.
213	func AddWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path, branch, base string) error {
214		exists := BranchExists(ctx, dir, branch)
215		args := []string{"worktree", "add"}
216		if exists {
217			args = append(args, path, branch)
218		} else {
219			args = append(args, "-b", branch, path)
220			if base != "" {
221				args = append(args, base)
222			}
223		}
224		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
225		return err
226	}

228	// MoveWorktree relocates a linked worktree through Git so the shared
229	// administrative metadata keeps pointing at the checkout's new path. dir may
230	// be any checkout of the same repository.
231	func MoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, source, destination string) error {
232		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "move", source, destination)
233		return err
234	}

236	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
237	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
238	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
239		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
240		if err != nil {
241			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current directory before removing worktree: %w", err)
242		}
243		inside, err := pathx.Contains(path, cwd)
244		if err != nil {
245			return fmt.Errorf("compare current directory with worktree %s: %w", path, err)
246		}
247		if inside {
248			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to remove worktree %s while the caller is inside it", path)
249		}
250		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
251		if force {
252			args = append(args, "--force")
253		}
254		args = append(args, path)
255		_, err = run(ctx, dir, args...)
256		return err
257	}

260	// were deleted behind git's back.

262		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "prune")
263		return err

266	// BranchExists reports whether a local branch of that name exists.
267	func BranchExists(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) bool {
268		if branch == "" {
269			return false
270		}
271		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+branch)

275	// RefState reports whether any ref or commit-ish resolves while preserving
276	// observation failures. A normal rev-parse exit 1 with no diagnostic is an
277	// authoritative missing ref; every other failure remains an error.
278	func RefState(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) (bool, error) {
279		if ref == "" {
280			return false, nil
281		}
282		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")
283		if err == nil {
284			return true, nil
285		}
286		var commandErr *Error
287		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
288		if errors.As(err, &commandErr) && errors.As(commandErr.Err, &exitErr) &&
289			exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 && strings.TrimSpace(commandErr.Stderr) == "" {
290			return false, nil
291		}
292		return false, err
293	}
294	
295	// RefExists is the compatibility predicate for callers where probe failure is
296	// intentionally equivalent to absence. Guarded lifecycle code uses RefState.
297	func RefExists(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) bool {
298		exists, _ := RefState(ctx, dir, ref)
299		return exists
300	}

276	// observation failures. A normal rev-parse exit 1 with no diagnostic is an

278	func RefState(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) (bool, error) {
279		if ref == "" {
280			return false, nil
281		}
282		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")
283		if err == nil {
284			return true, nil

287		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
288		if errors.As(err, &commandErr) && errors.As(commandErr.Err, &exitErr) &&

67	
68	For branch/worktree tasks, `dev done --pr` is intentionally not a HOT/WARM → DONE transition. It hands off a pushed branch (opening review when supported) and leaves state and cleanup unchanged. `dev flow` can manually query portable review existence/state/draft/URL evidence, but never infers DONE; integration still needs an explicit local ancestry proof.
69	
70	`dev flow [repo]` makes the underlying hybrid model visible: persisted intent,
71	typed live observations, and a revision-bound guarded plan are distinct. Errors,
72	unknowns, and stale facts do not become false; Apply revalidates exact task/Git/
73	worktree/runtime/artifact identity before mutation. See [Repository lifecycle
74	flow](../guides/repository-flow.md).
75	
76	## Checkout modes
77	
78	A task records intent; it does not always require a linked worktree.
79	
80	| Mode | Use | Lifecycle limit |
81	|---|---|---|
82	| direct | one small change in the canonical checkout | HOT ↔ WARM; canonical checkout cannot be removed |
83	| branch-only | isolated history without a second directory | can go COLD after push and switching the canonical checkout away |
84	| worktree | independent mutation, parallel streams, durable feature work | full lifecycle |
85	
86	The mode is selected by collision and recovery needs, not by ceremony.
87	
88	## Runtime is deliberately lossy
89	
90	`runtime.Runtime` exposes `Open`, `Close`, `List`, and `Annotate`. `auto` selects Herdr when available, then tmux, then Zellij, then the always-available `none` backend. Closing any backend must not remove the checkout, branch, or task entry.
91	
92	This separation is why rebooting, closing a multiplexer, or changing runtime backend does not abandon work. `dev sweep` can compare the registry with live Git/runtime facts and report drift.
93	
94	## Cross-machine handoff
95	
96	The branch is the transport boundary:
97

72	對 branch/worktree task 而言，`dev done --pr` 刻意不是 HOT/WARM → DONE transition。它會 handoff 已 push 的 branch（支援時建立 review），並保留原 state 與 cleanup 狀態。外部 merge 不會被自動推斷；請以 `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref>` 或 `dev flow` 的 Verify Merged action 明確證明 named ancestry，再以獨立 Retire plan cleanup。
73	
74	## Intent、evidence 與 action readiness
75	
76	Lifecycle state 只保存人類意圖，不會吸收所有外部事實。`dev flow [repo]` 把三層並列：recorded `HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE` intent、具 freshness 的 Git/runtime/agent/artifact/remote evidence，以及綁定 exact identity 的 guarded plan。`READY` 是某份 plan 的 action readiness；`REVIEW`、`MERGED` 與 `RETIRED` 是 result milestones，皆不是額外 TOML state。UNKNOWN/ERROR evidence 不會被當成 clean、closed 或 absent。完整操作方式見 [Repository Flow 預覽](../guides/repository-flow.zh-TW.md)。

79	
80	Task 記錄的是意圖，不一定要有 linked worktree。

86	| worktree | 獨立寫入、平行 stream、長期 feature | 完整 lifecycle |
87	
88	選擇 mode 的依據是碰撞與復原需求，不是儀式感。

92	`runtime.Runtime` 提供 `Open`、`Close`、`List` 與 `Annotate`。`auto` 會依序選 Herdr、tmux、Zellij，最後使用永遠可用的 `none` backend。關閉任何 backend 都不能移除 checkout、branch 或 task entry。
93	
94	`none` 只表示沒有可觀察的 multiplexer backend，不等於已證明「沒有 session 或 agent」。需要 occupancy/absence proof 的 guarded action 必須保留 unobserved evidence；`dev flow` 不會把它顯示成已關閉，也不提供 `--assume-no-runtime` expert override。
95	
96	因此 reboot、關閉 multiplexer 或更換 runtime backend 都不代表放棄工作。`dev sweep` 能比較 registry 與即時 Git/runtime facts 並回報 drift。

18		Hot State = "hot"
19		// Warm: worktree and branch kept, runtime closed. Back within days.

21		// Cold: committed and pushed, worktree removed. Reconstructible anywhere.

23		// Done: merged. Kept only until the entry is reaped.

32		got := State(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s)))

34			if got == valid {
35				return got, nil
36			}
37		}
38		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown state %q: want one of %s", s, JoinStates(", "))
39	}

132	// semantics and must be explicit.
133	func (t Task) EffectiveMode() CheckoutMode {
134		if t.Mode != "" {
135			return t.Mode
136		}
137		if t.WorktreePath != "" {
138			return ModeWorktree
139		}
140		return ModeBranch
141	}
142	
143	// Title is the display name, falling back to the branch when unnamed.
144	func (t Task) Title() string {
145		if t.Name != "" {
146			return t.Name
147		}
148		return t.Branch
149	}
150	
151	// OwnedBy reports whether host is this task's owner. An empty owner means
152	// unclaimed, which counts as owned by anyone.
153	func (t Task) OwnedBy(host string) bool { return t.Owner == "" || t.Owner == host }
154	
155	// Validate rejects a task that could not be acted on later.
156	func (t Task) Validate() error {
157		switch {
158		case t.Repo == "":
159			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo is required", t.ID)
160		case t.Branch == "":
161			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: branch is required", t.ID)
162		case t.RepoPath == "":
163			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo_path is required", t.ID)
164		}
165		if _, err := ParseState(string(t.State)); err != nil {
166			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
167		}
168		switch t.Mode {
169		case "", ModeWorktree, ModeBranch, ModeDirect:
170		default:
171			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: unknown mode %q", t.ID, t.Mode)
172		}
173		return nil
174	}

244				} else {
245					pathClaim = path == observed.checkout
246				}
247			}
248	
249			branchClaim := false
250			if candidate.Branch == observed.locator.Branch {
251				repoMatches, complete, detail := s.taskRepositoryMatches(ctx, candidate, *observed)
252				if !complete {
253					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
254						fmt.Sprintf("task %s repository identity is unavailable: %s", candidate.ID, detail))
255				} else {
256					branchClaim = repoMatches
257				}
258			}
259	
260			if pathClaim {
261				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
262					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "exact checkout path",
263				})
264			}

273					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: reason,
274				})
275			}

116	+It is independent of the six-view `dev tui` dashboard. From a canonical or linked
117	+checkout, `dev flow` resolves the canonical repository and focuses that exact
118	+surface; outside Git it opens a filterable repository picker. An explicit
119	+`dev flow api` overrides cwd.
120	+
121	+The left panel is the union of Git's registered worktrees and task records that
122	+have no checkout, including normal COLD and DONE tasks. Rows are labelled
123	+`canonical`, `managed`, `unmanaged`, `harness`, `task-only`, or `conflict`.
124	+Canonical worktrees are never removable; harness-owned and ambiguous/conflicting
125	+rows have no destructive path. An exact unmanaged linked checkout can be
126	+**Adopted** by creating task metadata without changing Git bytes, or **Removed**
127	+only when clean and safe; removal is non-force and always preserves the branch.
128	+
129	+The center distinguishes persisted task intent (`HOT`, `WARM`, `COLD`, `DONE`)
130	+from observed Git/worktree/runtime/artifact facts. Unknown, failed, loading, or
131	+stale evidence never becomes a false clean/closed fact. `runtime=none` leaves
132	+session occupancy unobserved, but the local Git/task snapshot can still be fresh;
133	+metadata-only adoption then remains WARM.
134	+
135	+The right panel offers concrete mode/state actions: warm/cold park, resume,
136	+direct or fast-forward completion, review handoff, verified-merge completion,
137	+and DONE retirement where legal. The preview deliberately excludes dirty
138	+commit/discard, WIP checkpoint, shared-writer, ownership-takeover, and unknown-
139	+runtime overrides. A blocked plan shows its exact evidence, remediation, and CLI
140	+fallback; existing command flags remain available outside the preview.
141	+
142	+```text
143	+j/k or ↑/↓       choose a surface      h/l or ←/→     choose an action
144	+Tab/Shift-Tab    move panel focus       Enter          build a plan, never apply
145	+r                reload local facts    R              Fetch refs / Query review / Both
146	+Esc              back out              ?              evidence and key help
147	+```
148	+
149	+A READY plan shows ordered conditions/effects, retained resources, network and
150	+destructive markers, and its exact PlanID. Press `y` only for a non-typed plan;
151	+typed branch deletion requires the displayed token and `Enter`. Apply locks and
152	+reloads the task revision plus repository, checkout, refs, runtime, artifact, and
153	+remote identities. Any change rejects the stale plan before a new effect. Once an
154	+effect starts, quit/refresh waits for the retained step ledger; partial success
155	+means completed effects remain completed and recovery is explicit.
156	+
157	+Startup and `r` never fetch or query a forge. `R` runs only the confirmed choice
158	+and keeps its evidence in this TUI run: named ref OIDs plus portable review
159	+existence, open/draft/merged/closed state, URL, provider, and observation time.
160	+It does not query review decisions or checks. Completion records DONE while
161	+keeping branch, checkout, and runtime resources; Retire cleans them from outside
162	+the target. Raw Git and configured external tools remain outside these
163	+`dev`-mediated locks and safety checks.
164	+

45		}

47			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(EffectOpenRuntime,

91	func resumeOwnerCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, options ResumeOptions) Condition {
92		if observed.task.OwnedBy(observed.taskflowHost) {
93			owner := observed.task.Owner
94			if owner == "" {
95				owner = "unclaimed"
96			}
97			return condition(ConditionOwner, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "task owner is "+owner, "")

101				"ownership transfer from "+observed.task.Owner+" was explicitly requested", "")
102		}
103		return condition(ConditionOwner, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
104			"task is owned by "+observed.task.Owner, "confirm the other machine pushed its work, then take ownership explicitly")
105	}

371	func resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
372		return observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && observed.hasCheckout() && observed.statusErr == nil &&
373			!observed.status.Detached && observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch
374	}
375	
376	func shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
377		return observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.savedRuntimeLive
378	}

380	func resumeEffectCheckout(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
381		if observed.hasCheckout() {
382			return observed.checkout
383		}
384		return observed.desiredWorktree
385	}
386	
387	func resumeRuntimeLabel(candidate task.Task) string {
388		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
389			return candidate.Repo + "/" + candidate.Branch
390		}
391		return candidate.Title()
392	}

394	func resumeFallback(id string, options ResumeOptions) string {
395		parts := []string{"dev", "resume", shellQuote(id)}
396		if !options.FetchRefs {
397			parts = append(parts, "--fetch=false")
398		}
399		if options.NoProvision {
400			parts = append(parts, "--no-provision")
401		}
402		if options.TakeOwnership {
403			parts = append(parts, "--force")
404		}
405		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
406	}

401	// parseAzureDevOpsRemote returns the provider identity and browser-safe HTTPS
402	// repository URL for supported Azure DevOps Services clone URL forms.
403	func parseAzureDevOpsRemote(raw string) (identity, webURL string, ok bool) {
404		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
405		if raw == "" {
406			return "", "", false
407		}
408		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
409			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
410			if err != nil || u.Fragment != "" || u.RawQuery != "" {
411				return "", "", false
412			}
413			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
414			case "https":
415				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
416					return "", "", false
417				}
418				return parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u)
419			case "ssh":
420				if u.User == nil || (u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22") {
421					return "", "", false
422				}
423				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
424					return "", "", false
425				}
426				return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(u.User.Username(), strings.ToLower(u.Hostname()), escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath()))
427			default:
428				return "", "", false
429			}
430		}
431		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
432		if at <= 0 {
433			return "", "", false
434		}
435		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
436		if colon < 0 {
437			return "", "", false
438		}
439		colon += at + 1
440		return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(raw[:at], strings.ToLower(raw[at+1:colon]), decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(raw[colon+1:], "/"), "/")))
441	}
442	
443	func parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u *url.URL) (string, string, bool) {
444		if u.User != nil {
445			if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
446				return "", "", false
447			}
448		}
449		host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
450		segments := escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath())
451		var organization, project, repo string
452		switch {
453		case host == "dev.azure.com":
454			if len(segments) != 4 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[2], "_git") {
455				return "", "", false
456			}
457			organization, project, repo = segments[0], segments[1], segments[3]
458			if u.User != nil && !strings.EqualFold(u.User.Username(), organization) {
459				return "", "", false
460			}
461		case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com") && host != "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com":
462			if len(segments) < 3 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[len(segments)-2], "_git") || u.User != nil {
463				return "", "", false
464			}
465			organization = strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")
466			project, repo = segments[len(segments)-3], segments[len(segments)-1]
467		default:
468			return "", "", false
469		}
470		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
471		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
472			return "", "", false
473		}
474		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
475		webURL := azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo)
476		return identity, webURL, true
477	}
478	
479	func parseAzureDevOpsSSH(user, host string, segments []string) (string, string, bool) {
480		var organization, project, repo string
481		switch {
482		case host == "ssh.dev.azure.com" && strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && len(segments) == 4 && strings.EqualFold(segments[0], "v3"):
483			organization, project, repo = segments[1], segments[2], segments[3]
484			host = "dev.azure.com"
485		case host == "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com" && len(segments) == 3 && strings.EqualFold(segments[1], "_ssh"):
486			organization, project, repo = user, segments[0], segments[2]
487			host = strings.ToLower(organization) + ".visualstudio.com"
488		default:
489			return "", "", false

67	
68	For branch/worktree tasks, `dev done --pr` is intentionally not a HOT/WARM → DONE transition. It hands off a pushed branch (opening review when supported) and leaves state and cleanup unchanged. `dev flow` can manually query portable review existence/state/draft/URL evidence, but never infers DONE; integration still needs an explicit local ancestry proof.
69	
70	`dev flow [repo]` makes the underlying hybrid model visible: persisted intent,
71	typed live observations, and a revision-bound guarded plan are distinct. Errors,
72	unknowns, and stale facts do not become false; Apply revalidates exact task/Git/
73	worktree/runtime/artifact identity before mutation. See [Repository lifecycle
74	flow](../guides/repository-flow.md).
75	
76	## Checkout modes
77	
78	A task records intent; it does not always require a linked worktree.
79	
80	| Mode | Use | Lifecycle limit |
81	|---|---|---|
82	| direct | one small change in the canonical checkout | HOT ↔ WARM; canonical checkout cannot be removed |
83	| branch-only | isolated history without a second directory | can go COLD after push and switching the canonical checkout away |
84	| worktree | independent mutation, parallel streams, durable feature work | full lifecycle |
85	
86	The mode is selected by collision and recovery needs, not by ceremony.
87	
88	## Runtime is deliberately lossy
89	
90	`runtime.Runtime` exposes `Open`, `Close`, `List`, and `Annotate`. `auto` selects Herdr when available, then tmux, then Zellij, then the always-available `none` backend. Closing any backend must not remove the checkout, branch, or task entry.
91	
92	This separation is why rebooting, closing a multiplexer, or changing runtime backend does not abandon work. `dev sweep` can compare the registry with live Git/runtime facts and report drift.
93	
94	## Cross-machine handoff
95	
96	The branch is the transport boundary:
97	
98	```bash
99	# machine A
100	dev park --cold --push
101	
102	# machine B
103	dev resume <task> --fetch
104	```
105	
106	One writer owns a branch at a time. If two machines or agents need to mutate the same feature concurrently, split the change stream and integrate afterwards.
107

73	
74	## Intent、evidence 與 action readiness
75	
76	Lifecycle state 只保存人類意圖，不會吸收所有外部事實。`dev flow [repo]` 把三層並列：recorded `HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE` intent、具 freshness 的 Git/runtime/agent/artifact/remote evidence，以及綁定 exact identity 的 guarded plan。`READY` 是某份 plan 的 action readiness；`REVIEW`、`MERGED` 與 `RETIRED` 是 result milestones，皆不是額外 TOML state。UNKNOWN/ERROR evidence 不會被當成 clean、closed 或 absent。完整操作方式見 [Repository Flow 預覽](../guides/repository-flow.zh-TW.md)。
77	
78	## Checkout mode
79	
80	Task 記錄的是意圖，不一定要有 linked worktree。
81	
82	| Mode | 適用情境 | Lifecycle 限制 |
83	|---|---|---|
84	| direct | canonical checkout 中的一個小變更 | HOT ↔ WARM；canonical checkout 不能移除 |
85	| branch-only | 只需要 history isolation，不需要第二個 directory | push 且 canonical checkout 切離後可進 COLD |
86	| worktree | 獨立寫入、平行 stream、長期 feature | 完整 lifecycle |
87	
88	選擇 mode 的依據是碰撞與復原需求，不是儀式感。
89	
90	## Runtime 刻意是可丟失的
91	
92	`runtime.Runtime` 提供 `Open`、`Close`、`List` 與 `Annotate`。`auto` 會依序選 Herdr、tmux、Zellij，最後使用永遠可用的 `none` backend。關閉任何 backend 都不能移除 checkout、branch 或 task entry。
93	
94	`none` 只表示沒有可觀察的 multiplexer backend，不等於已證明「沒有 session 或 agent」。需要 occupancy/absence proof 的 guarded action 必須保留 unobserved evidence；`dev flow` 不會把它顯示成已關閉，也不提供 `--assume-no-runtime` expert override。
95	
96	因此 reboot、關閉 multiplexer 或更換 runtime backend 都不代表放棄工作。`dev sweep` 能比較 registry 與即時 Git/runtime facts 並回報 drift。
97	
98	## 跨機器 handoff
99	
100	Branch 是傳輸邊界：
101	
102	```bash
103	# machine A
104	dev park --cold --push
105	
106	# machine B
107	dev resume <task> --fetch
108	```

107	// Collect builds the enriched inventory. Git probes run concurrently: each is
108	// a handful of process spawns, and a machine with dozens of tasks would
109	// otherwise make `dev ls` feel slow.
110	func Collect(ctx context.Context, tasks []*task.Task, rt runtime.Runtime, opts Options) []Row {
111		rows := make([]Row, len(tasks))
112	
113		sessions := opts.Sessions
114		tracked := opts.SessionsTracked
115		if !opts.SessionsSet && !opts.SkipRuntime && rt != nil && rt.Name() != "none" {
116			if s, err := rt.List(ctx); err == nil {
117				sessions, tracked = s, true
118			}
119		}
120	
121		var wg sync.WaitGroup
122		// Bound concurrency: git is process-heavy and an unbounded fan-out over a
123		// large inventory would thrash. Coordinated TUI loads share this limiter with
124		// repository enrichment.
125		limiter := opts.Limiter
126		if limiter == nil {
127			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
128		}
129	
130		for i, t := range tasks {
131			rows[i].Task = t
132			rows[i].Checkout = checkoutOf(t)
133	
134			if opts.SkipGit || rows[i].Checkout == "" {
135				continue
136			}
137			wg.Add(1)
138			go func(i int) {
139				defer wg.Done()
140				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
141				if !ok {
142					return
143				}
144				defer release()
145				enrich(ctx, &rows[i])
146			}(i)
147		}
148		wg.Wait()
149	
150		for i := range rows {
151			rows[i].Session = matchSession(sessions, rows[i])
152			rows[i].sessionsTracked = tracked
153		}
154		return rows
155	}
156	
157	func checkoutOf(t *task.Task) string {
158		if t.WorktreePath != "" {
159			return t.WorktreePath
160		}
161		return t.RepoPath
162	}
163	
164	func enrich(ctx context.Context, r *Row) {
165		info, err := os.Stat(r.Checkout)
166		r.CheckoutExists = err == nil && info.IsDir()
167		if !r.CheckoutExists {
168			if r.Task.WorktreePath != "" {
169				r.WorktreeMissing = true
170			}
171			return
172		}
173		if st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Checkout); err != nil {
174			r.StatusErr = err
175		} else {
176			r.Status = st
177		}
178		if unix, _, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, r.Checkout); err == nil && unix > 0 {
179			r.LastCommit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
180		}
181		// A recorded worktree that git no longer knows about is drift worth
182		// surfacing: the directory may exist while the administrative entry is gone.
183		if r.Task.WorktreePath != "" {
184			if _, ok, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, r.Task.RepoPath, r.Task.Branch); err == nil && !ok {
185				r.WorktreeMissing = true
186			}
187		}
188	}

190	// matchSession picks the runtime session hosting a row's checkout. An exact
191	// directory match is preferred over a containing one, so a worktree's own
192	// session always wins over the parent repo's.
193	func matchSession(sessions []runtime.Session, r Row) *runtime.Session {
194		if r.Checkout == "" {
195			return nil
196		}
197		var contains *runtime.Session
198		for i := range sessions {
199			for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
200				if d == r.Checkout {
201					return &sessions[i]
202				}
203				if strings.HasPrefix(d, r.Checkout+"/") && contains == nil {
204					contains = &sessions[i]
205				}
206			}
207		}
208		return contains
209	}

31			return fmt.Errorf("check live occupancy before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
32		}
33		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
34			return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
35		}
36		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("classify live runtime coverage before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionCoverageErr)
38		}
39		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("list live runtime sessions before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionList.Err)
41		}
42		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
44		}
45	
46		var occupied []string
47		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
48			if !agent.Blocking {
49				continue
50			}
51			activity := agent.Activity
52			label := activity.Agent
53			if activity.Name != "" {
54				label = activity.Name
55			}
56			if label == "" {
57				label = "agent"
58			}
59			occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, activity.PaneID))
60		}
61		if len(occupied) == 0 {
62			return nil
63		}
64		return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
65			config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
66	}
67	
68	// checkoutAgentActivities returns recognized agents whose reported cwd resolves
69	// to the same canonical Git worktree root as checkout. A pane is excluded only
70	// when its exact ID matches excludePane; lifecycle state never makes it free.
71	func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {
72		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{Profile: runtime.OccupancyStrict})
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
77			return nil, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err
78		}
79		out := make([]runtime.AgentActivity, 0, len(evidence.Agents))
80		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
81			if excludePane == "" || agent.Activity.PaneID != excludePane {
82				out = append(out, agent.Activity)
83			}
84		}
85		return out, nil
86	}

269	// unmergedBranches lists local branches carrying commits the default branch
270	// does not — unfinished work that would otherwise be invisible to dev.
271	func unmergedBranches(ctx context.Context, repoPath string) []string {
272		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repoPath)
273		if base == "" {
274			return nil
275		}
276		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname:short)", "refs/heads/")
277		if err != nil {
278			return nil
279		}
280		var branches []string
281		for _, b := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
282			b = strings.TrimSpace(b)
283			if b == "" || b == base || inventory.IsEphemeralWorktree("", b) {
284				continue
285			}
286			// Contained in the base means the work has already landed.
287			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", b, base); err == nil {
288				continue
289			}
290			branches = append(branches, b)
291		}
292		return branches
293	}

1	// Package lockx provides a cross-platform advisory lock over a directory.
2	//
3	// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction
4	// code need to serialize mutations, and neither should have to depend on the
5	// other to get a lock.
6	package lockx
7	
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"errors"
11		"fmt"
12		"os"
13		"path/filepath"
14	)
15	
16	// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir. The lock file
17	// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
18	// directory being protected. label names the caller in wrapped errors.
19	func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
20		if operation == nil {
21			return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
22		}
23		if ctx == nil {
24			ctx = context.Background()
25		}
26		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
27			return fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
28		}
29		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
32		}
33		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
34		if err != nil {
35			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
36		}
37		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
38		lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
41		}
42		defer func() {
43			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
44				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", label, releaseErr))
45			}
46		}()
47		return operation()
48	}
49

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15	)
16	
17	var (
18		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
19		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
20		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
21		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
22		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
23		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
24		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
25		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
26	)
27	
28	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
29	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
30	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
31	// before creating or moving anything into it.
32	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
33		if path == "" {
34			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
35		}
36		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
39		}
40		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
41	
42		probe := absolute
43		var missing []string
44		for {
45			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
46			if err == nil {
47				slices.Reverse(missing)
48				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
49				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
50			}
51			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
52				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
53			}
54			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
55			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
56			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
57			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
58			// still-missing suffix.
59			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
60				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
61				if readErr != nil {
62					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
63				}
64				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
65					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
66				}
67				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
68					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
69				}
70				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
71				if resolveErr != nil {
72					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
73				}
74				slices.Reverse(missing)
75				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
76				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
77			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
78				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
79			}
80			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
81			if parent == probe {
82				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
83			}
84			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
85			probe = parent
86		}
87	}
88	
89	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
90	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
91	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
92	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
93		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
94			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
95		}
96		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
99		}
100		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
101		if err != nil {
102			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
103		}
104	
105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
106		if err != nil {
107			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
108			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
109			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
110			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
111		}
112		switch {
113		case rel == ".":
114			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
115		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
116			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
117		default:
118			return canonicalCandidate, nil
119		}
120	}
121	
122	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
123	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
124	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
125		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
126		if err == nil {
127			return true, nil
128		}
129		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
130			return false, nil
131		}
132		return false, err
133	}
134	
135	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
136	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
137		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
138		if err != nil {
139			return false, err
140		}
141		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
142		if err != nil {
143			return false, err
144		}
145		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
146			return true, nil
147		}
148		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
149	}
150	
151	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
152	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
153	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
154	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
155		switch {
156		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
157			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
158		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
159			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
160		case component == "." || component == "..":
161			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
162		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
163			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
164		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
165			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
166		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
167			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
168		default:
169			return nil
170		}
171	}
172	
173	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
174	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
175	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
176	// single component.
177	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
178		if len(components) == 0 {
179			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
180		}
```

```text
1	# Adopting an existing setup
2	
3	What to do on a machine that already has repositories, worktrees and sessions.
4	
5	## There is nothing to migrate
6	
7	`dev` does not own a directory layout. It discovers repositories below
8	`paths.scan_roots` and at exact `paths.repo_paths`, and **never moves, renames or deletes anything** you
9	already have. Whatever your projects tree looks like — `~/Documents/Program`,
10	`~/src`, `~/code`, a ghq root, several of them — it keeps working as is.
11	
12	```bash
13	dev config init     # detects this machine's roots and writes a config
14	dev repo list       # confirm it found what you expected
15	```
16	
17	`config init` probes the conventional locations, counts the repositories in
18	each, and writes only the ones that exist. If it guessed wrong, the generated
19	file is ordinary TOML — edit `scan_roots`, or add an exact checkout such as
20	`~/.local/share/chezmoi` to `repo_paths`.
21	
22	## Importing work already in flight
23	
24	Repositories are discovered; *tasks* are not. `dev adopt` finds the work that
25	is already happening and offers to record it:
26	
27	```bash
28	dev adopt                   # report only
29	dev adopt --apply           # record, confirming each one
30	```
31	
32	It looks for three things:
33	
34	- **linked worktrees** git already knows about, from any tool;
35	- **live runtime sessions** sitting in a repository;
36	- **local branches ahead of the default branch** — unfinished work that is
37	  otherwise invisible.
38	
39	It skips branches already contained in the base (that work has landed) and the
40	turn-scoped worktrees an agent harness creates and cleans up itself.
41	
42	Nothing on disk changes either way. Adopting only writes task entries.
43	
44	For one exact linked checkout, `dev flow [repo]` offers the same metadata-only
45	boundary without applying the command-wide candidate report. Select an
46	`unmanaged` row, choose **Adopt**, inspect the plan, then approve it. The plan
47	revalidates Git/worktree/task/base/runtime/agent identity and refuses canonical,
48	harness-owned, already-claimed, locked/prunable, detached, or ambiguous rows.
49	A dirty checkout may be adopted because no bytes change. With runtime `none`,
50	occupancy is unobserved and the new task remains WARM rather than being called
51	falsely HOT.
52	
53	Afterwards, give the ones you care about a next action — that is what makes
54	parking them cheap later:
55	
56	```bash
57	dev park <task> --next "…"
58	```
59	
60	## Worktrees you already have elsewhere
61	
62	A worktree created by hand, or by another tool, in a location that is not
63	`paths.worktree_path` keeps working exactly as it did. `dev` records the path
64	git reports; it does not relocate it.
65	
66	New worktrees go to the configured template. If you want the old ones there
67	too, move them the way git expects:
68	
69	```bash
70	git worktree move <old-path> ~/Worktrees/<repo>/<branch-slug>
71	```
72	
73	There is no need to. Consistency is nice; disruption is not.
74	
75	## A different projects root
76	
77	```toml
78	[paths]
79	scan_roots    = ["/mnt/work/repos", "~/code"]
80	project_root  = "/mnt/work/repos"
81	worktree_root = "/mnt/work/worktrees"
82	worktree_path = "{{worktree_root}}/{{repo|lower}}/{{branch|slug}}"
83	```
84	
85	`project_root` is only used by `dev repo new|clone` and `dev graduate` to
86	decide where a *new* project goes. Existing ones are found through
87	`scan_roots` regardless.
88	
89	## Trying it without committing to anything
90	
91	Every path is overridable per invocation, so you can point a throwaway config
92	at a sandbox and see what happens:
93	
94	```bash
95	dev --config /tmp/try-dev.toml config init
96	dev --config /tmp/try-dev.toml ls
97	```
98	
99	And `dev --no-runtime` keeps it from touching your multiplexer at all.
100
```
</details></tool-use>
