87	func (i ReadinessInspection) Ready() bool {
88		if i.ObservationError != nil {
89			return false
90		}
91		if len(i.Intents) == 0 {
92			return i.KnownEmpty
93		}
94		if i.KnownEmpty {
95			return false
96		}
97		for _, intent := range i.Intents {
98			if intent.ObservationError != nil {
99				return false
100			}
101			switch intent.State {
102			case ReadinessDiscarded:
103				// Discard is the existing explicit operator escape hatch.
104			case ReadinessFinalizedReachable:
105				if !intent.Finalized || !intent.ReceiptReachable {
106					return false
107				}
108			default:
109				return false
110			}
111		}
112		return true
113	}

120	func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
121		inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
122		if ctx == nil {
123			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")

125			return inspection, err
126		}
127		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
128			inspection.ObservationError = err
129			return inspection, err
130		}
131		if store == nil {

133			inspection.ObservationError = err
134			return inspection, err
135		}
136	
137		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
138		if err != nil {
139			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
140			inspection.ObservationError = err
141			return inspection, err
142		}
143		inspection.Checkout = canonical
144	
145		intents, err := store.List()
146		if err != nil {
147			err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
148			inspection.ObservationError = err
149			return inspection, err
150		}
151		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
152			inspection.ObservationError = err
153			return inspection, err
154		}
155	
156		matched := make([]Intent, 0, len(intents))
157		unmatched := make([]Intent, 0, len(intents))
158		for _, intent := range intents {
159			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
160				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
161				break
162			}
163			intentCheckout, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)

165				canonicalErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, canonicalErr)

167				continue
168			}
169			if intentCheckout == canonical {
170				matched = append(matched, intent)
171			} else {
172				unmatched = append(unmatched, intent)
173			}
174		}
175	
176		if len(unmatched) > 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil {
177			identity, available, identityErr := inspectReadinessCheckoutIdentity(ctx, canonical)
178			if identityErr != nil {

180			} else if available {

182					intentCommon, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(intent.GitCommonDir)
183					if commonErr != nil {
184						inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError,

201		}
202

204		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError

212	func inspectReadinessCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout string) (readinessCheckoutIdentity, bool, error) {
213		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, checkout)
214		if errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
215			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, nil
216		}
217		if err != nil {
218			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, fmt.Errorf("discover artifact readiness checkout identity: %w", err)
219		}
220		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
221		if err != nil {
222			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness Git common directory: %w", err)
223		}
224		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
225		if err != nil {
226			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, fmt.Errorf("observe artifact readiness checkout branch: %w", err)
227		}
228		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
229			return readinessCheckoutIdentity{}, false, errors.New("artifact readiness checkout is detached; moved intent identity is ambiguous")
230		}
231		return readinessCheckoutIdentity{commonDir: commonDir, branch: status.Branch}, true, nil
232	}
233	
234	func inspectIntentReadiness(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (IntentReadiness, error) {
235		evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
236		var err error
237		switch intent.Status {
238		case Armed, Finalizing:
239			evidence.State = ReadinessPending
240		case Failed:
241			evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
242		case Discarded:
243			evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
244		case Finalized:
245			evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, checkout, intent)
246			switch {
247			case err != nil:
248				err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
249				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
250				evidence.ObservationError = err
251			case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
252				evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
253			default:
254				evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
255			}
256		default:
257			// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
258			// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
259			err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
260			evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
261			evidence.ObservationError = err
262		}
263		return evidence, err
264	}
265	
266	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
267		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
268			return false, nil
269		}
270		candidates := []struct {
271			dir string
272			ref string
273		}{
274			{checkout, "HEAD"},
275			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
276			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
277		}
278		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
279		var observationErr error
280		for _, candidate := range candidates {
281			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
282				continue
283			}
284			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
285			if seen[key] {
286				continue
287			}
288			seen[key] = true
289			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
290				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
291			}
292			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
293				return true, nil
294			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
295				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
296					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
297			}
298		}
299		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
300			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
301		}
302		return false, observationErr
303	}
304	
305	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
306		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
307		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
308	}
309	
310	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
311		if current == nil {
312			return next
313		}
314		if next == nil {
315			return current
316		}
317		return errors.Join(current, next)
318	}

320	func (s *Service) Prepare(ctx context.Context, request PrepareRequest) (*Intent, error) {
321		if s.Store == nil {
322			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
323		}
324		provider, sessionID, err := ParseSession(request.Session)
325		if err != nil {
326			return nil, err
327		}
328		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, request.Worktree)
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
333		if err != nil {
334			return nil, err
335		}
336		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
337			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires a named branch")
338		}
339		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
340			return nil, err
341		} else if active {
342			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation refuses Git operation %s in progress", operation)
343		}
344		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
345		if err != nil {
346			return nil, err
347		}
348		changes, err := statusPaths(ctx, repository.Root)
349		if err != nil {
350			return nil, err
351		}
352		var unrelated []string
353		for _, change := range changes {
354			if change.Staged {
355				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires an empty index; staged path: %s", change.Path)
356			}
357			if !isRecognizedArtifact(change.Path) {
358				return nil, fmt.Errorf("commit product changes before prepare; dirty path: %s", change.Path)
359			}
360			unrelated = append(unrelated, change.Path)
361		}
362		transcript, err := FindTranscript(repository.Root, provider, sessionID)
363		if err != nil {
364			return nil, err
365		}
366		tracked, err := gitTracked(ctx, repository.Root, transcript.Path)
367		if err != nil {
368			return nil, err
369		}
370		info, err := os.Stat(transcript.Path)
371		if err != nil {
372			return nil, err
373		}
374		limit := s.LargeLimit
375		if limit <= 0 {
376			limit = DefaultLargeLimit
377		}
378		if !tracked && info.Size() > limit && !request.AllowLarge {
379			return nil, fmt.Errorf("untracked transcript is %d bytes; re-run with --allow-large after reviewing repository growth", info.Size())
380		}
381		plans, err := normalizePlans(repository.Root, request.Plans)
382		if err != nil {
383			return nil, err
384		}
385		runID := request.RunID
386		if runID == "" {
387			runID = os.Getenv("DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID")
388		}
389		if runID == "" {
390			runID = fmt.Sprintf("run-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
391		}
392		selected := make(map[string]bool, len(plans)+1)
393		relTranscript, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, transcript.Path)
394		selected[filepath.ToSlash(relTranscript)] = true
395		for _, plan := range plans {
396			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, plan)
397			selected[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
398		}
399		filtered := unrelated[:0]
400		for _, path := range unrelated {
401			if !selected[path] {
402				filtered = append(filtered, path)
403			}
404		}
405		intent := &Intent{
406			RunID: runID, Provider: provider, SessionID: sessionID, TaskID: request.TaskID,
407			RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, GitCommonDir: repository.GitCommonDir,
408			WorktreePath: repository.Root, Branch: status.Branch, Base: request.Base,
409			Head: strings.TrimSpace(head), PlanPaths: plans, UnrelatedArtifacts: filtered, AllowLarge: request.AllowLarge,
410		}
411		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
412		if err != nil {
413			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact repository lock identity: %w", err)
414		}
415		if s.beforeIntentCreate != nil {
416			s.beforeIntentCreate()
417		}
418		if err := lockx.WithDir(ctx, filepath.Join(commonDir, "dev-taskflow"), "taskflow repository", func() error {
419			if err := revalidatePreparedIntent(ctx, intent); err != nil {
420				return err
421			}
422			return s.Store.Create(ctx, intent)
423		}); err != nil {
424			return nil, err
425		}
426		return intent, nil
427	}

429	func revalidatePreparedIntent(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
430		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
431		if err != nil {
432			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout before arming intent: %w", err)
433		}
434		checkout, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.Root)
435		if err != nil {
436			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize revalidated artifact checkout: %w", err)
437		}
438		expectedCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
439		if err != nil {
440			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize prepared artifact checkout: %w", err)
441		}
442		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
443		if err != nil {
444			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize revalidated artifact Git common directory: %w", err)
445		}
446		expectedCommon, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.GitCommonDir)
447		if err != nil {
448			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize prepared artifact Git common directory: %w", err)
449		}
450		if checkout != expectedCheckout || commonDir != expectedCommon {
451			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout identity changed before intent creation")
452		}
453		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
454		if err != nil {
455			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout status: %w", err)
456		}
457		if status.Detached || status.Branch != intent.Branch {
458			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout branch changed from %s to %s before intent creation", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
459		}
460		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(checkout); err != nil {
461			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact Git operation: %w", err)
462		} else if active {
463			return fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation refuses Git operation %s that started before intent creation", operation)
464		}
465		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
466		if err != nil {
467			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout HEAD: %w", err)
468		}
469		if strings.TrimSpace(head) != strings.TrimSpace(intent.Head) {
470			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout HEAD changed before intent creation")
471		}
472		return nil
473	}
474	
475	func (s *Service) ObserveSessionEnd(ctx context.Context, runID string, when time.Time) error {
476		intent, err := s.Store.FindByRunID(runID)
477		if err != nil {
478			return nil // SessionEnd without an armed intent is deliberately a no-op.
479		}
480		if when.IsZero() {
481			when = time.Now()
482		}
483		return s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
484			candidate.SessionEndedAt = when.UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
485			return nil
486		})
487	}
488	
489	func (s *Service) Finalize(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
490		if s.Store == nil {
491			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
492		}
493		intent, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
494		if err != nil {
495			return nil, err
496		}
497		lockDir := filepath.Join(intent.GitCommonDir, "dev-artifact-finalize")
498		var finalized *Intent
499		err = catalog.NewStore(lockDir).WithLock(ctx, func() error {
500			current, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
501			if err != nil {
502				return err
503			}
504			finalized, err = s.finalizeLocked(ctx, request, current)
505			return err
506		})
507		return finalized, err
508	}
509	
510	func (s *Service) finalizeLocked(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest, intent *Intent) (*Intent, error) {
511		if intent.Status == Finalized {
512			if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok && commit != intent.ArtifactCommit {
513				if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
514					return nil, err
515				}
516				return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
517			}
518			return intent, nil
519		}
520		if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok {
521			if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
522				return nil, err
523			}
524			return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
525		}
526		if s.ScanStaged == nil {
527			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scanner-missing", fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization requires a staged secret scanner"))
528		}
529		if err := s.revalidate(ctx, intent); err != nil {
530			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "git-drift", err)
531		}
532		if intent.SessionEndedAt.IsZero() && !request.WriterStopped {
533			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-unproven",
534				fmt.Errorf("finalization requires SessionEnd observation or explicit post-writer proof"))
535		}
536		transcript, err := FindTranscript(intent.WorktreePath, intent.Provider, intent.SessionID)
537		if err != nil {
538			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "transcript-missing", err)
539		}
540		if err := s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
541			candidate.Status = Finalizing
542			candidate.TranscriptPath = transcript.Path
543			candidate.FailureCode = ""
544			return nil
545		}); err != nil {
546			return nil, err
547		}
548		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
549			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
550		}
551		paths := append([]string{transcript.Path}, intent.PlanPaths...)
552		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, nil); err != nil {
553			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-not-empty", err)
554		}
555		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"add", "--"}, paths...)...); err != nil {
556			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "stage-failed", err)
557		}
558		cleanup := func() {
559			_, _ = gitx.Run(context.Background(), intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"reset", "--"}, paths...)...)
560		}
561		if err := s.ScanStaged(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
562			cleanup()
563			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scan-failed", err)
564		}
565		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
566			cleanup()
567			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
568		}
569		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
570			cleanup()
571			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
572		}
573		if err := stagedFilesMatch(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
574			cleanup()
575			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
576		}
577		message := fmt.Sprintf("chore: finalize %s agent session", intent.Provider)
578		trailers := fmt.Sprintf("Agent-Artifact-Session: %s:%s\nDev-Artifact-Intent: %s", intent.Provider, intent.SessionID, intent.ID)
579		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "commit", "-m", message, "-m", trailers); err != nil {
580			cleanup()
581			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "commit-failed", err)
582		}
583		commit, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
584		if err != nil {
585			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "receipt-failed", err)
586		}
587		if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, transcript.Path, commit); err != nil {
588			return nil, err
589		}
590		return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
591	}
592	
593	func (s *Service) resolveIntent(request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
594		if request.IntentID != "" {
595			return s.Store.Get(request.IntentID)
596		}
597		if request.RunID != "" {
598			return s.Store.FindByRunID(request.RunID)
599		}
600		return nil, fmt.Errorf("finalize requires an intent or run id")
601	}
602	
603	func (s *Service) revalidate(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
604		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
605		if err != nil {
606			return err
607		}
608		if repository.GitCommonDir != intent.GitCommonDir {
609			return fmt.Errorf("Git common-dir changed")
610		}
611		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
612		if err != nil {
613			return err
614		}
615		if status.Branch != intent.Branch || status.Detached {
616			return fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
617		}
618		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(intent.WorktreePath); err != nil {
619			return err
620		} else if active {
621			return fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
622		}
623		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
624		if err != nil {
625			return err
626		}
627		if head != intent.Head {
628			return fmt.Errorf("HEAD changed from %s to %s", intent.Head, head)
629		}
630		return nil
631	}
632	
633	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, id, code string, cause error) error {
634		_ = s.Store.Update(ctx, id, func(intent *Intent) error {
635			intent.Status = Failed
636			intent.FailureCode = code
637			return nil
638		})
639		return fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization %s: %w", code, cause)
640	}
641	
642	func (s *Service) markFinalized(ctx context.Context, id, transcript, commit string) error {
643		return s.Store.Update(ctx, id, func(intent *Intent) error {
644			intent.Status = Finalized
645			intent.TranscriptPath = transcript
646			intent.ArtifactCommit = commit
647			intent.FailureCode = ""
648			return nil
649		})
650	}
651	
652	type statusPath struct {
653		Path   string
654		Staged bool
655	}
656	
657	func statusPaths(ctx context.Context, repo string) ([]statusPath, error) {
658		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
659		if err != nil {
660			return nil, err
661		}
662		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
663		var paths []statusPath
664		for i := 0; i < len(fields); i++ {
665			entry := fields[i]
666			if len(entry) < 4 {
667				continue
668			}
669			code, path := entry[:2], filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:])
670			paths = append(paths, statusPath{Path: path, Staged: code[0] != ' ' && code[0] != '?'})
671			if code[0] == 'R' || code[0] == 'C' {
672				i++ // porcelain -z emits the source path as the next field.
673			}
674		}
675		return paths, nil
676	}
677	
678	func isRecognizedArtifact(path string) bool {
679		path = filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(path, "./"))
680		for _, prefix := range []string{
681			".specstory/history/", ".claude/plans/", ".cursor/plans/", ".cursor/rules/",
682			".opencode/plans/", ".specify/", ".codex/",
683		} {
684			if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
685				return true
686			}
687		}
688		return path == ".specstory/statistics.json"
689	}
690	
691	func normalizePlans(root string, paths []string) ([]string, error) {
692		var out []string
693		for _, path := range paths {
694			if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
695				path = filepath.Join(root, path)
696			}
697			inside, err := pathx.Contains(filepath.Join(root, ".claude", "plans"), path)
698			if err != nil || !inside {
699				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is outside .claude/plans", path)
700			}
701			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
702			if err != nil {
703				return nil, err
704			}
705			info, err := os.Stat(canonical)
706			if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
707				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is not a regular file", path)
708			}
709			out = append(out, canonical)
710		}
711		sort.Strings(out)
712		return out, nil
713	}
714	
715	func gitTracked(ctx context.Context, repo, path string) (bool, error) {
716		rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
717		if err != nil {
718			return false, err
719		}
720		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", "--", rel)
721		if err == nil {
722			return true, nil
723		}
724		var gitErr *gitx.Error
725		if errors.As(err, &gitErr) {
726			return false, nil
727		}
728		return false, err
729	}
730	
731	func ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx context.Context, repo string, allowed []string) error {
732		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z")
733		if err != nil {
734			return err
735		}
736		allow := make(map[string]bool, len(allowed))
737		for _, path := range allowed {
738			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
739			allow[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
740		}
741		for _, path := range strings.Split(out, "\x00") {
742			if path != "" && !allow[filepath.ToSlash(path)] {
743				return fmt.Errorf("index contains unrelated path %s", path)
744			}
745		}
746		return nil
747	}
748	
749	func stagedFilesMatch(ctx context.Context, repo string, paths []string) error {
750		for _, path := range paths {
751			rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
752			if err != nil {
753				return err
754			}
755			workingBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "hash-object", "--", rel)
756			if err != nil {
757				return err
758			}
759			stagedBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "rev-parse", ":"+filepath.ToSlash(rel))
760			if err != nil {
761				return err
762			}
763			if workingBlob != stagedBlob {
764				return fmt.Errorf("staged artifact %s no longer matches scanned working bytes", filepath.ToSlash(rel))
765			}
766		}
767		return nil
768	}
769	
770	func findReceipt(ctx context.Context, repo, intentID string) (string, bool) {
771		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "log", "-n", "100", "--format=%H%x00%B%x00")
772		if err != nil {
773			return "", false
774		}
775		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
776		for i := 0; i+1 < len(fields); i += 2 {
777			if strings.Contains(fields[i+1], "Dev-Artifact-Intent: "+intentID) {
778				return fields[i], true
779			}
780		}
781		return "", false
782	}

13	func guardSharedCheckout(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout string) error {
14		if app.allowSharedCheckout {
15			return nil
16		}
17		reportedPane := ""
18		if rt != nil {
19			switch rt.Name() {
20			case "herdr":
21				reportedPane = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
22			case "tmux":
23				reportedPane = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
24			}
25		}
26		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
27			Profile:      runtime.OccupancyStrict,
28			CallerPaneID: reportedPane,
29		})
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("check live occupancy before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)
32		}
33		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
34			return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
35		}
36		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("classify live runtime coverage before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionCoverageErr)
38		}
39		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("list live runtime sessions before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.SessionList.Err)
41		}
42		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("check live agents before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
44		}
45	
46		var occupied []string
47		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
48			if !agent.Blocking {
49				continue
50			}
51			activity := agent.Activity
52			label := activity.Agent
53			if activity.Name != "" {
54				label = activity.Name
55			}
56			if label == "" {
57				label = "agent"
58			}
59			occupied = append(occupied, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, activity.PaneID))
60		}
61		if len(occupied) == 0 {
62			return nil
63		}
64		return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership",
65			config.Contract(checkout), strings.Join(occupied, ", "))
66	}
67	
68	// checkoutAgentActivities returns recognized agents whose reported cwd resolves
69	// to the same canonical Git worktree root as checkout. A pane is excluded only
70	// when its exact ID matches excludePane; lifecycle state never makes it free.
71	func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {
72		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{Profile: runtime.OccupancyStrict})
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
77			return nil, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err
78		}
79		out := make([]runtime.AgentActivity, 0, len(evidence.Agents))
80		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
81			if excludePane == "" || agent.Activity.PaneID != excludePane {
82				out = append(out, agent.Activity)
83			}
84		}
85		return out, nil
86	}

13	// OccupancyProfile selects the policy applied to recognized-agent evidence.
14	// Session, pane, and activity observations are retained identically in every
15	// profile; only Blocking changes.
16	type OccupancyProfile uint8
17	
18	const (
19		// OccupancyStrict is for claiming a checkout for writing or adoption. Every
20		// recognized agent except the current caller is blocking, regardless of state.
21		// It is the zero value so an omitted profile fails toward exclusive ownership.
22		OccupancyStrict OccupancyProfile = iota
23		// OccupancyCleanup permits closeable idle and done agents. Unknown activity
24		// remains blocking unless CloseUnknown is set.
25		OccupancyCleanup
26	)
27	
28	// OccupancyOptions supplies live caller identity and action-specific policy.
29	// CallerWorkspaceID and CallerPaneID must describe the invoking runtime, not a
30	// handle remembered in durable task state.
31	type OccupancyOptions struct {
32		Profile           OccupancyProfile
33		CallerWorkspaceID string
34		CallerPaneID      string
35		CloseUnknown      bool
36	}
37	
38	// OccupancyObservation distinguishes an observed empty inventory from evidence
39	// that was unsupported, unattempted, or failed.
40	type OccupancyObservation struct {
41		Supported bool
42		Attempted bool
43		Err       error
44	}
45	
46	// Observed reports whether the observation completed successfully.
47	func (o OccupancyObservation) Observed() bool {
48		return o.Supported && o.Attempted && o.Err == nil
49	}
50	
51	// Unknown reports whether this evidence was not successfully observed.
52	func (o OccupancyObservation) Unknown() bool { return !o.Observed() }
53	
54	// OccupancySession is one live session whose panes cover the target checkout.
55	type OccupancySession struct {
56		Runtime  Session
57		Panes    []Pane
58		Mixed    []Pane
59		IsCaller bool
60	}
61	
62	// OccupancyAgent is one recognized agent whose cwd covers the target checkout.
63	type OccupancyAgent struct {
64		Activity      AgentActivity
65		Status        string
66		SessionHandle string
67		IsCaller      bool
68		Blocking      bool
69	}
70	
71	// Occupancy is structured, read-only evidence about one checkout. A remembered
72	// runtime handle is deliberately absent: Sessions and Agents are selected only
73	// from fresh canonical checkout coverage.
74	type Occupancy struct {
75		Target               string
76		Backend              string
77		Profile              OccupancyProfile
78		CallerWorkspaceID    string
79		ReportedCallerPaneID string
80		CallerPaneID         string
81		SessionList          OccupancyObservation
82		AgentActivityList    OccupancyObservation
83		CurrentPane          OccupancyObservation
84		SessionCoverageErr   error
85		Sessions             []OccupancySession
86		Agents               []OccupancyAgent
87	}

89	// InspectOccupancy collects independent runtime, recognized-agent, and caller
90	// evidence for target. Initial target canonicalization errors are returned;
91	// observation failures are retained in their corresponding fields so each
92	// action can apply its own fail-closed acknowledgement policy.
93	func InspectOccupancy(ctx context.Context, rt Runtime, target string, opts OccupancyOptions) (Occupancy, error) {
94		checkout, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, target)
95		if err != nil {
96			return Occupancy{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize occupancy target: %w", err)
97		}
98		result := Occupancy{
99			Target:               checkout.path,
100			Backend:              "none",
101			Profile:              opts.Profile,
102			CallerWorkspaceID:    opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
103			ReportedCallerPaneID: opts.CallerPaneID,
104			CallerPaneID:         opts.CallerPaneID,
105		}
106		if rt == nil {
107			return result, nil
108		}
109		result.Backend = rt.Name()
110		if result.Backend == "none" {
111			return result, nil
112		}
113	
114		result.SessionList.Supported = true
115		resolver, resolvesCurrentPane := rt.(CurrentPaneResolver)
116		result.CurrentPane.Supported = resolvesCurrentPane
117		if resolvesCurrentPane && opts.CallerPaneID != "" {
118			result.CurrentPane.Attempted = true
119			result.CallerPaneID = ""
120			paneID, resolveErr := resolver.CurrentPaneID(ctx)
121			if resolveErr != nil {
122				result.CurrentPane.Err = resolveErr
123			} else if paneID == "" {
124				result.CurrentPane.Err = fmt.Errorf("current pane resolver returned an empty pane id")
125			} else {
126				result.CallerPaneID = paneID
127			}
128		}
129	
130		result.SessionList.Attempted = true
131		sessions, listErr := rt.List(ctx)
132		if listErr != nil {
133			result.SessionList.Err = listErr
134		} else {
135			for _, observed := range sessions {
136				covering, mixed, classifyErr := classifyOccupancySession(ctx, checkout, observed, opts.Profile)
137				if classifyErr != nil {
138					result.SessionCoverageErr = classifyErr
139					result.Sessions = nil
140					break
141				}
142				if len(covering) == 0 {
143					continue
144				}
145				result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, OccupancySession{
146					Runtime: observed,
147					Panes:   covering,
148					Mixed:   mixed,
149					IsCaller: observed.Handle == opts.CallerWorkspaceID ||
150						occupancyPanePresent(observed.Panes, result.CallerPaneID),
151				})
152			}
153		}
154	
155		lister, listsAgents := rt.(AgentActivityLister)
156		result.AgentActivityList.Supported = listsAgents
157		if !listsAgents {
158			// Some backends can identify an agent on a pane without providing the
159			// richer recognized-agent inventory. Preserve that live evidence as the
160			// strict-profile fallback rather than treating an unsupported lister as an
161			// observed empty list.
162			for _, session := range result.Sessions {
163				for _, pane := range session.Panes {
164					if pane.Agent == "" && pane.AgentSession == "" {
165						continue
166					}
167					cwd := pane.CWD
168					if cwd == "" {
169						cwd = pane.ShellCWD
170					}
171					activity := AgentActivity{
172						PaneID: pane.ID, WorkspaceID: session.Runtime.Handle,
173						Agent: pane.Agent, Status: pane.AgentStatus, CWD: cwd,
174					}
175					if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
176						result.SessionCoverageErr = coverageErr
177						result.Agents = nil
178						return result, nil
179					}
180				}
181			}
182			return result, nil
183		}
184		result.AgentActivityList.Attempted = true
185		activities, activityErr := lister.AgentActivities(ctx)
186		if activityErr != nil {
187			result.AgentActivityList.Err = activityErr
188			return result, nil
189		}
190		for _, activity := range activities {
191			if coverageErr := appendOccupancyAgent(ctx, &result, checkout, opts, activity); coverageErr != nil {
192				result.AgentActivityList.Err = coverageErr
193				result.Agents = nil
194				return result, nil
195			}
196		}
197		return result, nil
198	}
199	
200	func appendOccupancyAgent(ctx context.Context, result *Occupancy, checkout checkoutIdentity, opts OccupancyOptions, activity AgentActivity) error {
201		covered, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, checkout, activity.CWD, opts.Profile)
202		if err != nil {
203			return fmt.Errorf("classify recognized agent pane %s: %w", activity.PaneID, err)
204		}
205		if !covered {
206			return nil
207		}
208		status := normalizeOccupancyStatus(activity.Status)
209		caller := result.CallerPaneID != "" && activity.PaneID == result.CallerPaneID
210		handle := correlatedSession(result.Sessions, activity)
211		result.Agents = append(result.Agents, OccupancyAgent{
212			Activity:      activity,
213			Status:        status,
214			SessionHandle: handle,
215			IsCaller:      caller,
216			Blocking:      occupancyAgentBlocks(opts, status, caller, handle != ""),
217		})
218		return nil
219	}
220	
221	type checkoutIdentity struct {
222		path   string
223		git    bool
224		linked bool
225	}
226	
227	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
228		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
229		if err != nil {
230			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
231		}
232		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
233		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
234			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
235			if canonicalErr != nil {
236				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
237			}
238			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true, linked: repo.IsLinkedWorktree}, nil
239		}
240		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
241			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
242		}
243		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
244	}
245	
246	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string, profile OccupancyProfile) (bool, error) {
247		if cwd == "" {
248			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
249		}
250		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
251		if err != nil {
252			return false, err
253		}
254		if target.git && activity.git {
255			if target.path == activity.path {
256				return true, nil
257			}
258			if profile == OccupancyCleanup && target.linked {
259				return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
260			}
261			return false, nil
262		}
263		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
264	}
265	
266	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session, profile OccupancyProfile) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
267		panes := session.Panes
268		if len(panes) == 0 {
269			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
270				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
271			}
272		}
273		var covering, mixed []Pane
274		for _, pane := range panes {
275			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
276			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
277				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
278			}
279			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
280			for _, path := range paths {
281				if path == "" {
282					continue
283				}
284				observed = true
285				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path, profile)
286				if err != nil {
287					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
288				}
289				if inside {
290					paneCovers = true
291				} else {
292					paneOutside = true
293				}
294			}
295			if paneCovers {
296				covering = append(covering, pane)
297			}
298			if paneOutside || !observed {
299				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
300			}
301		}
302		return covering, mixed, nil
303	}
304	
305	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
306		if id == "" {
307			return false
308		}
309		for _, pane := range panes {
310			if pane.ID == id {
311				return true
312			}
313		}
314		return false
315	}
316	
317	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
318		for _, session := range sessions {
319			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
320				return session.Runtime.Handle
321			}
322			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
323				return session.Runtime.Handle
324			}
325		}
326		return ""
327	}
328	
329	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
330		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
331		if status == "" {
332			return "unknown"
333		}
334		return status
335	}
336	
337	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
338		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
339			return !caller
340		}
341		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
342		// with a freshly listed covering session.
343		if caller || !correlated {
344			return true
345		}
346		switch status {
347		case "idle", "done":
348			return false
349		case "unknown":
350			return !opts.CloseUnknown
351		default:
352			return true
353		}
354	}
355

255	func (e *executionState) run(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error)) error {
256		step := StepResult{Effect: effect.Clone(), Status: StepAttempted, StartedAt: e.service.now()}
257		detail, err := operation()
258		step.FinishedAt = e.service.now()
259		step.Detail = detail
260		if err != nil {
261			step.Status = StepFailed
262			step.Failure = err.Error()
263			e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
264			return err
265		}
266		step.Status = StepCompleted
267		e.steps = append(e.steps, step)
268		return nil
269	}
270	
271	func (e *executionState) runWarning(effect Effect, operation func() (string, error), warningPrefix string) {
272		err := e.run(effect, operation)
273		if err != nil {
274			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, warningPrefix+": "+err.Error())
275		}
276	}
277	
278	func (e *executionState) result() Result {
279		spec := ResultSpec{
280			Steps: e.steps, Warnings: e.warnings, Recovery: e.recovery,
281			PartialSuccess: e.partial,
282			Milestone:      e.milestone, Handoff: e.handoff, Remote: e.remote, FreshSnapshotRef: e.snapshot,
283		}
284		for _, step := range e.steps {
285			if step.Status == StepCompleted {
286				spec.PartialSuccess = true
287				break
288			}
289		}
290		if len(e.steps) > 0 && e.steps[len(e.steps)-1].Status == StepCompleted &&
291			(e.snapshot != "" || e.remote != nil) && len(e.recovery) == 0 {
292			// Successful completion is not partial merely because it had effects.
293			// Remote refresh is intentionally run-local and therefore completes with
294			// structured data rather than a persisted snapshot reference.
295			spec.PartialSuccess = false
296		}
297		return NewResult(spec)
298	}

302		return e.result(), err
303	}

482			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current %s runtime pane: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.CurrentPane.Err)
483		}
484		if occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
485			return fmt.Errorf("classify %s checkout coverage: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.SessionCoverageErr)
486		}
487		if occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil {
488			return fmt.Errorf("list %s runtime sessions: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.SessionList.Err)
489		}
490		if occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
491			return fmt.Errorf("list %s recognized agents: %w", occupancy.Backend, occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err)
492		}
493		return nil
494	}
495	
496	func occupancyObservationError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
497		if probeErr := occupancyProbeError(occupancy, err); probeErr != nil {
498			return probeErr
499		}
500		if !occupancy.SessionList.Observed() {
501			return fmt.Errorf("%s runtime session inventory is unsupported or was not attempted", occupancy.Backend)
502		}
503		if occupancy.AgentActivityList.Supported && !occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed() {
504			return fmt.Errorf("%s recognized-agent inventory was not attempted", occupancy.Backend)
505		}
506		if !occupancy.AgentActivityList.Supported && len(occupancy.Sessions) > 0 && len(occupancy.Agents) == 0 {
507			return fmt.Errorf("%s has covering runtime sessions but cannot observe recognized-agent activity", occupancy.Backend)
508		}
509		return nil
510	}
511	
512	func occupancyObservationIncomplete(occupancy runtime.Occupancy) bool {
513		return !occupancy.SessionList.Observed() ||
514			(occupancy.AgentActivityList.Supported && !occupancy.AgentActivityList.Observed()) ||
515			(!occupancy.AgentActivityList.Supported && len(occupancy.Sessions) > 0 && len(occupancy.Agents) == 0)
516	}
517	
518	func strictOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
519		if observationErr := occupancyObservationError(occupancy, err); observationErr != nil {
520			return observationErr
521		}
522		var blockers []string
523		for _, agent := range occupancy.Agents {
524			if !agent.Blocking {
525				continue
526			}
527			label := agent.Activity.Name
528			if label == "" {
529				label = agent.Activity.Agent
530			}
531			if label == "" {
532				label = "agent"
533			}
534			blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, pane %s)", label, agent.Status, agent.Activity.PaneID))
535		}
536		if len(blockers) > 0 {
537			return fmt.Errorf("checkout is occupied by %s", strings.Join(blockers, ", "))
538		}
539		return nil
540	}
541	
542	func (s *lifecycleService) writerOccupancyError(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) error {
543		if s.allowSharedCheckout {
544			return occupancyProbeError(occupancy, err)
545		}
546		return strictOccupancyError(occupancy, err)
547	}
548	
549	func savedHandleLive(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, handle string) bool {
550		if handle == "" {
551			return false
552		}
553		for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
554			if session.Runtime.Handle == handle {
555				return true
556			}
557		}
558		return false
559	}
560	
561	func staleBoundary(reason string) error {
562		return &StalePlanError{Reason: reason}
563	}
564	
565	func isWorktreeNotFound(err error) bool { return errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) }
566	
567	func contextError(ctx context.Context) error {
568		if ctx == nil {
569			return errors.New("taskflow context is nil")
570		}
571		return ctx.Err()
572	}

21	func (s *lifecycleService) planSpec(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
22		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
23			return PlanSpec{}, err
24		}
25		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
26			return PlanSpec{}, err
27		}
28		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
29		if err != nil {
30			return PlanSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, request.Locator.TaskID, err)
31		}
32		spec, _, err := s.observeAndSpecify(ctx, request, *record)
33		if err != nil {
34			return PlanSpec{}, err
35		}
36		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)
37		if err != nil {
38			return PlanSpec{}, &StalePlanError{
39				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
40				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while planning",
41			}
42		}
43		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
44			return PlanSpec{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while planning")
45		}
46		return spec, nil
47	}

88	func validateLifecycleLocator(locator Locator) error {
89		switch {
90		case locator.TaskID == "":
91			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact TaskID is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
92		case !exactTaskID.MatchString(locator.TaskID) || filepath.Base(locator.TaskID) != locator.TaskID || locator.TaskID == "." || locator.TaskID == "..":
93			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, locator.TaskID)
94		case locator.TaskRevision == "":
95			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task revision is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
96		case locator.RepoPath == "":
97			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
98		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
99			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
100		case locator.Branch == "":
101			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
102		case !validMode(locator.Mode):
103			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout mode is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
104		case !validState(locator.State):
105			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task state is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
106		}
107		return nil
108	}

110	func validateRecordIdentity(locator Locator, record task.Record) error {
111		candidate := record.Task
112		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
113		if record.Revision != locator.TaskRevision {
114			return staleTaskRevision(locator.TaskRevision, record.Revision, "task revision no longer matches the selected row")
115		}
116		checks := []struct {
117			name     string
118			expected string
119			actual   string
120		}{
121			{"TaskID", locator.TaskID, candidate.ID},
122			{"mode", string(locator.Mode), string(mode)},
123			{"state", string(locator.State), string(candidate.State)},
124			{"branch", locator.Branch, candidate.Branch},
125			{"base", locator.Base, candidate.Base},
126		}
127		for _, check := range checks {
128			if check.expected != check.actual {
129				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
130			}
131		}
132	
133		selectedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(locator.RepoPath)
134		if err != nil {
135			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.RepoPath, err)}
136		}
137		recordedRepo, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate.RepoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.RepoPath, err)}
140		}
141		if selectedRepo != recordedRepo {
142			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task repository path changed from %q to %q", selectedRepo, recordedRepo)}
143		}
144	
145		expectedCheckout := recordedRepo
146		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
147			expectedCheckout = ""
148			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
149				expectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(candidate.WorktreePath)
150				if err != nil {
151					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", candidate.WorktreePath, err)}
152				}
153			}
154		}
155		selectedCheckout := ""
156		if locator.CheckoutPath != "" {
157			selectedCheckout, err = pathx.Canonical(locator.CheckoutPath)
158			if err != nil {
159				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected checkout path %q is no longer canonicalizable: %v", locator.CheckoutPath, err)}
160			}
161		}
162		if selectedCheckout != expectedCheckout {
163			return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("task checkout path changed from %q to %q", selectedCheckout, expectedCheckout)}
164		}
165		return nil
166	}

176	func (s *lifecycleService) observeLifecycle(ctx context.Context, request Request, record task.Record) (lifecycleObservation, error) {
177		observed := lifecycleObservation{record: record, task: record.Task, mode: record.Task.EffectiveMode()}
178		observed.setCaller(s.host, s.cwd, s.callerWorkspace, s.callerPane)
179	
180		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, record.Task.RepoPath)
181		if err != nil {
182			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, record.Task.ID, err)
183		}
184		observed.repo = repository
185		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
186		if err != nil {
187			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
188		}
189		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
190		if err != nil {
191			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
192		}
193		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(record.Task.RepoPath)
194		if err != nil {
195			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
196		}
197		if recordedRepo != observed.repoPath {
198			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q", record.Task.RepoPath, recordedRepo, observed.repoPath)}
199		}
200		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.GitCommonDir)
201		if err != nil {
202			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
203		}
204		if requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
205			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("Git common directory changed from %q to %q", requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir)}
206		}
207		if filepath.IsAbs(request.Locator.RepoKey) {
208			requestedKey, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(request.Locator.RepoKey)
209			if keyErr != nil {
210				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
211			}
212			if requestedKey != observed.gitCommonDir {
213				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository key changed from %q to %q", requestedKey, observed.gitCommonDir)}
214			}
215		}
216	
217		s.observeCheckout(ctx, request, &observed)
218		if observed.hasCheckout() {
219			observed.status, observed.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
220			if observed.statusErr == nil {
221				observed.head, observed.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
222				observed.head = strings.TrimSpace(observed.head)
223				observed.baseOID, observed.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
224				observed.upstreamOID, observed.upstreamOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.status.Upstream)
225				observed.operation, observed.inProgress, observed.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
226			}
227		}
228		s.observeActionRefs(ctx, request, &observed)
229		if err := validateLiveLocator(request.Locator, observed); err != nil {
230			return observed, err
231		}
232	
233		if isCompletionAction(request.Action) {
234			s.observeCompletionFacts(ctx, request, &observed)
235		}
236		observed.runtime, observed.runtimeErr = s.runtimeFor(observed.task)
237		if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
238			observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
239			s.observeActionRuntime(ctx, request, &observed)
240		}
241		return observed, nil
242	}

244	func (s *lifecycleService) observeCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
245		switch observed.mode {
246		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeDirect:
247			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
248			observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
249			if err == nil {
250				observed.worktreeFound = true
251				observed.checkout = registered.Path
252			}
253		case task.ModeWorktree:
254			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
255				registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.WorktreePath)
256				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, err
257				if err == nil {
258					observed.worktreeFound = true
259					observed.checkout = registered.Path
260				}
261			}
262			if observed.worktreeFound || request.Action != Resume ||
263				(observed.task.State != task.Warm && observed.task.State != task.Cold) {
264				return
265			}
266			worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
267			if err != nil {
268				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("list worktrees for parked-task resume: %w", err)
269				return
270			}
271			var candidate string
272			for _, worktree := range worktrees {
273				if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
274					observed.branchMatches++
275					candidate = worktree.Path
276				}
277			}
278			switch observed.branchMatches {
279			case 0:
280				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
281					observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has no checkout", gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound, observed.task.Branch)
282				}
283			case 1:
284				registered, resolveErr := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, candidate)
285				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = registered, resolveErr
286				if resolveErr == nil {
287					observed.worktreeFound = true
288					observed.checkout = registered.Path
289				}
290			default:
291				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: branch %s has %d registered checkouts", gitx.ErrWorktreeAmbiguous, observed.task.Branch, observed.branchMatches)
292			}
293		}
294	}

296	func validateLiveLocator(locator Locator, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
297		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.hasCheckout() {
298			checks := []struct {
299				name     string
300				expected string
301				actual   string
302				required bool
303			}{
304				{"upstream", locator.Upstream, observed.status.Upstream, true},
305				{"HEAD", locator.HeadOID, observed.head, locator.HeadOID != ""},
306				{"base OID", locator.BaseOID, observed.baseOID, locator.BaseOID != ""},
307				{"upstream OID", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.upstreamOID, locator.UpstreamOID != ""},
308			}
309			for _, check := range checks {
310				if check.required && check.expected != check.actual {
311					return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected %s changed from %q to %q", check.name, check.expected, check.actual)}
312				}
313			}
314			return nil
315		}
316		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.HeadOID != "" {
317			if observed.localBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.HeadOID != observed.localBranchOID {
318				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected local branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.HeadOID, observed.localBranchOID)}
319			}
320		}
321		if !observed.hasCheckout() && locator.UpstreamOID != "" && locator.Upstream == observed.remoteBranch {
322			if observed.remoteBranchOIDErr != nil || locator.UpstreamOID != observed.remoteBranchOID {
323				return &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("selected remote branch OID changed from %q to %q", locator.UpstreamOID, observed.remoteBranchOID)}
324			}
325		}
326		return nil
327	}

329	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRuntime(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
330		switch options := request.Options.(type) {
331		case ParkWarmOptions:
332			if options.KeepSession || !observed.hasCheckout() {
333				return
334			}
335			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
336			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
337		case ParkColdOptions:
338			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
339				return
340			}
341			cleanupOptions := observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
342			observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, cleanupOptions)
343			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
344				observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
345			}
346		case ResumeOptions:
347			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
348				return
349			}
350			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
351				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
352				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
353				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
354			})
355			if s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr) == nil {
356				observed.savedRuntimeLive = savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle)
357			}
358		case CompleteDirectOptions, CompleteFFOptions, ReviewHandoffOptions, VerifyMergedOptions:
359			if !observed.hasCheckout() {
360				return
361			}
362			occupancyOptions := runtime.OccupancyOptions{
363				Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
364				CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace,
365				CallerPaneID:      s.callerPane,
366			}
367			observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, occupancyOptions)
368			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
369				observed.integration.occupancy = observed.occupancy
370				observed.integration.occupancyErr = observed.occupancyErr
371			}
372			if request.Action == CompleteFF && observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.integration.worktreeFound {
373				observed.integration.occupancy, observed.integration.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(
374					ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, occupancyOptions,
375				)
376			}
377		}
378	}

380	func (s *lifecycleService) observeActionRefs(ctx context.Context, request Request, observed *lifecycleObservation) {
381		observed.localBranchExists, observed.localBranchOIDErr = s.gitRefState(ctx, observed.repoPath, localBranchRef(observed.task.Branch))
382		if observed.localBranchExists && observed.localBranchOIDErr == nil {
383			observed.localBranchOID, observed.localBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, localBranchRef(observed.task.Branch))
384		}
385		observed.remoteBranch = "origin/" + observed.task.Branch
386		observed.remoteBranchExists, observed.remoteBranchOIDErr = s.gitRefState(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
387		if observed.remoteBranchExists && observed.remoteBranchOIDErr == nil {
388			observed.remoteBranchOID, observed.remoteBranchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
389		}
390	
391		switch request.Action {
392		case ParkCold:
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
394				observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
395				if observed.baseRef == "" {
396					observed.baseRef = s.gitDefaultBranch(ctx, observed.repoPath)
397				}
398				if observed.baseRef != "" {
399					observed.baseRefExists, observed.baseRefExistsErr = s.gitRefState(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
400				}
401			}
402		case Resume:
403			observed.baseRef = observed.task.Base
404			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !observed.hasCheckout() {
405				switch {
406				case observed.localBranchExists:
407					observed.baseRef = observed.task.Branch
408					observed.baseRefExists = true
409					observed.baseRefExistsErr = observed.localBranchOIDErr
410				case observed.remoteBranchOIDErr != nil:
411					observed.baseRef = observed.remoteBranch
412					observed.baseRefExistsErr = observed.remoteBranchOIDErr
413				default:
414					observed.baseRef = observed.remoteBranch
415					observed.baseRefExists = observed.remoteBranchExists
416				}
417			} else {
418				if observed.remoteBranchExists {
419					observed.baseRef = observed.remoteBranch
420				}
421				if observed.baseRef != "" {
422					observed.baseRefExists, observed.baseRefExistsErr = s.gitRefState(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.baseRef)
423				}
424			}
425			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !observed.hasCheckout() &&
426				(observed.task.State == task.Warm || observed.task.State == task.Cold) {
427				if observed.task.State == task.Warm && observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
428					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.canonicalPath(observed.task.WorktreePath)
429				} else {
430					observed.desiredWorktree, observed.desiredWorktreeErr = s.renderWorktreePath(observed.task)
431				}
432				if observed.desiredWorktreeErr == nil {
433					observed.desiredWorktreeErr = wt.ValidateTarget(observed.desiredWorktree, observed.repoPath)
434				}
435			}
436		case CompleteDirect:
437			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Branch
438		case CompleteFF, ReviewHandoff:
439			observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base
440		case VerifyMerged:

442			observed.completionBaseRef = options.BaseRef
443			if observed.completionBaseRef == "" {
444				observed.completionBaseRef = observed.task.Base

588	func appendOptionAuthority(authority map[string]string, options ActionOptions) {
589		switch value := options.(type) {
590		case ParkWarmOptions:
591			authority["option.next"] = value.Next
592			authority["option.note"] = value.Note
593			authority["option.commit-wip"] = boolString(value.CommitWIP)
594			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
595			authority["option.keep-session"] = boolString(value.KeepSession)
596			authority["option.close-unknown"] = boolString(value.CloseUnknown)
597			authority["option.assume-no-runtime"] = boolString(value.AssumeNoRuntime)
598			authority["option.timeout"] = value.Timeout.String()
599		case ParkColdOptions:
600			authority["option.next"] = value.Next
601			authority["option.note"] = value.Note
602			authority["option.commit-wip"] = boolString(value.CommitWIP)
603			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
604			authority["option.close-unknown"] = boolString(value.CloseUnknown)
605			authority["option.assume-no-runtime"] = boolString(value.AssumeNoRuntime)
606			authority["option.timeout"] = value.Timeout.String()
607		case ResumeOptions:
608			authority["option.fetch-refs"] = boolString(value.FetchRefs)
609			authority["option.no-provision"] = boolString(value.NoProvision)
610			authority["option.take-ownership"] = boolString(value.TakeOwnership)
611		case CompleteDirectOptions:
612			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
613			authority["option.push"] = boolString(value.Push)
614		case CompleteFFOptions:
615			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
616			authority["option.push-base"] = boolString(value.PushBase)
617		case ReviewHandoffOptions:
618			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
619			authority["option.draft"] = boolString(value.Draft)
620			authority["option.title"] = value.Title
621			authority["option.body"] = value.Body
622		case VerifyMergedOptions:
623			appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
624			authority["option.base-ref"] = value.BaseRef
625			authority["option.squash-commit"] = value.SquashCommit
626			authority["option.push-base"] = boolString(value.PushBase)
627		}
628	}

630	func appendCompletionOptionAuthority(authority map[string]string, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) {
631		authority["option.dirty"] = string(dirty)
632		authority["option.commit-message"] = message
633	}

642	func (s *lifecycleService) resolveRefOID(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) (string, error) {
643		if ref == "" {
644			return "", nil
645		}
646		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", ref+"^{commit}")
647		return strings.TrimSpace(value), err
648	}

15	func (s *lifecycleService) applyGuarded(ctx context.Context, action Action, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
16		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
17			return Result{}, err
18		}
19		if approved.Action != action {
20			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("handler %s received %s", action, approved.Action)}
21		}
22		if err := validateLifecycleLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
23			return Result{}, err
24		}
25		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
28		}
29	
30		var result Result
31		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
32			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
33				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
34				if loadErr != nil {
35					return &StalePlanError{
36						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID,
37						Reason:         "task record disappeared before apply",
38					}
39				}
40				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
41					return identityErr
42				}
43				fresh, observed, planErr := s.freshPlan(ctx, approved.Request, *record)
44				if planErr != nil {
45					return planErr
46				}
47				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
48				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
49					actual := ""
50					if current != nil {
51						actual = current.Revision
52					}
53					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked plan rebuild")
54				}
55				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
56					return &StalePlanError{
57						ExpectedPlanID:               approved.PlanID,
58						ActualPlanID:                 fresh.PlanID,
59						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
60						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
61						Reason:                       "fresh task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or option authority differs",
62					}
63				}
64				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
65					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
66					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh required conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
67				}
68	
69				execution := &executionState{
70					service: s, plan: fresh, observed: observed, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision,
71				}
72				var applyErr error
73				switch action {
74				case ParkWarm:
75					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkWarm(ctx)
76				case ParkCold:
77					result, applyErr = execution.applyParkCold(ctx)
78				case Resume:
79					result, applyErr = execution.applyResume(ctx)
80				case CompleteDirect:
81					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteDirect(ctx)
82				case CompleteFF:
83					result, applyErr = execution.applyCompleteFF(ctx)
84				case ReviewHandoff:
85					result, applyErr = execution.applyReviewHandoff(ctx)
86				case VerifyMerged:
87					result, applyErr = execution.applyVerifyMerged(ctx)
88				default:
89					applyErr = &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: action, Stage: "apply"}
90				}
91				return applyErr
92			})
93		})
94		return result, err
95	}

97	func (e *executionState) applyParkWarm(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
98		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ParkWarmOptions)
99		observed := &e.observed
100		if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() && !options.CommitWIP {
101			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, observed.checkout+" has uncommitted changes; bytes remain in place")
102		}
103		if observed.desiredNext(options) == "" {
104			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "no next action is recorded")
105		}
106		if !options.KeepSession && observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
107			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "runtime remains active because the caller is contained; exit normally and reconcile later")
108		}
109	
110		closedRuntime := false
111		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
112			switch effect.Code {
113			case EffectCommitWIP:
114				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
115					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task and retry warm parking")
116				}
117				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
118					made, commitErr := e.service.wipCommit(ctx, observed.checkout, effect.Details.Map()["message"])
119					if commitErr != nil {
120						return "", fmt.Errorf("checkpoint WIP: %w", commitErr)
121					}
122					if !made {
123						return "no product changes required a checkpoint", nil
124					}
125					return "created WIP checkpoint", nil
126				})
127				if err != nil {
128					return e.fail(err, "preserve the checkout and retry after fixing the checkpoint failure")
129				}
130				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
131					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after WIP checkpoint: %w", err), "inspect the committed checkpoint before retrying")
132				}
133			case EffectPushBranch:
134				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
135					return e.fail(err, "inspect the checkout and retry the push")
136				}
137				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
138					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
139					if pushErr != nil {
140						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
141					}
142					return "pushed origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
143				})
144				if err != nil {
145					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains present; resolve the push and retry warm parking")
146				}
147				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
148					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after push: %w", err), "inspect the published branch before retrying")
149				}
150			case EffectCloseRuntime:
151				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
152					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task and retry runtime closure")
153				}
154				if err := e.service.revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx, *observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
155					return e.fail(err, "inspect runtime occupancy from outside the checkout")
156				}
157				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
158					closed, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
159						observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout))
160					if closeErr != nil {
161						return "", closeErr
162					}
163					observed.cleanup = closed
164					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", closed.ClosedSessions, observed.runtime.Name()), nil
165				})
166				if err != nil {
167					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and task record remain; inspect runtime occupancy and retry")
168				}
169				if err := e.service.ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx, observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
170					return e.fail(err, "a runtime reclaimed the checkout; close it from outside and retry")
171				}
172				closedRuntime = true
173			case EffectUpdateTask:
174				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
175					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task before recording WARM")
176				}
177				if !options.KeepSession {
178					var runtimeErr error
179					if closedRuntime {
180						runtimeErr = e.service.ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx, observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
181					} else {
182						runtimeErr = e.service.revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx, *observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout)
183					}
184					if runtimeErr != nil {
185						return e.fail(runtimeErr, "runtime occupancy changed; refresh and retry warm parking")
186					}
187				}
188				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
189					candidate := observed.task
190					candidate.State = task.Warm
191					candidate.Owner = e.service.host
192					if options.Next != "" {
193						candidate.Next = options.Next
194					}
195					if options.Note != "" {
196						candidate.Note = options.Note
197					}
198					if !options.KeepSession && !observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
199						candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
200						candidate.RuntimeName = ""
201					}
202					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
203					if updateErr != nil {
204						return "", fmt.Errorf("write WARM task state: %w", updateErr)
205					}
206					if updated == nil {
207						return "", errors.New("write WARM task state returned no revision")
208					}
209					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
210					observed.task = updated.Task
211					return "recorded WARM at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
212				})
213				if err != nil {
214					return e.fail(err, "Git/runtime effects may already be complete; reload the task and reconcile its state")
215				}
216			default:
217				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ParkWarm effect " + string(effect.Code)})
218			}
219		}
220		return e.result(), nil
221	}
