223	func (e *executionState) applyParkCold(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
224		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ParkColdOptions)
225		observed := &e.observed
226		if observed.desiredNext(options) == "" {
227			e.warnings = append(e.warnings, "no next action is recorded")
228		}
229		closedRuntime := false
230		checkoutRemoved := false
231		baseSwitched := false
232	
233		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
234			switch effect.Code {
235			case EffectCommitWIP:
236				if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
237					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task and retry cold parking")
238				}
239				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
240					made, commitErr := e.service.wipCommit(ctx, observed.checkout, effect.Details.Map()["message"])
241					if commitErr != nil {
242						return "", fmt.Errorf("checkpoint WIP: %w", commitErr)
243					}
244					if !made {
245						return "no product changes required a checkpoint", nil
246					}
247					return "created WIP checkpoint", nil
248				})
249				if err != nil {
250					return e.fail(err, "preserve the checkout and resolve the checkpoint failure")
251				}
252				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
253					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after WIP checkpoint: %w", err), "inspect the checkpoint before retrying")
254				}
255				if observed.status.Dirty() {
256					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("checkout remains dirty after WIP checkpoint: %s", observed.status.Breakdown()),
257						"commit or finalize the remaining bytes before cold parking")
258				}
259			case EffectPushBranch:
260				if err := e.service.ensureParkBranchIdentity(ctx, observed); err != nil {
261					return e.fail(err, "inspect the checkout before retrying the push")
262				}
263				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
264					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
265					if pushErr != nil {
266						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
267					}
268					return "pushed origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
269				})
270				if err != nil {
271					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains present; resolve the push before retrying cold parking")
272				}
273				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
274					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after push: %w", err), "inspect the published branch before retrying")
275				}
276			case EffectCloseRuntime:
277				if err := e.service.ensureColdGitReady(ctx, observed); err != nil {
278					return e.fail(err, "restore a clean, fully pushed branch before runtime cleanup")
279				}
280				if err := e.service.revalidateColdArtifact(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
281					return e.fail(err, "finalize or restore artifact receipts before runtime cleanup")
282				}
283				if err := e.service.revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx, *observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
284					return e.fail(err, "runtime occupancy changed; refresh cold parking")
285				}
286				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
287					closed, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout,
288						observed.cleanupOptions(options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout))
289					if closeErr != nil {
290						return "", closeErr
291					}
292					observed.cleanup = closed
293					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", closed.ClosedSessions, observed.runtime.Name()), nil
294				})
295				if err != nil {
296					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains present; inspect runtime occupancy and retry")
297				}
298				if err := e.service.ensureRuntimeReleased(ctx, observed, options.CloseUnknown, options.AssumeNoRuntime, options.Timeout); err != nil {
299					return e.fail(err, "a runtime reclaimed the checkout; close it from outside before retrying")
300				}
301				closedRuntime = true
302			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
303				if err := e.service.ensureColdRemovalBoundary(ctx, observed, options, closedRuntime); err != nil {
304					return e.fail(err, "the worktree was preserved; refresh every safety condition before retrying")
305				}
306				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
307					if removeErr := e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout, false); removeErr != nil {
308						return "", fmt.Errorf("remove exact worktree %s: %w", observed.checkout, removeErr)
309					}
310					return "removed exact linked worktree; branch retained", nil
311				})
312				if err != nil {
313					return e.fail(err, "inspect the still-registered worktree; never force removal without preserving bytes")
314				}
315				checkoutRemoved = true
316				branchExists, branchErr := e.service.gitRefState(ctx, observed.repoPath, localBranchRef(observed.task.Branch))
317				if branchErr != nil {
318					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify retained task branch after worktree removal: %w", branchErr), "restore reliable Git ref observation before updating task state")
319				}
320				if !branchExists {
321					return e.fail(errors.New("task branch disappeared after worktree removal"), "restore the retained task branch before updating task state")
322				}
323			case EffectSwitchBase:
324				if err := e.service.ensureColdRemovalBoundary(ctx, observed, options, closedRuntime); err != nil {
325					return e.fail(err, "canonical checkout was not switched; refresh cold parking")
326				}
327				base := effect.Details.Map()["base"]
328				baseExists, baseErr := e.service.gitRefState(ctx, observed.repoPath, base)
329				if baseErr != nil {
330					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("observe explicit base before canonical checkout switch: %w", baseErr), "repair Git ref observation and retry")
331				}
332				if base == "" || !baseExists {
333					return e.fail(staleBoundary("explicit base ref changed before canonical checkout switch"), "restore the recorded base and retry")
334				}
335				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
336					_, switchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "switch", base)
337					if switchErr != nil {
338						return "", fmt.Errorf("switch canonical checkout to %s: %w", base, switchErr)
339					}
340					return "switched canonical checkout to " + base, nil
341				})
342				if err != nil {
343					return e.fail(err, "the task branch remains retained; inspect the canonical checkout and retry")
344				}
345				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, base); err != nil {
346					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify canonical base switch: %w", err), "inspect the canonical checkout before reconciling task state")
347				}
348				branchExists, branchErr := e.service.gitRefState(ctx, observed.repoPath, localBranchRef(observed.task.Branch))
349				if branchErr != nil {
350					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify task branch after canonical checkout switch: %w", branchErr), "repair Git ref observation before updating task state")
351				}
352				if !branchExists {
353					return e.fail(errors.New("task branch disappeared during canonical checkout switch"), "restore the task branch before updating task state")
354				}
355				baseSwitched = true
356			case EffectUpdateTask:
357				if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !checkoutRemoved {
358					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "task update reached before worktree removal"})
359				}
360				if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && !baseSwitched {
361					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "task update reached before canonical base switch"})
362				}
363				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
364					candidate := observed.task
365					candidate.State = task.Cold
366					candidate.Owner = e.service.host
367					candidate.WorktreePath = ""
368					candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
369					candidate.RuntimeName = ""
370					if options.Next != "" {
371						candidate.Next = options.Next
372					}
373					if options.Note != "" {
374						candidate.Note = options.Note
375					}
376					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
377					if updateErr != nil {
378						return "", fmt.Errorf("write COLD task state: %w", updateErr)
379					}
380					if updated == nil {
381						return "", errors.New("write COLD task state returned no revision")
382					}
383					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
384					observed.task = updated.Task
385					return "recorded COLD at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
386				})
387				if err != nil {
388					return e.fail(err, "checkout cleanup succeeded but task persistence failed; reload and reconcile the task path/runtime/state")
389				}
390			default:
391				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ParkCold effect " + string(effect.Code)})
392			}
393		}
394		return e.result(), nil
395	}
396	
397	func (e *executionState) applyResume(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
398		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ResumeOptions)
399		observed := &e.observed
400		e.resumePath = observed.checkout
401		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && observed.savedRuntimeLive {
402			e.resumeRuntimeName = observed.runtime.Name()
403			e.resumeRuntimeHandle = observed.task.RuntimeHandle
404		}
405		runtimeMutated := false
406		checkoutMutated := false
407	
408		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
409			switch effect.Code {
410			case EffectFetchRefs:
411				if err := e.service.revalidateRepository(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
412					return e.fail(err, "refresh the canonical repository before fetching")
413				}
414				if observed.hasCheckout() {
415					if err := e.service.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
416						return e.fail(err, "refresh checkout authority before fetching")
417					}
418				} else if matches, err := e.service.branchCheckoutCount(ctx, *observed); err != nil || matches != observed.branchMatches {
419					if err != nil {
420						return e.fail(err, "refresh worktree topology before fetching")
421					}
422					return e.fail(staleBoundary("task branch checkout topology changed before fetch"), "refresh resume")
423				}
424				e.runWarning(effect, func() (string, error) {
425					_, fetchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "origin")
426					if fetchErr != nil {
427						return "", fetchErr
428					}
429					return "fetched origin", nil
430				}, "fetch failed")
431				if observed.hasCheckout() {
432					if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, resumeExpectedBranchBeforeSwitch(*observed)); err != nil {
433						return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh checkout after fetch: %w", err), "inspect fetched refs and retry resume")
434					}
435				}
436			case EffectCreateWorktree:
437				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeBranchRefs(ctx, observed, options.FetchRefs); err != nil {
438					return e.fail(err, "refresh the task branch before rebuilding its checkout")
439				}
440				localExists, localErr := e.service.gitRefState(ctx, observed.repoPath, localBranchRef(observed.task.Branch))
441				if localErr != nil {
442					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("observe local task branch before reconstruction: %w", localErr), "repair Git ref observation and retry")
443				}
444				remoteExists, remoteErr := e.service.gitRefState(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.remoteBranch)
445				if remoteErr != nil {
446					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("observe published task branch before reconstruction: %w", remoteErr), "repair Git ref observation and retry")
447				}
448				base := observed.task.Branch
449				if !localExists {
450					base = observed.remoteBranch
451				}
452				if !localExists && !remoteExists {
453					return e.fail(staleBoundary("local and published task branches are unavailable after fetch"), "restore origin/"+observed.task.Branch+" before reconstructing the checkout")
454				}
455				if matches, err := e.service.branchCheckoutCount(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
456					return e.fail(err, "refresh repository topology before rebuilding")
457				} else if matches != 0 {
458					return e.fail(staleBoundary("the task branch acquired a checkout before reconstruction"), "refresh and reuse the newly registered exact checkout")
459				}
460				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
461					created, createErr := e.service.createWorktree(ctx, wt.CreateRequest{
462						RepoPath: observed.repoPath, RepoName: observed.task.Repo,
463						Branch: observed.task.Branch, Base: base,
464						Path: effect.Target, Label: resumeRuntimeLabel(observed.task),
465						NoProvision: options.NoProvision, NoRuntime: true,
466					})
467					if createErr != nil {
468						var exists *wt.ErrExists
469						if errors.As(createErr, &exists) {
470							return "", staleBoundary("the task branch became checked out at " + exists.Path)
471						}
472						return "", createErr
473					}
474					if created == nil || created.Path == "" {
475						return "", errors.New("worktree manager returned no checkout path")
476					}
477					path, canonicalErr := e.service.canonicalPath(created.Path)
478					if canonicalErr != nil {
479						return "", canonicalErr
480					}
481					target, targetErr := e.service.canonicalPath(effect.Target)
482					if targetErr != nil || path != target {
483						return "", fmt.Errorf("worktree manager created %q, approved target is %q", path, target)
484					}
485					e.resumePath = path
486					return "rebuilt linked worktree from " + base, nil
487				})
488				if err != nil {
489					return e.fail(err, "inspect any partially created checkout, then refresh resume before retrying")
490				}
491				registered, resolveErr := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, e.resumePath)
492				if resolveErr != nil {
493					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("resolve rebuilt exact worktree: %w", resolveErr), "preserve the rebuilt checkout and reconcile its registration")
494				}
495				observed.worktree = registered
496				observed.worktreeFound = true
497				observed.worktreeErr = nil
498				observed.checkout = registered.Path
499				if !registered.IsLinkedWorktree() || registered.Worktree.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
500					return e.fail(errors.New("rebuilt checkout is not the exact linked task branch"), "preserve and reconcile the rebuilt checkout")
501				}
502				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
503					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify rebuilt worktree: %w", err), "preserve and inspect the rebuilt checkout")
504				}
505				checkoutMutated = true
506			case EffectSwitchBranch:
507				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeOccupancy(ctx, observed, !runtimeMutated && !checkoutMutated); err != nil {
508					return e.fail(err, "another agent or runtime changed occupancy; refresh resume")
509				}
510				if err := e.service.ensureBranchSwitchBoundary(ctx, observed); err != nil {
511					return e.fail(err, "preserve canonical checkout changes and retry resume")
512				}
513				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
514					_, switchErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "switch", observed.task.Branch)
515					if switchErr != nil {
516						return "", switchErr
517					}
518					return "switched canonical checkout to " + observed.task.Branch, nil
519				})
520				if err != nil {
521					return e.fail(err, "inspect the canonical checkout and retry resume")
522				}
523				if err := e.service.refreshCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch); err != nil {
524					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify task branch switch: %w", err), "inspect the canonical checkout before retrying")
525				}
526				checkoutMutated = true
527			case EffectOpenRuntime:
528				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeCheckout(ctx, observed); err != nil {
529					return e.fail(err, "refresh the exact checkout before opening a runtime")
530				}
531				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeOccupancy(ctx, observed, !runtimeMutated && !checkoutMutated); err != nil {
532					return e.fail(err, "another agent or runtime changed occupancy; refresh resume")
533				}
534				if savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle) {
535					return e.fail(staleBoundary("saved runtime handle became live before the declared open"), "refresh and reuse the saved runtime")
536				}
537				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
538					opened, openErr := e.service.openRuntime(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, resumeRuntimeLabel(observed.task))
539					if openErr != nil {
540						return "", openErr
541					}
542					if opened.Handle == "" {
543						return "", errors.New("runtime opened without a handle")
544					}
545					e.resumeRuntimeName = observed.runtime.Name()
546					e.resumeRuntimeHandle = opened.Handle
547					return "opened " + observed.runtime.Name() + " runtime " + opened.Handle, nil
548				})
549				if err != nil {
550					return e.fail(err, "the checkout remains available; open a runtime manually or retry resume")
551				}
552				runtimeMutated = true
553			case EffectUpdateTask:
554				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeCheckout(ctx, observed); err != nil {
555					return e.fail(err, "refresh the exact checkout before recording HOT")
556				}
557				if err := e.service.revalidateResumeOccupancy(ctx, observed, !runtimeMutated && !checkoutMutated); err != nil {
558					return e.fail(err, "another recognized agent appeared; close the new surface or refresh resume")
559				}
560				if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !runtimeMutated && observed.task.RuntimeHandle != "" &&
561					!savedHandleLive(observed.occupancy, observed.task.RuntimeHandle) {
562					return e.fail(staleBoundary("saved runtime handle disappeared before HOT task write"), "refresh resume and open a new runtime")
563				}
564				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
565					candidate := observed.task
566					candidate.State = task.Hot
567					candidate.Owner = e.service.host
568					if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
569						candidate.WorktreePath = observed.checkout
570					} else {
571						candidate.WorktreePath = ""
572					}
573					if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
574						candidate.RuntimeName = ""
575						candidate.RuntimeHandle = ""
576					} else {
577						candidate.RuntimeName = e.resumeRuntimeName
578						candidate.RuntimeHandle = e.resumeRuntimeHandle
579						if candidate.RuntimeName == "" || candidate.RuntimeHandle == "" {
580							return "", errors.New("HOT task requires the validated or newly opened runtime handle")
581						}
582					}
583					updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
584					if updateErr != nil {
585						return "", fmt.Errorf("write HOT task state: %w", updateErr)
586					}
587					if updated == nil {
588						return "", errors.New("write HOT task state returned no revision")
589					}
590					e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
591					observed.task = updated.Task
592					if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" {
593						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffDirectory, Path: observed.checkout, Label: candidate.Title()}
594					} else {
595						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffRuntime, Path: observed.checkout,
596							Runtime: candidate.RuntimeName, RuntimeHandle: candidate.RuntimeHandle, Label: candidate.Title()}
597					}
598					return "recorded HOT at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
599				})
600				if err != nil {
601					return e.fail(err, "checkout/runtime preparation may be complete; reload and reconcile task ownership, path, and runtime")
602				}
603			default:
604				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected Resume effect " + string(effect.Code)})
605			}
606		}
607		return e.result(), nil
608	}
609	
610	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateRepository(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
611		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, observed.repoPath)
612		if err != nil {
613			return staleBoundary("canonical repository is no longer discoverable: " + err.Error())
614		}
615		mainPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
616		if err != nil {
617			return staleBoundary("canonical repository path is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
618		}
619		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
620		if err != nil {
621			return staleBoundary("Git common directory is no longer resolvable: " + err.Error())
622		}
623		if mainPath != observed.repoPath || commonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
624			return staleBoundary("canonical repository or Git common directory changed")
625		}
626		return nil
627	}
628	
629	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateGitBaseline(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
630		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
631		if err != nil {
632			return staleBoundary("exact worktree registration changed: " + err.Error())
633		}
634		if registered != observed.worktree {
635			return staleBoundary("exact worktree path, branch, HEAD, Main, locked, or prunable flags changed")
636		}
637		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
638		if err != nil {
639			return staleBoundary("Git status observation changed: " + err.Error())
640		}
641		if !sameStatus(status, observed.status) {
642			return staleBoundary("Git status, branch, upstream, ahead, behind, dirty, or conflict evidence changed")
643		}
644		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
645		if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(head) != observed.head {
646			return staleBoundary("checkout HEAD changed")
647		}
648		baseOID, baseErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
649		upstreamOID, upstreamErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
650		if errorString(baseErr) != errorString(observed.baseOIDErr) || baseOID != observed.baseOID ||
651			errorString(upstreamErr) != errorString(observed.upstreamOIDErr) || upstreamOID != observed.upstreamOID {
652			return staleBoundary("base or upstream ref OID changed")
653		}
654		operation, active, err := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
655		if err != nil || operation != observed.operation || active != observed.inProgress {
656			return staleBoundary("Git operation evidence changed")
657		}
658		return nil
659	}
660	
661	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshCheckout(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation, expectedBranch string) error {
662		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
663		if err != nil {
664			return err
665		}
666		if registered.Path != observed.checkout || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
667			return errors.New("checkout path or Git common directory changed")
668		}
669		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree && !registered.IsLinkedWorktree() {
670			return errors.New("worktree task no longer resolves to a linked checkout")
671		}
672		if observed.mode != task.ModeWorktree && (!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare) {
673			return errors.New("canonical task no longer resolves to the main checkout")
674		}
675		status, err := s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.checkout)
676		if err != nil {
677			return err
678		}
679		if status.Detached || expectedBranch != "" && status.Branch != expectedBranch || registered.Worktree.Branch != status.Branch {
680			return fmt.Errorf("checkout branch changed: registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", registered.Worktree.Branch, status.Branch, expectedBranch)
681		}
682		head, err := s.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
683		if err != nil {
684			return err
685		}
686		head = strings.TrimSpace(head)
687		if registered.Worktree.Head != head {
688			return fmt.Errorf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", registered.Worktree.Head, head)
689		}
690		baseOID, baseOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.task.Base)
691		upstreamOID, upstreamOIDErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, status.Upstream)
692		operation, active, operationErr := s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.checkout)
693		if operationErr != nil {
694			return operationErr
695		}
696		observed.worktree = registered
697		observed.status = status
698		observed.statusErr = nil
699		observed.head = head
700		observed.headErr = nil
701		observed.baseOID = baseOID
702		observed.baseOIDErr = baseOIDErr
703		observed.upstreamOID = upstreamOID
704		observed.upstreamOIDErr = upstreamOIDErr
705		observed.operation = operation
706		observed.inProgress = active
707		observed.operationErr = nil
708		return nil
709	}
710	
711	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureParkBranchIdentity(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
712		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
713			return err
714		}
715		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch || observed.inProgress || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
716			return staleBoundary("task branch, conflict, or Git operation evidence changed before push")
717		}
718		return nil
719	}
720	
721	func (s *lifecycleService) ensureColdGitReady(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
722		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
723			return err
724		}
725		if observed.status.Dirty() {
726			return fmt.Errorf("cold parking requires a clean checkout: %s", observed.status.Breakdown())
727		}
728		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
729			return errors.New("cold parking checkout is no longer on the task branch")
730		}
731		if observed.inProgress || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
732			return errors.New("cold parking refuses an active Git operation or unresolved conflict")
733		}
734		if !observed.status.Published() || observed.status.Ahead != 0 {
735			return fmt.Errorf("cold parking requires a published ahead=0 branch; status is %s", observed.status.Summary())
736		}
737		return nil
738	}
739	
740	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateColdArtifact(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) error {
741		if observed.mode != task.ModeWorktree {
742			return nil
743		}
744		fresh, err := s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
745		if err != nil {
746			return err
747		}
748		if !fresh.Ready() {
749			return errors.New("artifact readiness changed to blocked")
750		}
751		if artifactAuthority(fresh, nil) != artifactAuthority(observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr) {
752			return staleBoundary("artifact intent or receipt authority changed")
753		}
754		return nil
755	}
756	
757	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateCleanupBaseline(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool, timeout time.Duration) error {
758		options := observed.cleanupOptions(closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, timeout)
759		fresh, err := s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, options)

872		}

874			errorString(remoteErr) != errorString(observed.remoteBranchOIDErr) {
875			return staleBoundary("remote task branch OID changed before worktree reconstruction")
876		}
877		return nil
878	}

880	func (s *lifecycleService) branchCheckoutCount(ctx context.Context, observed lifecycleObservation) (int, error) {
881		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
882		if err != nil {
883			return 0, err
884		}
885		count := 0
886		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
887			if worktree.Branch == observed.task.Branch {
888				count++
889			}
890		}
891		return count, nil
892	}

313	func sweepTaskPlan(ctx context.Context, app *App, id string, options flow.ActionOptions) (lifecycleSession, flow.Plan, error) {
314		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
315			return app.Tasks.Get(id)

324	func sweepPlanBlocker(plan flow.Plan, err error) string {
325		if err != nil {
326			return err.Error()
327		}
328		var parts []string
329		for _, condition := range append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...) {
330			parts = append(parts, string(condition.Code)+": "+condition.Evidence)
331		}
332		if len(parts) == 0 {
333			return "guarded plan is " + string(plan.Availability)
334		}
335		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
336	}

351	// orphanSuggestions handles the residue of a worktree removed while its
352	// transcript writer was still running: the path exists, Git has no record of
353	// it, and it holds only agent artifacts. Removing it is offered only once every
354	// file in it is proven byte-identical to one the repository already has.
355	func orphanSuggestions(app *App, r inventory.Row) []suggestion {
356		t := r.Task
357		if t.WorktreePath == "" || !r.WorktreeMissing || !r.CheckoutExists {
358			return nil
359		}
360		orphan, ok, err := retirement.InspectOrphan(t.WorktreePath)
361		if err != nil || !ok {
362			return nil
363		}
364		unsalvaged, err := retirement.Unsalvaged(orphan, t.RepoPath)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil
367		}
368		if len(unsalvaged) > 0 {
369			return []suggestion{{
370				row: r,
371				reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace holding %d file(s) the repository does not have",
372					config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(unsalvaged)),
373				action: fmt.Sprintf("salvage %s first — not removed automatically", strings.Join(unsalvaged, ", ")),
374			}}
375		}
376		return []suggestion{{
377			row:    r,
378			reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace git does not know", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
379			action: fmt.Sprintf("remove the empty shell %s (its %d artifact file(s) are already in the repository)",
380				config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(orphan.Files)),
381			apply: func() error { return os.RemoveAll(t.WorktreePath) },
382		}}
383	}

385	func suggestMergedWorktrees(app *App, ctx context.Context, rows []inventory.Row, requestedBase string, options sweepRetireOptions) ([]suggestion, error) {
386		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, mustGetwd())
387		if err != nil {
388			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees requires a Git repository: %w", err)
389		}
390		if repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
391			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees must run from the canonical checkout, not linked worktree %s", config.Contract(repository.Root))
392		}
393		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, err
396		}
397		base := requestedBase
398		if base == "" {
399			base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.Root)
400			if status.Branch != base {
401				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees defaults to %s; switch the canonical checkout to it or pass --base explicitly", base)
402			}
403		}
404		if !gitx.RefExists(ctx, repository.Root, base) {
405			return nil, fmt.Errorf("merged-worktree base %s does not resolve to a commit", base)
406		}
407	
408		claimed := make(map[string]inventory.Row)
409		for _, row := range rows {
410			if row.Task == nil || row.Checkout == "" {
411				continue
412			}
413			canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(row.Checkout)
414			if canonicalErr == nil {
415				claimed[canonical] = row
416			}
417		}
418		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, repository.Root)
419		if err != nil {
420			return nil, err
421		}
422		var suggestions []suggestion
423		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
424			if worktree.Main || worktree.Bare || worktree.Detached || worktree.Branch == "" || worktree.Branch == base {
425				continue
426			}
427			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", worktree.Branch, base); err != nil {
428				continue
429			}
430			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
431			if err != nil {
432				continue
433			}
434			if row, ok := claimed[canonical]; ok {
435				if row.Task.State == task.Done {
436					suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestFor(app, ctx, row, 0, options)...)
437					continue
438				}
439				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
440					fmt.Sprintf("task is %s; verify integration with `dev done --merged` first", row.Task.State)))
441				continue
442			}
443	
444			displayTask := &task.Task{
445				ID: task.MakeID(repository.Name, worktree.Branch), Name: worktree.Branch,
446				Repo: repository.Name, RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, Branch: worktree.Branch,
447				Base: base, WorktreePath: canonical, Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done,
448			}
449			row := inventory.Row{Task: displayTask, Checkout: canonical, CheckoutExists: true}
450			if inventory.IsClaudeHarnessWorktree(repository.Root, canonical) {
451				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
452					"checkout is owned by the Claude harness"))
453				continue
454			}
455			locator, locateErr := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, canonical)
456			if locateErr != nil {
457				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, locateErr.Error()))
458				continue
459			}
460			service, serviceErr := newCLILifecycleService(app)
461			if serviceErr != nil {
462				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, serviceErr.Error()))
463				continue
464			}
465			request, requestErr := flow.NewRequest(locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
466				RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base,
467				DeleteContainedBranch: options.deleteBranches,
468				CloseUnknown:          options.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.assumeNoRuntime,
469			})
470			if requestErr != nil {
471				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, requestErr.Error()))
472				continue
473			}
474			plan, planErr := service.Plan(ctx, request)
475			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
476				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)))
477				continue
478			}
479			branch := worktree.Branch
480			action := fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s (branch %s kept)",
481				config.Contract(canonical), branch)
482			if options.deleteBranches {
483				action = fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s and delete contained branch %s",
484					config.Contract(canonical), branch)
485			}
486			suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestion{
487				row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("untracked worktree branch is contained in %s", base), action: action,
488				apply: func() error {
489					approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
490					if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
491						approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
492					}
493					result, err := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
494					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
495					return err
496				},
497			})
498		}
499		return suggestions, nil
500	}
501	
502	func mergedWorktreeBlocker(row inventory.Row, base, blocker string) suggestion {
503		return suggestion{
504			row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch is contained in %s, but retirement is blocked", base),
505			action: blocker + " — not changed automatically",
506		}
507	}

236	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
237	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
238	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
239		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
240		if err != nil {
241			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current directory before removing worktree: %w", err)
242		}
243		inside, err := pathx.Contains(path, cwd)
244		if err != nil {
245			return fmt.Errorf("compare current directory with worktree %s: %w", path, err)
246		}
247		if inside {
248			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to remove worktree %s while the caller is inside it", path)
249		}
250		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
251		if force {
252			args = append(args, "--force")
253		}
254		args = append(args, path)
255		_, err = run(ctx, dir, args...)
256		return err
257	}

275	// RefState reports whether any ref or commit-ish resolves while preserving
276	// observation failures. A normal rev-parse exit 1 with no diagnostic is an
277	// authoritative missing ref; every other failure remains an error.
278	func RefState(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) (bool, error) {
279		if ref == "" {
280			return false, nil
281		}
282		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")
283		if err == nil {
284			return true, nil
285		}
286		var commandErr *Error
287		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
288		if errors.As(err, &commandErr) && errors.As(commandErr.Err, &exitErr) &&
289			exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 && strings.TrimSpace(commandErr.Stderr) == "" {
290			return false, nil
291		}
292		return false, err
293	}
294	
295	// RefExists is the compatibility predicate for callers where probe failure is
296	// intentionally equivalent to absence. Guarded lifecycle code uses RefState.
297	func RefExists(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) bool {
298		exists, _ := RefState(ctx, dir, ref)
299		return exists
300	}

258		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
259		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"

263		} else if observed.inProgress {

274		conflictVerdict := VerdictMet
275		conflictEvidence := "no unmerged paths"
276		if observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
277			conflictEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("%d unmerged path(s)", observed.status.Conflicted)
278			if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
279				conflictVerdict = VerdictBlocked
280			}
281		}
282		conflictRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
283		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
284			conflictRequirement = RequirementRequired
285		}
286		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionGitConflict, conflictVerdict, conflictRequirement,
287			conflictEvidence, "resolve conflicts before switching branches"))
288	
289		switchVerdict := VerdictMet
290		switchEvidence := "no branch switch is needed"
291		if resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) {
292			switchEvidence = "canonical checkout is clean and may switch branches"
293			if observed.status.Dirty() {
294				switchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
295				switchEvidence = observed.status.Breakdown()
296			}
297		}
298		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionSwitchSafe, switchVerdict, RequirementRequired,
299			switchEvidence, "commit or preserve canonical checkout changes before switching"))

302		targetEvidence := "target branch " + observed.task.Branch + " exists"
303		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed) && !observed.localBranchExists {
304			targetVerdict = VerdictBlocked
305			targetEvidence = "target branch " + observed.task.Branch + " does not exist"
306		}
307		conditions = append(conditions, condition(ConditionTargetBranch, targetVerdict, RequirementRequired,
308			targetEvidence, "restore the local task branch"))
309		return conditions

312	func (s *lifecycleService) resumeRuntimeConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
313		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
314			return []Condition{
315				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
316				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
317				condition(ConditionSavedRuntime, VerdictUnknown, RequirementAdvisory, "saved runtime was not validated", "refresh runtime state"),
318			}
319		}
320		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
321		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is available"
322		if observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
323			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
324			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
325		}
326		if !observed.hasCheckout() {
327			occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
328			occupancyEvidence := "missing checkout cannot be occupied; strict occupancy will be checked after reconstruction"
329			if observed.runtime.Name() == "none" && !s.allowSharedCheckout {
330				occupancyVerdict = VerdictError
331				occupancyEvidence = "runtime=none cannot observe writers after checkout reconstruction"
332			}
333			return []Condition{
334				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
335				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired,
336					occupancyEvidence, "select an observable runtime backend before reconstructing the checkout"),
337				condition(ConditionSavedRuntime, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
338					"saved runtime hint will be revalidated after reconstruction", ""),
339			}
340		}
341		occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr)
342		occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
343		occupancyEvidence := "no other recognized agent occupies the checkout"
344		if s.allowSharedCheckout && occupancyErr == nil {
345			occupancyEvidence = "shared-checkout override accepts the observed or explicitly unobserved runtime occupancy"
346		}
347		if occupancyErr != nil {
348			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
349			occupancyEvidence = occupancyErr.Error()
350			if observed.occupancyErr != nil || observed.occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil ||
351				observed.occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil || observed.occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil ||
352				observed.occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil || occupancyObservationIncomplete(observed.occupancy) {
353				occupancyVerdict = VerdictError
354			}
355		}
356		savedEvidence := "no saved runtime handle"
357		if observed.task.RuntimeHandle != "" {
358			if observed.savedRuntimeLive {
359				savedEvidence = "saved " + observed.runtime.Name() + " handle " + observed.task.RuntimeHandle + " covers the exact checkout"
360			} else {
361				savedEvidence = "saved runtime handle is stale and will be replaced or cleared"
362			}
363		}
364		return []Condition{
365			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired, availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
366			condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop the other recognized agent or use another checkout"),
367			condition(ConditionSavedRuntime, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, savedEvidence, ""),
368		}
369	}
370	
371	func resumeNeedsBranchSwitch(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
372		return observed.mode == task.ModeBranch && observed.hasCheckout() && observed.statusErr == nil &&
373			!observed.status.Detached && observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch
374	}
375	
376	func shouldOpenResumeRuntime(observed lifecycleObservation) bool {
377		return observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.savedRuntimeLive
378	}
379	
380	func resumeEffectCheckout(observed lifecycleObservation) string {
381		if observed.hasCheckout() {
382			return observed.checkout
383		}
384		return observed.desiredWorktree
385	}
386	
387	func resumeRuntimeLabel(candidate task.Task) string {
388		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
389			return candidate.Repo + "/" + candidate.Branch
390		}
391		return candidate.Title()
392	}
393	
394	func resumeFallback(id string, options ResumeOptions) string {
395		parts := []string{"dev", "resume", shellQuote(id)}
396		if !options.FetchRefs {
397			parts = append(parts, "--fetch=false")
398		}
399		if options.NoProvision {
400			parts = append(parts, "--no-provision")
401		}
402		if options.TakeOwnership {
403			parts = append(parts, "--force")
404		}
405		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
406	}

320	func checkoutExactVerdict(observed lifecycleObservation) (Verdict, string) {
321		if observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir {
322			return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("worktree common directory %q differs from %q", observed.worktree.GitCommonDir, observed.gitCommonDir)
323		}
324		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
325			if observed.task.WorktreePath == "" {
326				if observed.task.State != task.Cold || observed.branchMatches != 1 {
327					return VerdictBlocked, "the task has no exact persisted checkout identity"
328				}
329			} else {
330				// ResolveRegisteredWorktree matched the recorded hint by canonical path;
331				// subsequent operations use only the returned registered identity.
332				if observed.worktree.Path == "" {
333					return VerdictBlocked, "the exact registered worktree path is empty"
334				}
335			}
336		} else {
337			if observed.task.WorktreePath != "" {
338				return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("%s task unexpectedly retains worktree path %q", observed.mode, observed.task.WorktreePath)
339			}
340			if observed.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath {
341				return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registered main path %q differs from %q", observed.worktree.Path, observed.repoPath)
342			}
343		}
344		if observed.headErr != nil {
345			return VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
346		}
347		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head {
348			return VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("worktree registry HEAD %q differs from checkout HEAD %q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
349		}
350		return VerdictMet, "exact path, Git common directory, and HEAD match"
351	}

533		}

544	func parkFallback(id string, cold bool, options interface{}) string {
545		parts := []string{"dev", "park", shellQuote(id)}
546		if cold {
547			parts = append(parts, "--cold")
548		}
549		switch value := options.(type) {
550		case ParkWarmOptions:
551			parts = appendParkFlags(parts, value.Next, value.Note, value.CommitWIP, value.Push,
552				value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime)
553			if value.Timeout > 0 {
554				parts = append(parts, "--timeout", value.Timeout.String())
555			}
556			if value.KeepSession {
557				parts = append(parts, "--keep-session")
558			}
559		case ParkColdOptions:
560			parts = appendParkFlags(parts, value.Next, value.Note, value.CommitWIP, value.Push,
561				value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime)
562			if value.Timeout > 0 {
563				parts = append(parts, "--timeout", value.Timeout.String())
564			}
565		}
566		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
567	}
568	
569	func appendParkFlags(parts []string, next, note string, wip, push, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool) []string {
570		if next != "" {
571			parts = append(parts, "--next", shellQuote(next))
572		}
573		if note != "" {
574			parts = append(parts, "--note", shellQuote(note))
575		}
576		if wip {
577			parts = append(parts, "--wip")
578		}
579		if push {
580			parts = append(parts, "--push")
581		}
582		if closeUnknown {
583			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
584		}
585		if assumeNoRuntime {
586			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
587		}
588		return parts
589	}
590	
591	func shellQuote(value string) string {
592		if value != "" && !strings.ContainsAny(value, " \t\n'\"`\\$;&|()<>*") {
593			return value
594		}
595		return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\\''") + "'"
596	}

17	// Options controls only fail-closed observations. Caller protection and active
18	// agent states are never bypassable.
19	type Options struct {
20		CWD               string
21		CallerWorkspaceID string
22		CallerPaneID      string
23		CloseUnknown      bool
24		AssumeNoRuntime   bool
25		PollInterval      time.Duration

29	// Session is one runtime session that currently covers the target checkout.
30	type Session struct {
31		Runtime runtime.Session
32		Panes   []runtime.Pane
33		Mixed   []runtime.Pane

35	
36	// Inspection is a fresh view of every runtime surface covering a checkout.
37	type Inspection struct {
38		Target          string
39		Sessions        []Session
40		ClosedSessions  int
41		Blockers        []string
42		RuntimeUnknown  bool
43		CallerContained bool
44	}
45	
46	// Ready reports whether destructive cleanup may proceed.
47	func (i Inspection) Ready() bool { return len(i.Blockers) == 0 }
48	
49	// Inspect discovers covering sessions and applies caller, mixed-workspace, and
50	// agent-state safety policy.
51	func Inspect(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
52		runtimeName := ""
53		if rt != nil {
54			runtimeName = rt.Name()
55		}
56		if opts.CallerWorkspaceID == "" && runtimeName != "tmux" && runtimeName != "zellij" && runtimeName != "none" {
57			opts.CallerWorkspaceID = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
58		}
59		if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
60			switch runtimeName {
61			case "herdr":
62				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
63			case "tmux":
64				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
65			case "zellij", "none":
66			default:
67				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
68				if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
69					opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
70				}
71			}
72		}
73		evidence, err := runtime.InspectOccupancy(ctx, rt, target, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
74			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyCleanup,
75			CallerWorkspaceID: opts.CallerWorkspaceID,
76			CallerPaneID:      opts.CallerPaneID,
77			CloseUnknown:      opts.CloseUnknown,
78		})
79		if err != nil {
80			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect retirement occupancy: %w", err)
81		}
82		result := Inspection{Target: evidence.Target}
83		cwd := opts.CWD
84		if cwd == "" {
85			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
86			if err != nil {
87				return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve caller directory: %w", err)
88			}
89		}
90		if inside, compareErr := pathx.Contains(evidence.Target, cwd); compareErr != nil {
91			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("compare caller directory: %w", compareErr)
92		} else if inside {
93			result.CallerContained = true
94			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
95				fmt.Sprintf("caller is inside target checkout %s", evidence.Target))
96		}
97	
98		if evidence.CurrentPane.Err != nil {
99			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve current %s runtime pane: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.CurrentPane.Err)
100		}
101		if evidence.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
102			return Inspection{}, evidence.SessionCoverageErr
103		}
104		if !evidence.SessionList.Supported {
105			result.RuntimeUnknown = true
106			if !opts.AssumeNoRuntime {
107				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
108					fmt.Sprintf("runtime backend %s cannot enumerate covering sessions; use the explicit assume-no-runtime acknowledgement from an external caller", evidence.Backend))

111		}
112		if evidence.SessionList.Err != nil {

115			}
116			result.RuntimeUnknown = true
117		}
118		if evidence.AgentActivityList.Err != nil {
119			return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("list %s recognized agents: %w", evidence.Backend, evidence.AgentActivityList.Err)
120		}
121		for _, observed := range evidence.Sessions {
122			result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, Session{
123				Runtime: observed.Runtime,
124				Panes:   observed.Panes,
125				Mixed:   observed.Mixed,
126			})
127			if observed.IsCaller {
128				result.CallerContained = true
129				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
130					fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", observed.Runtime.Handle))
131			}
132			if len(observed.Mixed) > 0 {
133				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
134					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s also contains %d pane(s) outside the target", observed.Runtime.Handle, len(observed.Mixed)))
135			}
136			for _, status := range coveringAgentStatuses(observed.Panes, observed.Runtime.AgentStatus) {
137				appendAgentStatusBlocker(&result, observed.Runtime.Handle, status, opts.CloseUnknown)
138			}
139		}
140		for _, agent := range evidence.Agents {
141			if !agent.Blocking {
142				continue
143			}
144			if agent.IsCaller {
145				result.CallerContained = true
146				if agent.SessionHandle != "" {
147					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
148						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", agent.SessionHandle))
149				} else {
150					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
151						fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime pane %s contains the target checkout", agent.Activity.PaneID))
152				}
153				continue
154			}
155			if agent.SessionHandle == "" {
156				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
157					fmt.Sprintf("recognized agent in pane %s covers the target without a closeable runtime session", agent.Activity.PaneID))

161		}
162		return dedupe(result), nil
163	}

165	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
166	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
167	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
168		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
169		if err != nil {
170			return inspection, err
171		}
172		if !inspection.Ready() {
173			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
174		}
175		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
176			return inspection, nil
177		}
178		interval := opts.PollInterval
179		if interval <= 0 {
180			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
181		}
182		timeout := opts.Timeout
183		if timeout <= 0 {
184			timeout = 5 * time.Second
185		}
186		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
187		closed := make(map[string]bool)
188		for {
189			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
190			if inspectErr != nil {
191				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
192			}
193			if !fresh.Ready() {
194				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
195			}
196			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
197				inspection.Sessions = nil
198				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
199				return inspection, nil
200			}
201			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
202				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
203					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
204			}
205			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
206				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
207				if closed[handle] {
208					continue
209				}
210				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
211					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
212				}
213				closed[handle] = true
214				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
215			}
216			select {
217			case <-ctx.Done():
218				return inspection, ctx.Err()
219			case <-time.After(interval):
220			}
221		}
222	}
223	
224	func coveringAgentStatuses(panes []runtime.Pane, fallback string) []string {
225		set := make(map[string]bool)
226		for _, pane := range panes {
227			if pane.Agent != "" || pane.AgentSession != "" || pane.AgentStatus != "" {
228				set[strings.ToLower(pane.AgentStatus)] = true
229			}
230		}
231		if len(set) == 0 {
232			set[strings.ToLower(fallback)] = true
233		}
234		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
235		for status := range set {
236			out = append(out, status)
237		}
238		sort.Strings(out)
239		return out
240	}
241	
242	func appendAgentStatusBlocker(result *Inspection, handle, rawStatus string, closeUnknown bool) {
243		status := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(rawStatus))
244		switch status {
245		case "idle", "done":
246			// Eligible after all structural checks pass.
247		case "working", "running", "busy", "blocked", "waiting":
248			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
249				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has agent status %s", handle, status))
250		case "", "unknown":
251			if !closeUnknown {
252				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
253					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unknown agent status; pass --close-unknown from outside it", handle))
254			}
255		default:
256			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
257				fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unrecognized agent status %s", handle, status))
258		}
259	}
260	
261	func dedupe(inspection Inspection) Inspection {
262		seen := make(map[string]bool)
263		out := inspection.Blockers[:0]
264		for _, blocker := range inspection.Blockers {
265			if !seen[blocker] {
266				seen[blocker] = true
267				out = append(out, blocker)
268			}
269		}
270		inspection.Blockers = out
271		return inspection
272	}

474	func canonicalRepositoryID(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, queryPath string) (string, error) {
475		commonDir := r.CommonDir
476		if commonDir == "" && r.Bare {
477			commonDir = queryPath
478		}
479		if commonDir == "" && queryPath != "" {
480			if discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, queryPath); err == nil {
481				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
482			}
483		}
484		if commonDir == "" {
485			err := fmt.Errorf("Git common directory is empty")
486			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
487		}
488		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
489		if err != nil {
490			return "", &RepositoryIdentityError{Path: commonDir, Err: err}
491		}
492		return canonical, nil
493	}

496		if limiter == nil {

499		var wg sync.WaitGroup
500		for i := range checkouts {
501			if checkouts[i].Worktree.Bare || checkouts[i].Worktree.Prunable || !checkouts[i].Exists {
502				continue
503			}
504			wg.Add(1)
505			go func(index int) {
506				defer wg.Done()
507				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
508				if !ok {
509					checkouts[index].StatusErr = ctx.Err()
510					return
511				}
512				defer release()
513				checkout := &checkouts[index]
514				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
515				checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(
516					ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status,
517				)
518			}(i)
519		}
520		wg.Wait()
521	}
