145		options := request.Options.(CompleteFFOptions)
146		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
147		relation := effectiveCompletionRelation(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
148		if !relation.Contained() {
149			conditions = append(conditions, completionIntegrationCondition(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage))
150			if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
151				conditions = append(conditions, s.completionIntegrationOccupancyCondition(observed))
152			}
153		}
154	
155		relationEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%s is behind %d and ahead %d relative to %s",
156			observed.task.Branch, relation.BaseOnly, relation.BranchOnly, observed.completionBaseRef)
157		if relation.Contained() {
158			relationEvidence = observed.task.Branch + " is already contained in " + observed.completionBaseRef
159		}
160		conditions = append(conditions, condition(
161			ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, relationEvidence, "",
162		))
163	
164		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
165		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
166			if !relation.Contained() {
167				if relation.BaseOnly > 0 {
168					effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
169						EffectRebaseBranch, "rebase the task branch onto the explicit base", observed.checkout, false, false,
170						map[string]string{"branch": observed.task.Branch, "base": observed.completionBaseRef},
171					))
172				}
173				effects = append(effects,
174					NewEffect(
175						EffectSwitchBase, "switch the canonical main checkout to the explicit base", observed.repoPath, false, false,
176						map[string]string{"base": observed.completionBaseRef, "task-branch": observed.task.Branch},
177					),
178					NewEffect(
179						EffectMergeFF, "fast-forward the explicit base to the task branch", observed.repoPath, false, false,
180						map[string]string{"base": observed.completionBaseRef, "branch": observed.task.Branch, "strategy": "ff-only"},
181					),
182				)
183			}
184			if options.PushBase {
185				effects = append(effects, completionPushBaseEffect(observed))
186			}
187			effects = append(effects, completionTaskUpdateEffect(observed))
188		}
189		return s.completionPlanSpec(
190			request, observed, conditions, effects,
191			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Integrate this task with fast-forward only?"),
192			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--ff", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage, options.PushBase, "", ""),
193			"Fast-forward "+observed.task.Title()+" into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
194		)
195	}
196	
197	func (s *lifecycleService) reviewHandoffSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
198		options := request.Options.(ReviewHandoffOptions)
199		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
200		relation := effectiveCompletionRelation(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
201		relationVerdict := VerdictMet
202		relationEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d commit(s) not in %s", observed.task.Branch, relation.BranchOnly, observed.completionBaseRef)
203		if relation.Contained() {
204			if observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() &&
205				(options.Dirty == DirtyAuto || options.Dirty == DirtyCommit && strings.TrimSpace(options.CommitMessage) == "") {
206				relationEvidence = "reviewability will be recomputed after an explicit dirty policy is selected"
207			} else {
208				relationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
209				relationEvidence = observed.task.Branch + " is already contained in " + observed.completionBaseRef
210			}
211		}
212		conditions = append(conditions,
213			condition(ConditionBranchRelation, relationVerdict, RequirementRequired, relationEvidence,
214				"use fast-forward completion or add reviewable task-branch commits"),
215			completionReviewProviderCondition(observed),
216		)
217	
218		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
219		if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
220			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
221				EffectPushBranch, "publish the task branch for review", observed.task.Branch, false, true,
222				map[string]string{
223					"remote": "origin", "remote-url": observed.reviewRemoteURL,
224					"repository": observed.reviewRepository, "checkout": observed.checkout,
225				},
226			))
227			if observed.reviewResolveErr == nil && observed.reviewProvider != nil && observed.reviewAvailable {
228				effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
229					EffectCreateReview, "create a provider pull or merge request", observed.checkout, false, true,
230					map[string]string{
231						"provider": string(observed.reviewKind), "repository": observed.reviewRepository,
232						"remote-url": observed.reviewRemoteURL, "base": observed.completionBaseRef,
233						"head": observed.task.Branch, "draft": boolString(options.Draft),
234						"title": options.Title, "body": options.Body,
235					},
236				))
237			}
238		}
239		return s.completionPlanSpec(
240			request, observed, conditions, effects,
241			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Publish this task for review?"),
242			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--pr", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage, false, "", ""),
243			"Publish "+observed.task.Title()+" for review into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
244		)
245	}
246	
247	func (s *lifecycleService) verifyMergedSpec(request Request, observed lifecycleObservation) PlanSpec {
248		options := request.Options.(VerifyMergedOptions)
249		conditions := s.completionConditions(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
250		proofCondition := completionProofCondition(observed)
251		proofSurvivesDirtyPolicy := true
252		if options.SquashCommit != "" && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() && options.Dirty == DirtyCommit {
253			proofSurvivesDirtyPolicy = false
254			proofCondition = condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
255				"the squash attestation predates the new commit requested by --dirty=commit",
256				"commit and integrate the dirty work before supplying a fresh squash attestation")
257		}
258		conditions = append(conditions,
259			condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
260				fmt.Sprintf("local relation to %s is behind %d and ahead %d",
261					observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly, observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly), ""),
262			proofCondition,
263		)
264	
265		effects := s.completionDirtyEffects(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage)
266		if !proofSurvivesDirtyPolicy {
267			effects = nil
268		} else if completionDirtyExecutable(observed, options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage) {
269			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
270				EffectVerifyAncestry, "prove exact merge ancestry", observed.completionBaseRef, false, false,
271				map[string]string{
272					"proof-ref": observed.proofRef, "proof-oid": observed.proofOID,
273					"base-ref": observed.completionBaseRef, "base-oid": observed.completionBaseOID,
274				},
275			))
276			if options.PushBase {
277				effects = append(effects, completionPushBaseEffect(observed))
278			}
279			effects = append(effects, completionTaskUpdateEffect(observed))
280		}
281		return s.completionPlanSpec(
282			request, observed, conditions, effects,
283			completionConfirmation(observed, options.Dirty, "Verify this merge and record DONE?"),
284			completionFallback(observed.task.ID, "--merged", options.Dirty, options.CommitMessage,
285				options.PushBase, options.BaseRef, options.SquashCommit),
286			"Verify "+observed.task.Title()+" merged into "+observed.completionBaseRef,
287		)
288	}
289	
290	func (s *lifecycleService) completionPlanSpec(
291		request Request,
292		observed lifecycleObservation,
293		conditions []Condition,
294		effects []Effect,
295		confirmation Confirmation,
296		fallback string,
297		summary string,
298	) PlanSpec {
299		return PlanSpec{
300			Authority:         s.baseAuthority(request, observed),
301			Conditions:        conditions,
302			Effects:           effects,
303			RetainedResources: completionRetainedResources(observed),
304			Confirmation:      confirmation,
305			FallbackCommand:   fallback,
306			Summary:           summary,
307			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
308		}
309	}
310	
311	func (s *lifecycleService) completionConditions(
312		observed lifecycleObservation,
313		dirty DirtyPolicy,
314		message string,
315	) []Condition {
316		conditions := []Condition{
317			condition(ConditionTaskCurrent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
318				"task "+observed.task.ID+" revision "+observed.record.Revision, ""),
319			condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
320				"Git common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, ""),
321		}
322		conditions = append(conditions, completionCheckoutConditions(observed)...)
323		conditions = append(conditions, completionGitConditions(observed, dirty, message)...)
324		conditions = append(conditions, completionArtifactCondition(observed))
325		conditions = append(conditions, s.completionRuntimeConditions(observed)...)
326		conditions = append(conditions, completionBaseCondition(observed))
327		return conditions
328	}
329	
330	func completionCheckoutConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
331		if !observed.hasCheckout() {
332			verdict := VerdictBlocked
333			evidence := "the exact task checkout is not registered"
334			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !isWorktreeNotFound(observed.worktreeErr) {
335				verdict = VerdictError
336				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
337			}
338			return []Condition{
339				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "resume or reconcile the exact checkout"),
340				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout identity is unavailable", "refresh worktree topology"),
341				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unavailable", "refresh worktree topology"),
342				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout branch is unavailable", "restore the named task branch"),
343			}
344		}
345	
346		exactVerdict, exactEvidence := checkoutExactVerdict(observed)
347		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
348		kindEvidence := "canonical main checkout"
349		if observed.mode == task.ModeWorktree {
350			kindEvidence = "exact linked worktree"
351			if !observed.isLinkedWorktree() {
352				kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
353				kindEvidence = "worktree task does not resolve to a linked checkout"
354			}
355		} else if !observed.worktree.Worktree.Main || observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare {
356			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
357			kindEvidence = "branch or direct task does not resolve to Git's canonical main checkout"
358		}
359	
360		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
361		branchEvidence := "checkout and registry name task branch " + observed.task.Branch
362		if observed.task.Branch == "" || observed.statusErr != nil || observed.status.Detached ||
363			observed.status.Branch != observed.task.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached ||
364			observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.task.Branch {
365			branchVerdict = VerdictBlocked
366			branchEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q expected=%q detached=%t",
367				observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.task.Branch,
368				observed.status.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached)
369			if observed.statusErr != nil {
370				branchVerdict = VerdictError
371				branchEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
372			}
373		}
374		return []Condition{
375			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
376			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "reconcile task and worktree identity"),
377			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "reconcile the task checkout mode"),
378			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named task branch"),
379		}
380	}
381	
382	func completionGitConditions(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) []Condition {
383		status := observed.status
384		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
385		statusEvidence := status.Summary()
386		if observed.statusErr != nil {
387			statusVerdict = VerdictError
388			statusEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
389		}
390	
391		finishVerdict := VerdictMet
392		finishEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("fingerprint %s; base-only=%d branch-only=%d",
393			observed.finish.Fingerprint, observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly, observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly)
394		switch {
395		case !observed.hasCheckout():
396			finishVerdict = VerdictUnknown
397			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires the exact checkout"
398		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
399			finishVerdict = VerdictBlocked
400			finishEvidence = "finish analysis requires an explicit base ref"
401		case observed.finishErr != nil:
402			finishVerdict = VerdictError
403			finishEvidence = observed.finishErr.Error()
404		case observed.finish.Fingerprint == "":
405			finishVerdict = VerdictError
406			finishEvidence = "finish analysis returned no content fingerprint"
407		}
408	
409		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
410		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
411		if observed.operationErr != nil {
412			operationVerdict = VerdictError
413			operationEvidence = observed.operationErr.Error()
414		} else if observed.inProgress {
415			operationVerdict = VerdictBlocked
416			operationEvidence = "Git operation " + observed.operation + " is in progress"
417		}
418	
419		conflictVerdict := VerdictMet
420		conflictEvidence := "no unmerged paths"
421		if observed.statusErr != nil {
422			conflictVerdict = VerdictError
423			conflictEvidence = observed.statusErr.Error()
424		} else if observed.status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
425			conflictVerdict = VerdictBlocked
426			conflictEvidence = strconv.Itoa(max(observed.status.Conflicted, observed.finish.Status.Conflicted)) + " conflicted path(s)"
427		}
428	
429		cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence := completionDirtyCondition(observed, dirty, message)
430		return []Condition{
431			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
432			condition(ConditionFinishAnalysis, finishVerdict, RequirementRequired, finishEvidence, "refresh the exact finish analysis"),
433			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
434			condition(ConditionGitConflict, conflictVerdict, RequirementRequired, conflictEvidence, "resolve or abort conflicts before completion"),
435			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementRequired, cleanEvidence, "select fail, commit with a message, or discard"),
436		}
437	}
438	
439	func completionDirtyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) (Verdict, string) {
440		if observed.statusErr != nil {
441			return VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
442		}
443		if !observed.status.Dirty() {
444			return VerdictMet, "checkout is clean; dirty policy " + string(dirty) + " causes no content mutation"
445		}
446		evidence := observed.status.Breakdown()
447		if observed.finishErr == nil {
448			evidence += fmt.Sprintf("; %d path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
449				observed.finish.EquivalentDirty(), observed.completionBaseRef, observed.finish.UniqueDirty())
450		}
451		switch dirty {
452		case DirtyAuto:
453			return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; choose an explicit dirty policy"
454		case DirtyFail:
455			return VerdictBlocked, evidence + "; fail policy refuses dirty completion"
456		case DirtyCommit:
457			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
458				return VerdictNeedsInput, evidence + "; commit-all requires a nonempty message"
459			}
460			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; commit-all was explicitly selected"
461		case DirtyDiscard:
462			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
463				return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires DROP"
464			}
465			return VerdictMet, evidence + "; discard-all was explicitly selected and requires approval"
466		default:
467			return VerdictError, "unknown dirty policy " + string(dirty)
468		}
469	}
470	
471	func completionArtifactCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
472		switch {
473		case !observed.hasCheckout():
474			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
475				"artifact readiness requires the exact checkout", "restore the checkout")
476		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
477			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
478				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
479		case observed.artifact.Ready():
480			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, artifactEvidence(observed), "")
481		default:
482			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
483				artifactEvidence(observed), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
484		}
485	}
486	
487	func (s *lifecycleService) completionRuntimeConditions(observed lifecycleObservation) []Condition {
488		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
489			return []Condition{
490				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
491					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
492				condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
493					observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair recognized-agent observation"),
494			}
495		}
496		availableVerdict := VerdictMet
497		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + runtimeName(observed.runtime) + " was available for strict inspection"
498		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
499			availableVerdict = VerdictBlocked
500			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " is unavailable"
501		}
502		occupancyVerdict, occupancyEvidence := s.completionOccupancyVerdict(observed.occupancy, observed.occupancyErr)
503		return []Condition{
504			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, availableVerdict, RequirementRequired,
505				availableEvidence, "select an available runtime backend"),
506			condition(ConditionAgentOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired,
507				occupancyEvidence, "stop every other recognized agent or use another checkout"),
508		}
509	}
510	
511	func (s *lifecycleService) completionOccupancyVerdict(occupancy runtime.Occupancy, err error) (Verdict, string) {
512		occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(occupancy, err)
513		if occupancyErr == nil {
514			if s.allowSharedCheckout {
515				return VerdictMet, "shared-checkout override accepts the observed or explicitly unobserved runtime occupancy"
516			}
517			return VerdictMet, "no other recognized agent occupies the checkout; only the exact caller pane is excluded"
518		}
519		verdict := VerdictBlocked
520		if err != nil || occupancy.CurrentPane.Err != nil || occupancy.SessionCoverageErr != nil ||
521			occupancy.SessionList.Err != nil || occupancy.AgentActivityList.Err != nil || occupancyObservationIncomplete(occupancy) {
522			verdict = VerdictError
523		}
524		return verdict, occupancyErr.Error()
525	}
526	
527	func completionBaseCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
528		requirement := RequirementRequired
529		if observed.mode == task.ModeDirect {
530			requirement = RequirementAdvisory
531		}
532		switch {
533		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
534			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, requirement,
535				"completion has no explicit base ref", "record or select an explicit base ref")
536		case observed.completionBaseOIDErr != nil:
537			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, requirement,
538				observed.completionBaseOIDErr.Error(), "restore the exact base ref")
539		case observed.completionBaseOID == "":
540			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, requirement,
541				"base ref "+observed.completionBaseRef+" resolved to no commit", "restore the exact base ref")
542		default:
543			return condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, requirement,
544				fmt.Sprintf("base %s at %s", observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID), "")
545		}
546	}
547	
548	func completionIntegrationCondition(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) Condition {
549		if observed.mode == task.ModeBranch {
550			verdict, _ := completionDirtyCondition(observed, dirty, message)
551			if verdict == VerdictMet {
552				return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
553					"the exact canonical task checkout will be clean before switching to "+observed.completionBaseRef, "")
554			}
555			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, verdict, RequirementRequired,
556				"the canonical task checkout is not yet switchable", "finalize its dirty policy")
557		}
558		integration := observed.integration
559		switch {
560		case integration.worktreeErr != nil:
561			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
562				integration.worktreeErr.Error(), "repair canonical main worktree identity")
563		case !integration.worktreeFound:
564			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
565				"canonical main checkout is not registered", "restore the canonical main checkout")
566		case integration.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath || integration.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
567			!integration.worktree.Worktree.Main || integration.worktree.Worktree.Bare:
568			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
569				"integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout", "repair worktree topology")
570		case integration.statusErr != nil:
571			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
572				integration.statusErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout status observation")
573		case integration.headErr != nil:
574			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
575				integration.headErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout HEAD observation")
576		case integration.operationErr != nil:
577			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
578				integration.operationErr.Error(), "repair canonical checkout Git-operation observation")
579		case integration.inProgress:
580			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
581				"canonical checkout has Git operation "+integration.operation+" in progress", "finish or abort it")
582		case integration.status.Conflicted > 0:
583			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
584				fmt.Sprintf("canonical checkout has %d conflicted path(s)", integration.status.Conflicted), "resolve or abort conflicts")
585		case integration.status.Dirty():
586			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
587				"canonical checkout is dirty: "+integration.status.Breakdown(), "preserve its unrelated bytes before integration")
588		case integration.worktree.Worktree.Head != integration.head:
589			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
590				"canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD", "refresh worktree topology")
591		default:
592			return condition(ConditionIntegrationTarget, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
593				"canonical main checkout is exact, clean, conflict-free, and switchable", "")
594		}
595	}
596	
597	func (s *lifecycleService) completionIntegrationOccupancyCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
598		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
599			return condition(ConditionIntegrationOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
600				observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution")
601		}
602		verdict, evidence := s.completionOccupancyVerdict(observed.integration.occupancy, observed.integration.occupancyErr)
603		return condition(ConditionIntegrationOccupancy, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence,
604			"stop every other recognized agent in the canonical integration checkout")
605	}
606	
607	func completionReviewProviderCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
608		switch {
609		case observed.reviewResolveErr != nil:
610			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementAdvisory,
611				observed.reviewResolveErr.Error()+"; a successful branch push remains a valid publication", "open the review manually")
612		case observed.reviewProvider == nil:
613			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementAdvisory,
614				"no forge provider was resolved; a successful branch push remains a valid publication", "open the review manually")
615		case !observed.reviewAvailable:
616			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictUnsupported, RequirementAdvisory,
617				fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s is unavailable; a successful branch push remains a valid publication",
618					observed.reviewKind, observed.reviewProvider.Bin()), "install or authenticate the provider CLI, or open the review manually")
619		default:
620			return condition(ConditionReviewProvider, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
621				fmt.Sprintf("%s provider CLI %s will create the review", observed.reviewKind, observed.reviewProvider.Bin()), "")
622		}
623	}
624	
625	func completionProofCondition(observed lifecycleObservation) Condition {
626		switch {
627		case observed.completionBaseRef == "":
628			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
629				"merge proof requires an exact base ref", "select a local or explicit remote-tracking base ref")
630		case observed.completionBaseOIDErr != nil:
631			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
632				observed.completionBaseOIDErr.Error(), "restore the selected base ref")
633		case observed.completionBaseOID == "":
634			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
635				"merge proof requires an exact base OID", "restore the selected base ref")
636		case observed.proofRef == "":
637			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
638				"merge proof ref is empty", "restore the task branch or name an exact squash commit")
639		case observed.proofOIDErr != nil:
640			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
641				observed.proofOIDErr.Error(), "restore the exact proof ref")
642		case observed.proofOID == "":
643			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
644				"proof ref "+observed.proofRef+" resolved to no commit", "restore the exact proof commit")
645		case observed.proofErr != nil:
646			return condition(ConditionMergeProof, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
647				observed.proofErr.Error(), "repair local ancestry observation")
648		case !observed.proofContained:

652				"fetch explicitly if desired, then select the freshly observed ref; no fetch is assumed")
653		default:

655				fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is an ancestor of %s (%s)",
656					observed.proofRef, observed.proofOID, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.completionBaseOID), "")
657		}

660	func (s *lifecycleService) completionDirtyEffects(
661		observed lifecycleObservation,
662		dirty DirtyPolicy,
663		message string,
664	) []Effect {
665		if observed.statusErr != nil || !observed.status.Dirty() {
666			return nil
667		}
668		switch dirty {
669		case DirtyCommit:
670			if strings.TrimSpace(message) == "" {
671				return nil
672			}
673			return []Effect{NewEffect(
674				EffectCommitAll, "commit every staged, unstaged, and untracked change", observed.checkout, false, false,
675				map[string]string{"message": strings.TrimSpace(message), "scope": "all"},
676			)}
677		case DirtyDiscard:
678			details := map[string]string{"scope": "all", "finish-fingerprint": observed.finish.Fingerprint}
679			if observed.finish.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
680				details["token"] = "DROP"
681			}
682			return []Effect{NewEffect(
683				EffectDiscardAll, "discard every staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked change", observed.checkout, true, false,
684				details,
685			)}
686		default:
687			return nil
688		}
689	}

691	func completionDirtyExecutable(observed lifecycleObservation, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string) bool {
692		if observed.statusErr != nil || !observed.status.Dirty() {
693			return true
694		}
695		switch dirty {
696		case DirtyCommit:
697			return strings.TrimSpace(message) != ""
698		case DirtyDiscard:
699			return true
700		default:
701			return false
702		}
703	}

753	func completionFallback(id, mode string, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string, push bool, baseRef, squash string) string {
754		parts := []string{"dev", "done", shellQuote(id)}
755		if mode != "" {
756			parts = append(parts, mode)
757		}
758		if dirty != DirtyAuto {
759			parts = append(parts, "--dirty="+string(dirty))
760		}
761		if dirty == DirtyCommit && strings.TrimSpace(message) != "" {
762			parts = append(parts, "--message", shellQuote(strings.TrimSpace(message)))
763		}
764		if baseRef != "" {
765			parts = append(parts, "--base-ref", shellQuote(baseRef))
766		}
767		if squash != "" {
768			parts = append(parts, "--confirm-squash", shellQuote(squash))
769		}
770		if push {
771			parts = append(parts, "--push")
772		}
773		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
774	}

776	func gitIsAncestor(ctx context.Context, dir, ancestor, descendant string) (bool, error) {
777		_, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", ancestor, descendant)
778		if err == nil {
779			return true, nil
780		}
781		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
782		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 {
783			return false, nil
784		}
785		return false, err
786	}

15	func (e *executionState) applyCompleteDirect(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
16		observed := &e.observed
17		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
18			switch effect.Code {
19			case EffectCommitAll, EffectDiscardAll:
20				if err := e.applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx, effect); err != nil {
21					return e.fail(err, "the task checkout and lifecycle state were retained; inspect the content finalization before retrying")
22				}
23			case EffectPushBranch:
24				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
25					return e.fail(err, "refresh direct completion before pushing")
26				}
27				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
28					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
29					if pushErr != nil {
30						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
31					}
32					return "pushed origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
33				})
34				if err != nil {
35					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and task remain active; resolve the push and retry")
36				}
37				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, false); err != nil {
38					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after direct push: %w", err), "inspect the pushed branch before retrying")
39				}
40			case EffectUpdateTask:
41				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
42					return e.fail(err, "refresh direct completion before recording DONE")
43				}
44				if err := e.writeCompletionDone(effect); err != nil {
45					return e.fail(err, "Git effects may already be complete; reload the task and retry the idempotent DONE write")
46				}

50		}
51		return e.result(), nil
52	}

205	func (e *executionState) applyReviewHandoff(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
206		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(ReviewHandoffOptions)
207		observed := &e.observed
208		pushed := false
209		created := false
210	
211		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
212			switch effect.Code {
213			case EffectCommitAll, EffectDiscardAll:
214				if err := e.applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx, effect); err != nil {
215					return e.fail(err, "the task remains active; inspect content finalization and refresh review handoff")
216				}
217			case EffectPushBranch:
218				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
219					return e.fail(err, "refresh review handoff before publishing the branch")
220				}
221				if err := e.service.revalidateReviewRemote(ctx, observed); err != nil {
222					return e.fail(err, "origin changed; refresh review handoff before publishing")
223				}
224				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
225					_, pushErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, observed.checkout, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", observed.task.Branch)
226					if pushErr != nil {
227						return "", fmt.Errorf("push %s for review: %w", observed.task.Branch, pushErr)
228					}
229					return "published origin/" + observed.task.Branch, nil
230				})
231				if err != nil {
232					return e.fail(err, "the task state and resources remain unchanged; resolve the push and retry")
233				}
234				pushed = true
235				if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, false); err != nil {
236					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("refresh after review push: %w", err), "inspect the published branch before retrying")
237				}
238			case EffectCreateReview:
239				if !pushed {
240					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "review creation reached before branch publication"})
241				}
242				if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
243					return e.fail(err, "refresh checkout authority after the successful push before creating review")
244				}
245				if err := e.service.revalidateReviewRemote(ctx, observed); err != nil {
246					return e.fail(err, "origin changed after publication; do not create review against a different repository")
247				}
248				if observed.reviewProvider == nil || !observed.reviewAvailable || !observed.reviewProvider.Available() {
249					err := errors.New("approved forge provider became unavailable after branch publication")
250					stepErr := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) { return "", err })
251					return e.fail(stepErr, "the branch is published and task state is unchanged; open the review manually or retry provider creation")
252				}
253				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
254					url, createErr := e.service.createPR(ctx, observed.reviewProvider, observed.checkout,
255						completionReviewRequest(*observed, options))
256					if createErr != nil {
257						return "", fmt.Errorf("create %s review: %w", observed.reviewKind, createErr)
258					}
259					created = true
260					if strings.TrimSpace(url) != "" {
261						e.handoff = &Handoff{Kind: HandoffURL, URL: strings.TrimSpace(url), Label: observed.task.Title()}
262						return "created review at " + strings.TrimSpace(url), nil
263					}
264					return "provider reported successful review creation without a URL", nil
265				})
266				if err != nil {
267					return e.fail(err, "the branch is published and task state is unchanged; retry review creation or open it manually")
268				}
269			default:
270				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected ReviewHandoff effect " + string(effect.Code)})
271			}
272		}
273		if !pushed {
274			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "review handoff completed without publishing the branch"})
275		}
276		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
277			return e.fail(err, "the branch is published; refresh local safety evidence before reporting review readiness")
278		}
279		if !created {
280			if warning := reviewProviderWarning(*observed); warning != "" {
281				e.warnings = append(e.warnings, warning)
282			}
283		}
284		e.milestone = MilestoneReviewReady
285		e.snapshot = "task:" + e.revision
286		return e.result(), nil
287	}

341				}
342				if err := e.writeCompletionDone(effect); err != nil {
343					return e.fail(err, "the verified refs and resources remain; reload the task and retry the DONE write")
344				}
345			default:
346				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected VerifyMerged effect " + string(effect.Code)})
347			}
348		}
349		return e.result(), nil
350	}

352	func (e *executionState) applyCompletionDirtyEffect(ctx context.Context, effect Effect) error {
353		observed := &e.observed
354		if err := e.service.revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx, observed); err != nil {
355			return err
356		}
357		before := observed.finish
358		beforeBranchOID := observed.completionBranchOID
359		err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
360			switch effect.Code {
361			case EffectCommitAll:
362				message := effect.Details.Map()["message"]
363				if commitErr := e.service.commitAll(ctx, observed.checkout, message); commitErr != nil {
364					return "commit-all may have changed the index", fmt.Errorf("commit all checkout changes: %w", commitErr)
365				}
366				return "committed all checkout changes", nil
367			case EffectDiscardAll:
368				if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, observed.checkout); discardErr != nil {
369					return "discard-all may have partially reset checkout content", fmt.Errorf("discard all checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
370				}
371				return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
372			default:
373				return "", &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected dirty effect " + string(effect.Code)}
374			}
375		})
376		if err != nil {
377			e.partial = true
378			return err
379		}
380		allowBaseMove := observed.mode == task.ModeDirect && effect.Code == EffectCommitAll
381		if err := e.service.refreshCompletionCheckout(ctx, observed, observed.task.Branch, allowBaseMove); err != nil {
382			return fmt.Errorf("refresh after %s: %w", effect.Code, err)
383		}
384		if observed.finish.Status.Dirty() || observed.finish.Status.Conflicted > 0 || observed.inProgress {
385			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again after %s: %s", effect.Code, observed.finish.Status.Breakdown())
386		}
387		switch effect.Code {
388		case EffectCommitAll:
389			parent, parentErr := e.service.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBranchOID+"^")
390			if parentErr != nil || parent != beforeBranchOID {
391				return staleBoundary("commit-all did not create exactly one normal commit from the approved branch OID")
392			}
393			if observed.mode == task.ModeDirect {
394				if observed.finish.Relation != (gitx.BranchRelation{}) {
395					return staleBoundary("direct commit changed the self-relation unexpectedly")
396				}
397			} else if observed.finish.Relation.BaseOnly != before.Relation.BaseOnly ||
398				observed.finish.Relation.BranchOnly != before.Relation.BranchOnly+1 {
399				return staleBoundary("commit-all changed branch relation by more than the declared single commit")
400			}
401		case EffectDiscardAll:
402			if observed.completionBranchOID != beforeBranchOID || observed.finish.Relation != before.Relation {
403				return staleBoundary("discard-all unexpectedly changed committed branch identity or relation")
404			}
405		}
406		if observed.proofRef == observed.task.Branch {
407			observed.proofOID = observed.completionBranchOID
408		} else if e.plan.Action == VerifyMerged && effect.Code == EffectCommitAll {
409			return staleBoundary("dirty commit created a new task tip that is not represented by the approved merge proof")
410		}
411		return nil
412	}

414	func (e *executionState) writeCompletionDone(effect Effect) error {
415		return e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
416			candidate := e.observed.task
417			candidate.State = task.Done
418			updated, updateErr := e.service.taskUpdate(e.tx, &candidate, e.revision)
419			if updateErr != nil {
420				return "", fmt.Errorf("write DONE task state: %w", updateErr)
421			}
422			if updated == nil {
423				return "", errors.New("write DONE task state returned no revision")
424			}
425			e.snapshot = "task:" + updated.Revision
426			e.observed.task = updated.Task
427			e.milestone = MilestoneMerged
428			return "recorded DONE at revision " + updated.Revision, nil
429		})
430	}

432	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateReviewRemote(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
433		remoteURL := strings.TrimSpace(s.gitRemote(ctx, observed.repoPath, "origin"))
434		identityKind, repository := forge.IdentityFromURL(remoteURL)
435		kind := s.detectForge(ctx, observed.repoPath)
436		if identityKind != forge.Unknown {
437			if kind != forge.Unknown && kind != identityKind {
438				return staleBoundary("detected forge no longer matches origin repository identity")
439			}
440			kind = identityKind
441		}
442		if remoteURL != observed.reviewRemoteURL || kind != observed.reviewKind || repository != observed.reviewRepository {
443			return staleBoundary("origin URL or forge repository identity changed after planning")
444		}
445		return nil
446	}

448	func (s *lifecycleService) revalidateCompletionSafety(ctx context.Context, observed *lifecycleObservation) error {
449		if err := s.revalidateRepository(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
450			return err
451		}
452		if err := s.revalidateGitBaseline(ctx, *observed); err != nil {
453			return err
454		}
455		if observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.completionBranch ||
456			observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.completionBranch {
457			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("completion checkout branch changed: registry=%q status=%q expected=%q",
458				observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.completionBranch))
459		}
460		if observed.inProgress || observed.operationErr != nil || observed.status.Conflicted > 0 {
461			return errors.New("completion checkout acquired a Git operation or conflict")
462		}
463		freshFinish, err := s.analyzeFinish(ctx, observed.checkout, observed.completionBaseRef, observed.task.Branch)
464		if err != nil {
465			return staleBoundary("finish analysis failed during revalidation: " + err.Error())
466		}
467		if finishAuthority(freshFinish, nil) != finishAuthority(observed.finish, observed.finishErr) {
468			return staleBoundary("finish content fingerprint or branch relation changed")
469		}
470		baseOID, err := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.completionBaseRef)
471		if err != nil || baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {
472			return staleBoundary("completion base ref or OID changed")
473		}
474		if err := s.revalidateCompletionArtifacts(ctx, observed); err != nil {
475			return err
476		}
477		if err := s.revalidateCompletionOccupancy(ctx, observed); err != nil {
478			return err
479		}
480		return nil
481	}

644		if err != nil {

646		}
647		if compareAuthority && integrationAuthority(fresh) != integrationAuthority(observed.integration) {
648			return staleBoundary("canonical integration checkout or occupancy changed")
649		}
650		if expectedBranch != "" && (fresh.status.Detached || fresh.status.Branch != expectedBranch ||
651			fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch != expectedBranch) {

653				fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch, fresh.status.Branch, expectedBranch))
654		}
655		observed.integration = fresh

659	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectIntegrationTarget(
660		ctx context.Context,
661		observed *lifecycleObservation,
662	) (completionIntegrationObservation, error) {
663		var fresh completionIntegrationObservation
664		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.repoPath)
665		fresh.worktree, fresh.worktreeErr = registered, err
666		if err != nil {
667			return fresh, err
668		}
669		fresh.worktreeFound = true
670		if registered.Path != observed.repoPath || registered.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir ||
671			!registered.Worktree.Main || registered.Worktree.Bare {
672			return fresh, errors.New("integration target is not the exact canonical main checkout")
673		}
674		fresh.status, fresh.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, observed.repoPath)
675		if fresh.statusErr != nil {
676			return fresh, fresh.statusErr
677		}
678		if fresh.status.Dirty() || fresh.status.Conflicted > 0 {
679			return fresh, fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout is not clean: %s", fresh.status.Breakdown())
680		}
681		fresh.head, fresh.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, observed.repoPath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
682		if fresh.headErr != nil {
683			return fresh, fresh.headErr
684		}
685		fresh.head = strings.TrimSpace(fresh.head)
686		if registered.Worktree.Head != fresh.head {
687			return fresh, errors.New("canonical worktree registry HEAD differs from checkout HEAD")
688		}
689		fresh.operation, fresh.inProgress, fresh.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, observed.repoPath)
690		if fresh.operationErr != nil {
691			return fresh, fresh.operationErr
692		}
693		if fresh.inProgress {
694			return fresh, errors.New("canonical integration checkout has Git operation " + fresh.operation + " in progress")
695		}
696		fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr = s.inspectOccupancy(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.repoPath, runtime.OccupancyOptions{
697			Profile:           runtime.OccupancyStrict,
698			CallerWorkspaceID: observed.taskflowCallerWorkspace,
699			CallerPaneID:      observed.taskflowCallerPane,
700		})
701		if occupancyErr := s.writerOccupancyError(fresh.occupancy, fresh.occupancyErr); occupancyErr != nil {
702			return fresh, occupancyErr
703		}
704		return fresh, nil
705	}

707	func (s *lifecycleService) refreshIntegrationTarget(

714			return err
715		}
716		if fresh.status.Detached || fresh.status.Branch != expectedBranch || fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch != expectedBranch {
717			return fmt.Errorf("canonical integration checkout branch is registry=%q status=%q expected=%q",
718				fresh.worktree.Worktree.Branch, fresh.status.Branch, expectedBranch)
719		}
720		observed.integration = fresh
721		return nil
722	}

755		observed *lifecycleObservation,
756	) (bool, error) {

760		}
761		if baseOID != observed.completionBaseOID {

765		if err != nil {
766			return false, err
767		}

769			return false, staleBoundary("verification proof ref moved from its expected OID")
770		}
771		contained, err := s.isAncestor(ctx, observed.repoPath, proofOID, baseOID)
772		if err != nil {
773			return false, err
774		}
775		observed.proofContained = contained
776		observed.proofErr = nil
777		return contained, nil

122			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "  dev done --merged  verify a branch that was merged outside dev")
123			return nil
124		}

126		prompted := false
127		if view.Status.Dirty() {
128			switch selection.Dirty {
129			case flow.DirtyFail:
130				return dirtyFinishError(selected, plan)
131			case flow.DirtyAuto:
132				if !interactive {
133					return dirtyFinishError(selected, plan)
134				}
135				choice, promptErr := p.choice("Dirty changes (c=commit, d=discard, q=cancel)", "cancel",
136					"commit (c), discard (d), cancel (q)", map[string]string{
137						"c": "commit", "commit": "commit",
138						"d": "discard", "discard": "discard", "drop": "discard",
139						"q": "cancel", "cancel": "cancel",
140					})
141				if canceledDone(app, promptErr, choice == "cancel") {
142					return nil
143				}
144				if promptErr != nil {
145					return promptErr
146				}
147				selection.Dirty = flow.DirtyPolicy(choice)
148				prompted = true
149				plan, err = replanDone(ctx, session, plan, doneActionOptions(selected, selection, opts))
150				if err != nil {
151					return err
152				}
153				if err := doneFatalPreflightError(selected, plan); err != nil {
154					return err
155				}
156			}
157	
158			if selection.Dirty == flow.DirtyCommit && strings.TrimSpace(selection.Message) == "" {
159				if !interactive {
160					return errors.New("--message is required with --dirty=commit outside an interactive terminal")
161				}
162				message, promptErr := p.line("Commit message", "chore: finalize "+selected.Title())
163				if canceledDone(app, promptErr, false) {
164					return nil
165				}
166				if promptErr != nil {
167					return promptErr
168				}
169				selection.Message = strings.TrimSpace(message)
170				if selection.Message == "" {
171					return errors.New("commit message must not be empty")
172				}
173				prompted = true
174				plan, err = replanDone(ctx, session, plan, doneActionOptions(selected, selection, opts))
175				if err != nil {
176					return err
177				}
178				if err := doneFatalPreflightError(selected, plan); err != nil {
179					return err
180				}
181			}
182			if selection.Dirty == flow.DirtyDiscard {
183				if !interactive && !opts.Yes {
184					return errors.New("--dirty=discard outside an interactive terminal requires --yes")
185				}
186				if interactive && !opts.Yes {
187					prompted = true
188				}
189			}
190		}
191	
192		view = doneView(plan)
193		if mode != task.ModeDirect && selection.Integration == doneIntegrationNone {
194			if view.contained() && !(view.Status.Dirty() && selection.Dirty == flow.DirtyCommit) {
195				selection.Integration = doneIntegrationFF
196				prompted = true
197			} else {
198				choice, promptErr := p.choice("Integration (f=fast-forward, p=PR, q=cancel)", "ff",
199					"fast-forward (f), pull request (p), cancel (q)", map[string]string{
200						"f": "ff", "ff": "ff", "fast-forward": "ff",
201						"p": "pr", "pr": "pr", "pull-request": "pr",
202						"q": "cancel", "cancel": "cancel",
203					})
204				if canceledDone(app, promptErr, choice == "cancel") {
205					return nil
206				}
207				if promptErr != nil {
208					return promptErr
209				}
210				selection.Integration = doneIntegration(choice)
211				prompted = true
212				plan, err = replanDone(ctx, session, plan, doneActionOptions(selected, selection, opts))
213				if err != nil {
214					return err
215				}
216				if err := doneFatalPreflightError(selected, plan); err != nil {
217					return err
218				}
219			}
220		}
221	
222		if err := donePlanReadinessError(selected, plan, selection); err != nil {
223			return err
224		}
225	
226		approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
227		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped && opts.Yes {
228			approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
229		}
230		if prompted && !opts.Yes {
231			confirmed, token, promptErr := confirmDonePlan(app, p, selected, plan)
232			if canceledDone(app, promptErr, !confirmed) {
233				return nil
234			}
235			if promptErr != nil {
236				return promptErr
237			}
238			if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
239				approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, token)
240			}
241		}
242		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped && approval.Token == "" {
243			return errors.New("destructive finish plan requires its typed confirmation")
244		}
245	
246		if opts.ConfirmSquash != "" {
247			app.warnf("accepting operator attestation that squash commit %s represents branch %s",
248				opts.ConfirmSquash, selected.Branch)
249		}
250		result, applyErr := session.apply(ctx, plan, approval)
251		renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
252		if applyErr != nil {
253			return presentDoneApplyError(result, applyErr)
254		}
255		final, err := session.finalTask(app)
256		if err != nil {
257			return err
258		}
259		return renderDoneSuccess(app, selected, final, plan, result, doneView(initial))
260	}

262	func doneActionOptions(selected task.Task, selection doneSelection, opts doneOptions) flow.ActionOptions {
263		if selected.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
264			return flow.CompleteDirectOptions{
265				Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message, Push: opts.Push,
266			}
267		}
268		switch selection.Integration {
269		case doneIntegrationPR:
270			return flow.ReviewHandoffOptions{Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message}
271		case doneIntegrationMerged:
272			return flow.VerifyMergedOptions{
273				Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message,
274				BaseRef: opts.BaseRef, SquashCommit: opts.ConfirmSquash, PushBase: opts.Push,
275			}
276		default:
277			return flow.CompleteFFOptions{
278				Dirty: selection.Dirty, CommitMessage: selection.Message, PushBase: opts.Push,
279			}
280		}
281	}

283	func replanDone(
284		ctx context.Context,
285		session lifecycleSession,
286		previous flow.Plan,
287		options flow.ActionOptions,
288	) (flow.Plan, error) {
289		fresh, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
290		if err != nil {
291			if errors.Is(err, flow.ErrStalePlan) {
292				return flow.Plan{}, presentDoneApplyError(flow.Result{}, err)
293			}
294			return flow.Plan{}, err
295		}
296		if changed := changedDoneAuthority(previous, fresh); changed != "" {
297			stale := &flow.StalePlanError{
298				ExpectedPlanID: previous.PlanID,
299				ActualPlanID:   fresh.PlanID,
300				Reason:         changed + " changed while the finish plan was open",
301			}
302			return flow.Plan{}, presentDoneApplyError(flow.Result{}, stale)
303		}
304		return fresh, nil
305	}
306	
307	func changedDoneAuthority(previous, fresh flow.Plan) string {
308		before := previous.AuthorityFields()
309		after := fresh.AuthorityFields()
310		keys := []string{
311			"task.revision", "task.mode", "task.state", "task.repo-path", "task.branch", "task.base", "task.worktree-path",
312			"repo.git-common-dir", "worktree.fingerprint",
313			"git.status-error", "git.branch", "git.detached", "git.upstream", "git.ahead", "git.behind",
314			"git.changed", "git.staged", "git.unstaged", "git.untracked", "git.conflicted", "git.head",
315			"git.base-oid", "git.upstream-oid", "git.operation", "git.operation-active", "git.operation-error",
316			"artifact.fingerprint", "finish.authority", "completion.base-ref", "completion.base-oid",
317			"completion.base-oid-error", "completion.expected-branch", "completion.branch-oid",
318			"runtime.backend", "runtime.available", "runtime.occupancy-fingerprint", "runtime.occupancy-error",
319		}
320		if previous.Action == fresh.Action {
321			keys = append(keys,
322				"completion.proof-ref", "completion.proof-oid", "completion.proof-oid-error",
323				"completion.proof-contained", "completion.proof-error", "completion.integration",
324				"review.kind", "review.remote-url", "review.repository", "review.provider-bin",
325				"review.provider-error", "review.provider-available",
326			)
327		}
328		for _, key := range keys {
329			if before[key] != after[key] {
330				return key
331			}
332		}
333		return ""
334	}

336	func canceledDone(app *App, err error, canceled bool) bool {
337		if errors.Is(err, errPromptCanceled) || canceled {
338			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Canceled; nothing was changed.")
339			return true
340		}
341		return false
342	}

344	func doneFatalPreflightError(selected task.Task, plan flow.Plan) error {
345		view := doneView(plan)
346		if view.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
347			return fmt.Errorf("%s has %d conflicted path(s); resolve or abort the merge/rebase before finishing",
348				config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), view.Status.Conflicted)
349		}
350		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionCheckoutPresent); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
351			return fmt.Errorf("%s no longer exists — resume the task first", config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath))
352		}
353		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionExplicitBase); ok &&
354			condition.Requirement == flow.RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
355			return fmt.Errorf("cannot determine the base branch for %s — pass --base when starting a task", selected.Repo)
356		}
357		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionFinishAnalysis); ok && condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictError {
358			return errors.New(condition.Evidence)
359		}
360		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionArtifactReady); ok &&
361			(condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictBlocked || condition.Verdict == flow.VerdictError) {
362			return fmt.Errorf("artifact readiness for %s is blocked: %s; finalize or discard the intent before integration",
363				config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence)
364		}
365		return nil
366	}
367	
368	func donePlanReadinessError(selected task.Task, plan flow.Plan, selection doneSelection) error {
369		if plan.Availability == flow.AvailabilityReady {
370			return nil
371		}
372		if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionCheckoutClean); ok &&
373			condition.Requirement == flow.RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
374			switch selection.Dirty {
375			case flow.DirtyAuto, flow.DirtyFail:
376				return dirtyFinishError(selected, plan)
377			case flow.DirtyCommit:
378				if strings.TrimSpace(selection.Message) == "" {
379					return errors.New("--message is required with --dirty=commit outside an interactive terminal")
380				}
381			}
382		}
383		if plan.Action == flow.ReviewHandoff {
384			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionBranchRelation); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
385				base := doneView(plan).Base
386				return fmt.Errorf("%s is already contained in %s; use --ff to finalize cleanup instead of opening a PR",
387					selected.Branch, base)
388			}
389		}
390		if plan.Action == flow.VerifyMerged {
391			if condition, ok := doneCondition(plan, flow.ConditionMergeProof); ok && condition.Verdict != flow.VerdictMet {
392				fields := plan.AuthorityFields()
393				return fmt.Errorf("cannot verify %s is contained in %s", fields["completion.proof-ref"], fields["completion.base-ref"])
394			}
395		}
396		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
397		parts := make([]string, 0, len(blocking))
398		for _, condition := range blocking {
399			message := string(condition.Code) + ": " + condition.Evidence
400			if condition.Remediation != "" {
401				message += " (" + condition.Remediation + ")"
402			}
403			parts = append(parts, message)
404		}
405		if len(parts) == 0 {
406			return fmt.Errorf("finish plan is %s: %w", plan.Availability, flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
407		}
408		return fmt.Errorf("%s is %s: %s: %w", plan.Summary, plan.Availability,
409			strings.Join(parts, "; "), flow.ErrPlanNotReady)
410	}

412	func dirtyFinishError(t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) error {
413		view := doneView(plan)
414		return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes: %s; branch relation to %s is behind %d, ahead %d; "+
415			"%d dirty path(s) match %s and %d contain unique content",
416			config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), view.Status.Breakdown(), view.Base,
417			view.BaseOnly, view.BranchOnly, view.Equivalent, view.Base, view.Unique)
418	}

420	func renderDonePreflight(app *App, t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) {
421		view := doneView(plan)
422		s := app.outStyle()
423		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", s.title("Finish"), t.Title())
424		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s      %s\n", s.label("branch"), t.Branch)
425		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s        %s\n", s.label("base"), view.Base)
426		switch {
427		case view.BaseOnly == 0 && view.BranchOnly == 0:
428			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already equal to %s (behind 0, ahead 0)", view.Base)))
429		case view.contained():
430			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already contained in %s (behind %d, ahead 0)", view.Base, view.BaseOnly)))
431		default:
432			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("behind %d, ahead %d relative to %s",
433				view.BaseOnly, view.BranchOnly, view.Base)))
434		}
435		if !view.Status.Dirty() {
436			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.success("clean"))
437			return
438		}
439		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.warning(view.Status.Breakdown()))
440		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s, %s\n", s.label("contents"),
441			s.success(fmt.Sprintf("%d match %s", view.Equivalent, view.Base)),
442			s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("%d unique", view.Unique)))
443		for _, change := range view.Changes {
444			marker := s.warning("unique")
445			if change.BaseEquivalent {
446				marker = s.success("matches " + view.Base)
447			}
448			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s%s %s\n", marker,
449				strings.Repeat(" ", max(0, 12-width(marker))), change.Path)
450		}
451	}

453	func confirmDonePlan(app *App, p *prompter, t task.Task, plan flow.Plan) (bool, string, error) {
454		view := doneView(plan)
455		s := app.outStyle()
456		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\n"+s.title("Summary"))
457		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s        %s\n", s.label("task"), t.Title())
458		switch {
459		case donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectCommitAll):
460			message := doneEffectDetails(plan, flow.EffectCommitAll)["message"]
461			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("commit all as %q", message)))
462		case donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectDiscardAll):
463			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.danger("discard all staged, unstaged and untracked changes"))
464		default:
465			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.success("none"))
466		}
467		switch {
468		case plan.Action == flow.ReviewHandoff:
469			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.review("open a PR into "+view.Base))
470		case plan.Action == flow.VerifyMerged:
471			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("verify merge into "+view.Base))
472		case !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectMergeFF) && !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectRebaseBranch):
473			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("already contained in "+view.Base+"; cleanup only"))
474		default:
475			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("fast-forward into "+view.Base))
476		}
477		if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
478			label := plan.Confirmation.Prompt
479			if view.Unique > 0 {
480				label = fmt.Sprintf("Type %s to discard %d unique path(s)", plan.Confirmation.Token, view.Unique)
481			}
482			value, err := p.dangerLine(label)
483			if err != nil {
484				return false, "", err
485			}
486			return value == plan.Confirmation.Token, value, nil
487		}
488		confirmed, err := p.confirm("Proceed with this finish plan?", false)
489		return confirmed, "", err
490	}

492	func presentDoneApplyError(result flow.Result, err error) error {
493		for _, step := range result.FailedSteps() {
494			switch step.Effect.Code {
495			case flow.EffectCommitAll:
496				return fmt.Errorf("commit dirty checkout: %w", err)
497			case flow.EffectDiscardAll:
498				return fmt.Errorf("discard dirty checkout: %w", err)
499			}
500		}
501		if errors.Is(err, flow.ErrStalePlan) {
502			for _, step := range result.CompletedSteps() {
503				if step.Effect.Code == flow.EffectCommitAll || step.Effect.Code == flow.EffectDiscardAll {
504					return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again during finalization; stop the active writer and rerun dev done: %w", err)
505				}
506			}
507			return fmt.Errorf("checkout or branch changed while the finish plan was open; review the new state and rerun dev done: %w", err)
508		}
509		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "changed again after") {
510			return fmt.Errorf("checkout changed again during finalization; stop the active writer and rerun dev done: %w", err)
511		}
512		return err
513	}

515	func renderDoneSuccess(app *App, selected, final task.Task, plan flow.Plan, result flow.Result, initial donePlanView) error {
516		switch plan.Action {
517		case flow.ReviewHandoff:
518			if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneReviewReady {
519				return fmt.Errorf("review handoff completed without the review-ready milestone")
520			}
521			if final.State != selected.State {
522				return fmt.Errorf("review handoff changed task state from %s to %s", selected.State, final.State)
523			}
524			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nREADY FOR REVIEW · runtime and worktree kept")
525			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "After merge: dev done --merged --base-ref origin/"+doneView(plan).Base)
526			return nil
527		case flow.CompleteDirect, flow.CompleteFF, flow.VerifyMerged:
528			if result.Milestone != flow.MilestoneMerged || final.State != task.Done {
529				return fmt.Errorf("completion returned milestone %s and task state %s; want merged and DONE",
530					result.Milestone, final.State)
531			}
532		default:
533			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported completion result action %s", plan.Action)
534		}
535	
536		if plan.Action == flow.CompleteDirect {
537			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s completed directly on %s\n", task.Done.Icon(), final.Title(), final.Branch)
538			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   no branch or worktree was created or removed")
539			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · cleanup pending: run dev retire from outside this runtime")
540			return nil
541		}
542		view := doneView(plan)
543		if plan.Action == flow.CompleteFF && initial.contained() &&
544			!donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectRebaseBranch) && !donePlanHasEffect(plan, flow.EffectMergeFF) {
545			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   already merged  %s is contained in %s\n", final.Branch, view.Base)
546		}
547		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s merged into %s\n", task.Done.Icon(), final.Title(), view.Base)
548		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · runtime and worktree kept")
549		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   cleanup pending · run `dev retire %s` from outside its workspace\n", final.ID)
550		return nil
551	}

553	func doneView(plan flow.Plan) donePlanView {
554		fields := plan.AuthorityFields()
555		view := donePlanView{
556			Base:       fields["completion.base-ref"],
557			BaseOnly:   authorityInt(fields, "finish.base-only"),
558			BranchOnly: authorityInt(fields, "finish.branch-only"),
559			Equivalent: authorityInt(fields, "finish.equivalent-dirty"),
560			Unique:     authorityInt(fields, "finish.unique-dirty"),
561			Status: gitx.Status{
562				Branch: fields["git.branch"], Upstream: fields["git.upstream"],
563				Ahead: authorityInt(fields, "git.ahead"), Behind: authorityInt(fields, "git.behind"),
564				Changed: authorityIntFirst(fields, "finish.status-changed", "git.changed"),
565				Staged:  authorityIntFirst(fields, "finish.status-staged", "git.staged"),
566				Unstaged: authorityIntFirst(fields,
567					"finish.status-unstaged", "git.unstaged"),
568				Untracked: authorityIntFirst(fields,
569					"finish.status-untracked", "git.untracked"),
570				Conflicted: authorityIntFirst(fields,
571					"finish.status-conflicted", "git.conflicted"),
572			},
573		}
574		for index := 0; index < authorityInt(fields, "finish.change-count"); index++ {
575			prefix := fmt.Sprintf("finish.change.%d.", index)
576			view.Changes = append(view.Changes, doneChangeView{
577				Path: fields[prefix+"path"], BaseEquivalent: fields[prefix+"base-equivalent"] == "true",
578			})
579		}
580		return view
581	}
582	
583	func authorityInt(fields map[string]string, key string) int {
584		value, _ := strconv.Atoi(fields[key])
585		return value
586	}
587	
588	func authorityIntFirst(fields map[string]string, keys ...string) int {
589		for _, key := range keys {
590			if _, ok := fields[key]; ok {
591				return authorityInt(fields, key)
592			}
593		}
594		return 0
595	}
596	
597	func doneCondition(plan flow.Plan, code flow.ConditionCode) (flow.Condition, bool) {
598		for _, condition := range plan.Conditions() {
599			if condition.Code == code {
600				return condition, true
601			}
602		}
603		return flow.Condition{}, false
604	}
605	
606	func donePlanHasEffect(plan flow.Plan, code flow.EffectCode) bool {
607		for _, effect := range plan.Effects() {
608			if effect.Code == code {
609				return true
610			}
611		}
612		return false
613	}
614	
615	func doneEffectDetails(plan flow.Plan, code flow.EffectCode) map[string]string {
616		for _, effect := range plan.Effects() {
617			if effect.Code == code {
618				return effect.Details.Map()
619			}
620		}
621		return nil
622	}

13	// ReviewQuery identifies one exact head/base relationship in one repository.
14	// Repository is the forge's stable repository identity: owner/repository for
15	// GitHub, group/repository for GitLab, or organization/project/repository for
16	// Azure DevOps. Adapters must still verify the returned branches because CLI
17	// filters are not sufficient evidence on their own.
18	type ReviewQuery struct {
19		Repository string `json:"repository"`
20		Head       string `json:"head"`
21		Base       string `json:"base"`
22	}
23	
24	// ReviewState is the portable lifecycle state observed for a provider review.
25	type ReviewState string
26	
27	const (
28		ReviewOpen   ReviewState = "open"
29		ReviewDraft  ReviewState = "draft"
30		ReviewMerged ReviewState = "merged"
31		ReviewClosed ReviewState = "closed"
32	)
33	
34	// Valid reports whether s has defined portable review semantics.
35	func (s ReviewState) Valid() bool {
36		switch s {
37		case ReviewOpen, ReviewDraft, ReviewMerged, ReviewClosed:
38			return true
39		default:
40			return false
41		}
42	}
43	
44	// Review is the minimal provider evidence for an exact head/base relationship.
45	// ID is the provider-stable identity and Number is the repository-local human
46	// identifier. Head, Base, State and Draft are observations from the provider
47	// response rather than values copied from ReviewQuery.
48	type Review struct {
49		Provider   Kind        `json:"provider"`
50		Repository string      `json:"repository"`
51		ID         string      `json:"id"`
52		Number     int         `json:"number"`
53		State      ReviewState `json:"state"`
54		Draft      bool        `json:"draft"`
55		URL        string      `json:"url"`
56		Head       string      `json:"head"`
57		Base       string      `json:"base"`
58		ObservedAt time.Time   `json:"observed_at"`
59	}
60	
61	// ReviewQuerier is an optional forge capability. A nil Review and nil error is
62	// a successful observation that no exact review exists. One exact match returns
63	// provider evidence; multiple exact matches fail with AmbiguousReviewError.
64	type ReviewQuerier interface {
65		QueryReview(ctx context.Context, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error)
66	}
67	
68	var (
69		// ErrAmbiguousReview identifies a query with multiple exact head/base
70		// matches. Callers must not select one by recency or provider ordering.
71		ErrAmbiguousReview = errors.New("multiple reviews match")
72		// ErrMalformedReviewResponse identifies provider JSON that cannot supply the
73		// critical portable fields without guessing.
74		ErrMalformedReviewResponse = errors.New("malformed review response")
75	)
76	
77	// AmbiguousReviewError carries every exact match while keeping Error text free
78	// of provider response values such as private URLs and branch names.
79	type AmbiguousReviewError struct {
80		Provider Kind
81		Query    ReviewQuery
82		Matches  []Review
83	}
84	
85	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Error() string {
86		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review query returned %d exact matches", e.Provider, len(e.Matches))
87	}
88	
89	func (e *AmbiguousReviewError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguousReview }
90	
91	// MalformedReviewResponseError identifies the unusable response field without
92	// embedding its value or the response body. Index is zero-based and is -1 when
93	// the whole JSON document is malformed. Err retains safe decoder diagnostics.
94	type MalformedReviewResponseError struct {
95		Provider Kind
96		Index    int
97		Field    string
98		Err      error
99	}
100	
101	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Error() string {
102		location := "response"
103		if e.Index >= 0 {
104			location = fmt.Sprintf("response item %d", e.Index+1)
105		}
106		detail := "missing or invalid " + e.Field
107		if e.Err != nil {
108			detail = e.Err.Error()
109		}
110		return fmt.Sprintf("%s review %s is malformed: %s", e.Provider, location, detail)
111	}
112	
113	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
114	
115	func (e *MalformedReviewResponseError) Is(target error) bool {
116		return target == ErrMalformedReviewResponse
117	}
118	
119	// QueryReview invokes the optional capability without widening Forge. It never
120	// caches or initiates a query unless a caller explicitly calls this function.
121	func QueryReview(ctx context.Context, f Forge, dir string, query ReviewQuery) (*Review, error) {
122		querier, ok := f.(ReviewQuerier)
123		if !ok {
124			return nil, &ErrUnsupported{Kind: f.Kind(), Operation: "review queries"}
125		}
126		return querier.QueryReview(ctx, dir, query)
127	}
128	
129	type reviewCandidate struct {
130		ID                      string
131		Number                  int
132		State                   string
133		Draft                   *bool
134		URL                     string
135		Head                    string
136		Base                    string
137		SourceMatchesRepository *bool
138	}
139	
140	type reviewStateNormalizer func(state string, draft bool) (ReviewState, error)
141	
142	func validateReviewQuery(query ReviewQuery) error {
143		switch {
144		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Repository) == "":
145			return errors.New("review query repository is required")
146		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Head) == "":
147			return errors.New("review query head is required")
148		case strings.TrimSpace(query.Base) == "":
149			return errors.New("review query base is required")
150		default:
151			return nil
152		}
153	}
154	
155	func decodeReviewJSON(provider Kind, out string, target any) error {
156		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(out)
157		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "null" {
158			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON array", nil)
159		}
160		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), target); err != nil {
161			return malformedReviewResponse(provider, -1, "JSON", err)
162		}
163		return nil
164	}
165	
166	func selectExactReview(provider Kind, query ReviewQuery, candidates []reviewCandidate, normalize reviewStateNormalizer) (*Review, error) {
167		matches := make([]Review, 0, 1)
168		observedAt := time.Now().UTC()
169		for index, candidate := range candidates {
170			if candidate.Head == "" {
171				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "head branch", nil)
172			}
173			if candidate.Base == "" {
174				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "base branch", nil)
175			}
176			if candidate.Head != query.Head || candidate.Base != query.Base {
177				continue
178			}
179			if candidate.SourceMatchesRepository == nil {
180				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "source repository identity", nil)
181			}
182			if !*candidate.SourceMatchesRepository {
183				continue
184			}
185			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate.ID) == "" {
186				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "identifier", nil)
187			}
188			if candidate.Number <= 0 {
189				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "number", nil)
190			}
191			if candidate.Draft == nil {
192				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "draft flag", nil)
193			}
194			if !validReviewURL(candidate.URL) {
195				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "URL", nil)
196			}
197			state, err := normalize(candidate.State, *candidate.Draft)
198			if err != nil {
199				return nil, malformedReviewResponse(provider, index, "state", err)
200			}
201			matches = append(matches, Review{
202				Provider: provider, Repository: query.Repository,
203				ID: candidate.ID, Number: candidate.Number,
204				State: state, Draft: *candidate.Draft, URL: candidate.URL,
205				Head: candidate.Head, Base: candidate.Base, ObservedAt: observedAt,
206			})
207		}
208	
209		switch len(matches) {
210		case 0:
211			return nil, nil
212		case 1:
213			return &matches[0], nil
214		default:
215			return nil, &AmbiguousReviewError{
216				Provider: provider, Query: query,
217				Matches: append([]Review(nil), matches...),
218			}
219		}
220	}
221	
222	func malformedReviewResponse(provider Kind, index int, field string, err error) error {
223		return &MalformedReviewResponseError{Provider: provider, Index: index, Field: field, Err: err}
224	}
225	
226	func validReviewURL(raw string) bool {
227		parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
228		if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" {
229			return false
230		}
231		return parsed.Scheme == "https" || parsed.Scheme == "http"
232	}
