444			}
445			if _, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
446				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
447			}
448			pathKeys[candidate.Path] = entry.row.RepoKey
449		}
450	
451		pathResults := make(map[string]struct {
452			repository flowRepository
453			err        error
454		})
455		for _, record := range records {
456			path := record.Task.RepoPath
457			resolved, seen := pathResults[path]
458			if !seen {
459				gitRepo, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, path)
460				if discoverErr == nil {
461					resolved.repository, discoverErr = availableFlowRepository(gitRepo, nil, "")
462				}
463				resolved.err = discoverErr
464				pathResults[path] = resolved
465			}
466			if resolved.err == nil {
467				if _, exists := fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey]; !exists {
468					fresh[resolved.repository.row.RepoKey] = resolved.repository
469				}
470				pathKeys[path] = resolved.repository.row.RepoKey
471				continue
472			}
473			entry := unavailableFlowRepository(record, resolved.err)
474			if existing, exists := fresh[entry.row.RepoKey]; exists {
475				existing.unavailableTasks = appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(existing.unavailableTasks, record)
476				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = existing
477			} else {
478				fresh[entry.row.RepoKey] = entry
479			}
480		}
481	
482		rows := make([]flowtui.RepositoryRow, 0, len(fresh))
483		for _, entry := range fresh {
484			rows = append(rows, entry.row)
485		}
486		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
487			left, right := strings.ToLower(rows[i].Name), strings.ToLower(rows[j].Name)
488			if left != right {
489				return left < right
490			}
491			if rows[i].Path != rows[j].Path {
492				return rows[i].Path < rows[j].Path
493			}
494			return rows[i].RepoKey < rows[j].RepoKey
495		})
496		l.mu.Lock()
497		l.repositories = fresh
498		l.repoPathKeys = pathKeys
499		l.mu.Unlock()
500		return rows, nil
501	}

503	func appendUniqueFlowTaskRecord(records []task.Record, candidate task.Record) []task.Record {
504		for _, record := range records {
505			if record.Task.ID == candidate.Task.ID {
506				return records
507			}
508		}
509		return append(records, candidate)
510	}

512	func (l *flowLoader) LoadRepository(ctx context.Context, repoKey string) (flowtui.Snapshot, error) {
513		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
514			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
515		}
516		l.mu.Lock()
517		selected, ok := l.repositories[repoKey]
518		pathKeys := make(map[string]string, len(l.repoPathKeys))
519		for path, key := range l.repoPathKeys {
520			pathKeys[path] = key
521		}
522		l.mu.Unlock()
523		if !ok {
524			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is not in the current flow inventory", repoKey)
525		}
526		if !selected.available {
527			return l.unavailableSnapshot(selected), nil
528		}
529	
530		records, diagnostics, taskErr := l.app.Tasks.ListRecords()
531		selectedTasks := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(records))
532		selectedRecords := make(map[string]task.Record)
533		type pathResult struct {
534			repoKey string
535			err     error
536		}
537		resolvedPaths := make(map[string]pathResult)
538		for index := range records {
539			record := records[index]
540			path := record.Task.RepoPath
541			key, cached := pathKeys[path]
542			if !cached {
543				resolved, seen := resolvedPaths[path]
544				if !seen {
545					repository, discoverErr := l.discover(ctx, path)
546					if discoverErr == nil {
547						resolved.repoKey, discoverErr = pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
548					}
549					resolved.err = discoverErr
550					resolvedPaths[path] = resolved
551				}
552				if resolved.err != nil {
553					continue
554				}
555				key = resolved.repoKey
556			}
557			if key != repoKey {
558				continue
559			}
560			copy := record.Task
561			copy.Tags = append([]string(nil), record.Task.Tags...)
562			selectedTasks = append(selectedTasks, &copy)
563			record.Task = copy
564			selectedRecords[record.Task.ID] = record
565		}
566	
567		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
568		if err != nil {
569			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
570		}
571		if rt == nil {
572			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, errors.New("flow runtime resolver returned no backend")
573		}
574		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
575		runtimeObserved := runtimeErr == nil && rt.Name() != "none"
576		contextSnapshot := inventory.CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, selected.repository, selectedTasks, inventory.RepoContextOptions{
577			Runtime: rt.Name(), Sessions: sessions, RuntimeObserved: runtimeObserved,
578			RuntimeErr: runtimeErr, Limiter: l.limiter,
579		})
580		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
581			return flowtui.Snapshot{}, err
582		}
583	
584		base := ""
585		if queryPath := flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot); queryPath != "" {
586			base = l.base(ctx, queryPath)
587		}
588		taskComplete := taskErr == nil && len(diagnostics) == 0
589		locatorBuilder := newFlowManagedLocatorBuilder(l.gitRun, contextSnapshot, selectedRecords)
590		rows, targets, projectionIssues := l.projectRows(ctx, contextSnapshot, locatorBuilder, taskComplete, base)
591	
592		issues := make([]string, 0, 8)
593		if taskErr != nil {
594			issues = append(issues, "task inventory: "+taskErr.Error())
595		}
596		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
597			issues = append(issues, "task diagnostic: "+diagnostic.Error())
598		}
599		if contextSnapshot.IdentityErr != nil {
600			issues = append(issues, "repository identity: "+contextSnapshot.IdentityErr.Error())
601		}
602		if contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr != nil {
603			issues = append(issues, "worktree inventory: "+contextSnapshot.WorktreeErr.Error())
604		}
605		if rt.Name() != "none" && runtimeErr != nil {
606			issues = append(issues, "runtime observation: "+runtimeErr.Error())
607		}
608		for _, checkout := range contextSnapshot.Checkouts {
609			if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
610				issues = append(issues, "Git status "+checkout.Worktree.Path+": "+checkout.StatusErr.Error())
611			}
612		}
613		issues = append(issues, projectionIssues...)
614		issues = uniqueStrings(issues)
615	
616		freshness := flowtui.FreshnessFresh
617		if len(issues) > 0 {
618			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
619		}
620		repositoryRow := selected.row
621		repositoryRow.Available = contextSnapshot.RepositoryID == repoKey && contextSnapshot.IdentityErr == nil
622		if contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != "" && contextSnapshot.RepositoryID != repoKey {
623			issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("repository identity changed from %s to %s", repoKey, contextSnapshot.RepositoryID))
624			repositoryRow.Available = false
625			freshness = flowtui.FreshnessStale
626		}
627		snapshot := flowtui.Snapshot{
628			Repository: repositoryRow,
629			Surfaces:   flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
630			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(),
631			Freshness:  freshness,
632			Error:      strings.Join(uniqueStrings(issues), "; "),
633		}
634		l.mu.Lock()
635		l.targets[repoKey] = targets
636		if remote, exists := l.remote[repoKey]; exists {
637			snapshot.Remote = flowtui.SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
638		}
639		l.mu.Unlock()
640		return snapshot, nil
641	}

643	func (l *flowLoader) unavailableSnapshot(selected flowRepository) flowtui.Snapshot {
644		rows := make([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, 0, len(selected.unavailableTasks))
645		for _, record := range selected.unavailableTasks {
646			tracked := record.Task
647			rows = append(rows, flowtui.SurfaceRow{
648				RowKey: tracked.ID, Kind: flowtui.SurfaceTaskOnly,
649				Label: tracked.Title(), Branch: tracked.Branch, Base: tracked.Base,
650				Mode: tracked.EffectiveMode(), State: tracked.State,
651				Drift: flowtui.NewLines("repository-unavailable: " + selected.row.Error),
652				Evidence: flowtui.NewLines(
653					"recorded repository path: "+tracked.RepoPath,
654					fmt.Sprintf("task: %s mode=%s state=%s", tracked.ID, tracked.EffectiveMode(), tracked.State),
655				),
656			})
657		}
658		l.mu.Lock()
659		l.targets[selected.row.RepoKey] = map[string]flowTarget{}
660		l.mu.Unlock()
661		return flowtui.Snapshot{
662			Repository: selected.row, Surfaces: flowtui.NewSurfaceList(rows...),
663			ObservedAt: l.now().UTC(), Freshness: flowtui.FreshnessStale,
664			Error: selected.row.Error,
665		}
666	}

668	func flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext) string {
669		if main, ok := contextSnapshot.Main(); ok && main.Worktree.Path != "" {
670			return main.Worktree.Path
671		}
672		for _, candidate := range []string{
673			contextSnapshot.Repo.MainRoot,
674			contextSnapshot.Repo.Path,
675			contextSnapshot.Repo.RealPath,
676			contextSnapshot.Repo.CommonDir,
677		} {
678			if candidate != "" {
679				return candidate
680			}
681		}
682		return ""
683	}

690	type flowManagedLocatorBuilder struct {
691		run       func(context.Context, string, ...string) (string, error)
692		repoPath  string
693		repoKey   string
694		records   map[string]task.Record
695		refs      map[string]flowLocatorValue

699	func newFlowManagedLocatorBuilder(
700		run func(context.Context, string, ...string) (string, error),
701		contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext,
702		records map[string]task.Record,
703	) *flowManagedLocatorBuilder {
704		return &flowManagedLocatorBuilder{
705			run: run, repoPath: flowRepositoryQueryPath(contextSnapshot), repoKey: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID,
706			records: records, refs: make(map[string]flowLocatorValue), upstreams: make(map[string]flowLocatorValue),
707		}

710	func (b *flowManagedLocatorBuilder) locate(ctx context.Context, row inventory.RepoContextRow, taskID string) (taskflow.Locator, error) {
711		record, ok := b.records[taskID]
712		if !ok {
713			return taskflow.Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("task %s is absent from the loaded revision snapshot", taskID)
714		}
715		candidate := record.Task
716		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
717		locator := taskflow.Locator{
718			RepoKey: b.repoKey, RowKey: taskID, RowKind: "task",
719			RepositoryID: b.repoKey, GitCommonDir: b.repoKey,
720			TaskID: taskID, TaskRevision: record.Revision,
721			RepoPath: b.repoPath, Branch: candidate.Branch, Base: candidate.Base, Remote: "origin",
722			Mode: mode, State: candidate.State,
723		}
724		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
725			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
726				expected, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate.WorktreePath)
727				if err != nil {
728					return taskflow.Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize task %s checkout: %w", taskID, err)
729				}
730				locator.CheckoutPath = expected
731			}
732		} else {
733			locator.CheckoutPath = b.repoPath
734		}
735		if row.Checkout != nil {
736			locator.RowKey, locator.RowKind = row.Checkout.ID, "checkout"
737			locator.CheckoutPath = row.Checkout.ID
738			locator.HeadOID = strings.TrimSpace(row.Checkout.Worktree.Head)
739			if row.Checkout.StatusErr == nil {
740				locator.Upstream = row.Checkout.Status.Upstream
741			}
742		}
743		if locator.HeadOID == "" {
744			locator.HeadOID, _ = b.refOID(ctx, "refs/heads/"+candidate.Branch)
745		}
746		if locator.Upstream == "" && (row.Checkout == nil || mode == task.ModeWorktree) {
747			locator.Upstream, _ = b.branchUpstream(ctx, candidate.Branch)
748		}
749		locator.BaseOID, _ = b.refOID(ctx, candidate.Base)
750		locator.UpstreamOID, _ = b.refOID(ctx, locator.Upstream)
751		return locator, nil
752	}
753	
754	func (b *flowManagedLocatorBuilder) refOID(ctx context.Context, ref string) (string, error) {
755		if ref == "" {
756			return "", nil
757		}
758		if cached, ok := b.refs[ref]; ok {
759			return cached.value, cached.err
760		}
761		value, err := b.run(ctx, b.repoPath, "rev-parse", "--verify", ref+"^{commit}")
762		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
763		b.refs[ref] = flowLocatorValue{value: value, err: err}
764		return value, err
765	}
766	
767	func (b *flowManagedLocatorBuilder) branchUpstream(ctx context.Context, branch string) (string, error) {
768		if branch == "" {
769			return "", nil
770		}
771		if cached, ok := b.upstreams[branch]; ok {
772			return cached.value, cached.err
773		}
774		value, err := b.run(ctx, b.repoPath, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(upstream:short)", "refs/heads/"+branch)
775		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
776		b.upstreams[branch] = flowLocatorValue{value: value, err: err}
777		return value, err
778	}

780	func (l *flowLoader) projectRows(
781		ctx context.Context,
782		contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext,
783		locatorBuilder *flowManagedLocatorBuilder,
784		taskInventoryComplete bool,
785		defaultBase string,
786	) ([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, map[string]flowTarget, []string) {
787		rows := make([]flowtui.SurfaceRow, 0, len(contextSnapshot.Rows))
788		targets := make(map[string]flowTarget)
789		var issues []string
790		for _, contextRow := range contextSnapshot.Rows {
791			projected, rowIssues := l.projectRow(ctx, contextSnapshot, contextRow, locatorBuilder, taskInventoryComplete, defaultBase)
792			issues = append(issues, rowIssues...)
793	
794			validChoices := make([]flowtui.ActionChoice, 0, projected.Actions.Len())
795			for _, choice := range projected.Actions.Values() {
796				request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(projected.Locator, choice.Options())
797				if err != nil {
798					issues = append(issues, fmt.Sprintf("row %s action %s: %v", projected.RowKey, choice.ID, err))
799					continue
800				}
801				target := flowTarget{
802					repoKey: contextSnapshot.RepositoryID, rowKey: projected.RowKey,
803					actionID: choice.ID, request: request,
804				}
805				targets[flowTargetKey(target.repoKey, target.rowKey, target.actionID)] = target
806				validChoices = append(validChoices, choice)
807			}
808			projected.Actions = flowtui.NewActionList(validChoices...)
809			rows = append(rows, projected)
810		}
811		return rows, targets, issues
812	}

915	func validateProjectedManagedLocator(contextSnapshot inventory.RepoContext, row inventory.RepoContextRow, tracked *task.Task, locator taskflow.Locator) error {
916		if locator.RepoKey != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID || locator.RepositoryID != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID ||
917			locator.GitCommonDir != contextSnapshot.RepositoryID {
918			return errors.New("locator repository identity differs from inventory")
919		}
920		if locator.TaskID != tracked.ID || locator.Mode != tracked.EffectiveMode() || locator.State != tracked.State {
921			return errors.New("locator task identity, mode, or state differs from inventory")
922		}
923		if row.Checkout != nil && locator.CheckoutPath != row.Checkout.ID {

929	func classifyFlowCheckout(checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, tracked *task.Task, managedExact bool, conflicts []string) flowtui.SurfaceKind {
930		switch {
931		case checkout.Worktree.Main:
932			return flowtui.SurfaceCanonical
933		case len(conflicts) > 0:
934			return flowtui.SurfaceConflict
935		case checkout.HarnessEvidence != nil:
936			return flowtui.SurfaceHarness
937		case tracked != nil && managedExact:
938			return flowtui.SurfaceManaged
939		default:
940			return flowtui.SurfaceUnmanaged
941		}
942	}

944	func flowCheckoutLabel(checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, tracked *task.Task, kind flowtui.SurfaceKind) string {
945		branch := checkout.Branch()
946		if branch == "" {
947			branch = "detached HEAD"
948		}
949		if tracked != nil {
950			return tracked.Title() + " · " + branch
951		}
952		switch kind {
953		case flowtui.SurfaceCanonical:
954			return "Main · " + branch
955		case flowtui.SurfaceHarness:
956			return "Harness · " + branch
957		case flowtui.SurfaceConflict:
958			return "Conflict · " + branch
959		default:
960			return branch
961		}
962	}

1186	func (l *flowLoader) Plan(
1187		ctx context.Context,
1188		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1189		locator taskflow.Locator,
1190		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1191	) (taskflow.Plan, error) {
1192		expected, request, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1193		if err != nil {
1194			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1195		}
1196		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1197		if err != nil {
1198			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1199		}
1200		service, err := l.service(rt)
1201		if err != nil {
1202			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1203		}
1204		plan, err := service.Plan(ctx, request)
1205		if err != nil {
1206			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1207		}
1208		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1209			return taskflow.Plan{}, err
1210		}
1211		l.mu.Lock()
1212		l.approved[plan.PlanID] = flowApprovedPlan{target: expected, plan: plan.Clone()}
1213		l.mu.Unlock()
1214		return plan, nil
1215	}

1217	func (l *flowLoader) Apply(
1218		ctx context.Context,
1219		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1220		locator taskflow.Locator,
1221		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1222		plan taskflow.Plan,
1223		approval taskflow.Approval,
1224	) (taskflow.Result, error) {
1225		expected, _, err := l.validateTarget(repoKey, rowKey, actionID, locator, options)
1226		if err != nil {
1227			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1228		}
1229		l.mu.Lock()
1230		approved, ok := l.approved[plan.PlanID]
1231		l.mu.Unlock()
1232		if !ok {
1233			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply rejected a plan not produced by this run")
1234		}
1235		if !sameFlowTarget(approved.target, expected) {
1236			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply target differs from the approved repository, row, action, locator, or options")
1237		}
1238		if !reflect.DeepEqual(approved.plan.Clone(), plan.Clone()) {
1239			return taskflow.Result{}, errors.New("flow apply plan differs from the exact approved plan")
1240		}
1241		if err := validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan, expected); err != nil {
1242			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1243		}
1244		rt, err := l.runtime.Resolve(ctx)
1245		if err != nil {
1246			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1247		}
1248		service, err := l.service(rt)
1249		if err != nil {
1250			return taskflow.Result{}, err
1251		}
1252		result, applyErr := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
1253		l.mu.Lock()
1254		delete(l.approved, plan.PlanID)
1255		if remote, exists := result.RemoteObservation(); exists {
1256			l.remote[repoKey] = remote.Clone()
1257		}
1258		l.mu.Unlock()
1259		return result, applyErr
1260	}

1262	func (l *flowLoader) validateTarget(
1263		repoKey, rowKey, actionID string,
1264		locator taskflow.Locator,
1265		options taskflow.ActionOptions,
1266	) (flowTarget, taskflow.Request, error) {
1267		request, err := taskflow.NewRequest(locator, options)
1268		if err != nil {
1269			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, err
1270		}
1271		key := flowTargetKey(repoKey, rowKey, actionID)
1272		l.mu.Lock()
1273		expected, ok := l.targets[repoKey][key]
1274		l.mu.Unlock()
1275		if !ok {
1276			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action no longer matches the current repository snapshot")
1277		}
1278		actual := flowTarget{repoKey: repoKey, rowKey: rowKey, actionID: actionID, request: request}
1279		if !sameFlowTarget(expected, actual) {
1280			return flowTarget{}, taskflow.Request{}, errors.New("flow action locator or options differ from the current exact row choice")
1281		}
1282		return expected, request, nil
1283	}

1285	func validateFlowPlanIdentity(plan taskflow.Plan, expected flowTarget) error {

1290			plan.Action != expected.request.Action || plan.Request.Action != expected.request.Action ||
1291			!reflect.DeepEqual(plan.Request.Options, expected.request.Options) {
1292			return errors.New("taskflow plan does not match the exact flow request identity")
1293		}

1297	func sameFlowTarget(left, right flowTarget) bool {
1298		return left.repoKey == right.repoKey && left.rowKey == right.rowKey && left.actionID == right.actionID &&
1299			left.request.Locator == right.request.Locator && left.request.Action == right.request.Action &&
1300			reflect.DeepEqual(left.request.Options, right.request.Options)
1301	}

1321	func uniqueStrings(values []string) []string {

1325			if value == "" || seen[value] {
1326				continue
1327			}

13	// locateExactTask builds a managed locator from one exact task record and a
14	// fresh view of its repository. Missing checkout evidence is retained as an
15	// expected path (or an intentionally empty COLD path) so Plan can explain the
16	// drift instead of losing the task before transition validation.
17	func (s *lifecycleService) locateExactTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (Locator, error) {
18		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
19			return Locator{}, err
20		}
21		if !exactTaskID.MatchString(taskID) || filepath.Base(taskID) != taskID || taskID == "." || taskID == ".." {
22			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid exact TaskID %q", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID)
23		}
24	
25		record, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)
26		if err != nil {
27			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: load exact task %q: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
28		}
29		candidate := record.Task
30		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
31			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q is invalid: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
32		}
33		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
34		if !validMode(mode) || !validState(candidate.State) {
35			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: exact task %q has invalid mode or state", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID)
36		}
37	
38		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: discover exact repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
41		}
42		repoPath, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
43		if err != nil {
44			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize main checkout for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
45		}
46		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize Git common directory for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
49		}
50		recordedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
51		if err != nil {
52			return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize recorded repository for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
53		}
54		if recordedRepo != repoPath {
55			return Locator{}, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
56				"recorded repository %q resolves to %q, but Git reports main checkout %q",
57				candidate.RepoPath, recordedRepo, repoPath,
58			)}
59		}
60	
61		expectedCheckout := repoPath
62		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
63			expectedCheckout = ""
64			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
65				expectedCheckout, err = s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
66				if err != nil {
67					return Locator{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize expected checkout for task %s: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, taskID, err)
68				}
69			}
70		}
71	
72		locator := Locator{
73			RepoKey:      commonDir,
74			RowKey:       taskID,
75			RowKind:      "task",
76			RepositoryID: commonDir,
77			GitCommonDir: commonDir,
78			TaskID:       taskID,
79			TaskRevision: record.Revision,
80			RepoPath:     repoPath,
81			CheckoutPath: expectedCheckout,
82			Branch:       candidate.Branch,
83			Base:         candidate.Base,
84			Remote:       "origin",
85			Mode:         mode,
86			State:        candidate.State,
87		}
88	
89		registered, found := s.locateRegisteredCheckout(ctx, candidate, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
90		if found {
91			locator.RowKey = registered.Path
92			locator.RowKind = "checkout"
93			locator.HeadOID = strings.TrimSpace(registered.Worktree.Head)
94			if status, statusErr := s.gitStatus(ctx, registered.Path); statusErr == nil {
95				locator.Upstream = status.Upstream
96				if head, headErr := s.resolveRefOID(ctx, registered.Path, "HEAD"); headErr == nil {
97					locator.HeadOID = head
98				}
99			}
100		}
101		if locator.HeadOID == "" {
102			locator.HeadOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, localBranchRef(candidate.Branch))
103		}
104		if locator.Upstream == "" && (!found || mode == task.ModeWorktree) {
105			locator.Upstream = s.branchUpstream(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Branch)
106		}
107		locator.BaseOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, candidate.Base)
108		locator.UpstreamOID, _ = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, repoPath, locator.Upstream)
109	
110		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(taskID)
111		if err != nil {
112			return Locator{}, &StalePlanError{
113				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: record.Revision,
114				Reason:                       "task record disappeared while locating",
115			}
116		}
117		if current.Revision != record.Revision {
118			return Locator{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, current.Revision, "task record changed while locating")
119		}
120		return locator, nil
121	}

123	func (s *lifecycleService) locateRegisteredCheckout(
124		ctx context.Context,
125		candidate task.Task,
126		repoPath string,
127		expectedCheckout string,
128	) (gitx.RegisteredWorktree, bool) {
129		if expectedCheckout != "" {
130			registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, expectedCheckout)
131			return registered, err == nil
132		}
133		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree || candidate.State != task.Cold {
134			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
135		}
136	
137		worktrees, err := s.gitWorktrees(ctx, repoPath)
138		if err != nil {
139			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
140		}
141		match := ""
142		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
143			if worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch {
144				continue
145			}
146			if match != "" {
147				return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
148			}
149			match = worktree.Path
150		}
151		if match == "" {
152			return gitx.RegisteredWorktree{}, false
153		}
154		registered, err := s.resolveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, match)
155		return registered, err == nil
156	}
157	
158	func (s *lifecycleService) branchUpstream(ctx context.Context, repoPath, branch string) string {
159		if branch == "" {
160			return ""
161		}
162		value, err := s.gitRun(ctx, repoPath,
163			"for-each-ref", "--format=%(upstream:short)", localBranchRef(branch),
164		)
165		if err != nil {
166			return ""
167		}
168		return strings.TrimSpace(value)
169	}

234		m.listRequest.loading = false

255	func nearestRepositoryIndex(rows []RepositoryRow, repoKey string, oldIndex int) int {
256		if repoKey != "" {
257			for index, row := range rows {
258				if row.RepoKey == repoKey {
259					return index
260				}
261			}
262		}
263		if len(rows) == 0 {
264			return 0
265		}
266		if oldIndex < 0 {
267			return 0
268		}
269		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
270			return len(rows) - 1
271		}
272		return oldIndex
273	}

275	func (m Model) acceptRepositoryLoad(message repositoryLoadMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
276		if message.generation != m.loadRequest.generation ||
277			message.repoKey != m.loadRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.repository.RepoKey {
278			return m, nil
279		}
280		if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
281			m.loadRequest.cancel()
282		}
283		m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
284		m.loadRequest.loading = false
285	
286		if message.err == nil && message.snapshot.Repository.RepoKey != message.repoKey {
287			message.err = fmt.Errorf(
288				"loaded snapshot repository key %q does not match requested key %q",
289				message.snapshot.Repository.RepoKey, message.repoKey,
290			)
291		}
292		if message.err != nil {
293			m.loadRequest.err = message.err
294			m.loadRequest.stale = m.hasSnapshot
295			if m.hasSnapshot {
296				m.snapshot.Freshness = FreshnessStale
297			}
298			m.status = ""
299			return m, nil
300		}
301	
302		oldRow, hadOldRow := m.currentSurface()
303		oldIndex := m.rowCursor
304		oldActionID := ""
305		if choice, ok := m.currentAction(); ok {
306			oldActionID = choice.ID
307		}
308	
309		accepted := message.snapshot.Clone()
310		if accepted.Freshness == "" {
311			accepted.Freshness = FreshnessFresh
312		}
313		m.snapshot = accepted
314		m.hasSnapshot = true
315		m.loadRequest.err = nil
316		m.loadRequest.stale = accepted.Freshness != FreshnessFresh || accepted.Error != ""
317		m.repository = accepted.Repository
318		if remote, ok := accepted.Remote.RemoteObservation(); ok {
319			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
320		}
321	
322		rows := accepted.Surfaces.Values()
323		m.rowCursor = retainedSurfaceIndex(rows, oldRow, hadOldRow, oldIndex, m.desiredFocus)
324		m.desiredFocus = ""
325		m.actionCursor = retainedActionIndex(rows, m.rowCursor, oldActionID)
326		m.clampActionCursor()
327		m.status = ""
328		return m, nil
329	}
330	
331	func retainedSurfaceIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, previous SurfaceRow, hadPrevious bool, oldIndex int, focus string) int {
332		if len(rows) == 0 {
333			return 0
334		}
335		if hadPrevious {
336			for index, row := range rows {
337				if row.RowKey == previous.RowKey {
338					return index
339				}
340			}
341			if previous.Locator.TaskID != "" {
342				for index, row := range rows {
343					if row.Locator.TaskID == previous.Locator.TaskID {
344						return index
345					}
346				}
347			}
348			for index, row := range rows {
349				if locatorsReferToSameSurface(previous.Locator, row.Locator) {
350					return index
351				}
352			}
353		}
354		if focus != "" {
355			for index, row := range rows {
356				if row.RowKey == focus || row.Locator.RowKey == focus {
357					return index
358				}
359			}
360			for index, row := range rows {
361				if row.Locator.TaskID == focus {
362					return index
363				}
364			}
365			for index, row := range rows {
366				if row.Locator.CheckoutPath == focus {
367					return index
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		if oldIndex < 0 {
372			return 0
373		}
374		if oldIndex >= len(rows) {
375			return len(rows) - 1
376		}
377		return oldIndex
378	}
379	
380	func retainedActionIndex(rows []SurfaceRow, rowIndex int, actionID string) int {
381		if actionID == "" || rowIndex < 0 || rowIndex >= len(rows) {
382			return 0
383		}
384		for index, action := range rows[rowIndex].Actions.Values() {
385			if action.ID == actionID {
386				return index
387			}
388		}
389		return 0
390	}
391	
392	func locatorsReferToSameSurface(left, right taskflow.Locator) bool {
393		if left.RepositoryID != "" && right.RepositoryID != "" && left.RepositoryID != right.RepositoryID {
394			return false
395		}
396		if left.CheckoutPath != "" && right.CheckoutPath != "" {
397			return left.CheckoutPath == right.CheckoutPath
398		}
399		if left.TaskID != "" && right.TaskID != "" {
400			return left.TaskID == right.TaskID
401		}
402		return left.RepoKey != "" && left.RepoKey == right.RepoKey &&
403			left.Branch != "" && left.Branch == right.Branch && left.Base == right.Base
404	}

406	func (m Model) acceptPlan(message planMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
407		if message.generation != m.planRequest.generation ||
408			message.repoKey != m.planRequest.repoKey || message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey ||
409			message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey || message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
410			return m, nil
411		}
412		if m.planRequest.cancel != nil {
413			m.planRequest.cancel()
414		}
415		m.planRequest.cancel = nil
416		m.planRequest.loading = false
417		m.planRequest.err = message.err
418		m.overlay = overlayPlan
419		m.status = ""
420	
421		if message.plan.PlanID != "" {
422			m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
423			m.hasPlan = true
424		}
425		if message.err != nil {
426			m.planErr = message.err
427			return m, nil
428		}
429		if err := message.plan.Validate(); err != nil {
430			m.planErr = combineError("invalid plan returned by callback", err)
431			return m, nil
432		}
433		if message.plan.Locator != m.planTarget.locator {
434			m.planErr = errors.New("plan locator does not match the exact selected surface")
435			return m, nil
436		}
437		if message.plan.Action != m.planTarget.choice.Action() {
438			m.planErr = errors.New("plan action does not match the exact selected action options")
439			return m, nil
440		}
441		expected, err := taskflow.NewRequest(m.planTarget.locator, m.planTarget.choice.Options())
442		if err != nil {
443			m.planErr = combineError("selected action options are invalid", err)
444			return m, nil
445		}
446		if !reflect.DeepEqual(message.plan.Request.Options, expected.Options) {
447			m.planErr = errors.New("plan was built with different concrete action options than the selected choice")
448			return m, nil
449		}
450		m.plan = message.plan.Clone()
451		m.hasPlan = true
452		m.planErr = nil
453		if m.plan.Availability == taskflow.AvailabilityReady && m.plan.Confirmation.Kind == taskflow.ConfirmationTyped {
454			m.confirm.SetValue("")
455			m.confirm.CursorEnd()
456			return m, m.confirm.Focus()
457		}
458		return m, nil
459	}
460	
461	func (m Model) acceptApply(message applyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
462		if !m.applyRunning || message.generation != m.applyGeneration ||
463			message.repoKey != m.planTarget.repoKey || message.rowKey != m.planTarget.rowKey ||
464			message.actionID != m.planTarget.actionID {
465			return m, nil
466		}
467		m.applyRunning = false
468		m.overlay = overlayResult
469		m.lastResult = message.result.Clone()
470		m.hasLastResult = true
471		m.lastResultErr = message.err
472		m.status = ""
473		if remote, ok := message.result.RemoteObservation(); ok {
474			m.remote = SomeRemoteObservation(remote)
475		}
476		if message.err == nil {
477			if handoff, ok := message.result.Handoff(); ok {
478				m.finalHandoff = handoff
479				m.hasHandoff = true
480			}
481		}
482	
483		queuedQuit := m.queuedQuit
484		m.queuedQuit, m.queuedRefresh = false, false
485		updated, command := m.beginRepositoryLoad(false)
486		m = updated.(Model)
487		if queuedQuit {
488			// The fresh generation is established before honoring the queued quit. It
489			// cannot authorize anything and the mutation ledger remains in final Model.
490			if m.loadRequest.cancel != nil {
491				m.loadRequest.cancel()
492				m.loadRequest.cancel = nil
493			}
494			m.quitting = true
495			return m, tea.Quit
496		}
497		return m, command
498	}

205	// Clone returns a snapshot with independent surface/action storage.
206	func (s Snapshot) Clone() Snapshot {
